title: Authority Commander (Enemy)
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |image1=New auth commander.png |health=5000 |moves=*Flame Repulsion *Fire Blade *Flame Assault *Strong Left|drops=*[[Fur Parka]] *[[Shipping Schedule]] *[[Frigid Prism]]|caption1=I'll kidnap a thousand Gremors before I let this prison die!|weapon=*[[Adretian Axe]] *[[Officer Saber]]|title1=Authority Commander}} ==Description== Authority Commanders are high-ranking members of The Central Authority. The rank of "Commander" fits them very well, they have the combat skills of an experienced player and a huge health pool, making them a true challenge. At least '''ONE''' Commander is located within the prison of [[Fort Merit]], in a room staring at some empty shelves. An Authority Commander can also be found in the [[Cinders of Etris]] Disaster or can spawn along in an Ambush if you have low [[reputation]] with [[The Central Authority]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal is composed of either an [[Adretian Axe]] or [[Cavalry Saber]] along with the [[Flamecharm]] Attunement, and some hand-to-hand combat: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Cavalry Saber]]] Performs four quick slashes with their blade. [[[Adretian Axe]]] Raises axe before firmly slamming it down to the ground. *Adretian Axe critical is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Flame Repulsion'''
(★☆☆) |After a ~2 second wind-up, releases a burning area-of-effect blast that pushes back enemies. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Burning Servants'''
(★☆☆) |Summon a legion of flaming spearmen that lunge inwards. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★☆☆) |User lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |User slams down with their blade coated in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Relentless Flames'''
(★★☆) |Bear down on your foes with repeated fiery slashes. *Cancels if parried. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ash Slam'''
(★★★) |Strike the ground, turning it to ash. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Flame Scourge'''
(★★☆) |User gathers flames in their hand and spins it like a whip grabbing enemies around them, before slamming them into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Ballista'''
(★★☆) |Conjure a flaming arrow and fire it at your target. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} ===Passives=== *Experienced Fighter - Can block and parry common attacks and mantras. *Mantra Modification - An Authority Commander's "Flame Repulsion" mantra is modified with either 3 [[Cloudstone]]s or 2 [[Stratus Stone]]s. === Talents === * Eruption Path: Lava Serpent - Your fire abilities proc an eruption under the enemies feet instead of burn. * Empowered Eruption - Your next Eruption after landing a critical is empowered with increased range and damage. * Flash Point - Block-breaking an enemy with a fire mantra applies Burning. Posture breaking an opponent will also cause your Eruptions to be Empowered for the next 10s. * {{cl|advancedtlnf|The Floor is Lava}} - Your Eruptions leave lethal pools of lava beneath them. * {{cl|raretlnf|Mirage Clone}} - Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire. * Azure Flames - Many of your flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity. * Riot Breaker - You receive 15% less posture damage and deal 10% more posture damage when under attack by 3 or more enemies. * Immolation - Fire spells cost 70% less ether while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. * {{cl|advancedtlnf|Phoenix Flames}} - Any time you would burn to death, you instead rise again with 50% of your health restored. * Corpse Explosion - Bodies that you burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage. Your flames will also incinerate unconscious targets much faster. * Controlled Combustion - Your Agitating Spark no longer spreads to your allies. * {{cl|advancedtlnf|Audacity}} - Once you've brought down your prey, instill fear into all those who would separate you from claiming it. * {{cl|raretlnf|Impervious Slumber}} - Getting hit while knocked no longer resets your time knocked. ==Tips== *They can be assassinated, if they happen to not look in your direction/or were not alerted consider doing the following and pile up some damage with powerful mantras. *At almost any given time they'll try to use their mantras while performing an M1 combo. *Expect [[Authority Peacekeeper]]s and other nearby Authority NPCS to interfere with your fight. *You'll frequently get into a parry trade with the Commander, so feint to disrupt it. ==Gallery== EnchantedAuthCommander.png|An Authority Commander with an enchanted weapon Authority_commander_in_prison.png|An Authority Commander prior to their reworked appearance, wearing an [[Authority Captain Uniform]] ==Trivia== * You used to be able to pickpocket the Authority Commander for the Jail Keys, but it required the Pickpocket Talent to do so. * This was the only NPC you could pickpocket so far. * You cannot talk with them. Previously, attempting to do so would pickpocket them instead. *They wear the [[Authority Commander]] Outfit, an [[Authority Helm]], and a black [[Shrouded Cape]]. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] {{DEFAULTSORT:Authority Commander}}

title: Authority Ensign
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=A bright-eyed recruit deployed to the Eastern Front. Three cheers for the cause!|author=Origin description}}
[[File:AuthorityEnsignIcon.png|center]] __TOC__ ::''Authority Ensign'' is an immersive faction-based [[Origin]] that works mostly in the [[Eastern Luminant]], performing authority missions to progress to higher ranks for exclusive rewards. ==Description== Authority Ensigns are, as the name implies, ensigns or soldiers of [[The Central Authority]]. It is unknown whether they are conscripted or volunteered, but as a soldier, they are subject to chain of command under the Authority. Authority Ensigns are affiliated with [[The Central Authority]]. ==Obtainment== To obtain the Authority Ensign Origin, the player must do one of the following: *Reach maximum reputation with [[The Central Authority]]. OR *Defeat [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]]. If your reputation is already maxed with the Central Authority and you do not have this Origin yet, commit a crime to lower your reputation and then do an event to raise it again. ==Spawn== Members of the Authority Ensign spawn at [[Port Merit]] with the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]] and an [[Authority Helm]]. ==Effects== Your [[Guild]] will be automatically set to '''The Central Authority''' on that character, allying you with all members of the same Origin, which allows you use the shout feature (by starting your messages with !) to talk to all fellow Ensigns server wide. Your guild will reset back to normal if you wipe or get Exiled from the Authority. Your guild being changed is somewhat only a visual change; while you '''won't''' be able to use the [[Chime of Dwelling]], which is a major downside if you are already in a guild, if you claim a [[Guild Banners|Guild Banner]], it will still be under your Guild. You can also still interact with all of your Guild Base NPCs and respawn at your [[Guild Base]] if someone else places it down. After ranking up once, you gain the ability to jail players. If you manually grip a player, they will be imprisoned at [[Fort Merit]] and you will gain 80 points. This does not kill them (no life lost and no loot dropped), however, they'll be scheduled for execution in 5 minutes, drowning them and sending them to [[The Depths]] if they did not manage to escape. Visit the [[Escaping Jail]] page for a more detailed description. Most '''[[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]]''' can be equipped without meeting their normal requirements, without any penalty aside from (somewhat minor) effects such as damage scaling, which is a '''major''' benefit. Although you can automatically wear [[Outfits]] given to you from promotions, you '''cannot''' craft any non-Authority outfit to wear on your own, for [[Transmogrification|transmogging]] or otherwise, which is a '''major''' downside. All Ensigns will have an Authority insignia above their head to signify their rank, though your own insignia will be invisible to you. All of the previously mentioned neutral, beneficial, or detrimental effects or otherwise shall be removed upon being [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ===Salute=== Gain the Salute [[Emotes|Emote]]. File:Salute Emote.gif|Salute Emote ===Horn of Authority=== Gain a Talent Tool horn that marks escaping prisoners when blown by applying a combat tag onto them. The range of the horn is quite small, as you'll need to get fairly close to the prisoner in order for it to work. File:Horn.png ===Squads=== On the top left of your screen, next to the Help button, there will be an Authority Helmet icon with a red background, labeled "Squads." Clicking this will allow you to create a Squad with other Authority Ensign members. This is very similar to party systems in other games. Being in a Squad allows you to take on the Missions as a group and proc certain Authority Ensign Talents. This feature is highly recommended, especially at lower levels, as the enemies from Missions will often outnumber you and they do not have anti-gank AI. File:Squad Icon.png|Squads Icon File:Squad Invite.png|Invite UI File:Squadless.png|Squads UI (no Squad) File:Squad Member.png|Squads UI (member) ===Reputation Issues=== As you are affiliated with and work under [[The Central Authority]], certain factions will not take kindly to you. You also cannot raise your [[Reputation]] with The [[Kingdom of Etrea]] or [[The Children of Navae]], and your [[Hundred Legions]] reputation has a '''cap''' of high 'Ally'. *For The [[Kingdom of Etrea]]: You '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' raise your Reputation, and you start out as '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}'''. **You cannot gain immunity to [[Voidwalker]]s due to Etrea being one of the many factions that gives out [[Bounty Hunting|Bounties]]. **You cannot complete the [[Duke Ishamon Erisia|Sin of Erisia]] questline, which means you cannot obtain [[Contractor]] or fight [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] for his loot. **You cannot gain rewards tied to having good reputation with Etrea, which follows: ***You cannot obtain [[Stratos' Cloak]]. ***You cannot obtain [[Windwaker]]. ***You cannot obtain [[Fang and Coil]], unless you spawn with it from the [[Character Creation]] screen. *For [[The Children of Navae]]: You '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' raise your Reputation, and you start out as '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}'''. **There is currently no effects or downsides gained from being hunted by them, not even [[Faction Ambushes]]. *For [[The Hundred Legions]]: Your reputation has a '''cap''' of high 'Ally', and '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' be raised further. **You are unable to get [[Legion Intelligence]] or [[Blightsurger]] on an Ensign character, unless you are a [[Khan]] or have the {{t|Celebrity}} Talent due to their requirements being higher than the high 'Ally' cap. File:Hundred legions cap.png|Reputation cap as an Ensign on every other Aspect Visit the [[#Reputation|Reputation]] section to see the starting reputation with other factions as an Ensign. All of the previously mentioned neutral, beneficial, or detrimental effects or otherwise shall be removed upon being [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ==Exile== Upon being exiled from [[The Central Authority]], you will be kicked out of the Central Authority guild, removing your ability to gain future promotions. You will return to your previous [[Guild]] and regain access to your [[Chime of Dwelling]]. All Origin-exclusive Talents, Equipments, Weapons, Mantras and Outfits you've obtained prior to being exiled will be '''{{cl|ligreen|kept}}''', although you can no longer exchange your Faction talents with the [[Shrine of Chance]]. You lose the ability to equip [[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]] without meeting its normal stat requirements, though any currently equipped items will remain usable until swapped out. In cases where it is swapped out, you cannot equip them again without meeting its normal stat requirements. Your Authority reputation will also be lowered heavily, most of the time to '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' or '''{{cl|darkpurple|Villain}}''' reputation (though you can still raise your Authority reputation afterwards) and it will remove the restriction of not being able to raise your [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]], [[The Children of Navae]], and [[The Hundred Legions]]. You will also lose a bit of reputation with [[The Divers]] and [[The Knives of Eylis]], and gain ample reputation with [[The Hundred Legions]] upon exile. Alongside losing your insignia and rank, [[#Salute|Salute]] now no longer appears as an emote you can use. You can no longer [[Jail]] other players. You still keep your [[Horn of Authority]], although it needs testing on whether or not it still works. There is '''{{cl|lired|no way}}''' to return to the Authority's ranks upon being exiled. There are two ways to be exiled: ===Deserter=== If you leave [[:Category:Territory of The Central Authority|Authority controlled territory]], a '''fifteen minute''' AWOL (absent without leave) countdown will be displayed at the top of your screen. If this countdown reaches 0, you will be marked as a Deserter, exiling you from the Central Authority. The AWOL timer will reset if you leave the game, restarting from 15 minutes once you rejoin. Additionally, the timer will not appear if you are on a mission, have joined a Division, are in a squad in which the leader is in the Command Division, are in a [[Dungeons|Dungeon]], or are in [[the Depths]]. File:AWOL.png|AWOL countdown ===Traitor=== Upon killing another Authority Ensign member of equal or higher rank, you will be marked as a traitor, exiling you from the Central Authority. This includes kills in other non-overworld locations. Non-direct kills, such as dropping someone in water or blowing someone up from cannon fire do not mark you as a Traitor. ==Progression== Speak to [[Captain Trist]], [[Captain Klave]], [[Captain Massi]] or [[Captain Rendez]] to gain a Mission. Missions are timed objectives that vary in difficulty depending on the objective. When taking a Mission, you and your squad will be teleported to [[Port Merit]]. Your current Mission objective and the Mission's location will be displayed on the top left of your screen, similar to [[Job Boards|jobs]]. You can right click the Mission popup to view its location on the map. The amount of time allocated to each mission depends on the mission location. Upon completing a Mission, you will have to report back to the Captain. This will also be timed. Upon reporting back, you will gain 45 points towards your promotion, EXP, a small chest, and 3-5 '''full''' training points. The amount of full training points depends on your rank. If you fail a Mission by running out of time, failing the objective, or dying (which includes resetting your character with Esc + R + Enter to teleport), you will lose 25 promotion points instead. The mission will also be considered failed if any of the previous things happen while you are on your way back to Captain Trist after a successful mission. Leaving the game will forfeit your Mission and may result in your promotion points being '''voided'''. It is not advised to leave the game during an active mission. Even if you aren't in a Squad, other players may be assigned to the same Mission as you. For some Missions, like Armanent Sabotage, if the Mission is completed, it will be completed for both parties. Dying during a mission only counts as a Mission fail for the person who died. Alternative to missions, you can also gain 80 points from [[Jail]]ing other players.
===List of Missions===
#'''Armanent Sabotage''' - Destroy the legion stockpiles, bait patrols away at [Location]. #*Objective: The player and their squad are tasked with destroying several cargo barrels at a [[Hundred Legions|Legion]] encampment. The barrels can be destroyed by hitting them two times, and the encampment is guarded by 7 [[Legion Soldier]]s and a [[Legion Captain]]. #*Potential Locations: #**[[Starswept Valley]] - near [[Sordino]] and the [[Union Hooks|Union Hook]] that leads up to the Widow Cave; 44 minute time limit #**[[Starswept Valley]] - right before the [[Lifevents|Lifevent]] that leads towards the Widow cave; 38 minute 30 second time limit #**[[Siirka Point]]; 1 hour 40 second time limit #*Notes/Tips: #**When the Mission completes, the Legion Soldiers will immediately lose aggression. #**The Legion Soldiers and Captain will be completely passive if you have neutral or higher [[Hundred Legions]] reputation. #***Additionally, you can obtain the Captain's Rec from the Captain for [[Legion Kata]]. #**Sneaking around the fort to pick off or assassinate some of the Legion Soldiers is a good strategy to thin their numbers. #**Make sure to check inside all of the tents for barrels. #**These NPCs lack anti-gank AI; you will be jumped if you aren't careful. Taking out the weaker enemies first is advised. #**If you have a ship with cannons, you are able to shoot the Legion NPCs from afar, as all of the mission locations are near water. #'''Capture Prisoner''' - Find and Capture escaped prisoners. Distribute this information to your Squad. #*Objective: Track down and hunt a player who is attempting to escape the [[Fort Merit]] prison. #*Location: [[Fort Merit]]; 16 minute 30 second time limit #*Notes/Tips: #**This Mission will be completed if the prisoner gets teleported back into their cell, not when they get executed. #***When an escapee gets low enough health to be knocked from a player attack, they will be teleported back into the prison instead. #**The Mission will automatically fail if you enter the prison. #***When this Mission fails, you only lose 10 promotion points instead of the usual 25. #**This mission is only available when there's an active fugitive on the loose. If such is the case, the mission is very likely to be assigned over other type of mission. #**The location marker for this Mission does not follow the prisoner, instead it stays at the prison. You may need to search around for the prisoner in question. Remember to use your Horn of Authority to locate them. #***The primary, intended escape route is located at the top of the prison. More daring prisoners might attempt to make a run throught the bridge leading to the prison. Those with outside help can instead escape near the lower part of the prison, being picked up by a boat. #'''Hostage''' - Recon has reported there is a hostage at [Location]. Save and return the hostage. #*Objective: The player and their squad are tasked with saving a hostage from 5 [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s and a [[Blacksteel Pirate Captain]]. Pick up the hostage by pressing {{Input|keybind|V}} and run far enough away from where the hostage was being kept to complete this Mission. #*Potential Locations: #**[[Derelict Highchurch]] - the hostage is behind the altar in the church; 45 minute 30 second time limit #**[[Miner's Landing]] - the hostage is in the inn on the second floor; 21 minute 20 second time limit #**[[Summer Isle]] - the hostage is inside the abandoned building, the same location for the [[Chainwarden]] obtainment quest; 54 minute time limit #*Notes/Tips: #**When the Mission completes, the Blacksteel Pirates will immediately lose aggression. #**The hostage has very low health, and if the hostage is killed, the Mission will fail. #**The Blacksteel Pirate Captain is very strong and has a lot of health. It is generally advised to take out all of the other Blacksteel Pirates first. #**These NPCs lack anti-gank AI; you will be jumped if you aren't careful. Taking out the weaker enemies first is advised. #**For the Derelict Highchurch location, the surrounding [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Songseekers]] will not aggro onto you, seemingly due to a bug. You can use this to your advantage by hitting them once, causing them to aggro onto the Blacksteel Pirates instead. Alternatively, the Blacksteel Pirates are all positioned where they're facing the altar, meaning you can sneak up behind them and get free assassinations. #**For the Miner's Landing location, the Blacksteel Pirates will be fighting the [[Ignition Union Guard]]s by the time you get there. You can use this chaos to grab the hostage and flee. #**For the Summer Isle location, the Blacksteel Pirates are located around the front of the building, so if you sneak in through the hole in the back wall, you can avoid combat altogether. #'''Secure Perimeter''' - Secure the points and do not let any hostiles breach our defenses at [Location]. #*Objective: The player and their squad are tasked with defending two or three Authority-branded banners from 3 waves of enemies. #*Potential Locations: #**[[Miner's Landing]]; 19 minute 30 second time limit #**[[Summer Isle]]; 1 hour 5 minute 20 second time limit #*Notes/Tips: #**The types of enemies spawned and amount of banners you need to protect scales on the level of the Squad leader; #***Power 1-5: [[Bandit]]s #***Power 6-10: [[Bandit Leader]]s #***Power 11-15: [[Cloaked Assassin]]s #***Power 16-20: [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s #**For the Miner's Landing location, the enemies spawn along the southeastern shoreline. #**For the Summer Isle location, the enemies will spawn along the southwestern shoreline, near the docks, and the southeastern shoreline, to the right of the large staircase. #**The Mission will be completed when enough time passes (about 2 minutes). #**The enemies seem to be bugged, as they will spawn without aggroing onto the banners.
===Mission Lootpool===
{| class="fandom-table" width="100%" | style="width:10%;" |'''Miscellaneous''' | style="width:90%;" | *[[Items]]: [[Gems]], basic [[Mantra Modifiers]], all [[Sparks]] *[[Relics]]: [[Warped Blue Gem|{{cl|relic|Warped Blue Gem}}]] |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Weapons]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *'''Light Weapons''': [[Central Dirk]], [[Inquisitor's Thorn]] |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Equipment]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *{{text|lhhead}}: [[Deepwoken Hood]] *{{text|lharms}}: [[Bluesteel Pauldrons]], [[Deepwoken Cloak]], [[Fur Pauldrons]], [[Imperial Pauldrons]], [[Trimmed Overcoat]] *{{text|lhlegs}}: [[Bluesteel Boots]], [[Fur Boots]], [[Grand Boots]], [[Imperial Boots]] *{{text|lhtorso}}: [[Warmaster's Medallion|{{cl|relic|Warmaster's Medallion}}]] *{{text|lhface}}: [[Headband]], [[Inquisitor's Visor]] (Inquisition Division only) *{{text|lhrings}}: *#'''Generic Rings''': [[Chained Ring]], [[Dazed Band]], [[Freestyler's Band]], [[Isshin's Ring]], [[Konga's Clutch Ring]], [[Light Eater Ring]], [[Ring of Casters]], [[Ring of Curses]], [[Ring of Pestilence]] *#'''Legendary Rings''': [[Finisher's Ring|{{cl|legendary|Finisher's Ring}}]], [[Prophet's Ring|{{cl|legendary|Prophet's Ring}}]] *{{cl|lh|Inquisition Division Exclusive}}: **{{text|lhhead}}: [[Handler's Hood]], [[High Inquisitor's Hood]], [[Inquisitor's Hood]] **{{text|lharms}}: [[Inquisitor's Duster]] **{{text|lhface}}: [[Inquisitor's Visor]] |}
==Promotions== Through completing enough Missions, you will be promoted. Each promotion comes with benefits of their own benefits and rewards, being Faction Talent hands and potentially new dialogue with NPCs. Promotion points are '''reset''' upon being promoted. The message "'''YOU HAVE BEEN PROMOTED TO [RANK]. OORAH!'''" will appear when you reach enough points to rank up. You can change Faction Talents by using the [[Shrine of Chance]], but only if you are still currently an Ensign, and not [[#Exile|Exiled]]. Every Faction Talent available to you will appear upon every promotion, which means you will not be locked out of a talent due to a limit of talents appearing like a [[Whisper Draw|normal talent hand]]. You gain a Faction Talent hand upon every promotion, which means you get 1 talent from going from '''Private''' to '''Corporal''', and '''Corporal''' to '''Lance Corporal''', totalling to 2 talents. You do not gain a Faction Talent hand upon entering a division. In practice, this means that you are forced to pick 2 generic enlistment talents before you can start picking division-exclusive talents. How many division-exclusive (or more generic enlistment) talents you can pick depend on your chosen division. As you do not gain a talent hand upon entering a [[#Divisions|division]], how many ranks there are after your first division rank is how many talents you further get. The amount is 3 for the [[#Command Division|Command Division]], and 2 for both the [[#Inquisition Division|Inquisition Division]] and the [[#Shock Corps Division|Shock Corps Division]]. Keep mind that you can still exchange your Faction Talents by using the [[Shrine of Chance]] if you are not [[#Exile|Exiled]]. In total, from '''Private''' to the highest rank, choosing to enter the Command Division gets you 5 Faction Talents in total, and both the Inquisition and Shock Corps Division gets you 4 Faction Talents in total. Enlistment Ranks #'''Private'''; This is the standard rank that is granted upon obtaining the Origin. #'''Corporal'''; The 2nd rank, granted after reaching 155 promotion points. #'''Lance Corporal'''; The final Enlistment rank, granted after reaching 215 promotion points. #*Allows you to join one of the Divisions: Command, Inquisition, or Shock Corps. File:Ensign Private Insignia.png|Private insignia File:Placeholder.png|Corporal insignia File:Placeholder.png|Lance Corporal insignia
===Enlistment Talents=== These Talents can be chosen upon being promoted at any point in your Ensign playthrough.
*{{cl|factiontl|Armored Plating}} - Put on extra plating on your armor, giving you 50 temp health whenever you are put in combat. Due to the weight of this additional plating, you have reduced speed at all times. **Gain 50 Temporary Health whenever combat starts at the cost of having a passive movement speed debuff even outside of combat. *{{cl|factiontl|Crossguard}} - If you are using a sword, you gain 10% chip against other opponents wielding swords. **This applies only to Medium swords, meaning Greatswords are completely unaffected. *{{cl|factiontl|Oppressive Force}} - When using a weapon found in the Merit Armory, gain a unique two-hit flourish that does not knock back opponents and dazes them. **The first hit deals your regular M1 damage and posture damage, the second hit deals 80% of your weapon's scaled damage with 7 posture damage. **The damage and posture damage of the second hit cannot be buffed. **The second hit will only happen if the first one lands. This means it does not follow through on block. **The second hit does not count as a weapon hit, meaning it ignores your weapon's Chip stat, it cannot proc [[Enchantments|enchants]], and it cannot proc any "on flourish" Talents. **The second hit does not proc on non-humanoid targets. **These weapons are: [[Adretian Axe]], [[Big Brother]], [[Cavalry Saber]], [[Central Dirk]], [[Duskguard Axe]], [[Halberd]], [[Inquisitor's Greatsword]], [[Inquisitor's Thorn]], [[Markor's Inheritor]], [[Officer Saber]], [[Rifle Spear]], [[Rite of Authority]], [[Sovereign's Punishment]], and [[Warden Ceremonial Sword]]. **The {{cl|alloyed|Alloyed}} variants of all of the above weapons proc this effect as well. **Despite being found in the armory, the [[Battleaxe]], [[Stiletto]], and [[Sword]] do not proc this effect. *{{cl|factiontl|Riot Shield}} - While you are fighting two or more opponents and are using a [[shield]], reduce the total amount of chip damage you take by 40%. **Grants 40% damage reduction to chip damage, does '''not''' reduce your opponent's chip % by 40. *{{cl|factiontl|Steel Tread}} - Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.
==Divisions== Upon reaching the Lance Corporal rank and meeting the additional requirements of a Division, you can join them, granting exclusive bonuses such as [[Weapons]], Unique [[Outfits]], [[Talents]], and new dialogue that changes depending on your rank and Division. Additionally, the AWOL timer will no longer appear, allowing you to go where you please, and most Authority NPCs, including both [[Category:Central Authority Enemies|Enemies affiliated with the Central Authority]] who aren't in active combat and regular NPCs found within Fort Merit, will salute you when you approach them. File:NPC Salute.gif At maximum Division rank, you will gain clearance to purchase to the lategame weapons in the Fort Merit Armory, such as the [[Sovereign's Punishment]] and various [[Pluripotent Alloy|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed}}]] variants of Armory weapons. Each Division is unique in their themes, offering many avenues of gameplay and build diversity, but be warned as once you join a Division, you '''cannot''' go back or choose a different one.
==Command Division== The Command Division of the Central Authority is known for their charismatic commanders, leading the charges into the fight and empowering their fellow soldiers.
Joining this Division provides the '''Glorious Charge''' Mantra, the [[Authority Captain Uniform]] Expert Armor, and the edges of your [[Adretian Aegis]] changes color from gold to grey. Additionally, upon reaching Seneschal rank, you can speak to [[Warden Jericho]] to receive the [[Rite of Authority]] weapon. Uniquely, this Division has 4 ranks, allowing you to gain up to 5 Faction Talents while the other Divisions are limited to 4. ===Obtainment and Ranks=== Complete 10 missions as Squad leader, then speak to [[Warden Jericho]] as a Lance Corporal. Being solo counts as being the squad leader. '''Ranks''' #'''Warrant Officer'''; This is the standard rank that is granted upon joining this Division. #'''Captain'''; The 2nd rank, granted after reaching 329 promotion points. #'''Commander'''; The 3rd rank, granted after reaching 388 promotion points. #'''Seneschal'''; The final rank, granted after reaching 447 promotion points. File:Placeholder.png|Warrant Officer insignia File:Placeholder.png|Captain insignia File:Placeholder.png|Commander insignia File:Placeholder.png|Seneschal insignia ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Breakthrough Drive}} - Knocking a player refreshes your Glorious Charge cooldown and extends both effects it has by 5 seconds. [90 second CD] *{{cl|factiontl|Buster Call}} - Radio in the Authority's navy for a buster call, sending out a barrage of bombardment wherever you see fit. **Grants a Talent tool that lights a flare and highlights a large AoE on the ground. After a considerable delay, that location will be bombed several times, dealing very high damage. **Deals little to no pve monster damage (Works on humanoids, effective against legion camps) **Applies burn on hit. **Explosions cannot be parried and blockbreak. **Automatically grips knocked players. **The orbital strikes cannot knock players directly, but the burn can. **Cannot be used in [[Dungeons]]. **24 hour cooldown. 10 minute server-wide cooldown. File:BUST MY CALLS.gif *{{cl|factiontl|Officer's Slash}} - You now gain an additional critical attack with Authority armory weaponry while your regular critical attack is on cooldown. **Deals 35 damage. **20 second cooldown. **This critical has the [[M1 tag]]. **This works with the following weapons: [[Adretian Axe]], [[Central Dirk]], [[Halberd]], [[Inquisitor's Greatsword]], [[Inquisitor's Thorn]], [[Markor's Inheritor]], [[Officer Saber]], [[Rifle Spear]], [[Sovereign's Punishment]], and [[Warden Ceremonial Sword]]. **The {{cl|alloyed|Alloyed}} variants of all of the above weapons proc this effect as well. **Despite being found in the armory, the [[Cavalry Saber]], [[Battleaxe]], [[Stiletto]], [[Sword]], and [[Worshipper Longsword]] do not proc this effect. *{{cl|factiontl|Officer's Training}} - While using a Sword or Rapier, take 30% less posture damage from criticals. *{{cl|factiontl|Target Focus}} - Enemies you [[charm]] take more damage from your squadmates in your party. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Glorious Charge (☆☆☆) |image=Glorious Charge.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Yell with valor and courage, increasing the speed of nearby allies for 20 seconds and making them unknockable for 10 seconds. |ethercost={{stats|ether|70 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs=Command Division, given automatically after entering the division |effect=''User lets out a yell, buffing their allies. All of their nearby allies gain a speed boost for 20 seconds and become unknockable for 10.'' *The Breakthrough Drive Talent resets this Mantra's cooldown, as well as increasing the duration of both effects by 5 seconds upon knocking a player {{status|Unconscious}}. This has a 90 second cooldown. }}
==Inquisition Division== The Inquisition Divison of the Central Authority acts in the shadows, using their stealth and cunning to neutralize the opposition, while also serving as the eyes and ears for the Central Authority.
Joining this Division provides the '''Hidden Blade''' Mantra, the [[Inquisition Light]] Unique Armor, and the color of your [[Adretian Aegis]] changes from blue to black. Additionally, upon reaching Handler rank, you can speak to [[High Inquisitor Merey]] to receive the [[Big Brother]] weapon. ===Obtainment and Ranks=== Complete 10 missions solo, then speak to [[High Inquisitor Merey]] as a Lance Corporal. '''Ranks''' #'''Inquisitor'''; This is the standard rank that is granted upon joining this Division. #'''Inquisitor 1st Class'''; The 2nd rank, granted after reaching 329 promotion points. #'''Handler'''; The final rank, granted after reaching 388 promotion points. File:Placeholder.png|Inquisitor insignia File:Ensign Inquisitor 1st Class Insignia.png|Inquisitor 1st Class insignia File:Placeholder.png|Handler insignia ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Backstabber}} - Landing a backhit with a light attack causes you to grab your opponent and stab them again, dealing an extra 15 damage. [15 second CD] (+1 Passive Agility) **Procs on M1s and criticals with the [[M1 tag]]. **This Talent does not have a range limit. **Grants the target hit 3 seconds of Backstabber immunity. **Applies {{status|Dazed|daze}} and {{status|Ragdoll|ragdolls}}. **Prerequisite: 30 Agility File:BackStabber.gif *{{cl|factiontl|Executioner's Frenzy}} - Landing a light attack while their posture is paused reduces their assassination cooldown by 5 seconds. *{{cl|factiontl|Fatal Stealth}} - You deal increased backstab damage to opponents based on how high your [[stealth]] stat currently is. **Grants +0.2% damage per 1 [[Stealth]] to attacks that hit your opponent's back. This affects all damage sources that can receive damage modifiers. **Stealth that is not gained from [[Equipment]] or [[Outfit]] sources do not count towards this Talent. ***Strangely, the [[Obvious]] Flaw is an exception to this, reducing your backhit damage by 4%. ***The following [[Stealth]] sources '''do not''' apply to this Talent's damage buff: [[Felinor]]'s innate Stealth '''and''' its Stealth gain multiplier, Agility investment, Crouching, Lowstrude, Murmur: Tacet, and Tacet Minimization. **This does '''not''' buff [[assassination]]s. **See the [[Stealth]] page for info on where stealth can be obtained. ***The maximum Stealth you can gain from Equipment alone is 30% (+6% damage). ***Notably, the [[Inquisition Light]] Outfit grants 50% Stealth (+10% damage). *{{cl|factiontl|Flanking Maneuvers}} - Enemies you assassinate take more PEN from your squadmates in your party. *{{cl|factiontl|Stature Break}} - Landing a backstab of any kind disables posture for 4 seconds. [8 second CD] **This applies the {{status|Paused Posture}} Status effect, denying ''most'' sources of Posture restoration. **During Paused Posture, you cannot restore posture by: passive posture regen, [[Parry]]ing, or the {{t|Steady Nerves}} Talent. All other forms of posture restoration entirely ignore this status effect. *{{cl|factiontl|Tacet Minimization}} - Focus your [[Tacet]] even further, allowing the radius at which you get spotted to become smaller temporarily. **Decreases your Tacet bubble size to the minimum possible and grants 400% flat [[Stealth]] for 10 seconds. 1 minute cooldown. **Requires 100% [[Ether]] to be activated, even though it does not cost any Ether. **Prerequisite: [[Murmur: Tacet]] ***You must obtain Tacet through [[Cestis]] or [[Quiet Stranger]] in order to get Tacet Minimization. The Soulbreaker Oath variant will not allow you to obtain Tacet Minimization. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Hidden Blade (☆☆☆) |image=Hidden_Blade_gif.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Pull out a hidden blade and quickly stab your opponent, dealing a percentage of your opponents health while also applying a bonus poison. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype=Typeless |reqs=Inquisition Division, given automatically after entering the division |effect=''The user lunges forwards with their hidden blade and stabs their opponent, injecting a poison into them.'' *Deals 6% of your opponent's maximum health as damage. *Deals 6 posture damage. *Applies an extended hitstun, preventing the usage of all forms of attack, many Tools, jumping, eating food items, sliding, dodging, and certain Talent Tools for 2.5 seconds. *Applies a {{status|Poison}} for 8 seconds that increases the [[Shaky Block]] duration of your opponent by 20%. Having the [[Inquisition Light]] Outfit equipped will double the duration of this poison. *Grants iframes to the caster and the person hit during its animation. *Can be buffed through damage modifiers despite dealing percentage based damage. }}
==Shock Corps Division== The Shock Corps Division of the Central Authority sees frontliners taking the fight head on with overwhelming force.
Joining this Division provides the '''Grand Warden's Axe''' Mantra, the [[Shock Corps Light]] Unique Armor, and the color of your [[Adretian Aegis]] changes from blue to red. Additionally, upon reaching Operator rank, you can speak to [[Sentinel Augustus]] to receive the [[Duskguard Axe]] weapon. ===Obtainment and Ranks=== Complete missions with a high win to loss ratio, then speak to [[Sentinel Augustus]] as a Lance Corporal. This requires a ratio of 3:1 for completed missions, meaning you will need to complete 3 missions successfully for every mission you fail. '''Ranks''' #'''Frontliner'''; This is the standard rank that is granted upon joining this Division. #'''Interceptor'''; The 2nd rank, granted after reaching 329 promotion points. #'''Operator'''; The final rank, granted after reaching 388 promotion points. File:Placeholder.png|Frontliner insignia File:Placeholder.png|Interceptor 1st Class insignia File:Ensign Operator Insignia.png|Operator insignia ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Absolute Force}} - Evolve the technique of your Oppressive Force, letting both hits of your flourish deal 50% more posture damage. **Because the second hit of Oppressive Force cannot receive posture damage modifiers, this Talent only benefits the initial hit of your Oppressive Force flourish. **Prerequisite: Oppressive Force *{{cl|factiontl|Amp Overdrive}} - Guardbreaking an opponent causes them to take extra thunder damage and applies Electrify for 7 seconds. **Deals 15 Thundercall damage. **The Electrify status effect changes your opponent's damage type to Thundercall and gives you 10% damage reduction to their attacks. *{{cl|factiontl|Martial Brutality}} - The less health your opponent has, the more posture damage you deal to them. **Increases your posture damage by 0.1% per 1% health missing, up to a maximum of +10% posture damage against someone at 0% health. *{{cl|factiontl|Shocking Reverb}} - Landing enough [[Thundercall|lightning]] mantras without getting hit grants you a defensive lightning cloak for 15 seconds, letting you negate damage from light attacks and [[ironsing]]. [2 min CD] **You need to reach a threshold of 150 scaled damage with [[Thundercall]] Mantras without getting hit to proc this Talent. **The damage buildup to reach the threshold is unaffected by resistances and damage modifiers. **Also negates damage from critical attacks and [[Silentheart]] abilities. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Grand Warden's Axe (☆☆☆) |image=NoM1Axe.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Create a lightning axe! |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ltn|Lightning}} |reqs=Shock Corps Division, given automatically after entering the division |effect=''The user summons a floating axe made of Thundercall and strikes their opponent.'' *If you M1 during this Mantra's windup, the axe performs a vertical radial slash, ragdolling and knocking back your opponent. This variant deals more posture damage. *Has a base damage of 27 with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *The M1 variant has a base damage of 31 with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *The base variant deals 10 posture damage. *Applies Shock on hit. WithM1Axe.gif|M1 Variant }}
==Pros and Cons== As a lot of pros and cons have already been previously mentioned under the [[#Effects|Effects]] section, it will not be reiterated again unless its importance demands it. As such, this will only cover an overview of this origin when viewed as a whole. ===Pros=== *Many Authority Ensign players have a high sense of comradery; if you're being ganked, especially if it's at or around Fort Merit, there's a high likelihood of at least one of your fellow Ensigns to come to your aid. Using the shout feature to call for help will increase the odds of you receiving assistance. **And as the punishment for killing fellow Ensigns is quite major, most other Ensigns will never attack you. *You can equip most [[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]] without needing to meet its full requirements. *Your player grip is replaced with imprisoning them. This increases the time before someone can spin back after a fight. *Origin-exclusive Talents, Mantras, Weapons, and Outfits. *You start with an [[Authority Helm]] and the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]]. *Grants unique dialogue with a lot of Authority NPCs. Many of these dialogues will change based on your current rank and your [[reputation]] with the Authority. *The Master Armors from the Divisions are equipped instantly, completely ignoring their crafting materials and requirements. **But the Con is that because the Division Outfits are immediately equipped upon joining your Division without you ''learning'' the schematic, if you craft any other Outfit, the Division Outfit will be lost permanently. **Another Con is that you also cannot craft non-Authority [[Outfits]] while you are still an Authority Ensign; you can only craft other outfits if you have been [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ===Cons=== *Many of this Origin's benefits are locked behind a significant amount of time spent doing Missions. This will entirely take up your early-game progression on top of effectively softlocking you into only doing Missions until you join a Division. If you do not enjoy the gameplay loop of Missions, this Origin may not appeal to you as a whole, since it is a key part of the Origin and the Origin's progression. *Because your player grip is replaced with [[Jail|imprisoning]] them, you will need some kind of weapon or mantra that automatically [[Terminology (game)#Grip|grips]] in order to confirm kills (Auto-grips does NOT exile you). **This makes the obtainment of [[Tacet]], needed for the Tacet Minimization Talent in the Inquisition Division, a tad harder as you would need to rely on bleeding them out with light attacks if you don't have anything that auto-grips. Having outside help with allies that can grip normally also helps immensely. *As mentioned in the [[#Reputation Issues|Reputation Issues]] section, you cannot obtain stuff like [[Blightsurger]], [[Contractor]] and etc. due to the reputation limitations. **Due to the cap on [[Etrea]] reputation you will always be able to be voidwalked leading to unnecessary fighting and possible deaths. *Because your guild is "replaced" by The Central Authority guild, you will not be able to use the [[Chime of Dwelling]] or [[Guild Bases|Guild Officer]] tools. Being Exiled will remove this restriction. **If someone from your original guild places down the [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] or spawns their [[Ships & Sailing|Ship]], you can reset and choose those as your spawn point. **You are still able to access all the [[:Category:NPCs located in the Guild Base|NPCs]] that are located in the guild base. *There is no option to toggle or limit the shout feature, so your messages to your friends in the server will be intercepted by other Ensigns, and you may be subject to seeing shout messages that breaks Roblox's ToS or are otherwise not family friendly. **Remember to report messages like these. *If you aren't on a Mission, haven't joined a Division, or aren't in the squad of a player in the Commander Division, you are only given 15 minutes to return to Authority controlled territory before being Exiled. *Most Cons (and some Pros) are removed once the player has been [[#Exile|Exiled]], but exile has its own benefits and drawbacks. Visit the [[#Exile|Exile]] section for more information. ==Reputation== Your starting faction [[reputation]] is: *'''{{cl|medgreen|Ally}}''' with [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}}, [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}, and [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} *'''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' by [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} and [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} *''Note: Your chosen [[Aspect]] may affect your starting reputation.'' *You '''{{cl|lired|cannot gain}}''' [[Etrea]] or [[Children of Navae]] reputation. Your [[Hundred Legions]] reputation has a '''cap''' of mid 'Ally', and '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' be increased further. **Visit the [[#Reputation Issues|Reputation Issues]] section for major effects caused by this. If you have the [[Fugitive]] Flaw: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}}, [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}, [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, [[The Hive]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}}, [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}, and [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} *'''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' by [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}, [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}, [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}, and [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} ==Trivia== *The usage of ranks is incorrect, as a Lance Corporal is actually ranked below a Corporal. *Despite the [[Summer Company]] being on similarly friendly terms with the Central Authority, only the Divers and Ignition Union have Friend reputation with newly spawned Authority Ensigns. This is extra ironic as the Ignition Union have openly expressed disdain for the Authority and that they need to be stopped. This is likely due to past Authority treachery{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Rifle Spear}} and the Authority's refusal to pick a side in the Ignition-Summer conflict causing the Company to view them less favorably, even if they are willing to accept their finances. *Funnily enough, the Shock Corps Division has the most issues regarding its acquirement, as its requirements are unclear to this day. *The Buster Call Talent is a direct reference to ''One Piece'', being a tactic employed by the Marines where 10 warships are called to bombard a location. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:The Central Authority]] [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Origins]] [[Category:Faction Origins]]

title: Authority Lieutenant
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=1000 |weapon=*[[Cavalry Saber]] *[[Adretian Axe]] *[[Mace]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Fire Blade *Strong Left |drops=*[[Frigid Prism]]|image1=AuthorityLieutenant.png|caption1=That's a lovely DONATION for His Majesty's Bri'ish Museum ya got there}} ==Description== The Authority Lieutenant is an NPC found outside the shipwright hut in [[Fort Merit]], via [[Faction Ambushes]], or fighting with [[Legion Captain]]s in [[Starswept Valley]]. Their appearance consists of a Authority Captain Uniform, the [[Bluesteel Boots]] and [[Bluesteel Pauldrons|Pauldrons]], a black [[Shrouded Cape]] and, unusually for an Authority member, [[Aristocrat Eyeglasses]], however for some odd reason they wear their [[Authority Helm|helmet]] too. They are similar in appearance to the [[Authority Captain]] and [[Authority Commander (NPC)|Authority Commander]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal is composed of an Cavalry Saber/Adretian Axe/Mace along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Desciption |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |([[Cavalry Saber]]): Performs four quick slashes with their blade. ([[Adretian Axe]]): Does a windup by rising the weapon before slamming its blade on you.
([[Mace]]): Raises club upward before slamming it down to the ground. *Adretian Axe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |User slams down with their blade coated in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★★☆) |User lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Ash Slam'''
(★★★) |User imbues their fist with flames that explode on impact with the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} ===Talents=== *Azure Flames - Many of their flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity. *{{cl|raretlnf|Mirage Clone}} - Dodging attacks will leave behind a heat mirage clone that sets their enemy on fire. *Agitating Spark - Flame attacks spread to anybody nearby, including themselves. *{{cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} - Flame mantras landed after a flourish will explode their opponent. *Immolation - Hitting their opponent while on fire will apply fire damage, while also taking 50% less damage from self inflicted flames. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Phoenix Flames}} - Any time an Authority Lieutenant would burn to death, they instead revive with half of their health restored. *Corpse Explosion - Bodies they burn to death instantly detonate, dealing damage to anybody nearby. Their flames will also incinerate knocked targets much faster. *Controlled Combustion - Their Agitating Spark no longer spreads to those allied with them. ==Finisher== An Authority Lieutenant executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |([[Cavalry Saber]]):Pins down opponent before slicing their throat. ([[Adretian Axe]]):Pins down the opponent before splitting their skull with the weapon. ([[Mace]]):Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face with mace. |} ==Gallery== AuthorityLieutenantNew.png|Old appearance ==Trivia== *The Authority Lieutenant's dialogue when they are being executed is usually "You're pretty strong...", "How is this even possible?" or "What is someone of your strength doing here...?" the same as the Authority Captain. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]]

title: Authority Officer
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=400 |weapon=*[[Officer Saber]] *[[Mace]] *[[Adretian Axe]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Jolt Grab *Thunder Kick |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] *[[Spark Gland]] |image1=authorityfootsoldier.png |caption1=Jolt Grab go brrr}} ==Description== Authority officers are a type of enemy NPC working for [[The Central Authority]] that are frequently found around [[Erisia]]. They can spawn in the following events: *Authority Officers vs [[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] ([[Erisia]]) *Authority Officers vs [[Etrean Soldier|Etrean Soldiers]] ([[Upper Erisia]]) *Authority Officers vs [[Legion Soldier|Legion Soldiers]] ([[Upper Erisia]]) * Authority Officers with [[Authority Soldier|Authority Soldiers]] patrolling ([[Upper Erisia]]) **Defeating all four of them will reward the player with a chest containing low level gear along with negative reputation with The Central Authority. They are also the higher ranked and more dangerous counterpart to the [[Authority Soldier]]. Authority officers wear an [[Authority Helm]], a pair of [[Bluesteel Pauldrons]], a pair of [[Bluesteel Boots]] and an [[Authority Captain Uniform]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal consists of a [[Cavalry Saber]], [[Adretian Axe]] or a [[Mace]] (all of which can be enchanted) and the [[Thundercall]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Cavalry Saber]]] Performs a wind-up before thrusting sword forward. [[[Mace]]] Raises club upward before slamming it down to the ground.
[[[Adretian Axe]]] Does a windup by rising the weapon before slamming its blade on you. *Mace and Adretian Axe criticals are not blockable. *Adretian Axe critical grants hyperarmor during its windup. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Jolt Grab'''
(★★☆) |Grabs the nearest target with an electrified grasp. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Thunder Kick'''
(★★☆) |User performs an empowered lightning kick, shocking and knocking away any opponents. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Lightning Blade'''
(★☆☆) |Arcing blades of electricity. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Talents === * First Interrogation - Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage. * Second Interrogation - Electrified attacks do 50% less damage and posture damage to you. * Authority Intimidation - All moves that apply electricity slow the opponent more. * Resolve Crusher - Lightning moves now have a chance to apply "Electrify", attacks from electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you. * Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor - Your lightning no longer applies Shock, instead apply Surge. At maximum stacks of Surge, your opponents will Overload, sending arcs of lightning in every direction. * {{cl|raretlnf|Showstopper}} - When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing. ==Finisher== An Authority Officer executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Cavalry Saber]]] Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with blade. [[[Mace]]] Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face with mace.
[[[Adretian Axe]]] Pins down the opponent before splitting their skull with the weapon. |} ==Tips== *Run if you're inexperienced as its [[Thundercall]] mantras deal a lot of damage. ==Trivia== *An Authority officer can lose to a [[Mudskipper]] if it gets backed into a corner. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

If you were looking for a different page, view the [[Authority Guard (disambiguation)|disambiguation]].'' {{EnemyInfobox |health=1200 |weapon=*[[Rifle Spear]] *[[Officer Saber]] *[[Adretian Axe]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Fire Blade *Relentless Flames *Flame Grab |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] |image1=Authority Guard.png |caption1=Turns out the many, the few, the big, the small only applied to Blue people |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]]}} ==Description== ''Not to be confused with the outfit of a similar name, the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]]'' Authority Peacekeepers are a type of enemy NPC found patrolling [[Fort Merit]]. Despite their intimidating appearance, they are surprisingly weak compared to the [[Authority Officer]]. Their appearance consists of a Authority Peacekeeper Uniform and an Authority Helmet. They are almost identical to the [[Authority Soldier]], with only those wielding the [[Rifle Spear]] being unique at a glance. ==Moveset== Their arsenal is composed of a [[Rifle Spear]], [[Cavalry Saber]] or [[Adretian Axe]] along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Desciption |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |([[Rifle Spear]])Pulls the trigger on the spear that fires a bullet at opponent. ([[Cavalry Saber]])Performs four quick slashes with their blade.

This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 5 and have at least 5 [[Fortitude]] to be crafted. This Outfit '''cannot''' be crafted unless you are an [[Authority Ensign]]. {{EnemyInfobox |image1=RegularAuthorityFootsoldier.png |moves=*Assault *Critical *Flame Grab *Fire Blade *Burning Servants |health=200 |weapon=*[[Adretian Axe]] *[[Officer Saber]] |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] *[[Dying Embers]] |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]]}} ==Description== Authority Soldiers are enemy NPCs found in [[Upper Erisia]] and on [[Meteor Isle]]. They are ranked the lowest, and thus the most incompetent members of The Central Authority's army, frequently accidently incinerating or setting each other on fire. As a result, they have a standard appearance, sporting an [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]] and an [[Authority Helm]]. They can spawn in the following events: * 2 '''Authority Soldiers''' with 2 [[Authority Officer]]s patrolling [[Upper Erisia]]. * 2 '''Authority Soldiers''' raiding [[Meteor Isle]]. == Moveset == An Authority Soldier's arsenal consists of either a [[Adretian Axe]] or an [[Officer Saber]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Officer Saber]]] Performs four quick slashes with their blade. [[[Adretian Axe]]] Raises axe before firmly slamming it down to the ground. *Adretian Axe critical is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |Slams down with a blade coated in flame, dealing heavy damage in an arc. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Burning Servants'''
(★☆☆) |Summon a legion of flaming spearmen that lunge inwards. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★☆☆) |The Soldier lunges forward to grab and slam the player into the ground, igniting them in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |} ===Talents=== *Hell's Partisan - After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above. *Warding Radiance - Every fire mantra builds up one halo stack. At 3 stacks a halo appears that allows you to slide further. Hell's Partisan is also triggered passively while this is active. *Flaming Flourish - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. *To The Finish - You take 10% less damage when below 30% health. *Immolation - Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. ==Gallery== AuthSoldierMunchies.png|An Authority Soldier being eaten by a [[Megalodaunt]] ==Trivia== *They are one of two Authority enemies that can be non-Adrets, the other being the [[Authority Peacekeeper]]. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

== Description ==
'''Bamboo Bundle''' is an [[Ingredients|Ingredient]] in Deepwoken. It can be used to craft [[Fiber]], and can commonly be found near the shores of [[Erisia]], [[Etris]], [[Miner's Landing]], and [[Songseeker Wilds]], and on grass in Etris and [[Isle of Vigils]]. It is found in bunches of tall, green bamboo stems which can be harvested by the player.  

Every two Bamboo is equal to one Fiber, which every three of is equal to one [[Cloth]]. So, six bamboo is equal to one Cloth.

== Gallery ==
<gallery widths="400" position="center">
Bamboo.png|Bamboo found in the spring
</Gallery>

== Trivia ==
* In the June 9th, 2025 update, Bamboo that would occur on shores was replaced with [[Marram Grass]].
* The Bamboo Bundle changes color depending on the [[Seasons|season]], being a lighter green in the Spring and a darker green in the Summer.

==Description==
The '''Baneful Syrinx''' is a consumable [[Relic]] with '''10 uses'''. Baneful Syrinx's usage is teleporting you to various locations within [[Scyphozia]]. Short cooldown upon usage.

Upon usage, the user will be slowed and is prompted to select one of three locations:
# Shrine of the Keeper ([[Temple of Hearts]])
# Cathedral of the Voices ([[Cathedral of the Interstice]])
# Harbinger of the Fall ([[The Diluvian Mechanism]])

A teleportation circle will appear below the user's feet, and after a short delay, you '''and a maximum of 4 other players''' will be teleported directly to your chosen location.
==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BanefulUI.png
</gallery><gallery>

</gallery>
==Trivia==
*Baneful Syrinx is located in the utility category in your inventory rather than the Relic category.
*Baneful Syrinx was added alongside [[Reciprocal Bonecharm]] and [[Ouroboral Husk]] in the same update, with all three Relics having the same function of teleporting the user to specific locations.
*Baneful Syrinx cannot be used in combat.
*Baneful Syrinx can be used in the Overworld to teleport yourself into The Depths, acting similarly to [[Deepbound|Deepbound's]] Call of the Deep.
*Baneful Syrinx can be used to teleport out of layer 2

==Description==
Bankers are NPCs that a player can utilize to store items across slots. You can also turn [[Artifacts]] to bankers to receive 200 notes and a various assortment of items. Players can also hire bankers inside their guild base to make things easier.

===Safe Deposit Boxes===
Bankers have a unique ability to let the player store items '''across slots''', even if you wiped all your slots, your items would still be there. Items are stored forever until the player takes it out. When accessing the Banking UI by a Banker, players are immune to all forms of outside damage. 

The following item types are sorted as follows: 
*[[Weapons]]
*[[Equipment]]
*[[Treasures]], [[Relics]]
*[[Ingredients]]
*[[Mantra Modifiers]]
*[[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]], [[Enchant Stone]]s, [[Enchant Grease]]s, [[Food]]
[[Enchantments|Enchanted]] items are prioritized first in their respective category.

Players start with six free slots, each holding one item, almost all items can be put inside the bank slots. Soulbound and Relic items will have to go through a '''Vow of Safekeeping,''' where {{c|Knowledge|1}} is spent to create the vow.
<gallery widths="200" position="center">
File:Item Bank Vow of Safekeeping.png
File:Item Bank UI New.png
</gallery>

Each slot will call a small, or large fee depending on how many slots you currently have. The listed prices below apply to every new slot, (e.g, the 15th slot would cost {{c|Notes|2,500}}.)

*0-6, Free (Base Slots)
*7-12, ({{c|Notes|1,000}}) 
*13-17, ({{c|Notes|2,500}}) 
*18-60 ({{c|Notes|5,000}}) 
*61-102 ({{c|Notes|10,000}}). This comes up to a total of 653,500 notes to get all your bank slots.

To put an item in your safe deposit box, you must open your inventory and drag and drop the item you want to deposit into the box. If your box is full and you want to add an item to a stack already present—assuming that stack isn't already at its limit—you'll first need to take out an item that occupies a slot (i.e. equipment) out of it before placing the desired item inside. 

If you need help figuring out how to put an item in a safe deposit box, or just want to see an example of someone depositing, [https://youtu.be/2m4qD3xfOAM here is a great video]. 

====Items requiring a Vow of Safekeeping:====
*[[Weapons]] and [[Equipment]] that are Enchanted, Soulbound, or event exclusive.
*[[Enchant Stone]]
*[[Relics]] (Including Alloys)
*[[Dye Packet]]
*Monster parts required for [[Monster Mantras]]

====Unstorable Items:====
* Certain Unique [[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]]:
**[[Arachnid's Weave]]
**[[Authority Commander]]
**[[Cala-Mariner]]
**[[Jade Vigil's Weave]]
**[[Titanslayer's Adornment]]
**[[Titus's Raiment]]
*[[Kyrsan Medallions]] (Itemized)
*[[Ardour Manifestation]]
*[[Void Feather]]s (Craft it into 3 [[Dark Feather]]s then bank it instead)
*[[Deepshore Fossil]]
*Tools (Repair Hammer, Glider, Etc.)
*Campfires (Store wood instead)
*[[Hallowtide Mask]]
*[[Attunement Potions]] / [[Lotuses]]
*[[Poser's Ring]]
*[[Manor Key]]
*[[Orlandeau's Emerald]]
*[[Pleeksty's Inferno]]
*[[Mantle of Enmity]]

===Account===
Accessing your account will allow you to bank your notes, up to the max of 100,000. However the transaction of notes between slots depend on your level and trading cap (at level 1 you cannot accept more than 940 notes). The banker will inform you of the notes that you have, and will ask if you want to deposit or withdraw. 

==Artifacts==
Players can also give [[artifacts]] to banker NPCs, and in return the player will receive 200 notes and other moderate items, as rare armor, mantra ingredients, weapons, armor schematics, and some XP (the equipment that given can be rarely enchanted).

'''Note: Artifacts can only be turned in via normal bankers, not the ones in your Guild Base.'''

title: Barrel
content:
::''Not to be confused with the weapon, [[The Barrel]].''

[[File:Barrel.png|thumb|A standard Barrel|300px]]
__toc__
==Description==
Barrels are interactable objects that can be picked up, carried, and placed almost anywhere. They are commonly found throughout Lumen and serve a variety of practical purposes.

==Uses==
===Handy Tactics===
Barrels can be used as step stools to gain extra height when the players [[Agility]] is not high enough to reach certain areas. They can also be placed on the ocean’s surface and used as platforms for campfires, allowing players to rest while at sea.

Barrels can be stacked on top of each other to create ladders for areas that would be inaccessible otherwise. This can be done by standing on a placed Barrel and then dropping another near its edge, or by jumping and placing a Barrel midair.

===Barrel Constructions===
Barrels can be stacked in many creative ways beyond simple towers. Players have constructed Barrel tanks, Barrel helicopters, and even by exploiting the game’s physics, '''Barrel launchpads'''. These constructions are typically made by building a three-Barrel tower, removing the lowest Barrel, and building outward from there. Caution is advised though, being launched too fast, too far, or too high can result in death or, in rare cases, a false ban by anti-cheat. Aside from these risks, Barrel constructions are generally safe and serve as a fun activity for bored guilds.

</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Ginormous Barrels bigger than the player can be found at [[The Hidden Village]] and the [[Beloved Zofia]].
*There was an infamous moment of time where green Barrels would spawn throughout [[The Aratel Sea]]. This came from the now cut [[Cut Content#Other|Smuggler Investigation]] mission given by the [[Authority Ensign]] [[Origin]].
*As of June 24th 2026, there were counted in-game to be '''516''' Barrels in the [[Eastern Luminant]], featuring '''21''' unique sizes of Barrels, and '''330''' Barrels in the [[Etrean Luminant]], featuring '''18''' unique sizes of Barrels.
*As of June 25th 2026, there were counted in-game to be '''902''' Barrels in the [[First Layer]] of [[The Depths]], featuring '''9''' unique sizes of Barrels. '''794''' were within the [[City of the Drowned]], while '''108''' were located outside of it.
*Totaling these numbers, there are '''~1,750''' Barrels across the Etrean and Eastern Luminants and the First Layer.

title: Battle Royale
content: {{Location|name=Battle Royale|caption=Starting from scratch, warriors from across Lumen compete to be the last one standing!}} [[File:Kingmaker's Isle.png|center|thumb|900px|Kingmaker's Isle, the unforgiving grounds of Battle Royale, where fresh starts are mandatory and mercy is nowhere to be found]] ==Description== '''Battle Royale''' is a [[World Events|World Event]] that takes place on [[Kingmaker's Isle]] in the [[Open Sea]]. Players spawn with nothing but the bare essentials and must jump off from [[The Floating Keep]] into [[Kingmaker's Isle]] to gather loot, [[Talents]], [[Mantras]] and more to fight their way through the rest to be the last person standing. ==Mechanics== *A shrinking zone similar to the one seen in [[Chime of Conflict]] is always present and functions as such, and is referred to as "the storm". It always closes in on a random location. *You cannot bring a character slot, and instead spawn with a fresh character with a randomized [[Aspects|Aspect]], a [[Gliders|Flimsy Glider]], the {{t|Callout}} [[Talents|Talent]], a [[Sword]], the [[Stranded]] [[Outfits|Outfit]], and fixed [[Attributes]]. **These Attributes are: 50 on every Core Attribute, 100 on every Weapon Attribute and 50 on every Attunement Attribute. *Loot can be found scattered around the map in set locations, with better loot closer to the edge of the map. *[[Talents]] and [[Mantras]] have to be obtained from Deep Totems. *[[Oaths]] are obtained by consuming 3 [[Oath Shards]], which will give you a random Oath, with further Oath Shards progressing your given Oath. All Oaths are available except [[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]], [[Oath: Silentheart|Silentheart]], [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]], and [[Oath: Saintsworn|Saintsworn]]. *You steal all of your opponent's [[Talents]], [[Mantras]] and [[Oaths|Oath]] (if you didn't already have one) upon executing them. *Every once in a while a [[Random Encounters#Resonant_Dawn|Resonant Dawn Meteor]] will fall on a random location that will grant a random [[Resonance]] (no healthpack) to the player that interacts with it, however this takes a while as it locks the user in a lengthy animation in which they cannot act and can be interrupted by other players via damage, making them have to interact with it again if interrupted. **Battle Royale's Resonant Dawn does not spawn a [[Star Knight]]. *Dying will set you to spectate your killer, letting you switch around who to spectate or to return to the Battle Royale lobby. *Reward Eligibility begins when there is at least 20 players in a Battle Royale match. **Obtaining 5 points will award you with a [[Shiva's Codex]] and 2 [[Crowns]]. **Winning will award you with a [[Shiva's Finger]], [[Shiva's Codex]], and 2 [[Crowns]]. *The game "ends" once there is only one group standing. ==Locations== ===[[Kingmaker's Isle]]=== The very map of Battle Royale. In-between sections there is a small town, with plenty of houses. *'''Highly abundant loot, making it a hotspot for looters and fighters.''' ===[[King's Colosseum]]=== A large open colosseum at the center point of the map. *'''Far too little loot and far too much open space, making players near it highly vulnerable.''' ===[[Pillar Peak]]=== A giant temple, near King's Colosseum. *'''Handful of loot, both inside, on the roof, and on a nearby pillar.''' ===[[Hall of Heroes]]=== Another temple opposite of Pillar Peak, with large statues of figures. *'''Decent amount of loot all throughout, with the many trees and structures allowing you to sneak by.''' ===[[Yarix Yard]]=== On the edge of a cliff near the King's Colosseum and Pillar Peak, a small market is located. '''Has a fair amount of loot for its small size, but it can get drained quickly.''' ===[[Valiant Valley]]=== A large valley on the outskirts of the map, featuring many [[Lifevents]] and cliffs. *'''Lacking loot with dead ends and much ground to run on.''' === [[Mount Mavros]] === Higher up within the mountains is Mount Mavros, a small section with a few houses and many cliffs. *'''Medium amount of loot, with tight spaces for combat.''' ===[[Open Sea]] (Coastal areas)=== A small dock rests on the coast, closer to sea level. *'''Abundant loot, but no Healing Orbs and it either tends to get crowded near the end-game or closes you off from the rest.''' ==Loot== ===Chests=== *Gray chests contain [[Outfits#Expert|Expert Outfits]], with the Outfit's name above them. *Orange chests contain [[Outfits#Master|Master Outfits]], with the Outfit's name above them. *Regular chests contain all [[Equipment]] types and [[Oath Shards]]. ===Deep Totems=== Deep Totems are interactable entities that resemble [[Deep Shrines]], albeit much smaller, and are the main way to get [[Talents]] and [[Mantras]]. Interacting with them will lock you in a brief animation before giving you its contents. *Regular/gray Totems give random Common Talents. *Red colored Totems give random {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talents. *Purple colored Totems give random Mantras. ===Healing Orbs=== Green orbs floating above small pedestals can be found around the map, interacting with these will heal you for 20% of your health after a brief action-locking animation, similarly to Deep Totems. ===Weapons=== All of the game's [[Weapons]] can be found scattered around the map, interacting with one will give you a confirmation prompt to equip it. ==Gallery== File:Kingmaker's_Isle.png|Kingmaker's Isle File:King's_Colosseum.png|King's Colosseum File:Pillar_Peak.png|Pillar Peak File:Valiant_Valley.png|Valiant Valley File:Mount_Mavros.png|Mount Mavros File:BattleRoyaleHallowtide.png|Battle Royale during Hallowtide 2023 ==Trivia== *The music for this mode's loading screen is [[Blood And Thunder]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]. *Every location on the map is territory of [[The Hundred Legions]]. This is because Battle Royale takes place in the [[Luminants#Western_Luminant|Western Luminant]]. *If you spawn with the [[Tiran]] [[Aspects|Aspect]] you still gain the Feathered Glider, which retains its infinite uses and falls slower than the Flimsy Glider. *Battle Royale was originally only accessible to Deepwoken YouTubers during the Content Creator Royale on July 1st, 2023 and it was released to the public on August 25th, 2023 for limited-time testing. *According to Agamatsu in his stream "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eWXZPkM0Xpo&t=7909s Official Deepwoken Youtuber Battle Royale]", the developers were supposedly debating whether or not to make this game mode public due to it potentially "being too much fun" and killing off the main game, thus they decided to restrict the game mode to only weekends. *It is possible to steal an opponent's oath talents and/or passives if they're your first kill (and before you use any oath shards). This can be used to obtain talents like [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred's]] Death from Above and Wings passive, while obtaining a seperate oath like [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]]. *Surprisingly, regalias aren't disabled in Battle Royale, meaning that characters have a small chance to obtain regalias like Ancient Soul to gain a massive advantage over anybody else early game. The Beast Whistle is an item granted upon completing [[Sordino]]'s quest. It allows you to summon your [[mounts]] virtually anywhere provided there is solid ground. This includes but is not limited to the Overworld, Depths, and even Dungeons, so long as you are not in combat. The {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} is ruthless, and the fact they've been able to proceed with their actions without consequence is disgusting. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Acting sympathetic won't change anything, ''{{g|Pathfinders|Pathfinder}}''. Taking the fight to their home-turf, Fort Merit. You {{g|Pathfinders|Pathfinders}} have already done a great deal to save the Etrean prisoners from the prison complex, but for the town itself it remains unharmed. Attacking their barracks doesn't change that they still can function normally. Their town should be next. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Very well. I can assist in the fight. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Whatever. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Surprising to hear, {{g|Pathfinders|Pathfinder}}. You're courageously foolish, you know that? When you're ready.. come to the Fort, and we'll take them on. Rendezvous with me back here once we're done, alright? {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*She scowls at you.*'' Change will come. No matter the cost. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], Quest Accepted {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Quest End= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Mmm.. the wind's calm today. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Siege completed] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Siege not completed] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Are you satisfied? It brings me at least some peace, I suppose... {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}The main town of Fort Merit. == Description ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a [[Twinblades|Twinblade]] weapon in the Medium category. The weapon is covered in round bells with cracked blades made from [[Arkasid|Arkasids]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">Bellmarrow.gif</gallery>

The user twirls the blade around before summoning a rain of bells directly above the target. This hits 7 times, with each hit having a '''0.3x''' scaled damage multiplier. These bells will inflict [[Ironsing]] rods on each of the 7 hits, and will '''autogrip''' the target if they are knocked or at low health.

The critical has a cooldown of '''8 seconds'''.
