title: Beloved Zofia
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Beloved Zofia|area=Voidzone|caption=An abandoned ship lost to time, now corrupted by the spirits of the Voidsea.}}
[[File:Beloved Zofia.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Overview ==
The '''Beloved Zofia''' is a wrecked ship found in the [[Voidsea]] behind [[Minityrsa]]. The ship is similar in appearance to [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]], where the [[Tutorial]] takes place.

== Contents ==
=== [[The Dreadstar]] ===
*Required to speak to for the obtainment of [[Oath: Silentheart|Silentheart]].

=== Ghosts ===
A ghost can appear at the ship's helm. If the player has killed no one, the ghost says, "Remember the dead." However, if the player has killed anyone, the ghost says, "...Did you think we'd forget?" and four weak, short-lived apparitions attack. 
* Speaking to a ghost and fighting them is required for the completion of [[Suyuan]]'s [[Quests|Quest]].

== Potential Enemies ==
{{EnemyGallery
|BrainsuckerIcon.png|Brainsucker
|Kaijufinal.png|Dread Serpent
|Ghost.png|Ghost
|LionfishIcon.png|Lionfish
}}

== Location ==
The Beloved Zofia can be found by hugging the Minityrsa wall and making a left turn at its corner. After turning, keep going straight until the ship is spotted.
<gallery>
Belovedzosiamap.png|Viewpoint on the Map:
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
*While the ''Beloved Zofia'' is not the ship in the tutorial, they share similar - if not the exact same model. The Beloved Zofia is just a slanted version of the [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]]. This is likely just due to them both being the same make of ship.
*The ship is named after the [[w:c:fireemblem:Beloved Zofia|Beloved Zofia]], the signature weapon of Celica in ''Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.''

[[File:BestiaryScreen.png|thumb|Bestiary window]] [[File:SharkoBestiaryFull.png|thumb|Megalodaunt's Bestiary entry with all challenges completed]] ==Description== The Bestiary is a part of Deepwoken's Encyclopedia system along with the [[Glossary]]. The Bestiary can be accessed by clicking the book icon labeled "Encyclopedia" at the top left of the screen. The Bestiary grants a damage and defense bonus against monsters and bosses upon completing challenges. Upon defeating eligible [[Monsters]] or [[Bosses]], they will be added to the Bestiary, which tracks progress by showing how many times each has been slain. Defeating the same monster type 10, 25, and 100 times grants increasing damage and defense bonuses against that monster, as well as unlocking bits of lore about it. Defeating the same boss 10 times grants damage and defense buffs against the boss, as well as lore entries. Currently, the Bestiary contains entries for 19 monsters and 10 bosses. Encyclopedia Icon (closed).png|Encyclopedia icon Encyclopedia Icon (open).png|Opened Encyclopedia ==Notes== *Bestiary progress is saved across all slots and the bonuses apply to all slots regardless of your level. *Monster variants count towards and benefit from the original monster's Bestiary. This goes for bosses as well. **For example, defeating a [[King Thresher]] or [[Nightmare Thresher]] will award +1 kill towards the Thresher Bestiary completion, and having progress on the Thresher Bestiary will grant additional damage to these variants as well. *The bonuses tied to each Bestiary entry is '''only applied to that specific enemy''', meaning if you defeat a Brainsucker 100 times, it won't grant you increased damage against Megalodaunts and vice versa. Not even the boss Bestiary buffs are universally applied! *{{cl|corrupted|Corrupt}} Monsters count as '''2 kills''' instead of 1. *'Resilient' Monsters (such as [[Enforcer]]s or [[Bounder]]s) have halved damage and resistance bonuses. **While most monsters are +10% damage/5% resistance per milestone, totaling to +30% damage and +15% resistance, 'resilient' monsters only grant +5% damage and +2.5% resistance per milestone, totaling to +15% damage and +7.5% resistance. ==Bestiary Challenges== ===Monster Tasks=== {| class="article-table fandom-table mw-collapsible" style="width=100%" |+ !

==Description==
The Big Brother is a LHT weapon in the Dagger category that can be obtained by maxing out the Inquisitor division under the [[Authority Ensign]] origin.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Swift Strike}} procs when you land an M1 on your opponent's back, granting the {{status|Swift Strike}} status effect for an indefinite duration. This status effect changes your next critical attack into a teleporting backstab attack that procs all [[Talents#Assassin|assassination]] Talents and deals percentage based damage.

This has a 20 second cooldown. Using the Swift Strike-enhanced critical consumes the status effect.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BasicDagger.gif|Base critical without Talent
File:Critical followup (with talent).gif|Critical with Swift Strike Talent
</gallery>Big Brother uses the default Dagger critical, a series of 3 quick slashes. The first hit has a scaled damage multiplier of '''1x''', while the second and third have a scaled damage multiplier of '''0.8x'''.

When landing an M1 on your opponent's back, apply the Swift Strike Status effect, drastically changing your critical attack. On critical, the user briefly flashes out of the frame before reappearing behind their opponent's backs and deeply gashing them. Deals percentage based damage and procs all [[Talents#Assassin|assassination]] Talents.

The default Dagger critical has a cooldown of '''3 seconds''', while the Swift Strike Talent has a cooldown of '''20 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Big Brother Full.png|Full view
</gallery>

==Trivia== 
*Its name is a direct reference to the fictional character "Big Brother" from the novel ''Nineteen Eighty-Four'' by George Orwell, signifying the concept of constant, oppressive governmental or authoritative surveillance and control over a population.
*Swift Strike is not a "critical," meaning things such as [[Warmaster's Medallion]] or {{t|Critical Engine}} with [[Blessed Gem]] cannot reduce its cooldown.

== Description ==
The '''Black Death''' is the sister of its [[Red Death|red counterpart]], a tool of the Ministry which does not care about the mess it leaves behind.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Corporeal Dissolution}} applies {{status|Wither}} on any weapon attack that drains Ether, with the amount applied scaling on the amount of Ether drained. This is capped at 10 Wither per proc.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BlackDeathStanding.gif|Standing Critical
File:BlackDeathRunning.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>The Black Death has two criticals.

For the standing critical, the user raises the spear, summoning six stakes of shadow wherever the user is facing. These stakes solely inflict Shadow.

For the running critical, the user rapidly thrusts the spear while slowly moving forward, ending with a final blow that inflicts Shadow. The user then raises their hand, summoning three stakes that also inflict Shadow.

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''8 seconds.'''

{{text|m1leg2}}

==Trivia==
* Unlike the '''Red Death''' which is refered to as a spear, the '''Black Death''' is refered to as a pike.
* Before the limit on the amount of Wither its Talent could apply per proc, stacking enough ether drain effect could result in large amount of Wither being applied in one hit, sometimes outright one shotting players by turning their entire health bar into Wither.

{{History}}

Their appearance consists of the [[Black Diver]] Outfit and a randomized [[Aspects|Aspect]]. == Moveset == A Black Diver's arsenal consists of either a [[Forgotten Gladius]], [[Markor's Inheritor]] or [[Pale Morning]] which can be [[Enchantments|Enchanted]] along with either the [[Thundercall]] or [[Galebreathe]] attunement and the [[Oath: Dawnwalker|Dawnwalker]] [[Oaths|Oath]]. * Only used by Ambush variant and Tideknight variant.

*Pale Morning and Markor's Inheritor criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |

(★★★) |User leaps into the air before crashing down with the power of light. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |} === Talents === *Battle Tendency - Black Divers recover posture 20% faster. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Brick Wall}} - Black Divers are immune to all form of ragdolls, beside being knocked. Knockdowns duration are reduced by 30% *Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor - Black Divers Lightning mantras apply Surge instead of Shock. At maximum stack, target become Overloaded, which sends arcs of lightning in all directions. *Braced Collapse - Black Divers take reduced damage from the next hit they take after being guard broken. *{{cl|raretlnf|Showstopper}} - Black Divers stomp the grounds when an attack is dodged, dazing those nearby. *Strong Stern - Black Divers are Dazed for half the time if wall banged. *Perseverance - Black Divers wake up from being knocked faster. *Underdog - Black Divers deal more against enemies with more HP than them. They also deal +10% more damage to Monsters. *{{cl|raretlnf|Defiance}} - Negative Status effects are halved when Black Divers are below 35% HP. *Last Resort - Black Divers gain +10% damage while below 25% HP. *Steady Footing - Black Divers resist knockback effects and do not slide on ice. *Suffocating Impact - Black Divers apply Suffocation and Winded after a wall bang. *Heavy Hitter - Black Divers deal +10% posture damage with heavy weapon basic attacks. *{{cl|raretlnf|Concussion}} - Being flourished into a wall by a Black Diver alter vision and Daze for longer. *Static Link - Black Divers landing a Flourish or Uppercut apply a static link. *Storm Link - Black Divers apply Shock (Surge because of Surge Path) to enemies with a static link if hit with a Wind mantra. *{{cl|raretlnf|Chronostasis}} - Black Divers put target's Resonance on a short cooldown when they land hits. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Protagonist Syndrome}} - The grasp of shadow is meaningless in the face of the Black Diver's blinding light. The Black Diver's Dawnwalker mantras are empowered after being hit by Shadowcast. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Luminous Flash}} - After dealing a certain amount of damage while in "Absolute Radiance", the Black Diver gains a chance to empower their strikes with pure light. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Absolute Radiance}} - Dealing damage with Dawnwalker mantras briefly makes the Black Diver's immune to all elemental effects for a short period. == Finisher == A Black Diver executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" ! Name !Description |- |Execute |[⁣[[Forgotten Gladius]]] Pins down opponent before impaling the opponent's chest with their spear. [⁣[[Markor's Inheritor]] & [[Pale Morning]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. |} == Tips == * Fight them like any other humanoid NPC with a weapon. * Their wide moveset requires a bit of getting used to. Thankfully, these NPCS aren't very common. * Remember that killing these guys will take some time; they have 10,000 health. * Can take on most [[Monsters]] in [[The Depths]] due to their (fittingly) large health pool. == Gallery == File:BlackDiverNPC2.png|With an enchanted Weapon == Trivia == *Originally, Black Divers replaced the Divers Guards at Castle Light to improve its safety, they were however replaced with [[Journeymen Diver|Journeymen Divers]] on January 16th, 2023 due to their presence contradicting the established low number and high power level of actual Black Divers. **They then went unused until the May 15th, 2023 update, which brought [[Faction Ambushes]], which reintroduced them as part of high level ambushes. *If you talk to one in [[The Understrand]], they will begin attacking you as the only way you can find one there is if you have bad [[Reputation]] with The Divers. *They are one of the few enemies that use [[Oaths]], with the other enemies being the [[Ignition Union Arcwarder]], [[Subtle Knife of Eylis]], [[Old Knife of Eylis]], [[Ministry Enforcer]], and [[Iblis, The Fallen Angel|all]] [[Abaddon, Sinner of Ice|four]] [[Minos, Sinner of Flame|Starkindred]] [[Astaroth, Sinner of Wind|enemies]]. *They use both variants of [[Thundercall|Jolt Grab]], that being the Magnet Spark variant and the base version. *Curiously, [[The Hundred Legions]] are hostile towards them. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Enemies with Oaths]] [[Category:Diver Enemies]] [[Category:Black Divers]]

title: Black Divers division
content:
{{Spoiler}} {{Factions |image1=Silhouette.jpg |leader=*[[Deukalion Akarad]] (deceased){{Ref/Book|The Song of Fathoms / Oscillation}}
*[[The High Convocation]] |territory=[[The Depths]], [[Castle Light]] |goals=*Exploring and setting up bases in [[the Depths]].
*Sending expeditions to the the Depths.}} __TOC__ ==Description== '''The Black Diver Division''' are the highest rank of [[the Divers]]. The division was formed some time between 57 CE and 59 CE as the Citadel Divers' senior members evolved into their own rank. While [[The Citadel of Markor|the Citadel]] was actively recruiting, Black Diver agents would be sent on surface missions around the [[Luminants#Central Luminant|Central Luminant]], with the goal of potentially finding a cave system that would physically connect to [[the Depths]]. In 1272 CE{{Deep dates|Verse2}} [[Chaser]], a Black Diver, betrayed [[the Divers]]. Chaser sided with [[the Ministry]] and killed all Divers participating in the expedition to the [[Second Layer]]. ==Members== '''[[Deukalion Akarad]]''': A member of [[the Divers]], active shortly after its founding. Akarad was the first leader of the Black Divers and was known to Diver recruits as "father Diver". Akarad was among those who perished during the first Depths expedition of [[the Divers]], though his notes were able to reach [[Surface|the Surface]]. '''[[Akira]]:''' An [[Etrean]] with the rank of Black Diver. He has been a part of the organization for almost 10 years now. He wields a katana and possess a [[Resonance]] in the form of a bell, granting him the ability to explode the heads of his foes. This bell is corrupted, with every use taking from his lifespan. The time taken, if it even drains in time, rather than from a pool of his lifeforce, scales on the strength of those it is used on, allowing him to use it on lots of weak enemies with little consequences. He can be found in [[the Depths]] by a tree and a ruined building, reading his book. He will be interrupted by a group of Ignition Union workers, whom he disposes of with relative ease using his Resonance. The player can talk to him and, with the right dialogue options, be allowed to join [[The Divers]] [[Guilds|Guild]] and unlock the [[Deepbound]] [[Origins|Origin]] if they can reach him at [[Castle Light]]. '''[[Amorus Pleeksty]]:''' As a former Black Diver, Pleeksty still kept loose connections with the Divers but mainly pursued his individual research until he went missing. He is most likely residing currently in the Third Layer of [[The Depths]], also known as The Vents. In his time as a Black Diver, he was the first to venture into the Third Layer (and currently is the only one that has done so) and consumed a part of the Drowned God of Fire, [[Korilfiend, the Inferno's Provenance|Korilfiend]], in the form of a flower, causing him to become a '''[[Deepwoken]]''' and ascend to a near-godlike state. This newfound enlightenment allowed him to become the first true [[Flamecharm]]er, refining the art of pyromancy into what is commonly used today. He would then go on to establish a group known as “[[The Covenant of Flame]]”, a group of passionate [[Flamecharm]]ers who wish to follow the same path as Amorus Pleeksty, almost religiously studying his books and practicing his teachings such as the [[Talents#Amoran Seeker|Flame Within]]. Pleeksty, however, has come to think little of them, only now seeing them as a fan club. He would later join [[the Divers]] but would disappear into the Vents once more. Despite his tremendous power and age, he is described as a "chill" guy; if anyone encounters him, Pleeksty will most likely be very amicable. '''[[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]:''' Chaser is an [[Adret]] Black Diver who secretly possesses the gift of hemokinesis, granted to him by the Second Prophet of [[the Ministry]] in order to achieve his true goals. He was a Black Diver that volunteered to lead an expedition into the Second Layer but would later reveal that he had betrayed the Divers long ago. With the assistance of the native [[Kyrsgarde]], Chaser murdered all the Divers who went with him in the original expedition he was a part of.{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Apprentice Azel}} He then slaughtered the other Divers that were involved in expeditions following that one.{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Journeyman Skeli}}{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Apprentice Hero}} The players later encounter him as the boss of the First Floor of the Second Layer. He is for all intents and purposes Ministry aligned, having been a man on the inside for them for years, though had genuinely been a Diver at the start. '''[[Funke, Master of Thunder]] and [[Nell, Master of Frost]]:''' Funke and Nell wear Black Diver uniforms. Nell can be found at [[Etris]] and Funke at [[Summer Isle]]. Not a lot is known about these two and the reason behind being stationed on the surface, as there is no dialogue or a way to ask them about it. '''[[Carrion, Father of Evolution]] (Dr. Diver):''' Carrion (also referred to as “Dr Diver”) is a [[Ganymede]] Black Diver who is very skilled in terms of alchemy and science, being able to give people the abilities of certain [[monsters]] at the cost of the corresponding creature’s organs. Despite being a Black Diver, he is also the leader of The Apothecary, a group based on the creation and research of potions and some other scientific topics. This branch was later excommunicated from the Divers due to the actions of an undisclosed individual. He is not a combatant, rather a scientist. His objective is to create the Moonseye Vigor and be able to "transcend" everyone by drinking this potion. Carrion already drank a prototype of the Moonseye Vigor, which drove him to insanity, along with giving him green eyes. He is currently residing in Castle Light but can also be seen in [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|the Great Library of New Kyrsa]], probably researching to create a new Moonseye Vigor. Apparently, he doesn't care much for the events of [[Second Layer|The Second Layer]], instead choosing to prioritize his research of the Vigor rather than preventing the awakening of a drowned god that could destroy [[Lumen]]. This characteristic, alongside Klaris’ dialogue about him, tells us that Carrion prioritizes his research above everything else, giving little to no care about any major events in the game that doesn't assist his studies. ==Trivia== ==References== [[Category:The Divers]] [[Category:Black Divers]]

content:
{{Quotes|quote=Oh? Did you need something?|author=Blacksmith}} {{NPCInfobox |image1= File:Caragan.png|Etris File:Baragan.png|Isle of Vigils File:CastleLightBlacksmith.png|Castle Light File:VoidheartBlacksmith.png|Voidheart File:Guild base blacksmith.png|Guild Base File:Summer Isle blacksmith.png|Summer Isle File:Greathive Aratel Blacksmith.png|Greathive Aratel File:Fort Merit Blacksmith.png|Fort Merit File:Meteor Isle blacksmith.png|Meteor Isle File:Rudral.png|Miner's landing File:Louie Spellhardt.png|Floating Keep |name= *Etris: [[Caragan]] *Isle of Vigils: [[Baragan]] *Miner's Landing: [[Rudral]] *The Floating Keep: [[Louie Spellhardt]] |aspect=*Etrean *Vesperian *Chrysid *Capra *Gremor *Lightborn *Celtor |location= *[[Etris]] *[[Isle of Vigils]] *[[Summer Isle]] *[[Greathive Aratel]] *[[Fort Merit]] *[[Miner's Landing]] *[[Meteor Isle]] *[[Castle Light]] *[[The Floating Keep]] *[[Voidheart]] *[[Guild Bases]] |pronouns=He/him }} ==Description== {{PAGENAME}} are stationary NPCs found in numerous towns across Lumen. They are the primary station used to craft and manage [[Outfits]]. They are also the leading source of [[Cloth]] and [[Fiber]], essential to craft Outfits, as well as selling utility tools. Blacksmiths have 3 functions: opening the [[Outfits]] menu, crafting [[Seasonal Medals]], and exchanging [[Ore|Pure Ores]] for moderate-tier loot. Additionally, they sell: *[[Cloth]] for {{c|notes|6}} *[[Fiber]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Coal]] for {{c|notes|15}} *[[Pickaxe]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Lumber Axe]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Flint]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Ores|Iron]] for {{c|notes|20}} *[[Ores|Gold]] for {{c|notes|50}} Blacksmiths will refuse to service the player if their [[reputation]] is too low with the faction of the location they're at. ===To craft an outfit=== *The blue highlighted text is the schematics you have on hand, if you press '''Learn''', the outfit will move to the recipe that it belongs to. * An outfit recipe retains the requirements, stats, Talent description (if it has a Talent) as well as the outfit description. *If you have multiple crafted outfits, the current one will be an orange color while the rest will be a bolded white. *Repairing durability is free. ====Transmogging outfits==== ''More info: [[Transmogrification]]'' *If you have more than one outfit crafted, pressing '''Transmog''' will allow you to transmogrify currently equipped outfit with any other outfit you've crafted, wearing the '''appearance''' of the selected outfit but keeping the '''stats''' of your currently equipped one. [[File:Transmog UI 222.png|thumb|none]] ===To turn in pure ores=== *Press the second option with a pure ore in hand. ** Pure Iron is not able to be turned in. **Erisore chests are the plain wooden chests, and they usually give blindfolds among other Erisia loot. **If you turn in a pure ore 5 times, you get the excavator Talent. ===Craft event items with Knowledge=== * You are able to craft limited-time items using [[Knowledge]] if you bought [[Seasonal Medals]] during a [[Events|Deepwoken event]], such as Hallowtide Medals 22, 23 and 24 from [[Lysander Spellhardt]] during Hallowtide. You can also craft the [[Party Hat]] obtained by joining during the [[Festival of a Billion Souls]] mini event in 2024. ** You can craft outfits, weapons, and even enchants and mantras that were from these events. ==Shop== {{ShopTable|newtable|newset |title=Smithy's Supplies |name=Cloth |currency=Notes |price=6 |desc=Useful for a bit of tailoring. }} {{ShopTable |name=Fiber |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=Spun into thread or woven into cloth for tailoring. }} {{ShopTable| |name=Coal |currency=Notes |price=15 |desc=Used for fuel and in the production of steel. }} {{ShopTable| |name=Iron |currency=Notes |price=20 |desc=A crucial ore in blacksmithing, foundational to hundreds of alloys. }} {{ShopTable|end |name=Gold |currency=Notes |price=50 |desc=A rare and precious ore found deep beneath the ground. }} {{ShopTable|newtable|inset |title=Smithy's Tools |name=Pickaxe |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=You'll be needing one to get the ores for stronger armor. }} {{ShopTable |name=Lumber Axe |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=A sturdy axe for felling trees. }} {{ShopTable|end|endset |name=Flint |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=A sharp flint and a scrap of pyrite used for starting fires. }} ==Dialogue== |-|Base Dialogue= {{#tag:tabber|Good & Neutral Reputation= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Oh? title: Blacksteel Pirate
content:
{{EnemyInfobox|title1=Blacksteel Pirate|health=420|drops=*[[Blacksteel Helm]] *[[Blacksteel Pauldrons]] *[[Darksteel Greatsword]]|weapon=*[[Darksteel Greatsword]] *[[Battleaxe]] *[[Sword]] *[[Messer]] *[[Mace]]|moves=*Strong Left *Rapid Punches *Shadow Assault *Pressure Blast *Exhaustion Strike|image1=Blacksteel pirate.png|caption1=I could've been a hero…}} ==Description== Blacksteel Pirates can be found in [[The Etrean Sea]]. They spawn in groups of 5 in the [[Random Encounters|Water Tower event]] and can be encountered on islands during Sea Events in groups of five or four depending on the island. They wear a [[Darksteel Plate]] and a dyed black [[Silver Knight's Helm]]. ==Moves == Their arsenal consists of either a [[Darksteel Greatsword]], [[Battleaxe]], [[Sword]] or a [[Mace]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. [[[Sword]]] Performs a windup before thrusting blade forward.
[[[Darksteel Greatsword]]] Enters a stance before rushing forward and performing a quick upward strike. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. Darksteel Greatsword critical deals high posture damage. *Battleaxe critical has hyperarmor during the windup animation. Darksteel Greatsword critical has true hyperarmor during the full animation. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Strong Left'''
(★★☆) |A powerful, flinging punch that shatters the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Rapid Punches'''
(★★☆) |User unleashes a barrage of blows at their opponent. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Shadow Assault'''
(★★☆) |Windup before turning invisible and dashing forward, dealing very minor damage to anyone in front of caster while applying darkness. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement }} |- |
'''Pressure Blast'''
(★★☆) |A heavy downwards swing that cleaves through the air, sending out 3 large blasts of air that ragdoll and knockback. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Exhaustion Strike'''
(★☆☆) |A melee strike that transfers their posture damage on hit. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Talents === * {{cl|raretlnf|Bulldozer}} - Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact. * Shield Breaker - Blunt damage now deals full posture damage to shields. * Unwavering Resolve - Getting parried punishes your posture 50% less. * Bear Trap - Landing a hit with your critical against an opponent makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Also slows your opponent. * Fear the Dark - Enemies will briefly hang in place when they run from you. * Uproar - When hit 3 or more times within 3 seconds go into an uproar where you cannot be stunned for a short duration. Landing a hit on another player will end your Uproar. == Finisher== A Blacksteel pirate executes the player after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Battleaxe]], [[Darksteel Greatsword]] & [[Mace]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. [[[Sword]] & [[Messer]]] Pins down opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |- |Drown |Since they do not have the Fishman Talent, when you are knocked out in the water, they will spam mantras at you, eventually most likely drowning you in the water. It is possible to survive this with the help of Talents such as Scuba Drowner and Impervious Slumber. |} ==Tips== *The Darksteel Greatsword Blacksteel Pirates pose the biggest threat to rookie players; only engage if you know how to parry the critical. *They essentially act as very much high-risk reward types for lower-level players who want to earn exp and items quickly. *They may be more difficult than bandits as if you don't know how to parry, you will get combo'ed. *If you grip them close to the wooden tower, the other Blacksteel Pirates will be alerted, and you might get interrupted. Instead, carry the Blacksteel Pirate's body into the ocean; they will drown, and any other Blacksteel Pirates will not be alerted. *Be extremely cautious if you are knocked out in the water, as Blacksteel Pirates will use Rapid Punches on your body even if you are knocked out in the water, which you end up drowning. Even if you have Scuba Drowner, the Blacksteel Pirates will still use Rapid Punches even if your knocked out reducing your odds of survival to a bare minimum. ==Trivia== *Since they originate from below the ocean and they use [[Shadowcast]], they possibly are connected with [[The Depths]] or [[The Ministry]]. *The Tower Event drops 2 chests. First, at the top of the tower and the second can only be obtained when tower sinks as it is blocked by blocks. *They don't actually wear a [[Blacksteel Helm]] or [[Blacksteel Pauldrons]], despite being able to drop them and sharing their namesake, "Blacksteel". *If no one attacks the Wooden Tower, the Blacksteel Pirates will despawn, but the top of the tower will still spawn a chest and the Wooden Tower will sink. *The Wooden Tower can despawn while someone's actively fighting the pirates, not granting any XP and not spawning the chest at the bottom of the tower. *They strangely have the [[Cut Content#Uproar|now removed talent]] Uproar, which was removed on the 19th of Janurary 2025 update {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]]

They wear a [[Darksteel Plate]], a dyed black [[Silver Knight's Helm]], a Black [[Plain Cape]], and a pair of [[Blacksteel Pauldrons]]. ==Moves== Their arsenal consists of a [[Darkalloy Greatsword|{{cl|alloyed|Darkalloy Greatsword}}]] and the [[Shadowcast]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

(★★☆) |User leans and emits a giant cloud of shadow. It deals constant damage and ether drain per second to anyone who stands in it. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} ==Passives== *'''Perpetual Speed Boost''' - The Blacksteel Pirate Captain moves incredibly fast at all times. Running is not an option. ==Tips== *It is highly recommended that you take out all of the [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s first before attempting to fight the Blacksteel Pirate Captain. *As it is not required to kill them for the mission to complete, it may be more advisable to simply assassinate them or distract them using other enemies and then grab the hostage and run. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]]

title: Blade Instructor
content:
{{CutContent}} {{EnemyInfobox |title=Blade Instructor |image1=Blade Instructor.png |caption1=I am going to beat you to death |health=300 |drops=None |weapon=*[[Battleaxe]] *[[Sword]] *[[Mace]] *[[Iron Spear]] |moves=*Assault *Critical }} ==Description== The Instructor was an NPC that can only spawned in via sparring. To spawn him, the player had to talk to [[Das]], only then would an Instructor spawn. Instructors wore a [[Gladiator Helm]] and a [[Cloak of Winds]] outfit with their [[Aspects|aspect]] varying. With the introduction of [[Training Mode]], they were rendered obsolete and removed. ==Moveset== An Instructor's arsenal consisted of either a [[Battleaxe]], [[Sword]], [[Mace]] or [[Iron Spear]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. [[[Sword]]] Performs a windup before thrusting blade forward.
[[[Iron Spear]]] Enters a stance before performing a quick swipe with spear, will perform an additional short lunge if the first hit lands. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Feint'''
(★★☆) |Attacks, but then stops mid-way to catch the player off guard. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |} ==Finisher== If the Instructor is the one that downs the player they will disappear and the player will receive all of their health back, although they will not regain any blood. However, if the player is downed by any other means, the Instructor will grip the player like any other NPC. {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Disappear |Unequips weapon before disappearing into thin air. |} ==Trivia== *The Instructor could be killed by using moves that instantly grip opponents when they are on low HP, using certain moves, like Mani Katti, and employing burn. You could also grip him with help of the [[Poser's Ring]] with a [[Katana]] or [[Shattered Katana]], dealing enough damage and then sheathing your katana will knock him and you can grip him.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMiY1IgUpJo *The [[Blade Temple Guard]]s did not react should an Instructor be gripped near them. *Defeating one sometimes grants positive [[reputation]] with the [[Kingdom of Etrea]], usually when you don't get a health pack from killing them. *Gripping them would prompt them to say 'Hey, what do you think you're doing?!' *You could glitch an instructor by starting the spar and not doing anything at all. To fix it, you just needed to defeat them. *There was a secret text bubble that appears if the player is knocked due to hunger or other means while in a battle with him that says "Not bad, but not good enough," which could be due to the Instructor being meant to knock the player. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]]

[[Geta]] |innate stats={{stats|rarepip|3|a}} |description=Often worn by those who seek to perfect their martial skill with the blade, these robes trace their origins to ancient [[Etrean]] tradition, offering their wearer both comfort and mobility. Fragmented historical records suggest that this style of robe was highly preferred by [[Etrea]]n nobility. It is also said that the old Maestros - leaders of the [[Vigil of Winds]], - would wear similar robes during ceremonial occasions, and displays of their martial mastery. |obtainment=[[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] |requirements=LVL 12}} ==Description== The {{PAGENAME}} are an [[Equipment]] item under the "Arms" category. It is a traditional robe that is dropped by [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]]. ==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that applies burn to your opponent.

Blazing's flame particle color changes depending on your [[Flamecharm]] color, turning blue if you have {{t|Azure Flames}} or black if you have {{t|Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets}}.

==Effect==
After landing enough weapon hits, {{PAGENAME}} applies [[burn]] to your opponent on all weapon attacks for the next 5 seconds. This has a 10 second cooldown.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 3 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 2 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 1 hit for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*If you have {{t|Lava Serpent}}, this enchantment will proc Eruptions instead of applying burn. Eruptions have a 3 second cooldown.
*If you have {{t|Twisted Puppets}}, this enchantment will apply 'Puppet Burn,' spawning Puppets every 4 seconds and draining Ether.
*Like all other sources of [[burn]], Blazing's burn scales on your [[Flamecharm]] investment and is affected by all of your burn Talents.
**Base burn has a DPS of 8 at 0 Flamecharm, scaling up to 12 DPS at 100 Flamecharm. More information how Talents and other effects affect your burn damage can be found on the [[Flamecharm#Trivia|Flamecharm]] page.
*Blazing adds a separate instance of '''1''' flat Flamecharm damage to your attacks as hitregistry for burn. This procs even if Blazing hasn't procced yet and if your opponent is in burn immunity or your Eruptions are on cooldown.
**Because of this, you can use this enchantment to change your opponent's {{t|Everchanging Aegis}} type to Flamecharm resistance, allowing the first hit of your non-Flamecharm attuned attacks to deal 10% more damage against players using this Talent.
*This enchantment reduces the need for Talents that apply burn, such as {{t|Flaming Flourish}}, especially on heavy weapons.

content: {{ItemTemplate |image=Blessed Gem.png |value=80 |weight=1 |stack=25 |type=Deep Gem |rarity=Legendary |desc=A frequency emits from within like a choir... ---- On hit, reduces the cooldown of a Mantra by 50%. (5s CD) |obtainment= *[[Primadon]] *[[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] *[[Chaser]] *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[Ferryman]] *[[Lodestar|Lodestar Bounty]] job *{{lp|First Layer}} *[[Fishing]] *[[Cinders of Etris]] *[[Deep Crucible]] *[[Widow's Wail Cemetery#Trial of the Gourdskipper|Trial of the Gourdskipper]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *Found in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} *{{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} chests}} ==Description== The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a teal diamond-shaped [[Deep Gem]]. ==Effect== File:Blessed.gif Upon landing a Mantra with a Blessed Gem equipped, the cooldown of your Mantra will instantly be halved. If the Mantra only starts its cooldown once it ends, the cooldown will only be halved if the final part of the Mantra lands. This effect has a 5 second cooldown. ===Notes=== *This Gem is best used on high cooldown Mantras. *If you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} from the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]], {{PAGENAME}}'s cooldown reduction will be increased from -50% seconds to -66%. *Mantras with a 10 second base cooldown will have full efficiency with Blessed Gem, as they'll come off cooldown just as Blessed Gem does. **With the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}}, a 15 second cooldown Mantra will nearly have full efficiency with Blessed Gem, coming off cooldown just 0.1 seconds after Blessed Gem does. *[[Dread Whisper]] in specific is exceptionally good when paired with this Gem due to its gimmick requiring you to land it several times in a row. **On the other hand, Mantras that can reset their own cooldowns (e.g. [[Restrain]] or [[Slice 'n' Dice]]) will not be as good when paired with this Gem, it is highly recommended that you use a different Gem for them instead. *For usage with {{t|Critical Engine}}; **This Gem, naturally, halves your critical cooldown on hit. This is best used for criticals have have a cooldown of 10 seconds or higher. **You can pair this Gem with the [[Warmaster's Medallion]] to gain a total 55-60% cooldown reduction on your weapon critical, lowering a 25 second critical cooldown to 11.25-10 seconds. ***And when paired with the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}}, you'll have up to 69.4-72.8% cooldown reduction, lowering a 25 second critical cooldown to a mere 7.65-6.8 seconds. **Due to [[Mantle of Enmity]] counting as a critical attack for Talent effects, {{t|Critical Engine}} Blessed Gem can proc on it, though it will halve your regular critical cooldown instead of the Mantle's. ***This can be used to halve the cooldown of critical attacks that do not deal damage (e.g. [[Vortex Echo]] or [[The Weaving Web]]). **The critical cooldowns of certain weapons are not considered "critical cooldowns." For example, [[Big Brother]]'s Swift Strike Talent and [[Krulian Knife]]'s Krulian Charge critical will not have their cooldowns reduced if used with Blessed Gem {{t|Critical Engine}}. ==Crafting== This Gem can also be used to craft a variety of items. *[[Outfits]]: [[Authority Commander]] and [[Black Diver]]. {{History}} [[Category:Treasures]] [[Category:Mantras]] [[Category:Deep Gems]]

The {{PAGENAME}} is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Face" category.

content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure a swirling mass of chaotic energy that will drain the life out of your foes.|author=Blood Scourge description}}

==Description==
'''Blood Scourge''', also referred to as '''Reaper,''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll.
===''Appearance''===
When used, a red circle appears around the user or projectile. Any unconscious entities or players in this area are immediately gripped.
==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Blood Scourge''' Resonance. '''This combat tags the user.'''

'''Blood Scourge''' will near instantly execute any unconscious entity within it's range (even allies) and will recover some of the player's HP depending on the level and health of the target, occurs within a few seconds. It has a cooldown of about 20 seconds. The execution cannot be avoided once in range, unless the caster is attacked at the very start of the animation, or the target was picked up and moved out of the circle.

{{cl|corres|If Blood Scourge is corrupted, it can be charged by holding {{Input|keybind|resonance}}, which prevents the user from moving but sends all executed targets to The Depths. This roughly takes three seconds to charge. Can be negated if the user is hit while charging. Additionally, after executing a player with Corrupted Blood Scourge (regardless of charge), you will gain a 50% buff to incoming healing for 30 seconds.}}

==='''''Resonance Point usage'''''===
When obtained, Blood Scourge will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Thrown:''' If this stat is used, the player will launch a projectile ahead that then summons the AOE to grip entities. (The thrown version cannot be canceled)
*'''Range:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the further the range of the AOE becomes at the expense of a slower grip duration.
*'''Healing:''' The more points are spent on this stat; the more health given per grip.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
ReaperVariant1.png|Standing variant
ReaperVariant2.png|Throwing variant
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Blood Scourge Resonance does NOT give you hyperarmor while doing the animation, you can get cancelled while doing it if other players/NPCs attack you.
*Unlike the standing variant, throwable Blood Scourge cannot be cancelled.
*Shortly after the mechanic was added, Corrupted Blood Scourge could send people below Power 12 to The Depths. This was quickly patched.
*Most likely a reference to Dinakeri's/Wraith Knight's Soul Rip skill from Rogue Lineage, which itself is a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Dark_Hand|Dark Hand]] from the ''Dark Souls'' franchise.
*The sound that plays once using the Resonance originates from a 2012 meme: https://youtu.be/TS_VIVVmTTE?t=3

When equipped, even while its visibility is toggled off, the crown has swirling blood effects that are drawn towards the gem. ==Gallery== Bloodforged Crown Particles.gif|Particles Bloodforged anim.gif|Particles (Head Toggled) Better picture of bloodforged crown.png|Without Gremor Horns Bloodforged anim Dyed.gif| Particles (Dyed) ==Trivia== *The Bloodforged Crown is one of very few equipment to provide an Attunement-based Talent ([[Flamecharm]] in this case) without any stat requirements. *This [[Equipment]] piece shares the same innate stats as [[Celtor Commander Helm]]. *Goes great with [[Curse of the No Life King]] builds, due to the fact that the innate Talent decreases blood loss, one of No Life King's greatest weaknesses. **Be aware that NLK has heavily reduced effectiveness from both {{t|Cauterized Wounds}} and {{t|Alloyblood}}. *Due to its rarity, age, and prevalence within the trading community, this item is seen as the baseline item for trading, where the value of other items is often measured in comparison to the Bloodforged Crown. ==Description==
The Bloodfouler is a [[Weapons|Legendary Greatsword]]; a massive odachi that is as fearsome as it is long, commissioned by an unknown member of the Ministry during their training to one day become a prophet. The blade is well decorated in a crimson pattern, as well as its sheathe proving its intricate craft even more. It consists of a now worn, serrated blade and a hilt wrapped in scarlet cloth. The odachi sports decorative symbols along its make, and spikes that crop out opposite to the edge early into the blade's spine. It also comes with a strapped and black leather sheathe. 

The Bloodfouler scales off [[Attributes|Heavy Weapons]] alongside [[Bloodrend]]. The weapon can be acquired by retrieving three [[Strange Tomes]] from the following:

#[[Volu]], who is leaned against the wall in [[Outpost Antumbra]]'s basement.
#As a drop from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]].
#As a drop from [[The Understrand]] after defeating the [[Ministry Agent]].

When all three have been retrieved, they can be placed on the case that is right next to Volu, thus putting the Bloodfouler into your hands.

It can also be obtained as a direct drop from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]], as well as [[The Diluvian Mechanism]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Bloodfouler crit.gif|Standing Critical
File:BloodfoulerCritical2.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>
For the '''standing''' critical, the user moves forward in the direction they are facing doing a 360° sweep, striking the opponent and applying Blood Poisoning and briefly ragdolling them. The standing critical has the following stats: 1.4x scaled damage multiplier, inflicts 10% Blood Poisoning, and has a 1 second windup.

For the '''running''' critical, the user rushes forward and performs a much quicker sweep before striking the opponent, applying Blood Poisoning. The running critical has the following stats: 1.15x scaled damage multiplier, inflicts 10% Blood Poisoning, has a 0.75 second windup is jump avoidable and deals 35+ posture

The cooldown for both criticals is '''10 seconds'''.

==Trivia== 
*The sheathe depicts symbols of [[The Ministry]], alongside an emblem resembling the symbol for [[Notes]], the [[Moonseye]], and another pattern.
*The creator of the Bloodfouler is likely an Etrean due to the Ministry's ties with Etrea, as well as the weapon's shape being derived from Etrean make.
*It does not change appearance with Alloyblood.
*Despite coming with a sheathe, the [[Poser's Ring]] does not work with it and nor does the Paired Soul Talent from the [[Vigil Initiate]], [[Cloak of Winds]], and [[Royal Etrean Guard]] [[Outfits]].

This has a healing cap of 15 health. Reaching this cap will put Bloodless Gem on cooldown for 2 seconds. ===Notes=== *This Gem is best used on high damage Mantras, especially those that hit multiple times or can hit multiple opponents at once. *The formula for Bloodless Gem's healing is as follows:
ScaledDamage \times 0.8 \times 0.3 **Notably, the healing formula is based on your damage '''before''' Bloodless Gem's reduced damage effect is applied. **Although the description states "unscaled damage," it actually means damage before modifiers and resistances are applied, '''not''' base damage. *The heal cap of 15 will be reached once you deal 63 scaled damage. *While Bloodless Gems are on cooldown, your Mantra's damage will be restored to normal and the healing will be disabled. *If you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} from the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]], {{PAGENAME}}'s healing cap will be increased from 15 to 20. **You will need to deal at least 84 scaled damage to hit this heal cap. *[[The No-Life King's Crown]] increases the healing cap of Bloodless Gems to 30, at the cost of reducing the healing received from Bloodless Gems by 33%. **This changes the Bloodless Gem healing formula to:
ScaledDamage \times 0.8 \times 0.67 \times 0.3 **With this equipment, you will need to have a scaled damage of 94 or higher to heal more than 15 heath, and a scaled damage of 187 to reach the 30 heal cap. **When paired with the {{cl|brain|Brain}} Food Buff, you will need to have a scaled damage of 218 to heal 35 health from Bloodless Gems. *The Bloodless Gem effect can be enhanced with the [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Bloodcurdle]] and [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Regenerative Equipment Sets]], granting 50% of Bloodless Gem's healing [[Temporary Health]] when you proc the Gem. ==Crafting== This Gem can also be used as a crafting component for various items. *[[Outfits]]: [[Arachnid's Weave]], [[Celtorian Tideknight]], [[Familiar Occultist's Armor]], [[Prophet's Cloak]], [[Sanguine Finery]], [[Summer Dragoon]], and [[Titanslayer's Adornment]]. {{History}} [[Category:Treasures]] [[Category:Mantras]] [[Category:Deep Gems]]

title: Bloodrend
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Casting your mind back, you may recall a Black Diver of note was unveiled as the treacherous Crimson Scholar of Burning Blood, a student of the Second Prophet... But what of the Second Prophet's other students? Perhaps one of them might be more sympathetic; perhaps they might even be willing to share what they know of the mysteries of Blood? |author=Hallowtide 2024 Patch Notes}} [[File:Bloodrend.png|thumb|Bloodrend Icon]] == Description == '''Bloodrend''' is an [[Attunement]] that grants the user the ability to control, manipulate, and conjure their own and other's [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Combat_Mechanics#Survival_Basics blood]. Bloodrenders excel in long fights, their power ramping up as the fight goes on due to the effects applied to enemies from Blood Poison and Blood Drain. They can counter their opponents' sustain while using sustain to benefit themselves. However, Bloodrend is difficult to make use of outside of single target combat, as blood poison decays, making it hard to achieve high percentages of it against multiple enemies. It's extremely effective at long to mid range. To counter this attunement, prioritize staying up close and applying constant pressure, as Bloodrend lacks close range low windup mantras. Keep in mind that any mistake is likely to lead to you getting severely punished by the Bloodrend user, even at close range from Mantras like [[Bloodcurdle]]. ==PvE Mechanic(s)== Bloodrenders can leverage the '''Hemorrhaging''' mechanic, dealing a percentage, scaling on Bloodrend investment and player level, of a PvE enemy's current health in a singular damage instance, once a threshold of blood loss is met. At Power 20 with 100 Bloodrend, this deals 17.5% of the target's current health. This threshold can be built up by using any source of blood loss, not exclusively Bloodrend, and does not explicitly require the player to be a Bloodrender to use. When this procs, the enemy will lose a percentage of the {{status|Blood Poisoning}} you've applied to them. ==Obtainment== The [[Attunement Trainers|Attunement Trainer]], [[Vyrelda]], can be located in an igloo on the east side of Firfire Village, caring for an injured diver. She is only visible after having killed [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]] at least once. After killing Chaser, re-enter Layer 2 and go talk with Vyrelda - she will talk about her desertion from [[The Ministry]], and how she evaded the Ministry for so long, who are searching for her. She mentions "Bloodrend" and how she only wished to be taught under the Second Prophet for purely the attunement. After Vyrelda's backstory, the player will be prompted to request for Bloodrend. Vyrelda agrees to teach the latter under the condition that the player deals with some [[Ministry Bloodrender]]s to gain [[Heartstar]]s from their corpses. Walk out the building, and run around the village for a while. The blood-renders will notice you as a threat and begin to engage. Kill all the three cultists for 3 Heartstars, and return to Vyrelda to get the Curseblood potion. Upon usage, your body aches in pain for a split second. You have gained access to Bloodrend. *'''You don't have to re-kill Chaser to keep the Attunement, you can keep it by using a [[Light Hook]] or Deepdrill to leave L2''' After having unlocked Bloodrend at least once, [[Vyrelda]] will be available at [[Derelict Highchurch|The Derelict Highchurch]], where she will request 2 [[Heartstar]]s for the [[Attunement]] (you can easily obtain them via the ministry agents that spawn right outside of the church after talking to her.) It will also be available from the [[Character Creation|character creation]] screen. She can train your mantras in exchange for Notes. ==Training== {{text|att-training |train=using the [[Tourniquet]] to increase the attribute after landing {{PAGENAME}} Mantras to gain enough EXP |trainer=[[Vyrelda]] at the [[Derelict Highchurch]] }} ===Mantra Damage Calculation=== {{text|mantracalc}} ==Cantrip(s)== Cantrips are, often minor, passive abilities that are granted upon obtaining any Mantra from the respective Attunement. ===Bloodless=== This Cantrip visually hides the blood splotches that appear on the player's [[Outfit]] when at low health. This is purely visual. The {{t|Not a Scratch}} Talent also provides this effect, among other things. ===Carnivorous=== This Cantrip allows the player to consume raw meat-type [[Food]] items without vomiting. Even still, eating raw meat isn't very recommended, as the cooked versions provide significantly more sustenance and may grant additional buffs on consumption. [[Vegetarian]] Bloodrenders may still vomit upon comsuming meat-type Food items. {{col|sec|

'''It does not replace blood''', simply overlay itself on top of it. *Blood Poison can proc effects to an enemy upon reaching a certain percentage, here they are: **20% - {{cl|raretlnf|Vasculitis}} is activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Vasculitis}} - Hitting your opponent while they have over 20% blood poisoning disables their deep gems for a brief duration while giving you [[Status Effects#Gem Enhancement|Gem Enhancement]] against PvE temporarily. **25% - {{cl|raretlnf|Hemolysis}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Hemolysis}} - Deal 20% more critical attack damage. **40% - Enemies are under an Anti-Heal effect **50% - Enemies have their damage reduced **60% - {{cl|raretlnf|Bloodwarden's Sense}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Bloodwarden's Sense}} - Enemies you attack with a mantra are highlighted red briefly. **70% - {{cl|advancedtlnf|''Gruesome Harvest''}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|advancedtl|Gruesome Harvest}} - Landing Bloodrend mantras on opponents will give you 15 temporary health. *The [[Ironsing]] Talent, {{cl|advancedtlnf|Alloyblood}} changes the color of your Bloodrend mantras to a grey-ish blue. Alloyblood Wisp.png *Chaser seems to be using his own version of Bloodrend - tailored and handcrafted by none other than the Second Prophet, as said in [[Vyrelda]]'s dialogue, which is special. *While Bloodrend might seem like it'd be a good counter against [[Curse of the No Life King]] users and people with the [[Haemophilia]] Flaw, Bloodrend Mantra blood drain is actually entirely unaffected by blood damage modifiers. *The blood cost for casting Bloodrend Mantras is also completely unaffected by blood damage modifiers like {{t|Alloyblood}}, {{t|Cauterized Wounds}}, [[Curse of the No Life King]] Enchant, and the aforementioned [[Haemophilia]] Flaw; removing the possible synergy between Bloodrend and [[Bloodforged Crown]]. *Attempting to complete [[Vyrelda]]'s quest with multiple people will only spawn three enemies. These enemies will respawn upon talking to her again on another run. Along with this, [[Heartstar]]s are not affected by Light Hook, allowing you to save them for other Layer 2 runs if you end up with only 1 or 2 instead of 3. *{{cl|bld|'''Sanguine Dive'''}} is a reference to Vladimir's W ability in ''League of Legends''. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodtide Ritual'''}} is a reference to [https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Mohg,_Lord_of_Blood Mohg, Lord of Blood's] phase transition move "Bloodboon Ritual" from ''Elden Ring''. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodedge'''}} is likely a reference to Naoto Kurogane's "Bloodedge" and "Edge of Eternity" from BlazBlue Centralfiction. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodcurdle'''}} is likely a reference to bloodbending from Avatar: The Last Airbender *{{cl|bld|'''Veinbreaker'''}} is likely a reference to Slayer's "Mappa hunch" in Guilty Gear Strive. *{{cl|bld|'''Crucifixion'''}} is a reference to Klaus' "Unbreakable Cross Shield" from ''Blood Blockade Battlefront''; confirmed by a tester. *{{cl|bld|'''Vein Tendrils'''}} could be a reference to Spider-Man, from Marvel Comics. *'''{{cl|bld|'''Scarlet Cyclone'''}}''' was changed from 0 stars to 2 stars in the {{VersionHistory|2026|February, 26th}} update. {{Nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

The Bloodtide Trident is a Medium Weapon in the Spear category.

Like all other Hallowtide exclusive weapons, it cannot be dropped to other players.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Spear Pull.gif
File:Spear Throw Back View.gif|Without target

The user is able to aim the critical wherever their mouse is facing. When the trident makes contact with an object or surface, it will burst in a blood-red explosion. If the user hits an opponent with the trident, they will be sent upwards identical to the [[Flareblood Kamas]] critical and will shortly be pulled to the user when further away.

The critical can be landed at any range but will not affect the pull distance at far ranges. The critical has a cooldown of '''8 seconds'''.

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that explodes your opponent after enough time has passed.

==Effect==
After landing enough weapon hits, {{PAGENAME}} applies a 10 second countdown on your opponent. Landing weapon attacks will shorten the duration of the countdown by 1 second. Once the countdown ends, your opponent will explode after a 1 second delay, dealing damage scaling on your Weapon investment.

This attack has a base damage of 27.5, and is dealt as typeless damage. Bluster's damage is increased by 0.25 for every point in Weapon investment you have, up to 52.5 damage at 100 weapon.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 5 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 4 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 3 hits for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*Bluster can be blocked and parried, dealing 10 posture damage if blocked.
*Bluster procs certain "on flourish" Talents such as [[Chainlash]] and [[Hidden Tendril]].
*The [[Hardened Enforcer Boots]] increases Bluster's damage by 35%.

title: Boatman's Watch
content:
{{Location|name=Boatman's Watch|area=Voidzone|caption=A place remembered only by the waves.}}
[[File:BoatmansWatch.jpg|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
Boatman's Watch is a small island located in the [[Voidsea]]. The island is covered in vegetation and an arena can be found in the center.  

*Boatman's Watch can be found in the Eastern Luminant, by sailing through the gate to the right of [[Miner's Landing]], then taking a left off the highway and sailing past the left side of a giant rock you'll see in the ocean. If you see multiple whirlpools or floating trees, you're in the right direction.

==Potential Enemies==
{{EnemyGallery
|Theferryman.png|The Ferryman
}}

== Missions ==
[[The Ferryman]] can be fought here. For more information on his attacks, see [[The Ferryman|here]]. 

[[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]] can also be obtained here, by talking to [[Adrofalis]] after completing [[Ciea]]'s quest. For more information on the obtainment and requirements, read [[Oath: Saltchemist]].

===<u>Ferryman</u>=== 
#Enter the arena in the middle of the island.
# Build a [[Campfire|Campfire Pit]] on each end of the circle in the middle.
# Ignite all four [[Campfire|Campfire Pits]].
#A Teleportation ring will spawn, and standing in it will teleport you to an instanced server with purple flames on the [[Campfire|campfires]]
#Interact with him and the battle will start.

*Rewards in high-tier EXP and a seasonal reward.

Once spawned, you will not be able to leave Boatman's Watch until you defeat [[The Ferryman|The]] [[The Ferryman|Ferryman]] and leave through the portal, die or combat log.

==Trivia==
[[File:The Mines.png|right|frameless|260x260px]]
[[File:Library.PNG|alt=Library located past a breakable wall|right|frameless|263x263px]] 

*The music for this area is [[To Shores, Distant]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*Close to the shore, some [[Fishing|fishing spots]] can be found.
*Since there are trees around the island, you can chop them down and craft [[Campfire|campfires]] in case you don't have any.
*The combat music for this area is [[To Fight, Sanguine]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
* Boatman's Watch can be found by going straight along the wall opposite (towards hive) from the [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Eastern]] [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Interstitial]] [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Lighthouse]] into the [[Voidsea]], visible after about 20 seconds of sailing.
*A hidden mine and library can be found in Boatman's Watch through destructible walls.
*Although not really trivial, there are two [[Egg|eggs]] in this island, one found on a tree growing on the rocks near the dock and another found in a bigger tree growing in a patch of grass to the right of [[The Ferryman|Ferryman]]'s location, these two [[Egg|eggs]] can be used to create [[Mushroom Omelette]]s with the high abundancy of [[Gobletto|Goblettos]] which can be helpful in the fight against [[The Ferryman]].
*Within the Ferryman's instance, the tree behind the teleporter will have [[sap]] that does not deplete after 5-20 collections. This can be a very consistent way of getting [[sap]], if you ever need it.
*Despite the fact that [[Adrofalis]] has not entered [[The Ferryman]]'s portal, he can still  hear their music and lightning.

From depths to peaks across the land, [[The Ignition Union|the Union]]'s tools ignite; a path is blown. Onwards we march, powered by a spark.}}

==Description==

The '''Boltcrusher''' is a Legendary [[Weapons|Greathammer]]: a powerful engine cased with various parts and plates atop a wieldy metal spine. On the back of the hammer's head is a driven drill, and on its front is a weighted blunt piece to offset the weight of the drill and deal damage. It scales with [[Thundercall]] alongside [[Attributes|Heavy Weapons]].

Drilling-edge [[Ignition Union]] technology, the Boltcrusher was devised by [[Ignition Deepdelver]]s in order to assist in [[Depths]] resource extraction.

The Boltcrusher is obtained as a guaranteed drop from [[Finnegan The Lost]], an enemy NPC found in the [[First Layer]] of [[The Depths]] as part of the "[[Finnegan The Lost|Drowned Delver]]" Job. The Job itself can be taken from [[Job Boards]] scattered in a variety of locations, with an increased spawnrate at [[the Chariot's Spire]].

The Boltcrusher comes with two passive abilities:

*'''Powered By A Spark''' - Every basic attack will apply [[Shock]]ed or Surge stacks.
*'''Mining Sufficient''' - The Boltcrusher is capable of mining [[Ores]], and with greater efficiency.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="215" position="center">
File:Regular Boltcrusher Critical (Standing).gif|Standing Critical
File:Regular Boltcrusher Critical (Running).gif|Running Critical
</gallery>
<gallery widths="215" position="center">
File:Surge Boltcrusher Critical (Standing).gif|Standing Critical (Surge Path)
File:Surge Boltcrusher Critical (Running).gif|Running Critical (Surge Path)
</gallery>

The Boltcrusher has two criticals.

For the standing critical, the user reels back the weapon, drilling into them before spinning around and clobbering the enemy with the hammerhead side of the weapon, applying Sapped to the target. This has an estimated 1.6x multiplier. {{Text|slowturn}}

For the running critical, The user lifts the Boltcrusher up above their head before slamming it into the ground using the hammerhead side, creating a shockwave of lightning, applying Sapped to the target. This has an estimated 1.4x multiplier.

Both the running and the standing version share a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*The line ''"From depths to peaks across the land, the Union's tools ignite; a path is blown. Onwards we march, powered by a spark."'' from the item's description is a reference to [[The Hammer's Call]], the Ignition Union's in-universe anthem.
*This weapon is one of two weapons that is able to mine ores while equipped, the other being the [[Quartztone Pickaxe]].

title: Bone Keeper
content:
{{Quotes|quote=It's not somewhere one would want to stay for long. In my few ventures in there, I've always heard loud stomping... behind me, almost? I didn't want to stay to find out what was making those noises.|author=Sarkale talking about the Firfire Caverns}} {{Monster Infobox |health=9500 23750 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=*[[Giant Femur]] |attacks= *Spin Thrust *Leap *Crushing Grab *Charge *Bone Spikes *Femur Throw |image1=Bonekeeper.png |locations=*[[The Ethironal Shrine]] *[[Cathedral of the Interstice]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] }} ==Description== The Bone Keeper is a Monster mainly found in the [[Second Layer|Eternal Gale]]. It can also appear in the [[Pathfinder]] Depths Trial when you have 20 Drowns, potentially {{cl|corrupted|Corrupted}}, and in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} Depths Trial when Power 5 and below. Bone Keepers in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} have vastly less cooldown between their moves and their moves also play out faster, but they have far less health than they do in [[Pathfinder]]. Bone Keepers are giant, humanoid creatures, with inhuman proportions, having short legs yet large arms. It has noticeably clawed feet, with bone claws for hands. They sport a red and gold loincloth of sorts on their lower body and lack clothing on their upper half. Their head also appears to be made out of a cylindrical formation of bones. It is a highly persistent, mobile and hard-hitting Monster, featuring high health and high punishing damage for those unprepared. They are certainly a large difficulty step-up from the Monsters found in the [[First Layer]]. However, all of their attacks are well-telegraphed and can be consistently avoided with proper experience. Even then, be wary of not messing up, especially if the Bone Keeper is Corrupted. ==Attacks== If you would prefer a visual guide, consider watching ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMXwczlX4YE this video]''. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Crushing Grab'''
(★★★) |The {{PAGENAME}} holds its right arm high up before swinging forwards with it, and if it manages to grab a target, it will hold it up before crushing it in its hand, dealing devastating damage. *This attack seems to lack much range, meaning it can be avoided by simply stepping back before it tries to grab you. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, grab, autogrip |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Crushing Grab.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Charge'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} readies up a stance before charging forward, ragdolling and knocking those hit, as well as dealing considerable health damage and posture damage. The {{PAGENAME}} skids to a stop if successfully parried. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Charge.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Spin Thrust'''
(★☆☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} will wind up its right arm, before thrusting forward with its hand spinning, hitting three times. *It may follow up with '''Leap''', even if you parried, with it being more likely if you didn't. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Triple Slash.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Leap'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} leaps a small distance towards its target, crushing it with its impact, dealing serious damage if not avoided. *It seems to lack range, especially since it leaps towards you, potentially overshooting, meaning it can be avoided as long as you dont move towards where it is going to land. *It can be countered by rolling under it while its in the air {{AttackTags |indicator = avoid |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, autogrip |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Triple Slash Leap.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Bone Spikes'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} raises its leg and stomps the ground, emitting a long carpet of rising bones in front of it. *You can jump to avoid the rising bones, but your timing will depend on the distance from you to the {{PAGENAME}}. {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, ragdoll, jump |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Bone Spikes.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Femur Throw'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} digs into the ground with its right arm before pulling out a large femur bone, holding it with winding motions before throwing it towards its target at absurd speeds. *The femur itself behaves like a projectile, with a small AoE on impact and being able to collide with the physical world. *The timing for your defense depends on your distance from the {{PAGENAME}}. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Ezgif-2-a87d608fac.gif|border|frameless]] |} ===Passives=== * '''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal 20% less damage to the Bone Keeper. ==Gallery== File:Layer 2 Concept Art.png|Concept art File:Bonekeeper Honest Reaction.png|Close-up File:The Freddy Kruger.png|Full-body File:Bonekeeper sukuna pose jjk ep1.png File:Bonekeeper Grabs You yes YOU.png File:Hell yeah! Hell yeah! Hell yeah! hell yes! Fuck no! Hell no! Hello! Hi!.png File:Bonekeeper Dab Me Up!!!.png File:Bonekeeper offers you an ice cream.png File:Bonekeeper Jump Attack.png File:Bonekeeper Tom Holland Jump Bro Thinks He's Him.png File:Bonekeeper -e bowdown.png File:Bonekeeper Giant Femur Throw.png File:Bonekeeper left foot left stomp.png File:Bonekeeper Spike Wall of DOOM(house).png File:Bonekeeper Dancing to "elle spongebob car".png File:Bonekeeper Death.png|A dead Bone Keeper File:BonekeeperFly.gif|Comical death ragdoll ==Trivia== *Bone Keepers used to heal at a rate of 20 health per second (60 when Corrupted). This made them extremely tedious to defeat at times, locking out lower DPS builds from fighting them. After being made to fight it with [[Jus Karita]] and no equipment, which resulted in 70+ deaths, ''Deepwoken'' developer Ragoozer had it removed.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rVWCMiHQY4w **This same update also buffed Jus Karita. *Bone Keepers are the precursors of the [[Kyrsgarde]], as mentioned by the [[Kyrsglaive]] description. *The one found on the bridge before the Generator in [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|The Eternal Gale]] does not have knockback on its '''Charge''' and '''Femur Throw''' moves. This is the only instance of this feature. (Currently bugged and has knockback.) *They're called "boneboy" in the game files. *They are passive to other [[Monsters]] from [[The Depths]] but if they accidentally hit eachother they will fight to the death. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Layer 2]] [[Category:Floor 1]] [[Category:The Depths]]

content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=Bookkeeper Andros.png
