==Description==
A consumable fruit that can be found in [[Etris]], [[Isle of Vigils]] & [[Summer Isle]] growing on bushes in quantities of 3-5 per bush. It's a good idea to bring a few when going on excursions if you don't have a [[Canteen]] since it replenishes a good amount of thirst relative to other starting island foods. 

==Crafting==
===Used in===
*[[Candied Fruit]] - 2 Calabash and 1 [[Sap]] at a [[Campfire]].
*[[Canteen]] - 1 Calabash and 1 [[Beeswax]] at a [[Crafting Station]].
*[[Fruit Salad]] - 1 Calabash and 2 other [[Ingredients#Fruits|Fruits]], no [[Campfire]] required.

==Trivia==
*The Calabash has become quite a meme in the Deepwoken community, referred to as the Food of the Gods.
**It has a counterpart called the Red Calabash, similar to the Heroism Egg hoax that went around a few days earlier in April 2022. The Heroism Egg's genuine existence was disproved by Arch_Mage, stating that whoever made it "has a good sense of humour... and Synapse."
***This exists through one of ''Key Exploits''<nowiki/>'s livestreams. He pulled out the aforementioned Red Calabash and said "Agamatsu! Yoo, if you ever want to make a Red Calabash unsolved video, hit me up. I can give you all the ''gifs'' and ''videos'' you need!" He then proceeds to float around and eat the fruit.
***However, at the end of it all, a then-moderator of the game (Tarvero as Lightseeker Araki) was seen holding the Red Calabash in-game. When asked about it, he said that "You don't understand the sacrifice..."
**It is also noted that the Canteen was probably the start of this "Red Calabash" meme, due to its similar reddish/deep orange color.
*Multiple guilds have sprung up around it (most references to the cabbage cult from Runescape).

==Description==
Calamus is a member of [[The Hive]]. They are a guardian of [[Greathive Aratel]], sworn to protect the [[The Lordsgrove|Lordsgrove]] and [[Starswept Valley|The Valley]].

==Location==
Calamus is located on top of a cliff in the [[The Starswept Valley|Starswept Valley]]. There are several jump pads that can be used to reach them.

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|colspan="6" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
|colspan="6"|The sands here are flowing much quicker than before. New threats are appearing at alarming rates. It's getting quite dangerous for Hive operations to proceed here with how this situation is escalating..
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Who are you?
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What's the situation?
|-
|colspan="3"|My name is Calamus; I am a guardian of our Greathive, sworn to protect the Lordsgrove as well as the Valley itself. In order to ensure our operatives can complete their tasks safely, I am brought here to protect them. When a large threat appears and hinders our progress, it is my sole duty to eliminate it. Despite how troubling recent matters are, I must stay dedicated to my cause. To my people.
|colspan="3"|I see, this must be news to you. Aratel has become a much more dangerous place as of late. New threats of hostile creatures are appearing at alarming rates as well as the looming fear of the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}. While our standing with the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} isn't war, tensions between us are high, to say the least. My assignment is to slay these opponents to ensure the safe passage of our Hive operatives in this region, but.. it's beginning to become overwhelming. Each near death encounter brings more fatigue to myself than before, as if fate itself is telling me it's too late. I am their sole protector, yet.. I am facing a challenge like no other.
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What's the situation?
| colspan="3" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]

==Description==
Calypso is an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They are a member of [[The Ignition Union]].

==Location==
Calypso is located in [[Miner's Landing]], inside the main building standing in a corner.
<gallery widths="300px">
Calypso's Location.png|Calypso's Location
</gallery>

==Dialogue==

{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|-
|colspan="24" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
|colspan="24" |Oh, hey! We don't get non-business visitors often. What's up?
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Just passing by.
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Anything interesting going on here?
|-
|colspan="12" |Yeah I understand that. Are you travelling by any chance? ''*They wipe a bead of sweat off their forehead.*'' I can't talk for too long by the way. Work calls despite the, erm, chaos going around.
|colspan="12" |Well.. it's a little complicated. We had a test run of a new, erm, machine we've been working on, and unfortunate company stopped by at the worst time. Since the machine wasn't really... finalized, so to speak, it may have made things much worse. Most of us here are on clean-up duty now, while security helps out the upper-level situation.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I'm a traveller.
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Is the work here stressful?
| colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|-
|colspan="6" |I remember my days of travel too... sometimes I miss it! Eventually though, family calls, and responsibilities and such... For a brief moment at least, adventure can fill that sort of unrequited wanderlust. After it passes though, resting feels the best!
|colspan="6" |Oh, you could say that! Lots of hands-on stuff, tinkering with machinery and such. Plenty of failures too, but that's okay! Each little bump in the road helps us get further along, haha. ''*They give a weak smile.*'' I just hope the other mishaps occurring here will die down sooner or later.
|colspan="12" |
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Glad to hear things worked out.
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Anything interesting going on here?
|colspan="12" |
|-
|colspan="6" |Yeah, plenty of bumps in the road though, haha.. you can call me Calypso, by the way. Cool name, right? I picked it myself, heh.
|colspan="6" |[See first instance]
|colspan="12" |
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Nice.
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Picked?
| colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|colspan="12" |
|-
|colspan="6" |It's kind of complicated, haha. It felt.. more like the real me, I guess. My parents never understood, but the Union accepted me with open arms. Family isn't always the one you're born into, y'know? The Ignition Union has supported and accepted me throughout everything, and I'm forever grateful for that.
|colspan="6" |
|colspan="12" |
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|colspan="6" |
|colspan="12" |
|}

==Trivia==
*Calypso's story, with them choosing a new name for themself to better fit their identity while not being accepted by their family, is likely an allegory for being transgender.

==Description==
Campfires are used to [[Food|cook food]] and replenish the player's [[Combat Mechanics#Survival Basics|Blood]], [[Combat Mechanics#GUI|Health]], [[Combat Mechanics#GUI|Armor]], Natural Armor (requires the [[Vesperian]] Aspect '''OR''' the [[Talents#Freak of Nature|Exoskeleton]] Talent), and [[Sanity]].

A Campfire Pit can be must be crafted with the following recipe:

* One (1) [[Wood]] or three (3) [[Stick|Sticks]]

== Usage ==
A Campfire Pit must be placed down on the ground and lighting it by using a [[Flint]] or [[Umbral Flint]], letting a [[Flame Wisp]] light it or by shooting it using [[Fire Gun]].

After lighting a Campfire, the player can rest by pressing {{Input|keybind|interact}}, allowing them to cook food or replenish any lost stats (health, blood, armor, sanity).

Lit Campfires additionally create a small updraft, causing the player to ascend slightly while [[Gliders|Gliding]] directly above it.

A Campfire that is placed by a player can be destroyed by attacking it.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
DisguiseCampFirePit.gif|Campfire Transformation
Azure_Campfire.gif|Azure Flames
Black campfire.gif|Twisted Puppets
File:Purple Flame Campfire.gif|Purple
White campfiregif..gif|White
New Unlit Campfire.png|Unlit 
Unlitcamp.png|Unlit (Old)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*If a player with [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Flamecharm#Azure_Flames_.28Blue_Fire.29 Azure Flames] lights up a campfire, the flame will have a blue color instead of the regular red.
*Campfires will be put out under the effects of [[Environmental Hazards|weather]].
*Campfires spawned by the [[Random Encounters#Bandit Camp|Bandit Camp]] event are replaced by a chest with loot when the event ends, however, by killing two of the bandits and carrying the third you can have a chance to heal before it disappears.
*There used to be a glitch where campfire-spawning events in Summer Isle would not despawn the campfire, meaning there would be an endless amount of them around the island and also glitch chests inside of the campfire.
*An alternative to using a campfire is the Graceful Flame support mantra. It is not put out in rain and has a Talent that makes it so it can be used in the depths, making it much more viable for late game players.
*With the [[Mime|Disguise]] mantra, you can turn into a campfire. This requires it to be modified with 1 Blast spark, and 1 Tornado spark.
**Whether the campfire is lit or not depends on the order of the sparks (blast then tornado is unlit campfire and tornado then blast is lit campfire)
**Campfires despawn after 10 minutes.
*Four lit campfires are required to summon [[The Ferryman]].
*Campfires were visually revamped in the September 15th, 2025 update.
*Attempting to build a campfire on a boat will yield a message saying "Putting a campfire here probably isn't the best idea."
*If you're using the campfire to regen blood, it'll consume water/stomach.

==Description==
The Canor Fang is a LHT weapon in the Dagger category that can be obtained by enemy NPC chests in [[Songseeker Wilds]] and [[Minityrsa]]. It's a pretty solid weapon if there's no better alternatives.

Notably, this weapon have the highest weight stat of any daggers, at 5. Most other daggers have 4 or 3. This makes this dagger the best at potentially breaking the posture of opponents.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Clutch Recovery}} allows you to heal yourself by landing weapon attacks, if you are at or below 30% maximum health. This heals you for 1% of your maximum health, per hit.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths= "300" position= "center">
File:CanorFang.gif
</gallery>The user shortly winds up before bursting out into a flurry of 5 slashes, inflicting {{status|Bleed|bleed}} on each slash. {{text|slowturn}}

The first hit has a 0.6x scaled damage multiplier, and all subsequent hits have a 0.5x scaled damage multiplier.

The critical has a cooldown of '''5 seconds'''.

{{text|m1tag}}

==Trivia== 
*Despite the name, it's not actually made from a Canor's fangs.
*It's recommended to use a [[Whaling Knife]] or [[Gilded Knife]] instead of the Canor Fang due to their statistical superiority. That being said, the Canor Fang critical and weapon talent are both very good and warrants using this weapon.

== Description ==
Used to hold water on the go. You can spawn with a Canteen if you have its respective “Advanced Tools: Canteen” [[Echoes|Echo Upgrade]].

===<u>Recipe</u>===
[[Calabash]] + [[Beeswax]] near a crafting table. 

(Beeswax mainly spawns on trees around the [[Etrean Wilds]] as well as on a few trees in [[Lower Erisia]], Calabash is also most common around the [[Etrean Wilds]])

You can also get a Canteen from [[Merchant Ships]].

===<u>Uses</u>===
The Canteen can be filled by holding it out and pressing M1 at a well or any source of freshwater (the rivers around Starswept Valley, Merit's Reach, Greathive Aratel, Minityrsa, and Songseeker Wilds all count as freshwater sources) storing 5 uses before it must be refilled again.

The lake near the New Kyrsa also holds clean water, making it come in a clutch when your water bar is low.
===<u>Video Guide</u>===
You can easily get canteen at power level 1 if you know where to look:  https://youtu.be/CrnGXgYL138

==Trivia==
* You can also use a well to drink or refill your canteen.
**As well as this, you can use the blood pool in the [[Derelict Highchurch]], no [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]] included.
**You could also use the "honey" pool in [[Greathive Aratel]]
*Collecting water from the ocean or acid can cause you to vomit unless you have a purifying ring equipped.
*The [[Old Stranger]] asks for water. If you have a canteen full with freshwater and you speak to him, he will grant you [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour]]. Therefore, for players who do not have a [[Murmur]], it is recommended to keep a full canteen of freshwater on them at all times.
*The pond located in [[Guild Bases]] can also refill your canteen.
**However, drinking this water without a purifying ring equipped will cause you to throw up.

[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]] |image1= Orlandeau.png|The Scoundrel's Bounty Cap'n Orlandeau.png|New Kyrsa }} ==Description== Captain Orlandeau (more stylized as Cap'n Orlandeau) is a [[Felinor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is the captain of [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]]. He initially first appears in the [[tutorial]] for the game, which can be accessed via the [[Main Menu]]. After the events of the tutorial, he navigated The Depths, finding his way to [[Castle Light]], leaving him as the sole survivor among the crew of the Scoundrel's Bounty. After having an argument with [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]], she damned him to the [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|City of New Kyrsa]] in the [[Second Layer]]. Believing this may be his final plunder, he explores the sleeping city in search of wealth, fame, and power. The player can run into him in New Kyrsa atop of one of the balconies near the middle of the city with his dialogue changing depending on if you did the tutorial or not. {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|New Kyrsa= {{#tag:tabber|Castaway Origin, with Tutorial= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}What do we hav- ''*The man's eyes widen, his speech put to an immediate pause. He blinks twice.*'' You... [First Name]?! Is it really you? No, no, this must be a hallucination. Aye, it's you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It's me, Cap'n. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}By the gods, what are you doing here?! And the- the rest o'the crew! Did you seen any of 'em?! Gods, [First Name], I..I'm glad to see ye again, mate, above all else. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Slow down, Cap'n. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I never found the rest of the crew. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Yer right.. ''*The Captain takes a deep breath, dramatically heaving in excitement and curiosity.*'' Alright. Aaaalright. I've got me bicorn back on straight. Forgive me, mate. Alas, did ye find the rest of us? Did any live? {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*The Captain would let out a heavy sigh, pulling his bicorn over his eyes dramatically.*'' Aye.. I feared that to be true. When that Authority ship came, after the first explosion.. we were all Depths-sent, the lot of us. But you, you weren't, were you? What happened to ye, mate? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I never found the rest of the crew. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Someone found me, and brought me to Etrea. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Lucky soul.. must be some miracle, aye? Ye believe in good luck, mate? ''*He presses his thumb to his chin, narrowing his eyes at you.*'' Maybe ye got somethin' special in that soul of 'yers. Maybe not. But, for us to meet here.. I think somethin' awaits the both of us. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Well, what about you, Cap'n? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Oh, [First Name], I saw somethin' mighty scary. When I fell to the Depths... I braved through countless Depthsborn, until I discovered a Diver stronghold. Aye, it was nice briefly, but... we didn't get along, aha. That Klaris lady, she found my ideals to be problematic for their cause. We had a nasty dispute, and.. well, I was sent here as punishment. Cruel, aye? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why haven't you left? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Y'know our reputation, [First Name]. Even if I were to escape.. there's no life worth livin' up there. Now I'll have Klaris hounding me too. It's just not... argh. ''*He lets out another sigh.*'' Maybe if I can collect enough o' the medallions down here to clear my name, maybe. But as for now.. I'm afraid not. ''*Despite his morose circumstances, a glint shines through his eye at the mention of the medallions.*'' A great value, they be, hoho! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Medallions? A sort of plunder? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Hoho! Riches is an understatement, friend. Here lies, the ending of a saga for thousands of {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsgarde}}! Here lies.. ''the future for us.'' Throughout this city, a treasure trove of old {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} Medallions resides. And up above just one of those artifacts are worth more than both of us combined. If you can find the right person to trade these with.. you'll surely be able to trade for something marvelous. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll pocket any I come across, and keep that in mind. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Aye! ''*The captain stretches his arm forth, waving across the cityscape.*'' Go forth, [First Name]! Seek the treasures your heart desires. Seek out what belongs to you, seek your legacy. And to the ones above who think of us as sinners... ''the gods will not be watching.'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Without Tutorial= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Ohoho, what's this? ''*A feint glint in his eye sparks, as a wide grin spreads across his face*...'' {{sic|expected=*A feint glint in his eye sparks, as a wide grin spreads across his face...*}} is our final plunder. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Insane acts are my specialty, despite my sanity being intact. {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Plunder? Are there riches to be found here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*The man backs off, readjusting his cap once more.*'' Aye. Aye, I can tell that. And to the ones above who think of us as sinners... ''the gods will not be watching.'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}My name is [First Name]. I'm sent by Klaris. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}My name is [First Name]. I'm here for power. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[First Name], huh... I see. And Klaris, you say? Bah! Funny that, she sends a sorry soul down here to do her dirty work for her. ''*He sneers, looking off to the cityscape around him.*'' Sorry to say, [First Name], but you're just a pawn. Live for yourself, not some ''higher-up''. Indeed... the ''powers that be'' see us as nothin' but worms in a festering sea of corpses. Disposable, so fragile. Do you think she truly cares about you? She cares about ''HERSELF'', pawn. Herself and her ideals only; you are a worm, just like me! Baha! {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[First Name], I see. Powerseeking, an ideal of the weak willed! Bah! Surely 'ye got some tale of yours to bring you down here? Somethin' more interesting about 'ye? I know not one soul that would come to this hell for ''power'', of all things. 'Yer woefully mistaken for thinking you'll find power here, only tragedy awaits for us. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I see. And you are? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It seems you dislike power. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I see. And you are? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See "My name is [First Name]. And you are?"] {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Aye. What's there to like about those who see you as insects? What's there to like about those who send you into a hell no sorry soul could walk out of? ''*He gestures to the area around him, waving his hands as if to go 'see, see'*'' {{sic|expected=*He gestures to the area around him, waving his hands as if to go 'see, see'.*}} Oh, I don't wanna be down here till I die, [First Name]. But the powers that be deem me to be ''slaughtered'' should I show my face up above! So, I die as a fugitive on the run forever... or I die here. ''*His expression turns more somber for a moment, before shaking his head.*'' I'll try to escape eventually, [First Name], but even with the wealth of this city in my pockets, I'd have numbered days. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] }} |-|The Scoundrel's Bounty (Tutorial)= {{#tag:tabber|Lesson 2: Combat= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Feeling caught in the waves this morning, [Player Username]? Yer late for yer trainin'! Draw yer sword and let's get a move on. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Basics of attacking completed] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Basics of attacking incomplete] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Now, let's test yer reactions. We'll be startin' with ye '''Dodging''' my attacks. Dodged are forgiving and evasive. Handy for gettin' out of trouble. Ready? {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Well, [Player Username]? Give yer blade a go! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Let me at 'em. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[Orlandeau draw his cutlass]
'''Prepare yourself!'''
Three...
Two...
'''One!'''
'''And again!'''
[Dialogue loops from "Three..." if player has not dodged an attack] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player dodges an attack] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}'''That's it! Bravo!'''
Not bad! Next up, we'll have ye '''Parry''' my attacks. Parrying an attack will often interrupt it and give you an opportunity to retaliate. Ready? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Let me at 'em. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[Orlandeau draw his cutlass]
'''Prepare yourself!'''
Three...
Two...
'''One!'''
'''And again!'''
[Dialogue loops from "Three..." if player has not parried an attack] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player parries an attack] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}'''That's it! Bravo!'''
Very good, [Player Username]! Yer doin' great, mate. Wanna give it another go to get more practice in, or move on? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Let's move on to the next lesson. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Dodging] {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Parrying] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Moves on to Lesson 3: Survival] {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Revisits dodging section] {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Revisits parrying sections] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lesson 3: Survival= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}[Player is given 3x Sticks and a Flint]
Now then, ye look like you could do with a '''Rest.''' Why don't ye put together a '''Campfire''' to recover your health? Er. Don't mind the hazard to the ship, I'll snuff it out. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has sat at a campfire] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has not sat at a campfire] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}With recoverin' from damage out of the way, let's move onto using '''Equipment''' to ''reduce'' damage. Try this on fer size.[Player is given Leather Gloves] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Well, [Player Username]? Are ye gonna make yer own campfire to '''Rest?''' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Moves on to Lesson 4: Commerce] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lesson 4: Commerce= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has equipped Leather Gloves] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has not equipped Leather Gloves] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Alright! Let's have a change of scenery, I've had enough of this lower deck for a lifetime. Over here, mate. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Go on, then! '''Equip''' the gloves, mate. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Aye. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[Orlandeau moves to the cargo]
On yer travels, ye'll need to do a bit of buyin' and sellin', y'hear? Best way to make money is sellin' the things you find to an '''Antiquarian.''' Why don't ye try sellin' this gem to the fellow in the red outfit?[Player is given Orlandeau's Emerald] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has sold Orlandeau's Emerald] {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has not sold Orlandeau's Emerald] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}It brings a tear to me eye... Now, let's try purchasin' some '''Training Gear''' from the cabinet over there and we can get ye started on some '''Attribute Trainin'.''' {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Don't be shy, mate! Try to sell that emerald I gave ye to that '''Antiquarian''' over there, then come back to me. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has bought a Dumbbell] {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player has not bought and used a Dumbbell] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Moves on to Lesson 5: Power] {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Aye, need a reminder, mate? Try to buy that '''Dumbbell''' with the notes ye earned, then use it to train your '''Strength.''' Ye gotta hold it out just like yer Campfire Pit from befure, then '''use''' it. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lesson 5: Power= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}There ye go, mate! Lookin' sharp already! By raising your attributes, you can increase your '''Power''' in order to learn new little tricks to help ye along the way. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you mean by Power? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Once one improves enough of their physical attributes, their '''Power''' grows. With each level reached, one picks up further '''abilities.''' But enough of that, let's not keep yer crewmates waitin'. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Very well, Cap'n. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[Orlandeau moves to the upper deck]
Nothing quite like the smell of the sea, aye? Ye did great in yer training today, [Player Username]. Ye can take a moment to chat with yer crewmates if ye like, just come back my way when you've had enough. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player speaks to Orlandeau again] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Ye get a good enough chinwag out there, then? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yeah, I think so. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}As I was sayin' earlier, you'll have an opportunity to take up new '''{{g|Talent|Talents}}'''. You may also take up what're known as '''{{g|Mantra|Mantras}}'''. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Mantras? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Aye, fragments of the [[Glossary#The Song|Song]] that ye can call upon to wield in battle. Ye'll surely come across them as ye increase your '''Power.'''
[Player is given a Whisper Draw] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player claims a Mantra] {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player speaks to Orlandeau before claiming a Mantra] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ahah! A great choice. Why don't ye give it a whirl? {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Why don't ye pick one of the cards I gave ye? I'll walk ye through how to use it next. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Player uses their chosen Mantra] {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Moves on to Lesson 5: Power] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lesson 6: Horizons= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Pwoah! You're a natural, mate. Seems all my training is finally paying off, eh? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's next? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Heh, well next up we have my favor- {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No... The {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} can't have... '''GET BELOW DECK, NOW!'''
[The Authority busts the ship and screen goes black] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Everything goes black. Your mind feverishly slips into the dull complacency of unconsciousness, your thoughts no longer able to hold on.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*All dreams must come to an end. And so too must the endless procession of nightmares plague the Drowned...*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Or so you thought.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], Tutorial ends and player is returned to the Main Menu }} ==Gallery== TheCaptain?.png|"The Captain" who previously stood by some ruins in the [[Fragments of Self]]. ==Trivia== *Wears [[Flame Worshipper Armor]], a [[Brigand's Bicorn]], and a [[Celtor Commander Plate]]. *During the parrying section, there was a brief period where he used a regular sword rather than his [[Razor Cutlass]]. *Before the April 5th, 2026 update, a memory of Orlandeau stood by some ruins in the [[Fragments of Self]], allowing players to re-enter the tutorial. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Second Floor of the Second Layer]] [[Category:NPCs located in The Scoundrel's Bounty]] [[Category:Members of the Rotten Lot]]

==Description== Capra are an [[Aspects|aspect]] similar to goats, exhibiting various goat-like characteristics such as horns, rectangular pupils, and even masks shaped like a goat’s skull. Capra NPCs are rarely found in the Lumen of Deepwoken, and their characteristics are unspecified. Capra start with an intelligence and willpower bonus along with the ability to buff the regeneration of others at a campfire, with each buff having more potency dependent on the aspect variant. ==Traits== |-|Pathfinder= {| class="fandom-table" |[[File:TalentIconClaw.png|frameless|100x100px]] |
'''Mark of Ku''' (Capra)
'''Ku''' Variant
*"''Mark of Ku, the Mother. Improves the rest of those in your presence.''" **Grants affected players improved blood regen. **Heals 15% of affected players total HP. **Slightly slows the sanity loss of all affected players. **Slightly buffs the food and thirst gain from consuming food for all affected players. **All buffs lasts 60 seconds, the healing is over a 60 second period, healing 0.25% HP per second. **Must be activated at a campfire. **Cooldown: 3 Minutes 30 Seconds. |- |[[File:TalentIconClaw.png|frameless|100x100px]] |
'''Mark of Nemit''' (Nature)
'''Nemit''' Variant
*"''Mark of Nemit, the First Beast. Food consumed in your presence is more nourishing.''" **Buffs the food and thirst gain from consuming food for all affected players. **Heals 15% of the affected players total HP. **Grants affected players slightly improved blood regen. **Slightly slows the sanity loss of all affected players. **All buffs lasts 60 seconds, the healing is over a 60 second period, healing 0.25% HP per second. **Must be activated at a campfire. **Cooldown: 3 Minutes 30 Seconds. |- |[[File:TalentIconClaw.png|frameless|100x100px]] |
'''Mark of Jurik''' (Moon)
'''Jurik''' and '''Hallowtide''' Variant
*"''Mark of Jurik, the Moonseye. A beacon of calm, those in your presence are resistant to insanity.''" **Slows the sanity loss of all surrounding players. **Heals 15% of the affected players total HP. **Grants affected players slightly improved blood regen. **Slightly buffs the food and thirst gain from consuming food for all affected players. **All buffs lasts 60 seconds, the healing is over a 60 second period, healing 0.25% HP per second. **Does not require a campfire. **Cooldown: 4 Minutes. |- |
+2
 |'''Attribute Boosts''' *+3 Intelligence *+2 Willpower |} |-|Vow of Iron= {| class="fandom-table" | rowspan="4" |[[File:TalentIconClaw.png]] |
'''Scholar's Mark'''
''You now are able to inflict yourself with a Mark. The duration of this scales with how many people you inflict with this effect as well.'' *The Capran Marks now additionally mark yourself. **The duration of your marks is increased by the amount of people you mark. |} |-|Lore =
Not much has been revealed about the aspect but it is described to be more aware of the world around them, having old knowledge and experience to offer. They also align with three symbols or entities that are presumably the sources of their racial abilities, the Moonseye, the Mother and the First Beast. A Capra named [[Ezra]] in Songseeker Wilds gives you a quest to defeat the Songseekers in Derelict Highchurch. He also calls himself a follower of Ku, and his Capra variant is also the one called Ku. If this guy isn't insane, it's most likely the reason why Capra have different abilities depending on their variant is because each variant has the power of a Celestial or similarly powerful being. Jurik would have powers related to insanity/sanity gain, and Nemit would most likely be a god of farming and food, further proven with the weapon Nemit's Sickle; sickles are mostly used as farming tools. |-|Strengths = *+3 Intelligence *+2 Willpower *The ability to buff players around them, making them an excellent support. **They can buff non allies, but they are unable to buff themselves with their marks. |-|Surnames = *Aetad *Akarad *Arad *Eiad *Emirad *Ferad *Fulad *Loritad *Meditad *Memirad *Mirad *Nerad *Pluritad *Raanad *Thaanad *Truad *Tulad *Uurad *Velad *Ventad *Yolad ==Features== ===Masks=== Capra have masks made of bone that closely resemble the skull structures of goats. These can be [[Dye Packet|dyed]], though their color will match that of your horns. |-|Jurik= File:CapraMJurik1.png File:CapraMJurik2.png File:CapraMJurik3.png |-|Nemit= File:CapraMNemit1.png File:CapraMNemit2.png File:CapraMNemit3.png |-|Ku= File:CapraMKu1.png File:CapraMKu2.png File:CapraMKu3.png |-|Hallowtide= File:CapraMHallowtide1.png File:CapraMHallowtide2.png File:CapraMHallowtide3.png ===Horns=== Capra horns come in many shapes and sizes. These can be [[Dye Packet|dyed]], though their color will match that of your mask. |-|Jurik= File:CapraHJurik1.png File:CapraHJurik2.png File:CapraHJurik3.png File:CapraHJurik4.png File:CapraHJurik5.png |-|Nemit= File:CapraHNemit1.png File:CapraHNemit2.png File:CapraHNemit3.png File:CapraHNemit4.png File:CapraHNemit5.png |-|Ku= File:CapraHKu1.png File:CapraHKu2.png File:CapraHKu3.png File:CapraHKu4.png File:CapraHKu5.png |-|Hallowtide= File:CapraHHallowtide1.png File:CapraHHallowtide2.png File:CapraHHallowtide3.png File:CapraHHallowtide4.png File:CapraHHallowtide5.png ==Gallery== ===Concept Art=== CapraCA.png ===Removed Masks=== These are no longer in the game as of January 22nd, 2023. File:Capramask2.png File:Capramask1.png File:Capramask3.png File:Capramask4.png File:Capramask5.png File:Capramask6.png ==Trivia== * In [[homepage:video/4kZL7Ekz/roblox-deepwoken-the-loop|Roblox: DeepWoken - The Loop]], by FANDOM, it was suggested the Capra are a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Capra Demon|Capra Demons]] from ''Dark Souls'', but this was not the case.[[File:Archcapra_inspo.png|300px]] *Each of the marks appear to originate from a different real-world source, most closely in definition with Old Greek, and varying regions of Euro-Asia. *One of the Capra-exclusive ornaments does not have teeth included on the mask, while the rest do. *If you do not have any hair on your avatar as a Capra, you will be given a type of hair. * Once you mark another player, you will gain extra health regen, and presumably sanity/food buffs linked to the corresponding Mark. *During the 4/1/2022 April Fools update ([[Mudwoken]]), the Capra aspect name was changed to Skullskipper. * According to Arch_Mage, Capra are slightly inspired by the Shin from ''The Stormlight Archive'', which is reflected by the aspect having wider eyes than average because they lack epicanthic folds. *The latin word "Capra" is representative of Goats. *Choosing the Hallowtide Variant gives you the Mark of Jurik. *Capra look similar to some depictions, which are not truly accurate, of a wendigo, which is a creature formed by committing cannibalism out of hunger. *The Capra had their appearance reworked on 1/22/2023. *As of the 2/20202 patch, each Capra variant's mark grants the buffs that the other two have, but with less effectiveness. Additionally, each Capra mark was given the hp regen buff. ==References== [[Category:Aspects]]

title: Capran Aphorisms
content:
==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Book]]. ==Text== ===
Capran Aphorisms
===
A trio of sayings passed down through Capran oral tradition. From {{g|Jurik, the Moonseye|Jurik}} springs ken of sky and earth, ken of water and stone, ken of worldly making. From {{g|Jurik, the Moonseye|Jurik}} we take and learn of fire and smoke, glass and steel, salt and lye. From {{g|Nemit, the First Beast|Nemit}} springs ken of beast and root, ken of flesh and bone, ken of blood and sap. From {{g|Nemit, the First Beast|Nemit}} we take and learn of herd and pack, seed and harvest, medicine and salve. And of {{g|Ku, the Mother|Ku}} we share of our ken, learn and teach, listen and speak, see and do. {{g|Ku, the Mother|Ku}} is of us, and we are of {{g|Ku, the Mother|Ku}}. Always both mother and child, student and teacher, novice and sage.

title: Captain Marley
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{EnemyInfobox |title1=Captain Marley |image1=Captain Marley.png |caption1=You will be haunted... by three Solaires |health=7000 |drops=*Master Key *Release Key *Override Key *Armorer's Needle |weapon=*Central Dirk |moves=*Assault *Critical *Ice Daggers *Ice Cubes *Ice Lance *Crystal Impale}} == Description == Captain Marley is a [[Celtor]] miniboss NPC that spawns in the [[Merit Detainment Core]] Cell Control Room. Captain Marley wields a [[Central Dirk]] and wears an [[Authority Helm]] alongside a [[Trimmed Overcoat]] and an [[Fleet Warden Cape|Onyx Fleet Warden Cape]]. They also wear the [[Authority Captain Uniform]]. Their attunement is [[Frostdraw|Crystal Frostdraw]]. ==Moveset== Captain Marley's arsenal consists of the [[Central Dirk]] along with the [[Frostdraw]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |User unleashes a quick flurry of slashes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Daggers'''
(★☆☆) |User forms three daggers of ice before throwing them towards the nearest person. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Cubes'''
(★★☆) |Marley conjures three cubes of ice. On recast, he fires these ice cubes as projectiles towards the player. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Lance'''
(★★☆) |Marley forms a spear of ice in his offhand and lunges towards the player. If this lands, the ice spear will be embedded into the target. The embedded spear will then shatter after a delay, dealing additional damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Crystal Impale'''
(★★☆) |Marley ascends before performing a quick spinning dash towards his target. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |} == Finisher == Captain Marley pins their opponent down and slits their throat with their blade. == Tips == *Assassinate them to deal major damage. *Avoid being hit by their M1s or Critical Attacks, as they will do major damage to even the tankiest of builds. *Their AI is extremely intelligent, however they cannot parry most mantras, use this to your advantage. *Their weapons can be enchanted with 2 separate enchantments. == Trivia == *Captain Marley is the only unique 'Captain' NPC that does not share a name with the others. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

title: Captain Solaire
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} == Description == Captain Solaire is a group of three NPCs found in the [[Merit Detainment Core]]. They are dangerous enemies who guard the important parts of the core. Each of them deals a large amount of damage with M1s and Critical Attacks and uses a different double-enchanted weapon. |-|Warden's Ceremonial Sword= {{EnemyInfobox |image1=Captain Solaire.png |caption1=To protect Lumen from devastation... |health=6000 |drops=*Armorer's Needle *Override Key *Master Key *Release Key |weapon=*Warden's Ceremonial Sword |moves=*Assault *Critical Attack *Cannon Call *Lightning Assault *Lightning Stream *Rising Thunder *Fleeting Sparks}} This variant of Solaire wields a [[Warden Ceremonial Sword]] and wears an [[Authority Helm]] alongside an [[Authority Commander Coat|Amber Authority Commander Coat]] and [[Fleet Warden Cape|Silver Fleet Warden Cape]]. They also wear the [[Authority Captain Uniform]]. This one uses standard [[Thundercall]]. They are an [[Adret]]. == Moveset == {| class="sortable article-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical Attack'''
(★★★) |Solaire dashes forwards and performs a 360° horizontal slash. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Cannon Call'''
(★★☆) |Solaire whistles, signaling for Merit's cannons to fire upon you. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Lightning Assault'''
(★★☆) |Solaire rushes forwards in a zig-zagging trail. {{AttackTags |movement, teleport, parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Lightning Stream'''
(★★☆) |Solaire hooks their opponent with lightning before pulling them into melee range. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull, grab }} |- |
'''Rising Thunder'''
(★★☆) |Solaire rushes forwards and grabs their opponent. If this lands, they will teleport into the sky and crash down as a bolt of lightning. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll, grab }} |- |
'''Fleeting Sparks'''
(★★☆) |Solaire conjures three lightning orbs before sending them towards their targets. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} |-|Alloyed Adretian Axe= {{EnemyInfobox |image1=Captain Solaire2.png |caption1=To unite all peoples within our nation... |health=??? |drops=*Armorer's Needle *Override Key *Master Key *Release Key |weapon=*Alloyed Adretian Axe |moves=*Assault *Critical Attack *Ash Slam *Flame Blind *Flame Grab *Flame Scourge *Fire Blade *Rising Flame}} This variant of Solaire wields an [[Adretian Axe#Alloyed|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Adretian Axe}}]] and wears an [[Authority Helm]] alongside a [[Authority Commander Coat|Ruby Authority Commander Coat]] and [[Fleet Warden Cape|Scarlet Fleet Warden Cape]]. They also wear the [[Authority Captain Uniform]]. This one uses standard [[Flamecharm]]. They are an [[Adret]]. == Moveset == {| class="sortable article-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical Attack'''
(★★☆) |Solaire raises their axe above their head before crashing it down. *Solaire gains hyperarmor during the windup of this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Cannon Call'''
(★★☆) |Solaire whistles, signaling for Merit's cannons to fire upon you. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ash Slam'''
(★★☆) |Solaire imbues their fist with flames that explode on impact with the ground. Strikes twice in front of the user and creates a bursting explosion each time. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Flame Blind'''
(★★★) |Solaire snaps their fingers, summoning an orb of flames that implodes and blinds opponents temporarily. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, debuff }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, grab }} |- |
'''Flame Scourge'''
(★★☆) |Solaire gathers flames in their hand and spins it like a whip grabbing enemies around them, before slamming them into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull, grab }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire forcefully slams down their blade coated in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |

(★★☆) |Solaire spins and releases a fury of flames that sends both the user and opponent vertically into the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, grab }} |} |-|Sovereign's Punishment= {{EnemyInfobox |image1=Captain Solaire3.png |caption1=To extend our reach to The Heavens above... |health=??? |drops=*Armorer's Needle *Override Key *Master Key *Release Key |weapon=*Sovereign's Punishment |moves=*Assault *Critical Attack *Lightning Beam *Lightning Clones *Grand Javelin *Lightning Stream *Electro Carve *Lightning Blade *storm blades *Emotion Wave}} This variant of Solaire wields a [[Sovereign's Punishment]] and wears an [[Authority Voltspark Mask]] alongside the [[Grand Authority Plate]] and a [[Fleet Warden Cape|Shade Fleet Warden Cape]]. They also wear [[Authority Commander]]. This one uses [[Thundercall|Surge Thundercall]]. They are an [[Etrean]]. This variant also has [[Murmur: Ardour]]. == Moveset == {| class="sortable article-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical Attack'''
(★★☆) |Solaire raises their hammer above their head before crashing it down. *Solaire gains hyperarmor during the windup of this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Cannon Call'''
(★★☆) |Solaire whistles, signaling for Merit's cannons to fire upon you. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Lightning Beam'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire casts out a straight beam of lightning from where they are facing. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Lightning Clones'''
(★★☆) |Solaire touches their face, before snapping their fingers and summoning a white haired clone of themselves. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, summon }} |- |
'''Grand Javelin'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire conjures and throws a spear of lightning aimed at their target. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Lightning Stream'''
(★★☆) |Solaire grapples onto a target with a stream of lightning before pulling them in. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull, grab }} |- |
'''Electro Carve'''
(★★☆) |Solaire conjures a shocking orb from the end of their hammer, dealing rapid damage. Does not have autoparry frames. {{AttackTags |parry.nap, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Lightning Blade'''
(★☆☆) | Solaire dashes forward before performing two slashes, sending out 2 short-ranged arcs of lightning forward that pierce through targets. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Storm Blades'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire conjure a ring of lightning blades, dealing light AoE damage. *Solaire gains hyperarmor during the windup of this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Emotion Wave'''
(★☆☆) |Solaire conjures and slams a bolt of lightning into the ground from their right hand, causing volleys of lightning strikes to spread out. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} == Finisher == Captain Solaire executes their opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Warden Ceremonial Sword]]] Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with their blade. [[[Adretian Axe|Alloyed Adretian Axe]] & [[Sovereign's Punishment]]] Pins down opponent before crushing their skull with their weapon. |} ==Tips== *Assassinate them to deal major damage. *Avoid being hit by their M1s or Critical Attacks, as they will do major damage to even the tankiest of builds. *Their AI is extremely intelligent, however they cannot parry most [[Mantras]], especially multi-hit Mantras. Use this to your advantage. *Their weapons can be enchanted with two separate enchantments. == Trivia == *Their name Solaire may be a reference to Solaire of Astora, a Dark Souls character. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=It's the same reason so many people remain here - tradition.|author=Caragan}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Caragan |name=Caragan |location=[[Etris]] |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/NPC|Baragan}} |affiliation=[[Etrea]] |family=[[Baragan]] (brother)

Unnamed father (deceased)

His brother, [[Baragan]], works at the [[Isle of Vigils]]. ==Location== Caragan is located in the Blacksmith shop at Etris. title: Carbuncle
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Once the host's body is dead, the parasites start taking control of the husk left behind. It grows additional limbs, contorting into an awful shape, and the face... ''ugh.'' It's not a pretty sight. Those husks slowly become Carbuncles over time, and the host's body is left a mere puppet...|author=Sunway}} {{Monster Infobox |health=1250 3125 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=Lesser [[Mantra Modifiers]] Sparks |attacks= *Strong Attack *Successive Attacks |image1=Carbuncle1.png |locations=* [[Crypt of the Unbroken]] * [[Layer 2]] *[[Starfield Veldt]] *[[Starfield Tundra]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]]}} ==Description== Carbuncles are an enemy monster NPC of [[Second Layer|Layer 2]] and in certain locations of Lumen, and the final form of [[Diver Husk|Diver Husks]]. They also appear in [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]. ==Moveset== Carbuncles consist of only two attacks, utilizing their elongated hands from its maw: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Houeaoughh...'''
(★☆☆) |Bellow out a short, low-pitched voice, lashing out with one attack that dishes heavy damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Houeeaghughhh...'''
(★☆☆) |Bellow out a long, high-pitched voice, leaping first then lashing out with four, slow attacks in quick succession. *Has very awkward parry timings. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} ==Finisher== {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Feast |Feasts upon the Victim, executing them. |} ==Tips== *Carbuncles '''apply hitstun''' unlike most other monsters, potentially making them a formidable threat against powerful yet unprepared players, and annoying due to stunlocking in groups. **Attacks with Hyperarmor can still ignore their hitstun, such as the [[Enforcer's Axe]] critical. ***This does not apply to [[The Diluvian Mechanism]], due to them mainly being Thunderstruck. *Carbuncles always have hyperarmor, shrugging off all attacks that apply daze or stun. *They signify what kind of attack they'll use with an initial, distorted growl. ==Gallery== Carbuncle.png|Concept art Carbuncle Final Form (Leaping).png|Two Carbuncles in a tent in the Eternal Gale Carbuncle2.png Carbuncle3.png Carbuncle Final Form 1.png ==Trivia== *Carbuncles were first conceptualized in 2020, and remained floating around in the game's files for the entirety of Verse 1. They were finally added in 2022 in the [[Second Layer]]. *Carbuncles originate from The Eternal Gale's Parasites that brooded their victims, later in their initial phase of incubation. *With further analysis of what the Parasite does to the host's movement, the Parasite uses both of its limbs and the host's to maneuver and attack. *Carbuncles in real life are pus filled boils that form under the skin due to infections. Don't search those up if you are easily repulsed by pus. Alternatively, it can refer to a gemstone. *The former noises Carbuncles produced come from the 'Lunatic Cultist' boss from Terraria when it gets hurt.[[File:Carbunclesfx.wav]] ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Layer 2]] [[Category:Floor 1]]

title: Carnival of Hearts
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Location|name=Carnival of Hearts|caption=COME ONE, COME ALL! A BRUTAL SERIES OF TRIALS HOSTED BY AELITA AND TILLIAN AWAITS!}} [[File:Carnival of Hearts.png|thumb|900px|center]] == Description == The Carnival of Hearts is a [[World Events|World Event]] focused around several minigames created by [[Aelita]] and [[Tillian]]. You can get to the arena for Carnival of Hearts by talking to Aelita or Tillian in several locations around the map, or a notification giving you the option to enter the Carnival or dismiss the message(the notification will appear only 4 times(at XX:00, XX:02, XX:04 and XX:06 accordingly)). If you win the minigame, then you ''must'' loot quickly, as you will be kicked out of the Carnival in about 10 seconds, and you can't go back. ==Minigames== The minigames happen in a random order. Once all minigames are completed, all remaining players are granted a chest with loot from the event. ===Hot Pomato=== *A random participant gets a [[Flaming Pomar]] in their hands, and has 30 seconds to pass it before it explodes. *When the 30 seconds is over, the person holding the Pomar explodes and is eliminated. ===Bomb Ball=== *Everyone is given an infinite supply of Circus Bombs, and must throw them at the other players to eliminate them. *Lasts 120 seconds, with a 10 second grace period at the start. ===Beam Blitz=== *Numerous laser cannons will spawn around the arena, which fire large, white beams at random intervals. **These laser cannons can change the direction that they are firing. *Getting hit by a beam will deal massive amounts of damage, but can be blocked. *The duration scales with the amount of participants. ===Ingredient Hunt=== *Participants will have to search for a specific ingredient type. *The ingredients are shown as followed: **[[Alestrian Coral]] **[[Scallop]] **[[Thresher Egg]] **[[Urchin]] ==Rewards== Eliminated players have a chance of spawning chests where they were standing. Additionally, when all three games are over, a chest spawns in the center of the Carnival for each remaining player. Chests will spawn inside the circus that contain mixed loot.
===
Exhaustive Loot Table
===
{| class="fandom-table" width="100%" | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *'''Adept''': [[Carefree Garments]] *'''Expert''': [[Cerulean Gown]], [[Seamstress's Attire]] *'''Unique''': [[Cindergarb|{{cl|unique|Cindergarb}}]], [[Icebringer's Vestments|{{cl|unique|Icebringer's Vestments}}]], [[Jade Vigil's Weave|{{cl|unique|Jade Vigil's Weave}}]] [[Jester's Garb|{{cl|unique|Jester's Garb}}]], [[Sanguine Finery|{{cl|unique|Sanguine Finery}}]], [[Stormchanter's Raiments|{{cl|unique|Stormchanter's Raiments}}]], [[Tempestmaker's Threads|{{cl|unique|Tempestmaker's Threads}}]], [[Trickster's Habit|{{cl|unique|Trickster's Habit}}]], [[Vigil Sentinel|{{cl|unique|Vigil Sentinel}}]] |- | style="width:10%;" |'''Miscellaneous''' | style="width:90%;" | *[[Relics]]: [[Armorer's Needle|{{cl|relic|Armorer's Needle}}]], [[Dye Packet|{{cl|relic|Dye Packet}}]], [[Gilded Needle|{{cl|relic|Gilded Needle}}]], [[Moonseye Tome|{{cl|relic|Moonseye Tome}}]], [[Rain Spire|{{cl|relic|Rain Spire}}]], [[Sinner's Ash|{{cl|relic|Sinner's Ash}}]], [[Trickster Dust|{{cl|relic|Trickster Dust}}]], [[Void Spire|{{cl|relic|Void Spire}}]] *[[Items]]: [[Cake]], [[Iron Bomb]] *EXP, scaling on the amount of eliminated players |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Weapons]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *'''Relic Weapons''': *'''Legendary Weapons''': *'''Alloyed Weapons''': *'''Generic Weapons''': *#'''Light Weapons''': *#'''Medium Weapons''': [[Crescendo]] *#'''Heavy Weapons''': *'''Offhand Weapons''': |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Equipment]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *{{text|lhhead}}: *#'''Unique Head''': [[Tillian's Beret]] *#'''Generic Head''': [[Assassin's Hood]] *{{text|lharms}}: [[Assassin's Cloak]] *{{text|lhlegs}}: *{{text|lhtorso}}: *#'''Mythical Torso''': [[Trickster's Scarf]] *#'''Generic Torso''': [[Threadwork Kilt]] *{{text|lhface}}: *{{text|lhears}}: *{{text|lhrings}}: |}
==Trivia== *Before a shadow update on March 20th, 2025, this event was extremely buggy, where in most cases the minigames would not start and players would be kicked from the server, the suspected reasoning behind it was a short timer where those who joined were counted for the minigames, and therefore resulted in players who connected too late not being considered, often only having a single 'valid player' or none at all for it to begin. **In the rare case the minigames did start, [[Aelita]] and [[Tillian]] would only shoot one beam during '''Beam Blitz''' and '''Hot Pomato''' give everyone a bomb and kill all players, meaning eliminating every other player during '''Bomb Battle''' was the only way to get exclusive Carnival rewards. *There was a bug on release where players could use their weapons and mantras during the minigames, and kill all the other players. This bug has been fixed. *Players can use the [[Dimensional Travel]] resonance during the event to go on top of the tent and avoid all challenges. *Players can roll-clip onto the stands after the minigame has started, avoiding the minigames and other players. *If killed by Aelita, she will use the “A Fearsome Enemy” tag. *When put in danger by Aelita, her tag is .aelita4693. *Aelita and Tillian will occasionally shoot an extra beam at the last person standing during the Beam Blitz game, so be careful. *Sometimes the reward chest is bugged and the loot spawns on top of the carnival.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rwZ_5dDwGSE *Being alone in the carnival will prompt the message "Awgh, just you?! That's no fun.", then will kick you forcefully. ==References== [[Category:World Event]] [[Category:Dungeons]]

Grants I-frames. |[[Thresher Talon]] |- |[[Bone Wisp]] |Summon a wisp of bone that shoots an undodgeable bone on uppercut and flourish. |[[Charged Bonecharm]] |- |[[Brachial Spear]] |Throws a giant femur towards selected area. Deals high damage and high knockback, high wind-up time. |[[Giant Femur]] |- |[[Coral Spear]] |Similar to Megalodaunt Thousand Needles attack. Grow coral on your back and create a multihit AOE around you. |[[Megalodaunt Coral]] |- |[[Dread Breath]] |Turns user's head into a head of a [[Dread Serpent]], breathing out ice beam for the duration of the mantra. |[[Dread Serpent's Tooth]] |- |[[Enforcer Pull]] |When in proximity, pulls the victim towards the user. |[[Enforcer Eye]] |- |[[Mecha Gatling]] | Mounts a gatling gun upon the player's shoulder and fires it forwards, multi-hit. |[[Broken Gatling Gun]] |- |[[Whirling Blade]] |Grow a Terrapod claw from their left arm and spin forward after a short windup, cancelling if parried. |[[Terrapod Shell]] |} ==Trivia== *Carrion is based on Doc, a player who was one of the first members of the Divers guild. As a result, they have taken up that mantle. *Carrion means the flesh of a dead animal, which is fitting considering that he converts monster drops into mantras. *In the dialogue with Klaris after interacting with Carrion in New Kyrsa: the player will note Carrion describing himself as "Dr. Diver". *It has been confirmed by Arch_Mage that Dr. Carrion escaped from Layer 2 by stepping on Klaris' Light Hook, but it has not been confirmed if it is the same light hook the player used to escape Layer 2. This, of course, doesn't make any sense if you think about it for more than 10 seconds since he can return to Castle Light without you having taken the Light Hook.[[File:WhyYouLookinAtTheImageNameYouSilly2024-11-26 220011757.png|761x761px]] This also contradicts Doc's own words that it was a clone, but since he has a tendency to just ''say'' stuff, his word should be probably taken with two mountains of salt. *Hair id: 8213821125 ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the First Layer]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Second Floor of the Second Layer]] [[Category:Black Divers]]

title: Carry Load
content:
'''''FOREWORD''': '''<u>An up-to-date spreadsheet with every source of carry load and their requirements can be found [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1y_fTgtDKwjVsPV2TxA4jeWmvAk5A2fjg27godvMQHKU/edit?gid=847963897#gid=847963897 <nowiki>[here]</nowiki>]</u>'''''

==Description==
'''Carry Load''' dictates how many items you can carry. It can be increased in a variety of ways, and different items contribute a different amount towards your carry load.

You can view your maximum carry load on the bottom right of your inventory. It will be shown as [  X|Y  ], with X being the current space that your items are taking up and Y being your maximum carry load.<gallery widths=250>
Carrying_Capacity.png|19 used space out of 153 capacity
</gallery>

==Sources of Carry Load==
===<u>Talents</u>===

In order of carry load given:

*''Gourmand'' gives 5 carry load.
*''Pocket Bombs'' gives 5 carry load.
*''Steady Footing'' gives 5 carry load.
*{{cl|raretl|Strong Stern}} gives 5 carry load.
*''Cook's Kit'' gives 10 carry load.

All of these [[Talents]] combined would provide +30 carry load. Any other talents not listed here have had their innate carry load removed as of the 17/2/26 update.

===<u>Other Sources</u>===
This includes every source of carry load that isn't a regular Talent.

In order of carry load given:

*The [[Union Initiate]] outfit gives 10 carry load.
*[[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]] gives 20 carry load.
*The carrying capacity [[Echo Upgrade]] gives 5 carry load per upgrade, with a maximum of 30 extra carry load.
**Each upgrade costs 50 echoes, needing 300 total echoes to fully upgrade.
*The [[Grand Pathfinder's Backpack]] gives 50 carry load.
**The [[Wormwarder Lantern]] gives 10 carry load, but is inferior to the Grand Pathfinder's Backpack.
**The [[Threadwork Kilt]] gives 20 carry load, but is inferior to the Grand Pathfinder's Backpack.
**The [[Pathfinder's Backpack]] gives 35 carry load, but is inferior to the Grand Pathfinder's Backpack.
*The [[Packmule]] Boon gives 50 carry load.
*[[Strength]] increases your carry load by 0.5 for every point of Strength you get. Caps at +50 carry load at 100 Strength.
*[[Fortitude]] increases your carry load by 0.5 for every point of fortitude you get. Caps at +50 carry load at 100 Fortitude.
*The [[Character Stats#Carry Load|base character]] starts off with 100 carry load.
All of these miscellaneous sources combined would theoretically provide 360 carry load.

==Total Carry Load==
Combining both Talents and other sources, the total amounts to '''390'''. However, your character can carry 20% more than your carry load would normally allow, with the drawback of gradually reducing your movement speed. Accounting for this, the real maximum theoretical carry load is '''468'''. A build which obtains this carry load is quite simple to create, and can be found [https://deepwoken.co/builder?id=LIeKTFNW here].

==Trivia==
*The {{t|Another Man's Trash}} Talent provides a damage buff in PvE, scaling on how much weight you are currently carrying. This grants a 1% damage buff for every 100 weight carried.
*If you are carrying more than 150% of your maximum carry load, items above the threshold will be voided if you leave the game. This does not apply in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} gamemode.
*If you reduce your carry load (by taking off a backpack, for example) while at maximum capacity, you can still carry your previous max amount of items, even after rejoining. Though, if you drop any item, you won't be able to pick it back up.
*Five Talents that granted carry load have been removed from the game.
**''Volt Kick'' granted 7 carry load, but was removed on {{VersionHistory|2024|August 30th}}.
**''Pitcher'' and ''Duelist's Dance'' granted 3 and 4 carry load respectively, but were removed on {{VersionHistory|2025|April 15th}}.
**{{cl|raretl|Lootskipper}} granted 4 carry load, but was removed on {{VersionHistory|2025|July 15th}}.
**''Ether Conduit'' granted 7 carry load, but was removed on {{VersionHistory|2025|August 4th}}.
*On the {{VersionHistory|2026|February 17th}} update, several changes were made regarding carry load;
**A few Talents had their innate carry load changed: Gourmand 2 -> 5, Steady Footing 9 -> 5, Strong Stern 9 -> 5, Pack Mule 1 -> 10
**25 Talents and 4 Quest Talents had their innate carry load removed. This resulted in the theoretical maximum carry load build losing 170 carry load. Mileage may vary on pre-existing bank slots.
**The innate carry load gained from Strength investment was reduced from 1 per point to 0.5 per point, but Fortitude was changed to give 0.5 carry load per investment point as a tradeoff.
**The weight of [[equipment]] items were changed, with it being based on equipment type rather than it being a flat 2 per item.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:You're carrying too much!.png|Message that appears if your inventory is full when trying to pick something up.
File:Overcarry.png|Red carry load text, indicating you've gone over your maximum carry load.
File:Grand Pathfinder's Backpack Description.png|The Grand Pathfinder's Backpack, which gives 50 carry load.
File:Royal etrean guard in inventory.png|A Royal Etrean Guard schematic. The blue number in the bottom right signifies it takes up 1 carry load.
File:Maxed carrying capacity echo upgrade.png|The carrying capacity echo upgrade, fully upgraded.
</gallery>

title: Castaway
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=Washed ashore in an unfamiliar place, you find hospitality within the Kingdom of Etrea.|author=Origin description}}
[[File:Castaway.png|center|alt=]] __TOC__ ::The ''Castaway'' [[Origin]] is the default way to play the game, and is available to the player upon purchase of the game. ==Description== Castaways are those who were washed ashore after the events of the [[Tutorial]], during the [[Attack on the Scoundrel's Bounty]]. ==Obtainment== Castaway is unlocked by default. ==Spawn== Castaways spawn with the [[Stranded]] Outfit equipped. The player is able to choose to spawn in either the [[Etris]] or [[Isle of Vigils]] inns by clicking their respective origins . Inside the inns, the player can speak to either [[Trenti]] or [[Aristo]] depending on their spawn choice to gain {{c|notes|25}}. ==Effects== ===Justicar Whistle=== *''In-game description'': Request aid from a Justicar. **Using the whistle allows a player using the [[Justicar]] Origin to join you. They are duty bound to helping you and are rewarded when you complete events or defeat [[Voidwalker|Voidwalkers]] with them. **Justicars are actively prevented from hurting you with a lengthy stun. They will however lose this restriction if you attack them too much. **Outside of combat, the whistle will open a prompt to confirm usage. While in combat, the prompt is skipped. ==Pros and Cons== ===Pros=== *Castaway has no negative EXP modifiers nor preferred progression method, unlike most other Origins. This allows you to progress in any way you want to without any downsides to experience gain. *Can request help from Justicars, which can be useful if you are new to the game. ===Cons=== *The starter outfit is [[Stranded]], a no-resistance outfit that permanently has no armor durability. *Castaway has no positive EXP modifiers nor preferred progression method, unlike other Origins. Other Origins may allow you to progress at a much faster rate than Castaway due to this. ==Reputation== Your starting faction [[reputation]] is: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} and [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}, [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Divers}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} *''Note: Your chosen [[Aspect]] may affect your starting reputation.'' {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Origins]]

Castle Light
content:
{{Location|name=Castle Light|territory=The Divers|caption=A hidden operating base for the Divers of the First Layer, where many apprentices come to learn the harsh reality of the Depths.}}
[[File:Castle Light Closer Print.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Castle Light''' is a [[Locations|location]] belonging to [[The Divers]]. It is a sub-location in the [[Celtor Wastes]]. It is a [[Locations|starting location]] for those using the [[Deepbound]] origin. 

==Overview==
[[File:Castle Light.png|thumb|404x404px|The Castle Light gate]]
Castle Light is a (relatively) safe area within the [[First Layer]] belonging to [[The Divers]]. It is a castle with multiple lanterns floating around, brightening the surrounding area and making it visible from the outside. It's guarded by Journeyman Diver NPCs and stationary light-armed turrets that fire at monsters and hostile players. Additionally, it also has a Life Barrier preventing entry. Entry will only be granted if the player has entered The Depths through a whirlpool and does not have the vacant flaw, or by being a [[Deepbound]]. It is also the only place to descend into Layer 2 with friends and with a safety net through the form of the [[Second Layer|Light Hook]].  

It is also the only place the First Layer of the depths in which you can regenerate sanity / not go insane naturally, only if you are deepbound. It also features a stove, which functions as a campfire. It is the only natural campfire in the entirety of the depths. (Which, of course, you have to be Deepbound in order to use it.) 

==Contents==
[[File:Light hook.png|thumb|404x404px|The entrance to the Second Layer of the Depths]]

===Entrance to the second layer===

*The player can enter the [[Second Layer|Eternal Gale]] via the Light hook.
*You are able to trade [[Kyrsan Medallions]] to Klaris here.
*Players can obtain the Oath [[Dawnwalker]] through the second layer.
<big>Main Entrance</big>

*[[Mantra Lectern]]
*[[Crafting Station]]

===The Library===
*Contains a [[Cauldron]]
*The players can find the [[Antiquarian]], [[Banker]], and [[Carrion, Father of Evolution]] here.
*Only [[Deepbound]] players are able to interact with the Antiquarian and Banker.

[[File:The library.png|thumb|403x403px|An image showcasing the library.]]

===The Armory===
*Players can find the Blacksmith here

[[File:DepthsBlacksmith.png|thumb|402x402px|The Armory.]]

===Vendors and Notable NPCs===    
*[[Antiquarian]]
*[[Banker]]
*[[Barber]]
*[[Blacksmith]]
*[[Dust]]
*[[Graha]]
*[[Mark Adaset]]
*[[Nyanna]]
*[[Akira]] (if met in the random encounter)
*[[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]]
*[[Carrion, Father of Evolution]] (if met at the end of the library puzzle in [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]], Saves through slots.)

===Items===
*Cloth
*Fiber
*Accordion
*Violin
*Drums
*Trumpet
*Pickaxe

===Sanity Regen Aura===
If you are Deepbound and within Castle Light's radius, You will passively regain sanity.

==Trivia==
*While considered a "safe zone" to some extent, [[Monsters]] CAN enter the barrier. Journeymen Diver NPCs may kill some monsters, but stronger monsters, such as King Threshers or Mudskipper Broodlords, will quickly kill the Divers.
*Occasionally, three Black Diver NPCs can spawn. This happens when there are too many monsters or a player with bad reputation with the Divers enters.
*Castle Light has one of the two blacksmiths in the depths, making it very useful if you need to repair your armor after farming.
**If killed with a death ID (Text reading '''You died to'''), you will not be able to enter Castle Light, unless you are Deepbound.
**Castle Light can be entered if the player went through a whirlpool or used Call of the Deep.
*Castle Light can be considered the safest area in The Depths to take a break in, featuring a Deepbound exclusive stove, multiple vendors and sanity regeneration for those using [[Deepbound]].
**That said, Castle Light is a common spot for ganks, it is advised to be wary of large groups of players.
*Castle Light is the only place where along with guards, there are also turrets that attack hostiles.
*Larger mobs (King Threshers, King Jellyfish, etc) are often unable to enter the rooms of Castle Light due to the small entrances.
*It is advised to not attack the guards as they have a large amount of health and can quickly become a problem even for experienced players.
*Castle Light used to have normal divers guarding, then got replaced by Black divers, then got replaced with Journeyman Divers.
*It is possible to enter despite drowning, but requires the assistance of another player.
**Do note that if you defeat Chaser after doing this glitch, you will be allowed to pass through the barrier as if you entered the Depths via a whirlpool.
*Defeating Ethiron spawns you in Castle Light if you entered via the First Layer's void pits, but you still will not be allowed to pass through the barrier, forcing you to reset.
