title: Chests & Sacks
content:
File:Groose GFX Chest 1-2.png
== Chests == [[File:Chest.png|thumb|An image of an opened chest]] Chests are in-game boxes that spawn at the end of almost every [[Random Encounters|Event]]. They contain loot ranging from general items, [[Equipment]], [[Outfits|Schematics]], [[Weapons]], [[Mantra Modifiers]], and very rarely, [[Enchantments|Enchanted gear]], [[Enchant Stone|Enchant Stones]], [[Relics]], and just about anything else. Every area has it's own lootpool, with some items being exclusive to one area, while others being found across several areas. For example: A chest dropped from a [[Songseeker Wilds]] random event may contain items such as the Katana, the Canor Fang or the Glassdancer Wraps. However, chests that have dropped over in [[Erisia]] would contain items such as the Stilleto or the Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer [[Outfits|Schematic]]. Though, you can find a [[Blindfold]] in both areas. If you spawn near a chest, you can not open it. Loot inside a chest is shown with different colors depending on their rarity, ranging from common to enchanted: *General items such as [[Food|Consumables]], [[Gems]], [[Mantra Modifiers]], [[Attunement|Elemental Ingredients]], etc. are colored as dark green. *Uncommon items are colored as pastel yellow. *Rare items are colored as red. Though despite being rare, they're very common in The Depths and Hive *Legendary Gear, [[Outfits|Schematics]] or [[Equipment]] are colored as bright cyan. *Mythical Items such as Legendary [[Weapons]], [[Enchant Stone]]s/[[Enchant Grease|Grease]], and some [[Equipment]] are colored as bright purple. *Unique items are colored as deep magenta. *Relics are colored as a bright green. *Enchanted items are colored as white. The color of a chest depends on where you got it from, consisting of four variations as of current version. *A brown chest with silver metal parts, found commonly in the Etrean Luminant. *A gold chest with gold metal parts, found commonly in the East or from turning in [[Ore|pure ores]]. *A cyan chest with green-white metal parts, found commonly in the [[The Depths|Depths]] **This chest, along with the gold chest, can also be found through [[fishing]]. *A black chest with gold metal parts, found commonly after [[Bosses|bossfights]]. *A big neon pink chest, found in [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]]. '''Chest mimics''' (more commonly known as '''mimics''' or '''trick chests''') can spawn around the [[Luminants|Eastern Luminant]], and releasing beasts that were even thought to just stay around [[the Depths]]. These include: [[File:Mimic Chest.gif|thumb|A Mimic Chest]] * [[Megalodaunt]] *[[Crimson Megalodaunt]] * [[Alpha Megalodaunt]] *[[Terrapod]] *[[Thresher]] * [[Nautilodaunt]] == Sacks == [[File:Sackv2.png|thumb|An image of a sack]] Sacks are in-game bags that spawn after a player has died. They contain a stash of items from the deceased player's inventory, but not all as there is a limit for how many items there could be in the sack. Similar to chests, loot inside the sack will appear in different colors depending on the rarity of the items sorting from Legendary to Common. It is noted that the sacks despawn after ~15 minutes. [[File:Mercille New.png|alt=Mercille|thumb|178x178px|Mercille]] Carriable sacks (similar to the Summer Company's gunpowder boxes) can spawn around [[Starswept Valley]]. One can turn these into [[Mercille]], in the Summer outpost nearby [[Meteor Isle]], for a chest containing good tier loot. [[Category:Mechanics]]

title: Children of the Aftertide
content:
==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Books|Book Collection]]. ==Vol. 1== ===
Children of the Aftertide I
===
- a foreword by Mira Sokolof The world we live in - the world after the {{g|The Old World|Old World}}, the {{g|The Canticlysm|Canticlysm}}, and the {{g|The Tides|Tides}} - is a world without harmony and peace, a place of great turmoil and unrest. For some, such as the tide-scattered Celtor, it is a place without a past and a home. The surface is slowly turning into a graveyard of once-great cultures, as the few surviving ones vie for supremacy in a sea-sundered land. I myself, Mira Sokolof, am a descendant of the Celtor who survived the {{g|The Submergence of Celtor|Submergence of Celtor}} by fortune of being away from the city during the catastrophe. Despite that, the loss of our heartland - its wholesale disappearance to the {{g|The Depths|Depths}} below, - left a great wound in our collective psyche, and a rift in our cultural memory. Our traditions, once so accustomed to our former home, hardly survive after several centuries of diaspora, but they cling on to dear life, thanks to the efforts of individual Celtor. My family tried - and still try - their hardest to keep the Celtorian ways alive, passing old stories and customs down the family line through spoken word and repetition. But this alone, and in such small numbers, cannot preserve the old culture of my kin. Slowly, as we are forced to seek other homes to settle in - homes other than our own, - our ways fade, and the past is forgotten. It is hard to accept it, but the Celtor culture is experiencing its final sunset. Not only did the archives and libraries of our once-great {{g|The Drowned City of Celtor|drowned city}} contain a wealth of texts about our culture, but the city itself once housed the culture's living practitioners - the Celtorians themselves. But now, we are scattered, few and far inbetween, like chaff in the wind; and our wealth of culture is lost beneath the tide. At present day, the surface world is still dotted with a variety of cultures, each at a different stage of vitality. For example, the island of Etrea, the last remaining shard of a once-great kingdom of the same name, maintains its distinct way of life in relative isolation. However, their culture is growing stagnant, ossified, and inflexible due to such policies, remaining relatively unchanged for the past several centuries - an unnatural amount of time for any civilisation's lifestyle to stay so static. As another example, The Navaean nomads' ways are still going strong, flourishing in the face of great adversity - somewhat of a paradox considering their culture's wandersome nature, their reliance on traditions of spoken word, and their consistent clashes with the encroaching imperial influence of the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}. The {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} themselves, as yet another example, struggle to find any solid cultural ground to stand on, despite being made up of numerous varied groups of people, each with their own colourful histories and customs. Instead, they rely upon loyalty to hierarchy and on military tradition to keep their political ties from fraying. And then, of course, there are new cultures still emerging in the long wake after the {{g|The Tides|Tides}}, forming up in response to the changed ways of the people of the {{g|The Aftertide|New World}}. Where there was a lack of rooted national history and shared past, a variety of stand-ins arose - companies, labour unions, and guilds of workers and adventurers alike. Within these non-societal units, unique traditions, hierarchies, and customs take shape. They fight for their place beneath the sun, like any other. Despite all this, our world remains at strife with itself, and destruction reigns over creation. We have proven, time and time again, that humanity can persevere in the face of incredible adversity, and band together during and after world-ending events. What we have woefully failed to do, however, is preserve the past - the circumstances did not allow us to do this well. ---- It is for this reason that I publish this journal of mine, containing within it a continuous study of the surface world’s cultures, traditions, customs, and ways of life - old and new alike. Here I have set the records of my investigative journey throughout the world, accompanied by my very close life-long friend, a Khan warrior named Anna Nemises. We hope these writings are found satisfactory in the face of posterity. In truth, we do not know for certain what the future holds. Perhaps the world as it is may not exist for very long. Perhaps none are exempt from the fate that befell the city of Celtor, the Great Jewel - but from the shared, traumatic experience of the surviving Celtorian people, rebuilding will be a much easier task if at least a small ember of the past remains burning. This is my ember, brought to the altar of time. Never again may we suffer alone, in the dark.

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that applies chill and Bottom Freeze to your opponent.

Chilling's colors change depending on your [[Frostdraw]] color, turning pink if you have {{t|Glass Path: Crystallization}}.

==Effect==
After landing enough M1s, {{PAGENAME}} applies {{status|Chill}} and {{status|Bottom Freeze}} to your opponent. Once this happens, Chilling will go on a 5 second cooldown, preventing stack gain without disabling the damage Chilling does. If you have Crystallization Path, this enchantment will apply 1 Crystal on each M1 instead.

If the enemy is a PvE enemy, additionally apply {{status|b=y|Sluggish}} upon reaching the hit count, reducing the damage they deal for the duration of the slow.

Additionally, your M1s gain a secondary damage instance that deals 4% of your weapon's scaled damage as Frostdraw damage. This secondary damage increase is increased to 10% of your weapon's scaled damage for the hit that reaches Chilling's hit count requirement.

The hit count required to proc the Bottom Freeze effect varies based on your weapon type, requiring 5 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 4 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 3 hits for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*Chilling's secondary damage instance cannot be buffed.
*{{PAGENAME}}'s effects can be procced on weapon criticals if they have the [[M1 tag]].
*Because Chilling's secondary damage instance deals Frostdraw damage, you can use this enchantment to change your opponent's {{t|Everchanging Aegis|rare}} type to Frostdraw resistance, allowing the first hit of your non-Frostdraw attuned attacks to deal 10% more damage against players using this Talent.
*Chilling's cooldown is entirely separate from {{t|Bottom Freeze}}'s.

title: Chime of Conflict
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=Bloodshed awaits those who ring the bell...|author=Chime of conflict flavor text}}

== Description ==
The ''Chime of Conflict'' is a [[Talents|Talent]] and item obtainable by talking to [[Yamaketzal]] at the [[Songseeker Temple]] once the player has reached [[Power]] 5. It can be used to enter instanced PvP arenas for players to practice, compete for Experience, Loot and Glory, without risking themself in reality.

The Chime of Conflict is unusable while in [[The Depths]]. 
== PvP Arena ==
Players using the Chime of Conflict tool will be prompted to select a gamemode:
*'''Chime Solos (1v1)''' - The player is instantly taken to the matchmaking queue. 1v1 arena maps are unique from 2v2 and 3v3 maps.
*'''Chime Duos(2v2)''' - A small area is created around the user to let 1 other user join their team before being transported to the matchmaking queue.
*'''Chime Trios (3v3)''' - A small area is created around the user to let 2 other players join their team before being transported to the matchmaking queue.
*'''Challenge: Gladiator''' - The player uses a slider to select from 3-20 people to enter with. After which, the player must enter the User ID or Username of the player they wish to challenge.
Afterwards, players will be waiting in the queue and be put in a match with their opponent. For matchmaking to start in 3v3s or 2v2s, all players need to be ready

== Rules==

*'''Power range -''' When selecting opponents, the game will match players who are at most 5 Power levels apart from one another.
*'''One round -''' There is only a single round. Killing your opponent means winning the match and returning to the matchmaking lobby.
*'''Elimination''' '''-''' Dying removes the player from the round.<small>(3v3 and 2v2 only)</small>
*'''Death Circle -''' Similar to Battle Royale games, a "circle of death" forms around the arena shortly after the match starts. The circle will shrink forcing the players to approach each other. Being outside of the circle will rapidly deplete your HP, and immediately kills knocked players. If a match takes too long (approximately 4 minutes) the entire arena will be covered in the "circle of death" meaning you take constant damage.
*'''Resonance limitation -''' Resonances are disabled in 1v1 fights to prevent the possible scenario of being matched with an offensive resonance while having a support resonance.<small>(limit removed in 2v2 and 3v3)</small>
**
**
**
**
**

==Rewards==

*[[Attributes|EXP]]
*One chest (1v1) or three chests (2v2 , 3v3).
**Chest rewards may get better as you accumulate a win streak, or when you fight a high-level player. <small>(A player has noticed better rewards such as 3-star weapons after a 6+ win streak; anecdotal evidence and needs testing. Another player has attained a high-level weapon after victory against a high-level opponent. It was also said that enchants appear more commonly than normal means. (?))</small>
*Bell progression (heavily increased by the players current path) (around 25 wins for 1 stage of progression.)

== Rankings ==
Rankings are the accumulated rank of one's PVP Skill; determined only in Chime of Conflict. Your Ranking is account-wide.

All accounts start at 800 Ranking, and increases or decreases based on your victories and losses.

=== <u>Rank Titles</u> ===
Initiate '''(800-899)'''

Novice '''(900-999)'''

Apprentice '''(1000-1099)'''

Journeyman '''(1100-1199)'''

Pathfinder '''(1200-1299)'''

Vowbearer '''(1300-1399)'''

Oathkeeper '''(1400-????)'''

In addition to Rank Titles, the top 250 players in Chime also get a special title:

=== <u>Placement Titles</u> ===
? '''(Top 1)
*Black, Dark Red, & Yellow Username
Godseeker '''(Top 2-10)'''
*Red & Yellow Usernames
Grandmaster '''(Top 11-50)'''
*Gold Usernames
Master '''(Top 51-100)'''
*Silver Usernames below 50
Ranked '''(Top 101-250)'''
*Silver Usernames
Ranked  '''(Top 251-1000)'''
*Bronze Usernames

==Trivia==
*The music for the queue area is [[The Games Of War]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*The "Godseeker" title refers to those who [[Mendacia#Dialogue|seek out the Drowned Gods]]
**This is, in-itself, a reference to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollow_Knight Hollow Knight games]
*The lowest Elo possible is 500.
*You get a ranking once you are in the top 2500.
*Originally, Chime of Conflict featured a skull system. Every player would have 3 skulls that reset back daily. Upon losing a match, you'd lose a skull, and upon winning a match, you'd gain a skull back. Losing all three would send players to the Depths. However, following popular demand and outcry from players and public figures such as the Youtuber Eclipse, the skull system was ultimately removed.

title: Chime of Dwelling
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=There's always a road back home.|author=Chime of Dwelling's Description}}
==Description==
[[File:Guild Door.png|thumb|216x216px|An open guild base with the Chime of Dwelling. The guild name is up on the door and its symbol is on the door.]]
The Chime of Dwelling is an obtainable item added in the [[Verse 2|Verse 2 Update]] which is granted to the Officers, Lieutenants and the Leader of a Guild. It allows you to set a [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] in a wall, with some exceptions (see below).

Upon using the chime on an acceptable surface (Around 90° vertically, mostly on rock or wood), a short animation will play with the Guild Door being constructed. A sign will appear above the door, showing the guild name, and the guilds emblem is showcased as a window. Multiple bases can be placed near each other, but only one base per guild can be present in the same server at one time. 

The Chime of DweIIing does not work in or under the following:

*Inside of a [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]]
*[[First Layer|Depths]] and its [[The Depths|Layers]]
*[[Voidzones]]
*Dungeons or Missions ([[Duke Erisia|Duke]] Fight, [[The Ferryman|Ferryman]] Fight, [[Maestro Evengarde Rest|Maestro]] Fight, [[Trial of One]])
*Occupied Locations by Factions that see you as a Hostile
*Being in-combat
*[[The Monkey's Paw]] and [[Duke Erisia's Manor]] (as they are boss arenas)
*[[Voidheart]] and The Interstice ([[Dimensional Travel]]) (as they are in another realm from us) 
*When under the effects of Grasp of Eylis as a [[Voidwalker]] (actively hunting a player)
*Character created from the [[Authority Ensign]] origin.
*[[The Temple of the Forgotten Flame]] and [[Derelict Highchurch]] (as both areas have a sinister presence?)
[[File:GuildBase Editor.png|right|frameless|300x300px|The Guild Base Layout]]

==Trivia ==
[[File:ChimeOfDwelling.png|thumb|206x206px|Chime of Dwelling Item.]]
*While someone is inside of the [[Guild Bases|guild base]], you are not able to use the Chime to spawn another.
*Anybody can enter the base through the door, but only guild members can use appliances.
*If your guild base is present on the map you are able to respawn to it if you die or reset if you have the Quarters room.
*Players cannot go into or out of guild halls while carrying a body.
*Guild Bases only despawn if every guild member has left the server.
*If a base is present and the Chime is used again somewhere else, the current base will be moved to the new location, given that no one is present inside of the base.
*Similar to the [[Chime of Conflict]], this item is undroppable, and resides in your inventory at all times.
*If you are looking for a detailed page about the guilds inside, read [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] or [[Guilds]].
*Despite not being able to use the Chime in the The Temple of The Forgotten Flame itself, you can use it in its [[Temple Courtyard|courtyard]]

== Updates ==
In the '''13th February 2023 update''', a new mechanic was added for '''<u>leaders only</u>'''. Whilst inside of the base, upon using the Chime of Dwelling again, the leader of a guild may freely move any existing room around. Doing so will move the room and all its contents, so Libraries for example, won't lose their books.

In the '''August 7th 2023 update''', another new mechanic was added for '''<u>leaders only</u>'''.  Using the chime once again inside of the base will allow you to remotely exile anyone in your guild (Assuming you have their Roblox Username NOT Player Name) - Regardless of server, time etc. Officers cannot remotely exile however, and still need to find players to exile them.

==Description==
'''Chorus Divide''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain and is common to roll.

===''Appearance''===

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Chorus Divide''' Resonance. The user begins to charge up the elements within their arms, before unleashing two powerful beams of Attuned energy. The user will slowly spin 270° during the duration of this Resonance, removing the player's control over beam direction. The beams will be based off the user's highest invested Attunement, changing the visuals, status effect, and damage type to match.

Chorus Divide has 8 base damage per tick and 5 Attunement scaling, capping at 12 damage per tick with 100 Attunement.

{{cl|corres|If Chorus Divide is corrupted, its spins 180° instead of 270°, and becomes unblockable, but at the cost of it's wind-up being significantly longer, and the beams spinning slower.}}

===''Resonance Point usage''===
When obtained, Chorus Divide will spend its points on the following stats:

* Wind-up speed
* Rotation speed

====''<u>Attunements</u>''====
Chorus Divide will use the players highest invested attunement upon obtaining the Resonance.
*The [[Flamecharm]] variant will apply burn to players hit by the beams, turning the beams orange.
*The [[Frostdraw]] variant will apply chilled or crystallization to players hit by the beams, turning the beams blue.
*The [[Galebreathe]] variant will apply suffocate or other gale talents to players hit by the beams, turning the beams green.
*The [[Thundercall]] variant will apply shock or apply surge to players hit by the beams, turning the beams yellow.
*The [[Shadowcast]] variant will (potentially) steal ether from, blind, and proc shadow talents to player hit by the beams, turning the beams black.
*The [[Ironsing]] variant will proc metal rods to players hit by the beams, turning the beams grey.
*The [[Bloodrend]] variant will proc blood talents and blood poison to the player hit by the beams, turning the beams red.

If the player has [[Saintsworn]], the second beam will be the attunement of their current '''Saint Stance''' instead. Each beam will scale on their respective attunement stats.

If the player is [[Attunement-less]], the beams will be an off-white, dealing 8 '''typeless''' damage per tick.

==Description==
The '''Chorus of Agonies''' is a Unique tier Legendary [[Weapons|Greataxe]]; a massive, skeletal dark axe stained with blood, pulsating with the [[The Enforcer|souls twisted and damned]] by the Trial, begging for their release. It can be obtained as a direct drop from the [[Heart of Enmity]] or from one of its chests.

Similar to all other drops from the Heart of Enmity, it automatically Soulbounds.

The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Three cheers, citizen! Fear not, we fight for you!|author=Chud Steel}} {{NPCInfobox |name=Chud Steel |alias=Interceptor Steel |aspect=Adret |pronouns=He/him |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]] |family=15 unnamed brothers |location=[[Fort Merit]] |image1=Chud Steel.png|Helmet ChudSteelNoHelmet.png|No Helmet }} ==Description== The gaudily-dressed soldier, more commonly known as Chud Steel, is a Greymarch [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is part of the Shock Corps division for [[The Central Authority]], serving as [[Sentinel Augustus]]' assistant. Chud is the face of the Authority's propaganda. Despite this, he is not just a figurehead and is no slouch. He claims to be capable of carrying 15 soldiers at a time and having once moved an orphanage with his bare hands. He wears the [[Authority Captain Uniform]] [[Outfit]] with a blue [[Authority Helm]], [[Brilliant Cape]], and [[Brilliant Boots]], forming quite the garish outfit. Chud Steel holsters a bell at his hip, signifying his strength to obtain a [[Resonance]]. ==Location== Chud Steel is located on a balcony along-side [[Sentinel Augustus]] at the large castle in [[Fort Merit]]. Chud Steel Map.png ==Dialogue== |-|Authority Ensign= {{#tag:tabber|No Division= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*An {{g|Adretian}} soldier clad in garish blue armor stands before you, beaming with pride. You can't help but feel like you've seen that helmet before...*'' HURRAH, soldier! Welcome to the Central Authority Military! Keep on keeping on! ''*He flashes you with two finger guns. You can't tell, but you swear he's giving you a pristine smile underneath that helmet of his.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}-{{!}}Any Division= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}''*You salute the flashily-dressed soldier. He salutes back.*'' HURRAH, my comrade! Interceptor Chud Steel at your service! Proud to serve the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Chud Steel?.. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}''*A spark of recognition flashes violently in your mind. You've seen this guy before - he's plastered all over the posters in Fort Merit. You stand before Interceptor Chud Steel, a legendary {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} Warrior. Though, when last you checked, he was serving in the {{g|The Central Luminant|Central Luminant}}.*'' That's right, comrade! My name is indeed '''Chud Steel'''! I know, I get a lot of questions about it - it's a long-running family name! What's your name, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I am [Rank] [Full name]. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}''*Interceptor Steel radiates pride beyond measure, as he removes his helmet, almost supernaturally. It seems he was hiding a chiseled, flawless face, deep gold-amber eyes and an impeccably kept haircut underneath.*'' HURRAH, comrade! It is good to make your acquaintance! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Say, I thought you were meant to be serving in the Central Luminant? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're quite famous, what's your story, soldier? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the deal with all those letters, Interceptor? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, I'm a big fan of yours - may I get an autograph? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, may I hear one of your legendary catchphrases? You know... for the fans! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*Interceptor Steel flashes you a brilliant smile*'' That is true, my friend! However, I get moved around a lot! High command sends me where morale is low. They say my presence inspires the troops - and I'm told things feel quite grim in Fort Merit right now, so here I am! For now, I proudly serve as Sentinel Augustus' right-hand man! ''*He demonstratively holds up his left hand.*'' {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*He puts his chest out with pride.*'' My family were but humble farmers, [Rank] [Last name], but we could not stand idly by while so much villainy threatened the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}. So, my 15 brothers and I enlisted in the military, to defend {{g|Lumen}} from evil! I rose through the ranks serving in the {{g|The Western Luminant|Western Luminant}}, and my commanders took note of my good looks, endless bravado, and daring achievements, so they recommended me as a poster boy! I think I make a damn good one, I do! {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*He laughs with gusto.*'' That's mail from all of my adoring admirers! This batch here is all the ones that have come in today! I usually get about 20 letters each day. I write back to each of them! Each of them has a story to tell - looks like I inspire a lot of people to do their best! Hurrah! ''*The Interceptor winks.*'' {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*He laughs heartily.*'' I'd love to!... Er!.. Unfortunately, I don't have anything to sign with! Perhaps another time then, [Rank]! {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[See "Chud Steel's Legendary Catchphrases"] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're quite famous, what's your story, soldier? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the deal with all those letters, Interceptor? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, I'm a big fan of yours - may I get an autograph? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, may I hear one of your legendary catchphrases? You know... for the fans! {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are some of the notable things you've done? I'm curious. {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Have you ever gotten... *hate* mail? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Let's see! Once, I singlehandedly vanquished a platoon of enemies in a raid... One time, I swam 40 miles in armour to deliver a message to my besieged commander... I simultaneously carried 15 wounded soldiers on my back to home base after our field surgeon was killed in action... Oh, once I moved an orphanage building out of the way of a fire! Pushing it was a proper workout! ''*Is all of that actually true?.. Despite your doubts, this man looks physically incapable of lying. There is oblivious sincerity in his voice.*'' {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Hah, plenty! Many of the foul villains of {{g|Lumen}} write to me to let me know how angry they are with me! Plenty of them have said very rude words about me!.. I write back to them, too! I say polite things, though! Gotta be the bigger guy sometimes and show sportsmanship! ''*He shoots you a double thumbs up.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Really? How are you still only an Interceptor after all of this? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Say, I thought you were meant to be serving in the Central Luminant? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're quite famous, what's your story, soldier? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, I'm a big fan of yours - may I get an autograph? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, may I hear one of your legendary catchphrases? You know... for the fans! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*He flashes one of his sparkling trademark smiles.*'' High command says the rank suits me! I'm told being an Interceptor is better for my inspirational image as a rank-and-file soldier - and I wouldn't wanna disappoint my comrades! Besides, it motivates me to work ''harder''! One day, I'll surely become an Operator!.. But make no mistake, friend, for each of my great achievements, I've been issued a medal! {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How many medals do you have? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*Interceptor Steel winks.*'' I have twenty three Orders of the Star, thirteen Honours of the {{g|The Sovereign Drallis Ehr|Sovereign}}, thirty six Orders of the Revered, and sixty eight Steel Hearts! Those ones used to be called the 'Bronze Hearts of Valour', but they renamed them after me! Hahah! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Say, I thought you were meant to be serving in the Central Luminant? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the deal with all those letters, Interceptor? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, I'm a big fan of yours - may I get an autograph? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Interceptor Steel, may I hear one of your legendary catchphrases? content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=My protege! Care to undergo another lesson? I'll put your intellect to the test!|author=Ciea, after having done one quest.}}
{{NPCInfobox|image1=Ciea.png|name=Ciea|aspect=Vesperian|location=[[Starswept Valley]] (In a cave above [[Widow's Hollow]], next to [[Shrine of Mastery]])}}

==Description==
Ciea is a female Vesperian that tells the player to make potions with specific effects. So far she is known to ask you to make:

*A potion that brings forth a surge of speed '''''(Pomars or Alestrian Coral)'''''
*A potion that causes a person to lose sanity '''''(Urchins, Chum, Scallops, Seaweed, or Thresher Eggs)'''''
*A potion that restores some life force '''''(Redds or Glumfigs)'''''
*A potion that harms its victims '''''(Browncaps, Bluecaps or Pomars)'''''
*A potion to regenerate ether '''''(Dentifilo, Bluecaps)'''''

Every fulfilled request gives EXP. Fulfilling 3 requests gives you the {{t|Harvester}} Talent.

There may be different options when you talk to Ciea, but for the ones listed, you'll have to use those specific ingredients or else she won't take it. You can use diluted potions (potions with only 1 copy of an ingredient) without any detriments to rewards given.

Her quest is needed to get the [[Saltchemist]] Oath.

'''NOTE''': ''Certain ingredients such as [[Redd]] <u>'''do not spawn'''</u> during [[Winter]].'' Keep this in mind before doing her quest.

==Location==
Ciea is located in [[Starswept Valley]] right beside the [[Shrine of Mastery]].

title: Cinders of Etris
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Cinders of Etris|caption=DEFEND ETRIS OR BRING IT TO ITS KNEES}}
[[File:CindersOfEtris.png|center|thumb|900x900px]]
Also referred to as "Etris Raid Event", "Etris vs Authority Raid Event", "Etris Raid", "Etris Burning Event, "Etris War Event"

==Description==
The siege of Etris is a large and rare event/disaster in which [[The Central Authority|the Authority]] makes its way into the heart of [[Etrea]], the city of [[Etris]].

At the beginning of the event, NPCs at the dock such as [[Seraphina]] or [[Etrean Guardsmen]] will talk about the Authority ceasing their operations in the East, as if they're preparing for something. Soon after, the docks are greeted by a large number of both [[Etrean Guardsmen|Etrean]] and [[Authority Officer|Authority]] soldiers fighting as a deafening explosion rings throughout the island. Slowly, the Authority crawls up into the city of Etris, starting from the docks, to the Etrea Wilds, and eventually reaching the main city, causing more and more havoc to break out. 

Within the town, significant [[NPCs]] like [[Polis]] will attempt to fight off Authority soldiers that are crowding him, but will prioritize Authority Commanders above all. [[Nell, Master of Frost|Nell]] the Ice Trainer will stay neutral unless provoked, in which she will help fight off the Authority.  

If you participate in this event and defeat all of the [[Authority Footsoldier|Authority Guards]], an [[Authority Commander (NPC)|Authority Commander]], or [[Polis]], 3 Large Chests will spawn at the city's center, yielding '''high-tier [[The Depths|Depths]]''' Loot, sometimes including [[Deep Gems]], Legendary Rings, the powerful [[Wyrmtooth]] and [[Kanabo]], and the schematic containing [[Justicar's Armor]]. You will also unlock the [[Justicar]] [[Origins|origin]]. 

Additionally, you get positive [[Etrea#Reputation|Etrea reputation]] if you killed the Authority soldiers including the [[Authority Commander (NPC)|Authority Commander]], and positive [[The Central Authority#Reputation|The Central Authority reputation]] if you killed [[Polis]]. 

You are bound to accidentally hit NPCS belonging to the Etrea faction. Don't worry, as even though it gives bad reputation then, the positive reputation given for beating the event overcomes the negative reputation by quite a lot.

== Waves ==
The event is made up of multiple waves that spawn one after the other and get closer to Etris.

A wave is completed once all combatants of a side spawned by the event (thus, not including the naturally occuring Etrean Guards) are defeated, triggering the next one to spawn.

The waves will NOT progress if even just 1 member of a side is left. Make sure to look for strays stuck in odd places or pushed too far away to aggro.

==Trivia==
*'''[[NPCs]] will have special dialogue during this event, such as:'''
**"Get to the town center! Hurry!"
**"Something terrible draws near. You best run while you still can. I think this may be a bloodbath."

*Authority Guards will also have special dialogue nearing the end of the event, such as:
**''ONE FINAL PUSH! TO THE CENTER, ROUT THEM!''
*One of the only places that will never burn in the Etris Raid Event is [[Lord Regent]]s Palace.  
*[[The Children of Navae]] unintentionally help Etris by attacking any Authority NPCS that come too close to their camp in Etrean Wilds.
*Additionally, Nell the Ice Trainer will help fight any Authority NPC that wanders too close.
*This event was unable to spawn during the Winter season until the 5th of July 2024 Update.
*This is the only time in the game that the name of a place changes due to an event.
*This event is intended to be disabled so that it can be reworked into a [[World Events]]. However, it is not, which also allows it to spawn in [[Vow of Iron]].

title: Circle of Honour
content:
{{InProgress}} {{Quotes|quote=Memory of warriors,
In Iron we recall -
The triumphs of the glorious,
Who heard the solemn call.|author=Excerpt from 'Hymn Of Iron'}} {{Factions |leader=Unknown |subunits= |image1=Silhouette.jpg |territory=[[The Cerebral Spire]] |goals=Defeat [[Zi'eer]].}} __TOC__ ==Description== The Circle of Honour is an organization whose main goal is to defeat [[Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet]] of [[the Ministry]]. To this end, [[The Inheritor]] goes through [[Mementos]]: Memories of the fallen Circle of Honour members to face him in the past and find a way to defeat him in the present. Those who are members of the Circle must have taken the [[Vow of Iron]]. Certain members of the Circle wear an [[Iron Memento]], an iron tag. The Circle was allied with the [[Etrean Royalists]] during the [[Etrean Civil War]], due to both sharing the cause of wanting to take down Zi'eer. However, the Circle has no concrete political affiliation. Their members come from a variety of factions, many of which are at odds with one another. All of the deceased Mementos were said to be capable of defeating [[Zi'eer]], but failed to do so and ultimately fell to his hand. ==Notable Members== [[Reclaimer of the Recollection]] - The second known surviving member of the Circle of Honour besides [[Warden Jericho]]. He serves as the tutorial, progression and conclusion [[NPC]] in the [[Vow of Iron]]. He puts [[the Inheritor]] in [[the Recollection]] and helps them go through the [[Mementos]] with the ultimate goal of defeating [[Zi'eer]]. [[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]] - The Maestro of [[the Vigils]] during the [[Etrean Civil War]] and a wielder of the [[Oaths|Warmaster Oath]]. He was a predecessor of [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]], who seems to have the same views as Alkhurst, although, it is unknown whether Evengarde is allied with the Circle as well. [[High Monk Junsui]] - The High Monk of the [[Temple of Mur]]. Reveals information on the [[Etrean Royalists]], their leaders and the [[Etrean Civil War]]. He seems to know a lot about [[the Lord Regent]]'s power. [[Warden Jericho]] - The current Warden of the [[Eastern Luminant]] and the first known surviving member of the Circle of Honour. He wields the [[Oaths|Warmaster Oath]], holds a high-ranking position in [[the Central Authority]], and is torn between being a member of the Circle and an officer of [[the Central Authority]].[[Jericho's Journal]] [[Naan Zakshun]] - The grandmother of [[Traan Zakshun]]. Haggling junk runs throught the family, as she uses her ties to the Circle of Honor to sell items to the Inheritor. How relevant she actually is to the Circle is unknown. [[High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi]] - The High Inquisitor before [[High Inquisitor Merey]]. Although his impact may not be noticeable, he greets the Inheritor with the Circle's words and if they have bad reputation, Mordred will attack them and then reassure them that there's nothing personal. ==Trivia== *The Circle of Honour has been known to be part of ''Deepwoken'' long before the release of [[Vow of Iron]], with mentions going as far back as ''Verse 1'', from sources such as Discord lore drops for the [[Oaths#Warmaster|Warmaster Oath]], the [[Windrunner]], the former [[Journal of Warden Jericho]] and the current [[Jericho's Journal]], though its role in the story wasn't as emphasized as it is today thanks to Vow of Iron. At the time, they were largely believed to be part of the Central Authority, but it has since been clarified they are distinct groups. ==References== [[Category:Circle of Honour]]

__TOC__

==Description==
Cirryn, the Starset Blade was a hero of [[the Hive]]. He defended the Hive and its [[artifacts]] from [[Etrea]]n invaders.<ref name="Lament" />

Some times after this, he lost his one. [[Remaz]], one of the Hive's [[lifeweave]]rs, mentioned that there were a lot of stories about Cirryn and his power.<ref name="Lament" />

A group of [[lifeweave]]rs, consisting of [[Ehkusa]], [[Ka'al]] and Remaz is entrusted by a hivelord, [[Ximac Diri]], with a mission to revive Cirryn to serve the Hive, using their powers.<ref name="Lament" />

Their mission ended in partial success, as Cirryn was revived, but turned against them, going berserk and destroying the Greathive's plaza. Eventually, Cirryn was sealed in the lifeless chamber by Ehkusa and Remaz, with the latter one sacrificing his life in order to lure the rogue Cirryn in the chamber.<ref name="Lament" />

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The gunslinger's subtly shifts, as his ears perk up at your approach - although his efforts remain fixed on the trapdoor he appears to be trying to open.*'' Sorry, pal. Finders keepers. I've already staked a claim to this trapdoor and the contents of whatever lies inside. Just... can't get it to open. Thing's ''stuck''.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's inside?
{{!}}-

{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The gunslinger glares at your approach.*'' Another Union thug? You're below my paygrade, buddy. Buzz off.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Intellect=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has at least 25 [[Intelligence]].
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The gunslinger's subtly shifts, as his ears perk up at your approach - although his efforts remain fixed on the trapdoor he appears to be trying to open.*'' Sorry, pal. Finders keepers. I've already staked a claim to this trapdoor and the contents of whatever lies inside. Just... can't get it to open. Thing's ''stuck''.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}This places seems old. The wood is probably pockmarked with rot. Why not just break the trapdoor down? [Intelligence]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He looks at you for a moment, annoyed.*'' ...Yeah? I know that? I ain't ''stupid''. Of course I could just... ''*He trails off. Hesitating for a moment, he sighs.*'' ...Listen. I'll come clean. I'm just slacking off on my work here. Company pays me by the hour - and I'm {{sh|bored out of my gourd}} out there. I don't even get to shoot the Mudskippers that periodically clamber out of the mine. Ignacio puts them down without even lifting his eyes from that fancy doohickey he's using.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}That's rough. Or, good for you, I guess. Whatever. Have you seen what's beneath that trapdoor, then?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He smirks.*'' Tsch. Yeah? I'm as good with a lockpick as I am with a pistol. Of ''course'' I already looked inside. You know what's ''actually' in there? You're not ready for this.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Well? What is it?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He takes a deep breath, closing his eyes as he exhales.*'' {{sh|...ABSOLUTELY NOTHING}}. Just '''bricks.''' The room underneath has been '''WALLED IN.''' Straight up filled with bricks and stone and mortar. {{sh|For what purpose!?}} It took me HALF AN HOUR to pick the lock without breaking it out of the rotting wood! Just because I wanted to avoid making loud noises, so that I wouldn't draw my colleagues' attention?! I had to be '''EXTREMELY''' delicate with it!?! ''*His eye twitches. He looks positively apoplectic.*'' ...What kind of psychopath would ''DO'' something like that? To an honest plunderer?!?
{{!}}-

They wear a sleeveless version of the [[Assassin's Cloak]] and an [[Assassin's Hood]]. They can be of various races. Cloaked Assassins are spotted in various [[Random Encounters#Sea Events|Sea events]], having either captured an island or ambushing a [[Chili|Merchant Ship]]. They can also be found in groups of 3 during faction ambushes, spawning in place of the faction NPCs or [[Bounty Hunter (NPC)|Bounty Hunters]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal consists of either a [[Whaling Knife]], [[Krulian Knife]], [[Champion's Dagger]] or [[Tanto]] along with the [[Frostdraw]], [[Shadowcast]], [[Thundercall]] and [[Ironsing]] Attunements: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |User unleashes a quick flurry of slashes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Strong Left'''
(★★☆) |A powerful, flinging punch that shatters the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Revenge'''
(★☆☆) |A quick dash signified by a red-line effect, which teleports the user some distance forward upon activation. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, teleport }} |- |
'''Dash'''
(☆☆☆) |A dash that sends the user a considerable distance forward. Deals no damage. {{AttackTags |unharmful, movement }} |- |
'''Ice Daggers'''
(★☆☆) |Forms three daggers of ice before throwing them towards the nearest person. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Eruption'''
(★★☆) |An eruption of ice spikes in front of user. Deals moderate damage and applies freeze. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, stun }} |- |
'''Lightning Stream'''
(★☆☆) |Grapples onto an enemy and pulls them in. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull }} |- |
'''Lightning Cloak'''
(★☆☆) |The user's body is enveloped in a lightning-like cloak, improving agility, swing speed, and granting lightning dashes. {{AttackTags |unharmful }} |- |
'''Clutching Shadow'''
(★☆☆) |Targets one enemy within a radius around the caster (signified by a red glow around the targeted foe) and lifts them up into the air before slamming them down. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Shadow Assault'''
(★★☆) |The user pulls back weapon and rushes forward in a shadowy attack {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement }} |- |
'''Chain Pull'''
(★★☆) |Summons a chain out of their hand that quickly pulls you towards them. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull }} |} === Talents === *Precise Swing - After landing a critical, their next light attack will deal 25% chip damage towards your block. *{{cl|raretlnf|Cheap Shot}} - Your attacks gain 10% PEN when you have an active speed boost. *{{cl|raretlnf|Frozen Pin-Cushion}} - Ice Daggers now freeze opponents. *Frostbite - Enemies no longer heal when under the effect of your chill. *Time To Go - Taking a life grants a speed boost for 10 seconds. Taking a player's life doubles the speed boost and the duration. *Steady Footing - You're much more resistant to being pushed around. *Scaredy Cat - When enemies initiate a fight first, gain a speed boost. *Sunken Predator - Enemies you hit in the water have their speed buffs nullified and are slowed. *Swift Rebound - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. *{{cl|raretlnf|Evasive Expert}} - Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased. *{{cl|raretlnf|Risky Moves}} - When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Ghost}} - Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible until you attack. *{{cl|raretlnf|Strong Stern}} - The duration you are dazed from wall bangs is cut in half *In a Hurry - You grip faster with a movement speed boost. *{{cl|raretlnf|Chronostasis}} - Landing an M1 or Critical Strike puts target [[Resonance]] on cooldown for a short duration. ==Finisher== A Cloaked Assassin executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with their blade. |} ==Tips== *S-holding and constantly rolling and blocking is heavily recommended, as they '''WILL''' spam Mantras. *Pretty difficult to fight and seem very intimidating. However, just don't fold under pressure and parry as you normally would with any other NPC. *Basically all faction NPCS hate these guys. If you really are having trouble, just run to the nearest faction NPC. ==Gallery== CloakedAssassinEnchant.png|A Cloaked Assassin with an enchanted weapon ==Trivia== * Cloaked Assassins wear an [[Assassin's Cloak]]. However, their cloak is missing its sleeves. It is unknown why this is. * When spawning as a Faction Ambush, they can lose sight of their target and stop chasing them, saying ''Rats, we lost them.'' {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]]

[[File:Coldheart Journal.png|right|255x255px]] {{clear}} ==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Book]] found in [[The Cold Forge]]. ==Text== ===
Coldheart's Journal
===
Or: a dead end Blasted thing. Not cold enough.
I can still feel it. That fetid warmth that calls forth sweat to bead at the small of my back.
Never was warm enough for her. Always needed more coats. Coats and hats and scarves.
Put on another layer she'd say. Throw a log on the fire she'd say.
Blasted woman. Now it's not cold enough.
What does that say? Her mind is fickle. Wavering. Unfocused.
Make up your mind. And when you do, reveal it to me plainly.
The thermal transfer isn't good enough.
I'm sure the Castle won't miss a few things. ---------- Dee, I've nipped out to grab some parts. Thought umbrite might do this time? Won't be long.
-F ---------- Bitter words. Harsh voices. They don't get it.
They never understood her. Or me. Or us.
Or my work. No one does. She didn't. And now look where she is.
Turns out, all I had to do was stop asking and start doing.
Give it a bit of time, they'll regret this. They'll realise I'm a hero.
They're too busy polishing that boots of that hag. They need a reality check. ---------- Deirdre. Please. How many times must I say that I'm sorry?
You never listen to me anymore. But then... I don't listen to you either, do I?
Show me a sign. Make your wishes known. I'm doing all I can.

How was I to know? I followed the principles. I spoke to the turncoat witch.
I couldn't just as well walk up to a Prophet now, could I?
He did a lot in getting me that recommendation, but... You never liked those sorts did you?
But that witch didn't get it either. Not that she would. Liars sink furthest.
Their souls are heavier. Burdened by all the lies they're keeping up. So when they {{g|The Drowning|Drown...}}
She told me enough. There's much she doesn't understand about this art.
There are many metals within the human body. Within blood, too.
You're finally cold enough. But that's not enough, is it?
You're selfish. I gave you new form. I made you every blade you asked for. They weren't good enough.
If you wanted something particular, you should have asked for it.
You're not listening to me. ---------- You're asking for the impossible. You can't breathe life into a weapon. You've lost the plot.
The bootshiners got a shipment. I saw it when I was prying the spare screws out of the bedframes.
{{g|Lifeweave / Lifewoven|Lifewoven}} blades. I told you about them remember? But they're not good enough, are they?
They don't breathe, do they?
You don't breathe either, I suppose. But you're still alive in there.
Under all that mess. You've been helping me all along.
You'll be happier this way. Just give it some time. They wouldn't lie to me. Not him, at least. Maybe to the others, but not to me.
Never to me. He always looked after us.
We wouldn't have met if it weren't for him.
You wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for his advice. ---------- He's still down there, Dee. They keep sending scouts. He's still down there.
How do we get him out? We owe him so much.
They say he lost his mind.
But maybe he's just found it? What he was looking for?
That city?
I hope so. He was good to us.
He'll know what to do. ---------- How is it that I've learnt so much, but progressed so little?
Word is travelling. Just as the witch did. Those filthy labourers found something.
{{g|Ironsing}}. They found it. I don't know how. Maybe someone dredged something up from here?
But it won't do. What they found won't do what you're asking for.
You keep asking for it.
No matter how many blades I present you, it's never enough.

It was never enough. Was I never enough?
How can I apologize to you if you never hear me?
It's not my fault you don't have ears. Or a mouth. Or eyes.
I miss when we could just talk. Wasn't that enough?
Now it's all about which elements to use. Which blades to work.

How to breathe true life - a soul, you keep saying - into a blade.
It can't be done. Not here. We drown too readily.
Pry a soul free of its vessel and it drops like a stone.
Maybe in the {{g|The Old World|Old World}} they did it. Maybe out there all those ruins.
But no. Everything's gone. It all came down here. They city. Celtor. The whole lot of it.
Nothing remains. The surface has nothing for me.
It never did. ---------- It's clear to me you don't need my talents anymore.
You never did. Always so special. So so special.
To me, mind. And in a good way.
You never flouted it.
I loved buying you that coat you always wore. You lit up!
But, this is goodbye, Deirdre. I'm taking the ores.
You can keep the blades, okay?
And my notes. Maybe you'll take up the pen and start actually telling people something for once?
Sorry. I know you can't help it. You don't have hands after all.
I'll find a weapon for you, But it won't be the one you keep asking for.
But I need to be honest.
It can't be done.
I know you looked up to her. Sudaruska.
But what she did she did while she still drew breath. I have done what I can, but...
You aren't a weapon, Deirdre. You make weapons.
You can't be her. It's too late for that.
Give up your dream. You're not coming back. I'm sorry. ---------- i didnt mean it i didnt mean it i didnt mean it oh gods i didnt mean it
i didnt mean to put you in here
i didnt mean to make you like this ---------- what's up?
you won't talk?
you know where to find me when you change your mind ---------- do you hate me
i cant bear to look at you like this ---------- i miss you
i cant turn you back ---------- i put you in there
but i cant bring you back
you were a person not a blasted tool
and now you're all metal and pipes and
i said i would
i know i did
but i'm so sorry. ---------- i said i'd stop coming back
but were you ever in this forge?
it's been so long.
i'm so sorry.
i miss you so much
[[Category:Books]]

title: Coldheart Fortinbras
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |image1=Coldheart.png |caption1=And it seems to me you lived your life. Like a candle in the wind. |health=12,000 |drops=[[Hailbreaker]] |weapon=[[Hailbreaker]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Warden's Blades *Blood Stakes *Rising Frost *Ice Flock }} ==Description== '''Coldheart Fortinbras''' is an enemy found in [[The Depths]]. He can spawn randomly as an event, or more likely as a quest for [[The Divers]] (found on the Quest Board in [[Castle Light]] or in/around [[The City of the Drowned]]). When Fortinbras spawns, he will be in the leaning emote until you approach him. As a Black Diver, Fortinbras was a scientist of sorts, acting out of [[The Cold Forge]]. Fortinbras had a lover named Deirdre and was motivated to seek out [[Bloodrend]] to save her. As per the recommendations of fellow Black Diver, [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]], he sought out [[Vyrelda]] to unlock its secrets. His growing madness eventually lead him to be shunned by his colleagues. He is wearing a [[Black Diver]] Outfit and uses the [[Frostdraw]] and [[Bloodrend]] attunements while wielding the legendary Frostdraw weapon: the [[Hailbreaker]], with his version capable of having [[Enchantments]] on it. ==Moveset== Fortinbras' arsenal consists of the [[Hailbreaker]] along with the [[Frostdraw]] and [[Bloodrend]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Fortinbras winds up his blade and performs two quick slashes, freezing his opponent in place. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, stun }} |- |
'''Warden's Blades'''
(★★☆) |Summons four spinning blades of ice around himself. They deal constant damage before being launched as projectiles. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Blood Stakes'''
(★★☆) |Creates spikes out of his own blood and uses them to impale his enemies. Drains blood on hit. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Rising Frost'''
(★★☆) |Summons an ice glaive and performs a barrage that lifts both himself and the opponent into the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Flock'''
(★☆☆) |Summons a flock of rapid moving ice birds in front of himself, attacking his opponent from all angles. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} == Dialogue == *When spawning: **Crawling... Festering... Foul things... **Give it back... GIVE IT ALL BACK!! **BRING HER BACK! **There she is! Drowned and all... **She's right here... Drowned and all... **Frozen solid, they said... Can't help her... **Tombs of earth... Tombs of dirt... Tombs of mud... *When spawning with [[Dormant Splinter]]: **That... THAT THING! GIVE IT TO ME! **That... She must have it. I will feed it to her. She needs it. GIVE IT TO HER! **It... No.. All this time... NO!!! *When gripped: **Did you miss me? **I'll see you soon... **How cold... I thought you were happier this way... **I miss her. **Am I to be a machine, too? == Trivia == *His bell is frozen and produces a white mist, although what the bell does is unknown. *He has the same eyes as [[Nell, Master of Frost]], with dark sclera and blue irises. *He seems to be in his mid forties indicated by his crow's feet on his face. *His name is a reference to Prince Fortinbras, from ''The tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark''. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:The Depths]] [[Category:Random Encounters]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]]
