</gallery>
|desc=Every enemy you slay while equipping this weapon will always be Drowned. Enemies hit will also experience reduced healing. It also applies 10 seconds of Ether Sunder to PvE opponents.
|obtainment=
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' [[Enchant Stone]]:
*Trading 25 [[Void Spire]]s and {{c|crowns|10}} to [[The Gaunt Man]]
|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes
}}

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a [[Gaunt Man]]-exclusive debuffing curse [[enchantment]] applies anti-heal on hit.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} applies the {{status|Void}} status effect for 30 seconds. This applies a 40% anti-heal effect.

Additionally, if a player dies while under the effect of the Void status effect, they will be sent to [[the Depths]] regardless of how many lives they have.

In PvE, your weapon attacks apply {{status|b=y|Ether Sunder}} for 10 seconds, granting 30% elemental damage reduction against their attacks.

==={{cl|lired|Curse}}===
Your [[Health State]] is set to {{status|b=y|Cursed}} while a Curse of Void enchanted weapon is equipped, "staining" your health bar, and making every death send you to [[The Depths]]. Taking damage will extend this effect for 60 seconds, meaning your healthbar will remained stained for some time after weapon swapping. This may not be visually displayed as a stained healthbar due to a bug.

===Notes===
*'''If you have not completed [[The Gaunt Man]]'s trial on your character, this enchantment will not work and your weapon's damage will be voided.'''
*Anti-Heal does not stack with other sources of anti-heal. The most potent effect will take priority.

*[[Hive Construct]] (direct drop)
*[[Rogue Construct]] (direct drop)
|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes
}}

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is an RNG-based curse [[enchantment]] that applies burn on proc.

==Effect==
After landing enough hits, {{PAGENAME}} causes an explosion and applies a {{status|Lifelord's Blaze|green burn}} effect.

The explosion deals a random amount of damage, between 0 and 33. This deals typeless damage, ignoring armor resistances.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 5 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 4 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 3 hits for [[Heavy Weapons]].

==={{cl|lired|Curse}}===
On proc, your opponent is given a random amount of {{status|Temporary Health}}, between 0 and 50. Temporary Health given is always whole numbers.

Unlike all other sources of Temporary Health, the Temporary Health given from this Enchantment cannot be nullified or reduced through {{status|Anti-Heal}}.

===Notes===
*Mechanically, the burn is completely identical to base burn, with the only difference being its color.
*Critical attacks only grant 1 stack maximum, regardless of how many hits they have, similar to [[Detonation]].
*This enchantment is very good for PvE, as the explosion has 7.65x PvE scaling and the Temporary Health does not have PvE scaling.

==Trivia==
*This Enchantment was formerly called "Curse of Rhaemen's Ember".

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is an RNG-based curse [[enchantment]] that deals health-based damage.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} has a chance to add a percentage of your maximum health to your weapon's scaled damage on hit. If this procs, the enchantment goes on a 12 second cooldown.

The amount of your maximum health applied to your weapon's scaled damage varies based on your weapon type, being 3% of your maximum health on [[Light Weapons]], 4.5% of your maximum health on [[Medium Weapons]], and 6% of your maximum health on [[Heavy Weapons]].

==={{cl|lired|Curse}}===
Alternatively, instead of adding a percentage of your maximum health to your attack, take 7% of your maximum health as damage instead. If this procs, the enchantment goes on a 12 second cooldown.

===Notes===
*The curse and enchantment effects cannot proc on the same hit.
*Because this enchantment adds to your weapon's scaled damage, it will be applied '''before''' damage modifiers. This can lead to very high damage output.. assuming you get lucky.
*If the curse effect deals enough damage to knock you, you will be autogripped.

|obtainment=*Finding a {{PAGENAME}} enchanted weapon in a chest

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{text|enchantstone}}

|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes
}}

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a buffing curse [[enchantment]] that drains your opponent's blood on hit.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} grants a +10% damage modifier to your M1s. Additionally, your M1s attacks gain a blood drain effect.

==={{cl|lired|Curse}}===
Upon whiffing an M1, lose 2% of your maximum blood.

===Notes===
*The blood drain from this enchantment is unaffected by damage modifiers, blood damage resistances such as {{t|Alloyblood}} or {{t|Cauterized Wounds}}, and the [[Haemophilia]] flaw. However, it is affected by your opponent's damage resistances.
*Bloodthirsty's blood drain formula is as follows:
**Base: 0.1 * S * M + (0.1 * S + 3) × (0.9 + 0.1 * M)
**[[Daggers|Dagger]]: (0.1 * S + 1) * (0.9 + 0.1 * M)
**{{t|Alloyblood}}: 0.1 * S * M * 0.25 + (0.1 * S + 3) × (0.9 + 0.25(2 - M) + 0.1 * M)
**Key: S = weapon's scaled damage dealt, after resistances. M = blood damage multiplier; use 1 for Slash damage, 0.65 for Blunt damage, and 3 for Daggers.
*The blood drain from this Enchantment can be used to proc [[Bloodrend|Hemorrhaging]], dealing 15% of any PvE enemy's health once a blood drain threshold is met. Because of how high the proc threshold is, this may not proc on non-Boss enemies. Additionally, it is recommended to pair this enchantment with the Bloodrend attunement to more consistently proc this effect.

title: Curse of the No Life King
content:
{{Relic |image= Enchant Curse of the No Life King.gif|Enchantment Curse of the No Life King Enchant Stone.png|Enchant Stone |desc=Grants passive regen and damages the sanity of your foes, but succumb to the insanity much faster, lose twice as much blood, and never be more than a step away from death. The amount of healing scales with your weapon stat invested. |obtainment=*Finding a {{PAGENAME}} enchanted weapon in a chest *[[Laplace]] '''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{text|enchantstone}} *#Any [[Enchant Stone]], [[Bloodless Gem]], [[Umbral Obsidian]] *#Any [[Enchant Stone]], [[Bloodless Gem]], [[Urchin]] |droppable=No |pass down=Yes }} ==Description== {{PAGENAME}} is a buffing curse [[enchantment]] that grants the user passive health regeneration and sanity drain on hit. ==Effect== {{PAGENAME}} grants passive regeneration to your character, scaling on your weapon investment. This passive regeneration will scale down with the more maximum health you have, with its formula being:
\left(f_{n}\left(M_{axHp}\right)\%\operatorname{of}M_{axHp}\right)\cdot\frac{W_{eaponInvest}}{100} + B_{aseHealthRegen}
[https://www.desmos.com/calculator/dhzch05wnv Desmos here] Additionally, your basic attacks reduces your opponent's sanity by 2% with every hit. ==={{cl|lired|Curse}}=== Your [[Health State]] is set to {{status|b=y|Cursed}} while a Curse of the No Life King enchanted weapon is equipped, "staining" your health bar, and making every death send you to [[The Depths]]. Taking damage will extend this effect for 60 seconds, meaning your healthbar will remained stained for some time after weapon swapping. This may not be visually displayed as a stained healthbar due to a bug. You take 2x blood damage from all damage sources while in the Overworld. If you reach 0 Sanity while having a Curse of the No Life King weapon equipped, your head will explode and you will instantly die. While in the [[First Layer]], you lose 2 sanity per second if your weapon is unsheathed. This stacks with the passive sanity loss from the Depths, totaling to 122 sanity loss per minute. The following effects have reduced effectiveness or are entirely disabled while this enchantment is equipped: *Healing [[potions]] heal you for less. *The [[Viscosity]] Enchantment and {{t|Conditioned Runner}} Talent are disabled. *{{t|Alloyblood}} and {{t|Cauterized Wounds}} are less effective. ===Notes=== *[[Wyrmtooth]] will prioritize Heavy Weapons investment over Medium Weapons. *This enchantment does not work in the [[Chime of Conflict]]. *If you unequip your weapon, the life that this enchantment stole will come back after 60 seconds, assuming it's the reason why your healthbar was stained in the first place. *Blood '''drain''' effects are entirely unaffected by Curse of the No Life King's double blood damage curse. This means this curse does not affect the blood loss [[Resonance#Corrupted Resonances|{{cl|corrres|Corrupt}} Resonance Downside]] nor casting or being hit by [[Bloodrend]] Mantras. ==Trivia== *This enchantment has the most individual balance changes of anything in Deepwoken, and is made fun of within the community as being the most nerfed thing in the game. *This Enchantment is a reference to [https://grimgar.fandom.com/wiki/No-Life_King the No Life King] from ''Fantasy of Grimgar and Ash. It might also be a reference to Hellsing, where Alucard's alias is "No-Life King".''[[File:Nolifekingreference.png|alt=Yayafino confirming the curse of the no life king is a reference from grimgar|thumb|Yayafino confirming the "Curse of The No Life King" is a reference from grimgar]]. {{History}} {{nav|enchants}} {{nav|specunobenchants|2}} [[Category:Enchantments]] [[Category:Weapon Enchantments]] [[Category:Curse Enchantments]]

title: Curse of the Unbidden
content:
{{Relic
|image=<gallery>
Enchant Curse of the Unbidden.gif|Enchantment
Curse of the Unbidden Enchant Stone.png|Enchant Stone
</gallery>
|desc=Your critical attack is replaced with Unbidden Counter, restoring posture and stunning your attacker. Your attacks drain Ether on hit.
|obtainment=
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{text|enchantstone}}
*#Any [[Enchant Stone]], [[Blue Gem]], [[Crystal Lens]]
|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes
}}

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing curse [[enchantment]] that drains your opponent's Ether on hit and replaces your weapon critical with a counter.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} drains your opponent's Ether on hit, based on scaled damage dealt. This drains 1 Ether for every 1.3 scaled damage.

Your critical attack is replaced with the Unbidden Counter, which costs 25% of your maximum Ether to use. If you successfully counter an attack, your opponent will be stunned, and you will gain slight hyperarmor and i-frames and restore 15% of your maximum Ether and 30% of your maximum posture.

This critical attack has an 8 second cooldown, reduced to 6 seconds if you successfully counter something.

==={{cl|lired|Curse}}===
Unbidden's critical does not deal damage and costs Ether.

===Notes===
*Curse of the Unbidden is buggy in PvE, as humanoid mob attacks can be countered, while non-humanoid ones can't be.
*Because Unbidden's critical does not have hitregistry, it cannot proc any "on critical" effects.
**You can use [[Warp Kick]] or the [[Mantle of Enmity]] to proc these effects instead.
*The [[Inquisitor's Greatsword]] Talent, ''Sovereign Counter'' increases the amount of posture restored on successful counter by 10%. From 30% of your maximum posture to 40%.

1.02x (one-handed) |attack duration=0.6s |penetration=15% |special effect=Aftercut is applied to all attacks. |obtainment=Chests from: *{{lp|Scyphozia}} *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[Duke Ishamon Erisia]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Lodestar]] [[Job Boards|Bounty job]] *[[Heart of Enmity]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Island Events]] *[[Weird Trader]] *{{lp|Aratel}} *Sold in [[Traan Zakshun]]'s black market for {{c|Crowns|4}} |selling price=100 |description=A prized blade supposedly forged during [[the Canticlysm]] by the first [[Galebreathe]]rs. |image= Curved.png|Current Model Haunted Curved Blade of Winds.png|Specter Path Curved_New_Model.png|Old Model Curved blade of the winds.png|Older Model |m.equip=No |enchantable=No |rarity=Mythical |chip damage=5% |oath=Silentheart |stances=2 Handed, 1 Handed (Dual wield)}} ==Description== The '''Curved Blade of Winds''' is a Legendary medium [[Weapons|Sword]] that can cut through both air and guards with breeze. The blade curves like the start of a spiral, and within its blade is Galebreathe energy showing in swirling eddies and dotted swirls. It scales with both Medium Weapon and [[Galebreathe]]. This weapon comes with a passive ability: *'''Gale After Cut''' - M1 attacks now apply After Cut, dealing 5% of the initial damage of the attack. ==Critical== File:Curved One Handed Critical.gif|One Handed (Dual Wielded) Critical File:Curved Two Handed Critical.gif|Two Handed Critical The Curved Blade of Winds has two critical attacks, with it reflecting on the user's weapon stance. Both criticals apply {{status|b=y|Suffocation}} or spawn Apparitions when landed. For the One-Handed (Dual Wielded) Critical, the user propels in a whirlwind of air, gravitating towards their cursor. This has a scaled damage modifier of 0.25x per hit. Deals 2.5 posture damage per hit if blocked. For the Two-Handed Critical, the user shoots a blast of air and on collision or after a short amount of time it will proceed to explode. This has a scaled damage modifier of 0.3x per hit. Deals 1.5 posture damage per hit if blocked. {{text|m1leg2}} Both criticals have a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. ==Gallery== File:CurvedConceptArt.png|Concept art File:CurvedDual.png|The old dual-sword stance for the curved blades. File:Haunted Curved One Handed Critical.gif|One Handed Critical w/{{t|Specter}} File:Haunted Curved Two Handed Critical.gif|Two Handed Critical w/{{t|Specter}} ==Trivia== *The sword is similar to a Chinese Dadao sword, which are machete-like daos. *The original model of the Curved Blade of Wind closely resembled the Windshear from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. *This is one of the most widely recognized weapons in Deepwoken, even extending to real life blacksmithing! **[https://youtu.be/MFUmEsBYf9E?si=JeNeFasI0o-CkMUy Forging the Curved Blade of Winds from Deepwoken! Roblox] (YouTube video showing someone smelt a real Curved Blade) *The original updated Curved Blade of Winds contained an absurd 120k vertices. Following the {{VersionHistory|2023|March 27th}} update, this was reduced to a mere 7k vertices. *The Curved Blade of Winds features two sets of lines written in runes that run alongside the blade's markings. *As the weapon is a dual wield, you are unable to utilize a Shield or Off-Hand gun. **You however can have a shield on your back in both stances, allowing you to utilize the {{t|Turtle Shell}} Talent. *The original model was a Wardens Blade with wind particles put onto the blade. *When one-handing this weapon, you have two blades, meaning the two-hand stance only has one. **This often leads people to mistake the single sword stance as the faster stance. *The runes on the blade read "GALEBREATHE" (top side) and gibberish (bottom side). *The Old Model for the Curved Blade of Winds resembles a 2018 Roblox Gear, called [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Catalog:Immortal_Sword:_Celtic_Blade "Immortal Sword: Celtic Blade"] {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Swords]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Medium Weapons]] [[Category:Dual-wielded Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons with multiple Criticals]]

title: Daggers
content:
==Description== Daggers are a quick and dexterous [[Light Weapons]] that deal low damage and posture damage, but make up for it with their speed. These weapons are typically locked to the One Handed stance. ==PvE Mechanics== When used with the {{t|Knife's Journey|r=rare}} Talent, Daggers gain a 15% chance to '''critically hit''' on basic attacks, dealing 5x their normal damage. This has a 15 second cooldown. '''Critical hits''' are not to be confused with '''critical attacks''', as they do not proc any "on critical attack" effects. This effect is Dagger exclusive, and does not work with the {{t|Switchblade|r=advanced}} Talent. [[Moppet]]'s critical attack cannot critically hit. ==Default Animations==

==Description==
The '''Dangerous Depths Pin Pack''' was a pin pack that was released as part of a Deepwoken and Makeship collaboration. Classified under the "Enamel Pins" category, it featured [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]] and the PvE combat skull. Its campaign ran from June 12th, 2026, to July 11th, 2026. The pins measured 3.81 cm in width and 2.76 cm in depth, weigh 11.4 grams, and were made from plated zinc alloy.

<poem style="text-align: center">
"Perpetually in danger? Or are you the dangerous one?

Either way, Chaser's sneering expression will at least draw aggro away from you."

title: Dapple-Horned Besul
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{EnemyInfobox|weapon=[[Gremorian Longspear]] |health=5000? |drops=? |moves=*Assault *Critical
*Ice Lance
*Ice Smash
*Rising Frost
|image1=Dapple-Horned Besul.png |affiliation=[[The Children of Navae]] }} ==Description== Dapple-Horned Besul is a [[Gremor]] [[NPC]]. She is the leader of the Navaen settlement at Meteor Isle. ==Location== Dapple-Horned Besul is found sitting on a rock with a blanket located at [[Meteor Isle]]. Dapple-Horned Besul Map.png {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |''*A Gremor woman with dappled horns sits atop a blanket, overlooking Meteor Isle. She wears exquisitely-made fur armour, and her arms are covered in nomadic tattoos.'' ...Ah. A homelander. Welcome to Meteor Isle. My people call me Dapple-Horned Besul. What brings you here? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I'm just passing by. Are you in charge around here? |- | colspan="1" |''*She nods.*'' I am the leader of the people of Meteor Isle, yes. My kin have settled this land. You are not the first to pass our lands recently, stranger. Many others like you already have. It feels like more and more people visit us these days. Be welcome here, if you walk in peace. But should you cause trouble, I promise you my retribution, and the retribution of my people. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You're Children of Navae, right? I thought your people tend to be... nomadic? |- | colspan="1" |''Besul sighs softly.'' We tend to be, indeed. But the hand of my kin has been forced. The {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} moves ever eastwards, and their march of fire and ash seeks to push us out of the lands in which we dwell, as our ancestors have... Six years ago they came to the East, and we have not known peace since. And five years since, we have decided that enough is enough. We will run no longer. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You settled here to escape the Central Authority? |- | colspan="1" |In a sense. We settled here to stand a chance against them. When {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} forces approach, the other Children of Navae - the wanderkind, - tend to leave their places of dwelling, and move on elsewhere. I understand that not everyone wishes to fight. Many of us wish to be left in peace. But the walls are closing in on us. Soon, there may be nowhere else to go. So we stand our ground here. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |How is life here treating you? |- | colspan="1" |''*Besul ponders for a moment.*'' We have had our ups and downs. The {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} try to attack our settlement constantly. But we have the strength to defend ourselves. But recent times have been... strange. More and more strangers pass by here these days. Not all of them come in peace. But those who do not learn of Navae's fury. And... ''*She pauses briefly.*'' |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |And?.. |- | colspan="1" |''*She sighs.*'' Our fellow Children of Navae who remain nomadic do not look upon us very favourably. A rift grows among our own people... Nomads who pass by will sometimes set up camp outside of our settlement. We trade with them, sometimes. We tend to their wounded. We fight along their side when trouble comes our way. They sometimes return the favour. But... They do not quite see things our way, in the end. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |''*Dapply-Horned Besul acknowledges your presence.*'' You are welcome here, homelander. But remember, should you bring us violence, it will be returned in kind. | colspan="1" |''*Dapply-Horned Besul acknowledges your presence.*'' Walk in peace, homelander. | colspan="1" |''*Dapply-Horned Besul nods at you.*'' Ah, a homelander. Be welcome here and safe, once again. | colspan="1" |''*Dapply-Horned Besul nods at you.*'' Welcome back, homelander. Is there anything you need? |- | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I just wanted to ask - why have your kinfolk settled here, again? |- | colspan="4" |The Children of Navae tend to be nomadic, but the hand of my kin has been forced. The {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} moves ever eastwards, and their march of fire and ash seeks to push us out of the lands in which we dwell, as our ancestors have... Six years ago they came to the East, and we have not known peace since. And five years since, we have decided that enough is enough is enough. We will run no longer. |- | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |You settled here to escape the Central Authority? |- | colspan="4" |[See first instance] |} ==Trivia== *Besul's racial variant appears to be the 'Cedar' variant of a [[Gremor]], with deep purple sclerae instead of the faint Purple. *Besul wears the [[Navaen War Chief]] Outfit. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:The Children of Navae]]

== Drops ==
The Dark Feather is a crafting item that commonly drops from killing a non-corrupted [[Deep Owl]]. Not to be confused with a [[Dark Feather#Void Feather|Void Feather]], which can sometimes drop from the same mob. (Corrupted Deep Owls ''cannot'' drop Dark Feathers, and will always drop Void Feathers)
== Uses ==
The Dark Feather is used in these recipes:

*[[Authority Captain Uniform]]
*[[Authority Commander]]
*[[Celtorian Tideknight]]
*[[Darksteel Plate]]
*[[Grandmaster Pathfinder Cloak]]
*[[Hive Tactician Armor]]
*[[Justicar]]
*[[Legion Centurion]]
*[[Prophet's Cloak]]
*Void Feathers, with 1 [[Umbral Obsidian]] and 3 Dark Feathers
It can also be used to obtain the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] [[Oaths|Oath]].

|-|Void Feather=
{{ItemTemplate
|name=Void Feather
|image=Voidfeather.png
|value=100
|weight=None
|rarity=Rare
|droppable=No
|bankable=No
|type=Monster Material
|desc=The shadowy remains of a mysterious being.}}
== Drops ==
The Void Feather is an item that rarely drops from a [[Deep Owl]]. 
It always drops from a corrupted [[Deep Owl]].

Cannot be deposited nor can it be dropped by players, even on death.

== Uses ==
The Void Feather can be given to [[Surge]] to progress the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper Oath]].

The Void Feather is used in these recipes:

*[[Ferryman's Coat]]
*[[Royal Etrean Guard]]
*[[Darkened Bastion]]
*[[Shadow's Flight]]
*[[Inquisition Light]]
*Dark Feathers, which gives 3 of them per Void Feather.



== Crafting ==
A Void Feather can be crafted using 3 Dark Feathers and 1 [[Umbral Obsidian]].

Their rarity has only deepened with time; not only were they perilously difficult to obtain, but the very creatures that produced them are now all but extinct. }} ==Description== '''Dark Pearls''' are a Shadowcast [[Relic]] [[Equipment]] item under the "Ears" category. When equipped, the pearls emit faint magic circles while ink blots out from within. File:Darkpearls.gif|Inky Pearls {{t|Inky Pearls}} turns your [[Vent]] black, makes it drain 47.5 Ether from targets it hits, and increases vent damage by 0.5% per point of Shadowcast. This also increases your Vent's Ether cost on successful hit from 22.5 to 47.5, as well as proccing Shadowcast Talents and {{t|Twisted Puppets}}' {{status|Shadow Burn|burn}}. == Gallery == File:Darkpearls Worn.png|Worn File:DarkpearlsVFX.png|VFX File:ScaryGrinchGreenEarrings.png|Dyed (0, 255, 0) ==Trivia== *Dark Pearls stacks with [[Imperator's Fury]] and all other "on Vent" effects, though it doesn't make Imperator's Fury Vent black. *Dark Pearls is the first, and currently only Relic '''Ears''' equipment, as all Relic equipment prior to Dark Pearls have been Torso equipment. *Dark Pearls is currently the only Ears equipment to grant health. *Though exclusive to the Shadowcast attunement, these earrings are frequently sought after due to being the only Ears equipment that has a Talent while still being tradeable. *These are one of very few items that grant negative stats. *The lowest Posture possible is 17, when pairing [[Citadel Frames]] with Dark Pearls. {{History}} {{Nav|Equipment}} [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:Ears]] [[Category:Relics]] [[Category:Equipment Relics]]

title: Day-night cycle
content:
[[File:Day-night cycle 120x.mp4|thumb|center|700px|The full day-night cycle, sped up 120x]]

==Overview==
The day-night cycle is a mechanic affecting the state of the world, brightening or darkening Lumen. It has two phases:
*'''Day (XX:10 - XX:50)''': During the day, the world is illuminated under the light of the [[Suncross]]. It rises from the northern side of the world, orbiting across the sky until it sets on the southern side of the world.
*'''Night (XX:50 - XX:10)''': During the night, the world is dark. The [[Moonseye]] can be seen above, swirling in the center of the sky.

The cycle lasts from hour to hour, starting at XX:00 and ending at X1:00 (XX:00 of the next hour).

XX:10 refers to any hour at 10 minutes. As this page refers to ''[[wikipedia:UTC|UTC+0]]'' as its base timeframe, some timezones may differ.

===Notes===
*The period of the day-night cycle is the same regardless of server region or server creation time.
*The cycle still progresses in [[Dungeons]].
*In the [[First Layer]], it will always remain night time.
*The peak lighting during the day lasts for 15 minutes, and the peak darkness during the night lasts for 10 minutes.
**The brightest time of day is from '''XX:20 to XX:40''', and the darkest time of night is from '''XX:55 to X1:05'''.
*The transition periods between the two phases (dawn and dusk) last 10 minutes each.

==Effects==
The day-night cycle, mechanically, has little effect in ''Deepwoken'' besides changing the lighting of the world. Below are the few time of day-reliant phenomena:
*The {{t|Dark Hours}} [[Talent]] increases the damage of your [[Shadowcast]] Mantras during the night.
*The {{t|Praise The Sun}} [[Talent]] gained from equipping the [[Revitalizing Pendant]] or the {{voi|Radial Pendant}} grants increased health regeneration and halves the duration of Anti-Heal status effects if you are under direct sunlight.
*[[Deep Owl]]s in [[Erisia]] spawn more frequently during the night.

==Trivia==
*In sped-up footage, you can notice two abrupt points during the night near the end and beginning of the cycle where the cycle progresses 5 minutes backward.
*A Flaw called "[[Boons and Flaws#Special Flaws|Wishbound]]" was given to players who made a wish with a, now retired, [[Developer Specs#Iltria (Leafre Spellhardt) (Retired)|developer]] for Money, Power, or [[Astral]] (which was the only way to obtain Astral until later on). The Wishbound flaw gave you insanity whenever night fell.

title: Death
content:
''If you want to know more about where you go after dying twice, see [[The Depths]].''
[[File:Death by Songseeker Frostdrawer.png|thumb|[[File:Death of a lineage.png|thumb]]]]

==Dying as a Game Mechanic==
'''Death''' is one of the core aspects of Deepwoken, making it a punishing but extremely rewarding and fun experience where all your actions have weight and consequences matter. It is a game based on '''Trial and Error''', similar to many other games where progression as a player comes from experiencing defeat countless times and improving upon your failures. Most of the game's mechanics rely on skill and in order to learn to use them effectively one must first spend a few sessions before getting the hang of [[Combat Mechanics#Combat Basics|parrying]] and [[Combat Mechanics#Combat Basics|dodging]].

Provided you haven't taken the [[Hollow]] Echo Modifier, you'll effectively have two lives. Upon each death you drop roughly half your notes and unequipped items, though the losses can be decreased via the Talent [[Talents#Robber Baron|Robber Baron]]. Worry not, as '''Soulbound''' items are not dropped on death. May that death have been your first your health bar will now appear '''stained''', meaning you're at risk of '''Drowning''' by dying again without '''unstaining''' yourself. Do note that certain areas classified as [[Voidzones]], the [[Voidsea]] included, will ignore the stain and '''Drown''' you regardless, with '''2x''' '''EXP''' as compensation for the risk.

== Stained Health and Drowning ==
As mentioned previously, dying will result in your health being stained, a sign of great risk and danger. In order to return it back to it's original state, cleansing it, you must level up your [[Power]] by spending your '''Investment Points''', essentially allowing you to die once more before '''Drowning'''. As a new player you should refrain from mindlessly spending those points merely for the sake of unstaining yourself, as those changes are permanent and you'll eventually learn proper [[Attributes|Attribute]] allocation.

Dying with a stained health bar however will result in a '''Drown'''. You'll appear in the [[First Layer|Scyphozia, the First Layer of The Depths]]. The most gut-wrenching dangerous place in the entirety of Deepwoken, as any death here will result in '''permanently losing your character''', also called [[Fragments of Self|Wiping]], especially since staying alive here is much harder than in the Overworld. This underwater place harbors many unique [[Enemies]] that will make quick work of your fragile body, but there is a way to survive and escape this deranged place.

===Voiding in The Depths===
While in the [[First Layer]], you may notice that a large portion of your health bar seems to be corrupted; this is your '''void''' health threshold. If your health is '''above''' this threshold, then jumping into the void in the First Layer will send you to the [[Second Layer]], potentially saving you from [[Fragments of Self|Wiping]]. If your health is '''below''' this threshold, then jumping into the void in the First Layer will '''wipe you'''. This threshold will change based on a variety of variables:
#If you are not in combat, are in PvE combat, or are in PvP combat while being '''below''' Power 16, then your void threshold will be 50% of your maximum health.
#If you are in PvP combat while being Power 16 or higher, this threshold will gradually increase, up to 75% of your maximum health at Power 20.
#This threshold will be reduced by 5% for every Player you are in combat with, capping at a minimum threshold of 40% of your maximum health.
<gallery widths="300">
File:Void Threshold.png|Void Threshold while not in combat
</gallery>

=== See how to escape The Depths [[First Layer#Escaping First Layer|HERE]]. ===
Should you successfully escape, your lives will be restored, and you will respawn at your last set spawn point in The Overworld.

''If you want to know more about the ways you can die, read the [[Death Compendium]].''
==Tips on Survival==
*Heal at every good opportunity and keep an eye on your '''Blood''', '''Hunger''', and '''Thirst''' bars. Ensure you have at least some food on you for your adventures, along with wood and a flint for a [[campfire]].
*It is unwise to kill people in general, as player combat is the #1 most dangerous activity in the entirety of Deepwoken and you will '''NOT''' survive unless you are skilled enough.
**Although frowned upon, you can always log off before being hit if you see a player with ill intentions. '''However, always beware of Combat Tags'''. There are two types of in [[Combat Tag|Combat Tags]] (check it's page for a proper explication). If you are in combat, you cannot log off by clicking the menu button in the top left corner. You can, however, log by quitting the game. Doing so while tagged will often '''kill you''', the only exception is beyond above 60% health during a '''PvE''' '''Combat Tag'''.
**There is an option in the configurations to turn off the leave game prompt for much faster logging. '''Heavily recommended'''.
*Avoid [[Voidwalker]]s by increasing your [[Reputation]] with the 6 main factions, those being; [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}, [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}, [[The Hive]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}}, [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}, [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}} and also their own faction, [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}
**[[Voidwalker]]s have a distinct black swirling aura around them when they are hunting a bounty, though it may not show up until it's too late, so stay alert.
**If you are in combat, and you clearly aren't strong enough to fight back, run. Get good at dodging and running until you are out of player combat, then log.
**They cannot legally hunt players below Power 5, or players who have not reached Power 15 on any character. See the [[Bounty Hunting]] page for details. It also contains information on not being hunted so it's good to check it anyway.
*You are '''NOT''' safe in your [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]]. All placed guild locations are visible on the map and anyone can enter it. Either take care of your business in your guild quickly and quickly leave or hide the door in a place hard to reach!
*Stay near your allies and friends, just having someone near will spook away most toxic players and greatly boost your chances of surviving an encounter with monsters.
*[[Lower Erisia]] and in front of [[The Lordsgrove|The Lordsgrove's Gate]], the most common places for leveling, will often have Gankers lurking. Always watch your back, especially if you look like an easy target.
*Entering a [[Whirlpools|Whirlpool]] sends you to [[First Layer|The Depths]] regardless of current lives, but it will '''NOT''' count as a '''Drowning'''. As such, you can cleanse your health bar without making your [[First Layer#First Layer: The Trial|Depths Trial]] harder.
*If you find yourself in extreme danger and in risk of '''Wiping''' in [[First Layer|The Depths]] jumping into the void below while above the stained threshold shown in your health bar will '''NOT''' result in a death, instead sending you to the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|The Ethironal Shrine, the First Floor of the Second Layer of The Depths]]. Escaping will safely bring you back to [[First Layer|The Depths]], potentially saving you from restarting everything.
*Always know your own capabilities. There is no shame in not being as skilled as other players as long as you always strive to improve.

==Trivia==
*The first time you die in gameplay, you're merely "injured", escaping alive - not actually "dead" as in your life being taken away. The second time you will actually die and your body will stay as a normal corpse in the Overworld. When you die, once more, in [[The Depths]], your character will truly "die," as your soul is sucked downwards through the layers so fast, the mind is unable to process the information it receives and the soul is torn apart.
**Escaping [[The Depths]] will actually bring you back to life, healing your bodily injuries like a miracle, as described in the [[Munet Journal|Munet Journal, XIV]], one of the multiple books.
**Before [[Lore#The_Tides|The Tides]], souls who perished ascended into the [[Moonseye]] above.

title: Death Compendium
content:
{{Quotes|quote=You act as though your actions are of your own volition, but even now you show yourself to be a mere servant. Did you really think any of your actions were of any consequence? Do not worry, little swine, your true masters will soon awake.|author=[[Khan (NPC)|Khan]], moments before snapping your neck with a shadowy friend}}

<big>Deepwoken's Death Compendium, a list of '''every''' possible death you can achieve in game.</big>
* Getting "gripped" (executed) by a player or NPC, typically by pressing {{Input|keybind|B}}.
* Be executed by a [[Monsters|Monster]]'s Finisher move, such as being crushed by a [[Megalodaunt]] or being turned into a [[Mudskipper]] by a [[Nautilodaunt]].
* Drowning.
* Bleeding to death.
* Burning to death.
* Falling from a high enough height that your entire health bar and then some is depleted, killing you instantly on impact with the ground/water.
* Having both your stomach and thirst meter at 0, draining your blood and eventually your health.
* Be {{status|Unconscious|knocked down}} while having high [[Insanity]], instantly killing you.
* Having [[Insanity|no Sanity]] while holding a weapon that is enchanted with [[Curse of the No Life King]], making your head swell and burst.
* Be hit by a [[Wind-Up]] that has enough charges to Auto-Execute while {{status|Unconscious}}, decimating you in one hit.
* Disconnect while in [[Combat Tag|combat]]. (Internet disconnection, being kicked, being banned, etc.)
* Speak to the [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Shrine of Yun'Shul]] without a [[Resonance]], making your head explode.
* Lie to [[Misérables]] about how many [[Kyrsan Medallions]] you have on your character.
* Be in the range of [[Blood Scourge]] while {{status|Unconscious}}, turning your body into a shriveled husk.
* Take lethal damage from a Corrupted [[Jar of Souls]] that has Resonance Points put into its Auto-Execute stat, instantly killing you and turning you into another soul for its collection.
* Enter [[The Lord Regent]]'s Throne Room without an audience, making him rip you apart with his tendrils. This includes talking to him after completing - or failing - the quest.
* Be unfortunate enough to be struck by a [[Stone Knights|Stone Knight's]] arrival meteor in [[The Starswept Valley]].
* Be skewered by a [[Legion Sniper]]'s [[Grand Javelin]] while {{status|Unconscious}} or at low enough health. Having too many people get hit by this will also auto-execute everyone.
* Explode. (Boat cannons, [[Detonation]], etc)
* Fail the parry check in the [[Trial of One]]. Maybe you weren't the One.
* Be unable to keep up with [[The Ferryman]]'s dance.
* Get automatically executed by one of [[Duke Ishamon Erisia|Duke Erisia]]'s many [[Galebreathe]] Mantras.
* Get sucked clean of your blood by the overgrown magic mosquito that is [[Chaser, Scholar of the Burning Blood|Chaser]].
* A death of one thousand cuts during a spar with [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]].
* Spit on [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] and be instantly executed for your disrespectful behavior.
* Get dissolved by the acid rain of [[Upper Erisia]].
* Get dissolved by acid lakes found at [[Upper Erisia]].
* Try to threaten [[Akira]] without being charismatic enough.
* Get crushed by a [[Boulder]].
* Glitch out. (This could mean a number of things, such as being flung by an [[Boats|Ironclad]] or glitching underneath the map and falling into the Roblox void. In most cases you won't be provided with a death message, and also will sometimes have your life automatically restored upon respawning.)
* Be detected by the anti-cheat, typically without actually cheating and without being banned. Also known as "being AA-gunned".
** '''Note:''' You will not be auto-banned for being AA-gunned, but a log of it will be made. If you die too many times via being AA-gunned, you ''will'' be at a higher risk for being banned. Have a clipping software open at all times in case this happens.
* Mistake the parasite eggs growing on your body for clumps of snow in the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Second Layer]]. (You will die a few minutes after 5 parasites have accumulated)
* Be erased from existence by [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]]'s space-time collapse, either by the unstable orbs or from not getting back to [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris]]' [[Light Hook]] in time.
* Find a way to escape the reset timer before it hits zero seconds, ''without'' using a combat tag.
* Being blown into the side of a bridge by the wind in the Eternal Gale while knocked.
* Getting knocked by a player, then getting flung into a different universe due to a bug, then dying to fall damage.
* Falling into the void in the [[First Layer]] without meeting the layer descent health requirement.
* Falling into the void in the [[Second Layer]].
* Attempting to enter [[The Hall of Shattered Wills]] without being an Administrator, Moderator, Developer, or Tester.

Death Causes listed by the game:

"You fell in battle to..."
* A Fearsome Opponent
* A Raging Inferno (Burning to death)
* A Lowly Bandit (Being killed by a [[Bandit]])
* [Enemy Name] (e.g. "Bandit Leader")
* [Monster Name] (e.g. "Megalodaunt")
* [Player Name] (e.g. "Rook Rethige")
* Starvation (Empty [[Combat Mechanics#Survival_Basics|Hunger and Thirst]] bars, which will drain your Blood and then your Health)
* Gravity (Death via lethal fall damage)
* Gravity, among other things (Above, but having been damaged by other sources)
* Various Causes (Self-explanatory)
* Impatience (Dying by timing a self-applied combat tag to the removal of your character when resetting. e.g. Dropping an item at the end of the resetting countdown)
* The Ceaseless Gaze of a Watcher (Dying to a [[Hollow Angel]] spawned by a [[Watcher]])
* Daring to Trespass (Entering [[The Lord Regent]]'s room in [[Etris]] without an audience)
* Drowning (Being {{status|Unconscious}} in the sea for long enough)
* The cruel embrace of the sea (Same as above)
* The cold embrace of the sea (Same as above)
* Ṕ̸̕ͅĻ̸̭̤̐Ừ̶͔̔C̷̨̠̑K̴̨̲̓̈ ̶͚͠Ỏ̸̞̈́̀Ù̸̬̣͐͒T̶͖̟̃͋ ̸̝̽Ț̵͔̅̇Ḧ̴̜̞̏Ī̷̧̗͋͂N̴̢̊Ȩ̷̹̊ ̸̜̖̚É̸̢̞̉͝Y̶̛͍Ẽ̵͍̯̃S̴̯̘͒̑;̵̗̑̈ ̶̤̀Ţ̵̡̗̂Ȩ̵̨͙͊Ą̶̘͔̋̑R̶̯̿ ̶̳̐O̷̭͋Ȕ̷̦͍̅̆Ṱ̷͍̩͊͊ ̸̱̓͝T̸͕̽͑H̵͍̀̌I̵͈̟͝Ņ̸̝́Ë̶̝̊͂ ̴̪̰̆̾T̵̢̯̾͋H̴̛̭̤̀R̷̩̋ͅƠ̵̪͛A̸̺͠T̸͔̯͊;̷̮͉̅ ̴̝͆̄L̷̗̣̀Ạ̵̢͍̄͆Ý̵͔͎ ̷̤̄W̸̗͎̉̌Ä̶̧̳̒Ŝ̷̨̡̐̂Ț̸͛E̴͇̲͠ ̸̲̀Ṫ̵͔̂Ó̸̩ ̶̖̈Ą̶̿L̷͔̓͠L̴̘̕ ̶̱͈̅Ẁ̵̝̙͋H̶͇́̀Ḭ̷͒͊Ç̵͎̖͋̉H̸̭̃͜ ̷̘͔̒̍Ĭ̴̭̿͠S̸̗̐ͅ ̵̢͕̀S̷̺̘̈́A̶̟͛̎C̷̭̞̀͒R̶̯̩̈́̓Ê̸̘̏D̵̺̺͝;̷̢̊̀ ̶̬̄̿T̵͎̀H̶͔̭̍͑E̶̜̹̕͝ ̴̞͊Ṁ̸̰͘͜Ȏ̶̳̫̌̚O̸̲͘͠Ņ̶̲͠S̵̡̬̒E̷͍͇͝Y̷̢͖̅Ḙ̵̡̈̚ ̵̮̰́̚C̶̹͑Õ̶͈͎̐̚Ņ̷̱͘V̶͍̗͗E̶̗̍Ř̴͎̲͐Ģ̴̝̪̄͗E̵̼̊̊S̵͍̔͘ ̶̰̱̎W̸̤̾Í̵̗̙̆Ţ̸̘̐Ḩ̴̼̭͋͠ ̴̞̤̌͘T̶̬͑̽Ḩ̵͙͓̃A̶̢̽̐T̴̡̲̾̚ ̶̥́͑B̵͚̂͜Ë̴̲̦Ļ̸̫̮͐Ǫ̶̱͔̀W̶̢̝̓̋. ([[Yun'Shul]], [[Misérables]] and [[Insanity]]-related deaths)
* Your own mind (Direct death from [[Insanity]] without head explosion)
* Something Twisted (Being executed by a [[Mindless Servant]])
* Your own Foolishness (Failing to pass the Charisma check on [[Akira]])
* An insidious parasite sewn by the Gale (Dying to parasites in the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Second Layer]])
* The Eternal Gale (Death via bone attacks from the [[Scion of Ethiron]])
* Space-time Collapse (Dying to the white orbs that spawn at the end of a [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]] run, failing to make it back to the [[Light Hook]] in time, or dying to the [[Kyrsgarde Champion, Kyrsa's Star|Kyrsgarde Champion]])
* Your disrespect, punished by the Tempest Eye (Spitting on [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] in his fight)
* Your master (Command: Explode from [[Vow of Mastery]])
* The Office Creature (trying to enter [[The Hall of Shattered Wills]] while not being a Tester/Moderator/Administrator/Developer)

title: Debriefing Log on Operator Polaris Enigvidion
content:
==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Book]]. ==Text== ===
Debriefing Log on Operator Polaris Enigvidion
===
"Operator Enigvidion, are you listening? Ignoring me isn’t making this any easier for the both of us" A stern voice snaps me back from wandering thoughts, raising my head from the floor I see an aged man sitting before me on an equally as aged wooden stool. "Apologies… I wasn’t paying attention for a moment." The man tilts his head down, giving the illusion of a menacing shadow falling over his weathered mask as a barely audible sigh fills the room. "That’s apologies 'Sir' to you." He continues before I have a chance to retort. "Alright, start over from the beginning. I want to know exactly how everything went, with explicit details, am I understood?" "Yes… I understand." As I once again begin to recount the events of today before I wear the patience of Adjudicator thin. Even though I have never seen one in person before, I know he has to be one of them from his commanding spirit, let alone the fact this room only has the two of us in it, a feat that would be impossible for a standard guard to arrange. "It was a boring day, just like any other… I wake up, I do the tasks assigned to me by the High Curators and along with my fellow Hivekin I work on manufacturing weapons and tools to help defend our Greathives. Then I spend my free time researching ways to improve technology we have…though it’s not like anyone of my superiors would even listen to anything a mere junior operator has to say, although they really should. That is not to sound ungrateful, as I am sure many would make due sacrifices for the opportunity to be where I am, let alone receive the benefits that go along with it, as I gain what a Hivekin fighting on the front lines to defend our Greathives would get, but without any of the dangers that accompany it." Taking a deep breath as I pause, quickly glancing at the man across from me to make sure he is satisfied this time before continuing. "As usual after I finish doing any independent research I can, I head up to the upper canopy to eat dinner and watch the sunset. A common thing for many Hivekin really, as the views across great distances are always pleasing to the eye. That’s when it happened, I approach the balcony and suddenly… directly in front of me, there is nothing there.." That’s when my story is interrupted by the Adjudicator again, as this isn’t the first time I have gotten to this point. "What exactly do you mean, 'there is ''nothing'' there?' explain." I shrug before starting my explanation "I mean just as I said, directly blocking my path was a patch of nothingness, a void that was completely empty… except it wasn’t, I could feel that the area was still there with my other senses, but with my eyes I couldn’t see it anymore." This time the Adjudicator simply motions with his hand for me to continue, I snort a shallow breath that couldn’t even be called a sigh out of a slight fear that I may annoy him further. "As I was saying before, although it pains me to admit, this void caused as unknown feeling in me…a sinking but strikingly desperate feeling. It was my first time experiencing something like that, and genuinely speaking I became rooted to the spot, unable to move an inch upon seeing it." "That sounds like fear to me, Operator Enigvidion. Were you afraid of emptiness?" As the words enter my ears, I almost wince at how true they sound, of course I knew what fear was. But me? being afraid? How could I possibly feel an emotion so far beneath me, something that I thought I had no need for. "I asked a question, Operator." I visibly flinch and remain silent for a few more moments before he speaks again. "I’ve read your data, you are quite the prodigy it seems, being able to become an Operator at such an age is truly something commendable, not many have even a fraction of your skill at an age where most of us Hivekin are still budding." He says with a far lighter tone than earlier. The sudden change in attitude from the man leaves me speechless for the first time since I entered this room, I can only raise an eyebrow in wonder at what he is getting at. Just as I am about to ask why, he begins to speak again, as if anticipating what I was about to say. "We value Hivekin like you, those with the ability to grow like the very Greathives we inhabit. Trust that we won’t give undue punishment as long as you tell us the truth." Before I could even realize it, my unease had vanished and I had to immediately re-evaluate the person before me. This man is here not just because of his obvious combat experience, but his refined ability to move the hearts of others. I can only wonder if this man is really just an Adjudicator and not something more, but I have to shove those to the back of my mind and continue for now. "Yes, I was afraid. Something about that emptiness screamed out to me not to come any closer, at first I looked around at the other Hivekin in the area. None of them realized that it was there, none of them noticed anything was wrong, I even looked over to a nearby guard and asked if he could see that ‘thing’ and I merely got looked at as if my sanity had long since left me." "This is where things got a little complicated, as I was looking around for answers, a young Hivekin was running directly towards it." I pause to gather my breathing again. As the man nods he says "Continue." In a firm tone, commanding no debates. "Then… I grabbed him before he could get any closer to it. He looked at me confused and asked if there was anything I needed, but I could not answer, as I did not know either." "Then, more of them started to appear in seemingly random clusters around everyone, I knew something dreadful was about to happen. I knew there were more people in danger. So I had to act, I quickly reached into my bag and pulled out one of the devices I had been working on before raising it into the air and yelling with all my might: 'EVERYONE, OUT!' Instantly the room went quiet, and although it took a few seconds for everyone to register what I was holding in my hand, some of the smarter ones were already running. Afte-" I stop my story again, this time from the man simply raising his hand to get my attention. "You know it’s against Operator Code of Conduct to bring any materials used inside, outside. Right? Not just because they are dangerous if used in wrong hands, but because accidents can happen too." He says with a heavy tone, filling the room with a deadly atmosphere. "Yes, I understand." I respond, without breaking eye contact with him, I can feel my heart begin to beat faster and sweat starts to develop on my brow as I struggle to keep any of my inner thoughts from showing. Many breaths go by in silence before he finally relinquishes the pressure in the room, waving his hand again to signify I may continue. I let out a dry cough before I resume "…After everyone cleared out, which took less than a minute at most, the voids had grown to the point I could barely find a way out myself. And to make matters worse, I had forgotten to let go of the young Hivekin that I had stopped earlier, still holding his hand I began to sprint for the nearest exit while maneuvering between these growing chasms of nothingness. He asked why we were running as I continued to drag him out into safety, but I couldn’t afford to respond as I was using every breath to run faster. As soon as I reached the exit, the guard I had seen earlier had already come back with reinforcements to stop me. He barked a command to halt at me, and demanded I hand over the child and surrender before I made things worse for myself." "I could only lament the very safety of the Greathive that I had enjoyed my entire life, their swift response to danger now working against me." I sigh and look down to the floor again, averting Ysley’s gaze. "I then pleaded with the guards that I would surrender – but only on the condition that they promise me that no one would be allowed further into the canopy. I then threw the device back the direction I came for good measure, and raised my hands to surrender. They quickly moved to arrest me, muttering that I’d gone insane and ignoring my pleas. I could only bite my lip in frustration that none of them could see it. Explaining it at this point would be useless – could I even explain it? It’s something I don’t even understand myself, after all." "I’ll assume you know how I got into this cell? Or would you like me to recount that too?" I say with a small amount of disdain for my current situation, but all I am met with is silence. The man sits there, unmoving. So still that he could be confused for a statue, or a decoration someone had left in the room. Certainly not an actual person. My breathing slows. Oddly, I don’t feel afraid anymore. My punishment definitely won’t be light, I’ve committed a serious violation this time. But just as I was about to resign myself to my fate… The man vanished. No – it’s more correct to say that a patch of nothingness had appeared right where the man once was, completely obscuring him from my view. I instantly forget about all the resignation I had felt just a moment before, that sickly fear from before rising up again. I fall backwards out of the chair before backing up with the palms of my hands, scraping them against the wooden floor. "Gods bellow, not again!" I cry out. Then right as despair is about to take me, he appeared just as he was before, unmoving. "I see, so you were telling the truth after all. Everything fits together perfectly now." I can’t help but be indignant, even though from his words it sounds like I have been cleared of suspicion. "What are you talking about!? Just what happened to make one appear just now?" I fire out these lines before I’ve even had a chance to calm myself, which definitely won’t help my case or his opinion of me, but at this point I don’t care anymore. "Just how did you do that? And what makes it confirm my innocence?" Silence. Yet again he holds totally still for a few agonizing moments before a small chuckle escapes from under his mask, soon growing into a full laugh. His hearty laughter fills the room, dragging out seemingly incessantly. "Sorry about that – all that interrogation before was just an act. Before I arrived in your cell I had already done my own investigation and found the cause of your worries. This interrogation – no, this debriefing – was for another purpose. I had to make sure you were thoroughly convinced that I was a dangerous person to confirm my theory." He says in a tone that doesn’t sound like that of an old veteran, but of a lighthearted Elder. I can’t help but be annoyed to my very core, this old man had toyed with me the entire time. Not only had I been in the palm of his hand but I had been ridiculed enough to be laughed at as well! "Well, that’s great and all. But does that mean I’m cleared of all fault?" I ask in a petulant manner, yet the man seems to be smiling behind that mask now. "Of course you are, boy. You’re a hero, in fact. You risked your future to save lives of your fellow Hivekin. That makes you exemplary among all of us. Your keen senses uncovered a certain ''corruption'' that had seeped into the canopy undetected. We believe the source was an R&D lab just beneath where you were stood. Thanks to your efforts, it was brought to our attention and contained long before it could do any lasting harm. And to answer your other question, my disappearance wasn’t anything fancy. Not even a parlour trick." He continued in a jovial tone "It’s simple, really. I shifted my body weight and thought only of killing you, and prepared to attack so as to end your life in an instant. Something only a seasoned fighter could pick up on. Yet, in an instant you reacted as if you had been on the battlefield your entire life. It’s obvious when paired with your story. Your eyes fail to perceive danger in a very literal sense. Growing up here in the Greathive, I’m sure you’ve never really had anything dangerous enough show up for you to notice before." It's too much information at once, too much shock, yet I have no choice but to continue onward with this new information – my protestations die away on my lips before I can speak up. Nothing I can conjure up is able to disprove the old man’s theory. But what’s the point of being able to sense danger if I can’t even see it? He continues the conversation without me, as I’m still too stunned to speak. "Now, you could go back to your normal life as an Operator, but I have a better idea. I was serious about that bit I said before. We value Hivekin with great Talents. Have you ever considered what you could truly accomplish if given the right opportunity? Come with me and we can yet find out." Still in a daze, I looked up from the floor, where my chair still sits toppled over, and see his hand reaching out to me. "My name is Ysley". He adds while looking down at me. I stare at the hand for a few moments, though it doesn’t show any signs of growing tired or moving away, so I finally relent. "Ysley, I don’t have a choice in this do I?" He radiates his customary sunny disposition. "I can already tell we are going to get along." With those words alone, something tells me being imprisoned for life for attempted arson may have been a better result. There’s nothing else I can do, so I take his hand and let him pull me to my feet. "Just what are you, anyway? I suspected you were an Adjudicator." I ask briefly, before he heads to the door and replies "No, we are above all but one." He pauses for a moment then looks at me. Although I can’t see it, this man is definitely smiling, I am sure of it. He continues "…but you’ll find out soon, since you are about to get the same promotion." "Congratulations, Polaris."

title: Deep Crucible

{{PathfinderEx}}
[[File:Deep Crucible.png|thumb|center|900px|The inconspicuous Deep Crucible, awaiting the flames of a Forge]]

==Description==
The Deep Crucible is an event that can be started at the front of [[The Hidden Village]] if a player places an [[Artifact]] inside of the brazier.

Upon starting the event, "waves" of mobs will spawn one by one from white orbs that shoot out of the brazier, landing on the last location the player was standing on before shooting the orb. Orbs will continuously shoot out and spawn mobs, regardless if there are many already present. Additionally, if multiple players are present when the artifact is placed, the Deep Crucible will spawn an additional mob per wave. The Deep Crucible ends after twenty mobs (per person) have been slain.

==Potential Enemies==

==Rewards==
Upon first completion, the Deep Crucible will reward all participants that were present during its initiation with '''60 Full Trainings''', equating to '''4 Powers'''. A total of 3 small chests will spawn in after every 5 waves are completed, with a large chest spawning after 20 waves, signifying the completion of the Deep Crucible.<!--check if rewards scale with level or is the same for all players and not just erisia junk--><!-- also insert a table (copy and paste formatting from another page like duke or titus if u are a new editor looking at this) with rewards when enough data is collected :) -->

*If someone has started the Deep Crucible but dies before its completion, mobs will continue to spawn.

title: Deep Gems
content:
[[File:Blue gem.png|right|200x200px]]

==Description==
Deep Gems are items that can grant new effects to the [[Mantras]] that you equip them on.

You can equip Deep Gems onto Mantras by clicking on them from your inventory. Deep Gems can be removed from your Mantra and returned to your inventory by recalling the Mantra or by right clicking your Mantra icon and clicking remove.<gallery widths="200" bordersize="none">
File:Deep Gem equip.png
File:Deep Gem remove.png
</gallery>

==Effects==
There are currently 12 Deep Gems in Deepwoken, each with their own distinct effects. The effectiveness or efficiency of each Gem can be increased with the {{cl|brain|Brain}} [[Status Effects#Food Buff|Food Buff]], obtained by consuming the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]].

<gallery widths="150" position="center">
File:Aegis Gem.png|link=Aegis Gem|[[Aegis Gem]]; grants damage reduction upon landing your Mantra
File:Blessed Gem.png|link=Blessed Gem|[[Blessed Gem]]; reduces your Mantra's cooldown on hit
File:Bloodless Gem.png|link=Bloodless Gem|[[Bloodless Gem]]; grants lifesteal to your Mantras
File:Blue gem.png|link=Blue Gem|[[Blue Gem]]; reduces the Ether cost of your Mantras
File:Insignia Gem.png|link=Insignia Gem|[[Insignia Gem]]; reduces the windup of your next Mantra cast
File:KyrsanGem.png|link=Kyrsan Gem|[[Kyrsan Gem]]; applies a stacking slow on hit
File:Might Gem.png|link=Might Gem|[[Might Gem]]; increases your Mantra's posture damage
File:NocturnalGem.png|link=Nocturnal Gem|[[Nocturnal Gem]]; adds an additional hit to your Mantra after a 1 second delay
File:WarpedBlueGem.png|link=Warped Blue_Gem|[[Warped Blue Gem]]; reduces the Ether cost of your Mantras when cast while swimming
File:Wayward Gem.png|link=Wayward Gem|[[Wayward Gem]]; teleports you to your opponent after a 1 second delay
File:Wrath gem.png|link=Wrath Gem|[[Wrath Gem]]; increases your critical attack damage based on how many combat tags you have
File:Wind gem.png|link=Wind Gem|[[Wind Gem]]; grants a speed boost on hit
</gallery>

==Compatibility==
While any Deep Gem can be equipped onto any Mantra, certain Gems may not proc on certain Mantras and some Mantras may not benefit at all from specific Gems.
*Most Deep Gems proc upon dealing damage or otherwise landing a hit with your Mantra, and as such these Gems will not work with Mantras that do not deal damage.
*[[Revenge]] cannot proc [[Wayward Gem]]
*[[Gaze]] and [[Glare]] cannot proc any "on-hit" Deep Gem
*Some Mantras are not affected by [[Insignia Gem]]'s windup decrease, these are:
**[[Sightless Beam]]
**[[Eclipse Kick]]

==Critical Engine==
If you have the {{t|Critical Engine}} Talent, you can apply the effects of Deep Gems to your [[Weapon]] critical by holding any Deep Gem of your choice and using the Critical Engine Talent tool. Equipping a Deep Gem onto your weapon critical with Critical Engine will not consume the Gem, and will instead apply the effects of your Gem without it leaving your inventory. Your chosen gem will save across servers, so you only need to set it once.

Most Gems retain their original effect when being applied to your weapon critical, but [[Blue Gem]]s have a completely unique one; upon landing your critical with a Blue Gem equipped, you will gain Ether back based on scaled damage dealt.

title: Deep Owl
content:
{{Quotes|quote=A little mouse comes squeaking into my nest. What possesses it to do so? Please, do sate my curiosity.|author=???}} {{Monster Infobox |image1=Deep Owl.png |health=1600 4000 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops= *[[Dark Feather]] *[[Void Feather]] (5% - Non-Corrupted) / {{cl|corrupted|(100% - Corrupted)}} *[[Justicar Defender Coat]] *[[Dark Owl Chapeau]] *[[Dark Owl Cloak]] *[[Dark Owl Cape]] |locations= *[[Lower Erisia]] *[[The Viper's Jaw]] *[[Pathfinder's Respite]] *[[The Garden Reservoir]] *[[Upper Erisia]] *[[Burning Stone Gardens]] *[[The Lordsgrove]] *[[The Depths]] |attacks= *Talon Swipe *Owl Dash *Overhead Grab *Flock of Feathers |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} }} ==Description== The '''Deep Owl''' (also referred to simply as "Owl") is a relatively uncommon [[Monsters|Monster]] found in [[Lower Erisia]], [[The Viper's Jaw]], [[Pathfinder's Respite]], [[The Garden Reservoir]], [[Upper Erisia]], [[Burning Stone Gardens]], [[The Lordsgrove]], and [[The Depths]]. Deep Owls are related to the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] [[Oaths|Oath]] and illusion magic. Deep Owls will only spawn in the [[Locations|Etrean Luminant]] while the moon is out. This restriction does not apply to The Depths, nor the static Deep Owl spawn in [[The Lordsgrove]]. {{Quotes|quote=Yes, we Owls... Or I suppose, that's just how we appear to your limited perceptive abilities... An insidious predator that feasts on the meek...|author=The Nestmind}} Deep Owls hail down on Lumen from an inconceivable dimension that contains their collective hivemind known as [[The Nestmind]], where they are usually unable to interact with the outside world. This is changed by the [[Oaths|Oath]] made between [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshapers]] and The Nestmind. Deep Owls manifest themselves in our world with the ability of a Visionshaper's mind having the ability to turn illusions into reality. When appearing in [[Upper Erisia]] or [[The Depths]], its presence will be signaled by a sparse cloud of black feathers that gently fall down around an area. Upon entering the feathers, the Deep Owl will immediately drop down from the sky and open a dialogue with the player. During the dialogue, it is non-hostile and will not attack the player, remaining in this state until the player begins attacking or turns their back to the Deep Owl while in its detection range. Therefore, it's a good time to log out if unprepared for the battle. Unlocking the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] [[Oaths|Oath]] requires a [[Dark Feather]], but is progressed with [[Void Feather]]s. ==Attacks== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Talon Swipe'''
(★☆☆) {{AttackTags |slash }} |The {{PAGENAME}} swipes with one of its arms, the windup depending on which arm is used. *It can use this attack multiple times back-to-back, and is usually used during the downtime between other attacks. *Swipes from its right arm come more quickly, while swings from its left arm are delayed somewhat. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Owl Slashes.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Owl Dash'''
(★☆☆) {{AttackTags |shadow }} |The {{PAGENAME}} kneels on the ground for a moment before performing a spinning assault with shadowy waves in the target's direction. *Can end early without hitting you if it "collides" with something due to its large size. *It will step back and gain distance before using this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, crouch, movement }} |[[File:Owl Dash.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Overhead Grab'''
(★★★) {{AttackTags |shadow }} |Jumps into the air while turning into a burst of feathers, then descends back down to grab the player before flying upwards. *This is telegraphed by a small cloud of feathers suddenly appearing around you. *It is recommended to look up to time your dodge, as the Deep Owl's descent is deceptively slow. {{AttackTags |indicator = highposture |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, teleport, grab |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Owl Grab.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Flock of Feathers'''
(★★☆) {{AttackTags |shadow }} |Bursts into a puff of feathers that targets the closest target, dealing substantial armor and chip damage on block. *'''Overhead Grab''' and '''Owl Dash''' are typically used after this. {{AttackTags |parry.nap, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Flock of Feathers.gif|border|frameless]] |} ===Passives=== * '''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal ~50% less damage to Deep Owls. ==Finisher== {|class="fandom-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |
Claw Crush |The {{PAGENAME}} swiftly crushes the knocked player's torso with its talons. |[[File:Placeholder.png|border|frameless]] |} == Dialogue == Note: The player can only speak to a Deep Owl if they are the one to spawn it or have the [[Mute]] [[Regalia]]. |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |{{sh|A little mouse comes squeaking into my nest. What possesses it to do so? Please, do sate my curiosity.}} |- | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I'm just passing through. | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |What the.. Why can you talk?! |- | colspan="6" |{{sh|Ah. Carry on then, little mouse. I'm sure you have places to be.}} | colspan="6" |{{sh|My, my... Such impertinent squeaking. The mice of this land never fail to amaze me.}} |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |''*The creature tilts its head curiously.*'' |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} == Tips == One strategy an unprepared player should consider when encountering the Owl is the '''Fight''' or '''Flight''' response. '''Flight''' Log or run away. Since the Deep Owl can be seen before it is physically spawned, as signified by the falling feathers, it is almost guaranteed the player can get away by turning back and returning the way they came. (This strategy wont work if the owl spawns on-top of the player or if the Owl is standing somewhere and is already aggressive after killing an enemy.) In the event that the encounter is triggered, the Deep Owl will question the player and offer 3 different choices of dialogue (this includes the "End Dialogue" option). All of these options have same result. The Owl will stare at the player until it is attacked or shown the player's back, at which it will then turn hostile and attack. There isn't any time limit for the Owl's "staring" phase meaning that if the player encounters the owl, it can be held in that state forever until someone comes to help or the player escapes its detection range (either by walking backwards or logging out). Closing the game or using the Menu Button during its dialogue and before it becomes hostile is the only guaranteed way to not fight the enemy in this state, unless a different entity sent or is sending you into a combat tag. Do remember that owl will turn their direction towards the player whenever they move. '''Fight''' If choosing to fight the Deep Owl for the first time, there are several things the player should keep in mind; *Typically, the Owl becomes reasonable to kill from Power 7 onwards, but may be powerchecked around Power 12. *It is recommended to bring a shield if unfamiliar with the Owl in order to learn its attack patterns. *It will not turn hostile until attacked first, giving a chance to land a single hit before it starts attacking back. *It will also become hostile if the player turns their back on it. The most important part of this fight is parrying the '''Talon Swipe''' attack. Afterwards, the Owl can usually be hit once by any weapon type. It is best to look out for this move specifically for damage opportunities, but only get one or two swings - greed will usually lead to the player taking unnecessary damage. The Owl will typically, but not always, repeat the '''Talon Swipe''' attack once more. The alternative is usually that it'll use '''Feather Teleport''' or '''Owl Dash''', both of which can be parried on reaction. When using '''Feather Teleport''' or '''Owl Dash''', the Owl will likely then attempt to '''Overhead Grab''' the player. The optimal course of action is to roll to the left or right when the Owl tilts its head down to grab. The '''Flock of Feathers''' can be easily mitigated by rapidly pressing the {{Input|keybind|parry}} key, similar to blocking multi-hit moves from other enemies. If looking for owls, it is recommended to join highly populated servers because this increases their spawn rate. The Owls' special attacks are affected by shadow armour. ==Gallery== Deep Owl Concept Art.png|Concept Art Deep Owl Model Render.png|Model Render DeepowlIcon.png|Close-up of the mask Owl idle.gif|A Deep Owl's idle animation OwlHallowMask.PNG|A Hallowtide Mask depicting a Deep Owl DeepOwlHumorous.jpg|Underview Deep Owl Approaching.png|A Deep Owl walking Dab me up! owl.png|A Deep Owl performing Talon Swipe Owl crazy ass.png|A Deep Owl performing Talon Swipe while rotating its face Dark Feather Owl Attack.png|A Deep Owl performing Flock of Feathers Deep owl alakazam.png|A Deep Owl preparing to perform Owl Dash Bro think he black adam 💀.png|A Deep Owl performing Owl Dash BRO ACTUALLY IS HIM 🗣️🔥.png|Ditto FOR FREE?!.png|A Deep Owl's talons ===Merchandise=== Deep Owl Doughboi 1.png Deep Owl Doughboi 2.png Deep Owl Doughboi 3.png Deep Owl Doughboi 4.png Deep Owl Doughboi 5.png Deep Owl Doughboi 6.png Deep Owl Doughboi Art.png|100% Funded Art Deep Owl Doughboi Promotional.png|Promotional image announcing the Deep Owl Doughboi ==Trivia== *Deep Owls were originally intended to be exclusive to the [[Second Layer]].[[File:Owl Layer 2 mob.png|200px]] *There is a low chance that a non-corrupted Deep Owl will drop a Void Feather, which makes it possible to grind Void Feathers for [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] safely at the [[The Lordsgrove]] via the static spawn there. *Dark and Void Feathers are required to craft over half of the Expert and Master tier [[Outfits]]. *If you are unfortunate enough, one of these can spawn directly on top of you, trap you in dialogue and become hostile while speaking to you. *Due to the fact that the Deep Owl has 1.8k health, it is possible to stat check it if you are at a high enough [[Power]] due to PvE scaling, but it is recommended to still exercise some form of caution while fighting it, as with all boss-type enemies (Stat Check Level: 15). *Despite having lower health than a [[Lionfish]], they are foes to be reckoned with since they can quickly deal large amounts of damage if not defended against properly. *Occasionally when hit by the Deep Owl's '''Overhead Grab''', it will bug out and be flung/teleported out of its detection range, though this doesn't happen too often. *For a very long time after release until its eventual shadow-patch, there was a typo in one of its dialogue response lines that said "Ah. Carry on then, little mouse. I'm sure you have places to be be." Notice the difference at the very end. ==References== {{History}} {{nav|monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

title: Deep Owl Doughboi

==Description==
The '''Deep Owl Doughboi''' was a plush released as part of a Deepwoken and Makeship collaboration. Classified under the "Doughboi" category, it featured the [[Deep Owl]] mob. Its campaign ran from October 17th, 2025, to November 8th, 2025, before selling out. The plush measured 35.0 cm in height and was made from spandex plush fabric with 3D cotton down filling.

<poem style="text-align: center">
"What might possess you to let this thing nest in your home? Curiosity, perhaps. Or maybe it's that the size of it lets you seat it at the table and pretend it's not a nightmare-thing feeding on your thoughts?

We're pretty sure this is just a soft toy, but it might be wise not to turn your back on it. Just in case."
