title: Deep Shrines
content:
::''Not to be confused with [[Shrine of Courage]], [[Shrine of the Drowned]], [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Shrine of Yun'Shul]], or [[Shrines]] (aka Fountain Gates).'' {{PathfinderEx}} ==Description== '''Deep Shrines''' are a group of 10 shrines sharing identical appearance (excluding Solitude), scattered across the Lumen. Each bestows different deals in exchange for the client's [[knowledge]]. Each Deep Shrine can be found in a unique location in the overworld as well as the [[Temple of Hearts]], accessible by Deepbounds and anyone who has obtained their resonance. === Limitations === '''Deep Shrines''' can only be interacted with after approximately ~10 minutes of spawning, so trying to Deepbound won't work. ==Shrines==
{{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Temptation|Shrine of Temptation]]}} {{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Blasphemy|Shrine of Blasphemy]]}} '''Shrine of Temptation''': Trade a Mantra of your choice and {{c|knowledge|5}} to gain a Whisper Draw.
'''Shrine of Blasphemy''': For {{c|knowledge|5}}, '''POWER 1-16''' instantly Power Up 3 times, gaining the relevant amount of Talents and Whisper Draws, granting you a [[Boons and Flaws|Flaw]], Or '''POWER 17-20''' reroll a Flaw of your choice into another, random base [[Boons and Flaws#Flaws|Flaw]].
{{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Mastery|Shrine of Mastery]]}} {{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Chance|Shrine of Chance]]}} '''Shrine of Mastery''': For {{c|knowledge|1}}, trade 1 of your Trait Points into another Trait. You can also remove attribute points.
'''Shrine of Chance''': For {{c|knowledge|5}}, trade a Talent of your choice to obtain a Talent hand of equal rarity (e.g. Common/Advanced = Common/Advanced, Rare = Rare) OR a Rare Talent for a Talent hand of only Common/Advanced Talents. For {{c|knowledge|10}}, trade a Common/Advanced Talent of your choice for a Talent hand consisting only of Rare Talents.
{{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Order|Shrine of Order]]}} {{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Conceit|Shrine of Conceit]]}} '''Shrine of Order''': For {{c|knowledge|10}}, average your stats (up to a limit of -25 points on main stats, with no limit on attunement stats). Can only be done once per character. You must need '''POWER 8+ AND''' '''NO OATH''' to use this.
'''Shrine of Conceit''': For {{c|knowledge|1}}, unburn a card of your choice. Note that the Ace is '''NOT REFUNDED'''.
{{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Division|Shrine of Division]]}} {{Button/Legacy|[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Unification|Shrine of Unification]]}} Shrine of Division: For {{c|knowledge|5}} and a Mantra of your choice, obtain a Roll 2.
'''Shrine of Unification''': For {{c|knowledge|5}} and 2 Talents of your choice, get a Whisper Draw.
==Gallery== Depths shrine.png|Concept art ==Trivia== *[[Ganymede]]s can do deep deals with a discount of 1 knowledge off of all shrines, except the Shrine of Conceit and the Shrine of Mastery. *Deep Shrines, most notably the Shrine of Chance and the Shrine of Order, are obvious references to the roguelite Risk of Rain 2, sharing their names with and functioning similarly to the Shrine of Chance and Shrine of Order from that game. **In Risk of Rain 2, the Shrine of Chance takes money in exchange for a chance to gain an item (cannot be used after succeeding twice, cost increases each attempt), and the Shrine of Order randomly selects one item from each rarity and converts all other items of the same rarity to the selected item. **Ironically, in that game, Shrine of Order was more or less a joke, providing no utility whatsoever. ***It was theorized this was the intent behind Deepwoken's Shrine of Order, but due to it actually allowing for the creation of extremely powerful builds, the developers found themselves unable to roll back the change without creating huge backlash as well as resulting in builds that existed before any changes to the Shrine being far more powerful than any new ones after the changes. *You can use any shrine besides Solitude to obtain Contractor, however, Shrine Of Order is currently bugged and does not count towards Contractor progression. *Shrine of Order used to grant an additional random [[Flaws|Flaw]] on use. This was removed on September 6th, 2025 due to the recent changes of the time with Talents gaining reduced effects if you do not meet their requirements. *Deep Shrines may be a means for [[Yun'Shul]] to communicate, due to them appearing in the [[Temple of Hearts]]. Both the main shrine and Deep Shrines speak using the same font, as well as engaging in deals. *Before Shrine of Ostentation (Now the Shrine of Chance), the only way to obtain more Rare Talents on a fully progressed build was to obtain either [[Ardour]] or [[Rhythm]] and their child Talents, Ardour Scream or Spotter. Then after removing your Murmur with a [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Yun'Shul]] wish, you would be granted a new Talent hand that was guaranteed to have a rare Talent in it. **This method was extremely tedious if you were missing more than one rare, very expensive, and not every build could utilize it. *As of the 28/02/2023 patch, Shrine of Order's 25 stat point reduction limit does not work on attunements. *The [[Shrine of Ostentation]] allowed you to transfer Rare Talents into Common/Advanced Talents and vice versa. This effect was merged into the [[Shrine of Chance]], along with Ostentation itself being removed on the September 15th, 2025 update. *The [[Shrine of Solitude]] previously allowed players to favor specific Talents and Mantras. This became obsolete after favoring and foretelling were added, leading to the removal of Mystics and, later, the Shrine of Solitude itself. *Deep Shrines models were reworked on the update of '''15 September, 2025''' to be more performant. ==References== [[File:Imagen 2023-11-18 203758577.png|frameless|286x286px]] {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Features absent in Vow of Iron]]

However, you gain a [[Boons and Flaws#Flaws|Flaw]] and must catch up on the 45 Investment points of these three Power Ups. title: Deep Shrines/Shrine of Chance
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=PUPPET. WHAT DOES YOUR HEART DESIRE?|author=Shrine of Chance}}{{NPCInfobox|title1=Shrine of Chance|image1=ShrineOfChanceNew.png|location=[[Temple of Hearts]]
[[Meteor Isle]]
[[The Depths]]}} '''If you're looking for another shrine return to [[Deep Shrines]] or head to [[{{PAGENAME}}#Navigation|Navigation]].''' ==Description== Located behind a breakable wall in the [[Meteor Isle]] cave (with the crashed meteor), this Deep Shrine allows you to exchange Talents you own for a hand of three semi-random Talents at the cost of Knowledge. The hand of Talents received isn't fully random, as it can be influenced through [[Favour]]ing and [[Fortell]]ing cards, on top of being limited to a specific Talent rarity, as dictated by the specific deal you struck. Purchasing the [[Choice of Chance]] Echo Unlock for 200 Echoes permanently increases the amount of cards you receive in a Shrine of Chance hand by one; from three to four. While not necessary, this Echo Unlock is a great quality of life improvement. When using this Shrine, please make sure to '''check if you burned the card you're trying to get''' using the [[Shrine of Conceit]] or '''check if you already happen to have it'''. Otherwise, it could result in a mistake worth upwards of 10 Knowledge before you realize it wasn't just bad luck or a missing prerequisite. As with the other Deep Shrines, this is also located in the Temple of Hearts. It has an additional location in the First Layer, inside one of the brown topped ruins found throughout the map. File:Shrine of Chance's Location.png|The entrance to the shrine in the cave File:Shrine of Chance Depths Location.jpg|The Shrine of Chance in [[The Depths]] File:Shrine of chance--meteor isle.png|Shrine of Chance at [[Meteor Isle]] ==Effects/Details== {{ShopTable|newtable |title=Shrine of Chance |name=Talent Exchange |currency=Knowledge |price=5 |desc=Exchange a Talent for a hand of Talents of equivalent rarity. }} {{ShopTable |name=Talent Degradation |currency=Knowledge |price=5 |desc=Exchange a {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talent for a hand of Common Talents. }} {{ShopTable |name=Talent Elevation |currency=Knowledge |price=10 |desc=Exchange a Common Talent for a hand of {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talents. }} {{ShopTable|end |name=Faction Exchange |currency=Knowledge |price=5 |desc=Exchange a Faction Talent for a hand of Faction Talents. }} ===Details=== *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Advanced}} and Common Talents share a rarity as far as Shrine of Chance is concerned; **You can exchange a Common Talent for an {{cl|advancedtlnf|Advanced}} Talent and vice versa via '''Talent Exchange'''. **You can exchange a Common or {{cl|advancedtlnf|Advanced}} Talent for a {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} via '''Talent Elevation'''. **You can exchange a {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talent and potentially receive a Talent hand that has both Common and {{cl|advancedtlnf|Advanced}} Talents via '''Talent Degradation'''. *Players who are exiled from their faction are unable to reroll their faction Talents. *When using the {{cl|factiontlnf|Faction}} Talent exchange, you cannot exchange a base Faction Talent to gain a Talent that is exclusive to a [[Authority Ensign|Division]] or [[Justicar (Origin)|Path]]. For example, you cannot get a Talent from your [[Authority Ensign|Ensign Division]] by exchanging {{t|Crossguard|faction}}. *The Talent Draw is affected by Talent Favoring and Foretelling, make sure to use them to not waste Knowledge. *You must meet the requirements at least one non-mutually exclusive Talent in order to exchange a Talent for another. **For example, if the only {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talents you can obtain are {{t|Observation|rare}} and {{t|Safety Dance|rare}}, you will not be able to exchange {{t|Risky Moves|rare}} for them, however if you also meet the requirements of (but don't already own) {{t|Cheap Shot|rare}}, then you will be able to exchange {{t|Risky Moves|rare}} for either of the Leaf in the Wind Talents. *You cannot trade away a Talent if it is a prerequisite of another Talent. You must get rid of each Talent in the reverse requirement order to trade them away. ==Dialogue== |-|Requirements Met= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |{{sh|PUPPET. WHAT DOES YOUR HEART DESIRE?}} |- | colspan="2" {{cl|action}} |[Shop UI opens] |- | colspan="2" {{cl|action}} |[player completes a [[#Effects/Details|deal]]] |- | colspan="2" |{{sh|THE CONTRACT IS COMPLETE.}} |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Requirements Unmet= {{#tag:tabber|Unchosen Hand of Cards= If the player has an unchosen Talent, Mantra, or Trait hand, this dialogue will appear, forcing them to choose a card before a deal can be made. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|PUPPET. RETURN ONCE YOU HAVE DECIDED YOUR PATH. THIS WE CANNOT DIVINE FOR YOU.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}No Eligible Talents= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|RETURN AT ANOTHER TIME, PUPPET.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== Shrine Of Chance.png|Old Shrine of Chance model ==Trivia== *The Shrine of Chance used to be located at [[Fort Merit]], but was moved to Meteor Isle. {{clear}} {{History}} ==Navigation== {{DeepShrineNav}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Mechanics]]

{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes |quote=CHOOSE THE TRAIT OF YOUR SOUL TO DIMINISH. |author=Shrine of Mastery }} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Shrine of Mastery |image1= Shrine of Mastery.png|Current Temp Shrine of Mastery.png|Old |location=[[Temple of Hearts]]
[[Widow's Hollow]]
[[Celtor Wastes]] }} '''If you're looking for another shrine, return to [[Deep Shrines]] or head to [[{{PAGENAME}}#Navigation|Navigation]].''' ==Description== Located in the entrance cave before [[Deep Widow]] in the [[Widow's Hollow]], in the little house where [[Ciea]] is located. ==Effects/Details== ===Effects=== Shrine of Mastery has two different effects. *For {{c|knowledge|1}}, you can trade 1 of your [[Traits|Trait]] Points into another Trait. *For {{c|knowledge|1}}, you can remove 1 of your invested attribute points, allowing you to reinvest it. A maximum of 3 points can be removed per character. ===Details=== *You cannot add more than 6 Points into a given Trait. *You can only remove 3 attribute points per character. *You cannot remove innate attribute points granted by your aspect. **This limitation will be removed if you have the [[Multifaceted]] Echo Unlock, as it converts innate attribute points into regular investment points. *You cannot reduce an attribute if you have Talent(s) that require equal to or higher investment on that attribute. **For example: If you went 40 Strength to pick {{t|Showstopper|r=rare}}, you wouldn't be able to remove points from Strength to go below 40 investment, as long as you have Showstopper. This also applies if your Strength was already below 40 due to [[Shrine of Order]] usage, entirely preventing you from reducing the attribute. **This applies to the Attunement mastery Talents as well, such as Adept Flamecharmer; Shrine of Mastery will not allow you to go below the 1/20/30/50 Attunement investment milestones, in most scenarios (see [[#below|below]]). **This restriction does not apply to the following Talent requirement types, allowing you to freely uninvest: ***The alternative attribute requirements for Talents; for example, as {{t|Potion Quaffer|r=rare}} requires 15 Intelligence and [15 Fortitude or 15 Willpower], you can reduce your Fortitude and Willpower investment, but you cannot reduce your Intelligence investment below Potion Quaffer's requirements. ***Category attributes on Talents that require attribute category investment ([[Mind]], [[Body]], Element, and Weapon). For example, if you have {{t|Grounding Bolt}} (90 Thundercall, 90 Weapon), you can reduce your Weapon investment, but not your Thundercall investment. ***[[Attributes Unbound]] Talents, though Attunement Unbounded Talents will be removed from your character if you do not meet their requirements. ***Attribute requirements for Oath Talents; You can reduce your attributes below your Oath's requirements. ****{{anch|below|The}} only exception to this is [[Arcwarder]] in most scenarios, as you cannot lower your Attunement stats due to the Attunement Adept Talents. This however, can be avoided by using [[Shrine of Order]] to go ''up'' to exactly 20 Flamecharm and/or 20 Thundercall, obtaining the Oath, and then going to Shrine of Mastery. Keep in mind that if you invest any attribute points, die (including resetting your character), or leave the game, it will give you the Attunement Adept Talent, preventing you from uninvesting. ****The theorized reason for why this works at all is that the Oath trainers do a "check" to see if you meet the requirements to obtain their Oath, but the Oath Talents themselves have no stat requirement attached to them. ****When this was brought to the attention of Arch_Mage, one of Deepwoken's developers, he said "3 points aint the end of the world." *You cannot use this shrine if you have a pending Talent hand or [[Whisper Draw]]. *Despite popular belief, you can still change your attributes with this after Shrine of Order. **This idea stemmed from the previously mentioned Talent investment exception. *If you no longer meet the requirements for your weapon after using Shrine of Mastery, you will keep it equipped, but you'll receive a penalty, lowering your weapon's damage. This debuff scales on how far below your weapon's requirements you are, up to a maximum of -25% base damage, though the math behind it makes it only really effective on lower requirement weapons. **To explain, the exact formula for this debuff is 1-0.25*m/r where m is your current stat and r is your weapon's requirements [https://www.desmos.com/calculator/3hj2bmdzzj calculator here]. **If your weapon requires multiple stats, this will prioritize the fraction that is farthest from 1, for example if you have 17/20 Strength and 90/100 Weapon, your weapon's damage will be reduced based off your Strength stat and instead of your Weapon stat, as 17/20 < 90/100. **[[Khan]] and [[Silentheart]]'s requirement reduction is applied in these calculations. **This debuff is a damage modifier to your scaled damage that is multiplicative to all other multipliers. **Some weapons gain explicit downsides when you do not meet the requirements. For example, [[Sanguine Transfuser]]'s critical heals less health, and [[Vortex Echo]]'s critical is less effective at reducing cooldowns. *If you no longer meet the requirements for a Mantra or your Mantra's levels after using Shrine of Mastery, you will keep it equipped with its previous level intact with '''no''' penalties, aside from the minor damage loss from reduced investment. *If you no longer meet the requirements for a Outfit with stat requisites, you will keep the Outfit with no penalties and you will be able to unequip and reequip it with no restrictions. *This Shrine does not count for the "Bargained with Deep Shrines" [[Echo Triumph]]. {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|Requirements Met= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |{{sh|PUPPET. STATE YOUR PURPOSE.}} |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I wish to reevaluate my Traits. | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I wish to reevaluate my Attributes. |- | colspan="1" |{{sh|CHOOSE THE TRAIT OF YOUR SOUL TO DIMINISH.}} | colspan="1" |{{sh|CHOOSE THE ATTRIBUTE OF YOUR SOUL TO DIMINISH.}} |- | colspan="2" {{cl|action}} |Player selects a Trait / Attribute |- | colspan="2" |{{sh|THE CONTRACT IS COMPLETE. WASTE.}} |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], player loses {{c|knowledge|1}} to refund a Trait or Attribute point |} |-|Requirements Unmet= {{#tag:tabber|Unchosen Hand of Cards / Not Enough Knowledge= If the player has an unchosen Talent, Mantra, or Trait hand, this dialogue will appear, forcing them to choose a card before a deal can be made. Alternatively, if the player does not have enough Knowledge, this dialogue will also appear. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|RETURN AT ANOTHER TIME, PUPPET.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}No Invested Attributes / Traits= If the player has not invested any Attribute or Trait points, this dialogue will appear. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|PUPPET. STATE YOUR PURPOSE.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} ==Navigation== {{DeepShrineNav}} {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Mechanics]] ==Gallery== File:Shrine of Mastery location DEPTHS.png|The shrine's location in [[Celtor Wastes]] File:Location of the cave entrance.png|Entrance of the cave where the shrine is located in [[The Starswept Valley]]

[[Songseeker Wilds|Songseeker Mines]] }} '''If you're looking for another shrine, return to [[Deep Shrines]] or head to [[{{PAGENAME}}#Navigation|Navigation]].''' ==Location== Located in: [[Songseeker Wilds|Songseeker Mines]], through the passage containing mudskippers. Also located in [[Temple of Hearts]], being the first large shrine on the left when going towards the [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Shrine of Yun'Shul]].
Mineskipper Mine Location.png|Songseeker Mines entrance Shrine of Order Location.gif|Guide
{{clear}} ==Effects/Details== ===Effects=== For {{c|knowledge|10}}, average your stats (up to a limit*). This can only be done once per character. '''You need Power 8+ and no [[Oath]] (having [[Oathless]] will still allow you) to perform this deal.''' If you took an Oath beforehand, you may break the Oath to order yourself. This has [[Oaths#Oathbreaker_-_Oath_Removal|consequences]] of its own, however. ===Details=== *Any core attribute or weapon stat '''cannot lose more than 25 investment points''' from Shrine of Order. Attunement stats can lose any amount of investment points. *'''The effectiveness of some Talents may be reduced if you do not meet their requirements.''' This does not apply to all Talents, see info of specific Talents on the [[Talents]] page. *The main purpose of the Shrine of Order is allowing you to obtain expensive [[Talents]] or [[Mantras]], to then take a portion of these points away to invest into other stats, allowing your builds to effectively have more points than intended. *Only the stats you have invested at least 1 point into will be ordered by Shrine of Order. In the case of racial points, you need to invest 1 point manually into the stat (making it 3 or 4) for it to count. *Any points that cannot be evenly distributed during the averaging process will be returned to you as free points. *Adept/Expert/Master Attunement and Attunement Unbound Talents disappear after the attribute goes below their requirements. *Mantras' upgrade levels will be downgraded to the appropriate level if the requirements for their current levels are no longer met. *'''If you fall below an Equipment or Weapon's attribute requirements through Shrine of Order, that item will be automatically unequipped.''' *If you no longer meet the requirements of your [[Outfit]] after using Shrine of Order, it will stay equipped and you will be able to unequip/reequip it at any time as Outfit stat requirements are only enforced when crafting them. *Does not progress towards the [[Contractor|Contractor Oath]] obtainment. *If needed, there are a few ways to get around Shrine of Order's Power 8 requirement. *#You can use [[Shrine of Blasphemy]] at Powers 5-7 to level up three times and Shrine of Order with the stats of a Power 5-7. *#At Power 7, you can invest 3 points to reach Power 8 then use [[Shrine of Mastery]] to remove the points, allowing you to Shrine of Order with slightly below the stats of a normal Power 8. title: Deep Shrines/Shrine of Ostentation
content:
{{CutContent}}
{{Quotes|quote=THE TERMS ARE AS FOLLOWS: YIELD AN OFFERING, AND I SHALL TURN FORTUNE OVER.|author=Shrine of Ostentation}}{{NPCInfobox|title1=Shrine of Ostentation|image1=Shrine Of Ostentation .png|location=[[Ancient Rotlands]]}}
'''If your looking for another shrine return to [[Deep Shrines]] or head to [[{{PAGENAME}}#Navigation|Navigation]].'''
==Description==
Located in [[Ancient Rotlands]], after taking a right from the [[Songseeker Wilds]]-[[Ancient Rotlands]] door and going towards the "Brain," there will be a cave entrance connected to the far wall on the left. The shrine will be located inside the cave.

'''This Shrine's effects have been merged with the [[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Chance|Shrine of Chance]] on the update of September 15th, 2025.''' The Shrine itself, can still be found in Rotlands however.
==Effects/Details ==
===Effects===
For {{c|knowledge|10}}, transfer a Common or Advanced Talent into a random Rare Talent and vice versa.
===Details===
*The main purpose of Shrine of Ostentation is allowing you to obtain more Rares, Commons, or Advanced Talents if you didn't get everything you needed while progressing.

title: Deep Thresher Nest
content:
{{Location|name=Deep Thresher Nest|area=Voidzone}}
[[File:Deepthreshernest.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''The Deep Thresher Nest''' is a location in ''Deepwoken.'' It is a [[Voidzones|Voidzone]] found in [[Aratel Island]].

==Overview==
The Deep Thresher Nest is a [[Voidzones|Voidzone]]. Found in a part of the [[Lightkeeper Temple]] that has been overrun by the [[Thresher]]s, connecting to the cavern on the other side. There are a few [[Thresher]]s and a [[King Thresher]] that reside in the nest.

==Points of Interest== 
*After entering from the entrance, there is a [[King Thresher]] in the hall on the right.
*Deep there's a prison-like hall with several environmental chests with the loot of [[the Starswept Valley]]
*At the end, there is a cave leading to the [[Starswept Valley]], where there are two [[Thresher]]s, one [[King Thresher]], and several [[Empyrean Lotus]] and [[Brilliant Lotus]].

==Enemies==

Articulated Thrash|caption1=Deep Widow in [[Widow's Hollow]]. |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== The '''Deep Widow''' is a giant enemy spider that lurks in [[Widow's Hollow]] in [[Starswept Valley]], along with a set location in [[The Depths]]. This monster also spawns in [[The Depths]] in a location near one of the columned teleporters or spawns. There is a path which seems to lead towards the void but instead leads down towards an area which has a wooden door. It leads you to the Widow. Behind the Deep Widow in The Depths is [[Surge]], an NPC related to the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] [[Oaths|Oath]]. == Attacks== {| class="sortable article-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Deep Webbing'''
(★★☆) |The Widow spits webs onto her target, inflicting moderate insanity and a new webby look onto them for a short duration and dragging them towards herself. *Blocking it negates the sanity loss, but it still webs and pulls you. {{AttackTags |debuff, pull, parry.n, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Widow web.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Venomous Bite'''
(★★★) | The Widow delivers a crushing bite onto the victim, dealing moderate damage and inflicting a lingering poison that damages over time. *This move will auto-grip if it hits you while knocked or at low health. {{AttackTags |parry.fyw, block.n, dodge.y, debuff }} |[[File:Widow bite.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Swipe'''
(★☆☆) |The Widow slashes using her right leg with long charge, dealing moderate slashing damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Widow single slah.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Impale'''
(★☆☆) |The Widow quickly lunges with both of her legs, dealing moderate damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Widow 2 leg.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Articulated Thrash'''
(★☆☆) |The Widow charges up her leg and slashes her target three times in succession. *Does not grant autoparry frames, all slashes must be parried individually. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Widow combo.gif|thumb]] |} === '''Passives''' === *'''Unwavering Neurotoxins''' - The poison inflicted by the Widow's bite will deal '''percent-based damage''', no matter how much health or resistances the target has. It will also insta-execute the player if the player reaches 0% health when afflicted. ** This is especially dangerous in [[The Diluvian Mechanism]] where the Widow's bite simply ignores the resistances given by abilities such as [[Sacred Field]] or [[Tranquil Circle]]. As a result, it is recommended to target the Widows first when they spawn in during a wave. * '''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal ??? less damage to the Deep Widow. *'''Fireproof''' - {{PAGENAME}}s automatically extinguish [[burn]]. === Finisher === *'''Fatal Poison -''' The Deep Widow sinks her fangs into a downed player and liquefies them with a lethal dose of deep venom. =='''Tips/Trivia'''== *It is recommended for inexperienced or ill-equipped players to fight the Widow as a group, and flank her on opposite sides. All of her attacks come from the front and setting up this way will avoid all of the players in your group being hit at once. *Despite looking intimidating, she is a lot weaker than she looks, having a little more health than a [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] without its sheer mobility or damage. She still isn't a joke, though. **Try to only hit her twice with heavy weapons or thrice with others. Getting greedy and being bitten as a result will hurt. **The poison dealt by the Widow's Bite attack is a worst-case scenario, and is vital to avoid due to its percentage damage and armor pierce. **You can identify combos by their slower charging and faster swiping. **'''If a Deep Widow is corrupted, don't challenge it without being high power.''' She becomes far more punishing and inflicts more insanity with her attacks. *The Deep Widow can be cheesed. **She is not the brightest when it comes to getting stuck between two rock pillars in her own [[Greathive Aratel|Aratel]] home. She also has poor vertical mobility. **You can sneak past her by crouching and walking behind her, as she can only see in front. *Have a campfire ready if possible, as you will need to heal a lot if you're hit by the bite attack. **Staying out of reach with [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Talents#Meditative_Trance Warrior's Respite] also works, but doesn't restore sanity lost from the web attacks. It also buys time for other mobs to spawn and potentially see you, particularly in the Depths. =='''Item Pool'''== The Item Pool goes as follows *Relics: [[Smith's Alloy]] *Light Weapons: **[[Legion Cestus]], [[Anklets of Alsin]], [[Inquisitor's Thorn]], [[Apprentice Rapier]], [[Gilded Knife]], [[Whaling Knife]], [[Central Dirk]] and [[Flamekeeper Cestus]]. *Medium Weapon: **[[Trident Spear]], [[Serpent's Edge]], [[Rifle Spear]], [[Vigil Longsword]], [[Falchion]], [[Scimitar]], [[Worshipper Longsword]], [[Gremorian Longspear]], [[Cavalry Saber]], [[Shattered Katana]], [[Katana]], [[Summer Rifle]], and [[Rosen's Peacemaker]]. *Heavy Weapons: **[[Halberd]], [[Pale Morning]], [[Forge Greathammer]], [[Canorian Axe]], [[Adretian Axe]], and [[Darksteel Greatsword|Darkalloy Greatsword]]. *Other: **[[The Path's Defender]]. {{History}} {{nav|monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

title: Deepbound
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=Your training is almost complete, though you were raised in these halls, you must now venture out into the Wastes to prove your worth.|author=Origin Description}}
[[File:Deepbound.png|center]] __TOC__ ::''Deepbound'' is a [[The Depths|Depths]]-focused [[Origin]], granting unique bonuses and progression methods for Depths content. As such, this Origin has garnered the reputation of being a 'PvE Origin'. ==Description== Deepbounds all seem to be [[Apprentice Diver]]s due to them spawning with [[Diver Apprentice Robes]] automatically equipped. Deepbounds are affiliated with [[The Divers]]. ==Obtainment== To obtain the Deepbound [[Origin]], the player must do the following: #Encounter [[Akira]] in the [[Celtor Wastes]] and inquire to him about joining [[The Divers]]. #Reunite with him in [[Castle Light]] to obtain the Origin. #*Note that you do not have to accept the prompt to join The Diver's [[Guild]] to obtain this Origin. Warning: Do not attempt the Charisma check with Akira in the Celtor Wastes. If you do not have 75 or higher Charisma for the Charisma check, you will be killed and you will wipe. If you pass the Charisma check, you will not be able to obtain this Origin or [[Attributes Unbound|Unbound Willpower]] until you get another chance to redo the event by rejoining. ==Spawn== Deepbounds spawn with the [[Diver Apprentice Robes]] equipped, {{c|notes|25}}, and the Call of the Deep and Deepbound Contract Talents. You can choose to spawn at either [[Castle Light]] or [[the Diluvian Mechanism]] by clicking their respective icons in Character Creation. Due to time differences in the Depths, your character will be 17 years old on spawn, instead of the usual 18. ==Effects== You cannot enter the [[Trial of One]], even if you escape the Depths at power 1. You can enter the [[Temple of Hearts]] through a hidden crevasse in the wall next to the Resonance door. You can also speak to [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Yun'Shul]] as a Deepbound without him killing you, though you still won't be able to make any wishes unless you have a [[Resonance]]. ===Deepbound Contract=== Your experience gain while in the Depths is greatly increased, while your experience gain in overworld is greatly decreased. While below power 15, you'll gain another experience multiplier. You can restore your sanity in the Depths by going to [[Castle Light]] or defeating Monsters. Castle Light will always be open to you, even if you've drowned. Additionally, all NPCs and amenities at Castle Light will be accessible (e.g. the Banker, Antiquarian, and Stove). * Your [[Cathedral of the Interstice|Depths Trial]] is always an [[Enforcer]]. ===Call of the Deep=== Deepbounds gain a Talent tool called Call of the Deep, that is used to teleport the player to the [[First Layer]] or [[Castle Light]]. On use, your character will kneel with the ground turning into a black whirlpool. After 5 seconds, the player will be dragged down into the whirlpool, teleporting to the respective location. When used in the overworld, the player will delve into the [[First Layer]] without [[Death|drowning]]. When used in the [[First Layer]], the player will teleport directly to [[Castle Light]] with a 1 minute cooldown. File:Call of the Deep animation.gif|Call of the Deep being used in the overworld. File:CallOfTheDeepAnimDepths.gif|Call of the Deep being used in the Depths ==Pros and Cons== ===Pros=== *Increased experience gain in the Depths and an additional EXP multiplier while below Power 15, allowing for a very swift progression. *You gain bonus bell progress from killing monsters in The Depths, depending on their health and whether or not they're corrupted. *You start with the [[Diver Apprentice Robes]], an Adept Outfit, and {{c|notes|25}}. *Call of the Deep is incredibly useful as a potential time saver. *Sanity maintenance is incredibly easy, allowing you to stay in the Depths for extended periods of time. *Castle Light becomes a sanctuary within the Depths, having nearly all amenities a town needs and always being available to you. **[[Chariot's Spire]] can also be entered if you've drowned as a Deepbound. *You gain access to the [[Temple of Hearts]] without a Resonance. ===Cons=== *You gain reduced experience while outside of the Depths. *Your [[Cathedral of the Interstice|Depths Trial]] will always be an [[Enforcer]], though this is only really a con for lower levels. *You cannot do [[Trial of One]], even if you escape the Depths at Power 1, though the [[Diluvian Mechanism]] may be a good alternative. *Deepbound, at least in its progression, is very Depths centered, significantly raising the stakes, as a singular death will lead to you wiping. ==Reputation== Your starting faction [[reputation]] is: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}} and [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}, [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}}, and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} *''Note: Your chosen [[Aspect]] may affect your starting reputation.'' ==Trivia== *The Deepbound Origin was originally a Flaw, added before Origins even existed, however this was changed into an Origin during the 8/22/2022 update. *Deepbound is obtained only after talking to Akira about joining The Divers; you don't have to accept the request to join the Guild in order to obtain Deepbound. This misconception led to a handful of players leaving/disbanding their guilds. **There was a bug in which joining The Divers as an Officer or Leader of your own guild would make you one in the Divers guild. *Both [[Voidwalker]] and Deepbound were suggested by user MrTheBest2, who was later made a tester.[[File:Origins'Origin.png|250px]] ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:The Divers]] [[Category:Origins]] [[Category:Character]]

==Description==
The Deepdelvers are members of [[the Ignition Union]] who have proven their resourcefulness and critical thinking skills down in the [[The Depths]]. The rank grants them access to the [[Second Layer]] and beyond.<ref name="Gamma" />

There isn't a hierarchy in the Ignition Union, so the Deepdelver title is seen as only merit for being able to help others. The title does not reflect personal strength, but rather one's worth to risk their life for the Union.<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Deepdelver Gamma|quote=We aren't fond of hierarchy here, so the the merit [sic] of a Deepdelver is based on your ability to help others, not your strength.}}</ref>

==Description==
'''Deepfire Ring''' is a Ring [[Equipment]] piece that increases the tickrate of your {{status|Burn}} at the cost of duration and damage per tick. Deepfire Ring does not affect the {{status|White Flames}} status effect from [[Shard Bow|Corrupt Shard Bow]] and [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]], as they innately have its effects.

The tick rate of {{status|Burn}} is increased by 25%, from 2.4 ticks per second to 3 per second, but the base damage per tick is reduced from 3.33 per tick to 3.21 per tick, and the duration of {{status|Burn}} is reduced by ~17.5%.

If using Eruption Path: Lava Serpent, the ring will instead reduce the delay for explosions to occur.

==Notes==
*DPS is an incredibly effective stat for burn, as everyone is prone to remove it before the duration ends naturally, making this ring incredibly useful for Flamecharm players.
**It does however negatively affect {{t|Flame Within}} by making it run out faster.
**Base {{status|Burn}}'s DPS increases from '''8''' to '''9.6''' at 0 Flamecharm, and '''12''' to '''14.4''' at 100 Flamecharm.
**{{t|Azure Flames}} {{status|Azure Burning|Burn}}'s DPS increases from '''9''' to '''10.8''' at 0 Flamecharm, and '''13.5''' to '''16.25''' at 100 Flamecharm.
**{{t|Twisted Puppets}}' {{status|Puppet Burn}} DPS increases from '''1''' to '''1.2''' at 0 Flamecharm, and '''1.5''' to '''1.8''' at 100 Flamecharm.
**{{t|Twisted Puppets'}}' {{status|Shadow Burn}} DPS increases from '''2''' to '''2.4''' at 0 Flamecharm, and '''3''' to '''3.6''' at 100 Flamecharm.
*Both of Twisted Puppets' burn types heavily benefit from this Ring, as the Ether drain is ''per tick'' and is unaffected by Deepfire Ring's damage debuff.

{{stats|legendarypip|1|h}} |innate talent={{etal|equip|Already Dead}} |obtainment=[[The Understrand]] |description=An artifact of dark renown, convincing them they are already dead, instilling a strange reckless calm. Crafted from darksteel, its history is steeped in blood; its last owner met a grim fate during a forbidden [[The Ministry|Ministry]] Ritual to grow a murky, grotesque abomination. [[Grayrhule]] failed his experiments and succumbed to his own shadows. Dare to don this helm at your own peril. |type=Head |image=Deepscorn Casque.png}} ==Description== The '''Deepscorn Casque''' is a Unique [[Equipment]] Item found under the "Head" category. If you entered [[The Understrand]] through [[Silhuett]]'s event, this item along with the [[Deepspindle]] and [[Darkened Bastion]] will be guaranteed on the first clear. Grants the user the "{{t|Already Dead}}" Unique Equipment Talent, which reduces the self damage taken from certain abilities. These include: {{t|Electrify}}, {{t|Flame Within}}'s self damage ''on activation'', [[Oath: Linkstrider|Symbiotic Sustain]]'s wither, {{t|Shadow Travel}}, [[Shade Devour]], and {{t|Rush Hour}}(Rush Hour self damage reduction is 22%). Additionally this entirely removes the self damage taken by the [[Deepspindle]] running critical. This Talent also reduces the self damage/Wither application from the Poison (HP drain) and Wither Corrupted [[Resonance#Corrupted Resonances|Resonance]] downsides. ==Gallery == Deepscorn Casque (Side).png|Side Deepscorn Casque (Back).png|Back Deepscorn Casque (Held).png|Held File:Darkscorn Casque Lightborn.png|Lightborn File:Deepscorn casque dyed pink.png|Dyed ==Trivia== *When paired with the [[Stormchanter's Raiments]], casting {{t|Electrify}} will heal you for 12 health instead of dealing self damage. *Its previous description, "Because ten billion years' time is so fragile, so ephemeral... It arouses such a bittersweet, almost heartbreaking fondness," is a quote derived from the opening line in the anime ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Now_and_Then,_Here_and_There Now and Then, Here and There].'' *Due to the description it can be assumed that Darksteel is a powerful recurring substance in Deepwoken with other items having it's mention being the [[Darksteel Greatsword]] and the [[Darksteel Plate]]. *The emblem on the top of the helmet is a stylized version of [[Lost Celtor]]'s emblem. ==References== {{History}} {{nav|equipment}} [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:Head]] [[Category:Helmets]] [[Category:Equipment with Talents]] [[Category:Equipment with Exclusive Talents]]

===Quest (Cut Content)===
[[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]] at [[Castle Light]] in the First Layer of the Depths would give you the Fossil upon telling her information about the Second Layer. This quest was not repeatable. You would be able to tell her this once you meet the following requirements: * Have obtained Diver Journal I, II and III from the corpses in the [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|Second Layer]]: ** The first in the left wall of the [[Nest Corridor]] ** The second on a rock surrounded by Carbuncles somewhat near the Union Hook to [[Pilgrim's Respite]] ** The third on the body of a deceased Diver immediately off the bridge and to the left once entering the Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary *** Note that the Journal items themselves are not necessary, what matters is if you picked them up from the corpse. * Have completed the [[Galewax|Galewax quest]] at least once. * Have beaten [[Chaser]] at least once. * Have two Talents obtained within the Second Layer: ** Ethiron Gaze, which is obtained after interacting with an ice spear inside the [[Firfire Caverns]], and talking to the Leader located at [[Firfire]]. ** Union Hook, which is obtained after going to the powered [[The Frontier Furnace|Frontier Furnace]] and speaking with [[Alpha]], or obtained innately by the [[Ignition Delver]] Origin. You do not need to accomplish all of these requirements in the same run or even in the same order, nor do you need to complete the current run to get the requirement (save for the Chaser clear).

|description=This rapier's blade was not forged in the traditional sense; rather, it was grown from the darkest scoria of the abyss, taking shape as a twisting, malevolent shadow. Tales speak of a noble warrior from Celtor who, after discovering [[The Understrand|ancient ministry passages]], was consumed by a twisted curiosity and nurtured this vile blade. As the dark ritual progressed, the warrior's soul was pulled deeper into darkness, their essence decaying and their mind unraveling into madness. Ultimately succumbing to the depths, thus stirs the Deepspindle.
|image=deepspindleCloseUp.png
|oath=Silentheart}}

==Description==
The '''Deepspindle''' is a Legendary [[Weapons#Rapiers|Rapier]]; a malevolent manifestation of shadow forged into a curving assemblage of black tendrils drawing long into a sharp point, the blade of the rapier.

This weapon comes with the following passive:

* '''Understrand's Connection''' - Utilizing the Deepspindle with [[Darkened Bastion]]'s Withering Soul equipped will apply 25% of your weapon's scaled damage as Wither on M1s. The self-damage inflicted by the running critical is removed with [[Deepscorn Casque]]'s Already Dead talent.

The Deepspindle can be acquired as a guaranteed drop from a Ministry Cache Agent, or by chance from a random related event:

#Obtain {{t|Shadow Travel}} or [[Shadow's Flight]] by crafting two [[Void Feather]]s and an [[Umbral Obsidian]] together.
# Find an [[Understrand]] entrance. The entrance can spawn as a part of [[Silhuett|Silhuett's]] event, or as a random spawn in the following area, signified by their purple glow and the hex circle:
#* [[Outpost Antumbra]]
#* [[Minityrsa]]
#* [[The City of the Drowned]]
#Use {{t|Shadow Travel}} or [[Shadow's Flight]] on the hex circle. You will be teleported to a Ministry Cache and the fight will be initiated.
#*Depending on the type of event, the fight will initiate differently: [[Silhuett|Silhuett's]] entrance always guarantee a [[Ministry Agent]], while random spawned entrances will have the fight differ regarding your reputation with the Ministry.
#*The guaranteed drops from Silhuett's event can only be obtained once per slot; corresponding fights with the Ministry Agent will only guarantee the [[Deepscorn Casque]].
#*Assuming Ally reputation with [[The Ministry]], Silhuett's event's fight can be skipped immediately, giving you all the items; while random spawned events will allow you to fight a [[Black Diver (NPC)|Black Diver]] or [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] instead. Low/Neutral reputation random encounters will still have you fight the Ministry Agent, but will not guarantee drops like [[Silhuett|Silhuett's]] event. It should be mentioned that Broodlords and Black Divers WILL drop the same chest as the Agent, so these may be better grinding options for some, as their health pools are significantly smaller and their ai significantly easier.
==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:DeepspindleCritical.gif|Standing Critical
File:DeepspindleCriticalRunning.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>The Deepspindle has two different critical attacks.

For the '''standing''' critical, the user thrusts the weapon forward with both hands, dealing high posture damage and marking the target with a [[Combat Mechanics#Red|red telegraph]] before erupting in several dark blasts, dealing Shadow damage. The blasts cannot be parried after the initial hit however, you can vent out of it. The standing critical deals 1x scaled damage on the thrust, followed by the blasts dealing 0.2x * 7 scaled damage, totaling to 2.4x scaled damage.

For the '''running''' critical, the user stabs the weapon into themselves, dealing self-damage and creating dark bullets. The projectiles will teleport to the target and grant the user the {{t|Dark Rift}} state after landing, which has a 20 second cooldown. The self-damage is removed if you have the [[Deepscorn Casque]] headgear equipped. Each bullet deals 1x scaled damage, totaling to 2x scaled damage.

Both critical attacks have a cooldown of 9 '''seconds'''. However, the standing critical's duration lasts for a long time meaning the standing critical effectively has a cooldown of around 6.5 seconds as long as it lands.

<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:DeepspindleMinistryCircle.png
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This item ''can'' be dropped.
*Ironically, this weapon is longer than the [[Crypt Blade]].
*The running critical damage can be negated by the Unique equipment Talent "Already Dead", available by equipping the Deepscorn Casque.
*The magic circle sitting on top of the crossguard sports symbols bearing resemblance to the [[Ministry]].

title: Deepwoken
content:
::''Not to be confused with the name of the game, [[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]].''

::''See also the in-game glossary entry for [[Glossary#Deepwoken|Deepwoken]].''

{{Cleanup}}

==Description==
The '''Deepwoken''' are the individuals who have consumed and merged with a piece of a [[:Category:Drowned Gods|Drowned God]],<ref name=":0" /> causing them to "wake to the secrets of the deep" and develop a beyond advanced understanding of the Song, becoming immortal and attaining supernatural powers related to the Drowned God they merged with. As a consequence of becoming a Deepwoken, the individual undergoes physical changes, though the nature and magnitude of these transformations aren't known to a great extent. Being a Deepwoken is described as not being enviable, as they bring chaos where they go.

==Known Deepwoken==
There are three known Deepwoken, all likely well over a thousand years old.

*[[Amorus Pleeksty]]
** Pleeksty ate a part of [[Korilfiend]] in the form of a meteor flower. He received pyrokinetic powers, leading to the invention of the [[Flamecharm]] Attunement.
*[[Lore#The_First_Prophet|The First Prophet]] of [[The Ministry]]
**We don't know what Drowned God he merged with to become a Deepwoken, but we know that he isn't human anymore due to the physical changes of becoming one. His powers are unknown, but he would be able to defeat Pleeksty. Theorized to have brought [[Shadowcast]] upon the world, similar to Pleeksty and/or control water magic<ref>[[File:Archmage water magic discord.png|frameless|370x370px]]</ref> due to his inhumanity.

==Trivia== 
*It is unknown whether or not Deepwoken is an Oath, a state of being, or simply a title; developer Ragoozer has likened it to becoming a [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]]<ref name=":0">[[File:Ragoozer's statement regarding "Deepwoken" and "Starkindred".png]]</ref>—instead of eating a piece of a Drowned God, you eat a piece of a [[Celestial]].

title: Deepwoken (game)
content:
{{InProgress|Body=This page might not wholly reflect every facets existing in Deepwoken, its impact, or its drawn inspirations.}}
[[File:Roblox-Deepwoken-Featured-Image.png|600px|center|thumb]]
''[https://www.roblox.com/games/4111023553 Deepwoken]'' is an open world, roguelite, soulslike, action RPG developed and published by [https://www.roblox.com/communities/5212858 Monad Studios East] (formerly known as Vows by the Sea and Deepwoken Staff), a subdivision of Monad Studios, on the ''Roblox'' platform. The game serves as a spiritual antithesis to their previous project, ''[https://www.roblox.com/games/3016661674/Rogue-Lineage Rogue Lineage]''. Unlike most games on the platform, ''Deepwoken'' is not free-to-play and costs {{c|robux|400}} to purchase.

==Gameplay==
Players control a [[The Pathfinder|Pathfinder]] who sets out to explore the world. Players can choose from a variety of [[Origins]], [[Attunement]]s, and [[Oaths]] to alter their progression. The game features a much greater emphasis on Player versus Environment (PvE) mechanics than it's predecessor, though still features and encourages Player versus Player (PvP) encounters.

The combat revolves around balancing one's Posture and Health, parrying attacks to empty a player's own Posture while filling the Posture of enemies.

==Plot==
The game follows the adventures of various individuals in the world of [[Lumen]], chiefly the [[Eastern Luminant]]. Due to heavy usage of a magic source known as the Song, humanity finds itself beset on all sides by rising Tides and monsters from below, which have claimed much of what exists of the world. What remains are disparate factions with various conflicting ideas for how humanity should conduct itself, driving humanity to infighting as various eldritch monsters from the beyond and their servants begin to close in.

===Influences===
Made in Abyss and Sekiro have been cited as major inspirations for the world's setting.

The usage of the Song contributing to rising Tides and global devastation, but not being countered due to humanity growing reliant on it to progress, has been compared to the effects of using fossil fuels.

==Development==
The project was first revealed to exist on the 15th of November, 2019, dubbed "Project Deepwoken". Originally stated to release the on the autumn of 2021, the game released months later, on the 20th of December. Console support was later added on the 3rd of March, 2024.

On the 25th of July, 2025, raguza released documents detailing Deepwoken info, which were separated into two parts. The first document mainly consisted of FAQs from Twitter, whereas the other consisted of various in-game screenshots of locations. He had also stated that the project was the biggest Monad Studios has ever worked on, while also being the most complex.

==Reception==
In the 2022 Roblox Innovation Awards, Deepwoken was nominated in the Best Creative Direction and Best New Experience categories. The game won the award for Best New Experience.

Two years later, in the 2024 Roblox Innovation Awards, the game was nominated in Best Action/RPG category. In 2025, it was nominated for Best Action Experience.

title: Deepwoken (manga)
content:
{{NonCanon}}
'''''Deepwoken''''' is a one-shot manga written by Keiichi Tsuha and illustrated by Akeji Fujimura. It was published as part of a collection of short stories serving as adaptations of ''Roblox'' games. The collection was a collaboration between [[wp:Dentsu|Dentsu]], [[wp:Kodansha|Kodansha]] and [https://geek-out.io/en/ GeekOut], distributed during the Roblox Developers Conference of 2025.

==Plot==
An [[Unidentified adventuring party|adventuring party]] are informed by an [[Unidentified old man|old man]] about the return of [[The Duke (manga)|the Duke]], now hiding in the [[Northern Temple]]. He notes that if the Duke is not stopped, he'll destroy the city, or worse, the entire island. An injured man reveals himself to be the only survivor who escaped from the Duke, and the old man recounts the history of the island: once beset by constant invasions, the island was nearly destroyed, though the Duke's science combined with the will of its people and [[Marquis]] helped them hang on. The Duke eventually resorted to human experimentation, claiming many lives in the process and using their souls to create stone golems. The old man urges the party to defeat the Duke.

The party arrive at the Northern Temple and confront the Duke, who greets them, asking if they too seek power. The party dismiss any similarities between them and him, prompting the Duke to transform into a giant creature and unleash his army of golems onto the party in a demonstration of his strength. As the two sides do battle, the Duke taunts them over how his golems were created from past adventurers who challenged him and demands their souls, while the party find their attacks against the Duke to be ineffective. The group recognize the Duke has a shield of some kind, before being blasted away by the Duke's attack. The [[Unidentified swordsman|swordsman]], reeling from the attack, notices bone-like fixtures emerging from the ground, and remembers the old man explaining that the Duke had experimented on himself and turned his bones into conduits for magic. The swordsman removes one of the structures, dispelling the Duke's shield. In response, the Duke readies a fused Mantra, combining fire, ice and lightning. The swordman braces, and manages to parry the attack, which he vocalizes, giving the party the opportunity to go on the offensive, finally defeating the Duke.

As the party recover from the battle, they are confronted by a [[Unidentified knight|knight]]. The knight reveals they had been watching the group but dismisses them as unimpressive before picking them off one by one. The knight stands over their defeated bodies, musing that they appear inexperienced and shouldn't try learning what lies beyond power, disappearing into dust.

==Appearances==
*[[The Duke (manga)|The Duke]]
*[[Marquis]] {{Mo}}

==Trivia==
*Characters depicted within this story do not appear to have [[aspects]] like the inhabitants of Lumen seen within the game, and instead appear as normal humans.

==Overview==
Deepwoken Battlegrounds was an update to ''Deepwoken'' released on April 1st, 2025 to celebrate April Fools Day, upholding the tradition of annual April Fools' events. The Battleground mode could be accessed by clicking "BATTLEGROUNDS" on the main menu, taking the player into the battlegrounds servers. In Battlegrounds, players would spawn either on [[The Floating Keep]], above the [[Battle Royale]] map, or down on the Battle Royale map itself, with the player having 50 points in all [[Character Stats|stats]] besides the three Weapon stats which all had 100, access to all (non-oath) [[mantras]] freely, a base [[Sword]], and the exclusive Ether Fly mantra.

On the Battle Royale map, players could find excessive amounts of [[Battle_Royale#Deep_totems|Deep Totems]] and [[Battle Royale#Chests|Loot Chests]], along with the chance to find any weapons in the base game and outfits to wear. Death had very little penalty in the battlegrounds game mode, with people only losing their weapon, enchant effect, and any held items such as Bombs. Killing players was rewarded by granting the killer copies of their victim's [[Talents]], and the ability to equip their weapon.

==Trivia==

* Deepwoken Battlegrounds was the fourth annual April Fools' event.
** The three events prior were, in order of release: [[Mudwoken]], [[Coral Fever]], and [[Warring States Era]].
* The Battlegrounds gamemode had a bug when first released where dying removed the Ether Fly Mantra & the Flimsy Glider from your inventory.
** This made the only safe way to get down to the Battle Royale map was to use mantras that prevented fall damage such as Wind Passage or Neural Pathway, as otherwise you would instantly die from the fall.
* In Battlegrounds, upon taking an Oath, the only way to change it afterwards was to log from the server.
** Despite this, when you killed someone, it would often say you gained their Oath talents, despite not being able to use them.
*For unknown reasons, certain Oaths were unobtainable from Oath Shards. This includes some of the more recently released Oaths at the time, being [[Saintsworn]], [[Soulbreaker]], and [[Bladeharper]], as well as [[Linkstrider]], [[Silentheart]], and [[Saltchemist]]. Silentheart and Saltchemist were made unobtainable intentionally.
*As early as a few hours after the update, players would clamor for the spawn locations in each map to be randomized as to prevent spawnkilling, because they weren't before.

==Overview==
Deepwoken OG (referred to in update logs as "''[[Operation: Deep Healing|Deep Healing]]: Cool Ranch''") was an update to ''Deepwoken'' released on April 1st, 2026 to celebrate April Fools Day, upholding the tradition of annual April Fools' events.

After running an algorithm to pick community suggestions at random to determine what the everyday, "true median player" wants from the game,  two suggestions were added to the game, per "super_sonicmarioexe_fan67" and "xx_chimedwellah_xx"'s respective brief, 3-word long suggestions:
*Reverting the combat mechanics to those of [[Verse 1]]; "revert the combat"
*Giving [[Boats]] the ability to fly, because boats need to be able to fly in order to "fix flying boats".

==Changes==
===Combat mechanics===
The changes to combat mechanics were:
*Reverting flourishes - Instead of performing a flourish at the end of your M1 combo, your M1 combo would restart with the first attack of the combo missing. 
**To accomodate this, all abilities that would activate on flourishes were changed to activate on the final attack in the combo, 1 attack earlier than normal.
*Removing uppercuts - When attempting to perform an uppercut, you would instead perform a basic attack with the forward momentum of a running attack, due to the momentum you had from sliding. Unlike that of a regular running attack, the momentum was able to be halted at any point by letting go of the {{input|input=W}} key.
*Removing air dashes - Pressing {{input|input=Q}} in the air would perform a roll.
*Removing venting - Pressing {{input|input=G}} would do nothing.
*Roll cancel cooldown - Roll cancelling no longer refreshes your roll after a reduced cooldown. Having the {{t|Tap Dancer}} Talent returned your roll cancels back to normal, and its description was updated to reflect this.
*Parrying - Parrying received a few changes:
**Cooldown after missing a parry was heavily reduced.
**The window to land a parry was increased.
*Tempo becoming Reservoir - [[Tempo]]'s behavior was tweaked to match the behavior of the old [[Reservoir]] mechanic.

===Flying boats===
You were able to fly while driving a boat. Holding {{input|input|Space}} would ascend and holding {{input|keybind|ctrl}} would descend. Boats in mid-air would slowly descend to ground while unoccupied.

===Traan Zakshun's Bankrupt Extravaganza===
During this event, all [[Traan Zakshun]] stocks were replaced with Traan Zakshun's Bankrupt Extravaganza. In this unique stock, Traan Zakshun sold the following items: [[Erebus]] Enchant Stone for {{c|crowns|1,000}}, and [[Plumfruit Muffin]], [[Egg]], and [[Magic Bean]]s for {{c|crowns|1}} each. On top of this, each item came with a new shop UI description:
*''PLEAAASE PATHFINDER I NEEEED THIIISSSS''
*''I'm literally selling my last valuable belongings along side these damn beans... the least you could do is BUY something.......''
*''Short a crown?''
*''You seriously can't spare one more crown?...''

==Trivia==
*The reversion of combat mechanics to those of Verse 1 references a long-running sentiment from players for the game to return to the way it was in Verse 1, and in presentation intending to mimic ''Fortnite: Battle Royale'''s widely celebrated "OG" updates that revert the game's map, items, and mechanics to those of some of its oldest versions.
*Deepwoken OG was the fifth annual April Fools' event.
**The four events prior were, in order of release: [[Mudwoken]], [[Coral Fever]], [[Warring States Era]], and [[Deepwoken Battlegrounds]].

==Trivia== *Initially there were meant to be day themes and night themes in the game, but the idea was scrapped due to the workload this would have presented. In addition, due to a change in Deepwoken's gameplay during testing, the mechanic of a peaceful daytime and a dangerous night time was removed from the game. *Naktigonis created many of the early sound effects, but later on his line of work got pushed more towards music. *Despite how they are ordered in the Volume I album, the Greathive themes, which marked the change in artistic direction, were created before Summer Isle's music. *The earlier OST tracks were made when Naktigonis was still fairly new to FL Studio 20 and before he had a MIDI controller/keyboard, so he considers them simplistic. *The music for the [[Voidheart]] was the original music for Corvus Manor on the Isle of Crows. **Additionally, it seems that it used to be the original theme for "Of Labours, Veiled," but was quietly removed and replaced with the current theme for Duke Erisia's Manor. *The "A Memory of Tides" song is called "Accordion Vinyl" in-game. *"The Games of War" was heavily inspired by the soundtrack of Medieval 2: Total War, as Naktigonis is a big fan of Jeff van Dyck's work for the early Total War games. * A small part of "The Gideshu March" is used in "And Let Slip The Hounds of War" at 0:48 *"The Gideshu March" was never commissioned, rather, Naktigonis made the soundtrack out of his passion for the game. *Naktigonis's voice regularly features in the soundtrack: his voice is featured in the choirs in "Oscillation", "Kyrie", and "The Gideshu March", many of the chants in "And Let Slip The Hounds Of War", most of the scream vocals in "INSOMNIA", and in the singing vocals of "Sin-Smelted Scoriae." ** He was recovering from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19 Covid-19] when recording the vocals for "Sin-Smelted Scoriae," and is unhappy with how they came out, though he plans to leave it as how it is. *The "Picking a Talent" sound is from ''Stellaris''.Sound file used at [[:File:Tradition available 01.wav|Stellaris\sound\ui\tradition_available_01.wav]] *The "Unparryable attack" sound originates from ''Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice''. *For earlier tracks in the OST, ambient noises, such as the wildlife from "Solivagant", were not separated from the music, but rather made part of it, due to Roblox's technical limitations. **Naktigonis has stated '​early tracks in the OST tend to be laidback with the melody and let ambience take centre stage; this later changed as the game development progressed and Monad's design philosophy changed. According to him, the OST generally picks up in the second half when area-specific combat themes get introduced.' *Nakitgonis felt "Peregrine" ended up being used way less often than he liked. Most of the area it was meant for - the Seranece Mountains, - was cut from the game for its release. *Early combat themes were intended to be percussion-only, to contrast with the melodic ambience music, though this was obviously changed. *The vocals for "A Light in The Sky" are from a [https://www.fluffyaudio.com/shop/simple-opera-singer/ Kontakt 6 opera singer library], which features the voice of opera singer Ji Min Oh. * In the "Blood and Thunder", a leitmotif can be heard at 2:55, Naktigonis has stated that this is a reference to Johnny I Hardly Knew Ye by The Irish Rovers, and the piece is inspiried by Celtic folk music. * The SFX for the Revenge Mantra is directly from the indie RPG game "OMORI" ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bu-8jQaOUW8 Critical Hit | OMORI SFX]) * The "Megalodaunt Eating" sound effect is the sound of a horse eating a carrothttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-faLxYHaG74 [[Category:Deepwoken]] ==References==

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that changes your weapon's raw damage into a damage over time effect.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} applies a 0x damage modifier to your weapon attacks, removing their raw damage. Instead, your weapon attacks apply the {{status|Deferred}} status effect, dealing damage over a 2.5 second period.

Additionally, your weapon's damage is increased by 7%.

===Notes===
*Deferred ticks 10 times, every 0.25 seconds.
*Deferred's damage cannot be avoided once you've been hit.
*The damage over time from this enchantment can '''not''' be reduced by the [[Parasol Planter]].
*Deferred deals damage based on the active damage modifiers and resistances when you '''landed''' your attack.
**On one hand, you cannot apply a buff to yourself ''after'' landing a weapon attack to buff your DoT. And if your opponent gains a conditional damage reduction while your Deferred status is on them, the remaining damage over time ticks from the hits you've landed '''prior''' to the new resistances being added will ignore them.
**On the other hand, if you had a buff applied to yourself or your opponent had a conditional resistance source ''when'' you landed your weapon attack, the Deferred DoT damage for that hit will be calculated as if these effects are still active, even if they aren't.

==Description==
The Delicate Flower is an item that is obtainable from [[Suri]] in the [[Greathive Aratel]]. You must take it to a grave in [[Isle of Vigils]], specifically in a graveyard near the main area. If you get hit when you are holding the flower, it will become a Ruined Flower, and the quest will have to be restarted. 
<gallery widths="300px">
Ruined Flower.png|It's just a stem now
</gallery>

== Trivia ==

* This Quest is most likely inspired by Hollow Knight, which also has a mission to deliver a delicate flower that will be destroyed upon taking damage, to a grave. This theory is also supported by many similarities between [[Vesperian|Vesperians]] and bugs in Hollow Knight.
* The model of the flower is reminiscent of flower models from Rogue Lineage.

==Description==
Delta is [[Canor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He works for [[The Ignition Union]].

Delta is responsible for handing out Arc Suits, though he doesn't entirely understand the mechanics behind their function. Still, he's aware of the basics of Oaths and doesn't appreciate damaging the suits.

[[The Pathfinder]] is required to speak with him to obtain and progress the [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]] Oath after they rescue [[Epsi]] and speak with [[Alpha]].

He wears the [[Union Initiate]] Outfit.

==Location==
Delta can be found inside the lower-mountain part of the town, specifically behind the water mill just above the waterfall.

title: Derelict Highchurch
content:
{{Location|name=Derelict Highchurch|caption=High above the ancient rot, a place of worship to the unimaginable resides.}}
[[File:Derelict Highchurch.jpg|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
The Derelict Highchurch is a location in the East Luminant, it can be found above the [[Ancient Rotlands]]. It can be accessed from a broken bridge connecting to near the [[Songseeker Temple]] in the [[Songseeker Wilds]], or from two [[Talent Quests#Union Hook|Union Hooks]] on the backside. Four [[:Category:Songseekers|Songseekers]] will spawn at the front of the church, which must be killed as a part of [[Ezra]]'s quest.

It appears normal on the surface, however, one can open a hatch beneath the lectern, leading into a library, You can interact with some bookcases, to open a secret entrance, or just use a terrain breaking mantra on the bookshelves guarding the entrance to a room with a crucified [[Celestial]], and [[Samael]], who is crucial to receiving the [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]] [[Oaths|Oath]].

The [[Celestial|Celestial's]] blood is also a crucial part of obtaining the [[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]] [[Oaths|Oath]]. You can also find [[Beatra]], a Shadowcast user who acts as the trainer in the overworld. She can be found in the garden to the left of the church (She cannot grant the player Shadowcast however, only to upgrade Mantras).

''For a visual guide, consider watching [[:File:Derelict highchurch guide.gif|this gif]]'' below.
{|
|[[File:Derelict highchurch guide.gif|thumb|left|275px]]
|}

The [[Vyrelda|Bloodrend Trainer, Vyrelda]], can be found inside of the church itself, between the chairs on the left side.
{|
|[[File:Highchurchbloodrend.png|left|frameless|275px]]
|}

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Derelict Highchurch Location on the Map.png|Derelict Highchurch Location on the Map
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The music for this area is [[Of Labours, Veiled]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]], which is the the same track used in places such as [[Crypt of the Unbroken]], [[Duke Erisia's Manor]], [[Voidheart]], and the [[Beloved Zofia]]. 
*This location has the largest interactable bookshelves out of anywhere else in the game.
*This church was originally a spot owned by [[Ezra]] to worship [[Capra|Ku]], a [[Celestial]] that many [[Capra]] worship. Until [[Samael]] kicked them out in pursuit of [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]].
