title: Dravik, The Rat King
content:
{{Topbuttons|d=;|{{iv|Dravik, the Rat King (NPC)}}; {{iv|p|Dravik, The Rat King (Boss)}}}} {{IronVowEx}} {{Quotes|quote=From this point forward we shall only be using our weapons to fight. No more tricks, understand that?|author=Dravik, The Rat King}} {{EnemyInfobox |image1=Dravik, The Rat King.png |health=6000 |weapon=The King's Greataxe |affiliation=[[The Golden Rats]] |moves= *Axe Swings *Critical *Feint *Golden Tornado *Gilded Rushdown *Aureate Flourish *Gilded Left *Glowing Slashes *Ruler's Rush *Three Swing Cleave *Pasmarkintini *Sparkle Blitz *Rodent Pounce *Rites of the Rat *King's Might: Glistening Crush |drops=* 3 [[Knowledge]] * 2,500 [[Notes]] * [[Pluripotent Alloy]] * [[Ardour Manifestation]] * [[Memento]] Talents}} ==Description== Dravik, the Rat King is an instanced [[Bosses|boss]] fought in the {{Iv|Vault of the Aureate}} which is a boundary located in the {{Iv|The Golden Rat}}, near eastern most Waterlock in the [[Luminants|Etrean Luminant]]. He is the first King of the Golden Rats and the one enforcing the Golden Rule. This boss is not optional, as he is mandatory to fight the {{Iv|True Heart of Enmity}}. The fight unlocks the [[Flashing Thunder]] {{Iv|Memento}} upon defeat while using the [[Sightless]] {{Iv|Memento}}. When Dravik is killed, he appears as a memory inside the {{Iv|The Cerebral Spire}}. Upon talking to him, he will tell you to destroy the statue inside [[Etris Palace]] to break the barrier protecting {{Iv|Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet}}. To destroy the statue, you need to defeat the True Heart of Enmity in the [[Cathedral of the Interstice#The Trial|Depths Trial]]. He is an elderly [[Etrean]] man with pale, weathered skin and a thick white beard. A jagged scar cuts through his left eye. Light serpentine scales can be seen on his cheekbones and eyelids. He wears heavy, dark plated armor with sharp shoulder guards and fine metal designs, resembling what could be a darker version of the [[Imperial Pauldrons]] and [[Imperial Boots]]. A worn, dark cloak or scarf hangs from his shoulders, similar in appearance to a [[Brilliant Cape]] dyed black. He uses a custom Greataxe as his weapon, which has a glowing golden crescent blade. === Starting the Fight with Dravik === # Recommended but not necessary: Defeat the {{Iv|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)}} to uncap your Power past 5 and obtain your Memento-specific talents and mantras. # Make your way to the Waterlocks in-between the [[The Etrean Sea|Etrean Sea]] and [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel Sea]] and enter a small passage, leading to [[The Golden Rat]]. # Descend down into [[The Golden Rat]] and hug the right wall until you find a large boundary in the floor that teleports you to the boss arena. # Recommended but not necessary: Keep hugging the right wall until you encounter a boundary in a doorway. This unlocks the Golden Rat Den [[boundary]], letting you teleport back whenever you need to retry the fight. # Upon loading in and going through his intro, the fight begins. == Moveset == '''Moves marked with dark orange symbols only have some parts of the move Dodge/Blockable (usually due to high posture damage)''' {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |
'''Axe Swings''' |Dravik uses his battleaxe to slash his opponent. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y }} |[[File:Dravik Slash.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Dravik raises his battleaxe before firmly slamming it down into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} | |- |
'''Feint''' |Dravik cancels his attack mid swing to fake out the player. {{AttackTags |misc, unharmful }} | |- |
'''Golden Tornado''' (★★☆) |Dravik winds his axe behind him and swings it upwards, letting out a moderate scream before performing four quick spinning slashes. * There is a noticeable delay between the first swing and the follow-up spins. * A low-pitched sound cue plays to indicate this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type2_color=darkorange |type3_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik Beyblade.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Gilded Rushdown''' (★★★) |Dravik lets out a sound cue and slowly swings his axe twice, starting from the player's left side upwards, then downwards, after which he rushes the player twice before teleporting behind them with an attack and swinging again. *The timing for parrying the rushes depends on Dravik's distance from the player. *Dravik will always follow up with '''Sparkle Blitz''' if he rushes twice, but never once. *The rushing part is similar to '''Ruler's Rush''', which may throw you off. *A higher-pitched sound cue plays to indicate this attack, along with having different visual effects. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.n }} |[[File:Dravik RushDown.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Aureate Flourish''' (★☆☆) |Dravik attacks with two spinning slashes, starting from the player's left side, after which he winds up a big overhead slam. *The slam can be feinted into Gilded Lefts. *The slam may also be jumped over. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.n, jump }} |[[File:Dravik SpinSlam.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Gilded Lefts''' (★☆☆) |Dravik winds up his left arm and throws out three strong lefts. *This move is only performed after feinting '''Aureate Flourish.''' *The visual for this move is deceptively big compared to the hitbox. *Following what's said from the above, sometimes if you stand into the circle given by the visuals, you won't be hit, but standing right at the back of it gets you hit. *Oddly, this move seems to have the highest chance of a voiceline playing. For whatever reason, this seems to be intentional, as Pasmarkinti used to have the highest chance, but was deliberately changed to this move. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type2_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik FlashingLefts.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Glowing Slashes''' (★★☆) |Dravik winds back his axe then slashes upwards from the player's left side, then downwards. After a brief moment, he performs two quick slashes of light, then one delayed final swing. *This move can be feinted into '''Ruler's Rush''' after any of the slashes. *The windup is similar to the first swing of '''Golden Tornado''', but faster {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type3_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik GlowingSlashes.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Ruler's Rush''' (★☆☆) |Dravik stomps the ground then rushes towards the player with gold effects. * This move is only performed after feinting '''Glowing Slashes'''. *Dravik may follow this move up with '''Glistening Crush''' {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.n }} |[[File:Dravik StompFeint.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Three Swing Cleave''' (★☆☆) |Dravik performs three swings at a consistent interval: first from the player's right side, then left side and finishing with an overhead swing. *This move is always followed by '''Pasmarkinti'''. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type2_color=darkorange |type3_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik Triple Cleave.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Pasmarkinti''' (★★☆) |Dravik teleports to you and does three consecutive slashes *This move can be used up to three times in a row. *Dravik can feint the third slash of any of the three attacks into a slower slash. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type2_color=darkorange |type3_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik Pasmarkinti.gif|thumb|centre]][[File:Dravik ParFeint.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Sparkle Blitz''' (★★☆) |Dravik teleports behind the player and performs two quick slashes *This move is rarely ever used, mostly when the player is at a distance and facing away from Dravik. *This move has no sound or visual cue, making it very hard to react to. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y }} |[[File:Dravik Teleport.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Rodent Pounce''' (★☆☆) |Dravik leaps backwards, then jumps forward and slices at the player. *This move is heavily telegraphed. *This move also has an absurd hitbox, if you back up 1ft or two, you can easily dodge it. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y |type3_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Dravik Pounce.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Rites of the Rat''' (★☆☆) |Dravik summons two golden battleaxes to circle around you and at random, they strike. *This can be overlapped with Dravik's other attacks, causing you to be overwhelmed if not careful. *During his second phase, Dravik summons two sets of axes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.y }} |[[File:Dravik Mantra.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''King's Might: Glistening Crush''' (★★★) |Dravik enters a very long windup animation, after which he smashes the ground with a massive slash that covers half of the arena *The swing itself is quite quick, so try to learn the timing of the attack. Do not panic dodge. *Unlike '''Aureate Flourish''''s slam, if you try to jump over this, you will die. {{AttackTags |parry.y, dodge.y, block.n }} |[[File:Dravik FaultLine.gif|thumb|centre]] |} === Passives === * '''Golden Rule''' - Upon reaching '''60% HP''' ''(won't activate if he is downed)'', ** Dravik will say "From this point forward we shall only be using our weapons to fight. No more tricks, understand that?" ** Dravik will also gain a circle of light around him. ** '''Dravik gains immunity to a number of things and reflects their damage back to you. These include:''' *** '''Mantras''' (except for Prediction and Restrain) *** '''Damaging enchant effects (e.g. Storm and Chilling)''' **** Umbral Knight is not affected by this. *** '''Some criticals (currently only Pale Briar, First LIght, and Kyrsieger confirmed)''' *** '''Gran Sudaruska's Passive''' *** '''Jar of Souls and Chorus Divide''' == Battle Dialogues == {| class="fandom-table" !Condition !Dialogue |- |'''Battle initiation''' |Haha! Finally, a worthy challenger! |- |'''When the 'Golden Rule' Passive activates''' |From this point forward we shall only be using our weapons to fight. No more tricks, understand that? |- |'''Defeat''' |At long last... a death honorable for the Golden Rat. |} ==Gallery== rat_king_back.png|Back View DravikIcon.png|Face Close-up rat_king_ring.png|Dravik's Ring ==Trivia== *When defeated, Dravik will say "At long last, a death, honorable for a Golden Rat." *Dravik may bypass your memory shard and kill you instantly, though this is inconsistent across all his attacks. *Dravik is voiced by "a random guy off of Fiverr [for $50]".https://www.youtube.com/live/C9qd2A_NSk4?si=9menDzZFdYRic4rP&t=643 *The Triangular slash attack is likely a reference to "[https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Pilgrim_Knight Pasmarkinti Charged Blow]" from Monad Studio's previous game, ''Rogue Lineage''. *The current soundtrack that plays during the fight is "Shallow Breath" by Naktigonis, which was originally an OST meant for the [[Conquest]] gamemode. *Dravik, The Rat King was formerly one of the Blade Temple's most exceptional instructors, before his fallout with Maestro Alkhurst Legato regarding the temple's standards.{{Ref/NPC|Mofisu Clan Informant|quote=The 'Rat King' was formerly one of the Blade Temple's most exceptional instructors, before his fallout with Maestro Alkhurst Legato regarding the temple's standards...}} *The hair ID for Dravik's beard is 97197321204898. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Bosses}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Voiced Characters]] [[Category:The Golden Rats]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]] [[Category:Enemies]]

title: Dravik, the Rat King (NPC)
content:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Dravik, the Rat King}} {{Topbuttons|d=;|{{iv|p}}; {{iv|Dravik, The Rat King|Dravik, The Rat King (Boss)}}}} {{IronVowEx}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Dravik, the Rat King |name=Dravik |alias=*The Rat King
*King Dravik the First{{Ref/NPC|The Beard|quote=King Dravik the First, our glorious ruler - Duke of the Battleaxe, the Count of Gold, Monarch of the Tavern, the Golden Rat King!}}
*Duke of the Battleaxe
*The Count of Gold
*Monarch of the Tavern
*The Golden Rat King |aspect=Etrean |location=[[The Cerebral Spire]] |affiliation=*[[Etrea]] (formerly) *[[The Golden Rats]] |image1=dravik npc.png |death=Killed by a member of the [[Circle of Honour]] |deathdate=1233 CE{{Deep dates|Iron}} |pronouns=He/him}} ==Description== A phantom of [[the Inheritor]]'s victory - the late Dravik, the Rat King is located at [[The Cerebral Spire]] next to the Boundary portal. He was a former Etrean instructor, who sparred with [[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]], and possibly the Mentor of [[Evengarde Rest]], who at the time of the Vow of Iron gamemode is in the [[Luminants|West]] training with [[The Hundred Legions]]. Additionally he believes that only he could have a chance against [[The Lord Regent]], even if the Inheritor tries possibilities out to take him out. In his phantom dialog, he elaborates as to why he left the [[Temple of the Blade|Blade Temple]] for the Golden Rats, mainly critiquing the place being "a shadow of it's former self". {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {|table class="fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |''*The air shimmers before you, revealing a familiar face.*'' |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Hello? |- | colspan="1" |''*He smiles softly.*'' That was the greatest fight I have been gifted, aside from Maestro Alkhurst himself. Should you ever see him... Pass him my regards. I imagine you came to me with questions, though.
[Name is revealed] |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I need to know how to pass the barrier surrounding the Lord Regent's place. |- | colspan="1" |All of this for Zi'eer, eh? Well, if I'm being honest, he might be a bit out of your league, kid. The only person I know who might be capable of taking on him was a young prodigy from the Blade Temple. He's off training in the West with the Hundred Legions now... I don't really blame him - the Blade Temple is a shadow of it's {{sic|expected=its}} former self. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |That doesn't matter, how do I pass the barrier? |- | colspan="1" |''*The Rat King sighs.*'' The barrier is impenetrable from the outside. But it has no special protections once you're inside. If you destroy its source - the statue standing before the Royal Palace - you should be able to bring it down. There is only one method I know of that allows one to appear in any location in the world... But you're not gonna like it. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What do I have to do? |- | colspan="1" |Well, the first part is easy. You have to ''die''. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You have to be joking. |- | colspan="1" |This is no jest. When you die, you will enter the under-realm, where all souls are dragged to after death. Once there, make your way to the city, and find the temple whose tower reaches the light above. There will be voices speaking to you when you arrive. Hold the idea of a bargain in your own mind - these voices will be able to hear your thoughts. Should they agree to the terms, you'll be sent topside on the other end of the barrier. But be warned, kid - the voices don't take lightly to people like us asking anything of them. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Thanks for the help. |- | colspan="1" |No need to thank me. You have a long road ahead of you. I look forward to seeing your dance with the Regent. title: Dread Serpent
content:
::''Commonly referred to by the community as Kaido (Developers prefer that it is referred to as the Dread Serpent).'' {{Quotes|quote=The devouring of the Drakeheart had not lead to infinite wisdom, but an overwhelming sensation of dread. Countless memories of dark history, strife, tragedy, filled the head of the Steward. In his very place, he began to become a creature most grotesque. And thus, the first Dread Serpent was born, corrupted by the will of a thousand dead eras, a mind drowned with only histories of tragedy. |author=Lumen’s Folklore: Volume ‘North’}} {{Monster Infobox |image1=Kaido.png |attacks=Dread Breath
Claw Swipe
Tail Swipe |health=50,000 |drops=*Large Chest *[[Murmur: Ardour]] *[[Ardour Manifestation]] *[[Dread Serpent's Tooth]] (direct drop) *[[Dread Serpent's Mane]] (direct drop) *[[Dread Flesh]] (direct drop) *[[Enchant Stone]] *[[Petra's Anchor]], [[Anklets of Alsin]], [[Wyrmtooth]], and rarely a [[Dormant Splinter]] *[[Gumshoe Longcoat]], [[Brilliant Cape]], [[Crystal Pendant Earrings]] *[[Gilded Needle]] (direct drop) *Misc. (See [[Dread Serpent#Loot Table|Lootpool]]) |locations=[[Voidsea]] |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== A once normal steward seeking knowledge but now twisted into a mind of corruption, thus spawning a monstrous race of dragons, the '''Dread Serpent''' is a massive [[Bosses|Boss]] that appears in the [[Voidsea]] by chance or through usage of [[Ardour Manifestation]]. It's spawn is displayed by a mass of bubbles being on the water. The Dread Serpent appears as a long, gray serpent-like dragon possessing four horns and eyes. It sports a black mane and beard, as well as a black fur that runs throughout its back, ending with a fire-shaped tail. It primarily uses the power of [[Frostdraw]] to stop boats and prey alike. Upon defeat, a purple orb flutters toward the player, granting [[Murmur: Ardour]]. You must hit him at least once to obtain the Murmur. It will not be granted if you already have a [[Murmur]], although the orb still spawns and it still says it granted you the [[Murmur]]. Though there are many seen today, the first Dread Serpent was born when a man, only known as The Mad Steward, ate the heart of an Elder Edenkite, instantly flooding his mind with every tragedy that ever occurred, filling him with dread and transforming him into the first Dread Serpent. The man in question possessed [[Murmur: Ardour]], which is why killing one of the Dread Serpents results in obtaining it. Where the rest came from or why they all provide Ardour on death is unknown. The background information concerning the Dread Serpent is derived mainly from the lore book titled ''[[Books#Lumen's_Folklore:_Volume_'North'|Lumen's Folklore: Volume 'North'.]]'' ==Attacks== ''For a visual guide consider watching [https://youtu.be/zcUmCTAAjNU this video].'' {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |
'''Dread Breath'''
(★★☆) |The Dread Serpent opens its mouth and releases a white-frost beam, dealing extreme rapid damage to those around it and freezing the water. *Also deals heavy damage to boats. *This attack deals enough damage to knock a '''MAX POWER''' player in '''UNDER TWO SECONDS''' if consistently landed. If hit while knocked, it causes '''extreme''' amounts of blood loss. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Claw Swipe'''
(★☆☆) |Swipes two times in quick succession *Each hit will ragdoll you and therefore getting hit by first swipe will guarantee a hit from the second swipe. *Can be rarely preceded by Tail Swipe {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll, autogrip }} |- |
'''Tail Swipe'''
(★★☆) |An attack with the tail. *Often used after two claw swipes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} ==Loot Table== Upon defeating The Dread Serpent, he will drop a large chest containing many different items including: *Multiple Mid-Late Game [[Weapons]] for each weapon class, along with [[Deep Gems]], Legendary [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Equipment#Rings Rings] and other [[Equipment]]. *Very Rarely a [[Dormant Splinter]].

==Gallery== File:Dread Serpent Full.jpeg|Fullbody File:DeepwokenThumbnail2.png|A Dread Serpent in the second Deepwoken Thumbnail File:Dread Serpent being Dreadballed.png|Hurt by Cannonballs File:Dread Serpent Rizz Master S Rank.png|Hurt by Cannonballs File:Dread serpent vs groose era.png|Attacking an Ironclad File:KaidoKamui.png|Spawned in Dimensional Travel ==Trivia== It closely resembles serpent-style dragons from [[wp:Chinese dragon|Chinese Folklore]]. Specifically its general design is very smiliar to [https://onepiece.fandom.com/wiki/Kaidou Kaidou] from One Piece in his dragon form. According to Arch_Mage, this is a result of ''Deepwoken'' employing far more modelers via contracts prior to its release, resulting in lower quality work that was frequently stolen from other sources with no credit (such as with the [[repeater]] and [[Enforcer's Blade]]). As a result, Arch_Mage has expressed distaste to using the name and wishes that people call it Dread Serpent, while being very vocal about wanting the creature to be remodeled.[citation needed] *Anyone can get the Murmur as long as you did any damage, it doesn't matter how many people hit him, everyone will get the Murmur unless they already have one *You will only get hit if you are close to him, so keep your distance while behind him and be prepared to roll when he does a flip. *Since the Dread Serpent is so rare, having multiple people will boost the spawn rate, making the process of finding him much easier. *It is highly implied that a Dread Serpent is also responsible for the sinking of the Petra's Dawn, the first boat to cross the Voidsea without the help of a [[Lightkeep|Lightkeeper's]] Gift, as the Petra's Anchor is one of its drops. *The Dread Serpent's health does not increase with the number of people fighting it, so it is beneficial to fight it with a group of friends. *Its appearance is supposedly exactly what an Elder Edenkite once looked like, only wingless. *It's possible that the Dread Serpent will receive a rework to its appearance and moveset in a future update.[citation needed] *Was bugged and unable to spawn from 05/08/23 to 05/13/23. *Another bug was present since release until around October 2023, which made the Dread Serpent unable to spawn if anyone contained "(any letter)drago". This was because Ardour Manifestation checked for ".drago" which allowed anyone with drago at the start of their name to spawn but not drago with a letter before it. *It would take roughly 300-400 cannonball shots to kill a Dread Serpent. At Power 20 the amount is reduced to roughly 15-30 cannonball shots depending on PvE damage. *This is the preferred boss to fight if you are trying to obtain the [[Talent Quests|Echo Talent: Chain of Perfection]], as he can mostly be cheesed by staying behind his back. However, be careful because when the Dread Serpent comes out of the water it might hit you so be sure to dodge. *It has infinite-aggro, meaning if it gets flung away, it will still endlessly target you and attempt to reach you, even in [[Dimensional Travel]]. *Formerly summonable via Dimensional Travel anywhere due to leaving the Interstice putting you in a brief state of being considered in the Voidsea. The Dread Serpent would spawn wherever you returned to the overworld at. *The new Dread Serpent model was accidentally spawned during the Verse 3 Deepwoken Direct, closely resembling the art in it's Bestiary. File:DeepwokenNewDreadSerpentModel.png DeepwokenDirectNewDreadSerpentModel.png|Dread Serpent during the Verse 3 Deepwoken Direct. {{History}} {{Nav|Bosses}} {{Nav|Monsters|2}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Bosses]]

== Description ==
Drefa is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

When interacted with, they request 6 wood in order to keep the fires lit. In exchange, [[the Pathfinder]] gains 5 Notes and increased [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]]. They also give the Pathfinder a free [[Lumber Axe]] if they do not have one.

Their counterpart in [[Etris]] is [[Korin]].

==Location==
Drefa is located on the [[Isle of Vigils]]. They are standing beside a log next to the [[Banker]] and [[Antiquarian]] of the isle.

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Player has a Lumber Axe=

{{!}}-

{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Not enough wood]
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm having problems with my treefelling.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Thanks for the help.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Uh.. it seems like you don't have much on you. Come back with more wood and we can see about payment.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Uh huh. That so? What's the problem? Axe too dull?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], Lose 6 Wood, Gained 5 Notes, Gained slight reputation with Etrea

{{!}}-

{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}

{{!}}-

{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}*''The lumberjack's face of utter dumbfound bewilderment strikes you with inspiration. It's all about ''how'' you punch them! You reckon '''5''' more trees punched down would be sufficient research.''*

{{IronVowEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Defeat any true King while sustaining no damage|author=Drifter obtainment hint}} {{Memento |image=Drifter Memento.png |description=The world moves. They move faster. No one saw the moment they decided it was over. |final attributes=*150 Medium Weapon *100 Strength *20 Fortitude *150 Agility *50 Willpower *25 Charisma |final traits= *1 Vitality *6 Dexterity *7 Songchant *3 Erudition *8 Proficiency |locked armor=[[Unsung]] |allowed weapons=Sword |starting weapons=[[Purple Cloud]] |unlock=Defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard]], [[Dravik, The Rat King]], or [[True Heart of Enmity]] without taking any damage (self damage does not count) |starting attributes=*8 Medium Weapon *5 Strength *1 Fortitude *8 Agility *3 Willpower *2 Charisma|starting traits=*-6 Vitality *2 Dexterity *3 Songchant *1 Erudition *5 Proficiency}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. It is unlocked by defeating any of the three main progression bosses without taking any damage. Fall damage, chip damage, and self-damaging abilities, such as Rush Hour and Flame Within, do not count towards taking damage. This Memento changes the user's eyes to a light purple. ==Unique Features== Gain a dodge instead of a parry, coming out later than a parry but gaining the ability to parry '''Unparriable''' indicators. After defeating the [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)|Shogun Captain]], gain the ability to have a swift teleporting dash at the cost of ether. After killing [[Dravik, The Rat King]] the ability to unsheathe your '''Purple Cloud'''. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Drift}} [Memento Talent] - You're no longer slow enough to have to rely on parries. Dodge instead. **Replaces your parry with a fast dodge that can dodge unparryable attacks, at the cost of no parry stun. You still need to be hit by something for the dodge to occur. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Lackluster Guard}} [Memento Talent] - You aren't used to having to block, resulting in weaker posture.
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Precision Hitter [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your Basic Attack posture damage is increased by 15%. *Swift Rebound [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *Underdog [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes. **Underdog's damage to enemies with higher HP than you scales with your Willpower investment. **Underdog grants a 2.5% damage buff at 20 Willpower, this is increased by 0.0375% damage per Willpower above 20, capping at 4% with 60 Willpower. ***Underdog will grant a 2.875% damage bonus at requirements. **"Higher HP" refers to current HP. **"Larger foes" refers to non-humanoid NPCs. (Ex. Megalodaunts, Threshers, Deep Owls) *{{cl|raretlnf|Observation}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately. (+1 Passive Agility) **Cancelling your roll quickly will grant dodge frames equals to the length of a regular roll. Basically giving extra 0.1s dodge frames *{{cl|raretlnf|Speed Demon}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor. **Speed Demon's bleed deals 5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +15% damage over a 0.9 second period. **Works with M1s and criticals. *{{cl|raretlnf|Tap Dancer}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Rolling immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your roll on a longer cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Adrenaline Surge (☆☆☆) |image=Adrenaline Rush.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=An adrenaline rush of mobility. |ethercost={{stats|ether|20 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User activates an inner surge of energy'' *Grants a speed boost for 10/12/14/16/18 seconds per level. *Has a cooldown of 60/55/50/45/40 seconds per level. *Counts as a speed boost, meaning it can proc all speed boost reliant Talents. *The Mantra's visual effect does not increase with level, leading to it being very inaccurate. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Rapid Slashes (☆☆☆) |image=Rapid slashes.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Rush down your opponent cutting them apart. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User teleports to the enemy their cursor is located on and performs numerous slashes.'' *Deals 12+4/14+4.67/16+5.33/18+6/20+6.67 base damage per level with 1.65 Light Weapon scaling. *Deals 10 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.67 seconds. *Upgrading the Mantra increases teleportation range. *Bypasses armor resistances, but the damage can still be resisted with other sources of damage reduction. *Teleports the user to the enemy the cursor is pointed at. }}
===Power 10===
*Disbelief [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You're resistant to the effects of Illusion magic. You are resistant to charms and tricks. (+5 Sanity) **Halves the duration of the Charmed status effect and Illusionary Servant casted against you. ***Tough Love: 2s -> 1s ***Overcharm's Basic Attacks and [[Kyrsieger]] critical attack: 5s -> 2.5s ***Unnecessary Theatrics (at reqs): 7s -> 3.5s ***[[Dread Whisper]] and [[Sing]]: 7.5s -> 3.25s ***Overcharm's self-charm proc: 8s -> 4s ***Charismatic Cast, [[Allure]]: 10s -> 5s ***Chaotic Charm, [[Oath: Fadetrimmer#Hair Spray|Fadetrimmer's Charming Spray]]: 15s -> 7.5s ***Lasting Charisma (at reqs): 20s -> 10s *Padded Armor [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - While your armor is broken (or if you have no armor), you take 5% less damage. (+3% Blunt Armor) *Precise Swing [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - After landing a critical your next basic attack will gain 25% chip past your opponent's block. (+9 Carry Load, +1 Passive Agility) **If your critical lands, is parried, or is blocked, gain the [[Status Effects#Precise Swing|Precise Swing]] status effect for 30 seconds. **The Precise Swing status effect will be consumed if you hit someone's block with an M1, you land an M1, or your M1 gets parried. ***If your M1 is whiffed or dodged, the status effect will not be consumed. **Because this status effect is applied to yourself and not your opponent, you can land your critical on person A and then hit person B's block and still apply the chip damage. **Precise Swing is additive with weapon chip, and having above 100% chip causes you to deal more damage. *Ready or Not [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - The first attack to hit you while out of combat has its damage cut in half. *Steady Nerves [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You dance from toe to toe - successful dodges restore posture. (+7 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility) **Restore 2 flat posture on a successful dodge. *Steel Scales [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You take an additional 5% less damage when your armor is broken. (+3% Slash Armor) *{{cl|raretlnf|Bloodiron Spirit}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - You regain some Armor upon killing enemies. (+5 Health) **Any kill gives you 2.5% of your total armor durability. **Stacks with [[Bloodiron Ring]], totaling in 5% armor per kill. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Prominence Draw (☆☆☆) |image=Prominence draw.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Close the distance and deliver a fast slash. |ethercost={{stats|ether|65 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User locks onto all the closest targets that are in range, then dashes forward and performs a large AoE slice.'' *Deals 9/17/25/33/41 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals '''50% less damage''' if used while your weapon is sheathed or if used on a non-medium weapon. *Deals 5 posture damage. *Has a wind-up of 0.5 seconds with an endlag of 0.2 seconds. *Allows for movestacking an M1 strike which 100% guarantees the Mantra or M1 hit. *Can be modified with Glass Stones and Magnifying Stones to increase it's tracking range. *Having the [[Forgotten Gladius]] or [[Kindred Edict]] equipped will heavily decrease its windup. }} {{MantraInfobox |name=Master's Flourish (☆☆☆) |image=Master flourish.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=A powerful slash that chips through block and slashes through armor. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User performs a spinning double slice with their sword.'' *Deals 3+5.4/6+10.8/9+16.2/12+21.6/15+27 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage per hit (2). *Initial hit has 0.525 wind-up with the follow-up having 0.4s wind-up. *Master's Flourish has 0.35s endlag. *Deals Chip Damage. *Deals knockback. *Can be modified with a Glass/Magnifying stone to make it bigger. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Flashdraw Strike (☆☆☆) |image=Flashdraw Strike.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Switftly unsheathe your blade and deliver an upwards strike. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User readies their blade before performing a swift strike that uppercuts any targets within range and the user into the air.'' *Deals 20/22/24/26/28 base damage with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 12 posture damage. }}
===Power 15===
*Decisive Blow [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Hitting an enemy with your Critical Attack immediately after they dodge now procs Knife's Journey. Your Knife's Journey procs do 2x Armor damage **While the effect is active, gain a red trail on your weapon. The red trail will show up on non-daggers, but will have no effect. **Compatible with Switchblade despite not being a Dagger talent. *Finishing Touch [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - {{ttag|Daggers}} Instantly execute enemies finished with the critical attack of your dagger. **Your critical must knock the opponent for this Talent to proc. *Matador [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Deal +20% more damage to human enemies with hyperarmor. **Doesn't work on Non-Humanoid [[Monsters]]. *{{cl|raretl|Champion's Regalia}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Flourishing an opponent grants you +50% posture damage on Basic Attacks for 10 seconds. (+1 Carry Load) **Indicated by a gold shaded outline on your character. **Does not work on non-humanoid NPCs. **Works only if you successfully hit someone with flourish. Doesn't work on parry, block, dodge hits. *{{cl|raretl|Cheap Shot}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your attacks gain 10% PEN multiplicatively when you have an active speed boost. (+6 Passive Agility) **It multiplies your PEN by 1.1x. IE: if you are at 30% PEN, Cheap Shot will give you an additional 3% PEN. **Cheap Shot cannot bypass the PEN cap. *{{cl|raretl|Defiance}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP. **The Effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement. **Currently, the only things Defiance cuts in half are: ***Flamecharm's burn damage ***Frostdraw's chill duration ***Galebreathe's winded duration ***Galebreathe's suffocation duration ***Frostdraw's crystal stacks ***Thundercall's surge stacks ***Shadowcast's Sightless Still duration ***Blood Poisoning ***Wither gain ***Ring of Pestillence duration ***The potency of potions ***Time Unconscious (cut by 50% multiplicatively after other modifiers) *{{cl|raretl|Evasive Expert}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretl|Knife's Journey}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - {{ttag|Daggers}} Cancelling an enemy's Mantra windup with your Basic Attacks now deals 15% more damage **Displays a red particle on the target enemy after proccing. *{{cl|raretl|Perfect Flash}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away. **Poser's ring won't count towards the health threshold until sheathed, maintaining the bonus even after being "damaged". {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Twincleave (☆☆☆) |image=Twin Strike.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Dart around the battlefield with devastating cleaves delivered in quick succession. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''User unleashes 2 slashes, the first moving them forward, the second launching them backwards.'' *Deals 9+18.75/10.2+21.25/11.4+23.75/12.6+26.25/13.8+28.25 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 6.75 posture damage per hit (2). *Initial hit has a wind-up of 0.5s, with the follow-up attack having a 0.4s wind-up. *Twincleave has an endlag of 0.4s. *Can change the direction you launch backwards by turning your camera. }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Blinkstep}} [Memento Talent] - Your regular dash is enhanced into a Blinkstep above 90% ether but now has an ether cost. **Replaces your dash with a longer and faster dash that costs some ether. **Cannot be used if your Ether is below 90%. Having the True Drifter Talent will remove this requirement, assuming you have stacks of Cutting Pace. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Faster Blade}} [Memento Talent] - A successful "Drift" now grants a speed boost **Procs when "parrying" an attack. ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Cutting Pace}} [Memento Talent] - Dodging attacks will now grant 'Cutting Pace' stacks. Mantras and basic attacks consume a stack to shorten wind-up and increase damage, procs after dash. **Buffed attacks deal 15% more damage, have a slightly shorter windup, and are recolored to a purple. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Drifting Cloud}} [Memento Talent] - Cutting Pace now unsheathes the full potential of your [[Purple Cloud]]. **Upon proccing Cutting Pace, unsheathe your Purple Cloud. **This changes Purple Cloud's stats, animations, and damage type to Slash. Additionally Purple Cloud gains a unique swing trail. **The unsheathed Purple Cloud stays until you leave the game. ===True Heart of Emnity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Twin Drift}} [Memento Talent] - Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will bring upon twins who will follow up your assault. **Similarly to {{t|Spine Cutter}}, performing a basic attack after a roll cancel will perform a second slash, then two light purple clones of yourself will attack the target. *{{cl|mementotlnf|True Drifter}} [Memento Talent] - You are a true drifter. Gain double the 'Cutting Pace' stacks and consume stacks to Blinkstep below 90% ether. **Gain double the stacks whenever you proc Cutting Pace. Additionally, you can now Blinkstep when below 90% Ether by consuming a Cutting Pace stack. *Down Comes the Claw [Common Talent] - Landing a Critical while you have a speed boost prevents your opponent from being able to dodge twice in a row for 5s. (+1 Passive Agility) **Down Comes the Claw cannot be reapplied while it's currently active. **Lasts 6.5 seconds. *Maiming Claws [Common Talent] - Down Comes the Claw now disables your opponent's posture regeneration for 6s on proc. (+1 Passive Agility) **Applies to passive posture regeneration, Steady Nerves, and posture restoration from parrying. All other sources of posture restoration ignore Maiming Claws entirely. **Cannot be reapplied while Down Comes the Claw is currently active. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Exhaustion Strike (☆☆☆) |image=Exhaustion strike.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=A melee strike that removes your posture's damage on hit. |ethercost={{stats|ether|80 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''User pulls their arm back and then transfers their posture damage to their opponent.'' *Has a base damage of 20/22/24/26/28 damage per level with 1.65 Willpower scaling. *Transfers 20%/30%/40%/50%/60% of your current posture per level. *The posture transfer cannot guardbreak. *Has 0.5s wind-up with 0.3s of endlag. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Slice 'n' Dice (☆☆☆) |image=Slice 'n' Dice.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Step forward and slice through your enemies. Ability can be activated again on a successful hit. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''User dashes towards the camera and unleashes a wide slash. Can be performed again if the first slash lands.'' *Deals 19.1/24.2/29.3/34.4/39.5 base damage per hit with 1.3 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 16 posture damage and is 360 blockable. *Has a 25 second cooldown. *Has a 0.55s wind-up. *Landing the first slash refreshes the Mantra, allowing it to be used again at any time. **If used again within 15 seconds, the Mantra will go on cooldown. *Even if blocked, the cooldown of this Mantra will still reset. This is incredibly useful for block pressure. *Due to it being aimed with the camera, it can be a very useful tool for aerial mobility. *Does not register hits until the end of the move's animation, meaning you can phase through opponents without damaging them if used at close range. **Because of this, it is recommended to use this Mantra after uppercuts or while looking at the floor to land it in CQC. }}

title: Drill Sergeant Kernel
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{NPCInfobox |name=Cornelius Kernel Sr. |alias=*Drill Sergeant
*Interceptor{{Ref/NPC|Sentinel Augustus|quote=In fact, he inspired me to join the Shock Corps - his official rank is technically Interceptor. But with the structure of our military, he trains the recruits until they're placed in a division, after which the division leaders take over training and command.}} |aspect=Celtor |pronouns=He/him |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]] |family=[[Private Kernel]] (son)While Private Kernel is never explicitly stated to be Drill Sergeant Kernel's son, the fact they are the only Celtor with the surname "Kernel" found within Fort Merit all but confirms the private is Cornelius Kernel Jr. |location=[[Fort Merit]] |image1=Drill Sergeant Kernel.png}} ==Description== Drill Sergeant Kernel is a [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is the mentor for the freshly arrived [[Authority Ensign]]s in the east. His official rank is technically Interceptor, but with the structure of the Authority's military, he trains recruits until they're placed in a division, after which the division leaders take over training and command. His son, [[Private Kernel]], is also a member of [[the Central Authority]]'s eastern garrison. ==Location== Drill Sergeant Kernel is located on the training grounds at [[Fort Merit]]. Drill Sergeant Kernel Map.png ==Dialogue== |-|Authority Ensign= {{#tag:tabber|No Division= {{#tag:tabber|Private / Corporal= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The imposing, armoured Celtorian man looks down at you.*'' What do we have HERE? ''YOU'' must be one of the ROOKIES. High Command TOLD us we'd be getting new recruits, but you look a little {{sh|SCRAWNY}}, soldier! What is your {{sh|FULL NAME AND RANK}}, SOLDIER? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm [Rank] [Player's First and Last Name], sir!
[Player Salutes] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute the man with gusto.*'' I am not '''SIR'''! I '''WORK''' for a living! I am '''DRILL SERGEANT CORNELIUS KENERL SENIOR'''! To you, I'm '''SARGE''' or '''SERGEANT'''! Furthermore, say your name and rank with your {{sh|CHEST}}, soldier! You're now an ENSIGN in the CENTRAL AUTHORITY MILITARY! I bet your family's {{sh|REAL DAMN PROUD}}!! Now, I will give you a RUN DOWN of the way things '''WORK''' here! Until you are assigned to a DIVISION, you will be in ''MY'' world! Have I {{sh|MADE MYSELF CLEAR}}, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}YES, SARGE! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}OUT{{sh|STANDING}}, SOLDIER! That is what I like to '''SEE'''! Maybe High Command ''DID NOT'' assign us a ragtag band of ''MINDLESS ROOKIES'' after all! Now, allow me to give you a '''CRASH COURSE''' on your DUTIES HERE! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I am LISTENING, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}As a MEMBER of the AUTHORITY, your main task will be to '''COMPLETE MISSIONS''' assigned to you by '''CAPTAIN TRIST'''! He will be your ''MAIN'' point of contact for all of your '''ASSIGNMENTS''', and you will learn to {{sh|LOVE}} and {{sh|RESPECT}} him! ''UNLESS'' you are out on the field on an '''ASSIGNED MISSION''', you may '''NOT''' take leave of AUTHORITY-CONTROLLED TERRITORY for longer than '''FIFTEEN MINUTES''', until you are '''ASSIGNED TO A DIVISION'''! Do you {{sh|COPY THAT}}, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}COPY THAT, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}If you are '''AWAY FOR LONGER''' than fifteen minutes, you will be declared '''AWOL''' and be '''BRANDED A DESERTER'''! You will automatically become '''AN ENEMY OF THE AUTHORITY! And if you {{sh|SHOW YOURSELF}} here ''AFTER'' that, may all the gods have {{sh|MERCY}} on your ''SOUL'', for I will have {{sh|NONE}}! You better ''REMEMBER'' that, soldier! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I WILL, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}You may '''AVOID''' going '''AWOL''' in ''MULTIPLE'' ways! For example, you may already know soldiers can '''FORM SQUADS'''! If you '''JOIN A SQUAD''' under an '''OFFICER'S''' command, you may accompany them on '''INDEPENDENT MISSIONS'''! Or, once you are '''ASSIGNED TO A DIVISION''', you may '''FEEL FREE''' to hustle off your ''SCRAWNY BEHIND'' '''OUTSIDE''' of {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} territory, to engage in '''INDEPENDENT OPERATIONS''' at your own discretion! Are you {{sh|WITH ME}} so far? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}AFFIRMATIVE, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}When you '''COMPLETE ASSIGNMENTS''', you earn '''RANK POINTS'''! Once you earn a certain amount, you earn a '''PROMOTION''', having proven you're ''NOT AS SCRAWNY'' as you look! You start your service as a '''PRIVATE'''! There are '''THREE''' ranks you must progress through before you are eligible to enter a '''DIVISION''' - '''PRIVATE, CORPORAL''', and '''LANCE CORPORAL'''! Are we {{sh|CLEAR}} on this matter, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}UNDERSTOOD, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Once you become a '''LANCE CORPORAL''', you may choose to '''ENLIST WITH A DIVISION''' if you '''MEET''' their requirements! This is assessed according to your '''PERFORMANCE ON THE FIELD'''! You may '''ENLIST''' on a division by '''TELLING''' the respective '''DIVISION LEADERS''' you want to '''JOIN''' their ranks! Show them their {{sh|DUE RESPECT}}, soldier or I will {{sh|SHOW YOU MY BOOT}}! Now, listen ''CLOSELY'' to this next part, scrawny! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm ALL EARS, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The '''SHOCK CORPS''' division is led by '''SENTINEL AUGUSTUS BAASET''', the '''INQUISITION''' is led by '''HIGH INQUISITOR MEREY SCARSEN''', and the '''COMMAND''' division is led by the mighty '''WARDEN JERICHO''', who is our {{sh|SUPREME COMMANDER}} in this godforsaken region! Once you '''ENLIST''' with one of them, '''THEY''' will be '''OVERSEEING''' your '''FURTHER DUTIES'''! You better be {{sh|PAYING ATTENTION}}, soldier, or so help me Gods! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm PAYING ATTENTION, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The divisions have '''THEIR OWN RANKS'''! The hierarchy for the '''INQUISITION''' is ''INQUISITOR, INQUISITOR 1ST CLASS'', and '''HANDLER'''. For the '''SHOCK CORPS''', it's ''FRONTLINER, INTERCEPTOR'', and '''OPERATOR'''! And for the '''COMMAND''' division, there's {{sh|FOUR}} - ''WARRANT OFFICER, CAPTAIN, COMMANDER'', and '''SENESCHAL'''! Did you hear the EXCEPTION, {{sh|SOLDIER}}? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}LOUD AND CLEAR, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Once you are at the '''HIGHEST DIVISION RANK''', your division leaders may have '''INTERESTING THINGS''' to tell you! It is '''EASIER''' to confide occupational intricacies to your '''TOP RANKIG''' SUBORDINATES! What is {{sh|NOT}} easy, soldier, is to teach ''FRESH ROOKIES'' like {{sh|YOU}}! I hope you've ''MEMORISED'' all that! LET ME HEAR AN {{sh|OORAH}}, SOLDIER!!! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}OORAH, SARGE!!!
[Player Salutes] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Overwhelmed with a patriotic vigour burning in your heart, you salute the Drill Sergeant with all your might.*'' OUT{{sh|STANDING}}, SOLDIER! From now on, you will be known as ''' ''Private [Random Name]'' '''! If your muddled tiny mind '''FORGETS''' any of this information, you may feel free to ask me '''AGAIN'''! Now, {{sh|DISAPPEAR}}, worm! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="16" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="16" {{!}}''*You salute the Drill Sergeant.*'' '''AT EASE''', [Rank] [Ensign Name]! Did you come here to ''TRAIN'' with your comrades, or are you here to '''ASK''' me something, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I wanted to ASK about the ORDER OF THINGS again, SARGE! {{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I came to TRAIN, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}Looks like I was right about your ''TINY MUDDLED MIND'' getting all {{sh|SCRAMBLED}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! But I believe {{sh|REPETITION}} is the mother of '''LEARNING'''! You have my '''PERMISSION''' to '''ASK AWAY''', WORM! {{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}Then {{sh|GO AHEAD}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! You have {{sh|MY PERSONAL PERMISSION}} to beat the {{sh|SNOT}} out of each other! {{sh|MAKE ME PROUD}}!!! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like to hear about MISSIONS again, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like to hear about GOING AWOL again, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like to hear about RANKING UP again, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like to hear about DIVISIONS again, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|LISTEN UP}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! Your main task is to '''COMPLETE MISSIONS''' assigned to you by '''CAPTAIN TRIST'''! He is your ''MAIN'' point of contact for all of your '''ASSIGNMENTS''' - {{sh|LOVE}}} him and {{sh|RESPECT}} him! Did you {{sh|GET ALL THAT}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|PAY ATTENTION}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! ''UNLESS'' you are out on the field on an '''ASSIGNED MISSION''', you may '''NOT''' take leave of AUTHORITY-CONTROLLED TERRITORY for longer than '''FIFTEEN MINUTES''', until you are '''ASSIGNED TO A DIVISION'''! If you '''BREACH''' this rule, you will be declared '''AWOL''' and be '''BRANDED A DESERTER'''! You will become '''AN ENEMY OF THE AUTHORITY'''! And if you {{sh|SHOW YOURSELF}} here ''AFTER'' that, may all the gods have {{sh|MERCY}} on your ''SOUL'', for I will have {{sh|NONE}}! {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}You better be {{sh|ALL EARS}} this time, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! When you '''COMPLETE ASSIGNMENTS''', you earn '''RANK POINTS'''! Once you earn a certain amount, you earn a '''PROMOTON''', having proven you're ''NOT AS SCRAWNY'' as you look! You start your service as a '''PRIVATE'''! There are '''THREE''' ranks you must progress through before you are eligible to enter a '''DIVISION''' - '''PRIVATE''', '''CORPORAL''', and '''LANCE CORPORAL'''! Are we {{sh|CLEAR}} on this matter, [Rank] [Ensign Name]? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}{{sh|LISTEN WELL}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! The '''SHOCK CORPS''' division is led by '''SENTINEL AUGUSTUS BAASET''', the '''INQUISITION''' is led by '''HIGH INQUISITOR MEREY SCARSEN''', and the '''COMMAND''' division is led by the mighty '''WARDEN JERICHO''', who is our {{sh|SUPREME COMMANDER}} in this godforsaken region! Once you '''ENLIST''' with on of them, '''THEY''' will be '''OVERSEEING''' your '''FURTHER DUTIES'''! You better be {{sh|PAYING ATTENTION}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name], or so help me Gods! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}YES, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}CONTINUE, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}OF COURSE, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'M LISTENING, sergeant! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Out{{sh|STANDING}}! You best keep that information '''SAFE''' in that ''TINY MUDDLED MIND'' of yours, {{sh|[Rank] [Ensign Name}}! Do you have '''ANY OTHER questions, worm? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}You may '''AVOID''' going '''AWOL''' in ''MULTIPLE'' way! As you already know, soldiers can '''FORM SQUADS'''! If you '''JOIN A SQUAD''' under an '''OFFICER'S''' command, you may accompany them on '''INDEPENDENT MISSIONS'''! Or, once you are '''ASSIGNED TO A DIVISION''', you may '''FEEL FREE''' to hustle off your ''SCRAWNY BEHIND'' '''OUTSIDE''' of {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} territory, to engage in '''INDEPENDENT OPERATIONS''' at your own discretion! Did you {{sh|GET ALL THAT}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Once you become a '''LANCE CORPORAL''', you may choose to '''ENLIST WITH A DIVISION''' if you '''MEET''' their requirements! This is assessed according to your '''PERFORMANCE ON THE FIELD'''! You may '''ENLIST''' on a division by '''TELLING''' the respective '''DIVISION LEADERS''' you want to '''JOIN''' their ranks! Show them their {{sh|DUE RESPECT}}, soldier, or I will {{sh|SHOW YOU MY BOOT}}! Did you {{sh|GET ALL THAT}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The divisions have '''THEIR OWN RANKS'''! The hierarchy for the '''INQUISITION''' is ''INQUISITOR'', ''INQUISITOR 1ST CLASS'', and '''HANDLER'''. For the '''SHOCK CORPS''', it's ''FRONTLINER'', ''INTERCEPTOR'', and '''OPERATOR'''! And for the Command division, there's {{sh|FOUR}} - ''WARRANT OFFICER'', ''CAPTAIN'', ''COMMANDER'', and '''SENESCHAL'''! Note the EXCEPTION, {{sh|SOLDIER}}! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See "I wanted to ASK about the ORDER OF THINGS again, SARGE!"] {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}That's ALL, THANK you, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}YES, sergeant! {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}EXCEPTION NOTED, sergeant! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}That's {{sh|EXCELLENT}}, [Rank] [Ensign Name]! You are hereby '''DISMISSED'''! '''{{sh|DISAPPEAR}}''', worm! {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See previous instance] {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Once you are the '''HIGHEST DIVISION RANK''', your division leaders may have '''INTERESTING THINGS''' to tell you! It is '''EASIER''' to confide occupational intricacies to your '''TOP RANKING''' SUBORDINATES! What is {{sh|NOT}} easy, soldier, is repeating things! I've already explain to ''SIEVE-BRAINS'' like {{sh|YOU}}! I hope you've ''MEMORISED'' all of that this time! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}YES, sergeant! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See previous instance] }} {{!}}-{{!}}Lance Corporal= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*You salute the Drill Sergeant.*'' '''AT EASE''', Lance Corporal [Ensign Name]! I scarce believe it MYSELF, but your rank means you're due for a '''PROMOTION''' soon! You better have done '''WELL''' on your '''FIELD MISSIONS''', soldier, or your desire division may be {{sh|OUT OF REACH}}! Now, have you got any {{sh|QUESTIONS}}? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I wanted to KNOW where the DIVISION LEADERS are, sarge! {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I wanted to ASK about the ORDER OF THINGS again, SARGE! {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I came to TRAIN, sarge! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}{{sh|LISTEN WELL}} then, worm! '''WARDEN JERICHO, who leads the COMMAND''' division, is usually in the '''WAR ROOM''' at the top of the fortress! == Overview ==
Duke Erisia's Laboratory consists of a small interlude hall where you fight [[Golem Prime]]s and [[Mindless Servant]]s, and the arena where the player fights [[Duke Ishamon Erisia]]. You can enter this area by going through [[Duke Erisia's Manor]] and descending down through the elevator.

When entering the arena section, you will see the Duke himself and several tubes with [[Mindless Servant]]s in them.
==Notes==
* The first room is obligated to do, you must kill many Mindless Servants and two Prime Golems to advance to the other rooms
* You can skip all rooms except the first to go directly to the Duke Erisia

|caption=What was stolen from below lies within.
}}
[[File:DukeManor.png|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
'''Duke Erisia's Manor''' is a landmark found in [[The Garden Reservoir]]. Its exterior consists of patches of grass on the corner of the paths with some tall bushes, stone pillars, a distinct tall tree in the center and a blocked gate preceded by a massive bridge that leads to the [[Burning Stone Gardens]] where plentiful of [[Rock Golem]]s reside. In order to open the gate, you, or one of your allies must have a [[Manor Key]].

==Potential Enemies==
<gallery>
File:BrainsuckerIcon.png|[[Brainsucker]]
File:Mindless Servant.png|[[Mindless Servant]]
</gallery>

==Maps==
A map can be found at [[Maps#Surface]]

==Gallery==
<gallery widths=500>
File:DukeManorInside.png|Duke Erisia's Manor on the inside.
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The music for this area is [[Of Labours, Veiled]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]
*If the key to the manor is not glowing, it means that someone else already initiated a raid and as such the area is locked away until a certain amount of time passes. Either wait that timeframe out or switch servers to progress. 
*If the gate is stuck/gate doesn't close despite all mobs being dead, and no one has travelled down, you can climb on top of the door to open it. There is an interactable button to close the gate and reset the dungeon.
*The [[Brainsucker]]'s within the manor are not allied with other [[Monsters]].

==Description==
The '''Duke Erisia Plushie''' was a plushie released as part of a Deepwoken and Makeship collaboration. Classified under the "Plushie" category, it resembled the [[Duke Ishamon Erisia]]. I can't stop now.|author=Duke Ishamon Erisia}} {{EnemyInfobox |drops=*Chest (see [[#Rewards|loot table]]) *[[Duke's Coat Fiber]] *[[Kanabo]] *[[Ardour Manifestation]] *[[Pluripotent Alloy]] *[[Stoneheart]] *[[Smith's Alloy]] *[[Armorer's Needle]] *[[Curved Blade of Winds]] *[[Sinner's Ash]] *[[Idol of Yun'Shul]] *[[Whistling Periapt]] *[[Gale Stone]] |weapon=*[[Iron Cestus]] ([[Untrained Fist]]) |moves=*Assault *Critical *Counter *Feint *Binding Tempest *Gale Stomp *Cyclone Bomb *Strong Left *Summon [[Mindless Servant]]s |image1=Theduke.png |health=15000 per player 5000-10000 (Shield) per player |aspect=Celtor |affiliation= |pronouns=He/him |challenges={{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} |title1=Duke Ishamon Erisia}} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Duke Ishamon Erisia''' is a [[Bosses|Boss]] the player fights during [[Etris#The Lord Regent's Quest|"Duke of Sin" quest]] and is located in [[Duke Erisia's Laboratory]] within [[Duke Erisia's Manor]]. Likewise with all Bosses, defeating him will uncap your [[Attributes#Weapon_Attributes|Weapon]] and [[Attributes#Attunement_Attributes|Attunement Attributes]] given you have them at their capped maximum. Defeating him will also allow [[Galebreathe]] users to unlock the [[Pillars of Erisia]] Mantra in a Whisper hand, which is a modified version of his Gale Stomp. He is a noble who resided in the City of [[Lost Celtor|Celtor]] before its submergence and part of a lineage that ruled the island of [[Erisia]]. In appearance, Duke Erisia is a Marten [[Celtor]]. He wears a Slate [[Aristocrat Coat]] over the [[Eager Tradesman]] starter outfit with [[Eyeglasses]]. He also has a green [[Resonance]] by his side that allows him to create and control [[Rock Golem]]s. Duke Erisia can also use his Resonance to summon Golem arms that swing alongside his fists, and he wields extremely powerful, exclusive [[Galebreathe]] [[Mantras]]. ==Moveset== Duke Ishamon Erisia's arsenal consists of utilizing his [[Resonance]] and [[Galebreathe]]. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Strong Left'''
(★★☆) |Duke Erisia will charge up a punch, and teleport to his target, *Duke Erisia will '''only''' use any of his 3 Golem arm attacks after using '''Strong Left'''. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, teleport, ragdoll |type2_color = darkorange }} |[[File:Duke's Strong Left.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |

(★★☆) |The Duke conjures a Golem arm, rushing forward with wind and unleashing a punch. *Duke Erisia will '''only''' use this after using '''Strong Left'''. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Stonelife Sweep'''
(★★☆) |The Duke conjures a Golem arm, performing a right hook. *Duke Erisia will '''only''' use this after using '''Strong Left'''. {{AttackTags |indicator = block |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, crouch |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |

(★☆☆) |The Duke rises into the air before kicking three gusts of wind towards the target. {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, jump }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |

Any attacks against the shield during this time will be reflected back to the attacker- dealing significant damage and ragdolling them backwards. *He laughs afterward when something strikes his counter. *No range limit, damage is always induced if the counter is hit. *Can deflect [[Providence's Thorns]]. *Only used once the posture shield is down. After the attack lands, Duke Ishamon Erisia teleports in front of the first person hit, containing them in the ball of air before launching them up from the ground and punching them away. *Telegraphed by the lack of sound while rising and longer cast time, compared to Aero Spear. *Will daze targets if they hit a wall while ragdolled. *Projectiles have good tracking but have a limited turn angle, possibly delaying the hit if it orbits around you. *If evaded for long enough and then you get hit by them, the Duke will not teleport nor deal any damage. *Block breaking duke while he is rising into the air cancels it. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, teleport, ragdoll, grab, autogrip }} |[[File:Duke's Binding Tempest.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |

(★★☆) |Duke Erisia flies into the air and shoots a singular decently sized Wind Lance at whoever he's provoked/aggroed on to. *Telegraphed by an audio cue while rising and quick cast compared to '''Binding Tempest'''. {{AttackTags |indicator = guardbreak |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, ragdoll, autogrip }} |[[File:Aero Spear.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Gale Stomp'''
(★★★) |Duke Erisia stomps the ground, conjuring a wave of wind up from the ground towards his victim in his line of direction. *Will daze targets if they hit a wall while ragdolled. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll, autogrip |type2_color = darkorange }} |[[File:Gale stomp.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Cyclone Bomb'''
(★★☆) |Duke Erisia flies into the air, raising his hands above him to conjure a huge ball of wind before throwing it down. *Covers a large Area of Effect. *More often to happen if Duke takes major damage quickly. *Duke will usually use this move after he drops below half HP {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip }} |[[File:Cyclone bomb duke.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Mindless Servants'''
(★☆☆)
|Duke Erisia snaps his fingers, summoning [[Mindless Servant]]s from the pods around the boss room. *Mindless Servants are essentially health-packs and serve no real threat. *If fought solo, they may become a threat as they will combo you while fighting Ishamon if not killed fast enough. *There are ten pods in the room, and thus a maximum of ten Servants that can be summoned in a fight. Generally, he will summon three batches of three before summoning a lone Servant. *Only used once the posture shield is down. (Phase 2) {{AttackTags |summon }} |[[File:Duke's Mindless servents.gif|centre|thumb]] |} ===Passives=== *Guardbreak Resist - Duke Ishamon Erisia is immune to instant guard break effects. A unique white deflection visual and sound effect will play over his guard when this effect procs. *Hefty Stature - Duke Ishamon Erisia will instantly be dropped if the player attempts to carry his knocked body. This will not reset his knock timer. ===Talents=== *{{cl|raretlnf|Impervious Slumber}} - Hitting Duke Ishamon Erisia while knocked won't reset his time knocked. He cannot be carried as well. *Breathing Impact - When knocked into objects by wind mantras you will take additional blunt damage based off of how hard you are hit. *After Cut - If an attack is physical and wind it will apply an after cut that does 10% of the damage dealt to you again. If an attack was a Mantra, it does 5% damage instead. *Suffocating Impact - When flourished into walls by Duke Ishamon Erisia, you are suffocated and winded for a short duration. *{{cl|raretlnf|Stifled Jump}} - Those who jump while suffocated by Duke Ishamon Erisia will be dazed. *Air Pressure - When Duke Ishamon Erisia dodges an attack or hits your block his next dash will be a Gale Dash. *Pressure Break - When Duke Ishamon Erisia breaks your posture, you will take intense wind pressure damage and be flung backwards. *{{cl|raretlnf|Silencer's Blade}} - If Duke Ishamon Erisia melees you while you are 'Suffocated' it will extend the duration of the Suffocation. He will also gain a speed boost. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Collapsed Lung}} - When block broken by Duke Ishamon Erisia you are unable to Vent for 8s. *{{cl|raretlnf|Dirty Boxing}} - If Duke Ishamon Erisia hits you after feinting you with his fist, you will suffer slight bleed and have your vision obscured slightly. *{{cl|raretlnf|Concussion}} - When Duke Ishamon Erisia flourishes you into walls you will have your vision altered for a short duration and will be dazed longer than usual. *Concussive Force - Enemies knocked by Duke Ishamon Erisia will remain downed longer than usual. *{{cl|raretlnf|Bulldozer}} - If flourished into a wall by Duke Ishamon Erisia, you have a chance to break the wall and be guard broken on impact. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Million Ton Piercer}} - Duke Ishamon Erisia has 5% extra PEN and has no PEN cap. *Shield Breaker - Blunt damage from Duke Ishamon Erisia now deals full posture damage to shields (essentially your shield is useless for blocking). *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Audacity}} - When Duke Ishamon Erisia starts manually gripping you, he will create an AoE stun around him and slow people around him. It will also make him ignore Defiant Until the End and Last Second Negotiation. *Matador - Duke Ishamon Erisia deals +20% more damage to human enemies with hyperarmor. *{{cl|raretlnf|Showstopper}} - When you roll through one of Duke Ishamon Erisia's physical attacks, he will stomp the ground, negating your speed boosts and dazing everyone nearby. *Brassneck - When Duke Ishamon Erisia knocks an enemy, he gains 20% damage resistance for 15 seconds. *Charged Return - Being under an elemental status effect causes Duke's M1's and critical attacks to do 20% more damage. ==Finisher== Duke Ishamon Erisia executes his opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |'''Wind Collapse''' |Getting hit by any of his wind moves while you're low will cause you to die instantly. |- |'''Execute''' |Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} ==Combat== ---- === Duke Erisia: Combat Strategy === ==== General Combat & Offense ==== It's crucial to understand the Duke's behavior during his initial phase, where he is at his most aggressive and poses a significant threat, especially to solo players. Avoid attempting to use a '''Venting''' ability while his shield is active, as he will parry it. If the Duke is standing still, he is preparing to cast a mantra. This provides a brief window for you to land up to three safe hits with a heavy or medium weapon. After this, you should stop attacking and brace for his move, as his mantras have a low wind-up (especially his Strong Left) and are difficult to read. He usually uses 3 of his regular mantras, uses '''Strong Left''', then uses 3* of his Stonelife attacks, after which the cycle repeats. He '''can''' use '''Strong Left''' more than once at a time, sometimes even up to 3 times in a row, before his Stonelife attacks begin. Once you have dealt enough damage, his shield will deactivate. While this allows you to hit him normally, you must remain cautious, as many of his mantras can instantly grip you. The best strategy is to corner him and focus on breaking his posture. Be aware, however, that the Duke has a high '''Tempo''' and will vent every time you flourish him into a wall. ==== Survivability & Special Abilities ==== The appearance of his servants signals that you are close to victory, as you can use them to regenerate to full health. Maintain pressure by keeping him cornered and attacking relentlessly until he is defeated. For enchanted weapons, '''[[Vampirism]]''' is the most recommended option, as it allows you to heal off the Duke in the second phase. This is particularly useful if he doesn't summon his servants, which can happen. Alternatively, you can opt for high-damage enchants like '''Detonation''' or '''Astral''', but Vampirism provides a much safer approach. While Duke Erisia is immune to instant guardbreaks, his posture pool is relatively low. In the second phase, the Duke becomes very defensive and blocks frequently. The '''[[Enforcer's Axe]]''' and '''[[Enforcer's Hammer]]''' are excellent choices for heavy weapons, as they can quickly break through his posture. File:Duke grips his friends.gif|An example of baiting Gale Stomp, an autogripping attack File:Duke health bar.png|Duke Erisia's Health Bar. He does not have a separate one for his shield, his bar doesn't go down until his shield is broken
===Phases=== Phases begin in sequence, depending on the Bosses' Max HP. *'''Phase 1 -''' '''Tempest Shield''': Upon initiating the fight, Duke Erisia surrounds himself with a shield of Galebreathe, instantly parrying all attacks and Mantras. To destroy the shield, land attacks until it breaks. Focuses on '''damage''' ''. (15k per player)'' *'''Phase 2 -''' '''Hand-to-hand combat''': Duke Erisia's shield vanishes, and he will let himself get hit for a while before fighting back. During this phase, he may snap his fingers, teleporting the Mindless Servants from their tubes to all nearby Players (Teleports 3 servants per player, and the remainder of them when there's less than 3 x n servants, where n = present players (distributed equally amongst the fighters)). ===Rewards=== Upon defeating Duke Ishamon Erisia, you are rewarded a colossal sized chest that contains: *Rare Items & Equipment *[[Duke's Coat Fiber]], a crafting material for equipment. *Relics ([[Idol of Yun'Shul]], [[Smith's Alloy]], [[Sinner's Ash]], [[Armorer's Needle]]) *[[Weapons|Rare Weapons]] *[[Attributes Unbound|Attunement Uncap]] (If the requirements are met.) *[[Attributes Unbound|Weapon Uncap]] (If the requirements are met.) *The ability to obtain the [[Pillars of Erisia]] Mantra in a Whisper hand with sufficient Galebreathe. *[[Resonance]] (Bell) progression. **It will take around 6 Dukes with Max Resonance Progression Echo to unlock Resonance with either the boss path or the [[Regalia]] and around 9-10 without the boss path or the Regalia

[[File:Duke_Contractor.mp3]] |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], fight starts |} ==Gallery== File:The Duke better.png|Duke Erisia File:Duke erisia before the fight.png|A wider look at Duke Erisia's room before the fight File:DukeErisiaHaunted.png|Statuette in [https://www.roblox.com/games/82695214392018/The-Haunt The Haunt] hub === Merchandise === File:Duke Erisia Plushie 1.png|Duke Erisia Plushie File:Duke Erisia Plushie 2.png File:Duke Erisia Plushie 3.png File:Duke Erisia Plushie 4.png File:Duke Erisia Plushie 5.png ==Trivia== *The music for his bossfight is [[Sin-Smelted Scoriae]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]. **Naktigonis also provides the voice of Duke Ishamon Erisia, first heard in [https://x.com/naktigonis/status/1509956038598053895?s=20 an April Fools Twitter post] posted by Naktigonis, joking about ''Sin-Smelted Scoriae's'' release. *Duke Erisia gives the third best "monster" bell progression, with 1st and 2nd being [[Scion of Ethiron]] and [[Primadon]] respectively. *Initially, it was unclear if he was escaping The Depths each time he was refought. Arch_Mage thus made unique dialogue for his rematches, but due to a bug, these were not implemented until 8/7/23.[citation needed] The current dialogue states "The ruins of that city will '''never''' cage me. And with what's at stake... I can't stop now" when you fight Duke Erisia after your first encounter. This dialogue shows that Duke Erisia does in fact, escape the Depths after you kill him. *In older versions of ''Deepwoken'', you would have to make sure your group catches up with you. If you entered first, they would've likely been locked out of the boss room. This no longer happens as everyone will be teleported into the boss room once the first person activates the barrier. *This bosses attacks heavily resemble the interpretation of TOARU's [https://animebattlearenaaba.fandom.com/wiki/Accelerator Accelerator] in [https://www.roblox.com/games/1458767429/ABA Anime Battle Arena](more commonly known as ABA), a game that Par has worked on prior. **Specifically, Binding Tempest correlates to Air Grasp, Strong Left correlates to Ground Accelerate, Wind Gun correlates to Air Quake, Counter correlates to Redirect, Gale Stomp correlates to Ground Quake, and Cyclone Bomb correlates to Plasma. **They also both laugh manically following a successful counter. ***Cyclone Bomb also bears a striking resemblance to Goku's Spirit bomb from the Dragon Ball franchise. *The Duke used to use [[Way of Navae]] for his M1s with [[Legion Kata]]'s critical attack. He was changed to use [[Untrained Fist]] with the addition of the style. *Duke Erisia will always laugh when his counter is activated, even if the attack is from a mob such as a prime golem. *Before the [[Stoneheart]]'s description referred to him as Ishamon, his first name remained unknown, leading to it becoming a meme in the community. **Upon being asked, Arch_Mage said his name was "Duke Fancypants." **Naktigonis said it was "Duke Duke Erisia Erisia (of Erisia)." *Elaborating from the Stoneheart's description, his Resonance is likely corrupted, considering his acquisition of the Forge, allowing him to expand his ability capacity by a greater amount, whereas the Sinner's Ash relic allows it to corrupt one's Resonance while being a remnant of the Forge. *His hair ID is 4374334355. * Duke's Colors: #bfb5a9 Skin | #414A3B Hair | #7d9600 Pupils | #414A3B Facial Marking | #564236 Eyeglasses | Pastel Green - Resonance *In [https://x.com/Hautdesert/status/1722430043526181058 a video about seals], Duke Erisia states he is a Virgo. *In a video from Naktigonis [https://youtu.be/DCCjnfrZBCc celebrating the millionth viewing of Sin-Smelted Scoriae] on YouTube, it is revealed that Duke Erisia is a member of the band "The Seal Unleashed" as the vocalist. **Duke Erisia confirms that The Seal Unleashed does, in fact, perform Sin-Smelted Scoriae every single time someone challenges him to a fight. *He is able to drown; if you manage to glitch both yourself and Duke Erisia into the water under his arena with Skeleton Key (or otherwise) and knock him there, he will drown and die. This does still count as a kill for you/your guild, but you cannot get to his loot afterwards. *If [[Taunt]] is utilized before the player talks with Duke Erisia, all his dialogue will be skipped & the fight will start immediately. It is unknown if this is intentional or not. This doesn't work with Sing. *If you don't kill all the enemies in the first area, Duke Erisia and his servants won't spawn in the arena (possible to see via spark swapping with either a golem prime or brainsucker located in the second area). *Do NOT count on using Mindless Servants as health packs, due to the fact that the Duke may NOT SUMMON THEM AT ALL in a fight. After completing his "Memories of Home" challenge in the [[Bestiary]], extra information is revealed about him: "The Duke is known to have witnessed the Submergence of Celtor, an event that may well have set him down the path he chose." ==Bugs== *Killing Duke Ishamon Erisia while your character has an attunement you've obtained through the respective quest will cause ([Attunement] Attained) to appear twice, even if you have the respective attunement unlocked on that account. It won't mean anything if you already uncapped attunement and is just a simple bug that has been in the game. *Can instantly cast Aero Spear if his head is caught under something, especially the pipes found around the edges of his arena. {{History}} {{Nav|Bosses}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Humanoid Bosses]] [[Category:Voiced Characters]] [[Category:Members of the Erisia family]]

==Description==
A Dungeon is an isolated area in Deepwoken, typically for a boss fight or grinding area. Dungeons are unique; they teleport the player to a server (alone, or with a group depending on the dungeon), and isolates said player away from the rest of the game. 

The player is allowed to leave the dungeon either after a set goal is reached, if they die, or at any point, depending on the dungeon. Deepwoken labels the area as "Dungeon" in the top right area of your screen.

All players within Dungeons automatically count as allies to each other.

|Solo

|-
|[[The Blade Within]]

|Solo

|[[The Cradle of Symphonies]]
|Boss
|Solo
|
|[[File:The Cradle of Symphonies.png|frameless|450px]]
|-
|[[The Diluvian Mechanism]]
|Grinding Area
|Both
|A wave-based monster slaying dungeon, down the halls of the [[Marauder's Entrance]], featuring 50 waves of monsters and enemies. It can be accessed by interacting with the [[Diluvian Mechanism (NPC)|Diluvian Mechanism]] in Marauder's Entrance.

Featuring unique monsters and enemies such as [[Bonekeeper]]s, [[Bounder]]s, and the merciless [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]. It can be accessed by jumping into the [[First Layer]]'s void above 50% HP, speaking to [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris Llfiend]] above Power 15, or by using the [[The Chariot's Spire|Ignition Deepdriller.]]
