==Description==
The Duskguard Axe is a HVY weapon in the Greataxe category that can be obtained by maxing out the Shock Corps division under the [[Authority Ensign]] origin. You must return to Sentinel Augustus after obtaining the rank of Operator in order to receive the weapon.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Duskguard.gif
</gallery>

The user reels the axe backwards before chopping the opponent and guardbreaking them. The opponent will be lodged into the axe as the user leaps and smashes them into the ground, dazing them for 1.5 seconds in the end.

The initial hit does not count as a hit or weapon attack despite guardbreaking; this means it won't proc any Talents that proc on damage dealt, and it does not deal damage. Though, this hit can still proc general "on guardbreak" effects, like {{t|Cornered Fool}}. The second hit has a 1.375x scaled damage multiplier.

The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

{{text|m1tag}}

==Gallery==
===Enchantments===
<gallery type="slideshow" widths="300" position="center" style="clear:left">
File:Duskguard Axe Astral.png|Astral
File:Detonationduskguardauthority.PNG|Detonation
File:Duskguard Axe Storm.png|Storm
File:Curseofreplusion.png|Curse Of Replusion
File:Heorism.png|Heroism
File:MetalDuskGuard.png|Metal
File:Duskguardedenkite.png|Tears Of Edenkite
File:Duskguardgrim.png|Grim
File:Duskguardvampirism.png|Vampirism
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The first "hit" of the critical is not considered a weapon attack by the game. This means it cannot proc any effect that would normally proc upon landing, or guardbreaking with, a '''weapon attack'''.
**For example, the first hit of this critical cannot proc (unexhaustive list): most [[Enchantments]] (notably, [[Stone]] cannot proc on it), {{t|Dark Waltz}}, {{t|Manipulator}}, {{t|Unnecessary Theatrics}}, etc.
**Talents, such as {{t|Cornered Fool}}, that proc on guardbreak in general will proc on the first hit however.

|desc=A vial of swirling colors crafted by the hand of [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|a powerful Dawnwalker]]. Used to dye your equipment and various aspects of your appearance.
|droppable=No
|value=0
|bankable=Vow
|stack=99
|pass down=Yes
|usage=Changing the color of [[Equipment]] items, Aspect/character features, and other cosmetics.}}

==Description==
A Dye Packet is a [[Relic]] that allows the user to add a tint to their equipment. They are invented by [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]].

Dyes can be removed at a [[Barber]], or from [[Sev]]. The maximum Dye Packets that can be held per slot is 99.

The player can purchase the Manycolored Equipment upgrade from Sev for {{C|Crowns|25}}, which allows them to only dye their equipment without a Dye Packet. This upgrade is slot-wide and is purchasable once per account.

==Dye-able Components==
* [[Equipment]]
* Hair (each hair slot can be dyed separately or altogether)
* Eyes (both Pupils and Sclera) 
* [[Resonance]] bells
* [[Oaths|Oath]] Cosmetics (some Oaths, like [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]] come with multiple separately dyable parts)
* [[Outfits]]
* [[Aspects|Aspect]] Features (such as Gremor horns)

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Ganymede Dye.gif|The dyeing process
File:Goldleaf Helm Dyed Old.png|A dyed [[Goldleaf Helm]]
</gallery>

==Trivia==
* [[Vesperian]] masks and [[Ganymede]] hats have separate parts that can be dyed individually. After choosing the dye for the mask/hat, you will be prompted to change the dye on the ink/hat underside. Pressing submit without changing anything will allow you to progress to the secondary dye without spending a Dye Packet.
* Most equipment and outfits are just "tinted" instead of the actual color changing.
** The [[Familiar Heretic's Armor]] almost changes color entirely when dyed pure white (255/255/255), changing from darker colors like black to a lighter bluish hue on certain sections of the outfit. For most items, dying them white won't change much or anything at all, but this is an exception.
* [[Scaling Rings]] (i.e. [[Akira's Ring]] or [[Prophet's Ring]]) cannot be dyed.
* Originally, they could only be obtained from Klaris. This was eventually changed on the August 15th, 2023 update, making them available for purchase from Merchant Ships.
** Previously, Dye Packets would come with a Dye Remover item which was the only way to remove an equipment dye. If purchased from Chili's Merchant Ships, they would not come with the Remover. This item was made unobtainable on the {{VersionHistory|2024|April 5th}} update and later entirely removed in a shadow update of April 2025.
* Dye Packets have no model, so appear invisible on Chili's ship.
* Choosing to "Dye All" on hairs will only use 1 dye packet.

title: Echoes
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}{{Quotes|quote=The Legacy of my Lineage ... Shall be continued down to yours, my rogue friend-- to the next and after the other.|author=Echo of Inspiration}} {{CurrencyInfobox|title1=Echoes|caption1="The accumulated accomplishments of departed souls. The more a character accomplishes, the more you'll receive when you die. Used to unlock permanent upgrades for future characters."|usage=* Echo Upgrades * Echo Unlocks * Pass down Soulbound or Enchants|obtainment=* Wiping with Echo Triumphs|image1=EchoesCurrencyBig.png}} ==Overview== '''Echoes''' are a currency that is obtained by wiping characters. The amount of '''Echoes''' gained through wiping increases based on how much progress the character had made before being wiped. '''Echoes''' can be spent on '''Upgrades''' and '''Unlocks;''' permanent buffs that transfer with each Character Wipe. While in the character creation menu, the '''Echo Shop''' tab can be used to spend '''Echoes''' on '''Upgrades''' and '''Unlocks'''. In addition, '''Modifiers''' can be enabled in the '''Echo Modifier''' menu. *'''Modifiers''' are increases to difficulty that increase the amount of '''Echoes''' gained from wiping. Multiple '''Modifiers''' can be enabled at once. There are currently 13 Modifiers available, providing a total cumulative 3.1x modifier to '''Echo''' gain. *'''Echo Upgrades''' are account-wide, so purchasing an upgrade on one slot will affect the rest. *'''Echo Unlocks''' are account-wide, so purchasing an unlock on one slot will often affect the rest. Unlocks that pertain to new slots (like Starter Weapons or Tools) will not impact pre-existing slots however. The maximum amount of '''Echoes''' that a character can get is 140 (or 427 with all Echo Modifiers). ===Ranks=== [[File:W rank.png|thumb|259x259px|W Rank being obtained]] '''Ranks''' are granted to the character upon wiping, based on how much base Echoes they have obtained (before multipliers) Ranks by themselves do nothing, beside rank W, S and A that give a badge and, in the case of W, an emerald name on the player list. The emerald name overrides Silver & Gold names from [[Chime of Conflict]]. *A Rank unlocks the A Rank badge, giving 1 character slot for free. *S Rank is achievable by doing all Echoes tasks (listed below). This unlocks the S Rank badge. *A unique W Rank is achievable by obtaining S Rank while having enabled every Echoes Modifier, excluding Glass Bones. This unlocks the W Rank badge, giving you a green name in the player list on all slots. '''What rank your character will receive depends on amount of Echoes you collect, without taking multipliers from Echo Modifiers into consideration.''' {| class="fandom-table" !Rank !Echoes Amount |- |W |138 (421 w/ all Echoes Modifiers except Glass Bones) |- |S |138 (Must do all Echo Triumphs) |- |A |112-137 |- |B |87-111 |- |C |60-86 |- |D |30-59 |- |E |0-29 |} ==={{anch|Ways of Obtaining Echoes|Echo Triumphs}}=== Echoes are awarded depending on the number of Triumphs the character accomplished before wiping. Each triumph awards a different number of Echoes, and with a small number of exceptions, each Triumph can only be achieved once. Any item stored within your [[bank]] will not count for its respective Echo Triumph. For example, you cannot store an [[Enchant Stone]] and use that to complete the "Enchant an item" or "Soulbound an item" tasks. {| class="wikitable" ! Echo Reward ! Task/Requirement |- | data-row-id="food" style="text-align:center;" | 1 | Craft a [[Food]] item. |- | data-row-id="fishing" style="text-align:center;" | 1 | Catch a [[Fishing|Fish]].
Catching anything with a [[Fishing Rod]] counts.
|- | data-row-id="modify-mantra" style="text-align:center;" | 1 | Modify a [[Mantras|Mantra]]. |- | data-row-id="pure-ore" style="text-align:center;" | 1 | Turn in a [[Ore|Pure Ore]] to a [[Blacksmith]].
[[Pure Iron]] does not count. |- | data-row-id="chime-win" style="text-align:center;" | 1 | Win a [[Chime of Conflict]] match. |- | data-row-id="master-armor" style="text-align:center;" | 2 | Craft a [[Outfits|Master Armor]]. |- | data-row-id="deep-shrine" style="text-align:center;" | 2 | Use a [[Deep Shrines|Deep Shrine]]. |- | data-row-id="miserables" style="text-align:center;" | 2 | Make a deal with [[Misérables]]. |- | data-row-id="yunshul" style="text-align:center;" | 2 | Bargain with [[Yun'Shul]].
E.g. rerolling [[Resonance]]. Also the [[Idol of Yun'Shul]] counts for this Triumph. |- | data-row-id="unbound-attribute" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Unbound an [[Attributes|Attribute]]. |- | data-row-id="oath" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Obtain an [[Oaths|Oath]]. |- | data-row-id="soulbound-enchant" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Soul-bound an [[Enchantments|enchanted]] or legendary item. |- | data-row-id="enchant-item" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Enchant an Item with an [[Enchant Stone]] or [[Enchant Grease]].
Do not use these items on an already enchanted item. Both items have to be obtained on that slot and cannot be ones from your bank. |- | data-row-id="laplace-enchant" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Obtain an enchant from [[Laplace]]. |- | data-row-id="Clear a World Event" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Clear a [[World Events|World Event]].
Defeat [[Interluminary Parasol]] OR [[The Doom of Caeranthil]] OR complete the [[Carnival of Hearts]]. |- | data-row-id="pluripotent-alloy" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Use a [[Pluripotent Alloy]] to alloy a weapon.
Most alloyed weapons have a 75 weapon requirement. |- | data-row-id="murmur" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Obtain a [[Murmur]]. |- | data-row-id="serpents" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Defeat the [[Dread Serpent]] OR the [[Doom of Caeranthil]]. |- | data-row-id="duke" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Defeat [[Duke Erisia]]. |- | data-row-id="ferryman" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Defeat [[The Ferryman]]. |- | data-row-id="chaser" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Defeat [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]. |- | data-row-id="primadon" style="text-align:center;" | 5 | Defeat [[Primadon, Titan of the East]] OR [[Elder Primadon, The Titan Warlord]]. |- | data-row-id="scion" style="text-align:center;" | 10 | Defeat the [[Scion of Ethiron]]. |- | data-row-id="hell-mode" style="text-align:center;" | 10 | Complete [[Hell Mode]]. |- | data-row-id="layer2-no-hook" style="text-align:center;" | 10 | Complete [[Second Layer|Layer 2]] floor 1 without a [[Light Hook]].
You will need to leave through [[Chaser]]'s or the [[Scion of Ethiron]]'s escape portals for this to count. |- | data-row-id="power-level" style="text-align:center;" | 15 | [[Power]] up.
Every Power level up will award you with 0.75 Echoes, totaling to 15 Echoes at Power 20 |- | data-row-id="resonance" style="text-align:center;" | 15 | Obtain a [[Resonance]].
You must CHOOSE it. If you reroll in [[Fragments of Self]], it resets the task, even if you had one before. |} ==Upgrades, Unlocks, and Modifiers== There are 11 upgrades and 15 unlocks to purchase. Each upgrade can be purchased a maximum of 1 to 6 times, depending on the upgrade. Purchasing the maximum level of all Echo upgrades and all unlocks costs 2695 Echoes. Only pick this if you wish to embark on an unforgiving challenge. |style="border:2px solid #686868;border-radius: 15px|'''+0%''' |} ==Echo Talents/Items== [[File:Echo Talents Pic.png|thumb|480x480px|Example of an Echo Talent unlocked]] [[File:Quickfang.png|thumb|Quickfang Echo Unlock]] Other than replayability, Echoes can also be Talents and Items; all acquired under meeting requirements and completing quests. Echo Talents or Items, once acquired for the first time, can be obtained in later Power Levels per Character after. If you've obtained an Echo Talent on a different slot, you can talk to [[Yamaketzal]] to unlock the Talent on your current slot. This is useful for power 20 slots as they cannot level up to obtain the Echo Talents you've already obtained previously. ===Echo Quests=== '''(Power 1)''' Chain of Perfection [Echo Talent] - ''Gain Chain of Perfection at Power 1. '''Obtained by defeating any [[Bosses|boss]] without getting hit by one of the boss' attacks.''''' *Increases PvE damage by 5% each melee hit you deal without taking hits in return. **Unlocked on the initial slot, and any characters or slots created after obtainment upon reaching power 1. ***The maximum threshold of damage is 2x. ***Chain of Perfection does '''not''' work in PvP. '''(Visiting the Eastern Luminant)''' Hive Gate Open and Fountain Teleporters Unlocked - Gained Hive Gate and Fountain Teleporters after visiting the Eastern Luminant. '''Obtained by washing your face at least once at [[Lightkeeper Temple]].''' *Following Hive R&D, the restrictions on the Fountain Gate network's Vow have been relaxed. Merely having seen the majesty of the Greathive from afar is enough to create the mental link that enables one to utilize the network. '''Fountain Gates can now be used at any Power so long as you've visited the Eastern Luminant on that character and have unlocked the Hive Gate on your account''' ==Notes== *Buying most Echo Upgrades and some of the Unlocks will apply their effects to previously created slots. Any of the Starter/Starting: Weapon, Tools, Equipment, Knowledge, and Notes will '''not''' be applied to pre-existing slots however. *The actual effects of "Resonance Rarity" boosts the chance to receive Corrupted and Legendary Resonances by 0.2x per upgrade, with your chance doubling at the max upgrade. *There are a few sources of damage that bypass Glass Bones' effects, allowing you to take the damage without being knocked. These are: **The [[Boulder]] training gear **{{status|ncl=y|Starved|Starvation}} *Loose Change does not make you lose Notes when you take damage from any source like the description implies, instead only attacks from humanoids reduce your Notes, though it can be inconsistent at times. *Any Mantra hand not granted from leveling, and any Talent/Mantra hand granted from [[Deep Shrines]] do not get autopicked with Destined so you can abuse this to look for cards with more comfort. *Unlike all the other bosses in the game, defeating [[Knell, The Lunatic Resonator|Knell]], [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]], [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]], [[Heart of Enmity]], [[Parliament]], [[Kyrsgarde Champion]], and [[Interluminary Parasol]] do not reward Echoes. **This technically makes them the only true "optional" bosses in the game, as they are not required for W Rank. *The [[Leather Gloves]] and [[Leather Boots|Boots]] from the Starting Equipment Echo Unlock are equipped automatically at the end of character creation. This means, if you've chosen [[Lone Warrior]], you can spawn in the [[Trial of One]] with equipment on. *Multifaceted makes the 5 innate [[Aspects|Aspect]] points free to allocate. For example instead of having 3 Fortitude and 2 Willpower on a [[Vesperian]], all of your stats will be at 0 and you will be given 5 free points to invest. This allows for much more build diversity with all aspects. **After purchasing Multifaceted, all pre-existing characters will have their Aspect-given attribute points uninvested, while you keep any Talent or Mantra that you no longer meet the requirements of. *Elementalist allows you to choose more than 2 elements during [[Character Creation]]. Additionally, this Echo Unlock allows you to freely allocate attribute points into the starting Attunements, such as starting a character with 3 Flame 2 Ice 3 Shadow and 2 Gale, or 9 Blood and 1 Thunder, etc. This will take points out of your starting points though. *There previously was an Echo for consuming an [[Attribute Flasks|Attribute Flask]] but [[Attribute Flasks]] have been recently removed ==Trivia== *On March 16th, 2025, [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcB0KECJA6A| Chad09999 or Midq] became the first player to achieve W rank with the ''Glass Bones'' modifier. *On {{VersionHistory|2025|December 13th}}, with the addition of the [[Vow of Iron]], the '''Ironwoken''' and '''Vow of Thorns''' Echo Modifiers were removed form the game. **While Vow of Thorns was "removed", it was really re-purposed to handle certain mechanics in Vow of Iron; meaning that if you had a slot with Vow of thorns before it was removed, that slot and any future instances of it will have the "IronVow" echo modifier instead, making them drown from every surface death ***This can be fixed by pressing the "enable all/disable all" button in the echo-modifier section of character-creation. *Chain of Perfection was initially made to not gain stacks on mantra hits. But due to ''massive'' community uproar the change was reverted but made multihits give you less stacks. *Visually, combining all Echo Modifiers grants 3.1x Echoes, but dividing 421/3.1 will give you 136. Instead, Dividing by 420.9/3.05 will give you 138, the maximum amount of Echoes. This is due to the game always rounding to the nearest tenth, even if the value is not true. {{History}} [[Category:Echoes]] [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Creation]] [[Category:Features absent in Vow of Iron]]

title: Edenkite
content:
{{cnp}}
{{Species
|image1=
|name=Elder Edenkite<ref name="Folk">[[Lumen's Folklore#Volume 'North'|Lumen's Folklore: Volume 'North']]</ref><ref name="GlossNorth">{{Ref/Glossary|The Northern Luminant}}</ref>
|habitat=[[Northern Luminant]]<ref name="Folk" />
}}

==Description==
The Elder Edenkite, often shortened to just Edenkite,<ref name="Skyreap">{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Skyreap Blade}}</ref> were said to be an immortal species of flying wyrms from the [[Northern Luminant]], whose intelligence surpassed humanity's own. According to legend, they tended to avoid humanity, seeing them as a potential threat. However, after human scholars devised a method to communicate with them, and the Edenkite, partially enthralled by humanity's achievements during [[The Canticlysm]], decided to take the risk and offered the visitors wisdom and advice. This advice was said to be cryptic and hard to decipher, leading scholars to ruminate on them for hours upon hours.<ref name="Folk" />

In the twilight years of the Canticlysm, the Tides began to rise, and the Edenkite numbered only nine. According to the myths, an unnamed steward traveled to the Northern Luminant to ask the Edenkite how to stop them, secretly wondering if the Edenkite themselves were responsible for the disaster. He questioned an Edenkite, which responded by telling him that humanity's destruction was inevitable, and suggested it to be a boon worth accepting rather than something to be fought. Furious, the steward decided to obtain the answer by force, beheading the Edenkite with [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour]] and sending its corpse crashing down onto a mountain, skewering it. The steward hacked its abdomen open and devoured its heart in an attempt to obtain the wisdom of the Edenkite, but his mind was instead overwhelmed by the information within. Filled with the memories of countless tragedies across history, he was mutated into the first [[Dread Serpent]], a pale imitation of an Edenkite. The veracity of these claims are not clear, but it is said that the Edenkite's headless corpse is real and can be found on the mountains to this day.<ref name="Folk" />

Whether the Edenkite exist, have gone into hiding, or were driven to extinction is a matter of debate amongst modern scholars.<ref name="Folk" /> Allegedly, the [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] contains the remnants of an Edenkite that was slain by a hunting party that eventually found themselves lost to the [[Voidsea]].<ref name="EdenbrandDesc">{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Edenbrand Hellcoil}}</ref> Like all things relating to the Edenkite, whether this actually happened is up for some debate given the failure of the party to return home and their reputation lending itself to being mythologized, though the fact the Hellcoil can inflict soulfire upon its target suggests the claim may actually hold water.

The appearance of the Edenkite has yet to be properly detailed, though it is likely similar to the Dread Serpent. Edenkite are consistently described as "wyrms",<ref name="Folk" /><ref name="GlossNorth" /> suggesting they either have wings but no limbs, or lack wings altogether and achieve flight through some supernatural mechanism. The [[Skyreap Blade]], said to be made from the bones of an Edenkite,<ref name="Skyreap" /> is covered in feathers. Coupled with early accounts mistaking them for birds,<ref name="Folk" /> the Edenkite may have an avian appearance of sorts. Presuming the [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] to be an accurate depiction of an Edenkite's head, Edenkite posses two horns, a "beard" and two long whiskers.

==Text==
===<center><u>Eggs In A Basket</u></center>===
<poem style="text-align: center">
<cite style="text-align: center; display: block">A broadsheet of a popular sailor song</cite>
  
 
	Oh, my dear, you knew so long ago that I'd be leaving soon,
		And now the day has come at last me to cross the ocean blue.
	Weep your little heart out if I don't come say 'goodbye' tomorrow,
		But if I don't come back at all, then spare yourself from sorrow!
	
	I hope that soon you'll find another, -
		Though, I pray, don't tell your mother!
	I hope that you'll remember me,
		Although we were not meant to be.
    	
	Haven't you heard the saying blasted?
		I'll tell you, though no one asked it:
	Do as they say,
		And don't put all your eggs inside one basket!
</poem>

==Description==
Ehkusa was the main character of of [[Lament of Cirryn]]. With the [[book]]'s removal from the game, Ehkusa is no longer referenced within ''[[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]]''.

She was a [[Lifeweave]] scholar of [[The Hive]], who was sent out on a mission with two other scholars to revive [[Cirryn]] by Hivelord [[Ximac Diri]].<ref name="Lament" />

In the end, the mission ends in partial success, with [[Cirryn]] coming back to life, but going rogue and wreaking havoc in the Greathive.

Ehkusa a very peaceful woman, trying to make amends and communicate with her companions. She really values her friends, seemingly losing spirit when [[Ka'al]] dies, but finding power in herself to keep battling. She tries to stop [[Remaz]] from sacrificing himself by luring [[Cirryn]] into the lifeless chamber in order to stop him from killing more people by offering herself instead. In the end, she follows with [[Remaz]]'s plan and lets him sacrifice himself to save the Greathive from rogue [[Cirryn]].<ref name="Lament" />

She also has a deceased friend, [[Ryrda]], a part of who's mask she always keeps with herself.<ref name="Lament" /><ref>{{Ref/Book|God in the Machine}}</ref>

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that tethers your opponent on hit.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} applies the {{status|Tethered}} status effect on M1, pulling your opponent towards yourself.

Tethered PvE enemies deal reduced damage to you, scaling on how far away they are from you.

===Notes===
*Elastic cannot proc on [[Bullets]].
*{{PAGENAME}}'s effects can be procced on weapon criticals if they have the [[M1 tag]].
*Elastic's damage reduction in PvE is based on how far the center of the enemy is away from you. This means large enemies like [[Primadon]] will deal heavily reduced damage to you, even if they are standing right next to you.
*Elastic's pulling effect has a range limit of 92.5 studs.

==Trivia==
*This Enchantment is a reference to Hisoka's Bungee Gum from ''Hunter x Hunter'', hence why it was called Bungee Gum previously.

(★☆☆) |Elder Primadon will raise his right foot and stomps after a delay. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Heavy Stomp'''
(★★★) |Elder Primadon brings his right foot high in the air and roars. After a short while, he stomps the ground, dealing colossal damage to anyone unfortunate enough to be under his feet. *This move can be parried, but it's much easier to run away given how long he winds up the move for. *If Level 5 Prediction is used on this move it will deal about 9-10% of Elder Primadon's maximum health. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Triple Stomp'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping three consecutive times. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Stomp Blitz'''
(★★★) |Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping six consecutive times. *This move's stomps will be at a higher pitch, making it possible to differentiate from his triple stomp. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Punch'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon punches in front of him. *Elder Primadon can aim this move to hit people above him. *Has a variable wind-up. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Kick'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon winds up his right leg before kicking forwards. {{AttackTags |indicator = highposture |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll.true }} |- |
'''Grab'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon grabs in front of him, dealing massive damage after throwing his target. *This move is only used when the target is outside of stomping range. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, blockable?, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Rock Throw'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon bows forward and throws five rocks at his target. *This move is only used when the target is outside of stomping and punching range. *This move will usually guard-break if fully blocked, so it is recommended to roll halfway through. {{AttackTags |indicator = highposture |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Disengage'''
(★☆☆) |Elder Primadon will jump backwards while throwing two rocks at his target. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ground Slam'''
(★★☆) |Elder Primadon bends his knees and lifts his arms up, eventually slamming down after a variable amount of times. *This move has an indicator for when you should roll, which is his legs going forward slightly. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, blockable?, dodge.y }}'''''Autogrips''''' |- |
'''Enrage'''
(★☆☆) |At half health, Elder Primadon becomes enraged, roars and inflicts insanity to anyone affected. *When enraged, Elder Primadon will do attacks slightly quicker, but also leave much less room for attacks in between attacks. **You can still hit Elder Primadon twice with decently fast weapons after his generic kick and after he is finished with a stomp attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodgeable? }} |- |
'''Combo'''
(★★★) |Elder Primadon does a stomp, a kick, then a triple stomp in quick succession. *When Elder Primadon is enraged, the pause between the stomp, kick and triple stomp is near zero, meaning you can't attack after the first stomp without being kicked. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Stomp Feint'''
(★★★) |Elder Primadon raises his right foot, but will instead delay it and then proceed to feint. Afterwards he will punch and then he will kick. *Unlike the triple stomp feint, Elder Primadon will follow up with a kick if he feints a regular stomp. *You can block the kick, but this requires relatively high posture. Alternatively, you can roll cancel his punch so a second roll will be available for the kick. *Elder Primadon will have a much longer pause after the kick compared to his other moves even if enraged, allowing for potentially more damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type1_color = DarkOrange |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Triple Stomp Feint'''
(★★★) |Elder Primadon will raise his left foot, eventually stomping once, then feinting the second. Afterwards he will punch. *Unlike the regular stomp feint, Elder Primadon will not follow up with a kick if he feints triple stomp. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |} == Combat == Elder Primadon has 99% cannon resistance, according to a tester. So cannon cheesing him is out of the question. Unlike [[Primadon, Titan of the East]], Elder primadon can feint his attacks. == Strategy == The Elder Primadon is a far more challenging opponent than its counterpart, [[Primadon, Titan of the East]], due to the limited windows for attack. This is particularly true during its enraged state. It is recommended to limit your attacks to one or two strikes after the boss's actions, depending on your weapon's swing speed. This cautious approach is crucial for avoiding its highly lethal counterattacks. A key principle is to maintain a '''calm and patient mindset'''. Avoid being overly aggressive with your attacks. When in doubt, it is safer not to attack at all. Elder Primadon's moves are both fast to initiate and quick to execute. Using a faster-swinging weapon (medium or light) may be more forgiving, as it allows for more frequent attack opportunities compared to slower, heavy weapons. Elder Primadon has an extensive moveset that can be learned with practice. In addition to the standard attacks from its easier counterpart, its new moves include: '''Heavy Stomp''', '''Stomp Blitz''', and '''Ground Slam'''. The boss is also capable of '''feinting''' its regular and triple stomps. It may delay a regular stomp or feint the second stomp of a triple stomp combo. After a feint, the boss will often follow up with a punch and a kick. If you lack the posture to block the kick or fail to properly roll-cancel the punch, the kick will likely connect. Elder Primadon can also initiate a '''combo''' that always consists of a stomp, a kick, and a triple stomp. Because there is no clear indicator that the boss will continue a combo after a regular stomp, it's advised to avoid a double or even single attack after this move. == Drops == Elder Primadon drops 9 Chests, All of them can contain Relics and other high value loot. The center chest is more likely to contain Sinner's Ashes. {| class="fandom-table" width="100%" | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]]''' | style="width:90%;" |[[Titanslayer's title: Elemental Cantrips
content:
{{Quotes
|quote=Wielding any Mantra of an element grants you Cantrips of that element. Cantrips are minor feats available to wielders of an element, such as lighting campfires or purifying drinking water.
|author=[[Loading Screen]] tip
}}

==Overview==
Cantrips are, often minor, passive utility abilities that are automatically unlocked by obtaining any Mantra from the specified attunement.

==Cantrips==
===[[Bloodrend]]===
{{anch|Bloodless (Cantrip)|Bloodless|'''}}{{cl|bld|Bloodless}};''' This Cantrip visually hides the blood splotches that appear on the player's [[Outfit]] when at low health. This is purely visual.

The {{t|Not a Scratch}} Talent also provides this effect, among other things.

{{anch|Carnivorous|'''}}{{cl|bld|Carnivorous}};''' This Cantrip allows the player to consume raw meat-type [[Food]] items without vomiting. Even still, eating raw meat isn't very recommended, as the cooked versions provide significantly more sustenance and may grant additional buffs on consumption.

[[Vegetarian]] Bloodrenders may still vomit upon consuming meat-type Food items.

==={{anch|Flamecharm|[[Flamecharm]]}} / {{anch|Thundercall|[[Thundercall]]}}===
{{anch|Produce Spark|'''}}{{cl|flm|Produce}} {{cl|ltn|Spark}};''' This Cantrip allows you to light [[Campfire Pit|Campfire Pits]] without the use of [[Flint]].

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
Produce Spark.gif
File:Flame Wisp Flint 1.mp3|Produce Spark SFX ([[Flamecharm]])
</gallery>

===[[Frostdraw]]===
{{anch|Purifying Frost|'''}}{{cl|ice|Purifying Frost}};''' This Cantrip automatically purifies certain forms of unsafe water when collected in your [[Canteen]]. Sea water and the [[Celestial]] Ichor cannot be purified by this Cantrip.

The [[Purifying Ring]] Equipment has a similar effect. Most collectible water sources are already drinkable, removing most of the need for this Cantrip.

Purifiable water sources include:
*[[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] Fishing Pond water
*[[Temple of the Blade]] water, located in front of [[Stratos]]
*[[The Garden Reservoir]] acid water

===[[Galebreathe]]===
{{anch|Batch Harvest|'''}}{{cl|wnd|Batch Harvest}};''' This Cantrip allows the player to harvest multiple of the same [[:Category:Ingredients|ingredient]] at once if there are others of that ingredient nearby. For example, if there are three [[Dentifilo]]s that spawned close together, harvesting one will collect all three.

This does not work on [[Ores]].

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Galecantrip.gif
</gallery>

===[[Ironsing]]===
{{anch|Ore Siphon|'''}}{{cl|mtl|Ore Siphon}};''' This Cantrip allows the player to mine [[Ores]] with their Ironsing abilities, taking priority over their [[Pickaxe]] if they have one. Ore Siphon's visual effect will become yellow if the user has {{t|Gilded Path: Scrapsinger}}.

Currently does not work on [[Saramaed Hollow]] fuel.

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Default Iron Cantrip.gif|Default Ironsing Cantrip
File:Gilded Iron Cantrip.gif|Gilded Ironsing Cantrip
</gallery>

{{anch|Stainless|'''}}{{cl|mtl|Stainless}};''' This Cantrip hides all visual tears the player's [[Outfit]] gains when their armor durability is low. This is purely visual.

The {{t|Not a Scratch}} Talent also provides this effect, among other things.

===[[Shadowcast]]===
{{anch|Night Vision|'''}}{{cl|sdw|Night Vision}};''' This Cantrip allows you to see better in low-light environments.

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:with Night Vision shadow.png|WITH Night Vision
File:No Night Vision shadow.png|WITHOUT Night Vision
</gallery>

title: Elykris
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=The Ministry must be stopped, lest we fall victim to their power.|author=Elykris}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=Elykris NPC.png
|name=Elykris
|aspect=Celtor
|location=[[Minityrsa]]
}}

==Description==
Elykris is a [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They are investigating [[the Ministry]]'s presence in [[Minityrsa]].

They give the quest "Ministry Secrets" that tasks [[The Pathfinder]] to find a field report located inside of [[Outpost Antumbra]], by the ladder to [[Trial of One]]. The quest rewards them with 3 Aces and a Curiosity [[Talent]] hand.

Elykris wears the old version of the [[Darksteel Plate]] outfit, a Black [[Fur Parka]], a [[Black Blindfold]], and a [[Brigand's Bicorn]].

==Location==
Elykris is located leaning against a tree, on a ledge to the left of a Ministry Camp above [[Outpost Antumbra]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Elykris Location.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}They're lurking here. I know they are. The Trial has lured them to this land, in search of power.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you talking about?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}The Ministry. A shadow organization that rarely shows their face, yet here a great nest of them lies. They discovered something powerful beneath this land. A trial able to grant unfathomable power.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Tell me more about the nest.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A trial?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Indeed, they've taken great interest in this artifact. While I do not fully comprehend their goals, I believe they wish to use its power for their own benefit. If we were to understand their goals however, perhaps we could hinder their progress..
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Beneath the ruins they've setup their encampment in, a door to the unimaginable resides. I.. cannot say for certain its specifics, but only few fledgling adventurers are allowed entry through the white mist, and even fewer return. It rejects those who are already powerful, it seems.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What can we do?
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Tell me more about the nest.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}I've seen their members descend into the basement of the ruins, surely the knowledge they've gathered is stored there. Be wary of their patrols, and retrieve one of their field reports. Bring it back to me, and we'll unearth their true motives.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player already has Ministry Field Report
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player does not have Ministry Field Report
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I might already have what you're looking for.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll retrieve it.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}I see. So it seems my intuition was correct. I can only wonder what they'll use this power for, but all that's left to do is stop them. Thank you for your assistance, traveler. Allow me to lend you a.. gift of sorts, the ability to alter your path. When fate presents its hand to you, you can eliminate the paths you no longer desire now.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Very well. Their ruins are on a cliff side here on Minityrsa, surrounded by many patrols of their members. They wield a powerful attunement, so be on guard.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player receives 3 Aces and Curiosity Talent Hand
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest End=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}You're still walking; that's a good sign. How goes the mission?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has retrieved Ministry Field Report
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player does not have Ministry Field Report
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Here's the report.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I haven't found the report yet.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}I see. So it seems my intuition was correct. I can only wonder what they'll use this power for, but all that's left to do is stop them. Thank you for your assistance, traveler. Allow me to lend you a.. gift of sorts, the ability to alter your path. When fate presents its hand to you, you can eliminate the paths you no longer desire now.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Very well. Their ruins are on a cliffside here on Minityrsa, surrounded by many patrols of their members. They wield a powerful attunement, so be on guard. Return to me with the report.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player receives 3 Aces and Curiosity Talent Hand
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
}}

|-|Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Thank you again, traveler. The Ministry must be stopped, lest we fall victim to their power.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
</tabber>

==Trivia==
*The Ministry Field Report can be given to the [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] Librarian, preventing the quest from being completed.

title: Emar Vend
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{EnemyInfobox |health=8000 |drops=None |weapon=*[[Darksteel Greatsword]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Restrain *Caltrops *Vent |image1=Emar Vend.png |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/NPC|Chained Captive|quote=He's been camping out in this old fort, waiting for the right moment to steal one of the Company's boats.}} |caption1=Power is when we have every justification to kill, and we don't... That's what the kings had. A Felinor stole something. He's brought before the king, he begs for mercy. He knows he's going to die. And the king pardons him. This man, he lets him go. That's power, Drallis. That is power.}} ==Description== '''Emar Vend''' is a rogue Authority [[Oath: Chainwarden|Chainwarden]] who is the captor of an [[Chained Captive|Authority Soldier]]. He is part of the obtainment of [[Oath: Chainwarden]]. He wields a Darksteel Greatsword with the Metal [[Enchantments|Enchantment]] and uses [[Oath: Chainwarden|Chainwarden]] mantras. ==Tips== *He really isn't that big of a deal. Try to think of him like a strong [[Bandit]]: just parry his attacks and strike right after with an M1. Just try not to block too much, as his weapon deals a lot of posture damage. *Putting your [[Guild Base]] outside and luring him into the basement of the building might be a good strategy: when below half health, get out and get into your base to regenerate (if you have a [[Campfire]]). The alternative could be to place a Campfire. *He only has one ranged attack, [[Caltrops]]. Using your own ranged attacks might give you a better chance against him. ==Moves== Emar Vend wields a Metal Darksteel Greatsword, Two of the three [[Chainwarden]] Mantras, and [[Caltrops]]. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Emar Vend performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |

==Description==
Emel was an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]] who was a member of [[The Ministry]].

They used to give you a mission requiring the player to kill another player in the [[Songseeker Wilds]]. Returning to Emel with the mission completed granted positive [[Reputation]] with the Ministry and a payment for your deeds.

==Location==
Emel was found on a small islet located on the outskirts of the port of [[Summer Isle]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Emel Location.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan = "2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} You, you! Little killer! Looking for some fun?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} Maybe I am.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} Splendid, splendid! We'll make a deal. You can do a fun little party trick for me, and I'll pay you notes and good favor.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} Very well, I'm in.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} Oh, great, great! You're going to kill someone. Specifically, any poor sap you find on Songseeker. Sound good? Do the job, and return to me. They'll have to be as smart as yourself, you know!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] 

|-|Subsequent Encounters=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest in progress=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} Hello, fool! Have you completed your '''PARTY TRICK''' for me yet?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} I have not yet.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} AH! Have you forgotten your '''TASK'''? Kill a living being as smart as you anywhere on Songseeker, and then come back to me.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] 
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest end=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} Hello, fool! Have you completed your '''PARTY TRICK''' for me yet?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} I've eliminated the target.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan = "1" {{!}} Look at you! Blood on your hands! '''KILLER''', are you proud? Hah! Very well. A deal's a deal. Come back to me if you want to perform for me again.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
}}
</tabber>

==Trivia==
*Emel's racial variant was Boulder.
*Due to the similarity in name and [[Aspects|Aspect]] variant, Emel may have been a sibling of [[Imel]]. 
*On the {{VersionHistory|2026|August 12th}} update, Emel was removed.

==Description==
Emil is a young [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They are a student at the [[Temple of the Blade]].

Emil believes [[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]]'s strength is fading and hopes to surpass him. They will ask [[The Inheritor]] to bring them a [[Weapon Manual]] so that they can become stronger and surpass Legato.

Emil is located inside of the [[Temple Sparring Hall]].

Emotes are gestures or poses a player can use. The default input to select emotes is {{Input|keybind|K}}. To use an emote click the emote name in the emote selection UI.

== Description ==
The '''Enchant Grease''' is a mythical-tier [[Relics|Relic]] that can be used to apply an [[Enchantments|Enchantment]] to your currently held Equipment. Each vial is imbued with a random enchant. When used, an option will appear to choose what Equipment item you wish to enchant, Once one is selected it will ask if this is the equipment you wish to enchant and soulbind. After usage, The enchant grease will disappear from the inventory. Your selected equipment will receive the enchantment provided by the enchant grease.
==Obtainment==
=== Non-Exclusive Enchants ===
All but one of the game's Enchant Greases have non-exclusive obtainment locations, meaning there are several options available to you for their obtainment. There are three main ways to obtain an Enchant Grease.
*Exchanging {{c|medallions|5}} to [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris]] for a random enchant grease.
*Exchanging {{c|knowledge|5}} to [[Laplace]] for a random enchant grease.
*Chance to obtain from a chest in [[The Diluvian Mechanism]], [[War Mode]], and the [[Galewax]] Room in the [[Second Layer]] of the Depths.

=== Exclusive Enchants ===
These Enchant Greases can only be obtained through certain methods. Currently, the Rain enchantment is the only exclusive Enchant Grease.
*Sold by [[The Gaunt Man]] for 25 [[Rain Spire]]s and {{c|Crowns|10}}.

*You can use Enchant Grease on already enchanted equipment, it'll just switch the enchant.

==Description==
The '''Enchant Stone''' is a mythical-tier [[Relics|Relic]] that can be used to apply an [[Enchantments|Enchantment]] to your currently equipped weapon. Each stone is imbued with a random enchant or curse. When used, an option will appear to confirm if this is the weapon you wish to enchant and soulbind. After usage, an animation will play and the enchant stone will disappear from the inventory. Your current weapon will receive the enchantment provided by the enchant stone. This can also be used to re-roll enchants on already enchanted weapons

==Obtainment==
There are multiple ways to obtain an Enchant Stone, the usual and best source being from the [[Second Layer]]. The ways of obtainment are as follows:

===Non-Exclusive Enchants===
Most of the game's Enchant Stones have non-exclusive obtainment locations, meaning there are several options available to you for their obtainment.
*Exchanging {{c|Medallions|5}} to [[Klaris]] for a random non-exclusive Enchant Stone.
*Chance to obtain from a chest from several bosses including: the [[Heart of Enmity]], [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]], the [[Dread Serpent]], [[Scion of Ethiron]], and [[Chaser]].
*Chance to obtain from a chest from several dungeons including: [[Second Layer]], [[The Diluvian Mechanism]], and [[Saramaed Hollow]].
*Chance to obtain from [[War Mode]] and [[Hell Mode]].
*Unlocking the [[Galewax]] Room from the [[Second Layer]]. This room always contains three tiny chests, that have a '''25%''' chance of providing a random non-exclusive Enchant Stone per chest. If not an Enchant Stone, it's a random [[Weapons|Kyrsweapon]].
*Certain enchants can additionally be sold during [[Traan Zakshun|Traan Zakshun's]] black market for {{c|crowns|5}}, but are otherwise non-exclusive enchants.
*[[Crafting]] them with any other Enchant Stone and two catalyst ingredients. The recipe depends on the Enchant Stone; see their individual pages or the main [[Enchantments]] page.

===Exclusive Enchants===
These Enchant Stones can only be obtained through certain methods. These are: Astral, Bluster, Curse of Ysley's Ember, Curse of The Authoritative, Curse of Void, Harrowing, Nightbringer, Parasol's Blight, and Windswept.
*'''''[[Astral]]''''' can only be obtained from the [[Weird Trader]], in the chest at [[Moon's Eyrie]], or as a drop from [[Star Knight]]s and [[Moon Knight]]s. Astral can also be sold for {{c|crowns|10}} in [[Traan Zakshun|Traan Zakshun's]] black market.
*'''''[[Bluster]]''''' can be obtained from [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] or bought from [[Traan Zakshun]] in his black market for {{c|crowns|5}}.
*'''''[[Curse of Captain Greene]]''''' can be exclusively bought from [[The Gaunt Man]] for 1 [[Exotic Hide]].
*'''''[[Curse of the Authoritative]]''''' can only be obtained from [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]].
*'''''[[Curse of Void]]''''' can exclusively be bought from [[The Gaunt Man]] for 25 [[Void Spire]]s and {{c|Crowns|10}}.
*'''''[[Curse of Ysley's Ember]]''''' Enchant Stone can be obtained by defeating [[Hive Construct]]s or [[Rogue Construct]]s as a direct drop, turning in an [[Artifacts|Aratel Artifact]] to a Banker, rarely from [[Fishing]] chests, [[Primadon]] and [[Elder Primadon]] chests, or in any [[Starswept Valley]] chest (rarely). Ysley's Ember can also be sold for {{c|crowns|8}} in [[Traan Zakshun|Traan Zakshun's]] black market.
*'''''[[Harrowing]]''''' can be purchased from any [[Blacksmith]] for {{c|knowledge|10}} if you have the 2023 [[Seasonal Medals|Hallowtide Medallion]], bought from [[Glaive Spellhardt]] during the [[Hallowtide]] event for 150 Joy, or found in the [[Goodie Bag]].
*'''''[[Kyrsan Chill]]''''' can only be obtained from the [[Kyrsgarde Champion]].
*'''''[[Nightbringer]]''''' drops directly from [[Parliament]] and [[Prime Megalodaunt]]s. It is guaranteed to drop from Parliament.
*'''''[[Parasol's Blight]]''''' can be exclusively bought from [[The Gaunt Man]] for 1 [[Parasol Part]].
*'''''[[Suffocated (enchantment)|Suffocated]]''''' is exclusively obtained by [[crafting]] 1 [[Windswept]] Enchant Stone and 2 [[Gale Essence]] at the {{craft|Leiuna}}.
*'''''[[Windswept]]''''' can only be obtained from [[Kyrsgarde Champion]] and [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]].

===[[Vow of Iron]] Enchantments===
*'''''[[Ether Surge]]''''' is exclusive to the [[Ether Erudite]] [[Memento]].

==Trivia==  
*You can't use enchant stones to enchant legendary weapons.
*You can use enchant stones on already enchanted weapons, it will replace the current enchant on the weapon.
*You can sell enchant stones for 200 Notes.
*You can't drop enchant stones.
*You can pass down Enchant Stones through the [[Hippocampal Pool]] for 40 [[Echoes]].
*Complex to explain, but you can use Enchant Stones on starter weapons you bought. However, you normally can't use them on the very first starter weapon your character begins with. When trying to use on your first starter weapon, dialogue appears saying "This weapon is corrupted, denying the stone." For some ungodly reason; if you unequip then re-equip the weapon, the weapon isn't corrupt anymore.
*Enchant Stones are similar to enchant shards, that were previously removed from the game.

'''''NOTE: If adding Enchantment-related information, remember to update both this page and the Enchantment's own page.''''' '''Enchantments''' are powerful upgrades for your [[Weapons]] & [[Equipment]].
[[File:Enchanticon.png|right|thumb|280px]]
== Acquirement Methods == Enchantments have a set chance to be applied to a weapon during the following scenarios. * Chiefly, any gear you find in chests, craft, or get dropped by enemies have a small chance to be enchanted. (even if the item is normally unenchantable, except Rings, Torso and Face slot gear, which cannot be enchanted unless they already had an enchantment before the verse 2 update). *Talking to [[Laplace]] and trading three enchanted items for a new random enchant on your equipped [[Weapons|weapon]]. Note that all Enchants added within the Layer 2 update and forwards are '''not''' rollable, such as Stormbreaker, Nemisis, Curse of Ysley's Ember, Etc. *[[Laplace]] lets you turn in 5 [[Knowledge]] for a random [[Enchant Grease]] * Talking to [[Calamus]] and completing her quest can give you 1 enchant Item. *Talking to [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]] allows you to turn in 5 [[Kyrsan Medallions]] for a random Enchant Grease or Enchant Stone. *Using an [[Enchant Stone]] or [[Enchant Grease]] to apply an enchantment to a weapon or piece of equipment respectively. *Non-exclusive [[Enchant Stone]]s and [[Enchant Grease]] can be [[Crafting|crafted]] by using two ''catalyst'' ingredients and any other Enchant Stone/Grease. *Certain activities can provide heaps of Enchant Stones and more rarely Greases, these include but not limited to: **Certain [[Bosses]] **[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] **[[Saramaed Hollow]] *{{craft|station|Crafting}} ==Mechanics== Enchanted weapons/equipment have special mechanics compared to their regular counterparts. Enchanted items cannot be dropped on death. *Equipping an enchanted item for the first time will Soulbound it to you. Soulbounded items cannot be dropped. However, they can still be unequipped, stored in your bank or sold to an antiquarian. *Enchanted items can be passed down at the [[Hippocampal Pool]] at a cost of 40 [[Echoes]] per item. *Items cannot be "un-enchanted", however, another Enchant Stone or Grease can be used on it to replace the enchantment. *You cannot 'stack' two of the same enchantment; If you obtain a helmet with Multiplicity while having boots with Multiplicity equipped, you can't equip the Multiplicity helmet. Alternatively, if you gain Multiplicity on your helmet through [[Klaris]] while having Multiplicity boots equipped, only one instance of Multiplicity will function. ==Variants== There are two variants that enchantments come in: *'''Blessing -''' They have an effect with little to no downsides. *'''Curse -''' They have an effect along with a downside with the severity depending on the upside. ''For a showcase of all enchants in action, view [https://youtu.be/Ydl4gd2lBYQ this video.]'' ==List of Enchantments== |-|Weapons= {{#tag:tabber|Blessings= {{EnchantCard|newtable |name=Astral |style=text-shadow: #9900ff 1px 1px 15px; color: #8533ff; |image=Enchant Astral.gif |desc=Grants +20% weapon damage in PvE. Call down stars alongside your critical attacks, and after parrying thrice. |effect=Gain a +20% damage buff to your M1s in PvE. This bypasses both the soft and hard damage modifier caps. Upon landing your critical attack or parrying 3 times in a row, a star will rain down and explode, dealing 4% health damage in PvP or 100 PvE damage in a small AoE. |obtainment=Astral is exclusively obtained from its [[Enchant Stone]]. Astral Enchant Stone can be obtained from:

Burn damage scales on Flamecharm investment. Procs an Eruption instead if you have [[Talents#Eruption Path: Lava Serpent|Eruption Path]]. Landing additional hits while this is active will extend the duration. |desc=Landing enough light attacks gives you infinite ether for some time. |obtainment={{iv|Ether Erudite}} Memento }} |-|Unobtainable= {{#tag:tabber|Specs= {{EnchantCard|newtable |name=JOE's |style=text-shadow: #181d26 1px 1px 15px; color: #f2f2f2; |image=JOE.gif |desc=It stands for Judicator's Original Enchantment. An enchant that was supposed to be only for the strongest of monster slayers. No one knows what happened to the original Judicator who made this enchant. |effect=Landing M1s builds stacks for the critical attack. On critical attack, plunge your weapon into the ground and stop time in an AoE around you. The size of the AoE and the duration of the time stop scale on the amount of stacks you had. 1 hit = +1 second. Upon being guardbroken, negate the guardbreak stun. |obtainment=Unobtainable. When JOE's was obtainable, it was a potential reward from events hosted by Agamatsu. }} {{EnchantCard |name=Life Weave|link=Life Weave (enchantment) |style=text-shadow: gold 1px 1px 15px; color: cyan; |image=Enchant Life Weave.gif |effect=Unknown |obtainment=Unobtainable }} {{EnchantCard |name=Tainted Sorrow |style=text-shadow: #4749ae 1px 1px 15px; color: #a8b2d7; |image=Enchant Tainted Sorrow.gif |effect=On hit, the critical attack is replaced with the ability to pull/fling the victim towards the user with a corresponding small pillar effect. Flourishing makes all subsequent attacks fling the target upward. |obtainment=Unobtainable }} {{EnchantCard|end |name=Unstable |style=text-shadow: white 1px 1px 15px; color: gray; |image=Enchant Unstable.gif |effect=Every hit has an individual 10% chance to proc any other enchantment in the game. If a hit count-based enchantment is procced, you will gain 1 stack for that enchantment. |obtainment=Unobtainable }} {{!}}-{{!}}Removed= {{EnchantCard|newtable |name=Auto-Repair |style=text-shadow: white 1px 1px 15px; color: white; |image=Enchant Auto-Repair.gif |effect=An enchantment that Arch_Mage forgot to remove in the initial week of Deepwoken's release, and has since become unobtainable. Arch has confirmed there was no data associated with this. As such, we don't know the true function of this enchant. |obtainment=Unobtainable }} {{EnchantCard|end |name=Curse of Zariffs Absorption |style=text-shadow: white 1px 1px 15px; color: #f4bfe6; |image=Enchant Curse of Zariffs Absorption.gif |effect=Confirmed by yayafino, this enchantment let the user temporarily steal their opponent's enchantment on hit. |obtainment=Unobtainable }} }} ==Gallery== ===Old Enchants===
==Trivia== *Curse of the No Life King has the most individual changes of any thing in Deepwoken, and is made fun of within the community as being the most nerfed thing in the game. *Enchanted equipment used to not be able to be smelted by [[Jarvis]]. When attempted, he would respond with: "Huh? What're you doing bringing something like that to me, go take that wicked thing somewhere else." *Having a shield, offhand pistol, or parrying dagger equipped along with an enchant will transfer the visual effect and properties of said enchant to the offhand. **Equipping an enchanted item as a sidearm will have its enchantment be overridden by your main weapon, including the lack of an enchantment. *Providence of Storms, an enchant widely believed to be a removed enchant that combined Providence's Thorns and Obfuscation, was proven to be fake by Developer yayafino on January 1, 2023 on [https://clips.twitch.tv/ColdHardHawkSaltBae-Wlqrq5amEJHlJIir DaboSenpai's stream]. *Astral previously required having met a [[Developer Specs/Iltria|Wishmaker]] to obtain the enchant. *If you plan to use Deferred for its damage increase, do note that unless your damage is above or equal to 83, 61, or 50 for heavy medium and light respectfully, it is generally better to use Detonation instead. *Most, if not all curse enchantments emit sound when equipped, with some being louder than others. *In Verse 1, it was possible to obtain enchanted torso, face, or ring equipment. *The thunder strike caused by using Storm and Stormbreaker during the rain trains your [[Thundercall]] by a seemingly noticeable portion. *If you were to have more than three equipment enchants equipped at once via unobtainable items, one of those enchants will be automatically disabled. Head, arms, and leg equipment that cannot normally be enchanted also count towards this limit. *There is an exceptionally small chance that ''any'' head, arms, and legs equipment can be enchanted upon dropping in a chest or being crafted, even if they are unenchantable via any other means. This allows some players to obtain items like a Drowned [[Necrotic Cowl]]. *A few enchants are based on other series and shows. **Elastic is a reference to Hisoka's Bungee Gum from ''Hunter x Hunter'', hence why it was called Bungee Gum previously. **Nemesis' visuals and sound effects are based off the cursed status from ''Spiral Knights''. **Bounce, Viscosity, Deferred and Stench are most likely a reference to glyphs and enchantments from ''Shattered Pixel Dungeon.'' **Stormbreaker is based mechanically on Thor from ''God of War'' and it's namesake is the mythical axe ''Stormbreaker'' wielded by Thor from ''Avengers: Infinity War.'' **The sound effect for the Displacement proc is taken from ''The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild's'' Remote Bomb explosion. **Curse of The No Life King is a reference to [https://grimgar.fandom.com/wiki/No-Life_King the No Life King] from ''Fantasy of Grimgar and Ash''. It might also be a reference to ''Hellsing'', where Alucard's alias is "No-Life King".[[File:Nolifekingreference.png|500px]] ==Changelogs== *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|January 2nd}}''' - [[Hero Blades|Hero Blade of Flame, Frost, Lightning, Shadow & Wind]] can no longer be enchanted. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|February 18th}}''' - You can't have more than one of a specific enchant equipped at a time. - Limited to have 3 enchanted equipment. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|March 27th}}''' - Enchant rates have been buffed by 3x. - Enchanted equipment is soulbound when you equip it. - Enchants could no longer drop on death. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|April 11th}}''' - Enchant rates have been buffed by an unknown amount. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|June 27th}}''' - Enchanted equipment could be now smelted at [[Jarvis]]. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|September 12th}}''' - In celebration of Deepwoken obtaining the Best New Game award in the Roblox Innovation Awards, enchant rate have been increased by 2x temporarily (made permanent on '''{{VersionHistory|2022|October 3rd}}''') *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|September 13th}}''' - Enchanted weapons and equipment are now at least 1 star by default. Armors and weapons obtained before this date will remain starless if not equipped or re-equipped. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|September 19th}}''' - Weapons can be enchanted with a random enchant by giving 3 equipment enchants to [[Laplace]]. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|December 23rd}}''' - [[Enchant Stone]]s were added. *'''{{VersionHistory|2022|December 24th}}''' - Armor pieces can now be given a random Enchant from [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris]], by trading in 5 [[Kyrsan Medallions|Medallions]] from Layer 2. *'''{{VersionHistory|2023|January 16th}}''' - [[:Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments|These enemies and humanoid monsters]] had a chance to spawn wielding enchanted weaponry. *'''{{VersionHistory|2023|February 13th}}''' - [[Light's Final Toll]] can no longer be enchanted. *'''{{VersionHistory|2023|August 25th}}''' - [[:Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments|These enemies and humanoid monsters]] can now spawn with enchants again. *'''{{VersionHistory|2023|September 29th}}''' - [[Astral]] is made publicly available. *'''{{VersionHistory|2023|November 3rd}}''' - [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide]] Enchant: [[Harrowing]] is made publicly available. *'''{{VersionHistory|2024|April 5th}}''' - [[Railblade]]s are no longer considered Legendary Weapons, thus they can be enchanted. *'''{{VersionHistory|2024|July 12th}}''' - The weapon enchant [[Curse of Repulsion]] was added. *'''{{VersionHistory|2024|August 23rd}}''' - Equipment enchantments can now be obtained via [[Enchant Grease]] [[Relic]] through [[Laplace]] or [[Klaris]]. *'''{{VersionHistory|2025|February 1st}}''' - The weapon enchant [[Curse of Rhaemen's Ember]] is added. *'''{{VersionHistory|2025|July 7th}}''' - The weapon enchants [[Curse of Void|Void (Curse of Void)]], [[Parasol's Blight]] and [[Nightbringer]] were added, the equipment enchantment [[Rain (enchantment)|Rain]] was also added. *'''{{VersionHistory|2025|July 15th}}''' - The weapon enchant Void was renamed to [[Curse of Void]]. *'''{{VersionHistory|2025|July 25th}}''' - The weapon enchants [[Windswept]], [[Curse of the Authoritative]], and [[Bluster]] were added *'''{{VersionHistory|2025|August 4th}}''' - [[Curse of Rhaemen's Ember]] was renamed to [[Curse of Ysley's Ember]] *'''{{VersionHistory|2026|Febuary 16th}}''' - The [[Kyrsan Chill]] weapon enchant was added, [[Curse of Captain Greene]] and [[Suffocated (enchantment)|Suffocated]] weapon enchants were made publically obtainable. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Enchants}} [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Equipment]]

''This page is for human 'mob' enemies, for bosses, see [[Bosses]]. For monsters, see [[Monsters]].''
File:003 Chaser GFX Loading Screen.png
'''Enemies''' in ''Deepwoken'' are neutral-hostile humanoid NPCs that will attack the players. However, instead of being aggressive to everything, some of these NPCS will attack selectively, such as based on your reputation. == Overview == Beyond the safety of cities and towns, and sometimes even in them, there are humanoid NPCs that lurk within islands; either ambushing players, patrolling a certain area, or settling down around a campfire or stronghold. They serve as tools for player to advance their skills, unlock new areas, unlock better equipment and armor, or simply to act as a skill check. They could shred any players who are unskilled or unprepared, but like monsters, they can also be learnt. Depending on who they are, they can vary in their skill, equipment, and attunements. Each Enemy also has their aspect's unique passive, though this only really applies to Etreans, Canors, Felinors and Vesperians. Some Humanoid enemies also have a chance to spawn with '''[[Enchantments|enchanted]]''' weapons. ('''cannot have Curse of the No Life King or Curse of Yun'shul''') This page consists of Humanoid NPCs that fight back or attack you on sight. Includes all Factions. ==Enemies==

content:
{{Quotes|quote=The titans known as Enforcers are faithful servants of the Cathedral, rarely found outside its grounds. It is said that they are the tortured souls of those who have failed the Trial, twisted into fiends that deny mortal souls salvation.|author=Enforcer's Axe description}}{{Monster Infobox |title1=Enforcer|caption1="The Final boss from the voices."|drops= *[[Enforcer's Axe]] *[[Enforcer's Blade]] *[[Enforcer's Hammer]] *[[Enforcer Plate]] *[[Enforcer Boots]] *[[Enforcer Eye]] *[[Mantra Modifiers]]|attacks=*High Swing *Low Swing *Kick *Whirlwind *Space Pull *Feint |locations=*[[The Depths]] Trial *[[Hell Mode]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Trial of One]] *Summoned by the [[Heart of Enmity]] |health=3,600 (Sword)
*4,000 (Axe)
*4,100 (Hammer)
*10,250 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}}
*8,000 (Servant of Enmity)
*20,000 (Servant of Enmity {{cl|corrupted|Corrupted)}}
*800 {{To1Color|(Trial of One)}}
|image1= Sword Enforcer.png|Sword Enforcer.png|Axe Hammer Enforcer.png|Hammer |challenges= {{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== '''The Enforcer''' is a Depths [[Bosses|Mini-Boss]] that acts as the second to last trial of [[The Depths]] Trials, being a difficult trial for anyone that is unfamiliar with it. The Enforcer is said to be simply nothing more than "a destructive construct, made to kill those who tried to escape The Depths," but its origins are more complicated; according to the flavor text of the Enforcer's weapons, Enforcers are the souls of people who failed their own [[First Layer|Depths Trial]] and were morphed (assumedly by the Voices of the Cathedral) to be used as an obstacle for the player's own trial. The Axe Enforcer is the main type, but there is also an Enforcer's Hammer and Enforcer's Blade variant. The only significant differences between these are minor changes in size, health, damage, and posture damage. Besides these, they act identically to normal Enforcers. == Attacks== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Visual Demo |- |
'''High Swing'''
(★★☆) |The Enforcer lifts its weapon high and swings it down. *This is a slower attack that does high health and posture damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Enforcer_high_swing.gif|center]] |- |
'''Low Swing'''
(★★☆) |The Enforcer puts its weapon to its side, and swings it horizontally in a swiping motion. *This attack is faster but does less health and posture damage than High Swing. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Enforcer low swing.gif|center]] |- |
'''Kick'''
(★★☆) |The Enforcer kicks straight forward, throwing anyone hit far back and dazing them. *This does low damage with moderate knockback. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Enforcer kick.gif|center]] |- |
'''Whirlwind'''
(★★☆) |The Enforcer begins to spin rapidly from the waist-up while holding its weapon out, walking towards the closest opponent (fairly slowly) to cut them apart. *This attack is rarely used in close quarters. *This attack grants high autoparry frames. *This is typically used after Kick if it lands. *This attack hurts a lot if not properly defended/avoided *The Servants of Enmity cannot use this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Enforcer whirlwind.gif|center]] |- |
'''Space Pull'''
(★☆☆) |The Enforcer holds its hand out and pulls the nearest person to it, leaving them hanging in the air for a moment. *This attack is typically used at the start of the fight, or if the player '''runs too far away'''. *Enforcers spawned during [[Hell Mode]] will not be able to use this attack. *The Servants of Enmity cannot use this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, pull }} |[[File:Enforcer pull.gif]] |- |
'''Feint'''
(★★☆) |The Enforcer halts their attack mid-way in an attempt to mixup their opponent and create an opening. *The Enforcer only feints its swing attacks. *If The Enforcer feints and you whiff your parry, '''dodge''' the next attack instead of attempting to parry it. *You could also hold f on your failed parry to block it, but this is reliant on you having spare posture. {{AttackTags |misc, unharmful }} |[[File:Enforcer feint.gif|center]] |} ==Finishers== {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name !Media !Description |- |'''Headsplitter''' |[[File:Enforcer execute.gif]] |The Enforcer holds its weapon up with one hand, and smashes it down on any player, killing them, a reference to the [[:Category:Greataxes|Greataxes']] grip execution. |} ==Passives== *'''Resilient -''' Monsters damage buffs are half as effective against them. *'''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal around 30-40% less damage to Enforcers. ==Combat== The Enforcer is definitely a shake-up to the game's formula. Up to the point at which you encounter it, the game has been throwing progressively ''stronger and stronger'' mobs at you. Big, slow, tanky. Standing still, parrying and dodging usually does the trick. The Enforcer, however, is completely different from other [[Enemies]] and [[Monsters]]. Statwise, it is quite weak, with only (3700, 4000 or 4100 depending on the variant) health. This sounds like a lot, but if taking PvE scaling into account, even at the earliest level you can fight him, [[Power]] 16 (this can get lower based on your drown count), it would have about 890 health. Still large, but nowhere too big. Additionally, its attacks essentially do as much damage as a normal heavy weapon approximately would do to you, therefore you would have to be hit quite a number of times to die plainly from Axe hits. Do not be deceived by these stats, though. The dangerous part of the Enforcer isn't its stats, but its complexity and how it uses them. It draws the line between enemy and monster, being vaguely humanoid and being able to do things like feint, parry, and block, but still having higher strength than any normal enemy. It can chain together entire strings of parries, feints, basic attacks and special attacks. Even though the danger falls off in the far endgame, it can still kill any overconfident high level player. Ultimately, it's the definition of a skill check rather than a stat check. ===Tips=== *Get familiar with the Enforcer. Watch videos, watch guides with it, watch streams, watch as much as you can about the fight, and what goes down. Fighting it blindly on your first attempt, let alone on a power 17+ character, will surely lead to death. Its design and role are an integral part of the fight, with you knowing that if you die, you'll get wiped. Keep calm and react accordingly. *The biggest thing about the Enforcer is the feints; when it does this, dodge. **Holding F to parry will allow you to block the Enforcer's following attack if it feints, but blocking is not as sustainable as dodging, and getting posture broken could be deadly. **Try to roll cancel when dodging Enforcers; not putting distance between you and it will prevent it from getting an easy opportunity to Whirlwind, as it mostly uses its other attacks at medium to long range. *Whirlwind is by far its most heavy-hitting attack, but the Enforcer can be outran and damaged with ranged attacks while it's spinning. Experienced players may be able to spam parry it (similarly to a [[Rock Golem]]'s spin) but this is inherently risky. **Although more difficult and quite a bit more risky, you can actually m1 while spam parrying to deal more damage to it, and maybe even block break it *Mantras with a long wind up and no hyperarmor are not recommended as the enforcer is very likely to interrupt it, although certain mantras may break the enforcers Ai making it turn its back on the player essentially allowing for a safe kill. *Use heavy attacks if possible. There's a chance that The Enforcer will parry or block them, but if it lands, it will deal high damage and will usually posture break it, allowing you to hit it freely for a moment. Be wary on your timing though, as you won't want to be stuck charging a critical while it's Whirlwinding you. **Don't over-commit on counter attacks, the Enforcer has permanent hyper-armor and cannot be stunned or dazed by normal M1s. **Feinting can force it to react defensively. All in all, keep your nerves hardened, don't be fooled by the intimidating situation and appearance, and most of all, do not be afraid to encounter it. You will eventually have to fight it, at least once, so it's better to fight it on your own terms. Sending yourself to The Depths just to beat The Enforcer for closure, even once, may serve as a huge confidence boost for the future. Trying to fight it in trial of one might not be a bad idea either as it's easier to access early game and less risky if you die as such, just make sure you can reach it first. '''''If you're a freshie reading this page and about to do the Enforcer trial for the first time, good luck! Remember not to panic, and focus on parry trading. You got this!''''' ===Rewards=== *'''[[Enforcer's Axe]]:''' An endgame weapon of choice for heavy users, this Axe has some of the highest damage potential in the game. Requires 75 HVY to use. *'''[[Enforcer's Blade]]:''' A greatsword that serves as a middle point between the Axe and Hammer, having a decent amount of posture damage and chip damage but lacking in the ability to instantly guardbreak on critical. Fairly rare drop, requiring 80 HVY and 25 STR to use. *'''[[Enforcer's Hammer]]:''' Like the Enforcer's Blade, the Hammer is also a rare drop. Boasts superior posture damage and requires 80 HVY and 25 STR to use. *'''[[Resonance|Resonance Progress]]:''' The Enforcer gives a moderate amount of Resonance EXP, and more if fought with the corresponding Nature. *'''[[Enforcer Eye]]:''' A rare drop used to obtain the Enforcer Pull [[Monster Mantras|Monster Mantra]]. *'''[[Enforcer Plate]]:''' An equipment piece under the arms category. Enforcer Plate is a set of black plated shoulder guards. *'''[[Enforcer Boots]]:''' An equipment piece under the legs category. Enforcer Boots are a set of black plated boots. ==Gallery== File:Enforcer Concept Art.png|Concept Art File:Thorndemon.png|Concept Art Enforcer Model Render.png|Model Render File:Enforcer closeup.png|Enforcer close-up File:Enforcerdepths.png|Ditto File:EnforcersTemplate.png|[[Enforcer's Axe]] (Old Model) File:Enforcer's model.png|The Enforcer as featured in Agamatsu's Deepwoken Teaser File:TrialEnforcer.png|The Enforcer in the [[Trial of One]], prior to the Enforcer Axe model rework File:Enforcer spots player.png|The Enforcer performing its Whirlwind attack File:Enforcer's Backshot.png|The Enforcer from behind File:Enforcer idle animation.gif|Enforcer's Idle animation File:Enmity enforcer.png|An Enforcer spawned by the Heart of Enmity File:Enmity servant.png|A Servant of Enmity after being spawned ==Trivia== *The Enforcer can pull you through emotes that don't anchor you down; for example, the "Griddy" emote will not affect Enforcer's pull, meanwhile the "Resting" emote will. *It is possible to cheese it by just running away and throwing potions/bombs or glitching outside the trial room and hitting it through the walls. *After the 18/07/2022 update, The Enforcer cannot use its pull attack when Hell Mode is active, due to too many Enforcers pulling people into the void. *During the weekly update for 21/11/2022, The Enforcer could temporarily spawn as corrupted variants. This lead to 12000 health Enforcers which did 100+ damage per hit, wiping many players. *Enforcer's Eye, Giant Femur and Dread Serpent's Tooth are the only [[Monster Mantras|Monster Mantra Drops]] to have boosted drop rates out of the other mobs that have one. *The Enforcer's Blade Variant is physically smaller than The Enforcer's Axe Variant, Meanwhile The Enforcer's Hammer Variant is bigger than The Enforcer's Axe Variant. *If The Enforcer spawns attuned to [[Shadowcast]], due to its black effects, its animations can be semi-hidden by the particles. *Ironically, The Enforcer is really easy to beat using their own weapon critical. By parrying their attack once then using the Enforcer weapon critical. Using this method repeatedly will kill The Enforcer in a short time without any risk of wiping. *Very easy to cheese with any sort of burst of hits, like relentless flames, rapid punches, and the like, as it will usually try to block it which means you get a lot of posture damage in. staying defensive as you hit trade and then hitting one of those moves will usually posture break it/give you an opening to then do damage. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:The Depths]]

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage reduction equipment [[enchantment]] that grants damage reduction on proc, at the cost of slowing yourself.

==Effect==
Upon taking damage from a humanoid target, {{PAGENAME}} has a 20% chance to proc. On proc, the user will gain the {{status|Entangled Defence}} status effect, granting 10% damage reduction for 5 seconds at the cost of being slowed by 30%. Unless the user is casting a Mantra, this slow will be reduced to 22.5% due to the innate slow resistance players have.

This has no cooldown. If this enchantment procs while it is currently active, the damage reduction will refresh its duration, and the slow will stack.

===Notes===
*This enchantment does not proc against non-humanoids.
*Damaging status effects cannot initially proc this enchantment, however, the damage reduction from this enchantment will apply to them if it activates.
*The 10% damage reduction also applies to the hit that procced this enchant.
