'''Environmental Hazards''' are time/location-based events or dangers. While called "hazards," these can be used to your advantage and even directly help players.                                                                                          

<tabber>

|-|Weather=

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center"
|+ Weather consists of events that trigger due to RNG or timed events.
|-
! Name: !! Found: !! Effects
|-
|Rain
|Everywhere (Excluding Starswept Valley, [[The Depths|Depths]]), summoned via [[Rain Spire]] and [[Rain (enchantment)|Rain]] enchantment. 
|Procs certain Talents, all uncovered lit campfires are snuffed out after a few seconds (not including Flamecharm's [[Graceful Flame]]). [[Flamecharm]] receives a 10% damage debuff unless the {{t|Unyielding Inferno}} Talent is used. All [[Thundercall]] damage gains a 5% damage buff, which can be increased further with {{t|Stratoshock}}. Rainclouds will appear as dark smudges on the Map.
|-
|Hail || Everywhere (except Starswept Valley) during Winter, Upper [[Minityrsa]] (Always), summoned via [[Rain Spire]] and [[Rain (enchantment)|Rain]] enchantment. || Moderate vison obstruction, procs certain Talents. Additionally, all uncovered lit campfires are snuffed out. Grants all [[Frostdraw]] damage a 10% damage buff.
|-
|Acid Rain || [[Upper Erisia]], summoned via [[Rain Spire]] and [[Rain (enchantment)|Rain]] enchantment. || Passively damages the player by about ~1,3%/second and drains their armor. Damage and armor damage taken can be negated by using the [[Survivalist]] Boon. [[Etrean]]s take less damage from Acid Rain.
|-
|Sandstorm || [[Starswept Valley]] || Obstructs vision. All uncovered lit campfires will be snuffed out after a slight while.
|- 
|Day and Night Cycle || Everywhere (Except Depths) || Mostly visual difference, though some Talents and Flaws may cause various effects. [[Deep Owl]]s which spawn in the overworld will only spawn at night. Daylight lasts 2h and 45min and Night lasts 1h and 45min for a total of 4h 30min total.
|-
|Parasites || [[Second Layer]] || Parasites stick onto the player and after 5 of them are stuck, the player will instantly die. Parasites can be removed using the lanterns located across layer 2. Survivalist boon increases the amount of time you can survive by 2 minutes. The [[Wormwarder Lantern]] and [[Grand Fisher Helm]] grant full immunity to this.
|-
|Heavy Wind || [[Second Layer]] and [[Moon's Eyrie]] || Halts movement to a crawl when affecting a player. If the player does not face the wind and move forward it will ragdoll the player and fling them in the direction of the wind. The [[Delver Boots]] grants full immunity to the flinging effect. Found in Floor 1 of the [[Second Layer]], on bridges in the 2nd part of the floor and in the bridges to go to the top of Moon's Eyrie. Also increases parasite gain.

==Description==
Epsi is a [[Gremor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a young boy working for [[The Ignition Union]].

Epsi is encountered in the [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|Second Layer]]. Saving him is required to unlock the [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]] [[Oaths|Oath]].

His aspect variant doesn't appear in game, as no [[Gremor]] has white horns, nor pale skin.

==Trivia==
*Epsi is likely named after Epsilon, the equivalent of the letter 'E' in the Greek alphabet, as many of the other members of the Ignition Union in the area are named after Greek letters.
*Epsi, due to being a child, possesses a shorter model than other NPCs, being the only one to do so other than [[Karliah]].
**An NPC in the tutorial, [[Serendi]], is mentioned to be shorter than the player and thus needs to stand on crates to be at eye level with the player, despite being standard height. It may simply be that small character models are reserved for children.
*As a child working for the Ignition Union, Epsi is both a minor, an individual not yet of the age of legal responsibility, and a miner, someone who works in a mine.

'''''FOREWORD''': '''An up-to-date spreadsheet with the maximum amount of each stat each equipment can get can be found [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aELC50v4668ss5ShtI2RkshCQCOScH-ljFma_7o_NcY/edit?usp=drivesdk [here]]''''' '''''FOREWORD: A spreadsheet that can calculate the stats for each pip on each equipment can be found [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1flicSgb8pdMw7DKEdk1erfMZPtOF0YPOwuVveDBk6XY/edit?usp=sharing [here]]''''' ''An essential mechanic in Deepwoken, primarily used to resist damage from most sources, while also providing various benefits. It can be used to improve (or worsen) your character's appearance. If you're looking for Armor as in Outfits, then go to [[Outfits]].'' [[File:Item Stat.png|thumb|360x360px|An example of an item with rolled stats (in beige) and guaranteed stats (in grey)]] Equipment is a type of item usually found in chests, but can also be exchanged for using an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] or by various other means. They can be equipped to grant their listed stat bonuses. There are 7 different types of equipment: Head, Arms, Legs, Torso, Face, Ears, and Rings. Most equipment comes with innate stats that always appear, for example: '''+1 Posture''' for the Star Dusters or '''+8 Health''' from an Authority Helm. Some can even have Talents (These Talents cannot be to meet Talent requirements, and they do not grant the Talent's stat bonuses(e.g. you cannot use Mercenary's Boots' Endurance Runner to obtain Conditioned Runner, nor will this equipment grant any Passive Agility)). Talents granted by equipment do not stack with their regular variants. ''Innate stats are displayed in grey'', and {{cl|equiptlnf|''Talents are displayed in light purple''}}. By wearing all equipment within a Set, you may be eligible to obtain the equipment's Set Talent; an additional Talent that is exclusive to that Set. To make up for the Set Talents being exclusive and requiring you to wear equipment that otherwise might not be that good, the Set Talents are very powerful, but niche and specific. Not all equipment sets have a Set Talent. {{cl|settlnf|''Set Talents are displayed in blurple''}}. == Pips == All equipment, when obtained, will roll for random stats in the form of Pips, indicated at the bottom right of the tooltip and at the bottom of the tool. These Pips represent the bonus stats of an item and what amount of the stat they grant. The total amount of Pips an item can have is dictated by their amount of Quality stars and thr Innate Pips the equipment item has, which is a set value per-equipment.
All Pips are displayed in order of rarity, which is: Common, {{cl|uncommonpip|Uncommon}}, {{cl|rarepip|Rare}}, and {{cl|legendarypip|Legendary}} Pips are rolled with stat diversity, requiring that at least two different stats are present, meaning equipment purely consisting of one stat are impossible (bugged or old equipment will be rerolled when equipped). This rule is only applied to equipment that has '''3''' or more pips. Pips can be rerolled with a [[Armorer's Needle]] or [[Gilded Needle]]. The Armorer's Needle will change a Pip of choice into a different, random stat (e.g. Health -> Ether), while the Gilded Needle will allow you to choose what the Pip changes to. Every equipment item you come across has a chance to have quality stars. Quality stars on an equipment item will grant them additional Pips, with the amount of Pips and the Pip types given depending on how many quality stars the equipment item has (see below). You can add quality stars to a pre-existing equipment item by using the [[Forge Needle]]. Additionally, Head, Legs, and Arms equipment gain +1 Health for every quality star they have. Face, Ears, Torso, and Rings equipment cannot have more than two quality stars. The following table showcases the net gain of Pips, Health, and sell cost compared to a 0 starred variant of the same equipment. ==Trivia== *In previous versions of the game, Equipment could occasionally spawn with one of three different rarity tiers: Ascended, Enlightened, or Celestial. This system was replaced with stars for the sake of consistency with weapon rarity. *If you want to wear a specific equipment piece, but it has awful stats, you can [[Smelting|smelt]] something with good stats and apply the piece you want to wear as vanity. *You can't enchant Torso, Face, Ears, and Ring Equipment. However, there's a couple of instances of these items existing due to being obtainable back in [[Verse One]]. There has been evidence shown that unobtainable enchanted equipment won't void even when re-equipped, and the enchant still functions as it normally would (Info from October 12, 2023) *Mythical Pips, despite being said to exist by devs, are unused. No equipment piece uses mythical pips. *Highest theoretical '''Stealth''' kit in game is 30% stealth. (10% [[Dark Owl Chapeau]], 6% [[Mercenary's Garb]]/[[Ministry Cloak]]/[[Dark Owl Cloak]], 5% [[Shrouded Cape]], 6% [[Duelist Mask]], 3% [[Master Thief Earrings]]/[[Ossified Blood Earrings]]) **These will grant a total of 36% Stealth instead if the player is a [[Felinor]]. *Highest theoretical '''Ether''' kit in game is 403 ETH. (30 ETH [[Moon Ring|Moon]] and [[Waning Ring]], x2 24 ETH [[Scaling Rings]]/[[Ferryman's Ring]], 68 ETH (Drowned) [[Diver's Light Plate]] or equivalent, 44 ETH [[Fauld of Enmity]], 64 ETH [[Tillian's Beret]], 54 ETH [[Star Boots]] or equivalent, 30 ETH [[Hivelord Mask]], 35 ETH [[Old Blood Earrings]]) *Highest theoretical '''Posture''' kit is 22.5 Posture. (4x 3 Posture Legendary Rings, 2 Posture [[Legion Helmet]]/[[Gladiator Helm]]/[[Western Outlaw Hat]], 1 Posture [[Threadwork Kilt]], 1 Posture [[Inquisitor's Visor]], 3 Posture [[Glassdancer Wraps]]/[[Moonseye Gauntlets]]/[[Western Outlaw Robes]], 3.5 Posture [[Wartreads of Enmity]] with max Anchor pips) **Conversely, the lowest '''Posture''' you can have on any character is 17, with [[Citadel Frames]] and [[Dark Pearls]]. *Highest theoretical '''Health''' kit in game is 185 HP. (9 HP [[Moon Ring]], 9 HP [[Waning Ring]]s, 26 HP [[Transfusion Ring]], 7 HP [[Scaling Rings|Scaling Ring]]/[[Ferryman's Ring]], 47 HP (Drowned) [[Diver's Light Plate]] or equivalent, 18 [[Fauld of Enmity]], 30 HP [[Silver Knight's Helm]] or equivalent, 32 HP [[Star Boots]] or equivalent, 2 HP [[Dark Pearls]], 5 HP [[Citadel Frames]]) *Having multiple pieces of equipment with [[Drowned]] '''does not increase your stats further'''. *The Damage vs Monsters and Monster Armor pips are the only pip types to be removed from the game. In an update on June 24th, 2025, these stats were effectively made innate with the addition of the [[Bestiary]] system, removing their necessity. Following this change, all DvM pips were transferred into Health or Sanity pips (depending on the equipment type) and all Monster Armor pips were transferred into Physical Resistance pips. {{Nav|Equipment}} [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:In_progress_with_VOI_reason]]

==Description==
Eran was a minor character in the [[book]] [[God in the Machine]].<ref name="God" />

She's a close friend of [[Ryrda]] and a girlfriend of [[Fran]]. She agreed to help [[Ryrda]] with getting the [[Nightblood]] for him, even though she was sick. Ryrda was way too desperate to tell her she might die of ether vacancy, which eventually led to her death.<ref name="God" />

After [[Fran]] discovered Eran's lifeless body she was filled with rage, killing [[Ryrda]] in revenge for Eran.<ref name="God" />

==Trivia==
*Eran was never stated to be [[Fran]]'s girlfriend, but the way Fran spoke about her hints at that.<ref name="God" />

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that puts one of your opponent's [[Mantras]] on cooldown.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} procs on critical attack, applying a 1 minute cooldown to one of your opponent's [[Mantras]]. The Mantra that gets put on cooldown is entirely random. This effect cannot proc on the same person within 2 seconds.
===Notes===
*The disabling effect will prioritize Mantras of certain types over others.
**This goes: '''Support > Movement > Combat'''.

==Trivia==
*[[Erebus]] was once only obtainable by winning certain community events held by Agamatsu, but was later made publicly obtainable in the Operation: Deep Healing update.
*During the {{VersionHistory|Deepwoken OG}} April Fools update, the Erebus Enchant Stone was sold for {{c|crowns|1,000}} in [[Traan Zakshun#Bankrupt Extravaganza|Traan Zakshun's]] Bankrupt Extravaganza. Because the [[Crowns|Crown]] cap is 999, this item could not be purchased.

title: Eres
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=We few cannot change the world to make it better for everyone. But if we can make it better for at least some... I feel like that's a cause worth living and dying for. Wouldn't you agree?|author=Eres}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=NPC Eres.png
|name=Eres
|aspect=Etrean
|pronouns=He/him
|affiliation=[[Etrea]]
|location=[[Meteor Isle]]}}

==Description==
Eres is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Eres was part of an [[Etrean Soldier|Etrean Navy]] unit that was captured by [[The Central Authority]] in [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel]] and imprisoned at [[Fort Merit]]. He alludes to being rescued by the settlers on Meteor Isle and has dedicated the remainder of his life to helping others escape the horrors of the war. 

He also talks about his relationship with [[Sekh]], a [[Vesperian]] [[Hive Scout]] who also resides on Meteor Isle.

==Location==
Eres can be at [[Meteor Isle]], sitting against a fence.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
NPC Map Eres.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First encounter=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*A young, rough-looking Etrean probably in his twenties is sitting by a bench, visibly weary, tired and a little malnourished. He is clutching some small trinket in his hands, and is muttering something under his breath hurriedly, with his eyes closed.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hey, are you okay?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Say nothing, listen and try to make out what he's saying]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The young man shudders as if started from a deep slumber.*'' Oh, I'm... I'm okay, I think. Yes, I'm okay now, stranger. ''*He sighs, his breath slightly ragged.*'' Oh, where are my manners... My name is Eres. Nice to meet you.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*A frantic flood of furtive whispers flutters freely from his mouth.*'' --'''o king whose might surpasses all whose words encourage and compel pray help resist the ocean's call the rise of which I cannot quell--'''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't look like most of the other settlers here. Are you a traveller too?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What was that muttering, if you don't mind me asking?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hey, are you okay?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Keep listening]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Uh... no, not exactly... I'm a rescue from the prison at Fort Merit. Initially, I came to Aratel with an Etrean Navy unit, but...
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Oh, that... Just a prayer I learned at home. It's... meant to act as a ward. To protect you, from the evils of the world. ''*Eres glances bitterly at the trinket in his palms.*'' Little good that has done for me... Though, I suppose I'm still alive. There's that. And it reminds me who I am. It reminds me of home, and keeps me grounded.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}--'''protect us all from clouded sight aspersions cast away with light as crash the tides and winds yet blow as is above thus is below'''--
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}But..?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't look like most of the other settlers here. Are you a traveller too?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hey, are you okay?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Our troop was caught unaware and out of position, and we were captured by Central Authority forces. Then they rounded us up like cattle, and took us to Fort Merit... ''*The young Etrean shudders at the recollection.*''
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm sorry to hear that.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Such is war.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Sounds deserved to me.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The ragged Etrean lowers his head bitterly.*'' It's inevitable in war, I guess. I should consider myself lucky, too - the rest of my unit was caught during our escape attempt. They're all probably executed by now. I've known most of them since I was a kid. And I could do nothing... ''*He lowers his head, his lower lip trembling.*''
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Yes... Such is war... ''*He pauses for a brief moment.*'' ...But does it have to be, stranger? The things I would give up for peace... ''*He lets out a defeated sigh.*'' There is hope in my heart that this may come true, in the future. But likely not soon...
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The young Etrean looks at you with disgust.*'' Being treated like animals, held in a long-forgotten prison with no food and little water, tortured for information by those... ''monsters''... held until unceremoniously executed - do you think anyone deserves that, stranger? ''*There is a newfound wrathful vigour in his eyes, his words ring with brimstone and ire.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It's not your fault. One person cannot stand against a fort full of soldiers. You did your best.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what about this settlement?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}No, sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The young man slowly looks up at you, tears welling in his eyes.*'' You think so? I failed them in the fight, I failed them in the prison, I failed them in our escape. I- I... ''*He stops, trying to compose himself, slowly wiping the tears from his eyes.*'' No, you're right. I couldn't have helped them. Not on my own.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}You mean Meteor Isle? It's... unique. It's like Sekh-- I mean, like the Hive Scout over there keeps saying. An oasis of greenery and peace.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} ''*Eres' eyes, the shade of night-sky at midnight, meet yours head-on. His burning gaze pierces you, like a fang pierces pray.*'' I will not waste my breath on you. Do yourself a favour - seek misery, and hope death finds you before the Lord Regent does.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} ''*He squints apprehensively, a mistrustful glint of fire still in his eyes.*'' What '''did''' you mean then, stranger?..
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}But you're not on your own now, right?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've talked to the Hivekin? But aren't Etris and the Greathive at war here, in Aratel?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How long have you been here?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], locks the player out of further dialogue.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No. Now I'm among the kind and welcoming settlers here, helping them out in their struggle against the Authority's iron fist. It's the least I can do for them, as thanks. They're my new comrades now.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Generally speaking, yes. But not in this settlement. These are kind of neutral grounds. I'm told there's a bunch of complex politics behind it. Besides, the hivekin aren't ''all'' that bad, when you get to know them. Take... Sekh, for example. He makes for good conversation.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}My unit landed in Aratel some three months ago. We were captured about one and a half months ago, and I was rescued about three weeks ago. I've been here since then.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what about this settlement?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you two talk about?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What will you do now that you are free? Will you return home to Etrea?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Oh, uhm... You know. Stuff? The weather, the daily going-ons of Meteor Isle, current happenings elsewhere in Aratel... He's a great talker, and a great listener. Witty, too. Talking to him makes my situation much more bearable. Yet, we are still on two opposing sides of war. ''*He lowers his gaze sheepishly, smiling a little sadly with his eyes.*'' Maybe one day... things will be different.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He muses for a moment.*'' I'm not sure yet... but I think I might stay. Seeking vengeance for myself - or for my fallen friends - is pointless. But helping the people here... We few cannot change the world to make it better for everyone. But if we can make it better for at least some... I feel like that's a cause worth living and dying for. Wouldn't you agree?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How long have you been here?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what about your home?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}You mean Etrea? There is little there for me now. Most of my friends were in our captured unit, and I left no family behind - the Authority raids saw to that. My home is here now. ''*He looks wistfully into the distance, his glance lingering around one point.*'' The people I care for are now here.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

|-|Unlockable Dialogue=
{{#tag:tabber|Sekh=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="14" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="14" {{!}}''*A young, rough-looking Etrean probably in his twenties is sitting by a bench, visibly weary, tired and a little malnourished. He is clutching some small trinket in his hands, and is muttering something under his breath hurriedly, with his eyes closed.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="11" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hey, are you okay?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Say nothing, listen and try to make out what he's saying]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="11" {{!}}''*The young man shudders as if started from a deep slumber.*'' Oh, I'm... I'm okay, I think. Yes, I'm okay now, stranger. ''*He sighs, his breath slightly ragged.*'' Oh, where are my manners... My name is Eres. Nice to meet you.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See "First Encounter"]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="11" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't look like most of the other settlers here. Are you a traveller too?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="11" {{!}}Uh... no, not exactly... I'm a rescue from the prison at Fort Merit. Initially, I came to Aratel with an Etrean Navy unit, but...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="11" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}But..?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}Our troop was caught unaware and out of position, and we were captured by Central Authority forces. Then they rounded us up like cattle, and took us to Fort Merit... ''*The young Etrean shudders at the recollection.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} I'm sorry to hear that.
{{!}} colspan="5" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} Such is war.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} Sounds deserved to me.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See "First Encounter"]
{{!}} colspan="5" {{!}}Yes... Such is war... ''*He pauses for a brief moment.*'' ...But does it have to be, stranger? The things I would give up for peace... ''*He lets out a defeated sigh.*'' There is hope in my heart that this may come true, in the future. But likely not soon...
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See "First Encounter"]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="5" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what about this settlement?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="5" {{!}}You mean Meteor Isle? It's... unique. It's like Sekh-- I mean, like the Hive Scout over there keeps saying. An oasis of greenery and peace.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've talked to the Hivekin? But aren't Etris and the Greathive at war here, in Aratel?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How long have you been here?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've talked to Sekh?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Generally speaking, yes. But not in this settlement. These are kind of neutral grounds. I'm told there's a bunch of complex politics behind it. Besides, the hivekin aren't ''all'' that bad, when you get to know them. Take... Sekh, for example. He makes for good conversation.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}My unit landed in Aratel some three months ago. We were captured about one and a half months ago, and I was rescued about three weeks ago. I've been here since then.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*Eres' eyes widen a little. He shyly looks away.*'' Yes, a little... Can't be picky about company in my circumstances. Seems you've spoken to him, too...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you two talk about?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Indeed. He's mentioned you, you know.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What will you do now that you are free? Will you return home to Etrea?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See "First Encounter"]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The young Etrean unwittingly tightens his grasp on the trinket he is holding.* He has? *He pauses, considering his words.*'' And... what has he told you about me?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See "First Encounter"]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} He said you make his idle hours here more eventful.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} Oh, not much, he just mentioned you two spoke.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*His pale face turns a light plumfruit shade. He remains quiet for a moment. Then, he speaks up.*'' That's very nice of him... I appreciate you telling me that. If you talk to him again, let him know I feel the same way. About our talks, I mean... ''*His mouth crests into a furtive, secret smile that only you can see.*''
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He slowly purses his lips into a weary frown, looking down at his trinket.*'' ...I see. It would make sense. We ''are'' at war...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Locked dialogue=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The young Etrean, although seemingly deep in prayer, appears to sense your nearby presence. In response, he furrows his brow and coldly ignores you.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}
</tabber>

==Trivia==
*His racial variant appears to be Mamba.
*Based on Eres' story, some of the [[Etrean Guardsman Hostage|Etrean prisoners]] in Fort Merit that the player can rescue may be his friends.
**However, it is equally likely that - as Eres fears - his friends have already been executed and the Etreans in Fort Merit are from a different unit.
*Eres' prayer references a "king", who could be the Fifth King of Etrea - Eres asks for help resisting the "ocean's call", and it is said that the Fifth King could cut through the waves themselves.<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Theadre|quote=It is said that his Ardour could cut the seas themselves... But where are you now, oh King?...}}</ref> Finally, the prayer references "clouded sight", which could be [[The Lord Regent]]'s mental veil.
**However, it would be bizarre for the latter to be the case, as it would imply a prayer about resisting their current leader somehow became common among the people, despite the Lord Regent controlling the flow of information.
**It is likely that despite his distance from Etrea, Eres is still under the influence of the Lord Regent's veil, as the only recorded case of this veil being broken resulted in the veiled one's brutal death.
***Given Inquisitor Lotus' description of Authority Mind Veils, and Zi'eer's being a more powerful variant, this is most likely the case, unless the Lord Regent traded the range of the Veil in exchange for it's ability to affect multiple people.
**The "ocean's call" may also simply refer to the power of the Drowned Gods and the Tides.
*Eres' opening dialogue in subsequent conversations says that he sitting "against a wall", although there are no walls near him; only benches.
*Developer [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/User:Naktigonis Naktigonis] wrote the dialogue for Eres.<ref>[[File:eres_naktigonis_confirmation.png|300px]]</ref>
*Eres and Sekh are stated to both be gay<ref>[[File:Yeah they gay.png|300px]]</ref>, but appear to be stuck in the talking phase.

==Main Location Links==

== Description ==
'''Erisia''' is a large island found in the Etrean [[Luminants|Luminant]], it was designed to be accessible by sailing straight from both the [[Isle of Vigils]] and [[Etris Docks]].

Erisia is a [[Glossary#Driftlands|Driftland]], an island that moves in and out of [[Voidsea]],<ref>[[Neero]]</ref> but has currently settled in the east.

It was originally located in the Southern Luminant<ref name="A">[[Alastir]]</ref> and was ruled by the [[Erisia family]]<ref name="PR">[[Pathfinder's Respite]]</ref> as a duchy of [[Lost Celtor|Celtor]].<ref name="A" />

It is divided into two sections, being [[Upper Erisia]] and [[Lower Erisia]].

== Trivia ==
* The music for this area is [[The Trappings Of A Lord]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]
* The combat music for this area is [[Cry 'Havoc!']] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]
* Erisia is frequently referred to as "Bandit Island" by players.
* As a whole, Erisia is the second largest landmass in Deepwoken, only behind [[Aratel Island]].
*Erisia is a common [[Terminology|ganking]] spot due to contractor bounties/boosting. 
*It's better to do the [[Trial of One]] and then move onto [[Starswept Valley]] due to Erisia NPC's giving little to no EXP for later levels.
**However, Upper Erisia is perfect for Strength/Weapon EXP due to the [[Megalodaunt]] nest in Upper Erisia and the [[Rock Golem]]s in the [[Burning Stone Gardens]].

title: Erisor's Church
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Erisor's Church|caption=Why does this name speak to me and why do I know it so well?}}
[[File:Erisor's Church.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Erisor's Church''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a landmark found in [[Lower Erisia]], perpendicular to the entrance of Towerstruck Lands. 

== Overview ==
Erisor's Church is a small, abandoned church. On the right watchtower, there is a small chest with typical [[Erisia|Erisia loot]] inside and Erisae, a [[Loot Bag Gacha]] npc that allows you to spend {{c|notes|350}} on an equipment gacha. In front of the church is a capturable flag. Inside the church, there is a small, ruined platform with rows of seats on both sides like a standard church. Below the platform, there is a permanent campfire in the middle, with the three [[Forgotten Villager|forgotten villagers]] sitting around it. Talking with the one on the left and waiting for ~3 seconds will activate the event.   

It can be found by following the path on the right of the entrance to the [[Towerstruck Lands]]. 

==Potential Enemies==
*[[Bandit]]
*[[Bandit Captain]]
*[[Rock Golem]]
*[[Forgotten Villager]]

== Events ==
[[File:Forgotten Villagers.png|thumb|Forgotten Villagers inside the Church]]

=== <u>Forgotten Villagers Mission</u> ===
*Talking to the [[Forgotten Villager|Villagers]] for a bit will result in waves of [[Bandit Captain]] spawning.
*These [[Bandit|Bandits]] will progress in difficulty until a [[Rock Golem]] spawns.
*This event will end as soon as the [[Rock Golem]] is eliminated.
*If all of the [[Forgotten Villager|Villagers]] survive, a large chest will spawn at the end of the event with typical [[Erisia]]n loot.
*The Forgotten Villagers take ~20–30 minutes to respawn every time you beat or lose the event. If left alone without help, they will lose as they are severely outnumbered. There are always more Bandit Leaders than them so always aggro a Bandit Leader to fight you instead of fighting one that the Villagers are already fighting. Avoid hitting the villagers because they will aggro on you. If all the villagers die, you cannot claim your reward as you need to talk to one of them. Villagers do not know how to parry the Golem's attacks, and all 3 (if not already killed by bandit leaders) will most likely die to the golem.
*There is no penalty to losing. If all 3 villagers die, you just have to wait for ~20 minutes for them to respawn to get another shot at the quest.
*Most of the villagers of a high chance of being stuck in the church and not doing anything.

==Maps==
A map can be found at [[Maps#Surface]]

==Description==
Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus is a [[Kyrsan]] [[NPC]]. They are the leader of the Kyrsan village of [[Firfire]]. Erosius will refuse to speak to the player unless they have spoken to [[Aeroaseluniris Oricalum Forentus]] or have retrieved the Spear of Nakti.

Upon retrieving the Spear of Nakti and completing Erosius' [[Quest]], the player unlocked the {{t|Ethiron's Gaze}} Talent, allowing them to see through the fog present throughout the Ethironal Shrine. The player will still need speak to Erosius on subsequent entries into the Second Layer to obtain entry to the [[Nest Corridor]].
{{clear}}

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Frinwalter... Laeuve thous plwaeche.

{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Aero told me to talk to you.

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}He shortens his name for you fringewalkers, how disgraceful.

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Our names are our ''identity''. We add to our names as time progresses, it is a symbol of our time spent in worship of {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}}.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I heard you guys had a problem with your temple.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}One of '''YOUR''' people has desecrated our temple.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Well if you tell me how to get there, maybe I could help you out.

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I am not so foolish as to trust a fringewalker at their word. Return to me the Spear of Nakti that lay in the tombs below. You should know that your people desecrated this place as well...

title: Ether
content:
[[File:HDEther.png|center]]
== Description ==
'''Ether''' is the magical essence used to cast [[Mantras]] and use certain other abilities. It is represented by a light green bar below the health bar. If you try to cast a [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Mantras Mantra] while having insufficient Ether, it will make an error sound and not cast, unless you have a [[Talents|Talent]] that can bypass the ether required to cast.

== Interactions ==
*It is raised by [[Intelligence]] (+2 per point), [[Charisma]] (+1.5 per point), [[Erudition]] (+25 per point), [[Equipment]] stats, and certain [[Talents]].
*Regenerates faster with higher [[Tempo]], regenerates '''VERY''' slowly at 0 tempo. 
*Excluding Ether gained from [[Equipment]], the maximum obtainable Ether is 750 (120 base, 200 from Intelligence, 150 from Charisma, 150 from Erudition, and up to 130 from {{t|Devastating Power}} (not 140 because you lack 25 points for charisma if you get [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Talents#:~:text=Sage%20of%20Wisps-,Chorus%20of%20Souls,-%5BAdvanced%20Talent%2C Chorus Of Souls]).
**{{t|Devastating Power}} talent can give 140 ether with [[Saintsworn]] and [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Talents#:~:text=Sage%20of%20Wisps-,Chorus%20of%20Souls,-%5BAdvanced%20Talent%2C Chorus Of Souls].
**[[Contractor]] or [[Saintsworn]] must be used, as they benefit the most from {{t|Devastating Power}}.
*Maximum ether obtainable increases if you have not bought [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Echoes#Unlocks:~:text=500%20Echoes-,Multifaceted,-The%20Attribute%20points Multifaceted] [[Echoes|Echo modifier]].
**The [[Aspects|aspect]] that can get the most ether from not getting [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Echoes#Unlocks:~:text=500%20Echoes-,Multifaceted,-The%20Attribute%20points Multifaceted] is [[Celtor]] with a whopping 8.5 additional ether.
*Currently (04/07/2026) maximum ether is 1173, reaching this amount is not reccomended unless you wish to cast [[Mantras]] that are modified to the limit.

== '''Trivia''' ==

* Maximum ether used to be 1195, however changes to [[Equipment|Ring]] stacking and [[Traits|Erudition]] reduced this number.
* Certain [[Talents]] used to give ether, however most have lost that right.
** The talent that gave most ether was [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Cut_Content#:~:text=Health%2C%20%2B4%20Sanity)-,Ether%20Kit,-%5BCommon%20Talent%5D%20%2D%20It%27s Ether Kit].
* The only talent currently that gives ether is from the [[Oath: Contractor|Contractor oath]].
* You can cast [[Mantras]] without ether if you meet a certain requirement using [[Talents]]. 
** Namely [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Talents#:~:text=Pyromancer-,Hungry%20Flames,-%5BCommon%20Talent%2C%20Fortitude Hungry Flames] and [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Talents#:~:text=Mantra)%2C%2030%20Ironsing-,Metal%20Eater,-%5BCommon%20Talent%2C%20Ironsing Metal Eater] but there are more.

* The most expensive modified [[Mantras|Mantra]] award goes to [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Shadowcast#:~:text=Tornado%20Spark-,Shadow%20Gun,-(%E2%98%86%E2%98%86%E2%98%86) Shadow Gun].
** The reason for that is that [[Mantra Modifiers|Blast spark]] DOUBLES the cost of this mantra (and modifiers).

Ether Erudite
content:
{{IronVowEx}}{{Quotes|quote=Complete a task for the one who seeks mysterious artifacts in the Depths.|author=Ether Erudite obtainment hint}}{{Memento |image=Ether Erudite Memento.png |description=A scholar of the essence of Ether - their superior intellect once stood unrivalled. |final attributes=*50 Light Weapon *50 Medium Weapon *50 Heavy Weapon *10 Strength *20 Fortitude *25 Agility *150 Intelligence *50 Willpower |final traits=*8 Songchant *1 Proficiency |starting armor=[[Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer]] |allowed weapons=Any |starting weapons=[[Quickfang]] |starting items=[[Bloodless Gem]], [[Blue Gem]], [[Wayward Gem]], [[Wind Gem]], [[Ether Surge]] Enchant Stone |unlock=Give [[Jeremiah (Vow of Iron)|Jeremiah]] all of the base-game [[Deep Gem]]s (Insignia, Bloodless, Blessed, Wind, Wayward, Blue) |starting attributes=*3 Light Weapon *3 Medium Weapon *3 Heavy Weapon *1 Strength *1 Fortitude *2 Agility *8 Intelligence *2 Willpower|starting traits=*4 Songchant *-1 Proficiency|starting health=|talents=}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. You will spawn with the following items: 1 [[Bloodless Gem]], 1 [[Blue Gem]], 1 [[Wayward Gem]], 1 [[Wind Gem]], and an [[Ether Surge]] Enchantment stone. All of the [[Deep Gem]]s have static spawns or can otherwise be farmed in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|the Depths}}. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Erudite}} [Memento Talent] - The more total Ether you have, the more damage you deal. Gain Ether Erudite Stacks to improve your combat abilities. The max amount you can hold is 6. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Prediction (☆☆☆) |image=Prediction.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Predict an opponent's attack and reflect it. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype=Enemy's Attack |reqs=N/A |effect=''User creates a white pattern on the floor while deflecting attacks they take during the duration.'' *'''Deflects''' an attack back to the attacker. *Prediction cannot proc anything that procs "on hit" such as [[Deep Gems]]. *Upgrading this Mantra extends the 'prediction' frames (iframes). *Can be upgraded with the {{t|All Knowing}} Talent, removing the range limit Prediction normally has. *Can be upgraded with the {{t|Successive Prediction}} Talent, which allows you to predict multihits, as it grants a brief window of auto prediction. *Can be upgraded with the {{t|Twelve Steps Ahead}} Talent, halving Prediction's cooldown on successful Prediction (minimum 2s) and doubling Prediction's cooldown if you whiff it (maximum 30s). Going 30s without using Prediction will reset this effect. **The maximum Prediction cooldown from this Talent scales on your Intelligence investment. }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*{{cl|questtlnf|Engage}} [Quest Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a Basic Attack slightly restores some of your Ether. (+1 Posture) *Ether Absorption [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Receive Ether back when inflicted with damage from Mantras. (+7 Carry Load) *Hard Read [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Hitting your opponent during a feint will cause them to be dazed. **Applies daze for 1 second. *Mantra Permanence [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Knocking an enemy with a mantra refunds the cost of the mantra. *Master Craftsman [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your skills alone substitute the need for a Craft Station. (+5 Health) **When crafting, the user no longer requires a Craft Station in their recipes. (Ex. Glider) *Moving Fortress [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking no longer slows you down as much. (+1 Posture) **Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to a -20%. *Ready or Not [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - The first attack to hit you while out of combat has its damage cut in half. *Savior [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - After saving a player from being gripped gain a short speed boost for a short duration. (+1 Sanity) **"Saved" being interrupting a grip attempt. **The speed boost lasts 15 seconds. *Target Switch [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Parrying an opponent then hitting someone else makes your next mantra free. **This effect is signalled by a yellow halo. **Has a 4 second activation window with a 10 second duration. **This talent will still proc if you hit a knocked enemy. *The Eleventh Hour [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - When below 15% health your mantras require no ether to cast for 11 seconds. (60 Second Cooldown) (+10 Sanity) **Lasts 30 seconds with a 90 second cooldown, the Talent description was never updated. *Underdog [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes. **Underdog's damage to enemies with higher HP than you scales with your Willpower investment. **Underdog grants a 2.5% damage buff at 20 Willpower, this is increased by 0.0375% damage per Willpower above 20, capping at 4% with 60 Willpower. **"Higher HP" refers to current HP. **"Larger foes" refers to non-humanoid NPCs. (Ex. Megalodaunts, Threshers, Deep Owls) *{{cl|raretl|Observation}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately. (+1 Passive Agility) **Cancelling your roll quickly will grant dodge frames equals to the length of a regular roll. Basically giving extra 0.1s dodge frames. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Ether Barrage (☆☆☆) |image=Ether barrage.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure concentrated orbs of Ether to launch at your enemy. |ethercost={{stats|ether|30 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|blunt|Blunt}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User rises up in the air, and launches 4 orbs of Ether toward their cursor that explode and ragdoll on impact.'' *Has a base damage of 6/6.5/7/7.5/8 per level, per hit (6) with 1.65 Intelligence scaling. *Deals 0 posture damage. *0.65s wind-up. *10s cooldown. *When close enough to the enemy, the orbs will autotrack. **[[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]]es increase how far you can be for it to autotrack. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Master's Flourish (☆☆☆) |image=Master flourish.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=A powerful slash that chips through block and slashes through armor. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User performs a spinning double slice with their sword.'' *Deals 3+5.4/6+10.8/9+16.2/12+21.6/15+27 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage per hit (2). *Initial hit has 0.525 wind-up with the follow-up having 0.4s wind-up. *Master's Flourish has 0.35s endlag. *Deals Chip Damage. *Deals knockback. *Can be modified with a Glass/Magnifying Stones to make it bigger. }}
===Power 5===
*Dragon's Song [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Using a mantra after an uppercut grants ether. 2s CD **Grants +20 Ether on proc. *Full Reset [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Knocking an enemy resets your [[resonance]] cooldowns. This effect has a 60 second cooldown. *Keen Recovery [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a basic attack after feinting a mantra will restore the feinted mantra's ether cost. (+3 Carry Load) **If you have 55 or more Intelligence, this will recover double the feinted Mantra's Ether cost instead. **Does not proc if your basic attack is blocked, parried, or dodged. *Successive Prediction [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Predicting an attack will briefly allow you to predict another. **Allows you to reflect the entirety of multi-hit moves (such as Enforcer's spin attack) *{{cl|raretl|Chronostasis}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Landing a Basic Attack or Critical puts the target's [[Resonance]] on cooldown for a short duration. (+1 Posture) *{{cl|raretl|Everchanging Aegis}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element. (+7 Carry Load) **Getting hit by another element immediately changes your resistance to that element. i.e Getting hit by Shadowcast Mantras while having Galebreathe resistance will immediately change your resistance type to Shadowcast and vice versa. ***This means that multi-hitting Mantras are much less potent, even if your Everchanging Aegis type was not attuned to that Mantra. **Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry. You do not need to actually be ''hit'' by the attack for the swap to occur, largely mitigating the downside. **The damage type you become resistant to is indicated by a colored shield; continuous damage of the same element will give a colored outline of the damage type. ***[[Flamecharm]]: Orange / [[Frostdraw]]: Blue / [[Thundercall]]: Yellow / [[Galebreathe]]: Green / [[Shadowcast]]: Purple / [[Ironsing]]: Grey / [[Bloodrend]]: Red **Does not affect Oath damage. *{{cl|raretl|Overflowing Dam}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage. **The damage buff applies the moment you reach 100% Ether, despite what the Talent description says. *{{cl|raretl|Perfect Flash}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away. **Poser's ring won't count towards the health threshold until sheathed, maintaining the bonus even after being "damaged". {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Neural Pathway (☆☆☆) |image=Neural_Pathway.gif |mantratype=Mobility Mantra |desc=Using your mind's eye, you force your imagined position into reality, appearing to teleport a short distance. You alone know that the world moved, not you. |ethercost={{stats|ether|70 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''Teleport a short distance towards the direction you're moving.'' *Upgrading the Mantra decreases its cooldown by 2.5s per level. **15/12.5/10/7.5/5 second cooldown per level. *No endlag, great as a gap closer or as a back step to get into/out of close quarters combat. *If not moving, you instead teleport towards the direction you're facing. *The distance teleported will be reduced if you aren't moving when you cast the Mantra. *For ~2.5s after teleporting, all fall damage is negated. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Pressure Blast (☆☆☆) |image=Pressure Blast.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Unleash a powerful pressure blast from the weight of your weapon. |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''User performs a heavy downwards swing that cleaves through the air, sending out 3 large blasts of air that ragdoll and knockback.'' *Deals 8/10.5/13/15.5/18 base damage per level, per hit (3) with 1.65 Heavy Weapon scaling. *Deals 12 posture damage per hit (3). *Initial hit has a windup of 0.75s with each followup hit having a windup of 0.2s each. *Dazes opponents on hit. *Ragdolls and lightly flings opponents away. *Has Autoparry frames. }}
===Power 10===
*Foolish Outburst [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking or parrying a vent will absorb the Tempo cost of the vent. A Tactician steadies the course of battle. **Steals 40% of the Tempo used. *Water off a Duck's Back [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Venting will shift any elemental status effects affecting you onto those hit by your vent. **Transfers [[Suffocation]], [[Winded]], [[Chill]], [[Shock]], [[Burn]], and [[potions|potion]] effects from yourself to your enemy on vent. *{{cl|raretl|All Knowing}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your prediction now ignores the range requirement to reflect attacks. *{{cl|raretl|Eureka}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack. (+7 Carry Load) **Landing and parrying Mantras grants Inspiration stacks. Mantras cap at giving 1 stack per, and you do not gain stacks from autoparry frames. **At 3 stacks, gain the Inspired buff for 30 seconds or until you cast a Mantra. Inspired increases the damage of your next Mantra cast by 10%. ***If you gain Inspired by parrying Mantras, you gain the Inspired status effect for 30 seconds. ***If you gain Inspired by landing Mantras, the Inspired status will be instantly consumed to increase the damage of the Mantra used to gain the status. **Inspiration Stacks do not decay, even if you whiff Mantras entirely. *{{cl|raretl|Neuroplasticity}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your mind is a pliable, flexible substance. The Ether cost of additional modifications to your Mantras is now reduced by 20%. (+1 Wildcard Mantra Slot) **The increased Ether Cost from Modified Mantras is reduced by 20% (ether cost increase for tier 1 modifications is reduced from 10 Ether to 8, for tier 2 - from 20 Ether to 16). **Does not apply retroactively to previously modified mantras until you rejoin. *{{cl|advancedtl|Neural Overload}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - You can input up to 4 copies of each Mantra ingredient instead of being limited to 3. **The [[Mantra Modifiers]] limit is increased from 3 -> 4, for copies of modifiers. (ex. max of 3 crystal lens -> max of 4 crystal lens) **Removing this talent after modifying mantras will '''''not''''' alter their pre-existing modifiers, keeping the benefit. **This will '''''not''''' change the maximum 12 mantra modification hard limit. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Rapid Slashes (☆☆☆) |image=Rapid slashes.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Rush down your opponent cutting them apart. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User teleports to the enemy their cursor is located on and performs numerous slashes.'' *Deals 12+4/14+4.67/16+5.33/18+6/20+6.67 base damage per level with 1.65 Light Weapon scaling. *Deals 10 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.67 seconds. *Upgrading the Mantra increases teleportation range. *Bypasses armor resistances, but the damage can still be resisted with other sources of damage reduction. *Teleports the user to the enemy the cursor is pointed at. }}
===Power 15===
*Approaching Singularity [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You now gain +1% Mantra PEN for every 10 points of Intelligence. **Gives 0.1% Mantra PEN per point in Intelligence. ***Provides +15% PEN at 150 Intelligence. *Critical Engine [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You gain the ability to use Deep Gems on your critical attack. Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to apply to your crit then use the tool to enhance your critical. **Equipping a Deep Gem to your critical will not consume the Deep Gem. **Proccing this Talent will put the respective Deep Gem on cooldown if it has one. **[[Mantle of Enmity]] can proc Critical Engine. If you use a [[Blessed Gem]], your Mantle aerial attack will halve your critical cooldown rather than your Mantle's. **See info on specific [[Deep Gems]] on their individual pages. *Twelve Steps Ahead [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing Prediction will halve the cooldown to a minimum of 2s. Whiffing will double the cooldown to a maximum of 30s. This effect stacks for up to 30 seconds. **This effect requires your opponent to be within 90 studs of you.
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Barrage Mastery}} [Memento Talent] - For every Ether Erudite stack you have, gain one extra orb whenever you fire your Ether Barrage. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Quell}} [Memento Talent] - Landing a Critical Attack or Guardbreaking an opponent gives you 1 Ether Erudite Stack. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Reflux}} [Memento Talent] - Successfully countering an opponent with Prediction gives you 2 Ether Erudite stacks. ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Amplification}} [Memento Talent] - For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, increase the size and damage of your Pressure Blast. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Blitz}} [Memento Talent] - For every Ether Erudite Stack you have, reduce the windup of your enhanced Master's Flourish. This consumes your Ether Erudite stacks on use. ===True Heart of Enmity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ether Burst}} [Memento Talent] - Landing Rapid Slashes on your opponent gives them an overflow of Ether, causing them to take bursts of damage based on how many Ether Erudite stacks you had. **Consumes your Ether Erudite Stacks.

title: Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye
content:
''This is the Drowned God. For the boss of Floor 2 of the Second Layer, see [[Scion of Ethiron]].''
{{Quotes|quote=YOU HAVE DONE US A GREAT SERVICE LITTLE GODSEEKER. YOUR SCREAMS WILL ECHO ACROSS EONS. AN ETERNITY OF SUFFERING AWAITS YOU IN THE AGONY OF THE GALE.|author=Voice of Ethiron}}
'''Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye,''' also known as the Eye of Calamity,<ref>https://fxtwitter.com/Deepwoken/status/1508158183025614851</ref> is a [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Drowned_Gods Drowned God], sleeping deep within the [[Second Layer]] of [[The Depths]].
== Description ==
Little is known about Ethiron other than that he<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Naerotiv|quote=Ethiron's Scion, his puppet, has awoken.}}</ref> is the Drowned God of wind, pressure and sky. [[Chaser, Scholar of the Burning Blood|Chaser]] describes [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]] as like a bedchamber to Ethiron, with the [[Kyrsgarde]] having worked hard to keep him asleep. Ethiron seemingly emits a fog known as Mist Presence, which eventually brainwashed them and the [[Lost Diver]]s into worshipping him and devoting themselves to helping the [[Scion of Ethiron]] grow.

Ethiron is one of the most powerful beings in Deepwoken due to being a Drowned God, the phenomena in the Second Layer demonstrating some of his tremendous power despite being in a state of "sleep". He appears to have total control over the Eternal Gale and any forms of gale; mind control, specifically in Floor 2 showing how the Mist Presence produced by Ethiron controls the Kyrsgarde and Lost Divers; and the ability of time manipulation - this is less so an actual ability so much as a consequence of Ethiron's winds, so strong as to push time itself.

Ethiron has a personal domain of his own in the Depths, being the Second Layer. Despite having a lot of control in the Second Layer, as seen through [[The Ethironal Shrine]], constantly showing its effects, some other powers of Ethiron have less effects in certain parts of the Second Layer, for example the time dilatation effects can only be seen in Floor 2 and in the [[Cathedral of Ethiron]] in the Second Floor in the weakest way. This can probably mean that some parts of the Second Layer has less control over, for example the Ignition Union base and the multiple safepoints in the Second Layer are unaffected by Ethiron's powers, at least in his asleep state.

During Ethiron's slumber, he collected information present and assembled a crude form to resemble a Black Diver, which he dubbed [[Mendacia]], though several of the details were wrong. He used this disguise to try and trick individuals within the Gale into furthering his agenda.<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Mendacia}}</ref>

He also awakens the Scion of Ethiron to do his bidding against his enemies.<ref>[[File:ArchVoice.png|300px]]</ref>

==Trivia==
*The true boss of the Second Layer is named The Scion of Ethiron. Scion has two definitions. The first being "descendant of royalty," which suggests this "final boss" of the Second Layer may only be apart of a bloodline of these monsters. The second being "a young shoot or twig of a plant," likely referring to the fact that the Scion of Ethiron is just a small part of the Drowned God it resembles.
**Scion can also refer to wise individuals or worshippers in some media. Take this as you will.

title: Ethironal Shrine Outskirts
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Ethironal Shrine Outskirts|caption=You awake to a land covered in frost, the wind piercing your ears like the cries of lost souls.}}
[[File:ethironalout.png|thumb|900px|center]]
== Contents ==
The Ethironal Shrine Outskirts is a landmark in [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|The Second Layer of The Depths]].  

This is the landing location of the [[Second Layer]]. You can arrive here through speaking to [[Klaris]] and entering the [[Second Layer]] or jumping into the void in the [[First Layer]] while above a health threshold. The Ethironal Shrine Outskirts is a cold place, full of Eternal Gale parasites.  

If you stay here for too long, parasites in the form of snowballs will latch onto you, it will take a few minutes before said parasites will pop out and kill you instantly. 

In order to leave this area, you have to pick up light key and open a gate. That gate leads to the [[Sanctuary Gatehouse]]. From the Sanctuary Gatehouse you'll reach the [[Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary]].

== Objectives ==

* Obtain the Key
* Open the gate with the key

== Gallery ==
== Trivia ==

* The Ethironal Shrine is named after the [[Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity|drowned god Ethiron]], who oversees the [[Second Layer]]

title: Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary|caption=Stepping into the shrine the storm takes new form.}}
[[File:Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Overview ==
The Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary is the area directly after the [[Ethironal Shrine Outskirts]], and takes up the majority of [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Floor 1]]. Notable features include powerful winds, parasite pits and rapid gain of parasites. It is infested with [[Bounder]]s, [[Diver Husk|Husks]] and [[Carbuncle]]s on the ground, so you must stay on the bridges to avoid fighting powerful monsters. Sub-locations include the [[The Frontier Furnace|Frontier Furnace]].

The three Diver journals can be found here.

== Points of Interest ==
* [[Firfire]]
* [[The Maw of Ethiron]]
* [[Cathedral of Ethiron]]
* [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]

== Quests ==
* [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder Oath]] (Alpha quest)
* [[Talents|Union hook]]
* Spear of Nakti

== Trivia ==
* This is main First Floor location, since almost all the action takes place here. Generator, [[The Frontier Furnace|Frontier Furnace]], [[Pilgrim's Respite]] and even Firfire are located in Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary.
* The Spear of Nakti is most likely named after Naktigonis, the composer of the game’s soundtrack.

title: Etrea
content:
{{Spoiler}} {{Quotes|quote=Welcome, traveler. Don’t go causing any trouble, all right?|author=Etrean Guard}} {{Factions |image1=Etrea Icon.png |caption1=The emblem of the Kingdom of Etrea |leader=*King (formerly) **[[Rolen Vashtir]] *Acting regents **[[Lord Guardian]]s **[[The Lord Regent]] |territory=[[Etris]] [[Isle of Vigils]] |goals=Survival
Collecting artifacts and the Forge of Sin
Defeat [[The Central Authority]]}} == Description == Etrea, also known as the Kingdom of Etrea, is a nation of primarily [[Etrean]]s that are the main ruling faction in the [[Luminants|Etrean Luminant]]. They reside in their capital of [[Etris]]. The [[Isle of Vigils]] is also part of Etrea, acting as its military school, though Etrea's attitude toward the Isle is much more hands-off. Being the largest land ruling faction in the Etrean [[Luminants|Luminant]], they hold a large range of power, deploying foot-soldiers all across the Etrean Luminant. They are led by the [[Lord Regent]] who rules from his castle, and sees over the land of [[Etris]] and the [[Etrean Wilds]]. They had been ruled by their Kings for generations, until decades to months before the year 1271, when the new leader Lord Regent took over. The kingdom has faced much hardship over the years. [[The Central Authority]] has deemed them their next target for conquest, and they are far better armed and equipped than the Etrean people. Meanwhile, the Lord Regent is actually a [[Oath: Contractor|Contractor]] and Ministry Prophet, essentially making them a puppet state for [[the Ministry]], which has since only bolstered the Authority's resolve to destroy them. The soldiers in Etris are purely [[Etrean]], with the [[Mantra Collector]] sitting at the bottom near the docks being a [[Canor]]. If you go up to Schnitzel and talk to them, you will be given the normal dialogue options, as well as a third, "Why aren't you up in town?" Upon asking this question, Schnitzel will say "Canor no allowed to buy in town, new leader very strange." While many take this to mean they are racist, the Etreans welcomed three [[Adret]] into their capital, two of whom were [[The Divers|Divers]], as well as a [[Vesperian]], implying there was a different reason for Schnitzel's banishment that is currently unknown. == Reputation == For the Castaway and Lone Warrior [[Origins]], the player spawns in with Friend [[Reputation]] with Etrea. Deepbound players will spawn in with just below Neutral Reputation, Voidwalkers will spawn in with Enemy Reputation, and Authority Ensigns will spawn with hunted reputation. Being an [[Etrean]] increases your starting Reputation with Etrea. This sets your starting Voidwalker enemy reputation to neutral. Authority Ensigns cannot increase their Etrea reputation. There are a substantial amount of ways to gain reputation with Etrea: * Donating wood to either [[Korin]] or [[Drefa]]. (Unavailable if you have negative reputation; unable to reach 'Hero' reputation with this method) * Defeating the [[Bandit]]s at either [[Isle of Vigils]] or [[Etris]]. * Helping Etrea during the rare [[Etris: Siege|Etris Siege event]]. * Doing the [[Nanji]] or [[Lance's Brother]] [[quests]]. On top of that, Etrea has many [[Random Encounters|random events]] across the Luminants in which you may assist them and gain Reputation: * [[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Authority Officer]]s {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Erisia]]) * [[Etrean Soldier]]s {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Authority Officer]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Upper Erisia]]) * [[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Hive Scout]]s {{FactionIcon|Hive}} ([[Starswept Valley]]) * [[Etrean Soldier]]s {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Knife of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} ([[The Aratel Sea]]/[[The Etrean Sea]]) Etrea is among the factions with a [[Bounty Hunting|Bounty Board]]. They also have a Reputation reset NPC, [[Nerin]], located above the main entrance area of [[Etris]]. You need high Friend Reputation with Etrea in order to start the Lord Regent's questline. Having negative Reputation with Etrea removes your ability to talk to several key NPCs, such as [[Banker]]s and [[Antiquarian]]s, as usual. == Notable Members == * [[The Lord Regent]] (Presumed, actually belongs to [[The Ministry]]) * [[Polis]] * [[Kennith]] * [[Nerin]] (Resets [[Reputation]] to the slot's default, unlocks the [[Sly]] Boon.) == Associated Enemies== File:Etrean343.png|link=Etrean_Guardsmen|[[Etrean Guardsmen]] File:Etrean Sailor.png|link=Etrean_Soldier|[[Etrean Soldier]] File:Etrean footsoldier.png|link=Vigil_Swordsman|[[Vigil Swordsman]] File:Vigil guard.png|link=Blade_Temple_Guard|[[Blade Temple Guard]] File:Etrean Royal Guard (Enemy).png|link=Etrean_Royal_Guard|[[Etrean Royal Guard (Enemy)]] File:Polisimg.png|link=Polis|[[Polis]] File:Placeholder.png|[[Vigil Captain]] File:Etrean Captain.png|[[Etrean Captain]] [[File:Hive fountain Etrea.png|thumb|187x187px|The fountain leading to the Hive]] ==Trivia== * Like other major factions, they seem to be based on a real-world culture, with Etrea being based on East Asian countries like Japan and China. * In the Kings Garden, much like in Vigils and the hidden village, there is a fountain, it is located next to Lord Regents Palace * interestingly, the Etrea logo is similar to the Deepwoken logo, only flipped. * You used to be able to gain Reputation with Etrea from beating the [[Blade Instructor]] enemy, but this is no longer possible with the introduction of [[Training Mode]] having completely removed it. {{Nav|Factions}} [[Category:Factions]] [[Category:Etrea]]

*[[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]]† |commanders3= |commanders4= }} The '''Etrean Civil War''' was a civil conflict that took place between the [[The Ministry|Ministry]]-backed forces of [[Etrea]] and the combined forces of the [[Etrean Royalists]], [[The Vigils]], and the [[Circle of Honour]], who opposed the ascension of [[Zi'eer]] as Etrea's current ruler. ==Prelude== During the coup against [[Lord Guardian]] [[Ji'ang]], Zi'eer and his most loyal guards, whom he had transformed into Shoguns, stormed [[Etris Palace]] and rained bloodshed within. Ultimately, this led to Ji'ang's and the Etrean resistance's murders—allowing Zi'eer to usurp the throne in the palace. From there, he would shield the palace with an impenetrable barrier to ensure that he could not be taken down. Zi'eer's capabilities led to placing a Mind Veil over the people in [[Etris (Vow of Iron)|Etris]], erasing memories of the civil war's cause and altering the perception of the [[Etrean Royalists]]—ancient, well-respected families in its society, now being seen as bandits, or even scheming usurpers. ==The war== Learning about this illegal seize of power, the Royalists sprung up in rebellion. The Royalists would also be susceptible to attacks by Zi'eer, notably being the destruction of Clan Mofisu's [[Viridian Sanctuary Ruins|Viridian Sanctuary]] and the neighboring [[Temple of Mur]] through his Shoguns in 1233 CE. In the same year, the Sachans of the Royalists gathered in [[The Golden Rat]] to discuss strategies pertaining to fighting [[Dravik, The Rat King]], who holds the secret to destroying the barrier placed around the palace. Unable to decide a strategy, an argument broke out between the four Sachans, causing the Royalists to separate and go on their own ways. Sachan Mofisu insisted he would take back his destroyed territory and the temple, which was backed by Sachan Anako, while Sachan Ganba decided to seek contact with The Vigils and Sachan Kobura recognizing the need for powerful allies like [[The Central Authority|The Authority]], much to their dismay. In the end, Clan Ganba decided to head to the west and speak with [[The Hundred Legions]], and Clan Kobura withdrew from the war. ==Aftermath== ==References== [[Category:Civil wars]]

== Description ==
Etrean Guardsman Hostages are from [[The Kingdom of Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}. They appear exclusively as randomized [[Etrean|Etreans]], although they all wear the [[Etrean Guard]] Expert [[Outfits|Outfit]].

They are found in a prisoner pose, kneeled down on both knees and having their arms behind them, though they are forced into a standard pose when being knocked back. They spawn exclusively in prison cells within [[Fort Merit]].

Etrean Guardsman Hostages can be picked up by pressing {{Input|keybind|V}}. Dropping them will cause them to be knocked for a bit before returning to their original stance. Unlike any normal NPC, you can carry the hostage anywhere and everywhere, and will not despawn unless you travel to a new [[Luminants|Luminant]].

Bringing an Etrean hostage to the [[Etrean Guardmaster]] will reward you with a handful of XP, a [[Fort Merit]] chest, reputation with [[The Kingdom of Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}, and negative reptuation with [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Authority}}.

==Trivia==
*These NPCs do not respawn due to a bug, making these NPCs extremely rare.

They use common Etrean weapons along with [[Galebreathe]] [[Mantras]]. Upon killing one, more tend to come, quickly swarming the player. After killing a sufficient amount of them, [[Etrean Royal Guard]]s will start hunting you. Etrean Guardsmen wear the [[Etrean Guard]] Expert [[Outfits|Outfit]], and they are all Etrean (with varying skin tones and aspect variants) == Behavior == The Etrean Guardsmen are passive towards the player unless the player attacks them, or has negative reputation with [[Etrea]]. An Etrean Guardsman will sometimes feint. They have a passive which makes them immune to PVE scaling, meaning that even if you're power 20, it may take a good couple of hits to take one down. == Moveset == An Etrean Guardsmen's arsenal consists of either a [[Battleaxe]], [[Ritual Spear]] or [[Mace]] along with the [[Galebreathe]] attunement: === Attacks === {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before slamming it into the ground below. [[[Ritual Spear]]] Enters a stance before performing a quick swipe, will perform an additional short lunge if the first hit lands. *The Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |

(★★☆) |User lunges forward with their weapon coated in wind. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Passives === *Impervious - Immune to PvE scaling. ==Gallery== ConditionedSwimmer.png|Conditioned Swimmer in the wild ==Trivia== *There is an Etrean Guardsmen who stands near a hole, guarding the entrance to Etris near the Blacksmith and Polis. Their pathfinding is somewhat mediocre, which often leads to them falling through the hole into the ocean below. **As they were more often than not in the ocean, they were nicknamed Conditioned Swimmer, after the Conditioned Runner Talent. They were eventually modified so they would be teleported back to spawn should they fall through the hole. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]] [[Category:Guards]]

Attacking them or going near them without high enough reputation brings you the same fate as attacking any other faction guards. They'll appear when you grip two Etrean guards, (or during the Cinders of Etris event) even if you have positive reputation. They have a much higher required reputation level for peaceful interaction than normal [[Etrean Guardsmen|Etrean Guards]], requiring higher than Ally reputation for them to become passive. An Etrean Royal Guard wears a [[Blackleaf Helm]] and a darkened version of the [[Royal Etrean Guard]] outfit. Get out of my sight. |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Unlockable Dialogue= This dialogue only appears if the player has started the "Forge of Sin" questline. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |What's your business here? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I have an audience with the Lord Regent. |- | colspan="1" |Fine. You may enter. |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} ==Gallery== RoyalGuardEnchant.png|A Royal Guard with an enchanted weapon == Trivia == *The description of the [[Royal Etrean Guard]] implies that the Royal Etrean Guard is the name of the group, and the Etrean Royal Guard is the name of the members of said group. * They possess unquestioning loyalty to the Lord Regent. This is most likely done via a [[Lore|Mental Veil]] stronger than that placed by the Lord Regent over Etris. This is supported by the fact that the Palace Guards refer to the Lord Regent as "benevolent". This kind of praise is not expressed by any other NPCs in Etris. * If the player has the [[Contractor]] [[Oath]], they will say "Ah, the benevolent Lord Regent's associate has returned. Has he granted you a new task?" * You must rejoin after reaching the reputation threshold for the Guards to become passive. (Bug) * They commonly drop Gale Stones and are a good way of farming them {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]]

title: Etrean Royalists
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Greetings, traveller. Don't cause any trouble on the clan grounds.|author=Royalist Guard}} {{Factions |image1=Etrean Royalists Icon.png |leader=*Sachans **{{iv|Zaru Ganba}} **{{iv|Choji Mofisu}} **{{iv|Yi Anako}} **{{iv|Shisui Kobura}} |territory=[[The Sable Estate]]
[[The Indigo Citadel]]
[[Viridian Sanctuary Ruins]]
[[Red Lotus Keep]]
[[Temple of Mur]] |goals=Liberate Etrea
Preserve the history of Etrea
Defeat [[The Lord Regent]] |founded=1219 CE{{Ref/NPC|High Monk Junsui}}{{Deep dates|Iron}} As the Civil War began 14 years before the events of the gamemode, it can be assumed to have taken place in 1219 CE. |dissolved=1233 CE{{Deep dates|Iron}}}} ==Description== The Etrean Royalists, also known as the Old Guard, are a group of [[Etrean|Etreans]] belonging to the various ancient clans that make up the Old Guard of [[Etrea]] who were respected before [[The Lord Regent]]'s coup, being now treated as 'a gaggle of rebellious lords, - or worse, 'scheming usurpers' thanks to the Regent's mind veil over the people of [[Etris]]. They appear exclusively in the [[Vow of Iron]] mode and are working alongside the [[Circle of Honour]] to take down [[Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet|The Lord Regent]]. The Royalists are made up of four distinct clans: Clan Anako, Clan Mofisu, Clan Kobura and Clan Ganba. They are all led by their respective 'Sachans' or Clan Leaders: Yi Anako, Choji Mofisu, Shisui Kobura and Zaru Ganba. They are the primary enemy of [[Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet|The Lord Regent]] and seek to free [[Etrea]] from the mind veil he has imposed over its citizens. The Royalists during the Etrean Civil War used the [[Temple of Mur]] as a clandestine base of operations to plan their fight, however, it and the nearby [[Viridian Sanctuary Ruins|Viridian Sanctuary]] were attacked by [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard|Shoguns]] sent by the Lord Regent effectively causing the Mofisu Clan to go into exile. Following a heated argument between each of the Sachans at [[The Golden Rat]], the Old Guard was effectively disbanded leaving each clan alone to their own plans. Clan Ganba wished to make contact with the [[Isle of Vigils]] and use it as a base of operations against the Lord Regent, and if not possible, make their way westward and attempt to join with [[The Hundred Legions]]. They also wished to retake the Monastery of Mur and the Viridian Sanctuary to which Clan Mofisu and Clan Anako were 'adamant' about. On the other hand, Clan Kobura wanted to join forces with [[The Central Authority]] claiming they needed 'powerful allies against the Regent' or even join the Regent's forces if no other solution presented themselves. ==Reputation== Every [[Mementos|Memento]] regardless of [[Aspects|Aspect]] starts with Neutral Reputation with the Royalists. Their reputation is shared across every clan meaning doing the jobs of a single clan will raise it for the entire faction. There are only a few ways to gain reputation with the Royalists: * Talking to [[Seon]] or [[Kazue]] and picking the only dialogue option will increase your reputation slightly, and it can only be done once per character. * Completing [[Job Boards|Jobs]] from the various estates. Jobs on red boards require Power 5 to be accepted, jobs on blue boards require Power 10. * Helping Clan Ganba soldiers defeat members from [[The Ignition Union]] near the entrance of [[The Sable Estate]]. The Royalists have four Reputation Reset NPCs, [[Yen]], [[Kazue]], [[Ferenc]], and [[Seon]]. They are located near the [[Songseeker Temple]], outside the Sable Estate, at [[Summer Isle|Summer Isle,]] and in [[Isle of Vigils]] respectively. ==Notable Members== *[[Sachan Zaru Ganba]] *[[Sachan Yi Anako]] *[[Sachan Shisui Kobura]] *[[Sachan Choji Mofisu]] *[[Yen]] *[[Kazue]] *[[Ferenc]] *[[Seon]] *[[Mofisu Clan Informant]] ==Associated Enemies== File:Clan Mofisu Soldier.png|[[Royalist Guard]] ==Trivia== * During the very early start of Vow of Iron's release, the Royalists were always hostile against the players, making obtaining all [[Etris Flask|Etris Flasks]] harder. * The Royalists seemingly are the only Etreans still capable of making the previously mentioned Etris Flasks seeing as they are only obtainable in their estates. This likely means their dissolution are what makes them not appear in [[Pathfinder]]. * The naming scheme of the Royalists are a play on various snake species, evidenced by the Styles of related equipment like the [[Etrean Sashimono]]. The list is as follows: ** Anako -> Anaconda ** Kobura -> Cobra ** Ganba -> Mamba ** Mofisu -> Psammophis * Each clan of the Royalists don their own banner and emblems as shown below: File:Clan Mofisu Emblem.png|[[Clan Mofisu]] Banner File:Clan Ganba Emblem.png|[[Clan Ganba]] Banner File:Clan Anako Emblem.png|[[Clan Anako]] Banner File:Clan Kobura Emblem.png|[[Clan Kobura]] Banner ==References== {{Nav|Factions}} [[Category:Factions]]

This also extends the duration of {{t|Dancing Steps Of War}}, [[Geta]]'s Talent, by 0.5 seconds on proc. File:Katana Angled Crit.gif|link=Katana|
[[Katana#Critical|Katana]] Critical ==Trivia== *A ''{{W|sashimono}}'' is a banner that was worn by soldiers during Feudal Japan. *Two of the Styles are nods to flags used by the {{W|LGBTQ community}}. **The Pride Style is of the {{W|Rainbow flag (LGBTQ)|Pride flag}}. **The Joy Style is of the {{w|Transgender flag}}. **These are both references to the phrase "Pride and Joy". {{History}} {{Nav|Equipment}} [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:Torso]] [[Category:Equipment with Exclusive Talents]] [[Category:Equipment with Talents]] [[Category:Equipment of Etrea]]

They can also appear younger or older than 40 years old. == Moveset == An Etrean Soldier's arsenal only consists of a [[Battleaxe]] or [[Ritual Spear]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
