[[[Ritual Spear]]] Enters a stance before performing a quick swipe with spear, will perform an additional short lunge if the first hit lands. *Battleaxe critical is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |

title: Etrean Wilds
content:
{{Location|name=Etrean Wilds|caption=The sounds of the forest comfort your sea-weary soul, if briefly.}}
[[File:Etrean Wilds.png|center|thumb|767x767px]]
'''Etrean Wilds''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a sub-location of [[Etris]] found in [[The Etrean Sea]].

==Description==
Between the Etris Docks and Etris, there is a small forest, being the Etrean Wilds. It is relatively safe, but it is a popular location for players to hangout and spar with each other, so watch out for potential fights and potentially even ganks  

==Points of Interest==
===Navaen Nomad Camp===
* A small camp populated by [[Navaen Nomad]]s found before entering Etris.
* You can earn the [[Way of Navae]] fist style by turning in a Navaen hostage to [[Cheral]]
* This is the location of the first part of the [[Zana]] [[Poser's Ring|quest]].
* You can buy the following here:
**[[Navaen Nomad Robes]] for {{c|notes|45}}.
**[[Lumber Axe]] for {{c|notes|3}}.
**[[Flint]] for {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:Navaen Camp.png|thumb|none|262x262px]]

===Ruined House===
*A small ruined house found below Etris that has importance with the [[Kelsius]] Book quest.
**When doing the "Lost Books" Quest for the first time, the player guided to the house. [[Khan (NPC)|Khan]] can be found here.
[[File:Kelsius Hut.png|thumb|none|265x265px]]

title: Etris
content:
{{Topbuttons|p, {{iv|Etris (Vow of Iron)}}}}
{{PathfinderEx|counterpart}}
{{Location|name=Etris|territory=Etrea|caption=Highest amongst the peaks of the mountains, a proud fortress of a city stands against the world itself.}}
[[File:Etris New.png|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
Etris is the capital of the Kingdom of [[Etrea]], being on top of a tall mountain with amazing views and dangerous, possibly life-threatening falls. It marks the beginning of the adventures of many, as it is one of the two spawn locations new players can choose. It resides on a tall mountain. To get to the docks, you must take a short walk past the Navaen camp and pass the Etrean Wilderness.

==Landmarks & Sub locations==
*[[Etrean Wilds]]
*[[Etris Docks]]
*[[Etris Palace]]
*[[The King's Garden]]

==Potential Enemies ==
<gallery columns="dynamic" spacing="small" orientation="none" widths="120" navigation="true" position="center" captionposition="below" captionalign="center" captionsize="medium" bordersize="small" hideaddbutton="true">
File:Etrean343.png|link=Etrean_Guardsmen|[[Etrean Guardsmen]]
File:Etrean Royal Guard (Enemy).png|link=Etrean_Royal_Guard|[[Etrean Royal Guard (Enemy)]]
File:Etrean footsoldier.png|link=Vigil_Swordsman|[[Vigil Swordsman]]
File:Etrean Sailor.png|link=Etrean_Soldier|[[Etrean Soldier]]
File:Polisimg.png|link=Polis|[[Polis]]
File:Bandit.png|link=Bandit|[[Bandit]]
File:Nell Enemy.PNG|[[Nell, Master of Frost]]
</gallery>

==Points of Interest==

===Inn===
*Players can speak to the [[Innkeep]] to change their spawn to Etrea for {{c|notes|5}}.
*[[Trenti]] resides here, giving advice to new players.<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Inn.png|Inn
</gallery>

===Bank===
*Players can find a [[Banker]] they can turn found [[Artifacts]] in to, as well as store items and deposit [[Notes]] across all of their slots. 
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Bank.png|Bank
</gallery>

===Antiquarian===
*Players can find an [[Antiquarian]] who will purchase their sellable items.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Antiquarian.png|Antiquarian
</gallery>

===Blacksmith===
*Players can find [[Caragan]], the Etris [[Blacksmith]].
*[[Cloth]] and [[Fiber]] can be directly purchased from Caragan, but are also sold outside of the Blacksmith by [[Pori]], who can give you a 50% discount on them if you talk to him. 
**However you are still unable to purchase Cloth or Fiber unless you can afford their base price.
**Wood can be purchased for {{c|notes|2}}.
**Cloth can be purchased for {{c|notes|6}}/{{c|notes|3}} (discounted price).
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:EtrisBlacksmith.png|Blacksmith
</gallery>

===Weaponry===
*Players can buy a variety of starter [[Weapons]] around the shop and some directly from [[Astra]] here: 
**[[Bullets]] for {{c|notes|5}} per.
**[[Stiletto]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Apprentice Rapier]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Messer]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Mace]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Sword]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Iron Spear]] for {{c|notes|25}}.
**[[Hunting Bow]] for {{c|notes|25}}.
**[[Ritual Spear]] for {{c|notes|100}}.
**[[Battleaxe]] for {{c|notes|16}}.
**[[Steel Maul]]for {{c|notes|100}}.
**[[Zweihander]] for {{c|notes|100}}.
**[[Targe]] for {{c|notes|15}}.
**[[Parrying Dagger]] for {{c|notes|25}}.
*On the second floor, players can also purchase the schematic for:
**[[Skeptic Pioneer]] for {{c|notes|45}}.
**[[Shadow Hunter]] for {{c|notes|50}}.
**[[Experienced Adventurer]] for {{c|notes|80}}.
**[[Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer]] for {{c|notes|45}}.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:EtrisWeaponshop.png|Weaponry
</gallery>

===Odiolavoro's Food===
*Struggling to stay afloat from competition, [[Chef Odiolavoro]] can assign you to cook meals for them in return for rewards and the chance of unique weapons.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Odialovoro.png|Odiolavoro's Food
</gallery>

===Guildhall===
*Players can start a Guild when they reach [[Power]] 5 by talking to the [[Guild Clerk]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Guild Hall.png|Guild House
</gallery>

===Bookstore===
*[[Bookkeeper Andros]] can be found here.
*A permanent [[Campfire]] can be found here.
*Inside is a [[Mantra Lectern]] used to modify [[Mantras]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Bookstore.png|Bookstore
</gallery>

===General Store===
*Players can purchase a pickaxe, lumber axe, flint and fiber for {{c|notes|3}} each.
*Players can purchase wood here for {{c|notes|5}}.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:General store.png|General Store
</gallery>

===Lance's Food===
*[[Lance Leshi]] and [[Ms Stick]] can be found selling [[Mushroom Omelette]]s for {{c|notes|15}}, [[Megurger]]s for {{c|notes|15}}, and [[Mushroom Bisque]] for {{c|notes|20}}.
*[[Ploom]] can be found reading "The Eternal Flame and the Failure of Man. Amorus Pleeksty"
*Inside the shop the [[Worshipper's Shield]] can be purchased for {{c|notes|45}}.
*Inside the shop the [[Flame Worshipper Armor]] can be purchased for {{c|notes|60}}.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Lance Leshi's Store.gif|Lance Leshi's Food
</gallery>

===Etris Palace===
*[[The Lord Regent]] can be found here.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Palace.png|Etris Palace
</gallery>

===The Den===
*The [[Den Master]] can be found here. They sell all Tier 1 [[Mantra Modifiers]]
*To get there sail to the right of the docks and loop around the mountains.

===Alchemist's Lodge===
*[[Nell, Master of Frost]], the [[Frostdraw]] trainer can be found here.
*A functional [[Cauldron]] can be found here.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Etris Alchemist.png|Alchemist's Lodge
</gallery>

===Miscellaneous===
*[[Polis]] can be found in the middle of the city. If you follow the first dialogue, he will give you a [[Gold Ring]].

==Quests==

===<u>Etrean Apprentice</u> ===
*Located at the backside of the blacksmith, talk to the Etrean named Pori.
*Pori begs you not to rat him out to the blacksmith Caragan, as he will be revoked of his apprenticeship.
*Keeping his promise and not ratting him out rewards you a 50% discount on all materials in the blacksmith.
*Ratting him out does nothing, but at least your ego increased! (Even if you ratted him out, you could repeat the dialogue and get a discount after.)

===<u>Jim's Embers</u>===
*Talk to Jim, a red-haired [[Canor]] located in a house within the [[Etris Docks]].
*He mutters about lacking the necessary ingredients; agreeing to help him requires 2 [[Dying Embers]].
*The reward for completing this quest is a random high tier [[Mantra Modifiers|Mantra Modifier]] and a Curiosity Talent hand.

===<u>Lumberjack Quest</u> ===
*Speak to [[Korin]] who is idling outside a house by the exit to the [[Etrean Wilds]].
*They will ask you to chop wood so that they have a sustainable supply of lumber for the winter.
*Accepting the quest gives you a lumber axe for free if you don't have one already.
*Turning in 6 wood for gives back {{c|notes|5}}.
*This quest is repeatable.
*An incredible way of getting Etrea reputation.

====<u>Treefelling Blow</u> ====
'''[This Quest requires the 'Strong Left' Strength Mantra.]'''
*Talk to [[Korin]] and tell them you don't get any wood by punching trees.
*Bewildered, the Etrean offers the player to Strong Left 5 trees for research.
*After 5 trees are felled with Strong Left, return to the Lumberjack and gain the Talent.

===<u>Travelling Blade</u>===
*Talk to [[Nanji]] in Etris, located near the big slope ramp close to the [[Barber]].
*They mention about a missing individual, their brother [[Ilji]], whom they were supposed to meet in Etris. Agreeing to help find this person accepts the quest.
*The [[Chipped Sword]] that was used by [[Ilji]] can be found on the small island connecting the [[Isle of Vigils]] to [[Upper Erisia]].
*Returning to Nanji grants the {{t|Nanji's Training}} Talent, reputation with Etrea, and Compassion Talent hand.

===<u>The Duke of Sin</u>===
*To begin this quest, you must have at least ally [[Reputation]] with Etrea. This can be achieved by helping the Etrean Guards in the [[Random Encounters#X vs X|Etrea vs Authority]] random event or the [[Random Encounters|Etrean Guards vs Pirates event]]. If already above neutral reputation, you can simply buy wood from the [[Blacksmith]] and hand it to the [[Korin]] for a fast way to get reputation.
*Once you've become popular with the residence of Etrea (Etrean guards call you friend of Etrea/your name when you interact with them), talk to [[Kennith]]. Kennith is an Etrean Guard and is located next to a bridge near the [[Etris Palace]].
*[[Kennith]] will ask you to talk to the locals of Etris about [[The Lord Regent]]'s reputation as a ruler.
*Talk to [[Bookkeeper Andros]] in the library.
*After speaking with [[Bookkeeper Andros]], head to the Etris Docks and take a right, staying close to the wall. You will see marks on the ground that leads to the desecrated body of [[Kennith]]. A Royal Guard will send you to the Lord Regent as an audience. (Additionally, you are able to skip this stage by talking to any [[Etrean Royal Guard|Royal Guard]] as opposed to the one at the death scene of [[Kennith]] you must sneak up on them or they will aggro on you)
*Make sure you talk to the [[Etrean Royal Guard]]s to tell them that the the Lord Regent is expecting you, making them docile unless provoked.
*Heading upstairs, speak with the Lord Regent, making sure not to stay too close to his throne. He will hire you into doing his bidding of obtaining the artifact known as the "Forge of Sin" in [[Duke Erisia's Manor]] in [[Upper Erisia]]. Upon accepting his offer, he hands you the key to the locked iron gate in the Manor.
*Traverse through [[Erisia]]. Go through the [[Towerstruck Lands]] and through the [[The Garden Reservoir]] until reaching the manor entrance.
*To use the key to unlock the black iron gate, the key must be glowing white.
*Descend to the elevators, and fight against a handful of [[Mindless Servant]]s, [[Brainsucker]]s, and [[Golem Prime]]s.
*Fight [[Duke Erisia]]; a [[Celtor]] scientist who went insane from his corrupted knowledge.
**Failure to fight the [[Bosses|boss]] (via escaping the boss room through the elevators again or dying) and reporting to the Lord Regent that you failed to drive the Duke out of the Manor causes the Lord Regent to execute you where you stand.
*After you defeat the Duke, if you visit the Lord Regent once again, he thanks you for your help and disposes of you, as you're no longer needed.
**If this happens to you and you go back to try and get your loot, even if the guards are passive and you tell them you have an audience with the Lord Regent, the Lord will execute you again if you try to enter his room.

===<u>Diver Apprentice Quest</u>===
To begin this quest, talk to [[Karliah]], an [[Adret]] Diver. She is located in a house near the signs, next to the General store.
*Accepting to escort her activates the quest. Meet her at the [[The Viper's Jaw]], located in Lower Erisia. (She is located near the zip line placement near the ruins, on top of the cave deposit in Pathfinder's Respite. 
**You must have Charisma ~10 to charge Karliah {{c|notes|20}}.
*Save her from the [[Mudskipper]] that is attacking her.
*Interact with her.
*This quest is very easy to screw up, and if you do so there is no way to uncap Charisma, so be careful.
**Failing will result in her dying to [[Isopod|horseshoe crabs]].

====<u>Ending 1: Promise Broken</u>====
''"Don't be scared. I promise I'll protect you no matter what."''

*By choosing to continue the escort, Karliah will enter the cave and almost immediately get attacked by [[Horseshoe Crab]]s.
*There is no reward for this ending.  (The four horseshoe crabs on the ground can be seen beforehand but cannot be attacked or killed, neither before or during the attack. This route is meant only as some twisted ending.)
====<u>Ending 2: Eyes Wide Open</u>====
''"You've been through a lot—maybe you should go home and study on your own for awhile and come back later."''

*Picking the 2nd option, Karliah returns back home and studies. If the Player checks up on Karliah's Home in Etris, she is covered in blood and mentally deranged, along with petting the head of [[Joshua]] who she once helped.
*She greets you with a friendly tone and talks about her studies. Her eyes to the truth of the world were revealed due to the studies you ask her to.
*There is no way to save her, as the only option is to put her down, snapping her neck from behind.
*The reward from this ending is a fistful of EXP, and a shiver down your spine.

====<u>Ending 3: Snap Back to Reality</u>====
''"I don't think you're cut out for this. Mudskippers are small fry, and you'll face much worse as a Diver. You need to rethink your life goals."'' 

*Picking the 3rd option (which requires atleast 50 Charisma), Karliah accepts your harsh honesty, and retires from being a Depths Diver. She goes back home in Etris.
*Checking up on Karliah back in her house, she is now in a different set of clothing. Talking to her thanks you for seeing the realities of life and reflect about the people of Etris being friendly with her.
*The reward from this unbounds your Charisma, a fistful of EXP, and a moment of harmony and relief.
*If you don't have 75 Charisma, you won't uncap it. However, you can do the quest with 50 Charisma and come back to her in Etris after the quest. Talk to her again and get the uncap card.

===<u>Cinders of Etris</u>===
This is a disaster that happens every other hour. Fire and smoke clouds will cover over Etris.

NPCs at the Etris Docks will comment on the [[The Central Authority|Authority]] seeming to have been quiet today, signaling the start of the event.

At the beginning of the disaster, the Authority will begin to invade Etris, starting at the docks and making their way up to the city's center. Lesser Etrean Foot-soldiers and Royal Guards will spawn in to aid Etris. Polis will also fight as a unique enemy.

After all Authority Guards are defeated, peace is restored and all participating players receive a chest with mid and endgame loot.

===<u>Ploom's Embers</u>===
*Talk to Ploom, located in Lance's Food.
*Further through the dialogue, you can choose 3 ways of doing this quest. 
*#Do the quest normally and accept his offer. Fetch him 3 Dying Embers.
*#Perform a Charisma Check, which requires Charisma 50.
*#Perform a [[Flamecharm]] Check, which requires Flamecharm 40.

*Reward of doing Ploom's bidding is the ''Pleeksty's Will'' Talent, which increases [[Ether]] gain from consuming mantra ingredients.

===<u>Frostdrawer Nell Quest</u>===
*Talk to Nell, located in the Alchemy House.
*Accepting Nell's quest requires you to bring [[Frigid Prism]]s to them (two if already obtained and five if not unlocked).
*After giving them the required items, they then give the player [[Glassblood]].
*Drinking Glassblood will grant [[Frostdraw]].

===<u>Navaen Tribe Rescue Quest</u>===
*Find and rescue a [[Navaen Hostage]] in Erisia, in one of the many encounters there.
*Upon finding a Navaen tribe member, head back to [[Cheral]] and receive your reward.
*The reward for this quest is the [[Fists|Way of Navae]] fist style and Talent. In addition, it unlocks a new dialogue option from Polis. It also will prompt "Way of Navae" to be a starting style in the start menu.

Etris Docks
content:
{{Location|name=Etris Docks|caption=There are those who think of ports as a gateway between two worlds; that of the living and that of the lost.|territory=Etrea}}
[[File:Etris Docks.png|thumb|900px|center]]

'''Etris Docks''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a landmark in [[Etris]] found in [[The Etrean Sea]].

==Overview==
Etris Docks are docks in Etris that players can dock their [[boats]] in among other things.

==Potential Enemies==
{{EnemyGallery
|Etrean343.png|Etrean Guardsmen}}

==Contents==
===[[Fishing]] Shop===
*Players can purchase a Fishing Rod for {{c|notes|30}} and [[Chum]] for {{c|notes|10}} here.

===[[Mantra Collector]]===
*Players can find Schnitzel who will purchase their [[Mantra Modifiers]].

===[[Shipwright]]===
*Players can find a [[Shipwright]] who can craft you [[boats]] for notes and spawn your crafted boats.
**If you have low [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]], he will refuse to craft or spawn your boats.

===[[The Great Sharko Rumbling|Great Megalodaunt Rumbling]] Remembrance Shrine===
*"May The Depths be merciful to the souls we lost on that dreadful day"
**Using any [[Emotes|Emote]] next to the shrine will summon [[Destroyman III]]. He can be unsummoned by Emoting again.

title: Etris Flask
content:
{{IronVowEx}}
{{ItemTemplate
|title=Etris Flask
|image=Etris Flask.png
|type=Tool
|desc=A rejuvenating concoction based on etheric components. When [[the Lord Regent]] came to power, the [[Royalists]] fled with the secret of its production, ironically leaving [[Etris]] berefit of the flasks.
|obtainment=[[Vow of Iron]]
}}

==Description==
The '''Etris Flask''' is a small potion obtained on every character made within [[Vow of Iron]], it can be consumed to heal back 30% of the player's maximum health. In the mandatory progression bosses it will instead heal '''50%''' ([[Iron Vessel]]s heal 5%). Additionally, once a player is killed for the first time during a progression boss, the Etris Flask will automatically go down to one use left, regardless of how many uses it had prior.

Normally, it has only one use before requiring to be refilled by entering [[The Cerebral Spire]]. While the player is consuming the Etris Flask, they are locked in its animations (this can be negated by unequipping the flask, which does not consume a charge). Attempting to use the Etris Flask with no more uses will cause a silly animation of the player attempting to drink any last drops from the flask.

*Etris Flasks cannot bypass [[Wither]].

title: Etris Palace
content:
{{Location|name=Etris Palace|territory=Etrea|caption=An imposing aura of pride, tradition, and dignity courses through the halls of the estate.}}
[[File:EtrisPalaceSreenshot.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Etris Palace''' is a palace in [[Etris]] located in [[The King's Garden]]. It is surrounded by palace [[Etrean Royal Guard]] on the inside and outside. 

== Overview ==
The palace has two floors, the first has some unremarkable rooms, and the second [[The Lord Regent|Lord Regent]], needed to obtain the key for [[Duke Erisia]] or the [[Oath: Contractor|Contractor Oath]]. If you do not have an active quest gain on the aforementioned Duke, the Lord Regent will simply kill you when you approach him. Above the palace, there's an orb necessary for progressing the [[Oath: Jetstriker|Jetstriker]] oath

title: Evengarde Rest
content:
{{Topbuttons|p, Maestro Evengarde Rest, {{iv|Maestro Alkhurst Legato}}}} {{PathfinderEx|counterpart}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Evengarde Rest |image1=Evengarde.png |name=Evengarde Rest |alias=Maestro |aspect=Etrean |affiliation=[[Etrea]] |location=[[Temple of the Blade]] |pronouns=He/him}} ==Description== Evengarde Rest is the current [[Maestro]] of [[the Vigils]], having succeeded [[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]] and is highly respected by all of them. He resides within the [[Isle of Vigils]] and is found in their dojo, watching people train. An intimidating air lingers around him, and it prevents people from introducing themselves to him until they get permission. [[The Pathfinder]] can speak to rest if they save a Vigil swordsman named [[Vigil Isaac|Isaac]]. A master of combat arts, Rest is able to teach them how to overcome the limits of their weapon proficiencies. As a youth during the [[Etrean Civil War]], Evengarde was a known prodigy and departed for the Western Luminant to train with [[The Hundred Legions]]. [[Dravik]] believed that Evengarde was fully capable of defeating [[Etrea]]'s [[The Lord Regent|Lord Regent]] at the time.{{Ref/NPC|Dravik, the Rat King|quote=All of this for Zi'eer, eh? Well, if I'm being honest, he might be a bit out of your league, kid. The only person I know who might be capable of taking on him was a young prodigy from the Blade Temple. He's off training in the West with the Hundred Legions now... I don't really blame him - the Blade Temple is a shadow of it's former self.}} Rest is respectful towards those who save his Vigils and even feels in their debt, but also values strength, stating that he'll only teach those who "display some level of competence." If you lack 75 points in your weapon type's attribute, he will not uncap it After you commit various deeds for the good of Etrea, Rest reveals his devotion to the kingdom and his aspirations of felling [[The Ministry|the evil that controls it]]. However, he expresses dissatisfaction at his inability to deter [[The Central Authority]] should Zi'eer be eliminated, which would almost certainly result in them staging a final assault with everything they have. Seeing the assimilation of cultures into the Authority's soulless war machine as a fate worse than even the one the Ministry has in store for them, he can only watch as his people are puppeteered by forces beyond their knowledge and control to their deaths. ==Dialogue== |-|Base Dialogue= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |''*A chilling wind seems to pick up within the room as you approach the man. Something in your gut tells you now isn't the time to introduce yourself.*'' |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Vigil's Savior= This dialogue is unlocked once the player has completed the [[Temple_of_the_Blade#A_Lost_Sibling_Quest|Lost Sibling Quest]] from Apprentice Kj. '''Note: This set of dialogue is locked once the player meets the requirements for "Boss Fight Initiation."''' {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |Ah, well if it isn't [First Name]. I'm sure we have much to talk about, but let me start by thanking you for saving one of our own. I'm in your debt, truly. |- | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I need training. | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Maestro, Etrea needs your help. The Lord Regent must be stopped. |- | colspan="6" |I see... What are you proficient in? | colspan="6" |''*He grimaces.*'' Be that as it may, his presence is the only thing standing in the way of a full invasion by the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}. My strength alone cannot hold them back. |- | colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |I'm not very proficient in anything. | colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |I need training in [Light]/[Medium]/[Heavy] Weapons. | colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Surely the Authority is better than the state Etrea is in right now? | colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What if Etrea could stand on its own? |- | colspan="3" |Although you helped us greatly, I do not have the time to teach a true beginner. Come back when you have displayed some level of competence. | colspan="3" |'''MED:''' Ah, my specialty. Very well, I shall teach you the steps to become a Master.
'''Other:''' Ah, I will have to break out Astris and Aeris (LHT)/Galadriel (HVY). Very well, I shall teach you the steps to become a Master. | colspan="3" |They would strip our blades from our hands and destroy our way of life. Living under the thumb of {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} Peacekeepers is no life at all. I'd sooner fall upon my own blade than submit to those dogs. | colspan="3" |Should the tides shift... I would gladly stand at your side in vanquishing that foul creature. For too long has Etrea been subject to the whims of others. Be that the Ministry or the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}... |- | colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] | colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What if Etrea could stand on its own? | colspan="3" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |- | colspan="6" | | colspan="3" |[See first instance] |} |-|Boss Fight Initiation= This dialogue is unlocked once the player has defeated [[Duke Ishamon Erisia]] and has high Ally [[Reputation]] with Etrea. {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*The Maestro smiles as you approach him.*'' [First Name], what brings you here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I feel as if we're underprepared against the Lord Regent. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*He raises an eyebrow.*'' As much as I hate to admit it.. You may be right. ''*A moment of silence passes.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}..I heard you have an arsenal of weapons in this hall. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*The Maestro appraises you, his eyes flicking towards you.*'' I suppose I have amassed a collection over the years. However, those days are over now. Most of my blades are now collecting dust. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could I use them? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Hm? Use them? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I mean, if they're not being made use of there's no harm in it right? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Listen, [First Name]. I personally appreciate what you have done for us. However, there are no ordinary blades. They possess formidable strength behind them. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What if I prove myself? How about a challenge? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*The Maestro smirks, he finds the concept amusing.*'' A challenge, hm? Very well then, I will test your strength myself.
'''HVY''': The weapon I will offer you is known as the "Pale Briar." It's a weapon of some significance from the West.
'''MED''': The weapon I will offer you is known as the "Purple Cloud." It's an ill-tempered blade with a long history.
'''LHT''': The weapon I will offer you is known as the "Cerulean Thread". It's a fine dagger when coupled with steel wire as its thread.
That being said, I have no intention of going easy on you. This polearm ('''HVY''') / blade ('''MED''') / knife ('''LHT''') cannot be handled by the faint of heart. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll do it. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player is teleported into the dungeon {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Maestro Defeated {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Maestro Undefeated {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}*''The Maestro smiles''*. Ah, well if it isn't my friend, [First Name].
[Player has obtained a weapon from Evengarde Rest] How's "Pale Briar ('''HVY''') / Purple Cloud ('''MED''') / Cerulean Thread ('''LHT''')" treating you? {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}*''The Maestro grins.''* I'll skip the formalities, I assume you have already practiced after our last bout. Ready for another shot? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}We've been well, thank you. Care for another round? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes, I'm ready. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Let's see how your skills have improved, eh? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player is teleported into the dungeon {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== Group.png|Concept art(left) File:Maestro Face Upclose.png|Evengarde's face ==Trivia== *Kelsius is highly grateful towards Rest for taking him in, in spite of his complicated past as a war criminal. *Has two unique light weapons (Astris and Aeris) and a unique heavy weapon (Galadriel). These are only mentioned during his training and are not shown in-game. **Galadriel is likely named after Galadriel from ''Lord of the Rings''. *Whenever you try to spook him with a Hallowtide Mask, he doesn't get spooked and instead just says from these lines: "Give me a break." "Foolish." "Take that stupid thing off." *Rest is the only NPC to have heterochromia; the presence of different colored eyes in the same person. However his green eye is unlikely to be genetic, rather a product of his Tempest Eye. *His hair ID is : [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6101425666/Dark-Messy-Manbun 6101425666]. **Evengarde Rest and [[Aska]] share the same hair id *The coat Rest is wearing is a black [[Deepwoken Cloak]] with bright white dye to obtain the grey. **A white [[Deepwoken Cloak]] may be dyed grey to obtain the same effect. *[[File:Dialog box after the tp .png|thumb]]After starting the teleport to the fight there is another dialogue box with Evengarde Rest saying "Let's see how your skills have improved, eh?" *If you taunt him during your fight by pressing T, he will immediately activate his Tempest Eye and decapitate you, seeing it as disrespectful. **The Tempest Eye is only actually capable of sensing movement rather than providing strength-based utility, so his usage of it is solely theatrical. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Etrea]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Etrean Luminant]] [[Category:Maestros of the Vigils]]

This [[Megalodaunt]] variant is a rare spawn and it spawns in the [[First Layer]]. It is unknown where else it may spawn. {{clear}} ==Attacks== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !GIF |- |
'''Slash'''
(★★☆) |A short range '''Slash''' using their forearms, often used four or more times in a row or paired with a kick. *Heavy posture damage. Will commonly block break after two hits. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Normal sharko swing.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Quad Slash'''
(★★☆) |Four short range swipes using their arms. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.n, dodge.n }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Kick'''
(★★★) |The Megalodaunt will flash red before delivering a '''Kick''' that can rag-doll and send the player flying. *Causes the player to be Dazed if kicked into a wall. *This ability is very dangerous as it can send you into unwanted situations. *This ability is blockable, although you need alot of posture to block it. *Commonly avoided by walking or running sideways, as the hitbox has little width. *Animation changes to a "Bite" attack if the Megalodaunt is swimming but still functions the same as a normal kick. *Creates the longest duration in which this beast doesn't attack, letting you freely hit it more than the other attacks allow. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.n, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |[[File:Normal sharko watch your tone.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Thousand Needles'''
(★★☆) |The Megalodaunt bends over and points its coral tubes towards an opponent, spewing a large and constant spray of coral shards at anyone in front of/around it for a second. *Easily parryable. *There is a shorter ranged AOE version and a longer range, individual target version. Both function the same. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Normal sharko coral.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Roar'''
(☆☆☆) |Lets out a '''Roar''' at nearby targets, initiating combat and inflicting a generous amount of [[Insanity]] and [[Fear]]. *Blocking negates much of but not all the insanity gain. *Increases posture damage against all players affected by the roar, similarly to Ardour Scream. {{AttackTags |debuff, parry.n, block.y, dodge.y |type3_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Normal sharko rawr.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |

(★★★) |The Exotic Megalodaunt raises its entire body upwards, opening its jaws to begin charging up a dark orb. Once fully charged, It hunches back down, firing a massive laser beam at its target. If the player is low enough, It will '''AUTO-GRIP''' them. *This is its most dangerous move. *Players executed by the Cero move will be completely vaporized and will not drop a loot bag for others to interact with. *Can either fire it immediately or delay its use of the laser beam. Watch carefully for what it will try to do. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|thumb]] |- |

(★★☆) |The Exotic Megalodaunt feints their attack, mixing up their opponent. *This can chain into a different move eg: Slash feint into a Kick. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|thumb]] |- |
'''Jump'''
(☆☆☆) |If the target is above it, the Exotic Megalodaunt will Jump at the direction of it's opponent to close the distance. Often used after Kick. {{AttackTags |unharmful, movement }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |} ==Finisher== {| class="fandom-table" ! Name !Description |- |Curb Stomp |The Megalodaunt ends its opponent's life by delivering a stomp onto their bodies with a gruesome crunch. This happens in less than a second. This attack has an AOE effect which can be parried similar to the [[Rock Golem]]'s stomp. |} ==Passives== *'''Thick Hide''' - {{PAGENAME}}s automatically extinguish [[burn]]. ==Tips== *The Exotic Megalodaunt will often use multiple attacks in quick succession (including the same attack twice in a row) with very little downtime in between each attack. This paired with the monster being very fast and dealing high damage per hit makes it a very dangerous foe. *Their thousand needles (either variant) can be parried by simply tapping F once due to Autoparry frames, and allows you to get as many hits in as a Kick would. *Do not try to stat check this mob because it will most likely kill you faster than you can kill it *Try to get help in killing it as in one person can parry it and the others can deal damage *[[Run It Back]] makes it way easier. ==Passives== *'''Monster Resistance:''' Has an innate ~25% resistance to physical hits. ==Trivia== *This Megalodaunt variant was created by Agamatsu. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

The Submergence of the Southern Luminant was not solely perpetrated by the Horror that plunged Celtor into the Depths below, but by countless other smaller tragedies drowned out by the vastness of calamity. == Description ==
The Eye of Malice is a Legendary [[Weapons|Medium Sword]] that drops from [[The Doom of Caeranthil]]. It is a whipblade made of several bony segments, with a protrusion in one of the segments.

This weapon has one passive ability:

'''Gaze of The Doom''' - Every basic attack applies the Mark of Malice, enhancing the critical. Signified by an orange eye with swirling effects.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:EOM Crit1.gif|Whiffed
File:EOM Crit2.gif
</gallery>
The user leaps and thrusts the whipblade into the opponent, applying knockdown before lashing out into the air again. If the critical is landed on an opponent with the Mark of Malice, the weapon will damage the opponent twice, proccing talents like Spine Cutter.

Feinting during this critical will cancel momentum and allow you to more easily use this attack in close quarters combat.

The critical has a cooldown of '''6 seconds'''.

An eye at the heart of each furling spiral. Long before [[Drallis Ehr|Drallis]] tamed it, and before [[Glossary#The Tides|the Tides]] drew in, it was in contemplation of the devastation it wrought that Mankind cultivated the art that would become [[Galebreathe|Galebreathing]]. Yet, owing perhaps to its muse, this nascent art would also become the foundation of [[Shadowcast]]ing. In some senses, it was only in the years where the Godstorm was dormant that the wind and shadow could be considered separate.
|oath=Silentheart
|stances=2 Handed, <abbr style="cursor:help; text-decoration-style: dotted" title="All dual-wielded weapons are, mechanically, locked to the 1-Handed stance.">1 Handed (Dual wield)</abbr>
}}

== Description ==
The Eyes of Ethiron is a horrifying version of the [[Curved Blade of Winds]]. Now infused with [[Shadowcast]], it combines the power of [[Galebreathe]] to unleash a torrent of dark, malevolent wind. 

This weapon comes with a passive ability: 

* '''Twisted After Cut''' - Basic attacks apply After Cut dealing 5% of the initial damage of the attack, as well as stealing the opponent's Ether.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Sable Winds}} adds Shadowcast damage to your {{t|After Cut}} hits. Additionally, this Talent allows your Shadowcast Mantras to benefit from your {{t|Inhale}} Talent, even allowing you to Inhale the Shadowcast Mantras themselves.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Eyes of Ethiron Two Handed Critical.gif|One-Handed (Dual Wielded) Critical
File:Eyes of Ethiron One Handed Critical.gif|Two-Handed Critical
</gallery>
The Eyes of Ethiron has two critical attacks, with it reflecting on the user's weapon stance. Both criticals apply [[Suffocation]], steal Ether, and proc certain [[Shadowcast]] Talents on hit. 

For the One-Handed (Dual Wielded) Critical, the user swirls forward, leaving a trail of Shadow-imbued wind behind.  

For the Two-Handed Critical, the user unleashes a malevolent tornado, sending targets upwards when hit. Notably, this makes opponents that are flung upwards able to be [[Combat Mechanics|Air Countered]]. 

These criticals have the [[M1 tag]], allowing them to proc M1-exclusive [[Talent]] effects. Both criticals have a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*This weapon is merely invoking the name of [[Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye]], and has no further connection to him.<ref>[[File:EyesOfEthironNoRelationToEthiron.png|250px]]</ref>
*The [[Gatherhand]] inscription on the weapon are transcribed to:  "A murky gale slips thru town, Soft air hums a quiet curse, Folk fall as lambs go out, A whole mass wanes to nil"
*The weapons innate Talent can lead to some ridiculous results:
**Being able to spawn 35 to 45 [[Shadow Seekers]] by {{t|Inhale|inhaling}} a Mantra with maximum [[Cloudstone|Cloud]] and [[Mantra Modifiers|Stratus Stones]].
**Extremely large [[Shadow Roar]].
**Very large Shadowcast Mantras in general.

== Description==
Eylis is the leader of [[The Knives of Eylis]]. She stands near the table in the room next to the Bounty Board. Not much is known about her besides the fact that she has some sort of contract with the [[Voidmother]]. In the Voidwalker description it says she has plans in mind for you and that she says you're different from the other Whalers, what this could mean is beyond anybody, but some think it's hinting at a quest line.
{{clear}}

{|class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Here? Where is this?

Do not interfere with our operations. Do not seek us out. If you become an obstacle to me, you'll soon sink too.
|-

|-

==Description==
Ezra is a [[Capra]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

Ezra gives a quest to kill Songseekers at the [[Derelict Highchurch]]. He also provides some information about Songseekers. Upon completing his quest, you gain a Bravery Talent hand. 

Before [[Samael]] and the [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred]] took over the [[Derelict Highchurch]], it was a place for Ezra and the [[Capra]] to worship Mother [[Capra|Ku]], a [[Celestial]]. When [[Samael]] took over, he turned it into a place to "worship" an unknown [[Celestial]].

The quest and Talent hand is unavailable if you are a Starkindred.

==Location==
Ezra is located at [[Songseeker Wilds]], sitting on a mountain in front of a structure.

{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Ah, forgive my manners! I am Ezra, a devout of {{g|Ku, the Mother|Ku}}, the Mother. I travel these islands to dispense her wisdoms to those who'll lend an ear. But that's becoming awfully difficult with all of these ''cultists''...

{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}You... You bear the stench of their rituals! Did they send you to get rid of me?! I won't stick my nose into your secrets any longer, just leave me be...
{{!}}-

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The Capra is stunned, the next words stammered.*'' Y-you mean... No... Such sacrilege... To think they had been holding one captive under there. I knew something was up, but this is...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything we can do about it?

title: F'leche
content:
{{CutContent}}
{{Quotes|quote=You! You have no idea how happy I am to see your face right now. I thought I was losing myself from the loneliness of this city!|author=F'leche}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=F'lech NPC.png
|name=F'leche
|aspect=Tiran
|pronouns=She/her
|location=[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]]}}

==Description==
F'leche was a [[Tiran]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is one of several individuals who have become trapped in [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]], and is having trouble remembering her past.

F'leche is unable to remember the name of the [[Kyrsgarde]], but notes that they weren't always this frenzied until the presence of the player in the city. She gives insight to summoning the [[Scion of Ethiron]], and has knowledge about the obelisks needing to be de-activated.

At one point, she encountered [[C'lantaa]], but ended up driving him off.

She wore a [[Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer]] with [[Eyeglasses]].
{{clear}}

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|Base Dialogue=
{{#tag:tabber|First Encounter=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Is that... Gods below, another living soul?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}For now.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}You! You have ''no idea'' how happy I am to see your face right now. I thought I was losing myself from the loneliness of this city!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}..I don't believe we're as familiar as you think.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Ah, my apologies! Apologies, apologies. I may have gotten ahead of myself.. again! ''*She sighs, glancing around the hightowers of the city anxiously.*'' I may just be on edge is all. Lots of, hm.. ''abnormalities'' have happened today.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Abnormalities?
{{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't seem right.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Yes, yes! Many oddities... ''*She looks you up and down, puzzled.*'' Say, you wouldn't be the one to cause the big rumbling upstairs, right? Up above in the, um.. forever-hurricane, I think it was called? Eternal.. huh, can't remember. But yes, that! Was that you?
{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}''*She glares at you with contempt.*'' So I did get ahead of myself when it came to the niceties. I see. If you were down here as long as I, then you'd know how ''lonely'' it is. Maybe I just want someone to be nice back, instead of dwelling on my oh, so tragic tale!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}That's me, yes.
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Care to tell the tale?
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Apologies.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Wow... ''*She looks starstruck, staring at you intently.*'' That's.. so cool! Wow! I hope I can make that big of a ruckus some day. The whole city seems frenzied since then! The big men are so, so angry, they're walking circles everywhere!
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Ohh, I've waited so long to tell a tale! So, so I... ''*She trails off, her eyes looking downward.*'' I... don't remember? That's odd, no I... think! Think! ''*She hits her head a few times in frustration.*'' My tragic tale? What's my tragic tale? Where is it? I..
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}That's the spirit, thank you! Now then... what are you here for? No one seeks me out unless they want something, so spit it out.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you mean the Kyrsgarde?
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Are you okay?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do I get out of here?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do I open the door to Ethiron's Bedchamber?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}The uhh.. huh? ''*She tilts her head*'' I can't figure that out, my head's been jumbled, you see! But, but, enough about that, I wanna know about my new friend! I don't care about the big men and their atrocities, when I have ''you'' right in front of me!
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Am I.. okay? ''*Her eyes begin to well up with tears.*'' Why am I down here?... Who are you? What is... my tale? This doesn't make sense, I know it's there somewhere... ''*She hits her head once more.*'' Gods below, '''THINK'''! Why can I not.. remember?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*She laughs hysterically, almost to a concerningly manic degree, before straightening herself and looking at you blankly.*'' I've asked the same thing for so many years. So, so many. Want me to count them for you?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Well, that's quite a tricky question! ''*She glances up and around the towers of the city, pointing her finger across the blue rays of light in the skyline.*'' See those? There are obelisks that the main gate sends a ray to, thus keeping the gate sealed shut. There's even an obelisk down below this train station building... If only the door would open. If you can follow the rays, and deactivate each obelisk.. the security mechanism will shut off! All hells break loose, and {{g{{!}}Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye{{!}}Ethiron's}} Scion is no longer contained! Isn't that so... ironic? Better kill him, better kill him good! ''Or the [End Dialogue] will be your fault.''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't seem right.
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're awfully playful in such dire circumstances.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Gods below, forgive a woman for wanting to be happy for once! Am I creeping you out? Do I seem desperate? Are you bothered too, like all the others? ''Will you try to leave me too?''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Hey... Why aren't you saying anything? Did I say something wrong? Hey... don't go. I don't wanna be alone again.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]

{{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}My best friend, oh how I've missed you! Please please, tell me, how have you been? You're happy to see me, right? You won't leave me again, right?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}..I don't believe we're as familiar as you think.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}[See first instance]
}}

{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

We're not on the best of terms, to say the least. I scared him off, haha... silly 'ol me... ''*She gives a pained smiled, evidently hurt by this memory.*'' Oh, but you! You! You can be my new best friend! We've known each other for so, so long, right?

{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}..I don't believe we're as familiar as you think.

{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ah, my apologies! Apologies, apologies. I may have gotten ahead of myself.. again! ''*She sighs, glancing around the hightowers of the city anxiously.*'' I may just be on edge is all. Lots of, hm.. ''abnormalities'' have happened today.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You don't seem right.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*She glares at you with contempt.*'' So I did get ahead of myself when it came to the niceties. I see. If you were down here as long as I, then you'd know how ''lonely'' it is. Maybe I just want someone to be nice back, instead of dwelling on my oh, so tragic tale!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Care to tell the tale?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ohh, I've waited so long to tell a tale! So, so I... ''*She trails off, her eyes looking downward.*'' I... don't remember? That's odd, no I... think! Think! ''*She hits her head a few times in frustration.*'' My tragic tale? What's my tragic tale? Where is it? I..
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Are you okay?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Am I.. okay? ''*Her eyes begin to well up with tears.*'' Why am I down here?... Who are you? What is... my tale? This doesn't make sense, I know it's there somewhere... ''*She hits her head once more.*'' Gods below, '''THINK'''! Why can I not.. remember?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}..Have you dwelled in the mist, by any chance?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The.. mist? Have I dwelled in the mist? Have I dwelled.. anywhere? I can't remember. No, no it's all too.. far away, I just can't reach the thought. I just can't reach the thought. I just.. ''*She looks toward the ground, defeated.*'' My.. tale?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
</tabber>


==Trivia==
*F'leche's racial variant is a Cardinal.
*The name "F'leche" is a reference to the word "Flèche". Which means "Arrow" in French.

==Description==
Faction Ambushes are a [[Random Encounters|Random Encounter]] that involves a squad of several faction-affiliated [[Enemies]] being sent to kill a player that has sufficiently negative [[Reputation]] with their respective faction. The encounter can occur nearly anywhere in Lumen, and will only happen to players who have Hunted reputation or lower with at least one faction. Unlike other random encounters, killing the enemies sent after the player will incur a reputation penalty and therefore lead to an even lower reputation with the respective faction. In exchange, defeating all the enemies will reward a decent-sized [[Chests & Sacks|Chest]] filled with items pertaining to that faction.

== Description ==
The Factions of Lumen feature their own diverse narratives, characters, objectives, and territories. They serve as the key driving forces of the game.

The player's [[reputation]] shapes how both them and the faction interacts with each other, positively or negatively. 

The page and list below reflects the current status of the Factions in ''Deepwoken''.

== List of Factions ==
The primary and reputable factions in ''Deepwoken'' include:
{| class="fandom-table"
!Faction
!Description
|-
|[[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}
|Also known as the Kingdom of Etrea, it occupies half of [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|the Eastern Luminant]] with its territory being in [[Etris]] and the [[Isle of Vigils]]. It is temporarily ruled by [[the Lord Regent]].
|-
|[[Etrean Royalists]] {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}
|Serving under the Kingdom of Etrea before they suffered under consisting of four great clans. These clans are known as Ganba, Mofisu, Kobura, and Anako. '''They only appear in the [[Vow of Iron]] Gamemode.'''
|-
|[[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}
|A predominant military and political force run by [[Drallis Ehr|Sovereign Drallis Ehr.]] The Authority's goal is to unite all of Lumen in order to stand against [[the Depths]]. In [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|the Eastern Luminant]], they are at war with Etrea and the Hundred Legions. 
|-
|[[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}}
|A division of [[The Citadel of Markor]] that conducts expeditions into [[the Depths]] to study its nature and gather materials. 
|-
|[[The Hive]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}}
|Operating on four Greathives of Lumen, they seek to rise above the Tides through their use of [[Lifeweave]].
|-
|[[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}
|A freelancer company that is primarily focused on mining expeditions, trades, and [[The Depths|Depths]] exploration. They often come into conflict with the Divers and the Summer Company.
|-
|[[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}
|Founded by [[Gunsmith Rosen]], the Summer Company is the primary manufacturer of firearms that were brought back from [[The Canticlysm]]. They are often found sabotaging the Ignition Union for the sake of aggressive competition.
|-
|[[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}
|Primarily a [[Gremor]]-focused group that are usually nomadic and worship the [[celestial]] Navae.
|-
|[[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}
|A predominant power in [[Luminants#Western Luminant|the Western Luminant]], the Hundred Legions are an empire consisting of [[Khan|Khans]]. After a recent pact breaking between them and the Authority, 
|-
|[[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}
|Serving under [[Eylis, the Punished Dreamer]], the Knives of Eylis are a ruthless mercenary organization that seeks to get the job done, no matter what banner they serve under.
|-
|[[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}

==Description==
Falei is a [[Ganymede]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is one of the [[Apprentice Diver]]s who joined [[Chaser]] in his expedition into the Second Layer before his betrayal.

He is located in the [[Sanctuary Gatehouse]] in [[The Eternal Gale]]. He gives tips about the strong gale winds in the layer.

{{clear}}
== Dialogue ==

| colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="4" |''*The man lies hunched over on the ground, seeming defeated.*'' My gut really is always right.. This never seemed right. I should've... warned the others. ''*He coughs violently.*''
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |What happened?
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Are you okay?
|-
| colspan="2" |That man... Chaser. Him and the others, toward the <font color="#246c60">Spire</font>... ''*He begins to cough once more, shaking in his place.*'' Don't...

|-

==Description==
The False Memory is a near exact replica of the basic [[Sword]], but with slightly higher Medium Weapon scaling. It is obtained by interacting with the [[Hippocampal Pool]] in [[Fragments of Self]] and selecting the "False Memory" option.

{{DefaultCrit|Sword}}

==Trivia==
*At max MED, the weapon deals 21.4 damage.
*The weapon does not stay with you when creating a new character, and cannot be passed down. Instead, it's only known purpose is to allow you to switch weapons at [[Fragments of Self]] in order to pass down your current weapon
*When attempting to create a new character with False Memory in your character's inventory, upon being reborn, the False Memory will be replaced by the [[Sword]], retaining the quality stars of the False Memory.
*The weapon has a low chance to be blessed with one of the many [[Enchantments]] when pulling it from the Hippocampal Pool, and can be soulbound to the player.

This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 15 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 2000 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+25% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+25% Elemental resistance}}, {{stats|ether|+20% Ether Regen}}, and {{stats|stealth|+50% [[Stealth]]}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Bane}} Talent. The {{t|Bane}} Talent grants a Talent tool that upon activation, grants a speed boost and allows you to teleport to your opponent in radius of 25 studs when using M1s, for 20 seconds. This has a cooldown of 100 seconds. ==Trivia/Notes== *This outfit is based on Rogue Lineage's [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Faceless_One Faceless One] armor, the Night Lord's outfit. *The Bane talent is based on the Bane ability from the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Assassin Assassin] class in Rogue Lineage. Unlike its Deepwoken counterpart, this ability only works on daggers. **It also feature the Agility skill sound effect at first, which boosted movement speed and attack speed. The Agility + Bane combo was often used. *This outfit used to additionally require an [[Emerald]] in its crafting recipe, but this was removed with the addition of [[Trinkets]] in the Feburary 25th, 2026 update. The emerald requirement was a reference to the Faceless One class obtainment in Rogue Lineage, where players had to give Shadow, the Faceless Trainer an emerald as a prerequisite to obtain the class. *Initially on release, this outfit had a staggering 5000% stealth, however it was quickly toned down to 50%. {{History}} {{Nav|Hallowtide}} {{Nav|Outfits|2}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Hallowtide]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

x5 Fiber
x1 Nightbringer Enchant Stone |price=5,000 |stat_req=Power 15 |durability=4000 |resistances={{stats|phys|+35% Physical Armor}} {{stats|elm|+35% Elemental Armor}}

{{stats|sdw|+5% Shadow Armor}} |talents={{etal|outfit|Soul Rip}} |obtainment=*[[Lysander Spellhardt]] [35 Joy] *Any Blacksmith if you have the [[Seasonal Medals|Hallowtide '24 Medal]] [3 Knowledge] Chests from: *[[Widow's Wail Cemetery|The Trial of the Gourdskipper]] }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Unique [[Outfit]] in ''Deepwoken''. ==Statistics== ===''Requirements''=== This Outfit costs {{c|notes|5,000}} and requires five (5) [[Cloth]], five (5) [[Fiber]], and one (1) [[Nightbringer]] [[Enchant Stone]] to craft. This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 15 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 4000 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+35% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+35% Elemental resistance}}, {{stats|flm|+5% Fire resistance}}, and {{stats|sdw|+5% Shadow resistance}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Soul Rip}} Talent, but will passively reduce your movement speed by 30% while equipped. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|phys|35% Physical}}, {{stats|flm|38.25% Flamecharm}}, {{stats|sdw|38.25% Shadowcast}}, and {{stats|elm|35% Elemental|flm=n|sdw=n}}. The {{t|Soul Rip}} Talent grants 2 ''Runes'' every time you kill a player, then upon using its Talent tool it will consume a Rune to grant a 50% melee damage buff, a 20% defense buff, and infinite Ether for 25 seconds. Once Soul Rip ends, one of your legs will break, removing your ability to sprint for 30 seconds. ==Gallery== FamiliarHereticArmorDyedWhite.png|Familiar Heretic's Armor Dyed White. ==Trivia/Notes== *This outfit is based on Rogue Lineage's [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Wraith_Knight Wraith Knight's] armor, the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Wraith_Knight Wraith Knight] armor. **The Wraith Knight armor is notoriously very tanky, which is why this armor has very high Physical and Elemental Armor *The Soul Rip talent is based on the skill of the same name from the Wraith Knight class and Dinakeri race in Rogue Lineage. **Soul Rip was an alternate method to grip players, which granted runes to be used for the Berserk Rune effect (granting the same set of buffs as the talent form) or to be used for Rune Casting spells, allowing instant and sucessful usage of spells. **The Leg Injury following the effect would happen if a player had the Wraith Knight's Soul Rip but not the Rune Mastery passive. In practice however, this was very unlikely to be the case. *Soul Rip's rune count persists even after you switch outfits. *This outfit, along with its sister variant, [[Familiar Knight's Armor]], can be banked without spending any Knowledge. These are the only Hallowtide items to have this property. *This outfit was bugged on release, voiding itself if you attempted to learn the schematic. This was fixed shortly after the item's addition. *The Fire and Shadow resistance granted by this armor is in reference to Wraith Knights using Dark Flames as part of their skillset. Wraith Knight's Dark Flames are also the inspiration for Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets. *The description for this outfit, "Fit only for a traitor" is in reference to how in order to obtain the Wraith Knight class in Rogue Lineage, you have to start out as a Sigil Knight and then betray the order, becoming Chaotic rather than Orderly. *Familiar Heretic's Armor has a unique interaction with [[Dye Packet]]s, where instead of getting tinted, it dyes different parts of the outfit individually. *Despite popular belief, the melee buff is only ~25%. {{History}} {{Nav|Hallowtide}} {{Nav|Outfits|2}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Hallowtide]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 15 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 3500 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+30% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|40% Elemental resistance}}, and {{stats|ether|+10% Ether Regen}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Hyperbody}} Talent, but will passively reduce your movement speed by 30% while equipped. Using the {{t|Hyperbody}} Talent tool applies a buff to yourself and nearby allies that increases movement speed, defense, and regeneration. This effect becomes weaker the more allies are affected. Hyperbody lasts 30 seconds, but the duration is reduced by 3 seconds per person affected, including yourself. Hyperbody has a 2 minute cooldown. *Increases your movement speed by 7.5 studs/s. This counts as a speed boost for Talent effects. This speed boost will halve in effectiveness per ally buffed. **For example, at one ally you'll only gain +3.75 studs/s movement speed, at two allies this'll be reduced further to +1.875 studs per second, and so on. *Increases your passive health regeneration by +50%. This buff is split evenly amongst all people buffed. *Grants a 35.5% damage reduction buff. This is '''increased''' by 20% multiplicatively for every ally buffed. **For example at one ally, this will grant +42.6% damage reduction, at two allies this will grant 51.12% damage reduction, and so on. *Hyperbody can stack if one of your allies uses it, though the total effectiveness will only be 90% of the base effectiveness. File:Hyper body.gif|Hyperbody being applied File:Hyperbody.gif|Closeup of the Hyperbody effect ==Trivia/Notes== *This outfit is based on Rogue Lineage's [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Sigil_Knight_Commander Sigil Knight Commander's] armor, the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Armor Errant armor]. *This outfit, along with its sister variant, [[Familiar Heretic's Armor]], can be banked without spending any Knowledge. These are the only Hallowtide items to have this property. *The Hyperbody talent is based on the skill of the same name from the Sigil Knight Commander. It also features the weakened effect when shared. *This outfit was bugged on release, voiding itself if you attempted to learn the schematic. This was fixed shortly after the item's addition. *This outfit had a different appearance when it was first added to the game, but it was changed soon after to match its current appearance. *The outfit description, "You don't know why but a certain Murmur is making you very angry" is in reference to the Murmur, Ardour, which shares a very similar name to Ardor, God of Chaos, from Rogue Lineage. Ardor is the enemy of Solan, God of Order, and the Sigil Knights. {{History}} {{Nav|Hallowtide}} {{Nav|Outfits|2}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Hallowtide]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Family
content:
== Family ==
Players can be family members with each other with the [[Character Creation|character creation]] screen. Depending on what you choose, you can be someone's cousin, sibling, or even twin.

Having certain traits can make you someone else's relative. The chance to be relative to someone else is RNG, but it has requirements.  

* Cousin - Same variant of the same aspect, most common relative.
*Sibling - Same variant of the same aspect, same last names, born on a different date. 
*Twin - Same last names, same racial variant, same age.
*Juvenile - Same variant of the same aspect, must be 20 years younger than your relative.
*Elder - Same variant of the same aspect, must be 20 years older than your relative.
*Niebling - Same variant of the same aspect, same last names, must be exactly 20 years younger than your relative.
*Pibling - Same variant of the same aspect, same last names. must be exactly 20 years older than your relative.

==Trivia==
*Being a twin may not be age reliant, twins have been found who have different ages likely due to scales of inactivity and time of being online among twins.
*Pibling and nibling are probably equivalent to sibling chance, but with the 20 year age difference (while juvenile and elder are cousins equivalent.)
*It is possible that Ganymedes and Vesperians can be cousins, due to Ganymedes being evolved Vesperians in the lore

title: Fang and Coil
content: {{Weapon Infobox |bankable=No |droppable=No |enchantable=No |damage type=Blunt |attack duration=0.5s |range type=Sweep |image=Fang and Coil.png |type=Light Weapon |requirements={{t|Fang and Coil}} Talent |damage=12 |posture damage=3 |range=6 |swing speed=1.13x |obtainment= #Kill [[the Doom of Caeranthil]] #Have 20 LHT and ally [[reputation]] with [[Etrea]] #Talk to [[Vesque]] |description= |-|Weapon=''The serpentine martial arts of [[Etrea]].'' |-|Talent=''Adopt the path of the serpent.'' |scaling=LHT: 7 |m.equip=No |rarity=N/A }} ==Description== '''Fang and Coil''' is a leg-centered [[Fists|Fist]] style obtained from the [[Isle of Vigils]] by talking to [[Vesque]] with 20 Light Weapon, Friend reputation or higher with [[Etrea]], and after defeating [[The Doom of Caeranthil]]. Its attacks consist of a chain of kicks, a leg sweep, and an advancing front-flip before a stomp, the lattermost being accessible only if the player has the [[Jade Vigil's Weave]] outfit equipped. Fang and Coil is notable for its dazing capabilities and wide attack area, with both of its criticals dazing opponents on hit and covering decently sized areas around the player compared to other fighting styles. The standing critical ragdolls the opponent away on hit and is a bit slower but can be useful for mix-ups. The running critical both dazes and puts the opponent into knock-down on hit, giving it high combo potential, and with its forward advance giving it a factor of surprise and, as such, comparatively quicker speed, it's a useful tool for calling out enemy movement and starting combos from mid-range. {{text|fistswitch}} ==Obtainment== In order to obtain it you must speak to [[Vesque]], an NPC located in the [[Isle of Vigils]] near the Barber and the Attunement [[Training Gear]] store, while having above 20 Light Weapon, [[Etrea]] '''Ally''' Reputation or higher and having defeated [[The Doom of Caeranthil]] in such a way that awards a chest. These steps can conveniently be done in any order and lack a level requirement. You will receive the Fang and Coil Talent, granting you the fighting style and allowing you to select it from the Character Creation screen. [[File:Vesque.png|none|thumb|200px|Vesque]] ==Criticals== For its '''Critical''', the user does a quick leg sweep, ragdolling and dazing opponents. The standing critical deals 0.65x (or 65%) of your weapon's ''scaled'' damage. Additionally, it deals 10 Posture damage. This attack dazes and ragdolls for 1.25s, and with a short windup of 0.4s and an endlag of 0.25s. This attack has a '''3 second cooldown'''. For its '''Running Critical''', the user performs a front-flip followed by a dazing knock-down stomp with a wide AoE, and is only accessible while wearing the [[Jade Vigil's Weave]] outfit. The running critical deals 1x your weapon's scaled damage. Additionally, it deals 10 Posture damage and has 10% innate Chip damage. This attack dazes and knockdowns for 0.95 seconds, and with a short windup of 0.5s and endlag of 0.25s. This attack has a '''5 second cooldown'''. This additional critical can '''only''' be used on fist weapons that do not have unique criticals (Fang and Coil, [[Handcuffs]], [[Iron Cestus|Iron]]/[[Legion Cestus|Legion]]/[[Flamekeeper Cestus]], [[Gaunts of Enmity]], and [[Worldpiercer Gauntlets]]) and [[Markor's Inheritor]]. File:FangCrit.gif|Critical File:FangRunningCrit.gif|Running Critical File:Top View Fang and Coil running crit.gif|Top View ==Gallery== File:FangAndCoilNewIdle.gif|Idle Animation File:FangM1chain.gif|M1s File:Fang Coil CA.png|Concept Art of the fist style with the [[Steelscale Dusters]] and [[Jade Vigil's Weave]] {{History}} ==Trivia== *This fist style is likely based on the Shaolin Kung Fu Snake style. **This branch of Kung Fu emphasizes snake-like forms, which is reflected in the fluid animations and the acrobatic running critical associated with [[Jade Vigil's Weave]]'s innate Talent. "Coil" may refer to the Coil techniques of the Snake style. **The description of Fang and Coil confirms it's an ophidian martial art from [[Etrea]], whose design draws heavy inspiration from ancient Sinospheric civilizations. {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Fists]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Fighting Styles]] [[Category:Light Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with multiple Criticals]]

This is a reference to real-life sphynx cats being bald. *When wearing a helmet or hat, it will not hide the cat ears, instead they will go through the headwear. *For April Fools 2022 ([[Mudwoken]]), Felinors had their aspect name changed to "Abomination", which is unique compared to the other aspect names that were changed. **This ''may'' be because of the disdain the community shows towards them. *The [[stealth]] gain multiplier applies to negative stealth gain as well, making the [[Obvious]] Flaw grant -24% stealth. File:Ferrymancurse.gif|Ferryman's Curse applying on the wearer ==Trivia== *Like the name suggests, it's the signature outfit of the Ferryman. *Does not give you any abilities used by The Ferryman, nor does it affect your [[Thundercall]] Mantras. *Prior to the addition of [[Item Bank]]s, the schematic was able to be dropped. *If you have [[Thundercall]] with the {{t|Resolve Crusher}} Talent, when you electrify opponents by hitting them with a Mantra all their attacks will be converted into Lightning damage, allowing you to make great use of the heavy Lightning resistance granted by this Outfit. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Firfire
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Firfire|caption=The opening gives way to a small town inhabited by structures that appear familiar yet alien.}}
[[File:FirfireThumbnail.png|thumb|900px|center]]
==Overview==
One of the least hostile parts of [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Floor 1]], Firfire is located above the [[Firfire Caverns]] and is home to various friendly [[Kyrsgarde]] and a quest. It is necessary to visit this location in a run to open the way to [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]. 

Firfire does not have active wind or snowfall. Previously existing parasites will remain, but they do not progress or build up while in Firfire.

==Landmarks & Sub-locations==
[[File:Screenshot 2023-08-10 at 23.50.06.png|thumb]]
If you travel past Erosius and take a left, you will encounter a [[Kyrsgarde]] called Makolis Pariah Katatonicus. Talk to him twice then proceed to use the resting [[Emotes|emote]] next to him, and he will then tell you that you are a good friend and that he will remember you. This interaction can be done as many times as you please.

[[Aska]] is located behind three hidden Resonance Doors underneath a cliff, who can reward you with the [[Pleeksty's Inferno]] if you meet certain requirements. Black and orange sparks can be seen drifting in the air close to the location of these doors. 

The Bloodrend Trainer, [[Vyrelda]], can be found in an Igloo on the east side of the village, caring for an injured diver. She only appears after you have beaten Chaser on that slot. 

==Quests==
You can find a spear in the Firfire Caverns to obtain the Ethiron's Gaze Talent from Erosius. The Talent persists permanently on a slot after this; you merely have to speak to Erosius in the future instead of finding the spear to progress.

After talking to [[Vyrelda]], and accepting her quest, 3 [[Ministry Bloodrender|Ministry Bloodrenders]] will spawn in the village. After killing them, you can bring the [[Heartstar]]s they drop back to her to obtain [[Bloodrend]].

==Trivia==
* The music for this area is [[Whisperwind]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
* After using the resting emote near Makolis Pariah Katatonicus, if you talk to him in future runs he will label you as "Friendwalker" instead of "Fringe/Frinwalker."

title: Firfire Caverns
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Firfire Caverns|caption=Twisting turns and eternal darkness await those foolish enough to continue.}}
[[File:cavern.png|thumb|900px|center]]
==Overview==
The Firfire Caverns is a large cave system found in the [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|Second Layer]]. It is extremely dangerous; the ceiling will often collapse, and it contains every single monster found in the 1st Floor of the 2nd Layer. Its entrance will be locked if the player does not first activate the generator. 

It contains two exits. The first one leads to the [[Firfire|Firfire Village]], and the second is locked until the player talks to the village chief with the Ethiron's Gaze [[Talent]], leading to the [[Nest Corridor]].

Brief hallucinations of Bounder faces occasionally appear for a split second in the Firfire Caverns. These are only visual and serve to scare players (see [[Ghost Bounder]]).
==Contents==
===Spear of Nakti===
*At the bottom of a small pit deep inside the caverns, the Spear of Nakti can be found planted in the ground. Interacting with it will result in multiple [[Carbuncle]]s spawning in, defeating them will reward you with a chest.
*This spear is part of a quest to acquire the Ethiron's Gaze Talent.
===4 Rune Puzzle ===
*Located in the Firfire Cavern's bottom floor, accessed by falling through one of the false floors. Consists of 4 runes on the floor which when put in the right order opens up a long tunnel to a gate that teleports you to [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]]. You can see the teleport destination from spawn marked by a glowing blue gate off in the distance. This can only be used if you have the Ethiron's Gaze Talent from the Quest given by the [[Firfire]] village chief. However, be warned that this method will void your Light Hook.

=== Potential Enemies ===
*[[Bounder]]
*[[Diver Husk]]
*[[Carbuncle]]
*[[Ghost Bounder]]
*[[Bone Keeper]]

== Trivia ==
* The Spear of Nakti is a reference to the game's main composer, Naktigonis.
* For a guide on how to '''exit''' the caverns, click [https://youtu.be/z0jUO6LiA_8?si=UYXQXzbiiK5HpjZr&t=263 here] at the timestamp 4:23
* For a guid on how to '''enter''' the caverns, click [https://youtu.be/5xs6rLvl878?si=ksD8mklCBHIzdDql&t=578 here] at the timestamp 9:38
