Puppets turn purple if they've been alive for 15 seconds, signifying that they only have 10 seconds left to live. |} |-|Vaporborne= These Talents are found in the ''Vaporborne'' category. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" style="text-align: center" !Media !Talent !Card Description !Effects |- |[[File:TalentIconExplosion.png|120x120px]] |Flashboil
(30 Flamecharm, 30 Frostdraw) |Landing Ice/fire attacks on burning/chilled enemies extinguishes the flame and generates steam. |Dealing Frostdraw damage to a burning target or Flamecharm damage to a chilled target removes the burn and creates a stationary steam cloud. Steam clouds deal 2 typeless damage per tick in an AoE, at a rate of 6 ticks per second. Steam clouds are unparryable and unblockable. Steam clouds last 5 seconds and have an internal proc cooldown per target of 5 seconds. |- |[[File:TalentIconExplosion.png|120x120px]] |Boiling Point
(Flashboil) |Using a fire mantra near your own steam cloud detonates it |Landing a Flamecharm Mantra on one of your steam clouds causes the cloud to detonate, dealing 10 typeless damage in an AoE. |} ==Trivia== *All {{status|Burn}} types deal Flamecharm damage. **Base {{cl|fir|burn}} has a base damage of 3.33 per tick with 5 Flamecharm scaling, ticking 2.4 times per second. This gives base {{status|burn}} a DPS of 8 at 0 Flamecharm and a DPS of 12 at 100 Flamecharm. **{{status|Azure Burning|Azure Flames burn}} deals 12.5% more damage than base {{status|burn}} with the same tick rate and scaling. This means {{status|Azure Burning|Azure Flames burn}} has a DPS of 9 at 0 Flamecharm and 13.5 at 100 Flamecharm. **'''White Flames''' from [[Shard Bow|{{cl|corres|Corrupt}} Shard Bow]] or [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] has differing stats from base {{status|burn}}, with 3.21 base damage per tick and 5 Flamecharm scaling, at a rate of 3 ticks per second. This gives '''White Flames''' a DPS of 9.6 at 0 Flamecharm and a DPS of 14.4 at 100 Flamecharm. ***'''White Flames''' or [[Deepfire Ring]] + Azure Flames has a DPS of 10.8 at 0 Flamecharm and 16.25 at 100 Flamecharm. ***[[Deepfire Ring]] applies the same upsides and downsides that '''White Flames''' has to all other {{status|burn}} types, lowering {{status|burn}}'s base damage but increasing the tick rate. The DPS from '''White Flames''' and Deepfire Ring is identical, though Deepfire Ring '''does not''' affect '''White Flames'''. Deepfire Ring is seen as a direct upgrade due to the higher DPS. **{{status|Puppet Burn}} from Twisted Puppets deals 87.5% less damage than base burn with the same tick rate and scaling. This gives {{status|Puppet Burn}} a DPS of 1 at 0 Flamecharm and 1.5 at 100 Flamecharm. Additionally, this {{status|Black Flames|burn}} type drains 6.25 Ether per tick (15 Ether per second) from affected targets and spawns Puppets every 4 seconds. **{{status|Shadow Burn}} from Twisted Puppets deals 75% less damage than base burn with the same tick rate and scaling. This gives {{status|Shadow Burn}} a DPS of 2 at 0 Flamecharm and 3 at 100 Flamecharm. Additionally, this {{status|Shadow Burn|burn}} type drains 6.25 Ether per tick (15 Ether per second) from affected targets. *{{status|Burn}} didn't always scale on your Flamecharm investment, nor was it always affected by Flamecharm resistance. This was added in the {{VersionHistory|2024|October 31st}} update. *{{status|Burn}} benefits from '''general''' PEN, such as PEN from [[Strength]] or from having an [[Oath]]. *{{cl|fir|'''Searing Snare'''}} has the same sound effects as [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser's]] Burning Blood Explosion move. *All Flamecharm Mantras deal 10% reduced damage in the rain, unless the user has the {{cl|fir|''Unyielding Inferno''}} Talent. **This also applies to the [[First Light]] Critical and Twisted Puppets' Puppets. *Eruption delay can be reduced with the [[Deepfire Ring]], and Eruption AoE can be increased with the {{status|Empowered Eruption}} buff from Empowered Eruption and Flash Point Talents as well as Azure Flames. *Some Mantras are inspired from pyromancy and attacks from games created by the '''''FromSoftware Inc.''''' game company, the company also happens to be a large inspiration for the entirety of ''Deepwoken''. **The {{cl|fir|'''Flame of Denial'''}} Mantra is named and acts in a similar way to the [https://darksouls3.wiki.fextralife.com/Tears+of+Denial Tears of Denial] Miracle from ''Dark Souls III'', preventing the player from dying to one-shot moves. **"{{cl|fir|Flame Within}}" is named and acts in a similar way to [https://darksouls.wiki.fextralife.com/Power+Within Power Within] from ''Dark Souls'', boosting overall damage while draining health. **Although the {{cl|fir|'''Fire Palm'''}} Mantra looks similar to the "Ignis" spell from the Roblox game ''Rogue Lineage'', the Mantra is actually inspired from the "Combustion" skill in ''Dark Souls'' and [https://sekiroshadowsdietwice.wiki.fextralife.com/Flame+Vent Shinobi Prosthetic: Flame Vent] from the game '''Sekiro''', as the spell does NOT multihit; instead, being a single large hit that sets on fire. *Although the {{cl|fir|'''Flame Blind'''}} Mantra looks similar to the snap version of the "Velo" spell from the Roblox game ''Rogue Lineage'', the Mantra is actually inspired from the ''Valorant'' character "'''Phoenix'''" as one of his abilities involves throwing an orb flash made of fire. *The {{cl|fir|'''Fire Gun'''}} Mantra is most likely a nod to "Higan" (火ガン, literally meaning "Fire Gun"), one of the moves of the [https://onepiece.fandom.com/wiki/Mera_Mera_no_Mi Mera Mera no Mi] from ''One Piece.'' *The {{cl|fir|'''Flame Sentinel'''}} Mantra is likely a reference to the "[https://jojowiki.com/Magician%27s_Red#Life_Detector Life Detector]" technique from the Stand "Magician's Red" from ''JoJo's Bizarre Adventure'', which can detect lifeforms manifesting as a floating flame candelabrum. *The {{cl|fir|'''Flaming Scourge'''}} Mantra is inspired by one of Katakuri's [https://onepiece.fandom.com/wiki/Mochi_Mochi_no_Mi Mochi Mochi no Mi] moves from ''One Piece'' called Buzzcut Mochi. *The {{cl|fir|'''Flame Ballista'''}} and {{cl|fir|'''Flame Repulsion'''}}'s spring spark variant are references to ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. **{{cl|fir|'''Flame Ballista'''}} is Sukuna's "[https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Shrine#Divine_Flame Fuga]" [[File:FlameBallistaSuggestion.png|225px]], and {{cl|fir|'''Flame Repulsion'''}}'s spark takes inspiration from Gojo's [https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Cursed_Technique_Reversal:_Red Reversal Red]. *There used to be a Mantra called Flame Tornado during the beta. It worked similarly to {{cl|fir|Rising Flame}} with the same VFX but did not push either the enemy or the user into the air. *If a player procs "{{cl|fir|Meteor Impact}}" on another Flamecharm user who also has the Talent, should the victim parry the meteor slam, their character will immediately attempt it themselves, effectively reversing the attack. **{{cl|fir|Meteor Impact}} used to also apply to Uppercutting and had a range multiplier, but was removed due to balancing reasons, along with the range simply adding "+3" to your weapon range. *Flamecharm is a great attunement for grinding in [[The Depths]] as {{cl|fir|Undying Flames}} causes the user's {{cl|fir|'''Graceful Flame'''}} to work in the [[First Layer]] and restore sanity. *The Flamecharm Attunement can be used to {{cl|fir|burn}} multiple knocked enemies at once and is extremely useful in PVE or in Ganks/Guild wars. *The {{cl|fir|'''Graceful Flame'''}} Mantra allows anyone to cook food, regardless of its Level. *{{cl|fir|'''Ash Slam'''}} used to scale on Strength, as well as scale much higher, before a weekly changed it to pure Flame scaling. *Previously, and for a long time, Flamecharm was once the only attunement without a Legendary Elemental weapon, excluding the [[Hero's Blade of Flame]]. This changed in the '''April 4, 2024 update''', which introduced the [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]]. *If the character has the Azure Flames Talent while using a [[Railblade]], the effects of the Railblade critical attack will turn blue and apply azure flames upon a successful critical attack instead of regular flames. It can also work with Twisted Puppets, having the critical turn black and spawn in Puppets. *You cannot have both Azure Flames and Twisted Puppets at the same time. **Additionally, you cannot have any combination of Twisted Puppets, Eruption Path, and Flashboil at the same time. *Before its release, {{cl|fir|'''Flaming Scourge'''}} was a Mantra which could not be reliably blocked, parried or dodged, and could result in those being hit by it being, at best, flung and killed unfairly, or at worst, banned from the game. Similar to [[Shade Wisp]], this Mantra had not passed testing, on account of it banning all the testers who had been trying to test it. A similar controversy was the addition of [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]], which was also hidden from testers and led to an overpowered, albeit less buggy, release. *Flamecharm was invented by [[Amorus Pleeksty]], a Tiran who later went on to become a Deepwoken. *The {{cl|fir|'''Fire Gun'''}} Mantra gives the player fingers, similar to when casting a Ritual Cast Mantra. Its there, but it's difficult to see due to particles. *Before the Perfect Cast mechanic was removed, {{cl|fir|'''Flame Grab'''}} and [[Jolt Grab]] were among very few abilities and the only Mantras to have an innate unique interaction with it. When Perfect Casted, the duration of these Mantras would be shortened and capped, playing "extinguish"-like VFX unique from the regular version. **A video summarizing this effect can be found [https://youtu.be/o3AJne5Y04U?si=Jzim_sMEg3q-qTkX here]. ==References== {{nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

The {{PAGENAME}} is an [[NPC]] located in a small hidden cave with lava flowing out at [[Saramaed Summit]]'s highest area. It must be located and interacted with, along with [[Saintsworn Obelisks|4 other element-based obelisks]], to obtain the [[Saintsworn]] [[Oath]].

|oath=Silentheart
}}

==Description==
The '''Flareblood Kamas''' are a pair of Legendary [[Weapons|Light Weapon]] Kamas that scale with Light Weapon, Bloodrend, and Intelligence.

The Kamas are exclusively obtainable from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]], and occasionally the [[Weird Trader]].
==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Flare Bloodkamascrit.gif
</gallery>
The user raises both kamas, unleashing a fountain of blood at their cursor, launching the target into the air while ragdolling them for a short duration. The critical deals '''1.5x scaled damage,''' applies [[Status Effects#Blood Poisoning|Blood Poisoning]], and restores a portion of the user's blood on successful hit.

The critical has a cooldown of 8 seconds, not starting until the critical animation is finished.

{{text|m1leg}}

==Trivia==
*The weapon itself, "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kama_(tool) Kama]" is a traditional Japanese farming tool, used for harvesting crops, but also martial arts.
*This weapon model and Critical is a reference to [https://smite.fandom.com/wiki/Izanami Izanami], a character in [https://smite.fandom.com/wiki/Smite_Wiki SMITE].
*As 8/26/2025, it scales off Bloodrend, making it the first weapon in the game that scales off of attributes not listed in its requirements.
*There is a reskin of this weapon called the [[Moon Blades]], which belongs to both Supaa and Valekis since they won the first Deepwoken [[Battle Royale]] tournament.

title: Flashing Thunder
content:
{{IronVowEx}}{{Quotes|quote=Beat the Rat King with your third eye open, forfeiting your sense of sight.|author=Flashing Thunder obtainment hint}}{{Memento |image=Flashing Thunder Memento.png |description=Lightning always finds its mark. |final attributes=*100 Thundercall *100 Medium Weapon *50 Fortitude *100 Agility *50 Intelligence *45 Willpower |final traits=*4 Songchant *4 Proficiency *3 Vitality *4 Erudition |allowed weapons=Any |flaw=[[Blind]] |starting weapons=[[Shattered Katana]] |starting items=[[Pathfinder Lantern]] |unlock=Defeat [[Dravik, The Rat King]] as a [[Sightless]] |starting armor=[[Stormchanter's Raiments]]|starting attributes=*5 Thundercall *5 Medium Weapon *3 Fortitude *5 Agility *3 Intelligence *3 Willpower|starting traits=*3 Songchant *2 Proficiency *1 Vitality *2 Erudition}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. Similarly to its precursor Sightless, it starts with the 'Blinded' Talent and a [[Pathfinder Lantern]]. It starts with a unique Talent, {{t|Gathering Storm}}, which stores damage you deal into orbiting lightning orbs around you, up to a max of 8. Sheathing your weapon will fire all lightning orbs at your opponents. This is compatible with [[Divine Cast Ring]], Multiplying the damage you deal by 3x. '''Most of this Memento's Talents and Mantras are exclusively obtained through the progression bosses.''' {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|oathtlnf|All-Seeing Eye}} [Oath Talent] - The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted. **Invisible players are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position. ***Specifically reveals those under the effects of Ghost, Static Flash Clone, [[Oath: Visionshaper|Cheap Trick]], [[Oath: Visionshaper|Illusory Servant's]] casting animation, [[Beast Burrow]], [[Portals]], and other invisibility effects. **With this Talent, the [[Tacet]] is completely nullified, allowing you to see cloaked players normally. **This works on anyone who is invisible, yourself and monsters included. *Blinded - Your vision is obscured by something. Somehow, you feel safer. You remember the warmth of your youth. **Makes everything darker and creates fog at long distances **The Talent grants immunity to the [[Flame Blind]] and [[Gaze]] Mantras. *Blinded: [Equipment Talent] - Your vision is obscured by something. Somehow, you feel safer. You remember the warmth of your youth. **Makes everything darker and creates fog at long distances. **Grants immunity to the [[Flame Blind]] and [[Gaze]] Mantras. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Gathering Storm}} [Memento Talent] - Your damage is stored in a lightning orb. Sheathing your weapon will shoot the lightning orbs at the opponent. The orbs will do more damage based on how many orbs are being stored up. **Weapon damage is stored in lightning orbs above your character's head. Sheathing your weapon will consume all of the orbs and deal the stored damage all at once. **New orbs will be created once you reach certain thresholds of stored damage. You cannot have more than 8 orbs at once, but your stored damage will still be accumulated past this point. **This is essentially the [[Poser's Ring]] effect but with a visual aspect. **See [[Stored Damage Mechanic]] for more info. *Gathering Electricity [Common Talent] - {{ttag|Medium Weapons}} Reaching 5 Static Blade charges will now consume the stacks and apply a lightning buff to your blade. 60 second cooldown. (+10 Carry Load) **Clears all Static Blade stacks on proc. **You can still gain Static Blade stacks while Gathering Electricity is active. **For 15 seconds, this increases the base damage on your weapon attacks, including criticals by 3. ***+3 base damage might not seem like a large buff, but due to how Deepwoken's damage calculation works, this is very significant. *Overcharge [Common Talent] - Your next dash after activating Static Blade is enhanced by lightning. **Lightning Dashes increase your dash distance travelled by 2.3x and the duration of i-frames from rolling, but will end early if you attack. *Static Blade [Common Talent] - {{ttag|Medium Weapons}} Hitting blocks, blocking or parrying hits will now generate an electric charge in your blade, granting a small speed buff. Charges can stack up to 5 times. **Grants stacks when you '''get parried''', not when you parry attacks. Also grants stacks when you hit blocks or block attacks. **Each stack lasts for 15 seconds and refresh upon gaining another, including when you're at max stacks. You can be at max stacks indefinitely. **Each stack grants an ~2.35% speed boost, totaling to ~11.75% speed at max stacks. The duration of this speed boost is effectively indefinite, as gaining stacks can be done very easily just by playing the game. ***This speed boost can proc speed boost Talents, like Speed Demon or Cheap Shot. *Kickstart [Common Talent] - Play the resurrector. Use your lightning to defibrillate your allies on the battlefield. **Use kickstart on a knocked target to bring them back up in 3 seconds at the cost of some ether. ***Default knock time is 10 seconds, so you can make your friends get back into the fight over 3 times faster. ***Takes 5% ether on use and an extra 20% on successive use. ***Brings the target up with 10% health. ***Requires an animation, stunlocking yourself. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Lightning Blade (☆☆☆) |image=Lightning_blade.gif |desc=Arcing blades of electricity. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|thundercall|Lightning}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=None |effect=''Dash forward before performing two slashes, sending out 2 short-ranged arcs of lightning forward that pierce through targets.'' *Initial hits deal 7/8/9/10/11 base damage per level, per hit (2) with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *The [[Magnet Spark]] variant adds an additional hit that deals 8.75/10/11.25/12.5/13.75 base damage per level with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *Stormcaller Slash deals an additional 12.25/14/15.75/17.5/19.25 base damage per level with 5 Thundercall scaling. *Deals 3 posture damage per initial hit (2), Stormcaller Slash adds an additional 5 posture damage. *10 second cooldown. *Has 0.42 seconds of wind-up. *The arcs can completely phase through an enemy if you cast it too close to them, therefore mind the spacing. *Can be cancelled midway after the first 2 slashes by right-clicking. *At end of Mantra, performs a "'''Stormcaller Slash'''", a former Talent which is now innate. **Can be canceled by feinting right after the flash of lightning. This puts the Mantra on cooldown for 5 seconds. *Can be modified with a [[Magnet Spark]], which causes the mantra perform an additional short-ranged teleporting slash immediately after the first two. File:Lightning Blade Magnet Spark.gif|Magnet Spark }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Slice 'n' Dice (☆☆☆) |image=Slice 'n' Dice.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Step forward and slice through your enemies. Ability can be activated again on a successful hit. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=None |effect=''User dashes towards the camera and unleashes a wide slash. Can be performed again if the first slash lands.'' *Deals 19.1/24.2/29.3/34.4/39.5 base damage per hit with 1.3 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 16 posture damage and is 360 blockable. *Has a 25 second cooldown. *Has a 0.55s wind-up. *Landing the first slash refreshes the Mantra, allowing it to be used again at any time. **If used again within 15 seconds, the Mantra will go on cooldown. *Even if blocked, the cooldown of this Mantra will still reset. This is incredibly useful for block pressure. *Due to it being aimed with the camera, it can be a very useful tool for aerial mobility. *Does not register hits until the end of the move's animation, meaning you can phase through opponents without damaging them if used at close range. **Because of this, it is recommended to use this Mantra after uppercuts or while looking at the floor to land it in CQC. }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Power 20===
*{{cl|raretl|Risky Moves}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *Second Interrogation [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Electrified attacks do 50% less damage and posture damage to you. **Does not stack with Resolve Crusher's damage reduction, instead it replaces it with this, more potent, effect. **This also only applies to weapon attacks. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Lightning Cloak (★★★) |image=Lightning Cloak.gif |desc=A cloak of lightning itself. |ethercost={{stats|ether|20 Ether}} |mantratype=Support Mantra |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|1,250}} |effect=''Enveloped in lightning, increase the user's agility, swing speed (+10%), and granting them lightning dashes (long dodges).'' *Has a base duration of 8/8.5/9/9.5/10 seconds per level. *To increase the duration, you must parry, get parried, block, or attack, refreshing the duration entirely. **Lightning cloak has a maximum duration of 60 seconds. *Increases your swing speed by 10% for its full duration. *Grants a 35% speed boost for its full duration, proccing speed boost-reliant Talents (such as "'''Speed Demon'''"). *Turns all dashes into lightning dashes for its full duration, increasing their distance travelled and i-frames duration. *If you have no Tempo, the duration as well as the refreshing duration will be halved, applied retroactively. *If the caster's Ether goes to 0, Lightning Cloak will immediately end. *All '''base''' Ether regeneration is disabled during Lightning Cloak. Ether regeneration from sources like [[Talents]] or [[Outfits]] will still work however. }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *Grounding Bolt [Common Talent] - Anytime you summon a lightning strike on your opponent, apply knockdown if it lands. **10 second cooldown. **Storm Strikes from the [[Specialist Helmet|Specialist Set]] Talents and [[Storm]]/[[Stormbreaker]] Enchantments during the rain proc this Talent. *Fast Blade [Common Talent] - Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **Parrying without this Talent gives you a speed boost, but it's barely noticeable and lasts for the duration of the parry. **Increases the speed boost duration from parrying by 3 seconds. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Electrical Accumulation}} [Memento Talent] - While having 4 or more orbs, automatically gain 4 charges of Static Blade whilst you have 4 orbs. *Windup Battery [Common Talent] - Landing 3 Thundercall Mantras without whiffing reduces the windup of your next Mantra by 10%. (+7 Carry Load) **Applies this bonus to non-Thundercall Mantras. *Stratoshock [Common Talent] - Your lightning deals an additional +5% damage when in the rain. **Thundercall damage innately gains a 5% damage buff during rain, with Stratoshock increasing this to +10% damage. *{{cl|raretlnf|Static Fakeout}} [Rare Talent] - Roll cancelling immediately after a parry will cause you to teleport behind your opponent. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Prominence Draw (☆☆☆) |image=Prominence draw.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Close the distance and deliver a fast slash. |ethercost={{stats|ether|65 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=Defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)]] |effect=''User locks onto all the closest targets that are in range, then dashes forward and performs a large AoE slice.'' *Deals 9/17/25/33/41 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals '''50% less damage''' if used while your weapon is sheathed or if used on a non-medium weapon. *Deals 5 posture damage. *Has a wind-up of 0.5 seconds with an endlag of 0.2 seconds. *Allows for movestacking an M1 strike which 100% guarantees the Mantra or M1 hit. *Can be modified with Glass Stones and Magnifying Stones to increase it's tracking range. *Having the [[Forgotten Gladius]] or [[Kindred Edict]] equipped will heavily decrease its windup.}} ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Orb Discharge}} [Memento Talent] - If an extra orb is available, you can consume it to vent if you don't have enough tempo. *Swift Rebound [Common Talent] - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretlnf|Speed Demon}} [Rare Talent] - Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor. **Speed Demon's bleed deals 2.5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +7.5% damage over a 0.9 second period. **Works with M1s and criticals. *Blade Dancer [Common Talent] - Landing a Basic Attack removes your roll cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) *First Interrogation [Common Talent] - Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage. **Only procs on weapon attacks from Electrified opponents. **Ether given is equal to half of the attack's unmodified damage. **Still gives ether even if you block, parry, or dodge their attack. *{{cl|raretlnf|Lightspeed Reflexes}} [Rare Talent] - Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. (+1 Passive Agility) *Authority Intimidation [Common Talent] - Lightning moves slow your opponent more. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Ardour Slicer (☆☆☆) |image=Ardour_Slicer.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Close the distance and deliver a fast slash using your Ardour. |ethercost={{stats|ether|65 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs=Defeat [[Dravik, The Rat King]] |effect=''User launches a projectile similar to Wind Blade.'' *Deals 28 Oath damage. *Deals 10%(?) chip damage *Projectile goes really far (~150 studs) and can hit multiple people at once. *Upon hit, pushes the enemy in the direction of a projectile. *Has a windup of 0.5 seconds and a cooldown of 12 seconds. *This projectile can sometimes phase through opponents if used up close. }} ===True Heart of Enmity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Heir of Lightning}} [Memento Talent] - At max orbs, [[Lightning Cloak]] is enhanced. **This triples the base duration of your Lightning Cloak. *Steady Nerves [Common Talent] - You dance from toe to toe - successful dodges restore posture. (+7 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility) **Restore 2 flat posture on a successful dodge. *Precise Swing [Common Talent] - After landing a critical your next basic attack will gain 25% chip past your opponent's block. (+9 Carry Load, +1 Passive Agility) **If your critical lands, is parried, or is blocked, gain the [[Status Effects#Precise Swing|Precise Swing]] status effect for 30 seconds. **The Precise Swing status effect will be consumed if you hit someone's block with an M1, you land an M1, or your M1 gets parried. ***If your M1 is whiffed or dodged, the status effect will not be consumed. **Because this status effect is applied to yourself and not your opponent, you can land your critical on person A and then hit person B's block and still apply the chip damage. **Precise Swing is additive with weapon chip, and having above 100% chip causes you to deal more damage. *{{cl|raretlnf|Tap Dancer}} [Rare Talent] - Rolling immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your roll on a longer cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel. *{{cl|raretlnf|Safety Dance}} [Rare Talent] - Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s. (+1 Passive Agility) **You gain more invincibility frames while dodging, granting you longer immunity to damage. **Dodge IFrames increased from 0.3s to 0.35s. *Spinning Swordsman [Common Talent] - Running attacks do +15% extra damage when you have a speed boost. (+1 Passive Agility) *Resolve Crusher [Common Talent] - Lightning moves now apply stacks of "Resolve Crusher". At 4 stacks, you apply "Electrified" to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you. **Electrified targets have their physical attack deal lightning damage instead and deal 10% less damage. **Electrified only reduces damage from weapon attacks. **Resolve Crusher's "Electrified" effect is only applied after the 5th stack (not the 4th stated by the Talent) **'''Only''' Thundercall Mantras build up stacks for this. Thunder damage from any other source will not build up stacks. **Each stack lasts for 5 seconds. If another stack is not applied within that timeframe, the stack is reset, and you'll need 5 more stacks to activate this Talent. **Electrified, when procced, lasts for 4 seconds. **The visual effect for this talent is currently bugged, and isn't visible. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Storm Blades (★★☆) |image=Storm Blades Fixed.gif |desc=Conjure weapons of thunder with your ether. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|thundercall|Lightning}} |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''Conjure a ring of lightning blades, dealing light AoE damage.'' *Has a base damage of 20/22/24/26/28 per level with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *Deals 0 posture damage. *Has a cooldown of 12 seconds. *Has a short delay before dealing damage. *Can be modified with '''Cloudstones/Stratus Stones''' to increase the hitbox of the projectile, but reducing the Mantra's damage. *Can be modified with a [[Tornado Spark]] to cause the mantra to deploy ring of lightning; shocking and dealing damage to target(s) that touch its walls. **'''This increases its cooldown from 12 seconds to 20 seconds.''' **Good for isolating a target for a 1v1 situation. File:Storm Blades Tornado Spark.gif|Tornado Spark }}

==Description==
The '''Fondant Splitter''' is a [[Relic]] rarity [[Sword]]; an oversized cake in the shape of the [[Dormant Splinter]].

The Fondant Splitter is obtained through [[The Cold Forge]] by crafting in your Crafting Menu with: 
* A [[Dormant Splinter]]
* A [[Cake]]
* A [[Sword]], [[Messer]], [[Katana]], or a [[Scimitar]], however crafting Fondant Splitter with a Scimitar will take three Cakes instead of one.

The Fondant Splitter can be upgraded with the [[Chef's Toque]] equipment, granting it an extra 4 health on critical attack and a 35% chance to steal 1.95 * ln(D) + 1.075 hunger and thirst from your opponent on weapon hits, where D = scaled damage dealt (calculator [https://www.desmos.com/calculator/yktgme7xnc here]). This has a 3 second cooldown per proc attempt, going on cooldown even if it didn't proc.

Additionally, the Fondant Splitter's critical is buffed further when the player has all [[Talents#Tavernkeep|Chef Talents]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Fondant crit.gif
</gallery>
The user will take two bites out of the Fondant Splinter, healing 7.5 flat health per tick (15 flat health total).

The {{t|Artisan Chef}} and {{t|Master Chef}} Talents increase the healing gained from the critical by 2.5 each (+1.25 healing per tick, per Talent), and the {{t|Umami}} Talent increases the healing gained by +4 (+2 healing per tick). This allows the user to heal 24 health per critical if they have all three Talents.

This critical has a cooldown of '''20 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Fondant Splitter CA.png|Concept Art
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*First documented finding was on the 18th of December 2024, 12 days after the Dormant Splinter was added, and 5 days after the Cold Forge was added.
*Similarly to the [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]], when resting at a campfire the weapon will display a different name being: ''"Spongey and rich, with a hint of... Umbrite."''
*The Fondant Splitter is functionally soulbound, similar to the [[Diver's Light Plate]].
*The weapon is a reference to a popular trend among the community, where people used to bake real Dormant Splinter cakes in order to get a hint from Nuttoons.<ref>[[File:Nuttoons cake.png|300px]]</ref>
*The weapon originally was enchantable and required 5 MED and LVL 3 on release, but was changed to its current state on {{VersionHistory|2024|December 24th}}.
*The weapon's crit was exclusive to the 'Calabash' spec weapon before release.

title: Food
content:
File:Groose GFX Cooking.png|thumb|128.993x128.993px|
== Description == Food is a necessary need for your Character's survival. Both food and water drain at a rate of 1.25% per minute. ''To get food, one must collect ingredients from various Luminants or buy the food from [[:Category:Vendors|Vendors]] in certain places.'' * Mushrooms, fruit and wheat are all very easy to get, as they are plentiful and various on both starter islands. * In every [[Seasons|season]] (except Winter), the player can find fruit on smaller trees and some bushes, which is an easy and safe source of nutrition. * Purchased from [[NPCs]] such as [[Lance Leshi]], [[Lance's Brother]], and [[The Meat Lord]]. * Alternatively, you can turn in specific dishes that you cook to [[Chef Odiolavoro]] for some experience, although he is not a chef and should not be regarded as such. Although you can eat the ingredients directly, certain ingredients or eating too many of one thing (i.e Browncaps) may cause vomiting, which leads to an immense decrease in thirst and hunger. ''To cook food, one must be near a campfire.'' * By combining ingredients together, the player can make various types of foods/drinks. * Usually, 2-3 ingredients are needed to make a certain food recipe. (Mushroom Soup for example, requires two mushrooms of different types) ''One needs food and drink to live, much like you. Without it, one will die a slow and painful death.'' * When both the Thirst and Hunger bar reach zero, the health bar will slowly drain until it reaches half health. At this point, the Blood bar will be the next to go, and once that is gone, you quickly lose the rest of your health and die. ** With about 1/8 hunger left, healing from campfires is completely disabled. ** With about 1/8 thirst left, your vision becomes blurry, and your swing speed is lowered. * Once you reach the point of no return, you are permanently knocked for the rest of your life (which is to say not long) and cannot be picked up until you've died. When you wake up, you'll have 100?% of your Blood, Thirst and Hunger restored. __TOC__ == Food Buffs == Some foods fill a portion of your Hunger bar with a different color, known as Reinforced Hunger. *Reinforced Hunger grants certain buffs, signified by a specially colored secondary bar on top of the normal Hunger bar until it's depleted. *The type of buff can be identified by hovering over the differently colored bar. *Different types of buffs will replace each other. Same types of buffs will stack in duration. *The numbers in parenthesis after the buff type food tooltips does not indicate the potency of the buff, but instead how much of your hunger bar becomes reinforced upon consumption. For example, a Glazed Fish and Mushroom Omelette provide the same melee damage multiplier. === Buffs === * {{cl|power|''"A hearty meal that'll empower your melee strikes!"''}} The Power buff increases the user's melee damage. (5% M1 damage buff, also applies to criticals with the [[M1 tag]]) * {{cl|enchant|''"An energising meal that'll empower your mantras!"''}} The Enchant buff increases the user's mantra damage. (5% mantra damage buff) * {{cl|speed|''"A complex meal that'll get you moving!"''}} The Speed buff increases your sprinting speed. (5% running speed buff) * {{cl|ether|''"An aromatic meal to cultivate your focus!"''}} The Ether buff increases the user's ether regeneration speed. (+20% Ether regeneration) * {{cl|heal|''"A soothing meal to recover your strength!"''}} The Heal buff increases the user's health regeneration speed. (+30% health regeneration) * {{cl|full|''"A filling meal to keep you fed for longer!"''}} The Full buff significantly decreases the user's starvation speed. (10% reduced natural hunger loss) * {{cl|brain|''"A strange meat that empowers your Deep Gem knowledge."''}} The Brain buff enhances the effect of your [[Deep Gems]]: **[[Aegis Gem]]: Duration increased from 10s to 15s. **[[Blessed Gem]]: Cooldown reduction is increased from -50% to -66%. **[[Bloodless Gem]]: Heal cap increased from 15 to 20. **[[Blue Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Insignia Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Might Gem]]: Posture damage buff increased from +10% to +15%. **[[Nocturnal Gem]]: Damage is increased from 10 to 15. **[[Warped Blue Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Wayward Gem]]: Cooldown is decreased from 8s to 3s. **[[Wind Gem]]: Speed boost duration increased from 10s to 15s. **[[Wrath Gem]]: Critical damage buff per-combat tag increased from 7.5% to 15%. * {{cl|scale|''"A heavy meat that hardens your skin!"''}} The Scale buff grants 15% PEN reduction. * {{cl|throat|''"An odd meal that soothes your throat!"''}} The Throat buff increases your [[Taunt]] duration by 8 seconds, and your [[Vow of Mastery|Command: Fight]] duration by 7.5 seconds. * {{cl|strength|''"An invigorating meal that strengthens your muscles!''"}} The Strength buff grants a posture damage buff. (+10% M1 posture damage, also applies to criticals with the [[M1 tag]]) Food and their respective buffs can have their durations buffed by the ''[[Talents#Tavernkeep|Tavernkeep]]'' category of Talents. Power Buff.png|Power Buff Enchant Buff.png|Enchant Buff Speed Buff.png|Speed Buff Ether Buff.png|Ether Buff Heal Buff.png|Heal Buff Full Buff.png|Full Buff ==Food Recipes/Info== {{FoodTable|open}} == Notes == * Alternatively, you can regain your Food, Thirst and Blood bars by gaining a [[Power]], obtaining your [[Resonance]], or having the [[Talents#Apex Predator|Carnivore]] [[Talent]]. == Trivia == === General Trivia === [[File:Meat.png|thumb|Lifting The Meat Lord]] * Every fruit, more or less, has a real-life counterpart. ** Redd = Orange ** Ongo = Apple ** Calabash = Calabash ** Plumfruit = Plum ** Pomar = Mango/Pineapple ** Glumfig = Fig * Pomar is the only fruit that will damage you. ** Pomar may represent a pineapple. Pineapples contain bromelain, which breaks down proteins (what most of your body is made out of) which is why they damage you. ** Alternatively, may also represent a mango. Mango skin contains urushiol oil, which causes a reaction to the body near identical of that to poison ivy which may be why they damage you. *Mantra damage buff foods and Weapon damage buff foods provide around a 5% increase in damage.https://youtu.be/Zdj637SL9TI * Before the plates were added for most foods in a (supposed) shadow-update, the Cake model had no underside. * According to [[Destroyman III]], the strength buff the Megurger gives you is not from the food itself, but the concept. * The Glazed Fish model is placed incorrectly on the hand compared to other plate dishes. * Where did the garnish on the Omelettes come from? The world will never know. * Sushi used to be unique, in that it was completely weightless. However this is no longer the case, as it has now been assigned 2 weight. * '''Redd Juice''' is based on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_juice orange juice] because a '''Redd''' is based on an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_(fruit) orange] from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_life real life]. == Bugs == * Rejoining after eating a food that grants you a buff will make the Reinforced Hunger bar's color default to Purple. (Purely visual, the effects can still be seen by hovering over it) ** This no longer happens(at least as of 3/18/25), instead, the effect disappears once you change servers. ==References== [[Category:Food]] [[Category:Mechanics]]

{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Relic

|desc=When coated with [[Smith's Alloy]], an [[Armorer's Needle]] can be used to elevate the qualities inherent with [[Equipment]].
|value=250
|stack=25
|droppable=Yes, but not on death
|bankable=Yes, for {{c|knowledge|1}}
|usage=Increasing the quality star count on [[Equipment]] items.}}

==Description==
The '''Forge Needle''' is a [[Relic]] used for [[Equipment]]. It is an advanced version of the [[Armorer's Needle]], instead of rolling a pip on an equipment piece, the Forge Needle upgrades one of your equipment by one star. Essentially, it does the same thing as the [[Smith's Alloy]], except for [[Equipment]] rather than weapons.

This of course grants all of the benefits that come with having a higher star value, such as +1 Health to Arms, Head, and Legs equipment along with the {{cl|rarepip|Rare}} and/or {{cl|legendarypip|Legendary}} Pip(s) that the stars give as a bonus.

Somewhat unjustifiable for easily obtainable equipment, as grinding out a three-star version of the desired item would usually take much less time than the relics required to craft Forge needles. For rarer equipment pieces that are hard to find, however, such as the [[Simmerbloom Diadem]], [[Bloodforged Crown]], [[Pathfinder Elite|Pathfinder Elites]], [[Grand Fisher Plate|Grand Fisher Set]], etc, they can be very useful.

==Obtainment==
Crafted using 1 [[Armorer's Needle]] and 3 [[Smith's Alloy]]s OR 1 [[Gilded Needle]] and 1 [[Smith's Alloy]] (Can be crafted without a [[Crafting Station|crafting bench]]). Forge Needles can also be sold in [[Traan Zakshun#Black Market|Traan Zakshun's]] black market for {{c|Crowns|2}}.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:ForgeNeedle (angle1).png
File:ForgeNeedle (angle2).png
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This item was added on August 2, 2024 in the same update as the [[Grand Fisher Plate|Grand Fisher Set]].
*Like the Armorer's and Gilded needles, the item itself appears to resemble the shape of a Treble Clef, used in sheet music notation, which goes in hand with tons of other musical motifs and references within the game.
*Like many other relics, the concept of the item was suggested by YouTuber Agamatsu, who gave it the moniker "Blacksmith Alloy". The concept encompassed both the Forge Needle and the Smith's Alloy.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aYmOWi8fUZY</ref>

title: Fort Merit
content:
{{Location|name=Fort Merit|territory=The Central Authority|caption=Once a prison at the edge of Etrean influence, now a forward base for the Authority.}}
[[File:FortMeritNewer.png|center|thumb|900x900px]]
'''Fort Merit''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken.'' It is a landmark on [[Aratel Island]] found in the [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel Sea]].

==Overview==
Fort Merit is [[The Central Authority]]'s forward operating base in the [[Luminants|Eastern Luminant]].

It was previously known as Fortress Cascabel, Etrea's best fortified prison prior to its capture to the [[The Authority|Authority]], now claimed as their operating base. Ironically, [[Etrean Guardsman Hostage|Etrean Guardsman Hostages]] can be found in the cells of Fort Merit.

It is found to the right of [[Bluster Rift]] and has a port that can be docked from the shore.

==Contents==
*[[Santen]], the cartographer for the Eastern Luminant's Authority.
*[[Milgram]], a member of the Inquisition Division.
*[[Drill Sergeant Kernel]], instructor for the freshly arrived [[Authority Ensign]].

===Fortress===
<gallery>
File:MeritTower.png
File:Fort Merit Armory.png|Armoury
File:MeritMesshall.png|Mess hall
File:MeritQuarters.png|Quarters
File:MeritTopFloor.png|War room
</gallery>A large fortress on the peaks of the island, housing the leaders of the divisions and armoury.
[[Warden Jericho]], leader of the Command Division, can be seen residing in the war room.
*[[Sentinel Augustus]], leader of the Shock Corps Division, can be standing on the balcony outside the War Room.
*[[Chud Steel]], poster boy of Authority and Interceptor of the Shock Corps, is right beside Augustus.
*[[High Inquisitor Merey]], leader of the Inquisition Division, hidden in an interrogation room below the war room.
*[[Armourer Kev]] runs the Fort Merit Armoury containing weapons related to the Authority.

====Fortress Basement====
<gallery>
File:Fort Merit Prison.png
</gallery>A small basement that houses a prison containing enemies of the Authority.
*Heavily patrolled by [[Authority Peacekeeper]]s.
*[[Brutus]], a centurion from [[The Hundred Legions]] is imprisoned in a larger cell, who can unbound [[Fortitude]] and unlock [[Oath: Blightsurger]].
*[[Vice Warden Morredh]] and an [[Authority Commander (NPC)|Authority Commander]] can be found in the office.
*[[Private Kernel]], son of [[Drill Sergeant Kernel]] who briefs the Merit Detainment Core. He can be seen right next to the door that leads to the Detainment Core.

===Blacksmith===
<gallery>
File:Fort Merit Blacksmith Area.png
</gallery>The [[Blacksmith]] can be located right next to the Fortress and the Guild Hall.

*Right next to the Blacksmith is a display of weapons that correspond to their Authority Division.

===Medical Bay===
<gallery>
File:MeritMedical.png
</gallery>A small building housing injured soldiers of the Authority.

*Formerly, this building was the original Fort Merit Inn. The player will still respawn in this building if they purchased a stay at the [[Port Merit]] Inn.

===[[Merit Detainment Core]]===
<gallery>
File:Meritcore.png
</gallery>A large dungeon within the prison of Fort Merit containing the worst enemies of the Authority.
*Heavily guarded by Authority personnel, with much more dangerous forces like the [[Vice-Warden]].
*[[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] can be located here.

===[[Merit's Reach]]===
<gallery>
File:Merits Reach!.jpg
</gallery>Lawless area off the peak of the main territory.
*[[Rashet]] is located here, resting on a large pillar, allowing the player to reset their [[Reputation]] with the Authority.

===[[Port Merit]]===
<gallery>
File:Port Merit.png
</gallery>A functional port acting as the town for the island.
*Basic necessities such as the [[Antiquarian]], [[Banker]], [[Innkeep]], and [[Ships|Shipwright]] can be found here.
*Guarded by [[Authority Peacekeeper]]s and an [[Authority Lieutenant]].

===Prison Tower===
<gallery>
File:Fort Merit Impel Down.png|Prison tower exterior
File:Fort Merit Impel Inside.png|Prison tower interior
</gallery>A large towering prison branching off the main island and into the ocean.
*Players will be sent to '''execution''' here, instantly sending them to the [[First Layer]].
**Many parts of cells can be broken, allowing escape.
*Heavily guarded by [[Authority Peacekeeper]]s up and down the tower.
*See [[#Escaping Jail|Escaping Jail]] for more details.

===[[The Three Cheers]]===
<gallery>
File:The Three Cheers.png
</gallery>A bar for Authority Ensign to relax on their time off.
*Ran by [[Fabantou]], the barkeep and vendor.
*Contains [[Yakob]] and [[Taiga]].

==Quests==
==='''[[Attributes Unbound|Brutus Quest (Fortitude Uncap)]]'''===
* Reach 75 Fortitude.
* Talk to Brutus, this will result in Brutus damaging you until you are knocked granting you Fortitude Unbound card. (As a result, you can be easily gripped, best to come with a companion)
For more information, watch [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eaygZAbOxNk this video].

===<u>[[Beiruul]]</u>===
*A [[Gremor]] sitting on a tree near [[Meteor Isle]], right above the shipwright.
*Selecting the option "Very well. I can assist in the fight." will start the quest.
*With her assistance, you will have to fight 6 [[Authority Peacekeeper|Authority peacekeepers]].
*Gripping at least five signifies that you have completed the quest.
*Return to Meteor Isle and gain 2 [[knowledge]].

===Escaping Jail===
*To get jailed or imprisoned in [[Fort Merit#Prison Tower|Prison Tower]] inside Fort Merit in the first place, the player must either:
**Get [[Terminology (game)#Grip|gripped]] by an [[Authority Ensign]], or
**Talk to specific [[NPCs]] while having bad [[Reputation]] with [[The Central Authority]].
***For the list of NPCs with this effect: [[Chud Steel]], [[Drill Sergeant Kernel]], [[High Inquisitor Merey]], [[Sentinel Augustus]], and [[Warden Jericho]]<!-- there might be more, idk -->
*The player will not lose a life, nor their items, upon being imprisoned.
*While imprisoned, the player automatically equipped with [[Handcuffs]], which has the following effects:
**The player cannot use any mantras, and they can only perform light attacks and critical.
**The player will be put in a PvE [[Combat Tag]] forever, until the Handcuffs are unequipped.
**The player will be teleported back to prison whenever their health reaches 0. This heals them back to full health, and resets the timer.
*If the player does not escape prison within 10 minutes or 600 seconds, their execution will automatically commence, killing/drowning them and teleporting them to [[The Depths]] with an animation.
*To escape prison and its impending execution, the player must perform 2 actions:
*#Use their [[Handcuffs]] to break a weak part of the cell. It could be a wall or the iron bars. The breakable object will make a sound upon being swung upon, so use that noise cue to figure out which is the breakable object. This step might take over 100 seconds.
*#While avoiding capture and death, the player must seek out any [[Blacksmith]] or the [[Etrean Guardmaster]] to remove their handcuffs.
*#*Note that Blacksmiths will only remove your handcuffs if you have at least neutral [[Reputation]] with their associated faction in their location. So if you have bad reputation with [[The Central Authority]], try going to [[Greathive Aratel]], or talk to the [[Etrean Guardmaster]].

==NPCs==
Below is a list of NPCs and their uses (that are known) that you can find thorough Fort Merit.

*[[Brutus]]
*[[Chud Steel]]
*[[Drill Sergeant Kernel]]
*[[Guild Clerk]]
*[[Santen]]
*[[Sentinel Augustus]]
*[[Viridian]]
*[[Warden Jericho]]

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Fort Merit!!!1!!.jpg|Fort Merit prior to the revamp
File:Fort Merit VOI.png|Fort Merit in VOI
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The music for this area is [[Wardens Of The Valiant Dead]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*Fort Merit is called Fortification Peak by its guards when the player has maximum reputation with the Central Authority.
*Fort Merit is good place to pick up [[Bounty Hunting|bounties]], as most of the players have low/bad reputation with the Central Authority.
*Whenever you try to spook Brutus with a Hallowtide Mask, he doesn't get spooked and instead just says from these lines: "When are you gonna learn your lesson?" "Come on."
*[[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Chance|Shrine of Chance]] used to be located here, but the tunnels located on the left when entering the underground portion were removed, removing the shrine as well. It is now located at [[Meteor Isle]], neighboring Fort Merit to the east.
*Due to a bug, the [[Etrean Guardsman Hostage]] that are meant to spawn in the cells of Fort Merit no longer reliably spawn. If you want to get a Fort Merit chest from the [[Etrean Guardmaster]] you will have to get a [[Shipping Schedule]].
*According to [[Joshua (Vow of Iron)|Joshua (in Vow of Iron)]], it used to be called Fortress Cascabel.
*One of the training dummies at fort merit may be factioned under monsters causing humanoids to attack it but not [[Monsters]]

While in the Shattered State, the Fractine deals bleed damage, swings faster, but has less range and deals 30% less damage. Use the critical again to return it to its original form. |obtainment=*[[Voidsea]] Events *[[Moon's Eyrie]] *[[Semblance]] *[[Dread Serpent]] |selling price=100 |m.equip=No |rarity=Mythical |description=Ill-fated blade of void, once whole but nevermore.
Bound through Vow to the soul of a former wielder; soul now claimed by the void, shattered, fragments; through Vow, blade now fractured remnant; semblance of that which once claimed it. |enchantable=No}} == Description == The Fractine is a Legendary [[Weapons|Heavy Weapon]] that scales with, and requires [[Intelligence]] in addition to Heavy. It can be found exclusively from the [[Moon's Eyrie]], [[Voidsea]], and events found inside. It was originally the [[Ferractine]], a weapon wielded by the [[Iron Vessel]] before their defeat at the hands of the [[The Lord Regent]]. After landing the critical attack, the tip of your weapon will lodge itself into your opponent, changing the weapon into it's Shattered State. The Shattered State deals 30% less damage, has innate bleed, 7 Range, and slightly faster swingspeed (it's not very noticeable). Using the critical again returns it to its original form. ==Critical== File:Fractine1.gif|Standard File:Fractine2.gif|Shattered State The user quickly whirls the blade, performing a quick slash, leading into a heavy slam attack that shatters the blade with {{status|Hyperarmor}}. This lodges the blade into the target and puts the weapon in the Shattered State that gives the user less range and damage in exchange for {{status|Bleed}} damage and a faster swingspeed. When in the Shattered State, the user performs a downslash that regains the lodged tip of the blade, dealing damage and applying hitstun to the original target hit and all opponents within its range. The critical can be also used in further ranges to dislodge the blade from the target. This restores the weapon back into its original state. Fractine will still continue on to the Shattered State even if the second hit of the critical is parried or whiffed, but the tip of the blade will not be lodged into your opponent unless you land the critical fully. The Standard Critical has the following scaled damage multipliers: '''1.25x''' (first hit), '''1.00x''' (second hit), and '''0.85x''' (lodging the shard). The slash deals '''1.25x scaled damage''' and deals an additional '''8.16 flat damage''' upon recalling the shard. The critical has a cooldown of '''5.5 seconds'''. == Gallery == Fractine Wide.png|Wide view Fractine Shattered Wide.png|Wide view (Shattered) Fractine Full.png|Full view Fractine Shattered Full.png|Full view (Shattered) File:FractineShard.png|Fractine's shard being lodged onto an opponent. ==Trivia== *Unequipping and re-equipping your weapon while in the Shattered State will also return it to its original form. *It has the rarity of a [[Soulthorn]] in the [[Moon's Eyrie]], possibly even rarer. *Take caution in its slow swing-speed in both of the forms as it may mess up your combos. *The reason why it's fractured is due to the binding of the soul to the weapon being "too tight" causing the weapon to break when the initial user died, but it stayed in one general piece as it still had a soul binding it. *Its zig-zagged design may have been based off of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flamberge Flamberge]. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Greatswords]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Core-Attribute based weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Heavy Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with multiple Criticals]]

'''Fragments of Else''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a sub-location in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} of [[Vow of Iron]].

==Overview==
Fragments of Else acts as the counterpart to [[Fragments of Self]]. Players are sent to it whenever they die in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}}, choose to wipe their {{iv|Vow of Iron}} character in the main menu, or selecting Obliteration in [[Trial of One]].

==Contents==
===Glimmers of Return===
Located before the [[Reclaimer of the Recollection]], a beam of light emanating from the center of the Fragments of Else that allows you to return to the [[Locations|Surface]] by paying varying amounts of {{c|Robux|Robux}}, the amount depending on the [[Power]] level of your character; it is {{c|Robux|80}} for Power levels 1-5, {{c|Robux|400}} for Power levels 6-10, {{c|Robux|800}} for Power levels 11-15 and {{c|Robux|1000}} for Power levels 16-20.

===Reclaimer of the Recollection===
Located past the Glimmers of Return, the [[Reclaimer of the Recollection]] serves to wipe your character similarly to the Self in [[Fragments of Self]]. See their page for more information.

title: Fragments of Self
content:
{{Topbuttons|p, {{iv|Fragments of Else}}}}
{{PathfinderEx|counterpart}}
{{Location|name=Fragments of Self|caption=What will become of us?}}
[[File:Fragmentsofselfwider.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Fragments of Self''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a sub-location in [[The Depths]], yet also a place entirely within your mind...

== Overview ==
Fragments of Self acts as the sad purgatory of ''Deepwoken''. Players are sent to it whenever they die in [[The Depths]], choose to wipe their character in the main menu, or selecting Obliteration in [[Trial of One]].

== Contents ==

=== Campfire ===
Players could use this to remove equipment they want to pass down at the Hippocampal Pool. Now, all it's good for is making a food item to get an Echo Triumph.

=== Hippocampal Pool ===
Located to the left-hand side, beyond a small parkour section. Interacting with it allows you to pass down two (up to six, if you have the [[Echoes]] upgrades) items that will transfer to your next character. It used to allow you to obtain [[False Memory]] as a way to de-equip your primary weapon.

* You can pass down a Legendary Weapon or Enchanted Item, albeit at a cost of 40 Echoes.

=== Shrine of the Drowned ===
''Main page: [[Shrine of the Drowned]]''

Located before Self, a statue that allows you to pay 1000 {{c|Robux}} to return to the [[Locations|Surface]]. This can only be used once per character and requires at least [[Power]] 2.

=== Self ===
''Main page: [[Self]]''

=== '''The Legacy menu''' ===
[[File:Legacy of Isma Kanreshi.png|left|frameless|275x275px|The legacy menu upon wiping]]
The Triumphs section shows the player's achievement across the progression, these will add points for [[Echoes]], a  currency that purchases upgrades for their next and existing characters. 

The Echoes section shows how much echoes you earned, and the Rank Based on it. Rankings range from E-W, Rank S being extremely rare and Rank W even more so with the added requirement of having every Echo modifier active (except Vow of Thorns and Glass Bones) while also meeting the requirements for S Rank.
=== Captain ===
The Captain, otherwise known as Captain Orlandeau, was previously located on the stone arch to the right of the player. He's a dark-skinned, translucent [[Felinor]] wearing a [[Brigand's Bicorn]]. Talking to him would have allowed you to replay the [[Tutorial]] and forces you to start with the [[Castaway]] Origin.
==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Fragment.png|Concept art
</gallery>
[[File:Yunshul Fragments of Self .jpg|center|thumb|Trying to get to Fragments of Self ]]

== Trivia ==
<!-- The video of Yun'Shul saying "INCONCEIVIBLE" is fake, as you could tell by reading the comments. Sincerely stop adding it to the damn page.-->
* The music for this area is [[The End.]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]
** This track also plays while under the effects of a Void Spire.
* If you fall off one of the islands, you will be teleported back to spawn, falling down from above.
* You cannot M1 or use Mantras here, but you can use your weapon's critical or side-hand pistol (if you have one equipped), though it can't interact with the environment.
* There is currently no known way to die here, as fall damage is disabled and so is any form of PVP damage, starving also only drains the player's health down to 50%. It is unclear if bleeding out is possible, using Boulder does not execute you here, and dying here would most definitely be a bug and would send you here again.
* Owls and Lesser Angels can seemingly spawn here, but they are unable to actually damage you.
* Chests can also spawn here, but they cannot be opened.
*Fragments of Self is virtually located above The Depths, which could potentially (but unlikely) be the reason why Deep Owls are seen up there. If you were to somehow bypass the automatic teleportation barrier below, you may land back in Layer 1. Nothing comes of this other than the ability to distract mobs and roam around.
**Such a bug was previously possible, though now patched. 
*Self doesn't update if you de-equip or equip equipment, meaning it will always look like your character at the moment of wiping.
**However, if you wiped your character through the red skull in the main menu, "Self" will be a plain white character. This is due to your character not having been loaded in the game when you wiped. Since you were in the main menu, the game does not have any data to generate "Self" as it would normally appear as the character at the moment of a normal wipe.
*If you died during [[Hell Mode]], the red screen tint stays, although this is most likely a bug.
*It is actually possible to chop down the trees around the area if you have a [[Lumber Axe]].
*You can hypothetically save somebody from the fragments by headstacking, but it has only ever been done once and headstacking has since been made harder.
*Upon trying to get up to The Fragments of Self when you haven't wiped yet, Yun'shul interrupts you, saying "INCONCEVABLE.", disabling everything and stuns(?) for a moment, resulting in the player falling down, taking fall damage as normal. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AxPpST6d3eY

In order to obtain Galebreathe, you must bring five [[Gale Stone]]s to Friid (2 if you have already obtained Galebreathe on a previous character). Alternatively, if you have obtained the Silentheart Oath, you must kill them in order to get one of five Oath Talents. ==Location== Friid is located at a camp near the [[Temple of the Blade]]. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if their enemies are far away. *{{cl|raretl|Impervious Slumber}} - If Friid gets hit while Unconscious, their time Unconscious isn't reset. *''Gale Trap'' - If Friid knocks an enemy they tag them with a wind trap, anyone picking up the body gets sent flying. *''Suffocating Impact'' - If Friid flourishes an enemy into a wall they are {{cl|wnd|Suffocated}} and {{cl|wnd|Winded}} for a short duration. *{{cl|raretl|Stifled Jump}} - Enemies who jump while {{cl|wnd|Suffocated}} by Friid are dazed. *''Air Pressure'' - If Friid dodges an attack or hits an enemy's block, their next dash is transformed into a Gale Dash. *{{cl|raretl|Silencer's Blade}} - If Friid hits an enemy with a basic attack while the enemy is {{cl|wnd|Suffocated}}, the duration of the Suffocation is extended. Friid will also get a speed boost. *{{cl|advancedtl|A World Without Song}} - If Friid Lands a wind mantra it will apply {{cl|wnd|Suffocate}}. ==Finisher== Friid executes their opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |User pins down opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= {{{!}}table class="fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12"{{!}}Freedom. title: Frostdraw

{{Quotes |quote=Frost gathers at our fingertips, promising the coming winter. Have you come to let it envelop you? |author=Nell, Master of Frost }} [[File:Frostdraw.png|thumb|Frostdraw icon]] ==Description== '''Frostdraw''' is an [[Attunement]] that grants the user the ability to bring forth frost and the freezing cold, giving them access to abilities which focus on area denial and debuffs. Frostdraw is slightly slower compared to other [[Attunement]]s, but still offers offensive options that are relatively quick and cunning. This translates to the fact that the Attunement would fit well to people who have a defensive approach to combat. ===Abilities=== Landing Frostdraw [[Mantras]] applies [[Chill]], which slows down enemies and is able to be improved upon with certain [[Talents]]. Adding [[Aeon Logstone|Logstones]] to certain Mantras can increase the duration of Chill. ==Obtainment== The Attunement can be unlocked by using a [[Attunement Potions|Glassblood Potion]] obtained by giving [[Nell]], the Frostdraw trainer at [[Etris]], two [[Frigid Prism]]s. Nell is located in a small house to the right of the Etris Guild Hall. Alternatively, you can simply pick Frostdraw as your starting Attunement in Character Creation. ==Training== [[File:Frostdraw Capra.png|alt=|thumb|A Hemafrosted Capra casting a beam of ice.]] [[File:Frostdrawloco.png|thumb|187x187px|This is where the Attunement trainer is located.]] {{text|att-training |train=using the [[Hemafrost]] to increase the attribute after either landing {{PAGENAME}} Mantras or eating [[Frigid Prism]]s to gain enough EXP |trainer=[[Nell]] at [[Etris]] }} ===Mantra Damage Calculation=== {{text|mantracalc}} ==Cantrip(s)== Cantrips are, often minor, passive abilities that are granted upon obtaining any Mantra from the respective Attunement. '''Purifying Frost''' - Automatically purify certain forms of unsafe water collected in your [[Canteen]], turning it into fresh drinking water. Sea water and the [[Celestial]] Ichor cannot be purified by this Cantrip. The [[Purifying Ring]] Equipment has a similar effect. Most collectible water sources are already drinkable, removing most of the need for this Cantrip. Purifiable water sources include: *[[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] Fishing Pond water *[[Temple of the Blade]] water, located in front of [[Stratos]] *[[The Garden Reservoir]] acid water Placeholder.png {{col|sec|

This cannot be modified. *Capable of proccing {{t|Meteor Impact}}. *Can be modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s to increase the size of the AoE. }} {{MantraInfobox |name=Frost Grab (★★☆) |image=Frost-Grabv2.gif |desc=An icy chokehold. |ethercost={{stats|ether|65 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ice|Ice}} + {{stats|blunt|Blunt}} (Grab), {{stats|ice|Ice}} (Ice Chains) |reqs=30 Frostdraw |effect=''User turns invisible and teleports to their opponent within a short range, on hit choking their opponent while they get hit by the ice chains.'' *Has a base damage of 6/7.2/8.4/9.6/10.8 per level, per hit (3) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *The [[Blast Spark]] variant deals the same damage per level, per hit (3) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling, however the ice pillars have a 20% less damage than the chains on the un-sparked version. *Deals 3 posture damage per hit (3). *Has a 10 second cooldown (3 seconds if whiffed entirely or if it didn't target anything). *Has 9.176x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.176 for PvE damage). *Applies an extremely long 12 second Chill at base. *Shares a cooldown with all other [[grab Mantras]]. *Does not apply Chill through block with Unyielding Frost. *Gives brief I-Frames on hit. *Can be modified with a Blast Spark, creating an ice patch on the ground and stabbing the opponent with pillars. Crystal Knee Spring Spark.gif|Spring Spark }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ice Lasers (★★☆) |image=Ice Lasers.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Swift bolts of frozen air. |ethercost={{stats|ether|55 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ice|Ice}} |reqs=30 Frostdraw, Glass Path: Crystallization |effect=''Fires a bullet of ice.'' *Has a base damage of 8/11/14/17/20 per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 24.16 (26.89 with 6 songchant) DMG, 1 posture, 6s CD at 5 lvl. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inconsistent hitbox. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s to increase the amount of projectiles fired up to 7 total. The additional hit from Glass/Magnifying Stones deals 5 posture damage. *Has a 12 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Can be used to scale walls and terrain. *Inflicts a 1 second Chill. This cannot be modified. *Compatible with [[Mantra Modifiers|Glass]] and [[Magnifying Stone]]s, causing the move to form a small ice eruption at the end of the pillar. Adding more AoE modifiers increases the size of the eruption. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s to become wider. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Crystal]] and [[Mantra Modifiers|Perfect Lenses]] to increase the range of the Arc. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ice Skate (★★★) |image=Ice Skate.gif |desc=Skate freely on paths of ice. |ethercost={{stats|ether|80 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs=50 Frostdraw |effect=''Form a frozen path of ice as the user slides on at a high velocity.'' *Right click to cancel sliding. *Constantly consumes Ether to continue sliding. *Knocked players cannot be held while this Mantra is active. *When below Mantra level 5, gradually loses height similar to gliders. **Gradual height loss at level 5 is negligible, but still present. *Does not lose height when used in Layer 1, yet loses height in Overworld and Layer 2. }} ===Support Mantras=== {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Frost Wisp (★★☆) |image=Frost Wisp.gif |desc=A servant of ice. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs=30 Frostdraw |effect=''Conjure a wisp that travels around the user that freezes the ground below; Shoots a small beam of ice whenever the user vents successfully. Ritual Casted.'' *Shoots a beam of ice ~0.5 seconds after landing a vent that applies chill and deals ~6 damage. *Leveling up the Mantra increases the size of the ice floors, and damage of the beam. *Procs Cold Front and Chilling Flourish without needing the Talents. **The Chill of the beam lasts longer than Cold Front. *This Mantra can infinitely place ice on the ground without any modifiers. Only consumes uses when proccing Cold Front or Chilling Flourish via the wisp. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Iceberg (★★★) |image=iceberg_lettuceee.gif |desc=Enter a state of cryostasis. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ice|Ice}} |reqs=50 Frostdraw |effect=''Encases the user in a block of ice while releasing pulses of ice that Chill and pushes back any targets that get close, user heals in the first two pulses of a ring. The user will automatically parry one hit while this is active.'' *Has a base damage of 3/3.5/4/4.5/5 per level, per hit (5) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 3 posture damage per hit (5). *Has a cooldown of 33 seconds. *Has 6.48x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 6.48 for PvE damage). *Heals 2%, increasing with level and [[Mantra Modifiers|Drift/Rush Shards]], up to 10%. *Applies 1 second of chill per hit. This cannot be modified. *Iceberg applies bottom freeze on every hit (regardless of cooldown), but still puts the Frozen Legs status on cooldown. *Shares a cooldown with [[Reinforce]]. *Does not proc [[Deep Gems]] on hit. *Can be modified with a [[Blast Spark]], turning you into an ice crystal on use. While this variant of Iceberg is active, you gain i-frames, but cannot move or act. If used midair, you will quickly descend towards the ground, dealing damage on impact and flinging/ragdolling opponents. This also negates fall damage. **Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Drift/Rush Shards]] to increase the fall speed. (100 Frostdraw) |Your {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chill|Chilled}} can proc through block, with blocked {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chill|Chilled}} procs lasting 80% of the duration. |If you have less than 100 Frostdraw, your chill duration (when applied through block) will be reduced further to only 25% of its original duration. |} ==Trivia== *Everything that deals Frostdraw damage will gain a 5% damage buff if it is [[Environmental Hazards|snowing]]. *The [[Chilling]] Enchantment still applies 1 second Chill in PvP per hit until it applies Bottom Freeze and then goes on cooldown until you can reapply the status. *Frostdraw has the second-most Mantras with 3 stars on them, second to Ironsing. *Frostdraw has the most Mantras out of all attunements in the game. *This is by far the easiest attunement to obtain, mainly because everything you need is in Etris, and the [[Eastern Nomad]]s are easy to backstab and kill. *Frostdraw isn't the manipulation of water particles, instead, you are decreasing the temperature around you to create ice. *Prior to the {{VersionHistory|2024|January 12th}}, Glass Path: Crystallization didn't recolor your Frostdraw and the Crystals themselves were also blue. *Anything that would Freeze while using Glass Path: Crystallization would cause the crystals in your opponent to explode. *Saint Jay and Frostbite are less effective with Glass Path: Crystallization, as they are only applied for 2 seconds after a Crystal is applied. *Frozen Legs applies on all ice Mantras and has a fixed duration that can't be increased. *Fragile Freeze will Freeze the opponent on Posture break from anything if they are Chilled. *Similarly to every other Ritual Cast Mantra, '''Frost Wisp''' gives the player a finger on the hand that casts the Mantra. *Bottom Freeze has a global cooldown, meaning it's not recommended to have the Chilling enchant with the Bottom Freeze Talent. *The '''Ice Cubes''' Mantra is possibly a reference to Divine Beast Vah Ruta from The Legend Of Zelda: Breath Of The Wild. *It's possible to put your guild base on '''Glacial Arc''' if you aim it straight forward and upwards then put it on the side. *When '''Glacial Arc''' is used in layer 2 of the depths, it will start falling apart piece by piece. *The '''Ice Fissure''' Mantra is a reference to the Roblox game ''Strife'', specifically the class [[w:c:strife-official:Obsidian|Obsidian's]] Pyroclast move, which summons pulsing obelisks. *The '''Warden's Blades''' Mantra is likely a reference to ''Devil May Cry'', bearing a striking resemblance to Vergil's Summoned Swords specifically the move Spiral Swords as it also does the exact same thing '''Warden's Blades''' does. *The '''Ice Chain''' Mantra is a reference to [[w:c:typemoon:Enkidu (Noble Phantasm)|Gilgamesh's Chains of Heaven]] from the ''Fate'' series. *The '''Ice Eruption''' Mantra is a reference to the [https://nioh2.wiki.fextralife.com/Eight+Cold+Hells Eight Cold Hells] ninja skill in ''Nioh 2''. *The '''Ice Smash''' Mantra is a reference to one of Cirno's spell cards in ''Touhou 12.3''. *Frostdraw Mantras afflict a brief Agility penalty when targets are hit and can create physical objects that allow players to collide with. *Frostdrawers can refer to Frostdraw attunement users such as [[Eastern Nomad]]s on [[Etris]], [[Songseeker Frostdrawer]]s in [[Songseeker Wilds]] and [[Minityrsa]], Authority Captains in [[Starswept Valley]] and the Kyrsgarde in the [[Second Layer]]. *The '''Ice Chains''' Mantra was reworked into a new ability on the 8th of February 2022. *The now-removed "Frozone" Talent was a reference to [[w:c:the-incredibles:Frozon|Frozone]] from ''[[wp:The Incredibles|The Incredibles]]''. *The '''Iceberg''' Mantra is a reference to [[w:c:overwatch:Overwatch 1|Mei's Cyro-Freeze ability]] in ''[[wp:Overwatch|Overwatch]]''. ==References== {{Nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

==Description==
The '''Frostthorn''' are dual-wielded Legendary Daggers; two layered blades that have a spring powered mechanism that divides them into four separate blades, doubling as a fan. It is obtained by defeating the [[Kyrsgarde Champion]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:FrostthornCritical.gif
</gallery>
The user splits the blades into five in each hand and twirls around, dealing damage and applying Bottom Freeze and chill to targets hit.

Does '''<u>not</u>''' recolor with Crystallization Path, however does apply crystals on Crit due to the aforementioned chill effect.

This critical additionally grants the user a speed boost for a short duration.

This critical has a cooldown of '''5 seconds'''.

Frosviernr is a [[Kyrsan]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]] found in [[Second_Layer/New Kyrsa|second floor]] of the [[Second Layer]], in an alleyway behind a building following the right side of the city during the escape sequence. He made and wields the [[Kyrswynter]].
