title: Gran Sudaruska
content: {{Weapon Infobox |type=Greataxe |requirements=75 ICE, 40 HVY, LVL 10 |damage=24 |damage type=Slash |scaling=ICE: 6, HVY: 4 |posture damage=6 |range=8.5 |range type=Sweep |enchantable=No |penetration=5% |swing speed=0.83x |attack duration=0.9s |endlag=0.1s |obtainment=*{{lp|Crypt of the Unbroken}} *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] (wave 30-50) *{{lp|Second Layer}} *[[Weird Trader]] |selling price=100 |description=In her dying breaths, [[Sudaruska]] the Unbroken infused her very being into this weapon, cutting through hundreds of ancient [[The Ministry|Ministry]] as the last front to keep [[Minityrsa]] safe. Now that her mortal shell is no more, she has become Gran Sudaruska. |image= Gran Sudaruska.png|Standard Gran Sudaruska Crystal.png|Crystal |m.equip=No |rarity=Mythical |oath=Silentheart |oath2=Contractor |special effect=*Rain down Ice Shards after 3 M1 hits *Talks when killing Ministry NPCs, Contractors or users of Prophet's Cloak |name=Gran Sudaruska |stances=2H}} ==Description== '''Gran Sudaruska''' is a Legendary [[Weapons|Greataxe]]; a tall and heavy black bat-winged battleaxe fused by frost and Sudaruska's soul, lighting it with cold color. It scales with both Heavy and [[Frostdraw]]. '''Gran Sudaruska''' comes with two passive abilities: *'''Sudaruska's Fury''' - Landing three basic attacks on an enemy makes 12 ice crystals rain from the sky, each crystal dealing 20 PvP damage or 259.2 PvE damage. The area that an ice crystal lands on will have ice applied on the floor. 15 second cooldown. *'''Vengeful Soul''' - After gripping a player with the [[Contractor]] Oath, [[Prophet's Cloak]] outfit or any [[The Ministry|Ministry]] affiliated NPC, Sudaruska will talk and insult them. Additionally, killing a [[Rogue Construct]] will make Gran Sudaruska talk as well. ==Critical== GranCrit.gif The user rapidly spins the greataxe, raining down small shards of ice and guardbreaking targets as they propel upwards. The critical chills the opponent for 2 seconds for each hit landed and freezes the opponent on successful hit, with Glass Path: Crystallization the freezing effect is removed and the chill is replaced by applying 5 crystals instead. Everyone hit by the critical will be teleported to in front of the user. The critical counts as a full rising mantra uppercut procing uppercut talents & is able to proc {{t|Meteor Impact}}. The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds.''' ==Gallery== File:GranConceptArt.png|Concept art File:Gran Sudaruska Held.png|Held File:Gran Sudaruska Wide.png|Wide view File:Gran Sudaruska Crystal Wide.png|Wide view (Crystal) File:SudaruskaFury.gif|Sudaruska's Fury File:GranCrystal.gif|Glass Path: Crystallization Critical File:Gran Sudaruska talking.png|Gran Sudaruska talking GranSudaruskaImagery.png|Old ==Trivia== *Criticals do not count towards Sudaruska's Fury stacks. *When trying to equip the weapon as a [[Oath: Contractor|Contractor]], the game will state "The weapon rejects your very soul, the antithesis to your ideals." This is due to the fact that the soul of Sudaruska, the woman who occupies the weapon, hates the Ministry. **You can however, equip her before obtaining Contractor. Unequipping afterwards will make it impossible to equip her once more until you break your oath as a Contractor or equip her as a new character. **You can also equip her while wearing the [[Prophet's Cloak]]. *Gran Sudaruska M1s do not apply crystal or chill. This is intended. **Prior to a patch, Gran Sudaruska used to convert '''all''' damage into Ice/Chill damage, leading to unintentional mechanics such as basic attacks, any mantras, and even '''Venting''' to apply crystals, this was patched and removed. However, the M1s used to apply Crystals prior to a later hotfix. *Gran Sudaruska is the first and only weapon that currently has the ability to speak. **All of Her voice lines are: ***"A repeat of the pain you caused, now for yourself." ***"As I thought.. Weak." ***"Become memories, pawn." ***"Break, fragile pawn." ***"Broken easily." ***"Death cannot contain me." ***"Fall beneath our frost, drowned pawn." ***"False strength." ***"Foolish pawns playing God..." ***"Frail." ***"The sun will set only for your soul, pawn." ***"You will not take my home." ***"Your cause is a poison to this world, pawn." ***"Your own Depths shall take you." **Killing 2 or more enemies that would trigger Gran Sudaruska's voice lines at once will only make her say one voice line instead of stacking both on top of each other. **All Gran Sudaruska dialogues last for 8 seconds. **Some of her lines are very similar (likely as a result of inspiration) to the dialogue of ''[[w:c:riskofrain2:Mithrix|Mithrix]]'', the final boss of [[wp:Risk of Rain 2|Risk of Rain 2]]. ***"False strength." is one of Mithrix's quotes. ***Other instances—"Become memories, pawn.", "As I thought... Weak.", "Break, fragile pawn."—are all close to what he says. * The runes on the blade are Elder Futhark Runes, which reads "FROSTDRAW" and "FIMBULWINTER". **Fimbulwinter is a harsh winter that preludes Ragnarök in Norse mythology. *Bizarrely, Gran Sudaruska used to have a Power requirement of 3, despite it being impossible to meet the stat requirements within Power 3. *Gran Sudaruska could be used one handed even if the One Handed Training Talent was not obtained prior to its removal. *Gran Sudaruska's Critical attack used to only be a spherical hitbox infront of the player. However, on the {{VersionHistory|2024|July 5th}} update, this was instead changed to be a 360 hitbox around the player. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Greataxes]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Heavy Weapons]]

title: Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae
content:
{{InProgress|Body=Potentially more dialogue that has yet to be found.}} {{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Follow in Alsin's steps, and you will find your path as well.|author=Elder Sasha}} {{NPCInfobox |name=Vanguard Legidae |alias=Grandmaster |aspect=Tiran |pronouns=He/him |location=[[Alsin's Landing]] |affiliation=[[The Justicar]] |image1=NPC Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae.png }} ==Description== Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae is a [[Tiran]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a [[The Justicar|Justicar]] residing in [[Alsin's Landing]]. As the Grandmaster of the Vanguard path, he teaches [[The Justicar|Justicars]] to protect the weak and stand against villainy. Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae wears the sightly darkened down version of the [[Justicar's Armor]] outfit, with [[Grand Pauldrons]], [[Grand Boots]], and a Golden version of the [[Tiran Pendant]]. ==Location== Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae is located in a stronghold on the western side of [[Alsin's Landing]]. NPC Map Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae.png {{Clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|Justicar= {{#tag:tabber|No Introduction= If you have never introduced yourself, Legidae will not know your name. {{#tag:tabber|Neophyte / Disciple= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}''*The stout-looking Tiran smiles as you approach.*'' Ah, a new face among our ranks? Be welcome, Neophyte / Disciple, and safe. I am Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae - I offer guidance to those who would seek strength through the path of the Vanguard, to shield the weak from evil. I am a Justicar, just as you are, albeit, far more seasoned... But worry not! Follow in Alsin's steps, and you will find your path as well. What is your name, Justicar? {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I am [First Name], sir. {{!}}- {{!}}''*He bows his head politely.*'' It is a pleasure. If you require guidance in your pursuit of the Path, I suggest you return to me once you've gained deeper insights into the ways of the Justicars.
Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae now knows your name {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Elder= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''The Justicar regards you politely.''* Be welcome, Elder. It is good to see new faces around Alsin's Landing. I am Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae, a fellow Justicar. It seems you are fairly seasoned yourself now. The others have remarked on your achievements so far. Pray tell, what is your name? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I am [First Name], it is nice to meet you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Grandmaster Legidae nods.''* Likewise, [First Name], likewise... I assume that by now, you have gotten a decent sense of what it is like to walk the Path. And, as you must know, each Justicar interprets the Path their own way... But you need not walk the Path alone. Among our community, like-minded Justicars may band together, and follow in Alsin's footsteps as a group. Through shared experiences, we grow much stronger than we could on our own... One such group in these parts - a group I am part of, - follows the path of the Vanguard.
Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae now knows your name {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What is being a Vanguard like? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''The Vanguard beams solemnly.''* Those who walk the Path as a Vanguard prefer to protect the weak and the weary directly. Often, we find ourselves involved in martial combat. We believe that if all of humankind is to seek their own path freely, then the Vanguard must be a dissuading force against villainy - against those who would seek to deny the weak their choice and freedom. Would you be interested in walking the Path as we do? {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes, I would like to follow the Vanguard Path. {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Not yet... I'd like some time to think about this. {{!}}- {{!}}*''The Grandmaster smiles with pride.''* Then, with this knowledge, may Alsin's wisdom guide your way anew. May you dissuade the hunter from the prey, the ruthless from the weak, the villain from the victim. May you ensure that Alsin's will be done - for all deserve a chance to find their path, and live their lives in freedom. Stand proud, ye Vanguard, and endure!
Player receives [[Karita Swap]] mantra, and is automatically equipped with [[Justicar's Armor]]. {{!}}*''The Grandmaster nods understandingly.''* Of course, [First Name]. Such things must not be rushed. Alsin teaches us that we - and ''we'' alone - must choose how we walk the Path. Should you change your mind, I will be waiting here. But even if you do not choose this path, it could still be wise to band with other like-minded Justicars. Perhaps Grandmaster Warder Sapphire may have some insights for you... {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player is now a Vanguard Justicar {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Warder Path= If you didn't introduce yourself to Legidae prior to your promotion to Warder, you lose your chance to introduce yourself to him forever. If you have done so already, you will get [Introduction Complete -> Warder Path] as your dialogue. This only changes dialogue/flavor text. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} {{!}}WIP {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} {{!}}-{{!}}Introduction Complete= After you have introduced yourself to Legidae. {{#tag:tabber|Neophyte / Disciple= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}''*Grandmaster Legidae nods politely at your approach.*'' Welcome back, [First Name]. I hope your journey in the Path has been treating you well so far. If it is guidance you seek, I suggest you return to me after you've gained deeper insights into the way of the Justicar. Those who seek to follow the Path of the Vanguard often look to me for guidance - spiritual, or otherwise. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How can I gain more experience as a Justicar? {{!}}- {{!}}Traditionally, the Justicars here in the East believe that helping others pursue their path is the best way to honour Alsin's teachings. Should you also wish to do so, you may answer the Justicar's Call, and lend a hand to all those who might need it. Aid and protect them - guide them as Alsin guides us. But, of course, you may gain insights into the way of the Justicar in more traditional ways of training, too. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Elder= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Grandmaster Legidae regards you politely.''* Be welcome, [First Name]. It is good to see you again. You've clearly grown in strength and wisdom as a Justicar - the others have remarked on your achievements so far. With that in mind, there is some wisdom I would like to impart upon you - if you should like to hear it. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Of course, I'm listening. {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How can I gain more experience as a Justicar? {{!}}- {{!}}I assume that by now, you have gotten a decent sense of what it is like to walk the Path. And, as you must know, each Justicar interprets the Path their own way... But you need not walk the Path alone. Among our community, like-minded Justicars may band together, and follow in Alsin's footsteps as a group. Through shared experiences, we grow much stronger than we could on our own... One such group in these parts - a group I am part of, - follows the path of the Vanguard. {{!}}[See Introduction Complete -> Neophyte / Disciple] {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What is being a Vanguard like? {{!}}- {{!}}[See No Introduction -> Elder -> What is being a Vanguard like?] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Warder Path= If you didn't introduce yourself to Legidae prior to your promotion to Warder, you lose your chance to introduce yourself to him forever. See [No Introduction -> Warder Path] for said dialogue. This only changes dialogue/flavor text. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} {{!}}''*Grandmaster Legidae smiles at you warmly*'' Ah, [First Name]. It is good to see you again, fellow Justicar. I see you have chosen to follow the path of the Warder? I think it suits you. *He nods .* May Alsin guide your path, Justicar. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Vanguard Path= You cannot become a Vanguard without introducing yourself to Legidae. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Grandmaster Legidae welcomes you.''* Ah, [First Name]. Be welcome, fellow Vanguard! May you and your marks endure in your pursuit of the Path. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How can I gain more experience as a Justicar? {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|action}} {{!}}Below Grandmaster Vanguard {{!}} {{cl|action}} {{!}}Grandmaster Vanguard Rank {{!}}- {{!}}[See Introduction Complete -> Neophyte / Disciple] {{!}}*''A spark of admiration flashes in Legidae's eye.''* You have attained veritable insights into the Path, [First Name]. I fear there is little else I can teach you that you do not already know. Many Jusitcars believe that the best way to honour Alsin's teachings is to help others pursue their path. Should you also wish to do so, you may answer the Justicar's Call, and lend a hand to all those who might need it. title: Gravity Field
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure a gravity field that cripples your foes.|author=Gravity Field description.}}
{{Resonance|effect=Changes the gravity of all who are under the effect, changes the speed of attack, movement, disables mobility mantras, and also pushes inward when trying to get out.|appearance=Transparent hemisphere with a purple circle as the base.| cooldown=Duration + 70 seconds|
image1=<gallery>
File:Gravity Field Resonance.gif|Gravity Field
gravityf.png|Card
CoruptGF.png|Corrupt
</gallery>
}}

== Description==
'''Gravity Field''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

===Appearance===

A transparent hemisphere that has a purple edge and a purple area circle. The hemisphere shrinks over time.

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate '''Gravity Field''' Resonance. Additionally, you can press {{Input|keybind|resonance}} again to deactivate Gravity Field early. When activated, creates a hemisphere at the location of the resonance activation, from which it is very difficult or almost impossible to get out. Will decrease over time.

If someone touches the border of the field, they will be ragdolled and flung back inwards. On top of this, mobility mantras (such as [[Dash]]) are not usable.

Combat tags the user when someone enters the field.

{{cl|corres|If Gravity Field is corrupted, the user gains immunity to the effects of their own Gravity Field but the duration is halved. Another downside of this is that it doesn't pull people in anymore with no gravity variant.}}

===''Resonance Point Usage''===
When obtained, Gravity Field will spend its points on the following stats:
*'''Gravity:''' Determines whether the gravity will be reduced or increased, and by how much. (the jump will be lower or higher). The higher the gravity is, the shorter your gravity field lasts. In extreme cases, it can shorten your resonance duration to only a few seconds.
*'''Size:''' The more points spent on this stat, the larger the field size will be when it is created.
*'''Pull in gravity:''' Determines whether the gravity will be reduced or increased when players are initially pulled in by the resonance when attempting to leave/enter the field, and when the resonance is first activated.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
Gravity.png
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Since the rate of collapse doesn't scale with the size of the field, the size effectively determines the duration of the Resonance.
*Useful to use when you know your opponent is low and want to trap them to ensure their demise.
*Doing a running attack against the field will make you escape the field (probably a bug)
*Certain Mantras, such as Permafrost Prison, will cancel gravity field whether used before or after activating it.
*Gravity field was added in august 1st 2022.

The Great Maul is a Greathammer that can be dropped from [[Rock Golem]]s and [[Golem Prime]]s. It can sometimes be sold at the [[Chili|Merchant Ship]] for a random price. 

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:GreatMaul.gif
</gallery>The user performs three consecutive swings with the hammer: two fast-moving swings, followed up by slamming into the ground, creating a small shockwave around them. The first hit grants a speed boost on hit and has hyperarmor that follows into the second hit. The third hit has innate bleed, autogrips and applies 0.65 second knockdown effect. All hits apply Dazed.

If the first hit misses, or if the first or second hits get parried, the critical attack will abruptly end without continuing into the remaining hits.

This critical has a cooldown of '''9 seconds'''.

title: Greathive Aratel
content:
{{Location|name=Greathive Aratel|territory=The Hive|caption=Life in all its variety hums around you. The immensity of what has been accomplished in cultivating this place washes over you.}}
[[File:Greathive Araten!!!11.jpg|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Greathive Aratel''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a settlement in the [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel Sea]].

==Overview==
Greathive Aratel is a city built in a giant tree on the sea. Inside this tree is a large settlement: the Greathive itself.

To enter Greathive Aratel, you must have: 

* washed your face (requires you to be at least [[Power]] 10 to wash your face) on any character or slot, and
* have visited the [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|Eastern Luminant]] at least once on your current character.

Alternatively, you can [[Sailing|sail]] to Greathive Aratel, but getting to the top requires mobility mantras, clever usage of [[gliders]], lots of parkour and jumping on the heads of players. If you washed your face and have already invoked the Greathive fountain found in The Lordsgrove, you can sail to the shipyard of the Greathive Aratel and use the fountain in there in order to get teleported up to the entrance floor of Greathive Aratel.

==Contents==
Greathive Aratel is split up into 4 floors:
*Unnamed first floor
*Root Plaza
*Heart Plaza
*Canopy Plaza

===First Floor===
There is a Heat Stone resting spot and Fountains functioning as fast travel.[[File:Hive Fountains.jpg|thumb|328x328px|Hive Fountains]]

====Greathive Fountains====
*Five of [[The Hive]]'s fountains can be found within Greathive Aratel.
**The left fountain leads to [[Summer Isle]].
**The middle-left fountain leads to [[Miner's Landing]].
**The center fountain leads to [[The Lordsgrove]].
**The middle-right fountain leads to [[Ancient Rotlands]].
**The right fountain leads to [[The Temple of the Forgotten Flame]].
**Fountains have a 30-second cooldown, unless you are teleporting from the [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|Etrean Luminant]], in which case no initial cooldown is applied.
*Several fountains throughout the [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|Etrean Luminant]] can be used to return to Greathive Aratel:
**Inside [[The Hidden Village]].
**Within [[The King's Garden]], to the left of [[Etris Palace]].
**At [[Isle of Vigils]], opposite the path leading to [[Friid, Master of Gale|Friid]], inside the ruins beside a tree.
**At [[The Lordsgrove]].
*The fountain in [[The Lordsgrove]] is the largest of all Hive teleporters.
<gallery>
File:Here..png|Fountain found at [[Isle of Vigils]].
File:Lordsgrove Hive Teleporter (Saltspan).png|Fountain found at [[The Lordsgrove]].
File:Hive fountain Etrea.png|Fountain found at [[Etris]].
File:Hive.png|The doors leading to [[The Lordsgrove]].
File:Fountain in Hidden Village.png|Fountain found in [[The Hidden Village]]
</gallery>

====Shipyard====
*In the entrance floor of the Greathive Aratel and to the left, the player can find a Shipyard fountain that will spawn the player down to the shipyard area, In the shipyard the player can spawn, craft and recall their [[Boats|ships]].
**If the player is famous with [[The Hive]], the [[Shipwright]] will bring up ship modification, or [[Lifeweave|Lifeweaving]].
**The Shipwright NPC will not spawn, repair or recall a player's ship until the player reaches ally reputation with The Hive.

====Library====
*[[Gear Cabinet]] to buy training equipment.
*There is a [[Mantra Lectern]] near the entrance.

===Root Plaza===
====Cargo====
*A long corridor of rooms.
*At the end is a door that can be broken that leads to outside the Greathive.
*[[Banker]] can be found in the room to the right.

====Archive====
*Attunementless Mantra Trainer [[Regek]].
*A [[Barber]] at the balcony.

====Antiquarian====
* Players can find an [[Antiquarian]] who will purchase their sellable items.
*[[Cloth]] is sold here for {{c|notes|6}} each.
*[[Fiber]] is sold here for {{c|notes|3}} each.

===Heart Plaza===
[[File:Greathive secret phonograph.png|thumb]]
====R&D====
*[[Laplace]], the enchanter resides in this room. Hand in '''three''' enchanted items ([[Weapons]] and [[Equipment]]) to enchant your currently equipped weapon, provided it is eligible. You can also purchase [[Enchant Grease]] from Laplace for {{C|knowledge|5}}, allowing the user to apply an enchant to their Equipment.
*Behind the central metal bookshelf in the main R&D room, there are two breakable walls, which if destroyed by a strong enough mantra, reveals a hidden room with a phonograph playing "[[A Memory of Tides]]" by Naktigonis.
*[[File:Behind bookshelf room.png|thumb|The room behind the wooden bookshelf.]]Using [[Attunement-less|Strong Left]] (or any other environment-destroying mantra) on the wooden bookshelf in the right hallway a few times will reveal a, now presumably unused, extra room with three "containers" and broken pipes leaking gas.

===Canopy Plaza===
Hidden within the tree is another Heat Stone resting spot.[[File:Roblox 12 02 2024 00 24 02.png|thumb|A view of the blacksmith on the Canopy plaza.]]

[[File:Honey Pool.png|thumb|Honey Pool (Presumably)]]

====Tree Sap Pool====
*A pool of, presumably, tree sap that can be used to fill up [[Canteen|Canteens]].

====Blacksmith====
*Players can find a [[Blacksmith]].
*Players are able to purchase a [[Pickaxe]] and [[Lumber Axe]] for {{c|notes|3}} each.
*A [[Crafting Station]] is found right next to the Blacksmith.

====Inn====
* Players can spend {{c|notes|5}} to set their spawn point here.

====Canopy Peak====
[[File:Roblox 12 02 2024 00 25 13.png|alt=The most powerful being in the universe rules over his subjects|thumb|331x331px|The most powerful being in the universe rules over his subjects]]
* The office of the current Hivelord. Features a [[Hive Guard]] and a being of [[Destroyman III|immense power]].

====Observatory====
Greathive Aratel is home to the Celestial Telescope, which offers players a glimpse into the [[Lore]] surrounding [[Constellia]] and the [[Celestial|Celestials]].
[[File:CelestialTelescope1.png|center|thumb]]

Players can crank the telescope clockwise or counterclockwise to position it to other celestial objects:

*Turning it clockwise will show these images:
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
TelescopeClockwise.png
CelestialTelescope2.png
</gallery>
*Turning it counterclockwise will show these images, play the song "To Sleep, Dreaming (Contour 1)" and give you a good chunk of experience (with a side effect of making you incredibly sad):
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
TelescopeCounterclockwise1.png
TelescopeCounterclockwise4.png
TelescopeCounterclockwise3.png
TelescopeCounterclockwise4.png
TelescopeCounterclockwise5.png
TelescopeCounterclockwise6.png
</gallery>

[[Instruments]] can also be purchased here.

====Balconies====
*[[Flint]] and [[Wood]] can be purchased here.
*Features a lovely view of the [[Luminants#Etrean and Eastern Luminants|Eastern Luminant]]

==Quests==
===Grave Tending (Suri Quest)===
*Go and talk to [[Suri]]. He will give you a flower, and a task to go and place it at the grave of his brother on the [[Isle of Vigils]]. The flower can be destroyed by unnecessary movement (taking damage), though, so he suggests taking the safest route.
*If you come back to [[Suri]] after completing this quest, you get a Vibrant Gem. 
*A reference to a quest in [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollow_Knight Hollow Knight] with the same premise.

===Blooming Souls Quest (Soul Flower Quest)===
*Talk to the NPC named [[Regek]], in a small library room, hey will tell you to fetch 3 Souls from special flowers that bloom within the Greathive, all of which located in the Canopy Plaza. They are called Soulblooms. (You need to wash your face at the temple to be able to take the quest)
**A red flower located outside near the observatory balcony. Mind your footing.
**A white flower, located near the [[Blacksmith]], facing in front of it.
**A blue flower, hanging at the side of a tree root across the room from the Blacksmith.
*Completing this quest gives a handful of EXP and access to upgrade [[Attunement-less]] Mantras on every character.
===Soul Flower Locations===
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Flower 1.png
Flower 2.png
Flower 3.png
</gallery>

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Greathive big.png
Strange hive brick.png|A piece of Greathive that has been fireproofed
Hive Tube.png|Hive Test Tube
Image 2024-07-16 203323775.png|Aratel Rising
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The music for this area is [[Of Chitin, Kith And Kin]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*The combat music for this area is [[A Symphony Of Strife]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*Parts of the Greathive can be seen emitting black particles, which is fireproofing that allows [[Flamecharm]] to be used within the Greathive without the whole thing going up in flames.
*Everyone inside Greathive Aratel is a [[Hivekin]]: either a [[Vesperian]], [[Ganymede]], or [[Chrysid]].
*The Soulblooms have an option to taste the flower's sap. When attempting to do so, your Character has a violent gut feeling it is not for ingestion and ultimately decides not to.
*Artifacts are able to spawn at Hive. However, originally, Bankers did not exist in Aratel meaning they couldn't be made use of, without travelling to either [[Fort Merit]] or [[Miner's Landing]], for over two years.
*According to [[Destroyman III]], Greathive Aratel makes the best soft shell tacos in the entire Luminant.
*Back in [[Verse 1]], there was only three Teleporters instead of five.

They have a passive Fortitude and Strength bonus when choosing attributes. ==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that increases your opponent's incoming damage and posture damage.

==Effect==
After landing enough M1s, {{PAGENAME}} applies the {{status|Grim}} status effect to your opponent for 6 seconds. This status effect applies a +25% damage buff and +50% posture damage buff to all incoming attacks.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 5 hits for [[Light Weapons]] and [[Medium Weapons]], and 4 hits for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*{{PAGENAME}}'s effects can be procced on weapon criticals if they have the [[M1 tag]].
*Because Grim applies buffs into incoming attacks rather than increasing damage and posture taken, it '''is''' affected by the damage and posture damage modifier caps.

title: Grudge
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=5000 |moves= |image1=GrudgeNPC.png |drops=[[Wraithclaw]] |weapon=[[Wraithclaw]] |caption1=I would rather be a paid servant in a poor man's house and be above ground than king of kings among the dead.}} == Description == The Grudge is a manifestation of spirits that has a low chance to be randomly encountered as an event in specific locations. They can be found at [[Minityrsa]], [[Starswept Valley]], [[Songseeker Wilds]], [[Ancient Rotlands]], [[First Layer|The Depths (Scyphozia)]], [[Upper Erisia]], [[Meteor Isle]], the [[Towerstruck Lands]], the [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel Sea]] and [[The Viper's Jaw]]. It appears as a green, ghostlike figure wearing a [[Bloodfeather Cowl]] and a [[Dark Owl Cloak]]. It wields the [[Wraithclaw]] and utilizes the [[Galebreathe]] Specter Path. Killing them will give you the [[Wraithclaw]] along with a low tier chest. == Dialogue == |-|On spawn= * ... * The grudge lingers... * It has not been forgotten... * Pay for your crimes... |-|On Grip= * ... == Moveset == The Grudge wields a Wraithclaw alongside the Haunted Path: Specter in its attacks. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |The Grudge performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |The Grudge unleashes a barrage of six slashes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Vent'''
(★☆☆) |The Grudge releases an explosion of blue ether, pushing their opponent away. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, unharmful }} |- |
'''Wind Blade'''
(★☆☆) |The Grudge launches a slash of wind towards their opponent. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Wind Forge'''
|The Grudge conjures several blades of wind that impales the opponent. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Gale Punch'''
(★☆☆) |The Grudge releases a punch of wind that knocks the opponent back. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Wind Carve'''
(★☆☆) |The Grudge creates a swirl of sharp winds that carve the opponents within it. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Wind Passage'''
(★★☆) |The Grudge, in the blink of an eye, rushes forward, releasing aftercuts of wind for the distance it travelled. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement }} |} ==Gallery== File:Grudge2.png File:Grudge3.png|Knocked File:Grudge4.png|Ditto ==Trivia== *The Grudge does not cast a shadow.[[File:GrudgeShadowAnalysis.png|300x300px]] *Using [[Murmur: Rhythm|Rhythm]] to seek out event spawns is another strategy that may help you locate Grudge. *Arch has confirmed that the only requirement for Grudge to spawn is uncapped Galebreathe.[[File:Mambleswraith.png|300px]][[File:Archwraith.png|300px]] However, it is possible for the Grudge to spawn on a player who has no Attunements at all. *A strategy that has been alleged to increase Grudge's spawn rate is having multiple people with uncapped Galebreathe in a single server. *A viable strategy to encounter grudge more easily while solo is going to [[The Starswept Valley]] while utilizing a [[Ring of Curses]]. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:Random Encounters]] [[Category:Enemies]]

|description=A bow of sacred reverence for [[the Children of Navae]], the Guiding Star is wielded during the [[Festival of Lights]] by aspirants who seek to prove themselves in its trials. During these trials, competitors must hunt a [[wolf]] blindfolded, using only their other senses to track and remain hidden. Should the wolf sink its fangs into the competitor, or leave any mark upon them, they are disqualified. The bow itself is also somewhat of a curiosity, as its arrows are conjured from the Ether of its wielder and guided by their own will. Many of the previous winners of the trials speak of the Guiding Star speaking to them in a soothing voice, pushing them in the right direction.
|obtainment=[[Lodestar]]
|rarity=Mythical
|oath=Chainwarden}}
==Description==
The '''Guiding Star''' is a Legendary [[Weapons|Bow]]; a set of antlers as its limb with glowing strings woven near the ends of it, capable of creating a drawstring and arrows through the user's mind. It scales with Medium Weapons alongside Mind.

The bow is obtained through the "[[Lodestar|Lodestar Bounty]]" Job as a guaranteed drop. The Job itself can be found at the [[Summer Isle|Summer Isle]] [[Job Boards|job board]] and the [[Starswept Valley|Starswept Valley]] job board although rarer in Starswept.

This weapon comes with the following passive:

* '''Mind's Arrow''' - The Guiding Star consumes small amounts of Ether to fire arrows. If the user has no Ether, it will deal 20% less damage. Critical is affected by ranged attacks damage resistance.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Guiding Star crit.gif
</gallery>

The user slightly lowers down and fires three explosive Ether arrows in quick succession, dealing 1.15x scaled damage per shot, totaling up to 3.45x.

The critical has a cooldown of '''7 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Guiding Star CA1.png|Concept Art
File:Guiding Star CA2.png|Concept Art
File:Guiding Star CA3.png|Concept Art
File:Guiding Star M1 Cycle.gif|M1 Animations
File:Guiding Star M1 Cycle sideview.gif|Ditto but sideview
File:GuidingStarArrow.png|The arrow and drawstring appearing when firing the Guiding Star
Aranea.png|The Aranea, seen in its accidental debut
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Due to the ether drain on M1 its crucial for users to pay attention to their ether bar, spamming mantras and not landing enough hits will cause you to run out and make the bow deal even less damage. This is specially crucial when fighting [[Shadowcast]]ers who can and will drain most if not all of your ether quickly.
*Formerly known as the "Aranea", a weapon that was accidentally released as a drop from [[Chime of Conflict]] chests and had an absurd and impossible requirement of 200 Light Weapons, rendering it unusable for normal players.
**Both bows featured the same model & appearance. The string and arrow are also visible in its held state, which can only be viewed when using Basic Attacks.
**The name "Aranea" is a reference to the genus Araneus, a group of orb-weaving spiders. This explains why the bow has a web motif.
*Attempting to equip this weapon on [[Chainwarden]] will display a message stating: "The guiding light of [[Navae]] eludes you, your vow to bind others shackle you from wielding it."
*The description on the Guiding Star claims that previous users of the weapon had 'talked', and were guided through their trail, with the bow, hinting at it potentially having some power with soul 'magic'.
*The Guiding Star was the first Bow weapon added to ''[[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]]''.

== Description ==
'''Guild Banners''' are claimable landmarks that rewards 4-21 notes every 30 seconds to its controlling [[Guilds|Guild's]] Treasury, depending on how many players from other guilds are in the server. 

When capturing a Guild Banner, it will bear the emblem of the player's guild and gradually gain health at a fixed rate. The banner's health gain can be sped up if a player is within its radius. 

Standing near a Guild Banner controlled by an opposing guild will gradually decay its health, at which point the banner is then captured by the guild the player is in. Afterward, staying near a controlled banner will revert capture progress. Guild Banners passively revert capture progress to their owner as long that they aren't contested by enemies. 

The visual marker above the Guild Banner will change depending on its current status:
* White - Uncontested/Gaining health.
* Red - Contested by an opposing guild.
* Green - Controlling guild is within a banner's radius.
* Orange - Contested by multiple guilds.

== Locations ==
If you are lost on where to find any of these, check out the Etrean and Eastern Luminant [[Maps]].

# One right next to a statue at Statue Isle ([[The Etrean Sea]]).

=== [[Eastern Luminant]] ===

# One on the island with [[The Entropy Catalyst]] and [[War Mode]] Bell.

* One on a small island across from the [[Summer Isle]] Guildhall.

==== [[Miner's Landing]] ====
# One on the bridge to [[Starfield Veldt]], nearby [[Adar]].

==== [[Songseeker Wilds]] ====
# One by the bridge across from [[Derelict Highchurch]].
# One in front of the large windmill.
# One next to the [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]] meteor.

==== [[The Starswept Valley]] ====

title: Guild Bases
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Location|name=[Guild Name]'s Base|caption=The headquarters of [Guild Name], and a testament to their achievements.}} [[File:Guild base main big room.png|thumb|900px|center]] ==Overview== Guild Bases are a type of outpost that can be created by a Guild Leader. To create a guild base, a Leader, Lieutenant, or Officer must use a [[Chime of Dwelling]] on a wall. A small animation highlighting the creation of a door, and a sign with the guild's name above it, will play. Entering the Guild Base for the first time, you will be met with a glowing outline of an NPC. Speaking to them, prompts the option of hiring them for {{c|notes|500}} Notes. Once hired, the [[Treasurer]] can be interacted with to hold the Notes donated to the Guild. Treasury can be used to upgrade or purchase Room Slots and hire certain NPCs depending on the Room Slot. However, hiring the treasurer will increase the prices of all the rooms. Without the treasurer, the 2nd room is {{c|notes|2,100}}Notes, with them it is {{c|notes|4,100}} Notes. Currently, there are 8 NPCs that can join your Guild Base with a certain amount of rooms purchased; making it both an achievement and benefit to the Guild. [[File:Guildbasesroomnodes.png|frame]] * The [[Barber]], which can be hired after building 6+ rooms for {{c|notes|3,000}}. * The [[Banker]], which can be hired in the Trophy Room after building 6+ rooms for {{c|notes|10,000}}. * The [[Gunsmith]], which can be hired in the Armory for {{c|notes|1,000}}. * The [[Antiquarian]], which can be hired after building 9+ rooms for {{c|notes|10,000}}. * The [[Guild Librarian]], which can be hired after building the Library for {{c|notes|1,000}}. * The [[Artisan]], which can be hired after building the Trophy Room for {{c|notes|10,000}}. * The [[Blacksmith]], which can be hired after building the Armory for {{c|notes|1,000}}. * The [[Mess Chef]], which can be hired after building the Mess Hall for {{c|notes|2,000}}. * The Leader may expand the Guild Base by using either their personal notes on hand or the Guild's Treasury—with each expansion becoming staggeringly higher in price than the previous purchase. Should the Leader choose to they may remove rooms from the guild base by using the Chime of Dwelling inside of it (they are also able to exile members in the same menu). The pricing list is as follows: (Assuming you have the [[Treasurer]]) {| class="sortable mw-collapsible fandom-table" !Room !{{c|notes|Price}} !{{c|notes|Total Spent}} |- |Room 1 |{{c|notes|2,600}} |{{c|notes|2,600}} |- |Room 2 |{{c|notes|4,100}} |{{c|notes|6,700}} |- |Room 3 |{{c|notes|6,600}} |{{c|notes|13,300}} |- | Room 4 |{{c|notes|10,500}} |{{c|notes|23,800}} |- |Room 5 |{{c|notes|16,800}} |{{c|notes|40,600}} |- |Room 6 |{{c|notes|26,900}} |{{c|notes|67,500}} |- |Room 7 |{{c|notes|43,000}} |{{c|notes|110,500}} |- | Room 8 |{{c|notes|68,800}} |{{c|notes|179,300}} |- |Room 9 |{{c|notes|110,000}} |{{c|notes|289,300}} |- |Room 10 |{{c|notes|176,000}} |{{c|notes|465,300}} |- |Room 11 |{{c|notes|281,500}} |{{c|notes|746,800}} |- |Room 12 |{{c|notes|450,400}} |{{c|notes|1,197,200}} |- |Extension |{{c|notes|500,000}} |{{c|notes|1,697,200}} |} ==Rooms== A guild base can be increased in size through different rooms. Most provide practical uses, while others purely cosmetic. To build an XL, you will need two adjacent empty rooms. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" !Preview !Name !Cost !Size !Description |- |
[[File:Mess hall.png|270px|center]] |
Mess Hall |
{{c|notes|2,000}} |
2 Rooms
[XL] |
A large cafeteria with 2 long tables. This is a room that allows the hiring of a chef that will make food.
They sell: [[Fish Stew]], [[Mushroom Omelette]]s, [[Cheese]] and [[Glazed Fish]] for {{c|notes|20}} each, and sell [[Mushroom Bisque]]s for {{c|notes|25}} each. |- |
[[File:Training Hall.png|thumb|270px|center]] |
Training Hall |
{{c|notes|1,000}} |
2 Rooms
[XL] |
An arena meant for testing attacks and abilities. There are 2 dummies which can be used to test damage, the left tests your base damage, the right includes pve scaling. Hitting either dummy will cause it to display damage counters, showing how much you dealt. If a dummy is lit on fire, you can extinguish the fire by hitting it, or waiting a while. [[Training Gear#Attribute_Training_Gears|Training Gears]] are sold in this room. |- |
[[File:GuildBase_TrophyRoom.png|270px|center]] |
Trophy Room |
{{c|notes|5,000}} |
1 Room
|
Allows the hiring of an Artisan for {{c|notes|10,000}}. For {{c|notes|800}} (a {{c|notes|200}} discount), allows the Player to merge attributes and appearance of an Item through [[smelting]]. Allows the hiring of a Banker for {{c|notes|10,000}} notes to access your Safe Deposit Box, a box that allows you to transfer items across your slots. You cannot turn in Artifacts to the Guild Banker. |- |
[[File:GuildBase_Quarters.png|270px|center]] |
Quarters |
{{c|notes|1,000}} |
1 Room
|
If you die or join in the server and the guild base is active you can spawn in the room. A room with a [[Campfire|Heat Stone Resting Spot]], [[Crafting Station]], and some beds.
(You cannot [[Food|cook]] at the Heat Stone Resting Spot) |- |
[[File:Laboratory.png|center|270px|center]] |
Laboratory |
{{c|notes|1,500}} |
1 Room
|
A room that features a cauldron where you can [[Alchemy|brew potions]], along with various cosmetic empty plant pots. |- |
[[File:GuildBase_SongRoom.png|270px|center]] |
Song Room |
{{c|notes|2,000}} |
1 Room
|
A room that features a [[Mantra Lectern]] for the for the player to add [[Mantra Modifiers]], name mantras, or level them up. The room also includes a Heat Stone Resting Spot and a [[Gear Cabinet]] to purchase [[Training Gear#Attunement_Training_Gears|Training Gears]] |- |
[[File:GuildBase_Armory.png|270px|center]] |
Armory |
{{c|notes|2,500}} |
1 Room
|
Allows the hiring of a [[Blacksmith]] for {{c|notes|1,000}}, allowing the Player to craft [[outfits]], repair their current outfit, turn in schematics, and turn in [[ore]]s for profit. Allows the hiring of a Gunsmith for {{c|notes|1,000}}, allowing the Player to craft bullet casings. |- |
[[File:GuildBase_FishingRoom.png|270px|center]] |Fish Pond |
{{c|notes|1,000}} |
1 Room
|A room featuring a small pond for [[fishing]] and a purchasable Fishing Rod for 35. There isn't a [[Fishing#Fishing Spots|fishing spot]]. The water from the Fish Pond is drinkable through a [[Canteen]] (not currently working). |- |
[[File:Library Guild Base.png|270px|center]] |
Library |
{{c|notes|2,000}} |
2 Rooms
[XL] |
Allows the hiring of a Librarian for {{c|notes|1,000}}, whom the Player can donate/withdraw [[Books|lore books]] to/from. Only one of each book can be stored, and they are listed by their title, followed by the name and surname of the book's first donator. You are still able to unlock the instrument's musics from your library's donated songbooks. Only Guild members can access the Library collection. (There is a 1 minute 15 second cooldown on turning in books) You can buy [[Training Gear#Attribute_Training_Gears|Training Gears]] here |- |
[[File:Greaterarenaextension.png|270px|center]] |
Arena Extension |
{{c|notes|500,000}} |
16 Rooms (4x4)
[XXL] |
A giant room consisting a large circular arena in the center to fight your guildmates, as well as a Heat Stone Resting Spots in each of the four corners. The ceiling in the Arena Extension is much higher than all other rooms, and the central arena dips into the ground by about one room's height. |} ==Gallery== File:Guild Base Donator Books .png|A Guild Base Library displaying donated books File:Guild Base Bandit Raid.webp|A group of Bandits spawned in a Guild Base ==Trivia== *Not purchasing the Treasurer makes guild rooms cheaper, but prevents you from buying rooms that cost more than {{c|notes|15,000}}, such as Room 5 and above. This is because Pathfinder mode only allows players to hold {{c|notes|15,000}} at a time, meaning larger purchases require depositing notes through the Treasurer. **A workaround is to buy the first 4 guild rooms before purchasing the Treasurer. *Previously, combat dummies in the Training Hall gave Attunement and Weapon EXP. *Players gain a small amount of experience when visiting a new guild base. *The Arena Extension does not require every guild room. It only requires one of the back-middle rooms, either left or right, located 3 purchased rooms deep. *Carriable items, such as [[Artifacts]], [[The Summer Company|Summer Company]] crates, [[Chests & Sacks|Sacks]], and similar objects, will remain inside a Guild Base if the entrance is moved. This can be used to transfer items over long distances. **However, carriable items will despawn if the player switches servers, such as traveling between [[Luminants]] or entering [[The Depths]], unless another guildmate remains in the server with the guild base active. *{{t|Grand Skewer}} is disabled inside Guild Bases because it can fling players out of the base. *Although enemies are not intended to spawn inside Guild Bases, [[Bandit]]s may still appear, and enemies such as [[Mudskipper]]s or [[Lionfish]] can still be fished up from the Fish Pond. *Guild Bases can be used as climbing ledges because their walls provide small footholds. *Placing mobs or [[Navaen Hostage]]s near a Guild Base entrance can prevent players from entering, which may help against assassinations or Voidwalkers. *If a player glitches out of a Guild Base and falls into the surrounding void, they will respawn outside the Guild Base. *Books donated to the [[Guild Librarian]] are saved even if the Library room is removed. *Guild Bases can help train Charisma, as their NPCs count as an audience. *The trees in the Quarters room can be cut down for wood with a lumber axe if struck from the correct angle. *The PVE dummy in the Training Hall can be used to build [[Chain of Perfection]] stacks. *According to Arch_Mage[''Citation Needed''], there is an unknown feature that can permanently turn all Guild Base NPCs into long white-haired Felinors with moustaches. *Voidwalkers hunting a player may be able to teleport to their Guild Base. If this happens, the player receives the message, "This is no longer a safehaven."[Confirmation needed] *As of the March 21st, 2026 update, [[Songwright]]s were removed from Guild Bases. They previously allowed players to upgrade mantras inside their Guild Base instead of visiting [[Attunement Trainers]], though at a higher cost. ==References== [[Category:Guilds]] [[Category:Locations]]

{{Factions|title1=Guilds|image1=GuildInfo.png|goals=Up to leader's choice|caption1=A guild's info in the playerlist}}

==Description==
Guilds are associations created by players, allowing people to represent themselves as a group as well as take advantage of mantra-based buffs. They are an influential part in ''Deepwoken'' and a lot of [[Talents]] and [[Mantras]] can be enhanced or require a guild member in order to operate. 

Once the player is [[Power]] 5, a guild can be founded by talking to the [[Guild Clerk]] in the Guild House at either [[Etris]], at [[Summer Isle]] in the Inn, or at [[Fort Merit]].    

==Creation and Customization==
Upon meeting the requirements, talking to the Guild Clerk will open a window that allows the player to start the Guild-making process. 

===Naming===
A guild requires 1-26 characters maximum, and cannot reuse already existing names. Special characters (e.g. !, $, #, @, &) cannot be used as well. '''Inappropriate names will be taken as a bannable offense and will depend on its severity.''' 

===Guild Emblem===
[[File:Guild elbem.png]]

When creating an emblem, a window will open up, dividing into two sections. One side contains a list of icons that can be chosen. The other shows a color picker for the Guild's background and emblem. Both emblems cannot have their color changed separately. 

A total of '''89 icons''' can be chosen, as seen below: <gallery type="slideshow" widths="300" position="center" style="clear:left">
File:Icon1.png
File:Icon2.png
File:Icon3.png
File:Icon4.png
File:Icon5.png
File:Icon6.png
File:Icon7.png
File:Icon8.png
</gallery>

After submitting an emblem, the guild will be successfully created and the leader will automatically gain the [[Chime of Dwelling]]. Additionally, the guild emblem will be visible on the following: 

*On top of the player's name
*The player list
*[[Ships & Sailing|Ship]] sails and flag
*Captured [[Guild Banners]]
*Guild bases
*Displayed with counters during [[War Mode]]

===Editing===
Guilds can be edited to change their emblem or be renamed for {{C|robux|100}}, the latter having a week long cooldown. Guilds that are recently created will also face the same effect.

When choosing to leave a guild and joining a new one, there is a 1 minute cooldown when switching between guilds.

==Members and Rankings==
Within a guild, the player can choose to recruit members. It is also used to promote and exile guild members, depending on their rank. If a guild's leader is terminated from Roblox, permanently banned from Deepwoken or has left the guild, leadership will be given to the first person who speaks to a Guild Clerk.  

The guild ranks are listed below:

|}Members of a guild including its leader will stay in their guild after death and/or wiping. Currently the only way to leave a guild is by speaking to the [[Guild Clerk]] or being exiled by an officer. You can have as many members in a guild as you want.   

==Chime of Dwelling and Guild Bases==

===Chime of Dwelling===
Main article: [[Chime of Dwelling]]

Chime of Dwellings are tools used by guildmates to access their Guild Base. The owner can also use the Chime to remove rooms and exile players remotely, as long as they are inside the Guild Base.

===Guild Bases===
Main article: [[Guild Bases]]

Guild Bases are the primary housing system used by guild members, which provides accessibility to various utilities in one spot.

==Guild Score==
Guilds have a score system with 2 main categories, PvE and PvP. The player must be [[Power]] 18 in order to earn Guild Score. PvE Score can be gained by defeating [[Bosses]], while PvP Score can be gained by killing players. 

The following ways to obtain guild score and the amount earned is listed below:

When reaching a certain amount of overall Guild Score, your guild's rank will be displayed on the playerlist. Upon reaching the top 1000, your guild will be displayed on Guild Leaderboards. Guild Score resets at the start of every month.

During [[Doubled Rates Weekends]], earned guild score will be doubled.

==Faction Guilds==
In certain [[Origins]] that pertain to its [[Factions & Groups|Faction]], the player can choose to join their respective guild by talking to its NPCs:

*[[The Central Authority]], which is gained upon selecting the [[Authority Ensign]] [[Origins|Origin]].

In addition to being inside a Faction guild, they cannot obtain any guild score. As of now, Faction guilds cannot be joined by talking to their NPCs, and are capable of obtaining guild score.

==Effects==
* Being in the same guild as someone with a spawned boat will allow you to spawn on their boat upon dying or resetting your character. You also spawn in the [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] if you have the Quarters room. 
*Nemesis, Radiant Kick, Taunt and Ankle Cutter all don't work on guildmates. This helps prevent some friendly fire during guild wars.
*[[Canor]]s' Innate [[Talent]] and the Talent "Give and Take," makes you deal and take less damage from any allies.
*[[Resurrection]] and [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]] allows you to see your Allies health bars. Know that not all of your guildmates may be considered as an "ally". To set someone to ally forcefully, you can make a vow of allegiance with them.
*Shout feature, allowing you to read and send messages between any guildmate or allies via [[Combat Mechanics|Vow of Allegiance]] in the server.
**In public servers, shouts are sent by prefixing "!" (without quotation marks) to your messages.
**In instanced servers (including Dungeons), any message will be sent to anyone inside without needing to prefix an exclamation mark.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Guild Ship.png|A guild emblem displayed on a ship's sails
File:Player Guild Title.png|The guild title displayed above a player's head
File:Juuse Goes To Scary Island.gif|The Guild Base door lighting up as a player walks in
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Guilds can be seen like [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Houses Houses] from ''Rogue Lineage'', another game by ''Monad Studios''.
*If a Guild Leader leaves the guild, an Officer or higher can take their place as the Guild Leader. If there are no Officers or higher ranks in the Guild, anyone in the Guild can take ownership. You '''must''' go to the [[Guild Clerk]] to claim leadership once the guild leader has left; it's not given to anyone randomly.
*Guild bases can be summoned by using [[Chime of Dwelling]] near a wall. However not all surfaces can be used to create a door, the criteria requires that the space must be big enough. Additionally, the guild base cannot be placed in Voidzones, in [[The Depths]], territory of factions that you are considered enemies with, if enemies are nearby, if the wall isn't made from the right material, and if placed on uneven surfaces.
*If a guild fails to properly load on your client side it will display as "The Authority."

title: Guns
content:
[[File:Guns Thumbnail.png|thumb|A [[Vesperian]] firing a [[Flintlock]].]] == Description == '''Guns''' are ranged weapons that are designed to fire projectiles if the user has bullets in their inventory which are capable of adding ranged capabilities (1H only) while also providing advantages and disadvantages depending on the [[Bullet Casings|ore the bullets are made of]]. Most pistols can be purchased in the Castle at [[Summer Isle]], except for the [[Dawnshot]] and the [[Silversix]], with the latter being an advanced starting weapon that is purchased with echoes when creating a new character. Rifles are found only as drops from enemies. There are several different types of guns in game. For the editor (and viewer's) sake, 1 hand wielding pistols will be referred to as "1H" for the rest of this article. ===General Gun Talents===
*{{cl|raretl|Armor Piercing}} [Rare Talent] - [Guns] Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied. **Due to this being combined multiplicatively rather than additively, this is worse than just +10% PEN, especially on [[Rosen's Hellflame]] and [[Stormseye]] due to their dual damage typings. Additionally, [[Rifle Spear]] will only benefit from this Talent on critical due to it being a slash based weapon. **Armor Piercing has heavy diminishing returns based on how much PEN you have. While at 0% PEN, this effectively grants +10% PEN against blunt armor, but this amount gets reduced by 1% for every 10% PEN you have. ***For example: having 20% PEN + Armor Piercing is equivalent to having 28% PEN against blunt armor (+8), or 65% PEN + Armor Piercing is equivalent to having 68.5% PEN against blunt armor (+3.5). **Armor Piercing does not bypass the 50% PEN cap. **Prerequisites: 30 Medium/Light Weapon and have completed the [[Summer Isle#Trig (QUEST)|Trig quest]] (helping The Summer Company) **The "[[Summer Company Uniform]]" outfit has this Talent *{{cl|raretl|True Ether Bullets}} [Rare Talent] - Using Ether Bullets applies elemental damage of your highest investment. **Prerequisites: 30 Intelligence, 20 Weapon (20 LHT OR 20 MED OR 20 HVY), Using a Pistol/Rifle/Greatcannon ***Landing 2 shots will make the 3rd shot deal elemental damage. ****The 3rd shot apply your attunement's elemental effect: *****Flamecharm: Your bullets apply burn/eruption (Lava Serpent) *****Frostdraw: Your bullets apply chill/crystal (Crystallization) *****Thundercall: Your bullets apply shock/surge stack (Surge) *****Galebreathe: Your bullets after cut and apply winded briefly *****Shadowcast: Your bullets drain ether/apply burn (Twisted Puppets) *****Ironsing: Your bullets apply metal rods *****Bloodrend: Your bullets drain blood ****If the user has multiple attunement at the same level, it will use the first attunement in the priority list: Thundercall > Shadowcast > Flamecharm > Galebreathe > Frostdraw ***'''If the user has no attunement, this Talent has NO EFFECT. It is recommended to put one point into an attunement if using this Talent on an attunement-less build.''' ***This Talent does not make guns scale off your attunement. It still scales off your Light/Medium Weapon stat but just converts your Physical Damage to Elemental Damage. ***Despite the fact that you can obtain this from Greatcannons, this Talent does '''nothing''' on them.
== Pistol Moveset == ===Single Gun=== Commonly referred to as one hand gun, wielding a singular main-hand pistol grants access to exclusive animations and Talent abilities. When pressing {{Input|keybind|Y / Z}}, reload your pistol. Pistols can hold 4 to 6 bullets, depending on the weapon in specific. On an unloaded pistol, your M1s will deal more posture damage, performing a pistol whip animation. Additionally, your weapon critical will be a default unloaded M1, proccing M1-exclusive Talents instead of those that proc on critical. When your pistol is loaded, your M1s will gain +10% chip damage, a +15% damage modifier, and a different M1 animation consisting of several shots with your pistol. Additionally, your critical will fire a ranged projectile on use. If you have physical [[Bullets]] in your inventory, your M1s will fire projectiles at the cost of 1 bullet on each M1. The amount of bullets you can load into a pistol is dependent on which weapon you have equipped. The [[Dragoon]], [[Flintlock]] and [[Dawnshot]] can hold 4 bullets, and the [[Repeater]], [[Iron Requiem]], and [[Silversix]] can hold 6 bullets. Reloading has a sound cue and slows the player greatly, leaving them vulnerable in combat. It takes 0.5 seconds to load each bullet (0.4 If the player has the {{t|Rapid Reload}} Talent an empty gun, and 0.25 if the {{t|Ultrakill}} Talent is active). You can end your reload early by pressing {{Input|keybind|feint}}. File:BasicPistol1H.gif|Loaded, singular pistol critical === Dual-Wielding === By equipping an offhand pistol while wielding a main-hand pistol, your animations and pistol-exclusive mechanics will be altered. Your M1 combo will now consist of two consecutive blast shots before a flourish. The reload mechanic will be removed, along with all benefits and downsides it may have. The offhand pistol will entirely inherit all stats (excluding Chip Damage) and the [[Enchantment]] from your main-hand one, '''overriding''' their original stats and enchantment. For example, if you have a [[Repeater]] in your main hand and a [[Silversix]] in your offhand, your Silversix shots will retain the stats of your Repeater. The Chip Damage stat does not transfer to your offhand weapon. Similar to the loaded singular pistol, the dual pistol critical consists of a projectile fired from your weapon. File:BasicPistol.gif|Critical === Offhand Gun === Using your gun as an offhand weapon will remove a lot of the pistol-exclusive mechanics such as reloading. Pressing {{Input|keybind|M2}} will make you extend your arm and fire the gun, creating the usual blast you'd see in other guns with no bullet coming out. The {{t|Hip Shooter}} Talent will allow it to fire a projectile bullet with a 5s CD as long as your main weapon is a medium or heavy weapon. This attack isn't used in your M1 combo and often has too much windup to be properly used in an M1 combo. The {{t|Quick Draw}} Talent will make possible, however, though '''you need to wait for the full endlag of your M1 and then use {{Input|keybind|M2}}''', otherwise the attack wont happen, which may cost you a hit during an intense fight. The stats of an offhand pistol will change slightly depending on what your equipped main hand weapon is. If your main hand weapon is another pistol, the offhand pistol will completely inherit the stats of the main one. If your main weapon is not another pistol, it will have a 20% reduction to its base damage along with inheriting the scaling and swing speed stats of your main weapon. All other stats on the pistol will be retained. For example, an Offhand [[Silversix]] on [[First Light]] with 80 heavy and 0 proficiency will deal 11.84 damage due to now having 8 base damage and 8 Heavy Weapon scaling. Offhand pistols completely inherit the [[Enchantments|enchant]] that your main weapon has. === Talents=== Pistols have their own Talent trees - {{t|Outlaw}} and {{t|Gunslinger}}.
====Outlaw==== *Lock n Load [Common Talent] - [1H Guns] The first bullet in your gun does more damage when fully loaded. This damage buff scales with the number of bullets up to 15%. **Prerequisites: 60 Light Weapon, using a Gun *Rapid Fire [Common Talent] - [1H Guns] When you land a critical shot gain an ability to rapidly fire your critical for 2s. 12s Cooldown. **Procs on dodge,block and getting hit. **Prerequisites: 50 Light Weapon, using a Gun *Rapid Reload [Common Talent] - [1H Guns] You have 20% faster reload when reloading an empty pistol. **it takes 0.4 seconds to reload each bullet of an empty gun instead of 0.5 seconds. **Prerequisites: 50 Light Weapon, using a Gun *Sleight of Hands [Common Talent] - [1H Guns] When you flourish an opponent you instantly load a bullet. **Prerequisites: 50 Light Weapon, using a Gun *Ultrakill [Common Talent] - [1H Guns] When under the effects of Rapid Fire you reload 2X as fast. **Prerequisites: Rapid Fire, 55 Light Weapon, using a Gun ====Gunslinger==== =====Offhand Gun===== *{{cl|raretl|Hip Shooter}} [Rare Talent] - When wielded with a Medium/Heavy weapon, your side gun can now fire a bullet projectile. 5s CD **Prerequisites: 25 Light Weapon, 50 Medium Weapon/Heavy Weapon, Have a Pistol in your offhand *Quick Draw [Common Talent] - Allows you to fire your offhand gun right after swinging. [Not necessary on dual guns] **Allows the user to instantly start attacking with their offhand gun after attacking with their main weapon **Prerequisites: 55 Light Weapon, Using a Pistol =====Dual Guns===== *Parting Gift [Common Talent] - After you land a flourish, gain the ability to shoot bullets for 5 seconds. [Dual Gun] **On proc, all dual gun M1s within the next 5 seconds have projectiles. **The projectile M1s from this Talent can proc True Ether Bullets. **Prerequisites: 75 Light Weapon, Dual Guns equipped (pistol in your main AND off hands) *{{cl|advancedtl|Prime Ether Bullets}} [Advanced Talent] - Your bullets take one less hit to proc elemental effects and now have slight intelligence scaling. [Dual Gun] **True Ether Bullets now procs in 2 hits instead of 3. **Adds 1.2 Intelligence scaling to your Pistols. ***The Intelligence scaling stacks with the [[Rosen's Ring]]. **Prerequisites: 90 Light Weapon, 60 Intelligence, True Ether Bullets, Dual Guns equipped (pistol in your main AND off hands)
Despite having the highest range of all the weapons, utilizing the range can often be difficult. The hitboxes for guns are much like a pencil in the sense that it's not very wide or tall compared to other weapons meaning most people will easily jump over your shots. ===Pistol Stats=== {{AllPistolWeapons}} == Rifles == Rifle moveset has a 5 hit combo (melee, shoot, melee, shoot, flourish). Rifles are limited to the 2 handed stance, and they are all exclusively medium weapons. === Talents === Rifles have their own Talent tree - {{t|Marksman}}.
*{{cl|raretl|Leg Shot}} [Rare Talent] - [Rifles] Landing your critical slows your enemy for a bit while making PvE enmies {{status|Sluggish}}, and also disables any speed boosts they get for the next 10 seconds. **The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets. **Prerequisites: 80 Medium Weapon, Rifle Equipped *Stock Bash [Common Talent] - {{ttag|Rifles}} Your running attacks now apply a brief amount of daze and {{status|Stagger}} PvE enemies. **Applies daze for one second. **Prerequisites: 55 Medium Weapon, 25 Strength, Rifle Equipped *{{cl|raretl|Tactical Reload}} [Rare Talent] - {{ttag|Rifles}} Activate to make your rifle shoot bullets for 15 seconds. (90 second CD) **Upon activating the Talent tool, your rifle will gain the ability to fire [[Bullets]] for 15 seconds. **Note that you need physical bullets in your inventory for this Talent to work. **Has a 60 second cooldown instead if you are wielding the [[Rosen's Peacemaker]]. **Prerequisites: 95 Medium Weapon, Rifle Equipped
===Rifle Stats=== {{AllRifleWeapons}} == Trivia == *You can buy bullets at the [[Etris]] weapon store and Summer Isle or craft them using 1 [[Iron]] for 50 bullets. **You can also modify your bullets with [[Bullet Casings]] by giving certain [[Ore]]s to a [[Gunsmith]], which can be located in your [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] and [[The Furnace]]. *There are three legendary guns in the game [[Stormseye]], [[Rosen's Hellflame]] and the [[Iron Requiem]]. (Two Rifles and one Pistol.) *The [[Rosen's Hellflame]] and [[Iron Requiem]] are the only guns with multiple crits, both being legendary weapons. *One handed guns are the only type of guns where having [[Bullets|iron bullets]] isn't a direct upgrade. **Loading bullets into pistols exchange posture damage for 10% chip and 15% increased damage. *Rifles and dual pistols used to fire ranged projectiles in their M1 combo, but this was removed in the March 3rd, 2024 Update. Today, you can perform something similar to this by using the {{t|Tactical Reload}} and {{t|Parting Gift}} Talents respectively. *No gun weapon has recoil in Deepwoken. *The [[Dawnshot]] is the only gun that can be [[Pluripotent Alloy|alloyed]]. *Reloading you gun during other animations, such as blocking, parrying or movestacking used to be possible. This was later fixed 2025, February 2th update. [[Category:Weapon Classes]]

*[[The Summer Company]] (as a spy) |family= }} ==Description== The former protégé of [[Gunsmith Rosen]], Hierka was really loyal to the [[The Central Authority]]'s [[Bureau of Research]] and had aligned himself with [[The Summer Company]] to steal their secrets. Under Rosen's watch, Hierka achieved the rank of gunsmith. Hierka modified Rosen's designs to produce the [[Rifle Spear]], but his deception was eventually discovered.The description of the [[Rifle Spear]] details Hierka's actions and calls him Rosen's ''former'' protégé. Weapon descriptions are shown to not be omniscient, suggesting that Hierka's true alliegance became known to the public. The usage of the phrase "it is said" further conveys this. ==References== [[Category:Individuals with He/him pronouns]] [[Category:Gunsmiths]] [[Category:Bureau of Research personnel]]

content:

{{Character
|image1=Silhouette.jpg

== Description ==
Gunsmith Rosen is the current leader of the arms company known as [[The Summer Company]]. He is responsible for reintroducing [[guns]] across the Luminants. His aspect is also [[Vesperian]]. Its unknown if Rosen resides within [[Summer Isle]] but it is assumed so due to him signing off the creation of the [[Stormseye]]. 

[[Gunsmith Hierka]] was Rosen's former protégé who deceived Rosen and hid his ranking as a member of [[The Central Authority]]'s [[Bureau of Research]] in order to steal the Summer Company's Secrets. This would go on to spark the invention of the [[Rifle Spear]], a standard issue weapon for the Authority.

While Rosen is known for his mechanical expertise, he has shown himself to still be skilled in designs that revolve around the manipulation of ether.<ref>{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Winter Rifle}}</ref>

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Group.png|Concept art (bottom right)
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
*Concept art has depicted him as a [[Canor]] as well as a Vesperian.
*While the [[Flintlock]] was designed by Rosen he only made the first Prototype, it now is mass produced by various gunsmiths.
*He also wore [[Equipment|Rosen's Ring]], which gives 1.2 INT scaling, but he lost it for an unknown reason, and so now the player can obtain it.
*The name "Gunsmith Rosen" could be a reference to the famous 90s rock band [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guns_N%27_Roses Guns N' Roses].

==Description==
The '''Hailbreaker''' is a [[Greatswords|Greatsword]] that scales with Frostdraw; it's a dark carbon fiber patterned blade with sharp edges and a slightly lighter-colored trim along the blade's length. The hilt has a futuristic appearance, incorporating glowing cyan accents, which enhance its high-tech aesthetic. It is only obtainable from [[Coldheart Fortinbras]].

This weapon comes with the following passive:

* '''Ingenious Invention''' - The Hailbreaker's blade changes after a critical attack is used, signifying its advancement to the next stage There are three stages in total, with the final stage being enhanced.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Hailbreaker Crit (stage1).gif|Stage I/II
File:Hailbreaker Crit (stage3).gif|Stage III
</gallery>
The Hailbreaker has three different criticals. When a critical is landed, it will advance to the next stage, changing its appearance. The stages are reset upon being sheathed.

For the '''Stage I'''/'''II''' critical, the user slowly winds up before performing a heavy ice-infused slash, Three ice blasts will form a triangle around the user after a short delay.

For the '''Stage III''' critical, the user rushes forward  before unleashing a horizontal ice-infused slash, Six ice blasts will form a ring around the user after a short delay before moving to the weapon's first stage.

All criticals give the user brief hyperarmor and apply Frozen on the initial hit, and have a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

Pressing {{keybind|k|feint}} during the windup of the critical will perform a feint that resets stages and has a cooldown of 2 seconds. All stages have this ability.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Meursault.gif|Stage I/II (Glass Path: Crystallization)
File:HailbreakerC3.gif|Stage III (Glass Path: Crystallization)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Strangely, when the user has {{t|Glass Path: Crystallization}}, the particles of its critical change to match the alternate path's color, but the actual model of the weapon does not.
