title: Hallowtide
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Hallowtide arrives in Deepwoken... Seek out the mysterious Floating Keep and complete your tasks to be awarded limited edition loot and cosmetics!|author=Hallowtide Update Logs}} {{Event |title1=Hallowtide |image1=Hallowtide Icon.png |date1=2025: Rimefall, 1620 CE |date2=*October 31st 2022 *October 27th 2023 *October 31st 2024 *October 31st 2025 |items=*Hallowtide-exclusive Equipment, Outfits, and Weapons *[[Joy]] *[[Hallowtide Mask]] and its [[Hallowtide Mask Ingredients|ingredients]] *[[#Aspect Variants|Aspect Variants]] *[[Harrowing]] [[Enchant Stone]] *[[Pumpkin Pitch]] *[[Instruments|Spectral Instruments]] *[[A Light In The Sky]] |type=Seasonal (Halloween) }} ==Description== Hallowtide is an event that first started on Halloween Night of 2022, and ended on November 13th, 2022. It has subsequently returned on the follow dates: *October 27th, 2023, ending on November 10th. *October 31st, 2024, ending on November 16th. *October 31st, 2025, ending on November 29th. ===Hallowtide 2022=== The first Hallowtide added... *'''New Features''': **[[Joy]] - A currency gained by scaring NPCs used to exchange for rewards. **[[The Floating Keep]] - The moving home of the Spellhardt family. **[[Hallowtide Mask]] - A crude mask used to scare NPCs for Joy. *'''New [[#Aspect Variants|Aspect Variants]]'''. *'''New Equipment''': [[Familiar Heretic's Helm]], [[Familiar Knight's Helm]], [[Familiar Priest's Helm]]. *'''New Weapons''': [[Skull Piercer]] (Rapier), [[Hallowscleave]] (Sword), [[Skyreap Blade]] (Greataxe). ===Hallowtide 2023=== The second Hallowtide added... *'''New Features''': **[[Widow's Wail Cemetery]] and Trial of the Gourdskipper - A eight-wave minigame that rewards the player with joy and Hallowtide loot upon blasting [[Gourdskipper|Gourdskippers]]. **[[Harrowing]] [[Enchant Stone]] - An [[Enchantments|Enchant]] that obscures health, posture, and armor bars on hit. **[[Pumpkin Pitch]] Mantra - A flaming pumpkin that can be hurled at enemies at an arc. *'''New Equipment''': [[Mushroom Costume]], [[Pumpkin Head]]. *'''New Weapons''': [[Drakemaw Gauntlets]] (Fist), [[Bloodtide Trident]] (Spear), [[Putrid Edenstaff]] (Greathammer), [[Gourdguard]] (Shield). ===Hallowtide 2024=== The third Hallowtide added... *'''New Features''': **[[Instruments|Spectral Instruments]] - A ghastly set of instrument skins sold by [[Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire]]. **[[A Light In The Sky]] Book - A musical notation made for a quartet composed by Galpin Spellhardt, grants A Light In The Sky shanty in the Worn Songbook. *'''New Weapons''': [[Spectral Grasp]] (Dagger), [[Death's Reverie]] (Twinblade), [[Wretched Mawblades]] (Greatsword). *'''New Schematics''': [[Familiar Heretic's Armor]], [[Familiar Knight's Armor]]. ===Hallowtide 2025=== The fourth Hallowtide added... *'''New Weapons''': [[Moppet]] (Dagger), [[The Weaving Web]] (Spear), [[Smouldering Hallow]] (Greatcannon). *'''New Items''': [[Goodie Bag]] (Relic), [[Nocturnal Gem]] (Deep Gem). *'''New Foods''': [[Candy]], [[Candy Suncorn]], [[Toffee]], [[Pumpkin]], [[Pumpkin Pie]]. *'''New Equipment:''' [[Crawling Necktie]], [[Death's-Head Necktie]]. *'''New Schematics''': [[Familiar Assassin's Armor]], [[Familiar Demon's Armor]], [[Familiar Occultist's Armor]]. ==Content== ===The Floating Keep=== [[The Floating Keep]] is a floating island near the [[Isle of Vigils]] and [[Greathive Aratel]] that can be accessed by talking to the Hallowtide Caller (a pumpkin) near the mantra shop at the Isle of Vigils or by the corner of the waterfall area at Greathive Aratel. The Floating Keep is also currently the "Battle Bus" of the battle royale mode. ===Joy=== {{Main|Joy}} *Joy can be obtained by putting on a Hallowtide Mask (obtained from turning in [[Hallowtide Mask Ingredients|1 Shell Stock, 1 Paperette, and 1 Fine Ink]]), and scaring any Passive/Neutral NPC that has a dialogue option by pressing E. You also gain 40 joy for completing the Trial of the Gourdskipper, Getting 3 each wave and 16 at the final wave. **Common NPCs (ex. Blacksmiths, Bankers, Antiquarians) that can be found in almost any town can only be scared once for each. (For example, scaring the blacksmith at Etris means you cannot scare any other blacksmiths until the scaring cooldown is over for that NPC. **Experienced characters, such as [[The Ferryman]], [[Lord Regent|The Lord Regent]], [[Polis]], [[Evengarde Rest]], and many others have unique interactions when you attempt to scare them. ===New Helmets=== *The [[Familiar Priest's Helm]], [[Familiar Heretic's Helm]], and [[Familiar Knight's Helm]] can be obtained by turning in 30, 35, and 50 "Joy" respectively. Four of the helmets are references to [https://www.roblox.com/games/3016661674/Rogue-Lineage Rogue Lineage], Monad Studios' previous main game. **The [[Familiar Priest's Helm]] is an exact replica of the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Helmets Church Knight Helmet] from Rogue Lineage. **The [[Familiar Heretic's Helm]] is an exact replica of the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Helmets Dark Sigil Knight (Wraith Knight) Helmet] from Rogue Lineage. **The [[Familiar Knight's Helm]] is an exact replica of the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Helmets Sigil Helmet] from Rogue Lineage. **The Shroom helmets are a remodeled version of the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Scroom Scroom] from Rogue Lineage. **The [[Pumpkin Head]] is a a replica of the heads on the [[Pumpkin Head|Gourdskippers]]. ===Aspect Variants=== The Hallowtide update added a special new variant for each aspect in the game. To unlock the Hallowtide aspect variants, you will have to turn in 70 "Joy" to [[Lysander Spellhardt]] who can be found in the hallway directly in front of the entrance. Once you purchase this option, all of your slots will be able to change their aspect variant to the Hallowtide variant upon speaking to him, though you will need to get a Hallowtide Mask to speak to him. You can also switch variants by going to a [[Barber]] and asking them to change your variant, or by wiping and choosing your Hallowtide Variant in the character customization screen.
====Gallery====
{{EnemyGallery|widths=200 |Adret Hallowtide.png|Adret |Canor Hallowtide.png|Canor |Capra Hallowtide.png|Capra |HallowtideCeltor.png|Celtor |ChrysidHallowtide.png|Chrysid |EtreanHallowtide.png|Etrean |Hallowtidefelinor.png|Felinor |HALLOWTIDEVAR.png|Ganymede |HallowtidyGremor.png|Gremor |Hallowtidekhan.png|Khan |KironHallowtide.png|Kiron |Birdhollow.png|Tiran |VesperianHallowtide.png|Vesperian }}
===Exclusive NPCs=== ====The Spellhardt Family==== *[[Alina Spellhardt]] *[[Brasidas Spellhardt]] *[[Everis Spellhardt]] *[[Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire]] *[[Glaive Spellhardt]] *[[Green Spellhardt]] *[[Leaf Spellhardt]] *[[Louie Spellhardt]] *[[Lysander Spellhardt]] *[[Mikhail Spellhardt]] *[[Tundra Spellhardt]] ====Other==== *[[Hallowtide Caller]] *[[Suspicious Skeleton]] ==Gallery== File:Floating keep spawn.gif|350x350px|The Floating Keep appearing ==Trivia== *The Floating Keep is the only place in game where the player can actually see [[NPC]] [[Lightborn]]s (Aside from [[Kaide, the Drowned Light]] in [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa.]]). *The Teleportation effect used when being transported to The Floating Keep is similar to the one used when using a [[Greathive Aratel|Greathive Fountain]], though it is purple instead of pale yellow. *Oddly, the third Hallowtide (2024) occurred outside of the weekly update schedule, instead returning on a Thursday on Halloween Day (31st of October). *The end of the fourth Hallowtide (2025) marked the longest Hallowtide in ''Deepwoken'' history, lasting 4 weeks and 1 day (29 full days), double the usual Hallowtide period. {{Nav|Hallowtide}} {{Nav|Events|2}} [[Category:Events]] [[Category:Hallowtide]]

|desc=It's crude... But maybe that adds to the scare-factor?}}

==Description==
The Hallowtide Mask is a Tool obtained from [[Lysander Spellhardt]] during [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide]]. It can be used to spook NPCs. Each spook grants you 3 [[Joy]]. All NPCs have a 30 minute cooldown before they can be scared again. The mask can be worn whenever but cannot spook NPCs unless it is Hallowtide.

Dynamic/non-human NPCs such as Town Guards or the friendly [[Kyrsgarde]] will act as normal and not be scared. This does not grant Joy.

== Obtainment ==
A Hallowtide mask can be crafted by bringing a [[Paperette]], [[Fine Ink]], and [[Shell Stock]] to Lysander Spellhardt in [[The Floating Keep]]. When bringing all three items to him, he will give you the mask.

== Scare Reactions ==

=== Generic ===
* "ACK!"
* "Ah-ah. Love a good scare, Cheers."
* "AHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
* "Bah! Shoo, shoo! I have a bad heart.."
* "BAH! You're cruel!"
* "GET AWAY FROM ME!"
* "Gods below!"
* "Gods below! Awful, awful display! Go away!"
* "Help, help!"
* "I HATE HALLOWTIDE- AHHHHHHH!"
* "JEEPERS!"
* "JIMINY!"
* "MONSTER MONSTER MONSTER!"
* "MONSTER- Wait. You look.. oh, you!"
* "NOOOOOOOOOO!"
* "PLEASE NO!"
* "THAT'S RUDE, BAH!"
* "You-AH! I'll get you for that.. Watch your back."

=== Unfazed ===

* "Come on."
* "Foolish."
* "Give it a rest already."
* "Give me a break."
* "Pfft... Come on."
* "Nice try."
* "Oh please."
* "Oooh, I'm so scared- that's what you want me to say, right?"
* "Take that stupid thing off."
* "What a nice tradition."
* "When are you gonna learn your lesson?"

==== Unique ====
* "...And to all - a good fright!" ([[Brasidas Spellhardt]])
* "A valiant effort... but no." ([[Warden Jericho]])
* "Dress up as a salad and maybe then you'll get a reaction from me." ([[The Meat Lord]])
* "...Happy Hallowtide." (Warden Jericho)
* "Hah, I've seen worse." ([[High Inquisitor Merey]])
* "Hahah, good one! Hey, Interceptor, check this out!" ([[Sentinel Augustus]])
* "Hey, nice mask, bub! Where'd you get one?" (Sentinel Augustus)
* "Ho ho! That's the spirit! Now do that unto someone else." ([[Galpin Spellhardt]])
* "Hoy, Well done, such joy! Now, show the world what thou canst do!" (Galpin Spellhardt)
* "HUTTAH- Oh, it's just you! Be careful, I almost knocked you out there!" ([[Chud Steel]])
* "I may be old, but I'm still brave, young one." ([[Polis]])
* "Joyous Hallows to all!" (Brasidas Spellhardt)
* "Nothing compared to what I've seen." ([[Akira]])
* "Nothing meant to imitate flesh and bone will ever scare me. Meat is my domain." (The Meat Lord)
* "Oh, you like to take different forms too?" ([[The Ferryman]])
* "Ooo, spooky." (High Inquisitor Merey)
* "Oorah! Joyous festivities to you too, citizen!" (Chud Steel)
* "SHOW ME YOUR WAR FACE!" ([[Drill Sergeant Kernel]])
* "Such a funny little tradition. I do like a game." (The Ferryman)
* "What was that? I felt a calm breeze..." ([[Stratos]])
* "What a foolish tradition." ([[The Lord Regent]])
* "You can't scare [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pvy9km7g6fw the storm that is approaching], surface dweller." (Brasidas Spellhardt)
* "You call THAT a scare? THIS is a scare!" (Drill Sergeant Kernel)
* "You'll find I'm being very merciful right now." (The Lord Regent)

==Description==
'''Handcuffs''' are a pair of heavily rusted handcuffs worn by prisoners of [[the Central Authority]]. While this weapon is equipped, you will not be able to swim-- getting knocked after touching water, use [[Mantras]], use your [[Resonance]], or hold any item in your hands, and your movement speed will be heavily reduced.

This weapon is automatically equipped upon being detained (gripped) by an [[Authority Ensign]] player or by speaking to a few Authority NPCs ([[Chud Steel]], [[Drill Sergeant Kernel]], [[High Inquisitor Merey]], [[Sentinel Augustus]], and [[Warden Jericho]]) while having Enemy or lower Authority reputation. You will also be teleported into Fort Merit's prison and a 10 minute countdown to your execution will start. If the countdown reaches 0 while you still have the handcuffs on, you will be immediately drowned and sent to [[The Depths]].

You can remove the handcuffs by speaking to a [[Blacksmith]] or the [[Etrean Guardmaster]]. Removing your cuffs via a Blacksmith requires you to have at least neutral reputation with the faction the Blacksmith is affiliated with.

{{DefaultCritFists}}

==Trivia==
*The Handcuffs share the weapon quality bonus and [[Enchantments|enchantment]] of your normal weapon.
*The critical of the Handcuffs is based on your [[Fists|fist styles]].
*While handcuffed, if you get knocked by any player (including yourself through self damage), you will be teleported back into the prison.
*You gain a perpetual PvE combat tag while the handcuffs are equipped.
*Despite your hands being bound, you can still pilot [[Boats]] and use their cannons.
*Due to its all around unbearably low stats, this is the weakest weapon in the game.
*Very likely based around as a mechanic and in functions around the Bound Cuffs from Tales From The Valley

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a [[Hallowtide]]-exclusive debuffing [[enchantment]] that obscures your opponent's UI or causes {{status|b=y|Confusion}} in PvE.

==Effect==
On M1, {{PAGENAME}} inflicts the {{status|Harrowing}} status effect for 12 seconds, obscuring your opponent's Health, Posture, and Armor meters with a nearly opaque yellow and purple pattern.

In PvE, {{PAGENAME}} inflicts the {{status|Confusion}} for 12 seconds, making your opponent have a 5% chance to hit themselves instead whenever they attack you. This applies a brief stun.

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Harrowingfx.gif|The brief visual effect of Harrowing being applied
File:Harrowingstatus.png|The UI under the effects of Harrowing
</gallery>

===Notes===
*Landing another M1 while Harrowing is active will refresh the debuff's duration. This also applies to Confusion.
*Confused enemies hitting themselves can proc [[Bloodrend|Blood Hemorrhaging]].
*Hovering over your health, posture, and armor bars while Harrowing is active will '''not''' display their percentages.
*If your opponent has the "Stat Bar Behavior" [[Settings|setting]] on "Always," then their health, posture, and armor percentages will be disabled when Harrowing procs, only turning back on if they rejoin, die, or toggle the setting off and back on again; even hovering over the meters will not display their percentage values.
*{{PAGENAME}}'s effects can be procced on weapon criticals if they have the [[M1 tag]].

A gargantuan creature wrought of iron and animosity and far superior to any mere [[Enforcer]], it is a creation of the [[Voices of the Depths#Voice of Enmity|Voice of Enmity]], a response to those making a mockery of the Trial with sheer numbers. To summon it, at least 5 players need to enter the Depths trial at the same time, and one player must have at least 60 difficulty score (+3 score per Power and +1 score per Drown). The Heart of Enmity possesses 65% oath damage resistance, 90% elemental resistance, ?% PEN reduction and is '''immune to all enchantments'''. It is also immune to potion effects. Has an unknown (but noticeable) amount of resistance to Damage versus Monsters and partially ignores Monster Armor (He has PEN). == Moveset == '''While some attacks can be blocked with over 50 posture and Ardour, it is not recommended due to the high risk of posture breaking.''' All moves instantly grip the opponent if they are knocked. Enmity Servants are also capable of executing downed players. {| class="fandom-table" !'''Name''' !'''Description''' !'''Media''' |- |
'''Enmity's Call'''
(★★☆) |The Heart of Enmity raises his axe into the air and summons 3 Enmity Servants, which are Soul [[The Enforcer|Enforcers]] with bright yellow eyes. *These serve to heal you during the fight via killing them. *Each Servant has 8,000 HP, and does not scale per player. *Posture break moves have the same effect as in bosses. *They don't have the Enforcer Pull or Whirlwind attacks. *[[Talents#Apex Predator|Carnivore]] is disabled against the Servants of Enmity. {{AttackTags |summon }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Homerun Bat'''
(★★★) |Heart of Enmity kneels down and grabs a nearby player, tosses them up then bats them with his axe. *The grab is unparryable, but the swing is parryable. **There is a brief window between the throw and the swing, around 0.1s after the throw has reached its maximum height, where you can parry the swing or vent to avoid the swing using i-frames. *This attack rarely can also be used to attack other outlier players trying to heal, when he bats them the victim can be batted towards another person and collide with them which can end up killing them or the other. *It is best advised to try blocking this attack instead of parrying/dodging as he will punish you for both, you need good posture + the [[Ardour]] Murmur however. {{AttackTags |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, grab, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkRed }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Sadistic Fury'''
(★★☆) |The Heart of Enmity kneels down on one leg and swings his axe twice, dealing significant damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = darkorange }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''The Brutalizer'''
(★★☆) |The Heart of Enmity delivers a powerful stomp then slamming his axe down, the stomp knocks down the victim. *The stomp may also be cancelled into Condemnation's Fall, and Sadist's Fury. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Condemnation's Fall'''
(★★☆) |The Heart of Enmity slightly kneels then tosses his axe towards where he's aiming, causing an AoE where the axe lands and major damage alongside ragdoll. *He uses this attack when someone is far from him. *Heart of Enmity doesn't jump into the sky despite the belief, its just a bug. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Event Horizon'''
(★★☆) |The Heart of Enmity raises its arm and charges a pull attack, forcing players to go within the attack's blind spot near Enmity. Anybody caught outside the blind spot will be pulled and take serious damage. *During this charge up, Enmity is free to be hit. {{AttackTags |indicator = avoid |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, pull }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |} == Passives == *Enchantment Immunity - The Heart of Enmity is immune to all [[Enchantments]]. *Potion Immunity - The Heart of Enmity is immune to all [[Alchemy|Potion]] effects. *'''Enmity's Rot - The Heart of Enmity applies a powerful anti-heal on attacks that last for 30 seconds.''' *'''Last Rite - Any time a player dies a Corrupted Servant of Enmity will spawn, possessing 20,000 hp.''' == Battle Dialogues == {| class="fandom-table" !Condition !Dialogue |- |'''Battle initiation''' |Despicable. Additionally, the player will receive a significant amount of experience, [[Attributes|attribute training]] and resonance progress. ==Strategies == ======Offense/General====== *It is recommended to fight the Heart of Enmity with only 5 people, as each extra player adds another 30 thousand health to the boss, and makes it difficult to not friendly fire. **Keep in mind that more players will bring more loot. *Fight the Heart of Enmity in teams of one or two, taking turns to engage the boss. Rest and switch out with teammates as needed to manage the battle effectively. *Be mindful of Enmity's very wide hitbox on most of his axe swings. They have an almost 270° radius from where he is currently facing and can often catch players to his sides off-guard. * Try not to hit allies with your offensive bells or high damage moves. *Wearing the [[Grand Fisher Plate]] or [[Ignition Gauntlets]] or using the [[Ignition Deepdelver]] outfit is recommended, because it allows you to parry all of his non-parryable attacks. ======Support====== *Although not needed, bring a support build with either [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]] or [[Oath: Blindseer|Blindseer]], as both oaths heal immense amounts of HP. **It is also recommended to have vow of mastery on the slot, as although not necessary, most support builds possess one already and are also quite helpful. **Focus on distracting the servants from attacking whoever Enmity is currently targeting ======Survivability====== *Get the talent '''Mythic Stability''', as it makes you ungrippable to auto-grip abilities, which is useful against the Heart of Enmity’s auto-grip attacks. * Have one person bring a [[Repair Kit|repair kit]] or two, as the boss does a lot of armor damage (note that campfires and Graceful Flames, even with Undying Flames, are unusable in the Depths Trial (alternatively you could just not be hit once) *If you're struggling with blood levels you can use '''[[Bloodrend]]''' to obtain Mantras that create blood pools to heal your blood by standing in them. **Alternatively, you can also get grand feast and use it to heal blood from the enforcers spawned or run the multiplicity armor enchant. ======Resonances====== *Corrupted [[Payback]] is amazing for damage and support. Make sure you get the beam variant of it and stay FAR away from teammates right before use to prevent friendly fire. *Corrupted [[Sacred Field]] is also amazing for general survivability. *Corrupted [[Run It Back]] is another amazing choice, as it heavily increases survivability and is great for killing enforcers with its hyperarmor. ==Gallery== File:Heart of Enmity Concept Art.png|Concept Art File:Heart of Enmity Concept Art 2.png|Ditto File:Heart of Enmity Concept Art 3.png|Ditto File:Heart of Enmity Concept Art 4.png|Ditto File:Heart of Enmity Teaser.jpg|Heart of Enmity's teaser image posted by the Official [https://twitter.com/Deepwoken Deepwoken Twitter account] File:Enmitydesert.png|Heart of Enmity spawned by a developer in Starswept Valley. File:Enmity servant.png|A Servant of Enmity winding up a kick after being spawned File:Enmity enforcer.png|A Servant of Enmity standing still ==Trivia== *The Heart of Enmity is the first ever [[First Layer|Scyphozia]] Boss added. *The Heart of Enmity has the highest base health out of any entity in the game. *It was briefly able to spawn corrupted, which was restorable. *It is unclear if the Heart of Enmity is the physical form of the [[Voices of the Depths|Voice of Enmity]], or just a stronger monster variant used in the trial. However due to the dialogue given after defeating the boss, it implies that the creature is a physical form of the Voice of Enmity (as opposed to the other conjurations). *Their summons are internally referred to as ".enmity_enforcer_WEAPON" *There was a bug that could instakill/void the boss by hitting the back of its neck with Rising Thunder or Rising Wind, as it would teleport far outside the confines of the arena, upon which it would die. *Before the World Events update, which added the boss, going to the trial with 5 or more people at once would force the participants to fight until one remained. ==References== {{History}} {{nav|bosses}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Voiced Characters]]

==Description==
Heartstar is an [[Attunement]] item with the primarily used to unlock the [[Bloodrend]] attunement. Secondary uses include being a consumable, and to spawn [[Primadon]].

By giving 3 Heartstars to [[Vyrelda]] located in [[Firfire]], you will obtain the [[Bloodrend]] attunement. 

[[Vyrelda]] can also be found in the [[Derelict Highchurch]], and she can be given Heartstars there too. 
==Obtainment==
Heartstars  can drop from enemies that use the [[Bloodrend]] attunement. Additionally, it can be sold by [[Traan Zakshun]].
*[[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]]
*[[Ministry Bloodrender]]
==Notes==
*Can be consumed so be careful when holding it.
*Eating Heartstars if you have [[Bloodrend]] will give EXP for [[Bloodrend]], thus training it.
*Holding it emits a pulsing red glow and blood particles.
*You can lighthook with Heartstars in your inventory.

== Description ==
Hector is an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He joined the Authority Navy only to be posted as a prison guard in the [[Merit Detainment Core]].

Unhappy with his position, Hector has no real stake in the Authority's goals, and is perfectly willing to help facilitate the escape of [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]]. Should such a breakout succeed, Hector hopes to use the opportunity to desert the military and return home.

He wears the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]] outfit, a Golden [[Plain Cape]], and [[Tracker's Boots]].

== Location ==
Hector is located in the [[Merit Detainment Core]].
{{clear}}
== Dialogue ==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="1" |''*Unlike the rest of the guards in the Detainment Core, this one seems to be entirely unbothered by your presence, almost as if you don't exist. He only sits there, weary, quietly polishing his sword.*''
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Uh... En garde?..
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He briefly looks at you, then shakes his head.*'' ...Nah.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Huh? What you *mean* 'nah'? En garde!
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He shrugs.*'' ...Nnnnnah. I can't be bothered. You feel me? Besides, the sword needs polishing.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You're... not a very good prison guard, are you?
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He shrugs once more.*'' Wasn't exactly my first choice for a job. Couldn't earn an honest living back home, so I signed up for the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} Navy instead. ''Really'' wish I hadn't by now, though. Pa always said, '' 'It's not for you, Hector' ''... I should've listened. Now, do you need something, or can I enjoy my peace?
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Do you know how to get past those lasers and cannons?
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He considers for a moment.*'' Eh, what the heck, sure. Sorta. The cannons will shoot hostiles on sight if you climb high enough, but the lasers have always been a nuisance for everyone here. Some of the senior guys around here carry keys for manual system control, though. There's an '''Override Key''' for the lasers. If you get a '''Master Key''', that works on all devices - cells, cannons, lasers, you name it. If you manage to get the right keys and plug'em in at the right slots, you could turn the systems off.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |The right slots?
|-
| colspan="1" |Yeah. The systems aren't all managed in one place. The generators powering the lasers are just on the opposite side of the corridor, a bit to the left. It's that balcony guarded by lasers. The cannon controls are behind a locked door - big gated entryway, just on the bend there. You'll probably need to break the door down, though.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Aren't you gonna get in trouble for telling me all this?
|-
| colspan="1" |''*Hector chuckles.*'' ...Nah. If you get yourself killed, then no one will know that I told you anything. And if you succeed at whatever it is you're here for, well... Once that absolute '''<font color="#44518c">giant of a Khan</font>''' breaks free from the cells back there, this place won't stay standing for long - and I'm not sticking around to see the fireworks. Family's not seen me in seven years, anyway - it's about time I came home.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Oh. Well... Thanks! I'll get going now.
|-
| colspan="1" |''*Hector nods.*'' Yeah? No worries. Good luck with your jailbreak, or whatever it is you're doing here. ''*With an uncaring smirk and apathetic gaze, he returns to idly polishing his sword, now tiredly humming a tune.*''
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}
==Trivia==
*Despite claiming to be part of the navy, his status as a prison guard suggests he was either transferred to the terrestrial army, or the Central Authority's military is incredibly homogenized.

title: Hell Mode
content:
{{Quotes|quote=If you ring that bell, '''all hell will break loose'''... No one could survive if that bell were to ring.|author=Karthal}}
[[File:Hell Mode Thumbnail.png|center|thumb|900px|The ominous Hell Bell, awaiting in the corner of Scyphozia to those foolish enough to ring it]]

==Description==
Hell Mode is a player-activated event that can be started in the corner of [[Scyphozia]] if four players who are at least Power 15 ring the Hell Bell. Upon starting the event, the lighting in the Depths will change to hellish-red and a kill count starting at 100 will appear over the bell. For every player that rings the bell after the initial four, 10 more mobs will be added to the kill count. There is a 20 minute duration to kill the required mobs.

===Effects===
During Hell Mode, part of the game will be tweaked to accommodate for the event. The effects are as follow:

*The server will publicly display the tag "[HELL]" next to its player count and will be tinted red.<ref>[[File:Hell Mode Tag.png]]</ref>
*Monster spawn rates are increased by 10x.
*Any monster that is spawned by Hell Mode ''will'' be corrupted, with the exception of [[King Thresher]]s and [[Mudskipper Broodlord]]s.
*[[Enforcer]]s and [[Nautilodaunt]]s are added to the regular spawn pool for the duration of the event.
*The Enforcer's "Space Pull" attack is disabled to prevent players being pulled into the void.
*Mudskipper Broodlords have their anti-heal debuff reduced to 50%.
*[[King Gigamed]] are unable to spawn.

These conditions will effect every player in the server, not just the players who interacted with the bell. However, only players who initiate Hell Mode will have increased spawn rates.

==Rewards==
Upon slaying the required mobs, Hell Mode will reward all participants that were present during its initiation with '''60 Full Trainings''', equating to '''4 Powers''', per completion. 

If the 20 minute duration reaches its end before the kill requirement, the event will forcefully end and no rewards will be granted. The event may also end early if the original players who ring the Hell Bell all die or leave the server.<!--table here with loot pool please!-->

Upon reaching 100 or more kills, players that rung the bell will always receive a [[Diver's Light Plate]] in their inventory and a large chest containing high tier loot including [[Relics]], [[Enchant Stone]]s and [[Enchant Grease]]s, Mid/Endgame [[Equipment]] and [[Weapons]] with a guaranteed two star quality, [[Deep Gems]], and the exclusive [[Ritual Sacrifice|{{cl|war|Ritual Sacrifice}}]] weapon.

==Tips==
*'''Hell Mode chests are accessible to any player, including chests that spawn after Hell Mode is completed.''' Because of this, the player is advised to be cautious around any other players they do not trust when spawning a chest, including those who may have rung the bell as well. Lower-tier chests, which are still more valuable than the average chest in the First Layer, can also spawn after killing certain monsters that are not locked to a specific player.
*'''Use height advantages to reach safe places.''' Although most monsters can jump fairly high, they may struggle to hit the player depending on elevation. Finding high ground to heal, survey surroundings, and take a breather is important, as being caught off guard by unprepared enemies can be fatal. However, the player should also be cautious of other players, as elevated positions will make them less susceptible to ambushes or others stealing loot. Be wary as well, as [[Nautilodaunt]]s and [[Deep Owl]]s can scale even the tallest walls.
**It is common for one player to have the Teleportation or Dimensional Travel [[Resonance]] to quickly create distance and evade any potential threats.
*'''Have a player who is capable of PvP'ing gankers.''' Assuming that most players who start Hell mode are using characters specialized in PvE, having a player who is specialized in PvP can act as a "bodyguard" to prune away any lingering gankers.
*'''When helping others fight monsters, avoid hitting each other.''' While doing so will not put them into player combat, it will still deal damage to them.
*'''Other players that did not ring the bell can combat-tag the player, and vice versa.''' The player should stay cautious of those who have not initiated the Hell Mode, as they may put the player in combat. A lack of health gain from monsters can result in a hasty death.
*'''Fighting near the [[Temple of Hearts]] is a fairly good option, as almost no mobs can enter it.''' Nautilodaunts, Threshers, and Deep Owls may still be able to get inside, otherwise, no other monsters can enter.
**Provided the player has available [[Wishes]], they can almost guarantee an escape from gankers by escaping from the [[Shrine of Yun'Shul]]. This should only be done if the player is completely overwhelmed, as leaving the server forfeits all potential loot.
*Most heavy weapons are viable in Hell Mode, but the [[Enforcer's Axe]] is a particularly strong option due to its critical hit potential.
**Many [[Enchantments]] are also effective in Hell Mode. Detonation can build stacks quickly but risks damaging allies. Vampirism improves survivability. Providence's Thorns can punish enemies that the player can parry frequently, and Wild deals reduced damage to allies while excelling against stacked mobs. Astral is a simple and effective choice for faster kills.
*If the player is low on health, they should attempt to kill weaker monsters such as  [[Lionfish]], [[Thresher]]s, or [[Megalodaunt]]s.
*The player should be extremely cautious of [[Nautilodaunt]]s, [[Fury Nautilodaunt]]s, and most notably [[Mudskipper Broodlord]]s. They are among the most dangerous threats in Hell Mode due to their shock, anti-heal, and unparriable attacks respectively.
*If the player is certain they have their [[Resonance]] and are below the HP threshold required to jump into the void, they may attempt to unlock it to restore full health before jumping into the void. This can be done by taking damage from players, monsters, or by climbing a wall just before reaching the void to incur fall damage. Be warned that this will send the player to the [[The Ethironal Shrine]] without a Lighthook.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Hell mode bell.png|Hell Bell prior to being remodeled
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Hell Bell can be rung up to a total of 15 times before starting the event, adding up to 250 total kills needed if done so.
*After five Hell Modes are completed, enough Full Trainings will be granted to the player to reach Power 20.
*The initial screen shake and red tint of Hell Mode can be seen in the [[Fragments of Self]].
*Some servers can rarely bug and retain Hell Mode features, even after the the 20 minute duration ends. '''Death by these means are restorable.'''
*In private servers (only accessible by Content Creators or Developers of the game), Hell Mode can be started by just one player.
*The Hell Bell was remodeled in the {{VersionHistory|2025|January 24th}} weekly update.
*Camping in [[Castle Light]] during Hell Mode will render the player ineligible for rewards.

==Description==
The Hemobloom is a red-colored flower with a structure that appears to be a blood crystal on the middle. It can be found in [[The Valley of Heroes]] during the [[Winter]], being Saltspan or Rimefall. They spawn in groups of two near the back. Alternatively, [[Traan Zakshun]] can potentially sell Hemoblooms for {{c|crowns|1}} in his black market.

It can be utilized to craft the [[Sanguine Transfuser]], needing 1 Hemobloom, a [[Dormant Splinter]] and an [[Ancient Dagger Remains]] at [[The Cold Forge]]. Alternatively, using 5 It can also be used to craft the [[Familiar Occultist's Armor]] at the [[Blacksmith]].

It is the only alchemic ingredient so far to have the revitalizing effect, and thus the only way to get the debilitating effect by using antithetic salts.

==Obtainment==

The Hero's Blade of Flame is an elemental weapon serving as the [[Flamecharm]] variation of the [[Hero Blades]].

The user plunges the weapon into the ground and exhausts the Hero of Flame, creating a whirlwind of flames around the user.

*The Hero of Flame is a [[Khan]] named [[Jace]], identified by their crown.
**Jace tells the player about Flamecharm being a gift and a curse at the same time in his respective [[Saintsworn Obelisk]].

*Attempting to use this Hero Blade with the Silent Heart Oath gives the dialogue: "The Hero of Flame, Jace, looks upon you with burning judgement and rejects your very soul."

==Description==
The Hero's Blade of Frost is one of the several elemental weapons apart of the Hero Blade line, being specifically the [[Frostdraw]] variant of the [[Hero Blades]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Ice heroblade crit.gif
</gallery>
The user slams the Hero Blade into the ground alongside the Hero of Frost, summoning multiple surges of ice around the initial location, dealing damage while applying Frost and Bottom Freeze to targets within it for up to 5 times. The user is unable to act for its full duration of the critical.

The critical does 8.4 Frost damage per hit (5) with 5 Frostdraw scaling. The initial hit has a 0.6s windup, whereas the surges have a 0.45s windup between hits. The critical has a 0.1s endlag.

If the user has Glass Path: Crystallization, the critical will apply additional crystals on hit.

The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Hero's Blade of Frost (OLD).png|Old Hero's Blade of Frost

</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Hero of Frost is a [[Capra]] named [[Faust]]. Identified by their horns and mask.
**Faust understood the way of the world better than anyone else, as said in their respective [[Saintsworn Obelisk]].
**Faust is based on a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faust German legendary character of the same name], who makes a deal with the Devil in exchange for unlimited knowledge.
*Once deciphered, the runes on the blade says, "I FAUST ONE PIECE OF A FIVE POINTED STAR GIVE MY COLDEST FROST TO THIS BLADE FIVE WE PLEDGE OUR SOUL LET WIELDER BLADE HEED OUR CALL BEAR THIS TORCH BEYOND OUR FALL".
*It's previous description read: "A blade said to be enruned with a passage of the song, it evokes the freezing oblivion of the cold wastes."

{{Weapon Infobox |damage type=Slash |range type=Sweep |attack duration=0.6s |name=Hero's Blade |type=Sword |requirements=100 ELM, LVL 10 |damage=19 |penetration=10% |scaling=5.5 ELM |posture damage=5 |range=8 |enchantable=No |swing speed=1x |obtainment=*Defeating [[Blizzard Knight]]s in [[Valley of Heroes]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Hell Mode]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *Sold in [[Traan Zakshun|Traan Zakshun's]] for {{c|notes|4,500}} or in his black market for {{c|crowns|3}} |selling price=100 |m.equip=No |rarity=Mythical |description=A blade said to be enruned with a passage of the song, it evokes the element within. |image=HeroBladeBlank.png |oath=Silentheart}} ==Description== The Hero Blades, or Hero's Blades, are a series of legendary blades enhanced and enruned with the Song. Each blade is connected to a respective Hero who bound their soul and Attunement into the weapon. The Hero Blades and the Heroes themselves are connected to the [[Oath: Saintsworn|Saintsworn Oath]]. Although they purely scale off of the player's element, Hero Blades deal physical slash damage and additionally scales off of the Proficiency [[Traits|trait]]. Each of the Hero Blades possess a unique critical attack, summoning the fallen heroes to aid dealing elemental damage of their respective type. {{clear}} == List of Hero Blades == File:Hero blade critical.gif|link=Hero Blade of Flame|[[Hero's Blade of Flame]] File:Ice heroblade crit.gif|link=Hero Blade of Frost|[[Hero's Blade of Frost]] File:LightningHero.gif|link=Hero Blade of Lightning|[[Hero's Blade of Lightning]] File:UniqueWindCrit.gif|link=Hero Blade of Wind|[[Hero's Blade of Wind]] File:HeroBladeShadowCrit.gif|link=Hero Blade of Shadow|[[Hero's Blade of Shadow]] ==Gallery== Heroblade of Blank Old.png|Old appearance ==Trivia== *At reqs, the damage is (26.8) for all the Hero Blades. *There used to be visible markings on the old Hero Blade model, which seem to be Elder Futhark runes. **These Elder Futhark runes used to translate to "jfeondkthz", from the tip of the sword to the guard. **The new Hero blade models written in [[Gatherhand]] generally translates to "I (hero name) ONE PIECE OF A FIVE POINTED STAR GIVE MY (attunement) TO THIS BLADE FIVE WE PLEDGE OUR SOUL LET WIELDER BLADE HEED OUR CALL BEAR THIS TORCH BEYOND OUR FALL". *Prior to Verse 2 (12/24/2022), the critical of the Hero Blades was the basic sword critical. *Every critical of the Hero Blade summons a hero and features their own aspect. **The Hero of Flame is a [[Khan]] named [[Jace]]. *** Identified by their crown. **The Hero of Frost is a [[Capra]] named [[Faust]]. ***Identified by their horns and mask. **The Hero of Thunder is an [[Adret]] named [[Tessa]]. ***Identified by her face markings. ***Her name was first stated in [https://x.com/Deepwoken/status/1801820070403772727 this] Twitter post. **The Hero of Wind is a [[Tiran]] named [[Trinity Galenwarde]]. ***Identified by the feathers on their head. ***The Hero of Wind was named Sven Corbet and appeared in a video prior to the public release of Deepwoken. Whether this is a retcon or they are simply another Hero of Gale is unclear. **The Hero of Shadow is a [[Kiron]] named [[Urek Felhand]]. ***Identified by their ears. *Any clones ([[Visionshaper]] or [[Lightning Clones]]) will use the default starting sword critical instead of the Hero Blade critical. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Swords]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Hero Blades]]

|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes
}}

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a buffing [[enchantment]] that grants the user damage buffs if their health is within a certain range.

==Effect==
When your health is at 75% or higher, {{PAGENAME}} grants a damage buff to your weapon attacks scaling on how close to 100% health you are. When your health is at 25% or lower, {{PAGENAME}} grants a damage buff to your weapon attacks scaling on how close to 0% health you are.

Heroism's damage buff is lessened in PvE.

Being under certain negative status effects will apply them to your opponent when you hit them with your weapon attacks. Note: Despite not removing the visual of negative debuffs, it DOES remove the status effect from you and transfer it to the opponent.

===Notes===
*Heroism's damage buffs start at +4% damage when at 75% or 25% health, and it gains +4% damage for every 5% health you are towards your respective goal. This means you gain a +20% damage buff when at 100% or 0% health.
**In PvE, Heroism grants a 1% damage buff for being at 75% or 25% health, and gains +1% for every 5% health you are towards your respective goal. This means you only gain a +5% damage buff when at 100% or 0% health in PvE.
*Heroism's status effect transfer works on the following [[Status Effects]]: {{status|Burn}}, {{status|Chill}}, {{status|Suffocation}}, {{status|Winded}}, {{status|Shock}}, {{status|Fear the Dark|Fear}} (from the {{t|Fear the Dark}} Talent), {{status|Anti-Heal}}, and {{status|Taunt}}.
*The status effect transfer applies with you having the ownership of the status effect. This means if you were to transfer {{status|Burn}} for example, it'd scale on '''your''' [[Flamecharm]] investment and it'd be affected by '''your''' Flamecharm Talents, not your opponents.

==Trivia==
*Heroism was once known as the "Blessing of the Hero" Enchant, and it used to deal 3x your scaled weapon damage on proc as seen from [https://youtu.be/SOdkNcZATtA infernasus video].
