content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{InProgress}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=High Inquisitor Merey |name=Merey Scarsen |aspect=Canor |pronouns=She/her |affiliation=*[[The Central Authority]]
**[[The Inquisition]] |location=[[Fort Merit]] |image1=High Inquisitor Merey.png }} ==Description== High Inquisitor Merey is a [[Canor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is the lead of the Inquisitor division for [[The Central Authority]] garrison positioned in the Eastern Luminant, the second to possess this rank, and a [[Thundercall]]er. Merey inherited her current position from [[High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi]]. She appears aged with small wrinkles around her eyes. She wears an [[Inquisitor's Visor]], a [[Brilliant Cape]], an [[Inquisitor's Duster]], and a pair of [[Grand Authority Sabatons]]. On her right side, she holsters a bell at her hip, signifying her strength to obtain a [[Resonance]]. On her left side she wields the [[Big Brother]] dagger. ==Location== High Inquisitor Merey is located inside of the fortress at [[Fort Merit]], she is on a hidden floor below [[Warden Jericho]]. *To find her, the player can enter a cracked wall on the south side of the fortress. From there, enter the cracks and air dash to enter her corridor. High Inquisitor Merey Map.png|Map High Inquisitor Merey Spot.png|Entrance ==Dialogue== |-|Authority Ensign= {{#tag:tabber|No division= {{#tag:tabber|Private / Corporal= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}''*With her visor covering her eyes, she remains inscrutably impassive, though you are sure that she is tracking every movement you make.*'' [Rank] - it seems you've strayed a little too far from your post. It'd be more appropriate for an ensign like yourself to return to your Drill Sergeant, rather than waste time poking around where you oughtn't be. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lance Corporal= {{#tag:tabber|Meets requirements= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*You recognize the shadow-clad {{g|Canor}} woman with dark, lightly-silvered hair and a visor. This is the High Inquisitor, Merey Scarsen. You offer a salute.*'' ...Ah. You must be... Lance Corporal [Last Name] was it? Very good. I had just finished looking over the reports on your field mission performance. You pass the criteria for joining the Inquisition division. Would you like to enlist in our ranks? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes, High Inquisitor. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like some time to think about it, High Inquisitor. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute the High Inquisitor. She offers a solemn, graceful salute in return.*'' Very well, Lance Corporal. By the powers vested in me, in the name of our Sovereign of Eras, Drallis Ehr, I name you an Inquisitor of The Central Authority. You shall now serve under my supervision. May you be the faithful eyes and ears of the Authority, may you act as it's restless, haunting shadow, and may you slice apart with measured blade the chains that seek to bind us. You may report back to me at your discretion. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The High Inquisitor's eyes, sharp and curious, pierce you like needles from beneath her visor.*'' Very well, Lance Corporal. Know that it is both a privilege and a recognition of your achievements to receive the offer. If you change your mind... I'll be waiting here. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player joins Inquisition Division {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Does not meet requirements= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*With her visor covering her eyes, she remains inscrutably impassive, though you are sure that she is tracking every movement you make.*'' Lance Corporal - it seems you've strayed a little too far from your post. It'd be more appropriate for an ensign like yourself to return to your Drill Sergeant, rather than waste time poking around where you oughtn't be. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Command Division= Dialogue stays the same throughout your ranks as Warrant Officer, Captain, Commander, or Seneschal. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You gracefully salute the High Inquisitor. She salutes you back, stern as ever. Though, even through her steeled demeanour, you can tell your presence draws her attention.*'' Welcome, [Rank]. I'm currently preoccupied with something, so if you bring any messages from Warden Jericho, please leave them on the table. If the Warden asks, you may tell him that the plans regarding our latest agent networks are proceeding apace. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Inquisition Division= {{#tag:tabber|Inquisitor / Inquisitor 1st Class= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The High Inquisitor nods at you, but her demeanor remains steeled.*'' Once again, welcome to the Inquisition of the Central Authority, soldier. I must offer a proper introduction. -I am High Inquisitor Merey, the leader of your division. I advise you to learn and understand the weight and importance of your position within the Authority's ranks and to represent me and my team adequately. Restraint and conscientiousness are the most important values an Inquisitor can have. Remind me your name and rank, Inquisitor? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I am [Rank] [Full Name], ma'am. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}*You give the High Inquisitor your most rigid salute. She responds kind, in her typical austere fashion.* Good to have you on board, [Rank], Is there anything you'd like to know about? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Inquisition? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}We are the eyes and ears of the Authority - and often, its faithful shadows. Your responsibility is to find out everything there is to know about our many rivals through subterfuge and interrogation, even if extracting that information requires some... ''enthusiastic'' encouragement. All I ask for is that you keep your tavern 'gossip' to non-Inquisitic matters, and do not spend your time laughing over reactions to interrogation methods. It is certainly not an appropriate topic. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I see. That is all for now, ma'am, thank you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Very well, I hope that was informative enough. I expect to see you more around more often, [Rank] [Last Name]. I will be observing your career with interest - even if you won't be aware of it. ''*Uncharacteristically to herself, she chuckles.*'' If you have any other questions in the future - do not hesitate to stop by. Dismissed. *You once again exchange stern salutes with the High Inquisitor.* {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute the High Inquisitor. She returns a rigid salute herself.*'' Welcome back, [Rank] [Last Name]. I hope your work is keeping up to our standards. Remember - restraint and conscientiousness are the most important values an Inquisitor can have. Now... Do you have something on your mind? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Inquisition? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Unlockable Dialogue= This dialogue is unlocked after speaking with [[Milgram]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*You salute the High Inquisitor. She returns a rigid salute herself.*'' Welcome back, [Rank] [Last Name]. I hope your work is keeping up to our standards. Remember - restraint and conscientiousness are the most important values an Inquisitor can have. Now... Do you have something on your mind? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I met a dark-eyed Adretian with a scar earlier... Were they an Inquisitor? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The High Inquisitor sighs.*'' Sounds like you ran into Milgram. Indeed, they're a Handler of our division. Milgram's one of our finest, although they can be quite the individualist. Were they giving you a hard time, Inquisitor? Pay it no heed. In this division, our work is a competition - even if some of the more competitive Inquisitors might enjoy putting down lower ranks, and schmoozing up to peers with good prospects. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Inquisition? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I see. That is all for now, ma'am, thank you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See previous instance] {{!}}} }} {{!}}-{{!}}Handler= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}''*Upon your approach, she exhales, her previous tension released. She only permits a small, taut smile, but certainly relaxes in your presence, as you exchange easy salutes.*'' [Last Name], it's good to see you again. And you seem to be doing well. I do hope you aren't too burdened with how antsy the interrogators have gotten - I'm deeply sorry that I don't really have the spare time to help you. But perhaps this tool will provide you with what you need.
[Player obtains [[Big Brother]]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="10" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Starting Dialogue] {{!}} colspan="10" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[During Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="10" {{!}}*''She nods politely, a half-smile forming on her lips.''* Of course. Inquisitors should share information where it is pertinent - be it as friends, or colleagues. What would you like to know? {{!}} colspan="10" {{!}}*''She nods, patiently.''* Of course. What else would you like to know? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="18" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Options are presented as normal] {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[This option also appears, but only outside Starting Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="14" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me a bit about yourself, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What can you tell me about Warden Jericho? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If I may speak freely, ma'am... You don't seem to have the highest opinion of Sentinel Augustus?.. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all for now, ma'am. Thank you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="14" {{!}}*''A smile dares to tug at the sides of her mouth.''* I'm not all that interesting, [Last Name], I can assure you. I studied linguistics at the {{g|The Citadel of Markor|Citadel}} of Markor for a little while... But, trust me when I say that it's all rather dead-end there. You study there, you work in some dusty institution, and you die there. Career prospects and job satisfaction seemed quite dire. Soldiering about with the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} wasn't too alluring either, but at least there's some achievement to it. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Mmm... He's a good colleague and leader - though I can't say I know him very personally. He holds most people at an arm's length. I can't say that's too different to his battlefield tactics, though. Yet, also... *''She pauses thoughtfully for a moment.''* It's not my place to question the Warden's choices, mind you... but I feel as if little to no ''actual'' progress is being made on this side of {{g|Lumen}} these days. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''The High Inquisitor pauses, exhaling lightly.''* He's certain got the mettle of a great soldier, and his achievements undeniably reflect that. And, I do respect his ability to fixate himself on a task and get it done, though at the expense of a little... tact. Like an enraged, blinkered thresher. He suits his role the way I do mine. But I would argue he does not make for a particularly captivating conversation partner. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''The High Inquisitor nods.''* Very well, [Last Name]. If there's anything else you'd like to talk about, don't be stranger, yes? I wish you luck on your upcoming missions. Make the Inquisition '''proud'''. *''You once again exchange stern salutes with the High Inquisitor.''* {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What led you to enlist with the Authority? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why did you end up joining the Inquisition? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What was it like, studying in the Citadel? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all for now, ma'am. Thank you. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What makes you say that, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why not, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''A brief, listless moment of recollection seems to cross her mind.''* To put it simply, [Last Name], once I finished my studies, I came to realise that academia was not the environment where I wanted to ply my trade. The {{g|The Citadel of Markor|Citadel}} taught me... ambition. To pursue perfection. To strive for excellence. Driven relentlessly by that desire in my younger days, I joined the one place I could think of where I could find satisfaction in my work, and apply the skills I had learned. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''The High Inquisitor's expression betrays a spark of ambition in her eyes.''* When I joined the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}, it made the most sense for me to join the Inquisition. I never quite had the tactical skills needed for the Command division, and the Shock Corps didn't seem all that appealing. I enjoyed the tasks sent my way. The field work was quite demanding, but I was persistent. Though, I excelled at investigative work. It's like putting together a puzzle each time, piece by piece... {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''She wanders insouciantly in her memories.''* It was wonderful and challenging at the same time, [Last Name]. All the books you could ever want, and on any topic. You're taught and tutored by the best minds in {{g|Lumen}}. There's lively discussion and debate of all kind... But the academic standards were sky-high. The scholars expect nothing but excellence from their pupils... It does foster a healthy sense of ambition within the students, though - and prepares the next generation of {{g|Lumen|Lumen's}} finest. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''She shakes her heads, straightening her visor meticulously.''* He expects a lot of his subordinates, and thus, I do my part in giving him all the information he needs to survey the dynamics of the region. But it never seems to amount to anything further than surveying. Probing and pushing. Small scuffles on long-contested territory which inevitably ammounts to little. To be frank, things have ground to a screeching halt compared to my early days as the High Inquisitor, [Last Name]. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''You can tell Merey rolls her eyes underneath her visor.''* The Sentinel, if I am to speak freely, has all the subtlety of a wall of bricks. He also has no grasp of metaphors, or figures of speech. Though, I admit - it's almost endearing to see him try to pick up idioms and phrases from me... I just wish he didn't have his natural talent for immediately turning them into metaphors. I guess you can't teach an old {{g|Canor}} new tricks, eh, [Last Name]? *''She chuckles.''* {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why did you end up joining the Inquisition? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What was it like, studying in the Citadel? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all for now, ma'am. Thank you. {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you end up becoming the High Inquisitor? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What led you to enlist with the Authority? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why did you end up joining the Inquisition? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all for now, ma'am. Thank you. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Were things different before? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}I inherited the mantle from the first High Inquisitor of Fort Merit, Mordred Hirculi. I was designated as his successor long before he passed. He appreciated my ambition, and helped temper it into a useful tool. He was a great mentor... *''Merey lowers her head pensively.''* Uncharacteristically to many in the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} military, he passed peacefully in his sleep. The High Inquisitor was already an old man when he came to Fort Merit. I can only hope that my current work would make him proud. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''She nods solemnly.''* When I first assumed my current position, we were making tremendous strides. We built up a vast network of agents within each of the major regional players. But once we ramped up our efforts of infiltrating the Etrean ranks, things suddenly changed. We began losing Inquisitors in droves during field missions. It's... hard to explain, [Last Name]. The events of those days are quite complex. But ever since then, Warden Jericho has been hesitant to act. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you think about the current state of the Inquisition, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hesitant how? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''She runs a hand through her dark, lightly silvered hair.''* Well, if I were to do a fair reckoning... Improvements could be made. For example... Some of the newer Inquisitors lack restraint, and enact violence for the sake of violence. I understand that the current stalemates make them antsy... But restraint and conscientiousness are the most important values an Inquisitor can have. The purpose of an interrogation is to extract information, not to prolong suffering. It is a necessary evil. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}*''Her brow furrows slightly.''* We pace about in circles. Outside of... certain operations, which I am strictly not allowed to discuss with personnel without the appropriate clearance, we've been interrogating mostly the same kinds of people, and getting mostly the same information. I can only hope the Warden's current planned endeavours lead somewhere... {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What led you to enlist with the Authority? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What was it like, studying in the Citadel? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all for now, ma'am. Thank you. {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Upon your approach, she exhales, her previous tension released. She only permits a small, taut smile, but certainly relaxes in your presence, as you exchange easy salutes.*'' [Last Name], it's good to see you again. And you seem to be doing well. I do hope you aren't too burdened with how antsy the interrogators have gotten - I'm deeply sorry that I don't really have the spare time to help you. Is there something you'd like to talk about? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Unlockable Dialogue= {{#tag:tabber|After Speaking with Sentinel Augustus= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*Upon your approach, she exhales, her previous tension released. She only permits a small, taut smile, but certainly relaxes in your presence, as you exchange easy salutes.*'' [Last Name], it's good to see you again. And you seem to be doing well. I do hope you aren't too burdened with how antsy the interrogators have gotten - I'm deeply sorry that I don't really have the spare time to help you. Is there something you'd like to talk about? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Sentinel Agustus requested me to pass you a message, ma'am. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}*The High Inquisitor's typically inscrutable demeanour betrays a tinge of disappointment.*Is that so,[Last Name]?Most curious.Let me guess...He requests to participate in the next interrogation of General Titus Fulminus Destellus. Did i guess correctly? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...Uncannily so, ma'am. How did you know? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}*The High Inquisitor demonstratively brushes off her shoulder. *All in a day's work, [Last name]. Gathering intel is what an Inquisitor does. *She laughs. Just for a split second, it's like she's another person entirely, before she returns to her stern self. * Of course, I jest. You are not the first Inquisitor he's sent my way with this request. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If I may ask - who is this 'General Destellus'? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}*She leans back against the wall.*I suppose you're due for an intel briefing, [Last name]. General Titus Fulminus Destellus of the Hundred Legion, commander of the 49th Legion, is currently a prisoner in the Merit Detainment Core. Everything about his case seems unusual. Every circumstance surrounding his capture just raises more questions... Tell you what let's make this a deduction exercise. Where should I start? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What were the circumstances of his capture? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I assume he was interogated - what did that yield {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}He seems valuable - have the Hundred Legions asked for his return? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*The High Inquisitor thinks for a moment. * He was captured by a detachment led by Sentinel Augustus in Aratel. They were en route to a separate mission when they encountered General Destellus, with a small detachment of Legion Shock Troopers. The man is known for emerging victorious even against overwhelming odds. yet he was captured in a stray skirmish by a relatively small number of our own soldiers. What next? {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*Disappointment flashes across Merey's face as she frowns. *Not much, unfortunately. He's rather physically and mentally resilient. Conditions were further complicated by the subject's natural resistance to our traditional methods of a electrical shocks to the cerebrum - something to do with the martial techniques he has mastered. In fact the shocks only seem to invigorate him. And, his astonishingly high pain threshold makes it difficult to apply most other methods. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*The High Inquisitor thumbs her chin contemplatively. *They have not. The Legions inquired on whether Destellus is alive and in our custody, but did not attempt to negotiate a prisoner exchange. Although, recent events suggest they may be engaging in acts of subterfuge concerning the prisoner. A recent commotion in the Detainment Core was linked to Legion espionage. The circumstances are still under investigation. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}WIP {{!}}- {{!}}-{{!}}Haven't spoken to Merey since joining= If you haven't spoken to High Inquisitor Merey since you've joined the division, you will be met with this dialogue. You can still obtain the [[Big Brother]] by speaking to High Inquisitor Merey again. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Despite the visor covering her eyes, the High Inquisitor notices your approach. You both exchange rigid salutes.*'' Handler [Last Name], is it? I don't believe we've spoken since you first enlisted in my division. But I suppose stealth is the mark of a good Inquisitor. ''*She gives you an icy smirk.*'' I've heard good things about your work, Handler. Do you have any questions for me? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something, ma'am? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance] }}}}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Shock Corps Division= {{#tag:tabber|Frontliner / Interceptor= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You vigorously salute the High Inquisitor. She gives you a steely salute in return. You could swear she just sighed, if softly.*'' I'm sorry, [Rank], there are no joint training exercises between the Shock Corps and the Inquisition planned today. Sentinel Augustus and I are still working out the details. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have other matters to attend to. Dismissed. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Operator= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The high inquisitor lets out a small, beleaguered sigh as you instinctively salute her. She returns the salute.*'' Did Augustus send you, Operator? Please tell the Sentinel I ''can't'' just 'shock Destellus harder' to make him speak, as it just makes him ''stronger''. Pray also tell him that I'm aware 'he can handle him', and that an interrogation's purpose isn't to start a barefist brawl. If you'll excuse me, I have matters to attend to right now. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], unlocks dialogue with [[Sentinel Augustus]] {{!}}} }}}} |-|Not Authority Ensign= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Although the {{g|Canor}} woman wears a visor, you can tell her eyes are set upon you like daggers.*'' This area is off-limits to outsiders. I highly suggest you make yourself scarce, civilian... Unless you'd like to be introduced to the Fort Merit dungeons firsthand. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} |-|Bad Authority Reputation= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Lost, mouse? Let me show you the way out. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player is jailed and sent to '''execution''' {{!}}} ==Gallery == High Inquisitor Merey Blindfold.png|High Inquisitor Merey's Visor ==Trivia== *Due to her rank, Merey does not have floral-themed codenames other Inquisitors have. *As a Handler, reading the [[Operation 'Puppet Master' Report]] will unlock new dialogue. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]] [[Category:Inquisitors of The Central Authority]]

title: High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi |name=Mordred Hirculi |alias=High Inquisitor |aspect=Vesperian |pronouns=He/him |affiliation=*[[The Central Authority]]
**[[The Inquisition]]
*[[Circle of Honour]] |location=[[Fort Merit]] |death=Died in his sleep{{Ref/NPC|High Inquisitor Merey|quote=I inherited the mantle from the first High Inquisitor of Fort Merit, Mordred Hirculi. I was designated as his successor long before he passed. He appreciated my ambition, and helped temper it into a useful tool. He was a great mentor... *''Merey lowers her head pensively.''* Uncharacteristically to many in the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} military, he passed peacefully in his sleep. The High Inquisitor was already an old man when he came to Fort Merit. I can only hope that my current work would make him proud.}} |deathdate=Between 1233 CE{{Deep dates|Iron}} and 1272 CE{{Deep dates|Verse3}} |image1=High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi.png}} ==Description== High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi is a [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He was the lead of the Inquisitor division for [[The Central Authority]] garrison positioned in the Eastern Luminant, the first to possess this rank. Mordred also possessed unknown ties to the [[Circle of Honour]], and was aware of [[Warden Jericho]]'s allegiance to the information. Mordred was an elderly man and eventually died in his sleep. He was succeeded by [[High Inquisitor Merey]], who had been assigned as his successor prior to his passing, as the two had a good relationship during his career. He appears aged with grey hair. He wears an [[Inquisitor's Visor]], a [[Fleet Warden Cape]], an [[Inquisitor's Duster]], and a pair of [[Grand Authority Sabatons]]. ==Location== High Inquisitor Mordred Hirculi is located inside the war room of the fortress at [[Fort Merit]]. NPC Map Warden Jericho.png ==Dialogue== |-|Good/Neutral Reputation= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |''*The aged Vesperian is wearing an elaborate visor over his chitin mask. Despite this, it appears he can see you perfectly well. He gives you a meaningful nod. As he speaks, his voice is raspy, almost like a hiss.*'' Recall in Iron, friend. The Warden's not around at the moment, I'm afraid... But he should be back in time. Good luck on the mission. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Bad Reputation= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |Tsk tsk. Shabby form! ''Forgive me, Ironsworn - one must keep up appearances.'' |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], you get stabbed |} ==Trivia== *{{W|Mordred}} is a figure in Arthurian legend. Details vary greatly, but Mordred is generally characterized in popular culture as a villainous relative of {{W|King Arthur}}'s who serves as a member of his {{W|Knights of the Round Table}}, before he eventually betrays and kills Arthur for the throne. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Inquisitors of The Central Authority]] [[Category:Deceased characters]]

title: High Monk Junsui
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=High Monk Junsui |aspect=Etrean |name=Junsui |alias=High Monk
Ironsworn Monk |location={{iv|The Golden Rat}} |affiliation={{iv|Circle of Honour}} |image1=High Monk Junsui.png |death=Deceased prior to the events of the game |deathdate=Between 1233 CE{{Deep dates|Iron}} and 1272 CE{{Deep dates|Verse3}} }} ==Description== High Monk Junsui was a figure of note among the {{iv|Circle of Honour}}. ==Location== High Monk Junsui is located inside of {{iv|The Golden Rat}}, standing between {{iv|Monk Nako}} and {{iv|Monk Kasan}}. NPC Map High Monk Junsui.png ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="240" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="240" |''*A weary-looking man dressed in monastic garb leans back against a wall, observing a bickering group of what appears to be Etrean nobility. His appearance seems familiar - his name escapes you, but you recognise him as a prominent member of the Circle of Honour. He eyes you, as if seeking something in you.*'' |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |[Continue] |- | colspan="240" |[Reclaimer of the Recollection speaks to the player]
''*You hear the Reclaimer's voice, coloured by a tinge of bitter loss.*'' A warrior of our cause, now fallen. His was an important quest... ''*Your eyes flick to the Iron Memento dangling from his rope belt as you hear this.*'' This man knows something useful. Speak to him the words of the Circle. That should trigger a memory. |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |In Iron we recall, friend. |- | colspan="240" |[Reclaimer fades off and the Monk speaks]
''*The man eases up a little.*'' In Iron we recall, indeed. My greetings, friend. Strange to meet a comrade in arms in a place such as this, don't you agree? |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |I had some help in finding you, from a wounded man at the Monastery. What are you doing here? |- | colspan="240" |[Alias revealed as Ironsworn Monk]
''*The man lowers his eyes mournfully.*'' One of the Mofisu warriors, no doubt. I advised Sachan Choji not to split our forces. But he was insistent... Nevertheless. As you see, I am accompanying a group of nobles - four '''sachans''', or clan leaders. The ones over there. ''*He sighs, nodding his head towards the colourful group of armoured Etreans behind you.*'' Allow me to introduce myself. I am High Monk Junsui, of the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}. To my right is Monk Kasan, and to my left - Monk Nakom, both comrades to our cause. And you? |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |I am [Full Name]. |- | colspan="240" |[Revealed as High Monk Junsui ]
''*You remember hearing legends of this man. A legendary Circle of Honour member - a warrior monk who fought in the Etrean Civil War, who gave his life for your order's cause. Junsui nods, sagely.*'' It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [First Name]. I assume you are here for the same purpose as us, then? |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |Indeed. I am looking for a way to defeat the Calamity. |- | colspan="240" |Aren't we all. ''*He chuckles.*'' Outside of the crossing of our paths here... Have you had any luck in other avenues? |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |My initial lead turned up nothing, although I faced one of the Regent's generals. |- | colspan="240" |A Shogun. Of course... ''*He ponders for a moment.*'' An interesting start. Then you saw the devastation they unleashed at the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}. ''*He lowers his head pensively.*'' They caused my order great grief. In shame, I must admit we failed to defend our home against them. Although we were strong, their numbers were overwhelming. We would have fought to the death... But the sachans issued a retreat, to regroup our forces - and we were sworn to follow. An oath binds use to the Old Guard. |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |The Old Guard? |- | colspan="240" |''*He gestures at the group behind you once again.*'' Etrean Royalists. The Lord Regent's opposition in the Civil War. Not everyone in Etrea was keen on his ascension to the throne. The elder clans of the kingdom rose up in arms to oopose his coup. We have waged bitter war ever since, for 14 years now. After such a long time, it seems even bonds forged in the fires of war may start to fray. |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |Why did the Shoguns attack your monastery? |- | colspan="240" |''*Junsui smirks.*'' I suppose we became too much of a threat to the Lord Regent. The Old Guard used the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} as a sort of clandestine base of operations, after the Calamity's forces began tracking our every move. But eventually... Evil assaults even the most sacred of places. I suppose we should have seen it coming. I had told the sachans that we should not stay put for too long. ''*He chuckles.*'' But they did not heed my advice. |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |The clan leaders appear to be arguing. |- | colspan="240" |Indeed. The sachans cannot agree on a strategy. ''*He sighs, beleaguered.*'' Their cause is aligned with ours. Like the Circle, they would also wish to see the Lord Regent defeated, and their homeland restored to the old order. But the war has been long and arduous, and our forces dwindle. I had hope that I could make them see reason. But nobility is stubborn. With each passing day, they listen to my counsel less and less often. |- | colspan="240" {{cl|reply}} |What are they arguing about, exactly? |- | colspan="240" |''*Junsui's sigh betrays his weariness.*'' This knowledge would be pertinent to you as well, given our mission. Dravik, the Rat King - a former Vigil, -is known to hold a powerful a secret. He knows how to cross and destroy the barrier surrounding the Royal Palace of Etrea. However... He claims he will only surrender it if he is bested in a fight. When deciding our strategy going forward, an argument broke out. Templers flared. Now, our alliance grows fragile. |- | colspan="100" {{cl|reply}} |Who are those four sachans? | colspan="140" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? |- | colspan="100" |They are Sachan '''Zaru Ganba''', Sachan '''Choji Mofisu''', Sachan '''Yi Anako''', and Sachan '''Shisui Kobura'''. Their four clans are ancient, and were once greatly respected in Etrean society. Now, the Veil has obscured them in the minds of our people, and they are seen as mere bandits. Yet, they are the main remaining Etrean resistance against the Regent's influence. | colspan="140" |''*The High Monk ponders for a moment.*'' It is a complicated topic. What would you like to know, specifically? |- | colspan="80" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the clan leaders? | colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? | colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} |'The Veil'? You mean, the Regent's Mind Veil? | colspan="40" {{cl|reply}} |How did the civil war start? | colspan="40" {{cl|reply}} |Remind me - why are the sachans arguing again? | colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} |What is the sachans' strategy? |- | colspan="80" |''*Junsui nods.*'' There is no reason why I could not. What would you like to know? | colspan="10" |[See first instance] | colspan="10" |''*Junsui leans in closer, whispering.*'' Lower your voice, [First Name]. But so, you do know of it. The Mind Veil. Zi'eer's power to manipulate the memories of many people at once... I can tell by the look on your face - you're wondering why our group is not affected by the Veil. We were simply outside of Zi'eer's reach when he placed it upon Etris. At the beginning of the war 14 years ago, he was much weaker than he is now. And Etrea was a much larger kingdom... Powerful as he may have been, he simply could not have used his powers so broadly. Even to this day, the range of his abilities is limited to the capital itself. | colspan="40" |''*His gaze turns to the middle distance, as blazing recollections seem to dance before his weary eyes.*'' He staged a devastating coup. It was not a blood less affair, as some might have you think. He stormed the royal palace at night, with a group of guards loyal to him - those who would later become his Shoguns, twisted beyond their mortal coil. He slaughtered any resistance in cold blood, and murdered Lord Guardian Ji'ang. Once he seized the throne of Etrea... He placed a mental veil upon the population of the city. Etris carried on as if nothing had happened. Everyone thought the Lord Regent had been the ruler for years the following morning. | colspan="40" |''*Junsui's sigh betrays his weariness.*'' This knowledge is pertinent to you as well, given our mission. Dravik, the Rat King - a former Vigil,- is known to hold a powerful secret. He knows how to cross and destroy the barrier surrounding the Royal Palace of Etrea. However... He claims he will only surrender it if he is bested in a fight. When deciding our strategy going forward, an argument broke out. Tempers flared. Now, our alliance grows fragile. | colspan="10" |[Bugged Dialogue] |- | colspan="16" {{cl|reply}} |What's their strategy, anyway? | colspan="16" {{cl|reply}} |What can you tell me about Sachan Zaru? | colspan="16" {{cl|reply}} |Tell me about Sachan Choji. | colspan="16" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about Sachan Yi? | colspan="16" {{cl|reply}} |I would like to know more about Sachan Shisui. | colspan="10" | | colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} |How did Zi'eer come to power? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |And the Veil only affected the city? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |What do you mean by 'twisted beyond mortal coil'? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |Who are those four sachans? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? |- | colspan="16" |As it stands, we are currently entertaining the idea of fighting Dravik. Yet, although the sachans are valiant fighters in their own right, it would be too great of a risk if they were the ones to face him. | colspan="16" |He is the one bearing the '''black''' and '''gold''' standard. A shrewd diplomatic mind, and a cunning strategist, with no patience for imperfection and inefficiency - which he finds bountifully in his unlikely allies. They say he is the man of a thousand tricks... In my experience, that is often true. He manoeuvres the other clan leaders skillfully - but his own patience is beginning to dwindle. The Ganba clan once occupied a place of prestige among the Etrean Royal Guards, serving the Lord Guardian honourably until his last moments. For Sachan Zaru, the fight against Zi'eer is both a fight for the preservation of his family's history, and for revenge. | colspan="16" |He bears the '''green''' and '''silver''' standard. Sachan Choji is a devoutly religious man, and an ardent follower of the tenets of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}. Clan Mofisu have kept close ties with our monastery, as their noble estate was built close to it, and each one of them would give their lives to protect the faith... During the recent Shogun attack on our monastery, Clan Mofisu were the first to come to our aid - and the first to pay the bitter price. Their own estate now lies in ruins, and they roam in exile alongside our forces. Sachan Choji would very much wish for us to retake the monastery and their estate as a stronghold for our forces... But, alas. | colspan="16" |Her house fashions the '''red''', '''black''', and '''silver''' standard. Sachan Yi is a stalwart warrior, dedicated to protecting Etrea until her last breath. Clan Anako take great pride in their martial prowess, and they used to supply a great deal of some of Etrea's finest and most legendary warriors. In spite of this... They are not necessarily well-liked by the other clans. The others see their military dominance as competition. On top of that, Sachan Yi is known for her short temper, and her sometimes unappreciated candour - both of which can complicate matters in discussions... | colspan="16" |The valiant house of '''indigo''' and '''silver'''... Yet, not all see them as reliable allies. Clan Kobura are often seen as independent and ambitious, and Sachan Shisui is not too different herself. She's the youngest of the four sachans, and certainly the most ambitious. Regrettably, she sometimes tends to ignore the collective for her own gain, or for the benefit of her clan. If we did things her way, the Old Guard would either scatter to the four winds so she could exploit their bickering, or she'd have them crown her the Queen of Etrea. The lands of the Kobura lie in frigid ice and snow- they have the least to lose, but also the most to gain from this war. | colspan="10" | | colspan="10" |''*His gaze turns to the middle distance, as blazing recollections seem to dance before his weary eyes.*'' He staged a devastating coup. It was not a blood less affair, as some might have you think. He stormed the royal palace at night, with a group of guards loyal to him - those who would later become his Shoguns, twisted beyond their mortal coil. He slaughtered any resistance in cold blood, and murdered Lord Guardian Ji'ang. Once he seized the throne of Etrea... He placed a mental veil upon the population of the city. Etris carried on as if nothing had happened. Everyone thought the Lord Regent had been the ruler for years the following morning. | colspan="20" |''*Junsui nods.*'' Yes. When the great clans learned of this usurpation, they rose up in open rebellion, denouncing the coup. Zi'eer could shape the memories of Etris, but he was - and remains - too weak to affect the rest of the kingdom. It would take an impossible amount of power to impose the Veil on every Etrean citizen in the East. The Etreans in the city knew the cause of the civil war, at first. It was a fresh wound in the people's memory. But now... I am told he has eroded even that. | colspan="20" |''*The High Monk smirks knowingly.*'' You have faced one yourself by now. You saw how the armour obscures their giant forms entirely. But their metal shells are not quite filled by any form you could consider familiar. For their loyal servitude, Zi'eer has rewarded them with great power, turning them into monstrosities. They are no longer human, but something else entirely. Closer to Zi'eer's own form true form... | colspan="40" |[See first instance] |- | colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} |Who are those four sachans? | colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Tell me about Sachan Choji. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about Sachan Yi? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I would like to know more about Sachan Shisui. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |What can you tell me about Sachan Zaru? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about Sachan Yi? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I would like to know more about Sachan Shisui. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |What can you tell me about Sachan Zaru? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about Sachan Yi? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I would like to know more about Sachan Shisui. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |What can you tell me about Sachan Zaru? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Tell me about Sachan Choji. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I would like to know more about Sachan Shisui. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. | colspan="10" | | colspan="5" {{cl|reply}} |And the Veil only affected the city? | colspan="5" {{cl|reply}} |What do you mean by 'twisted beyond mortal coil'? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |Is the Veil getting stronger, then? | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. |- | colspan="80" |[See first instance] | colspan="10" | | colspan="10" |[See first instance] | colspan="20" |''*The High Monk hesitates for a moment.*'' We are not sure exactly how... But his power grows - if not in scope, then in focus. Fourteen years ago, the people of Etris knew we fought to oppose the Lord Regent's ascendance to the throne. Now, they think the Old Guard are just a gaggle of rebellious lords - or worse, scheming usurpers, unhappy with taxation and new laws. Thanks to him, our cause has been reduced to that of lowly bandits in the minds of our people. Should we lose the war, we might be erased from history altogether... Then, the truth will be whatever Zi'eer desires it to be. | colspan="20" |''*Junsui nods.*'' Of course, my friend. If you have questions - ask away. |- | colspan="100" | | colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} |I'd like to discuss another matter. | colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the clan leaders? | colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? |- | colspan="100" | | colspan="38" |[See first instance] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |''*High Monk Junsui leans back against a wall, observing a bickering group of what appears to be Etrean nobility. He recognises you as you approach, nodding in your direction.*'' Welcome back, friend. I hope your mission is going well- {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} knows, mine has hit a snag. ''*He chuckles.'' {{sic}} Is there something you'd like to talk about? |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |I wanted to discuss a certain matter with you. |- | colspan="2" |''*Junsui nods.*'' Of course, my friend. If you have questions - ask away. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the clan leaders? | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me more about the Civil War? |- | colspan="2" |[See first instance] |} ==Trivia== *Junsui is a Japanese name meaning "pure". **It was partially chosen due to resembling the name "Jinshi", a character in ''The Apothecary Diaries'', a historical drama novel, manga and anime series set in a fictionalized version of Tang Dynasty China. *Junsui has a unique [[Iron Memento]] on his braided sash. **This same unique Iron Memento can also be found in Nagatony's Picture Booth. ==Description==
Found in the [[Fragments of Self]], the '''Hippocampal Pool''' allows you to pass down 2 items (can be increased at the cost of [[Echoes]], up to 4 additional pass-downs for a maximum of 6,) from your current character to your next character (in the same slot) '''after wiping'''. Using a Drowned Favour will '''not''' grant you the items already deposited.

Enchanted items and Legendary items can be passed down with the cost of 40 [[Echoes]] per item. ''This is '''<u>not</u>''' an Echoes upgrade. ''

Passing down soulbounded items will keep them soulbounded to the next character you create upon wiping.

===Ineligible Items===
There are a few items that the Hippocampal Pool will not accept, meaning they will be lost permanently upon starting your next character. These include:

*[[Ingredients]] 
*[[Mantra Modifiers]] (some mantra ingredients ''can'' be passed down such as [[Mantra Modifiers|Crystal Lens]] or [[Mantra Modifiers|Aeon Logstones]])
*[[Training Gear]]
*[[Food]]
*[[Relics]] except for [[Equipment|Armors]] like the [[Whistling Periapt]]
*Any item that cannot be banked. Barring things already stated, this includes:
**[[Pleeksty's Inferno]]
**[[Mantle of Enmity]]

title: Hiri
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=To put it simply, a difference in ideals. While the Ganymedes and Vesperians of the Hive believed in a future of eternal bark reaching ever-higher in a technological sprawl... the Chrysids saw it differently. To them, they believed steadfast in religion, the Moonlit Faith. They believed our roots would decay and weather with the waves, while the Moonseye above could never touch the sea.|author=Hiri}}{{NPCInfobox
|image1=NPC Hiri.png
|name=Hiri
|aspect=Chrysid
|affiliation=[[The Hive]]
|pronouns=He/him
|location=[[Greathive Aratel]]}}

==Description==
Hiri is a [[Chrysid]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

==Location==
Hiri is located inside of the library at [[Greathive Aratel]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Hiri Map.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |[When interacting as any other Aspect]
| colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |[When interacting as a Chrysid]
|-
| colspan="6" |Something wrong, traveler? You've been staring for a moment now. Surprised to see a Chrysid in the Greathive?
| colspan="6" |Ah, another Moonlit descendant. Surprised to see another of our kin here in the Greathive?
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I don't see many Chrysids around here. Why is that?
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I don't see many Chrysids around here.
|-
| colspan="12" |Aye. Well, most of my ancestral folk had left many ages ago. Most Chrysids, in fact. Only a rare few stayed with the Greathive. They're the only species of Hivekin to this day that has succeeded in such a withdrawal.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |What happened? Why did they leave?
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Have other Hivekin attempted withdrawal before?
|-
| colspan="6" |To put it simply, a difference in ideals. While the Ganymedes and Vesperians of the Hive believed in a future of eternal bark reaching ever-higher in a technological sprawl... the Chrysids saw it differently. To them, they believed steadfast in religion, the Moonlit Faith. They believed our roots would decay and weather with the waves, while the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} above could never touch the sea.
| colspan="6" |Not to my knowledge, but the Chrysid exodus is still a notable part of the Hive's past. There's no hard feelings between the Greathives and Chrysids, but.. it's a shame the tides turned such ways.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |So the Hive believes in technology, and the Chrysids believed in religion.
| colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|-
| colspan="6" |Aye. My ancestral folks were always a reclusive bunch... they mostly kept to themselves, that is. They departed en masse during the construction of the first Greathive, most forming small settlements of their own on splinter islands, growing their own little societies.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |So they're scattered.
|-
| colspan="6" |Indeed, indeed. Most still rarely travel from their villages unless on some sort of pilgrimage, or so their faith demands. They tend to keep to themselves, although they have quite a way with words once you're more acquainted with them.
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What are their villages like?
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What led you to leave them?
|-
| colspan="3" |Quiet, and lonely. Most reside within an archipelago known as the {{g|The Lullaby Isles|Lullaby Isles}}. It's surrounded by a dense mountain range at sea, off the coast of Markor. Multiple small islands are within the region, with each village serving under the Lady {{g|The Lady Confessor|Confessor}}.
| colspan="3" |''*The man looks off to the side, frowning slightly.*'' Well.. I wouldn't describe it as leaving, per se. Just as they had different ideals compared to the Hive, I had different ideals to them. Faith never did any good for me, traveler. I hold no bearings in such things anymore.
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Lady Confessor?
| colspan="3" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|-
| colspan="3" |Within the central mass of the {{g|The Lullaby Isles|Lullaby}} Isles is a city-state known as {{g|The Echelon|The Echelon}}. It's the center of the Moonlit Faith's beliefs, and where the council of the faith resides. The Lady {{g|The Lady Confessor|Confessor}} is.. a cruel woman. She declares what is sin, and what is not... and deals punishment to sinners.
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |Punishment?
|-
| colspan="3" |''*A grimace grows upon the man's face.*'' I don't want to talk about it, friend. I've already lost many of my kin to those beliefs.. I do not wish to remember it.
|-
| colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} |What led you to leave them?
|-
| colspan="3" |[See First Instance]
|}

title: Hive Construct
content:
{{h2|Golem Constructs}}
{{Topbuttons|p, [[Rogue Construct]]}} {{Quotes|quote=DON'T STAND IN THE WAY OF TRUE PROGRESS.|author=Hive Construct}} {{Monster Infobox |title1=Hive Construct |health=3000 |locations=*[[Starswept Valley]] *[[Bluster Rift]] *[[Faction Ambushes]] |image1=Hive Construct.png |drops= *[[Mantra Modifiers|Tier 2 Mantra Modifiers]] *[[Hivelord Mask]] *[[Pomar]] *[[Hivelord's Hubris]] *[[Enchantments|Curse of Ysley's Ember Enchant Stone]] }} ==Description== It has a brown wood-like appearance, with foliage around its legs, resembling wires. It also sports a Hive logo made of wood on its torso. It is powered by the Lifeweaving technology of the Hive, which explains its unique abilities to create life with some attacks. It is shorter than a [[Megalodaunt]], however it's size is not to be underestimated. It wields incredible power and can easily take out an inexperienced player. It cannot climb, but does walk very fast, so if you're unlucky enough to encounter one and are underleveled / unprepared, it is recommended to run away. It can be tipped over, so if you have Mantras like [[Flame Ballista]], [[Grand Javelin]] or [[Wind Gun]], you can use them to stun it to aid your escape. Hive Constructs can spawn in [[Starswept Valley]] and [[Bluster Rift]]. ==Moves== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Stomp'''
(★☆☆) |The Construct stomps the ground, dealing high damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:RogueConstructStomp.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |

(★★☆) |The Construct uncoils its arms and swings them upwards. *Flings and ragdolls player. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:RogueConstructSwing.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Scream'''
(☆☆☆) |The Construct screams, signifying that '''Meteor Punch''' is off cooldown and can be used again. *Stay cautious of the Meteor Punch attack after he uses this move. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |[[File:RogueConstructRoar.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Meteor Punch'''
(★★★) |Punches the ground with it's right fist, creating two circular shock-waves. *Deals roughly 200 damage total. *Insta-grips/insta-executes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Golem move 1 gif.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |

(★★☆) |Used alongside 'Stomp', spawns a few temporary trees within 1 second, allowing it to climb some short walls. *You cannot walk through some of the tree's leaves. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, unharmful }} |[[File:Woodpunch.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |} == Tips == *These things do unrelenting damage even at Power 20. Do not take them lightly. Pay attention to undodgeable cues and stay wary for the blue particles around the fist signifying a Meteor Punch usage. *Be careful if fighting alongside Hive Constructs; if you get downed, there's a solid chance you will get instantly executed in the crossfire. *If you are being chased by a Thresher, King Thresher, Sand Knight, etc. and there's a Hive Construct nearby, try going to the Construct as it will aggro onto the mob trying to kill you. *Meteor Punch can be parried, but if you miss, you will take heavy damage. ==Gallery== Golem Construct Concept Art.png|Concept art Golem.png|The original Hive Construct appearance Hive Construct Talking.png|A Hive Construct talking ==Trivia== *It was virtually impossible to fight these directly for years after Deepwoken's release due to their animations being heavily bugged. They were fixed at an unknown date. *Prioritizes [[Stone Knight]]s below [[Authority Captain]]s, meaning it will fight the Captain before the Knight. *Can win every fight with another [[Monsters|monster]] in [[Starswept Valley]]. *They will mock The Central Authority after defeating an [[Authority Captain]] during the '''Hive Construct vs Authority Captain''' event. **Hive Constructs will almost always win these events without player intervention. *Unlike most monsters, they have cancollide on, which means you can touch their model without phasing through them. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:The Hive]] [[Category:Hive Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]]

They wear a pair of Woodland Pauldrons and Woodland Boots along with a pair of Crystal Pendant Earrings. In addition, they also don a [[Grandmaster Pathfinder Cloak]] outfit. Similar to any other guard, killing one will give the player negative reputation with [[Reputation|The Hive]]. Other than that, they are all either [[Vesperian]]s, [[Ganymede]]s or [[Chrysid]]s. ==Moveset== A Hive Guard's arsenal consists of a [[Ritual Spear]] that has a chance to be enchanted along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

(★☆☆) |The Hive Guard shoot a projectile that explodes after a short delay and blinds those looking at it. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n }} |} ====Boons==== *Impervious - Immune to PvE scaling. ===Talents=== *Flaming Flourish - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. *Hard Read - Hitting your opponent during a feint will cause them to be dazed. *{{cl|raretlnf|Lightspeed Reflexes}} - Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. *Nullifying Clarity - Deal 10% more damage to enemies with status effects on them with your basic attacks, but the effect is removed on impact. *Polite Awakening - Recover 15% of your max health after getting up from being downed ==Finisher== A Hive Guard executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before impaling them through the chest with their spear. |} ==Tips== *Don't underestimate them. Anyone who entirely ignore them and focus on chasing their target are often quickly overwhelmed by Hive Guards due to their Flame Assault allowing them to quickly catch up with and ragdoll players. *They are very strong in numbers do not underestimate them if you hunt a target down in there Greathive Aratel. ==Gallery== HiveGuardEnchant.png|A Hive Guard with an enchanted weapon ==Trivia== *In Verse 1, they only consisted of Ganymedes and Vesperians. title: Hivekin
content:
== Description ==
Term representative of the aspects Vesperian, Ganymedes, and Chrysids. 

A kinship formed by once similar views of advances of technology. Currently though not all the aspects agree to it as the majority of the Chrysids live isolated away from the Great Hive.  

The Hivekin are the inhabitants of the Great Hives and in the faction The Hive.

==Description==
The Hivelord's Hubris is a Greathammer [[Weapons|Heavy Weapon]] which is the brutally torn off arm of a [[Golem Constructs|Hive Construct]], ending in its spiked shoulder. It is presumably absurdly heavy, given its slow swing speed and 100 HVY requirement.  

It drops from all [[Golem Constructs]].

{{DefaultCrit|Greathammer}}

==Gallery==
===Enchantments===
<gallery type="slideshow" widths="300" position="center" style="clear:left">
File:Chilling Hubris.png|Chilling
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*It's actually smaller than the arm of a Hive Construct, which can be easily compared by breaking the Hive Construct out of the ice in [[Minityrsa]].<ref>[[File:HubrisSizeComparison.png]]</ref>
*Hivelord's Hubris has by far the slowest swing speed out of any weapon. While more predictable than other heavy weapons, it does gargantuan damage when landing a hit.
**Pairing this with the [[Heavy Hands Ring]] can make the swing speed 0.58x, making it extremely slow.
*One of the most damaging heavy weapons in the entire game, being on par with the damage from [[Crazy Slots]]' Divine Weapons.
*The name might be a humorous reference to the humerus, a major bone of the arm.
*Despite having 10 range in statistics it has less M1 range than the [[Pale Briar]], another heavy weapon with 10 range.

title: Hobo
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{EnemyInfobox |image1=Hoboclose.png |health=450 |drops=*Four Chests *[[Dying Embers]] |weapon=None |moves= *Fire Eruption *Flame Assault *Flame Repulsion *Flaming Scourge *Rising Flame }} == Description == The Hobo is a wealthy and proficient [[Flamecharm|Flamecharmer]] that you may find when roaming around [[Erisia]]. The Hobo is a neutral NPC that can be found in the wild. It guards three chests that can be obtained safely if you pass a [[Attributes|Charisma]] check, or alternatively you can kill them, granting you another chest. You may loot the chests without completing the Charisma check, but it will anger them and initiate a fight. Their movements are very jagged and extremely fast, almost as if they're flying. In order to parry their hits you need to predict them, and during their frenzy it's impossible to flourish them, as they will be attacking nonstop with [[Flamecharm]] mantras. You must fight back when they stop moving, or by using AoE skills while they're moving. Killing the Hobo results in another chest spawning. A Hobo only wears a [[Stranded]] outfit. == Moveset == A Hobo's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] '''(Way of Navae)''' and the [[Flamecharm]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Fire Eruption'''
(★★☆) |An eruption of flame under the user hitting anyone nearby. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Flame Assault'''
(★★☆) |User dashes forward covered in flames; hitting anyone in their path. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement }} |- |
'''Flame Repulsion'''
(★☆☆) |After a wind-up of ~2 seconds, user releases a burning AoE blast. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flaming Scourge'''
(★★★) |User gathers flames in their hand and spins it like a whip grabbing enemies around them, before slamming them into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Rising Flame'''
(★★☆) |User spins and releases a fury of flames that sends both the user and opponent vertically into the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Boons === * Third Eye - A Hobo cannot be assassinated under any circumstance. * High Supply - A Hobo has plenty of moves that apply hyperarmor at no cost of [[Ether]], making them a difficult enemy to face. == Finisher == A Hobo executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} == Tips == *The Hobo becomes hostile when you open any of their chests, however they will not aggro until you walk in front of them. *Hobos have a very similar AI to [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Songseeker Flamecharmers]], with a faster attack rate. Flourishing them into walls and spamming M1's is a good way to make it an easier fight. == Dialogue == {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |I am very happy, very rich! Woooo! I love notes! |- | colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Can I have a chest? [Charisma] |- | colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |Player passes Charisma check | colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |Player does not pass Charisma check |- | colspan="6" |Sure, help yourself! | colspan="6" |No! It's mine! Go away! |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} *Opening chest: Hey that's mine! *Killing Hobo: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! == Trivia == *Hobos can spawn in such a way that one of their chests is inside a wall. * The Hobo seems to be someone who escaped from The Depths or from [[Duke Erisia|The Duke]], and has lost their mind since. ** This can be supported by the fact that when gripping them, they laugh like a madman. ** It could be suggested that the Hobo is "wealthy" due to him stealing from The Duke. * All factions appear to have it out for them, as they all try to attack them. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Etrean Luminant]] [[Category:Enemies]]

==Description==
The Hollow Forge is a in appearance a furnace; in the middle its the window with on-going lava and valves on the top. It can be found in [[Miner's Landing]] and [[The Chariot's Spire]]. It was likely created by [[The Ignition Union]], hence why it is only usable by them.

While the Forge can '''only be used by players with the [[Ignition Delver]] Origin''', you can perform a workaround for a few of the conversions. [[Smith's Alloy]]s and [[Armorer's Needle]]s can be banked, meaning you can transfer these Relics to a slot with this Origin to convert them into the opposing type. [[Pluripotent Alloy]]s, on the other hand, are unable to be banked.

==Usage==
The Hollow Forge can be used to convert [[Pluripotent Alloy]] into [[Smith's Alloy]] and [[Armorer's Needle]] as well as converting Smith's Alloys into Armorer's Needles and vice versa.

The Hollow Forge has the following recipes

* 3 Pluripotent Alloy -> 1 Smith's Alloy
* 9 Pluripotent Alloy -> 1 Armorer's Needle
* 3 Smith's Alloy -> 1 Armorer's Needle
* 1 Armorer's Needle -> 3 Smith's Alloy

title: How to Make Friends
content: How to Make Friends is Training Gear used to increase your '''charisma'''. It can be found in bookstores, and costs {{c|notes|25}}. In order to train your Charisma, you must recite the provided phrase that appears at the top of your screen. At around 10-20 points of Charisma, you may start getting Charisma Talents. Starting at 20 Charisma, you can get Vow of Mastery. At 15 Charisma and beyond, you can get Charisma mantras, such as Sing or Taunt. ==Usage== In order to successfully use How to Make Friends and level up your Charisma, select the item in your inventory and click. Both a line of text and a textbox will appear on your screen with the line of text saying: "Try some small talk with someone nearby, [Phrase]. Type out the '''Phrase''' provided, word for word. [[File:Charisma training word pop.gif|thumb|402x402px]] An alternative will be clicking on the words that pop up, doing this will fill up the textbox with the necessary dialogue given. You do ''not'' need to capitalize letters or use punctuation (Including spaces!), ''however'' if you misspell a word (Example: "Restuarant"), you will '''not''' gain your Charisma. You won't obtain charisma either if you are alone by yourself, however if there are npcs or players near you, you'll receive exp. ==Phrases== *'''Me-wow,''' is that the latest Felinor fashion? *'''So,''' '''what's''' keeping you busy these days? *'''Hey hivekin,''' can I bug you for a moment? *'''So,''' how's work? *'''Wow,''' this breeze is great, right? *'''Sometimes''' I have really deep thoughts about life and stuff. *'''Some''' weather we're having, huh? *'''You ever''' been to a Canor restaurant? The food's pretty howlright. When the lines are said close to an NPC or a player, the receiving player / NPC will say one of these lines depending on the charisma of the player who spoke the line. ==Responses== These numbers are determined without your Aspect stat in mind, and due to this, races such as [[Celtor]] would need 36 Charisma instead of 33 to get new lines and have a max of 103 instead of 100. === Charisma 1-32 (Not including Aspect stats.) === *I don't have time for this... * Ahah... *Huh?... * Er... *What?... * Please leave me alone... ===Charisma 33-65 (Not including Aspect stats.)=== *Uh huh. *Oh, sure. *Mhm. *Yeah. ===Charisma 66-100 (Not including Aspect stats.)=== *Oh! I see! *Wow! *Of course! *No way! *Alright! *Hah! ==Notes/Trivia== *You can't train charisma when not near an NPC or player. *It is not usually recommended to type out the phrases yourself, you may simply open up Notepad and put the phrases in, then CTRL + C CTRL + V them when needed. **A few helpful tools to use are https://charisma-trainer.vercel.app or https://ergonomic-charisma-trainer.vercel.app (if you want to rebind your phrase keybinds) as they are faster than copying phrases from a notepad. *Many of the phrases in How to Make Friends are really corny and often reference an aspect. **For example, Hivekin refers to the [[Vesperian]], [[Ganymede]] and [[Chrysid]] aspects (as they live in the hive) *'''Charisma''' does not train faster when reciting phrases next to an NPC. This has been tested on [https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&rct=j&q=&esrc=s&source=web&cd=&cad=rja&uact=8&ved=2ahUKEwjk9qCY2Mz5AhWqFjQIHZ4pDBQQtwJ6BAgOEAI&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DWbl-w6EovHY&usg=AOvVaw1R6klHjwBpxc3bj52TuDyr this video] (made by Birbingish) *Spitting on NPCS/Players while having high charisma will make them thank you instead of aggro on you, there are also green particles that are the same as the grand feast particles, so it may buff/heal the people spat on (Needs testing). *Farming '''Charisma''' is a lot faster than levelling up with the [[Isle of Vigils|Instructor]] or at [[Lower Erisia]]. *Unlike '''many other stats''', '''Charisma''' can be trained to max very fast, due to the method of farming Charisma which is significantly easier than chopping down trees or solving math problems, for example. *There were some phrases that got people's accounts deleted from ROBLOX, because the moderation thought they were ''Online Dating'' or attempting to get ''Personal Information''. As of 12/27/2021, some of the lines in the "How to Make Friends" book are removed. Some removed phrases will be listed '''below''' Notes/Trivia. *The [[Gremor]] aspect was once mentioned in a phrase of How to Make Friends, but it is now removed. *The book is a loose reference to ''How to Win Friends and Influence People'' (1936), a self-help book by Dale Carnegie. *Having an [[Aspects|Aspect]] That gives more charisma will affect how the npcs respond with you even when you have [[Echoes|'''Multifaceted''']]. ==Removed Phrases== *You doing anything next week? Because I'd like to see you Gremore. (Roblox did not approve.) * So, you doing anything on the weekend? [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Training Gear]]

The {{PAGENAME}} is a utility item which can be purchased on the first floor of the castle on [[Summer Isle]] or in [[Chili|Merchant Ships]]. This item is temporary when used and will disappear once you logout if you choose to put it on.

==Trivia ==
*This item was first introduced with the release of the game, but it's temporary nature and thus lack of any resource effective application have rendered it largely forgotten. It has since been made completely redundant given the release of [[Ignition Deepdelver]], which can provide the same service permanently.
*This item can improve your chances of surviving monsters that use unparryable attacks, so if you don’t have the [[Ignition Deepdelver|Ignition Deepdelver Outfit]]. It allows you to avoid damage from these attacks without needing to rely on your roll.

title: Hybrid Abilities
content:
'''''FOREWORD''': '''A table visualizing the requirements of every hybrid ability can be found [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10XWlQrWREAcNno86_VbON9Y71Qs1SbbaNABcRdYBf30/edit?gid=1468165034#gid=1468165034 [here]]'''''[[File:Hybrid Icon Temp.png|thumb]] ==Overview== '''Hybrid Abilities''' are a special category of [[Mantras]] and [[Talents]] that require investment in multiple [[Attunement]]s to use. Hybrid Mantras typically use elemental effects and Talents from both attunements and can even inherit path abilities such as Surge Path or Wraith Path. These mantras can be upgraded at either one of their respective [[Spelltrainers|attunement trainers]]. For example, you can have level 5 Permafrost Prison with 80 Shadowcast OR 80 Frostdraw. ==Mantras== {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Iron Tether (★★☆) |image=IronTether.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Summon two cubes tethered by lightning, setting a trap for your enemies. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ltn|Lightning}} + {{stats|mtl|Metal}} |reqs=30 Ironsing, 30 Thundercall |effect=''User creates a tripwire using their Thundercall and Ironsing.'' *Has a base damage of 6.08/6.65/7.22/7.79/8.36 per level, per hit (2) with 2.75 Thundercall and Ironsing scaling. *The damage will ramp up the longer the Tether has been on the field, having a maximum base damage of 16/17.5/19/20.5/22 per level, per hit (2) with 2.75 Thundercall and Ironsing scaling. *After being on the field for a certain duration (presumably at max damage), iron tether will become unblockable. *Can apply Electrified. *Compatible with Surge Path and Gilded Path. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Eternal and Aeon Logstones]] to increase its duration slightly. *Can be upgraded with a [[Multiplying Spark]] to summon 3, but dividing the damage dealt per Tether into thirds. *Can be upgraded with a [[Magnet Spark]] allowing it to move. This has no cooldown, but will stop working if any Wisp is not present. {{!}}- {{!}}} ==Equipment== Rarely, equipment will require the usage of two or more attunements to be used. Currently, there is only one equipment set that requires this. ===Specialist Set=== The [[Specialist Helmet|Specialist Set]] is a Thundercall Galebreathe hybrid equipment set, increasing the user's mobility and damage output through Stormcall Strikes. Upon equipping all items within this set, you will gain the Set Talent, ''Shock Trooper Specialist''.

====[[Specialist Helmet]]==== A black and gold plated helmet with the ''Volt Draft'' Talent. Volt Draft strengthens your Inhale, allowing you to proc Storm Strikes with your basic attacks. Storm Strikes from this Talent scale their damage off your Galebreathe and Thundercall investment. This has a 20 second cooldown. ====[[Specialist Plate]]==== A black and gold plated chest plate with the ''Stormcall'' Talent. Stormcall applies the [[Status Effects#Stormcall Shock|Stormcall Shock]] status effect whenever a Storm Strike procs from one of your other Specialist Talents. Stormcall Shock deals damage to and applies Shock and Winded to anyone who attempts to cast a Mantra while affected by it. ====[[Specialist Boots]]==== A pair of black plated boots with gold highlights with the ''Flashwind'' Talent. Flashwind allows you to re-empower your dashes after using a gale or thunder dash. ====Set Bonus: [Shock Trooper Specialist]==== When wearing all equipment in the set, you gain the Shock Trooper Specialist Talent. Upon meeting a 100 accumulative damage threshold with Galebreathe and Thundercall Mantras, strike your opponents with a Stormcall Strike, dealing 40 damage with no scaling. This has no cooldown. [[Grand Javelin]], [[Electro Carve]], and [[Thunder Kick]] turn green, gaining a 15% increase to their base damage. [[Astral Wind]], [[Gale Lunge]], and [[Champion's Whirlthrow]] turn yellow, gaining a 15% increase to their base damage. File:Shock Trooper Set 21st Legion.png|
Full Set File:Green lightning .png|
Shock Trooper Specialist in action
==Trivia== *Tempest Blitz was the first Hybrid Mantra introduced into the game on 12/19/2023. *The Specialist Set were the first equipment items to require hybrid attunements to be used. *Upon its release, Permafrost Prison was incredibly powerful and had to be quickly nerfed, causing it to be one of the quickest and harshest nerfs towards any Mantra in Deepwoken history. *[[Thundercall]] has the most Hybrid Mantras, with 3 out of the 4 scaling off of it *The [[Ironsing]] Talent, {{cl|advancedtlnf|Alloyblood}} changes the color of your Bloodrend Mantras to a blue-ish grey.
