title: Iblis, The Fallen Angel
content:
{{Quotes|quote=THE PATH YOU CHOOSE TO FOLLOW IS WROUGHT WITH LIES. DECEIT. YOU ARE THE TRUE FOOLS, PLAYING AS GOD.|author=Iblis}} {{EnemyInfobox |image1=New Iblis.png |caption1=The flames of disaster! |health=3500 |drops=N/A |moves=*Fire Blade *Flaming Scourge *Flame Ballista *Sinister Halo *Ascension *Celestial Assault |weapon=[[True Seraph Spear]] |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/NPC|Samael|quote=A vile and wicked wretch by the name of Iblis who turned his back on the faith.}} |location=[[Starfield Grove]]}} ==Description== Iblis, The Fallen Angel, is a powerful [[Starkindred]] apostate located in [[Starfield Grove]] [[Voidzones|Voidzone]]. He must be defeated to obtain [[Starkindred]]. ==Moveset== Iblis' arsenal consists of a [[True Seraph Spear]] along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement and [[Starkindred]] Oath: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |The user performs a quick downslash before lunging forward. Both hits of this critical have innate bleed. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Feint'''
(★★☆) |Performs a fake attack, before pulling back and committing to a thrust. {{AttackTags |unharmful }} |- |
'''Fire Blade
(Starkindred)'''
(★★☆) |While he has his wings out, Iblis will rise in the air before unleashing a big wave of flames in front of him, dealing heavy damage if all hits land. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Flaming Scourge'''
(★★☆) |Iblis gathers flames in his hand and spins it like a whip grabbing anyone around him, before slamming them into the ground and inflicting Burn. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Ballista'''
(★★☆) |Conjures a flaming arrow and fires it at the nearest target, homes in and ricochets if blocked. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Ascension'''
(★★☆) |Rises into the air, before swooping in downwards. This applies hard knockdown on hit. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Sinister Halo'''
(★★☆) |Launches a multi hit halo of divine energy forward, shredding anyone caught in its range. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Celestial Assault'''
(★★☆) |Delivers an upward slash that makes both parties airborne before delivering another sideway slash that sends the target away. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} ==Gallery== IblisNew.png|Old IBLISTHEFALLENANGEL.png|Older ==Trivia== *In Islam, Iblis was a [[WP:Jinn|Djinn]] that ascended to the rank of an angel for his good deeds. Later on, for believing he was superior to Adam and refusing to accept Adam as Allah's new creation due to his arrogance, he was cast out of the heavens and vowed to bring all of mankind to hell. He is called Shayṭān in Islam (not to be confused with other Shayṭān and shayāṭīn, which are general demons and evil spirits) and can be considered a counterpart to Satan from Christianity. **Interestingly enough, one of the quotes that Iblis, the Fallen Angel says is "THE PATH YOU CHOOSE TO FOLLOW IS WROUGHT WITH LIES. DECEIT. YOU ARE THE TRUE FOOLS, PLAYING AS GOD." This quote implies that the actions the player trying to get Starkindred is doing (i.e. killing Iblis and doing "unholy" actions such as drinking the blood of Celestials) are too extreme to the point of disgusting Satan. In the Qur'an, the holy book in Islam, Satan himself fears God, and the quote said in-game is extremely similar to Qur'an 8:48. Whether this is just a coincidence or not is up to speculation. *If you aren't confident enough to fight Iblis, You can get other NPC's to fight them and lower Iblis's HP or you can use fall damage to your advantage as Iblis still takes heavy fall damage, for example if you were to knock him off the cliff with a heavy knockback move E.G strong left. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:Individuals with He/him pronouns]] [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies with Oaths]] [[Category:The Starkindred Church]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

==Description==
The Icarus Sun Shield is a [[Weapons|offhand weapon]] in the Shield category. The requirement to wield it is 60 Fortitude.

The shield's silhouette is identical to the [[Legion Shield]], however the Khan symbol in the middle of the shield has been changed to be glowing a yellowish orange color and the symbol itself is changed to be [[General Titus Juventius|Titus]]'s face.

The only obtainment for the Icarus Sun Shield is by defeating [[General Titus Juventius]] by lowering his health below 90%, after that the shield will be given to whoever has contributed to doing damage to Titus.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Champion's Shield}} increases the posture damage you deal by 25%. Additionally, you will gain a further posture damage buff, scaling on the amount of posture your character has.

==Trivia==
*{{W|Icarus}}, the son of {{W|Daedalus}}, is a well-known figure in Greek mythology. He met his end after flying too close to the sun with wings bound by wax, which melted and sent him falling into the sea. However, in the world of ''[[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]]'', the identity of “Icarus” remains unknown.

==Description==
The '''Idol of Yun'shul''' is a ritual idol and [[Relic]] connected to the Drowned God [[Yun'Shul]], that allows its user to redeem one [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|wish]] from anywhere and without the need of a [[Resonance]]. ''(one-time use, re-obtainable)''

Using the Idol of Yun'Shul to escape [[The Depths]] can only be done once per character.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Idol of yun shul.png
File:Idol of Yun'Shul1.png
File:Idol of Yun'Shul2.png
File:IDol of Yun'Shul3.png
File:Idol Dialogue1.png|Overworld Options (Oathless)
File:Idol Dialogue2.png|Depths Options
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*You can hold more than one of this item.
*Upon usage for Resonance rerolling, you'll obtain the Tarnished flaw.
**You cannot use an Idol of Yun'Shul to reroll your Resonance until you untarnish yourself.
*Can't be used in Combat. Dialogue appears saying "The Idol won't respond to a panicked heart."
*Attempting to use it in [[Fragments of Self]] will display a message saying "The Idol cannot respond to a shattered soul"
*Cannot be used to remove your Oath unless you're [[Oathless]].
*Cannot be used to talk to [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|Yun'Shul]] for [[Contractor]] or [[Soulbreaker]].
*It functions without the need of a Resonance, but will not provide you one.
*Cannot be used to escape the depths in [[Layer 2]] or in [[Fragments of Self]].
*This item has an interesting history with [[The Ferryman]], being removed and then readded to his loot pool multiple times.
*The concept of the item was suggested by YouTuber Agamatsu, who conceptually named it "Yun'Shul's number".<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aYmOWi8fUZY</ref>

''*The man gives you a brief acknowledging nod, barely moving his eyes away from the paper he's holding.*'' Just a moment pal... Azimuth of 142 degrees, altitude of 15, distance of... Mhm... Yep, maths checks out... There, there, and ''there''. Brilliant. ''*He turns to you again.*'' Friend of the Company, huh? Nice of you to visit. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you doing here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He blinks idly.*'' ...Someone hasn't read their copy of the latest Summer Company Quarterly Review, huh? Fine, I'll clue you in. We're surveying the mines here at Songseeker Wilds. ''*He gestures at the contraption besides him.*'' Using the theodolite here, I'm measuring angles and distances, writing them all down. Drafting a map. Getting the lay of the land down, so to say. Oh, uh... Don't touch the equipment, by the by. I've callibrated it just where I need it to be. Very precise instruments, you see. ''*He gently taps on of the levels on the mechanism with his finger.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Surveying this old place? It looks abandoned. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Abandoned? Heh. Maybe on the surface, sure. Some of our colleagues were doing a bit of... Let's say, ''snooping...'' On the Ignition Union's activities recently. We've managed to nab some of their plans. Turns out, their higher-ups are looking into a network of caverns underneath {{g|Lumen}}. Their reports suggest it's full of precious minerals, as well as other things. And ''this'' place was one of the potential surface entry points they've marked down on their maps. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So that rickety old mine potentially leads down to... What, caves deep underground? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He nods.*'' The ''{{g|Boundary}},'' my friend. The space between the surface and the under-realm. Most likely rich with minerals, possibly rich with relics, and '''definitely''' rich with danger. The Company doesn't exactly aspire to contest the Union across the ''entirety'' of the {{g|Boundary}}, mind you. But this entry point was uncomfortably close to Summer isle. We figured we'd stake a claim to it before the Union did, lest they manage to establish a beach head this close to home. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Continue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Besides all that, they say this place was once a nitre mine. Most people think the resources here have been wholly depleted - but if there's a connection a cavern network underneath, then maybe that ain't the case at all. {{g|Pathfinder}} miners still linger around this place, trying to excavate whatever remains... ''*He glances over towards the miner hunched over by the entryway.*'' But, of course, the things that ultimately stopped the ''previous'' operations in these mines persist. Won't be a problem for us, though. ''*He smirks.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Ignition Delver= This dialogue is unlocked if the player is an [[Ignition Delver]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The dragoon shoots you a scornful gaze. He gives his colleagues a meaningful look, as their hands shift towards their pistols.*'' Come to get your trade secrets back? '''Too bad.''' The Company's staking a claim to this territory, and all the resources herein... And don't even bother trying to persuade us otherwise. If you want us ousted from here, you're more than welcome to try. But I doubt you chumps have the wherewithal for that, eh? ''*He chuckles, and his companions laugh.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== Ignacio Alt.png|Ignacio beside his theodolite ==Trivia== Ignacio's hair id is 84136627828367 {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]]

title: Ignition Deepcrusher
content:
{{Weapon Infobox |damage type=Slash |range type=Sweep |attack duration=0.6s |image= Ignition Deepcrusher 2H.png|Two-Handed Stance Ignition Deepcrusher 1H.png|One-Handed Stance Ignition Deepcrusher 2H Gilded.png|Two-Handed (Scrapsinger) Ignition Deepcrusher 1H Gilded.png|One-Handed (Scrapsinger) |type=Club/Sword |requirements=40 MED, 75 MTL |damage=18 + {{cl|bleed|'''2.7 BLD'''}} (1H)
20 (2H) |scaling=MED: 3, MTL: 4 |posture damage=8 (Club) / 4 (Sword) |range=8 |enchantable=No |swing speed=1x (Club) / 1.05x (Sword) |penetration=10% (Club) / 20% (Sword) |obtainment=*{{lp|First Layer}} *{{lp|Second Layer}} *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Weird Trader]] |rarity=Mythical |special effect=Can switch between 2 weapon types on stance swap *2 handed: on hit, apply a metal rod and deal blunt damage. *1 handed: gain Bleed damage and deal slash damage. |selling price=100 |m.equip=No |description=... |oath=Silentheart }} ==Description== The '''Ignition Deepcrusher''' is a Legendary Club and Sword; an invention of ferrofluid that can become either a mace for clubbing, or a sword for cutting. The mace is held by a bordered hilt in both hands, under a chess piece cross that makes the club, its gambit being to inhibit with Ironsing rods. The sword has a sleek but effective design, optimal for cutting power and bleed application. This weapon has 1 passive by default: '''Ferrofluid Structure''' - Changing the stance of this weapon completely changes the playstyle: *While used with 2 hands, this weapon is a club dealing blunt damage and applying a [[Status Effects#Metal Rods|Metal Rod]] on each M1. It also gains higher weight compared to the sword variant. *While used with 1 hand, this weapon is a sword, dealing slash damage. Additionally, it gains innate {{cl|bleed}} damage, increasing its unmodified damage by 15%. It also gains a slight swing speed and PEN increase compared to the club variant. The weapon also changes colors when the player owns the {{t|Gilded Path: Scrapsinger}} Talent, turning golden yellow. This effect applies to criticals as well. ==Critical== File:Deepcrush default.gif The user plunges the Deepcrusher into the ground, causing an eruption of metal spikes surrounding the player in a hexagonal formation. Both the plunge and spike eruption deal damage and apply hitstun. If the plunge is parried, the spike eruption will be cancelled, however it will not be cancelled if blocked or dodged, as well as being hit after the plunge is complete. The first hit has a base damage of 20 with 5 Ironsing scaling, dealing pure Ironsing damage. Additionally, it has a windup of 0.55s. The second hit has a base damage of 25 with 5 Ironsing scaling, dealing pure Slash damage. Additionally it has a windup of 0.4s. Both hits have innate {{cl|bleed}} regardless of your weapon stance. The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. ==Gallery== File:DeepcrusherCA1.jpg|Initial concept art File:DeepcrusherCA2.jpg|Finallized concept art File:DeepcrusherStances.gif|Switching stances File:Gildedcrit.gif|Gilded Path: Scrapsinger Critical ==Trivia== *The Ignition Deepcrusher is the first weapon to be part of two weapon categories as its stances are both Club and Blade, which you can switch between by pressing Y. This is similar to the unique stance effect used by the [[Curved Blade of Winds]], however it instead changes the weapon type from Club to Sword and vice versa. *Currently the only legendary weapon with no description. *The weapon is inspired by the [https://bloodborne.fandom.com/wiki/Kirkhammer Kirkhammer] from ''{{W|Bloodborne}}''.[[File:Kirkhammer.png]] *Based on the [[DeepcrusherSword|similar leftover weapon]] which required 55 HVY to wield and was in the game for a short period of time, this could have been heavy weapon at some point during development. *You cannot use the stance swap feature while in the Battle Royale mode unless you have the Ironsinger Talent, which can be achieved by getting an Ironsing Mantra. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Clubs]] [[Category:Swords]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Medium Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons of The Ignition Union]]

Additionally, it provides the {{t|Force Your Way}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|phys|30% Physical}}, {{stats|mtl|44.75% Ironsing}}, {{stats|ice|44.7% Frostdraw}}, and {{stats|elm|35% Elemental|ice=n|mtl=n}}. The {{t|Force Your Way}} Talent grants the player the ability to parry unparryable attacks from large monsters at the cost of some armor durability. The armor durability lost is based on the damage the attack would've done. Note that normally unparryable attacks have a much stricter parry timing than regular attacks, which will take some getting used to. This effect is also given by the arms equipment [[Ignition Gauntlets]]. The [[Grand Fisher Plate]] and [[Hunter's Brace]] have similar effects. Visually, an unparryable attack that is parried will cause steam and heat to release from the user. File:Force Your Way.gif|Force Your Way's parry visuals ==Trivia== *Combining this outfit with the Metal [[Enchantments|enchant]] (steal/replenish armor durability on hit) allows you to essentially negate the durability cost of the Talent. **Having multiple means of increasing armor replenishment or durability like Bloodiron Spirit, Armor Conserver, the [[Steadfast]] Boon, [[Armorer's Ring]], etc. can keep armor up in The Diluvian Mechanism or other mob-heavy areas. *There are some attacks that cannot be parried even with Deepdelver on. These include (not exhaustive): **'''Pillars of Erisia''' ([[Duke Erisia]]) **'''Cero''' ([[Lionfish]]/[[Glacial Lionfish]]/[[Prime Megalodaunt]]/[[Exotic Megalodaunt]]) **'''Golem Lasers''' ([[Rock Golem]]/[[Golem Prime]]) **All of [[Chaser, Scholar of the Burning Blood|Chaser's]] non-parryable attacks **[[Maestro Evengarde Rest|Maestro's]] '''Tempest Eye''' {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:The Ignition Union]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Ignition Deepdrill
content:
{{ToolInfobox|image1=DeepdrillerMechanism.png|usage=}}

== Description ==
The '''Ignition Deepdrill''' is a transport vehicle created by the [[The Ignition Union|Ignition Union]] for excavation purposes. 

== Usage ==
Depending on the location, the Deepdrill has two uses:

=== Saramaed Hollow ===
The Deepdrill can be used for expeditions in the Hollow. While descending, all of the stored fuel in the Deepdrill is consumed and will require the player to fetch more.

A radio located inside the drill allows the player to be sent back to the starting point.

=== The Depths ===
In the [[First Layer]], the Deepdriller can only be used by [[Ignition Delver|Ignition Delvers]] at [[The Chariot's Spire]] to start expeditions in the [[Second Layer]], given that the player has already escaped via the Deepdrill at least once. Entering the Second Layer through the Deepdrill spawns the player at [[The Frontier Furnace]] with the generator already activated.

A Deepdriller can be called down by [[Llevyn]] at The Frontier Furnace, appearing at the [[Nest Corridor]] for an alternative escape method. This will require the generator to be turned on.

title: Ignition Delver
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=Just another day on the job. The riches below ain't gonna extract themselves now, are they?|author=Origin description}}
[[File:Ignition Delver.png|center]] __TOC__ ::''Ignition Delver'' is a PvE-focused [[Origin]], highly favoring, but not mandating, completing [[Job Boards|Jobs]] and [[Dungeons]] for experience gain. ==Description== Ignition Delvers are those who work under the Ignition Union, doing odd jobs for their union's gains. Ignition Delvers are associated with [[The Ignition Union]]. ==Obtainment== To obtain the Ignition Delver Origin, the player must do one of the following: *Save [[Epsi]] in [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Floor 1]] of the [[Second Layer]] of [[the Depths]] and report to [[Alpha]] afterwards. OR *Complete the [[Orion|Summer Goons]] quest and return to Orion. ==Spawn== Delvers spawn with the [[Union Initiate]] Outfit equipped, {{c|notes|25}}, and the Union Card, Union Pager, and Union Hook Talents. You can choose to spawn at either [[Miner's Landing]] or the [[Chariot's Spire]] by clicking their respective icons in Character Creation. ==Effects== All necessities at the [[Chariot's Spire]] will be accessible to you such as the [[Item Bank|banker]], stove, and [[antiquarian]]. Additionally, you can use the [[Hollow Forge]] at the Chariot's Spire or Miner's Landing to melt down [[Pluripotent Alloy]]s into [[Smith's Alloy]]s or [[Armorer's Needle]]s or turn Smith's Alloys into Armorer's Needles and vice versa. If you escape the [[Second Layer]] through the Deep Drill, you will be able to use the Deep Drill at [[Chariot's Spire]] to re-enter the Second Layer. This will spawn you at [[The Frontier Furnace]] with the power already turned on, skipping the [[Bone Keeper]] fight. You will not have a [[Light Hook]] if you do this. ===Union Card=== *''In-game description'': A card representing your membership in the Ignition Union. Entitles you to speedier experience gain from Dungeons and Jobs, though the fees will slightly reduce your experience gain outside of these. *This [[Talents|talent]] increases your EXP gain from completing [[Job Boards|Jobs]] and [[Dungeons]], however decreases your EXP gain from everything else. ===Union Pager=== *''In-game description'': Check up on job listings remotely. *A portable job board that allows you to check on and take jobs anywhere on the map. Proves useful in [[Celtor Wastes]], since there are only two job boards placed on both entrances to [[The City of the Drowned]]. File:Union Pager.png|Union Pager render File:Union Pager Jobs.png|Current Union Pager job menu File:Union Pager Jobs Old.png|Old Union Pager job menu ===Union Hook=== *''In-game description'': You can now make use of the Ignition Union hooks to ascend or descend. *Character gains the ability to use the [[Union Hooks]] to ascend or descend. *This Talent is must-have if you're planning to do Layer Two. *While this Talent is not exclusive to this Origin, it is granted for free for Delvers. *For more info - visit the [[Union Hooks]] page. ==Pros and Cons== ===Pros=== *Increased EXP gain from completing [[Job Boards|Jobs]] and while in [[Dungeons]]. *Union Pager allows you to take jobs remotely, saving you a significant amount of time. *Jobs are one of the most popular progression methods and this Origin is tailored to them. *You start with the {{t|Union Hook}} Talent, providing greater navigation options in the Overworld and Second Layer. *[[Union Initiate]] is the only outfit in the game that grants [[Carry Load]], making this Origin a must have for bank slots. *Allows you to use all necessities at the [[Chariot's Spire]] such as the Banker, stove, and Antiquarian. Additionally, being at the Chariot's Spire will passively regenerate your Sanity. **However, you still won't be able to enter the Chariot's Spire through the main entrance way if you've drowned, unlike [[Deepbound]]. *The [[Hollow Forge]] is an exceptionally useful item for transfusing lesser used Relics into ones that are more desirable. *If you've already escaped the [[Second Layer]] via the Deep Drill at least once on your character, you will be able to use the Deep Drill at the [[Chariot's Spire]] to reenter the Second Layer. This will spawn you in the [[Frontier Furnace]] with the Generator already turned on, skipping a decent chunk of the dungeon. **You can bring up to 4 other players with you. **However, you, and all other players you bring along, will not have a [[Light Hook]]. ===Cons=== *Reduced EXP gain from non-Job or Dungeon sources. **Because there are very few dungeons that are balanced towards mid-game progression, you may have to resort to unconventional/debuffed sources of experience gain if you do not wish to do Jobs. ==Reputation== Your starting reputation is: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, and [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}. *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}, [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}}, [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} and [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other [[factions]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}} {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} ''Note: your chosen [[Aspects|aspect]] may affect your starting reputation.'' ==Gallery== IUTeaser.png|[https://x.com/Deepwoken/status/1832243726103503042 Saramaed Hollow teaser released with Ignition Delver Origin] {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:Origins]] [[Category:The Ignition Union]] [[Category:Character]]

title: Ignition Lanterns
content: {{Quotes|quote=Think of it as... hm, blasting the eggs with an absurd level of heat enough to shock it, forcing it to let go of your body.|author=Sunway}} {{ToolInfobox|image1=File:Ignition_Lantern.png|usage=Clear your parasites}} ==Description== The '''Ignition Lanterns''', or "Burners" are lanterns commonly found around the [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|Second Layer]]. They remove accumulated parasites that the player has incurred when interacted with. Upon first interaction, the player learns of the recipe to make the [[Wormwarder Lantern]]. Not to be confused with the [[Wormwarder Lantern]]. These Lanterns are developed by [[The Ignition Union]] as a way to survive in the Second Layer. They are seen scattered around the area, with one of them in the [[The Frontier Furnace]]. As mentioned by [[Sunway]], these lanterns work by blasting the parasites with enough heat to shock them, forcing them to let go. All the while only dealing a minor sting to the user. There is a different version of this lantern with white and blue coloring that is only present in the [[Galewax]] area, where you would get [[Enchant Stone]]s. ==Locations== They are scattered around the first floor of the Second Layer, with most of them being around places where you'd want to go to. # The first location is in the [[Pilgrim's Respite]], more commonly referred to as the Radio Tower. There are a total of 9 Lanterns in this location. # The second location is in [[The Frontier Furnace]], right next to [[Sunway]]. It sits in the center of the room, obvious to anyone who enters. # The third location is in the [[Firfire Caverns]], near the [[Firfire|Kyrsan Camp]]. At the door that you need to press a blue button to open, you can find the Lantern on its left side when you exit. # The fourth location is in [[The Maw of Ethiron]], in the first left tower. Hanging next to the front door. The blue lanterns are found within the Galewax Secret, and having three in the area. ==Gallery== File:Pilgrims Lantern.png|Pilgrim's Respite's Lantern File:Furnace Lantern.png|The Frontier Furnace's Lantern, next to Sunway File:Caverns Lantern.png|Lantern in the Firfire Caverns (Door closed) File:IgnitionLanterns4.png|Lantern in The Maw of Ethiron File:BlueIgnitionLanterns.png|Lantern in the Galewax Secret. ==Trivia== *Despite being commonly referred to as "'''Lanterns'''", ingame they are called different names. **[[Sunway]] calls them "'''Lamps'''" **The Player calls them "'''Burners'''" when applying heat to [[Epsi]]. *After 10 uses of the same lantern, it will go out and can no longer be used. ==Description==
Imel was an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]] who was a member of [[The Ministry]].

They used to give you a mission requiring the player to kill another player in the [[Erisia]]. Returning to Emel with the mission completed granted positive [[Reputation]] with the Ministry and a payment for your deeds.

==Location==
Imel was located in [[The Etrean Sea]] on a small island with four king statues, they were leaning against a wall facing the gate to [[Erisia]].

title: Immortal Guardian
content:
{{Quotes|quote=INFERIOR.|author=Immortal Guardian}} {{EnemyInfobox|image1= Immortal Guardian (Axe).png|Axe Immortal Guardian (Sword).png|Greatsword Nightmare Immortal Guardian (Axe).png|Nightmare (Axe) Nightmare Immortal Guardian (Sword).png|Nightmare (Greatsword) |health=1200 2000 (Nightmare) |drops= *[[Immortal Helm]] *[[Mantra Modifiers]] *[[Umbral Obsidian]] *[[Umbrite]] |weapon= *[[Soulwrought Axe]] *[[Soulwrought Greatsword]] |moves= *Assault *Critical}} ==Description== Immortal Guardians are humanoid mobs that can be found in [[Crypt of the Unbroken]]. They spawn in groups in the halls. They are people enhanced through experiments by [[The Ministry]], their helmets binding to their mind and controlling them. Immortal Guardians seem to wear what resembles some sort of futuristic armor, similar to the original [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder Armor]], with a unique symbol located in their chest, concealing their [[Aspects|aspect]] and gender. Under unknown conditions, the glowing white parts on their armor will glow red instead, turning them into the more powerful Nightmare variant. ===Nightmare=== Nightmare Immortal Guardians spawn in groups in the upper floor's halls or sometimes in the lower floors, replacing the normal Immortal Guardians. Compared to the normal variant, their healthpool is raised considerably, and they have an increased tendency to parry attacks and wield [[Enchantments|Enchanted]] weapons. ==Moves== An Immortal Guardian's arsenal consists of a [[Soulwrought Greatsword]] or a [[Soulwrought Axe]]. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !GIF |- |
'''Assault'''
(★★☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:ImmortalGuardianAssault.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |[[File:ImmortalGuardianCritical.gif|center|thumb]] |} ==Boons== *Experienced Fighter - Can parry common attacks and mantras. *The Great Wall - Has an immense posture pool compared to other humanoid mobs. ==Finisher== An Immortal Guardian executes the player after knocking them. {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Splits the enemy's head in two with their Soulwrought Weapon. |} ==Tips== *Immortal Guardians are rather tanky, especially Nightmare ones, and have one of the highest posture pools in the game, surpassing some bosses in terms of posture. It's easy to get overwhelmed by them, considering they spawn in groups, so be careful and make sure to isolate each one. * Best way to kill them is either Parry-Trading or using weapons with high chip damage, as they do have a habit of blocking attacks rather than parrying due to their high posture pool *Nightmares can take way more posture than their little brothers, so some mantras that Guard break them will most-likely just be blocked normally by them. *Nightmares will always spawn with a random [[Enchantments|Enchant]] on their weapons, so pay close attention to the visual effect that their weapon will have to see what you're fighting against, as some of these enchants, will punish you far harder than you'd expect from an NPC. *Nightmares have a chance to replace the regular guardians on the first floor, so tread with caution when the guardians on the first floor respawn. *Once you knock them it's advisable to carry them to the exit as gripping them inside the voidzone would alert nearby NPCS. Worst case scenario you're gonna alert all of them including the Alpha Megalodaunt and the nightmare guardians in the second floor. *Sometimes their anti gank breaks and they start fighting you no matter what instead of stepping away if you are already being attacked which makes them VERY dangerous in groups. ==Gallery== File:TheyTalk.png|Talking after downing a player with Mute File:RobloxScreenShot20230508 002457406.png|Nightmare Immortal Guardian saying "Thanks." after being spit on ==Trivia== *Removing their armor reveals them to be [[Etrean]]s sporting the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]]. This was likely done simply because they look visually appealing when combined with the armor, rather than as anything lore significant. **The regular Guardians are the File Etrean variant while the Nightmare Guardians are File Etreans with a slightly darker skin tone, reinforcing that there is no real significance to them being Etrean. *Their helmet is a reference to that of [[w:c:madeinabyss:Bondrewd|Bondrewd’s]] from the anime and manga franchise, ''Made in Abyss''. *They speak in all capital letters, much like the [[Golem Constructs]]. **The only exception to this are pieces of stock dialogue used by other generic NPCs. *According to TheRealPunchee, the armor that Immortal Guardians wear was actually the original design of the Arc Suit for the [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]] [[Oaths|Oath]], created before the sketches for the current Arc Suit were even a thing. **The "Crypt Arcwarder" as it's called in the video was ultimately scrapped due to not fitting the current artstyle of Deepwoken. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]]

==Description==
The '''Imperator's Edge''' is a Legendary Spear. Used by the frontlines of the Hundred Legions, it is a gargantuan, ornate spear with a glowing tip infused with the very essence of light itself. 

The Imperator's Edge comes with a passive ability: 

* '''Enlightened Brilliance''' - Landing three hits on a target with '''only''' the tip of the spear enters the user in the Enlightened state, signified by a glowing halo on their head. During this state, the user's criticals will be amplified. Enlightened has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.
==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Basic Imp crit.gif|Standing Critical
File:Enlightened Crit Spear.gif|Enlightened Standing Critical                                                                              
File:Medal pBn6z5knD6.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>
For the standing critical, the user performs three quick thrusts with the spear, dazing the target whilst sending them forwards. If the user is in the Enlightened state, this critical is followed up by another three thrusts, consuming the effect. The standing critical has a scaled damage multiplier of 0.6x on the first two hits and 0.45x on the third, totaling to 1.65x scaled damage. All hits have innate {{cl|bleed}}. Deals 26.97 posture damage if all hits are blocked.

For the running critical, the user lunges with the spear, firing a projectile of light that dazes the target. This critical is not affected by Enlightened. The running critical has a scaled damage multiplier of 1x on the thrust and 0.6x on the projectile, totaling to 1.6x scaled damage. Both hits have innate {{cl|bleed}} and deal 17 posture damage if blocked.

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''6 seconds.'''

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Imperator's Edge transparent.png
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Imperator's Edge has the highest stat requirement in the game, with 240 total points.
*Used to have the highest ranged weapon (If you dont include gun's) Though on March 16th 2025, the [[Guiding Star]] took the throne by one point.
*This weapon might be inspired by God of War: Ragnarök's free DLC, Valhalla. The appearance of the spear resembles Tyr's spear and somewhat the level 3 of the Draupnir Spear. However, the standing critical of the Imperator's Edge seems to be based on a Light Runic Attack belonging to Draupnir; "Thrust of a Thousand Soldiers," although with much less stabs. On the other hand, the running critical does not seem to be based on any attack, Runic, or even any attack performed by Tyr.

The Imperator's Fury is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Torso" category. It is a stake planted into the core of the wielder, amplifying their physical abilities.   <gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Brute Strength.gif|Brute Strength
</gallery>The {{t|Brute Strength}} talent replaces the player's Vent with a slam attack that deals 35 blunt damage and knocks enemies back. This attack deals 20 Posture damage and has double the windup of a regular Vent (0.25s -> 0.5s).

This Vent can proc all "on Vent" effects in the game, including [[Solar]].

== Gallery ==

==Trivia==
*This has 6.48x PvE scaling (226.8 PvE damage without {{status|b=y|Perfection}} stacks). While this is low compared to most other things, this does still massively increase the damage output of your Vent.
*The damage Brute Strength deals cannot be increased with damage modifiers.
**{{t|Cold Front}} and [[Dark Pearls]] still apply however.
*Affected by general PEN, such as [[Strength]] investment, [[Prophet's Cloak]], or having an [[Oath]].
*This item's previously used the Warmaster's Medallion model before receiving its own unique model.
*This ability is used by [[Titus]].
*Arguably one of, if not the most valuable obtainable item in the game. It's also one of the rarest and therefore most sought after items.
*Despite being a "Common" rarity item, it is estimated to have about a 0.1% droprate and still costs Knowledge to unbank.
*Due to a bug or oversight, Imperator's Fury was obtainable from [[Lysander Spellhardt]]'s 100 Joy for 1 [[Relic]] trade for a short period of time during 2025's [[Hallowtide]] event.

== Description ==
The Imperial Staff is a Legendary [[Staff]] [[weapon]] that scales with and requires [[Strength]] in addition to Medium. It is a long bo staff that is capable of changing its length which it employs for a variety of unique attacks.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Both Ends}} allows you to followup an M1 with a swing from the opposite end of the staff by pressing {{input|keybind|feint}}. This attack comes out much faster, but only does 45% of your weapon damage. This has the [[M1 tag]], allowing it to proc M1-exclusive [[Talents]] and [[Enchantment]] effects.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Imp staff stand crit.gif|Standing
Imperial Staff Jump crit.gif|Aerial
Imperial Staff Run Crit.gif|Running
</gallery>
The standing critical is a long-ranged attack where the user swings their staff forward and extends it in both directions, allowing the user to hit opponents both in front of and behind them. Ragdolls opponents on hit, and deals roughly '''1.4-1.45x scaled damage'''.

The aerial critical is a slam with a '''windup of 0.55s''', where the staff grows in size and slams back down onto the ground dealing high posture. This Critical counts as an uppercut procing talents such as soaring storm.

The running critical is a multi-hit where the user spins the staff in their hands dealing '''18 hits''' in quick succession, each hit dealing roughly '''0.3x scaled damage'''. The crit grants a speed boost to the user for the duration of it, and getting parried at any point during the critical will end it. Can be cancelled manually by right-clicking during the attack.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Imperial Staff Held.png|Held
Imperial Staff Wide.png|Wide view
Imperial Staff Full.png|Full view
</gallery>
===Old Animations===
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Imperial Staff Stance.gif|Idle
Imperial Staff M1s.gif|M1 Cycle
Imperial Staff Blocking.gif|Blocking
</gallery>


==Trivia==
*The Imperial Staff is inspired by Sun Wukong's "金箍棒" (Jīn gū bàng; lit. gold cudgel), including the little effects around the head the staff gives you imitating the controlling crown Sun Wukong wore. The Jīn gū bàng is Wukong's signature weapon, a pillar once owned by the Dragon King of the East Sea, portrayed as a gold and red staff in most media like movies and games.
*This weapon had its weapon class changed from Spear to Staff on the May 2nd, 2026 update.
*The placeholder critical for this weapon was the [[Unsung Scythern]]'s when used in old servers during its release.
*The Aerial crit can proc {{t|Meteor Impact}}.

Emphasises the sweeping motions of wind.'' |-|Talent=''Wield an advanced form of the Legion's martial arts.'' |image=Imperium Kata.png |scaling=LHT: 7 |m.equip=No |rarity=N/A }} ==Description== Imperium Kata is an advanced form of the [[Legion Kata|Legion's martial arts]] obtained by talking to [[Caitus]], defeating [[Titus Fulminus Destellus|Titus]], and having high reputation with [[The Hundred Legions]]. Its attacks consist mainly of vertical swings and swift kicks. {{text|fistswitch}} == Obtainment == '''Imperium Kata''' is obtainable by defeating and speaking with [[Titus]], then reporting back to [[Caitus]]. After obtainment it is available as a starting weapon at [[Character Creation]]. You do not need to have the [[Legion Intelligence]] to get Imperium Kata, although you need someone with it to start the fight with Titus. == Critical == File:Imperium Kata Crit.gif The user performs two swift sidekicks and is slowed by 60% for the duration of the critical. Despite slowing you, the critical gives you a 12.5% speed boost for 2.5 seconds, allowing you to benefit from Talents such as {{t|Speed Demon}} even after the critical ends. Imperium Kata's critical gains 5 Thundercall Scaling if you have {{t|Electrify}} active. The first hit deals 1.2x your weapon's base damage, the second hit deals 2x your weapon's base damage. This critical isn't affected by your weapon's weight stat or weight stars, dealing 6.8 posture damage on the first hit and 10.2 on the second regardless of weapon choice. This critical has a cooldown of 5 seconds. ==Gallery== File:Imperium Kata M1 Cycle.gif|M1 cycle ==Trivia== * Added on the July 25th, 2025 Weekly update. * Imperium Kata did not benefit from [[Legion Centurion]] when it was first added, this was changed in the update on August 4th, 2025. * The '''{{t|Imperium Kata}}''' Talent Card also gives +1 Passive Agility. ** When the style first released, it additionally granted +5 Health. This was patched shortly after. *While its Talent description has a 20 LHT requirement, the fighting style can be obtained without it. *When selecting Imperium Kata in [[Character Creation]] it will give you the [[Legion Kata]] critical attack, until you equip a Cestus. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Fists]] [[Category:Fighting Styles]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Light Weapons]]

title: Ingredients
content: This page is about Ingredients. If you are looking for Food, click [[Food|here]]. == Description == Ingredients are scattered throughout Deepwoken. Where it is in the wilderness, in loot and other sources, Ingredients are used for crafting. Effects of Food and Ingredients that can be consumed are located [[Food|here]]. Crafting Recipes are located [[Crafting Recipes|here]]. ===Color Coding=== * Mint Green Items can be crafted, cooked or used in food recipes and potions. * Yellow Items are generic items, such as Materials, Gems, Food and Harvesting Tools. * Violet Items are Mantra Modifiers and recalled Mantras. * Each of the different colors have symbols behind the name of the item. ==Ingredients== ===Harvestables=== Raw materials harvested from the environment. ====Mushrooms==== *[[Gobletto]] - A mushroom that is white and has a tube-like stalk. *[[Browncap]] - A brown mushroom with a white stalk. *[[Dentifilo]] - Smallest mushroom with a dotted cap. *[[Bluecap]] - Found only in a library area coated in blue fog on Erisia. **There are two ways to get into this location; First by an upwards shaft from the cave in [[Lower Erisia]] where one can find gold [One can only access this location with movement mantras, and clever use of the Cauldron], secondly [and the intended way] is via a puzzle at the [[The Birdcage|Birdcage]] which you need a Soul Hearthgem for, then take the nearby zipline and head into a hole in the floor of a nearby ruin. *[[Squelcap]] - A slim and tall mushroom found only in [[Simforea]]. ==== Fruits==== *[[Calabash]] - Similar to gourds, but green. They grow on bushes and hold water very well. They mainly restore thirst than hunger. *[[Redd]] - Small round, orange fruit. Most commonly found in [[Songseeker Wilds|Songseeker]] and [[Isle of Vigils|Vigils]]. *[[Ongo]] - Red, roundish fruit. Basically, an apple. Commonly found in the [[Etrean Wilds]] and [[Songseeker Wilds|Songseeker]]. *[[Pomar]] - Large yellow fruit. Also occasionally damages you slightly when eaten. *[[Plumfruit]] - It's a plum, what did you expect? *[[Glumfig]] - A purple fruit that's as glum as it is tart. Obtained exclusively through being bought from [[Traan Zakshun]]'s shop at a random chance for {{c|notes|2,500}} or from his black market for {{c|crowns|2}}. ==== Other==== *[[Beeswax]] - Hives found on trees. *[[Gathered Wheat]] - Wheat, picked and bundled. *[[Bamboo Bundle]] - Bamboo sticks, growing mostly '''near''' beaches and shores. *[[Marram Grass]] - Short grass, growing '''on''' beaches and shores. *[[Egg]] - Bird eggs, found in trees and on elevated spots. *[[Alestrian Coral]] - Mainly used in speed potions. Found in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]]. *[[Sap]] - Amber streak of sap that appears on large trees. *[[Scallop]] - Found in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]]. *[[Urchin]] - Found in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]] *[[Thresher Egg]] - Found in Thresher nests. *[[Stick]] - Scattered around trees and foliage. *[[Hemobloom]] - A scarlet red flower found only in [[The Valley of Heroes]] during Winter. *[[Latchgrain]] - A slick grain found only in [[Simforea]]. *[[Grudgeroot]] - A inedible root found only in [[Simforea]]. ===Ores=== ''Main Page: [[Ore]]'' Ores come from mining ore deposits found across various locations or can be bought in certain towns such as [[Etris]] and [[Isle of Vigils]]. They're mainly used for crafting certain [[Outfits]] and utility items. *[[Rock]] *[[Coal]] *[[Iron]] *[[Gold]] *[[Erisore]] *[[Irithine]] *[[Astruline]] *[[Umbrite]] *[[Indichite]] ===Enemy Drops=== Many common [[Monsters]] and some [[Bosses]] have a chance of dropping exclusive items, often used in crafting and for various [[quests]]. ===Enemies=== *[[Authority Chainwarden]] **[[Warden's Armor Piece]] ====Monsters==== *[[Megalodaunt]], [[Alpha Megalodaunt]], [[Crimson Megalodaunt]] and [[Prime Megalodaunt]] **[[Megalodaunt Hide]] *[[Megalodaunt]], [[Alpha Megalodaunt]], [[Crimson Membrane]] ===Miscellaneous=== Any ingredients that do not fall under other categories and are obtained through other methods. *[[Ancient Dagger Remains]] *[[Shiva's Codex]] ===Mantra Ingredients=== ''Main Page: [[Mantra Modifiers]]'' Mantra Ingredients consist of Mantra Modifiers, unique items that can be utilized at a [[Mantra Lectern]], or in the case of Deep Gems equipped while resting at a [[Campfire]], to enhance the player's [[Mantras]]. There are 3 types of Mantra Modifiers: Regular, Sparks, and Deep Gems; Deep Gems, however, are categorized as Treasures and not Mantra Ingredients. Regular Mantra Modifiers and Sparks drop from a variety of [[Monsters]] and [[Enemies]], while Deep Gems are uncommonly found in chests from the [[First Layer]], including [[Random Encounters]] that reward Depths chests, and commonly found in chests from certain [[Bosses]] and from other events and dungeons. ====Regular==== *Cloudstone *Stratus Stone *Crystal Lens *Perfect Lens *Aeon Logstone *Eternal Logstone *Drift Shard *Rush Shard *Amnesic Driftwood *Glass Stone *Magnifying Stone *Vibrant Gem ====Sparks==== *Blast Spark *Magnet Spark *Multiplying Spark *Reversal Spark *Round Spark *Spring Spark *Tornado Spark ====Deep Gems==== *[[Aegis Gem]] *[[Blessed Gem]] *[[Bloodless Gem]] *[[Blue Gem]] *[[Insignia Gem]] *[[Wayward Gem]] *[[Wind Gem]] ===Treasures=== ''Main Page: [[Treasures]]'' Treasures are a category of item that contain miscellaneous gem items that are found at the bottoms of chests whose main purpose is to be sold and can be sold to [[Mantra Collector]]s, and also contain Deep Gems and Elemental Ingredients, items dropped from [[Attunement]]-wielding enemies that can be consumed by the player if they also wield that Attunement to train it, and given to the corresponding [[Attunement Trainers]] to unlock the attunement. While Treasures are not "Ingredients" in the literally defined sense, some Deep Gems and Elemental Ingredients are used to craft [[Outfits]]. ====Elemental Ingredients==== *[[Dying Embers]] - [[Flamecharm]] *[[Frigid Prism]] - [[Frostdraw]] *[[Spark Gland]] - [[Thundercall]] *[[Gale Stone]] - [[Galebreathe]] *[[Umbral Obsidian]] - [[Shadowcast]] *[[Heartstar]] - [[Bloodrend]] [[Category:Ingredients]] [[Category:Items]] [[Category:Mechanics]]

content:

It can be obtained by defeating the [[Shogun Specialist]] and [[Etrean Apostle]] NPCs, whose jobs can be found together at the Isle of Vigils and [[the Indigo Citadel]] job boards. The jobs require you to be at least Power 15 to start them. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Prince of the Wind}} [Memento Talent] - You are the one who the wind bends around. Your galebreathe is enhanced. *Windwaker [Common Talent] - Call upon a gust of wind to propel your boat even faster. **The ability can be used as long as the player is standing on a boat, even if not in control. **Сannot be used in combat. *{{Cl|questtlnf|Engage}} [Echo Talent, Quest Talent] - Landing a Basic Attack slightly restores some of your Ether. (+1 Posture) *Air Pressure [Common Talent] - Dodging an attack or hitting an enemy's block will transform your next dash into a Gale Dash. Gale Dashes carry you further than regular dashes and have extended iframes, but will clear immediately should you initiate an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *Apparitions [Common Talent] - Your Haunted Phantoms become Apparitions that apply [[Winded]] on hit. Apparitions cannot be parried if you are in [[Status Effects#Phantom Step|Phantom Step]]. **Apparitions can be parried in "Phantom step" (Possibly a bug) *Haunted Gale [Common Talent] - Landing 3 Galebreathe Mantras without whiffing calls for a Haunted Phantom. The Phantom will attack alongside you for the next 8s before dissipating. **On proc, gain the Haunted status effect, spawning ghosts that attack your opponent every time you land a Mantra. ***Haunted Gale is capped at 1 ghost per Mantra. **If your Mantra is blocked, parried, or dodged, it will be "''whiffed''", resetting all stacks of Haunted Gale. **Haunted Gale stacks are counted '''per person''', not globally. *Haunted Path: Specter [Common Talent] - Build up spectral energy by performing successful dodges and landing Wind mantras. Phantom winds from Haunted Gale no longer appear. You can no longer suffocate enemies. **Any Talent or Mantra that '''applies''' suffocation will have the status effect replaced with a Haunted Phantom. *Kick Off [Common Talent] - You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall. (+6 Passive Agility) **Causes '''''all''''' falls to be considered "shorter" by 10 studs, also reducing larger falls. **Increases climb distance by ~15% when off cooldown. **Slide jumping now also slightly increases climb distance. **Has a cooldown of 3 seconds. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Overflowing Dam}} [Rare Talent] - Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage. **For every point of Ingelligence below 40, Overflowing Dam's damage bonus will be reduced by 0.125%, having a minimum damage buff of 6.875% at 15 Intelligence. **The damage buff applies the moment you reach 100% Ether, despite what the Talent description says. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Perfect Flash}} [Rare Talent] - Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away. **Poser's ring won't count towards the health threshold until sheathed, maintaining the bonus even after being "damaged". *Phantom Step [Common Talent] - Press X to begin running at high speeds and your regular dashes transform into gale dashes. (Must have at least 10% Spectral Gauge) **Phantom Step's activation keybind can be configured in settings. **Has a 3 second cooldown on activation. **Passively drains your Spectral Gauge while active. **Grants a speed boost for the full duration. **Phantom Step dashes have an extended travel distance and increased i-frames, however they will end early if you attack. **Phantom Step dashes have a 3 second cooldown. ***Phantom Step dashes and Gale Dashes have separate cooldowns. **Phantom Step dashes can proc Cyclone Blade. *{{cl|advancedtl|Possession}} [Advanced Talent] - After an apparition hits an enemy, receive 15% posture damage on all Galebreathe attacks for 6 seconds. If the apparition hits while you have Phantom Step activated, receive a 15% chip damage buff as well for the same duration. **The posture damage and chip damage buffs have reduced effects if you have under 75 Galebreathe. **The posture damage boost activates from Inhaled M1s and Crits. If you are using [[Wraithclaw]], [[Curved Blade of Winds]] or [[Hero Blade of Wind]] (only critical) you don't have to inhale a mantra for it to take effect. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Vanishing Wraith}} [Rare Talent] - Your 'Aerial Attacks' while in Phantom Step will now teleport you behind your target *Wind Step [Common Talent] - Create a step of wind below you when jumping in the air. Jumping while sliding down a slope or off a cliff launches you forwards. **Press space while in the air to double jump. This leaves a small tornado behind that someone else can jump into to also double jump. **While in combat, this ability cost Ether to use. **Jump while sliding down a slope to perform a gale leap that propels you forwards. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |image=WindBlade1Gif.gif |name=Wind Blade (☆☆☆) |desc=Slicing blades of wind. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|galebreathe|Wind}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Launch a wind projectile towards where you're facing.'' *Has a base damage of 18/20.5/23/25.5/28 per level with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. *The Tempest Wind variant has a base damage of 15/22.5/30/37.5/45 per level with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. *The default variant deals 12 posture damage regardless of level, while the Tempest Wind variant deals 4/5/6/7/8 posture damage per level. *Both variants have a windup of 0.5 seconds. *Projectile lasts about 3-5 seconds *Modifying with a [[Drift Shard|Drift]]/[[Rush Shard]]s will increase projectile's speed significantly. *Casting Wind Blade while sliding will perform the "'''Tempest Wind'''" variant of the Mantra. This version deals increased damage at the cost of range. **This variant can be increased further with the [[Tempestmaker's Threads]] Talent, increasing the damage of your Tempest Wind-Wind Blade by 20% and granting a 20% damage buff while midair after proccing it. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Wind Gun (★★☆) |desc=A powerful wind blast. |image=Windgun.gif |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|galebreathe|Wind}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Fire a penetrating bullet of wind.'' *Has a base damage of 32/36/40/44/48 per level with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. *The Blast Spark variant has a base damage of 6.4/7.2/8/8.8/9.6 per level, per hit (4) with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. This deals 80% of the unmodified variant's damage if all hits land. *The Multiplying Spark has a base damage of 4.08/4.59/5.1/5.61/6.12 per level, per hit (8) with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. This deals 102% of the unmodified variant's damage if all hits land. *Combining both sparks grants a base damage of 2.04/2.295/2.55/2.805/3.06 per level, per hit (24) with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. This deals 153% of the unmodified variant's damage if all hits land. *The base variant deals 10 posture damage. The Blast Spark variant deals 4 posture damage per hit (4), while the Multiplying Spark variant deals 0.8 posture damage per hit (8). Both sparks combined deals 3 posture damage per hit (24). *Has a windup of 0.45 seconds. The Multiplying and both Spark variants has a windup of 0.55 seconds. Has a 15 second cooldown. *Pushes and ragdolls opponent. *Applies the [[Suffocate]] status effect. *Can be modified with a [[Multiplying Spark]] to fire a few bullets at once in a vert tight cone AoE. *Can be modified with a [[Blast Spark]] to fire a few bullets at once in a wide cone AoE. *Both Sparks can be combined, making three consecutive short-range bullet rounds. File:Wind Gun Multiplying Spark.gif|Multiplying Spark File:Wind Gun Blast Spark.gif|Blast Spark File:Wind Gun Multiplying Spark + Blast Spark.gif|Both Sparks }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Down Comes the Claw [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a Critical while you have a speed boost prevents your opponent from being able to dodge twice in a row for 5s. (+1 Passive Agility) **Down Comes the Claw cannot be reapplied while it's currently active. **Lasts 6.5 seconds. **For every point in Agility under 75, Down Comes the Claw loses 0.055 seconds of duration, capping at a minimum of 5.11 seconds with 50 Agility. *Endurance Runner [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Even when things look dire, you still have it in you to keep your legs moving. (+2 Passive Agility) **Halve the speed penalty tied to lost health. *Inhale [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - [[Combat Mechanics#Combat Basics|Feinting]] a [[Galebreathe|Wind spell]] stores its power in your lungs for 5 seconds, empowering the next wind spell cast in that time. All relevant [[Mantra Modifiers|modifications]] and upgrades from the inhaled wind mantras are applied to the empowered mantra. **Inhaling a Galebreathe Mantra adds (Mantra level multiplied by 2)% damage to the next Galebreathe Mantra. For example, a level 5 inhale will give your next Gale mantra a 10% damage buff. **Inhaling grants a speed boost for 3 seconds. **Inhaling grants the [[Status Effects#Maestro's Blade|Maestro's Blade]] status effect. This effect allows your basic attacks to proc After Cut and Possession. **The duration of Maestro's Blade is the inhaled Mantra's Ether cost (before [[Blue Gem]]) divided by 5. For example, a 50 Ether cost Mantra will apply Maestro's Blade for 10 seconds. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Aerogliding}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - When falling from a high place, hold spacebar to generate wind currents until you hit the floor. (+2 Passive Agility) **Has a windup of 1 second. **When active, create an aura that reduces fall speed and stopping fall damage. ***Does not prevent existing fall damage, if user was already falling, Aerogliding may still damage the user upon activation. **Automatically ends after 5 seconds, although it can be reactivated midair up to 3 times, however the windup will cause the user to take fall damage. ***By air stalling you can continually reactivate Aerogliding and prevent fall damage. **When active, also lightly pushes user forwards, giving the user control. **Greatly reduces height loss with glider, allowing for much longer distances to be traveled. (Stacks with Feathered Glider) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Cut to the Chase}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Air Counter damage scaling is largely increased. Landing an Air Counter now initiates an uppercut. (+5 Passive Agility) **Air Countering innately deals 10% of your weapon's scaled damage, '''Cut to the Chase''' increases this amount to 70% of your weapon's scaled damage. ***The damage bonus to your Air Counters will scale down if you have less than 60 Agility. **Air Counter is initiated when using an Aerial attack after your opponent does any of the following: wall jumps (parkour), uses Wind Step (Galebreathe Talent), or uses a [[Lifevents|Lifevent]] (Starswept jump pad). *{{Cl|raretlnf|Evasive Expert}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Wyvern's Claw}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead. **Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds. **Synergizes very well with uppercuts.
===Power 20===
*{{Cl|raretlnf|Going Nowhere}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - When enemies dodge your attacks, their momentum is killed and they're briefly prevented from sprinting. (+6 Passive Agility) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Risky Moves}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **User is covered in a blue highlight when the effect is active. **Visual effect might not line up with duration. **Attacking will cancel the effect early. **Takes priority over block, allowing for you to "auto-dodge" while simultaneously blocking. **20 second cooldown. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Spine Cutter}}[Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Hitting an enemy in the back after a roll cancel will initiate a second slash that deals your weapon's raw damage. (+6 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility) **5 second cooldown per enemy. The cooldown indicator may suggest the cooldown is per enemy type, but it isn't. **The second slash has no PEN. **Can proc from some [[Attunement-less|physical]] Mantras and criticals with the [[M1 tag]]. *{{cl|advancedtl|A World Without Song}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Every 3 hits with a Wind Mantra now procs Suffocate. **Requires 4 hits to proc if you have less than 75 Galebreathe. **Requires 5 hits to proc if you have less than 40 Galebreathe. **Suffocation prevents the victim from casting Mantras and deals a small amount of damage over time. *{{cl|advancedtl|Ghost}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible, ending early if you attack. (+5 Passive Agility) **Provides I-frames for the duration of the invisibility. **The invisibility and I-frame duration is 1.2 seconds if you have 40 or higher Agility. **Ghost's duration will be reduced by 0.0133 seconds per point in Agility under 40, capping at 0.866 seconds at 15 Agility. **Will also proc from dodging bleed, occurs when dodging a m1 late in high ping. **Has a 20 second cooldown. **You cannot parry attacks during the invisibility. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Hollow Wraith (☆☆☆) |desc=A blast of wind. |image=Hollow Wraith.gif |ethercost={{stats|ether|20 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype=(?) |reqs={{c|notes|1200}} |effect=''Shoot out a projectile of wind in front of you with 2 wraiths following it.'' *Memento exclusive }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *Maiming Claws [Common Talent] - Down Comes the Claw now disables your opponent's posture regeneration for 6s on proc. (+1 Passive Agility) **Applies to passive posture regeneration, Steady Nerves, and posture restoration from parrying. All other sources of posture restoration ignore Maiming Claws entirely. **Cannot be reapplied while Down Comes the Claw is currently active. **Maiming Claws' duration will be shortened if you do not have at least 75 Agility. *Suffocating Impact [Common Talent] - Flourishing enemies into walls applies [[Winded]] and [[Suffocation|Suffocating]] for a short duration. (+2 Passive Agility) *Speed Emission [Common Talent] - Gain a slight speed boost after landing a vent. *{{cl|advancedtl|Conditioned Runner}} [Advanced Talent] - You regenerate health faster than normal when sprinting below 75% HP. The health amount scales with your agility stat. (+1 Passive Agility) **After 3 seconds of sprinting without taking damage, gain increased health regeneration. **The health regen is reduced in PvP combat. **Scales linearly in effectiveness. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Silencer's Blade}} [Rare Talent] - Meleeing a 'Suffocated' opponent will extend the duration of the Suffocation and grant a speed boost. **Landing M1 attacks or criticals with the [[M1 tag]] on suffocated targets applies a new stack of suffocation that lasts 5 seconds. **Grants an ~22.5% speed boost for 3 seconds. **[[Bleed]] damage can proc this effect. *Fast Blade [Common Talent] - Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **Parrying without this Talent gives you a speed boost, but it's barely noticeable and lasts for the duration of the parry. **Increases the speed boost duration from parrying by 3 seconds. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Gale Lunge (★☆☆) |desc=A rush of piercing wind. |image=GaleLungeGif.gif |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|galebreathe|Wind}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=Defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)]] |effect=''Lunge forward with your weapon coated in wind.'' *Has a base damage of 12.5/13.75/15/16.25/17.5 per level with 2.75 Galebreathe scaling. *Deals 4/5/6/7/8 posture damage per level. *Has a windup of 0.5 seconds with a cooldown of 13 seconds. *Can be used as mobility to push the user forward. *Has a relatively large hitbox. *Shares a cooldown with [[Ice Lance]]. *The '''base damage''' of this Mantra is increased by 15% if you are wearing the full [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Specialist Set]]. Additionally, it will become a yellow color. }} ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *Breathing Impact [Common Talent] - When knocked into objects by wind mantras enemies take additional blunt damage based off of how hard they are hit. **The following Galebreathe Mantras have knockback and can benefit from this Talent: [[Air Force]], [[Champion's Whirlthrow]], [[Tornado Kick]], [[Gale Punch]], [[Rising Wind]], and [[Wind Gun]]. **The increased damage dealt is based on the attack's initial damage and your opponent's acceleration. **Due to the increased damage being based on acceleration, it is '''heavily''' affected by server performance and ping. *Blade Dancer [Common Talent] - Landing a Basic Attack removes your roll cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) *Swift Rebound [Common Talent, Agility] - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Speed Demon}} [Rare Talent] - Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor. **Speed Demon's bleed deals 2.5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +7.5% damage over a 0.9 second period. **Works with M1s and criticals. *Cyclone Blade [Common Talent] - After a successful Gale Dash you wrap your weapon in wind, causing your next Light attack to do +30% damage as bleed and have +10% chip damage. (+2 Passive Agility) **Does not have a cooldown, lasts for 3s. **Also procs from Phantom Step dashes. **Despite the Talent description stating "Light attack", it also grants bleed to weapon criticals. *Pressure Break [Common Talent] - Breaking an enemy's posture will cause them to take intense wind pressure, increasing the attack's damage by +25% and flinging the enemy backwards. (+8 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Lightspeed Reflexes}} [Rare Talent, Agility] - Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. (+1 Passive Agility) {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Wind Vortex (☆☆☆) |desc=A blast of wind. |image=Wind Vortex.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |ethercost={{stats|ether|20 Ether}} |dmgtype=(?) |reqs=Defeat [[Dravik, The Rat King]] |effect=''Shoot out a vortex of wind in front of you.'' *Memento exclusive }} ===True Heart of Enmity=== *Silencer's Song [Common Talent] - Silencer's Blade now procs on your mantras. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Safety Dance}} [Rare Talent] - Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s. (+1 Passive Agility) **You gain more invincibility frames while dodging, granting you longer immunity to damage. **Dodge IFrames increased from 0.3s to 0.35s. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Cheap Shot}} [Rare Talent] - Your attacks gain 10% PEN multiplicatively when you have an active speed boost. (+6 Passive Agility) **It multiplies your PEN by 1.1x. IE: if you are at 30% PEN, Cheap Shot will give you an additional 3% PEN. **Cheap Shot cannot bypass the PEN cap. **Cheap Shot's PEN multiplier will be reduced by 0.11% for every point in Agility below 65, having a minimum multiplier of +7.22% PEN (or 1.072x PEN) at 40 Agility. *Precise Swing [Common Talent] - After landing a critical your next basic attack will gain 25% chip past your opponent's block. (+9 Carry Load, +1 Passive Agility) **If your critical lands, is parried, or is blocked, gain the [[Status Effects#Precise Swing|Precise Swing]] status effect for 30 seconds. **The Precise Swing status effect will be consumed if you hit someone's block with an M1, you land an M1, or your M1 gets parried. ***If your M1 is whiffed or dodged, the status effect will not be consumed. **Because this status effect is applied to yourself and not your opponent, you can land your critical on person A and then hit person B's block and still apply the chip damage. **Precise Swing is additive with weapon chip, and having above 100% chip causes you to deal more damage. *Spinning Swordsman [Common Talent] - Running attacks do +15% extra damage when you have a speed boost. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Tap Dancer}} [Rare Talent] - Rolling immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your roll on a longer cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel. *Steady Nerves [Common Talent] - You dance from toe to toe - successful dodges restore posture. (+7 Carry Load, +2 Passive Agility) **Restore 2 flat posture on a successful dodge. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Windfall (☆☆☆) |desc=A devastating crash of wind. |image=Windfall.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|galebreathe|Wind}} |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''Stomp on the ground to launch yourself upward before crashing down with a strong downdraft.'' *Exclusive to Inheritor of the Gale and [[Theros Disciple]] }}

== Description ==
The '''Innkeep''' is an [[NPC]] that allows the player to set their spawn at their given inns for {{c|notes|5}}. Having less than the required Notes or being at least an enemy of the housing faction, the Innkeep will deny the player's stay. 

There are currently 6 Innkeep allowing stay in these locations: [[Etris]], [[Isle of Vigils]], [[Greathive Aratel]], [[Miner's Landing]], [[Port Merit]], and [[Summer Isle]]. [[Meteor Isle]] has an Innkeep, however it's currently bugged and does not allow players to set their spawn on the island.

This Outfit will be automatically equipped upon joining the Inquisition Division of the [[Authority Ensign]] Origin, ignoring all crafting requirements. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 3500 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+30% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+35% Elemental resistance}}, {{stats|sdw|+10% Shadow resistance}}, {{stats|mtl|+10% Ironsing resistance}}, {{stats|bld|+10% Blood resistance}}, {{stats|ether|+15% Ether Regen}}, and {{stats|stealth|+50% [[Stealth]]}}. The {{t|Lethal Dose}} Talent doubles the duration of the Poison status effect from your [[Hidden Blade]]. ==Trivia== *Similarly to [[Hive Adjudicator]], During 2025's Hallowtide, this outfit became temporarily obtainable from [[Glaive Spellhardt]]'s Master Schematic gacha alongside [[Shock Corps Light]]. This conflict between the Authority and Etrea is intentional and there are forces at play that we are yet to understand. Should I feel the hands of this creature pry too close to my mind, I will take the necessary measures to insure I am not captured.|author=Inquisitor Lotus' finals words in their report.}} {{Character |image1=Silhouette.jpg |name=Unknown |alias=Inquisitor Lotus |pronouns=They/them{{Ref/NPC|High Inquisitor Merey|}} |affiliation=*[[The Central Authority]]
**[[The Inquisition]] }} ==Description== The individual known as Lotus was an Authority Inquisitor and [[Thundercall]]er assigned to [[Warden Jericho]]'s forces in the Eastern Luminant. Lotus partook in [[Operation 'Puppet Master']], which saught to obtain intel on [[The Lord Regent]]. Lotus initially attempted to obtain information from the civilian population, which proved ineffective. They later organized the kidnapping of [[Aster Leshi|an Etrean guard]], replacing him with an Authority colleague, and interrogated them using Thundercall shocks to the guard's Hippocampus. As the guards responses differed if the memory of their initial responses were erased, Lotus suspected foul play and thus increased their voltage output, successfully breaking the mind veil that had been applied to the guard but also killing him and giving Lotus a vision of the Lord Regent, who had been alerted to their presence. Lotus later noted being plagued by whispers, seemingly from their, now MIA, colleague, and a feeling as if his mind was being probed by hands. Lotus was able to ensure the report reached [[Warden Jericho]] but either was killed, committed suicide or disappeared before they could return to base.{{Ref/Book|Operation 'Puppet Master' Report}} ==Trivia== *Lotus' codename refers to the ''[[wp:Nelumbo nucifera|Nelumbo nucifera]]'', better known as the lotus flower. ==References== [[Category:Individuals with They/them pronouns]] [[Category:Inquisitors of The Central Authority]]

title: Insanity
content:
{{Quotes|quote=P̴L̷U̴C̷K̴ ̴O̶U̶T̴ ̵T̵H̴I̸N̶E̵ ̶E̵Y̶E̶S̵,̷ ̴T̸E̵A̷R̵ ̶O̶U̴T̶ ̶T̷H̸I̵N̴E̸ ̷T̸H̴R̶O̵A̴T̴,̷ ̴L̵A̴Y̶ ̵W̷A̸S̷T̵E̴ ̷T̶O̶ ̷A̷L̶L̴ ̴W̷H̶I̷C̷H̸ ̷I̸S̴ ̵S̸A̷C̷R̸E̵D̶,̷ ̴T̵H̵E̴ ̶M̶O̷O̵N̸S̶E̶Y̶E̵ ̵C̵O̷N̴V̷E̶R̴G̸E̷S̸ ̶W̶I̷T̵H̷ ̵T̷H̸A̶T̵ ̷B̶E̷L̴O̴W̵.|author=Insanity Killsplash.}}

'''Insanity''' is a game mechanic mainly present in [[The Depths]], but also on the Surface to a lesser extent.

Insanity is dictated by a meter that is not directly shown to the player, but its progress can be tracked by a blue hue on the border of the screen. Once your sanity has decreased enough, it will begin to debilitate your character in increasingly harsher ways the more insane you become.

Players start with 80 base sanity. Being in The Depths passively takes sanity at a rate of 1 point every 30 seconds, meaning you can spend about 40 minutes in The Depths with 0 Willpower and no equipment bonuses before you reach maximum insanity and proceed to inevitably die

Sanity can be increased by increasing the [[Willpower]] attribute (+3 per investment), taking [[Talents]] that provide Sanity, or wearing [[equipment]] with a sanity bonus. The [[Ganymede]] Aspect grants a 1.2x multiplier to Sanity gain.

== Insanity Effects ==
[[File:Stage 2.png|thumb|227x227px|Said "Blue Hue" and "New Motifs"]]When losing enough sanity, the player will endure negative effects.

==Sanity Decreasing Effects==

*Being in range of the [[Megalodaunt]], [[Mudskipper Brute]]/[[Broodlord]], or [[Primadon]]'s roar attacks.
*Being hit by the [[Deep Widow]]'s web attack.
*Being in the [[First Layer]], draining 1 Sanity every 30 seconds.
*Being hit by the [[Ardour Scream]] of a player who has the {{t|Echoing Lunatic}} Talent.
*Drinking or being splashed by a [[Alchemy|Mindbreaking potion]].
*Using {{t|Heretic's Sutra}}, draining 15% of your Sanity on use. If you were above 80% Sanity on cast, you will be set to 65% Sanity instead.
*Using [[Blindseer]] Mantras.
*As a potential corrupted [[Resonance]] downside, draining 40 Sanity on use.
*Being hit by a player with {{t|Shared Misery}} active, draining 3% of your maximum Sanity. This stacks with Curse of the No Life King.
*Being hit by a weapon enchanted with [[Curse of the No Life King]], draining 2% of your maximum Sanity on hit. This stacks with Shared Misery.
*Unsheathing a weapon enchanted with [[Curse of the No Life King]] while in [[The Depths]], draining your Sanity by 2 per second. This stacks on top of the passive Sanity drain from being in the Depths, equating to 122 Sanity drained per minute.
*Having the [[Wishbound]] flaw during nighttime.

==Sanity Restoring Effects==

*Passive sanity regeneration. Regen 0.25 sanity per second at day time and 0.05 at night time. (Disabled in the Depths)
**The {{t|Breathing Exercise}} grants 50% more passive sanity regeneration, granting 0.375 sanity during the day, and 0.075 sanity at night.
*Sitting at a [[campfire]] (Improved if sharing the campfire with a [[Capra]]) regenerates 0.5 sanity per second.
*Standing near a [[Graceful Flame]] if the caster has the {{t|Undying Flame}} Talent.
*Receiving the Mark of Jurik from a [[Capra]].
*Drinking or being splashed by a [[Alchemy|Heartening potion]].
*The {{t|Conquer Your Fears}} Talent grants sanity when depths mobs die or when allies grip humanoid enemies near you.
*The [[Castle Light]] and [[Chariot's Spire]] sanity aura, which are exclusive to the [[Deepbound]] and [[Ignition Delver]] Origins respectively.

== Trivia==
*While often attributed to him by the community, [[Yun'Shul]] is not the cause of Insanity; rather, the eldritch nature of the First Layer is responsible. This is likely why the Second Layer does not cause Insanity, as despite its variety of monsters it's more grounded in reality.
*The not including [[Equipment]], the maximum amount of Sanity you can have is 544 (80 base, 300 from [[Willpower]] investment, and 164 from [[Talents]]).
**If you are a [[Ganymede]], this is increased to 637.8 (80 base, 360 from [[Willpower]] investment, and 197.8 from [[Talents]]), as Ganymede has a 1.2x Sanity gain multiplier.
**This equates to over 4 and a half hours of time spent in The Depths before you reach 0 Sanity, or over 5 hours if you are a [[Ganymede]]. If you are using the [[Curse of the No Life King]] enchantment, then this will be decreased to just under 4 and a half minutes, or just over 5 minutes as a Ganymede.
*Each point of Sanity equates to 30 seconds of time spent in The Depths before you reach 0 Sanity.
**If you are using the [[Curse of the No Life King]] enchantment, then each point of Sanity will equate to 0.49 seconds of time spent in The Depths before you reach 0 Sanity.
*The spoken phrases caused by {{t|Heretic's Sutra}} can consist of the following:
**HELP ME
**OH, THE AGONY
**THE VOICES CALL OUT
**THERE ARE NO GODS

content:
[[File:Instruments Teaser.png|center|thumb|700px]]

== Description ==
Instruments, or Shanties, is a feature that was added on the 2023 December 1 update. Purchasing any instrument gives you the "Worn Songbook" item, which you can use to play songs together with your friends or alone. There are currently 4 instruments: The Accordion, Drum, Trumpet, and Violin. Playing along with others staves off hunger and thirst, grants you a blood regen buff, slightly improves your passive HP regen, and a resistance to insanity while in the Depths. It may regen sanity if you have a way to stop gaining insanity, such as the Mark of Jurik [[Capra]] aspect Talent or being [[Deepbound]] and in [[Castle Light]]. However, movement is limited and you cannot use any other items.

Instruments can be purchased, for {{c|notes|25}} each, at:

*[[Etris]] inside the [[Antiquarian]]'s store.
*[[Isle of Vigils]] inside the Inn.
*[[Castle Light]] near the campfire.
*[[Miner's Landing]] under a ladder in a room and in the Pub<!-- (Why are there 2?) yeah same here -->.
*[[Greathive Aratel]] in the observatory.
*[[Varicosa District|The Varicosa District]] inside one of the buildings in the southeast sector.
*[[Port Merit]] beside the [[Antiquarian]].
If you are near another player, the prompt to play a song now adds Play Along, syncing your instrument with theirs. You can only play along with songs you currently have.

To access songs, you must read the corresponding book. These books can be obtained from either searching through a bookshelf or buying them from a [[Chili|Merchant Ship]]. The current books in the game that give you shanties are:
*[[The Song of Fathoms / Oscillation]]
*[[The Gideshu March]]
*[[A Light In The Sky]]

'''The following songs can be played on the instruments:'''
*[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IZgNo7Pv0hA ''The Gideshu March''] <sub>YouTube link</sub>
