*[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zu9uDHqFcS8 ''A Memory of Tides''] <sub>YouTube link</sub>
*[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t89tvQBZhWQ ''Carol of Resonances''] <sub>YouTube link</sub>
*[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WSxvkVEJ8zs ''A Light in the Sky''] <sub>YouTube link</sub>

==Worn Songbook==
{{Quotes|quote=Start a tune! Play along with someone else to gain a rallying buff.|author=Description of the Worn Songbook ability}}
Upon purchase of any instruments, the player will gain an ability in their inventory called '''Worn Songbook'''. The player will also unlock '''A Memory of Tides''' and '''Carol of Resonances''' by default once they purchase an instrument to play as songs.

Clicking on the ability to select it and then clicking anywhere on the screen will show an interface, prompting the player to choose what instrument they want to use, along with which song they want to play. The player can also change the skin of their instruments from this interface.<gallery widths="250">

title: Interluminary Parasol
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=The sight of a Parasol is more than enough to make many lose their lunch. It's thought that they act as a form of cross-pollinator for various creatures that make their way from the Depths to Lumen, exchanging the traits and properties between them and dismantling ecosystems by injecting them into a competing niche.|author=Parasol Planter Description}}{{Monster Infobox|title1=Interluminary Parasol|image1=Interloper.png|health=150,000-168,000(hp varies)
225,000 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}}|drops=Chest *[[Parasol Planter]] *[[Parasol Part]] (direct drop) *[[Charged Parasol Part]] (direct drop) *[[Raw Parasol Brain]] (direct drop) *[[Parasol Membrane]] *[[Summer Scarf]] *[[Threadwork Summer Scarf]] *[[Vigil Sentinel]] *[[Jade Vigil's Weave]] *Etc. (Check [[#Loot Table/Rewards|loot table]] for more info)|locations=[[Leiuna]] |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== The Interluminary Parasol is a large, brainy organism covered by a bioluminescent, umbrella-shaped bell with light blue ribs, hence its name. Four appendages stick out of the brain-like structure, ending with sharp, armored needles. According to the item description of its exclusive drop, the Parasol emerges from [[The Depths]], its sole purpose being to spread [[The Depths]]' influence by bringing its mobs up to the surface, disrupting the ecosystems on the surface. ==Moveset== This giant foe's moveset is relatively simple and is easy to avoid; however it deals a massive amount of damage if caught off guard. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Pierce'''
(★☆☆) |When close enough, the Parasol starts rapidly stabbing random targets with its tendrils, injecting poison when hit. *Autogrips players if they are knocked. *If the player is guardbroken through this attack, they will not be poisoned. *Depending on the variant this attack will '''go through dodge''' unless you have talents like [[Talents|Ghost]]. *This attack has 2 variants one is a simple launch of one of its tendrils towards a player the second variant will hold the player in place dealing higher poison and massive damage being able to partially bypass [[Payback]] {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull }} |- |
'''Abyssal Hive'''
(★☆☆) |The Parasol spits out a random Monster, varied to a [[Mudskipper Brute]], [[Mudskipper Broodlord]], [[Void Thresher]], and [[Nautilodaunt]]. It can only spawn one type of creature at a time, and can sometimes spawn two of them. * Parasol mostly uses this after getting a hit with any of its moves. Therefore, the less hits you take, the less additional enemies you have to deal with. * Interestingly, getting guardbroken by '''Pierce''' does not activate this move. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, summon }} |- |
'''Parasol Planting'''
(★★☆) |The Parasol shrieks before planting all four tendrils into the ground and charging itself with electricity. *For the duration of this attack, it will not use '''Pierce.''' {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Abyssal Storm'''
(★★☆) |At random intervals, the Parasol creates a stormclouds surrounding itself, striking random targets. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Overcurrent'''
(★★☆) |The Parasol sends a current of electricity across its tendrils, shocking targets that are within the area of a tendril. *This move is only used when it has Parasol Planting. {{AttackTags |telegraph = jump |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n }} |- |
'''Greater Overcurrent'''
(★★★) |The Parasol starts to convulse, charging up a large static pulse that sends nearby targets flying. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |} ==Loot Table/Rewards== The Parasol drops an assortment of late game items, such as [[Relics]] and the exclusive [[Parasol Planter]].

*[[The Ministry]] |side2=The Vigils |side4= |commanders1=[[The Lord Regent]] |commanders2=[[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]]† |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1= |unit2= |unit3= |unit4= |ppl1= |ppl2= |ppl4= |casual1=Unknown |casual2=Maestro Alkhurst Legato |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} During the twilight years of the [[Etrean Civil War]], the [[Ministry]]-backed forces of [[Etrea]] launched a full '''invasion''' of the [[Isle of Vigils]]. Without the [[Etrean Royalists]] to help them the Vigils, under [[Maestro Alkhurst Legato]], had to fend them off on their lonesome. Though the Vigils emerged victorious, the victory was a pyrrhic one. Maestro Legato lost his life in the process and their victory was quickly rendered meaningless. The Vigils were soon fully integrated into Etrea and their participation in the war was lost from memory, drawing the Civil War to a close. ==Prelude== ==The invasion== ==Aftermath== ==References==

==Description==
Iris is a [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Talking to them will start the Grave Tending [[Quests|quest]] where they ask you to bring a flower to their brother's grave.

==Location==
Iris is located in [[The Lordsgrove]], following the path that trails left.

title: Iron Bomb
content:
{{ItemTemplate |title=Bombs |image= Ironbomb.png|Iron Bomb Circus Bomb.png|Circus Bomb .png|Circus Bomb |type=Tool |desc= Iron Bomb: Useful for solving problems. Can be thrown or placed.
Circus Bomb: Alleyoop! |obtainment= Iron Bomb: *2 [[Iron]] + 1 [[Coal]] at a [[Crafting Station]] (Requires {{t|Family Recipe}}) *[[Carnival of Hearts]] Circus Bomb: *[[Carnival of Hearts]] exclusive }} ==Description== An explosive formerly used for demolition, now used to demolish all. It can be thrown with the keybind {{input|input|E}}. The base maximum amount of bombs you can hold is 99, though can be surpassed by with the [[Packmule]] Boon. To gain this recipe, you will have to talk to [[Lucien]] at [[Songseeker Wilds]] nearby the gate of [[Ancient Rotlands]]. Talk to him and purge [[Mineskipper]]s. Talk to Lucien once you've purged them all and obtain the Family Recipe Talent. After this you will be able to receive Talents from the "Saboteur" Talent tree which allows for more ways to play around with your bombs. ===Recipe=== 2 [[Iron]] + 1 [[Coal]] at any [[Crafting Station]], this requires the Family Recipe Talent. ===Uses=== The iron bomb is a great damaging tool for those who wish to put time and effort into crafting them. *Pressing {{Input|keybind|M1}} or your left mouse button lets you place your bomb down, it detonates after 3 seconds of being placed down. *Pressing {{Input|input|E}} on your keyboard allows you to throw your bomb in the direction of your cursor. This has a 5 second cooldown. **You cannot use bombs mid-animation and vice versa. **These keybinds cannot be changed. ===Movement=== The Talent Hot Potato allows the user to gain a noticeable speed boost when thrown. It does not work when pocket bombs is procced or when a bomb is placed down. You are able to get up to high obstacles by propelling yourself using your bombs. You can throw a bomb under you whilst airborne or time your jump with your placed down bomb. Your bombs can't damage you. ==Talents== *'''Family Recipe''' - You can now craft bombs at a crafting bench. **Allows you to create Iron Bombs. *'''Incendiary Formula''' - Bombs will set your enemies on fire upon detonation, as well as launch with more force. Bombs will deal 20% increased damage to burning enemies. **Bombs now light your opponent ablaze. This burn is completely identical to that of Flamecharm's, despite the changelogs stating it scales on your Intelligence attribute. **Bombs gain +20% damage when hitting a burning target. *'''Sulphur Surprise''' - Your cooldown for throwing bombs will be shortened after your first bomb damages an enemy. **Lowers the cooldown of your '''next''' bomb throw by 1 second (from 5 seconds to 4). **Has a 20 second cooldown. *'''Hot Potato''' - Gain a large boost of speed after throwing a bomb. Your bombs have a chance to detonate twice. (+6 Passive Agility) **Thus speed boost lasts 2 seconds. *'''Explosive Efficiency''' - Crafting a bomb will yield two bombs. Chance to make three. **This Talent is a must take as it will greatly increase the efficiency of your bomb crafting. **Requires Hot Potato. *'''Pocket Bombs''' - You have a chance to activate a bomb in your inventory when damaged. (+1 Health, +5 Carry Load) **When hit, you have a chance to drop 2 bombs at your feet. This only consumes a singular bomb. ==Information== *Bombs deal 10 typeless damage at base and scale on Intelligence. At 100 Intelligence, they deal 45.5 damage. *Because bombs deal typeless damage, they ignore physical and elemental resistances. *Iron Bombs can be buffed with universal damage modifiers such as [[Taunt]] or [[Ardour Scream]]. *Bomb usage has a 5 second cooldown. ==Tips== *Just like any other burn source, you can increase the effectiveness of your bomb-applied burn with Talents such as {{t|Azure Flames}} or {{t|Corpse Explosion}}. **Your Incendiary Formula bombs will apply Puppet Burn, spawning puppets if you have [[Talents#Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets|Twisted Puppets]] or create [[Talents#Lava Serpent|Eruptions]] if you have Eruption Path. *The {{t|Excavator}} Talent will greatly help with gathering materials for bombs, as it has a chance to double your mining output. *The [[Miner's Hardhat]] equipment grants two Talents, one of which being the aforementioned Excavator with the second being {{t|Rock Blaster}}; this will double your mining output with a chance to quadruple it through Excavator. This equipment is a must have when it comes to farming for bombs. *[[Coal]] can be purchased from any [[Blacksmith]] for {{c|notes|15}}. *[[The Viper's Jaw]] is home to many materials needed to create bombs, having a rich balance of coal and iron. **An alternative to [[The Viper's Jaw]] is the [[Widow's Hollow]], above the Starswept sands. *If you manage to get your hands on [[Pumpkin Pitch]], you can use this as a feint for your bombs, keeping your opponent busy and unsure whether you're throwing a fake or real bomb. ==Gallery== Bomb.png File:Placed bomb.gif|An Iron bomb being placed File:Bomb throw.gif|An Iron bomb being thrown File:Bomb jump.gif|A bomb jump being performed ==Trivia== *Bombs can interact with and destroy terrain. *You can kill mobs quickly with bombs, but PvE scaling dependent on your power plays a huge factor in this. Talents as Underdog greatly improve the usage for bombs in PvE. *[https://www.youtube.com/@TijnHams/videos The biggest bomb preacher] *[https://youtu.be/yEaDf1yHxCg?si=3a6atZGJYWW_YNpW Helpful guide] [[Category:Items]]

==Description==
The Iron Mask is is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Face" category. It can be found in chests in [[Lower Erisia]].

The Iron Mask is a mask made out of an unknown alloy (presumably iron) inlaid with a black fabric in the interior. Two angular holes are bored into the mask. Additionally, Two slits built vertically are on each side of the mask. When worn, the Iron Mask completely covers the wearer's face.

== Trivia ==
* The Iron Mask is seen at the [[Antiquarian]] at [[Etris]]. However, the player cannot interact or buy it.
* May or may not be a reference Mark 1 armor from Ironman.
* The description is a reference to The Man In The Iron Mask, an unidentified political prisoner held during the reign of Louis XV, France, who was forced to use an Iron Mask by the state.

==Description==
The Iron Requiem is a Legendary [[Ironsing]]-Scaling Pistol obtained within Ignition Union territories, most commonly through the [[Saramaed Hollow]] dungeon. Unlike other Pistols, it may only be used as a '''Main Hand''' weapon, but an offhand weapon can still be used alongside it.

The Iron Requiem has a [[Bullet]] capacity of 6, meaning you get a little over one full string of M1 attacks and 6 Ranged critical attacks.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center>
File:StandingRequiem.gif|Standing Critical
File:MetalLament.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>For the '''standing critical''', the user fires a large bullet that explodes on contact. The critical has 42 base damage with 5 Ironsing Scaling, dealing 63 damage at 100 Ironsing. Deals 14 posture damage if blocked.

For the '''running critical''', whip around wildly and continuously fire the pistol around your opponent, applying a rod each time the pistol is fired. This critical can fire up to 4 or less bullets, and will not work if there is no ammo loaded. This attack has a base damage of 12 per hit with 5 Ironsing scaling, dealing 18 damage per hit at 100 Ironsing. Deals 1.5 posture damage per hit if blocked.

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''7 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Iron Requiem Equipped.png|Equipped
Iron Requiem Gilded Equipped.png|Equipped (Gilded)
Iron Requiem close up.png|Close up
Iron Requiem Gilded close up.png|Close up (Gilded)
Iron Requiem Transparent.png|Transparent
Iron Requiem Gilded Transparent.png|Transparent (Gilded)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The description previously had "print(4*1) Reverse-engineered..." in it.
*The Ironsing icon is engraved on both sides of the gun.
*The {{t|Sleight of Hand}} Talent procs on dual guns, reloading one bullet on flourish, despite stating it's single gun only. Because of this, you can use Iron Requiem's running critical on dual guns.
*Along with the [[Soulwrought Gun]] and [[Rosen's Roscoe]], these are the only three pistols in the game to play a unique sound effect on M1/crit.
*This Weapon is likely a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JoJo%27s_Bizarre_Adventure JoJo's Bizarre Adventure] Reference. The gun most likely being a reference to [https://jojo.fandom.com/wiki/Hol_Horse Hol Horse's] [https://jojo.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor Emperor]. This is also shown in this Weapon's Name "Iron '''''Requiem'''''" likely coming from [https://jojo.fandom.com/wiki/Gold_Experience_Requiem Gold Experience '''''Requiem'''''] or [https://jojo.fandom.com/wiki/Chariot_Requiem Silver Chariot '''''Requiem''''']

title: Iron Vessel
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{Memento |image=Iron Vessel Memento.png |description=A master of iron - both in blade, and in the song. |starting health=160 |starting attributes=*5 Ironsing *3 Medium Weapon *5 Fortitude *1 Agility *2 Intelligence |final attributes=*100 Ironsing *50 Medium Weapon *100 Fortitude *10 Agility *70 Intelligence |starting traits=*5 Songchant *5 Proficiency *1 Dexterity *1 Erudition |final traits=*6 Songchant *6 Proficiency *2 Dexterity *2 Erudition |starting armor=[[Blacksteel Attire]] |allowed weapons=Sword, Club, Dagger |starting weapons=[[Ferractine]] |unlock=Defeat {{Iv|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)}} }} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. A being of iron that wields [[Ironsing]], the Iron Vessel is effectively impervious to damage if not pushed to their limits. The lightest of blows become mere scratches, but should they falter in their defence, their shell shatters, making them suffer greatly. ==Unique Features== Instead of taking any health damage, automatically block the hit and take posture damage instead, this posture is affected by armor and defense such as Isshin's Ring. Parrying or Spitting gives back far less posture. Reaching full posture guard breaks you and causes you to receive '''significantly increased damage from the attack that caused the guard break. This may pose to be fatal, depending on the attack.''' This may even pierce Death Nullifications such as [[Memory Shard]]s. All sources of healing are significantly reduced (e.g [[Etris Flask]]s). {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*[[Oath: Bladeharper|{{cl|oathtl|Oath: Bladeharper}}]] [Oath Talent] - You vow to carry your blades as an instrument, to lend yourself to any cause it guides you to. Collapse the infinite number of possibilities ahead of you into just one. The blade keeps you as much as you keep it. *{{cl|advancedtl|Alloyblood}} [Advanced Talent] - You don't bleed like others do. Bleed damage reduced by 30%. Blood loss is reduced by 75%. **While at 100 Ironsing, bleed damage is reduced from 15% scaled damage to 10.5%. Bleed from {{cl|raretlnf|Speed Demon}} is reduced from 7.5% scaled damage to 5.25%. **Blood loss reduction is less effective if you are using the [[Curse of the No Life King]] Enchantment. **Alloyblood's effects linearly scale with Ironsing investment up to its requirement, losing 0.3% bleed damage reduction and 0.75% blood loss reduction per point in Ironsing below 100. **Makes your blood a shade of light grey when being attacked by a bleed damage attack. *{{iv|i|Reforged Alloy}} [Weapon Talent] - Anytime you consume iron rods using Metal Pull or any Rending Needle technique, reduce the cooldown of your next critical based on the amount of rods consumed. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Steelvessel}} [Memento Talent] - Landed attacks deal posture damage but when guard broken take massive damage. Posture gain on parry is reduced. **Take posture damage instead of health damage. You can be guardbroken by being hit. ***Some things like fall damage will ignore this and deal slight health damage. **Upon being guardbroken, the damage you take will be massively increased. This can prove fatal and ignore certain lifelines such as [[Memory Shard]]s. **Posture restoration from parrying attacks is reduced. **All forms of healing, most notably [[Etris Flask]]s are massively reduced. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Iron Quills (★★☆) |image=Iron Quills.gif |desc=Conjure metal from within, impaling surrounding entities. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|ironsing|Metal}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} + {{cl|bleed}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Send metal spikes piercing through your body, impaling all nearby targets.'' *Has a base damage of 20/22/24/26/28 per level with innate {{cl|bleed}} damage and 2.75 Ironsing scaling. *Deals 12.5 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.45 seconds with a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Casting Iron Quills doesn't break your momentum, allowing you to sprint at full speed during the casting animation. *Despite blood particles appearing from your body on cast, it doesn't deal any self damage. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Metal Rampart (☆☆☆) |image=Metal Pillar.gif |desc=Summon a large metal pillar. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ironsing|Metal}} + {{stats|blunt|Blunt}} + {{cl|bleed}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Form a pillar from below, causing the character to ascend upwards as the pillar forms.'' *Deals damage on placedown with a very small AoE. *Has a base damage of 10/14/18/22/26 with innate {{cl|bleed}} damage and 2.75 Ironsing scaling. *Deals 8 posture damage. *0.5 second windup before damage is dealt, 1.5 second windup before the pillar is fully created. *The pillar lasts 6 seconds at base with a 15 second cooldown. The duration increases by 1 second per upgrade, reaching a total maximum of 10s. *Has 9.2x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.2 for PvE damage). *The height of the pillar will depend on what is above the user. *Can be modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloudstones/Stratus Stones]] to extend its width. *Can be modified with [[Aeon Logstone|Aeon/Eternal Logstones]] to extend its duration. }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Battle Tendency [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen. (+2 Posture, +10 Sanity) **In combat, by not running/blocking regenerate posture passively, Battle Tendency increases this regen by +20%. *Dancing Guard [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Parrying an opponent and then parrying another enemy in quick succession applies slow for 7s. *Metal Eater [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - When you have no ether, consume Armor durability to cast your Ironsing mantras. **If you can't cast a mantra due to a lack of ether, consume ~30% total armor durability to cast it. ***Always takes 30% armor, doesn't scale with ether to cast, aka 1 or 9999 ether mantra will always take only 30% armor. *Metal Thief [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Pulling an opponent absorbs a portion of their current Armor durability. **Each rod will steal 2% of your opponent's current armor durability. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Enforcer Pull (★★☆) |image=Enforcer Pull.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=A powerful gravitational pull. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''Create a vacuum of space from your hand, auto-tracking enemies and pulling them in. Based on the [[The Enforcer|Enforcer]]'s ''''Space Pull'''' attack.'' *Missing still takes Ether and does not put this mantra on cooldown. *The set Talent "'''Enforcer's Pull'''" from [[Reinforced Enforcer Plate]] and [[Reinforced Enforcer Boots]] heavily decreases the windup of the pull after landing a flourish. *Can be modified with Crystal and Perfect lens to increase range }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Metal Kick (★☆☆) |image=Metal kick.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=A powerful kick laced with metal. |ethercost={{stats|ether|30 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ironsing|Metal}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''Jump vertically into the air before slamming down with an axe-kick, dealing moderate damage and applying knockdown to any targets hit.'' *Has a base damage of 7.2/13.2/19.2/25.2/31.2 per level with 2.75 Ironsing scaling. *Deals 14 posture damage. *Has a 13 second cooldown. *Has 9.2x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.2 for PvE damage). *Spring Spark has a wind up of 0.55 second and non spark a wind-up of 0.95s (0.65s to enter gain height and enter fall state + 0.4s or more seconds to land(depending on ur fall distance)) *Your base Metal Kick can't be Interrupted once you enter fall state, but you still can be hitstunned. Basically you will hit your enemy with Metal Kick but won't be able to attack after landing Metal Kick. *Can be modified with a [[Spring Spark]] that causes the Mantra to perform a faster drop-kick that doesn't apply knockdown. File:Metal Kick Spring Spark.gif|Spring Spark }}
===Power 5===
*{{cl|factiontl|Armored Plating}} [Faction Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Put on extra plating on your armor, giving you 50 temp health whenever you are put in combat. Due to the weight of this additional plating, you have reduced speed at all times. **Gain 50 Temporary Health whenever combat starts at the cost of having a passive movement speed debuff even outside of combat. *Moving Fortress [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking no longer slows you down as much. (+1 Posture) **Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to a -20%. *{{cl|raretl|Champion's Regalia}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Flourishing an opponent grants you +50% posture damage on Basic Attacks for 10 seconds. (+1 Carry Load) **Indicated by a gold shaded outline on your character. **Does not work on non-humanoid NPCs. **Works only if you successfully hit someone with flourish. Doesn't work on parry, block, dodge hits. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Rocket Lance (★★★) |image=Rocket Lance.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Create a lance, impale your opponent, and send them flying. |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ironsing|Metal}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} + {{cl|bleed}} |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''After a small wind-up, conjure an iron claw on the character's left arm before thrusting forward, pushing back any targets in the way.'' *Has a base damage of 15/23/31/39/47 per level with innate {{cl|bleed}} damage and 2.75 Ironsing scaling. *Deals 10 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.5 seconds with a cooldown of 13 seconds. *Has 9.2x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.2 for PvE damage). *Comparable to Galebreathe's [[Gale Lunge]] Mantra and Frostdraw's [[Ice Lance]] Mantra. }}
===Power 10===
*Risky Defense [Equipment Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Decrease how much posture damage you take from physical attacks by 25%, but take 50% more posture damage from mantras. **Increases incoming posture damage from Mantras by 50%. **Decreases incoming posture damage from weapon attacks by 25% *Unwavering Focus [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - When your mantras are parried, receive less posture (scales with intelligence). *Unwavering Resolve [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Getting parried punishes your posture 33% less. (+2 Posture, +4 Carry Load) **The posture reduction effect is reduced by 0.433% for every point in Strength below 40. **Because Iron Vessel has 0 Strength, this will only grant 15.66% posture reduction from being parried. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Alloy of the Heavens}} [Memento Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - Posture attack from mobs reduced by 50% **Reduces posture damage taken from mobs by 50%. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Metal Armament (★★★) |mantratype=Combat Mantra |image=Metal armament.gif |desc=Summon a blade of metal to swing alongside you. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ironsing|Metal}} + {{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''Coat the character's body and weapon in iron sparks. While active, a greatsword is conjured and moves as light attacks are being performed with an attack interval of 3 seconds.'' *Has a base damage of 20, this does not increase with levels but has 2.75 Ironsing scaling. *Deals 4 posture damage. *Metal Armament lasts 20 seconds at level 5 with a 30 second cooldown. *Has a 0.6 second windup on attack, massively delaying the armament hit. *Has 5.15x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 5.15 for PvE damage). *Applies very brief parry stun to user and gives very brief auto parry frames to opponent if parried. *Upgrading the level increases the duration of the Mantra. *Does not proc any "on hit" [[Deep Gems]]. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Master's Flourish (☆☆☆) |image=Master flourish.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=A powerful slash that chips through block and slashes through armor. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User performs a spinning double slice with their sword.'' *Deals 3+5.4/6+10.8/9+16.2/12+21.6/15+27 base damage per level with 1.65 Medium Weapon scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage per hit (2). *Initial hit has 0.525 wind-up with the follow-up having 0.4s wind-up. *Master's Flourish has 0.35s endlag. *Deals Chip Damage. *Deals knockback. *Can be modified with a Glass/Magnifying stone to make it bigger. }}

Once you teleport to a new enemy, hit them with a significantly weakened Decimate and proc a flurry of slashes. The weakened decimate deals 0.1 damage and the slashes deal 12 damage total (3 slashes that deal 4 damage each). **Deals a total of 49.74 Oath & Slash damage in Reveal (18.67 * 2 base hits + 0.1 teleport + (4 * 3 slashes)) *Direct hits '''autogrip''' players if low enough or knocked. title: Ironsing
content:
{{Quotes|quote=I have some theories. It's said that the discovery of Pluripotent Alloy was what led to Ironsing's development, and that's the line of questioning I've chosen to follow. Interestingly, they say that the combination of a catalyst and the right frame of mind are what induce the attunement to an element of the Song.|author=Adar, Master of Metal}}[[File:Ironsing.png|thumb|Ironsing Icon]] ==Description== '''Ironsing''' is an [[Attunement]] based around the ability to harness and manipulate metal, commonly used by Blacksmiths around the Luminants. Ironsingers make use of applying Metal Rods to enemies, allowing for a variety of interactions depending on the chosen Talents. Most primarily, accumulating enough Metal Rods on a target will allow the user to perform an '''Iron Pull''', which will cause the target to be dragged towards the user by pressing {{Input|input=X}}. ==Obtainment== The [[Attunement Trainers|Attunement Trainer]], [[Adar]], can be found inside a tower on the left side of the end of [[Saramaed Crossing]] at [[Miner's Landing]], on the path to the [[Starfield Veldt]]. This bridge always spawns two [[Brainsucker]]s. To unlock Ironsing, you must first have a [[Pluripotent Alloy]]. Then, talk to the blacksmith at [[Miner's Landing]]. He will say that a friend of his is looking for a Pluripotent Alloy. '''If you have obtained Ironsing before, obtaining a [[Pluripotent Alloy]] and talking to the blacksmith is not required.''' Go to the trainer and he will tell you that he is looking for 6 [[ore]]s. '''The ores you need are:''' *[[Iron]] *[[Gold]] *[[Erisore]] *[[Irithine]] *[[Astruline]] *[[Umbrite]] After you give him these ores, he will give you an Alloyed Elixir. Drink the Elixir, and you will unlock Ironsing. '''DO NOT LEAVE THE TEXT BOX BEFORE RECEIVING THE ELIXIR.''' Doing so will cause the trainer to consume your ores without giving you the potion. The easiest way to obtain all of the required ores without visiting [[The Depths]] is to obtain them from chest and [[Mechalodaunt]] drops in [[Saramaed Hollow]] along with mining ores in [[Saramaed Summit]]. Alternatively, you may visit the cave in [[Songseeker Wilds]] and kill [[Mineskipper]]s, which can drop all the ores necessary. ==Training== {{text|att-training |train=using the [[Ferrofluid]] to increase the attribute after landing {{PAGENAME}} Mantras to gain enough EXP |trainer=[[Adar]] at [[Miner's Landing]] }} ===Mantra Damage Calculation=== {{text|mantracalc}} ==Cantrip(s)== Cantrips are, often minor, passive abilities that are granted upon obtaining any Mantra from the respective Attunement. ===Ore Siphon=== This Cantrip allows the player to mine [[Ores]] with their Ironsing abilities, taking priority over their [[Pickaxe]] if they have one. Ore Siphon's visual effect will become yellow if the user has {{t|Gilded Path: Scrapsinger}}. Currently does not work on [[Saramaed Hollow]] fuel. File:Default Iron Cantrip.gif|Default Ironsing Cantrip File:Gilded Iron Cantrip.gif|Gilded Ironsing Cantrip ===Stainless=== This Cantrip hides all visual tears the player's [[Outfit]] gains when their armor durability is low. This is purely visual. The {{t|Not a Scratch}} Talent also provides this effect, among other things. {{col|sec|

Mantras

After reaching 10 metal rods, opponent will take extra 5% DMG until rod stacks will drop below 10. |} ==Gallery== File:K1IronsingPath.png|Developer K1LLUA announcing the Ironsing path: Scrapsing in #polls, asking for either Trick or Treat ==Trivia== *Ironsing was first accidentally leaked in a weekly update, and later confirmed to be an upcoming attunement by Arch_Mage in a bug report later that day. **Prior to the leak, Ironsing was originally supposed to be an Oath, as stated by Arch_Mage *Ironsing did not create the Ironclad. The Ironclad was constructed by shipwrights and shipped from The Central Luminant. *Iron Rods last 30 seconds each with no way to be refreshed unless removed and reapplied. *Iron Pull has a 0.1s animation with 0.4s endlag, though it ''is'' parryable. *On release, Ironsing had 12 mantras and 11 Talents, making it the most content lacking Attunement during its release. *Ironsing is the only Attunement to have five 3-star Mantras. *{{cl|mtl|'''Needle Barrage'''}} is practically identical to Autumn Rain from Monad Studios' '''Rogue Lineage'''. *{{cl|mtl|'''Firing Line'''}} could be a reference to [https://fategrandorder.fandom.com/wiki/Oda_Nobunaga Oda Nobunaga] from the ''Fate/Series'', in which her signature move being shooting a line of matchlock rifles towards her enemy. **It could also be a toned down version of an attack used by [https://bleach.fandom.com/wiki/Gremmy_Thoumeaux Gremmy Thoumeaux] from the ''Bleach'' Series, where he summons an arsenal of guns behind him and shoots at an enemy. *{{cl|mtl|'''Metal Gatling'''}} could be a reference to [https://onepiece.fandom.com/wiki/Charlotte_Katakuri Katakuri's] move called "Mochi Gatling" from the anime ''One Piece''. *Ironsing is the fastest Attunement to obtain a Legendary Weapon, with the [[Ignition Deepcrusher]] released in the exact same update as Ironsing itself. *Ironsing is one of two Attunements that does not have a [[Hero Blades|Hero Blade]], with the only other being [[Bloodrend]]. *'''{{cl|advancedtlnf|Alloyblood}}''' turns your [[Bloodrend]] mantras blue-ish grey. *Using ores actually gives you a buff; the only ones that you can use as of now are Gold, Irithine and Erisore, but only one has a known effect. This is a holdover from Ironsings development time as an Oath, being initially heavily inspired by "Allomancy" a magic system based on ingesting metals from Brandon Sandersons "Mistborn" Series of books. **Using [[Gold]] gives a 5% damage buff to M1s and a gold particle effect for 25 seconds. **Using [[Irithine]] gives a green particle effect. Effects unknown. *Similarly to every other Wisp Mantra, {{cl|mtl|'''Metal Wisp'''}} gives the player a finger on the hand that casts the Mantra. *Ferrofluid, the item required to train Ironsing, is an actual real-life fluid attracted to magnetic forces, created by suspending iron or other magnetically-affected particles in a solution, usually oil. *Caltrops in real life are small, spiked weapons originally used as early as the Roman times to be used against men and horses. Later versions of Caltrops were used in the second world war to deflate tires of automobiles. *The icons for Ironsing Talents formerly featured the symbol for Frostdraw. It was replaced with a unique icon during the 30th of August, 2024 update, 466 days after the attunement's release. *The support Mantra {{cl|mtl|'''Iron Skin'''}}, especially the Scrapsinger variant, might or might not be a reference to "The Indestructible Virgin" from ''Scissor Seven''. https://scissorseven.fandom.com/wiki/He_Dachun ==References== {{Nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

==Description==
Ishan is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They are an employee of [[The Summer Company]] ruminating on the origins of the [[Adret]].

If spoken to while being an Adret, their dialogue changes.

==Location==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Ishan Location.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" |You ever think about the {{g|Adret}}? They really aren't like the rest of us.
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Uhh...
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|action}} |[Player is an Adret]
| colspan="1" {{cl|action}} |[Player is not an Adret]
|-
| colspan="1" |Oh. Uh. No offence. Just, well, the rest of the people in this world take after animals, right? Whereas you... Well, you don't, right?
| colspan="1" |Well, the rest of us each take after animals, right? Snakes, deers, insects, and so on. But the {{g|Adret|Adret..}}. They don't have any of those traits, do they?
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |I guess.
|-
| colspan="2" |Not to mention their origins are a little unclear, no? I've done some reading. Of Old Texts, right?
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Go on.
|-
| colspan="2" |So these old books speak here and there of the people back then, only, there's no mention of the {{g|Adret}} anywhere. It's like they came into existence with the waves themselves...
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Gallery==
<gallery>
Ishan.png|Old Outfit
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Their assumptions are a bit of a red herring, as Adret already existed prior to their spread, and have no actual link to the ocean. Their sudden appearance was due to rising sea levels bringing their mountaintop homes closer to the ground. While their spread was motivated by the ocean, the ocean is not responsible for their existence.

== Description ==
Ishmael is a [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

Ishmael is capable of crafting [[Monster Bait]], and giving out the recipes for it to the player. The bait requires two of the respective drops from the monsters. These monsters are:
*[[Megalodaunt]]: [[Megalodaunt Hide]]s
*[[Thresher]]: [[Thresher Spine]]s
*[[Terrapod]]: [[Strange Claw]]s

==Location==
Ishmael is located in a fishing hut, on a rocky island in the ocean near the [[Isle of Vigils]].

title: Isle of Vigils
content:
{{Location|name=Isle of Vigils|territory=Etrea|caption=A solemn sanctuary carved in stone, where warriors hone the dancing steps of war.}}
[[File:Isle of Vigils.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Isle of Vigils''' is a [[Locations|starting location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a settlement found in [[The Etrean Sea]].

== Overview ==
The Isle of Vigils is a collection of small islands that hold the [[Temple Approach]] and the [[Temple of the Blade]], as well as a few necessities to get you started on your progression. 

== Landmarks & Sub locations==
*[[Temple of the Blade]]
**[[Temple Approach]]
**[[Vigil's Mark]]
**[[Temple Sparring Hall]]

==Potential Enemies==
<gallery columns="dynamic" spacing="small" orientation="none" widths="120" navigation="true" position="center" captionposition="below" captionalign="center" captionsize="medium" bordersize="small" hideaddbutton="true">
File:Vigil guard.png|link=Blade Temple Guard|[[Blade Temple Guard]]
File:Bandit.png|link=Bandit|[[Bandit]]
File:Friid Enemy.png|[[Friid, Master of Gale]]
</gallery>

==Points of Interest==
===Camp===
* Players can find [[Friid]], a Celtor [[Spelltrainers|spelltrainer]] who can upgrade your [[Galebreathe]] [[Mantras]].
* Players can find a permanent [[campfire]] here.
* Player can buy [[Pathfinder Cloak]] outfit inside the tent.

===Inn===
* Players can spend {{c|notes|5}} to change their spawn location.

===Mantra Shop===
* Players will find a [[Gear Cabinet]], allowing them to purchase any Training Gear for {{c|notes|25}} each.
* Players can find the [[Barber]], who can change your looks.
* Players can also purchase two schematics here: 
**[[Vigil Initiate]] for {{c|notes|45}}.
**[[Cutthroat Light Armor]] for {{c|notes|45}}.

*Near the Mantra Shop, there is a destructible wall. Behind the wall contains some small chests and the [[Cave Master]] who sells [[Mantra Modifiers]].

[[File:Wall.png|thumb|The wall]]

===Bank & Antiquarian===
*Players can find a Banker to access their [[Item Bank]] and turn in [[Artifacts]] to.
*Players can find an [[Antiquarian]] who will purchase their sellable items.

===[[Mantra Collector]]===
*Players can find Cumberland, a [[Canor]] who will buy your [[Mantra Modifiers]] and [[Gems]].

===Ziplines===
*A zipline can be found near the Antiquarian, which is used as a shortcut to the docks.
*Up in the mountains, (climb from the bottom of temple via trees) there is a zipline. This zipline will lead to a mountain, where a chest usually spawns up there.<!-- Don't delete this bullet point -->
*Taking the zipline near the mantra shop leads you to a sword needed to complete [[Nanji|Nanji's]] Quest.

==Missions==
Events that spawn in Isle of Vigils that involve combat. For more info, see [[Random Encounters]].

*[[Bandit]] Attack (rewards EXP and Etrea Reputation)

==Quests==
''Not what you're looking for? See [[Temple of the Blade#Quests|Temple of the Blade Quests]].''

===<u>Lumberjack Quest</u>===

*Talk to the Etrean that is idling next to a log, near the Bank.
*She will ask you to chop wood for her so that they have a sustainable supply of lumber for the Winter.
*Accepting her quest gives you a Lumber Axe for free.
*Asking her about Etrea increases your Intellegence stat, indicated by a white particle effect.
*Acts similar to Korin in Etris; 6 Wood for {{c|notes|5}}, plus Etrea [[reputation]] and some EXP.
*This quest is repeatable.

===<u>Treefelling Blow Talent Quest</u>===
{{Quotes|quote=...But that's okay. Their muscles just aren't big enough to comprehend it. You now wield the sum knowledge of ALL lumberjacks, after all.|author=End Quest Dialogue}}
'''[This Quest requires the 'Strong Left' Strength Mantra.]'''

* Talk to the same Etrean NPC that gives you the Lumberjack Quest; and tell her that you can get wood through punching.
*Bewildered, the Etrean offers the Player to Strong Left 5 Trees for research.
* After 5 Trees has been Strong Left'd, return to the Lumberjack and gain the Talent.

===<u>Travelling Blade</u>===
*Ilji's broken sword. Worth telling [[Nanji|his sister]] about it.

===<u>Lost Sibling</u>===
'''[The quest does not require Weapons 75 to complete.]'''
* Talk to the crying Vigil guard, Apprentice Kj, on the other side of the library.
* He will tell you about his lost brother and will ask you to rescue him.
* Go deep into the [[Burning Stone Gardens]], his brother will be near the [[Tomb of the Nameless Warrior]]. [[File:Vigil Isaac Map.png|thumb|91x91px]]
*Bring him a Gale Stone.
*Hold out the Gale Stone when you talk to him to give it to him.
* Go back and talk to Apprentice Kj.
* Then go to the [[Evengarde Rest|Maestro]], facing opposite the sparring instructor, with the white cloak.
* Talk to him to unbound your weapon proficiency by picking your weapon type.

===<u>Seroth</u>===
*Taking a zipline to a mountain near the docks of vigils will lead to a destructible wall.
*Inside players can find [[Seroth]], an Etrean Royal Guard observing the corpse of a [[Ministry]] agent.
*Upon speaking with Seroth players can obtain the [[Ancient Dagger Remains]] that can be used to craft the [[Sanguine Transfuser]].

==Trivia==
*The music for this area is [[To Shores, Distant]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]
*Though it may be closer to [[Erisia]], Vigils is often much less travelled than Etris and can be considered a worse spawn location.
*Vigils has one of the best [[fishing]] spots which is near the docks. There is a high chance of a fishing up a chest.
*The Isle of Vigils used to be attached to [[Etris]], but now they are separate.

==Description==
Isshin's Ring is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Rings" category.

It makes the wearer deal 15% more damage, but also take 20% more damage. Isshin's ring actually stacks with [[Ring of Casters]], making it specially useful for mage builds.

Both the increased damage dealt, and the increased incoming damage are applied as damage modifiers to the respective attacker, meaning Isshin's Ring ''is'' affected by the damage modifier cap.

This is inherently risky to use, especially since it doesn't bypass the game's damage cap mechanics, but can prove useful for doing massive burst damage or when trying to kill [[Bosses]] one is more experienced with quickly.

==Trivia==
*The name and item description may be a reference to [https://sekiro-shadows-die-twice.fandom.com/wiki/Isshin_Ashina Isshin Ashina] from ''Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice'', which heavily inspired much of ''Deepwoken'' and its combat.

File:Item Bank UI New.png|New Bank UI as of {{VersionHistory|2026|January 20th}}
</gallery>

== Overview ==
The Item Bank is a way of securely storing and transferring items on your account, even across different slots. They are accessible at any [[Banker]], including the one found in the [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]]. To store an item, click and drag an item from your inventory to a slot in the bank.

Item Banks initially have 6 item slots, though you can purchase more with [[Notes]]. The Note cost per slot increases based on the amount of slots you have. The item slot count caps at 102.

====Cost Per Slot====
Unlocking every slot in the Item Bank costs {{c|notes|624,000}}.
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table" style="text-align: center"

|}

== Restrictions ==
Along with this ability comes several limitations, being that certain items of significance are treated differently or have requirements to be stored in the bank. 

*When storing any items rare items such as most [[Relics]], [[Monster Mantras|Monster Parts]], '''Soulbounded''' [[weapons]] or [[equipment]], or [[Hallowtide]] exclusive items, you will be prompted to spend 1 [[Knowledge]] to withdraw the item.
**Some Unique or Legendary tier items will require a Vow of Safekeeping to be banked, even if it hasn't been soulbound.
*When storing weapons or equipment items, they will take up their own slot and cannot stack like regular items do.
*Starter weapons obtained from [[Echoes]] cannot be banked unless they are [[Enchantments|enchanted]].
*You can have a max of 100,000 Notes in your bank account at a time.
*Attempting to stack an item that you already have stored while having all slots filled will not work, and you will have to take an item out to complete your stack.
**For example, if you have 5 [[Mushroom Soup]] stored in your bank, and you are trying to stack another 5, you may need to remove a different item first.

==Miscellaneous==
*The item bank follows the rules of how items are displayed in chests: if an item in a chest stacks, then it can stack in the bank.
*You cannot store any item in the tools category.
*Most quest rewards (like the [[Pleeksty's Inferno]] and [[Poser's Ring]]) cannot be banked.
*You cannot be attacked while in the GUI.
*[[Food]] items can be banked.

Down Below are links to a list of items in Deepwoken

==[[Mantra Modifiers]]==
'''Mantra Modifiers''' are items that can be used to expand the potential of the player's [[Mantras]]. These can easily be found by killing most enemies and can also be found in Erisia Chests.

==[[Weapons]]==
Tools constructed with the intent to harm others, polished to be efficient killing devices. They can be bought from shops or obtained from chests.

==[[Equipment]]==
An essential mechanic in Deepwoken, primarily used to resist damage from most sources, while also giving many different benefits. Though it can also be used for cosmetic purposes. Found in chests, exchanged for using an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] or by various other means.

==[[Treasures]]==
Glistening gemstones and metals that can fetch a modest price. They can commonly be obtained from chests.

==[https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Fishing#Fish Fish]==
Creatures of the sea, usually cooked into delicious delicacies. They can be obtained by fishing.

==[[Books]]==
Books are items that are found in the world of Deepwoken and are a separate category from loot, tools, weapons, etc. Books can be obtained by looting the various bookshelves around the world (10%-15% chance) or as a guaranteed item sold at a Traveling Merchant Ship.

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} was an {{cl|spec|'''unobtainable'''}} stunning [[enchantment]] that could stop time briefly.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} changed your weapon's critical. On use, it would plant your weapon in the ground, creating a Stasis Sphere around yourself for a duration. Anyone in the Stasis Sphere, excluding the caster, would not have been able to act or see any actions made within the Sphere for the duration of the Sphere.

The duration and AoE of the Stasis Sphere is based on the amount of M1 attacks you land prior to activating your critical. Each landed M1 increased the Stasis Sphere's duration by 1 second. Caps at 15 seconds.

The creation of the Stasis Sphere is parryable, granting yourself immunity to the effects. While it could have also been dodged and blocked, doing so would not have benefitted you much, as you would still be stuck in stasis. This critical could also have been interrupted by hitting the user during the animation.

Upon being blockbroken, a unique visual effect would play and the guardbreak stun would be negated.

==Trivia==
After the Operation: Deep Healing update, all copies of [[JOE's]] were converted to [[Heroism]].

title: Jar of Souls
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Consume the souls of your enemies and unleash them in devastating attacks.|author=Jar of Souls description}}
{{Resonance|effect=Collects souls, can be used as damage output against players.|appearance=White beam that appears in front of the user.|
image1 =<gallery>
Souljargif.gif|Jar of Souls
Jar of souls card.jpg|Card
File:Jar of Souls Corrupt Card.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
==Description==
'''Jar of Souls''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll. 
===''Appearance''===
On input, souls can be found and absorbed near deceased humanoids and monsters. It uses a soul counter to indicate the amount of souls the player has. 

On output, the user fires a large, bright beam in front of them. Deals around 120 damage in PvP and 1,000 damage in PvE.

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Jar of Souls''' Resonance. This has a 30 second cooldown.

Passively, '''Jar of Souls''' store the souls of dead humanoids and monsters nearby. Different souls recharge the resonance in different amounts (this will of course vary from person to person based on their own resonance point usage). However, you'll find higher-tier entities recharge the resonance faster than lower tier, e.g, it may only take one Primal Golem's soul to recharge to capacity, whereas in contrast, it may take 10 Bandit Leader's souls to recharge to capacity. 

Activating the resonance fires a white beam that deals damage.

=== ''Resonance Point usage'' ===
When obtained, Jar of Soul will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Beam type:''' Decides the type of beam that will be used.
** The burst beam is a singular beam that uses all stored souls at once to deal damage in one instance. Doing around 56 damage based on soul count.
** The "continuous" beam is a long-lasting beam that hits multiple times and uses the souls stored over time. Hold {{Input|input=C}} to keep firing the laser if available.
*'''Refill multiplier:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the easier it is to recharge the resonance to full.
*'''Auto Execute:''' Decides if your attack can auto execute (Must have at least one soul to do this)
*'''Range:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the further the beam can reach.
*{{cl|corres|'''Corrupted Jar of Souls''' has more resonance points allocated as compared to regular Jar of Souls.}}

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Soul Manipulation.png|Soul capturing
File:Jar of Souls dot.png|Jar of Souls indicator
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*It may be a reference to the Urn of Souls from The Binding of Isaac which also requires you to kill enemies to shoot it.
**It may also be a reference to an item of the same name from Risk of Rain, which summons similar ghosts.
*[[Rock Golem|Golems]], which are formed using the souls of villagers, have human souls.
*The first bell with a passive ability, the second being [[Resurrection]].
*Your bell will shows up to five dots depending on how many souls you've gather to max it out.
*Not to be confused with [[Remnants of Soul]].

==Description==
Jarvis is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]] who is able to smelt two pieces of equipment into one.

His main use is to [[Smelting|Smelt]] two pieces of equipment for {{c|notes|1000}} Notes; the first keeping its attributes, the second being its overall appearance. 
* The first item you hold out to them will always be the one you keep the stats of, and the second will be the one you keep the appearance of.
* This will ''not combine'' stats, only replaces them, with the item you want to keep the appearance of losing its stats completely and gaining the other item's stats.
** For a further, more in-depth explanation, see ''[[Transmogrification]].''

title: Jericho's Journal
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} [[File:Jericho's Journal.png|right|255x255px]] {{clear}} ==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Book]] found in [[Fort Merit]]. ==Text== ===
Jericho's Journal
===
I'm torn. Torn between my position - the torch passed to me - and the {{g|Vows}} I have made. I am but one, but I stretch myself paper-thin. Perhaps I must accept that things are out of my hands now. My hearts twists knowing that the people of this land will soon be casualties in a war beyond their reckoning. A war we could have stopped. The strings that bind this land, and the hand that moves them. They belong to that ''thing'' that deigns to call itself a Lord. We, the Circle, have failed. Zi'eer has resurfaced. How short-sighted we must be, for it was in the arms of our old enemy that we found him. Surely now, the Contractors must be gathering in their ranks. And in our lack of vision, the machines we swore to hold in checks now move beyond us, set now upon the tracks laid by the Prophets. All we can do now is struggle - see how far we can jam our limbs into the spokes of the war engine before they break us too. Failing that, we must make good on the vengeances owed to us. Or there can be no honour.
[[Category:Books]]

==Description==
Jessamine is a [[Ganymede]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Talking to them will start a quest that allows [[the Pathfinder]] to obtain the Talent "Thresher Scales" to regain armor at campfires. 

===Location===
Jessamine is located underneath some ruins. They are near the Legion Camp that is just outside of the entrance to the [[Widow's Hollow]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Jessamine Map.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Tch.. I'm afraid I cannot push myself further. Keep your wits about you in this place, lest you want to meet an untimely end.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Untimely end?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Those threshers.. they're tougher than they seem. Their scales make them heavily resistant to my attacks, and are near impossible to fight a group on my own. They seem to follow a leader of their pack, a king thresher. Despite the scales' worth.. I'm not sure if I should press on.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What makes the scales have worth?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A king thresher?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ah, you see, they're a premium in the arms business. They seem to carry regenerative properties, slowly repairing even the bulkiest of armors over time when exposed to heat. However, without killing the king thresher, it's too dangerous for me to safely harvest them.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Indeed, a king thresher lurks within these sands. It tends to come with backup, making it all the more difficult to take it on. Say, if you can perhaps slay it, I could sneak past and gather scales. However.. I highly suggest bringing comrades. Kings are not an opponent you should combat alone.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A king thresher?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll take them on.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Looks like we have a deal then! Depending on the harvest, I may have an extra Thresher Scale to grant you as well. Return to me once the deed is done, and I'll share how my harvest went.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest End=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Friend, I've been waiting for the opportunity to see you again!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has not killed a King Thresher
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has killed a King Thresher
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The pleasure is mine.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I've slain the king thresher. How was the harvest?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Indeed, indeed! Please, return to me once you've slain a king thresher so I can harvest the scales; it will be worth it, trust me.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Bountiful, friend! While you distracted them, I managed to locate and collect a wonderful amount. Here, as my thanks, this is a precious one. You've saved me a lot of headaches today, heh.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player obtains [[Echoes#Echo Talents/Items|Thresher Scales]]
}}

At least if you make a fool of yourself, you're dressed for the part! |shirt=16178494443 |pants=16178500106 |obtainment=[[Carnival of Hearts]] |buffs={{stats|ether|+50% Ether Regen}} |price=400}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Unique [[Outfit]] in ''Deepwoken''. ==Statistics== ===''Requirements''=== This Outfit costs {{c|Notes|400}} and requires seven (7) [[Cloth]], five (5) [[Fiber]], and ten (10) [[Vibrant Gem]]s to craft. This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 12 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 2500 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+25% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|blunt|+15% Blunt resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+35% Elemental resistance}}, and {{stats|ether|+50% Ether Regen}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Mocking Favor}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|blunt|36.25% Blunt}}, {{stats|slash|25% Slash}}, and {{stats|elm|35% Elemental}}. The {{t|Mocking Favor}} Talent causes [[Tillian]] to appear when you taunt (spit) or emote. He'll do an emote, say a quip, and apply a random buff or affliction to you. This Talent has a 30 second cooldown. List of buffs being: *[[Visionshaper]] invisibility from the Cheap Trick Talent for around three seconds. [Hey, where’d you go?!] *Grants you ~18% Tempo. Indicated by a light blue effect, somewhat similar to [[Reinforce]]'s vfx. [Don't worry - It's on the house!] *30% Posture restoration. Indicated by a metal clanging sound effect. [Quick, they're weak!] *A free reroll, granting you an additional buff or affliction. [Bravo, bravo!] *One 0 cost Mantra, this affects your allies as well. Indicated by a dark blue [[Reinforce]]-like vfx. *A percentage of the damage you've taken recently will be turned into healing. [Wanted to give ya a quick breather!] *Vent cooldown reset, allowing you to Vent again. List of afflictions being: *Suffocation applied to self for a few seconds. [Zip it, focus on the fight!] *Longer spit cooldown with no other effect. Increases your spit cooldown to ~20s. Indicated by black cross marks coming off your body. [Down on your luck, huh.] *Lowers your Swingspeed. Indicated by black cross marks coming off of your body. [Hah! How embarrassing!] ==Trivia== *Worn by [[Aelita]]. *This Outfit shares identical stats with [[Trickster's Habit]], the Outfit worn by [[Tillian]]. *Both afflictions where your Taunt cooldown and swingspeed are modified use the same visual effect. *Occasionally, the text and buff may not line up. It is unknown if this is a bug or intentional case. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Job Boards
content:
__TOC__
==Description==
[[File:Job-board.png|thumb]]
'''Jobs''' are repeatable quests provided by various factions, accessible through Job Boards located in populated territories. Completing a Job grants rewards such as [[Power|Event EXP]], a [[Chests & Sacks|Chest]], and a significant boost to your [[Reputation]] with the corresponding faction.

The core of a Job usually involves traveling to a designated area and fulfilling a specific objective. These objectives can range from transporting goods to eliminating enemy patrols. When interacting with a Job, {{Input|M2}} will present two options: "Abandon Objective" to abandon the quest, or "View on Map" to display the Job's location on the players map.

Territories fully controlled by a single faction (e.g., [[Fort Merit]] and [[Etris]]) will exclusively offer Jobs From: their ruling faction. However, Job Boards in neutral zones (e.g., [[Songseeker Wilds]] and [[Starswept Valley]]) provide Jobs from any faction that can generate in that area. Players with the [[Ignition Delver]] origin can utilize the [[Union Pager]] tool to accept jobs remotely.

<tabber>
|-|Pathfinder=
==Etrean Luminant==
===Erisia===
''Jobs relating to [[Erisia]] can be given by [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}, [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}, [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}, and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}) '''A Daunting Task''' : ''"A Megalodaunt has been spotted in the region. With due caution, a price has been placed upon its head."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Megalodaunt]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} '''Authority Patrol''' : ''"Authority scouts have been spotted in the region. A reward has been promised to whoever can send them packing."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two [[Authority Officer]]s and two [[Authority Soldier]]s.
**Note: Killing them will reduce your [[Central Authority]] [[reputation]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}) '''Black Feathers''' : ''"A dangerous entity lurks at the boundaries of perception. Extreme caution is urged."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Deep Owl]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} '''Clash Of Empires''' : ''"Tensions between the Hundred Legions and the Central Authority have come to a head. A dispute between soldiers of the rival empires has exploded into a bloodbath. Put a stop to this."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two enemy soldiers, either two [[Legion Soldier]]s or two [[Authority Officer]]s.
**Rewards: A chest of the '''{{cl|lired|TBA}}''' [[Loot Tables#|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}) '''Forge Recall''' : ''"In order to prevent one of the Duke's creations from reporting back to him, a reward is being offered for its destruction."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Stonespark]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}) {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} '''Knife To Antler''' : ''"Knives hired by the Authority have captured a travelling party of Navaen nomads. Free them."''
**Tasks the player with defeating three [[Knife of Eylis]]'.
**Note: Killing the Knife of Eylis' will reduce your [[Knives of Eylis]] [[reputation]]. Additionally, the hostage spawned from this Job can be turned in to [[Cheral]] from the [[Way of Navae]] [[Fist Style|fist style]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}) {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} '''The Eastern Conflict''' : ''"The Authority have mounted an assault but have been ambushed by a contingent of Etrean soldiers. Lend your blade."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two enemy soldiers, either two [[Authority Officer]]s or two [[Etrean Soldier]]s.
**Rewards: A chest of the '''{{cl|lired|TBA}}''' [[Loot Tables#|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

==Eastern Luminant==
===Aratel Island===
''Jobs relating to [[Aratel Island]] can be given by [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}, [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}, [[The Hive]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}}, [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Hive}}) {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} '''Aratel's Blood''' : ''"The Hive are expanding further into Aratel through means of their Lifewoven devices. A squad of Vigils training in the area stumble across something they should not have."''
**Tasks the player with defeating three enemy soldiers, either three [[Hive Scout]]s or three [[Etrean Soldier]]s.
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Aratel Island]] [[Loot Tables#Aratel|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} '''Authority Patrol''' : ''"Authority scouts have been spotted in the region. A reward has been promised to whoever can send them packing."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two [[Authority Officer]]s and two [[Authority Soldier]]s.
**Note: Killing them will reduce your [[Central Authority]] [[reputation]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} '''Clash Of Empires''' : ''"Tensions between the Hundred Legions and the Central Authority have come to a head. A dispute between soldiers of the rival empires has exploded into a bloodbath. Put a stop to this."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two enemy soldiers, either two [[Legion Soldier]]s or two [[Authority Officer]]s.
**Rewards: A chest of the '''{{cl|lired|TBA}}''' [[Loot Tables#|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''Lodestar Bounty''' : ''"A blindfolded nomad wielding a bow has been causing a surprising amount of trouble, despite not seeming to know where they are."''
**<small>Previously: ''"A mysterious figure wielding a bow and wandering around aimlessly has been causing a surprising amount of trouble. A reward is offered to whoever can put a stop to this madness."''</small>
**Tasks the player with defeating the [[Lodestar]].
**Rewards: A chest that contains [[Lodestar]]'s unique [[Loot Tables#Lodestar|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}. Additionally, [[Lodestar]] is guaranteed to drop the [[Guiding Star]] [[Bows|bow]] weapon and [[Navaen War Chief]] [[outfit]] schematic on death.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} '''Restricted Technology'''
**Tasks the player with defeating either a [[Authority Captain]] or [[Golem Constructs|Golem Construct]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Aratel Island]] [[Loot Tables#Aratel|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''Thresher Infestation''' : ''"A Thresher displays the potential to become a greater threat."''
**<small>Previously: ''"A price has been put on the head of a Thresher that displays the potential to become a greater threat."''</small>
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Thresher]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Aratel Island]] [[Loot Tables#Aratel|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''Thresher Regicide''' : ''"A king has emerged from the fierce competition between Threshers. Slay it at all costs."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Thresher]] and [[King Thresher]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Aratel Island]] [[Loot Tables#Aratel|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

===Songseeker Wilds===
''Jobs relating to the [[Songseeker Wilds]] can be given by [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}, and [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}.''
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Songseeker Wilds]] [[Loot Tables#Songseeker Wilds|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} '''Authority Patrol''' : ''"Authority scouts have been spotted in the region. A reward has been promised to whoever can send them packing."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two [[Authority Officer]]s and two [[Authority Soldier]]s.
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Erisia]] [[Loot Tables#Erisia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Summer Company}}) '''Songseeker Fanatics''' : ''"Members of the Songseeker Cult have been ambushing trading vessels. A reward is offered to those that can teach them a lesson."''
**Tasks the player with defeating a Songseeker Monk. The Monk can use [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Flamecharm]], [[Songseeker Frostdrawer|Frostdraw]], [[Songseeker Thundercaller|Thundercall]], or [[Songseeker Galebreather|Galebreathe]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Songseeker Wilds]] [[Loot Tables#Songseeker Wilds|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

===Summer Isle===
''Jobs relating to [[Summer Isle]] can be given by [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Summer Company}}) '''Lodestar Bounty''' : ''"A blindfolded nomad wielding a bow has been causing a surprising amount of trouble, despite not seeming to know where they are."''
**<small>Previously: ''"A mysterious figure wielding a bow and wandering around aimlessly has been causing a surprising amount of trouble. A reward is offered to whoever can put a stop to this madness."''</small>
**Tasks the player with defeating the [[Lodestar]].
**Rewards: A chest that contains [[Lodestar]]'s unique [[Loot Tables#Lodestar|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}. Additionally, [[Lodestar]] is guaranteed to drop the [[Guiding Star]] [[Bows|bow]] weapon and [[Navaen War Chief]] [[outfit]] schematic on death.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}) '''Security Detail'''
**Tasks the player with defeating two [[Bandit]]s and a [[Bandit Leader]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Summer Company]] [[Loot Tables#Summer Company|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

==The Depths==
===Celtor===
''Jobs relating to The Depths can be given by [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}} and [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Divers}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''A Daunting Task''' : ''"A Megalodaunt has been spotted in the region. With due caution, a price has been placed upon its head."''

**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Mudskipper Broodlord]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Divers}}) '''Brute Extermination'''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Mudskipper Brute]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Divers}}) '''Coldheart Fortinbras'''
**Tasks the player with defeating [[Coldheart Fortinbras]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Divers}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''Crustaceous Regicide'''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Crustaceous Rex]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Divers}}) '''Deep Owl Extermination'''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Deep Owl]].
**Rewards: A chest of the [[Scyphozia]] [[Loot Tables#Scyphozia|loot pool]], positive [[reputation]] from the [[faction]] who assigned the job, and {{c|notes|50}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}) '''Drowned Delver'''
**Tasks the player with defeating [[Finnegan The Lost]].

==Etrean Luminant==
===Etris===
''Jobs relating to [[Etris]] can be given by [[Etrean Royalists]] {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} '''The Etrean Apostle''' : ''"The Etrean Apostle is making it much more difficult to continute the assault on Etris. We need you to take care of him."''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} '''War of Attrition''' : ''"Kill one of the Shogun occupying Etris."''
**Tasks the player with defeating a {{iv|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard}}.

===Minityrsa===
''Jobs relating to [[Minityrsa (Vow of Iron)|Minityrsa]] can be given by [[Etrean Royalists]] {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Deep Owl Hunt''' : ''"A deep owl has invaded this area, marking the space as its hunting grounds. Approach with caution."''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Deep Widow''' : ''"A deep widow has been spotted in the region."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Deep Widow]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Immortal Knights''' : ''"A powerful ancient knight has been spotted in the region."''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Merchant Recovery''' : ''"A merchant caravan has gone missing somewhere in the region and has missed their deadline. Find out what happened to them."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Snow Knight]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Roaming Broodlord''' : ''"A group of brutes accompanying a broodlord have been spotted in the area.''"
**Tasks the player with slaying two [[Mudskipper Brute]]s and a [[Mudskipper Broodlord]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} '''Save Hostage''' : ''"Save the hostage, getting seen could be fatal."''
**Tasks the player with defeating two [[Ministry Scout]]s and a [[Ministry Captain]].

==Eastern Luminant==

''Jobs relating to Bluster Rapids can be given by [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} and [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Navae}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} '''Authority Patrol''' : ''"Authority scouts have been spotted in the region. A reward has been promised to whoever can send them packing."''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}{{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}) '''Bounty Hunter Encampment'''
**Tasks the player with defeating three [[Bounty Hunter (NPC)|Bounty Hunter]]s.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Brain Eaters''' : ''"Brain eating creatures have been spotted in the region. Clear them out from the merchants."''
**Tasks the player with slaying three [[Brainsucker]]s.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Brutes''' : ''"A small group of mudskippers accompanying a brute have been spotted in the area."''
**Tasks the player with slaying three [[Mudskipper]]s and a [[Mudskipper Brute]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}) {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} '''Eliminate Legion Sniper''' : ''"Eliminate the Legion Sniper that has been spotted."''
**Tasks the player with defeating a [[Legion Sniper]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}}) {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} '''Legion Patrol''' : ''"Legion scouts have been spotted in the region. A reward has been promised to whoever can send them packing."''
**Tasks the player with defeating three [[Legion Soldier]]s and a [[Legion Captain]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Megalodaunt Attack'''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Megalodaunt]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Moss Knight Hunt''' : ''"A Stone Knight seems to be covering a cave we need to get to. Take care of it."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a {{iv|Moss Knight}}.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Thresher Infestation''' : ''"A Thresher displays the potential to become a greater threat."''
**<small>Previously: ''A price has been put on the head of a Thresher that displays the potential to become a greater threat.''</small>
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Thresher]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Navae}}) '''Thresher Regicide''' : ''"A king has emerged from the fierce competition between Threshers. Slay it at all costs."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Thresher]] and [[King Thresher]].
