''Jobs relating to Etris can be given by [[Etrean Royalists]] {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Crab Infestation''' : ''"Theres {{sic}} an infestation of grabs {{sic}}, get rid of them for a reward."''
**Tasks the player with slaying three [[Crab]]s.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Songseeker Fanatics''' : ''"Members of the Songseeker Cult have been ambushing trading vessels. A reward is offered to those that can teach them a lesson."''
**Tasks the player with defeating one Songseeker Monk. The Monk can use [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Flamecharm]], [[Songseeker Frostdrawer|Frostdraw]], [[Songseeker Thundercaller|Thundercall]], or [[Songseeker Galebreather|Galebreathe]].


===Songseeker Wilds===
''Jobs relating to Songseeker Wilds can be given by [[Etrean Royalists]] {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}.''

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Bounty Hunter Encampment'''
**Tasks the player with defeating three [[Bounty Hunter (NPC)|Bounty Hunter]]s.

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Clipped Wing''' : ''"Malformed adherents of the Starkindred faith shamble through the Rotlands. Grant them rest."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Maljuror]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Deep Owl Hunt''' : ''"A deep owl has invaded this area, marking the space as its hunting grounds. Approach with caution."''
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Deep Owl]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Songmaster Coven''' : ''"A coven has been spotted harassing traders moving through the Songseeker Wildlands."''
**Tasks the player with defeating a group of four Songseeker Monks, each using a different attunement. The Monks can use [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Flamecharm]], [[Songseeker Frostdrawer|Frostdraw]], [[Songseeker Thundercaller|Thundercall]], or [[Songseeker Galebreather|Galebreathe]].

*(From: {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}}) '''Swamp Nightmares''' : ''"A strange abomination has been reported, seemingly taking the form of a Thresher."''
**<small>Job previously called: "Nightmares"</small>
**Tasks the player with slaying a [[Nightmare Thresher]].

==Description==
Joe is a [[Canor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Completing their dialogue starts the "Joe's Embers" [[Quest]].

==Quest==
===Joe's Embers===
#To start the quest, the player has to finish Joe's dialogue. They will then ask the player to retrieve 2 [[Dying Embers]].
#To finish the quest, speak to Joe again with at least 2 Dying Embers inside of the inventory.

===Rewards===
Upon retrieving the Dying Embers, Joe gives the player a random tier two [[Mantra Modifiers|Mantra Modifier]]. 

==Location==
Joe is located inside of the library at the [[Temple of the Blade]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Joe Map.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}None here, either... Hey, you. Interested in doing me a favor? There could be something in it for you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A favour? What do I get?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I'm trying to tune this spell to my style perfectly, but it appears I've run out of Dying Embers. If you bring me 2 of them, well, I suppose I could give you something interesting.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll bring them.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I thought you would. Well, the secret of what I have in store is waiting on you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest End=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}You got the embers?

{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has 2 Dying Embers
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player doesn't have 2 Dying Embers
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Thanks, now I can get back to my trial-and-error. As promised, here's your reward.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Don't try to fool me. You don't have 2 Dying Embers yet.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], quest complete
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
}}

title: Joshua
content:
{{Topbuttons|p, {{iv|Joshua (Vow of Iron)}}}}
{{PathfinderEx|counterpart}}
{{Quotes|quote=Good day to you, youngster. Was there something you needed?|author=Joshua}}
{{NPCInfobox
|title1=Joshua
|affiliation=[[Etrea]]
|image1=Joshua New.png

|aspect=Etrean
|pronouns=He/him<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Joshua (Vow of Iron)}}</ref>
|location=[[Etris]]}}

==Description==
Joshua is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

Joshua has the appearance of an old man with wrinkly skin.
==Location==
Joshua is located inside of his house at [[Etris]], it is near the General Store and [[Lance|Lance's]] Restuarant.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Joshua Map.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|Base Dialogue=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Good day to you, [Age]. Was there something you needed?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you think of the Authority?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}? Hmm. I'm not too politically minded myself, but the people here certainly don't take kindly to them. If you ask me, they should keep to themselves and leave us be. I don't see what all the fuss is about.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

|-|Unlockable Dialogues=
{{#tag:tabber|Karliah=
These dialogues are unlocked if the player has started the "Diver Apprentice" [[Quest]].
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Good day to you, [Age]. Was there something you needed?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you know Karliah? I'm supposed to go on a research expedition with her soon.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Oh, Karliah! Of course. She comes and cooks for little old me every now and then. She's truly a blessing
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Karliah Saved=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Karliah seems a lot happier lately, thanks to you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you think of the Authority?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Karliah Killed=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Have you seen Karliah lately? She mentioned she was so excited to go on that expedition with you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}It's okay if you don't know where she is either, I'm just a bit worried about her. She's such a pure soul.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Lord Regent=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has started the "Lord Regent Who?" [[Quest]].
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Good day to you, [Age]. Was there something you needed?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you know anything about the Lord Regent?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The Lord Regent eh? Can't say I do, really. In my later years I haven't paid much attention to politics. In my youth I was travelling the world, not cooped up here on Etrea like I am now.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
}}
</tabber>

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Joshua.png|Appearance prior to 8th of November, 2025
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Depending on the players progress in the "Diver Apprentice" quest, Joshua will change:
**If the quest is in progress, he will make mention of [[Karliah]], a Diver Apprentice who cooks for him.
**In one of the bad endings of the quest, he is nowhere to be seen and his decapitated head is being held by Karliah in her house.
**In the good ending of the quest, he will thank the player for making Karliah seem happier.

Joshua Vow of Iron Map.png {{Clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |''*An Etrean sits by the fire in a small campsite, resting. What's your name? |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |I'm [First Name]. Nice to meet you.
[Player rests with Joshua] |- | colspan="2" |''*You take up Joshua's offer to sit down by the fire. After all, it really is quite chilly...*'' Nice to meet you too, indeed! I'd offer you something to eat, but I recently ran out myself. Guess I'll have to go out and forage soon. But - let none say Joshua is not hospitable! ''*He smirks.*'' |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |That's alright. Say... You look like you're from Etrea, correct? |- | colspan="2" |''*He nods, chuckling.*'' Perceptive, stranger! Was it my blade that gave me away? But aye, indeed. There was trouble stirring back home, so I figured I'd get myself out to Etris and travel the world... So, here I am now. |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |What sort of trouble? |- | colspan="2" |Well... All sorts of it, really! There was the rebellion, then, I'm told, the invasion by the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}... It's been difficult keeping up with the news during my travels, but I try my hardest. Even when I'm far away from home, it's still on my mind. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Could you tell me more about this 'rebellion'? | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |An invasion by the Central Authority? |- | colspan="1" |''*Joshua thumbs his chin contemplatively.*'' Well... I can't say I know much about how it all started... But I've heard some of the old Etrean clans decided to take up arms against the Lord Regent. Maybe it was some new policy that set them off... But, just as I came of age, they rose up in open rebellion. I think they're still out there, in shattered numbers, but the main action has been over for a while now... Such a shame, that the greed of the highborn makes Etreans shed each other's blood. | colspan="1" |''*He nods.*'' Aye. Now, I've not seen it first hand - it started after I left Etrea, - but I hear an expeditionary force from the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} sailed into this {{g|The Luminants|Luminant}}, and laid siege to Fortress Cascabel, Etrea's best-fortified prison. After a brutal siege, they claimed the fortress as a forward operating base. ''*He shakes his head.*'' Such grotesque acts of violence... I try not to think about them. Though, given how my homeland struggles so... I can't help but feel a little guilty for leaving it to travel the world. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What about the invasion of the Central Authority? | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What about the rebellion? |- | colspan="1" |I may not be up to date with the news, but... I've not seen it first hand - it started after I left Etrea, - but I hear an expeditionary force from the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} sailed into this {{g|The Luminants|Luminant}}, and laid siege to Fortress Cascabel, Etrea's best-fortified prison. After a brutal siege, they claimed the fortress as a forward operating base. ''*He shakes his head.*'' Such grotesque acts of violence... I try not to think about them. Though, given how my homeland struggles so... I can't help but feel a little guilty for leaving it to travel the world. | colspan="1" |[See Could you tell me more about this 'rebellion'?] |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |I see... Well, I best get going. Thanks for the hospitality. |- | colspan="2" |''*Joshua smiles warmly.*'' Of course, of course! Thank you for your company, [First Name], it was a pleasant distraction in these idle hours... Safe journeys to you! |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |''*Noticing your approach, Joshua beckons your way.*'' Ah, [First Name]! Back to warm yourself by the fire once more? |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Sure, why not.
[Player rests with Joshua] |- | colspan="2" |''*You sit down by the campfire once again.*'' Hope your journeys have been safe. I've been spending a fair bit of time getting to know this myself, heh, exploring and such... So. Anything on your mind? |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Remind me - how did you start travelling again? |- | colspan="2" |''*He looks toward the middle distance, wistful.*'' Of course, of course... | colspan="1" |''*Most of the pages are missing and some passages smudged, but you can make out some of what is written.*'' I'm torn between my duty to the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} and keeping my {{g|Oaths|Oath}}... The fake shrine outside seems to have been destroyed, probably by some local bandits or maybe the Etreans?... I fear for the Etrean people that they are to become casualties in a war beyond their understanding. Being lead by that ''thing'' they call a Lord... I thought the Contractors had been wiped out, but they surely just been hiding within the Ministry... It all makes sense now, but it seems far too late. I fear we may have fallen for his plan, the Authority's Peacekeeping may soon become the sole reason for the largest Submergence since Celtor.

Your stolen goods are now forfeit.}} ==Description== Journeyman Diver Guards are NPCs that act as the guards of [[Castle Light]] as well as ambushing "Hunted" reputation players. They are able to use all four standard Attunements, along with Shadowcast at a time, the only NPCs in the game capable of doing so. A Journeyman Diver Guard's appearance only consists of a [[Diver Journeyman Robes]] outfit with their [[Aspects|aspect]] varying. {{clear}} ==Moveset== A Journeymen Diver's arsenal consists of either a [[Acheron's Warspear]], [[Markor's Inheritor]], [[Crescent Cleaver]] or [[Tanto]] along with the [[Thundercall]], [[Galebreathe]], [[Frostdraw]], [[Shadowcast]], and [[Flamecharm]] attunements: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |The Journeyman Diver Guard uses the critical attack of their equipped weapon. *The Markor's Inheritor criticial is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Gale Lunge'''
(★★☆) |Diver lunges forward with their weapon coated in wind. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Jolt Grab
(Magnet Spark)'''
(★★☆) |Teleports to the nearest target before sending out a shocking AoE. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |typ4 = teleport }} |- |
'''Lightning Stream'''
(★★☆) |Sends a projectile that latches onto a target before pulling them in. Has insane range. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, pull }} |- |
'''Ice Daggers'''
(★★☆) |Throws out three daggers of ice that fly to you and damage you, freezing you in place momentarily. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |Wraps their weapon in fire and strikes, dealing massive posture damage if blocked. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Encircle'''
(★☆☆) |Conjure shadows around your enemy before warping to them after a delay. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Spark Swap'''
(☆☆☆) |Snaps their fingers and swaps their location with another target. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |- |
'''Vent'''
(★☆☆) |An explosion of blue ether around the user that pushes opponents away. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, unharmful }} |} ===Boons=== *Impervious - Immune to PvE scaling. === Talents === *Battle Tendency - You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Brick Wall}} - You refuse. You cannot be knocked off your feet until you are knocked completely unconscious. *Braced Collapse - After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage. *{{cl|raretlnf|Showstopper}} - When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing. *{{cl|raretlnf|Strong Stern}} - The duration you are dazed from wall bangs is cut in half *{{cl|raretlnf|Frozen Pin-Cushion}} - Ice Daggers now freeze opponents. *Perseverance - When you're knocked down, you get back up again more quickly. *Underdog - You deal slightly more damage to those with higher HP than you. Deal 10% more damage to larger foes. *{{cl|raretlnf|Defiance}} - Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP. *Moving Fortress - Blocking no longer slows you down as much. *Charged Return - Being under an elemental status effect causes your M1's and critical attacks to do 20% more damage. *{{cl|raretlnf|Champion's Regalia}} - Flourishing an opponent grants you 1.5x posture damage for 10 seconds. *Nullifying Clarity - Deal 15% more damage to enemies with status effects on them with your basic attacks, but the effect is removed on impact. *Scorched Peak - Blockbreaking an enemy on fire or with a fire mantra causes them to be struck by lightning. *Frozen Web - Landing a critical with a Static Link on your opponent applies Chilled. *Static Link - Flourishing or uppercutting an enemy creates a static link between you and your enemy. Your lightning stuns enemies for 1.5x as long. *Storm Link - While you have a Static Link on someone, your Wind mantras that hit them are imbued with flashes of Lightning. ==Finisher == A Journeyman Diver executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[⁣[[Acheron's Warspear]]] Pins down opponent before impaling the opponent's chest with their spear. [⁣[[Markor's Inheritor]] & [[Crescent Cleaver]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. [⁣[[Tanto]]] User pins down the opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |} ==Tips== *Don't try to fight them in any circumstances. They will jump you, and they have little to no cooldown on Mantras. *Look at their enchant before attempting to engage in a fight with them, as if you lack necessary Talents such as Carnivore or a form of Campfire in the depths, enchants such as Gluttony and Bloodthirsty may lead to an untimely end. == Trivia== *They were originally [[Black Diver (NPC)|Black Divers]], but were changed to Journeyman Divers due to their presence contradicting the established low number and high power level of actual Black Divers. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:The Divers]] [[Category:Diver Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]]

title: Joy
content: {{PathfinderEx}} {{EventContent}} {{CurrencyInfobox |title1=Joy |caption1=Go spread some Hallowtide JOY! |usage=Obtainment of [[Hallowtide]] exclusive items |obtainment=*Scaring people with the [[Hallowtide Mask]] *Doing the [[Widow's Wail Cemetery|Trial of the Gourdskipper]] }} Joy is used as a currency in the [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide]] event, and can be traded for Hallowtide exclusive items. You can check how much Joy you have by either talking to [[Lysander Spellhardt]], [[Glaive Spellhardt]] or [[Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire]], though this requires that you have made a [[Hallowtide Mask]] first. Joy is bound to your character. If your slot wipes, and you make a new character, Joy will not be transferred over. However, if your character should somehow survive from the end of one year's Hallowtide to the beginning of another, any remaining Joy will be carried over. Generally, it is recommended for you to to buy the [[Seasonal Medals#Hallowtide|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide Medals'''}}]] and the ''Hallowtide Aspect Variants'' first, as the all the yearly medals will allow you to unlock Hallowtide-exclusive weapons and equipment with knowledge later '''''after the event is over'''''. Which also includes the [[Harrowing]] enchantment, the [[Pumpkin Pitch]] mantra, and the [[Instruments#Spectral Instruments|Spectral Instrument Set]]. ==Obtainment== Joy can be obtained in 2 ways: #Spooking stationary NPCs with the [[Hallowtide Mask]]. This gives you 3 Joy per NPC spooked, with a cooldown of 30 minutes for each NPC. Guards and similar NPCs cannot be spooked. #By doing the [[Widow's Wail Cemetery|Gourdskipper Trial]]. There are 2 ways to get Joy by doing this trial. #*First, by surviving each wave, which gives you 3 Joy per wave. There is a total of 8 waves, and once you complete the whole trial, you get 16 Joy on top of it, ultimately giving you 40 Joy per full trial. #*Second, by getting infected, and infecting other players, which gives you 3 Joy per players you infect. ==Usage== Joy can be used to exchange for a lot of [[Hallowtide]]-exclusive items. Mainly with 3 [[NPCs]]. [[Lysander Spellhardt]], [[Glaive Spellhardt]], and [[Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire]]. Each of their options can be viewed below: *[[Lysander Spellhardt]]: Sells you Hallowtide-exclusive [[equipment]]s and [[Outfits]], ''Hallowtide aspect Variants'', and yearly [[Seasonal Medals|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide Medals'''}}]]. *#For '''35 Joy''': You can buy 3 Head Equipments: [[Familiar Priest's Helm]], [[Familiar Heretic's Helm]], and [[Familiar Knight's Helm]]. *#*You can also buy 2 Unique Outfits: [[Familiar Heretic's Armor]], [[Familiar Knight's Armor]]. *#For '''50 Joy''': You can buy the [[Pumpkin Head]] Head equipment. *#For '''70 Joy''': You can buy a ''Hallowtide Variant'' for all of your aspects. This purchase is account-wide, unlocking for your current and future slots and aspects. You can talk to Lysander again to activate the variants immediately. *#For '''100 Joy''': You can buy random [[Relics]]. All chances for any relics are the same. *#*You can also buy a Head Equipment for the same price: [[Mushroom Costume]]. *#For '''200 Joy''': You can buy the [[Seasonal Medals#Hallowtide|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide '22 and '23 Medals'''}}]]. *#For '''300 Joy''': You can buy the [[Seasonal Medals#Hallowtide|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide '24 and '25 Medals'''}}]] *#*'''This is a must-buy'''. Each medal will allow you to purchase [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide]]-exclusive items released in its respective year using [[Knowledge]] instead of Joy '''after the event is over'''. More information can be found on its respective page here, [[Seasonal Medals#Hallowtide|Hallowtide Medals]]. *[[Glaive Spellhardt]]: Sells you Hallowtide-exclusive [[weapons]] and [[Pumpkin Pitch]], along with the [[Harrowing]] Enchant, and a master [[outfit]] gacha. *#For '''20 Joy''': You can buy a random Master [[Outfits|Outfit]]. Useful to get [[Celtorian Tideknight]]. *#For '''80 Joy''': You can buy a Hallowtide-exclusive shield, the [[Gourdguard]]. *#For '''100 Joy''': You can buy All Hallowtide-exclusive weapons. The cost is 100 Joy per weapon. *#*'''Light Weapons''': [[Skull Piercer]], [[Drakemaw Gauntlets]], [[Spectral Grasp]], [[Moppet]]. *#*'''Medium Weapons''': [[Hallowscleave]], [[Bloodtide Trident]], [[Death's Reverie]], [[The Weaving Web]]. *#*'''Heavy Weapons''': [[Skyreap Blade]], [[Putrid Edenstaff]], [[Wretched Mawblades]], [[Smouldering Hallow|Smouldering Hallow.]] *#For '''150 Joy''': You can buy a [[Harrowing|Harrowing]] [[Enchant Stone]]. *#For '''300 Joy''': You can buy the [[Pumpkin Pitch]] mantra. *[[Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire|Galpin Spellhardt]]: Sells you a Hallowtide-exclusive [[Instruments|Instrument]] skin, the [[Instruments#Spectral Instruments|''Spectral Instrument Set'']], and some [[Books|Shanties]]. *#For '''20 Joy''': You can buy [[Books|Shanties]], though not all of them can be used to play music: *#*Eggs In A Basket, Our Fortress (Of Smoke And Steel), Tale of the Storm, The Ferryman's Lullaby, The Gideshu March, The Hammer's Call, The Song of Fathoms / Oscillation. *#For '''50 Joy''': You can buy a [[Books|Shanty]] that sings about the [[Lightborn]] aspect: A Light In The Sky. (Not hallowtide-exclusive, can be found in book shelves at a rare chance. *#For '''200 Joy''': You can buy the [[Instruments#Spectral Instruments|''Spectral Instrument Set'']], which is exclusive to Hallowtide. ==Trivia== *There used to be an option to buy [[Void Feather]]s and a random [[Deep Gem]] from [[Lysander Spellhardt]]. *Joy given from all sources was buffed in the {{VersionHistory|2024|November 8th}} hotfix. {{Nav|Hallowtide}} [[Category:Hallowtide]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Currency]]

title: Jus Karita
content:
{{Weapon Infobox |bankable=No |droppable=No |enchantable=No |damage type=Blunt |attack duration=0.5s |range type=Sweep |type=Fist |requirements={{t|Jus Karita}} Talent |damage=14 |posture damage=3 |range=6.5 |swing speed=1.14x |obtainment= Step 1: Get 40 LHT, and Power 5.
Step 2: Talk to [[Polis]] at [[Etris]]. |description=The traditional martial arts style of [[the Justicar]]s. |image=Jus Karita.png |scaling=LHT: 9 |penetration=20% |rarity=N/A |m.equip=No}} ==Description== Jus Karita is a taekwondo-like fighting style obtained from [[Polis]] in [[Etris]] or as a [[Character Creation|Starting Weapon]] if previously unlocked. Compared to the other base fighting styles, it has higher scaling, swing speed, range, and a 20% penetration stat. Jus Karita is unpopular due to it having worse damage compared to the other fighting styles, which also surpass it in swing speed. To make up for it, it has [[Talents#Justicar|unique Talents]], slightly more range, and synergizes with its unique Mantras [[Karita Leap]], [[Karita Divebomb]], and [[Tacet Drop Kick]]. In addition, the [[Justicar]] armor Talent {{t|The Path, Unveiled}} gives it a 10% damage boost, surpassing the other fist style armor Talents in strength. Being considered a "Kick Style" rather than a [[Fists|Fist Style]], you '''cannot''' cycle between it and other fist styles you've obtained, and it will not trigger fist style talents. Jus Karita however, does get its own set of talents dedicated to it. ==Obtainment== To obtain Jus Karita, you must first have Power 5 and 40 [[Attributes|Light Weapon]]. Then, talk to the Justicar named [[Polis]] at [[Etris]] seen leaning on the biggest tree in the center of the city. Choose his first dialogue option to obtain the Gold Ring, then talk to him again to ask him about the Justicar. Completing this will grant you the Jus Karita Talent which enables you to use the fist style and unlock it for consecutive uses on the Character Creation screen. Alternatively, the [[Justicar]] Origins starts with Jus Karita available to them, regardless of starter weapon choice. ==Critical== File:JusKaritaCriticalFrontViewGuildArena.gif|Front View File:JusKaritaCriticalBackViewGuildArena.gif|Back View Dash forward while performing a kick. This critical has a scaled damage multiplier of '''2x'''. This critical has a '''3 second cooldown'''. ==Mantras== Jus Karita users gain access to its own unique Mantras, obtained through [[Whisper Draw]]s. These can help the user maneuver through the kick style's difficulties and weaknesses, possessing three separate Mantras that are effective for comboing. *[[Karita Leap]] is a flying kick, useful as a quick burst option to catch your opponent off-guard. When colliding with a wall, you'll bounce back. *[[Karita Divebomb]] is an attack where you jump into the air and dive down onto your opponent. Its wind-up is heavily reduced upon being used directly after Karita Leap, demonstrating the ability to chain the two mantras together to create a quick combo. *[[Tacet Drop Kick]] requires [[Murmur: Tacet]] to unlock. It's an overhead, teleporting dropkick used to knockdown opponents and confuse them of your position. For more information on these Mantras, such as their requirements and other in-depth information, visit their pages. File:Tacet drop kick.gif|link=Tacet Drop Kick|[[Tacet Drop Kick]] File:Karita Divebomb Front .gif|link=Karita Divebomb|[[Karita Divebomb]] File:Karita Divebomb Side.gif|link=Karita Divebomb|Side view File:KaritaFlipFrontAngle-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif|link=Karita Leap|[[Karita Leap]] File:KaritaLeapSideAngle-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif|link=Karita Leap|Side view File:KaritaLeapFlip-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif|link=Karita Leap|[[Karita Leap]] Backflip File:KaritaFlipDivebomb-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif|link=Karita Leap|[[Karita Leap]]-[[Karita Divebomb|Divebomb]] Chain ==Talents== *{{t|Justicar's Prowess}} - Jus Karita gains +30% posture damage against other fist styles. *{{t|Justicar's Renewal}} - Hitting an opponent with your Jus Karita critical resets the cooldown. *{{t|Swiftkick Prodigy}} - Hitting successive basic attacks with Jus Karita will give a temporary speed buff. *{{t|Flying Swiftkick}} - Hitting a Jus Karita critical attack while Swiftkick Prodigy is active will greatly slow your enemy, and consume your speed boost. ==Gallery== File:JusKaritaIdleGuildArena.gif|Idle Animation File:JusKaritaM1sGuildArena.gif|M1 Animations File:JusKaritaicon.png|Icon on Character Creation screen LKJK Placeholder.png|Previous placeholder Icons for Legion Kata and Jus Karita in Character Creation ==Trivia== *The Justicar armor's damage boost was buffed after developer Ragoozer challenged himself to fight a corrupted [[Bone Keeper]].https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rVWCMiHQY4w **Furthermore, [[Bone Keeper]]'s health regeneration was disabled and LHT & MED scaling in PVE was increased. *Spawning with Jus Karita at character creation will allow you to use the fist style without the criterion of 40 LHT, though its base damage will scale down accordingly due to LHT investment below the usual requirements. **You're still able to get [[Attunement-less|Jus Karita's Mantras]] as long as you have the requirements for them. **You will also not be able to obtain a [[Gold Ring]] from [[Polis]] until reaching 40 LHT. *Jus Karita was made by Dexerius.[[File:DexJK.png]] *Currently, there is a bug in game that allows you to use Jus Karita with any Cestus weapon by equipping Jus Karita first. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Fists]] [[Category:Fighting Styles]] [[Category:Light Weapons]] [[Category:Justicars]] [[Category:Jus Karita Weapons]]

Additionally, it provides the {{t|The Path, Unveiled}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|blunt|33.5% Blunt}}, {{stats|slash|30% Slash}}, {{stats|ice|33.5% Frostdraw}}, {{stats|sdw|33.5% Shadowcast}}, and {{stats|elm|30% Elemental|ice=n|sdw=n}}. The {{t|The Path, Unveiled}} Talent grants a 10% damage buff to your [[:Category:Jus Karita Weapons|Jus Karita Weapons]]. ==Trivia== *This used to have the most physical resistance in the game on release, with a whopping 40%. It did not have ether regen or blunt damage. **This was later nerfed to 35% but given 100% ether regen. **It was then gutted to 30% physical resistance but given an additional 5% blunt armor. **This was most likely due to non-Jus Karita users using the armor more than actual [[Jus Karita]] users. *Previously used to be called "Lightkeeper." The Roblox clothing items still use this name. **Roblox clothing (Previous): [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6710728579/Justicar-Inquisitor-Shirt Shirt] / [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6704509655/Justicar-Inquisitor Pants] *There is an unused version of this armor titled "lightkeeper armor" **Roblox clothing (Unused): [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/10438182843/Lightkeeper-Shirt Shirt] / [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/10438280268/Lightkeeper-Pants Pants] {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Justicars]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Justicar (Origin)
content:
{{InProgress}} {{PathfinderEx}} ::This article is about the [[Origin]]. For the [[Faction]] itself, refer to [[The Justicar]].
{{Quotes|quote=Help those who are too weak to walk the path alone...|author=Origin description}}
[[File:JusticarPreview.png|alt=|center|164x164px]] __TOC__ ::''Justicar'' is an [[Origin]] focused around helping players and making sure that they remain unharmed. Justicar is the counterpart of [[Voidwalker]]. ==Description== Justicars are those who follow [[Alsin]]'s wisdom by interpreting and walking The Path their own way. Many Justicars in the [[Eastern Luminant]] believe that helping others in the pursuit of ''their'' Path is a Justicar's true purpose. Justicars are named after and are affiliated with [[The Justicar]]. ==Obtainment== To obtain the Justicar [[Origin]], the player must do the following: #Meet either of these requirements. Only one is needed to be done before the next step. #*Participate in the [[Cinders of Etris]] Disaster [[World Events|World Event]]. You only need to kill one [[Authority Soldier]] for this method. #*Help a player at or below Power 15 escape the [[Depths Trial]]. #Speak to [[Polis]] after you have already received a [[Gold Ring]] from him. After which, talk to him about wanting to join his cause, which allows you to walk the path of [[Alsin]] and unlock '''Justicar'''. ==Spawn== Justicars spawn at [[Alsin's Landing]] with the [[Justicar Neophyte]] [[Outfits|Outfit]], alongside utilities like [[Jus Karita]] and the Justicar's Call. You can however change outfit, unlike with the [[Authority Ensign|Authority Origin]]. ==Effects== ===Justicar's Aid=== *''In-game description'': Pulls up a list of active [[Castaway]]s that have used their [[Justicar Whistle]]. Select one to teleport to their server and location, and assign them as your mark to protect and help. ===Vow of Protection=== *'''Justicars''' took a vow to protect and thus, cannot easily bring harm to [[Castaway]]s. *Attempting to harm Castaways will stun the Justicar in place for a few seconds. Justicars will also be stunned if a Castaway hits them. **If a Castaway attacks a Justicar too much, the Justicar may retaliate with no consequences. If said Castaway is the Justicar's current mark, the Castaway will lose their allied status with the Justicar. ==Progression== Justicar's progression is based around helping [[Castaway]]s, which is rewarded in the form of experience points and promotion points. Using [[Justicar's Aid]] will allow you to choose from a list of Castaways who have used their [[Justicar Whistle]]. This reveals their name, [[Power]], Luminant, general location, and server region. *Helping [[Castaway]] progress via events, killing their [[Voidwalker]], and etc. will provide you with 15-50 rankpoints per event. **Using '''Justicar's Aid''' will massively speed up this process, although beware that if you die, or the Castaway dies during this, you will lose 50 points. **Note that you are not required to use '''Justicar's Aid''' to be eligible for point gains from this, although using it will help in speeding up the process a lot. There are alternative methods for promotion points as well: *Killing a [[Voidwalker]] of similar level or higher will award you with 50 points. *Killing a World Boss for the first time (with the sole exception of [[Scion of Ethiron]]) will award you with 74 points. ==Promotions== These are the ranks you can progress through: #Neophyte/Initiate #Disciple (155 Points / ~3-4 Events) #Elder (205 Points / ~4-5 Events) #*Upon reaching Elder, you may choose between being a Vanguard or a Warder by talking to their respective NPCs, being [[Grandmaster Vanguard Legidae]] in the armory and [[Grandmaster Warder Sapphire]] in the library. #Master Vanguard / Master Warder (329 / ~5-7 Events) #Grandmaster Vanguard / Grandmaster Warder (388 / ~7-8 Events)
===Promotion Talents=== These Talents can be chosen upon being promoted at any point in your Justicar playthrough. These talents cannot be removed or rerolled once obtained so choose carefully. As you can only gain a maximum of 4 promotions which inludes Path promotions, your Talents of choice are limited. You are also forced to pick 2 generic promotion Talents before you can start picking Path exclusive talents, so there is a maximum of 2 Path-exclusive Talents that you can have, as you cannot reroll generic promotion Talents into Path-exclusive ones with [[Shrine of Chance]] outside of a niche interaction with the "Choice of Chance" Echo upgrade that allows for a third Path-exclusive promotion talent.
*{{cl|factiontl|Justicar's Adaptation}} - Jus Karita running attacks and criticals can now proc Jus Karita talents even if you arent currently using [[Jus Karita]]. Your Jus Karita running attacks can now also proc fist talents. **Having the Justicar's Technique Talent allows you to have the Jus Karita running attack on any weapon. This allows you to proc Jus Karita and Fist exclusive Talents on any weapon via the running attack. *{{cl|factiontl|Justicar's Preference}} - Replace your critical with the [[Jus Karita]] critical attack. **Regardless of your currently equipped weapon, this will replace your critical attack/attacks with [[Jus Karita]]'s. **The Jus Karita critical will adopt your equipped weapon's scaling stat. **Having the Vanguard Style Talent will override this Talent, allowing you to use the Vanguard Style critical on any weapon instead of the Jus Karita one, at the cost of increasing your critical cooldown from 3 seconds to 8 seconds. File:JusKaritaCriticalFrontViewGuildArena.gif|link=Jus Karita|[[Jus Karita]] critical *{{cl|factiontl|Justicar's Technique}} - Replace your running light attack with the Jus Karita running light attack. With the Justicar's Training, your legs extend the range of this running attack by an extra 0.5. *{{cl|factiontl|Swiftfoot}} - Reduce all slows you recieve by 10%. *{{cl|factiontl|Trained Legs}} - Slightly increase your climb strength. **Increases how high you can climb.
== Paths == Players can choose between 2 different paths upon reaching Elder rank before they can progress further, those being [[Justicar#Vanguard Path|Vanguard]] and [[Justicar#Warder Path|Warder]]. Vanguards typically focus on combat, while Warders focus on support and healing. ==Vanguard Path== Vanguards are focused on combat and are designed to aid you in defending Castaways. Upon taking the Vanguard Path, you will automatically be granted [[Justicar's Armor|Justicar's Armor.]] ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Karita Combo}} - Remove the endlag from your next running attack. [5 second CD] Landing a critical attack right after your running attack makes that critical attack have no cooldown and deal more damage. [10 second CD] **Prerequisites: Justicar's Technique *{{cl|factiontl|Righteous Crash}} - Slamming down your opponent in the air with a flourish or your upgraded Vanguard Jus Karita critical deals extra true damage based on high up in the air they were. *{{cl|factiontl|Swiftkick Master}} - Proccing Swiftkick Prodigy now extends its duration to 15 seconds. **Prerequisites: Swiftkick Prodigy *{{cl|factiontl|Soaring Swiftkick}} - Flying Swiftkick no longer consumes your speed boost and instead gives you more speed. **Prerequisites: Flying Swiftkick *{{cl|factiontl|Vanguard Style}} - When using the [[Jus Karita]] critical attack, turn it into a kick that brings your enemies up in the air. Landing the critical attack while your opponent is in the air brings them up and slightly stuns them while upgrading your next critical. **This new critical attack has a windup of 0.47 seconds and 20 base damage with no investment scaling. *{{cl|factiontl|Vanguard's Onslaught}} - Landing a Vanguard Style Jus Karita critical attack makes you deal 20% more damage in the air for the next 5 seconds. **Prerequisites: Vanguard Style {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Karita Swap (☆☆☆) |image=Karita Swap.gif |mantratype= |desc=Grab your ally and swap places with them while moving in with a swift kick to save them. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs=Vanguard Path, given automatically after joining it. |effect=''User swaps with someone and heals them.'' }} ==Warder Path== Warders are primarily focused on support and granting buffs to your allies. Upon taking the Warder path, you will automatically be granted [[Warder's Attire]]. ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Justicar's Mark}} - Mark someone you wish to protect for a minute. While marked, you take 20% of the damage they receive and they take 20% less damage. Marking someone also cause you to take 20% more damage while they are marked. **Grants a Talent tool that allows you to apply the {{status|Justicar's Mark}} status effect on one of your allies. **While this effect is active, the {{status|Justicar's Mark|marked}} target gains 20% damage redirection, as 20% of the damage they would have taken is redirected to you instead. Additionally, you take 20% more damage. *{{cl|factiontl|Emergency Mark}} - Applying a mark on someone who has less than 20% health heals them for 10% of their health. **Prerequisite: Justicar's Mark *{{cl|factiontl|Justicar's Blessing}} - Allies you mark with {{stats|Justicar's Mark}} gain 15% more healing. **Prerequisite: Justicar's Mark *{{cl|factiontl|Marked Descent}} - When your {{status|Justicar's Mark|marked}} target takes damage, they are revealed. Using your [[Karita Divebomb]] will target them. **Prerequisite: Justicar's Mark *{{cl|factiontl|Mark Mastery}} - Reduce the amount of extra damage you receive while your ally is marked with the {{status|Justicar's Mark}} from 20% to 5%. **Prerequisite: Justicar's Mark *{{cl|factiontl|Righteous Violence}} - Landing a Critical Attack heals your {{status|Justicar's Mark|marked}} ally. Landing a [[Jus Karita]] critical or Karita Swap heals your marked ally even more. **Prerequisite: Justicar's Mark *{{cl|factiontl|Kindness}} - Whenever you heal another player, heal 5 health yourself. **3 second cooldown. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Alsin's Aid (☆☆☆) |image=Karita Aid.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Give your ally an aura that grants them more speed, and increase the amount of healing they receive for 10 seconds. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs=Warder Path, given automatically after joining it. |effect=''User heals someone.'' }} ==Pros and Cons== ===Pros=== *Great for those who want to help (usually newer) players. **This is also a great way to start off a fresh [[Guild]], as [[Castaway]]s are usually newer players who have yet to be invited to a guild. Helping them progress will make them feel indebted to you, and less likely to [[Terminology (game)#Guild hopping|guild hop]]. *You start with the {{t|Jus Karita}} Talent, allowing you to have [[Jus Karita]] and something else as a starting weapon. *Access to multiple Paths allowing for a variety of unique builds unobtainable otherwise. *[[Justicar Neophyte]] has relatively good stats for a starter armor. *Gives great exp. for farming together with a Castaway. *Grants unique dialogue with [[The Justicar|Justicar]]-affiliated NPCs and exclusive Faction related weapons and gear. ===Cons=== *Somewhat slow progression in regard to Justicar ranks. Ideally, you would be job stacking with your [[Castaway]], which they might not know to do. This is also similar to being an [[Authority Ensign]]. *Some newer Castaways may not know about the details of this origin, and could lead to misunderstandings that could range from them being uncooperative with your help, to them mistaking a Justicar for a [[Voidwalker]] that's teleporting to them, leading them to be antagonistic against said Justicar. *Evil, sabotaging Castaways with ill-intent. **Some Castaways can, using [[Justicar Whistle]] to, spawn you into [[Whirlpools]] or atop of mountains to kill you, and thus lose rank. Although you do not lose any rank points in the first 10 seconds of teleporting to a Castaway, and you gain details of the location of your target before teleporting. **Some Castaways can, using [[Justicar Whistle]] to, bait Justicars into a trapped area with a lot of players or a restricted area, leading them to a quick death. **These events can be avoided by using your spawn i-frames to see the situation. Though if there is fighting you may want to be quick. *Ironically, Justicars benefit most from competent Castaways who can quickly complete events, such as veteran players, who likely do not need a Justicar's help in the first place. Such a scenario is unlikely during intended gameplay. ==Reputation== Your starting reputation is: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}. *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}}, [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other [[factions]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}} {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} ''Note: Your chosen [[Aspects|Aspect]] may affect your starting [[reputation]].'' ==Gallery== File:Justicar Origin Promo.png|Justicar Origin Teaser, showcasing Karita Swap {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Origins]]

==Description==
[[Ka'al]] was one of the side-characters in the [[Books|book]] [[Lament of Cirryn]].

He is a [[Lifeweave]] scholar of [[The Hive]], who was sent out on a mission along with 2 other scholars to revive [[Cirryn]] by a hivelord [[Ximac Diri]].<ref name="Lament">[[Lament of Cirryn]]</ref>

Ka'al wasn't very talkative, rather always seeming troubled and keeping to himself. Though, his interactions with [[Remaz]] hint that they're good friends.<ref name="Lament" />

Ka'al participates in the ritual of reviving [[Cirryn]], but his interest gets the better of him and he meets his demise at the hand of rogue [[Cirryn]]. He is too weak to survive [[the Depths]], as mentioned by [[Ehkusa]], although, his ultimate fate is unknown.<ref name="Lament" />

title: Kaide, the Drowned Light
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=<gallery>
Kaide, the Drowned Light.png|Current
Old Kaide.png|Old 
</gallery>
|name=Kaide
|alias=The Drowned Light
|aspect=Lightborn
|pronouns=He/him
|affiliation=[[Constellia]]
|location=[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]]}}

==Description==
Kaide is a [[Lightborn]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He was the last king of the fallen city [[Constellia]], one of the largest Celestial Cities in the Heavens. 

As the king of Constellia, he was imprisoned in the outskirts of New Kyrsa after the invasion by the [[Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans]] under Ethiron's will, the sole survivor of the conflict. Kaide was set to be killed during the final days of the war, but due to the intervention of [[Raeva Ferash Kenestos]] was captured instead. He mentions about the limited power of the Song and the unsuccessful war between the Celestials and Lightborn against the Drowned Gods, eventually leading to the Celestials fleeing and the Lightborn losing morale, giving up in the process.

Kaide is an aged man with purple eyes and a stern expression. He has long white hair styled into curtain bangs, symmetrically hanging down to his abdomen. His armor consists of gray robes laid over a black, long-sleeved top that features patterns on each sleeve. Lesser aspects such as his pouches and gloves take a dark brown color. A large, bright lavender halo fashioned into a crown with numerous spikes circling it. On his hand is a dark, faded purple twinblade that sports a zig-zag blade with numerous four-pronged star embellishments in between.

<!--
==Location==
-->
==Dialogue==
{{clear}}
<tabber>
|-|Base Dialogue=
{{#tag:tabber|First Encounter=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="36" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{!}}Hm... You make a lot of noise. Are you here simply to disturb my meditation, surface dweller?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{!}}A distinct lack of manners, though it's not like I'm surprised. I suppose my people do not often touch the {{g|The Surface|Surface}} to make contact with your kind. I am {{g|Lightborn}}, child of Man and {{g|The Celestials|Celestial}}. Who are you?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Give him your name]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{!}}Ah, a pleasure to meet you, [First Name]. You surface dwellers do have such strange names. You can call me {{g|Kaide, the Drowned Light|Kaide}}. It's been many centuries since I've spoken to one of your kind here, I assume you seek entrance to the Bed Chamber of {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}}?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm not so certain I even know what that is. 
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="36" {{!}}Oh, you poor fool. You may not realize it yet, but you trespass on the territory of a sleeping God. This is the City of {{g|The City of New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa}} it holds the sleeping form of {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}} deep within. I assume it is only now being rediscovered due to the discordant sounds of the {{g|The Song|Song}} projecting out from this place.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's happening with the Song?
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who are you?
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do you know all of this?
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Child of Man and Celestial?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}Hmm.. I am not sure how aware you are, surface dweller, but the ''magic'' you make use of is not some projection of your own strength. Your power lies within the {{g|The Song|Song}}. All you can conjure is a cheap imitation of the power held within the {{g|The Song|Song}} that {{g|The Drowned Gods|Drowned Gods}} wield as their birthright. If {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}} were to wake, as the projections seem to indicate, the world above would simply cease to be.
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}I once was Ruler of a place known as {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}}. A gleaming City of Light that you surface dwellers often referred to as 'The Guiding Star'. We knew it as the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials'}} Last Gift. It was left in the hands of my forebearers, and passed to me. Unknown to me, I was to be the last king. The {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}}, under {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron's}} will, found a way to invade and took me prisoner. Now your skies lay dark, unable to be navigated, and here I sit until eternity ends.
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}I have been alive far longer than any living member of your kind, save for some of your... ah .. immortals. Our forebearers were once soldiers in the war to fight back the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}. But when the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} fled, so too did our morale - our will to fight. Those of my people that still reside in the skies above the surface merely wait in fear of their prophesied doom.
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}A hybrid, you might say. Our creators had hoped to bring our disparate peoples together and combine our strengths. Our bodies were enhanced by hybrid vigor; unyielding to age or to ailment. Our minds... Well, many of us ended up just as clueless and arrogant as the templates we were created from. There are few of us now, as we cannot bear our own kin.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who are you?
{{!}} colspan="5" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do you know all of this?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's happening with the Song?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do you know all of this?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did they reach your City? Isn't this place beneath the surface?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Immortals?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's happening to the Song?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who are you?
{{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What did the Celestials have to gain? Aren't they gods?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="15" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}No, the {{g|The Depths|Depths}} is far more sinister and cunning than a horde that simply emerges from the Sea. This realm is but one part of the all-encompassing maw of the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}. I do not know this for certain, but you've seen the ruins here, no? They aren't of Human or {{g|The Celestials|Celestial}} make. I have a suspicion that the realms we call 'Layers' of the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}, with their strange environments, may well be worlds that were consumed far before {{g|Lumen}} ever existed...
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Yes, you don't know of them? You surface dwellers have always been a secretive lot. All so suspicious and paranoid. I imagine if they're still alive, then they no doubt occupy positions of power within your world. Behind the scenes though, I should think.
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*He rolls his eyes.*'' What a web they've spun around you. We thought they were gods too, once. But perceptions change quickly when they alone are the sole architects of your suffering.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="15" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did they reach your City? Isn't this place beneath the surface?
{{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="18" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Hm... You return and yet you still make so much noise. You'll scarcely leave me with enough time to meditate. I only have eternity, after all.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's happening with the Song?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who are you?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do you know all of this?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you have anything could help me?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Hmm... If you should return to the {{g|The Surface|Surface}}, let me impart you with a tidbit of knowledge. The {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} were a crafty sort, and would hide many of their relics away in the {{g|The Voidsea|Voidsea}} to obscure their whereabouts. The {{g|The Voidsea|Voidsea}} being what it is, of course, some of their reliquaries may have now drifted between the {{g|The Heavens|Heavens}} and {{g|The Surface|Surface}}. If you should find one... Use my blessing to take what you will from it. Note that they're likely still well-defended, however.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Well-defended?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He chuckles.*'' A gift from our predecessors. And part of why we didn't ransack them ourselves.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}

|-|Unlockable Dialogue=
{{#tag:tabber|Frostthorn=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has a [[Frostthorn]] equipped.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The daggers by your side... I recognise those ridges, and the spring-loaded blades. Yet, that ''chill''... So unsightly, and unfamiliar. Like a mockery of sorts. Are you aware you wield a weapon of my homeland? Though, admittedly, it appears to have been altered somehow.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You recognise these daggers?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Not necessarily this exact pair, but yes, I recognise the make. The smiths of {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}} forged hundreds of them under my rule, if not thousands. Made of skywrought alloys, resistant to rust, and said to never dull, with an edge honed to perfection. Not my first weapon of choice, as you can see - but our warriors favoured these blades as sidearms in close encounters.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It's cold to the touch, and the blade has a crystal-like ringing... Is that part of the original design, too?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He shakes his head.*'' A ghastly and alien feature altogether. If I were to guess, the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}} must have seized these from our dead, and reworked them for their means. Though, their reasoning for this is beyond me. {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}} has bestowed his own fell arsenal of weapons upon the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}} - some of it infused with his power. Plundering weapons from the fallen seems pointless in that regard. Perhaps the daggers were originally seized as a sort of war trophy. But what use are trophies to the enthralled?..
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Kyrsieger=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has a [[Kyrsieger]] equipped.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Gah! That ''ghastly'' thing you wield. You truly do have poor taste.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Oh. I'm sorry.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm using it for good, don't worry.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He pinches his brow.*'' Look, whatever you do with that thing isn't my business. Just keep it out of my sight.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Right. I'm sure that when {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}} whispered to the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}} and stole away their minds that they also felt they were doing 'good' when they burnt my city to the ground.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Can I ask how long it's been?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He sighs.*'' I'm sure you know by now that time doesn't behave itself down here. But to put it into relative terms, {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}} fell some 77 years after the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} abandoned us. Truth be told, I don't know which calendar you're using or how long I've been down here, so I can't offer you much more than that.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}We use Citadel Era.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}That's great, but I don't know what this '{{g|The Citadel of Markor|Citadel}}' ''is''. What I know of your kind is from ''what I assume to be'' a very long time ago. You were a fragmented people scattered across a waterlogged waste. We pitied you and thought ourselves fortunate. How ironic.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Soulthorn=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has a [[Soulthorn]] equipped.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}A sinister blade you wield... It calls to mind the one who wielded by {{g|Zhatarn, the Moonlight Prince|Zhatarn}}, the Moonlight Prince. A tortured presence you bring before me, indeed.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Zhatarn?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}A {{g|The Celestials|Celestial}} driven mad by his own folly in days long past. He took from the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} and so too did it take from him. Though, I'm afraid he passed into myth by our time. Some thought of it merely as a cautionary tale. Though to see such a blade, I have my doubts...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How come I never heard of him?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What happened to him?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Well, look at it this way. Your kind only knows of the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} who fled to the {{g|The Surface|Surface}} following the Heavensfall. And I can't imagine the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} would have exactly ''wanted'' you to know about one of their exiles, so you'd really have little reason to know of him.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Hm, The legends said that after his exile from the {{g|The Heavens|Heavens}}, he roamed the Void as a wraith. Though, I truly could not tell you if there's any truth to that.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What happened to him?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How come I never heard of him?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Starkindred=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has the [[Oath: Starkindred]].
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Hm. You bear their scent. I hesitate to ask what you did.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm not surprised. I drank their ichor.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why're you smelling me?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*He wrinkles his nose.*'' You're just as depraved as they were. I had hoped better, though I'm not sure why. And just to tap into their art?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}I was being polite. I can be more direct. You ''reek''.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}They created you and yet you scorn them?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I needn't listen to the prattling of a heretic.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Their art?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}It is ''because'' they created us that I scorn them. As any child would a parent that leaves them to die to save their own skin.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He rolls his eyes.*'' Worship them all you like, human. So did we.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}You drank of their blood and you don't know why? Where Mankind modifies its surroundings with the {{g|The Song|Song}}, the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} modify themselves. Your drinking of their ichor is no doubt to facilitate a {{g|Vows|Vow}} that imitates how the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} accessed it.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Vortex Echo=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has a [[Vortex Echo]] equipped.
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}How strange, I could have sworn your watch is- Ah, yes... you've been here before. My fate really must be sealed.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You could come with me you know.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}...If only it were that simple. The very fact you can come and go raises too many questions. If I left with you, would every other 'me' be convinced to do the same? My absence from your world already proves the choice I made long ago. Leave me to rest, mortal.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Words of Light=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has read the [[Books|Book]] [[Words of Light]].
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Hm... You return and yet you still make so much noise. You'll scarcely leave me with enough time to meditate. I only have eternity, after all.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Have you ever heard the name 'Raeva Ferash Kenestos'?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*His expression betrays bemusement and mild confusion.*'' ...As I understand it, the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}} bear similar names. At least, for the ''most'' part. Though, I cannot say I am personally well-acquainted with the locals, given the circumstances. Where have you heard this name?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I found it in a manifesto signed with that name. It talks of a Kyrsgarde commander who seemingly resisted Ethrion's thrall.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*He raises an eyebrow.*'' How... Unusual. Where did you come by such a thing?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I found a copy on the body of a powerful Kyrsgarde Champion.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Indeed? And what did this {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} look like?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}They were significantly taller than the others, and wore a cape. They also carried a strange glaive decorated with Moonseye symbols.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}...Most curious. Your description of this 'Champion' is eerily similar to that of the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} commander who took me prisoner during the siege of {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}}. The circumstances of it were unusual, to say the least. He is the sole reason I am now captive here, as opposed to lying among the bodies of my kin within the ruins of the city. An uncanny coincidence... Or, perhaps, a strange twist of fate.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What was unusual about your capture?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Look around you. Can you count how many {{g|Lightborn}} you see here? I'll tell you - only ''one''. The rest of my kin were given no quarter during the siege. The invaders took no prisoners. But just as I was moments away from my own death at the hands of their warriors, a {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} commander matching your description intervened, and ordered my capture instead. Does that not strike you as bizarre? Stranger yet, he appeared to wield a weapon of our own design - a glaive bearing motifs of the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}}. And his movements seemed much more refined than those of his warriors. More... ''lucid'' {{sic}}
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Strangely individual quirks for a Kyrsgarde, given their enthrallment.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}...Indeed. If this 'Champion' and the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan}} commander are one of the same, this only raises more questions. Given everything you've told me, it sounds as though this one has somehow escaped {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron's}} control. What's more - of the three names you mentioned, the first one is distinctly non-Kyrsan, and is well-known to me. {{g|Raeva}} was the name of one of the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} that presided over {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}} before I came to rule the city. I was not there for their departure, but until now, I had assumed they fled, like the others...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you make of all this?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*His eyes narrow contemplatively.*'' All of this seems too specific to be a coincidence. But I cannot offer any satisfying answers to these questions. My original presumption was that all of the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} fled {{g|Constellia, the Guiding Star|Constellia}} before the {{g|Kyrsan / Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans}} came - none of them were seen during the siege. But perhaps this was not the case?.. Whatever this 'Champion's' reason for possibly adopting ''that'' name is, it's clear that there are things about that woeful day which even I had no clue of...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}

</tabber>

==Trivia==
*The "immortals" that Kaide mentions in his dialogue are presumably the [[Deepwoken]]. His hesitation when he mentions this brings up the possibility that the term is a sacred or touchy subject. It also could mean that the Pathfinder and other people in Lumen cannot comprehend the concept of a Deepwoken.
**When he references immortal individuals ruling the world from the shadows, he may be referring to [[Drallis Ehr]], the ageless ruler of [[The Central Authority]] who is famed for his secrecy.
*The relics mentioned by Kaide may be referring to the [[Moon's Eyrie]] and the [[Random Encounters#Resonant Dawn|Resonant Dawn]] event, which are both found in the [[Voidsea]].
*Kaide's old appearance consisted of the [[Soren]] outfit, deep purple eyes, with the halo of the same color hanging over his wolf cut.
*Kaide is one of the only NPCs to have special dialogue depending on the Pathfinder's weapon and Oath.
**When speaking to Kaide with a [[Kyrsieger]] equipped, he judges the Pathfinder as the Kyrsieger was used in an assault on Constellia, the city Kaide ruled over.
**When speaking to Kaide with a [[Soulthorn]] equipped, he reminisces Zhatarn, a Celestial that was exiled from the Heavens who once wielded the Soulthorn.
**When speaking to him while having [[Oath: Starkindred]], he recognizes the scent of Celestials, calling the Pathfinder "Depraved" as they used to be. Even though he scorns Celestials because of betrayal, he "had hoped better, not sure himself why" when felt their scent from the Pathfinder. 
*Lightborn, due to being immortal, do not often show signs of aging. Despite this, Kaide has noticeable under-eye wrinkles consistent with stage 2 of the aging process. According to [[Mikhail Spellhardt]], a Lightborn will change appearance over time if something is weighing on their mind and soul, so Kaide's wrinkles may be a result of him "feeling old" or having many responsibilities that weigh upon his mind constantly.<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Mikhail Spellhardt|quote=I suppose it's natural to your kind, but for us {{g|Lightborn}}, the passage of time isn't really a concern . We don't age quite like your lot do, and we appear ageless. But Galpin, well... Lysander says that if something weighs heavy on the heart and soul of one of our kind, their appearance changes to reflect their feelings.}}</ref>
*Kaide's clothing IDs are the following: [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/81399248825021/God-Kings-Swordsman Shirt] / [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/124979649911501/God-Kings-Swordsman Pants]
*Kaide's hair IDs are [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/87549044824881/Long-Black-Straight-Hair 87549044824881] / [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/135749891781739/Black-Anime-Male-Long-Hair 135749891781739]

== Description ==
The Kanabo is a [[Weapons|Heavy Weapon]] that scales with and requires [[Attributes|Strength]] in addition to Heavy. It is a long mace-like hammer that displays pure damage.
==Criticals==
<gallery widths="300" position="center>
File:Kanabo - Standing (Whiff).gif|Standing critical, whiffed
File:Kanabo - Standing.gif|alt=
File:Kanabo - Running.gif|Running critical
</gallery>

The Kanabo has two criticals.

For the '''standing''' critical, the user winds up, stomping the ground before unleashing a devastating blow, ragdolling and launching opponents from great distances, and '''insta-guardbreaking''' opponents who attempt to block it. This critical does '''1.7x scaled damage.''' If there is no eligible target, the critical will be abruptly ended without continuing.

For the '''running''' critical, the user winds up before unleashing two unblockable slams each dealing '''0.5x scaled damage''' followed by a larger third slam that ragdolls and knocks away, dealing '''0.6x scaled damage.''' This critical has [[Hyperarmor]], but cancels on dodge or parry.

Both criticals share the cooldown of '''8 seconds'''.

title: Karas
content:
{{Topbuttons|[[Zana]], {{iv|p}}}} {{IronVowEx|counterpart}} {{Quotes|quote=T-that wasn't fair, dude... J-just... Enjoy the ring, jerk. Who even cares, man... I'm telling my MOM about you.|author=Karas}} {{EnemyInfobox |health=500 |weapon=* [[Shattered Katana]] |image1=Karas.png |caption1=CUT MY LIFE INTO PIECES |moves=* Assault * Critical |pronouns=He/him}} == Description == Karas is a [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a rather bombastic individual who actually has some pretty deep-seated insecurities. Karas gives the player a quest to obtain a [[Poser's Ring]], a Katana-exclusive ring that deals all damage at once onto a target upon sheathing. You can do his quest no matter what weapon you use. He wears a [[Royal Pathfinder]] and the [[Cutthroat Light Armor]] [[Outfit]]. == Location == Karas can be found at the island southwest to the one with the [[Summer Isle|Summer Inn]]. File:Karas Location.png ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{sh|DREAD ME, LITTLE ONE. IN THE UNLIKELY CASE OF YOUR VICTORY, PERHAPS I WILL REWARD YOUR COURAGE...}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''He seems to be dumbfounded.''* H... Hey... There's nothing-- *''The stranger clears his throat.''* {{sh|THERE IS NOTHING WRONG WITH MY APPEARANCE, WORM. MY MOTHER MADE THIS COAT FOR ME. WEAKLINGS SUCH AS YOU WOULD SLING THEIR INSULTS AT THOSE WHO CHERISH THEIR KIN, AND DRESS ACCORDING TO THEIR HIGH STATION. FACE ME IN BATTLE, AND WE'LL SEE IF YOUR ACTIONS ARE AS BOLD AS YOUR WORDS.}} jerk... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Let it be so. What are your terms? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're on, trashbag. Name your terms. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''They consider you momentarily, then shake their head, chuckling.''* {{sh|THE REWARD WHICH I HAVE IN MIND WOULD BENEFIT YOU LITTLE, BRAVE FRESHSPAWN. BUT BE THAT AS IT MAY, MY BOUNTEOUS REWARD IS YOURS, IF YOU DEFEAT ME IN MY NATURAL HABITAT. WHICH I DOUBT YOU WILL...}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''They consider you momentarily, then hesitantl'' [sic] ''shake their head again.''* Um... Th-the item wouldn't... You'd not-- *''He clears his throat again.''* {{sh|MY BOONS WILL BE OF LITTLE USE TO YOU, WEAK AND BRUTISH FOOL. BUT BE THAT AS IT MAY, A DUEL IS A DUEL. MY BOUNTEOUS REWARD IS YOURS, IF YOU DEFEAT ME IN MY NATURAL HABITAT. WHICH I DOUBT YOU WILL...}} chump... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Where? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{sh|FIND ME FIRST IN STARSWEPT ARATEL, WHERE THE CLASH OF BLADES IS UNCEASING, AND WHERE THE WEAK LEARN TO FEAR THE STRONG. BEFORE THE GATES WE SHALL DO BATTLE. SHOULD YOU DEFEAT ME THERE, I SHALL REVEAL TO YOU THE NEXT LOCATION OF OUR DUELS.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Quest in Progress= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player defeats Karas at Starswept Aratel {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{sh|BAH. BEGINNER'S LUCK. THE HEAT OF THE DESERT MADE ME LOSE GRIP ON MY BLADE. BUT WE'RE NOT FINISHED. MEET ME NEXT IN THE SONGSEEKER WILDS, WHERE AVARICIOUS SOULS CONQUER UNSUSPECTING FOES. SHOULD YOU DEFEAT ME THERE, I SHALL REVEAL TO YOU THE NEXT LOCATION OF OUR DUELS.}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player defeats Karas at Songseeker Wilds {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{sh|VEXING. FRUSTRATING. I WILL BE GOING ALL OUT FOR OUR NEXT DUEL, WEAKLING- MAY MY MASTERS FORGIVE ME. MONKEY'S PAW, WHERE WARRIORS VIE FOR GLORY AND PLUNDER, AND NO HONOUR IS FOUND AMONGST THIEVES. YOU WILL FAIL}} {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Quest End= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player defeats Karas at Monkey's Paw {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}T-that wasn't fair, dude! Rigged!.. My palms were sweaty, my shoelace was untied, I was off-balance... Why did we fight at Monkey's Paw, anyway, that's so far from my home! J-just take the prize, dork. Who cares! I'm telling my MOM about you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], Player receives [[Poser's Ring]] }} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''His voice trembles.''* T-that wasn't fair, dude... J-just... Enjoy the ring, jerk. Who even cares, man... I'm telling my MOM about you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} == Moveset == Karas' arsenal consists only of a [[Shattered Katana]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★☆☆) |Karas performs a quick vertical and horizontal slash, which he then follows up with two additional delayed aftercuts. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} == Finisher == Karas executes his opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |User pins down the opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |} == Quest == Karas will challenge you in 3 different locations. ==== Location 1 ==== In front of the gate at [[The Starswept Valley]]. ==== Location 2 ==== At the shore of the Songseeker Island facing the mainland, on a rocky surface. ==== Location 3 ==== The entrance of [[The Monkey's Paw]], He spawns after the narrow channel with the falling leaves. Karas acts as an encounter in the places you're suppose to challenge him; so it'll take time for him to spawn in. You must deal 100% of the damage dealt to Karas in order for the quest to progress. Once Karas is defeated, he'll drop a chest after roughly 20 seconds with Songseeker related loot. == Trivia == *"Karas" means "war" in {{W|Lithuanian language|Lithuanian}}. *Just like [[Zana]], they also seem to reference metamancers, but instead of those of Verse 1, he references those of Late Verse 2, mentioning that he's not a wielder of "the emerald thunder which strikes fear into the hearts of many", making allusion to the [[Specialist Plate|Specialist Set]]. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Quests]]

==Description==
Karliah is an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is an apprentice Diver in [[Etris]] who allows you to [[Attributes Unbound|unbound]] your Charisma. Karliah's quest has numerous Charisma checks, and you can only unbind the attribute if you have it at max, that being seventy-five (75).

More details about the quest can be found [[Etris#Diver_Apprentice_Quest|here]].

After the quest, Karliah quits [[The Divers]] and can be found resting in her house wearing different clothing. Now grateful for your insight on the realities of life, she reflects on how friendly the people of Etris are with her.

==Dialogue==
NOTE: '''This quest is not repeatable.''' Choosing the dialogues that escort Karliah into the Erisian Mines or tell her to get stronger, doing so will end the quest unsuccessfully and not unbound your Charisma.

{{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*You can see a young {{g|Adret}} woman packing supplies into a bag, too absorbed in her preparations to notice her surroundings.*''

{{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hello?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}Oh, hey, didn't notice you there. I'm Karliah, apprentice {{g|The Divers|Diver}} extraordinaire!

{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're a 'Diver'?
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you doing here in Etrea?
