{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}I'm undergoing training to become a full member of the {{g|The Divers|Divers}}! Based at the {{g|The Citadel of Markor|Citadel}} in Markor, they're at the front of research into understanding the mysteries of the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}.
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}I was sent here as a part of my training. I'm about to head out on an expedition, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't nervous.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why do you want to become a Diver?
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What type of expedition is it?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}''*Karliah grimaces slightly.*'' I lost a childhood friend of mine to mudskippers a few years ago. I want to do my part in creating a safer world through understanding the dangers of the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}.
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}I'll be heading into the Erisian mines to sample some of the cave flora. I don't imagine I'll run into too much trouble, but going on my own is a little out of my depth...

{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What if I go with you as your escort?

{{!}}-

{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Of course. Adventuring is my specialty.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Sure, for 20 Notes. [Charisma]

==Trivia==
*Karliah's hair combo is 4584787037.
*Karliah Hex Code Colors: #96acba Skin | #5D6072 Hair | #daa400 Pupils | #be0000 Facial Marking
*Karliah seems to show a romantic interest in your character, likely as a result of the player's high charisma required to begin her questline.
*Karliah is quite inexperienced in combat, and was easily beaten down by [[Mudskipper]]s during her quest.
*Karliah wears the [[Diver Apprentice]] outfit as a Diver and the [[Hired Mercenary]] armor after the quest.
*With enough Charisma, you can get {{c|Notes|20}} out of Karliah by choosing "Sure, for 20 Notes. [Charisma]"
*Karliah is visibly short. Her in-game model is shorter than every other NPC, including [[the Pathfinder]]. This is a trait shared with [[Epsi]], although Epsi is short because he is a child.
*Karliah's hair can be found [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/4584787037/Brunette-Bangs-w-bun here].
*Karliah can be seen in the [[Main Menu]] screen along with [[Kennith]] and [[Polis]].

Kasen is a [[Capra]] NPC in [[Sanctuary Gatehouse]], [[Second_Layer/The_Ethironal_Shrine|Eternal Gale]]. The fastest way to get to them is, upon entering the Shrine, immediately turn right and dash off of the bridge and onto the cliffs. Then, jump down.

==Description==
The Katana is a Medium Weapon that has a base damage of 18 and requires 25 MED to equip. Its damage is increased by 25% (5% when Alloyed) when wearing the [[Vigil Initiate]], [[Cloak of Winds]], or [[Royal Etrean Guard]] [[outfits]], due to their innate Talent: ''{{t|Paired Soul}}''.

Additionally, you can upgrade the Katana with the use of a [[Pluripotent Alloy]], turning it into an endgame weapon by increasing its stats and adding a slight purple hue to the blade.

When paired with the [[Poser's Ring]], the damage of its M1s and critical attacks will be suspended until it is sheathed, at which point all of that damage is inflicted at once. This damage cannot exceed 70% of a player's maximum health.

<gallery widths="300" position="center">

title: Kelsius
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|name=Kelsius
|aspect=Adret
|pronouns=He/him
|affiliation=*[[The Central Authority]] <small>(formerly)</small>
*[[Etrea]]
|location=[[Temple of the Blade]]
|image1=Kelsius.png}}

==Description==
Kelsius is an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He works as the librarian at the [[Isle of Vigils]].

Upon accepting his quest, he tasks the player into retrieving his lost books for a mantra hand and access to books to instantly gain a random attribute point. If the player has already obtained an extra mantra hand, completing his quest will instead reward 1 [[Knowledge]].

He is a [[Thundercall]]er and former member of [[the Central Authority]]'s Shock Corps.

==Location==
Kelsius is located inside the library at [[Temple of the Blade]].
<gallery widths="300px">
Kelsius Location.png|Kelsius Location
</gallery>

==Dialogue== 
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= 
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Ah, welcome to my library. Looking for something?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you have any books I can buy?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Hmm... I don't think I would be willing to part with such knowledge without a good judge of your character. Would you be interested in completing an errand for me? It shouldn't take too long.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Alright, I'll help you out.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...They're just books. Why do you care?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Ah. Well. Some young folk borrowed a few of my books for what was meant to be a couple of weeks, and they still haven't returned them after three months... Could you retrieve them for me?
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}These are books that further one's understanding of the {{g|The Song|Song}} - Codexes. {{sic|expected=Codices}} They aren't the dry accounts of commerce you'd find in an Adretian library. Generations of brave and intrepid researchers have dedicated their entire lives solely to uncovering the knowledge now contained within these tomes. I'm not so foolish as to hand them over to whoever passes by. To do so would be an insult to their sacrifice.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Sure, I'll get them for you.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}On second thought, no thanks.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Great! They've been skulking around somewhere on the island. Can't be too far away. I'm expecting great things from you! ''*He grins and gives you two thumbs up.*''
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}That's alright! You can come back to me whenever if you still want those books - and don't mind carrying out an errand for me.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest End=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has retrieved the books
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player hasn't retrieved the books
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Ah, excellent work! As a token of my thanks, please take these cards of mine. Perhaps you'll find some use for them? And feel free to browse through any of the books here.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Huh. You don't have the books? That's alright, but I can't offer you any of the books here until you bring them back.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What books do you have to offer?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Ah yes, I have information on a variety of skills. It'll cost you about [X] notes.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Alright.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has enough experience
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player does not have enough experience
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has no available attributes
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ah perfect, I found something just for you.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I think you should go get a little more experience before hitting the books.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I don't think anything in this library would be of any use to you!
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player gains a random attribute point
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Castaway Origin, with Tutorial=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Hmm... I hope you won't mind me asking, but what brings you to this part of the world?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}We were headed to Etrea when our ship was attacked by the Authority and we capsized.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}...You don't say. I'm... I'm sorry. ''*His expression seems racked with pain.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Everything alright?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I... I used to serve under them. Not anymore. That much I assure you. But... I would be more than happy to let you peruse the books here, Really, it's the least I can do.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So... The books?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Oh! Er... Yes! I have information on a variety of skills. It'll cost you about [X] notes.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Alright.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See previous instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
}}

|-|Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Oh, welcome back. Are you looking for anything today?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What books do you have to offer?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Tell me about yourself.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Myself? What an interesting question to ask a librarian... ''*Ahem.*'' Well, before I came here to the Temple I was an officer in the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}. Specifically, I worked in the Shock Corps as a {{g|Thundercall|Thundercaller}}.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Continue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Our stated mission was to dismantle guerrilla elements in the {{g|The Central Luminant|Central Luminant}}. Only, those '' 'guerrilla elements' '' often turned out to be peaceful protests against the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Continue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}We were always told to keep our mind off the politics and focus on the work, but I never could quite disassociate from the oppression we were complicity in as tools of the government. So I handed in my badge, jumped on the first ship I saw, and never looked back.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And then what?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Finally, the good Maestro here saw my prowess in the {{g|The Song|Song}} and offered me a position in this library looking after the many Codexes {{sic|expected=Codices}} stored in this temple.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
</tabber>

== Lost Books Quest ==
This quest tasks the player with retrieving the missing books from the cabin located under [[Etris]]. Upon interacting with the NPC blocking the doorway, they will move aside and allow entry inside the cabin, the player will then have to speak to [[Khan (NPC)|Khan]], who reveals Kelsius as a "murderer" and knocking the player out. Upon returning to Kelsius, the player gains a mantra hand and the ability to use the attribute books for notes. 

If the quest was done on the account previously, Kelsius will instead ask the player to find the books in Isle of Vigils. These books can be located behind the building that resides the [[Antiquarian]] and [[Banker]] on a pile of rocks.

<gallery widths=300px>
Kelsius Quest Book.png|The books if the quest was done on your account previously
Kelsius Quest Book Location.png|Location of the books if the quest was done on your account previously
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Despite his record, Kelsius was accepted by the Maestro to work as the vigils librarian.
*You are able to completely skip the quest and unlock special dialogue if you have completed the [[Castaway]] tutorial on the same character.
*Oddly enough, having the [[Authority Ensign]] [[Origin]] doesn't unlock new dialogue from him, despite his past as a member of the Shock Corps.
*Kelsius' dialogue used to be slightly different, with there being two possible avenues to inquire about their past. One was more direct, while the other was more subtle, and Kelsius would react appropriately.
*Kelsius will still suggest the books are on the Isle of Vigils even if the books have not been retrieved previously, and thus are on [[Etris]] instead.

title: Kennith
content:
{{Topbuttons|p, {{iv|Kennith (Vow of Iron)}}}} {{PathfinderEx|counterpart}} {{Spoiler}} {{NPCInfobox |image1= Kennith.png|Etris Lostkennith.png|New Kyrsa |name=Kennith |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=He/him |affiliation=[[Etrea]] |location=*[[Etris]]
*[[Kyrsan Wilds]] }} ==Description== Kennith is an [[Etrean]] working for law enforcement in [[Etris]], suspicious of his leader, [[The Lord Regent]] of Etrea. He keeps an eye on suspicious individuals. He wears an [[Investigator's Hat]] and [[Brigand's Cloak]], as well as the [[Etrean Guard]] Expert [[Outfits|Outfit]], which is shared by [[Etrean Guardsmen]]. Should one have enough [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]], Kennith will implore them to find information on the Lord Regent. Upon interviewing Bookkeeper Andros, Kennith is dragged to the Lord Regent, killed and pinned out in the [[Etrean Wilds]] to be found. This results in him being sent to the [[Kyrsan Wilds]], where he can be found and informed of the situation in Etris. {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|Etris= {{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= '''Kennith''' begins his questline if you have High friend [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Well, if it isn't [Full Name]! It sure puts an Etrean's heart at ease seeing you around. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm sorry, have we met? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}I can't say we have, but you're somewhat famous around here. A man like Kennith ought to show appreciation for those who serve this great nation- I'm Kennith, by the way. ''*His shining white teeth glimmer as he cracks a smile.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Right... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Is it just me, or does this feel like the start of a friendship that was written in the stars? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yeah, sure, I guess. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I feel the same way. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ah, er, anyways. Friend-to-friend, do you think I could count on you to check something out for me? {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Kennith's eyes twinkle with ever-increasing reverence,*'' You've made my week, [First Name]. Do you think I could count on you to check something around here for me? Friend-to-friend. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Check something? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Indeed. You see, as a simple man who wants the best for the land I grew up in, I chose the path of becoming a guard. Common-folk like myself have no place in politics around these parts, after all. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Nod] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Be that as it is, I believe a man who cares for his town-folk ought to ask the questions no one is asking. Why is it that barring baseline guard provisions there is no real movement from Etrea's government? Why is there seemingly no active effort from our leadership to improve things around here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So what is it that you want? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}As a fellow aspiring hero of Etrea, I want your help in investigating the current Lord Regent's rise to power. Personally if it were legal without official audience, I'd like to just ask the man what's going on myself, but I figure learning a bit more about him first is the better approach. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll look into it. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Dear old friend! I knew I could count on you. You might find some leads by talking to the other townsfolk. I'll keep checking around myself, let me know if you happen upon anything. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], quest starts {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Quest Ongoing= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}}Found a lead? {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Not yet. {{!}}- {{!}}Alright just let me know if you happen upon anything. {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lower Reputation= '''Kennith''' will not begin his questline if you have lower than High Friend [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|action}} {{!}}Neutral Reputation or above, but below High Friend with Etrea {{!}} {{cl|action}} {{!}}Negative Reputation with Etrea {{!}}- {{!}}I've got an eye on you, so don't go causing any trouble around here... {{!}}''*The strangely dressed Etrean guard spits in your general direction.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} |-|Kyrsan Wilds= After he is killed by one of the [[Royal Etrean Guard]]s, appearing in the [[Kyrsan Wilds]]. {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Kennith is that you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The last thing I remember... One of the Regent's guards clad in black threw a bag over my head. Everything beyond that is a thousand needles. A thousand lacerations. Then black. All black. Now here. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm sorry. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Snooping around a tyrant's affairs. Didn't you see it coming? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No, friend. I probably should have seen it coming. It all feels so obvious now, like a veil's been lifted. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Pah! A tyrant? The regent is... Wait. Huh. I guess you're right. Feels like some kinda veil's lifted, now that you've pointed that out.. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How long have you been down here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Hm? I only just stirred, so I'm not sure. Can't have been that long though, right? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Kennith is that you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}The last thing I remember... One of the Regent's guards clad in black threw a bag over my head. Everything beyond that is a thousand needles. A thousand lacerations. Then black. All black. Now here. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You said the same thing before. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Huh? When? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Last time I was down here. [Available if the player escaped after talking to him for the first time] {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Five minutes ago. You're losing the plot. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Huh? But I haven't seen you since Etris.. Or... Huh. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}No... That can't be right, can it? Did I hit my head or something? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's up? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Just messing with you. {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yeah man, huge gash on your head. Should probably do something about that. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Something's not right here... I'm losing track of time. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Oh! Haha. Just a joke between friends, I see. Only... I really do feel like I've hit my head... {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Gods below! Thanks for letting me know, friend. Might've bled out and died otherwise, hah. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Read "Operation 'Puppet Master' Report"= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Kennith is that you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}The last thing I remember... One of the Regent's guards clad in black threw a bag over my head. Everything beyond that is a thousand needles. A thousand lacerations. Then black. All black. Now here. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm sorry. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}No, friend. I probably should have seen it coming. It all feels so obvious now, like a veil's been lifted {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You're closer than you think. There's a mental veil placed over Etris. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}Huh. No kidding. Guess it wasn't my own stupidity, after all. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How long have you been down here? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="20" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== Kennith dead.png|Kennith on the wall ==Trivia== *Having read the [[Operation 'Puppet Master' Report]] will unlock unique dialogue with Kennith in the [[Kyrsan Wilds]]. **Being a [[Oath: Contractor|Contractor]] does not unlock any unique dialogue with him. *The reason he's in the [[Second Layer]] is because a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wd7Qp4SlxTM satirical video] was made, showing him bonding with and then entering in a relationship with Ambrosius. Developer Arch_Mage saw this video, and decided to add Kennith to Layer 2 as a result.[[File:ArchApprovesKennithYaoi.png|200px]] **Ironically, the video shows Kennith in [[Firfire]], while he was ultimately placed in the Kyrsan Wilds. *Kennith's corpse still has a talk hitbox, but nothing happens if you try to talk to him, *Kennith shares the same hair as [[Ministry Necromancer]]s (4735347390). *Kennith can be seen in the [[Main Menu]] screen along with [[Karliah]] and [[Polis]]. *Kennith's blood was originally red before being changed to purple for censorship reasons. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Etrea]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Etrean Luminant]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Second Floor of the Second Layer]]

==Description==
Kennith is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a citizen of [[Etris]].

He aspires to be an Etrean Guardsman when he grows older. [[The Inheritor]] believes in him, but maybe that belief is misplaced.

==Location==
Kennith can be found sitting on a mat with his toys at [[Etris]], near the Frostdraw hut.
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Baby Kennith.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="1" |''*A little Etrean boy with a sparkle in his eye appears to be playing pretend, wearing a strange hat. A wooden toy sword hangs by his hip.*'' I can't wait to be a guard one day! I'll do my best to be the '''''hero''''' Etrea needs!..
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Kid, you're gonna do a great job in the future. I believe in you.
|-
| colspan="1" |''*The child smiles at you, full of glee.*'' You really think so? Thanks! I'll do my best! One day, maybe I'll be a detective, just like my pa!..
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

Khans have a strength and agility bonus, the ability to use equipment 3 points earlier as well as having increased reputation with [[The Hundred Legions]]. ==Traits== |-|Pathfinder =

The circlets can be [[Dye Packet|dyed]]. |-|Tamarin= File:KhanCTamarin1.png File:KhanCTamarin2.png File:KhanCTamarin3.png File:KhanCTamarin4.png File:KhanCTamarin5.png File:KhanCTamarin6.png |-|Capuchin= File:KhanCCapuchin1.png File:KhanCCapuchin2.png File:KhanCCapuchin3.png File:KhanCCapuchin4.png File:KhanCCapuchin5.png File:KhanCCapuchin6.png |-|Albino= File:KhanCAlbino1.png File:KhanCAlbino2.png File:KhanCAlbino3.png File:KhanCAlbino4.png File:KhanCAlbino5.png File:KhanCAlbino6.png |-|Silverback= File:KhanCSilverback1.png File:KhanCSilverback2.png File:KhanCSilverback3.png File:KhanCSilverback4.png File:KhanCSilverback5.png File:KhanCSilverback6.png |-|Hallowtide= File:KhanCHallowtide1.png File:KhanCHallowtide2.png File:KhanCHallowtide3.png File:KhanCHallowtide4.png File:KhanCHallowtide5.png File:KhanCHallowtide6.png ==Gallery== Monsksipper2.png|Monkskipper during [[Mudwoken]] ==Trivia== *The aspect is based on monkeys, drawing elements from {{W|Sun Wukong}} and his iconic crown, as well as their name and natural disposition as warriors referencing {{W|Genghis Khan}}. **Khan means "King" in Mongolian, and Hindi, Hence the reason why they have a crown as ornament. **In the novel ''{{W|Journey to the West}}'', the crown of Sun Wukong is actually a curse. *During the 4/1/2022 April Fools update (Mudwoken), Khan's aspect name was changed to Monkskipper. *When in character creation, if you reroll off of Khan and choose to switch back to it, instead of saying "Switch to Khan" it says "Return to Khan" as a reference to the "Reject humanity, return to monke" meme. *Weapons with tri-stat requirements can be equipped whilst nine points under their normal requirements, this also goes for weapons with a dual-stat requirement, which can be equipped whilst 6 points under the normal requirements. *Khans are known to bet on fights.[[File:Celtor and Khan lore.png|Arch_Mage stating that Khans frequently bet on fights.|400px]] ==References== [[Category:Aspects]]

content:

BDY: 2.5 |posture damage=4.5 |range=7.5 |swing speed=1.05x |penetration=10% |special effect=Critical cooldown is cleared on hit and can be used multiple times. Applies [[Wither]] on critical if your [[Starkindred]] wings are out. |requirements=50 MED, 30 BDY |m.equip=No|selling price=50 |obtainment=*Sold in [[Traan Zakshun|Traan Zakshun's]] black market for {{c|crowns|1}} *[[Maljuror]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *Sold in [[Naan Zakshun|Naan Zakshun's]] black market for {{c|notes|1,000}} |rarity=Rare |description=A blade forged from pale metal recovered from [[Celestial]] crash-sites by [[The Starkindred Church|Starkindred]] artisans. Nearly weightless, this type of blade is a staple in the West amongst adherents of the faith. Once one has spilt enough of their own blood in service of the Church, they are bestowed a weapon thrice-bathed in the sacred ichor of a Celestial.}} == Description == The Kindred Edict is a Medium-Body Sword; a pallid, glimmering blade forged from the remnants of Celestial crash sites, used as a staple in the Starkindred Faith. == Critical == File:Edict1.gif|Standing File:Edict2.gif|Aerial The Kindred Edict has two criticals. For the '''standing''' critical, the user unleashes a horizontal slash that hits twice and dazes the opponent. Upon landing, the user is given a speed boost. The critical cooldown will be cleared upon hit, and can be used multiple times. The speed boost can stack multiplicatively. The standing critical does 0.55x scaled damage per hit, hitting twice for 1.1x scaled damage in total. For the '''aerial''' critical, the user leaps above and performs a downslash that hits twice and dazes the opponent. Upon landing, the user is given a speed boost and will be sent back upwards. The critical cooldown will be cleared upon hit, and can be used multiple times. The speed boost can stack multiplicatively. The aerial critical does 0.45x scaled damage per hit, hitting twice for 0.9x scaled damage in total. This also has innate {{cl|Bleed}} damage. Both criticals apply 5 [[Wither]] on hit if your [[Starkindred]] wings are out. Both criticals have a cooldown of '''6 seconds''' if whiffed. {{text|m1tag2}} == Gallery == File:EdictHeld.png|One-handed stance File:EdictHeld2.png|Two-handed stance File:EdictCycle.gif|M1 Cycle == Trivia == *Judging by the aerial critical and the weapon's model, Kindred Edict could be a ''Hollow Knight'' reference. The aerial critical resembles the pogo from Hollow Knight's base attack, and the weapon's model is similar to that of Hollow Knight's [https://hollowknight.fandom.com/wiki/Nail Nail]. *Uniquely, this weapon uses the running attack animation from [[Spears]]. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Swords]] [[Category:Medium Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Animations]] [[Category:Core-Attribute based weapons]] [[Category:The Starkindred Church]]

title: King's Colosseum
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Stub}}
{{Location|name=King's Colosseum|territory=The Hundred Legions|lawless=true|caption=Far to the west, warriors are forged in the heat of battle.}}
[[File:King's Colosseum.png|center|thumb|900px]]
'''King's Colosseum''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is one of the unique areas exclusive to the [[Battle Royale]] gamemode.

== Overview ==
With a healing orb in the middle and an open place nobody can hide, this is often a place where people fight, though not too often due to the lack of loot. 

Most of the loot is located on the sill-like structures of the colosseum but is spread out and hard to obtain quickly. Two totems/shrines for Talent are almost always at a certain entrance.

== Trivia ==
*This is the complete center of the map though widely misunderstood as the place the zone encloses on. 
*While this is true for some games, the zone is usually random closing off on anywhere from the temples on the high peaks or the coastal areas closer to sea level.
*Otherwise, this location is not a good place to land or linger an can sometimes be unoccupied for whole games.
*Found in battle royale on [[Kingmaker's Isle]]

5500 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=Advanced [[Mantra Modifiers]] |locations=[[First Layer]] |image1= KinggigamedIcon.png|Normal GigaHat.png|Hat |challenges= {{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} |title1=King Gigamed}} == Description == Gigantic, Purple versions of Normal [[Gigamed]]s, found in the '''''[[First Layer]]'''''. They have different attacks and behavior as opposed to the Gigamed. Commonly referred to as '''Mama/Mother Jellyfish & King Jellyfish'''. Sometimes, they can be very stylish and dapper. == Attacks == {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Greater Stun Pulse'''
(★☆☆) |Emits a large pulse attack that can target one player per use. *Deals ~30 damage. *After they use this attack, they will back away if a player is close to them, and come closer if a player isn't close to them. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Static Discharge'''
(★★☆) |The King screeches and releases a purple AoE attack that pushes you away from them and stuns you for a short duration. However, this attack deals little to no damage. *Be cautious when fighting them near cliffs. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Gigamed Erupt'''
(★★☆) |The King screeches and summons 3 Gigameds that are launched towards your position. *The summoned Gigameds will die after using Electric Stun Pulse, along with having 1 health, allowing them to die to even a Vent. **Electric Stun Pulse is a [[Gigamed]] attack that, similar to Greater Stun Pulse, causes a pulse of a electricity in an AoE. This attack is blockable and dodgeable, but not parryable. *If killed, the summoned Gigameds will give you a solid healthpack. {{AttackTags |summon }} |} === Finisher === {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |
'''Bull Suck''' |Teleports to you and drives itself into your body, consuming you. This is a very fast gripping animation, so don't underestimate it. |} == Gallery == File:Ten-Gallon Hat King Gigamed.png|A King Gigamed with a hat File:King Giggy Idle1.gif|A King Gigamed's idle animation ==Trivia== *There is an extremely rare chance that a King Gigamed will spawn with an oversized [[Ten-Gallon Hat|top hat]] whilst playing [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDE7DvHSVUA Jellyfish Jam], a reference to ''Spongebob Squarepants'' too. *King Gigamed has an intentionally cowardly behavior, meaning it will jump around objects and move in ways that makes it harder for you to fight it. *Despite not looking like it, The King Gigamed has a back, meaning you can proc {{t|Spine Cutter}} on it. *You can fight King Gigameds at low levels by venting when they are about to spawn Gigameds to get a healthpack, this is a consistent way as you get a lot of tempo from m1ing. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

title: King Thresher
content:
{{Quotes|quote=As Thresher nests become more gregarious and populated, a shift in their behaviour takes place, with the males growing in size and competing with one another. [...] This escalates into an undefeated 'King' emerging, standing at a stature far above its kin and leading the pack. Threshers led by a King are emboldened and may be found scouting far beyond their nest in order to expand their territories.|author=King Thresher Spine Description}} {{Monster Infobox |health=2500
6250 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |locations=[[Starswept Valley]]
[[The Depths]]
[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] |drops=(Common) *[[King Thresher Spine]] (Rare) *[[Mantra Modifiers]] *[[First Ranger Duster]]
(Rare)
*[[Acheron's Warspear]] *[[Serrated Warspear]] *[[True Seraph Spear]] |attacks=*Royal Breath *Talon Swipes *Rending Maul *Tail Sweep *Burrow *Body Slam |image1= KingThresher.png|Current KingMamaThresher.png|Old |challenges={{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== The King Thresher is a larger and usually older male [[Thresher]] that is found in the [[Starswept Valley]] and [[The Depths]]. Sometimes, it can be found with another Thresher. King Threshers, as its name suggests are similar to an [[Alpha Megalodaunt]] in terms of social hierarchy; a dominant Thresher leading their own pack. They are a result of male Threshers competing with each other in populated nests, where behavioral shifts sink in. Their growth is derived from an organ in their necks which can be significantly cut short if a competing Thresher's teeth is lodged into an opposing Thresher, thus leading into a Thresher emerging as a king. These Threshers have distinct features from their lesser counterparts, such as its large size, purple body, and a unique ability to breathe purple flames.[[King Thresher Spine]] A King Thresher is required to be killed to complete [[Jessamine]]'s [[Quests|Quest]], granting the Thresher Scales [[Echoes|Echo Talent]], which repairs the player's Armor while resting at a campfire. This quest can be completed/recompleted to get a hand of cards if you already have the Talent. == Attacks == {| class="sortable article-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |
'''Talon Swipes'''
(★☆☆) |The King Thresher stands on its hind legs and swipes twice. Deals moderate damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:King Thresher Talon Swipes.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Rending Maul'''
(★☆☆) |The King Thresher bites 3 times in quick succession. Deals moderate damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:King Thresher Rending Maul.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Tail Sweep'''
(★★☆) |The King Thresher brings its tail back and flicks around to deliver a powerful blow that deals a tremendous amount of posture damage. Deals moderate damage. Attacks following this move come out sooner. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, jump, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:King Thresher Tail Sweep.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Burrow'''
(★★☆) |The King Thresher burrows underground to avoid being hit and digs towards the player, jumping out and dealing moderate damage. *While burrowed, a red circle effect will flash on where they would normally be, serving as an indicator for their location. *When about to jump out of digging, a purple telegraph will flash, use this to time your defense. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |[[File:King Thresher Burrow.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Royal Breath'''
(★★★) |The King Thresher turns its head to the side before rapidly turning the other direction and breathing out purple flames. Starts with a sound cue and the sound of the King Thresher roaring. *Despite being unparriable and unblockable, it does not actually block-break you, instead merely bypassing your parry and block. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:King Thresher Royal Breath.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Body Slam'''
(★★☆) |The King Thresher stands on its hind legs for a moment before slamming its body into the ground. {{AttackTags |indicator = block |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.n, jump, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:King Thresher Body Slam.gif|border|frameless]] |- |} ===Passives=== *'''Serrated Claws''' - King Threshers have 100% PEN and inflict Bleed on hit. *'''Thresher Scales''' - King Threshers have 40% physical attack resistance. *'''Thick Hide''' - {{PAGENAME}}s automatically extinguish [[burn]]. == Finisher == {| class="fandom-table" ! Name !Description |- |'''Circus Trick''' |Flings the victim vertically into the air with its mouth, then catches it to eat them whole. |} == Tips == *Its attacks behave very similarly if not identical to the attacks of its smaller counterpart, the [[Thresher]], meaning knowledge learned from it can be re-applied to the King Thresher, except for its exclusive attacks, that being '''Royal Breath''' and '''Body Slam'''. **Though, the '''Burrow''' attack works somewhat differently from a Thresher's. The timing is much more strict due to the King Thresher being quicker to react to getting in its larger range, as well as having a larger rising hitbox, meaning you will have to pay more attention. *The '''Royal Breath''' attack has a very small window before it actually damages you, though its damage is relatively low. Be wary for this attack if you wish to avoid taking damage. *If you get hit by its '''Tail Sweep''' attack, press {{Input|keybind|feint}} to quickly get back up. It is recommended that you do this as it will allow you to defend yourself if it decides to use '''Royal Breath''' afterwards, which happens often. * It is one of the most dangerous [[Monsters]] to encounter '''Corrupted''' in [[The Depths]], second to only the [[Mudskipper Broodlord]]. This is due to its already high damage and health being amplified further due to being Corrupted, as well as its chasing ability being even more prominent due to the nature of Monsters in The Depths. * Avoid fighting it on sloped ground as it will keep moving back and forth, thus making it more difficult to avoid/parry it's attacks. If possible try to bring it towards flatter ground. * This is one of the Monsters that benefits the most from being in a horde alongside other Monsters as well as being in a chase regardless of the situation, due to its fast movement speed, its attacks having a large reach and from being able to shut down your movement, either from hitstun or from ragdolling. ** If you are not confident enough in your fighting ability against the King Thresher, then be aware of your surroundings and have an escape route planned as it might save your life. If you are in The Depths, be wary for other monsters. **A safe way to practice fighting a King Thresher would be to head to the [[Lightkeeper Temple]] located on the far right side of the [[Starswept Valley]]. Once you enter, on the right you will see a King Thresher in a room full of books. This method will allow you to escape through the small doorway whenever you get low on health, but do be wary as there are other [[Thresher|Threshers]] in the area. ==Gallery== Threshers Model Render.png|Old Model Renders ==Trivia== *Despite having flame visuals, '''Royal Breath''' is not Flamecharm and has never been Flamecharm. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

|desc=As [[Thresher]] nests become more gregarious and populated, a shift in their behaviour takes place, with the males growing in size and competing with one another. It's thought that this growth is spurred by an organ in their necks similar to the thyroid, as males will take one another out of the competition by sinking their teeth into the necks of their competitors, preventing them from growing any further. This escalates into an undefeated 'King' emerging, standing at a stature far above its kin and leading the pack. Threshers led by a King are emboldened and may be found scouting far beyond their nest in order to expand their territories.}}
==Description==
The '''King Thresher Spine''' is an [[Ingredient]] dropped from the [[King Thresher]], it can be found wherever the King Thresher can spawn, with those locations being [[Starswept Valley]], [[Deep Thresher Nest]], and [[The Depths]] or in the [[Diluvian Mechanism (NPC)|Diluvian Mechanism]].

== Trivia== 
*It is almost identical to a [[Thresher Spine]] except it has a purple tint instead of a brown one.
*The first actual 'use' for this item is to craft the [[Royal Etrean Guard]] outfit.
*Three of them can be used to summon [[Primadon]].

title: Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights |image1=Klaris.PNG |name=Klaris Llfiend |alias=Mother of Lights |aspect=Canor |pronouns=She/her |affiliation=*[[The Divers]]
**[[Black Divers division]] |location=[[Castle Light]] }} ==Description== Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights, is a [[Canor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is a [[Black Divers division|Black Diver]] in charge of the expeditions to and from [[The Eternal Gale]]. She is a young Canor who has long golden hair that end onto her shoulders. Two bangs rest on both sides of her face, reaching down to her upper chest. Her pupils glow white and have a "web" shape to it, and has vibrant yellow facial markings resembling lightning patterns. Above her head floating orb that resembles the [[Moonseye]], a sideffect of being a Dawnwalker. As a result of being the inventor/discoverer of the Radiant Tones she wears the standard [[Black Diver]] outfit. Of the Divers, she is considered one of the strongest, along with [[Chaser]] and [[Akira]].{{Ref/NPC|Carrion, Father of Evolution}} She is rather rude at times, frequently insulting those she views as weak, and is generally disliked by her fellow Divers.[[Mark Adaset]] She also appears rather arrogant, as she banished [[Cap'n Orlandeau]] to [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]] for disagreeing with her and how she reacts to players under Power 10 talking to her.[[Cap'n Orlandeau]] ==Location== ==Shop== {{ShopTable|newtable|newset |title=Medallion Exchange |name=Enchant Stone |currency=Kyrsan |price=5 |desc=A shard of enchantment; it can apply its given Enchant to your currently equipped weapon. }} {{ShopTable |name=Enchant Grease |currency=Kyrsan |price=5 |desc=An oil of enchantment; it can apply its given Enchant to your Equipment. }} {{ShopTable|end |name=Dye Packet |currency=Kyrsan |price=1 |desc=A vial of swirling colors crafted by the hand of a powerful Dawnwalker. Used to dye your equipment and various aspects of your appearance. }} {{ShopTable|newtable|end|endset| |title=Radiant Teachings |name=Treading the Light |currency=Kyrsan |price=15 |desc=Enhance your skills as a Dawnwalker. }} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {{#tag:tabber|Player is Power 10 or above= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Someone competent? That's rare. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why do you need competent people? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who are you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}We lost an expedition team heading into the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Second Layer}}. We sent one of our {{g|Black Divers}}, Chaser, down with about 20 experienced {{g|The Divers|Divers}}. Something seems to have gone wrong down there - it's not normal for him to not report back. We had reports from our scouts that powerful reverberations of the {{g|The Song|Song}} were coming from a passage within one of the Ethironal Sanctuaries. We think this might have clues to the resting place of {{g|Ethiron, the Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron}}. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Skip the honorifics and call me Klaris. I run things around here, and I guess you could say I'm credited with the discovery of the {{g|Radiant Tones}}, among other things. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So where does that leave me? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Ethiron? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Radiant Tones? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}We can't afford to keep sending more {{g|The Divers|Divers}} down, we're thin on our numbers as it is. If you and a team are willing to go, I will bless you with a '{{g|Light Hook}}' so you can make your way down. Also, if you can retrieve any of the {{g|The Divers|Divers}} we sent down we would really appreciate it. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}The {{g|The Drowned Gods|Drowned God}} of the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Eternal Gale}}. The one responsible for not only the harsh conditions of the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Second Layer}}, but also possibly the key we need to further understand the {{g|The Depths|Depths}} itself. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}The {{g|Radiant Tones}} are a Verse of the {{g|The Song|Song}} that can reproduce Light. According to our research, we believe {{g|Lightkeep|Lightkeepers}} have used it latently for centuries to Illuminate pathways through the {{g|The Voidsea|Voidsea}}, but I found a way to reproduce the Verse and wield it against the {{g|The Depths|Depths}} itself. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Light Hook? What's that? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So, why send me down? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So where does that leave me? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You talk about the Depths like it's a living creature. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The {{g|Light Hook}} is a special technique of the {{g|Radiant Tones}}. It will allow me to pull you back up from below should you suffer fatal injuries while it's active. Beware, as it will only last a maximum of 20 minutes once you enter the Layer. Less if you've used it recently. If you suffer fatal wounds after that time runs out... I'm afraid you'll have to take fate into your own hands, as no {{g|Light Hook}} will save you then. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}By the looks of it, you're the best bet around here for someone who might actually live to tell the tale, and explain what happened down there. The Apprentices on the {{g|Scyphozia, the First Layer|First Layer}} are simply not experienced enough, as made evident by our recent losses... I have hope for you. If you're willing, the '{{g|Light Hook}}' is ready. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}The landscape here... It ''reacts''. Evidently not through some specific will or agenda, but as if we were interacting on a microscopic level with the processes of some slumbering creature. Just as we take tiny particles of air into our own lungs, this thing seems to be processing us, as if we were fuel. Or worse, a waste product. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm ready. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Light Hook? Opened generator? Walked inside the base? Talked to the guy? Got union hook? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Chaser betrayed you. {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Chaser was somehow alive again. It seems time behaves weirdly down there. {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The Ignition Union have set up a base down there. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*She sighs.*'' I knew sending him down there was a mistake. But for him to turn on us like this... {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Huh. You're sure? We've received some accounts of the time dilation in the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Eternal Gale's}} area of effect, but this is something else entirely. More research is obviously required. It seems Chaser may remain a thorn in our side for a while yet... {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Ugh. How typical of them. They must have found ''some'' kind of grift down there. I'll tell the others to be wary of them on any expeditions. Still, I find it disturbing that they managed to establish a base there before us... We can't afford to underestimate those opportunists. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I thought you'd be more surprised. {{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{g|Black Divers}} are all driven by their ideals. For Akira and I, it's a desire to learn all we can about this place. For Chaser... It's clear he wants the spoils of whatever's down there all for himself. He's already got what he wanted from us, I suppose. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Floor 1 Optional= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Ah, you're back. Any clue? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Can you tell me about the Interstice of Skies? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}An... Arch-Diver? Either you've come across a surviving diver with an inflated ego, or... ''*She grimaces.*'' {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}...Never heard that phrase before in my life. I can only assume you're talking about the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Eternal Gale}}? It's relatively unexplored, we've had {{g|The Divers|Divers}} make it far but never return. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Or what? {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Or something much more troubling. If someone's story doesn't add up down there... Get away. Get away as quickly as possible. If you're up for it, another expedition would surely further our understanding of the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Second Layer}}. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Obtain Kyrsan Medallions {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Shown Kyrsan Medallions previously {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Meet Dr. Carrion in the Grand Library of New Kyrsa {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Know anything about this? [Show Kyrsan Medallion] {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you have to offer? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Uh, I met a strange man in Black Diver armor down in the Second Layer. He talked about monster parts. Called himself Dr. Diver. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*Her eyes light up briefly*'' Well I'll be.. So it's true? I had heard the stories about the City under the Gale, but I never imagined anything concrete would be produced. You could buy an entire Kingdom with those Medallions... if anyone knew that City existed, that is. Fortunately you may still be rewarded for your haul, how about you sell them to me? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Opens [[#Shop|Shop UI]]] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*Her nose wrinkles in a look of disgust.*'' I can only assume you found Dr. Carrion. Pay him no mind, he's absolutely useless for anything practical. He would let the world drown just to focus on his insane zoology expeditions. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What can you offer for Medallions? {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Opens [[#Shop|Shop UI]]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Others= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Talked to Nimea {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Having Dawnwalker {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Maxing out Dawnwalker {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You wouldn't happen to know a Lightkeeper from the Etrean Luminant, would you? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the significance of the Moonseye over our heads? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm ready. Let me speak the Words in their entirety. [10 Knowledge] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Ah... You must mean Viqh. I suppose I do know her yes, I learnt a great deal from her Gift. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}{{g|Lightkeep|Lightkeepers}} are not the only ones that project Light. So too does the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} cast its Light upon both halves of {{g|Lumen}}. Just as its watchful gaze keeps what little of the world that remains whole, we bear its image in the hope that we can take back what was lost. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Requirements Met {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Not Enough Knowledge {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...How is she? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The Moonseye projects Light? Why is that? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Hm. I won't deny that I'm impressed. Maybe it wasn't a mistake to share this {{g|Oaths|Oath}} with you. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Not everyone can be a prodigy, but I respect your confidence. Keep at it, diver. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*Klaris gives you a puzzled expression, seeming momentarily like she might dismiss your question, but conceding.*'' She is... preoccupied. {{g|Lightkeep|Lightkeepers}} do not get a great deal of rest, and what time she had spare she often spent writing. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*She sighs.*'' I'd like to know that for certain myself. As best as I can tell, it's likely something to do with its nature. Many believe that before the {{g|The Tides|Tides}}, souls departed for the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} upon the death of their corporeal forms. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], Maxed out Dawnwalker {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Writing? {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*She gives a thin smile.*'' Poetry, from what I could see. Though none of it is permitted to leave the Lighthouse. I believe there is a great deal she misses of her former life, before her duty. I only hope that my research can alleviate the burden of the {{g|Lightkeep|Lightkeepers}}. We aren't there yet. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Victory Lines= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Defeating Chaser {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Defeating Ethiron {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Entered Second Layer via Ligthook {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Entered Second Layer via Void {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Whatever you've done has caused the {{g|The Eternal Gale, the Second Layer|Eternal Gale}} to destabilize! You need to get out before it's too late. I managed to call forth a {{g|Light Hook}}, but only at the front of the City! Get to it quickly before that place is torn from eternity! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Seems some of the disturbance has cleared up thanks to your efforts... Hitch a ride on the {{g|Light Hook}} or delve deeper, your choice. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}It doesn't matter who you are - you've done us all a favour. Hitch a ride on the {{g|Light Hook}} or delve deeper, your choice. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} |-|Shop UI= {{#tag:tabber|Base Dialogue= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you have to offer? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Hmm... Take a look and tell me if there's something you like. Prices should be listed.
[Opens [[#Shop|Shop UI]]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Knowledge [1 Medallion] {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Purchasing Enchant Stone, Enchant Grease, or Dye Packets {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Not enough Medallions for any purchase {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Regarding Dawnwalker {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Ah, a little forbidden knowledge? Not a bad trade. I'll show you just a taste of what I've seen... {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}A pleasure. Come my way if you come across any more of these things - they're fascinating. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I don't think you have enough on hand. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See Dawnwalker] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Slider from 1 to {{c|knowledge|100}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}A pleasure. Come my way if you come across any more of these things - they're fascinating. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Dawnwalker= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Not having Dawnwalker {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Purchasing Radiant Mastery {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Can you teach me the secret of Radiant magic? [30 Medallions] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}I will teach you the next stages of the morning light. Now, listen... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Requirements Met {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Already having an Oath {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player progresses Dawnwalker {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Hm. Perhaps. you have the potential. Child, do you swear to carry the Light as a weapon against the Deep? To wield the {{g|The Song|Song}} only as a Radiant Blade against that which it beckons? {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Your soul belongs to another. I cannot teach you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I vow it. {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Very well. You shall connect with the Light around us, surrounding all of {{g|Lumen}}. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== Klaris' Eyes.png|Klaris' eyes ==Trivia== *Her name, Klaris Llfiend, has a resemblance to the Drowned God of Layer 3's name: Korilfiend. *Despite her appearance, she's actually a Canor without eyeliner.[[File:Klaris Canor.png]] *Klaris Colors: #F0E2B6 Skin | #F0E2B6 Hair **The colour of her skin is identical to that of her hair. **Klaris' Hair id's are
8465862459
7337593886 *Klaris' Eyes and Facial Marking have a slight glow within them. *Despite her more supportive role and her abilities coming in the form of magic rather than martial arts, Klaris is still rather muscular.[[File:FREWALk.png]] *Attempting to enhance your skills as a [[Oath: Dawnwalker|Dawnwalker]] while fully progressed will prompt the message, "Your mastery can go no further." *Multiple past reworks have made Klaris's dialogue go through multiple changes, removing certain lines and etc. A non-exhaustive list is shown below. You must be signed in to view these links to due Fandom limitations. **On the {{VersionHistory|2024|August 23}} update, dialogues pertaining to [[Enchantments|enchanting]] your [[Equipment|equipment]] with random enchants was removed.([https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Klaris_Llfiend,_Mother_of_Lights?oldid=112179#Shop_UI:~:text=Equipment%20Enchantment%20%5B5%20Medallions%5D viewable here], See Shop UI) ***This update added the [[Enchant Grease]], and replaced the option to imbuing your equipment with a random enchantment that Klaris used to sell. Before this, she would imply that she was enchanting your equipments with [[Enchant Stone]]s. **On the {{VersionHistory|2026|May 31}} update, dialogues pertaining to the [[Deepshore Fossil]] was removed ([https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Klaris_Llfiend,_Mother_of_Lights?oldid=210985#Floor_1_Optional:~:text=*You%20hand%20her,us.%20Take%20it. viewable here], See Unlockable Dialogues -> Floor 1 Optional) ***This update added the option to craft [[Enchant Stone]]s that were previously uncraftable. {{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Oh... I see it now. Yes... enough. Every brilliant song reaches its end!|author=Knell}} {{EnemyInfobox |drops=*[[Dissonant Chimecaller]]
*[[Bellmarrow Reave]]

*[[Idol of Yun'Shul]] |moves= |image1=Knell, The Lunatic Resonator.png |health=30000 |aspect=Anansi |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/Bestiary|Knell, The Lost Anansi}} |locations=*[[Simforea]] *[[The Cradle of Symphonies]] |challenges={{Bi|Knell, The Lunatic Resonator|small}} }} ==Description== Knell, The Lunatic Resonator is a humanoid [[Bosses|Boss]] found in [[Simforea]], an island in the [[Voidsea]] within the [[Eastern Luminant]]. He is a disheveled Anansi with unkempt hair, white eyes, and red markings. His present form shows his upper body is wrapped in bells fastened to a red rope, with two needles piercing diagonally from his back into his chest. During the time of the Old World,[[Ringing Scholar's Raiments]] Knell was an inhabitant of [[Simforea]], where he was a scholar. Knell had a keen fascination with sound, which became the object of his research, and in particular was drawn to bells and chimes of various designs.[[Ringing Scholar's Garb]]Knell's clothes are infused with [[Indichite]], which is only found on Simforea, meaning he must have been an inhabitant of the isle rather than a visitor during its rapid decline. This translated to him frequently adorning his apparel and crafts with the instruments.[[Ringing Scholar's Capeline]][[Ringing Scholar's Necktie]]{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Bellmarrow Reave}} Knell also hoped to one day obtain a [[Resonance]]. Thus, he had his [[Ringing Scholar's Garb|clothes]] infused with [[Indichite]]. Such a process could help his soul better resonate, but was also unstable. At some point, Knell met an individual he referred to as [[Ten]], who promised him that his soul would be mended and that he would finally obtain a [[Resonance]]. Knell also used [[Arkasid]] husks and Simforea's native plant life to craft the [[Bellmarrow Reave]], its engravings reflecting his current state of mind. Eventually, Simforea and its inhabitants disappeared from the world. Knell was left on his lonesome and was driven mad over the centuries within the [[Voidsea]]. Though Knell avoided total loss of his mental faculties, thanks to the steady pounding of his soul, his mind became laser-focused on his desire to resonate. However, his soul had been left in a discordant state, ensuring he would never be able to attain what he so badly craved. When [[Simforea]] drifted through the [[Voidsea]] near to the [[Eastern Luminant]], Knell was effectively returned to the world after centuries. Witnessing [[The Pathfinder]]'s own [[Resonance]], a frenzied Knell believed killing them would finally put an end to his troubles. Knell attacked them and was ultimately killed in the ensuing fight. ==Moveset== ''For a visual guide, consider watching [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K-cIjJWdbjg this video.]'' {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |

Get OUT of my head fake person fake... |- | colspan="6" | | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} ==Gallery== File:Knell digging though bells.gif|Knell rummaging through bells File:Knell Stare.png|Knell after rummaging through bells File:Knell Dance.gif|Knell's dance while fighting File:Knell Wave.png|A pose Knell does while fighting File:Knell Wave2.png|A pose Knell does while fighting File:Simforea Concept Art.png|A compilation of concept arts featuring the Aspects of [[Simforea]] and Knell ==Trivia== *This boss was made by Nuttoons. *The frenzied sounds produced by Knell are voiced by iiPessimystic.[[File:Statement Knell VA.png]] *Knell's name comes from the noun used to describe the sound of a bell, especially when rung solemnly for a death or funeral. *Knell is the only entity whose title in the [[Bestiary]] differs from their usual name. *Knell's final Bestiary name is a possible reference to the song "For Whom The Bell Tolls" by Metallica, as they also had a previous Metallica based event featuring their 72 seasons album release, [https://youtube.com/watch?v=B_HSa1dEL9s&is=cIXw9OtuDMw_GHOO here]. *Knell and his fight appear to be heavily inspired by the boss [https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Widow Widow] from ''Hollow Knight: Silksong''. Both have extremely similar attacks with rushdown swipes, and the myriads of thrown bell attacks. The two also share a design detail of two pins lodged in their backs. *Knell does not respawn after being defeated, on account of being [[Death|dead]]. If one wishes to fight him again, one must ask [[Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts]] to return him from [[The Depths]] to the surface via an [[Idol of Yun'Shul]] or the [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts]]. **This makes Knell the only boss to permanently die in the [[Pathfinder]] gamemode without player input: ***[[Chaser]], [[Raeva Ferash Kenestos]] and the [[Scion of Ethiron]] are revived by the temporal anomalies present in [[New Kyrsa]]. ***[[The Doom of Caeranthil]], the [[Dread Serpent]], the [[Interluminary Parasol]], and [[Primadon, Titan of the East]] will respawn, either due to being species comprised of multiple individuals or simply for gameplay convenience.(Or they may simply swim out the Depths, true reason, however, will most likely remain unknown,) ***[[Duke Ishamon Erisia]] will escape the Depths himself. ***The fights against [[The Ferryman]], the [[Heart of Enmity]], [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] and [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] are not to the death. *Roblox clothing: [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/131895593576238/Dolis-Tribal-Robes Shirt] • [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/131855934926710/Dolis-Tribal-Robes Pants] ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Bosses}} [[Category:Individuals with He/him pronouns]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Humanoid Bosses]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[Category:Voiced Characters]]

{{Quotes
|quote=A measure of concepts and ideas that have wormed their way into your mind. Used for rituals and strange bargains, Knowledge can change fates.

}}[[File:Knowledge obtained.mp3|center|Your Knowledge '''grows'''...|thumb]]
{{CurrencyInfobox
|title1=Knowledge
|usage=* Engaging in deals with [[Deep Shrines]]
* Purchasing Clarity(Bell Reroll) from [[Misérables]]
* Increasing [[reputation]] with [[The Ministry]] through the [[Soothsayer]]
* Instantly fully progressing an [[Oath]] completed on a previous slot
* Banking Relics, Enchanted items, and certain rare Ingredients.
|obtainment=* Levelling up
* Purchasing from [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]]
*Turning in [[Crowns]]
* Completing quests and achieving milestones
* Defeating bosses
* Soloing bosses
* Soloing waves 35+ in the diluvian mechanism
* Defeating certain unique mobs for the first time
* [[Echoes]] upgrades
*Using the [[Moonseye Tome]] relic
|image1=KnowledgeLargeNew.png}}

Prior to '''''<u>Verse 2</u>''''', if one wanted to make a specific build, then it would be entirely up to luck on whether or not they would be able to obtain this build—aside from using methods to narrow down Whisper cards and using Aces to clear up any unwanted Talent cards. This often led to a round of wipes until the player (now tired and exhausted) eventually obtained their desired build- or at least, an image of it.

With the advent of '''<u>''Verse 2''</u>''', these acts are left in the past. One can now thoroughly customize and change up their build- Talents, mantras, undo burns, and more using the many '''[[Deep Shrines]]''' around the overworld, and can even gain as many bell rerolls as one desires through the fabled '''[[Misérables]]''' so long as they have sufficient ''Knowledge.''

== Overview ==
Knowledge is a special in-game currency that can be used to engage in a deals with various [[Deep Shrines]] and the deity known as [[Misérables]]. Its function serves similar to [[Notes]] in the sense that you can purchase various things to help benefit your character in specific ways; however, Knowledge-related services reap much higher benefits for the player, such as gaining the ability to reroll your Resonance again.

== Ways of Obtaining Knowledge ==
Achieving milestones and completing certain quests will award the player with Knowledge.
*<u>Gaining [[Power]]</u>, awarding 1 Knowledge per Power up, with the maximum being 19 Knowledge.
*<u>Spawning in with the Inheritance [[Regalia#Inheritance|Regalia]]</u>, which gives 50 Knowledge on spawn.
*<u>Choosing your first [[Resonance]]</u>, awarding 5 Knowledge. (Note: You have to '''CHOOSE''' the [[Resonance]], meaning you're only awarded the knowledge after you pick your desired [[Resonance]])
*<u>Purchasing Starting Knowledge</u> ([[Echoes#Upgrades, Unlocks, and Modifiers|Echo Upgrade]]), awarding 1 Knowledge per Upgrade level, with the maximum being 5 Knowledge. ''The currency is granted to every slot upon '''creation of a new character'''. It won't be given to already-existing characters.''
*<u>Finishing [[Beiruul|Beiruul's]] quest</u> at [[Meteor Isle]], awarding 2 Knowledge when returning to her after the quest is complete.
*<u>Finishing [[Kelsius]]' quest</u> at [[Isle of Vigils]] awarding 1 Knowledge when returning to him after the quest is complete, only if the player has obtained a free mantra hand from another method.
*<u>Supplying the [[Random Encounters#Supply the Diver Expedition|Diver Expedition]]</u>, awarding 1 Knowledge after turning in the supplies.
*<u>Collecting [[Kyrsan Medallions]]</u> and handing them into [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris Llfiend]] at a rate of 1 Medallions for 1 Knowledge after beating [[Scion of Ethiron]] and escaping [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]]. ''This can be repeated as long as you have the medallions to afford it. '''Klaris may refuse your Medallions as she will not talk to you if you are below Power 15.'''''
*<u>Turning in [[Crowns]]</u> by clicking the currency icon, awarding you 1-5 Knowledge per Crown depending on your Power. Grants 1 Knowledge per at Power 1, scaling up to 5 Knowledge per at Power 20. This can be repeated and it bypasses [[Simple|Simple's]] -25% Knowledge gain debuff.
*<u>Finishing [[Mendacia]]'s quest</u> in Layer 2 Floor 1, awarding 2 Knowledge after talking to her in Layer 2 Floor 2 (Denying quest also give you knowledge though).
*<u>Catching [[Fishing|Golden Fish]]</u>, awarding 1 Knowledge per catch, maximum being 5 catches.
*<u>Defeating any [[Bosses|Boss]] solo</u>, awarding 1 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing [[Primadon]]</u> for the first time, awarding 2 Knowledge.
**<u>Killing [[Primadon]]</u> while having dealt at least 8000 damage (20% of his HP). This rewards 1 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing [[The Ferryman]]</u> for the first time, awarding 2 Knowledge after taking the exit portal.
**<u>Killing [[The Ferryman]]</u> rewards you 1 Knowledge and can be repeated.
**<u>Talking to [[The Ferryman]] in Spring after killing him</u>. This rewards 1 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]</u> for the first time, awarding 2 Knowledge.
** <u>Killing  [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]</u> while having dealt at least 35% of his HP.  This rewards 1 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing [[Duke Erisia]]</u> for the first time, awarding 1 Knowledge once teleported out of the dungeon. If you dealt 33% of his maximum health as damage on the first kill, it will grant 2 Knowledge instead.
*<u>Killing the [[Scion of Ethiron]]</u> for the first time, awarding 2 Knowledge.
*<u>Killing a [[Dread Serpent]]</u>  for the first time, awarding 2 Knowledge.
*<u>Killing [[The Doom of Caeranthil]]</u> for the first time while contributing at least 10% to the kill, awarding 1 Knowledge.
**<u>Killing [[The Doom of Caeranthil]]</u> while contributing at least 25% to the kill. This awards 2 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing [[Interluminary Parasol]]</u> for the first time while contributing at least 10% to the kill, awarding 1 Knowledge.
**<u>Killing [[Interluminary Parasol]]</u> for while contributing at least 25% to the kill. This awards 2 Knowledge and can be repeated.
*<u>Killing the Attunement Trainers</u> for [[Silentheart]], awarding 1 Knowledge each for a total of 6 Knowledge.
*<u>Killing Iblis and the Sinners</u> ([[Abaddon, Sinner of Ice|Abaddon]], [[Astaroth, Sinner of Wind|Astaroth]], [[Iblis]], and [[Minos, Sinner of Flame|Minos]]) for [[Starkindred]], awarding 1 Knowledge each for a total of 4 Knowledge.
*<u>Killing the following Monsters</u> for the first time while dealing at least 50% of the damage, awarding 1 Knowledge each:
**[[Crimson Megalodaunt]], [[Alpha Megalodaunt]], [[Mechalodaunt]], [[Megalodaunt]], [[Prime Megalodaunt]], [[Blizzard Knight]], [[Deep Owl]], [[King Thresher]], [[Deep Widow]], [[Nautilodaunt]] (<u>not</u> the [[Fury Nautilodaunt|Fury version]]), [[The Enforcer]], [[Bounder]], [[Stone Knight]], [[Rogue Construct]]/[[Hive Construct]], [[Rock Golem]], [[Golem Prime]], [[Bone Keeper]], and any {{cl|corrupt|Corrupted}} [[Monsters|Monster]]. 
*<u>Using the [[Moonseye Tome]] relic</u>, which grants 100 Knowledge the first time, then 50 Knowledge for each subsequent uses.
*<u>Completing waves in [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]</u>, which gives around 20 Knowledge in total when completing through wave 50.
*<u>Completing [[Hell Mode]]</u>, which gives 15 Knowledge to each player who rang the bell when finished.

The limit of on-hand Knowledge a player can have is 999. The currency is bound to a character and is lost upon wiping.

The [[Simple]] Flaw decreases Knowledge gained from all sources by 25% (rounds up). Gaining 1-3 Knowledge at once will have no change, but a tax will be applied once 4 or more is gained at once. Gaining an even amount of Knowledge that is not divisible by 4 will cause it to round up.

The [[Insightful]] Regalia increases all knowledge gain by 1.5x, rounding up to the nearest whole number. This Regalia persists on death if your level was low enough when you wiped.

A checklist can be found [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RxSJhKnT9RZ-FWgMiHhZwltjNjVejLS9nFHQgqAnFWY/edit here].

== Usage of Knowledge and Specifics ==
As stated at the beginning of this page, Knowledge can be used to bargain with powerful objects and beings. 

Each transaction is conducted via dialogue option, with Knowledge being ''consumed instantly'' after the deal is done '''''<u>without any warning message or notice</u>''''' and will be lost permanently. Before making a deal, ''it's advised that you are '''<u>absolutely ready</u>''' to make the desired exchange- and go slowly through the dialogue,'' because most times, there is no going back once the deal is made (such as in the case with Shrine of Order).

*Engaging in a deal with '''[[Shrine of Order]]''' or performing a ''Talent elevation'' with '''[[Shrine of Chance]]''' costs <u>10 Knowledge</u>. [[Ganymede]] reduces the Knowledge cost of these Shrines by 1.
**''After making a deal with the Shrine of Order, whatever was done to your build '''CANNOT''' be undone. Make sure you are absolutely ready to make the deal before you commit''.
*Engaging in a deal with '''[[Shrine of Division]]''', '''[[Shrine of Chance]]''' (for most deals), '''[[Shrine of Unification]]''', or '''[[Shrine of Blasphemy]]''' costs <u>5 Knowledge</u>. [[Ganymede]] reduces the Knowledge cost of these Shrines by 1.
**Using Shrine of Blasphemy when below Power 17 will level you up 3 times, almost offsetting the Knowledge cost entirely. 
*Engaging in a deal with '''[[Shrine of Conceit]]''' or '''[[Shrine of Mastery]]''', costs <u>1 Knowledge</u>.
*Purchasing [[Yun'Shul|Clarity]] from [[Misérables]], costs <u>15 Knowledge</u>. If you wish to stack Clarity wishes, it costs an <u>extra 5 on top of the previous Knowledge cost</u>. (e.g. 15 -> 20 -> 25 -> 30; by stacking a mere 4 wishes, you have spent a total of 90 Knowledge.)
*Purchasing an item from a [[Blacksmith]] using [[Seasonal Medals]], this can range from <u>1 to 10 Knowledge</u> depending on the item.
*Purchasing [[Enchant Grease]] from [[Laplace]], costs <u>5 Knowledge</u> per Grease.
*Fully progressing your [[Oath]], costs <u>10 Knowledge</u>. This can only be done if you've fully progressed the Oath previously on another character. Speak to the Oath giver to perform this action. Note: [[Bladeharper]], [[Chainwarden]], [[Oath: Blightsurger|Blightsurger]], and [[Soulbreaker]] cannot be skipped this way.
*Changing your [[Resonance]] shape at a [[Barber]], costs <u>1 Knowledge</u>.
*Withdrawing an item that requires a ''Vow of Safekeeping'' to be placed in the bank, costs <u>1 Knowledge</u>. The ''Vow of Safekeeping'' allows you to [[Item Bank|bank]] any [[Enchantments|Enchanted]] item, any Soulbound item, or any [[Relics|Relic]]-tier item.
*Using the {{cl|war|Sacrificial Boon}} Talent on [[Ritual Sacrifice|{{cl|war|Ritual Sacrifice}}]], consuming <u>5 Knowledge</u> per use.

== Trivia ==
*Knowledge functions similarly to ''[[w:c:rogue-lineage:Insight|Insight]]'', from ''Rogue Lineage'' and ''Tales from the Valley'', which in turn are references to ''[[w:c:bloodborne:Insight|Insight]]'' from ''Bloodborne''.
*Obtaining Knowledge through normal means is inefficient, and thus not recommended for grinding (unless you are in need of emergency Knowledge before using Shrine of Order).
*Power-gained Knowledge will be enough to make a deal with the Shrine of Order at Power 10.
*[[Ganymede]]s have a special racial bonus that make [[Deep Shrines]] cost one less Knowledge point to make a deal with. 
**Most [[Deep Shrines]] will cost <u>4 Knowledge</u>.
**[[Shrine of Order]] will cost <u>9 Knowledge</u>.
**The [[Shrine of Conceit]] and [[Shrine of Mastery]] are unaffected, and will still cost <u>1 Knowledge</u>.
*An icon identical to the old Knowledge icon was in the game during the early beta. Its purpose was unknown.
*Knowledge is not simply just knowing about things; it is specifically "forbidden knowledge" as described by [[Klaris]], which explains why it is valuable enough to be traded with other beings.
**As such, the Moonseye Tome likely floods the user's mind with aforementioned forbidden knowledge. As the cacophony and madness of the voices decreases, so too does the Knowledge granted by the tome.
*In an unknown update, the symbol for Knowledge was visually touched up.
*There was a bug introduced in the 30th of June 2025 update that made every enemy kill grant knowledge, leading to players amassing thousands of knowledge. This was hotfixed in a patch the same day.
