**[[Emiya Konga]] (great grandfather) |affiliation=[[The Justicar]] |image1=NPC Konga The Third.png }} ==Description== Konga The Third is a [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a [[The Justicar|Justicar]] who follows the Vanguard Path. As the great grandson of [[Emiya Konga]], Konga inherited the Slider Style, as well as the [[Karita Plating]]. ==Location== Konga The Third is located at the very top of the library tower of [[Alsin's Landing]]. File:Konga The Third Location.png ==Dialogue== |-|Justicar Origin= {{#tag:tabber|Base Dialogue= If the player hasn't chosen a [[Justicar#Paths|Path]] to follow. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Yet to follow a path to enhance your skills? I'd recommend Vanguard. I'm told they're universally beloved, ya hear? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Vanguard Path= If the player is a [[Justicar#Vanguard|Vangaurd Justicar]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Requirements met for [[Karita Plating]] (80 Light and 80 Agility) {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Requirements unmet {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Whoa whoa WHOA, kid, I can tell just by lookin' at ya. You got some serious speed and skill with your legs! {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Glad to be seeing more Vanguards around. A shame, though - a bit more speed and skills, and you could be rockin' one of these. ''*He points to his legs.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Thanks? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hey, you look familiar... Have I seen you somewhere before ? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Nah nah nah, I see it in just the way ya stand. You could be the next KONGA incarnate. The new MASTER of the SLIDER STYLE. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Hm? Don't think so. But I get that a lot, kid - people seem to think I'm some 'Gusto', or 'Matsu', or whatever. No idea what that's about. ''*He shrugs.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Konga? You mean that infamous thief? With the ring that kinda looks like the one you're wearing? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you wearing? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Yes, kid-that's my great grandfather you speak of! And yes, the very same ring -though, I wear only a replica. For decades, the Slider style {{sic|expected=Slider Style}} was used for thievery and mischief. But I decided to break that cycle, in order to get rid of the infamy that followed our family name. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}That's Karita Plating, made for guys who could use a bit more speed when sliding around. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Oh, wow. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why would these make you faster? Seems like they would slow you down, if anything. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}I won't waste your time any longer - take these. If ya ever wanna start sliding and fighting at the same time, put em' on.
[Player receives [[Karita Plating]]] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Alright, kid, you're asking too many questions now, get on outta here. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Thanks. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Take it easy now, kid. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Warder Path= If the player is a [[Justicar#Warder Path|Warder Justicar]]. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}A goody two-shoes, eh? Shouldn't you be off healing some poor sod on the field? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} |-|Voidwalker= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |Seriously, kid? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], you are beaten up |} |-|Other Origins= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |''*He looks at you with slight concern.*'' Are you lost, kid? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} ==Trivia== *Konga's line about being mistaken for a "Matsu" is a reference to developer and YouTuber [[w:c:youtube:Agamatsu|Agamatsu]]. Him being called "Gusto" is in reference to a [https://www.reddit.com/r/deepwoken/comments/1t2o4ft/amagusto/ community meme] where a user mistakenly calls him "Amagusto". This is a nod to the fact Konga's mask makes him resemble Agamatsu's profile picture. *This character, as well as his great grandfather [[Emiya Konga]], [[Konga's Clutch Ring]] and [[Konga's Parka]], is primarily a reference to bcongeboy5, a tester during ''Deepwoken'''s development who was notorious for spamming sliding movements and attacks. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Etrean Luminant]] [[Category:Justicars]] [[Category:Members of the Konga lineage]]

title: Korilfiend, the Inferno's Provenance
content:
{{cnp}}

==Overview==
Korilfiend is the [[:Category:Drowned Gods|Drowned God]] of heat, slumbering deep within The Vents, the Third Layer of [[The Depths]].

[[Black Divers division|Black Diver]] [[Amorus Pleeksty]], before being reported as missing in action, merged with a meteor flower that was part of Korilfiend, becoming a [[Deepwoken]] and inventing [[Flamecharm]] as a result. Korilfiend is also the creator of the [[Forge of Sin]], an [[Artifacts|artifact]] formerly held at [[Temple of the Forgotten Flame]], stolen by [[Duke Ishamon Erisia|Duke Erisia]] for his own nefarious purposes. 

==Trivia==
*The [[Deepfire Ring]] is described to be Korilfiend's. Whether it was used or created by them is unknown.
*[[Crimson Megalodaunt]]s appear with a dark red color because they have been exposed to The Vents and have mutated enough to inherit [[Flamecharm|Flamecharming]]. [[Venn Kaelhand]], the former owner and likely creator of the [[First Light]] is known to have met their demise to one.
[[Category:Drowned Gods]]

title: Korin
content: {{Topbuttons|p, [[Drefa]]}} {{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Hey. We need more wood to keep the fires burning, you got any?|author=Korin}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Korin |image1=Korin.png |name=Korin |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=They/them |location=[[Etris]] |affiliation=[[Etrea]] }} ==Description== Korin is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Once aspiring to join the [[Temple of the Blade]], Korin failed to make the cut and is now a lumberjack living within [[Etris]]. When interacted with, they request 6 wood in order to keep the fires lit. In exchange, [[the Pathfinder]] gains 5 Notes and increased [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]]. They also give the Pathfinder a free [[Lumber Axe]] if they do not have one. Korin offers the easiest way to increase reputation with Etrea, which allows the Pathfinder to easily obtain the [[Manor Key]]. The Manor Key is necessary to access the boss, [[Duke Erisia]]. Their counterpart in the [[Isle of Vigils]] is [[Drefa]]. ==Location== Korin is located in [[Etris]], in front of the [[Antiquarian]]. They are standing outside of a house. Korin's Location.png Korin's Hut.png|Korin's House ==Quest== Upon talking to them, Korin will give the player a free lumber axe if the player does not already have one. They will then ask the player for 6 wood, which when handed to them, will increase the player's reputation with [[Etrea]], alongside giving the player 5 notes. This quest is repeatable. === '''Selling Wood''' === It is recommended to '''BUY THE {{c|notes|2}} NOTES WOOD FROM THE [[Etris|ETRIS]] [[Blacksmith|BLACKSMITH]]''' area rather than the more costly {{c|notes|5}} wood from the general store. Alternatively, the player can chop trees or pick up sticks to craft wood.[[File:EtrisWoodBlacksmith.PNG|thumb|Wood from the blacksmith's costs only {{c|notes|2}}...]] [[File:WoodEtrisGeneralStore1.png|thumb|..whereas wood costs {{c|notes|5}} each in the general store.]] If starting out with neutral reputation with [[Etrea]], the player needs at least ~100 wood to begin the [[Duke Erisia]] quest, which translates to ~200 notes, if the wood is purchased from the blacksmith. If the player wants to get Hero reputation with [[Etrea]], they would need around ~{{c|notes|1,000}} notes to achieve it, which translates to about ~500 wood or about 10 minutes of buying and selling wood. === Treefelling Blow Quest === If the player has felled at least 1 tree with the Mantra [[Strong Left]], Korin can give them the quest to obtain the [[Talents#Treefelling Blow|Treefelling Blow]] Talent. To complete the quest, the player must fell at least 5 trees with the [[Strong Left]] mantra. As the name implies, this [[Talents|Talent]] allows the player to get wood by punching down a tree with Strong Left. Although trees can be destroyed this way without the Talent, trees will not drop wood unless the player has Treefelling Blow. ==Dialogue== |-|Base Dialogue= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" |- | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |Hey. We need more wood to keep the fires burning, you got any? |- | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Yeah. | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Can you tell me anything about Etrea? | colspan="4" {{cl|action}} |Player has destroyed a tree using [[Strong Left]] |- | colspan="2" {{cl|action}} |[Enough wood] | colspan="2" {{cl|action}} |[Not enough wood] | colspan="4" |Many of the lads here have taken up the sword and train at the Blade Temple to try to become a Vigil. Not many make the cut, though. Myself included. Still, it's a good experience, maybe they'd take you on? | colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |I'm having problems with my treefelling. |- | colspan="2" |Thanks for the help. | colspan="2" |Uh.. it seems like you don't have much on you. Come back with more wood and we can see about payment. | colspan="4" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] | colspan="4" |[See Treefelling Quest] |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], Lose 6 Wood, Gained 5 Notes, Gained slight reputation with Etrea | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|No Axe= This dialogue plays if the player does not yet own an axe {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" |- | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |Looking for some work? I need someone to gather some wood for me. |- | colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Yeah. [Obtain Axe] |- | colspan="12" |Go cut some trees and bring the wood back here. We need that wood to keep the fires burning in the winter, so you'd be doing us a big favour. |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue], Lumber Axe Obtained |} |-|Treefelling Quest= Regarding the [[Quests#Treefelling Blow|Treefelling Blow Quest]]. {{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm having a problem with my treefelling. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Uh huh. That so? What's the problem? Axe too dull? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I splinter the tree and leave no usable lumber behind when I punch it down. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Huh? I... What? You're kidding, surely. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}No, I wouldn't kid about not getting wood from trees when I punch them. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}In what world would you get lumber from trees you've punched down? Is this a game to you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}*''The lumberjack's face of utter dumbfound bewilderment strikes you with inspiration. It's all about ''how'' you punch them! You reckon '''5''' more trees punched down would be sufficient research.''* {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Quest End= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player has punched down at least 5 trees with Strong Left {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Requirements Unmet {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}*''You stand at the top of your field before your student. ==Description==
Kraphtalos is a [[Canor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. 

He is a retired [[The Justicar|Justicar]] at [[Alsin's Landing]] that was formerly known for using his [[Resonance]] to transport others across the Luminant. As the Justicars began working more independently, he decided to leave that path behind to pursue pottery instead.

Kraphtalos wears the sightly darkened down version of the [[Justicar's Armor]] outfit, a rocky version of the [[Silver Pauldrons]] with a rocky pair of [[Silver Sabatons]], and [[Smith's Goggles]].

==Location==
Kraphtalos is located in a small workshop hall across from [[Braun]] on [[Alsin's Landing]].

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="12" |''*The tall Khan woman is investigating some sort of document, sighing heavily with each flip.*'' Shipment A-45: delayed. Shipment B-23: cancelled. Shipment B-24: lost cargo... gods, we can't catch a break.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Shipments? What's going on?
|-
| colspan="12" |Curious? Are you looking to join us someday, little one? ''*She grins, taking away her distressed expression for but a moment.*'' It's hard work, are you sure you'd be up for that?
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Not really, I was just curious about what's troubling you.
|-
| colspan="12" |''*Her expression deflates.*'' Oh. Well. We have resource teams dispatched across the {{g|The Luminants|Luminant}} gathering minerals and natural resources for our various research projects. However, as of late, they repeatedly keep having troubles on the water. It makes me wonder if something more... deliberate is going on.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |Do you think there's someone sabotaging the shipments?
|-
| colspan="12" |Possibly... but naval sabotages are quite hard to be stealthy about. It'd have to be someone on-board. The reasonings in the report follow a similar domino effect: a flow of small issues continuously piling up over a period of time, until ultimately the only option is to either abandon ship, or seek repairs at nearby docks.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |That sounds suspicious. Any ideas on who it could be? Is it a rebel Union member?
|-
| colspan="12" |A rebel member? Gods no. If anything... I'd suspect Summer Company meddling with our goods. They're obsessed with monopoly and profit, and we're direct competitors. But, in terms of espionage, to be frank they're quite awful at being stealthy about it. They're a 'go in loud' type of crew. I suspect they've possibly enlisted help from a more professional source.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |An organized criminal ring sounds interesting.
|-
| colspan="12" |In this {{g|The Luminants|Luminant}}, the only reliable source of mercenary work is the Knives of Elyis. It has to be them. They have no sense of morality or alignment, they do what they're hired to do. They could be paid by the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} to sabotage Etrean ships, and then on the same day be paid by Etrea to do the same to the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}. It's all the same to them, it's just mercenary work. Stupid, awful war economy...
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |Player is a Voidwalker
| colspan="6" {{cl|action}} |Player is not a Voidwalker
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |The Knives. Right. Haha.
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |How can these factions even trust the Knives?
|-
| colspan="6" |''*The tall woman raises her brow concerningly at you.*'' What's with that reaction? You sound amused. Do you know all of this already, am I being patronizing? Apologies.
| colspan="6" |Simple. They get the job done consistently, no matter what flag or banner they're hired under. Most of us barely know anything about them besides their business practices. Eylis herself has only been seen on the most high stakes missions of theirs. It's my only guess at this point as to whom these sabotages may be performed by...
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] 
| colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] 
|}

title: Krulian
content:
{{Quotes|quote=I am a Krulian, and one of the few known to you surface-folk. We are the closest bridge between the Gods below and your kind. The next step in the evolutionary chain you could say... But I really must be off, it was a pleasure dancing with you as always.|author=The Ferryman}}
{{Species
|image1=TheGauntMan.png
|name=Krulian
|habitat=
}}

== Description ==
Krulians are a mysterious species that possesses demigod-like powers. They are essentially the missing link between the [[Lore#Drowned Gods|Drowned Gods]] and the people of Lumen.

According to [[The Ferryman]], not many Krulians have been seen by mankind, implying that Krulians are either from [[The Depths]] or some islands in the [[Voidsea]]. He also mentions that they are the "next step in the evolutionary chain" and that they are "the superior aspect that will live on after the Drowned Gods awake."

They have no set appearance, shapeshifting into whatever they see fit. In the Ferryman's case, he appears as a white-haired Etrean wearing the [[Ferryman's Coat]]. Whereas [[The Gaunt Man]] is a tall pale humanoid who doesn't appear to be trying to take the appearance of any of Lumen's aspects. He wears the [[Varicosan Finery]] outfit.

It has been stated by the devs that "Every Krulian has a purpose." and that they are also servants of the Drowned Gods, therefore it could be interpreted that they would be what the Lightborns are to Celestials, just with Drowned Gods.

While weaker on the surface, they become far more powerful in [[The Depths]].

The [[Krulian Knife]] seems to originate from them. Additionally, [[The Ministry]] appears to worship the Krulians in some form, considering how almost every member wields a [[Krulian Knife]] and the faction's goal being becoming the entity they serve.

Krulians do not take [[Oaths]].

Krulians were described as "amalgamations of souls" by ragoozer. It is unclear how they come to be, or if the Ferryman's degree of individuality is shared by every Krulian.

==Trivia==
*It is not possible to become a Krulian. Krulians are born, not created.
*A majority of Krulian lore comes from the devs, and barely any is disclosed from [[The Ferryman]], though a decent amount can be inferred from [[The Gaunt Man|The Gaunt Man's]] dialogue.
*Krulians took inspiration from [https://coppermind.net/wiki/Kandra Kandra]<ref>[[File:KrulianKandra.png]]</ref>, a species being able to reshape their bodies and well-practiced at imitation.

==Description ==
The Krulian Knife is a boss weapon [[Weapons|dagger]] either obtained by defeating [[the Ferryman]] in any of his chests, or buying it from a [[Merchant Ships]] or [[Traan Zakshun]].

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Cruel Counter}} procs when you land Krulian Charge critical attack, applying the {{status|Cruel Counter}} status effect to your opponent. This effect increases your critical attack damage by ?% against them for 20 seconds.

If you cancel your opponent's attack with your Krulian Charge critical, the damage buff will be +40% instead.

The damage buff affects all critical attacks, including non-Krulian Knife ones, and attacks from other people who did not apply the status effect. This damage modifier '''bypasses''' the damage modifier cap.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:KrulianChargeStart.gif|Krulian Charge
File:KrulianChargeDash.gif|Critical while Krulian Charge is active
File:BasicDagger.gif|Critical while Krulian Charge is on cooldown
</gallery>The user raises the knife into the sky, causing pink lightning to strike the weapon and dealing 15 Thundercall damage with 5 Thundercall scaling in a small AoE. This grants the {{status|Krulian Charge}} status effect, causing their weapon to be electrified with pink lightning for 10 seconds.

While under the Krulian Charge effect, using basic attacks applies a purple {{status|Shock}} effect, a 2.5% Swing Speed buff, and a {{status|Speed Boost}} for the full duration of this effect. Additionally, this replaces your critical with a Thundercall rush-down attack, similar to [[Lightning Assault]]. This attack has 30 base damage with '''5 Thundercall''' scaling, increasing by 0.15 per point in Thundercall.

Using your critical attack while Krulian Charge is on cooldown will use the default Dagger critical. Unlike the normal default dagger critical, {{text|m1tag}}

Krulian Charge has a 17 second cooldown (7 second downtime). The Lightning Assault critical has a 5 second cooldown. The default dagger critical has a 3 second cooldown. None of these can be reduced through any method (explanations can be found below).

==Trivia==
*Cruel Counter is a reference to an infamous suggestion for a hypothetical "Ferryman Oath", which was endlessly mocked by the community. One of the Oath Mantras was named Kruel Kounter.
* The Krulian Charge cooldown is not considered a normal critical cooldown; its duration cannot be decreased via {{t|Critical Engine}} Blessed Gem or [[Warmaster's Medallion]].
* There is a minor cooldown that stacks onto of all of the normal crit cooldowns. This cooldown takes priority over all others, meaning {{t|Critical Engine}}, [[Blessed Gem]], and [[Warmaster's Medallion]] are completely useless to the Krulian Knife as a whole.
* This blade's appearance is based on one of many "[https://hunterxhunter.fandom.com/wiki/Ben%27s_knives/Image_Gallery Ben's knives]" from the anime ''Hunter x Hunter''.

[[File:KyrsanMedallian1.jpg|thumb|The medallions in hand|218x218px]]'''Kyrsan Medallions''' are an end-game currency that can be obtained from [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|New Kyrsa]] within the [[Second Layer]]. They can be exchanged at [[Klaris Llfiend]] for [[Enchant Stone]]s, [[Enchant Grease]], or [[Knowledge]]. They are also required for obtaining and progressing the [[Oath: Dawnwalker|Dawnwalker]] Oath.  

== Obtainment ==
[[File:Chest in building.png|thumb|A Kyrsan Medallion chest]]
Currently, New Kyrsa is the only location where Medallions can be found. There are two primary ways of obtainment: 

* They can be found in pink chests around the city, containing 7-18 Kyrsan Medallions.
** These chests spawn only at static locations around the location and their location and content resets after player spawning in [[Kyrsan Shrine of Arrival]] or defeating the [[Scion of Ethiron]].
* They can be obtained via summon event inside the trap buildings. Activating the event via a button will result in 2 waves of [[Kyrsgarde]] spawning. After defeating the enemies, multiple Kyrsan Medallions will spawn at the central point of the building.

<u>'''Using the light hook or dying while in Second Layer will result in all of your collected Medallions being lost.'''</u> The only way to keep the currency is escaping via Klaris light hook after defeating the Scion of Ethiron. Once obtained, these medallions cannot be dropped or lost upon death.

The limit of on-hand Medallions a player can have is 250. '''<u>The currency is bound to a slot and is lost upon wiping.</u>'''

==Usage==
Kyrsan Medallions can be exchanged for lots of services, crucial for the end-game as well as the Dawnwalker [[Oaths|Oath]]. In order to use your Medallions, talk to '''Klaris Llfiend, Mother of the Lights''' in Castle Light. She is the same NPC that teleports you to Layer 2. '''You must be Power 15 or above to exchange your Medallions'''. If you have any Medallions, she will have an additional dialogue option that states: "What do you have to offer?" - clicking on this option opens the Kyrsan Medallions shop:
# [[Knowledge]] [1 Medallion] - Gives you knowledge points.
# [[Enchant Stone]] [5 Medallions] - Gives you an enchant stone engraved with a random enchant that can be used to enchant your current weapon.
# [[Enchant Grease]] [5 Medallions] - Gives you an enchant grease engraved with a random enchant that can be used to enchant any of your currently equipped [[Equipment]].
# [[Dye Packet|Equipment Dye]] [1 Medallion] - Gives you an item that allows you to dye one of your armor pieces, your Bell, your Oath colors or your Hairs. To remove dye talk to barber
# Can you teach me the secret of Radiant magic? [30 Medallions] - Grants you the [[Oath: Dawnwalker]]. Requires additional Medallions in order to unlock Talents and mantras.
#[if you have the Dawnwalker Oath] Can you enhance my Radiant mastery? [15 Medallions] - Gives Dawnwalker users an additional skill. There are three skills in total and the base Oath costs 30 medallions to obtain, meaning it costs 75 medallions to max out the Oath.
Medallions can also be spent at [[Misérables]] for a unique deal:
# I seek power in my upcoming battles. [5 Medallions] - Grant the player a ~33% damage buff (estimated) against [[Scion of Ethiron]] (Highly recommended for low damage output players).

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:KyrsanCurrency2.png|Previous Kyrsan Medallion symbol
File:Person holding medallion above layer 2.png|Medallions outside of Layer 2
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*There is proof of obtaining them from Fishing in the past; whether or not this has been shadow patched is unclear.
*[[Dye Packet]]s cannot be dropped, but this can easily be bypassed by dyeing a piece of armor and then dropping that armor piece to whoever needs it.
*The medallions used to be kept as a physical item after leaving the [[Second Layer]]. This was changed in order to fight exploiters abusing the system.
*In an unknown update, the symbol for Kyrsan Medallions was visually touched up.

[[File:Kyrsan Shrine of Arrival.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Overview ==
The Kyrsan Shrine of Arrival is the first thing adventurers will find upon entering the second floor of [[Second Layer|Layer 2.]] 

It is a carved-out dark cave with statues on each wall. 

When the space-time collapse takes place within New Kyrsa for the first time, you will be sent back here and forced to reenter the city. This event taking place twice will resort in you being torn away from reality and wiping.

There is not a lot of use for this place other than acting as a spawn point and being the gateway to the rest of New Kyrsa.

title: Kyrsan Wilds
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Kyrsan Wilds|caption=Deep cavern walls painted with the serene glow of starlight emanating from a city lost to time.}}
[[File:Kyrsanwilds.png|thumb|900px|center]]

==Contents==
Kyrsan Wilds is a sub-location to [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]], located in the Second Floor of the Second Layer. It's a small location with one of five obelisks, that are used to open gate and halt time in Second Floor. With a certain chance a pink chest with Kyrsan medallions spawns near to Naerotiv. Kyrsan Wilds is being defended by artillery. If you are spotted by it, you will be fired at for 20–30 seconds with ice spears.

Be warned that the wilds are above a dangerous void, and due to the usage of smooth terrain, it can be quite easy to fall in, prematurely ending your run, and most likely, your slot.

==Objectives==
#Making your way to [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|The Grand Library of New Kyrsa]]

==NPCs== 
*[[Naerotiv]]
*[[Plath]]
*[[Kennith]]
*[[Amenre Skiggle Bop]]

== Trivia== 
*In order to get spotted by artillery, you have to step in pink circles on the ground. Ice spears fall from above, so you can just hide under something. These spears can be annoying sometimes and deal medium-high damage.
*Naerotiv tells about New Kyrsa and Scion of Ethiron lore, also mentioning Kyrsgardes ritual called "The Ninefold Blessings of Marrow", used to lull him to sleep. He refers to New Kyrsa as a "not only a shrine to Ethiron, but to ensure it remains asleep" and "bedchamber". Naerotiv tells us that ritual must be completed and we must seal Scion of Ethiron.

In contrast to the ferocious beasts that stalk its wastes, the Kyrsans dwell in small villages sheltered from the gale.|author=Glossary description}} {{Species |image1=KyrsgardeCover.png |name=Kyrsgade
Kyrsan |habitat=[[Second Layer]] }} ==Description== Also known as Kyrsans, the Kyrsgarde are an intelligent form of species unlike the Humans (or by their view, Fringewalkers) that are native to [[The Depths|The Eternal Gale]] and follow Ethiron as both their leader and idol in their society. However, this worship is ultimately skin-deep, or in their case bone-deep, as they ultimately fear Ethiron's power and had been taking measures to prevent his revival. Those residing in [[Firfire]] and the surrounding [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|outskirts]] are peaceful towards Fringewalkers, while the ones laying in the depths of [[New Kyrsa]] prove hostile towards the player, protecting Ethiron from threats with fanatical zealotry. ==Kyrsans== Friendly Kyrsans are found in [[The Ethironal Shrine]], with only three in [[New Kyrsa|The City]] being friendly. *Shrine Kyrsans: **[[Aeroaseluniris Oricalum Forentus]] **[[Aezeroth Kaladin]] **[[Eltus Ferikus Pleristus Zzetchus]] **[[Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus]] **[[Kadrivus Entomolius Auditan]] **[[Makolis Pariah Katatonicus]] *City Kyrsans: **[[Amenre Skiggle Bop]] **[[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] **[[Naerotiv]] *Enemy Kyrsans found within the city: **[[Kyrsgarde Brute]] **[[Kyrsgarde Crawler]] **[[Kyrsgarde Lancer]] **[[Kyrsgarde Sniper]] **[[Kyrsgarde Champion]] ==Gallery== Layer 2 Concept Art.png|Concept Art ==Trivia== *They are quite similar to the [[Miasmera]], a scrapped Monster. *Having the [[Talents|Brick Wall]] Talent makes the fight with the [[Kyrsgarde Lancer|lancers]] '''trivially''' easy. *The Kyrsgarde are enslaved by presumably Ethiron themselves or something related to Ethiron, having their will morphed to Ethiron's, this may be due to the fact that the puppet known as the "Scion of Ethiron" have done something to them using some sort of "mist." Or the fact that the Kyrsan built New Kyrsa City on top of Ethiron's Bedchamber. However, it also could've been due to the Kyrsan's foolishness led to a failure related to some sort of ritual to prevent the Scion of Ethiron in some way. *The Kyrsans in Firfire are not hostile, due to how far they are from Ethiron's mist presence. **In fact, they will give you a name similar to themselves, which is consistent with the UserID of the player, meaning it is shared across every slot. *Kyrsgardes have quite a strong resemblance to the infamous [[Bone Keeper]], which sparked theories that Bone Keepers are possibly Kyrsans gone rogue, were affected by the parasites, or a multitude of other factors, and it's possible they are Kyrsgarde Brute based on how they are built and their noises every time they walk, albeit seeming a bit shorter. *Ironically, despite the fact that the crawlers crawl around the floor, in their idle animation and in general they have functioning legs and can even stand up. It is unknown why they crawl; they also make the exact same noise as Figure from ''DOORS''. *Although several of the Kyrsgarde will refer to their kin as "Brother" Kyrsgarde have no concept of gender and reproduce through parthenogenesis, as "confirmed" by Archmage.[[File:ArchmagePartheogensis.png|300px]] *Sneaking behind a hostile Kyrsgarde and attempting to talk with it prompts in special dialogue: "Waheit... Yaere fraeum aboeave!", which can be translated as "Wait... You're from above!". **In the dialogue box the Kyrsgarde is named "New Kyrsa Guardian". ==References== {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Sapient species]]

'' This might have not been the page you were looking for, if you were looking for a different page, view the [[Kyrsgarde_(disambiguation) | disambiguation]].'' {{PathfinderEx}} {{Monster Infobox |title1=Kyrsgarde Brute |image1=KyrsBrute.png |attacks= * Clenching Assault * Slam |health=4000 10000 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops= *[[Frozen Membrane]] *[[Kyrsan Schematic]] |locations=*[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]] |challenges= {{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== An unusual deviation from the typical Kyrsgarde, the Kyrsgarde Brute is a blunt and relentless being that is not at all similar to the some-what elegance that the other Kyrsgarde have up to this point. They can be distinguished by their bigger build, glowing red Membrane as opposed to the Blue of the rest of the Kyrsgarde, and can be heard with their loud stomping. Contrary to the other Kyrsgarde, they seemingly have no ability to manipulate [[Frostdraw|Frostdraw,]] instead choosing their physical attributes to crush their foes into oblivion. ==Attacks== {| class="article-table" !Name !Description |- |
'''Clenching Assault'''
(★★★) |The {{PAGENAME}} will swing it's arm at the player once before waiting for a short-duration and then swinging with it's other arm. *Being hit by this attack will cause the {{PAGENAME}} to drill its arm into you for a few seconds, dealing rapid damage, before throwing you away. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Slam'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} raises it's arms before crushing them into the ground, dealing moderate damage. *'''This attack instantly executes the player if they are knocked unconscious or low enough health. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |} ==Finisher'== A Kyrsgarde Brute executes its opponent: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Lethal Drill |The Kyrsgarde brute will pick up with its arm and spin you around until you die. (you will only die by this if you are downed or low) |} ==Trivia== *The Kyrsan Brutes seem restless, when attacking they seem a little desperate and mindlessly swing their arms, let alone the fact they walk like they are tired. This is evidenced by the fact that [[F'leche]] remarks, "The big men are so, so angry, they're walking circles everywhere!" after Chaser is defeated. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Layer 2]] [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Floor 2]]

title: Kyrsgarde Champion, Kyrsa's Star
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=THE ESSENCE IS NAMED LIGHT, AND I AM ITS APOSTLE.|author=Raeva Ferash Kenestos}} {{Monster Infobox |image1=Kyrsgarde Champion.png |health=40,000 (+15k per player) |drops=*[[Whistling Periapt]] *[[Gale Essence]] *[[Frost Essence]] *[[Frostthorn]] *[[Kyrsan Necklace]] *[[Kyrsan Chill]] Enchant Stone *[[Cryptwaker's Ring]] *[[Rimebreakers]] *[[Marrowmade Boots]] *[[Coldpoint]] *[[Bone Ring]] *[[Kyrsan Gem]] *[[Words of Light]] (Direct Drop) |locations=[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]] |challenges= |attacks=*Permafrost Colosseum *Pylons of Frost *Decapitating Sweep *Altitude Swipes *Frostgrave *Champion’s Quake *Rime-Rise *Splintered Thrust *Crossrend Cryocleave *Shatterline *Blizzard’s Sanction |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/NPC|Kaide, the Drowned Light|quote=Your description of this 'Champion' is eerily similar to that of the Kyrsan commander who took me prisoner during the siege of Constellia. The circumstances of it were unusual, to say the least. He is the sole reason I am now captive here, as opposed to lying among the bodies of my kin within the ruins of the city.}}}} ==Description== Raeva Ferash Kenestos, the Kyrsgarde Champion, is a boss located in [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]]. He is a muscular white-coil Kyrsan donning uniquely colored armor, alongside a black cape that ends with a purple gradient. An immensely powerful and skilled Kyrsgarde, he wields a large, pale glaive that bears [[Moonseye]] motifs, which is highly capable of utilizing frost. According to [[Words of Light|his manifesto]], he served for New Kyrsa even during the [[Constellia|raid on Constellia]], who was gravely aware of the mass killings that took place. Amongst the ruins of Constellia, he discovered an essence of Light that was the Celestial [[Raeva (Celestial)|Raeva]], breaking him free [[Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron]]'s control and ultimately having a goal of destroying the latter and his Scion for the Heavens and New Kyrsa. He can be encountered after achieving the following requirements: # Speaking to [[Misérables]] and choosing the "'''I seek power in my upcoming battles.'''" dialogue option. # Interacting with the [[Purge Shrine]] in the area [[Kaide, the Drowned Light|Kaide]] is imprisoned, which is to the left of where he is facing; above the terrain. # Defeating a somewhat more difficult and enhanced version of the [[Scion of Ethiron]] (It will not spawn any [[Kyrsgarde Sniper|Kyrsgarde Snipers]] meaning you cannot use them to restore your health, on top of it doing more damage than the normal boss and summon more bones and shooting out his Vehemens Ventus Attack faster). After these conditions have been fulfilled, entering the main city will spawn the Kyrsgarde Champion instead of a horde of [[Kyrsgarde Lancer|Kyrsgarde Lancers]]. During the fight, the remaining time to escape the Layer is increased from three minutes to seven. {{clear}} ==Attacks== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Permafrost Colosseum'''
(☆☆☆)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion summons a large ring of ice pillars, similar to Ice Eruption's round spark variant. * This move is only used when you deal damage to it. * Can be destroyed. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, harmless, unavoidable }} |[[File:Permafrost Colosseum.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Pylons of Frost'''
(★☆☆)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion spins its glaive in the air before slamming into the ground, causing three pillars of ice to erupt in succesion from beneath the player. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.n, dodge.n |type2_color = Darkorange }} |[[File:Pylons of Frost.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Decapitating Sweep'''
(★☆☆)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion performs two low slashes with its glaive, before spinning into a high slash. * the third slash is marked by a yellow indicator, crouch to avoid this attack. {{AttackTags |indicator = duck |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, crouch |type1_color = Darkorange |type2_color = Darkorange |type3_color = Darkorange }} |[[File:Decapitating Sweep.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Altitude Swipes'''
(★★☆)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion performs a quick jumpable sweep, followed by another that must be crouched. {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, jump, crouch }} |[[File:Altitude Swipes.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Frostgrave'''
(★☆☆)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion proceeds to raise its glaive, before detonating ice below the player's feet. {{AttackTags |indicator = hp |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Frostgrave.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Champion’s Quake'''
(★★★)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion crouches slightly before jumping up and crashing into the ground. * This attack deals damage as soon as The Champion's feet touch the ground. * Can be parried with [[Talents|Force Your Way]] but will cost an immense amount of armor {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, jump }} |[[File:Champion’s Quake.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Rime-Rise'''
(★★☆)
|With a horizontal slash, the Kyrsgarde Champion creates a line of ice spikes in the direction of the nearest target. * This attack is capable of dealing very high damage due to each "ice spike" The Champion sends dealing one instance of damage. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.n, unavoidable }} |[[File:Rime-Rise.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Splintered Thrust'''
(★★☆)
|The Champion lets out a swift thrust with its glaive. {{AttackTags |indicator = hp |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Splintered Thrust.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Crossrend Cryocleave'''
(★★★)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion uses its glaive to execute two slashes, followed by a sweep that must be jumped over, and an overhead slash that must be avoided by dodging. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, jump |type1_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Crossrend Cryocleave.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Shatterline
(★★★)'''
|Enraged, the Champion raises its glaive and summons two ice spikes, rushing forth and delivering two slices. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type1_color=DarkOrange |type2_color=DarkOrange |type3_color=DarkOrange }} |[[File:Shatterline.gif|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Blizzard’s Sanction'''
(★★★)
|The Kyrsgarde Champion briefly winds up before unleashing four cleaves, followed by a delayed '''Splintered Thrust'''. *All four slashes follow the green telegraph. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.n, dodge.n }} |[[File:Blizzard’s Sanction.gif|center|thumb]] |} ==Passives== *Kyrsan Chill - Being hit by the Kyrsgarde Champion's applies a permanent slowing effect that stacks. All active slow stacks are cleared when the Kyrsgarde Champion reach 50% HP, and again when defeated. *Temporal Immunity - The Kyrsgarde Champion is immune to the Space-time collapse vortexes. *Thorn Guard - The Kyrsgarde Champion is immune to the effects of [[Providence's Thorns]]. ==Tips and Strategy== *'''You can break the Permafrost Colosseum at any time.''' If you don't feel like you are able to beat the Kyrsgarde Champion at any point while in it, you are able to get out and escape alive. *If the player doesn't damage the Kyrsgarde Champion, it won't use its '''Permafrost Colosseum''' move. This lets you be able to practice and leave at any time you want. **Though, if you walk far enough away from the gate, the initial two Kyrsgarde Lancers will respawn. This could either be a useful healthpack, or your untimely end. **Using attacks that do not deal damage, such as using Poser's Ring, he will not use this move either. *Be aware of your positioning, as the space-time collapse vortexes are still active even when you're fighting the Kyrsgarde Champion. *Light weapons and fast medium weapons are better than heavy weapons, since it allows you to get a lot more m1's in between its attacks. Although, heavy is safer if you do not know how to properly fight him yet. *Sustain is very important on this fight, using [[Bloodless Gem]] on your mantras is recommended. *Defeating the Kyrsgarde Champion as a group reduces the chances of getting its exclusive drops. **Additionally, most of its exclusive drops are both undroppable and unbankable. ==Drops== {| class="fandom-table" width="100%" |- | style="width:10%;" |'''Miscellaneous''' | style="width:90%;" | *[[Relics]]: [[Armorer's Needle|{{cl|relic|Armorer's Needle}}]], [[Frost Essence|{{cl|relic|Frost Essence}}]], [[Gale Essence|{{cl|relic|Gale Essence}}]], [[Kyrsan Chill|{{cl|relic|Kyrsan Chill Enchant Stone}}]], [[Kyrsan Gem|{{cl|relic|Kyrsan Gem}},]] [[Smith's Alloy|{{cl|relic|Smith's Alloy}}]], [[Windswept|{{cl|relic|Windswept Enchant Stone}}]] |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Weapons]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *'''Legendary Weapons''': [[Coldpoint|{{cl|mythical|Coldpoint}}]], [[Frostthorn|{{cl|mythical|Frostthorn}}]], [[Rimebreakers|{{cl|mythical|Rimebreakers}}]] |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Equipment]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *{{text|lhhead}}: TBA *{{text|lharms}}: TBA *{{text|lhlegs}}: [[Marrowmade Boots]] *{{text|lhtorso}}: *#'''Relic Torso''': [[Whistling Periapt|{{cl|relic|Whistling Periapt}}]] *#'''Unique Torso''': [[Kyrsan Necklace|{{cl|unique|Kyrsan Necklace}}]] *{{text|lhface}}: TBA *{{text|lhears}}: TBA *{{text|lhrings}}: *#'''Relic Rings''': [[Bone Ring|{{cl|relic|Bone Ring}}]] *#'''Legendary Rings''': [[Cryptwaker's Ring|{{cl|legendary|Cryptwaker's Ring}}]] |} ==Trivia== * Kills against the Kyrsgarde Champion contribute towards the general Kyrsgarde [[Bestiary]] entry, so the boosts from that entry should also apply against him. * Climbing over the '''Permafrost Colosseum''' is possible if it is summoned near certain tall buildings in New Kyrsa. ==References== {{Nav|Bosses}} [[Category:Individuals with He/him pronouns]]

Ah in the ways of the Song... A Tone. And then the Gale came. Gods above, it deafened us all. And when our hearing returned... They're puppets now, just like him. Eternally bound to guard his shrine... and to allow his arrival.|author=Naerotiv on his fellows}} {{Monster Infobox |title1=Kyrsgarde Lancer |image1=KyrsgardeLancer.png |attacks= * Assault * Glacial Javelin * Skyward Spear |health= 3000 7500 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=*[[Frozen Membrane]] *[[Kyrsan Schematic]] |locations=*[[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]] |challenges= {{Bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} }} ==Description== Also known as Kyrsans, the Kyrsgarde is an intelligent form of species unlike the [[Aspects|humans]] (or by their view, Fringewalkers) that are native to [[The Eternal Gale]] and follow Ethiron as both their leader and idol to their society. Not all Kyrsgarde are friendly unlike the ones in [[Firfire]] towards Fringewalkers, and will protect Ethiron from such threats with pure loyalty. The most versatile and common version of the Kyrsgarde found in [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]], the Lancers can easily contend for the top spot in terms of danger as well. They are master wielders of [[Frostdraw]], using it for both devastating melee and ranged attacks. They can be distinguished by their Burgundy membranes. ==Attacks== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★★☆) |The Kyrsgarde conjures a spear of ice before performing a slash, lance and throw at it's opponent. A 3-hit combo in total. * Recommended to roll back for the first 2-hits and parry the throw. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Glacial Javelin'''
(★★☆) |The Kyrsgarde conjures a spear of ice before throwing at it's opponent. * Easiest move to parry if fighting one on one. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |

(★★☆) |The Kyrsgarde conjures a spear of ice before performing a backflip high in the air and throwing said spear at it's opponent. * Parry it when the arm of the Kyrsgarde reaches the highest point. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |} ==Finisher== A Kyrsgarde Lancer executes its opponent: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Devastating Slash |The Kyrsgarde swipes its spear at its opponent, dealing a fatal blow and killing them. |} ==Dialogue== {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |Waheit... Yaere fraeum aboeave! |- | colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} ==Trivia== *Having the [[Talents#Human Architecture|Brick Wall]] Talent makes the fight with the lancers '''trivially''' easy. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Floor 2]] [[Category:Layer 2]] __NOTOC__

==Description==
The Kyrsglaive is an Endgame [[Weapons|Medium Weapon]] under the Spear category obtained from the [[Second Layer]] of [[The Depths]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Kyrsglaive new crit.gif|Standard
</gallery>
The Kyrsglaive has two criticals. 

For the standing critical, the user raises the spear before slamming it into the ground to burst forth an eruption of bones, applying Daze to the affected opponent.

For the aerial critical, the base spear critical is used instead. {{text|m1tag}}

Both criticals has a cooldown of '''6 seconds'''.

==Description==
The Kyrsieger is a Legendary [[Weapons|Heavy Weapon]] that scales with, and requires [[Attributes|Charisma]] in addition to Heavy. While it functions near identically to a greatsword normally, its true purpose is that of a railgun, manipulating a fraction of Ethiron's power to unleash a devastating blast of energy.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Kyrsieger.gif|Partially charged critical
File:Kyrsiegercrit.gif|Fully charged critical
</gallery>
The user lowers the blade, charging a shot of purple energy with a [[Combat Mechanics#Red|red telegraph]], applying ragdoll and 5 seconds of [[Charm]] on hit. It can be charged by holding {{Input|keybind|R / M3}}, and releasing it at any point will cause the critical to be fired. After fully charging the critical (at around 2 seconds), firing the critical will increase the range, damage, and will instantly guardbreak the opponent on hit.

The critical has a cooldown of '''15 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
KyrsiegerCA.png|Concept art
Kyrsieger Full.png|Full view
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This weapon is designed noticeably differently from other weapons prefixed "Kyrs." This may be a result of it being more closely tied to the [[Scion of Ethiron]] than the [[Kyrsgarde]].
**It shares this property with the [[Kyrswynter]], being tied to the Kyrsgarde prior to New Kyrsa's fall.
**A part of the Kyrs series ([[Kyrsedge]], [[Kyrstear]], [[Kyrstreza]], [[Kyrsblade]], [[Kyrsglaive]], [[Kyrscleave]], [[Kyrswynter]], [[Kyrsieger]])
*This critical will trigger a Nautilodaunt to vent. While charging the critical, it will be forced into blocking which will make it easier for other players to land hits on it from behind, or using an instant guardbreak attack on it.
*Weapon is soulbound upon being equipped.
*Speaking to Kaide with the Kyrsieger equipped will unlock special dialogue.

*12/24/2024-1/4/2025}} == Description == This is [[Deepwoken]]'s equivalent of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christmas Christmas], strongly resembling it in real life, with decorated pine trees, wrapped presents, and also being from late December to early January the next year. The name "Kyrsmas" is most likely named after the [[Kyrsgarde]]. During this time, chests are converted into presents, islands like [[Etris]] and [[Erisia]] are decorated festively, and double the loot can be found in all chests. Due to developmental constraints, a downplayed version was released for 2024-2025. There were minimal changes, with only the central tree in Etris being changed to a Kyrsmas theme, and the release of the [[Kyrsmas Hat]]. == Gallery == File:Kyrsmas2.png == Trivia == *Unlike [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide]], Kyrsmas appears to have no in-universe justification, especially given the average denizen of Lumen would not know what a Kyrsgarde is. However, dialogue with [[Sentinel Augustus]] acknowledges it, but only from the player's perspective. {{Nav|Events}} [[Category:Events]]

title: Kyrswynter
content: {{Weapon Infobox |type=Spear |requirements=50 MED, 75 ICE |damage=17 + {{cl|bleed|'''2.55 BLD'''}} |damage type=Slash |scaling=MED: 5, ICE: 3 |posture damage=6 |range=9 |range type=Lunge |swing speed=0.97x |attack duration=0.6s |special effect=Upon flourishing, unleash a frigid explosion. Procs chilled and ragdolls your opponent. |obtainment=[[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] after defeating the [[Scion of Ethiron]] |selling price=100 |penetration=20% |chip=5% |droppable=Yes |enchantable=No |m.equip=No |rarity=Mythical |oath=Silentheart |description=Forged in an age lost to history and salvaged from the Eternal Gale, this relic hails from a forgotten era. As the last whispered remnant of its kind, it comes from a time before the people of New Kyrsa fell under the command of the Drowned God [[Ethiron]]. The spear is extremely cold to the touch, with an unsettling chill that clings to your skin, leaving a lingering numbness. It embodies the delicate and refined artistry of the Kyrsgarde, showcasing their elegance and sophistication prior to their corruption. Though the Kyrsgarde still wield spears of frost, the craftsmanship of their modern weaponry pales in comparison, having become crude and uninspired under Ethiron's thrall. |image= Kyrswynter.png|Standard Kyrswynter Crystallization Variant.png|Crystal |chip damage=5% }} ==Description== The '''Kyrswynter''' is a Legendary Spear; an intricate curved and wrapped white polearm, its blue-white coloration indicating the frost of the [[Kyrsgarde]], and the patterns under its hilt indicating the winds of the Eternal Gale. It is obtained from [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]]. The Kyrswynter comes with a single passive ability: * '''Subzero Strike -''' Enemies are blasted away with an explosion on flourish, dealing extra damage and proccing Chill or Crystal stacks. This does 10 base damage. ({{t|Dazing Finisher}} does not proc.) ==Obtainment== The Kyrswynter can be obtained from the [[Second Layer]] of [[The Depths]]: #Have '''75''' Frostdraw and obtain the Talent [[Talent Quests|Ethiron's Gaze]]. #Speak to [[Naerotiv]]. He is along the path to the right of the first shrine near spawn. #Defeat the [[Scion of Ethiron]]. #Go to [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] as the Eternal Gale is collapsing and speak to him. You need the 75 Frostdraw to '''obtain''' the Kyrswynter but you need points in Medium Weapon to '''equip''' the Kyrswynter. *(Note that only '''ONE''' Kyrswynter may be obtained per character). ==Criticals== File:Kyrswynter Standing Critical V1.gif|Standing (the blast doesn't apply Daze) File:Kyrswynter Standing Crit V2.gif|Standing File:Kyrswynter Running Crit.gif|Running File:Kyrswynter Standing Crit + M1.gif|Standing + M1 The Kyrswynter has '''two''' different criticals. For the standing critical, the user pokes the spear forward, ragdolling enemies and knocking them back before conjuring a blast underneath their feet, knocking them away once more. Standing on the blast allows you to combo into an uppercut. The stab has a scaled damage multiplier of 1.4x, deals 20 posture damage, and has a windup of 0.65s. The blast has a scaled damage multiplier of 1.2x and has a windup of 1.3s after the stab occurs. Both hits have innate {{cl|bleed}}. The secondary blast counts as an uppercut. For the running critical, the user winds up before leaping forward with the weapon, finishing with an explosive ice blast. Right clicking while still in the air will allow you to cancel your forward momentum. The initial hit of this attack has a 1.1x scaled damage multiplier with 20 posture damage and a 1.45s windup. The second hit has a 1.25x scaled damage multipler with 12 posture damage. Both hits have innate {{cl|bleed}}. The criticals can be chained together by M1ing during the windup of the standing critical, which causes you to perform the running critical after the standing critical's first hit. Both criticals share a cooldown of '''9 seconds'''. ==Gallery== File:KyrswynterConceptArt.png|Concept art File:Kryswynter2.png|Transparent background File:KyrswynterCritStandingCrystal1.gif|Standing crit w/{{t|Glass Path: Crystallization}} File:KyrswynterCritStandingCrystal2.gif|Ditto File:KyrswynterCritRunningCrystal.gif|Running crit w/{{t|Glass Path: Crystallization}} File:KyrswynterCritStandingAndM1Crystal.gif|Standing crit + M1 w/{{t|Glass Path: Crystallization}} ==Trivia== *Previously the running critical used to have an Ice Blue indicator. This was later changed to a standard Red indicator to avoid confusion. *As stated in the description of the Kyrswynter, it explains how Old Kyrsan weaponry was far more pristine than New Kyrsan weaponry. As implied by his sibling, [[Naerotiv]], [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] was likely the last Kyrsan to create a weaponry of such intricacy. *The Kyrswynter also used to be enchantable on release through [[Laplace]]. This was quickly patched 2 days after its release. **Following enchanted weapon rules, Kyrswynter used to already come enchanted from [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero|Frosviernr]] himself. *The passive ability '''Subzero Strike''' is a reference to the [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Fairfrozen Fairfrozen] from Rogue Lineage, which is another ice-themed spear that possesses an ability of the same name. Their ability effects were also quite similar: The Fairfrozen's Subzero Strike also resulted in ragdolling the target backwards and applying ice, if landed. *A part of the Kyrs series ([[Kyrsedge]], [[Kyrstear]], [[Kyrstreza]], [[Kyrsblade]], [[Kyrsglaive]], [[Kyrscleave]], [[Kyrswynter]], [[Kyrsieger]]) *The running crit is almost identical to (and probably inspired by) the Royal Greatsword's "[https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Wolf's+Assault Wolf's Assault]" Skill in ''Elden Ring''. *This weapon bears a striking resemblance to the [https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Celebrant%27s+Rib-Rake Celebrant's Rib-rake] spear from ''Elden Ring''. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Spears]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Medium Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with multiple Criticals]] [[Category:Kyrs series]]

== Description ==
Lake is a [[Chrysid]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is a native of the [[Lullaby Isles]], specifically [[Daphnes]], who got lost and somehow found herself in the [[Songseeker Wilds]].

Lake somehow ended up in the [[Eastern Luminant]], wherein she encountered a band of sailors. Thinking the Songseeker Wilds were her home, she had them take her there. As she explored, she ran afoul of some [[Songseeker]]s.

She wears the [[Scholar]] [[Outfits|Outfit]].

==Location==
Lake is inside a cave within [[Songseeker Wilds]].

== Dialogue ==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

| colspan="12" |''*This Chrysid's eyes are wide with boundless wonder, fixed on the sky above.*'' And to think such a far off land had such beauty to it...

He gave me some new clothes and said I could stay in this cave unt'l I find m' way home, but he says it's not safe f'r me to walk back right now... He br'ngs me food sometimes, but I really don't know how he can cook with that blindfold he wears... I'm sure you'll meet h'm one day, he might be able t' help you, too!
