==Trivia==
*This weapon is based on the concept of voodoo dolls, effigies, that ironically have no link to neither Voodoo nor Vodou, which are frequently depicted in media as dolls made to resemble individuals by those seeking to do them harm. These are then used as a medium to harm the individual by inflicting damage onto the doll.
*Their name may derive from poppets, a more obscure make of doll that is frequently depicted being used for the same purposes as voodoo dolls in media, and is speculated to be the reason for the existence of the false concept of voodoo dolls.
*Despite having a sewing needle as an offhand, the player can still equip offhand weapons.
*Replacing Moppet's critical attack with a [[Talent]]-given critical attack causes it to lose the [[Poser's Ring (mechanic)|stored damage mechanic]]. Using an [[Enchantment]] that replaces your critical attack will retain the stored damage mechanic, despite not having a way to deal the stored damage.
*Because this critical is guaranteed to land, this weapon is exceptional at proccing "on critical attack" effects.
**Notably, Moppet is likely the best user of the {{t|Finishing Touch}} Talent due to how common it is to kill a player ''with'' its critical attack, as this Talent does not proc if the target is already Unconscious.
**For usage with {{t|Critical Engine}}:
***[[Blue Gem]] has no cap for the Ether it can restore, potentially restoring all of your Ether on crit.
***[[Bloodless Gem]] has a cap of 15 health restored, granting exceptional lifesteal but requiring you to spread your damage between crits.
***[[Wayward Gem]] has a 500 stud range limit, though it is very good for this weapon in most scenarios.
***The ''innate'' effects of [[Might Gem|Might]] and [[Wrath Gem]]s do not apply to Moppet's critical.
***All other [[Deep Gems]] work, but they aren't as notable or have no unique properties with this weapon.
*[[Visionshaper]] Clones cannot use Moppet's critical. Additionally, they will deal damage on M1 instead of storing it.
*This weapon's critical originally had the [[M1 tag]]. On its release, using this with {{t|Spine Cutter}} allowed you to bypass the health gate limitation and one shot players.

==Description==
Mortus is a [[Capra]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]].

Mortus is capable of crafting [[Monster Bait]], and giving out the recipes for it to the player. The bait requires two of the respective drops from the monsters. These monsters are:
*[[Megalodaunt]]: [[Megalodaunt Hide]]s
*[[Thresher]]: [[Thresher Spine]]s
*[[Terrapod]]: [[Strange Claw]]s

==Location==
Mortus is located in a fishing hut, on a rocky island in the ocean near [[Lower Erisia]].

title: Motifs
content:
==Description== Motifs allow you to replace your [[Weapons]] current critical attack with the critical attack from another weapon. However, there are certain restrictions and limitations to this. To obtain a Motif, use a [[Smith's Alloy]] on a Motif-compatible weapon and select the “Extract Motif” option. Doing this will permanently destroy the weapon, leaving behind only a [[Formless Shard]]. Having a Motif on a weapon will make your weapon will go translucent on critical, showcasing a glowing version of the weapon the Motif is based on and '''increasing the windup of your critical by 0.15s'''. Default critical Motifs do not increase your critical windup. ==Obtaining and using Motifs== To obtain a Motif, use a [[Smith's Alloy]] on a compatible weapon and choose the ''Extract Motif'' option. Doing so will '''destroy your weapon''', replacing it with a [[Formless Shard]] that will grant you the weapon's Motif as an item. Use the Motif item from your inventory to equip it onto your weapon. This will '''replace your critical attack''' with the critical attack of the weapon your Motif came from. For example, if you have a Crescent Cleaver Motif on your [[Zweihander]], it will have [[Crescent Cleaver]]'s critical instead of the base Greatsword one. There are limitations and not every weapon can equip Motifs. See below for more information. Motifs can be unequipped at any time by right clicking your equipped weapon; the Motif will return to your inventory on unequip. == Compatibility == Motifs can only be applied to weapons that can be extracted for their Motif or weapons that can have their unique criticals overwritten. This means, most weapons with unique criticals '''cannot''' cannot equip a Motif. For example, you can apply a Motif to [[The Flippers of Fate]] or [[Crescent Cleaver]], but you cannot apply a Motif to [[Katana]]. Motifs cannot be applied to [[Soulwrought Weapons]]. Any weapon with a default critical (excluding Fist, Pistol, Rifle, and Greatcannon weapons) can be used to obtain a Motif. Base critical Motifs can '''only''' be equipped onto other weapons within that weapon class with the only exception being the 'Sword' Motif. ===Overridable Weapons=== There are a few specific weapons that can equip Motifs despite them not being Motif-able themselves. For instance, you can Motif [[Whaling Knife]]'s critical onto the [[Tanto]], but you can't apply Tanto's critical to any other weapon. These weapons are: *Light Weapons: [[Needle's Eye]] / [[Tanto]] / [[Alloyed Tanto|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Tanto}}]] *Medium Weapons: [[Gremorian Longspear]] / [[Alloyed Longspear|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Longspear}}]] / [[Hunting Bow]] / [[Shadebolt]] / [[True Seraph Spear]] *Heavy Weapons: [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] / [[First Light]] ===
Full list of Motif-able weapons
=== {| class="fandom-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" !Weapon you can get a Motif from !Critical visual (important for scaling) !What weapon classes the Motif works on |- |[[Krulian Knife]] |[[Krulian Knife]] |Daggers |- |[[Nemit's Sickle]] |[[Nemit's Sickle]] |Daggers |- |[[Whaling Knife]] / [[Alloyed Whaling Knife|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Whaling Knife}}]] |[[Whaling Knife]] |Daggers |- |[[The Flippers of Fate]] / [[Warden Ceremonial Sword]] |[[Warden Ceremonial Sword]] |Swords, Clubs, Twinblades, Spears, Staves, Bows |- |[[Serpent's Edge]] |[[Serpent's Edge]] |Swords, Spears |- |[[Cavalry Saber]] / [[Alloyed Cavalry Saber|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Cavalry Saber}}]] / [[Officer Saber]] / [[Alloyed Officer Saber|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Officer Saber}}]] |[[Officer Saber]] |Swords |- |[[Shotel]] / [[Alloyed Shotel|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Shotel}}]] |[[Shotel]] |Swords, Clubs, Twinblades, Spears, Staves, Bows |- |[[Trident Spear]] / [[Alloyed Trident Spear|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Trident Spear}}]] / [[Golden Swordfish]] |[[Trident Spear]] |Spears |- |[[Kyrscleave]] / [[Crescent Cleaver]] / [[Alloyed Crescent Cleaver|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Crescent Cleaver}}]] / [[The Long Tong of the Law]] |[[Crescent Cleaver]] |Greatswords |- |[[Kanabo]] |[[Kanabo]] |Greathammers |- |[[Halberd]] / [[Alloyed Halberd|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Halberd}}]] |[[Halberd]] |Greataxes, Spears |- |Any weapon in the respective weapon class with a default critical attack

Excludes Fists, Pistols, Rifles, and Greatcannons |'''Light Weapons''':
Dagger: [[Stiletto]], Fists: N/A, Pistol: N/A, Rapier: [[Apprentice Rapier]] '''Medium Weapons''':
Sword: [[Sword]], Spear: [[Iron Spear]], Staff: [[Wooden Staff]], Club: [[Mace]], Rifle: N/A, Twinblade: [[Scalesplitter]], Bow: N/A
'''Heavy Weapons''':
Greataxe: [[Battleaxe]], Greatsword: [[Soulwrought Greatsword|{{cl|divine|Soulwrought Greatsword}}]], Greathammer: [[Pale Morning]], Greatcannon: N/A |The weapon class the Motif-ed weapon belongs to

Sword Motif: Swords, Clubs, Twinblades, Spears, Staves, Bows |- |} ==Additional Notes== Weapon criticals may have their own stats, separate to the weapon they're on. This means that weapon criticals like [[Shotel]]'s will '''retain their unique properties''' when put on another weapon; being Shotel critical's 100% chip damage in this case. Unique critical Motifs have an additional 0.15s windup before the attack is used. Default weapon type Motifs do not have this downside however. As for the damage a Motifed critical will deal on another weapon; it's quite weird. For some reason, '''it takes the scaling stat from the weapon visually shown''' when you use your critical and '''the base damage stat of your actual weapon''' to make up its damage; this is then multiplied by the critical's scaled damage multiplier. This '''overrides''' your weapon's innate scaling, often removing additional innate scaling stats. For some Motifs like [[Kanabo]] and [[Krulian Knife]], it can instead add core attribute/elemental scaling to the critical of the weapon you equipped the Motif on. For example, if you had Shotel Motif on Razor Cutlass, your critical would have less medium scaling than normal, making it deal less damage than a no-Motif critical without even taking into account scaled damage multipliers. Or if you put Greatsword Motif on [[The Long Tong of the Law]], it'd replace the critical's innate Mind and Heavy Weapons scaling with 12 Heavy Weapons scaling from [[Soulwrought Greatsword]], dealing significantly more damage than it would've otherwise, while making your investment somewhat obsolete. This also means Motifs like [[Halberd]], that can be equipped onto other weapon types, will still scale with their original attribute regardless of what weapon type they are equipped on. ==Trivia== *Motifs themselves cannot be banked nor dropped. **However, weapons with a Motif equipped can be banked, dropped, and [[Hippocampal Pool|passed down]] without the equipped Motif being removed/voided. *Equipping a Motif onto the following weapons '''disables''' their {{t|Weapon Talents}}; [[Ritual Spear]], [[True Seraph Spear]], and [[Withered Gale Pale]]. *Motifs can be applied to the '22 [[Hallowtide]] weapons (excluding [[Skyreap Blade]]). *If a weapon has a Motif equipped, but then loses their Motif slot or compatibility with its equipped Motif after an update, your Motif will stay equipped and you'll still be able to use it. This allows you to have certain weapons with normally unobtainable criticals. *You can swap Motifs during combat to change up your critical for mixups. *[[Visionshaper]] clones do not use your equipped Motif, instead they'll use the base critical of your weapon. *[[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] is the only legendary weapon to have a Motif slot. Strangely though, it is not compatible with any currently existing Motif, and the other Greatcannons cannot equip Motifs. ==Gallery== File:Motif in patch notes.png|Motif in patch notes File:Smith's Alloy Message.png|Smith's Alloy message File:Motif Slot.png|Old Motif Slot File:Hivelord kanabo.gif|A [[Hivelord's Hubris]] with a [[Kanabo]] Motif. title: Mounts
content:
[[File:Thresher Mount.png|thumb|A Player riding a Thresher ]]

== Description ==
Mounts are tamed creatures that can be used to traverse terrain quicker. Mounts can be purchased at [[Sordino]] after completing his quest. Doing so will unlock his shop permanently across all slots. Obtaining a mount will give you the [[Beast Whistle]], which is used to summon your mount. However, equipping a weapon, using a Mantra, or getting combat tagged will instantly dismount you, and you cannot summon your mount while in combat.


== Thresher Usage Notes ==

* While mounted on a Thresher, you can completely resist the slow effect of the wind in Layer 2, but still can be pushed away.
* The Thresher walks with speed of 22 stud/sec and runs with speed of 34.5 stud/s.
** The Thresher mount's movement speed is affected by any movement speed modifiers you currently have, though the effectiveness of your movement speed modifiers will be greatly reduced.
* Having a mount doesn't negate fall damage but slightly reduces it by around 2%. This value needs further testing.
* The Thresher mount can walk on lava without dismounting the rider.
* If you are carrying something before using the Whistle, you will continue to carry said item while mounted. This greatly increases your movement speed while carrying objects.

== Current Mounts ==

* Thresher - Unlock costs {{c|crowns|3}}.

title: Movement
content:
'''Movement''' in Deepwoken is essential to travelling around. This page includes details on basic mechanics, techniques, and talents/equipments that affects your movement.

''Knowing this information is absolutely crucial to when running away from something or someone you cannot defeat.''

== Running ==
Running is performed by double-tapping the {{Input|input|W}} key or pressing  {{Input|keybind|ALT}} to toggle sprint. 

Over the course of 3 seconds of running you will passively gain momentum and speed, making you (1.15x?) faster than your normal running speed. The start of the process of gaining momentum is shown when thin white trails starts trailing behind your character, the trails stop 1 second after gaining full momentum.

== Rolling ==
Rolling is done by pressing {{Input|keybind|dodge}}. On top of the movement benefits, rolling grants brief iFrames to most attacks in the form of dodging them. The default direction of the roll is backwards.

When rolling in the air, you perform an air dash. An air dash can be aimed towards any direction, it can also be used to dodge attacks when airborne.

If you touch the ground during an air dash, it will start rolling instead. The duration of the roll is not affected by the duration of the air dash. This mechanic is also known to negate fall damage when the damage is below a 15% (still needs testing on whether its the height or damage that it checks) of your maximum health. If not, then it will reduce the fall damage by roughly 37%.

== Crouching/Sliding ==
Crouching is performed by pressing {{Input|keybind|crouch}}. While crouched, your [[Stealth]] is increased and you can perform Assassinations.

By pressing the crouch button while running, you will start sliding.

Jumping during the slide will perform a slide jump, sending you upward by roughly 37 degrees from the ground while keeping your momentum. When landing after performing a slide jump, you perform a mini-slide, continuing to slide for a few more studs while allowing the change of directions. (Isn't consistent, may be bugged or something that I'm doing it wrong.)

== Wall Jumping/Climbing ==
Wall jumping is done by jumping in the air or air dashing while moving towards a wall without facing towards it and touching it. The direction of the wall jump will be towards the side of the character that is not touching the wall. By holding {{Input|input|W}} before the wall jump, it will send you foward diagonally. You can only wall jump twice, after that, you won't be able to Wall Jump anymore. (You can still do Wall Climbing after the two wall jumps.) 

Wall Climbing can be done by doing a wall jump while your character is facing the wall. When initiating a wall climb, your character gets sent roughly (i'll test this later too) degrees upwards while sending your character backwards for a few studs. After initiating a wall climb, you are able to do one air jump by jumping before landing back onto the ground, sending you directly upwards. When you are able to do an air jump, you are unable to wall jump. If you jump to a wall when you are in water, you will be able to do two wall climbs. (Including the air jump.) 

By jumping right under an edge of a wall, you start holding the edge. To stop holding the edge, you can either jump, which sends you directly upwards, or move away from the wall.

== Techniques ==

* '''Movement Tech:''' You can improve the overall speed of your movements by following these steps: slide jump then air dash towards the ground at roughly 37 degrees to start rolling, then repeat, Slide > Jump > Air Dash > Repeat.
* '''Momentum Tech:''' When using a move that restricts your movements right before a mini-slide, the mini-slide would still continue to bring you foward without canceling the move.

Grgrglrgl.|author=Mudskippers during Mudwoken}} There are a few types and variants of '''Mudskippers'''. Where more can be found in the [[Mudskipper (disambiguation)]] page, this page covers two variants of Mudskippers. {{Monster Infobox |title1=Mudskipper |image1= Mudskipper.png|Standard bloatskipper.png|Bloated Mineskipper.png|Mineskipper FatMineskipper.png|Mineskipper (Bloated) Miniskipper.png|Miniskipper |attacks=*Scratch *Air Force (Enhanced) |health= 150 / 120
{{cl|corrupted|375 / 300 (Corrupted)}}
250(Mine)
|drops= *[[Mantra Modifiers|Lesser Mantra Modifiers & Sparks]] *[[Gale Stone]] (Enhanced) *[[Dying Embers]] (Bloat) *[[Ore|All Ores]] (Mine) *[[Miner's Hardhat]] (Mine) |locations= *[[Random Encounters#Islands/Outposts|Random Sea Event]] *[[Random Encounters#Mudskipper Emergence|Mudskipper Emergence]] event *Stairway to [[The Viper's Jaw]] *[[Pathfinder's Respite]] *Summoned by [[Mudskipper Brute]]s and [[Broodlord]]s (Mini and Bloat) *[[The Depths]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Songseeker Wilds|Songseeker Mines]] (Mine) |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} }} ==Description== The Mudskippers are a large category with lots of variations made up of mindless enemies formed from the bodies of the decayed, or by the forceful conversion from a [[Nautilodaunt]]. Their notable feature aside from their bright unusual colours, are their empty eyes and the large mass of coral on their head that covers one of their eyes. They all used to be human at some point or another, but their corpses are now piloted by a parasite. They are mostly in complete lack of intellect with a [[Mudskipper Knight|few exceptions]], leaving them only able to scratch their enemy with no sense of basic combat knowledge, making them entirely defenseless if fought back. However, they seem to still have some sense of intellect, as they will only attack you one at a time, and will tend to swap out if there are multiple. While weak on their own, these earlygame enemies can be a threat when they attack alongside other enemies. Mudskippers are notorious for their high hitstun attacks that can easily stunlock unexperienced players to death. ===Normal Mudskippers=== Normal Mudskippers can only attack with their scratches, with the second attack being faster than the first. When there are multiple of them, they will usually swap in and out of each other, taking turns on hitting the player. ===Enhanced Mudskippers=== Enhanced (or Emergent) Mudskippers can do what normal Mudskippers do, but will also have a Mantra to help with in their disposal. Shooting from their mouth, this [[Air Force]] Mantra will knock the player back greatly when hit. They can only be found during the [[Random Encounters#Mudskipper Emergence|Mudskipper Emergence]] event, popping up from the ground. ===Bloatskippers=== Bloatskippers are, as the name implies, bloated Mudskippers. These Mudskippers instantly die upon being knocked and cause an explosion momentarily after their death, dealing damage. This explosion can autogrip if you are low enough on health or are already knocked. ===Mineskippers=== Mineskippers wield pickaxes, dealing slightly more damage than normal Mudskippers. Bloated versions of these Mudskippers lack the ability to wield pickaxes and do not explode on death, instead have the ability to use [[Air Force]], similar to Enhanced Mudskippers. These Mudskipper variants can be found at [[Songseeker Wilds]] in the mines. ===Miniskippers=== Miniskippers are exclusively spawned from [[Mudskipper Brute]]s and [[Mudskipper Broodlord]]s. These Mudskipper variants have but one unique quality; on knock, they instantly die without granting a health pack. This singular trait turns the normal minor annoyance of a Mudskipper into a potentially dangerous opponent, as you will need to deal with them while also fighting their summoner, and if their summoner kills them, you won't get a health-pack ==Moveset== {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description !GIF |- |
'''Scratch'''
(★☆☆) |Weakly smacks opponent over and over again until knocked. *Used by most Mudskipper variants. *Has relatively high hitstun. *If you whiff a parry against this attack, let the next attack hit you instead of retaliating, as you'll just get hit again. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:MudskipperScratch.gif|360x360px]] |- |
'''Pickaxe Swipe'''
(★☆☆) |Weakly slashes opponent with a pickaxe over and over again until knocked. *Mineskipper exclusive. **Notably, this is not used by the Bloated Minskipper variants, they use Scratch instead. *Has relatively high hitstun. *If you whiff a parry against this attack, let the next one hit you instead of retaliating, as you'll just get hit again. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Mudskipper pickaxe.gif|360x360px]] |- |
'''Air Force'''
(★☆☆) |Leans backwards while holding their mouth shut, before firing a powerful blast of air at the enemy. *Enhanced Mudskipper and Mineskipper (Bloated) exclusive. *Identical to the [[Air Force|Mantra]] by the same name. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Mudskipper air forces 1.gif|360x360px]] |} ===Passives=== *'''Bloating''' - Bloated Mudskippers will violently explode '''after being gripped''', dealing '''AoE Autogrip''' damage around their body. == Finisher == {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with their claws. |} ==Tips== *Due to their low health and damage, they don't pose a lot of danger. *If you are struggling to parry them, remember that the second attack comes faster, and the first attack comes slower. Get hit a few times intentionally to see the timing, and parry accordingly. *When overwhelmed with a lot of Mudskippers, [[Vent]] by pressing {{Input|keybind|G}}. Make sure you have the required [[Tempo]] to do this. **When fighting more than one Mudskipper at a time, only one Mudskipper will actually be attacking, while others could be using any secondary abilities they have access to. For example, {{cl|wnd|''Air Force''}}. If they don't have any, they would usually just take turns hitting you. **If you are struggling with a horde, try using ranged attacks like [[Fire Palm]] or [[Ice Forge]]. *If they are Enhanced Mudskippers, listen to when are about to cast [[Air Force|{{cl|wnd|''Air Force''}}]], and dodge. **If you get hit by {{cl|wnd|''Air Force''}}, you will be flung backwards greatly, maybe even off a cliff. Make sure you pay attention to your surroundings so that you may not fall into worse situations. **If there are more than one Enhanced Mudskippers, they will often spam this Mantra. Hold block when you feel that they are going to do this. *Bloated Mudskippers will explode after being gripped, so take care to move away if anyone is low. **This will also instantly execute any knocked enemies nearby, including you or your allies. *When fighting a [[Mudskipper Brute]] or [[Broodlord]], it is imperative that you take out their summons as quickly as possible, as they can and will interrupt your fight, and if not killed in-time, the brute/broodlord could stop you from getting a healthpack. == Gallery == Corrupted mudksipper?.png|Corrupted Mudskippers found in the First Layer MudskipperConversation.png|Mudskippers conversing ==Trivia== *Mudskippers slightly resemble the [https://thelastofus.fandom.com/wiki/Clicker Clickers] from "The Last of Us", as well as vaguely resembling [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Shrieker Shriekers] from [https://rogue-lineage.fandom.com/wiki/Rogue_Lineage_Wiki Rogue Lineage]. They twitch their heads and bodies when standing still and demonstrate a lack of conscience. **Despite this, they can still start conversations. *According to the [[Bestiary]], Mudskippers are produced by a wide variety of parasitic corals that originate from [[the Depths]]. [[Nautilodaunt]]s appear to be able to implant these parasites in corpses. *On the [[Mudwoken|2022, April Fool's Day]], Mudskippers took over the Deepwoken Discord server and game, with the text "Grgrlglrgl grrgl. Grgrglrgl." appearing in the update log channel and the game's name being changed to Mudwoken. **Every player and a select few NPCs became Mudskippers. Aspects had their own unique names. *The Mudskipper has the greatest number of variants out of any NPC in the game, having nine in total, not including the April Fool's variants. *If you don't want to risk going down to the depths for Umbrite to get Ironsing, just fight the Mineskippers as they have a chance to drop every ore in the game. *Mudskippers participated in the [[Warring States Era|2025, April Fool's Event]] under the name the "Blue Skippers." *Dodging a Bloatskipper's explosion will cause you to be combat tagged by "God." *Hair IDs for Mudskipper head: 17538022269 - Head - b9e4ff, 78002702231117 - Face - 000000, 17536531879 - Yellow Stripes - dab260. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Humanoid Monsters]]

content:
''This might have not been the page you were looking for, if you were looking for a different page, view the [[Mudskipper (disambiguation)|disambiguation]].'' {{Topbuttons|p, [[Mudskipper Broodlord/Gallery|Gallery]]}} {{Monster Infobox |attacks=*Punch *Left Hook *Broodrot Thrust *Broodrot Smash *Rotted Mudtoss *Call of the Horde |health=5500
13750{{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=*Mantra Modifiers *[[Coral Cestus]] *[[Martial Artist]] |locations=*[[Voidsea]] *[[The Depths]] *[[The Aratel Sea]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]] |image1=Mudbroodlord.png |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}}}} ==Description== A far more powerful and dangerous variant of the [[Mudskipper Brute]]. They appear more intelligent, capable of using their fellow [[Mudskipper]]s as tools, and are distinguished from their weaker counterparts by their purple hue. '''They inflict heavy anti-heal''' similar to the Talent "All the Dead Gods" whenever an enemy is in combat with them, making them incredibly threatening in horde situations such as [[Hell Mode]], [[Saramaed Hollow]], or [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]. ==Moveset== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !GIF |- |
'''Right Hook'''
(★☆☆) |The Broodlord throws a brutal and powerful punch. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:When is 003 Coming Ou-.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |
'''Left Hook'''
(★☆☆) |The Broodlord throws another brutal and heavy blow. Typically used right after Punch. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Hey Witherald! How was wo-.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |
'''Broodrot Thrust'''
(★★☆) | Delivers a stronger, unparriable thrust with its rotten fist. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color=DarkOrange }} |[[File:Witherald! I used to be a fan of your rogue vide-.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |
'''Broodrot Smash'''
(★★★) |Rigorously leaps forward and raises its arms into the air, swinging down on its prey with an unparriable rotten slam. *This move autogrips knocked enemies. *This attack is used most often when the player is too far away from the Broodlord for it to land its melee strikes. {{AttackTags |telegraph=red |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown, autogrip }} |[[File:Hi Witherald, great news! You're now employe-.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |
'''Rotten Mudtoss'''
(★☆☆) |Hurls a [[Mudskipper]] or [[Bloatskipper]] at the opponent. If Mudskipper, it will act as a new summoned enemy. If Bloatskipper, it will explode upon impact. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, summon }} |[[File:Witherald please i want to see my family agai-.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |
'''Call of the Horde'''
(★☆☆) |Unleashes a blood-curdling screech that alerts any nearby mobs of your presence, as well as summoning two [[Mudskipper]]s that can be either a [[Bloatskipper]] or a [[Miniskipper]]. Two of the same Mudskipper type can spawn as well. Applies anti-heal and deals sanity damage. The scream can be blocked to avoid anti heal. {{AttackTags |debuff, summon, parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:So when's my payment, Witherald?.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |} ===Passives=== *'''Broodlord Rot''' - When the Mudskipper Broodlord lands an attack on a target, '''80% anti-heal is applied''' for a few seconds. It also applies Bear Trap. **Natural health regeneration is unaffected. Artificial health regeneration is, however. **In [[Hell Mode]], this is reduced to 50%. ***In [[The Diluvian Mechanism]], the amount of anti-heal is increased up to 100%[[File:Keelerbot denying Restoration.png|Restoration Moderator Keelerbot denies a restoration after Corrupted Payback's healing is nullified by Broodlord's Rot. Confirms that Broodlord's Rot is 100% in the Diluvian Mechanism]], excluding health packs received from killing monsters. *'''Sturdy''' - When the Mudskipper Broodlord's natural armor is broken, it remains stunned for 50% less time than other monsters. *'''Adaptation''' - When damaged by anything at medium-long range, the Mudskipper Broodlord will make a '''parry it''', causing the parried to suffer parry stun and damage be negated. *'''Chained Attacks''' - when a broodlord lands a hook, if it wasn't parried, the next one will have decreased windup, this does not apply to '''Smash''' or '''Thrust'''. ==Tips== *The Broodlord's punch chains have similar timing, but there's just enough distance between hits and a short enough windup to confuse even experienced players. Avoid hitting them more than once between their attacks. **Don't hold F to parry. Their unparriable attacks make this inadvisable and it will likely lead to being blockbroken. Parry only when you see that their windup doesn't have an unparriable cue. **Don't spam ''anything''. You need to preserve as much reaction time as possible. *Be mindful of Broodrot Smash. This move allows the Broodlord to cover quite long distances with ease and catch up to you. Additionally, this move also allows them to easily board boats, especially larger ones. *Being one of the most tanky and difficult mobs to fight in the game, they should be approached with extreme caution. Additionally, they can swim faster than you, so try to fight them on land where you have a speed advantage. **Cannons on [[boats]] are a good way to kill them when encountered at sea. *You ''can'' use {{t|Force Your Way}} from [[Ignition Deepdelver]] or the [[Ignition Gauntlets]] to parry Broodrot Slam and/or Broodrot Thrust, but be advised that it is incredibly risky and requires noticeably precise timing to parry either attack. *The Broodlord is deceptively fast, even without using Broodrot Smash, typically able to catch up to the average player, especially on low health. If you're being chased, try to get to higher ground, as Mudskipper Broodlords are, for the most part, incapable of getting to higher elevations. Although, be incredibly mindful of their ability to phase through walls and ceilings with Broodrot Smash. *When escaping from a Mudskipper Broodlord, pay close attention to it's attack audio. Broodrot Smash will knock you down, stunning you, allowing it to potentially get another hit in, dealing high damage. Dodge immediately if you hear it charging up its slam. *Be mindful of their ability to parry mantras, as this can make them harder to deal with from long range ==Trivia== *They were once able to spawn in the Etrean Luminant. Due to community backlash—a result of players being hunted down by Broodlords while being low level—their overworld spawns were made exclusive to The Eastern Luminant on May 3rd, 2024. Note: they can still spawn in Etrea but only in sea events like mudskipper hive *They're based on the [https://thelastofus.fandom.com/wiki/Clicker Clickers] from ''The Last of Us'' series. **Prior to the October 11th 2024 update, Mudskipper Broodlords could see through walls, as well as behind themselves. Clickers are known for their hearing. *They can accidentally hit their own Mudskippers and kill them using their Broodrot Smash move. *They used to deal more damage and used Broodrot Smash and Rotten Mudtoss more frequently being one of the, if not the hardest mob ever, they were nerfed at an unknown point during late 2024 to early 2025 reducing the damage of its punch and left hook and only using Broodrot Smash to grip and stopped using Rotten Mudtoss. In the March 21st 2026 Update, it turned out that Broodrot Smash and Rotten Mudtoss were bugged and were unable to be used by the Broodlord for over an entire year. *In the caves of [[Saramaed Hollow]], Mudskipper Broodlords will start to fight their spawned Mudskippers and vice versa if they get hit by them too many times. Outside of being funny, this allows the player openings to escape without being chased. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]]

It boasts higher innate stats, unique attacks, and a much larger body. Despite their menacing look, they have a simple moveset and low health compared to most other monsters, making them easily learnable. They are not to be confused with the [[Mudskipper Broodlord]], which is a more powerful variant of this monster that is often considered as one of the most dangerous. == Moveset== {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description/Danger !GIF |- |

Two of the same Mudskipper types can spawn as well. Also inflicts some amount of insanity. {{AttackTags |debuff, summon, parry.n, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Mudskipper Brute Call of the Horde.gif|center|250x250px]] |- |} ==Gallery== Official Deepwoken Brute Post.png|Mudskipper Brute teaser posted by the Official [https://twitter.com/Deepwoken Deepwoken Twitter account] Sideshot.png Brute backview.png MudskipperbruteIcon.png|Close up File:Corrupted Mudskipper Brute.png|Corrupted File:The hardest brute image by far.png File:Mudskipper Brute talking.png|Mudskipper Brute talking == Trivia== *It was added to the game in the weekly update of April 12th, 2024. **The Mudskipper Brute replaced [[Megalodaunt]]s within the Trial of One upon release, only to be swapped back with the Megalodaunts the week after. *Its design, along with the [[Mudskipper Broodlord|Broodlord]] variant, are inspired by the Clickers from ''The Last of Us''. **The design could also be influenced by the Bloater from the same game. **Prior to the October 11th 2024 update, Mudskipper Brutes could see through walls. title: Mudskipper Knight
content:
'' This might have not been the page you were looking for, if you were looking for a different page, view the [[Mudskipper (disambiguation) | disambiguation]].'' {{Monster Infobox |attacks= *Assault *Critical |health=600(Trial)
1500{{cl|corrupted|(Trial, Corrupted)}}
1100 (Meteor Isle) |drops= *Lesser [[Mantra Modifiers]] and Sparks |locations= *[[The Depths]] (Trial) *[[Burning Stone Gardens]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Meteor Isle]] |image1= Mudskipper Knight.png|Normal Meteorskip.png|Armored }} ==Description== Found commonly where the drowned reside, Mudskipper Knights are the decayed remnants of those who knew basic combat. They appear in the [[First Layer|Depths]] within [[The Diluvian Mechanism]] and during the fight in the Depths Trial at power levels 3-6. While similar in appearance, they're nothing like regular [[Mudskipper]]s. They are able to utilize defensive mechanics - blocking, parrying, and dodging - and can see in a 360 degree field of view around them. Outside of the Depths, they can be found in both the [[Locations|Etrean and Eastern Luminants]]. In the former, they are located in graves at the [[Burning Stone Gardens]], while in the latter, they can be found crashing into [[Meteor Isle]]. Here, they are a slightly buffed version of the earlier ones you would have encountered, compensating for the change in [[Luminants]]. Within the [[Locations|Etrean Luminant]] and in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]], they wield a [[Falchion]], have no equipment, and wear relatively weak armor. In contrast, the Mudskipper Knights found on [[Meteor Isle]] may wield a variety of weaponry and now wear [[Darksteel Plate]] armor alongside some basic equipment. __TOC__ ==Moveset== {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !GIF |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Mudskipperknightassault.gif|360x360px]] |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Winds up their weapons before striking, dealing high posture damage. *The 'block-ability' of the Mudskipper Knight depends on what weapon they're wielding. **Most notably [[Falchion]]'s critical has very high chip damage and [[Zweihander]]'s critical is unblockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Mudskipperknightcritical.gif|360x360px]] |} ==Tips== *Parrying is essential when combating one as an inexperienced player can die easily to it. **It's essentially a skill check. *This trial is regarded as being on par to [[Enforcer|The Enforcer]] due the pressure it forces in fights despite having no special gimmicks, and it being an overall skill check for the level. Though with enough practice, it can be done flawless like any other monster. ==Trivia== *Mudskipper Knights do '''not''' count as Mudskipper kills in the [[Bestiary]]. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Humanoid Monsters]]

title: Mudwoken
content:
{{Event|image1=Mudwoken Game Icon.png|effects=Majority of NPCs and all players become Mudskippers|items=None|type=April Fools Update|date1=1296|date2=4/1/2023}} ==Mudwoken== Mudwoken was an update pushed on April 1st, 2022. This was an update made as a joke, in which every player would be a [[Mudskipper]] no matter their aspect. Canonically, Mudwoken was 549 years ago in-game from April 1st, 2025. Every April 1st is roughly 183 in game years from the last.
==Mudskipper Traits== You are able to use any weapon just like a normal player. You can also wear armor and do anything a normal player can, just as a mudskipper. ==Gallery== Screen Shot 2022-04-01 at 5.07.47 PM.png|Game thumbnail Mudskipper-player.png|A player as a Mudskipper Mudskipperrace.png Mudguard.png|A Mudskipper [[Etrean Guardsmen]] Legionskippers.png ==Trivia == *No matter what you put in chat, you will make a mudskipper sound *Every human-like npc was turned into a mudskipper as well. This includes bandits, [[The Ferryman]], etris guards, etc... **This excludes [[Karliah]], [[Lance Leshi]] (the Etris food seller), Ploom and the Spelltrainers. **If you opened up your menu and looked at your aspect, it would not just be “Mudskipper” depending on your aspect, it could change. For example a [[Khan]] would be a "Monkskipper" and a [[Gremor]] would be a "Hornskipper". **If your aspect was [[Felinor]] you would be labeled as an "Abomination". {{Nav|Events}} [[Category:April Fools' Day events]] [[Category:Events]]

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is an RNG-based equipment [[enchantment]] that grants the user one of three buffs on proc.

==Effect==
Upon taking damage from a weapon attack, {{PAGENAME}} has a 20% chance to proc. On proc, recover health, restore your sustenance meters, or gain an agility bonus, each of these effects have an equal chance to proc, meaning each individual effect has a 6.6% chance to be procced when you get hit. This enchantment has a 5 second cooldown.

On health recovery: Restore 1.5% of your maximum health. This is applied '''after''' Anti-Heal on the same attack (meaning it could be nullified entirely), but '''before''' damage is taken, possibly saving you from being knocked.

On sustenance restoration: Restore 20% of your maximum blood and 11% of your maximum hunger and thirst.

On agility bonus: Increase your climb height by 15% for 5 seconds.

===Notes===
*This enchantment does not proc against non-humanoid NPCs.

title: Munet Journal
content:
==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Books|Book Collection]]. ==Vol. XIV== ===
Munet Journal, XIV
===
by Wakeguard Winona Munet The aftermath of a battle is always ugly. Many soldiers despise it for the injuries, the breaking of gear, or the politics that come after the victor is decided. For me, it is the process of body watching that I dread the most. It starts with collection. The bodies are everywhere, scattered around the battlefield like a stack of paper left in the wind. Alas, it is my job, and I do as I am told. I walk stretches of bloodied sand and dirt with my cart for hours in the unforgiving sun, packing our fallen onto its wooden surface as I go. The dealings are always deathly quiet, disturbed only by the squeaking of my cart's old wheels. ---- Once I have gathered all of the bodies, they get piled onto a bigger cart. That cart then moves to a secluded lot on the outskirts of my army's territory, the stockyard. It's placed far as it can be from our camps; no living soul goes there but me. Who would want to visit such a location, anyway? When the final body is loaded out and arranged in its own spot in the yard, my job truly begins. Those uninformed may assume It is easy to watch bodies all day. But it is not a job for those weak in the mind. ---- Two weeks. That's how long a fresh body must stay in the stockyard. It is the time allotted for one's soul to return from the {{g|The Depths|Depths}} below into their rightful vessel. It is the time when I stay in my corner of hell, growing immune to the smell of rotting flesh, counting how many flies can nest in a body out of demented boredom. It is the time when I spend my days and nights gazing upon a field of the dead, waiting for one to suddenly awake in a flash of light, wounds healed, limbs returned to their body. When it does happen, it is the only time this job brings me any sort of joy. I welcome them and all their confusion with open arms, embracing their return to the surface. ---- Yet it doesn't happen as much as I would like it to. More often than not, I am dozing off to the buzzing of flies, hoping to awake to a returned vessel asking for guidance. But I never do. Here, with the flies and maggots, I am faced with mortality at its rawest. Here, I wonder when I will be a part of the stockyard, vacant body laid out on the dirt, glassy eyes staring up at the vast sky above.

{{Character

|name=Mur of Light
|species=Celestial}}
== Description ==
Mur Of Light appears to be a goddess, responsible for bringing [[Murmur]]s into this world. 

[[Theadre]] is the NPC who shares such information with the player, apparently needing to have a friendly-high reputation with [[The Kingdom of Etrea]].

Theadre dialogue when questioned about Mur: "Aye... Eldest mother of our people, ''Mur of Light''... She who descended from the Heavens and brought out the Light of our souls in our darkest days..."

The main understanding amongst the people of Etrea is that the Mur was a [[Celestial]], though [[Bookkeeper Andros]] says that he has yet to see records of the Mur even existing outside the borders of the [[Luminants|Eastern Luminant]].

title: Murmur
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Aye... Eldest mother of our people, Mur of Light... She who descended from the Heavens and brought out the Light of our souls in our darkest days...|author=Theadre}}

'''Murmurs''' are [[Talents]] obtained by completing an objective or requirement that allows the user to channel the Song in various ways to gain special buffs or abilities.
==Overview==
Players can only obtain one Murmur, though gaining the [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]] Oath, you can wield all three Murmurs.

Currently, there are three known obtainable Murmurs; [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour]], [[Murmur: Tacet|Tacet]], and [[Murmur: Rhythm|Rhythm]]. Should you wish, they can be removed via the [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts]], using a Wish.

Murmurs are strong but hard to master abilities. A weak user will have a harder time making good use of them until they become stronger and more experienced. As such, Murmurs scale with the user's Power, reaching their maximum potential at Power 20.

==Murmurs==
There are currently three Murmurs:

* [[Murmur: Ardour|'''Ardour''']] - A Murmur that increases outgoing M1 posture damage by 20% and decreases incoming posture damage by 15%. 
** [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour Scream]] - An offshoot talent that debuffs the enemies defense by 25% and posture by 50%.
*** Requires 15 strength and 40 willpower on top of [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour]]
* [[Murmur: Tacet|'''Tacet''']] - A Murmur focused on stealth and concealing oneself, which allows the user to become invisible to other players
** [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Attunement-less#Tacet_Drop_Kick Tacet Drop Kick] - An offshoot 0-star attunementless mantra that requires 5 strength and [[Jus Karita]] on top of [[Murmur: Tacet|Tacet]]
* [[Murmur: Rhythm|'''Rhythm''']] - A support-based Murmur that allows for tracking of others and their health.
** [[Talents#Leader|Spotter]] - An offshoot talent that allows you to show your allies HP of any entity or player while being in [[Murmur: Rhythm|Rhythm]] and using [[Talents#Leader|Callout]] talent
*** Requires 40 charisma and [[Talents#Leader|Callout]] talent on top of [[Murmur: Rhythm|Rhythm]]. Can be also obtained with [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]] [[Oaths|Oath]]

==Trivia ==
*All Murmurs have links to music theory.
**Tacet translates to 'silent', while the Murmur completely silences your actions by making you invisible.
**Rhythm, meaning the systematic arrangement of musical sounds, in which the user listens to beats emanating from entities.
**Ardour means great enthusiasm or passion. In this case it could mean a burning passion for fighting.
*Rhythm used to be obtainable by defeating [[The Ferryman]] during spring. This was scrapped in Verse 2.
*Murmurs were likely introduced to the world of Deepwoken through the being [[Mur Of Light|Mur of Light]].
*Tacet is the only murmur to have a corresponding Mantra.

title: Murmur: Ardour
content:
{{Basic Infobox
|title1=Murmur: Ardour
|image1=<gallery>
MurmurArdour.png|Murmur: Ardour
Ardour_Scream.png|Ardour Scream
</gallery>}}
{{Quotes|quote=An application of the Song that enables one to channel the Murmur into raw strength.|author=Card description}}
__TOC__
==Overview==
'''Murmur: Ardour''' is one of the 3 [[Murmur]]s that, when active, gives 20% extra posture damage on outgoing M1 posture damage, and reduces incoming posture damage by 15%, guardbreaking with an M1 while Ardour is active grants that attack an extra 15% damage multiplier. Activating the Murmur will release gentle purple particles from your weapon, and will make a quiet hum alongside whispers as long as it is active. It will also add a vibrato to the sound of your weapon's swings. Running out of ether at any point while using Ardour will cancel it.

By default, it drains a large amount of [[Ether]] when used; however, at Power 18 the ether cost is low enough for your ether regen to overpower it, but it will still be slow. At Power 20, activation of the Murmur will be free and your Ether regen won't be affected. 

For a more detailed view on Ardour, see the [[Lore#Whispers of Ardour|lore]]. 
===Ardour Scream===
{{Quotes|quote=Amplify your shout into a scream using Ardour, dominating weaker foes. (Hold H and release.)|author=Card description}}
'''Ardour Scream''' is a Common [[Talent]] in the "Murmur" category that can be obtained when the user has '''Murmur: Ardour''', 15 Strength, and 40 willpower. Alternatively this Talent is granted to you upon obtaining the [[Soulbreaker]] Oath.

When activated, you let out a scream, applying the Ardour Scream status effect to targets in a large AoE. Affected targets take 1.5x posture damage and 12.5% more damage and are forced out of Tacet. This ability does not scale on Power, always draining all of your Ether. Ardour Scream can only be used if you are at 100% Ether, unless you have [[Soulbreaker]], in which case it can be used at a minimum of 40% Ether. Ardour Scream grants a +12.5% damage and posture damage modifier to the attacks targeting the opponent affected by Ardour Scream, it does '''not''' make them take increased damage/posture damage by lowering their defenses; Ardour Scream '''cannot bypass the damage modifier or posture damage modifier caps'''.

<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Ardour screech.gif|A player using Ardour Scream
</gallery>

==<u>Obtainment</u>==
====<u>Method One - Serpent Slayer</u>====
Defeat the [[Dread Serpent]] either by randomly encountering it in the [[Voidsea]] or summoning it with a [[Ardour Manifestation|Ardour Manifestation]].

====<u>Method Two - World Serpent</u>====
Defeat the [[The Doom of Caeranthil]] by randomly encountering it in the Etrean Luminant as a [[World Events|World Event]]

====<u>Method Three - The Old Stranger</u>====
Encounter the [[Old Stranger]] on a dinghy and assist them by giving them a refreshing drink such as a [[canteen]] containing fresh water (you can use ocean water if you have a [[Purifying Ring]] equipped), the [[Talents#Cryomancer|Condensation Drip]] Talent, or [[Redd Juice]].

====<u>Method Four - Obtain [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]]</u>====
Obtaining the [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]] [[Oaths|Oath]] will instantly grant you Ardour as well as Ardour Scream.

title: Murmur: Rhythm
content:
{{Basic Infobox
|image1=Rhythm.png
|title1=Murmur: Rhythm
}}
{{Quotes|quote=An application of the Song that enables the user to perceive the subtle Murmur emanating from all things.|author=Card description}}
__TOC__
==Overview==
'''Murmur: Rhythm''' is one of the 3 [[Murmur|Murmurs]] that, when activated, will point out entities nearby. Similar to ESP, but range-limited. It also mutes background music and amplifies sounds made by entities, be that parrying or mantra usage for players, or sounds and attacks by mobs.

Pressing G while crouched, the player will be granted vision of entities and where their event origin is. Entities, such as players, will emit a white ping, while event origin locations beat at 1/4 the speed of normal heartbeats and are yellow with white outlines in addition to being detectable from ''much'' further away.

The detection range scales with the user level: higher level means the player will be able to point out sound from further away. Detection range also scales with usage time, gradually growing greater with use, up to a limit of your power level. Also detection range can be increased by 50% with [[Ferryman's Ring]].

This also allows the user to see a rough estimate of entity health (orange for ~65% or under, red for ~33% or under.).
===Spotter===
'''Spotter''' is a Common [[Talents|Talent Card]] that can be obtained when the user has '''Murmur: Rhythm''', Callout, and 40 charisma. When Callout is used in Rhythm, this Talent marks the target for you and your allies to see, allowing your allies to see an estimate of their health. This ability does not cost any ether to use. Getting Spotter is not recommended if you plan on playing solo, as you can see the HP estimate of the target with base Rhythm, but it can help in heated multiplayer fights.
===<u>Obtainment</u>===
====<u>Method One - [[Second Layer|Layer 2]] Quest</u>====
*In the first floor of Layer 2, The Eternal Gale, find [[Kadrivus Entomolius Auditan]] (located below a broken bridge near the original [[Bone Keeper|Bonekeeper]] mini-boss fight). Required to be at least power 6 in order to initiate a conversation.
*You will need to listen to the audio cues given off by the holes in the wall (indicated by a pulsing marker) and interact with the hole that make a lower pitched sound compared to the other 3. Consider lowering your music volume and raising the audio of your Roblox client to hear more clearly. Repeat this task 3 times and you will be granted the murmur.
*Failed attempts will lead to 2-3 Parasites forming into your body. If you have the [[Wormwarder Lantern]] or [[Grand Fisher Helm]] equipped, parasites will form on your body but will never hatch, allowing you to retry the task as needed.
''For a more in-depth walkthrough, consider watching [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z_D3wekcclg&ab_channel=TheDeepwokenGuide this video].''

====<u>Method Two - Obtain [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]]</u>====
Obtaining the [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]] [[Oaths|Oath]] will instantly grant you Rhythm as well as Spotter. However, Spotter will not work unless you have the [[Talents#Leader|Callout]] Talent.
[[Category:Murmurs]]

title: Murmur: Tacet
content:
{{Basic Infobox|image1=tacet card.png|title1=Murmur: Tacet}}
{{Quotes|quote=An application of the song that enables the user to suppress their own Murmur.|author=Card description}}
__TOC__
==Overview==
'''Murmur: Tacet''' is one of the 3 [[Murmur|Murmurs]] that, when active, makes the user completely invisible to anyone not in close proximity of them, it also grants 400 [[Stealth]], greatly reducing the aggro range of enemies. Activation is indicated by an inward ring and a fade-out noise, while deactivation with an outward ring and a fade-in noise.

'''BE WARNED:''' Tacet in PvP scenarios may not prove reliable, as it may end up not even making you invisible upon use, instead just showing you crouching and moving as if it weren't active. It is also removed when [[Murmur: Ardour|Ardour Scream]] is used.

The only actions a user can perform during Tacet are crouch walking, rolling, Air Dashing, falling down ledges, and holding items. Uncrouching, attacking, being hit, or interacting with the world will deactivate Tacet.

Upon standing up for '''any''' reason (climbing, sprinting, etc.), Tacet will automatically disable.

The detection range of the invisibility scales inversely on the player's Power and [[Stealth]] stat: the higher Power and Stealth, the closer entities need to be to spot the user. The detection range (for PVP) is indicated by a ring around the user.

Tacet has two different detection radius, one for PVE and PVP:
*In PVE, the detection radius is effectively 0 at Power 20, the player can avoid any and all monsters or NPCs even when touching them. However, the unaggro range is larger than 0 studs, so the user must make some distance to evade any fight. Do be aware that Tacet is disabled during hellmode though, and attempted use of Tacet to escape could possibly result in death. In some situations, PvE enemies might still aggro onto you if you are too close to them.
**The de-aggro range is still quite large, you will need to make some distance between you and your enemy before using Tacet.
*In PVP, the detection radius is roughly 40 studs at Power 20. Players who enter the range of Tacet will see the user quickly fade out of its invisibility. If a player goes out of range, they will see an inward ring at the last seen location of a player using Tacet.
**Range scales with stealth up to 100% and after that, it grows bigger because of a bug.

===<u>Obtainment</u>===
Murmur: Tacet can be obtained in four ways, only one of which does not require any Charisma.
====<u>Method One - Fetch Quest</u>====
Locate [[Cestis]] in Meteor Isle and accept his quests, he will give you a random player in the server's current location and name asking you to kill them. Asking for a bounty from him requires 10 Charisma.  You need 5 Kills to Obtain Tacet. (Must have the "hunted" reputation with Etrea)
====<u>Method Two - Born Assassin</u>====
By completing 5 Bounty Hunting Contracts from any [[Bounty Hunting|Bounty Board]], [[Cestis]] (Whether or not you previously met him) will be intimidated by your presence; netting you the Murmur for free. You do not need any charisma for this method. (Bounty Assists do not count)[[File:Deepwoken stranger.png|thumb|254x254px|A screenshot of the Quiet Stranger NPC , found by Restative.]]
====<u>Method Three - The Quiet Stranger NPC</u>====
Passing the Charisma Check, requiring 50 Charisma, of sitting Ministry NPC grants you the Murmur for free. (Note: The [[Quiet Stranger]] NPC is not a set NPC, he has a rare chance to spawn anywhere at Erisia.) Obtainment of the Murmur via this method is not recommended.
====<u>Method Four - Obtain [[Soulbreaker]]</u>====
The [[Soulbreaker]] [[Oath]] will grant you Tacet instantly upon obtainment. However, you cannot use the Oath's variant of Tacet to obtain [[Tacet Drop Kick]].

''For a more in-depth walkthrough, consider watching [https://youtu.be/-nlSAteFox4 this video].''

title: My Warm Blood
content:
{{CutContent}} ==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' was a [[Book]]. ==Text== ===
My Warm Blood
===
- Another sinful kin of Merit I reach out to the sky once more. Clouds stretch across the blue sky, my hand blending within its hue. Though, cracks in my skin adorn it with splotches of red, I can still see the true blue within the expanse. Mother told me to leave behind something to remember, I’ve produced naught but countless letters yet. Each visit to the mirror, my family’s tattoos along my body remind me once more of who I am, the only child, the one responsible to carry on our blood. Day after day, with each additional line, I recall her stories of each one to come before me. Legacy. Legacy, they say. And what will I leave behind? A pile of bodies, nothing more. A soul whose too damned to be loved, and too rotten to rehabilitate. Within my corps, they would call this a “lost cause,” and I cannot help but agree. “You can settle down and start a family,” the captain tries to reassure me time, and time again. But I don’t go by what he says. A lump in my throat grows each time I walk into Merit’s tavern. I am only worth a glance, then they return to their normal acts. I can sit in silence for hours there, listening to the musings of others, unable to make or share my own. For what tales does a soldier have worth telling? I slayed a man here. I slayed one there. I watched one beg me not to, whilst a rifle spear behind me would cut me in two if I refused. This is not the legacy I want. This is not the life I want. This flesh is a prison, and no other vessel would accept a soul as rotten as this. Despite all of this, time and time again, the tavernkeep reassures me, “You can settle down and start a family.” But I don’t go by what he says. A little light of hope sparks within me sometimes, despite this. Perhaps it’s just residual ether, perhaps it’s muscle memory tied to my flame. This light, this little light within my soul tells me that there is a future, a real legacy to leave behind. It lasts until I’m greeted by the mirror once again. Tattoos and cracks, little lines and bruises adorn this vessel. My eyes glaze, anguished, draping a cloth over the mirror, then sitting within the barracks for hours, waiting. Waiting for nothing in this worn down, broken vessel. I often find myself conjuring flame just to hold close, to see if this is real. To see if I can feel still. To see if this is just a dream I’ll wake from. Opening my eyes, I meet the sear upon the vessel. And for all of that, what is my reward? Resounding silence. I can start a family, no, I can start a fire. That’s all I’ve ever been able to do. I don’t go by what anyone says, anymore. Legacy! Legacy! Legacy! And to be remembered! Leave something behind, she told me. Bodies fade away, and flame lives past men. I don’t want a family, ma. I want to be forever. For the first time, it all makes sense to me. For the first time, my legs move on their own. For the first time, I feel. The cage around my skull has opened, and I see it all as it ever was: flame. No longer shall all my actions be planned out in advance. I shall waver, I shall grow, I shall be snuffed out within a gust. When I return to this town, I will not be the same as them, I will be dust lasting far longer than their sorry souls, I will be their sunset. Sol above me, I feel myself melting away, my mind, flesh, and all. It reaches its hand out, welcoming me into its hellfire embrace. No longer will vessels bind me. No longer will I- “What are you doing?” A voice. “What in the hells is wrong with you?!” It calls once more, but I feel too incandescent to reply. Warmth is in my grasp, and no soul shall deny it. That is, until it’s snuffed out by the everpresent gale. “Gods below, Vreia!” The voice calls out once more, as the warmth fades. My eyes open, staring forward. Another Adretian woman stands in front of me, the one responsible for snuffing out my flame. I look down at the sear, and begin to process its true feeling behind it all: regret. Weakness overwhelms me, as the pain washes over me all at once. I crumble in my seat, conscious fading. “..Hey. Snap out of it.” The voice mutters, before I slip out of this vessel once more. In my dreams, I see fire. I see a radiant gardener, gently raising each flame, growing its might with delicate care. The gardener can smile bright, happily embracing her incandescence. I try to smile back at her, and I feel my flame waver. I waver unto the night, shrinking until she pities me enough to snuff me out for good. Upon my eyes opening, I see not flame, but hair. I brush my own out of my eyes, staring up at the ceiling as I have many moons before. Shapes dance across it as my consciousness comes to, and I analyze my surroundings. An infirmary. I look towards my vessel, delicately dressed in bandages across my chest. I hold my hand against my heart... and it still beats. These are not the {{g|The Depths|Depths}}, I am still within Merit’s walls. My hair draped along my shoulders seemed to have also been touched by the sear, some being singed as a result of it. The door to my ward swings open, a tall Khan watches over me, etching notes in his pad before we’ve even exchanged words. Just as all people have before, a glance is all given. I open my mouth, and try to speak. Nothing. “Who did this to you?” The man asks, without looking up from his pad. I let out a sigh. Chirurgeons never take kindly to the truth if it’s not something they can justify. And this warmth I feel, this attraction to the flame, there is no justification for. It simply feels right. The thought eludes me for moments, until I feel a hand upon my shoulder, and flinch, pushing it away. I glare towards the hand, only to see it was not the chirurgeon, but the Adretian woman from earlier. She looks hurt by this expression, and my glare turns to a somber gaze. “You were, ah.. struggling, out there. ” She mumbles, running her fingers over the spot on her hand which I swatted away moments earlier. I feel bad, but I already struggle enough to communicate with peers as is. A moment of silence passes, while she stands over me. I’m too ashamed to look up, as the reality of what has occurred begins to dawn upon me. “Vreia?” She speaks my name, and my thoughts are quickly interrupted. I shake my head, managing to speak for the first time in days, “..Yes?” Though, quiet as a mouse. Pathetic.
[[Category:Books]]

title: Mystery Boxes
content:
{{IronVowEx}} ==Description== Mystery Boxes are apart of the exclusive gamemode, [[Vow of Iron]], allowing you to purchase a variety of randomized equipment and weapons out of them via exchanging [[Notes]] {{c|notes}}, and are located throughout several locations within Lumen. Mystery Boxes appear as dark, chest-like boxes, with question mark decals all over the lid and base. They also feature gray strips across the base and lid. Every known location goes as follows: *One inside of the [[Derelict Highchurch]] *Two near the [[Temple of Mur]] *One underneath the stairs near the Group of Etrean Nobles inside of [[The Golden Rat]] *One inside of [[The Entropy Catalyst]] *One on an island to the northeast of [[Meteor Isle]] *One inside of a cell in the [[Fort Merit]] prison tower *One inside of the [[Songseeker Temple]] *One on an island west of [[Etris (Vow of Iron)|Etris]] *One in [[Etris Palace]] right above Lord Regent *One on the second floor of the main building in [[Summer Isle]] *One inside of the caves below [[Saramaed Summit (Vow of Iron)|Saramaed Summit]] ==Loot Pool== Below is a table of everything that can be obtained using the Mystery Boxes.
===
Obtainable Items
===

For a small price I will surmise your great destiny!|author=Mystic}} {{NPCInfobox|title1=Mystic|image1= Mystic.png | Etris Summer isle mysic.png | Summer Isle Castle Light Mystic.png | Castle Light VoidheartMystic.png | Voidheart Aratelmystic.png| Greathive Aratel Miner's Landing Mystic.png | Miner's Landing VigilsMystic.png | Isle of Vigils GuildBaseMystic.png | Guild Base Meteorislemystic.png | Meteor Isle |name=Mystic|aspect=Chrysid|location=*[[Etris]] *[[Summer Isle]] *[[Castle Light]] *[[Voidheart]] *[[Greathive Aratel]] *[[Miner's Landing]] *[[Isle of Vigils]] *[[Guild Bases]] *[[Meteor Isle]]}} ==Overview== Mystics were [[Chrysid]] NPCs that appeared in multiple locations around the map. For {{c|Notes|20}}, they used to prompt you with [[Talents|Talent]] or [[Mantras|Mantra]] categories. Upon picking a prompt, the next time you obtain a Talent or [[Whisper Draw]], you would be guaranteed to get at least 1 Talent or Mantra of that type. This interaction could have been repeated infinite number of times with sufficient number of Notes. Before powering up, the last prompt you choose will overwrite whatever other prompts you chose. Note: Mantras are generated as the cards are flipped, meaning Mystics can be used during a Power up and inbetween card choices to manipulate the cards you obtain on your next hand. == Dialogue == Note that you could have only gotten prompts for Mantra types that you are eligible to obtain, and your Whisper Draw may not be exclusively that Mantra type. * I seek Initiate level Mantras of any kind. (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Mantras of any kind. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Mantras of any kind. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Mantras of any kind. (★★★) * I seek Strength Mantras * I seek Fortitude Mantras * I seek Agility Mantras * I seek Intelligence Mantras * I seek Willpower Mantras * I seek Charisma Mantras * I seek Light Weapon Mantras * I seek Medium Weapon Mantras * I seek Heavy Weapon Mantras * I seek Hybrid Mantras (☆☆☆) -> (★★★) '''(Note; can only give hybrid Attunement mantras)''' * I seek Blood Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Blood Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Blood Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Blood Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Blood Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Fire Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Fire Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Fire Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Fire Mantras . (★★☆) * I seek Master level Fire Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Ice Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Ice Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Ice Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Ice Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Ice Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Wind Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Wind Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Wind Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Wind Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Wind Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Metal Mantras: * I seek Initiate Metal Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Metal Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Metal Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Metal Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Shadow Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Shadow Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Shadow Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Shadow Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Shadow Mantras. (★★★) * I seek Lightning Mantras: * I seek Initiate level Lightning Mantras (☆☆☆) * I seek Adept level Lightning Mantras. (★☆☆) * I seek Expert level Lightning Mantras. (★★☆) * I seek Master level Lightning Mantras. (★★★) ==Locations== * [[Etris]], in the [[Etris#Mantra Shop|mantra shop]] near the weapons shop. * [[Isle of Vigils]], to the right of the guard protecting the entrance of the [[Temple of the Blade]]. * [[Summer Isle]], just outside the docks. * [[Meteor Isle]], on a rock near Ata, the spark NPC and the Smithy. * [[Castle Light]], in the library, at the back. * [[Voidheart]], next to the cauldron near the well and the antiquarian. * [[Greathive Aratel]], in the hall connecting the Library and Root Plaza, just before the stairs. * [[Miner's Landing]], atop a fallen stone pillar behind the docks. * [[Guild Bases]], in the Song Room. '''(Costs {{cl|notes|2000}}.)''' ==Gallery== OGMystic.png|The original Mystic that was exclusive to Etris ==Trivia== *Mystics used to have unique dialogue for most Talent trees in the game, but due to this system overall being quite confusing and requiring a third party website most of the time, these were removed and were replaced with simply the Talent category's name. These can be found on the [[Cut Content#Mystic|Cut Content]] page. *If you lack the {{c|notes|20}} Note fee, the Mystic would state: "No money, friend? How ever will I feed myself?" *When you are at a campfire, hovering over classes in your Talent list in-game shows you the Mystic prompt for it. *Mystics were almost exclusively [[Chrysid]]. Seemingly due to their connection with spirituality and religion, however there is one non-Chrysid mystic, being the one in [[Saramaed Hollow]] who is a [[Vesperian]]. Strangely, this Mystic had the [[Chrysid]] antennae. *The Mystic uses the following outfits made by SirAndrove2: **Roblox clothing: [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6400450739/Nilfgaardian Shirt] / [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6399954985/Nilfgaardian Pants] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

She is a merchant who sells various equipment and weapons labelled as "Naan's Salvaged Stock". She is the grandmother of [[Traan Zakshun]], raising the man and setting him on the path of the merchant. She wears an [[Iron Memento]] around her neck that signifies her ties to the [[Circle of Honour]], though she mainly uses these ties to better haggle with its members. Unlike Traan Zakshun, who has the same stock for everyone, her stocks depends on the player's progression. After defeating a memory boss, such as the {{iv|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard}}, {{iv|Dravik, The Rat King}}, and the {{iv|True Heart of Enmity}}, her stock will be "upgraded". Said stock is the same for all players with similar progression. She's always seen leaning on a [[Pernach]]. ==Location== Naan Zakshun is located in the [[Celtor Wastes]], inside of a ruined building with many signs pointing to her shop. It is overlooked by the nearby Diver Camp. ==Gallery== Naan Zakshun Sign 1.png|Naan Zakshun's signs on the left side Naan Zakshun Sign 2.png|Naan Zakshun's signs on the right side ==Trivia== *As with [[Traan Zakshun|her grandson]], Naan Zakshun's name is a pun/wordplay: her first name sounds similar to "nan", a slang word for one's grandmother, playing on the fact that she is Traan's grandmother. **Despite being written with two of the letter "a", she indicates her name is pronounced as "nan". *Naan's shop dialogues contain references to other media: **''"Life is roadblocks, don't let anything stop you... from getting this insane deal"'' is a reference to a phrase said by DJ Khaled that became a meme. **"''Naan Zakshun has wares if you have coin- I mean... notes... yeah''" is a reference to Khajiits from ''The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim'', travelling merchants who, when interacted with, will say the line "Khajiit has wares if you have coin". **"''I lost my fangs a long time ago...''" is a reference to a panel in the manga ''Chainsaw Man'', where Kishibe holds a note stating "Makima is listening" while saying this line. Given that figures resembling [[The Lord Regent]] can be spotted spying on the player, this further proves that Lord Regent is always watching. **"''You want it? It's yours, my friend! As long as you have enough Notes.''" is a reference to Morshu from ''Link: The Faces of Evil''. *The shop dialogue "''You seen Hotdog anywhere?''" could possibly be referring to Hotdog, the Summer Isle [[Mantra Collector]]. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the First Layer]] [[Category:Vendors]] [[Category:Circle of Honour members]]

title: Naerotiv
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=...The spirit of my brother and the spirit of Kyrsa will stand with you should you invoke their blessings.|author=Naerotiv}}
{{NPCInfobox
|species=Kyrsan
|location=[[Kyrsan Wilds]]
|name=Naerotiv
|family=[[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] <small>(brother)</small>
|image1=Naerotiv.png
|pronouns=He/him<ref>[[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]]</ref>}}

==Description==
Naerotiv is a [[Kyrsan]] [[NPC]].

He is located to the right of the entrance to the [[Second_Layer/New Kyrsa|second floor]] of the [[Second Layer#New_Kyrsa,_The_Sleeping_City_(F2)|Second Layer]]. He has a brother named [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] further into the city, who made and gives the player the [[Kyrswynter]]. Interacting with Naerotiv is needed as a step to obtain the aforementioned [[Kyrswynter]].

Naerotiv tells you how the [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|City of New Kyrsa]] came to be today, about how the [[Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans]] once lived, and where they built a shrine over [[Scion of Ethiron|Ethiron's Scion]] to ensure it remains asleep, which eventually led to the City being developed. He mentions of how they used a ritual, namely the The Ninefold Blessings of Marrow, to ensure the Scion remains asleep. When the Ninth blessing was left incomplete as a result of the Kyrsans attempting to harness the puppet's power.

Once the Scion was awoken, it released a sound, a Tone of Song, which deafened everyone around the City. A sound that turned all of the [[Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans]] nearby into puppets, just like itself.

Naerotiv urges the Pathfinder to set his kind free by completing the ritual and sealing the [[Scion of Ethiron]] away for good. If not, the Gale present in the [[Second Layer]] would seep through and eventually engulf the Surface as well.

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="12" |Aelahi, frinwalter- ah. You are not.. one of us. Why are you here, frinwalter? This is no place for man.
|-
| colspan="12" {{cl|reply}} |I'm an adventurer.
|-
| colspan="12" |So, the bravery of man prevails. But, adventurer, this place is not welcoming. To the likes of myself, and you as well.
|-
| colspan="10" {{cl|reply}} |1. Why's that?
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |2. What happened here?
|-
| colspan="10" |Ethiron's Scion, his puppet, has awoken. Our ritual to lull him to sleep.. ''The Ninefold Blessings of Marrow'', had not succeeded, despite the eras of it doing so. Now, my kind are enthralled to his will.
| colspan="2" |[See first instance]
|-
| colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} |1. A ritual?
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |2. Generations?
|-
| colspan="8" |Indeed. Ethiron's Avatar has laid dormant here for generations, our city built to be not only a shrine to it, but to ensure it remains asleep. The Ninefold Blessings would lull his puppet to sleep for one hundred years, but we grew foolish.
| colspan="2" |[See first instance]
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |1. Generations?
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |2. What happened here?
|-
| colspan="6" |The Scholars say it had always been here. That the Architects built New Kyrsa over its resting place knowing full well what would come of it.. nightjewels drawn to flame. We should've known it was doomed from the start.
| colspan="2" |[See first instance]
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |What happened here?
|-
| colspan="6" |Our last ritual, the Ninth blessing was not finished. Our.. foolishness. Man's bravery is like our own, we couldn't know when to stop. The Scholars sought that we try to harness the puppet for its power... but this only drew Ethiron himself closer.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |The city woke him, then?
|-
| colspan="6" |No, no. It's not that simple. We.. played god, is all. But when one toys with the plaything of something far beyond their own ken... its owner notices. Trying to harness the power of the puppet was like a flare set off in the dark. His Eye turns on us, and now his Avatar wakes.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |What happened once he awoke?
|-
| colspan="6" |It... It began with a sound. Ah, in the ways of the Song... A Tone. And then the Gale came. Gods above, it deafened us all. And when our hearing returned... They're puppets now, just like him. Eternally bound to guard his shrine... and to allow his arrival.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |How did you survive?
|-
| colspan="6" |I am an outsider. I have always lived beyond the city, though it is my home. But close enough to see it. To see it all engulfed, and to feel the weight of leaving my kin behind.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |How can we stop him?
|-
| colspan="6" |Frinwalter, the Ninefold Blessings must be completed. Our last attempt was interrupted by our own hubris, but you must seal him permanently this time. When you enter his Bedchamber.. the bonestaves of the eld, they are needed for the ritual. Upon their pedestals, the path to a future worth living will open.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |...And if we don't?
|-
| colspan="6" |The puppet wakes its master. The dormant Gale will engulf your world and ours. What has happened here is only a glimpse. A glimpse of what will happen if his avatar is not sealed.
|-
| colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |I see..
|-
| colspan="6" |I wish you good luck frinwalter.. Should you succeed in whatever it is that you're doing down here, for the sake of my people, set them free..
|-
| colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |1. Thank you, I'll try.
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |2. Your kin, are they still here?
|-
| colspan="4" |Your support is a beacon of hope in our darkest hour. Invoke the blessings, and my people's souls will be with you.
| colspan="2" |[See first instance]
|-
| colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Your kin, are they still here?
|-
| colspan="4" |My brother? He's somewhere deep in the city, I believe. It pains me to witness what's become of everyone. Such sophistication, now spoiled and purged. It's truly lamentable. Even in our simplest arts, before the thrall, my brother could fashion the finest spears of frost, infinitely more elegant than the conjured weaponry of our contemporaries. The spirit of my brother and the spirit of Kyrsa will stand with you should you invoke their blessings.
|-
| colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} |Spears of frost, huh? Any chance you could fashion me one?
|-
| colspan="4" |Would that I could, frinwalter, I... Was never quite able to find the knack for it, however much I tried. Please accept my sincere apologies that I have failed you so.
|-
| colspan="4" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Trivia==
*He is located right next to where a possible [[Kyrsan Medallions|Medallion]] chest would spawn.
*[[Alpha]] mentions of how [[The Ignition Union]] is trying to use the Gale to harness infinite power as well, same as The Scholars.
**But that idea was the very thing that led to the [[Kyrsgarde|Kyrsan's]] downfall.
*His name, "Naerotiv" is a play on the word "narrative".

== Description == Your Name is one of the many ways to choose how you appear in-game to yourself and others. * A Randomized name will be assigned to you at the beginning of character creation, though this may be changed at any time during the process or later at a [[Barber]] for 100 notes. * Your name consists of a first name and last name. Some characters may obtain a "Title" after their name, which is indicated with a comma after the name, although these are exclusive to community events and the moderation team. * First names may be chosen from 3 pools of Masculine, Feminine and Neutral choices. * Last names are exclusive to each [[Aspects|Aspect]]. == Flairs == Flairs are cosmetic name colours obtained by surpassing the most difficult challenges in-game, including PvP and PvE accomplishments. They will change the colour of your name on the character list (Top-Right corner in-game) depending on which flair(s) you have obtained.
