title: Outpost Antumbra
content:
{{Location|name=Outpost Antumbra|territory=The Ministry|caption=A mysterious base of operations for the Ministry, lurking within the snowscape.}}
[[File:Outpost Antumbra.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Overview ==
Outpost Antumbra can be found by taking a small route on the right side of [[Minityrsa]]. Contains the entrance to [[Trial of One]] in the basement along with a Ministry Field Report. 

== Description ==
Outpost Antumbra is the small outpost for The Ministry, it has a good amount of Scouts around here, and five chests, four near the Trial of One and the other around the left top. This base was referred to as a "Nest" by [[Elykris]].

== Quests ==

* There is a quest for 3 Aces and a hand of Talents. You must find [[Elykris]]. He tells you to get a book of Ministry records found inside Outpost Antumbra. Once you return the book to him, you get the rewards.

== The 'Purple Lights' ==
There is an event in this location known as the "Purple Lights" event. A purple light appears over a dark sigil inside the outpost, easily found by the light of course.

Using Shadow Travel (A rare talent requiring 75 [[Shadowcast]] and the talent Dark God) or [[Shadow's Flight]] on the sigil will cause you to be teleported to [[The Understrand]], where you will have to duel a [[Ministry Agent]], [[Black Diver (NPC)|Black Diver]] or [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] depending on your reputation. 

Successfully defeating the enemy within 5 minutes can reward you with the [[Deepspindle]], [[Deepscorn Casque]], the [[Darkened Bastion]] schematic, and relics such as Void/Rain spires or different needles.

==Maps==
A map can be found at [[Maps#Surface]]
== Trivia ==

* This area didn't have a name before the Verse 2 update, rather it just remained as an unnamed sanctuary for [[Ministry Scout]]s.
*Eight chests can be found near the entrance to [[Trial of One]].
* The word 'Antumbra' means "before the shadow", which is quite interesting, considering the fact this used to be a base inside Minityrsa before the Ministry seized the island, implies the said term.

The {{PAGENAME}} is a katana [[weapon]] in the [[Medium Weapons]] category. These are used by [[the Lord Regent]]'s [[Threadcutter]]s. Its damage is increased by 5% when wearing the [[Vigil Initiate]], [[Cloak of Winds]], or [[Royal Etrean Guard]] [[outfits]], due to their innate Talent: ''{{t|Paired Soul}}''.

When paired with the [[Poser's Ring]], the damage of its M1s and critical attacks will be suspended until it is sheathed, at which point all of that damage is inflicted at once. This damage cannot exceed 70% of a player's maximum health. See [[Stored Damage Mechanic]] for more info.

==Description==
The '''Pale Briar''' is a Greataxe that is obtained by beating [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] with a Heavy Weapon. It is one of the 3 drops that is guaranteed from Maestro if you fight him with a specific weapon type(Guaranteed the first time, becomes a low drop rate in any later attempts), with the others being the [[Purple Cloud]](MED) and the [[Cerulean Thread]](LHT).

==Critical==
[[File:Pale briar crit yippie.gif|center|frameless|356x356px|pale briar crit]]



The user chants their weapon, summoning a shower of light that rapidly damages opponents and grows in size over time, totalling up to six times. The damage will gradually decrease per tick. The critical is sent towards the location of the user's cursor, but will always track to the nearest target. 

The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds''' and deals around '''2.3x''' scaled damage if all ticks hit.

title: Paralytic Dust
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure sensory particles that drop targets into instant, paralytic slumber.|author=Paralytic Dust}}
{{Resonance
|title1=Paralytic Dust
|effect=On hit, Ragdolls target for 5 seconds and applies daze for ~10 seconds
|appearance=Throws a small cloud of dust from the users off-hand.
|image1=<gallery>
File:Paralytic Dust Demo.gif|Paralytic Dust
File:paralyticdustcard.png|Card
</gallery>
}}

== Description ==
Paralytic Dust is a [[Resonance]] that players can obtain and is common to roll.

== Usage ==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Paralytic Dust''' Resonance, throwing out a dust cloud that applies the {{status|Sleeping}} and {{status|Dazed|Daze}} status effects to anyone hit.

{{Status|Sleeping}} grants 90% damage reduction and immunity to True Damage when applied through this Resonance, {{status|Ragdoll|ragdolls}}, and completely prevents all inputs for a short duration, but is removed upon taking damage.

The sleeping status effect in the [[First Layer]] grants full damage immunity. It however, will still be removed by taking any instance damage.

{{cl|corres|If Paralytic Dust is Corrupted, it will apply {{status|b=y|Blinded|blindness}} for 5 seconds.}}

==== <u>'''''Variants'''''</u> ====

*'''Throw Variant''': Throw dust in front of you, applying the Sleeping and Daze status effects to players hit by this Resonance for '''10 seconds'''.

*'''Self Cast Variant''': Create a cloud of dust around you that affects everyone in a wide area. This dust applies the Sleeping and Dazed status effect for '''5 seconds''' to everyone caught in the range, including yourself. Additionally, this will heal for 5% of your maximum health over the duration of the Sleeping effect.

==Notes==
*The Sleeping status effect cannot be applied to players with {{t|Brick Wall}} (including yourself, removing the healing from the Self Cast variant).
*Using this on a player who is currently using {{t|Cap Artist}} will force them to get up, allowing them to move while under the effects of Paralytic Dust. This is referred to as 'sleep walking'.
*Because Wither damage is based on scaled damage (or is flat), applying Wither can effectively bypass the 90% damage reduction. This makes the [[Umbrite Witherblade]] critical especially deadly against Sleeping targets.
*The healing from the self-cast variant is affected by [[Anti-Heal]], but cannot be stolen by the {{t|Saint Jay}} or {{t|All Above, Gods Below}} Talents.

== Trivia ==
*'Sleep walking' works because the game uses the same 'sleep' state for Paralytic Dust and Cap Artist; if sleep is reapplied while you're in the sleep state, the state flips back to neutral, allowing you to move again.
*Uniquely, Paralytic Dust's visual effects can be dyed with [[Dye Packet]]s by dying your Resonance color.

|droppable=No

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a [[Gaunt Man]]-exclusive summoning [[enchantment]] that spawns an allied [[Monsters|Monster]] upon killing a player.

==Effect==
When hitting a player with a weapon attack, {{PAGENAME}} applies the {{status|Parasol's Blight}} status effect for 60 seconds. Landing subsequent attacks on affected targets will refresh the debuff duration. If an affected player dies, an allied [[Monsters|Monster]] will spawn over their corpse.

PvE enemies you kill have a small chance of proccing Parasol's Blight and summoning allied monsters.

Parasol's Blight can summon any of the following Monsters: [[Alpha Megalodaunt]], [[Mudskipper Broodlord]], [[Nautilodaunt]], [[Prime Megalodaunt]], or [[Void Thresher]]. These monsters can spawn {{cl|corrupted}} if this enchantment is used in [[The Depths]].

===Notes===
*The summons count as Allies for all effects.
*The summons can be buffed by equipping the [[Cryptwaker's Ring]], saying to increase the health of your monsters but it only gives them 5% resistance, and granting you a small chance to spawn [[Bone Keeper]]s instead.
*The monsters summoned will not attack you, even if you attack them first.
*There is no cooldown on the monsters spawning. You can proc this effect multiple times at once.
*The PvE targets can be allied or player summons, though the proc chance is still very low in PvE. Additionally, you can proc this enchantment on a PvE target while in a PvP combat tag.
**Notably, summons from [[Lightning Clones]], {{t|You'll Need to Get Past Me}}, [[The Weaving Web]]'s critical attack, and ironically [[Parasol's Blight]] can be hit by the caster.
*The enemies do not need to be killed through manually and pve enemies are exempt from needing to be hit with a basic attack in order to summon a monster as even [[Combat Mechanics|venting]] or using [[mantras]] to kill [[Thundercall|lightning clones]] can summon a monster.
*You cannot apply the Parasol's Blight status effect to already Unconscious opponents.
*The monsters summoned count as 'summons' for the [[Familiar Occultist's Armor]], healing you when they deal damage.
*[[Bone Keeper|Bonekeepers]] summoned from parasols blight are passive to other [[monsters]] summoned but if they accidentally hit each other they will become aggressive to each other.

Parsnip was a [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They worked for the [[Ignition Union]].

Parsnip was located inside of a small house near the water wheel at [[Miner's Landing]].

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="1" |This day seems to.. Not have any signs of improving! How quaint! Peculiar, even! Perhaps even... No, peculiar was enough, actually.

| colspan="1" |Oh, you know. The weather. Things and such. What the ''HELL'' do you think I'm talking about?! Do you not hear that ruckus in the upper level?

|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Systems? What do you mean?

| colspan="1" |Look, look. You're asking for some business secrets, buddy. I can't tell 'ya much. Just... If you do go up there, if theres {{sic|expected=there's}} something you see that looks, er.. ''familiar'' .. It was a work in progress of ours. Those ''goons'' are just sabotaging our operations and research, that's all. Its current hostility is simply because of their presence...

|}

title: Pathfinder
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} ::''This page is for the Pathfinder gamemode. For the "Pathfinder" term, see the [[Glossary#Pathfinders|"Pathfinders" Glossary entry]] and [[Lore#The Pathfinders|The Pathfinders]]. For the Pathfinder NPC, see [[Pathfinder (NPC)]].'' {{Quotes|quote=Follow your own path.
The ink is not yet dry. Your fate is what you make it.|author=Path description}} [[File:PathfinderIcon.png|center|150px]] ==Description== Pathfinder is one of two Paths (gamemodes) available in ''Deepwoken'', the other being [[Vow of Iron]]. In Pathfinder, the player plays as the eponymous Pathfinder, in their journey throughout the world of ''Deepwoken''. They discover what remains of a broken world torn by war, politics, gods and other beings. ===In-game Description=== ''Talents and Mantras are obtained through increasing your Power.'' ''Shrines enable you to freely exchange your abilities.'' ''Guild Bases can be built, providing many utilities.'' ''Earn Echoes and upgrade subsequent playthroughs.'' ==Differences from Vow of Iron== Pathfinder is the intended main gamemode of ''Deepwoken''. Progress your character by [[Training Gear|training]] your [[attributes]], acquire [[Talents]] and [[Mantras]] as you [[Power|Power up]], gear up, explore [[Lumen]] and [[The Depths]], encounter friend and foe alike and try to make a name for yourself. While Pathfinder has no defined goal or ending per se, [[Echoes]] can be considered your main goal, providing upgrades that persist beyond death and across [[Character Slots|character slots]]. Purchasing an {{c|robux|Aspect Reroll}} on either gamemode will give you an '''Aspect Reroll Token''' for the opposite gamemode. This allows you to reroll your Aspect for free. Reroll Tokens are account wide and can be cashed in on any slot. Reroll Token.png|Reroll Token Reroll Token2.png|Token Confirmation [[Category:Game Modes]] [[Category:Paths]] [[Category:Character]]

title: Pathfinder's Respite
content:
{{CutContent}}{{Location|name=Pathfinder's Respite|caption=A peaceful grotto to escape the horrors of a cursed land lost to time.}}
[[File:Pathfinder’s Respite.jpeg|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Pathfinder's Respite''' was a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a landmark in [[Lower Erisia]] found in the [[The Etrean Sea|Etrean Sea]].

== Overview ==
Pathfinder's Respite is a small den with a spot of flowers in the middle. Resting on one of the sides is an NPC named [[Alastir]]. Completing his dialogue will give you access to bringing him hostages and a [[Gliders|Glider]] schematic. [[Ivory]], the [[Talents#Air Dash|Aerial Assault]] questgiver used to reside here, as the ability is now innate.

==Potential Enemies==

}}

==Missions==
Events that spawn in Pathfinder's Respite that involve combat. For more info, see [[Random Encounters]].

*[[Etrea]] vs. [[The Central Authority]]
*[[The Hundred Legions]] vs. [[The Central Authority]]

==Maps==
A map can be found at [[Maps#Surface]]

==Trivia==
*There will be wooden planks blocking the entrance. Only some mantras can break it (Strong Left, Fire Blade, Lightning Beam, Shoulder Bash, etc)
*[[Ivory]], the [[Talents#Air Dash|Aerial Assault]] questgiver used to reside here, and was removed upon the talent being innate.
*Despite being in Lower Erisia, [[Upper Erisia]] events can still spawn here.
*[[Artifacts]] spawn can also spawn here.
*[[The Meat Lord]] can spawn here.

title: Payback
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Pay back your enemies for the damage they deal to you.|author=Payback description}}
{{Resonance
|effect=Reflects damage to opponents.
|appearance=Green circle that appears around user.
|cooldown=22.5 Seconds + Duration
|image1 =<gallery>
Payback.gif|Payback
Payback card.png|Card
File:Payback Corrupt Card.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
=='''Description'''==
'''Payback,''' also known as Counter or Full Counter, is a [[Resonance]] or "Bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

===Appearance when Used===
When used, a green circle appears around the user and shrinks until the Resonance finishes.

==How to Use==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Payback''' Resonance.

'''Payback''' reflects all damage inflicted within the Resonance's timeframe to the user's opponents.

{{cl|corres|If Payback is corrupted, it gains lifesteal from the reflected damage, equal to 50% of damage dealt, with a cap of 50 health per use.}} Do note that this cap is '''per use''' and thus, hitting multiple targets will not let you heal more.

* Posture reflected will be based on how much damage was taken, with low damage dealing low posture while high damage deals high posture.
* 80% of damage will be completely absorbed when the Payback is charging. True Damage (ex: [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] critical) can bypass this, but will still have the damage reflected back.

====<u>''Variants''</u>====
'''Payback''' has four different variants.
#'''Instant'''; Instantly reflects any damage and [[Status Effects]] taken within ~2.5 seconds to the user's opponents.
#*This can grant conditional effects from Talents that the user does not have, such as granting them the {{t|Emperor Flame}} effect. This also has some weird oddities, like reflecting the {{status|b=y|Unconscious}} status effect, instantly knocking the person hit Unconscious, if you counter a hit that would've done the same to you.
#'''Sniper'''; Multiplies and reflects all damage taken within ~1.25 seconds, firing a beam in front of the user to deal the damage. This deals all of the damage instantly.
#'''Delayed'''; Multiplies and reflects all damage taken within ~1.5 seconds, firing a beam in front of the user to deal the damage. This deals the damage at the end of the Resonance's duration. This also reflects [[Status Effects]], like the Instant version.
#'''Continuous'''; Multiplies and reflects all damage taken within ~1.5 seconds, firing a beam in front of the user to deal the damage. This beam hits multiple times, with the damage being spread out between all hits.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
Hit reflection.png|Counter variant
NewPaybackBeam.png|Beam variant
</gallery>
==Trivia==

*Payback (excluding instant variant) can be either blocked, parried or dodged.
*The damage type of Payback is dependant on the damage type(s) of the attack(s) you countered. This also allows your Payback to proc damage type-specific conditional effects through countering an attack with said damage type.
**For example, if you are {{status|Burn|on fire}}, and you counter an attack that deals {{stats|phys|Physical damage}}, your Payback can proc {{t|Immolation}}, applying {{status|Burn}} to your opponent as well.
*Similar to other resonance's this one can be cancelled if the user is hit during their initial bell windup.
*Version 1 of the spell was named after and functions very similarly to the ability that Meliodas has in the anime "''Seven Deadly Sins''".
*This resonance was formerly known as "Full Counter".
*The best way to counter beam variant payback resonance is by using the instant/delayed variant payback. This usually will reflect the multiplied damage on top of multiplying it, the strategy can be used against jar of souls resonance if possible.
*Payback beam variant can be used for damage redirection which differs it from other 2 variations due to the other variants being limited to reflect damage to those who attack the user whilst the beam variant can redirect damage to multiple targets if given the amount of enemies to can hit.
*Executing someone while Payback is on allows you to confirm it, as you can't be interrupted even if you get hit.

Peipre wears the [[Inquisition Light]] Outfit and wields the [[Big Brother]] on their back, signifying their allegiance to [[The Inquisition]]. ==Location== Peipre is located near the [[Shipwright]], looking out to the sea near some scaffolding at [[Port Merit]]. File:Peipre location.png ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |Hey there, I can see you creeping up next to me in my peripheral. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Ah, Sorry for intruding. | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Hi? |- | colspan="1" |It's fine, I'm not doing anything of particular note- yknow {{sic|expected=y'know}} nothing under lock and key. | colspan="1" |... Err-wow I've lost my train of thought. Thanks for interrupting. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What are you out here for? | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What are you out here for? |- | colspan="1" |Just some personal research to be honest, a similar albeit not the same phenomenon to when Erisia washed it's way into the {{g|The Eastern Luminant|Eastern Luminant}} is going on nearby. | colspan="1" |[See first instance] |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |And that means? |- | colspan="1" |It's possible that there's some driftland- well... drifting by. I'm observing the ripples and waves in the sea to try and chart a course there, obviously not for me though. I'm not quite mad enough to venture into the Void over a hunch. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |That's fair honestly. |- | colspan="1" |Damn right it is! Do you have any idea how many folks we in the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} lose to void related incidents?- It's ridiculous! Though, you're more than welcome to try haha. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Hah, maybe. |- | colspan="1" |Hey if you can come back in one piece, come back and tell me what you saw!- Not that you necessarily have to, again I'm just genuinely curious. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Unlockable Dialogue= This dialogue is unlocked after the player has defeated [[Knell, The Lunatic Resonator]]. {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="1" |Hey stranger, you end up heading out there? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Yeah, that place sucks. |- | colspan="1" |I'd assume so, most old driftlands are pretty dim, What'd you end up seeing? |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |There was this messed up spider guy and messed up spider bugs and they all tried to kill me it was horrible. |- | colspan="1" |...? Wow, alright. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |It's not worth it, man. |- | colspan="1" |Yeah I'll take your word for it, I'll let the troops know not to bother with it. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} ==Gallery== File:Peipre back.png|Back File:Peipre sneakpeak.png|Peipre Teaser ==Trivia== *Peipre seems to be a different [[Capra]] variant to the available options. *Peipre has a unique telescope. **Peipre actually has green eyes, but the eye magnified through the telescope is blue. **Peipre, like all NPCs, will turn to whoever is talking to them. This causes his eye to no longer be aligned with the telescope, though doesn't cause the magnified image of his eye to disappear. *Peipre's name is a play on the word "peeping," specifically describing someone as a "peeper" referring to someone who secretly watches.[[File:Peipre Name Dev Statement.png]] **Given their allegiance to The Central Authority's Inquisition, Peipre's name may also derive from {{W|Joachim Peiper}}, an infamous member of the ''{{W|Waffen-SS}}''. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]] [[Category:Military personnel of The Central Authority]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]

==Description==
'''Petra's Anchor''' is an endgame Greathammer that can be obtained from the [[Dread Serpent]] or merchant ships, albeit at a rather high price. This weapon has a base damage of 26 with a swing speed of 0.8x, and requires 75 HVY and 10 STR to equip.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Initial Hit (Critical).gif|Critical
File:Petra’s Anchor Crit GIF (Slam).gif|Critical + Follow up
</gallery>The user briefly winds up before lunging forward, briefly {{status|Ragdoll|ragdolling}} the target when hit. If landed, the user can follow up using an {{keybind|keybind|M1}} to initiate an overhead strike that ragdolls and sends the target flying. The rush has a '''scaled damage multiplier''' of '''1x''', and the follow up has a '''scaled multiplier of 1.2x,''' meaning the two are actually not far apart in damage.

The critical has a cooldown of '''9 seconds'''.

==Description==
Petris is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is an adventurer who is looking to summon [[The Ferryman]].

==Location==
Petris is located at the front of [[Boatman's Watch]].
{{clear}}
==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" |''*The Etrean adventurer seems distracted.*'' Heheheh... The flames will call the Ferryman... I'll be rich!
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |What are you talking about?
|-
| colspan="2" |''*Your intrusion startles him.*'' Ack!.. Has nobody ever told you not to sneak up on people like that? I could have easily mistaken you for an enemy... And, mind your business, eh? I was talking to myself.
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |I'm curious though, what was that about some 'Ferryman'?
|-
| colspan="2" |Tsch... Damn! Fine, I guess I'll explain, since you already overheard me. There's this old folk story about this powerful mythical figure called the Ferryman. Most people say it's just a fairytale, but I think it's true! They say if you light the fires on the isle of Boatman's Watch in the {{g|The Voidsea|Voidsea}}, he will appear before you, bearing gifts - '''expensive''' gifts! I'll be rich, you hear me? Rich! No more toil for ol' Petris!.. Though, I've been lighting fires all day, and - no luck...
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |...Doesn't the poem have a verse that also says 'Dance, puppet, dance! Dance, if you can!'?
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Well... Best of luck to you, then.
|-
| colspan="1" |''*Petris' expression grows pale with horror for a moment.*'' Wh... What? H-hah, that's... No, the story says-- ''*He stops himself before squinting at you suspiciously.*'' ...Ah. I see what you're doing here, stranger. You're trying to dissuade me from his treasures. Nice try, chump! I'll get those gifts of his on way or another, you'll see - and I'm '''NOT''' sharing!
| colspan="1" |*''Petris scoffs.''* Luck? Hah! Why would I need luck? Calling forth the Ferryman will be all the luck I need - once I get his gifts, I'll be rich enough to retire early! And don't you even ''think'' of getting in my way, stranger.
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Description==
The Phantomcleave was a [[Vow of Iron]] exclusive Medium Weapon. Uniquely, the Phantomcleave's M1 attacks bypass block, dealing full damage and applying shaky block on hit. This also allows this weapon to proc Talents and enchantment effects on blocking targets.

When paired with the [[Poser's Ring]], the damage of its M1s and critical attacks will be suspended until it was sheathed, at which point all of that damage was inflicted at once. This damage cannot exceed 70% of a player's maximum health. 

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Katana Angled Crit.gif
</gallery>The user sheathes their katana before dashing forward and slashing horizontally. This critical deals '''1.1x scaled damage''' and procs {{cl|Bleed}}. This critical is shared with the [[Shattered Katana]] when one handed.

{{text|m1tag}}

Phantomcleave VFX.gif|Visual effect

</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This weapon is very likely a reference to the [https://darksouls3.wiki.fextralife.com/Darkdrift Darkdrift] from ''Dark Souls 3'', with both weapons being a nearly transparent-bladed Katana with a unique trait (or Weapon Art in Darkdrift's case) that bypass block.

content:
{{ToolInfobox|image1=Pickaxe.png|caption1=Mining away...|usage=*Used to mine ores.|recipe=*Iron x2 + Wood x2}}
The '''pickaxe''' is a utility item that allows players to mine [[ore]] deposits by pressing {{Input|keybind|interact}} on them.

== Obtainment ==
The pickaxe can be obtained in two ways:
* [[Crafting Station|Crafted]] using two (2) [[Iron]] and [[Wood]].
* Bought for free, for {{c|notes|3}} or for {{c|notes|5}} depending on the vendor.

== Locations ==
<tabber>
|-|Etrean Luminant= 
{{#tag:tabber|Etris=
The pickaxe in [[Etris]] is located on a table in the General Store.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_etris.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

{{!}}-{{!}}
Isle of Vigils=
The pickaxe on the [[Isle of Vigils]] can be found leaning against three crates outside the inn.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_vigils.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

{{!}}-{{!}}
Lower Erisia=
The pickaxe at [[Lower Erisia]] is located on a table near the well in the Bandit Camp.
* Cost is '''free'''.
[[File:pickaxe_erisia.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

{{!}}-{{!}}
Voidheart=
The pickaxe in the [[Voidheart]] is located on a table next to the [[Antiquarian]].
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
* The Voidheart can be accessed from both the Etrean and Eastern Luminants by [[Voidwalker]]s.
[[File:pickaxe_voidheart.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

}}
|-|Eastern Luminant=
{{#tag:tabber|Summer Isle=
The pickaxe on [[Summer Isle]] is located on a cart outside the docks.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_summer.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

{{!}}-{{!}}
Miner's Landing=
The pickaxe at [[Miner's Landing]] can be found on a crate inside the pub.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_miners.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]


{{!}}-{{!}}
Meteor Isle=
The pickaxe on [[Meteor Isle]] can be found leaning against two crates behind Ata.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_meteor.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

{{!}}-{{!}}
Greathive Aratel=
The pickaxe at [[Greathive Aratel]] is located on a table next to the Blacksmith.
* Costs {{c|notes|3}}.
[[File:pickaxe_greathive.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

}}
|-|First Layer=
{{#tag:tabber|City of the Drowned=
The pickaxe in the [[First Layer]] is located on a table in the [[Nautilodaunt]]'s marketplace.
* Costs {{c|notes|5}}.
[[File:pickaxe_depths.png|border|frameless|421x227px]] 
{{!}}-{{!}}
Castle Light=
This pickaxe in the [[First Layer]] is located on a barrel in the front of the castle.
* Costs {{c|notes|5}}.
[[File:Castle Light Pickaxe.png|border|frameless|421x227px]]

}}
</tabber>

== Trivia ==

* The easiest way to obtain a pickaxe is to buy it for free from the Bandit Camp at Lower Erisia (see above).
* The pickaxe has the exact same recipe as the [[Lumber Axe]].
* The recipe for the pickaxe will not appear in your recipe list unless you have crafted one.
* It takes roughly 3 seconds to mine an ore, and roughly 1.5 seconds with the {{t|Excavator}} Talent.
** To get the Excavator Talent you must turn in any 5 pure ores to a [[Blacksmith]], excluding Pure Iron or Pure Gold.

title: Pistols
content:
==Description== Pistols are a ranged [[Light Weapons|Light Weapon]] class designed to shoot projectiles. They can be used in three different ways, with each having unique Talents and mechanics; #'''Singular''', which involves only using a singular pistol in your main hand. This introduces a ''reload'' mechanic. #'''Offhanded''', which involves equipping an Offhanded Pistol alongside any other weapon. #*'''Dual Guns''', which involves equipping an Offhand Pistol alongside a main hand one. With this type, you cycle your shots between each Pistol. These weapons are typically locked to the One Handed stance. ==Singular Pistol== Singular Guns, or having a main-hand Pistol with no offhand one, can fire ranged projectiles, provided the user has [[Bullets]] and has a loaded pistol. Reload with {{input|keybind|Z / Y}}, loading the chamber with bullets. While loaded, your Pistol will perform 'blast' shots rather than the default pistol whip attacks, and your critical can be used. Additionally, your pistol will gain a 15% damage modifier and 10% Chip damage when loaded. The amount of bullets you can load into a pistol is dependent on which weapon you have equipped. The [[Dragoon]], [[Flintlock]], and [[Dawnshot]] can hold 4 bullets, and the [[Repeater]], [[Iron Requiem]], and [[Silversix]] can hold 6 bullets. Reloading has a sound cue and slows the player greatly, leaving them vulnerable in combat. It takes 0.5 seconds to load each bullet (0.4 If the player has the {{t|Rapid Reload}} Talent an empty gun, and 0.25 if the {{t|Ultrakill}} Talent is active). You can end your reload early by pressing {{input|keybind|feint}}. Having a [[Shields|Shield]] or [[Parrying Daggers|Parrying Dagger]] equipped will reduce your reload speed by 20%. Note: You do not need to have [[Bullets]] in your inventory to load your Pistol, but you do need them in order to fire ranged projectiles on your basic attacks. ==Offhanded Pistol== Pistols can also be used in your offhand slot to complement your main hand weapon. Offhand shots do not innately fire projectiles. When equipped in your offhand, your Pistol will mirror certain stats from your main hand weapon. If your main weapon is '''not''' a Pistol, Offhand shots are performed with {{input|input=M2}} and have a 5 second cooldown. Additionally, your Offhand Pistol's base damage will be decreased by 20%, and the '''Scaling''' and '''Swing Speed''' stats will be copied from your main weapon to your Offhanded Pistol. For example, an Offhanded [[Silversix]] with a main hand [[Kanabo]] will have a base damage of 8, 3 Strength and 6 Heavy Weapons scaling, and 0.8x Swing Speed. If your main weapon '''is''' a Pistol, every other basic attack will perform an Offhand shot. This is commonly referred to as "Dual Guns". Additionally, you will gain a 10% Swing Speed increase, and '''all''' stats '''excluding Chip Damage''' will be copied from your main Pistol to your Offhand. For example, if you have a [[Silversix]] Offhand with a [[Rosen's Roscoe]] main hand, your Silversix will gain increased Base Damage, Range, Swing Speed, and Posture Damage, and the Scaling will be decreased to match the Rosen's Roscoe's stats, but the Chip Damage stat will remain the same (at 0%) rather than being increased to 20%. The [[Iron Requiem]] cannot be Offhanded. ==Miscellaneous Mechanics== *[[Bullets]] grant Pistol blast shots +10% PEN. *[[Bullet Casings]] can be used to entirely modify the effects you apply on blast shots, though usually at the cost of a decrease in weapon damage. For more information on Pistol mechanics, view [[Guns]]. ==Default Animations==
The {{PAGENAME}} weapon class comes with a set of default weapon animations.

title: Pleeksty's Inferno
content:
{{Weapon Infobox |type=Club |requirements=40 MED, 80 FIR |damage=22 |damage type=Slash |scaling=MED: 3, FIR: 4 |posture damage=7.5 |range=8 |range type=Sweep |swing speed=0.94x |attack duration=0.7s |chip damage=10% |penetration=10% |obtainment=[[Aska]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *[[Saramaed Summit (Vow of Iron)|Saramaed Summit]] |selling price=100 |m.equip=No |rarity=Mythical |description=In the [[Tiran]] homelands, weapons are often fashioned using knapped volcanic glass like obsidian. Though brittle, the prismatic blades embedded in the sides are sharper than any blade of metalwork. Following the ascent of [[Amorus Pleeksty]] and his Pioneering of [[Flamecharm]], many Tirans worked floral patterns into their Macuahuitls in reverence of the Deepwoken. Of these Macuahuitls, this particular specimen was a gift to Pleeksty himself, imbued with the eruptive and scorching heat of magma, and fit only to be wielded by those who truly walk in his footsteps. |image= Pleeksty's Inferno.png|Standard AzurePleekstyInferno.png|Azure Flames (Twisted) One-Handed Pleeksty's Inferno.png|Wraith Path |bankable=No |oath=Silentheart |droppable=No |enchantable=No}} ==Description== The '''Pleeksty's Inferno''' is a legendary Club; a knapped obsidian macuahuitl created using magma, with the deceptively sharp, obsidian blades on the edges as well as the floral patterns on the flat sides glowing with it. It is not able to be banked, [[Hippocampal Pool|passed down]], or dropped, being permanently bound to the character you fought [[Aska]] with. This weapon comes with the following passive: * '''Simmerbloom Synergy''' - Pleeksty's Inferno will apply burn on hit if you are wearing the [[Simmerbloom Diadem]]. ==Obtainment== {{collapse|uncollapse}} In [[Pathfinder]], the Pleeksty's Inferno can be obtained from the [[Second Layer]] of [[The Depths]]: #Have '''75''' Flamecharm and enter the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|Second Layer]] without a Light Hook. #Fulfill one of the following criteria. Keep in mind you only need '''one''' of these three criterias to get confirmation to fight [[Aska]]. For example, having Pleetsky's Will allows fighting Aska despite not having Flame Worshipper Armor equipped or Pleeksty's Faith. #*Wearing the [[Flame Worshipper Armor]]. #*Having the [[Talent Quests|Pleeksty's Will]] Talent. #*Having the {{t|Pleeksty's Faith}} Talent. #Head to [[Firfire]] and approach the [[Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus|head of the village]]. To the right of him will be an opening in the wall. #When you go through the opening, you'll see a path going to the left. Do not follow the path. Instead, go forward and jump down to the ledge beneath. #When you jump down, walk forward following the path. (Be careful, don't fall down, there's a hole in the middle of the path) Eventually, you'll reach three Orange Resonance Doors that require a [[Resonance]], and 75 Flamecharm to open. #Fight [[Aska]] and defeat him. If you do not meet the requirements, you will be killed immediately through burning and wipe. Note that if you meet all the requirements but dont have a Resonance, he wont wipe you. Alternatively, if you meet all requirements and have the Destined [[Echoes|Echo]] Modifier, Aska will still attempt to burn you to death, but you will survive and obtain the weapon without needing to fight him. In Vow of Iron, the Pleeksty's Inferno can be found stuck in a rock at Saramaed Summit; recommended to grab it if you're using the [[Flame Worshipper]] Memento, since the Memento's final attributes are min-maxed to be perfect with the weapon. ==Critical== File:Pleeksty's Inferno Normal Crit.gif|Standing Critical File:Pleeksty's Inferno Running Crit.gif|Running Critical The Pleeksty's Inferno has two different critical attacks. For the '''standing''' critical, the user plunges the macuahuitl into the ground, creating three small eruptions and performing an upward slash afterwards, knocking the target away with ragdoll. Each hit applies Burn. The plunge has three consecutive hits, each dealing '''0.4x scaled damage''', followed by a '''guardbreaking''' upward slash dealing '''1.4x scaled damage'''. {{text|slowturn}} For the '''running''' critical, the user reels the macuahuitl back before unleashing a diagonal slash, creating a projectile of flame that ragdolls and burns the target. The projectile is directional and will fly in the direction of your characters momentum. The projectile deals '''1.5x scaled damage'''. Both criticals will instantly max out your {{t|Emperor Flame}} stacks after the critical hits (unless it's on its 20 second cooldown), even if you do not have the Talent. Both criticals have an initial windup of '''0.45 seconds''' and a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. ==Gallery == File:Pleekstys Inferno New M1 (1 handed).gif|M1 Cycle File:PleesInferno.png|alt= File:Azure Flames Pleeksty's Inferno.png|Azure Flames File:Twisted Puppets Pleeksty's Inferno.png|Twisted Puppets File:(Twisted) Pleeksty's Inferno Block.png File:(Twisted) Pleeksty's Inferno Backshot.png File:IInferno's location.png|General Location in [[Vow of Iron]] Pleeksty's Inferno Location on map VOI.png|Map location of Pleeksty's Inferno in [[Vow of Iron]] ==Trivia== *Elaborated in the description, a [[wp:Macuahuitl|macuahuitl]] is from the Aztec culture. **In real life, macuahuitls are embedded with sharp obsidian blades, providing a sharper edge than normal swords, which is also mentioned in the description. *The player does not need to defeat [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]] to keep Pleeksty's Inferno, as it can be equipped immediately. In the case that the player wipes purposefully or accidentally before exiting [[Second Layer]], the weapon cannot be dropped on death. **If [[Aska]] falls off the map, you may defeat Chaser and be awarded with the weapon upon Chaser's death instead of Aska's. *A [[Tiran Pendant]] is wrapped around the weapon. *The embers that form off the weapon are shaped like musical notes. **These characteristics are seen in the [[Deepspindle]] and the [[Wraithclaw]], which emit musical note particles.

==Description==
The '''Pluripotent Alloy''' is a utility item in Deepwoken that can be used to transform certain early and midgame weapons into (usually) endgame-viable variants.

==Obtainment==
Pluripotent Alloys can primarily be obtained from most [[Bosses]]. Killing the first boss on any character is guaranteed to reward a Pluripotent Alloy. Afterwards, bosses have a 25% chance of dropping it. There is a pity system, where not obtaining a Pluripotent Alloy after 3 boss kill guarantees a drop on the 4th kill.

Pluripotent Alloys can also be found in chests in the [[Saramaed Hollow]].

==Usage==
===Alloying a Weapon===
Using a Pluripotent Alloy while wielding an Alloyable weapon will consume the Alloy to transform the weapon into an endgame variant of itself with higher stats and requirements. To perform this, you must be at least [[Power]] 10 and you need to meet the weapon requirement of the respective weapon's alloyed variant, which is usually 75 investment. Alloyed weapons will retain the enchant and the quality stars of the original weapon.

The list of alloyable weapons can be found [[:Category:Alloyed Weapons|here]].

===Hollow Forge===
If you are using the [[Ignition Delver]] Origin, you can speak to the [[Hollow Forge]] at [[Miner's Landing]] or the [[Chariot's Spire]] to transfer Pluripotent Alloys into other [[Relics]].
*'''3''' Pluripotent Alloys -> '''1''' [[Smith's Alloy]]
*'''9''' Pluripotent Alloys -> '''1''' [[Armorer's Needle]]

===Ironsing===
When obtaining [[Ironsing]] for the first time on your Roblox account, you will need to speak to [[Rudral]] while having a Pluripotent Alloy in your inventory. Doing this will unlock dialogue with [[Adar]], allowing you to obtain this Attunement. This will not consume your Pluripotent Alloy.

If you have obtained this Attunement previously, this part can be skipped, as the [[Adar]] dialogue will be unlocked automatically.

==Trivia==
*The alloy itself cannot be dropped or lost on death, but the weapons can.
*The texture applied to weapons upon alloying them resembles [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Damascus_steel damascus steel], a legendary type of steel known for its strength.

NPC Map Polis.png ==Dialogue== |-|Other Origins= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="8" style="color:#32CD32;" {{!}}Begin {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}Ah, another transient? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" style="color:#E4D00A;" {{!}}What are you doing here? {{!}} colspan="4" style="color:#E4D00A;" {{!}}How do I get strong like you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Name's Polis. How goes your wary travels? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" style="color:#E4D00A;" {{!}}What are you doing here? {{!}} colspan="6" style="color:#E4D00A;" {{!}}How do I get strong like you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Jus Karita obtained= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}How strange that our Paths should cross again so soon... {{!}}- {{!}} {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} |-|Justicar= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="8" style="color:#32CD32;" {{!}}Begin {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}Ah, a fellow Justicar? I'm a fellow Justicar walking the Path, from the Frozen Coast. {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Follow in Alsin's wisdom - that freedom is the most valuable thing of all - and pursue the Path. I hope your pursuit of the Path is fruitful. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What are you doing here? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do I become stronger as a Justicar, like you? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }} ==Moveset== Polis' arsenal consists of a [[Darksteel Greatsword]], their [[fists]] ('''[[Jus Karita]]''') along with the [[Galebreathe]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Enters a stance before rushing forward and performing a quick upward strike. *Polis gains true hyperarmor during the full animation of this attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |

'''Rapid Punches'''
(★★☆) |User unleashes a barrage of blows against their foes. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |

'''Karita Leap'''
(★☆☆) |User launches themselves into a flying kick, backflipping into the air if they hit a wall. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} ===Talents=== *Collapsed Lung - When Polis block breaks someone, they are unable to vent for 3 seconds. *Bulldozer - When Polis flourishes an enemy into a wall, they are guard broken and have a chance of breaking the wall. *Audacity - When Polis starts gripping an enemy, they create an AOE stun and slow. They also resist the effect of Defiant Until the End and Last Second Negotiation. *Braced Collapse - If Polis is guard broken, they take less damage from the next hit. *Perseverance - If knocked, Polis gets up faster. *Impervious Slumber - Polis' knock timer cannot be reset. *Moving Fortress - Polis isn't slowed as much while blocking. *Battle Tendency - Polis restores posture +20% faster. *Reinforced Armor - Polis resists Armor PEN by 30%. *Matador - Polis deals +20% more damage against human enemies with hyperarmor. *Brutal Momentum - Polis gains hyperarmor on their next swing if they dodge an attack. *Showstopper - Polis stomps the ground if an enemy tries to dodge their attacks, dazing them. *Warrior's Swing - Polis takes less damage if hit during the hyperarmor of their melee attacks. *Destructive Recovery - Enemies who parry Polis recover much less posture. *Heavy Hitter - Polis deals +10% posture damage. *Punishing Blow - If Polis hits an enemy while they are swinging their weapon, they are dazed. *Hard Read - If Polis hits a feinting enemy, they are dazed. *Swift Rebound - Polis gains a speed boost after dodging an attack. *Evasive Expert - Polis gains even more speed from dodging an attack. *Ghost - Polis becomes invisible for 2 seconds whenever they dodge an attack. *Concussive Force - Enemies knocked by Polis remain knocked for 15 seconds instead of 10. *Strong Stern - Polis is only dazed for half the time if wall banged. *Concussion - When Polis flourishes an enemy into a wall, they are slightly blinded and are dazed for longer. *Risky Moves - When Polis dodges an attack, they will automatically dodge the next attack. *Wyvern's Claw - Polis deals +10% damage while in the air. *Chronostasis - If Polis hits an enemy, their resonance is put on cooldown. *In a Hurry - If Polis has a speed boost, they grip their enemy 16.67% faster (-0.5s). *Grand Support - Polis gains health and heals those they Reinforce. ==Finisher== Polis executes their opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |'''Execute''' | User pins down opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |} ==Trivia== *Killing them will give the player negative [[Reputation]] with Etrea. *During the event there's a bug where their face mask changes to a different pattern than the one they have while they are static. *Though Polis can be killed, doing so will not affect them, as they will respawn back in their usual spot and act like nothing happened. *The price of the Gold Ring they gave used to be 25 Notes. Now it sells for 14 Notes, however the price may vary due to quality stars. *Polis has special dialogue when attempting to scare them with a [[Hallowtide Mask]]: "I may be old, but I'm still brave, young one." *When having [[Jus Karita]] as a starting weapon Polis will say "How strange that our Paths should cross again so soon...", as if you have already met, and does not give you a Gold Ring or any other dialogue. *Despite teaching Jus Karita and donning a Justicar Armour, they favour a Greatsword in combat instead. This is because Jus Karita is intended to be a last resort if disarmed, a mechanic that does not exist in ''[[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]]''. **Polis does use Jus Karita Mantras though, despite wielding a Greatsword. **The [[Justicar]] origin does elaborate on this, as Justicars can complement their weaponary with Justicar techniques. Specifically, players can replace their running attack and critical with Jus Karita's. *Their name historically means "Greek city state." *Their hair ID is [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6101425666/Dark-Messy-Manbun 6101425666] *Polis has an actual obtainable build if you utilize [[Deep Shrines/Shrine of Order|Shrine of Order]], with all of their [[Talents]] (''except Audacity'') and all [[Mantras]] being obtainable. *Polis can be seen in the [[Main Menu]] screen along with [[Karliah]] and [[Kennith]]. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Etrean Luminant]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Justicars]]

==Description==
'''Portals,''' also referred to as '''Yoru,''' is a [[Resonance]] that players can obtain, and is uncommon to roll. 
===''Appearance''===
Once used, the user summons a white portal in front of them and becomes invisible & invincible for a brief period of time.

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Portal''' Resonance.

'''Portal''' grants the user invisibility & invincibility to all damage except insta-kill damage such as death bricks or the orbs within layer 2, increased walk and swim speed for 5-9s until removed from your portal. While using the Bell, interacting with objects, picking up players/npc's, eating and emoting will force you out of your portal early.

{{cl|corres|If Portals is corrupted, you move faster and can take objects and ''ALLIED'' players with you.}} (Note: the carried player or item will NOT be invisible.)
=== ''Resonance Point usage'' ===
When obtained, Portals will spend its points on the following stats:

* '''Dive:''' The dive variant will allow you to double tap {{Input|keybind|resonance}} to dive into the ground. When ended or cancelled, you are shot back up. Acts as uppercut if an entity is hit.
** Deals around 60 damage, it is unknown whether this is typeless or physical.
** Must be timed accurately in order to activate (requires a slight pause).
** Increases the cooldown by 5-10s if used as such.
** Landing the kick will lower the cooldown of the bell by 15s.
* '''Duration:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the longer the user can stay in the portal.
* '''Speed:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the faster the user move while inside the portal.
* '''Footprints''': If points are spent in this stat, using the portal will not leave behind footprints.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
Just gif.gif|Portals during the release of the game
File:Witherald SPEAKS PORTUGUESE?? WHAT!! (Portals Bell 2).gif|A demonstration of the immunity granted by the Resonance
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*There is a known bug where if the bell is Tarnished, you're able to immediately use it again after leaving the portal for the first time. The devs have chosen to leave this bug in the game for the time being.
*If portals is found to be corrupted, its downside will only be applied after exiting the portal.
*Chat bubbles persist through '''Portal''', so it is recommended that none are visible before using. 
**As such, do ''not'' use [[Spell Shout|spell shout]].
*This Resonance can be a great tool to ambush other players.
*Similar to ''Valorant'' character '''Yoru's''' ultimate ability, Dimensional Travel, not to be confused with the Legendary Bell, "Dimensional Travel" (hence its nickname: '''"Yoru").'''
*Trying to use this bell while carrying a player (without it being corrupted) will drop the player.
*Although the resonance points can be used to hide footprints, it's useless if you have low graphics mode on, which hides your character's footprints.
*The Eternal Gale's slowness effect in [[Second Layer|Layer 2]] can be negated by using the '''Portal''', but the wind '''may sometimes push you off''', so be cautious when using it.
*If you somehow take damage/get assassinated during, it forces you out of the portal. 
*This Resonance can be used to clip through walls<ref>https://youtu.be/iY0FSqBhFXs</ref>, and by extention, exit the boundaries of [[Guild Bases]].<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_bq6CeNMLzE</ref>
**Distance clipped likely depends on speed stat and whether or not the bell is corrupted.
*Portals now properly makes enchant VFX disappear, unlike the outdated gif
*Dive variant counts as an uppercut, and can proc meteor impact. 
**Interestingly, it cannot proc soaring storm.

==Description==
The Poser's Ring is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Rings" category. It can be obtained by completing [[Zana|Zana's]] quest.

While using a [[Katana]], [[Alloyed Katana|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Katana}}]], [[Palace Tachi]], or [[Shattered Katana]], the Poser's Ring makes it so that your Katana's attacks and critical deal 0 damage until the user "Sheathes" their Katana. When this happens, all damage dealt by the Katana will be dealt instantly. See [[Poser's Ring (mechanic)]] for more info.

<gallery widths="250" position="center">
Poser's Ring Sheathe.gif|Poser's Ring Sheathe
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Damage from the Poser's Ring sheathe cannot exceed 70% of a Player's maximum health.
**'''All non-player enemies are not affected by this cap''', meaning with enough M1s, you are capable of depleting even boss health bars from 100% to 0% in one sheathe.
*Effects that are scaled off of your weapon's scaled damage, like {{status|Bleed}} or Chip damage, still work on Poser's Ring, dealing their effects on weapon hit, and not on sheathe.
*The sheathe damage cannot be directly buffed, although you can buff it by applying buffs to your melee attacks before you sheathe.
*It is possible to obtain and equip this ring at Power 1, if no stat points are distributed at the character creation menu, and are instead all invested into Medium Weapon.
*Shares the same model as the [[Diver's Ring]].

title: Power
content:
Power or Level is the leveling mechanic of Deepwoken that enables players to increase their stats as well as unlock new [[Talents]], [[Mantras]], [[Traits]], and select an [[Oaths|Oath]].
[[File:PlayerTabMenuStatExampleLongFileNameFunnyThisGameSucks.png|thumb|An example of a player's Power and stat allotment back in Verse One]]
Each level of Power grants 15 investment points to a player, these investment points can be put into any of the skills present within the game which are redirected into their actual stats. Once all 15 points have been invested a player will increase their Power upon meeting EXP requirements. As players Power up further the EXP required to invest a point will also increase. The maximum [[Power]] is currently 20. 

Once powered up, players will be given a selection of cards to choose from which can be [[Talents]], [[Mantras]], or rarely a fifth card which is fold. Additionally, their health is restored, they gain 4 maximum health, and their health bar is unstained (if they were previously stained). Hunger and thirst are also brought back to full.

Fold cards will postpone the player's reception of a Card until their next Power up. If you fold, you will receive an additional hand on your next Power Increase. This second hand will be randomized and differ from the previously folded one.

To keep progressing, however, you will need regular EXP, obtained by killing things, visiting new places, turning in artifacts, and more:

* The white sparkling particles mean you are getting EXP, the density showing the amount obtained.
* The yellow/golden sparkling particles mean you have reached an EXP threshold, meaning that further progress is available.
** If you've reached the point where using [[Training Gear]] says "I've learned what I can from training right now, I should put it into practice...", those yellow particles usually indicate that you should be able to continue without this message, even if for just 1 point.
* If you've gotten all 15 investment points and it shows 0 without you powering up it means you require more EXP.

==Attributes==

===Base Attributes===
====Body (BDY)====
*[[Strength]] ('''STR''')
*[[Fortitude]] ('''FTD''')
*[[Agility]] ('''AGL''')
====Mind (MND)====
*[[Intelligence]] ('''INT''')
*[[Willpower]] ('''WLL''')
*[[Charisma]] ('''CHA''')

===Weapon Attributes===

*[[Weapons|Heavy Weapons]] ('''HVY''')
*[[Weapons|Light Weapons]] ('''LHT''')
*[[Weapons|Medium Weapons]] ('''MED''')

===Attunement Attributes===

*[[Bloodrend]] ('''BLD''')
*[[Flamecharm]] ('''FLM''')
*[[Frostdraw]] ('''ICE''') 
*[[Galebreathe]] ('''WND''')
*[[Ironsing]] ('''MTL''')
*[[Thundercall]] ('''LTN''')
*[[Shadowcast]] ('''SDW''')

== Trivia ==
*As your Power increases, so does your damage towards all non-player enemies.
*You gain 4 health per Power, starting at a base of 224 health at Power 1 and scaling up to 300 health at Power 20.
*Before the Verse 2 update, the required amount of investment points was 5. However, this was increased to 15 after Verse 2. This was changed with the Power 60 to Power 20 compression.

title: Preservation
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure a protective energy that will guide those fallen in battle towards you. The protective energy will stay the hands of death, preventing starvation, drowning, and incineration.|author=Preservation description}}
{{Resonance|effect=Puts all knocked entities, within a radius, into a protective bubble|appearance=A golden circle appears around center of use.|
image1 =<gallery>
Preservation.gif|Preservation
File:Preservation Card.png|Card
File:Corrupt Preservation Card.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
==Description==
'''Preservation''', is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll. It can be used on knocked entities to preserve them in a yellow ball that follows the player around at a slow pace. When the bubble breaks, any knocked entities inside will be able to stand again. The bubble can break either when it is attacked (normal variant), when the duration runs out, when the caster presses c again, or when the caster begins gripping an opponent.

=== ''Appearance''===
When used, a golden circle appears around the user or projectile. Any knocked entities or players in this area are put into a protective bubble and are unable to be carried, gripped, killed by autogrips, lit on fire, drown, and have immunity to [[Blood Scourge]]. The entities will also follow the person casted preservation

==Usage ==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} once will activate the '''Preservation'' Resonance. If you press {{Input|keybind|resonance}} while the resonance is active the duration will immediately end and will also cause captured players to be unknocked.

{{cl|corres|If Preservation is corrupted, the bubble will automatically parry any attacks against it.}}

===''Resonance Point Usage''===
When obtained, Preservation will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Thrown:''' If this stat is used, the player will instead launch a projectile ahead that will summon the AoE to shield entities.
* '''Energy Duration:''' If this stat is used, shielded entities will be protected for a longer duration.
* '''Activation Size:''' If this stat is used, the ability will yield a larger AoE.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Witherald causes GENOCIDE... that's about it, cya.gif|The Massacre
File:Preservation x duke.png|Preservation bell being used against [[Duke Erisia]]
Perservation.png|Old Reference (Thrown Variant)
The New Layer 2 Bell..gif|Reference (Standing Variant)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This resonance was added alongside [[Smite]] & [[Smokescreen]] during September 15, 2023. All of these bells were inspired by AlwaysAFK.
*Entities affected by this resonance will sometimes become stuck on a corner as the user moves, allowing enemies to simply pop the defensive bubble and attack. As such, anybody looking to use this resonance is advised to {{cl|corres|corrupt}} their ability.
*It uses the same windup sound and animation as [[Blood Scourge]]. Ironically forms a duality as while [[Blood Scourge]] drains the life of knocked entities and grips them, Preservation does the opposite by shielding knocked entities in a forcefield, keeping them safe from threats as they recover.
**Both also have similar animations, as well as their variants both being an AoE around the user, or a thrown ball that generates the AoE when it lands.
*Preservation has a decent chance to fling the player at very far distances, occasionally gripping them. It is advised not to use this resonance in [[The Depths]] as it can grip your allies.
*Possibly negates the Talent Impervious Slumber (Requires testing)
*Similar to Blood Scourge, Preservation can also work against players that're being carried.

It can be found in [[The Monkey's Paw]]. Not to be confused with [[Elder Primadon, The Titan Warlord]]. ==Description== Loud and enormous, '''Primadon''' is a giant aquatic ape-like [[Bosses|Boss]]. It is a bipedal primate creature, standing at nearly 81 feet (25 meters), with some features of marine life, featuring webbed feet and fins on its shoulders, hips, and head. It features blue-grey fur, and prior to Verse 2, Primadon had a dark blue face. After Verse 2, the model was changed slightly to make Primadon shorter and flip its lip inside out, much like real life primates do to show aggression. It can be summoned by making an offering (Most monster drops work, to a varying degree) to the large bonfire located in the center cliff of [[The Monkey's Paw]]. Spawning Primadon has a 3-minute cooldown and is received by summoning or hitting Primadon during the fight (You only get the cooldown by hitting it if it dies, if it despawns you won't be on cooldown). {| class="sortable mw-collapsible fandom-table" |+Known Offerings !Offering !Qty |- |[[Umbral Obsidian]] |3 |- |[[Dark Feather]] |3 |- |[[King Thresher Spine]] |3 |- |[[Odd Tentacle]] |3 |- |[[Megalodaunt Hide]] |5 |- |[[Thresher Spine]] |5 |- |[[Lionfish Scale]] |5 |- |[[Strange Claw]] |5 |- |} Primadon accepts Hemoblooms the amount required to summon him is unknown In the {{Iv|Vow of Iron}} gamemode however, it is not required to summon Primadon through item means, as you can summon him directly through the large bonfire, though requiring the "Simian Terror" memory task. After defeating Primadon you may not spawn him again on the same character. ==Attacks== ''For a visual guide consider watching [https://youtu.be/nESMPhJary8 this video].'' {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name ! (★☆☆) |Primadon winds back its '''right''' leg in order to deliver a devastating kick that is capable of ''punting the player into the atmosphere'', inflicting strong damage, with a large chance of being followed up with fall damage. *If close enough to a wall, Daze upon impact. *If the enemy is above his waist, he will instead swat away the enemy, dealing an incredibly hard to react punch version of the kick. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.n, dodge.y, ragdoll.true |type2_color=darkorange }} |[[File:Primadon Kick.gif|thumb]] |- |

Most Chests have 1-6 [[Umbral Obsidian]] in them, and can rarely include the '''Small Chest''' loot. *'''Small chest -''' Has 1-3 [[Umbral Obsidian]] in it and a high chance of 1-2 Deep Gems or Legendary Rings, and can rarely include the [[Imperator's Edge]], [[Stormseye]], [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]], and the [[Imperial Staff]]. ==Strategies & Tips== === General Preparation === For this boss fight, a '''[[Power]]''' level of 15-20 is highly recommended due to the level scaling of damage dealt to NPCs. Primadon's health does not scale with the number of players, but you have a strict '''16-minute time limit''' to defeat it. If you fail to do so, it will despawn and no rewards will be granted. Equipping armor with '''Physical/Blunt damage resistance''' is crucial, as it significantly reduces the damage you take from Primadon's stomps. === Combat Strategy === '''Fighting Solo:''' A highly effective strategy is to stay completely still while fighting and remain between the boss's feet. In this position, Primadon's moveset is limited to '''Stomp''', '''Trample''', '''Disengage''', and '''Kick'''. These attacks are telegraphed and can be easily parried or rolled away from, making this an ideal method for solo players. If Primadon uses '''Disengage''', quickly close the distance to prevent it from using its '''Grab''' or '''Rock Throw''' abilities. '''Fighting in a Group:''' If you're fighting with other players, ensure everyone attacks from the same direction. This prevents the boss from constantly rotating, which can make it difficult to read its attacks for parrying or dodging. '''Positioning and Dangers:''' Avoid fighting Primadon with a large body of water, especially the ocean, directly behind you. A failed dodge on a kick can send you flying into the water, with a high chance of drowning. In the ocean, a '''[[Lionfish]]''' may also spawn to finish you off, even if you survive the fall or have the '''Scuba Drowner''' talent. === Abilities and Mechanics === * '''Move Timing''': The most common mistake players make is incorrect timing. For the '''Kick''' attack, you should dodge as the foot comes down, not during the wind-up. * '''Stomp/Kick Sounds''': Both the '''Kick''' and '''Stomp''' attacks make a distinct whooshing sound when the foot is raised, which further helps in anticipating them. * '''Move-Set Reads''': The boss's movements are predictable. If its right foot raises, prepare for a '''Trample'''. If its left foot raises (without swinging back), a single '''Stomp''' is coming. Parrying stomps and dodging kicks will significantly increase your success rate. * '''Attack Windows''': You can typically land two M1 attacks with a heavy weapon or three with a medium weapon after a '''Trample'''. * '''End-Lag''': Primadon has the longest end-lag after a '''Trample''', or a '''Stomp''' followed by a '''Trample/Stomp'''. The end-lag is significantly shorter if it kicks after a stomp. === Other Tips and Notes === * '''Gems and Debuffs''': '''Blessed''', '''Wind''', '''Wayward''', and '''Insignia Gems''' will still activate. '''Bloodless''' will also proc, but since its healing now scales with your damage, the low physical damage dealt to Primadon means it will heal very little. Debuffs from mantras, however, do affect Primadon. * '''"Grip" Mechanic''': Primadon cannot actually "grip" you unless it stomps or throws you. You can use this to your advantage. If a friend gets downed by a rock throw, you can lure Primadon over to their downed body, allowing you to heal up. Just remember to wait for your friend to stand up, as a stomp or grab on a downed player will result in their death. * '''Retreating''': To retreat, either wait for Primadon to use '''Disengage''' before running (be prepared to dodge frequent rock throws) or have a friend take aggro. Be warned, Primadon's aggro priority is unique and it may continue to pursue you despite others attacking it. Alternatively, if you have very low health and the '''Perseverance''' talent, you can intentionally get kicked towards a rope. You should have enough time to recover and climb before the boss reaches you. * '''Weapon Usage''': As cannons deal blunt damage, you can effectively use them to attack Primadon. However, a recent update has given the boss a '''??% cannon resistance'''. * '''Healing Exploit''': A common cheese strategy is to place an '''Undying Flames''' Graceful Flame nearby to heal back any damage you take during the fight * '''Blocking Trick:''' When Primadon uses enrage you can actually block the roar, meaning you wont lose sanity. The posture debuff still applies, however. ==Gallery== ===Current=== File:Closeup Wideview Primadon.png|Wide close-up File:Primadon Fullbody One.png|Full-body File:The Glorious Primadongle.png|Ditto, ground view File:NewPrimadon.png|Ditto, air view File:Primadon Backsssview backview. backview..png|Backview File:PrimadonDark.png|Under [[The Depths]] lighting ===Verse Two=== File:Primadon verse two zygi image.png|Wide close-up File:I wonder what a-tunament it is.png|Enraged File:Enraged Closeup Primadon.png|Ditto, close-up ===Verse One=== File:Primadon Selfie.png|Primadon taking a selfie File:Primadon Full Body picture.png|Full-body File:Primadon No Thoughts.png|Full of empty thoughts File:Primadon's Eye im feisty like that i guess.png|Primadon's Eye File:Primadon's Eye.png|Ditto
==Trivia== *Primadon's second phase significantly increases his attack speed, only allowing one hit in between his attacks. *[[Deep Gems]] were temporarily stripped from the loot pools of all ''Etrean Luminant'' enemies, including Primadon. After a day, however, Deep Gem [[Chests]] were added back to Primadon's loot pool, although Deep Gems are not guaranteed to spawn after his defeat. **This chest has since been repurposed to house many of the rarer drops such as Relics and Legendary Weapons. *Primadon's respawn time is around 3 minutes. ** This cooldown is account wide for the player who summoned Primadon and any who dealt damage to him. *In the game files, it is called "MonkyWorldBoss." and ".monky" *[[Providence's Thorns]] is a great way to defeat Primadon, since parrying deals damage according to your level, allowing you to only parry to kill it. **It takes ~80 parries to kill Primadon without damaging him. * It's known to be a sort of "Giant [[Megalodaunt|Sharko]]" due to their move-sets being very similar except with 40 times more health. * The music that played when fighting it used to be a track from the anime ''Attack on Titan''. * As of 3/29/2024, Primadon was slightly tweaked to have a bluer color scheme. ** The purple "nose" is due to developer Arch_Mage explaining how primates flip their lips.https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/888259230082146385/1224049575174734005/image.png?ex=6679ae80&is=66785d00&hm=a3e8eb76f2338817dffc2e4147788e6c09c63fccd04ed1d54edde3951a54e5a3&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=838&height=816 * Primadon, during Verse One, stood at a height of 25 meters (81 feet) ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} {{Nav|Bosses|2}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Bosses]]

"Ancient Vesperians lost to time." '''Currently Unobtainable'''
== Description == An alternate version (subrace) of Vesperian with dark chitin and white markings, currently '''unobtainable''' by normal means. ''This is not an entirely different aspect in and of itself, more so a racial variant with special properties.'' {{clear}} ==Traits== {| class="fandom-table" |[[File:TalentIconSkeleton.png|frameless|100x100px]] |'''Chitin''' *"''You have a layer of natural armor that replenishes when you rest.''" **5% damage reduction. Degrades with damage but can be replenished at a campfire **This buff also stacks with Exoskeleton ( Rare Talent ) albeit is slightly reduced. *Identical to the base aspect |- |
+2
 |'''Attribute Boosts''' *+2 Fortitude *+2 Willpower |} ==Miscellaneous== |-|Lore =
Primal Vesperians do not play a significant role in the lore, though they did exist, and have some brief lore behind them. [[File:Primordian.png|alt=|left|59x59px|Emblem of the Primal Vesperian clan Stag was a part of (Made by Nuttoons)]] Primal Vesperians are the remnants of a branch of the [[Vesperian]]s who have since faded into obscurity. {{Header|title=Known Variants}} File:Nuttoons mask.png|Nuttoons' Mask File:Mask compared.png|Left: A variant of Arch_Mage's mask. Right: Nuttoons' mask. File:Archmage current mask.png|Variant of Arch_Mage's Mask, Dark Hairs FIle:Archmage old mask.png|Arch_Mage's old mask *Nuttoons gained this after winning first place prize in the first Deepwoken artist contest, where they chose to have their own custom [[Vesperian]] variant as their cosmetic, along with the custom name 'Stag Acrossus.' *This variant of [[Vesperian]] is unobtainable as of now. *Has similar traits to [[Ganymede]], the eyes & hair, perhaps due to their heritage. |-|Strengths =
  • +2 Health
  • +2 Fortitude
  • +2 Willpower
A layer of protective armor that regenerates at rest. -Face [[Equipment]] will always be hidden. |-|Full Names =
  • Stag Acrossus
  • Haske Vantage
 == Trivia == * Both Stag & Haske are the remaining members of an Ancient clan of [[Vesperian]]s who deviated and took their own form roughly around the initial split of the hivekin aspects. The reason why Haske and Stag remain, as opposed to their kin who had died out millenniums ago, is that they both have 'immortal' properties, with Haske actually being an Immortal and Stag being bewitched to elude death by an Unknown entity. *Haske wears an [[Equipment]] piece exclusive to him, called the [[Eternal Restraints]]. *Stag wears an [[Equipment]] piece exclusive to him, called the [[Stag Wraps]]. title: Prime Megalodaunt
content:
'' This might have not been the page you were looking for, if you were looking for a different page, view the [[Megalodaunt (disambiguation)| disambiguation]].'' {{Monster Infobox|title1=Prime Megalodaunt|image1=Prime Sharko.png|attacks=*Slash *Kick *Jump *Quad Swipe *Roar *Thousand Needles *Tacet Hug *Tacet Drop Kick *Cero *Finisher: Curb Stomp |locations=[[The Vat]] |drops=*[[Megalodaunt Hide]] *[[Nightbringer]] [[Enchant Stone]] (~1%) *[[Mantra Modifiers]]|health=15000 36000 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |caption1=|challenges={{bi|Megalodaunt|small}}}} ==Description== The Prime Megalodaunt is a powerful [[Megalodaunt]] variant, spawning as the second trial in [[The Vat]], as a Power 6+ trial in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} Depths Trial (albeit significantly weakened), or through the [[Parasol's Blight]] enchant. Primes are the strongest variant, with them hitting harder, having a much higher HP pool, and being noticeably faster at attacking compared to its normal counterparts. {{clear}} ==Attacks== {| class="article-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Slash'''
(★☆☆) |A short range swipe using their arms. After the initial slash, it can slash again or '''Kick'''. *Heavy posture damage. *{{PAGENAME}}s attack with a much quicker pace and don't leave much time for you to attack back. Do not get greedy for hits as you can get punished easily. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange |type3_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Normal sharko swing.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Quad Slash'''
(★★☆) |Four short range swipes using their arms. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.n, dodge.n }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Kick'''
(★★★) |The {{PAGENAME}} will wind up its right leg back with a red circle effect before delivering a kick that ragdolls and sends the player flying. *Causes the player to be [[Status Effects#Dazed|Dazed]] if kicked into a wall. *It will take longer to attack again after using this. {{AttackTags |indicator = hp |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll.true |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Normal sharko watch your tone.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Thousand Needles'''
(★☆☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} bends over and points its coral tubes towards an opponent, spewing a large and constant spray of coral shards at anyone in front of/around it for a second. *Lasts as long as auto-parry frames, meaning you can simply parry once to parry the whole attack. *There is a shorter-ranged AoE version and a longer-ranged single-target version. Both function the same. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Normal sharko coral.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Roar'''
(★☆☆) |Lets out a roar at nearby targets, inflicting [[Insanity]] and [[Status Effects#Fear|Fear]]. *Usually used as the {{PAGENAME}}'s first move. *Blocking negates much of but not all the Insanity gain. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, debuff |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Normal sharko rawr.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Tacet Hug'''
(★☆☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} turns invisible, with a white ring signifying where they are. After a moment, it turns visible again and appears over its target, grabs it, holds it up, and chews it down, before throwing it away and ragdolling it. *This attack drains ether and increases sanity gain upon landing. {{AttackTags |indicator = hp |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip, teleport, grab, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Alpha Sharko Tacet Hug.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Tacet Drop Kick'''
(★★☆) |Starts out similarly to '''Tacet Hug''', but after it turns visible again, it will throw out its entire body in a drop kick, flinging and ragdolling targets hit. *While Alpha & Crimson Megalodaunts can use this attack too the {{PAGENAME}} is the only variant that can use this attack on its own. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, teleport |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|center|thumb]] |- |
'''Cero'''
(★★★) |The Prime Megalodaunt raises its entire body upwards, opening its jaws to begin charging up a dark orb. Once fully charged, It hunches back down, firing a massive laser beam at its target. This attack is similar to the [[Lionfish]]'s own Cero attack. *This is its most dangerous move, as it requires attention, precise timing, and deals high damage *Can either fire it immediately upon hunching or delay the firing of the laser beam. Watch carefully for what it will try to do. *Players executed by the '''Cero''' move will be completely vaporized and will not drop a loot bag for others to interact with. *This attack does high sanity damage so if you have low sanity beware. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, autogrip }} |[[File:PrimeCero.gif|centre|thumb]] |- |
'''Jump'''
(☆☆☆) |If the target is above it, the {{PAGENAME}} will jump in the direction of its opponent to close the distance. Often used after '''Kick'''. {{AttackTags |unharmful, movement }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|centre|thumb]] |} ===Passives=== *'''Apex Predator''' - The Prime Megalodaunt can use many of its attacks back to back with little endlag or delay. Additionally, they can feint their attacks and all of its attacks have very little endlag. Playing passive is highly recommended. *'''Thick Hide''' - {{PAGENAME}}s automatically extinguish [[burn]]. *'''Thorn Guard''' - {{PAGENAME}} is immune to [[Providence's Thorns]]. ==Finisher== {|class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Curb Stomp |The Megalodaunt ends its opponent's life by delivering a stomp onto their bodies with a gruesome crunch. This happens in less than a second. This attack has an AOE effect which can be parried similar to the [[Rock Golem]]'s stomp. |} ==Tips== This variant will test your reaction and knowledge skills to the fullest, it is vital to know when to switch from playing aggressive to playing passive, and viceversa. ==Trivia== *First featured in Agamatsu's "Depths Games" event. *Also referred to as "Divine megalodaunt" or "Divine sharko" {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:The Vat Exclusive]]
