title: Prince of the Moon
content:
::''This page is about the Vow of Iron [[Memento]]. For other uses, see [[Moon (disambiguation)]].'' {{IronVowEx}}{{Quotes|quote=Defeat 3 powerful foes under the blessing of the moon|author=Prince of the Moon obtainment hint}}{{Memento |image=Prince of the Moon Memento.png |description=Following in the footsteps of [[Zhatarn]], the fallen Celestial prince, they sought power at the cost of madness. |final attributes=*75 Medium Weapon *80 Agility *80 Intelligence *80 Willpower |final traits=*4 Proficiency *4 Songchant *3 Vitality |locked armor= |allowed weapons=Sword |resonance=[[Jar of Souls]] |starting weapons=[[Soulthorn]] |unlock=Defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)|Shogun]], [[Dravik, The Rat King]], and [[True Heart of Enmity]] with the {{t|Blessing of the Moonseye}} Talent. |starting armor=[[Moonseye (Outfit)|Moonseye]] |starting health=90|starting attributes=*4 Medium Weapon *4 Agility *4 Intelligence *4 Willpower|starting traits=*2 Proficiency *2 Songchant *-1 Vitality|aspect=[[Lightborn]]}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. This Memento is obtained by defeating all three progression bosses while having the {{t|Blessing of the Moon}} Talent, which permanently applies tier three [[Insanity]]. The Blessing of the Moon Talent is obtained at [[Moon's Eyrie]]. A visual feature this memento bears is that your skin is always pale white, with gray Sclera, white Pupils and black hair. '''If you unequip your [[Soulthorn]], you will not be able to re-equip it.''' '''This Memento permanently gives you Tier 1 Insanity.''' {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Soul Veil}} [Memento Talent] - Soulthorn now directly siphons the song of your enemies. Accumulating stacks and increasing your power. Perfect plays are encouraged. **Landing basic attacks with the Soulthorn grants a stacking 7.5% damage buff. This caps at +30% damage. **If you get hit while having stacks of Soul Veil, your attacker will steal your stacks for themselves. You can steal your stacks back by hitting them. *{{cl|raretl|Dark Rift}} [Rare Talent] - Enter a rifted state when you successfully dodge, where you can't be damaged until its duration ends. Can be cancelled with feinting or attacking. **Blocking, parrying, dodging, or sliding will also cancel the effect. **You cannot use mantras during the effect. **You hover with a dark outline while dark rift is active. **This ability last for 1.8 seconds and goes on a 20 second cooldown when it activates. *{{cl|raretl|Shadow Travel}} [Rare Talent] - Teleport to a location in exchange for Ether cost. Certain ranges will require a health sacrifice. Be careful as this technique can prove lethal to the user. **Deals 0.25 self damage damage per stud teleported. This '''can''' kill you if you don't have enough health to survive the teleport. **If your teleport distance is less than 300 studs, you will not take self damage. **Drains 100 Ether on use, with each stud travelled increasing this Ether cost by 0.2. **The maximum distance you can travel is based on your Ether. Subtract your Ether by 100 and multiply the result by 5 to get the maximum amount of studs you can travel. **Studs teleported calculations are directly based on your starting position (where you '''casted''' Shadow Travel) and your end position, meaning that height and length aren't calculated separately. **The Already Dead Talent from the [[Deepscorn Casque]] halves the self damage taken from Shadow Travel. **Can teleport users to the roof of the depths, and wipe them due to fall damage. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Restrain (☆☆☆) |image=Restrain.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Deliver a powerful kick that binds your opponent's soul to yours. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''User twists their body to unleash a devastating kick. If this lands or is blocked, your opponent will be chained to you, disallowing their escape.'' *Deals 10 posture, and 31 damage. *Will inflict Enchained (Single target), Perpetual Wrath, and lowers in cooldown when landed, including on block. *Unaffected by [[Bloodless Gem]]. *Dazes for 0.5 seconds. *1 second cooldown when landed, including on block. *10 second cooldown when whiffed/interrupted. }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Power 5===
*{{cl|questtlnf|Chain of Perfection}} [Quest Talent, Echo Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You gain stacks of 'Perfection' on hitting mobs with close-range attacks. Perfection increases your damage towards mobs the more stacks you have. All stacks are lost on taking damage. **Gain a 5% damage boost against PVE enemies for every hit against at close range. **Can stack up to 20 times, for a 100% damage boost. **Lose the entirety of the damage boost after taking damage. (Excludes self damage from most sources.) *Swift Rebound [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretl|Evasive Expert}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretl|Perfect Flash}} [Rare Talent, Intelligence] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Having over 95% health causes your mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away. **Poser's ring won't count towards the health threshold until sheathed, maintaining the bonus even after being "damaged". *{{cl|raretl|Risky Moves}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **User is covered in a blue highlight when the effect is active. **Visual effect might not line up with duration. **Attacking will cancel the effect early. **Takes priority over block, allowing for you to "auto-dodge" while simultaneously blocking. **20 second cooldown. **Procs at the same time as Dark Rift. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Shadow Eruption (★☆☆) |image=Shadow_Eruption.gif |desc=Form a shockwave of darkness. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat |dmgtype={{stats|shadowcast|Shadow}} |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''The user makes a swipe with their right hand before releasing a large sphere of shadow.'' *Has a base damage of 20/21.5/23/24.5/26 per level with 2.75 Shadowcast scaling. *Drains 4.85 Ether regardless of level, with 2.75 Shadowcast scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.45 seconds with a 0.4 second delay before the second hit. Has a 12 second cooldown. *The "second hit" does not deal damage and does not grant parry stun to the user if it is parried. *Has 9.178x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.178 to get PvE damage). *[[Cloudstone|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s increase the size of the eruption. }}
===Power 10===
*{{cl|raretl|Defiance}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP. **The Effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement. **Currently, the only things Defiance cuts in half are: ***Flamecharm's burn damage ***Frostdraw's chill duration ***Galebreathe's winded duration ***Galebreathe's suffocation duration ***Frostdraw's crystal stacks ***Thundercall's surge stacks ***Shadowcast's Sightless Still duration ***Blood Poisoning ***Wither gain ***Ring of Pestillence duration ***The potency of potions ***Time Unconscious (cut by 50% multiplicatively after other modifiers) *{{cl|raretl|Everchanging Aegis}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element. (+7 Carry Load) **Getting hit by another element immediately changes your resistance to that element. i.e Getting hit by Shadowcast Mantras while having Galebreathe resistance will immediately change your resistance type to Shadowcast and vice versa. ***This means that multi-hitting Mantras are much less potent, even if your Everchanging Aegis type was not attuned to that Mantra. **Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry. You do not need to actually be ''hit'' by the attack for the swap to occur, largely mitigating the downside. **The damage type you become resistant to is indicated by a colored shield, continuous damage of the same element will give a colored outline of the damage type. ***Flamecharm: Orange / Frostdraw: Blue / Thundercall: Yellow / Galebreathe: Green / Shadowcast: Purple / Ironsing: Grey / Bloodrend: Red **Does not effect Oath, Attunement-less, or Monster mantras. *{{cl|raretl|Eureka}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack. (+7 Carry Load) **Landing and parrying Mantras grants Inspiration stacks. Mantras cap at giving 1 stack per, and you do not gain stacks from autoparry frames. **At 3 stacks, gain the Inspired buff for 30 seconds or until you cast a Mantra. Inspired increases the damage of your next Mantra cast by 10%. ***If you gain Inspired by parrying Mantras, you gain the Inspired status effect for 30 seconds. ***If you gain Inspired by landing Mantras, the Inspired status will be instantly consumed to increase the damage of the Mantra used to gain the status. **Inspiration Stacks do not decay, even if you whiff Mantras entirely. *{{cl|raretl|Neuroplasticity}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your mind is a pliable, flexible substance. The Ether cost of additional modifications to your Mantras is now reduced by 20%. **The increased Ether Cost from Modified Mantras is reduced by 20% (ether cost increase for tier 1 modifications is reduced from 10 Ether to 8, for tier 2 - from 20 Ether to 16). **Does not apply retroactively to previously modified mantras until you rejoin. *{{cl|raretl|Overflowing Dam}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage. **The damage buff applies the moment you reach 100% Ether, despite what the Talent description says. *{{cl|raretl|Tap Dancer}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Rolling immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your roll on a longer cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Negate the extra half a second cooldown added to the roll following a roll-cancel.
===Power 15===
*Dark God [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If a Shadowcast mantra would drain your opponent's Ether to 0, drain from their Tempo instead and increase your Tempo. *Dark Hours [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your Shadowcast Mantras deal 15% more damage at night and in realms the Sun does not reach. **Night cycle is XX:50 to XX:10. **Always active in the depths. *Dark Replenishment [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Knocking out an enemy in combat restores a portion of your ether. *Dark Synergy [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Engulf your enemy in shadows when flourishing them. **Deals 5 Shadowcast damage on proc. **Does not proc any shadow Talents except Shadow Overflow. **Does not steal or halt any Ether regen. *Fear the Dark [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Enemies will briefly hang in place when they run from you. **After you land a Shadowcast Mantra, if your opponent attempts to distance themselves from you, they will be locked in place for 1.5 seconds. **This does not apply hitstun. *Overwhelming Drain [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If multiple enemies are hit by your Shadow Eruption, they are dazed. *Shadow Overflow [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Extra ether stolen with mantras are exerted as dark energy, damaging and absorbing ether from those nearby. **Has a 4 second cooldown. **Deals 5 Shadowcast damage around you in a small aoe from the target you hit. *Sightless Still [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - The more a person is affected by your shadowcast the more you obscure their vision. Block breaking an opponent obscures their vision with darkness more potent than your Shadow mantras. *Singularity [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Enemies will briefly hang in place when hit by a shadow move. *{{cl|raretl|Cut to the Chase}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Air Counter damage scaling is largely increased. Landing an Air Counter now initiates an uppercut. (+5 Passive Agility) **Air Countering innately deals 10% of your weapon's scaled damage, '''Cut to the Chase''' increases this amount to 70% of your weapon's scaled damage. ***The damage bonus to your Air Counters will scale down if you have less than 60 Agility. **Air Counter is initiated when using an Aerial attack after your opponent does any of the following: wall jumps (parkour), uses Wind Step (Galebreathe Talent), or uses a [[Lifevents|Lifevent]] (Starswept jump pad). *{{cl|raretl|Lightspeed Reflexes}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. (+1 Passive Agility) **Prerequisites: 20 Agility, 20 Intelligence *Speed Emission [Common Talent] - Gain a slight speed boost after landing a vent. *{{cl|raretl|Speed Demon}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor. **Speed Demon's bleed deals 5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +15% damage over a 0.9 second period. **Works with M1s and criticals. *{{cl|raretl|Thresher Claws}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - All of your attacks have +5% more PEN. Your Basic Attacks and Criticals have an additional +5% PEN on top. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Rising Shadow (★★☆) |image=Rising Shadow.gif |desc=Form a Shockwave of darkness. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat |dmgtype={{stats|shadowcast|Shadow}}, {{stats|blunt|Blunt}} (Slam) |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''User moves their hands outward, creating a black tendril that chases nearby enemies. When connecting with an enemy, they will be lifted into the air and smashed into the ground.'' *The first hit has a base damage of 15/18/21/24/27 per level. The second hit has a base damage of 5 regardless of level. Both hits have 2.75 Shadowcast scaling. *Drains 2.5/3.5/4/4.625/5.25 Ether per level with 2.75 Shadowcast scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage. *Has a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 to get PvE damage). *[[Drift Shard|Drift]] and [[Rush Shard]]s increase projectile speed. *[[Cloudstone|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s increase range. *Can be modified with a [[Blast Spark]], removing the damage to apply the [[Status Effects#Shadowed Touch|Shadowed Touch]] status effect. This effect massively increases your opponent's Mantra Ether cost and returns a portion of that Ether to you. If your Ether is full when they cast a Mantra, the Ether gained will overflow into your Tempo instead and you will emit a wave of shadow. File:Rising Shadow Blast Spark.gif|Blast Spark }}
===Power 20===
*{{c|oathtlnf|Chainlash}} [Oath Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - On flourish, whip your chain to seize and yank enemies toward you, setting them up for a crushing kick. **On flourish, enchain the opponent. **"'''The Pull'''" is procced by Impel or flourishes, moving targets, but dealing no hitstun or damage. ***2 seconds true endlag on flourish. ***Prevents targets from moving after flourish. ***Forces targets back to the user on flourish, holding them in place for a duration. ****Game determines user's location 0.4 seconds late, using it airborne can drag targets upwards. ***'''Movestack''': Using a mantra at the ''very first moment'' after a flourish let's you movestack it. **"'''Crushing Kick'''" is activated after pulling targets by M1ing dealing 46 Oath damage and 25 posture. ***0.45s windup, [[True Hyperarmor]] and ragdolls/flings targets in the direction you are looking, cannot wallbang. ****Has a 360° hitbox, can't be whiffed by turning around, but you can kick targets back to you. ***Using the kick too quickly will have increased endlag, due to the Pull's endlag. ***'''Movestack''': Using The Kick at the ''very last moment'' provides a small movestack with mantras/attacks. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Rupture (☆☆☆) |image=Rupture No Chain.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Detonate your chained target, unleashing a powerful blast that shatters their restraints and inflicts significant damage. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |reqs={{c|notes|1,250}} |effect=''User punches the target twice, dazing them with each hit. If the target is '''enchained''', then the target will be detonated instead, and flung towards the user's cursor.'' *'''Base variant''' will do 2 melee punches, dealing 36 damage (20.6 + 15.4) and 30 posture (15 + 15). **Each punch dazes targets for 0.5 seconds. **The second punch will only commence if the first one lands/hits block. **Windup of ''first'' punch is sped up by [[Insignia Gem]]. *'''Enchained variant''' creates AOE explosions centered at ''all'' Enchained targets, ragdolling/flinging them, and dealing 37 damage and 15 posture. **Inflicts '''''anti-roll''''' for 1.35 seconds similar to {{t|Frozen Legs}}, allowing for true combos with mantras. **Will strongly fling enemies '''away from your relative direction'''. (Ex. enemies above you will fling upwards) ***You can [[True Daze|wallbang]] off the environment, jumping above targets while using the mantra can [[True Daze|wallbang]] off the ground. **Adding a [[Reversal Spark]], will prevent [[True Daze|wallbangs]], weaken knockback, and instead fling ''diagonally and downwards'' in the '''opposite direction of your camera'''. **Has hyperarmor on its second chained hit. *Has a cooldown of 15 seconds. File:Rupture.gif|Chain variant }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *{{cl|raretl|Lose Your Mind}} [Rare Talent] - Deal more damage the more insane you are. Grants +15% damage at maximum insanity. (+5 Sanity) **The damage buff starts at 70% Sanity (Tier 1 [[Insanity]]) and scales non-linearly with your sanity until it caps out at +15% damage with 0% Sanity (Tier 3 Insanity). **The specific specific formula is- f(x) = 15 - 15 * (x/0.7)^1.2 {0.7≥x≥0} (x= current sanity / maximum sanity) ***ex. 321 sanity w/ 175 current sanity would be a 3.89% increase [https://www.desmos.com/calculator/q9hbw3enrw] ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|questtl|Heretic's Sutra}} [Quest Talent] - A chant that steers you into the state of [[Insanity]] for 20 seconds. **Heretic's Sutra has a base windup of 0.4s and a base cooldown of 24 seconds at 30 Willpower. For every point in Willpower above 30, the windup is reduced by 0.00429 seconds. ***Has a windup of 0.186 seconds and a cooldown of 19.71 seconds. **Gives a burst of insanity to yourself. ***Immediately lose 15% sanity on use. ***If above 80% sanity, immediately lose sanity down to 65%. **You start benefitting from Talents that require insanity to use (namely {{cl|raretl|Lose Your Mind}}) **Talents that need you to be losing sanity to proc are passively activated for 15 seconds. ***Namely Shared Misery and {{cl|raretl|Piercing Will}}. ***Note that this passive does '''NOT''' work with {{cl|raretl|Lose Your Mind}}, as it only procs based on your current sanity percentage. And while Heretic's Sutra can help with sanity loss, it does not passively activate {{cl|raretl|Lose Your Mind}}. ===True Heart of Enmity=== {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Trance (☆☆☆) |image=Prince_TranceVOI.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=FEAR ME |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |dmgtype=? |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''User summons a moonseye sigil below themselves that pulses. Each pulse heals the user and deals high damage in an AoE.'' *Heals 80 health. *Deals high damage and posture damage. *Each pulse drains the user's sanity. *Each pulse is parryable, but they do not have autoparry frames.}}
==Trivia== *The memento is based on developer melonbeard's spec character.[[File:Prince of the Moon Ref.png]][[File:Melonbeard Prince of the Moon.png]] ==References== {{Nav|Mementos}} [[Category:Mementos]]

title: Pristine Lotus
content: {{ItemTemplate |title=Pristine & Scarlet Lotus |image= File:Pristine Lotus.png|Pristine File:Scarlet Lotus.png|Scarlet |value=15 |weight=1 |stack=99 |bankable=No |droppable=No |type=Common|desc= |-|Pristine=An exotic lotus, unblemished by the world. |-|Scarlet=An exotic lotus, drenched in another's blood.|usage=Obtaining the [[Linkstrider]] [[oath]] [Pristine Lotus only] Crafting [[Providence's Thorns]] enchanting stone|obtainment=[[The Entropy Catalyst]]}} == Overview == Pristine Lotuses are items that can be found scattered around the [[The Entropy Catalyst|Entropy Catalyst]]. Upon killing a player with an [[Oaths|Oath]] or a [[Bosses|Boss]], a Pristine Lotus will become a Scarlet Lotus. Upon obtaining 3 Scarlet Lotuses, you can return to the Entropy Catalyst to place them within the sacrifical holes, and obtain the [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]] Oath. ==Tips/Trivia== *Deaths to bloodloss are counted, neither players need to be combat tagged and allies do count. * This was introduced on the 10th of July 2023 update, as an alternative to the usual Linkstrider obtainment of knocking and carrying 4 [[Oaths|Oath]] users to the catalyst and sacrificing them, sending them to [[The Depths]] due to it being a [[Voidzones|Voidzone]]. ** This was often very difficult to do solo, not only would you usually have to carry someone a very long distance to get to the catalyst, but many people knocked would simply combat log, as just dying was preferable than being sacrificed and sent to The Depths. title: Private Kernel
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|title1=Private Kernel
|name=Cornelius Kernel Jr.<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Drill Sergeant Kernel|quote=I only hope '''MY SON''', Kernel Junior, can follow in your example!}}</ref><ref>[[File:He is THE FATHER.png]]</ref>
|alias=Struggling Guard
|aspect=Celtor
|pronouns=He/him
|affiliation=[[The Central Authority]]
|family=[[Drill Sergeant Kernel]] <small>(father)</small><ref>While Private Kernel is never explicitly stated to be Drill Sergeant Kernel's son, the fact they are the only Celtor with the surname "Kernel" found within Fort Merit all but confirms the private is Cornelius Kernel Jr.</ref>
|location=[[Fort Merit]]
|image1=Private Kernel.PNG}}

==Description==
Private Kernel is a [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He possesses information on who [[The Central Authority]] contains in the [[Merit Detainment Core]].

He is equipped with an [[Authority Helm]], a [[Plain Cape]], [[Leather Boots]], and the [[Authority Peacekeeper]] [[Outfit]]. On his back, he wields an [[Adretian Axe]].

==Location==
Private Kernel is located in the prison of [[Fort Merit]], standing in front of the gate to the [[Merit Detainment Core]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Private Kernel Map.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" |''*The guard mumbles something as you approach, unaware of you.*'' ...they couldn't even get a helm my size, can't see a damned thing with this...
|-
| colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Soldier?
|-
| colspan="2" |''*The guard startles, and immediately jumps to attention, saluting you.*'' {{sh|SIR YES SIR!}} I STAND ALERT ON DUTY, captain! None shall get past me on my first day!!
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |At ease, soldier. What's behind that door?
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Er... I think you've confused me for someone else...
|-
| colspan="1" |''*Although he wears a helmet, you can tell his face drops.*'' S... sir? is this a test?.. Wait... yeah! {{sh|SIR YES SIR!}} I WILL NOT FAIL THIS TEST! THIS IS THE ''' ''FORT MERIT DETAINMENT CORE'' ''', SIR! The highest security prison this side of the {{g|The Eastern Luminant|Eastern Luminant}}, {{sh|SIR!}}
| colspan="1" |''*You can tell he is violently squinting under his helmet, trying to tilt his head for a better look at you*'' {{sic|expected=look at you.*}} ...A civillian?.. '''HEY! {{sh|YOU'RE NOT ALLOWED HERE!}}''' Get lost before I call some back up, pal!
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Very good. Who's currently held inside?
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|-
| colspan="1" |{{sh|SIR}}, only the ''worst'' of the ''' ''worst'' ''', SIR! All hostile elements sworn to fight against the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}, SIR! Criminals, pirates, and enemy combatants, SIR! ...and that one ''{{sh|unnerving}}'' Legion commander.. {{sh|SIR!}}
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Unnerving Legion commander?
|-
| colspan="1" |{{sh|SIR, CORRECT, SIR!}} The uhh... uhm... ''' ''TITUS'' ''' guy, SIR! Commander of the 49th Legion, {{sh|SIR!}} ...He scares me. Sir.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Why does he scare you, private?
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He tenses up like a spring.*'' {{sh|SIR!}} PRIVATE KERNEL fears '''NO MAN''' but '''THE CAPTAIN HIMSELF''', {{sh|SIR!}}.. But, that prisoner... He moves for no man, SIR! There was a prison riot not long ago when the systems malfunctioned and all the cells opened, and he didn't even try to escape, {{sh|SIR}}! He just... sat there. ''Unmoving''... Sir.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Why did he not try to break out, private?
|-
| colspan="1" |''*He appears stumped for a moment.*'' ...{{sh|SIR}}, PRIVATE KERNEL does not know, {{sh|SIR!}} The man easily brushed off anyone who tried to pick a fight with him, SIR! We interrogated the other prisoners, and they all said something about him 'biding his time' for something, and 'waiting for a message', SIR! PRIVATE KERNEL thinks that is why the prisoner will not fight, {{sh|SIR!}}
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Very good, private. Carry on.
|-
| colspan="1" |''*The soldier vigorously salutes you, beaming with pride.*'' {{sh|SIR YES SIR!}} I WILL DO MY BEST FOR THE AUTHORITY, {{sh|SIR}}! {{sh|HURRAH}}! THREE CHEERS!
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Trivia==
*Before the player chooses the dialogue option "Why does he scare you, private?", Private Kernel is named as "Struggling Guard."
*His full name is a play on the words corn kernel.<ref>[[File:Kernel Name.png]]</ref>

{{stats|flamecharm|+20% Fire Armor}} |price=1,000 |buffs={{stats|ether|+50% Ether Regen}} |obtainment= *Sold by [[Nyanna]] for {{c|notes|200}} *Sold in [[Traan Zakshun]]'s regular shop for {{c|notes|200}} *[[Glaive Spellhardt]] Chests from: *[[Saramaed Hollow]] *[[Primadon]] *{{lp|Aratel}} *{{lp|Scyphozia}} *[[The Understrand]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *Sold in [[Naan Zakshun]]'s regular shop for {{c|notes|200}} |talents={{etal|outfit|Crippling Darkness}} |shirt=5049282750 |pants=5049284828 |caption=Cloak of a [[The Ministry|Ministry]] Prophet.}}'''Prophet's Cloak''' is a Master [[Outfit]] in ''Deepwoken''. == Statistics == ===''Requirements''=== This Outfit costs {{c|Notes|1,000}} and requires five (5) [[Cloth]], one (1) [[Bloodless Gem]], five (5) [[Vibrant Gem]]s, five (5) [[Umbral Obsidian]], one (1) [[Dark Feather]], one (1) [[Odd Tentacle]] and one (1) [[Thresher Spine]] to craft. This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 15 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 2600 durability and grants {{stats|physical|+25% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elemental|+25% Elemental resistance}}, {{stats|frostdraw|+20% Ice resistance}}, {{stats|flamecharm|+20% Fire resistance}} and {{stats|ether|+50% Ether Regen}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Crippling Darkness}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|physical|25% Physical}}, {{stats|flamecharm|40% Flamecharm}}, {{stats|frostdraw|40% Frostdraw}}, and {{stats|elemental|25% Elemental|flm=n|ice=n}}. The {{t|Crippling Darkness}} Talent gives the user 20% PEN to any non-weapon attack, such as Mantras and Talent abilities. Additionally, because [[Reinforce|Reinforce's]] general resistance is affected by PEN, Crippling darkness allows your typeless damage attacks (e.g. {{cl|bleed}}) to deal more damage against Reinforce users than you would otherwise. ==Trivia== *It includes a full cosmetic 3D model of a collar when equipped. ==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that attacks your enemies when you parry them.

==Effect==
'''<big>PvP</big>''': After parrying three attacks within a 7 second window, {{PAGENAME}} strikes your opponent after a short delay, dealing 4% of your opponent's maximum health as damage.

'''<big>PvE</big>''': After parrying an attack, {{PAGENAME}} strikes your opponent after a short delay, dealing damage scaling on your level and the damage of the attack you parried. This deals 35% of the parried attack's damage * your current level, capping at 500 damage per proc.

===Notes===
*Providence's Thorns hit can be parried and countered, but it does not grant autoparry frames.
*Providence's Thorns does not proc on autoparry frames.
*Some [[Bosses]] are '''entirely immune''' to Providence's Thorns. These are: [[Heart of Enmity]], [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]], [[Parliament]], [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] and [[Kyrsgarde Champion]].

[[File:Purge Shrine.png|center|thumb|900px]]

==Description==
The Purge Shrine is an interactable tower that can be found atop a small cliff near [[Kaide, the Drowned Light]] in [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]]. Interacting with the shrine after wishing for power from [[Misérables]]. But using the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine#Puzzle Route (Skip)|Puzzle Route]] you will skip having to interact with Misérables abd will prompt the screen to shake, signaling the effect has incurred.

==Effects==
===Scion of Ethiron===

* The [[Scion of Ethiron]] will be buffed, dealing increased damage and no longer spawning [[Kyrsgarde Sniper]] (To be used as [[Terminology_(game)#Health_pack|health packs]]).
* The Bonegrow attack will be significantly faster and will have it's amount of waves increased from 3 to 5.
* The Bonestaves of Eld attack will spawn 4 bones instead of 3.
* Vehemens Ventus will come out way faster (approximately 8 seconds faster) and can easily catch players off guard, doing significant damage if not parried or dodged.

===Space-time Collapse sequence===
*The time the player has to escape before the space-time collapse will be increased from 3 minutes to 7 minutes.
*The spawnrate frequency of instakill orbs will be reduced by around 2-3 times and the orbs take slightly longer to detonate/explode.
*The [[Kyrsgarde Champion]] will spawn at the intersection where you will normally find the 4 [[Kyrsgarde Lancer]] while escaping.

==Description ==
The Purple Cloud is a Boss drop [[Weapons|Medium Weapon]], obtained after defeating [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] (guaranteed on first win, then, very slim chance afterward). It's part of a trio of weapons from the [[Maestro Evengarde Rest|Maestro]]'s arsenal, its counterparts being the [[Pale Briar]] (HVY) and [[Cerulean Thread]] (LHT). The Purple Cloud mainly utilizes your fists and legs to attack, with the blade itself only being employed during its critical where you perform a single, powerful strike. Effectively, it combines the move sets of swords with those of [[Fists]]. It can only be used one-handed.

Akin to the [[Shattered Katana|Shattered]] and [[Alloyed Katana]]s, the {{t|Paired Soul}} [[Outfit]] Talent increases its damage by 5%.

===In Vow of Iron===
In the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode, the Purple Cloud is available as a weapon exclusive to the [[Drifter]] [[Memento]], bearing the same stats as the Pathfinder version. With the Drifting Cloud Talent conditions fulfilled, the player can fully unsheathe the blade. The neon white pattern on the blade in Pathfinder is changed to a saturated magenta in its Vow of Iron variant, and each swing follows up with magenta afterimages.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Purple Cloud Critical.gif|Purple Cloud critical landing on an opponent
</gallery>
The user leans downward and grabs the blade's handle before dashing forwards, teleporting behind the first enemy hit, dealing '''1.2x''' scaled damage and high posture damage with the blade. This critical innately applies {{cl|bleed}} damage.

The critical has a cooldown of '''7 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*Despite having a scabbard, the [[Poser's Ring]] doesn't work with it.
**This is because the Purple Cloud is sheathed most of the time, and when it is unsheathed for the critical, the blade is put right back in its place, so it would just deal delayed critical damage
**The other weapons that possess scabbards are the [[Katana]]/[[Alloyed Katana]], [[Palace Tachi]], [[Shattered Katana]], and the [[Bloodfouler]]
*Despite being a pseudo fist-type weapon, it does not proc/activate Talents related to fists.
*Despite this weapon looking as if it is a light weapon (using your fists and legs instead of the blade), it keeps the stats of a medium weapon with the average damage, attack speed and slightly below average range as what you would expect from a medium weapon.
*Its critical attack is based on the martial art "Iaido", which involves quickly drawing and sheathing the sword in order to attack or defend.
*Clones (e.g. [[Lightning Clones]] summons) wield the weapon unsheathed. 
*Vow of Iron's version of Purple Cloud shares its swing animations with [[Umbrite Witherblade]].

== Description ==
The '''Quartztone Pickaxe''' is a rare, previously exclusive Greataxe resembling a pickaxe. It's the only weapon alongside the [[Boltcrusher]] that can be used to mine ores; it also mines them faster.

This weapon comes with two passive abilities: 

* '''Mining Sufficient''' '''-''' The Quartztone Pickaxe is capable of mining [[Ores]], and with greater efficiency.
* '''Maximum Tuning -''' Using criticals cost Ether, and cannot be used without a sufficient amount.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:QuartztoneStandardCritical.gif|Standard
File:QuartztoneAerialCritical.gif|Aerial
</gallery>
The Quartztone Pickaxe has two critical attacks. 

For the standing critical, the user shines the pickaxe and spins it, then causing a blast in the ground that ragdolls and sends the opponents backwards. Deals 1.15x your weapon's scaled damage.

For the aerial critical, the user shines the pickaxe, performing a slash in the air followed by two larger slashes on the ground. The first slash deals 0.33x your weapon's scaled damage, the second deals 0.3x your weapon's scaled damage, and the last slash deals 1.2x your weapon's scaled damage. 

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''6 seconds'''. Both cooldowns will count down when the user is done performing the critical.

==Trivia==
*The weapon was supposed to be released along with [[Conquest]], with Order of the Unsung members only having a preview. However, developer Arch_Mage made the decision to release stuff that would've released with Conquest earlier, because of the huge [[Conquest]] delays.
*In the December 7th, 2024 update, this weapon, along with [[Boltcrusher]] can both be used as more efficient [[Pickaxe]]s.
*In later updates, the Quartztone Pickaxe's texture has been removed to reflect better enchantment colors.

{{Spoiler}} ==Description== '''Quests''' are a major part of ''Deepwoken''. They are a significant means of progression, rewarding essential [[Talents]], EXP, or items upon completion. Most quests require killing enemies or obtaining certain items while some simply require talking to a [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Quests for [[Murmur]]s, [[Oaths]], [[Job Boards]] and [[Attributes Unbound]]s are on their own pages. Quests are divided into Curiosity, Bravery and Compassion quests. Completing a quest in a category for the first time will display the message "You have shown your [Trait] and grown from it" and an extra Talent hand will be awarded on [[Power]] increase or by rejoining. If you are Power 20, the hand is given immediately. Any subsequent completions of quests in that category will not award a Talent hand, meaning you can get a maximum of 3 extra Talent hands from quests. ==Talent Quests== When these quests are completed, they give a [[Talent]] (or [[Mantras|Mantra]] in the case of [[Disguise]]). They can sometimes be repeated. ===Bravery=== The following quests grant the ''Bravery'' Talent hand on top of their other rewards. Keep in mind this cannot be stacked with other Bravery quests. ====Mineskipper Mayhem==== {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
'''Quest Location''': [[Songseeker Wilds]]
'''Guide''': Talk to the NPC named Lucian outside the entrance of the [[Mineskipper|Mudskipper]] mine (near the Voidzone entrance). They will ask you to kill 5 Mineskippers. Do so and return.
'''Reward(s)''': {{t|Family Recipe}}, Bravery, 3 Full Training points

[[Lucien]]

'''Reward(s)''': EXP, Bravery, 2 [[Knowledge]], {{t|Beiruul's Vengeance}}, 5 Full Training points

[[Beiruul]]

He'll heal his wounds and ask you to head back to Isle of Vigils and talk to Kj about his status. *Talking to Apprentice Kj after giving the Gale Stone finishes the quest. *Vigil Isaac can be found next to the Mantra Modification table at Vigils after completing the quest. title: R/place - Marking Territory
content:
[[File:The Glory.png|The glory of the Deepwoken community.|500px|center|thumb]]

==Description==
Behold, the Deepwoken community's contribution to r/place 2022.

r/place is a collaborative Reddit event held around April Fool's Day, where users work together on a massive shared canvas by placing individual pixels. Throughout the event, millions of participants created artwork, defended their creations, and competed for limited space on the ever-changing board.

During r/place 2022, the Deepwoken community united with a single goal: to establish a place for the game on the canvas. Through coordination and persistence, the community successfully secured a small section of the board. While modest in size, the final artwork became a symbol of community spirit and cooperation, creating a rare sense of unity among Deepwoken players.

==Timeline==
===The Original Plan===
On April 3rd, 2022, HorrorTM, a head moderator of the official Deepwoken Discord server, shared two links with the community. One outlined the construction plan, while the other provided the coordinates of the intended location. The operation was initially successful, with the Deepwoken logo even appearing in the thumbnail of a video by MoistCr1tical.

However, the artwork soon came under attack. The original logo was gradually overwritten and transformed by another community, led by Spanish YouTuber Putupau. Unable to maintain control of the area, the Deepwoken community was ultimately forced to abandon its original location.

===Reconstruction===
Rather than giving up, the community regrouped and relocated to a quieter section of the canvas. AreaForce and Agamatsu helped organize the reconstruction effort, providing a revised design and new coordinates.

The new artwork featured the Deepwoken trident logo alongside the iconic phrase "The Deep Calls." With stronger coordination and fewer territorial conflicts, the project proved successful. As development continued, additional Deepwoken references were incorporated, including a Bell, an Owl mask, Primadon, a Red Calabash, a Rogue Lineage Scroom, and the Blindseer Oath symbol. The well-known community phrase "block parry dodge" was also included, serving as a tribute to one of Deepwoken's most recognizable memes.

==Trivia==
*He is a reference to Patches, a recurring character in games developed by ''Fromsoftware''. The character often attempts to gain the trust of the player or trick them into pursuing treasure, before kicking them off a cliff. Attempting to return to him will often result in him grovelling or attempting to act as though nothing happened.
**Developer Arch_Mage even attempted to get a voice for him that was similar to the iconic character, but had trouble due to it being "too nasally."
*Rabanastre may be a member of [[The Ministry]], given he oversees and feeds people to Bounders, seems overall comfortable with his situation, is carrying out acts of homicide rather than worrying over dying to the elements and Chaser will not spawn unless the Bounders he's overseeing spawn.
**Furthermore, a scrapped quest meant to elaborate on Chaser's connection with the Second Prophet was meant to have players search for Ministry members in the Second Layer, so it's possible Rabanastre may have been among them.
*Rabanastre knocking you off a cliff into the Bounder Nest below is in possible reference to Big Hoss from ''Rogue Lineage'', who knocks you off a cliff in the Tundra into a pack of Howlers if you don't meet the requirements to obtain the class Oni.

==Description==
Raen is a [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a [[Knife of Eylis]] residing within the [[Voidheart]].

He gives a few pointers to new [[Voidwalker]]s on what to do for progression.

If the player chooses the dialogue option "I see. Can you help me with affording equipment?" a new dialogue choice will appear for [[Rook Rethige]].

{{clear}}
== Dialogue ==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" |Fresh Knife, aye? If you need any info about anything, let me know. Eylis lets us mostly freelance unless it's a big job. Granted, she does take a cut of the coin though for who knows what...
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What is this place?
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What do I do here?
|-
| colspan="1" |Well, Eylis calls this place the Voidheart. As for its whereabouts.. I cannot really say. We wake up here - in our dreams at night - ever since we signed the contract. There's a lot of details I don't really understand, since the Voidmother speaks only in riddles. Eylis and her seem awfully chummy, though.
| colspan="1" |Well.. despite the rather esoteric nature of the place itself, everyone ''human'' here is a lot more grounded in reality. ''*He scoffs, glancing toward the direction of the Voidmother's hall.*'' We do jobs. We're here for money, some for power.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Who's the Voidmother?
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Jobs?
|-
| colspan="1" |Funny you ask, I tried asking her the same thing. I was given a completely incomprehensible answer. No one really understands much about her, but she seems to be the overseer of this place, I guess. Eylis has some sort of deal with her. If you want to talk to the Voidmother yourself, seek her hall. She's.. not exactly like us, though.
| colspan="1" |''*He looks at you with a bewildered expression.*'' You.. do know what you signed up for, right? We're mercenaries. Maybe not the typical kind, but we do assassination operations for almost every faction within this {{g|The Luminants|Luminant}} for coin. You can take jobs on the bounty board over there, and wake up from this place by talking to the Voidmother.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What do I do here?
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I see. Can you help me with affording equipment?
|-
| colspan="1" |[See First Instance]
| colspan="1" |Really? I just showed you a great kindness by helping your sorry soul learn what you're here for, and you ask me for charity? I have a family to feed, and my mother... I'm not in this job because I want to be. Do bounty board work like the rest of us for coin, you'll find no ''innocent little helper'' here... we're just murderers, all the same.
|-
| colspan="1" |
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

==Description==
The '''Railblade''' is a [[Weapons|Greatsword]] obtained exclusively from the [[Second Layer]]. It is dropped from any chest in the Second Layer at an uncommon-rare rate. The Railblade requires 80 HVY and Power 10 to equip. This weapon deals 35.7 damage at 100 Heavy, and with 6 proficiency and three-star damage, it deals 43.5.

[[Prototype Railblade]]s were developed during or prior to 1233 CE<ref>{{Deep dates|Iron}}</ref> as a generalist tool against the Deep by [[The Ignition Union]].<ref>{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Prototype Railblade}}</ref> Following the discovery of the Second Layer, it was outfitted with a heating mechanism to allow the wielder to better resist the climate.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Railbladecrit1.gif|Grounded Critical
File:Railbladecrit2.gif|Airborne Critical
</gallery>
For the '''grounded''' critical, the user braces themselves in a wind-up stance emitting the critical particles, applying knockdown, followed by exhausting the Railblade to unleash a flaming blow. Only the secondary hit will apply Burn, and; the first will only knockdown. Cancellable in the initial windup, however becomes uncancellable as the attack itself unfolds.

For the '''airborne''' critical, the user hovers and raises their weapon overhead before unleashing a diagonal downwards slash, dealing high damage, short knockdown, and applying Burn. 

The flames emitted by both Critical Attacks will proc Burn and any applicable Flamecharm Talents, including different paths & Talents such as Azure Flames. The cooldown for either critical is '''9 seconds'''; they share a Critical cooldown.

{{text|m1tag2}} Spine Cutter does not proc however.

File:Railbladecaptaingreene.png|Curse of Captain Greene
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Railblade was originally a Legendary Weapon and as such could not be enchanted, but was revised to later be a normal weapon during the 4/5/2024 update.
*This weapon was modelled by contributor oNoodlez.
**They took inspiration from Nagoriyuki's sword from ''Guilty Gear -Strive-'' and Jetstream Sam's Murasama high-frequency blade from ''Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance''.<ref name="railorigin">[[File:RailbladeInspo.png|200px]]</ref>
*The Railblade running attack originally dealt no knockback, this was later changed in a shadow update making it deal knockback like the rest.
*The Railblade resembles the make of an Ōdachi or Nodachi, a great-katana from Japan.
*The Railblade was originally intended to be a [[Thundercall]] Elemental Legendary weapon, hence the name Railblade (as railguns utilise electricity and it also had a thundering glow), was also supposed to be an Authority owned weapon instead of Ignition Union, hence the guard being shaped like the Central Authority logo, but was changed prior to release due to not fitting the whole theme of the Layer.<ref name="railorigin" /><ref>[[File:Onoodlez best dev.png|100px]]</ref><ref>[[File:Screenshot 7.png|150px]]</ref>
**With the removal of the Central Authority connection, it's unknown why, in-universe, the Railblade's guard is shaped like the Central Authority logo, especially given the Union's views on the Authority. However, given their track record, it may simply be the Union being hypocritical again.
*This weapon can only be used in the one-handed stance, allowing access to offhand guns, daggers, and shields.
*NanoProdigy was rewarded with this weapon when he reached 1st place in the Lightborn tournament, making him the first Railblade user along with gifting him the unobtainable Lightborn aspect.
*Previously, Railblades dropping from Chaser were equivalent in rarity to items such as the [[Curved Blade of Winds]] dropping in the [[First Layer]].

|droppable=No
|pass down=Yes

==Description==
Rain is a [[Gaunt Man]]-exclusive equipment [[enchantment]] that creates a moderate sized rain cloud on proc.

==Effect==
Upon taking damage, Rain has around a 12.5% chance to proc. On proc, a moderate-sized rain cloud is created above your head, lasting 27.5 seconds. This has a 45 second cooldown (effectively 17.5s with uptime efficiency).

The rain this enchantment creates functions identically to normal rain, reducing [[Flamecharm]] damage by 10%, putting out burn and campfires, and increasing [[Thundercall]] damage by 5%.

If you have the [[Chilling|<font color="#7deddc">'''Chilling'''</font>]] Enchantment on your weapon, if it's [[Seasons|Winter]], or if you're in a location with a low climate like [[Minityrsa]], create snow instead, increasing the damage of your [[Frostdraw]].

If you have the [[Stench|<font color="olive">'''Stench'''</font>]] on another equipment piece, or if you are in [[Upper Erisia]], create an acid rain cloud instead. This will damage yourself and all players in its AoE, however you will become immune to the damage it deals if you have the [[Survivalist]] Boon. Lasts 15 seconds instead of the standard 27.5 seconds.

===Notes===
*'''If you have not completed [[The Gaunt Man]]'s trial on your character, this enchantment will not work.'''
*This enchantment is best used with [[Thundercall]], the [[Storm]] or [[Stormbreaker]] weapon enchantments, [[Chilling]] enchantment + [[Frostdraw]], or [[Survivalist]] + [[Stench]] enchantment for various synergies.

==Description==
The '''Rain Spire''' is a reusable [[Relic]] similar in design to the [[Void Spire]] that allows its user to summon [[Rain]] and [[Fishing|fishing spots]] for 5 minutes. It has infinite uses but has a 40 minute cooldown as a drawback.
==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Rain Spire with player.png|Size comparison to a player
Rain Spire beam.png|Beacon
</gallery>
==Trivia==
*Rain Spire can summon different [[Environmental Hazards]] depending on the area.
**[[Upper Erisia]]: Acid Rain
**[[Minityrsa]] & [[Winter]]: Hail
**[[Aratel Island]]: Sandstorm
*The rain spire has a multitude of synergies due to environmental effects;
**The [[Storm]] and [[Stormbreaker]] enchantments deal increased damage during [[rain]]. These deal 33% of your weapon's scaled damage on proc when it's raining as opposed to the base 16.5%.
**All sources of [[Thundercall]] damage gain a 5% damage buff when it is [[rain]]ing. The {{t|Stratoshock}} Talent increases this by another 5%.
**[[Flamecharm]] deals 10% less damage and burn extinguishes during [[rain]], potentially debuffing your opponent. Though, these downsides can be negated if they have the {{t|Undying Flame}} Talent.
**All sources of [[Frostdraw]] damage gains a 10% damage buff if it is [[snow]]ing.
*Rain Spire can, for whatever reason be used in [[Chime of Conflict]].
*Rain Spire is the first ever Relic to release in Deepwoken. It came in the same update that released the [[Ironsing]] Attunement on May 22, 2023.
*Rain Spire is one of the two [[Relics]] that has infinite uses, with the other one being the [[Void Spire]].
*Similarly to the Void Spire, when trying to place it during its cooldown, dialogue appears saying "The Spire has not yet reformed."
*You can't place a Rain Spire on ice sheets or boats.
*Rain Spires can summon multiple Fishing Spots when used near water, which will last for the Rain Spire's duration.
*After completing [[the Vat]], you can trade 25 Rain Spires and {{c|crowns|10}} to [[The Gaunt Man]] to receive the [[Rain (enchantment)|Rain]] enchantment.
