title: Random Encounters
content:
{{Outdated}} {{Stub}} ==Description== Random encounters are randomly spawning events that occur throughout target areas in Deepwoken. Although some encounters are specific to certain areas, the majority can be found anywhere. Furthermore, when two or more different encounters meet each other, it will often result in a large battle. '''Note:''' This is not yet a comprehensive list of every single random encounter: more will be added. [[File:MotherthresherVShiveconstructVSAuthority.png|thumb|155x155px|A King Thresher, Hive Construct, and an Authority Captain fighting each other at Starswept Valley. |center]] ==AI-Driven Encounters== These events occur randomly in the world or within a [[Locations|location]].

Etrean Luminant

==== Fight between Factions ==== Groups of NPCs from different factions will spawn in Etrean Luminant and attack each other. Helping a side will usually reward you with their respective reputation. *[[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Authority Officer]]s {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Erisia]]) Named "The Eastern Conflict" *[[Etrean Soldier]]s {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Authority Officer|Authority Officers]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Upper Erisia]]) Named "The Eastern Conflict" *[[Legion Soldier]]s {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} vs [[Authority Officer|Authority Officers]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Upper Erisia]]) Named "Clash of Empires" *[[Legion Captain]] + [[Legion Soldier]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} vs [[Authority Officer|Authority Officers]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[The Viper's Jaw|The Vipers Jaw]]/[[Upper Erisia]]) Named "Clash of Empires"
[[File:Banditcamp.png|thumb|A Bandit Camp in Erisia]]
====Bandit Camp==== A campfire, circled by three NPCs, consisting of two regular [[bandit]]s and one [[Bandit Leader]]. Loot from the chests after killing every bandit is mediocre (as expected, for bandits are farmed by low levels). Occurs at Erisia.
[[File:Banditswithoutcampfire.png|thumb|Wandering bandits]]
====Bandit Ambush==== While in Erisia, there is a chance that three bandits will fall from the sky and ambush you. This event is similar to the Bandit Camp event, but you cannot assassinate the captain, as they automatically aggro onto you. If they spawn on an elevated space or behind an object, it is possible to assassinate the regular bandits, though note gripping their captain will alert them and only downs the captain unless you have the Cutthroat Assassin Talent. Completing this event rewards you with XP and a chest at which where they appeared from. Occurs at Erisia.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Thieves==== A group of three [[Thief|thieves]], recognizable by their black armor and the lack of campfire. They will always wield a dagger. In the event where the player is knocked in their presence, the bandits will mug any downed non bandit or thief for their 56 and saying "Score!" before disappearing into a puff of shadow, leaving the player alive. If the player were to complete this event, the players will be rewarded XP and a chest. Occurs at Erisia. They are the only non-faction hostile NPCs to spare the player intentionally.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Knife to Antler==== Three to four [[Knife of Eylis|Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} hired by the Authority are escorting a captured a [[Navaen Hostage|Navean Nomad Hostage]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}. They wield [[Whaling Knife|Whaling Knives]] and the [[Subtle Knife of Eylis|leader]] of the group has the ability to create an expanding bubble which slows time inside it. Defeating them will reward you with a chest and EXP, but killing them also gives negative [[Reputation]]s in [[The Knives of Eylis|Knives of Eylis]]. Occurs at [[Upper Erisia]]. Occasionally the captain may spawn on his own and without a hostage, only around the Bandit Village. * The hostage is no different from any other Navaen nomad hostage, and you may give them into the [[Eastern Camp Master]].
[[File:Authority Footsoldier.png|thumb|An Authority footsoldier]]
====Authority Scouts==== In [[Upper Erisia]], you may see four Authority members marching back and forth in unison. Two of them will be [[Authority Officer]]s and the other two will be [[Authority Soldier]]s. Defeating them will reward you with EXP and a chest, but killing them also gives negative Authority Reputation. This can be avoided by letting the Soldiers set the corpses on fire, as that will cause them to die without you earning negative rep. They will not automatically engage you if you have neutral reputation.
[[File:LostVillagers.png|thumb|145x145px|Lost villagers]]
====Lost Villagers==== In Upper Erisia, the player can encounter two villager NPCs in Stranded clothes. You will need to bring these NPCs to the [[Alastir|Royal Pathfinder]] at the [[Pathfinder's Respite]]. After doing so, the player will be rewarded a chest and some XP, similar to the Fort Merit rescue quest. Alastir will give you new dialogue options after this. This quest is repeatable. Gripping the NPCs will make them say "Wait, please take us to the shrine!" hinting towards the later use of them.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Mudskipper Emergence==== An encounter limited to Erisia, can happen during any season, contrary to the popular belief that it only happens during Spring and Summer. A group of special [[Mudskipper]]s will emerge from the ground, some of them use a modified Gale Force to push the target back, while the others explode on death, indicated by larger stomachs and a darker green coloration. These explosions instantly execute anyone that has been downed around them. This encounter is made up of three waves. Successfully killing all the Mudskippers will spawn a large chest where the Mudskippers emerged.
[[File:Golden Warrior.png|left|thumb|A Golden Warrior Bouncer in the neutral position.]]
====Golden Warrior==== A fighter hailing from The [[Rat's Den]], recognizable by his gold armor (not to be confused with the Legion), looking for a worthy opponent. He invites the player to a battle to the death, even allowing the player to get 3 free hits before he retaliates. He wields a combat axe and uses Galebreathe. Upon death, he will drop a Gold Plate, five of which can be given to the bouncer at the Rat's Den for a loot chest. Defeating him will grant the player a chest which spawns where he stood. Occurs in Erisia. * See [[Golden Warrior]]
[[File:Hoboclose.png|left|thumb|226x226px|A Hobo in the neutral position.]]
====Hobo==== The Hobo can be found across Erisia and will spawn three chests around him. If you interact with the Hobo, they will brag of their wealth. With 50+ Charisma, you can take one of their chests. If you open one of their chests (you don't have to take the loot), they will yell at you and start to become hostile. Be careful, because he is a very annoying opponent, with Flamecharm and no cooldowns on their Mantra. He is an enemy of all factions. Though, he can be easily taken out if you get it on a wall and get it stunned. The Hobo also uses the old AI of the Flamecharm Songseeker. * See [[Hobo]]
[[File:PathfinderNPC.png|thumb|A Pathfinder]]
====Pathfinder Gathering==== Rarely, the player may find 2 [[Pathfinder (NPC)|Pathfinder]]s sitting around a campfire with a [[Teacher]]. Most people mistake them for bandits and regret it when they see them using Frostdraw mantras. Talking to the teacher will grant the player the ability to upgrade one of their main attributes (Strength, Fortitude, Agility, Intelligence, Willpower, and Charisma) with no cost. This will use one of your investment points. Killing them may reward you with Frigid Prisms. Finishing the dialogue will not reward you with a chest, nor will killing them. Occurs in Erisia. Curiously, they hate all factions and vice versa.
[[File:Erisia Merchant Event.png|250x250px]]
====Erisia Merchant==== A bound Etrean with a [[Pathfinder Cloak]] surrounded by a bandit camp can be found in [[Lower Erisia]]. Killing the bandits without killing the merchant grants a chest containing lower-erisia loot.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Megalodaunt vs Golem==== A [[Megalodaunt]] can be found fighting a [[Rock Golem|Golem]] in [[Upper Erisia]] (especially in [[Burning Stone Gardens|Burning Stone Garden]]). The Golem will almost always win, due to his high damaging spin attack and way higher health pool (1500 HP compared to the Megalodaunt's 900.) If you are low level, use this opportunity to finish off the victor, as it is probably low from the fight.
[[File:Dinner.gif|250px]]
====Feasting Megalodaunt==== A [[Megalodaunt]] feasting on the corpse of an [[Authority Soldier]], found in [[Upper Erisia]]. Stuffs its face until attacked or despawns. When you kill the Megalodaunt, the Authority Solider's corpse will turn into a chest.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Deep Owl==== Sparse cloud of black feathers that gently fall down around an area. Upon entering the feathers, the [[Deep Owl]] will immediately drop down from the sky and open a dialogue with the player. Only spawn in the [[Locations|Etrean Luminant]] while the moon is out or in the [[First Layer]]. An owl also spawns in [[The Lordsgrove]] in a predetermined location but without black feathers as a warning and will automatically attack you.
File:REnounter_BanditAttack_Etris.png|Etris bandits File:REnounter_BanditAttack_Vigils.png|Vigils bandits
====Bandit Attack==== In [[Etris]] two [[bandit]]s can spawn in front of the guards near the entrance. Helping the guards will reward you, giving you XP and reputation. This event does not spawn a chest. This event is triggered to occur when a player comes within range of the entrance so hearing this event without your presence is a blatant sign of another player. There's a small chance for them to drop low tier mantra modifiers. At the [[Isle of Vigils]], they spawn on a bridge leading to the [[Barber]] shop.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Brainsucker Swarm==== An event that happens in [[Starswept Valley]] or [[Minityrsa]]. Two [[Brainsucker]]s spawn in mid air and swarm their prey, all dive bombing them at once. Killing them spawns a chest in the fitted area.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Ministry Necromancer==== Exclusive to [[Minityrsa]], this is a unique humanoid enemy that is able to use [[Shadowcast]] and summon two special Mudskippers; the [[Redskipper]] and [[Blueskipper]] consisting of one than can use [[Flamecharm]] and another that can use [[Frostdraw]]. They will spawn in a medatitive position, and will only be aggro'd if it sees a player or provoked by an attack.

Eastern Luminant

====Fight between Factions==== Groups of NPCs from different factions will spawn in Eastern Luminant and attack each other. Helping a side will usually reward you with their respective reputation. *[[Summer Company Guard]]s {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} vs [[Ignition Union Fighter]]s {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} ([[Summer Isle]]/[[Miner's Landing]]/[[Saramaed Summit]]) *[[Eastern Nomad]] + [[Eastern Nomad Leader]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} vs [[Ministry Scout]]s {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} ([[Summer Isle]]) *[[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Hive Scout]]s {{FactionIcon|Hive}} ([[Starswept Valley]]) *[[Legion Captain]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} vs [[Authority Lieutenant]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Starswept Valley]]) *[[Golem Constructs|Hive Construct]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}} vs [[Authority Captain]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} ([[Starswept Valley]])
[[File:Flamercharmermonk.png|175px]]
====Songseeker==== In the [[Songseeker Wilds]], a Songseeker may spawn anywhere on the island. They can be seen meditating, but will aggro onto you if you enter their line of sight or you attack them. They will be using one of four elements, which will be [[Flamecharmer Monk|Flamecharm]], [[Frostdrawer Monk|Frostdraw]], [[Thundercaller Monk|Thundercall]] or [[Songseeker Galebreather|Galebreathe]]. They cannot be assassinated. Defeating them will reward you with a good chunk of XP and a chest.
[[File:Maljuror.png|175px]]
====Maljuror==== In the [[Ancient Rotlands]], [[Maljuror]]s may spawn. They utilize the [[Flamecharm]] [[Attunement]] and wield the [[Kindred Edict]] weapon. [[Maljuror]] may spawn handcuffed, or unhandcuffed, but the drops remains the same. Killing them grants the player a [[Chests & Sacks|chest]] with [[Songseeker Wilds]] loot and either a [[Mantra Modifiers#Sparks|Spark]] or with a small chance the [[Kindred Edict]]. *See [[Maljuror]]
[[File:Legion_Captain_Hostile.png|200x200px]]
====Legion Sniper==== A single [[Legion Sniper]] will spawn in [[Starswept Valley]]. Killing him will reward the player with XP and a chest, but also negative [[reputation]] with [[The Hundred Legions]]. He can be talked to (with a good reputation) and can also be used to obtain a recommendation for [[Legion Kata]] if you have already helped at least two [[Legion Captain]]s in their respective events.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Summer Isle Bandit Raid==== Groups of bandits engage the guards of [[Summer Isle]] in various locations. There are two main types: * Regular bandit raid: Three bandits, the type of bandits is random, can range from three Bandit Captains to two Captains and one regular to just three regular bandits. * Greater bandit raid: Seven or so regular bandits that spawn on the steps.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Ministry Massacre==== A single Ministry scout, sitting around a campfire in Summer Isle, surrounded by the corpses of bandits. Killing them will reward you with EXP and the campfire will turn into a chest.
[[File:SharkoTragedy.png|250px]]
====Megalodaunt vs Crimson Megalodaunt==== Exclusive to the [[Songseeker Wilds]]. This is a rare event involving a regular Megalodaunt fighting its red variant. If left by themselves, the red one will always win. Red Megalodaunts have 3x it's normal HP and being able to rain fire swords.
[[File:AuthorityMeteor.png|318x318px]]
====Meteor Isle Authority Raid==== Two [[Authority Soldier]]s will attack [[Meteor Isle]]. Killing them does not grant negative reputation with [[The Central Authority]] nor does it grant positive reputation with [[The Children of Navae]]. This event rewards the player with a mediocre chest and XP.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Meteor Isle Meteor ''(Vaulted)''==== A meteor will hit [[Meteor Isle]], spawning [[Mudskipper Knight|Mudskipper Knights]] in waves. Killing all of them will despawn the meteor and award XP and a golden chest at the center of the meteor.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Alpha Megalodaunt vs Desert Knight==== Seemingly exclusive to the [[Starswept Valley]], this event spawns an [[Megalodaunt#Alpha Megalodaunt|Alpha Megalodaunt]] and a [[Stone Knight#Desert Knight|Desert Knight]], making them fight. If left by themselves, the Desert Knight will almost always win, due to it having almost double the health of an Alpha Megalodaunt.
[[File:SharkoShip.png|391x391px]]
====Megalodaunt On a Ship==== A [[Megalodaunt]] can spawn on a schooner in the [[The Aratel Sea|Aratel Sea]], feasting on a the corpse of an [[Authority Soldier]]. Upon killing it, a chest will spawn in the ship with mid tier loot.
==Sea Events== Across the Luminants, events will appear in the seas. Some are challenges, some are rewards. ==== Fights between Factions ==== [[Etrean Soldier]]s {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} vs [[Knife of Eylis|Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} ([[The Aratel Sea]]/[[The Etrean Sea]])

Etrean/Eastern Luminant

Various islands appear on the sea with various enemies. After defeating all enemies, two chests will spawn, one on the island and one visible after the island is sunk. Different islands have different loot tables. |-|Tower in the Water= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A Pirate outpost stands on the sea. Inside the tower are 5-6 [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s. Killing all of them will give two Erisia-tier chests. *The tower may spawn [[Cloaked Assassin]]s instead of [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s in the Eastern Luminant.
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:WaterTower.png|thumb|right|
A tower in the sea.
]] |} |-|Isle of Outlaws= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
The stones on both sides of the island cover the central hut like a pair of hands, which has been occupied by illegals. Defeating all of them will reward you with two large chests of [[Upper Erisia]] loot. Possible Enemies:[[Blacksteel Pirate]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]]/[[Bounty Hunter (NPC)]]
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheHandsIsland.png|thumb|right|
You can't get into that hut anyway, don't try.
]] |} |-|Fort= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
An outpost, the ruins of a tropical fortress resembling [[Fort Merit]] occupied by multiple enemies. Defeating all of them will reward you with one large chest of Authority loot and one large chest of Erisia loot. Possible Enemies:[[Thresher]]/[[Blacksteel Pirate]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]].
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheFortIsland.png|thumb|right|
A Fort Island
]] |} |-|The Depth Fragment= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A rotten island floats out of the depth, with a hand-shaped stone covered in coral and mushrooms. Defeating all of the mobs will reward you with one large chest of [[First Layer|Depths]] loot and one large chest of Erisia loot. Possible Enemies: [[Mudskipper|Bloatskipper]]/[[Carbuncle]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]]/[[Mudskipper Brute]]
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheDepthIsland.png|thumb|right|
They really like hands, huh?
]] |} |-|The Church Ruins Island= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A rotten island floats out of the depth, with a hand-shaped stone covered in coral and mushrooms. Defeating all of the mobs will reward you with one large chest of [[First Layer|Depths]] loot and one large chest of Erisia loot. Possible Enemies: [[Mudskipper|Bloatskipper]]/[[Carbuncle]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]]/[[Mudskipper Brute]]
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheChurchRuinsIsland.png|thumb|right|
Fortunately, they all end up the same - occupied by bandits.
]] |} |-|Bandits' Respite= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
An island with a few trees temporarily being used as a bandit camp. Defeating the bandits will reward you with two Erisia chests. There are two variations of this island.
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheBanditIsland.png|thumb|right|
A Bandit Island
]] |} |-|Sandstone Tower= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A sand island contains ruin of a sandstone tower and withered trees. Defeating all enemies on it will give you two chests filled with [[Starswept Valley]] loot. Possible Enemies:[[Thresher]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]]/[[Bounty Hunter (NPC)]]
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheSandTowerIsland.png|thumb|right|
]] |} |-|Sandy Remnants= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A sand island contains ruin of a sandstone tower and withered trees. Defeating all enemies on it will give you two chests filled with [[Starswept Valley]] loot. Possible Enemies:[[Thresher]]/[[Cloaked Assassin]]/[[Bounty Hunter (NPC)]]
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:TheMiniAratelIsland.png|thumb|right|
]] |} |-|Mudskipper Hive= {| style="width:100%;" | style="vertical-align:top;" |
A corrosive island filled with mushrooms, corals, and a distinctive tower atop it. Depending on the variant of the island, different [[Mudskipper]]s can spawn with the addition of a [[Mudskipper Brute]]s or [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] (Eastern Luminant only). Defeating them will grant a Depths Chest and an Erisia Chest.
| style="width:1px; vertical-align:top;" | [[File:Mudskipper hive.png|thumb|right|
]] |}
File:Traveling Merchant.png|Bottom deck. File:Traveling Merchant Ship.png|The ship's flags. File:MerchantShip WeaponOnly.png|Merchant ship with only a weapon being sold.
====Travelling Merchant==== A light-blue [[Chili|Merchant Schooner]] can spawn in the seas, selling random items in it's bottom deck. This can include books, cooked food, weapons, armor, Tools and very rarely, Dye Packets. * See the full item list in [[Travelling Merchant]]. * These are commonly referred to as "Merchant Ships"
[[File:REncounter_FalseMerchantShip.png|190px]]
====False Merchant Ship==== A merchant ship that spawns with a black flag and a ramp entrance on the bottom deck. This is pretty rare, and drops high tier loot. When approached, the boat will burst into flames and spawn 3-8 [[Cloaked Assassin]]s after you. Can be identified via whether or not the antiquarian is in its usual position. If it ain't there, be prepared.
[[File:Weird_Trader.png|175px]]
====Weird Trader==== A [[Boats|Dinghy]] with a lone [[Ganymede]]. Upon talking to him, he asks you to give him three random items. Any of which could be a [[Weapons|weapon]], [[Mantra Modifiers|mantra ingredient]], or [[Ingredients|ingredient]]. Falsely claiming to have the items he asks for will send you up flying from his uppercut, dealing high damage. However if you give him the specific items he asks for, he'll reward you with a random item. See the [[Weird Trader]] page for more info. He seems to be talking in broken english, without the use of proper grammar. * See [[Weird Trader]]
[[File:DiverOutpost.png]]
====Supply the Diver Expedition==== One [[Diver Quartermaster]] and three [[Journeyman Diver Guard|Diver Journeymen]] spawn on an outpost at The Aratel Sea, interacting with the Quartermaster will start a quest where you have to bring in supplies from [[Port Merit]] back to the outpost in exchange for 1 [[Knowledge]] and the [[Armorer's Needle]] relic or [[Smith's Alloy]] relic. The supply crate will not spawn unless the Quartermaster has been spoken to. The Divers will return to the depths once this event is completed. *WARNING: Dropping the supply crate into the ocean will softlock the quest; both the Quartermaster and Journeymen can die to mobs, also softlocking the quest. Do not attempt to drop the crate into the center of the structure; it'll drown the supply crate.
[[File:Old_Stranger.png|175px]]
====Old Stranger==== A [[Boats|Dinghy]] with a lone [[Khan]]. He requests a canteen of clean water. When fulfilling his request, he rewards the player with [[Murmur: Ardour]]. * Having the Talent Condensation Drip will also allow the player to obtain the Murmur without a canteen. * He will also accept a [[Redd|Redd Juice]] instead of a canteen of water.

The Depths (Scyphozia)

[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Mudskipper Attack==== In the Diver Camp in [[First Layer|Scyphozia]], three Mudskippers can spawn in front of the guards. Helping the guards will reward you, giving you XP and reputation. This event does not spawn a chest.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Divers vs Monster==== One, two or three divers taking on a monster in [[The Depths]]. With larger numbers, they might have a chance of beating certain foes, but if the monster is corrupted, they will likely always lose. Strangely, they seem to only win against Alpha Megalodaunts. This event can also appear on the surface in [[The Aratel Sea]] (Not just in [[Starswept Valley]] or [[The Depths]]) very rarely.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Faction Ambush==== A randomly occurring event in which bounty hunters or faction soldiers will ambush you without warning. Beware as these events can occur ''anywhere'' in the overworld with a few exceptions. Bounty hunters will spawn for players with good rep with all factions and faction soldiers for the specific faction which you have ''Hunted'' or below reputation with. Enemies will be in trios or solo and will be scaled off your current level. Beware as these enemies possess powerful weapons, mantras, and even Oaths. * See [[Faction Ambushes]]
==Unique Events== These events are fixed at a certain place or time or are extremely rare.
[[File:Forgotten Villagers.png|thumb|Forgotten Villagers]]
====Raid on Erisor's Church==== A group of three [[Forgotten Villager|villager]] NPCs spawn around a campfire in [[Erisor's Church]]. Skeptical of Alastir's intentions due to his allegiance to the Duke, they ask the player for help, but then hear something outside. After some time, three waves of five [[Bandit Leader|Bandit Captains]] will spawn. The NPCs then rush to take them on, using fists to fight. The waves spawn at set timings rather than after the previous one's completion, so they can quickly overwhelm the NPCs and players. Despite the Villager's possessing a larger health pool and better combat AI, the bandits will overpower and grip them. Ironically, a [[Rock Golem]] will spawn and then wipe out the bandits. It will then face away from the church in the direction of the path leading to it. It can be fought by the player or will alternatively despawn on its own. It can be easily cheesed due to it not being able to enter the church and its laser being blocked by the walls, making it a good spot to grind weapon exp by parrying its spin with minimal danger. If the villagers survived, a chest will spawn once you kill the golem. As the villagers do not trust Alastir, you cannot turn them in for a chest. To get the event to spawn, you must interact with the villager on the left. You can also get the event chest just by pushing the left villager NPC out of the view of the bandits, and then speaking to them (This will only work if the bandits have spawned, and the villager hasn't noticed the bandits)
[[File:EtrisEvent.png|250px]]
====Cinders of Etris==== The [[The Authority|Authority]]'s invasion of [[Etris]] is a rare disaster event. The event is foretold by a chat bubble from some NPCs around Etris before the event actually begins. '''More information can be found [[Cinders of Etris|here]].''' The raid can be identified by the presence of Authority NPCs, specifically the Authority Soldiers, Officers, Peacekeepers and the Authority Warden within Etris, as well as the town being set on fire and covered by a large grey cloud of smoke. In this event, Authority NPC will fight Etrean Guards, Royal Guards and Polis, the latter being a very strong NPC. If left alone, the Authority is capable of winning due to their superior mantras and larger numbers. Once the event is fully completed by killing all Authority NPCs, three large chest will spawn near the large tree in the middle of the town. These chests contain high tier loot, including end game weapons, [[Deep Gems]], legendary rings, and is one of the few sources of the [[Justicar]] and [[Royal Etrean Guard]] armor schematics. During this event, most regular NPCs from the town will not be available. If you want higher chance for the raid to happen, join a new server that has "???" as its age. Wait at least two minutes at the Etris Docks. If you see the guard talking about the Authority, the raid will happen. Otherwise, leave and repeat. Note that the event won't happen if it's Winter.
[[File:Aelita_On_a_Rock.png|325px]]
====Aelita==== [[Aelita]] spawns in the center rock in the Valley of Heroes during a non-winter season. (She is a [[Felinor]] with the [[Oath: Visionshaper|Visionshaper]] [[Oaths|Oath]], which is why her eyes are purple.) When talking to her, she prompts you to play a game, which you can't refuse. The rules are simple, no killing, and all her orders must be followed. The first order is to use a mantra, the second order is to choose a clone that isn't her (One whose eyes that are not purple), and the third and final order is to choose her (A clone with purple eyes). Successfully completing a game will give you a small portion of EXP and gives dialogue hinting to the Winter [[Snow Knight|Blizzard Knight]] event.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Akira==== An uncommon event that only spawns in [[The Depths]] within the Celtorian Wastes. While reading a book, he will be interrupted by a group of [[Ignition Union]] soldiers, telling him to leave the area. In an act of defiance, Akira draws a line of ice with his Ice Wisp and dares the soldiers to cross the line, which they do. Akira will use his Resonance to pop their heads. The player can interact with Akira if they have neutral or good [[reputation]] with [[The Divers]]. Having a bad reputation or taking the wrong dialogue option result in the same fate to the player. After taking the right option, Akira can be found at [[Castle Light]], where he can be talked to again to obtain the origin Deepbound. If the player were to have 100 charisma, you can side with The Union and insult him. You will not be gripped and Akira will flee. However this means he will not be able to let you join his faction. Doing this with anything less than 100 Charisma will get you killed. * See [[Akira]]
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====Blizzard Knights==== Blizzard Knights is an event that only occurs in Winter, encountered in the Valley of Heroes of Minityrsa. The [[Stone Knight|Blizzard Knights]] are huge monsters, sporting a white body, red eyes, and a menacing red sword. They're a stronger version of the Stone Knight; having more health, completely disabling healing from Bloodless gems, and spawning in a group of six. Once entering the main area, your screen will start shaking as giant blue meteors come crashing from the sky. Upon impact, these meteors will explode into the aforementioned Blizzard Knights. Defeating the whole group will spawn a chest near the frozen river that's guaranteed to contain at least one of the five Hero Blades and/or possibly one of the many variants of the Ministry Cloak.
[[File:Rogue Construct.png|250px]]
====Rogue Construct==== Upon the ice lake atop of [[Minityrsa]], next to the [[Valley of Heroes]], a [[Golem Constructs|Rogue Construct]] will spawn.
[[File:Meat Lord.png|200px]]
====The Meat Lord==== [[The Meat Lord]] is a merchant NPC that can appear on [[Starswept Valley]] and more rarely in [[Upper Erisia]], [[Pathfinder's Respite]], [[Saramaed Summit]], [[Songseeker Wilds]], [[Temple of the Forgotten Flame]], [[The Garden Reservoir]], [[The Hidden Village]], [[Towerstruck Lands]], [[Viper's Jaw]] and, [[Summer Isle]]. He offers a selection of 3 of several meat-based food to the player in exchange for 2 notes each. You must bow down every time you buy from him or else he will ignore you.
[[File:Deepwoken_stranger.png|250px]]
====Stranger NPC==== An incredibly rare event which has only been spotted in [[Erisia]] so far. A [[Ministry Scout]] will reveal themselves with the Tacet effect, revealed sitting down. If you have 50 Charisma, you can initiate a dialogue to gain the murmur [[Murmur: Tacet]] without having to go through the 5 grips. If you do not have the requirements, the dialogue will start a fight. Incredibly glitchy, with some who have fought him even reporting that he can't be gripped/executed.
[[File:Placeholder.png]]
====The Depths Collapse==== The ceilings of [[The Depths|Scyphozia]] shake as huge earthquakes rumble through the First Layer causing meteors to rain from above. 2-4 boulders slam down landing near the player and spawn monsters from each impact. These range from [[Thresher]]s, [[Megalodaunt]]s, and [[Deep Owl]]s to even [[Nautilodaunt]]s. These monsters are frequently hostile to each other and are eligible to be corrupted. After you killed all the mobs, a chest will spawn for each boulder that the event spawned. The loot has an extremely high likelihood of having at least one [[Outfits|Master Schematic]] and [[Mantra Modifiers|Deep Gem]] per chest.
[[File:Star_Knight_Dialogue.png|175px]]
====Resonant Dawn==== A meteor crashes down into the area, spawning a [[Star Knight]]. Defeating it allows the player to obtain their [[Resonance]] for free from the meteor. ('''Beware, interacting with the meteor while having a Resonance will reroll it without the option to keep the old one''') You cannot choose your resonance. The Star Knight also drops an Astral [[Enchant Stone]]. This event has been seen around [[Saramaed Summit]], [[Summer Isle]], [[Starswept Valley|Starswept]] Valley, [[Minityrsa]], [[Simforea]], and in [[Voidsea]]. When this event spawns in {{iv|Vow of Iron}}, it grants a murmur instead of a resonance/ This event is '''VERY RARE''' and the odds of it happening are near zero. You have a better chance just getting Resonance yourself.
[[File:MimicTerrapod.gif]]
====Mimic==== A special chest can spawn at a very rare chance. Upon opening, it will spawn either a [[Megalodaunt]], [[Terrapod]], [[Thresher]], or a [[Nautilodaunt]]. * A white particle trail is emitted from mimic chests, as a way to differentiate them between normal chests. This may be hard to see while the chest is closed.
[[Category:Mechanics]]

==Description==
Raphael is a mysterious [[Celtor]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He offers the player the unfinished quest to find 'Morning'.

Based on his dialogue after accepting the quest but not completing it, it can be assumed that he works for some sort of shadow organization. It is hinted that he is a member of [[The Ministry]] as he has different dialogue with neutral or higher Ministry Reputation.

Raphael is located in [[The City of the Drowned]] inside a building within the [[Varicosa District]].

==Description== Bridging the gap between Medium and Light weapons, the Rapier [[Light Weapons|Light Weapon]] class boast the Swing Speed and Range of Swords with the dexterity of Daggers. These weapons are traditionally locked to the One Handed stance. ==PvE Mechanics== Using a weapon attack within 1 second of parrying an attack will riposte your opponent, adding a secondary damage instance to the attack that deals 25% of your hit's total damage. title: Rat's Den
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Rat's Den|territory=The Golden Rats|lawless=true|caption=A little tavern under a ruin harbors what remains of a once lucrative business.}}
[[File:Rat's Den New.png|thumb|900px|center]]
'''Rat's Den''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken.'' It is a landmark in [[Burning Stone Gardens]] found in [[Upper Erisia]].

==Overview ==
Rat's Den appears as a ruined house on the surface. However, underground, a second floor/basement that resembles a tavern bar or pub filled with Golden Rat fighters. The area around Rat's Den is absorbed by the disembodied cheering of an audience.

Outside, the Golden Bouncer will tell you to enter. If you obtain 5 Gold Plates and talk to him, he will reward you with a mid-tier [[Chests & Sacks|chest]].
==Potential Enemies==

== Trivia==

*The bouncer in front of the establishment has tons of health yet will not grip you. Use him as farming fodder.   
** The bouncer also has the Soulwrought Axe on his back, which is a weapon from the [[Crazy Slots]] Resonance.
*The [[Golden Warrior]]s likely originate from here.

* A sound that sounds like "eerie cheering and wind in the distance" can be heard radiating from a support beam in the bar area.
* You can break the leftmost wall in the back to open an unintended area that is underneath the map. Doesn't actually provide any utility but it's neat!

title: Rat Fighter
content:
{{EnemyInfobox|image1=Rat Fighter.png|health=1000|drops=[[Gold Plate]]|weapon=[[Soulwrought Axe]]|moves=*Assault *Critical *Gale Lunge *Heavenly Wind *Astral Wind|caption1=They ALL know what you did.}} ==Description== Rat Fighters, not to be confused with the [[Golden Warrior]], are exclusively found in the [[Rat's Den]], a sub-location of [[Erisia]]. They wear a [[Goldleaf Helm]], [[Warden Pauldrons]], a [[dye]]d [[Steel Plate]] outfit and a pair of [[Flameguard Boots]]. Rat Fighters drop a [[Gold Plate]] upon being killed, of which 5 can be turned in to the [[Golden Rat Bouncer]] for mid-tier Erisia loot. ==Moveset== Their arsenal consists of a [[Soulwrought Axe]] and the [[Galebreathe]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Raises axe upward before slamming it down to the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Gale Lunge'''
(★★☆) |User lunges forward with their weapon coated in wind. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Heavenly Wind'''

==Description==
The Razor Cutlass is a rare [[Weapons#Medium_Weapons|Medium Weapon]] primarily found in the [[Starswept Valley]], [[Songseeker Wilds]] and [[Minityrsa]]. It can also be found in [[The Depths|Depths]] chests or dropped by the [[Crimson Terrapod]].

Being a medium weapons that deals bleed on top of its normal attacks, the Razor Cutlass is effective at dealing very high damage with the {{cl|bleed|bleed}} effect and good PEN.

It may be crafted into an [[Umbrite Witherblade]] with 3 [[Umbrite]], a [[Dormant Splinter]] and itself in [[The Cold Forge]].

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

Gain stacks of {{etal|weapon|Continuous Bleed}} upon landing a critical attack, flourish, or uppercut. Stack gain has a 1.5 second cooldown, and each stack has an independent 15 second duration. Each stack reduces your {{status|Bleed|bleed}} damage by 5%, but grants an additional bleed damage tick. On the first stack, this equates to a net increase of +26.7% bleed damage. This has diminishing returns for each stack you have, peaking at a 179% net bleed damage increase on the 16th and 17th stacks, and then decaying from the 18th stack onwards, though it is functionally impossible to reach this many stacks.

[https://www.desmos.com/calculator/qlbcvgz9yr Desmos calculator]

content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Relic
|image=Reciprocal Bonecharm.png
|type=Effigy
|rarity=Relic
|obtainment=*[[Scion of Ethiron]]
*[[Lysander Spellhardt]]
|desc=A fleshbound [[Kyrsan]] effigy of [[Ethiron]]al worship. As their minds and focuses were robbed, their precise artisanry was twisted into a feverish production of foul convolutions of the organic. Peering into the beady eyes of the bonecharm, you see an early Ethironal shrine; unfinished, misshapen taxidermies lining the walls like an abattoir.
|droppable=No
|bankable=No
|usage=Teleporting the user to the [[Second Layer]].
|stack=10
|value=N/A}}
==Description==
The Reciprocal Bonecharm is a consumable [[Relic]] with '''10 uses'''. Reciprocal Bonecharm's usage is teleporting you to the [[Second Layer]]. Short cooldown upon usage.

Upon usage, the user will be prompted to select a location:
*If using this Relic outside of the Second Layer:
*# Sanctuary Outskirts (Second Layer: Floor 1)
*If using this Relic inside of the Second Layer:
*# Sanctuary Outskirts (Second Layer: Floor 1)
*# Shrine of Arrival (Second Layer: Floor 2) 

A teleportation circle will appear below the user's feet, and after a short delay, you '''and a maximum of 4 other players''' will be teleported directly to your chosen location.

==Gallery==
<gallery>

</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Assuming you had one previously, you will '''keep your Light Hook''' and it's current duration (even if it was above 10 minutes) when using this to skip the first floor.
*Reciprocal Bonecharm is located in the utility category in your inventory rather than the Relic category.
*Reciprocal Bonecharm was added alongside [[Baneful Syrinx]] and [[Ouroboral Husk]] in the same update, with all three Relics having the same function of teleporting the user to specific locations.
*Reciprocal Bonecharm can be used in the Overworld or the [[First Layer]] to teleport yourself directly into the Second Layer.

The Reclaimer is the only way the player is able to increase their power and gain further abilities regarding their [[Mementos]]. They also provide information on how to unlock new Mementos. They're an Aspen [[Gremor]] in stage 2 of aging (50-59 years old). They wear the [[Light's Final Toll]] beads on their arm, a [[Canticlysm Pendant]], and an [[Adventurer Coat]]. Additionally, they wear a pair of [[geta]]. They also have pink irises. ==Location== The Reclaimer is found in {{iv|The Cerebral Spire}}, {{iv|Fragments of Else}} and {{iv|Cerebral Requiem}}. ==Shop UI== {{ShopTable|newtable |title=Recollection |name=Power Recall |desc=Increase your Power and access more of the memories within your Memento. |notes= |currency=Notes |price=500 }} {{ShopTable|end |name=Ability Recall |currency= |price= |desc=Expand you arsenal of abilities by retrieving them from your Memento. |notes= }} {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|The Cerebral Spire= {{#tag:tabber|Base Dialogue= {{#tag:tabber|Non-Powercapped= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Well met, Inheritor. [[File:Reclaimer Dialogue 1.ogg]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How am I to proceed? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}As best you can, you must live out the memories of the one who created your Memento. Many of the Circle made their way to the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}, found at Aratel's peak, not far from the Viridian Sanctuary estate belonging to the Etrean Royalists. I believe a powerful foe may lie in wait there, so be prepared.

As you witnessed after facing the Shogun's memory, a warrior from the Etrean resistance against Zi'eer mentioned that you should make your way to the Golden Rat. There, allies of our cause once gathered, seeking to learn how to pierce the barrier surrounding Zi'eer's palace from a man who called himself 'the Rat King'.

== Description ==
The '''Red Death''' is a Legendary [[Bloodrend]]-[[Shadowcast]] Spear; a vile tool used by [[Ministry Heartspiller]]s to aid in ruthless interrogation tactics while also leaving no trace of the target's organic remains and ether. It can be dropped from the [[Ministry Heartspiller]]. It is also sold by [[Traan Zakshun]] in the black market rotation for {{c|crowns|4}}. 

The Red Death comes with a passive ability: 

*  '''No Trace Behind''' - When executing a humanoid, they will shake and turn transparent for a few seconds before disappearing in a black smoke, leaving no trace behind.

== Critical ==
<gallery>
File:RedDeathStandingCrit.gif|Standing Critical
File:RedDeathStandingCritAngle.gif|Standing Critical (Side View)
File:RedDeathRunningCrit.gif|Running Critical
File:RedDeathRunningCritAngle.gif|Running Critical (Side View)
</gallery>
The Red Death has two criticals.

For the standing critical, the user raises the spear, summoning six stakes of blood and shadows wherever the user is facing. All of the hits inflict both Blood Poisoning and Shadow.

For the running critical, the user rapidly thrusts the spear while slowly moving forward, inflicting Blood Poisoning every time the target is hit, ending with a final blow that inflicts both Blood Poisoning and Shadow. The user then raises their hand, summoning three stakes that also inflict both Blood Poisoning and Shadow.

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''8 seconds.'''

{{text|m1leg2}}

== Trivia ==
*The weapon's original design was based on a fence post.<ref>[[File:RedDeathFence.png|252x252px]]</ref>
*The name is based on the 'Red Death' from the 'Destiny' franchise.<ref>[[File:DestinyReference.png]]</ref>
**Both weapons have no correlation besides their name and being themed around blood.
*The emblem of [[The Ministry]] is set below the crossguard of the spear.
*Two weeks after the Red Death was released, it was given a visual rework alongside its running critical.

title: References and Easter Eggs
content:
'''CONTAINS SPOILERS FOR MULTIPLE MEDIA!!!'''
==Description== This is a page dedicated to all of the easter eggs and references to other works of media found in Deepwoken. Be warned that this may spoil many of the referenced media to you. View at your own risk. ==Outfits and Equipment== * The style of the '''Double Strapped Hat''' seems to take inspiration from ''{{W|Bloodborne}}''. * The '''Providence Coat''' looks similar to [[w:c:devilmaycry:Dante|Dante's]] coat from the ''{{W|Devil May Cry}}'' series. * The mod spec Outfit '''[[Hive Leader's Garment]]''' along with the [[Hive Greatlord's Royal Adornment|companion hat]] is [[w:c:genshin-impact:The Balladeer|Scaramouche's]] outfit from open world RPG ''{{W|Genshin Impact}}''. *The Outfit '''Black Diver's''' original design was [[w:c:madeinabyss:Bondrewd|Bondrewd's]] outfit from ''{{W|Made in Abyss}}''. **Made even more apparent when combining it with a [[Diver's Light Plate]]. *The [[Big Alchemist's Hat]] and its [[Alchemist's Hat|smaller version]] are a reference to [[w:c:darksouls:Big Hat Logan|Big Hat Logan]] from ''{{W|Dark Souls (video game)|Dark Souls}}''. *Master Thief Earrings are very similar to those of Chrollo Lucifer from ''{{W|Hunter × Hunter}}''. *The Flameguard Pauldrons may be a reference to the armor the Fire Nation wears in ''{{W|Avatar: The Last Airbender}}''. *The Wheel Pendant is a reference to [[w:c:skyrim:Azura's Star|Azura's Star]] from ''{{W|The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim}}''. *The Outfit Veteran Adventurer is a reference to [[w:c:guiltygear:Sol Badguy|Sol Badguy's]] outfit from ''{{W|Guilty Gear Strive}}''. *Every Familiar Helmet from the Hallowtide event are helmets taken from ''[[w:c:rogue-lineage|Rogue Lineage]]''. **Church Knight's helmet is the '''Familiar Priest Helmet,''' the Wraith Knight helmet is the '''Familiar Heretic Helmet,''' and the Sigil Helmet is the '''Familiar Knight Helmet''', respectively. *Every [[Mushroom Costume]] is a direct reference to the [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Scroom|Scroom]] race from ''Rogue Lineage''. ==Attunements== ===Flamecharm=== *'''Flame of Denial''' and '''Flame Within''' are inspired by similar spells in ''Dark Souls''. **'''Flame of Denial''' works similarly to [[w:c:darksouls:Tears of Denial|Tears of Denial]]. **'''Flame Within''' works similarly to [[w:c:darksouls:Power Within|Power Within]]. *'''Flame Blind''' is inspired by [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/agents/phoenix/ Phoenix's] Curve Ball ability in ''{{W|Valorant}}'', blinding anyone who looks at the exploding projectile. **Moreover, the Talent deck Duelist Flame refer to [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/agents/phoenix/ Phoenix's] role in the game, being a duelist. *There are a handful of references to ''{{W|Jujutsu Kaisen}}''. **'''Flame Ballista''' is directly lifted from [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Sukuna|Ryomen Sukuna's]] "Divine Flame" move that he used against [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Jogo|Jogo]] and [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga|Mahoraga]]. **'''Flame Repulsion's''' Spring Spark modification strongly resembles [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Satoru Gojo|Satoru Gojo's]] [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Cursed Technique Reversal: Red|Reversal Red]]. *'''Flaming Scourge''' is inspired by [[w:c:onepiece:Charlotte Katakuri|Katakuri]]'s Buzz Cut Mochi from ''{{W|One Piece}}''. ===Thundercall=== *'''Lightning Cloak''' is a possible reference to [[w:c:hunterxhunter:Killua Zoldyck|Killua]]'s Godspeed ability from ''Hunter × Hunter'' as it used to be blue, making it almost identical. ** The name also matches up and works nearly the same as the [[w:c:naruto:Lightning Release Chakra Mode|"Lightning Release Chakra Mode" Jutsu]] from ''{{W|Naruto}}'', often called "Cloak of Lightning". *'''Grand Javelin''' is inspired by the Lightning Spear spells: [[w:c:darksouls:Lightning Spear|Lightning Spear]], [[w:c:darksouls:Great Lightning Spear|Great Lightning Spear]], and [[w:c:darksouls:Sunlight Spear|Sunlight Spear]] in ''Dark Souls''. *'''Bolt Piercer''' is a reference to Ishida Uryu's [[w:c:bleach:Licht Regen#Variations|Licht Regen]] from ''{{W|Dark Souls (video game)|Bleach}}''. This becomes more apparent with the Surge path. *'''Lightning Assault''' might be a possible reference to [[w:c:kimetsu-no-yaiba:Zenitsu Agatsuma|Zenitsu]]'s [[w:c:kimetsu-no-yaiba:Zenitsu Agatsuma#Techniques|Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash]] from ''Demon Slayer.'' **It also bears striking resemblance to the spell [[w:c:wizardoflegend:Shock Assault|Shock Assault]] from ''{{W|Wizard Of Legend}}'', having a similar name and similar effects. *'''Spark Swap''' is a reference to the snap version of [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Celeritas|Celeritas]] from ''Rogue Lineage''. Both abilities share the same utility, and both have a similar sound effects and lightning visuals on usage. *Contrary to popular belief, '''Rising Thunder''' was not based on [[w:c:kimetsu-no-yaiba:Zenitsu Agatsuma|Zenitsu]]'s Thunderclap and Flash Sixfold, but rather [[w:c:naruto:Kakashi Hatake|Kakashi's]] [[w:c:naruto:Lightning Cutter: Double Lightning Quake|Raikiri: Sōraishin]] from the videogame ''{{W|Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm}}''.[[File:DexKashi.png|200px]] ===Frostdraw=== *The '''Ice Skate''' Mantra is a reference to [[w:c:disney:Frozone|Frozone]] from ''{{W|The Incredibles}}'', along with freezing ability being used to skate around. **Previously, there was an advanced/legendary Talent with the same name, allowing the user of '''Ice Skates''' to skate on solid ground. *The '''Ice Chains''' mantra looks similar to [[w:c:typemoon:Gilgamesh#Primary|Gilgamesh's]] [[w:c:typemoon:Enkidu (Noble Phantasm)|Chains of Heaven]] from the ''{{W|Fate/stay night|Fate}}'' series. *'''Warden's Blades''' is a reference to [[w:c:devilmaycry:Vergil|Vergil's]] [[w:c:devilmaycry:Summoned Swords|Summoned Swords]] from the ''{{W|Devil May Cry}}'' series. *'''Iceberg''' is a reference to [[w:c:overwatch:Mei|Mei's Cryo-Freeze]] ability from ''{{W|Overwatch (video game)|Overwatch}}''. ===Galebreathe=== *The '''Aerogliding''' Talent is a reference to Jett, from ''Valorant'', whose passive ability which allows her to glide instead of falling. *'''Wind Forge''' modified with a Multiplying Spark is a reference to [[w:c:typemoon:Gilgamesh#Noble Phantasms|Gilgamesh's Noble Phantasm "Gate of Babylon"]] from the ''Fate'' series. ===Shadowcast=== *'''Shadow Gun''' resembles the finger [[w:c:bleach:Cero|Cero]] technique used by Arrancars from ''Bleach''. **A '''Shadow Gun''' modified with a Blast Spark resembles the [[w:c:bleach:Cero Metralleta|Cero Metralleta]] used by [[w:c:bleach:Coyote Starrk|Coyote Stark]], especially when coupled with guns. **It is also possibly a reference to Duelist Dash from ''Rogue Lineage'', a move used by the [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Duelist|Duelist]], better known as Uber Spy, Class. *'''Eclipse Kick''' resembles the Axe Kick, an attack from ''Rogue Lineage'' used by the [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Oni|Oni]] class. **Oni itself is a reference to [[w:c:streetfighter:Akuma|Akuma]], one of the characters from ''{{W|Street Fighter}}''. *'''Shadow Assault''' resembles Akuma's [[w:c:streetfighter:Ashura Senku|Ashura Senku]] technique. **Its Blast Spark modification is a spin on the famed [[w:c:streetfighter:Shun Goku Satsu|Shun Goku Satsu]]. *'''Shadow Travel''' may be a reference to [[w:c:overwatch-archive:Reaper#Abilities|Reaper's]] '''Shadow Step''' from ''Overwatch''. *'''Rising Shadow''' is a reference to [https://youtu.be/EcQP0UcvLtE?t=203 Shadow Tendrils], one of Lannis' abilities from ''Rogue Lineage''. ===Ironsing=== *Needle Barrage is near identical to Autumn Rain from ''Rogue Lineage'', a move used by the [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Shura|Shura]], better known as Uber Shinobi, class. *Being able to consume ores for buffs could be a reference to Allomancy from ''{{W|Mistborn}}''. === Bloodrend === * '''Veinbreaker''' may be a reference to Slayer's [https://youtu.be/WvZLibhVVDQ Super Mappa Hunch] from ''Guilty Gear Strive''. * '''Scarlet Cannon''' is a reference to [[w:c:jujutsu-kaisen:Choso#Abilities and Powers|Choso's]] Piercing Blood from ''Jujutsu Kaisen''. ===Attunementless=== *'''Punishment''' may be a reference to [[w:c:devilmaycry:Dante|Dante's]] [[w:c:devilmaycry:Royalguard Style|Royal Guard]] from ''Devil May Cry.'' ==Oaths== *'''Arcwarder's''' activation animation is a reference to the {{W|Iron Man's armor (Marvel Cinematic Universe)|Iron Man suit}} from ''Marvel Comics''. *The description for '''Arcwarder''' quotes Karl Marx, a reference to the Ignition Union's socialist beliefs. *Starkindred has many references:[[File:Sephiroth wings.png|thumb|An image showing the singular wing]] **The Celestial underneath the [[Derelict Highchurch]] is a reference to [https://evangelion.fandom.com/wiki/Lilith Lilith] from ''Neon Genesis Evangelion''. The white body, red cross, and pool of blood are all traits shared with it.[[File:Arch with celestials.png|thumb|317x317px|Arch's tweet]] **The different characters met for this Oath have mythological or religious origins: ***The trainer, '''[[Samael]]''', is an angel in Judaism. ***'''[[Iblis, The Fallen Angel]]''' is named after Iblis, the leader of the devils in Islam. ***'''[[Abaddon, Sinner of Ice]]''' is named after Abaddon. Lovecraft's ''Call of Cthulhu'', being very similar to the sunken city of [https://lovecraft.fandom.com/wiki/R'lyeh R'lyeh], which is inhabited by Cthulhu, who is likely an inspiration for the '''[[Nautilodaunt]].''' ====Layer 2 (The Eternal Gale)==== *After beating the [[Scion of Ethiron]], you are forced to run to the exit with a time limit all the while [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Void_Reaver?so=search instant kill orbs] spawn around you. This is all ripped from ''Risk of Rain 2'', as [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Mithrix#Arena_Escape_Portals you do the same thing] after beating [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Mithrix Mithrix] on [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Commencement Commencement]. **This is also reinforced by the fact that the spawning sounds for the white orbs are just the [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Void_Reaver Void Reaver] death implosion sound effect. *Among a hidden cliff, a frozen [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Yeti|Yeti]] from ''Rogue Lineage'' can be found. ===Factions=== *'''Etrea''' is very similar to a mixture of various East Asian countries. *'''The Ministry''' is possibly a reference to ''The Ministry'' from ''Fahrenheit 451.'' *'''The Knives of Eylis''' is a reference to a faction in ''Dishonored'' as they can travel to a place that only exists within dreams, are assassins and have a supernatural entity that allow said group to exist. *'''The Divers''', especially the Black Divers, are a reference to the Whistles of ''Made in Abyss'', having the rank of Black Diver being very similar in design of the armor and concept of the White Whistles. ===Aspects=== *'''Etreans''' share many visual similarities with [[w:c:naruto:Mitsuki|Mitsuki]] and [[w:c:naruto:Orochimaru|Orochimaru]] from ''Naruto''. ** Regarding their culture, they have similarities to Eastern civilizations, in architecture, and names. *'''Adrets''' are a combination of [https://www.dndbeyond.com/races/22-goliath Goliaths] from ''Dungeons and Dragons'', and [https://coppermind.net/wiki/Steel_Ministry#Obligators Obligators] from ''Mistborn''. **While both have markings on their face, Adrets markings are specifically referenced from Obligators. *'''Canors''' are confirmed to be based on the design of [[w:c:blackclover:Mereoleona Vermillion|Mereoleona]] from ''Black Clover''. **On a broader reference, Canor surnames are German. Zweihanders, a weapon of German creation in real life, are used by Canor Borderwatchers. *'''Khans''' resemble modern interpretations of [[wp:Monkey King|Sun Wukong]] from ''Journey To The West'', with their near identical hair on sideburns and cheeks, and headband. **It also references the meme "Return to Monke" in character selection, as when you roll off Khan, you are able to switch back, though instead of the text saying "Switch to [aspect]" it says "Return to Khan" *'''Vesperians''' somewhat resemble the [https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Vessels Vessels] from ''Hollow Knight''. **The origins of '''Vesperians''' can be traced back to ''Arch_Mage's'' earlier game, ''[https://www.roblox.com/games/361122402/Yggdrasil Yggdrasil],'' where they were depicted as hostile automatons. This history is still evident today, reflected in their [[Lore#Vesperian|lore]] by being more robust than any other aspect. *'''Ganymedes''' are a likely reference to the [https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Snail_Shamans Snail Shamans] from ''Hollow Knight.'' ** '''Ganymedes''' are also named after [[wp:Ganymede_(moon)|a moon of Jupiter.]] **'''Ganymedes''' origins stems from ''Arch_Mage's previous game, [https://www.roblox.com/games/361122402/Yggdrasil Yggdrasil].'' Where it serves as the player's race. *'''Tiran''' hair feathers, and the Jay variant are a reference to [https://oneshot.wiki.gg/wiki/Alula Alula] from ''OneShot''. ===Misc=== * The echo modifier '''One Bit''' may be a reference to One Piece, given that they have similar names and the modifier makes you take damage when you swim, while in One Piece when a person eats a devil fruit they lose their ability to swim. *The Drowned Gods are inspired by the gods from the H.P. Lovecraft mythos: **Perceiving them drives you to insanity. ** They are too great to interact with the world normally, and must interact with it via shrines, avatars and vessels. ** They have to be summoned via rituals. *'''Sudaruska the Undying''' may be a reference to [[w:c:undertale:Undyne#Genocide Route|Undyne the Undying]] from the Undertale Genocide route, given that they have similar names and held themselves together by determination until the end. *The '''Emerald''' item's description is a reference to the Chaos Emeralds from the Sonic franchise. *The sound that [[Artifacts|the Forge]] emitted was taken from Asura Wrath. *The "Hoss" emote is a reference to Akuma from Street Fighter, while the name of emote is a reference to [[w:c:rogue-lineage:Big Hoss|Big Hoss]] from Rogue Lineage, the trainer of Oni and Sunaikinti's Blessed classes. *When enemies spot you there is a chance to play the alert sound effect from ''Metal Gear Solid''. *Voideye's Teleportation animation bears a striking resemblance to Final Fantasy XIV's teleport animation. *If the game has trouble loading you somewhere, the loading screen will display the image of a confused/shocked dog, with the text: "Uh oh. Where's the game? This can't be good. Games are supposed to ''work''. Games are supposed to let you ''play'' them. ...Probably won't be broken forever though, right? Like they've probably got a guy for this, right? Man." **If this keeps going long enough, the text will be replaced with this: "Huh. Still no dice? Maybe if we wait like 30 seconds longer some suggestions for games to play while we wait will start scrolling down the screen. Games do that kinda things nowadays, apparently. As if the game breaking wasnt enough". ***The games that can appear are the following: A Hat in Time, Abyss World, Airship Assault, Animal Crossing: New Leaf, Baba Is You, Backgammon, Bad Business, Barotrauma, Battleblock Theatre, Castle Crashers, Celeste, Checkers, Citizen Sleeper, CONE, CRAZY HORSE GAME 🐴, Crypt of the Necrodancer, Deep Rock Galactic, Deltarune, Doors, Don't play ABA please (ABA), Don't Starve Together, Dredge, Dwarf Fortress, Final Fantasy VII, Find Everything, FPS Chess, Goose Goose Duck, Hades I & II, Halo 3, Halo 3 ODST, Halo Reach, Hello Kitty Island Adventure, Hollow Knight, Hollow Knight: Silksong, Inscryption, Isle, Kingdom Series, L.A. title: Reforged Gauntlets
Regalia
content:
'''Regalia''' are passive abilities that positively affect progression or aid the player in some way. The only way to obtain them is through random chance upon character creation or when leveling up. Most Regalia are kept on the new character if the previous character with Regalia was wiped at Power 10 or below (see below for which Regalia are always lost upon wipe). {{notoc}} ==Obtainment== *Regalia can be randomly obtained every time you buy a new slot, wiping a slot above Power 10, or randomly when powering up mid progression. *Your odds of obtaining a Regalia increase the more progressed your previous character was (the extent of the increase in odds is unknown). *You may only have 1 Regalia per character, though obtaining a Regalia is extremely rare & not guaranteed.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pUgSI5Xg0VQ[[File:OneRegaliaOnly.png]] ==List of Regalia== ==={{anch|Mute}}=== Mute (also known as “Animal King”) grants the user majorly decreased aggro range around '''all''' monsters. It also {{cl|ligreen|'''does work'''}} against some humanoids This Regalia is {{cl|ligreen|'''kept'''}} upon wiping below Power 10. === {{Anch|Two-Faced}} === Unlocks a special dialogue with [[Rook Rethige]] in the [[Voidheart]] that lets you purchase [[Call of the Deep]], [[Horn of Authority]], or [[Union Pager]] for {{c|knowledge|20}}. You can only purchase one of these. ==={{anch|Prodigy}}=== Increases [[Power|XP]] gain and [[Attributes|Attribute]] training speed by 300%. ==={{anch|Inspired}}=== Grants increased [[Resonance Progress|Resonance progress]] gain from all paths instead of only one.
[[Sibex]]'s dialogue changes:
"Ah, interesting. Your Soul is giving off a consistent frequency. It's kinda like you've tuned an instrument. That's more than can be said for most, but still quite a way off." ==={{anch|johg|Worthy}}=== Grants unique dialogue with the [[Legendary Boot]]. Functionally, this does nothing to progression, abilities, or anything crucial to the game. It is just a silly piece of dialogue. "The Legendary Boot waits for the day that one worthy will claim it. Someone worthy with smaller feet." ==={{anch|Ancient Soul}}[[File:RegaliaConfirm1.png]]=== When creating a character, you start with a hand of [[Resonance]] draws. This cannot be obtained if you have the [[Tarnished]] Flaw. This Regalia is {{cl|lired|'''not'''}} kept upon wiping at any Power. ==={{anch|Noble}}=== A flat increase is applied to your reputation with each faction. ==={{anch|Inheritance}}=== You start with 1,000 [[Notes]] and 50 [[Knowledge]], as well as every item from the Advanced Tools [[Echo Unlock]]s, even if you haven't purchased them. This Regalia is {{cl|lired|'''not'''}} kept upon wiping at any Power. ==={{anch|Ace of Spades}}=== You start with 20 [[Aces]]. This Regalia is {{cl|ligreen|'''kept'''}} upon wiping at or below Power 10. ==={{anch|Joker}}[[File:RegaliaConfirm2.png]]=== You are granted an additional [[Talents|Talent]] choice in each Talent hand. This Regalia is {{cl|ligreen|'''kept'''}} upon wiping at or below Power 10. ==={{anch|Hungerless}}=== You no longer passively lose hunger or thirst. You lose a lot less hunger and thirst while regenerating blood (3 Bars of blood for 5% of Hunger and Thirst). Vomiting, the [[Gluttony]] Enchantment, and emergency blood regeneration will still cause you to lose hunger and thirst at a normal rate. ==={{anch|Insightful}}=== [[Knowledge]] gain from all sources is increased. The amount of Knowledge gained with the Insightful Regalia is 1.5x the amount without the Regalia, rounding to the nearest integer. For example, a reward of 1 Knowledge will instead reward 2, and a reward of 2 Knowledge will yield 3. This works with the [[Moonseye Tome]], granting 150 knowledge upon first time use and 75 Knowledge on all subsequent uses. This Regalia is {{cl|ligreen|'''kept'''}} upon wiping at or below Power 10. ==={{anch|Oscillator}}=== You are granted an additional [[Resonance]] choice when rerolling or obtaining one. ==Trivia== *For almost the entirety of the game's lifespan, Mute was the only Regalia known to exist, until Arch_Mage told the community about the others and the obtainment method. *Regalia by definition are the emblems or insignia of royalty, especially the crown, scepter, and other ornaments used at a coronation. *The Mute Regalia previously worked on Ministry Necromancers, Ministry Scouts, and Immortal Guardians, but it was fixed. Despite being a bug, Immortal Guardians had unique dialogue upon knocking a player with Mute. ==References== [[Category:Mechanics]]

==Description==
Regek is a [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They act as [[Attunement-less]] trainer.

To upgrade Attunement-less Mantras, players must first complete Regek's quest by collecting sap from three Soulblooms. This quest cannot be started until the player has washed their face. The quest will finish account-wide, allowing the player to upgrade mantras even on slots that have never spoken to Regek.

==Location==
Regek can be found inside of a section labeled "Archives" in the Root Canopy of [[Greathive Aratel]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Placeholder.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= 
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Khimimi...? Another moth drawn to the flame?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Can you help me grow stronger?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Not a paw on those books, flea! I don't want you leaving your greases and oils on the inks... No no, you'll need to get something for me first...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you need?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Souls.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Souls?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Yes. Souls. Three. I want three souls.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Uhh...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Khimimi... The souls of three rare plants that only grow here in the Hive due to the work of the {{g|Lifeweave / Lifewoven|Lifeweavers}}.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Oh! Yeah. I can do that.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Khi! I knew you were the kind of flea that would accept meaningless tasks. Bring me the souls or no books for you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Quest End=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player does have three souls
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Player does not have three souls
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Keh! Nicely done, waterflea. ''*They stash the vials of sap away somewhere unseen, and a shiver runs up your spine.*'' With that out of the way, I'd be happy to share with you the knowledge of the Hive...
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Keh keh! Showing yourself to me before you've done as I've asked? How impertinent this waterflea is... Bring me the souls. The plants.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Can you help me grow stronger?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Tell me about yourself.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}[Opens Mantra Upgrade UI]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}I'm the librarian. That's all you get to know. Keh heh heh! I can tell you about the Hive, though.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Alright, what is there to know?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Keh. This huge tree we're in right now is just one of the four '''Greathives''' in the world. The Greathives were constructed by the combined efforts of countless '''{{g|Lifeweave / Lifewoven|Lifeweavers}}''', those who utilise the {{g|The Song|Song}} to manipulate life itself.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the motive?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The goal? To create a new world over the waves, one that can ''grow'' to match the rising tides. Ambitious, no? Khimimimi...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what of the lands beyond the hive?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*They smirk, betraying a certain smugness.*'' They can ''drown'' for all I care. Clinging onto the relics of the {{g|The Old World|Old World}}... How foolish to think that the idiots that left us this world would have any insights into how to solve our dilemma. Khimimimi...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
}}

{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"

{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Tell me about yourself.

==Description==
The Relic Axe is a [[Weapons|Heavy Weapon]] of legendary rarity that is obtainable as a rare direct drop from [[Stone Knight]]s found in the [[Starswept Valley]], [[Saramaed Hollow]], or at any of the Star Trees respectively. It can also dropped by the [[Blizzard Knight|Blizzard variant]] of Stone Knights found in the [[The Valley of Heroes]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Relic Axe Crit.gif
</gallery>
The user performs an overhead slash with a [[Combat Mechanics#Red|red telegraph]] before sending out three stone pillars. If the opponent is hit by the pillars, they will be sent upwards and ragdolled.

These pillars can be broken and interacted with. The red telegraph is only applied to the stone pillars themselves.

The critical has a cooldown of '''5 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*The stone pillars spawned by the critical used to have collision and could be stood on and climbed but now acts like how the walls on the [[The City of the Drowned|City of the Drowned]] work.
*The stone pillars are perfect for putting a guild base on since their size is almost exactly the size of the guild base and can be placed anywhere. 
*The stone pillars are unparryable, however they are both blockable and dodgeable.
