==Description ==
'''Rosen's Hellflame''' is a Legendary Rifle: the product of the highly intelligent Gunsmith Rosen. In exterior design, it is akin to the [[Rosen's Peacemaker]], with its shape similar and mechanisms gilded, though it bears a much more lavish design, and boasts a sheen of scarlet metal. Utilizing Ether, it can propel flames in a spectacular display.

This weapon comes with a singular passive ability:
* '''Spark of Genius''' - "Shot" attacks (the 2nd and 4th Basic Attack, including Aerial Attacks) will apply {{status|Burn}} or Eruption if the user has the corresponding path.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Hellflame crit1.gif|Standing
File:Hellflame crit2.gif|Aerial
</gallery>

Rosen's Hellflame has two critical attacks.

For the '''standing critical''', the user aims at the target and fires a constant torrent of flames from its barrel, dealing a burst of damage at the start before spraying weaker flames afterwards. The critical consumes Ether to spray flames and will end if the user runs out or if 5 seconds pass. Applies {{status|Burn}}. It is not cancelled on being parried or blocked. This critical can be canceled by pressing {{keybind|k|feint}}.

For the '''aerial critical''', the user performs a side flip, slamming the muzzle on the opponent and coming down with an explosive shot. This leaves a {{status|Burn|burn}}-inflicting patch of fire on the ground which sets any foes on fire if they come in contact with it.

Both critical attacks share a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="200" position="center">
File:Rosen's Hellflame Equipped.png|Equipped
File:Rosen's Hellflame on back.png|On back
File:Hellframe crit with Azure Flames1.gif|Standing crit w/{{t|Azure Flames}}
File:Hellframe crit with Azure Flames2.gif|Aerial crit w/{{t|Azure Flames}}
File:Hellframe crit with Twisted Puppets1.gif|Standing crit w/{{t|Twisted Puppets}}
File:Hellframe crit with Twisted Puppets2.gif|Aerial crit w/{{t|Twisted Puppets}}
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Despite being a flamethrower, Rosen's Hellflame is capable of using bullets and [[Bullet Casings]]. (Note: You must press the Y/Swap Weapon key in order to use bullets. All guns are set to "No Bullet" by default.)
**Additionally, the Bullet Casings change the color of the flames that come out on the 2nd and 4th M1.
*Before October 8, 2024's update, The critical cooldown started as soon as the button was pressed, Allowing for the grounded crit to essentially have no cooldown if you had the ether to spam it.
*Using the Rosen's Hellflame's Grounded Crit make you immune to [[The Ferryman|The Ferryman's]] Lightning Assault. (First phase only)
*The jumping critical places two hitboxes, one around the character and one below them. The below hitbox has a surprising amount of reach, being able to hit people on the ground after using flame leap.
*Essentially a downgraded Flamecharm version of the [[Stormseye]] due to it having worse stats for the same investment cost (not accounting for their unique criticals).

|talent={{etal|weapon|Rosen's Technique}} - If you use {{t|Tactical Reload}}, Rosen's Peacemaker has 45 seconds less off its cooldown.
|Image=Pictures:DW_Peacemaker_Fixed.png}}
==Description==
Rosen's Peacemaker is a Medium Weapon and was released in the Verse 2 content update. It is among the first medium weapon [[Guns|rifles]] along with it's brutal brother the [[Iron Blunderbuss]].

Rosen's Peacemaker, like the Iron Blunderbuss, rotates between a blunt swing attack and a longer-range firing attack during its M1 combo. The critical of Rosen's Peacemaker is a slightly slower version of its M1 firing cycle, but it shoots a projectile in the direction the wielder faces. The bullets do not incur parry stun on the attacker if they get parried at far range.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Rosen's Technique}} reduces the cooldown of your {{t|Tactical Reload|r=rare}} Talent by 45 seconds; from 90 seconds to 45.

==Critical==
Rosen's Peacemaker uses a modified variant of the default Rifle critical, dealing increased damage. It has a scaled damage multiplier of '''1.5x''' compared to the default critical's 1.35x. This critical has a cooldown of '''3 seconds'''.
{{DefaultCrit|n|nh|Rifle}}

==Trivia==
*First shown in combat in Agamatsu's 1v1 between him and Nuttoons.
*The critical's speed is very similar to the regular swing speed yet a tiny bit slower.
*It is considered a direct upgrade to the [[Summer Rifle]] as they share the same swing speed but has superior stats.
*Unlike its swing M1, the shot M1 has a straight line hitbox making it generally harder to hit enemies.
*The critical can still proc [[Talent Quests|Critical Attack]] even if it gets blocked.
*The rifle can utilize [[Bullet Casings]] but only on its shot M1s.

The Rotten Lot is a pirate crew. Not much is known about them, but they are said to travel with crew members who want to improve their lives.<ref>Said in the caption in The Scoundrel’s Bounty location banner; [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]]</ref> Their boat is [[The Scoundrel's Bounty|The Scoundrel’s Bounty]] and their captain is [[Cap'n Orlandeau|Captain Orlandeau]]. However this changed when, on a voyage to Etrea, their boat was attacked by [[The Central Authority]] and capsized<ref>Said in Kelsius’ dialogue if his quest has been completed and the player is a Castaway; [[Kelsius]]</ref>, leading to the deaths and disappearances of most of the crew — including the Captain.  

Some other crew members include: 

* [[Flabbernaster Filingree, the First Mate|Flabbernaster Filigree]]
** A Gremor. She is the First Mate (Second in-command) of the ship. She is also seemingly proficient in combat, as she is said to have ‘devastated’ the player character in their previous spar.<ref>[[Flabbernaster Filingree, the First Mate]]</ref>
* [[Frank F'alzone]]
** A Celtor, who is potentially the cartographer/janitor of the ship. He is nicknamed ‘The Swabber’ for his abilities in cleaning.
* [[Pete]]
** A Vesperian, who is found sitting down against the wall on the ship. He seems to be nauseous from a meal that was given to him, along with his seasickness. His role on the ship is unknown.
* [[Mr. Quarters, Halfmaster|Mr. Quarters]]
** An Adret who serves as the Halfmaster of the ship.
* [[Serendi]]
** An apparently 'short' Etrean found standing up on two crates, keeping watch of the sea. She mentions a ship that she sees on the horizon — it is implied that this is the Authority boat which attacked the Bounty.
*[[The Pathfinder|The player character]] (Assuming they are a Castaway)

==Trivia==
*Their boat is where the game’s tutorial takes place. 
**This means that if you are a [[Castaway]], you were on the boat as part of the crew, and the reason you’re a Castaway is due to the Authority’s attack, being the sole survivor.
*Despite being hinted at that she is short, Serendi is physically the same height as the rest of the crew.
*A ‘Halfmaster’ is not a real role on a ship. It is likely that Mr. Quarters’ role is equivalent to a quartermaster, given his name.

'''Royal Etrean Guard''' is a Master [[Outfit]] in ''Deepwoken''. ==Statistics== ===''Requirements''=== This Outfit costs {{c|Notes|1,000}} and requires five (5) [[Cloth]], five (5) [[Fiber]], five (5) [[Vibrant Gem]]s, ten (10) [[Umbral Obsidian]], one (1) [[Void Feather]] and one (1) [[King Thresher Spine]] to craft. This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 15 to be crafted. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 3000 durability and grants {{stats|phys|+30% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+30% Elemental resistance}}, and {{stats|ether|+20% Ether Regen}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Paired Soul}} Talent. The {{t|Paired Soul}} Talent increases the damage of the base [[Katana]] by 25%. This also increases the damage of the [[Shattered Katana]], [[Alloyed Katana|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed Katana}}]], [[Palace Tachi]] and [[Purple Cloud]] by 5%. ==Trivia== *A darkened version of this is worn by the [[Etrean Royal Guard]]. *The Outfit originally had a requirement of Power 20 but it was shortly lowered to 15. *This Outfit is a superior version of the [[Cloak of Winds]], boasting an extra 10% Physical Armor and 20% Ether Regen but loses the 25% Shadow Armor. *Originally, this was an Adept Outfit that existed in the files since the very release of Deepwoken. It was eventually added nearly two years after the game released during the 12/15/2023 update, reworked into a Master Outfit due to there being no Outfits with the Paired Soul Talent that could be used effectively. *This is the first Master outfit to not require a [[Deep Gem]] to craft. It is also the first outfit to require a [[King Thresher Spine]] to craft, thus giving the first use for the [[King Thresher Spine]]. *This outfit is usable as an essential factor of a katana build, allowing the Katana to deal 30 damage with 75 Medium which is only 2 points of damage off from Shattered Katana. This leaves you with 25 stat points that you can spend on other attributes you see fit. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]] [[Category:Outfits of Etrea]]

==Description==

'''Run It Back''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.
===''Appearance''===
When used, particles of flame, lightning, or shadow appear below the user's feet.
==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Run It Back''' Resonance.

'''Run It Back''' will grant the user around five to ten seconds of immunity (randomized upon getting your bell). Once finished, the user will be teleported back to the position where it was first used. While active, all forms of incoming healing are immensely reduced, [[campfire]] healing is disabled, and damage output is reduced by 25%.

{{cl|corres|If Run It Back is corrupted, it grants the user 5 second of {{status|Hyperarmor}} on use.}} However, hyperarmor ends early if you cast a Mantra.
===''Resonance Point usage''===
When obtained, Run It Back will spend its points on the following stats:

* '''Resonance Duration:''' The amount of time that the resonance is active for.
* '''Damage Tolerance:''' The amount of damage it takes for the resonance effect to expire early.
* '''Resonance Cooldown:''' The cooldown time before being able to use the resonance again.
* '''Attunement Variant:''' The attunement Variant you'll roll upon getting the resonance.

====''<u>Attunements</u>''====
Run it Back has randomized attunements upon obtaining the bell.

*The [[Flamecharm]] variant will {{status|Burn}} players nearby on use.
*The [[Thundercall]] variant will {{status|Shock}} players nearby on use.
*The [[Shadowcast]] variant will {{status|Shadow|steal the Ether}} of players nearby on use.

File:Flame Run It Back Bell.png|Flame Visual
File:RunItBackCorruptedBurningDownside.gif|Corrupted Burning Downside, Old Lightning Visual
File:RunItBack NewLook-GIF.gif|Current Lightning Visual
File:Shadow Visual.png|Shadow Visual
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This is a reference to ''[https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Phoenix Phoenix]'' from ''Valorant'', whose ultimate is also called "Run it Back".
*If your health goes to 0% during Run it Back, you will die.

|aspect=[[Vesperian]]}}


__TOC__

==Description==
Ryrda is a major character in the [[book]] [[God in the Machine]] and a mention on [[Lament of Cirryn]]. After parting ways with [[the Hive]], he went to chase his dreams of becoming a [[Shadowcast]]er.

After some while he found a way to obtain [[Nightblood]]: the potion, neccessary to become a [[Shadowcast]]er. The way involved sacrificing one's [[Ether]]. [[Eran]] agreed to help him and use her own [[Ether]] to obtain [[Nightblood]].

Ryrda was desperate, if not insane in chasing his dreams, even accidentally killing his friend in the process. He never noticed other's feelings and was too focused on himself, to the point where he didn't realize [[Eran]] died and celebrated his dream coming to life. Despite [[Eran]] being ill and having a chance of dying after her [[Ether]] was drained, Ryrda seemingly did nothing to warn her of that possibility, as he saw it as an opportunity to finally reach his goal of becoming a [[Shadowcast]]er.

He died shortly after reaching his goal, as he was burnt to death by [[Fran]], who was infuriated by the demise of her friend, [[Eran]]. After his death, [[Ehkusa]], his friend, kept a shard of his mask in hopes of meeting him again.

{{IronVowEx}} {{NPCInfobox |name=Shisui Kobura |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=She/her |location={{iv|The Indigo Citadel}} |family={{iv|Clan Kobura}} |affiliation=*{{iv|Clan Kobura}}
*{{iv|Etrean Royalists}} (formerly) |image1=Sachan Shisui Kobura.png}} ==Description== Sachan Shisui Kobura is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She is the head of the [[Clan Kobura|Kobura Clan]]. In an argument with the three other Sachans in [[The Golden Rat]], she held that the [[Etrean Royalists]] needed to seek powerful allies to make the next move, namely [[The Central Authority]], and proposed to be the head of such an alliance. Shisui is often described as ambitious and selfish. ==Location== Sachan Shisui Kobura is located at {{iv|The Indigo Citadel}}, inside of the main house. Sachan Shisui Kobura Map.png {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |''*The Sachan gracefully sits on a mat, glancing at you nonchalantly. You offer a respectful bow.*'' Ah... An ally of the Old Guard. Whatever brings you to the Indigo {{g|The Citadel of Markor|Citadel}}? I do not have any remaining dealings with the alliance, if that's what you're here for. |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |'No remaining dealings'? What do you mean? |- | colspan="2" |''*The Sachan scoffs.*'' Have you not heard? The Old Guard is no more. Clan Kobura has withdrawn their support to the Royalist cause, for the time being. We shall bleed no longer, while the other clans lay their claims to glory and power at our expense. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |So... The Old Guard truly is falling apart. | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You would betray your allies just like that? |- | colspan="1" |''*Sachan Shisui bursts out laughing, with an air of dismissiveness.*'' It is not 'falling apart'. It has been in that state for years now. Now, it finally ''has'' fallen apart. When discussing our next step, the others bickered like children over which point to attack. I recognised that we need allies - ''powerful'' allies, - and offered to parley with the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} on our behalf. The other sachans foolishly took offence to my proposal. The argument that followed finally undid our bond. | colspan="1" |''*She frowns, baring her teeth, meaningfully placing her hand upon the hilt of her blade.*'' Mind your tongue, outsider, or I may have it cut out for you. Clan Kobura merely claims its fair share - and when we do not receive what we have rightfully earned, we rise from the negotiation table, and walk away, as is our right. For fourteen years we have fought by the side of the other clans, and we have nothing to show for it - nothing but the corpses of our fallen kin. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What will you do, then, now that the alliance is no more? | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |Are you saying you fight for your own gain, Sachan Kobura? |- | colspan="1" |I will do what's right for ''our'' clan, regardless if I am alone or not. We will fortify our lands, and possibly seek a way to resist the Lord Regent. My scouts tell me an ancient power sleeps within Minityrsa - and perhaps we will investigate that. Or, perhaps, we will even make peace with the Lord Regent, and rejoin the fold of the Kingdom. It has been a long war - much was lost, and we must be pragmatic to survive. My clan and I have already paid a dear price in the Civil War - I will not throw away any more lives of my kinfolk for a broken cause. A cause we no longer follow. | colspan="1" |''*She narrows her eyes, glaring at you.*'' I only expect my fair dues when contributing to an alliance. The jealousy of others is not my fault. I recognise that we need allies - ''powerful'' allies. When discussing our next step, the others bickered like children over which point to attack. I offered to parley with the {{g|The Cenral Authority|Central Authority}} on our behalf instead. The other sachans foolishly took offence to my proposal. The argument that followed finally undid our bond. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What will you do, then, now that the alliance is no more? |- | colspan="1" | | colspan="1" |[See first instance] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" | colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="2" |''*The Sachan glances at you nonchalantly once more.*'' We have nothing else to discuss, warrior. Be welcome at the estate, should you come in peace. But do not linger here. Our hospitality is limited, at a time like this. |- | colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} |Could you remind me why you're no longer with the Old Guard? |- | colspan="2" |''*The Sachan scoffs.*'' The Old Guard is no more. Clan Kobura has withdrawn their support to the Royalist cause, for the time being. We shall bleed no longer, while the other clans lay their claims to glory and power at our expense. |- | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |So... The Old Guard truly is falling apart. | colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |You would betray your allies just like that? |- | colspan="2" |[See first instance] |} ==Gallery== File:Sachan Shisui Kobura Goldenrat.png|Kobura clad in her armor in {{iv|The Golden Rat}} ==Trivia== *Roblox clothing: [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/8457576608/Hokkaido-Ronin Shirt] • [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/8457577787/Hokkaido-Ronin Pants] {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Sachans]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

{{IronVowEx}} {{NPCInfobox |name=Zaru Ganba |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=He/him |location={{iv|The Sable Estate}} |family={{iv|Clan Ganba}} |affiliation=*{{iv|Clan Ganba}}
*{{iv|Etrean Royalists}} |image1=Sachan Zaru Ganba.png}} ==Description== Sachan Zaru Ganba is an [[Etrean]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is the head of the [[Clan Ganba|Ganba Clan]]. In an argument with the three other Sachans in [[The Golden Rat]], he asked to find a way to contact the [[Isle of Vigils]] for a potential new operating base. He seems to know that [[The Inheritor]] is apart of the {{iv|Circle of Honour}}, and he considers joining the organization himself. ==Location== Sachan Zaru Ganba is located at {{iv|The Sable Estate}}, inside of the main house. NPC Map Sachan Zaru Ganba.png ==Dialogue== |-|Base Dialogue= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*The Sachan stands before a table covered in papers, deep in thought. He appears to snap out of it as you approach. You offer a respectful bow.*'' ...Ah. A comrade of the High Monk. You are welcome to the Sable Estate. Though, I pray you do not linger. Whatever business you have with me, conduct it now - I will not be staying around here for long. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Are you leaving for somewhere, Sachan Ganba? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I see you are not with the rest of the Old Guard, Sachan Ganba... May I ask why? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*Zaru scoffs.*'' Soon, I will be departing the estate. There is nothing for us left here. The Old Guard is no more. The civil war may as well be over in the East. Myself, my retainers, and most of my remaining force shall be headed West. To stop the Lord Regent, we must seek new allies elsewhere - without, a broad. There is little strength to be found ''within'' now, it seems. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*Zaru sighs.*'' Because the Old Guard is no more. The sachans have all gone their separate ways. During our discussion in the Golden Rat, tensions flared. We could not agree on a singular way forward , and the others - fools they are, - would not listen to me nor the High Monk. Sachan Kobura insisted we join with the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}, with her as our representative. Sachan Mofisu was adamant about recapturing the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} and his destroyed keep, and Sachan Anako sided with him. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The Old Guard is no more? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what was your advice? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*Zaru sighs.*'' The sachans have all gone their separate ways. During our discussion in the Golden Rat, tensions flared. We could not agree on a singular way forward , and the others - fools they are, - would not listen to me nor the High Monk. Sachan Kobura insisted we join with the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}, with her as our representative. Sachan Mofisu was adamant about recapturing the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} and his destroyed keep, and Sachan Anako sided with him. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See other instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what was your advice? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The Sachan scoffs dismissively.*'' I told the others that we should seek contact with the Isle of Vigils. Our previous attempts to establish contact over the past years were unsuccessful - none of our scouts returned from there. High Monk Junsui told us that to his knowledge, the island was either captured, or still under siege. But he agreed that we should investigate - if the island remains free of the Regent's clutches, lifting the siege would have given us a base of operations close to the Lord Regent. The others disagreed, though. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why not investigate this matter with your own forces, then? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}My forces '''dwindle'''. I simply cannot afford to lose more warriors. That's all there is to it. Clan Ganba paid dearly in their defence of the Lord Guardian. ''*A bitter trembling rattles his voice.*'' My sons and daughters, my nephews and nieces, my grandchildren, my cousins... We lost many of our finest on the night of the Lord Regent's coup. The civil war has already cost us too many lives, and I simply cannot afford to keep sacrificing my kinsmen while the other clans refuse to cooperate. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Then, what will you do now? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*He clutches the scroll he is holding in his fist.*'' As I said - I shall head westward. I seek parley with foreign forces. Perhaps the Hundred Legions - although, I doubt they will respond to my offer. Or perhaps, I shall reach out to the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}}. Sachan Kobura may have been right about them, in the end. Maybe the famed Warden Jericho will take pity on me, and aid my cause against our common enemy. Or perhaps he will simply throw me into the prisons of Cascabel to rot. What do you think... Ironsworn? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I... beg your pardon? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*Sachan Zaru smirks, sly as a fox.*'' You may drop your pretence. I know of your order. The Circle of Honour... I myself am not a member. But I know you are. I also know that the High Monk and Warden Jericho are also members of the organisation. Am I correct? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Where are you going with this, Sachan Ganba? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Tsch. You see, Clan Ganba were not only the Lord Guardian's royal guards. We were also frequently in the business of procuring intelligence. ''Espionage'', if you will. I admit, I do not know much about your organisation. But I know that you seek to defeat the Lord Regent - and all that is all I wish as well. Hence... Perhaps I will make an offer to Warden Jericho. My cooperation for his assistance. Or perhaps, I will seek to join your order myself. I am yet to decide, if I am honest. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Then speak to him the words, 'In Iron we recall'. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I can only wish you good luck, Sachan Ganba. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Zaru smiles.*'' I had heard Junsui utter this phrase a couple of times. I always assumed it was some lesser-known blessing of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}... But I will remember this, Ironsworn. Thank you. I wish you well on your journeys - and may we both achieve our goal. The Lord Regent's reign '''will''' come to an end. Soon may he fall {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Sachan Ganba lowers his head pensively.*'' Thank you. You may trust in my silence, Ironsworn. Regardless of what happens next, know that we both have the same enemy. I wish you well on your journeys - and may we both achieve our goal. The Lord Regent's reign '''will''' come to and end. Soon may he fall. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl{{!}}action}} {{!}}Player chose "Then speak to him the words, 'In Iron we recall'.." {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl{{!}}action}} {{!}}Player chose "I can only wish you good luck, Sachan Ganba." {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The Sachan smiles at you, gratefully.*'' ...In Iron we recall, hm? Swift journeys to you, true friend of Etrea. Soon may he fall. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The Sachan acknoweldges you with a nod.*'' Do not linger here overlong, friend of Etrea. During our discussion in the Golden Rat, tensions flared. We could not agree on a singular way forward , and the others - fools they are, - would not listen to me nor the High Monk. Sachan Kobura insisted we join with the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}, with her as our representative. Sachan Mofisu was adamant about recapturing the Monastery of {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} and his destroyed keep, and Sachan Anako sided with him. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See other instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what was your advice? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The Sachan scoffs dismissively.*'' I told the others that we should seek contact with the Isle of Vigils. High Monk Junsui told us that to his knowledge, the island was either captured, or still under siege. The others disagreed, though. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I had been to the Isle of Vigils, and spoken to Maestro Alkhurst. Then after a few moments, he slowly chuckles.*'' ...So I was right. And to think... Well... We cannot turn back in time, unfortunately. title: Sacred Field
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure a field of sacred light, protecting you and your allies from harm.|author=Sacred Field description}}
{{Resonance|effect=Protects you and allies from harm substantially.|appearance=Various colored field that spreads around the user.|cooldown=45 Seconds + Duration|
image1 =<gallery>
Witherald(Sacred Field).gif|Sacred Field
Sacred field card.png|Card
CorruptedSacredField.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
==Description==
'''Sacred Field''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain, and is uncommon to roll.

===''Appearance''===
When used, an orange, red, blue, green or purple field will appear around the user. Depending on the Resonance Points, the field can last anywhere from 20 seconds to around 1 minute. 

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Sacred Field''' Resonance.

Holding {{Input|keybind|resonance}} to activate will make the '''Sacred Field''' affect non-allies too.

'''Sacred Field''' will spawn an area that grants you and your allies defense against physical and elemental damage. The area isn't a field, yet a sphere meaning you can be under and over the area and you will still get the effect of '''Sacred Field.'''

{{cl|corres|If Sacred Field is corrupted, the field will follow its user instead of staying where it was placed.}}

=== ''Resonance Point usage'' ===
When obtained, Sacred Field will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Resistance type:''' Decides the type of resistance that will be used (you can roll all three).
**Physical resistance reduces damage from physical attacks (example: m1, critical, etc.)
**Elemental resistance reduces damage from elemental attacks (example: [[Lionfish]] beam, attunements, etc.)
**Sanity resistance reduces sanity loss (example: sharko roar? is untested but confirmed by tester)
*'''Resistance strength:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the higher the damage resist percentage is.
*'''Range:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the larger the area covered by the resonance is.
*'''Duration:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the longer the resonance lasts.
*'''Color:''' A free stat. Changes the color of the field, the color is always random, but always vibrant.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Bettersacredfield.png|Image of Sacred Field.
File:Sanity loss.png|tester confirms sanity loss variant
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*'''Sacred Field's''' usage can allow players to focus less on their health and more on damage output.
*When in a fight, using this next to a healing station will allow you to out heal damage. This most to only applies to Physical resist fields though.
*This resonance works with any build just like [[Portal]], [[Blood Scourge]], and etc. It is a good support bell for you and your team party.
*'''Sacred Field''' is very useful for fighting large groups of people or bosses such as Duke.
*'''Sacred Field''' can't be used in the [[Voidsea]]. If corrupt, the drawback still applies.

Your Pressure Blast is also now unparryable.
{{etal|weapon|Reverse Necrosis}} - Landing any mantra will now heal you based on how slow your opponent is. |m.extract=No}} ==Description== The Saint Jay's Hammer is a [[Vow of Iron]] exclusive greathammer weapon. This weapon, once wielded by [[Saint Jay (individual)|Saint Jay]], features a multi-stage critical attack that changes the weapon's appearance. In the third and final stage, the Saint Jay's hammer will be encased in ice. ==Talents== {{text|wtal}} {{etal|weapon|Bulwark Breaker}} gives your [[Pressure Blast]] a very noticeable AoE increase. Additionally, the final hit of your Pressure Blast now deals 3x posture damage, going from 12 to 36. Assuming all of your Pressure Blast hits hit your opponent's block, they will take 60 total posture damage, compared to the original 36. Your Pressure Blast also becomes '''unparryable'''. {{etal|weapon|Reverse Necrosis}} grants healing when you land [[Mantras]], with the healing scaling on how slowed your opponent is. ==Critical== File:Hailbreaker Crit (stage1).gif|Stage I File:Hailbreaker Crit (stage2).gif|Stage II File:Hailbreaker Crit (stage3).gif|Stage III The {{PAGENAME}} has three different criticals. When a critical is landed, it will advance to the next stage. For the '''Stage I''' critical, the user slowly winds up before performing a heavy ice-infused slash. This will advance the weapon to its next stage. For the '''Stage II''' critical, the user performs a heavier ice-infused slash, freezing the target in place. This will advance the weapon to its final stage, coating it in ice. For the '''Stage III''' critical, the user dashes forward before performing a large upward ice-infused slash, freezing the target in place. This will revert the weapon to its first stage, removing the ice on the weapon. At the end of each critical, the slashes are followed up by explosions of ice around the user that grow in size with each stage. They deal the same damage as each tick of the critical as pure Frostdraw damage. The positions of these explosions are random, but they are telegraphed with a blue swirl effect before they explode. All criticals have a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. Pressing M2 during the windup of the critical will perform a feint that resets stages and has a cooldown of 2 seconds. All stages have this ability. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Greathammers]] [[Category:Heavy Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Talents]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]]

This procs regardless of Bottom Freeze's cooldown.}} *Shield Breaker [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blunt damage now fully ignores the posture bonus from shields. Effectively, your enemy is stripped from their shield. *{{cl|advancedtl|Unyielding Frost}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Your {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chilled}} can proc through block, with blocked {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chilled}} procs lasting 80% of the duration. **If you have less than 100 Frostdraw, your chilled duration (when applied through block) will be reduced down to 25% of its original duration instead. **Does not proc Frozen Legs. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Glacial Arc (★☆☆) |image=Glacialarc.gif |desc=An arc of ice. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Mobility Mantra |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''Conjure a torrent of solid ice that extends towards the user's cursor.'' *Has a base damage of 30{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/32.7}}]]}} per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Modifying this Mantra with [[Mantra Modifiers|Glass]] and [[Magnifying Stone]]s grants it an additional hit, dealing 7/9.5/12/14.5/17 base damage per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 15 posture damage per level. The additional hit from Glass/Magnifying Stones deals 5 posture damage. *Has a 12 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Can be used to scale walls and terrain. *Inflicts a 1 second Chill. This cannot be modified. *Compatible with [[Mantra Modifiers|Glass]] and [[Magnifying Stone]]s, causing the move to form a small ice eruption at the end of the pillar. Adding more AoE modifiers increases the size of the eruption. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s to become wider. *Can be modified with [[Mantra Modifiers|Crystal]] and [[Mantra Modifiers|Perfect Lenses]] to increase the range of the Arc. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ice Smash (★☆☆) |image=Icesmash.gif |desc=A colossal mace of ice. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''Perform a wind-up before conjuring and slamming a spiked ice club into the ground ahead.'' *Has a base damage of 35{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/38}}]]}} per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *The Glacial Finish ({{Input|keybind|parry}}) variant has a base damage of 28/30.4/32.8/35.2/37.6 per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 10/14/16/18/guard break posture damage per level. This additional Ether cost cannot be reduced. *Has a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Chill for 5 seconds. This can be increased with [[Mantra Modifiers|Aeon]] and [[Eternal Logstone]]s. *Slightly knocks back target(s). *Can break objects. *Press {{input|keybind|block}} during Ice Smash's windup to initiate a second hit dealing 80% of the damage of the first hit. Glacial finish.gif|Glacial Finish }}

{{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chilled}} applied by Mantras prevents your opponent from rolling. **Lasts the first 0.75 seconds after chill/freeze procs. {{TalentInfo/Talents|name=Defiance|rarity=Rare|icon=Climb|notes=250|tags={{abf|nowiki|[[Saint Jay (Memento)|Saint Jay]]}} {{abf|[Scale-down]}}|category=Champion |description=Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP. |additional info=*The effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement. *Currently, the only things Defiance cuts in half are: **Flamecharm's {{status|Burn}} damage **Frostdraw's {{status|Chill}} and {{status|Crystals|Crystal}} stack duration **Galebreathe's {{status|Winded}} and {{status|Suffocation}} duration **Thundercall's {{status|Surge Rods|Surge Rod}} duration **Shadowcast's {{status|Obscured|Sightless Still}} duration **{{status|Blood Poisoning}} gain **{{status|Wither}} gain **[[Ring of Pestilence]] duration **The potency of [[potions]] **Time {{status|Unconscious}} (cut by 50% multiplicatively after other modifiers)}} {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Ice Carve (★★☆) |image=ice carve.gif |desc=A sharp disk of ice. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |reqs={{c|notes|1,200}} |effect=''Conjure a deadly rapidly moving saw of ice with the user's left hand.'' *Has a base damage of 5{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/5.5}}]]}} per level, per hit (9) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *The [[Spring Spark]] variant has a base damage of 10/10.5/11/11.5/12 per level, per hit with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *The [[Round Spark]] variant has a base damage of 3/3.5/4/4.5/5 per level, per hit (20) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 1 posture damage per hit (9 when sparkless). The Round Spark variant deals 2 posture damage per hit (10, hitting block counts as 2). *10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Does not inflict Chill. *Ends instantly if parried. *Spawns an ice patch on use. However, it barely increases the size (~1%). *Can be modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloud]] and [[Stratus Stone]]s to increase the Mantra size. *Can be modified with a Round Spark to cause the user to spin the projectile of the Mantra around them. *Can be modified with a Spring Spark to cause the user to throw the projectile forward before recalling it back. ==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *Cryonis [Common Talent] - All ice spells casted ontop of ice cost less Ether. **Ice Mantras cost 20% less ether if casted while standing on ice. *Punishing Blow [Rare Talent] - {{ttag|Heavy Weapons}} Daze opponents for 1s and {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Stagger}} PvE enemies for 2s when you interrupt their Basic Attack / actions with your own. **If you M1 your opponent during their M1 animation, they will be dazed for 1 second. **Also procs if you land a critical with the [[M1 tag]] during their M1 animation. **The Stagger status effect makes your opponent take 33% more posture damage. === Dravik, The Rat King === *{{cl|raretlnf|Destructive Recovery}} [Rare Talent] - {{ttag|Greatsword}} Enemies recover 20% less Posture when parrying. (+1 Posture) *{{cl|raretlnf|Unstoppable Force}} [Rare Talent] - {{ttag|Greathammer}} You take 15% less posture damage when parried. (+1 Posture) ===True Heart of Enmity=== *Fragile Freeze [Common Talent] - Your Basic Attacks and Criticals now apply {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Frozen}} to {{status|b=y|ncl=y|Chilled}} opponents on guardbreak. **Guardbreaking a chilled opponent with a weapon attack will encase them in {{status|Frozen|ice}}, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time. **Taking damage by any source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early **You can spam {{input|keybind|parry}}, {{input|k|dodge}}, or {{input|Space}} to get out of Freeze faster. *Crippling Darkness [Outfit Talent] - Your non-Basic Attacks have 20% PEN. **Grants +20% PEN to anything that is not a weapon attack. ***Primarily, this is just 20% Mantra PEN, however this will also affect non-Mantra/weapon damage sources like Crystal detonations, Eruptions, Surge overloads, and others. ***[[Reinforce|Reinforce's]] general resistance is affected by PEN, meaning Crippling Darkness will make things such as bleed or Steam, which bypass armor, deal more damage against Reinforce than they would otherwise. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Iceberg (★★★) |image=iceberg_lettuceee.gif |desc=Enter a state of cryostasis. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Support Mantra |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=''Encases the user in a block of ice while releasing pulses of ice that Chill and pushes back any targets that get close, user heals in the first two pulses of a ring. The user will automatically parry one hit while this is active.'' *Has a base damage of 3{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/3.5}}]]}} per level, per hit (5) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 3 posture damage per hit (5). *Has a cooldown of 33 seconds. *Has 6.48x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 6.48 for PvE damage). *Heals 2%, increasing with level and [[Drift Shard|Drift/Rush Shards]], up to 10%. *Applies 1 second of chill per hit. This cannot be modified. *Iceberg applies bottom freeze on every hit (regardless of cooldown), but still puts the Frozen Legs status on cooldown. *Shares a cooldown with [[Reinforce]]. *Does not proc [[Deep Gems]] on hit. *Can be modified with a [[Blast Spark]], turning you into an ice crystal on use. While this variant of Iceberg is active, you gain i-frames, but cannot move or act. If used midair, you will quickly descend towards the ground, dealing damage on impact and flinging/ragdolling opponents. This also negates fall damage. **Can be modified with [[Drift Shard|Drift/Rush Shards]] to increase the fall speed. Iceberg Blast Spark.gif|Blast Spark }}

::''This page is for the [[Memento]]. For the Oath, see [[Oath: Saintsworn]].'' {{IronVowEx}}{{Quotes|quote=Bring a memento of each attunement to its respective shrine.|author=Saintsworn (Memento) obtainment hint}}{{Memento |name=Saintsworn |image=Saintsworn Memento.png |description=Harness the power of the heroes, wielding control over five attunements. |starting attributes=*75 Flamecharm *75 Frostdraw *75 Thundercall *75 Galebreathe *75 Shadowcast *2 Strength *1 Fortitude *1 Agility *3 Intelligence *1 Willpower |final attributes=*100 Flamecharm *100 Frostdraw *100 Thundercall *100 Galebreathe *100 Shadowcast *25 Strength *10 Fortitude *20 Agility *50 Intelligence *10 Willpower |starting traits=*-3 Vitality *1 Erudition *1 Proficiency *1 Songchant *2 Dexterity |final traits=*1 Vitality *6 Erudition *8 Proficiency *7 Songchant *6 Dexterity |allowed weapons=Fist, Greathammer, Greataxe, Sword, Spear, Club, Rapier, Dagger, Greatcannon, Twinblade, Bow, Greatsword |starting weapons=[[Hero's Blade of Flame]], [[Hero's Blade of Frost]], [[Hero's Blade of Lightning]], [[Hero's Blade of Shadow]], [[Hero's Blade of Wind]] |unlock=Interact with the [[Saintsworn Obelisks]] with the corresponding [[Mementos]]: *Flamecharm: [[Flame Worshipper]], [[Solborn]], or [[Steampunk Soldier]]
*Frostdraw: [[Saint Jay]] or [[Steampunk Soldier]]
*Thundercall: [[Flashing Thunder]] or [[Theros Disciple]]
*Galebreathe: [[Inheritor of the Gale]] or [[Theros Disciple]]
*Shadowcast: [[Strange Merchant]] or [[Void Glutton]] |resonance=[[Chorus Divide]] |starting armor=[[Hero's Regalia]]}} ==Overview== {{PAGENAME}} is a playable [[Memento]] available in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. You gain access to the [[Oath: Saintsworn|Saintsworn]] Oath and its abilities. The Saintsworn is a resolute champion, drawing power from the sacred forces of the core Attunements, standing unshaken in battle as they channel the song through the [[Saintsworn Obelisks]] and their respective heroes. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*[[Oath: Saintsworn|{{cl|oathtl|Oath: Saintsworn}}]] [Oath Talent] - A vow to the fallen heroes. Press L to swap to Saintsblade. *{{cl|oathtl|Ether Proselyte}} [Oath Talent] - All of your Elemental Mantras below Lv. 5 are 1 Mantra level higher. Your Mantras are converted to the element of your active stance. **The level change for attuned Mantras is not displayed on their tooltips. **Ether Proselyte is a Talent that allows your elemental Mantras to proc the Talents of your currently equipped Saint Stance. This however does not work with all attuned Talents. **Attuned Talents that work with Ether Proselyte will not be mentioned if this Memento doesn't have access to them. For all info, view [[Oath: Saintsworn]]. ***'''Ether Proselyte: Flamecharm Stance''': In the {{cl|fir|'''Flamecharm'''}} Saint Stance, all attuned Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ****'''[[Talents#Dancing Steps|{{cl|fir|Dancing Steps}}]]''': Your attuned mantras will gain a lunge during their windup, closing distance. ****'''[[Talents#Hungry Flames|{{cl|fir|Hungry Flames}}]]''': Your attuned Mantras will consume your Stomach and Thirst meters to cast if you don't have enough Ether. However, this talent will no longer proc when using Flamecharm mantras outside of the {{cl|fir|'''Flamecharm'''}} Saint Stance. ****'''[[Talents#Immolation|{{cl|fir|Immolation}}]]''': Your attuned Mantras will cost 70% less Ether if you're burning. ***'''Ether Proselyte: Galebreathe Stance''': In the {{cl|wnd|'''Galebreathe'''}} Saint Stance, all attuned Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ****'''[[Talents#A World Without Song|{{cl|wnd|A World Without Song}}]]''': After landing 3 hits with any attuned Mantra, apply [[Suffocation]]. The hit count requirement will be increased if you have less than 75 Galebreathe. ****'''[[Talents#Inhale|{{cl|wnd|Inhale}}]]''': You can inhale non-Galebreathe Mantras. ***'''Ether Proselyte: Shadowcast Stance''': In the {{cl|sdw|'''Shadowcast'''}} Saint Stance, all attuned Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ***'''Ether Proselyte: Frostdraw Stance''': In the {{cl|ice|'''Frostdraw'''}} Saint Stance, all attuned Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ****'''[[Talents#Bottom Freeze|{{Cl|ice|Bottom Freeze}}]]:''' Hitting your enemies with any attuned mantra projectiles while they are on ice freezes them to the ground. ****'''[[Talents#Frozen Legs|{{Cl|ice|Frozen Legs}}]]:''' Hitting anyone with a slow effect attuned mantra prevents them from rolling. ***'''Ether Proselyte: Thundercall Stance''': In the {{cl|ltn|'''Thundercall'''}} Saint Stance, all attuned Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ***'''Ether Proselyte: Miscellaneous''': in '''any''' Saint Stance, your Mantras are able to proc the following Talents: ****'''[[Talents#Winter's Protection|{{cl|def|Winter's Protection}}]]''': Effect ''with Ether Proselyte'' is currently unknown. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Verses of Harmony}} [Memento Talent] - Each elemental stance grants access to select talents from the corresponding attunement. |-|Flamecharm= {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Blade of Saints (☆☆☆) |image=SS-FireCrit.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure a blade attack depending on your Saint stance |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|fir|Fire}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Rise into the air, and slam down your Saintsblade to apply {{status|Burn|burn}} and {{status|Knockdown|knockdown}} to anyone hit.'' *Upon changing your Saint Stance, this ability will change accordingly. }} |-|Frostdraw= {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Blade of Saints (☆☆☆) |image=SS - Frost Crit.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure a blade attack depending on your Saint stance |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ice|Ice}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Use your Saintsblade to shoot out 3 crescent-shaped ice projectiles, followed up by a lunge which applies heavy knockback.'' *Upon changing your Saint Stance, this ability will change accordingly. }} |-|Galebreathe= {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Blade of Saints (☆☆☆) |image=SS - Gale Crit.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure a blade attack depending on your Saint stance |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|wnd|Wind}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''You propel yourself forwards with the winds, uppercutting anyone in your wake.'' *Procs {{t|Meteor Impact}}. *Upon changing your Saint Stance, this ability will change accordingly. }} |-|Shadowcast= {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Blade of Saints (☆☆☆) |image=SS - Shadow Crit.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure a blade attack depending on your Saint stance |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|sdw|Shadow}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''The Saintsblade releases a horizontal mid-range slash of darkness that pulls enemies along with it, knocking them up at the end of its path.'' *Upon changing your Saint Stance, this ability will change accordingly. }} |-|Thundercall= {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Blade of Saints (☆☆☆) |image=SS - Thunder Crit.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Conjure a blade attack depending on your Saint stance |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ltn|Lightning}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''Slash twice with your Saintsblade, applying {{status|Knockdown|knockdown}} on the second hit, followed up by a devastating bolt of lightning that applies stun.'' *Gains additional hits when modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloud]] & [[Stratus Stone]]s. *Upon changing your Saint Stance, this ability will change accordingly. }}
=={{cl|attune5|Verses of Harmony}}==
While in the respective Saint Stance, you gain the Talents listed below. These Talents will appear in your Journal under "effects". Upon swapping out of the corresponding Saint Stance, all Talents gained through this effect will be lost until you swap back. Some Talents will be unlocked when you reach a certain Power threshold. ==={{cl|fir|Flamecharm Stance}}=== *Dancing Steps [Common Talent] '''Starter''' - Fire mantras now move you in the direction you're facing. **Casting a Flamecharm Mantra will give you a moderate boost of horizontal movement in the direction your character is facing. This will still proc even if the Mantra is feinted. **Very useful for closing distance and getting into close quarters combat. **5 second cooldown. *Immolation [Common Talent] '''Starter''' - Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. (+8 Sanity) **"Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you. **"Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. It also applies burn even if you have Eruption Path: Lava Serpent. ***Not all attacks proc this effect, unlike what the Talent description implies. Instead, all instances of Physical damage apply burn, even if the attack doesn't deal pure Physical damage (e.g. [[Clutching Shadow]]). And all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) vfx on hit like [[Ice Daggers]] or [[Gale Lunge]] will also proc Immolation, applying burn. *Agitating Spark [Common Talent] '''Power 5''' - Applying [[Burn]]ing to enemies spreads to to anyone nearby. Including yourself. **On proc, a small orange particle will trail between the burning target you hit and other targets nearby, setting them on fire. **Agitating Spark bypasses block and parry. **Agitating Spark procs caused by self damage will not apply burn. Flame Within is an exception to this. **Has a 1 second cooldown. **Can spread to allies. The Controlled Combustion Talent will prevent Agitating Spark spreading burn to yourself and your allies. ==={{cl|ice|Frostdraw Stance}}=== *Condensation Drip [Common Talent] '''Starter ''' - Passively collect condensation from the air, greatly reducing your thirst. **Slows thirst drain by approximately 3 times. *{{cl|raretl|Saint Jay}} [Rare Talent] '''Starter''' - When a Chilled enemy receives a heal, it's nullified and 60% of the healing is redirected to you. While this is active and they are on ice your rate of healing is increased, raise your PvE [[Status Effects#Heal Boost|Heal Boost]] to 10% as well. **This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent. **This only procs on non-passive healing. For example (non exhaustive list): something like [[Flame Wisp]], spits, or [[Bloodless Gem]] will proc this effect, but campfires, Conditioned Runner, or [[Curse of the No Life King]] will not. **If using Glass Path: Crystallization then every hit with a Frostdraw mantra will proc Saint Jay for 2 seconds. (Doesn't stack) **The "on ice" effect of Saint Jay is bugged and does not work. **The heal boost status effect increases all non-passive healing gained from enemies who are currently affected by your anti-heal. This Talent grants +10% Heal Boost. **The maximum amount of Heal Boost you can have have is 45%, by having the following Talents: All Above, Gods Below (+15%), All the Dead Gods (+5%), Frostbite (+5%), Saint Jay (+10%), and Sin Stacker (+10%). *{{cl|raretl|Frozen Legs}} [Rare Talent] '''Power 5''' - Your slow effect prevents your opponents from rolling. **Does not work with Crystallization. **Lasts the first 0.75 seconds after chill/freeze procs. **Only procs off mantras. *Fragile Freeze [Common Talent] '''Power 10''' - Your Light Attacks and Critical will now freeze chilled opponents on guardbreak. **Guardbreaking a chilled opponent with a weapon attack will encase them in ice, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time. **Taking damage by any source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early. **You can spam F to get out of Freeze faster. *Chilling Flourish [Common Talent] '''Power 10''' - When flourishing an enemy, they leave behind a trail of ice in the direction you send them. **Leaves 3-4 ice patches on the ground. ==={{cl|wnd|Galebreathe Stance}}=== *Pressure Break [Common Talent] '''Starter''' - Breaking an enemy's posture will cause them to take intense wind pressure, increasing the attack's damage by +25% and flinging the enemy backwards. (+2 Passive Agility) *Wind Step [Common Talent] '''Starter''' - Create a step of wind below you when jumping in the air. Jumping while sliding down a slope or off a cliff launches you forwards. **Press space while in the air to double jump. This leaves a small tornado behind that someone else can jump into to also double jump. **While in combat, this ability cost Ether to use. **Jump while sliding down a slope to perform a gale leap that propels you forwards. *Air Pressure [Common Talent] '''Power 5''' - Dodging an attack or hitting an enemy's block will transform your next dash into a Gale Dash. Gale Dashes carry you further than regular dashes and have extended iframes, but will clear immediately should you initiate an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **8 second cooldown. *Cyclone Blade [Common Talent] '''Power 10''' - After a successful Gale Dash you wrap your weapon in wind, causing your next Light attack to do +30% damage as bleed and have +10% chip damage. (+2 Passive Agility) **Does not have a cooldown, lasts for 3s. **Despite the Talent description stating "Light attack", it also grants its buffs to weapon criticals. *Inhale [Common Talent] '''Power 10''' - [[Combat Mechanics#Combat Basics|Feinting]] a [[Galebreathe|Wind spell]] stores its power in your lungs for 5 seconds, empowering the next wind spell cast in that time. All relevant [[Mantra Modifiers|modifications]] and upgrades from the inhaled wind mantras are applied to the empowered mantra. **Inhaling a Galebreathe Mantra adds (Mantra level multiplied by 2)% damage to the next Galebreathe Mantra. For example, a level 5 inhale will give your next Gale mantra a 10% damage buff. **Inhaling grants a speed boost for 3 seconds. **Inhaling grants the [[Status Effects#Maestro's Blade|Maestro's Blade]] status effect. This effect allows your basic attacks to proc After Cut. **The duration of Maestro's Blade is the inhaled Mantra's Ether cost (before [[Blue Gem]]) divided by 5. For example, a 50 Ether cost Mantra will apply Maestro's Blade for 10 seconds. **Can be procced through shadow mantras while using the [[Eyes of Ethiron]] weapon. *{{cl|advancedtl|A World Without Song}} [Advanced Talent] '''Power 15''' - Every 3 hits with a Wind Mantra now procs [[Suffocation|Suffocating]]. **Suffocation prevents the victim from casting Mantras and deals a small amount of damage over time. ==={{cl|ltn|Thundercall Stance}}=== *{{cl|raretl|Static Fakeout}} [Rare Talent] '''Starter''' - Roll cancelling immediately after a parry will cause you to teleport behind your opponent. *Stratoshock [Common Talent] '''Starter''' - Your lightning deals an additional +5% damage when in the rain. **Thundercall damage innately gains a 5% damage buff during rain, with Stratoshock increasing this to +10% damage. *Resolve Crusher [Common Talent] '''Power 5''' - Lightning moves now apply stacks of "Resolve Crusher". At 4 stacks, you apply "Electrified" to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you. **Electrified targets have their damage on weapon attacks changed to Thundercall damage. **Electrified only reduces damage from weapon attacks. **Resolve Crusher's "Electrified" effect is only applied after the 5th stack (not the 4th stated by the Talent) **'''Only''' Thundercall Mantras build up stacks for this. Thunder damage from any other source will not build up stacks. **Each stack lasts for 5 seconds. If another stack is not applied within that timeframe, the stack is reset, and you'll need 5 more stacks to activate this Talent. **Electrified, when procced, lasts for 4 seconds. *Static Blade [Common Talent] '''Power 10''' - {{ttag|Medium Weapons}} Hitting blocks, blocking or parrying hits will now generate an electric charge in your blade, granting a small speed buff. Charges can stack up to 5 times. **Grants stacks when you '''get parried''', not when you parry attacks. ==Description==
The five Saintsworn Obelisks are NPCs that are required to be located and interacted with to obtain the [[Saintsworn]] [[Oath]]. These obelisks are based in five elements: [[Flamecharm]], [[Frostdraw]], [[Thundercall]], [[Galebreathe]], and [[Shadowcast]], each inhabited by the soul of [[The Five Heroes|the element's Hero]]. 

Obelisks can only be interacted with if you have atleast 15 of their respective element.

==Obelisks==
{{EnemyGallery
|File:FrostdrawObelisk.png|Frostdraw Obelisk
|File:GalebreatheObelisk.png|Galebreathe Obelisk
|File:ThundercallObelisk.png|Thundercall Obelisk
|File:FlamecharmObelisk.png|Flamecharm Obelisk
|File:ShadowcastObelisk.png|Shadowcast Obelisk
}}

==Location==
Each Obelisk is located in a unique, secluded area within another landmark. These areas are all hazardous, each hazard covering the floor and inflicting a debuff; in the Frostdraw Obelisk's case killing you instantly; or in the Shadowcast Obelisk's case, being situated in a high-up area that experiences [[Wind (hazard)|Wind]] and is prone to falls.

*The {{cl|ice|Frostdraw}} Obelisk is located in the [[Glacial Remnant]], accessible through a crack in the wall behind a destructible bookshelf on the second floor of the [[Crypt of the Unbroken]].
*The {{cl|wnd|Galebreathe}} Obelisk is located in the [[Burning Stone Gardens]], near [[Duke Erisia's Manor]].
*The {{cl|ltn|Thundercall}} Obelisk is located on the [[Boatman's Watch]], found within a cave on the northern side of it.
*The {{cl|fir|Flamecharm}} Obelisk is located in [[Saramaed Summit]], found within a crack in the wall accessible through parkour atop the summit's heights.
*The {{cl|sdw|Shadowcast}} Obelisk is located on the [[Moon's Eyrie]], atop a path leading to a high-up, dangerous area above its pillars and found in a crack in the wall at the end of the path.

See the [[Oath: Saintsworn#Obtainment|Saintsworn page]] for guides on how to reach all Obelisks.

==Dialogue==
'''{{cl|fir|Flamecharm}} Obelisk''': "I've seen what happens when fire burns too hot. It leaves nothing behind but ruin. If you choose this path, remember. you will never be the same. Flame is both a gift and a curse, and it will show you what you're made of..." - [[Jace]]

'''{{cl|wnd|Galebreathe}} Obelisk''': "You must decide, seeker. Will you let the wind carry you, or will you struggle against its pull? It is a path only those who truly understand the winds dare to walk." - [[Trinity Galenwarde]]

'''{{cl|sdw|Shadowcast}} Obelisk''': "Once, I stood with the Five, a hero among them. But loyalty? It's a fragile thing. Betrayal? It's as inevitable as the night." - [[Urek Felhand]]

'''{{cl|ice|Frostdraw}} Obelisk''': "Ah, a seeker of knowledge, or perhaps just a fool seeking the ice... Faust they called me. The one who saw the patterns, who understood the way of the world better than anyone else." - [[Faust]]

'''{{cl|ltn|Thundercall}} Obelisk''': "Thundercall, huh? You want that power? That zing that comes with it? But remember thundercall isn't something you can control easily, not even if you try really hard." - [[Tessa]]

==Trivia==
*There is a symbol marked on all 4 sides of the base of each obelisk. Curiously, two of these symbols match the emblem of [[The Central Authority]].

The {{g|The Suncross|Suncross}} is symbolic of the sacrifices made by our Gods, their struggle, and their divinity. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The sinners are still out there, but I cannot deny that you have proven your piety. Perhaps your task is greater than merely taking care of loose ends. The stars will avail themselves to you, of this I am sure. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Do not presume to know that which is not yours. I have given you a task. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...Is the Suncross a Celestial? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Does the Moonseye hold a similar position? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player instantly full progresses the Starkindred Oath {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*They smile.*'' Some sects of the faith believe so. I cannot fault such a line of thinking, but having spent so much time in the presence of a {{g|The Celestials|Celestial}}, I do not believe it to be so. To the senses of we {{g|The Starkindred Faith|Starkindred}} Oathsworn, it does not seem to possess Ichor. We do not feel the same connection to it that we do to the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} through our {{g|Vows|Vow}}. So in a sense, we interpret its gift ''through'' the gifts of the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}}. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} is sacred, of this there is no doubt. Within the {{g|The Starkindred Faith|Starkindred}} faith, the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} is the gateway to the promised land that we will journey to upon the revival of the {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} and the banishment of the Deep. We believe that the souls of deceased {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}} make their way to the {{g|The Moonseye|Moonseye}} to make preparations for the promised day. It's comforting to think of them looking down at us from it, no? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What about the Moonseye? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See "Does the Moonseye hold a similar position?"] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}-{{!}}Maxed Out= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}It is good to see you once more, kin. Have you come to pay your respects? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the significance of the Suncross within the faith? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}-{{!}}Encountered a Maljuror= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}It is good to see you once more, kin. Have you come to pay your respects? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's up with the twisted Starkindred that roam the Rotlands? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}Ah, you have encountered a Maljuror? They are those that the Ichor has ''rejected''. Either in their initiation or at some point in their service, they lost their faith and fell into sin. As such, they are rightly punished by the divinity within them, and twisted into wretched beasts. You need not pity them. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So you're saying I could become one of those things? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The sinners we hunt don't seem to be affected, though? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*They smile.*'' Only if your faith falters, kin. From what you've displayed thus far, I don't foresee it being an issue. Do you? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}No, not as such. They seek the protection of the Ichor, but it is for their own selfish ends. They have 'faith', but it is ''heretical''. They turn their back on the flock. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] }} |-|Other= {{#tag:tabber|Player has an Oath= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}You enter this sanctum with a mind full of ''false ideals''. Savour this most holy of sights, but know that the path it promises is forever closed to you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}-{{!}}Oathbreaking Starkindred= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Initial dialogue in Temple of Hearts {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Subsequent Encounters with Samael {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}The Stars were never yours to lay claim to. You're just another heretic rejected by the blood. {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Treacherous worm. {{sh|Leave}}. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] }} ==Trivia== *Of the currently playable aspects in-game, Samael cannot be any of the following based on the absence of their defining traits: Adret, Capra, Chrysid, Ganymede, Gremor, Tiran, or Vesperian. This narrows the possibilities to Canor, Celtor, Etrean, and Khan. *Their old appearance simply left them with the old [[Hollow Angel|Lesser Angel]] mask that completely hid their identity while keeping the [[Pathfinder Arch-Sorcerer]] Outfit. {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]] [[Category:Oath Trainer]] [[Category:The Starkindred Church]]

content:
{{Topbuttons|[[Nanji]], {{iv|p}}}} {{IronVowEx|counterpart}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Samnang |name=Samnang |aspect=Etrean |pronouns=He/they |location=[[The Lordsgrove]] |family=*{{iv|Clan Mofisu}}
**{{iv|Sophon}} (brother) |affiliation={{iv|Clan Mofisu}} |image1=Samnang.png }} ==Description== Samnang is a [[Etrean]] [[NPC]]. His brother {{iv|Sophon}}, is a sworn warrior for {{iv|Clan Mofisu}}. ==Location== Samnang is located against a rock ledge near {{iv|Vesna}} at [[The Lordsgrove]]. Samnang Map.png ==Dialogue== |-|First Encounter= {{#tag:tabber|Quest Start= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Oh brother, where have you gone?.. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is something wrong? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}My brother... He's a warrior of Clan Mofisu. Lord Choji summoned him to the Viridian Sanctuary, calling all remaining warriors of our clan to arms... But he was meant to return by now. I worry for him so much, stranger. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Maybe I've heard something. What's his name? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}His name is Sophon. I'm Samnang. We're both kinsmen of Clan Mofisu... We used to reside in Etrea, until the war broke out. We've been trying to secure refuge at the Greathive, but we've not had much success... My brother is a sworn warrior of the clan, and must answer their calls to arms. I know he's a capable warrior, but still, I worry greatly for this safety... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Scabbard not found {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Scabbard already found {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm sorry. I haven't heard a thing. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I found a scabbard at the Mofisu estate. The Viridian Sanctuary was attacked. I'm afraid your brother is gone... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Sigh.*'' I suppose I shouldn't have expected you to... These are turbulent times. Stranger, if you hear any word from him, I pray, come back and let me know. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No, this cannot be... He gave his life for our clan?.. He shouldn't have gone, I told him, I told him, I... ''*Samnang seems shattered, their lip quivering. He lingers silently for a moment, grieving, before turning to you with teary eyes.*'' Forgive me, I... Thank you for helping me. At least I know what happened now... May {{g|Mur of Light|Mur's}} light shine your path, stranger. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'll keep an eye out. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], gain Reputation with Etrean Royalists and a small chest {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}If you end up finding him, I'll be forever grateful to you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}-{{!}}Quest End= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}You're back!.. But... My brother is not with you... Did you find out anything at all?.. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Scabbard found {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|action}} {{!}}Scabbard not found {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I found a scabbard at the Mofisu estate. The Viridian Sanctuary was attacked. I'm afraid your brother is gone... {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I haven't been able to find him. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No, this cannot be... He gave his life for our clan?.. He shouldn't have gone, I told him, I told him, I... ''*Samnang seems shattered, their lip quivering. He lingers silently for a moment, grieving, before turning to you with teary eyes.*'' Forgive me, I... Thank you for helping me. At least I know what happened now... May {{g|Mur of Light|Mur's}} light shine your path, stranger. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No?.. Please, I pray, keep looking for him... I will remain here, just in case he returns... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], gain Reputation with Etrean Royalists and a small chest {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] }} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Their eyes are full of sorrow.*'' My poor brother... May his soul rest... Thank you for bringing me this closure, stranger. May {{g|Mur of Light|Mur's}} light shine upon your path... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] ==Trivia== *Samnang is a Khmer name that means "peaceful" or "calm". {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Clan Mofisu]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

The corroded dagger falls away, leaving the splinter and blood to dance through the helical mold. ==Description==
The Sanguine Transfuser is a support-based [[Relic]] weapon, fused with the [[Dormant Splinter]]. The dagger has a build consisting of spiraling helix of crystallized blood with a pointy edge on the top, constantly emitting mist-like particles of blood. The guard is circular and flares outward with jagged, petal-like projections, resembling a flower. The handle is wrapped in a red leather-like material, and the pommel resembles a crystal.

It is crafted within [[The Cold Forge]] with:
	
*1 [[Hemobloom]]
*1 [[Ancient Dagger Remains]]
*1 [[Dormant Splinter]]
	
==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Transfusion.gif
</gallery>
The user stabs themselves, applying 40 [[Wither]] to themselves before spraying their blood onto the ground. Following the stab, anyone who stands on this blood pool, including the user, will be healed for 5 health per tick. This blood pool has a durability of 20 ticks over 6 seconds. The blood pool will dissipate faster if several people are in it since each person causes 1 more durability to be used per tick.

If you do not meet Sanguine Transfuser's attribute requirements, the healing per-tick will be reduced to 3.

If the user has high enough Wither, or low enough HP, using the critical will automatically grip themselves.

If the critical is used in the air, it will apply 40 wither to the user and then follow up with the default Dagger critical.

The critical has a cooldown of '''19 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Sanguine Transfuser Equipped.png|Equipped
File:Sanguine Transfuser Alloyblood Critical.png|Critical (Alloyblood)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*This weapon is held in reverse grip.
*The critical's healing does not count as passive regeneration, allowing you to turn it into a damaging tool with the {{t|Hemorrhaging Blow}} Talent.
*The aura and critical effect of the Sanguine Transfuser do not change color with alloyblood.
*If the Sanguine Transfuser is brought back to [[Seroth]] on the same character that made it and is equipped, he will unlock a unique set of dialogue.
*This weapon reuses the animations of the [[Spectral Grasp]].

== Description ==
Santen is a [[Ganymede]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. Santen is the cartographer for [[The Central Authority]]'s Eastern garrison.

Santen was trained by her parents in the Citadel of Markor to make maps since she "could hold a pen."

She appears to be aged shown by the wrinkles around her eyes.

She wears a Black [[Deepwoken Cloak]], the [[Seamstress's Attire]] outfit, a [[Brigand's Bicorn]], and a [[Pathfinder's Backpack]].
== Location ==
Santen is located inside of a building at the edges of [[Fort Merit]], close to [[Merit's Reach]].

__TOC__

==Description==
Santiago Talo was a Ranger of [[the Divers]]. They were assigned with leading a patrol party, consisting of them, Ranger [[Bykof]], Ranger [[Emirad]] and new Diver recruits. Eventually, he diverted his scouting party away from his assigned path, heading towards the direction of the Landfall.<ref name="Interrogation" />

With two other Rangers: Bykof and Emirad, they dispatched of a stray [[Thresher]] and found deceased bodies of Celtorian citizens of the upper class. After which, they looked at [[the City of the Drowned]] and saw individuals leading a procession into the city. Eventually, they decided to stick to the assigned route and finish it.<ref name="Interrogation" />

On Sunsdawn, 9th Bloomfall, 904 CE he was interrogated by a [[Black Divers division|Black Diver]] [[Ulysses Disii]] on the case of insubordination. [[The High Convocation]] were responsible for his punishment, although, Disii recommended for his assignment to sanitation duties at [[The Citadel of Markor|the Citadel]] for two weeks.<ref name="Interrogation" />

==Description==
'''Sap''' is an [[Ingredients|Ingredient]] in Deepwoken. It can be found on all types of trees (except for palm trees) in several locations such as [[Greathive Aratel]], around [[Etris]], in [[Miner's Landing]], and lots of other locations and looks like a small, yellow liquid coming out of the tree. It is used frequently in recipes, specifically food items that require sweetness. It also gives the strongest negative speed buff and the strongest positive Ether regen buff. 

For more information, read [[Alchemy]] and [[Ingredients]].

==Recipes==
*[[Cake]] - 1 Egg, 3 Gathered Wheat, 1 Sap.
*[[Candied Fruit]] - 2 of any [[Fruit]]s.
*[[Glazed Fish]] - 1 Fish Meat, 1 Sap.
*[[Sticky Bun]] - 1 Sap, 3 Gathered Wheat.

For more information, you can read [[Food]].

==Trivia ==

*Sap cannot be found during the Winter, except in Greathive Aratel.
*The model when you are holding sap is just a translucent, orange block.

The Saramaed Crossing is a giant, broken passage, located between the [[Miner's Landing]] and the [[Starfield Veldt]]. The passage has a number of static [[Brainsucker]] spawns, and a [[Random Encounters|random encounter]] with 2 [[Summer Company Guard]]s fighting a [[Mechalodaunt]].

The player will have to use the [[Gliders|glider]] in order to get from the end of the passage to the [[Starfield Veldt]].
