title: Saramaed Hollow
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Location|name=Saramaed Hollow|caption=The deeper one digs, the more the fruits of the earth avail themselves, though there are things better left interred within...}} [[File:Location Saramaed Hollow.png|center|thumb|900px]] '''Saramaed Hollow''' is a dungeon in Deepwoken. It is a sub-location of [[Miner's Landing]], == Description == [[File:Deepdelver Tau.png|thumb|174x174px|[[Deepdelver Tau]]. NPC that sends you to '''Saramaed Hollow.''']] This dungeon, taking place deep underground beneath Miner's Landing and its [[Saramaed Summit]], is the primary method of progression for the [[Ignition Delver]] Origin. However, anyone can partake in this dungeon as long as they have above neutral reputation with the Ignition Union. '''Saramaed Hollow''' can be entered by interacting with [[Deepdelver Tau]] in [[Miner's Landing]] behind the watermill, if you're part of the Divers (aka the origin), [[Deepdelver Tau]] will tell you to scram, but this can be overwritten by increasing your rep slightly (it took me one of the Summer's Dusk quests to be allowed). You can choose to work solo or as a team of up to 5 players. To start the dungeon, you need to enter the Union Drill and pull the lever. '''Saramaed Hollow''' has four types of maps, which are selected randomly. You may encounter mobs, and killing all of them will spawn chests near the Union Drill. None of the mobs are corrupted; they can only be Attuned. Note that all the maps contain lava as an environmental hazard, which deal an extreme amount of damage for both new and more experienced players and for the new players it could burn you to death. == Dungeon Features == [[File:Orb.png|thumb|Orb which used to refuel Union Drill]] '''Saramaed Hollow''' features 20 Floors in 100 meter increments (2000 meters or 2KM in total). Floor 0/0 meters is a lobby area that features a Heat Stone Resting Spot, a Training Gear Cabinet, a Crafting Table, an Antiquarian, a Mantra Lectern and a Blacksmith. There are also pickaxes on the ground by the Union Drill available to buy for 3 notes if you do not already own one. Each floor of the dungeon has you go down 100 meters (IE: floor 10 is 1000m, floor 20 is 2000m). To travel through each floor, the Ignition Deepdrill is used, fitted with a lever to go to the next floor and a radio to return to the lobby, which can notably be used anytime, even while in danger. You start at a different depth on your first time going down depending on what power you are. If you go up and go back down, you will go down half of how far you were before you went up. The higher power you are, the farther down you start. The monster presets get harder as you go down farther. You can't get past 2km / 2000m. Trying to press the lever on this level be met with the text: ''The lever jams. Seems the cable wont extend any further.'' There are 4 room layouts, featuring randomized enemy spawns: * The Bridge * The Canyon * The Rail Tracks * The Open Field Strictly speaking, to progress within this dungeon, players must mine and deposit fuel ore into the fuel hatch, located on the left of the door. A progress bar will show how much fuel was added. It takes 5 ores (+2 per player after the first, up to a max of 13) to refuel the drill. Once the fuel hatch shows a green bar, the drill is fueled and ready to go to the next floor. Fuel Ore can be stacked on top of each other when mining for easier carrying. You can also slide, dodge, use mantras and critical attacks as well as being able to summon and ride a mount while carrying Fuel Ore. Do note that using your weapon while carrying these ores makes you drop the ore. To actually be rewarded during this activity, players are required to kill every monster in a given floor. Doing so will grant a large amount of EXP, along with attribute training EXP and chests spawning near the Ignition Deepdrill. It is worth noting that the lava is not as deadly as one might expect. Falling into it is not a death sentence, one can easily climb up on a nearby rock to go back to the main area. However, they deal quick damage over time, making it ''not so ideal'' to fight monsters down there. == Monster adaptations == Monsters within the Saramaed Hollow have adapted to the fiery heat of their domain, gaining 1 of 2 (or both) abilities. The deeper one goes, the more adapted monsters will appear, eventually culminating in monsters with both adaptations. Additionally, some mobs' appearances are overridden, making them look like rocks. This also means you can NOT tell which variant a mob is by only viewing it from afar. For example, a Crimson Megalodaunt and a normal Megalodaunt may have the same rock appearance, meaning you will be unable to tell the difference. Be cautious. * ''Magma Guard'' - The monster becomes immune to DvM. These monsters have a rocky exterior. (Note: Innate PvE scaling, such as from your Power level, isn't affected.) * ''Magma Flow'' - The monster procs an effect on hit that weakens your armor and nullifies your Monster Armor temporarily. These monsters will drip with molten lava. == Monsters == Monsters shown here will start showing up and replacing other monsters the deeper one goes in the order shown, but may show up much earlier or even show up later on. A Mudskipper Broodlord can appear in Floor 5 for example, while a regular Megalodaunt might show up in Floor 20. {{EnemyGallery |AlphsharkoIcon.png|Alpha Megalodaunt |CarbuncleIcon.png|Carbuncle |CrimsonMegalodauntIcon.png|Crimson Megalodaunt |MechalodauntIcon.png|Mechalodaunt |MegalodauntIcon.png|Megalodaunt |MudskipperIcon.png|Mudskipper |MudskipperbruteIcon.png|Mudskipper Brute |MudskipperBroodlordIcon.png|Mudskipper Broodlord |Stoneknighticon.png|Stone Knight |ThresherIcon.png|Thresher }} == Loot == Loot is based on the type of mob you kill. Some of the loot confirmed to drop from Saramaed Hollow can be found in the table below. ===

The mobs that currently drop the best loot are the [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] and [[Mudskipper Brute]] due to dropping a chest with loot weighed more favorably towards rare drops. More loot will appear if bringing more players, but naturally, this will also result in more monsters. Be cautious! [[Relics]] and [[Enchant Stone]]s can drop from any chest at any floor. Floors at 1.50km or higher have a higher chance at rarer loot, only when 1-3 [[Thresher]]s Spawn. ==Gallery== IUTeaser.png|[https://x.com/Deepwoken/status/1832243726103503042 Saramaed Hollow Teaser] File:Molten Rocks Stacking.png|A player stacking ores File:Cave Drawing .png|A humanoid being chased by an unknown entity File:Cave drawing 2.png|A large humanoid tyrant File:Cave Drawing 3.png|Unknown Markings File:Saramaed Hollow Markings 4.png|A group of humanoids fighting Threshers File:Cave art.png|More Unknown Markings File:Drill.png|Bottom of the Drill ==Tips== *The [[Talent Quests|Excavator talent]] is highly recommended for faster Saramed runs. It can be obtained from wearing a [[Miner's Hardhat]] or completing the [[Talent Quests|Excavator quest]]. *The Saramaed Hollow is a fairly low-risk, high-reward dungeon as you have the chance of getting most relics, enchant stones, and godroll gear just from killing medium level mobs like Megalodaunts and Threshers. **But due to the difficulty spikes early on, deep delves into this dungeon are not recommended for low level players. It may be more convenient to seek experience elsewhere. *If you are at low health and about to die, you can easily escape by running back to the Deepdrill and interacting with the radio inside to pull you up. This can be used even if you are in danger, to quickly help you escape. Do note that if you do successfully escape, you will be sent back up to 0m and will have to restart the delving all over again. **Do note that if you are doing it with one or more friends, you will need to wait for all of them to be near / inside the Deepdrill before you can use the radio to call you up. *A valid strategy is to stockpile fuel in the Deepdrill and take it with you to other floors. Then, if you reach a floor that is a hassle to deal with, you can instantly fully fuel the Drill and skip the floor. *Despite all the upsides, Saramaed Hollow is very time-consuming, and the drops are very RNG dependant; you can either get REALLY lucky and hit the jackpot, or, more than likely, go back up to the surface practically empty-handed. *The Saramaed Hollow can be used to very easily farm notes, since the first layers are relatively easy and give large chests that give a ton of equipment. The equipment can then be sold to the antiquarian above. You can expect to get over a thousand {{c|notes|Notes}} per floor. *The [[Mounts|Thresher Mount]] can be used while carrying ores. The mounts can also stand on lava without you being dismounted. *To farm this dungeon efficiently, it is recommended to build for mobility options. Additionally, due to Magma Flow, it is heavily recommended to primarily build for HP, over resistance stats, on your equipment. Good luck, and happy deepdelving! == Trivia == *This is the first source of [[Pluripotent Alloy]] outside of bosses. *Saramed allegedly awards you [[Resonance|Resonance progression]] but '''this is not confirmed''' and needs testing *There is a rare chance for the drill to bring you to 666m, this is visual, as the layer will still act as your first delve, being 800m. *The more people you have, the more fuel you need to continue to progress. **1 person: 5 fuel ores **2 people: 7 fuel ores **3 or more people: 9 fuel ores *Rarely, there may be a floor that usually comes after or at 1.5km that requires you to kill just one to three [[Thresher]]s in turn for amazing loot. **The belief among the community is that the dungeon is attempting to spawns monsters that it cannot (presumably [[King Thresher]]s), leading to only a few Threshers spawning. *The cave paintings show that civilization has once been here long before the Union have. **The cave painting on the first image depicts a humanoid being encountering a large, unknown beast, possibly a Megalodaunt. **The cave painting on the second image depicts what seems to be three Gremors (identified by their large horns) near a larger, humanoid figure, which seems to be speaking. *When you try to leave the dungeon by calling for the cable crew to haul you back up and your teammate isn't nearby, a message "Leave no delver behind" will be displayed. This is a reference to "Leave no dwarf behind" from ''Deep Rock Galactic''. *Previously, you were not able to slide or dash while holding Fuel ore. However, as of the Vow of Iron update, this has been changed and are now able to, making movement much easier. '''Saramaed Summit''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a [[Voidzones|Voidzone]] area found in the East Luminant.

== Overview ==

Saramaed Summit is an area within the upper area of [[Miner's Landing]], accessible through hallways past the boiler room's circular vault door. The air is constantly permeated with a thick, orange mist, and many [[Mechalodaunt]]s are often present throughout the area.

There are multiple entrances that lead to Saramaed Summit. One entrance, located to the right of the boiler room's vault door, requires a [[Resonance]] to open. The other entrance which is easily accessible by going to the left after entering the vault door, which will take you to the board room, making another left at the doorhole to enter. The last entrance is located in a room with an Ignition Union NPC and does not have a Resonance door.

The [[Flamecharm]] obelisk for [[Oath: Saintsworn|Saintsworn]] can be found in this area.

Saramaed Summit is a '''Voidzone''', meaning you will directly be sent to [[The Depths]] if you die in it regardless of other influences.

Saramaed Summit in {{iv|Vow of Iron}} is a [[Voidzone]] found in {{iv|Miner's Landing (Vow of Iron)}}.

__TOC__

==Overview==
In {{iv|Vow of Iron}}, Saramed Summit is the crater of an active volcano. [[Miner's Landing]] is still under construction, with only a few [[Ignition Union]] settlements scattered across the island.

Unlike it's [[Saramaed Summit|pathfinder counterpart]], Saramaed Summit in Vow of Iron is a big open area with minimal human intervention, besides a few construction cranes.

==Contents==
===Magma Shrooms===
Located in the southern point of the Saramaed Summit is a small hill, with dangerous cracks filled with lava and several magma shrooms.

The static spawn for 1 [[Golem Magma]] and 2 [[Mechalodaunt]]s is located here. The Mechalodaunts will always win against the golem as they outnumber and overpower it easily.

[[File:StaticSpawnSaramaedVOI.png|thumb|center|500px]]

This is also the location you may find the [[Prototype Railblade]], which lies in the southwest corner (-6613 494 3576).
[[File:PrototypeRailbladeLocation.png|thumb|center|500px]]

[[File:Prototype Railblade location.png|300px|center|Map location]]

===Elevator===
The easiest way to get to Saramaed Summit in {{iv|Vow of Iron}} is the elevator, located in the western point of the location.

[[File:ElevatorSaramaedSummitVOI.png|thumb|center|500px]]

[[File:ElevatorSaramaedSummitVOIMap.png|300px|center|Map location]]

===Ignition Union Camps===
Near the center of Saramaed Summit you can find camps of [[the Ignition Union]]. This is also where you will find the [[Pleeksty's Inferno]] on a small rock inside a lava lake (-6944 416 3552).

title: Sarkale
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|image1=Sarkale NPC.png
|name=Sarkale
|aspect=Khan
|pronouns=He/him
|location=[[Firfire Caverns]]}}

==Description==
Sarkale is a [[Khan]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He can found leaning against a mesh gate at the mouth of [[Firfire Caverns]]. Wearing the [[Darksteel Plate]] outfit, a scavenger as he so claims to be. Speaking of the caverns and advising the player to follow the various blue cubes scattered in the caves. 

{{clear}}
==Dialogue==
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
| colspan="3" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
| colspan="3" |Hm? You aren't a {{g|The Divers|Diver}}, what are you doing down here? I'm afraid this is not the ideal place to be exploring, traveler.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I'm seeking Chaser and his Divers.
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |I'm simply adventuring
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What are you doing down here?
|-
| colspan="1" |Ah, some sort of contingency if the party went missing, you are. But, then... ''*The man looks down and furrows his brow, lost in thought for a moment.*'' I've been watching that group for a while, but I lost sight of them after they traveled through here. Perhaps they didn't make it, or perhaps they did, but not in time.
| colspan="1" |A fool, in all of their glory! I pity you, traveler, I truly do. If you plan to make it out of here in one piece... I suggest you listen carefully. These tunnels are ''layered'', and there are corridors within this cavern system that allow you to ascend or descend its layers. Good luck, traveler. ''*He gives you a bright, almost too happy of a smile, before sending you off.*''
| colspan="1" |I'm just a vulture, traveler. Scurry off and die somewhere, and I'll happily take what you leave behind. You look like you carry much more worth than one of those {{g|The Divers|Divers}}... I'll be sure to ''watch'' you!
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |What's in this cave?
| colspan="2" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|-
| colspan="1" |It's not somewhere one would want to stay for long. I prefer the light outside much more to its crushing darkness. In my few ventures in there, I've always heard loud stomping... behind me, almost? I didn't want to stay to find out what was making those noises.
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} |How did you get out then?
|-
| colspan="1" |I turned around, and ran! ''*He laughs loudly, as if it were obvious.*'' Ah, but you're an adventurer, how could I forget! Since you'll be on different levels of the cavern, you'll want to run, hm... much deeper in that hell. In your case, perhaps running toward your destination would servr you better rather then running toward whence you came. Follow the lights, little lamb...
|-
| colspan="1" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

== Trivia ==
* The Aspect variant of Sarkale is Silverback

title: Scion of Ethiron
content:
''This is the boss encountered at the end of [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]]. For its puppeteer and namesake, see [[Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye]].'' {{PathfinderEx}} {{Quotes|quote=The egg hatches soon, little diver. The wails of the screaming child born under the snow will bring it all crashing down.|author=Carrion}} {{Monster Infobox |title1=Scion of Ethiron |image1=SCION_L2_BOSS.png |health=40,000 |drops= *Chest (see [[#Loot Table|loot table]]) *[[Kyrsieger]] *[[Whistling Periapt]] *[[Deep Gems]] *[[Armorer's Needle]] *[[Reciprocal Bonecharm]] *[[Ethereal Bone Dust]] *All Kyrs series weapons *Respawns Medallion Chests. *Misc. |locations=[[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]] |challenges= {{bi|{{PAGENAME}}|small}} }} ==Description== The Scion of Ethiron is a boss encountered at the end of the [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|second floor]] of the [[Second Layer|Eternal Gale]]. It's treated as a "final boss" to the game, allowing the access of endgame content such as [[Kyrsan Medallions]] among other things. It is tied to [[Ethiron]], acting as his puppet and avatar, with sealing it also sealing him temporarily, as described by [[Naerotiv]]. After being awoken by your disturbance, it takes the form of a skeletal monster made up of bones and feathers, with it's head being distinctively tetrahedron shaped, with a color scheme of purple-pinks and yellow fiber protruding from each corner. It also completely '''empties your lighthook''' to 0 minutes if any time was remaining. It uses a variety of attacks to defeat you, notably summoning bones and directing them at either the player or the ground. In addition, it has the abilities of [[Galebreathe]], able to fire a large laser, blind you, or fire a devastating death sphere at the player, obliterating any hit by it. Do note it is '''heavily resistant''' to [[Enchantments|Vampirism]] and [[Deep Gems|Bloodless Gems]]. Upon defeat, five chests containing [[Kyrsan Medallions]] will spawn in the City, along with a '''Large Chest''' at the entrance of his arena; containing a myriad of loot, including rare or exclusive items such as the [[Kyrsieger]], or [[Whistling Periapt]]. However, defeating him will also prompt a hard 3 minute timer, or 180 seconds, in order to escape the City at the Light Hook at the front of the city before you are guaranteed to wipe, more information can be found on [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa]]. Do note that telling [[Miserables|Misérables]] "'''I seek power in my upcoming battles'''" then interacting with the [[Purge Shrine]] not only spawns the [[Kyrsgarde Champion]] but also overall makes Scion of Ethiron much harder, making him not spawn healthpacks, charge his ult wind-up faster and a damage boost on all attacks. ==Attacks== ''For a visual guide consider watching [https://youtu.be/xJqekqeHmlg this video].'' {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Visual Demo |- |
'''Vehemens Ventus'''
(★★★) |The Scion holds its hands together and charges up a powerful attack for ~10 seconds. Once the attack is released, approximately 3 seconds after the charging sfx finishes, a large purple gale ball will be thrown in a player's direction with a loud sound cue. Upon impact, it deals insanely high posture and '''Wind''' damage. *It can be easily avoided with an air-dash, '''Ghost'''/'''Dark Rift''', jumping down a floor, using a waypoint with [[Run It Back]] or using [[Portals]]. *[[Payback]], despite not being disabled like other invincibility moves, will not prevent damage from this attack. *This attack can be cancelled with a group by attacking three small gale balls at the first floor, but is un-recommended due to the time it takes, along with requiring 2 people. *This attack is able to be tanked on the right setup, but is not recommended.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, this attack deals increased damage and charges twice as fast. However, it does '''NOT''' match the sound cue and will fire midway through it rather than at the end, though The Scion's throw speed remains unchanged.
{{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Vehemens Ventus.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Blinding Gale'''
(★☆☆) |The Scion charges up it's fist, then fires a blinding ball of gale towards the player. *This animation is shared with Pressured Wind, however does a pitiful 1 damage.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, this move remains unchanged. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Blinding Gale.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Pressurized Wind'''
(★★☆) |The Scion charges up its arm and releases a purple laser, locking onto a random player and forcing them to parry it. *While the damage is punishing if you get hit by the full beam, you should parry it on reaction to taking damage rather than reacting to the animation, as the animation is shared with Blinding Gale.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, this attack deals increased damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Pressurized Wind.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Whiplash'''
(★★☆) |The Scion pulls its arm back, then swings at the player. *The arm will remain for ~2 seconds after hitting the player, regardless of if it hit or not, leaving the Scion vulnerable for a few hits on parry.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, this attack deals increased damage. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.y, dodge.n, ragdoll }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Whiplash.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Bonestaves of Eld'''
(★★☆) |The Scion launches three bones per player in a set order. *These do medium posture damage per bone and can be blocked or parried. *If blocked/parried, the bone will fall onto the floor to be picked up and put into a shrine. *If the bone instead hits, does a low amount of damage and will not fall onto the floor. *If the bone collides with a wall, it will fizzle out and despawn. *This attack always targets the same players in the same order unless someone dies/leaves.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, the amount of bones increases from 3 to 4, and the damage increases. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.n }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Bonestaves of Eld.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Bonegrow'''
(★☆☆) |Bones will appear on the ground and grow upwards, this can be used in combination with any other move. *If this hits, it will launch you into the air and do low damage, but makes the next hit guaranteed. *In order to avoid this jump or roll through the spikes.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, the time between the bone sprouts appearing on the floor and their rising is drastically reduced, and the damage increases. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll, jump }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Bonegrow.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Bone Stream'''
(★★☆) |Bones will rise from the ground and circle around '''a single floor'''. *Similar to Bonegrow in able to remain active during other attacks, but sends you further, is more constant, does more damage, and is completely unable to be blocked. *To avoid this move, you must jump, or hold the Jump key and leave to another floor.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, this move will come out much earlier than usual, and the damage increases. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Scion of Ethiron Bone Stream.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Debris'''
(★☆☆) |The Scion summons 1 Kyrsgarde Sniper on each of the currently available Shrines, these have greatly reduced health and stats and are unable to move. *These only serve to heal you in the fight via killing them.

*While the Purge Shrine is active, The Scion will not use this move. {{AttackTags |summon }} |[[File:Placeholder.png|thumb]] |} ===Passives=== *'''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal 25% less damage to the Scion of Ethiron. Elemental Attacks deal 2x damage to the Scion of Ethiron *'''Stringed Puppet''' - The Scion is unable to be damaged by any means including damage reflection/redirection unless stunned by the nine-fold ritual or using its punch. *'''Unharvestable''' - All forms of on-damage healing such as Vampirism and Bloodless gems are negated if used on it. *'''Reverence''' - You are unable to gain Tempo from basic attacking or using mantras on the Scion. Many forms of on-demand Immunity moves such as Beast Burrow are disabled. == Beating the Scion == While the Scion of Ethiron may appear intimidating, it is widely considered one of the easier bosses in the game. Aside from its ultimate ability, none of its attacks pose a significant threat. It is crucial to maintain a calm and composed mindset, as panicking is the most common reason players are hit by its ultimate. Note that many on-demand invincibility abilities are disabled during this fight and should not be relied upon to avoid the ultimate. The primary strategy for defeating the Scion is to use the bones it throws during its '''Bone Throw''' move. You must place these bones into their corresponding shrines. This will stun the boss, creating a window for you to deal heavy damage. To accomplish this, simply block or parry the bonestaves and then run to a shrine while carrying them. A secondary, albeit much slower, win condition is to simply ignore the bone mechanic. If you allow the Scion to hit you with its punch multiple times, it will eventually die without summoning the [[Kyrsgarde Sniper]]s for health packs. Keep in mind you must activate the first 3 Shrines on the first floor for the Scion to use its punch. To avoid the ultimate, you can either parry or dodge it. The dodging method involves sliding, waiting for the audio cue of the Scion firing its orb, and then jumping and air-dashing to evade the attack. To parry the ultimate, wait for the same audio cue, but begin your parry just before the orb makes contact. While these maneuvers may seem difficult initially, they will become muscle memory with practice. For players without experience, air-dashing is generally the easier method to learn. With the Surge Shrine active you must pay attention to the orb and not the sound queue since the windup decreases while the sound cue stays the same. ==Loot Table== Upon defeating the Scion, it will drop a large chest at the entrance of his bedchamber containing: *Many Kyrsan series weapons. *2 [[Knowledge]] on first kill, 1 knowledge per kill if contributing 35% or more damage. *1 [[Crowns|Crown]] on kill *Very high odds of Deep Gems. *A variety of Rare and Legendary [[Equipment]], [[Weapons]], rings and [[Outfits]], all guaranteed to be at least 1 star quality. *Lesser [[Relics]] such as the [[Armorer's Needle]] or the [[Void Spire|Spires]]. *Rarely, [[Enchant Stone|Enchantment Stones]], various Legendary Weapons like the [[Kyrsieger]], or the [[Lightkeeper's Medallion]]. *Extremely Rarely, a [[Whistling Periapt]]. *15 Full Trainings on first kill.
===

===
'''All equipment and weapons are guaranteed to be at least one star quality.'''
This list may be missing items, please help us by filling in the gaps.

[[Reciprocal Bonecharm|{{cl|relic|Reciprocal Bonecharm}}]], [[Void Spire|{{cl|relic|Void Spire}}]]. |- | style="width:10%;" |'''[[Weapons]]''' | style="width:90%;" | *'''Legendary Weapons''': [[Curved title: Sea Highway
content:
{{CutContent}}

[[File:SeaHighway.png|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
[[Sea Highway]]s were structures found within the Etrean and Eastern [[Luminants]]. Upon a [[Boats|ship]] passing through what are commonly referred to as "Wind Gates", a 'jolt' of energy and powered waves caused them to traverse much faster across the sea while remaining within the highway. 

These highways are a masterwork of [[Thundercall]] efficiency, actively maintained and constructed by [[the Golden Link]], a company of [[Thundercall]]ers originally formed within [[the Citadel of Markor]].

Sea Highways were removed in the October 25th, 2025 update, replaced with a system that increases boat speed as you sail further from land.

* Standing on top of a guild base sign spawned by a [[Chime of Dwelling]] can let you summon a boat anywhere there is a valid surface.
* The Seafarer's Chime can be used on random encounter events terrain, such as the islands spawning in the Etrean Sea. 
* The Chime seems to have a height limit for spawning, as it refuses to spawn your boat if you're too high up from the sea level.
* The Seafarer's Chime can be used while in combat

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that increases your opponent's incoming PEN and drains their water.

==Effect==
{{PAGENAME}} increases your weapon's PEN by 5%. On hit apply the {{status|Cauterize}} status effect, increasing your opponent's incoming PEN, up to 40%.

The amount of PEN given per hit varies based on your weapon type, granting +5.45% incoming PEN per hit on [[Light Weapons]], +8% incoming PEN per hit on [[Medium Weapons]], and +10% incoming PEN per hit on [[Heavy Weapons]].

Stacks of Cauterize last 15 seconds. Applying a new stack does not refresh this timer.

Additionally, your weapon attacks drain your opponent's water meter, with the drain scaling on your weapon's scaled damage. The water drain is 20% of your weapon's scaled damage.

===Notes===
*Sear grants 1 stack of Cauterize per critical hit. This is exceptionally good on certain multihit criticals like [[Trident Spear]]'s, as they can max Sear's PEN bonus with one critical attack.
*Sear '''does not''' bypass the 50% PEN cap.
*Cauterize's PEN bonus is universal PEN, applying to all damage sources.

==Trivia==
*Prior to August 2nd, 2022, Sear would steal thirst on hit, similar to [[Gluttony]].

content: {{EventContent}} __TOC__ ==Description== Seasonal Medals are special tags that allow you to redeem Seasonal event items from [[Blacksmith]]s in exchange for [[Knowledge]]. The way you get each medal is different for each event. But what they all have in common is that after you unlock them, you can use them at any time, even after the event is over. Currently, there are 3 types of medals, [[Hallowtide (Event)|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide'''}}]] medals, the [[Festival of a Billion Souls|'''Festival of a Billion Souls''']] medal, and the [[Ordergeddon]] medal. The medals and obtainment method to get them are listed here: *Hallowtide: There are currently 4 [[Hallowtide]] medals. *#Hallowtide '22 Medal: You can purchase this medal for 200 [[Joy]] during the 2023, 2024, and 2025 Hallowtide events. *#Hallowtide '23 Medal: You can purchase this medal for 200 [[Joy]] during the 2024 and 2025 Hallowtide events and for 300 [[Joy]] during the 2023 Hallowtide event. *#Hallowtide '24 Medal: You can purchase this medal for 300 [[Joy]] during the 2024 and 2025 Hallowtide events. *#Hallowtide '25 Medal: You can purchase this medal for 300 [[Joy]] during the 2025 Hallowtide events. *Festival of a Billion Souls: Login during the [[Festival of a Billion Souls]] event. *Ordergeddon '25: Speak to the [[Shrine of Order]] on any build that has utilized its ability prior to the September 6th, 2025 update. ==Medals== ===Hallowtide=== All Hallowtide medals allow you to craft [[Hallowtide (Event)|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide'''}}]]-exclusive items released in their respective year. title: Seasons
content:
== Description ==
Seasons are a core part of ''Deepwoken's'' world system. Each season lasts two in-game months, making a full year eight months long. One in-game month corresponds to a single real-life day, with seasons transitioning at Midnight UTC (7-8 PM EST depending on daylight savings).

In the calendar, the first month of a season ends with '''"-span"''', while the second ends with '''"-fall."''' The only exception to this rule is Spring, with its last month ending in '''"-watch."'''

Seasonal changes primarily affect environmental visuals and the behavior of flora and fauna. Certain plants can stop growing during specific seasons as well, such as Wheat ceasing growth in Winter, and some fruits can no longer growing. 

Seasonal mob changes also occur. For example, [[Blizzard Knight]]s only appear in [[The Valley of Heroes]] during Winter. When it is not Winter, [[Aelita]] will spawn instead.

== Seasons ==

=== <u>Spring</u> ===
'''Months''': Hearthspan, Rootwatch
* Rain is more common.
* Fruits and wheat will start to spawn.
*Grass and Leaves are green.
<gallery position="center" widths="500">
File:Deepwoken Spring.png
</gallery>

=== <u>Summer</u> ===
'''Months''': Seedspan, Bloomfall
* Rain is less common.
* Abundant with fruits and wheat.
*Grass and Leaves are green.
*Sap is unlikely to appear.
<gallery position="center" widths="500">
File:Summer Example.png
</gallery>

=== <u>Autumn</u> ===
'''Months''': Scythespan, Ardfall
* Rain has an average chance of appearing.
*Grass and Leaves are orange or orange variations.
<gallery position="center" widths="500">
File:Autumn Example.png
</gallery>

=== <u>Winter</u> ===
'''Months''': Saltspan, Rimefall
* Snow will cover the grass and leaves.
* Fruits, vegetables, etc. will not spawn.
* [[Stone Knight|Blizzard Knights]] will spawn if you enter the [[Valley of Heroes]], triggered at the [[Aelita|Aelita Event]] area.
*[[Hero Blades]] and Ministry Cloaks may be fished up.
*The Trees in the [[Burning Stone Gardens]] emit a white glow instead of their usual orange.
<gallery position="center" widths="500">
File:Winter Example.png
</gallery>

== <u>Notes</u> ==
*If a full in-game year passes (8 real-life days), your character ages by one year unless wiped.
*The year counter also advances (e.g., 1273 → 1274).
*All races visually age over time, gaining wrinkles and other age-related traits.
*The [[Ferryman]] rewards an additional chest on defeat, with the loot pool of this chest varying depending on the current season. During Spring and Summer, Ferryman will give 1 [[Knowledge]] instead.
*The Aelita event can spawn in Valley of Heroes if it is not winter. For more information, see [[Aelita]].
*Aelita will still have a chance of spawning Snow Knights if it only recently turned to Spring in the server.
*The one and only moment in history where the time in Deepwoken will be the exact same as the time in real life, down to the tenth of a second, is projected to be 15:15:50.4 UTC (50.4 seconds after 3:15 PM UTC) on April 15, 2030. After this moment, Deepwoken's year will forever be higher than ours. <ref>[[File:Seasonprediction1.png|left|thumb]]
</ref><ref>[[File:Seasonsprediction2.png|left|thumb]]
</ref><ref>[[File:Finalprediction.png|left|thumb]]
</ref><ref>[[File:Deepgraphs.png|left|thumb|Where x is a year in Deepwoken, f(x) is the corresponding year in real life, and g(x) is the number of days after December 31, 2021 that day will occur.]]
</ref>
*During the Hallowtide Event, the map appears as Fall, regardless of the season.
*When the game released the time was around 1270 as said in TheRealPunchee's video 'Full Lore Timeline'
*As of October 7th, 2025, Deepwoken years now last 8 real life days. This took effect starting Spring/Hearthspan 1617 CE.

== Description ==
A consumable plant commonly found in [[The Depths]] or while [[Fishing]]. They can be found in groups of three near [[Castle Light]]. 
<gallery>
Seaweed1.png|Location nearby castle light easily spotted when heading out
Seaweed2.png|Location when headed to Castle light from the Hellmode Bell area
Seaweed3.png|Location closest to castle light behind the barrier
</gallery>

==Crafting==
===Used in===
* [[Dried Seaweed]] - 1 Seaweed Bundle + Campfire.
* [[Sushi]] - 1 Seaweed Bundle, 1 Fish Meat.
* [[Fish Stew]] - 1 Seaweed, 2 Fish Meat + Campfire.

== Trivia ==
*Seaweed Bundles, ever since the release of the game, could only be obtained through Fishing. However, the Proficient Baiting Talent, automatically unlocked through Fishing, reduced the chances of actually getting Seaweed Bundles, leading to heavy complaints. Eventually, Arch_Mage added them in a shadow patch alongside a description for the [[Authority Helm]] due to a Discord user constantly pinging him since November 2023 and requesting they be added.
* If used in [[Alchemy]], the primary affect applied is '''Mindbreaking'''.
*Dried Seaweed is heavier than a Seaweed Bundle despite being dried, meaning it contains less water and thus logically should have less mass.
*Seaweed is classed as a fish despite both obviously not being a fish and also being able to be harvested normally without the use of fishing.

title: Second Layer
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{Location|name=The Eternal Gale|caption=The harsh winds seem to seep beneath your skin.}} [[File:Layer2CombinedF1F2.png|850x850px|thumb|center|]] ==Main Locations== EthironShrineOut.png|link=Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|[[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|The Ethironal Shrine]] File:NewKyrsaWalkway.png|link=Second Layer/New Kyrsa|[[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|New Kyrsa]] ==Overview== Part of [[The Depths]], The Second Layer is a wind-based layer below the depths of [[First Layer|Scyphozia]], housing the Drowned God [[Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity|Ethiron]], along with his [[Scion of Ethiron|puppet]]. The Shrine is made by [[Kyrsgarde|Kyrsans]], with the City right below it, and thus directly on Ethiron's Resting Chamber. The City's library has a distinct code in order to access it, being 1 2 1 2 2 2 1 2 3 1 4 2 3 1. __TOC__ ==Accessing== The Second Layer uniquely is accessed in three different ways: # The safest (and best recommended) option is to enter through [[Castle Light]], via [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris]], who will let you enter with the [[Light Hook]] if you're power 10+. Unlike the second option, you can bring others (who may not be power 10+) with you. # The second (and most dangerous) option is to fall into the void at/above 50% Health (75% Health if in Player Combat), which has a complete lack of the Light Hook system, requiring you to either use the [[Ignition Deepdrill]] or defeat [[Chaser, Scholar of the Burning Blood|Chaser]] if you wish to escape. # The third (and second best) option is to use the Ignition Deepdrill in [[The Chariot's Spire]]. This method has no light hook system but skips the generator and spawns you right inside [[The Frontier Furnace]] (note that you can only use this method if you have chosen the [[Ignition Delver]] origin) # The fourth(and best for carrying) option is [[Reciprocal Bonecharm]], which doesn't grant [[Light Hook]], nor does it grant the [[Ignition Deepdrill|Deepdrill]], however it grants "Defeated Layer 2 Without Light Hook" echo triumph for everyone in the party. ==The Ethironal Shrine / The Eternal Gale== The Eternal Gale is a supernatural occurrence that is permanent to the geological structure of Second Layer, covering (and piling) onto the surfaces with unusual snow. It originates from [[Ethiron|Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity]], the Drowned God of The Eternal Gale. The Eternal Gale itself is a supernatural weather effect comprised not of snow but rather of parasitic organisms; though these are mitigatable by various sources.

Along with this, heavy winds are amidst throughout the area, blowing away any who are not aware of how to counteract it. == New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City== The Second Floor of the [[Second Layer]], located directly atop [[Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity|Ethiron]]'s bedchamber, New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City is incredibly unstable, experiencing '''space-time distortions''' and frequent collapses. New Kyrsa is stuck in a time loop; '''every 15 minutes, you are teleported back to the entrance.''' Numerous hostile [[Kyrsgarde]] inhabit the city, sworn to protect Ethiron at all costs. In order to ensure Ethiron's continued slumber, a 9-fold ritual is performed on his [[Scion of Ethiron|puppet]]. Unfortunately, the last one failed. {{clear}} ==Gallery== Layer 2 Concept Art.png|Concept Art [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:The Depths]] [[Category:Layer 2]]

title: Second Layer/New Kyrsa
content:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City}} {{PathfinderEx}} {{Location|name=New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City|caption=Far below the Gale, a city of gleaming lights was rekindled by the flames of religious fervour into a grand temple.}} [[File:New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City.png|thumb|900px|center]] New Kyrsa is a [[Locations|location]] added in ''Deepwoken's Verse Two'' update. It is located in the [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|Second Floor]] of the [[Second Layer|Eternal Gale]]. ==Overview== The Second Floor of the [[Second Layer]], located directly atop [[Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity|Ethiron]]'s bedchamber, New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City is incredibly unstable, experiencing '''space-time distortions''' and frequent collapses. New Kyrsa is stuck in a time loop; '''every 15 minutes, you are teleported back to the entrance.''' Numerous hostile [[Kyrsgarde]] inhabit the city, sworn to protect Ethiron at all costs. In order to ensure Ethiron's continued slumber, a 9-fold ritual is performed on his [[Scion of Ethiron|puppet]]. Unfortunately, the last one failed. New Kyrsa contains numerous large, pink glowing chests. They contain 8-10 '''{{c|medallions|[[Kyrsan Medallions]]}}''', which you can exchange for dyes, [[Enchant Stone|Enchantment Stones]], [[Enchantments#Equipments|Enchanted Equipment]], [[Knowledge]], or the [[Dawnwalker]] [[Oaths|Oath]]. Defeating enemies can grant chests from the Second Layer loot pool. In order to escape New Kyrsa, you must activate all 5 Obelisks and defeat the [[Scion of Ethiron]]. Along with that, you have 45 minutes to activate all Obelisks. On the first and second 15 minute mark, you will be sent to the start with all Obelisks still activated. When the time is up, you die instantly. After activating all the Obelisks, time will halt and you may freely explore the floor without dying. This place is currently one of the most challenging places in-game, since the many hostile Kyrsgarde the player can meet are extremely difficult to fight. The final enemy, Scion of Ethiron, is a very "challenging" boss fight, by far the biggest wall of clearing the Second Floor. ==Space-Time Distortions== Due to the instability of New Kyrsa, there is a hard-set time limit displayed through the '''Old Diver's Watch''' within your inventory. Using the watch displays your remaining time. *The timer starts at 16 minutes, yet visually appears at 15 minutes. Upon the timer reaching 0, the city experiences a distortion, looping you back to the start of the floor. This '''resets all progress''' done, along with stripping away any items or medallions found within the floor. However, the '''Obelisks''' will '''stay lit'''. *If this timer reaches 0 '''three times''', you die instantly. This gives you '''48 minutes''' in order to complete the floor before instantly wiping. *If all Obelisks are activated, this timer will '''stop''', allowing you as long as you need to investigate the floor. After the Scion is defeated, another collapse will happen in 3 minutes. Failing to reach the escape point will slowly cover your screen in white before you die instantly after 10 seconds (minimum, as shown near the end of the video; https://youtu.be/YwiBjmDwsh0). *[[Immortal Helm]]'s Immortality talent or gaining a [[Resonance]] will save you, but your screen will stay as '''pure white''', most likely leading to your death anyways (ex. blindly wandering and falling off a cliff, being attacked by enemies you can’t see, etc). == Points of Interest== ===Grand Library of New Kyrsa=== The Grand Library of New Kyrsa is a large library, containing a rotation puzzle and many hostile Kyrsgarde within it. If someone fails the rotation puzzle, everyone in the instance will be teleported back to the start of the library, no matter where they are. === [[The Sunken Railways]] === An underground railway system beneath the alien structures. At least 2 Medallion chests can spawn here, and contains one of the five obelisks needed to summon the Scion of Ethiron. If the obelisk is activated, [[Kyrsgarde Crawler]]s will appear and attack the player as they escape the train station. === [[Scion of Ethiron]] === The Scion of Ethiron is a boss encountered within the Second Floor of the Eternal Gale. It is an exceedingly large, imposing figure made of bones and other materials. The Scion is powerful in every aspect; it boasts a massive amount of HP, possesses large amounts of damage with most attacks, and requires a lengthy process to even land a hit on. More information on the fight is on the main page. === [[Misérables]] === Misérables is an NPC found in the outskirts of New Kyrsa. He is an enigmatic figure capable of granting you either a 30% damage boost against Scion of Ethiron for 5 '''Kyrsan Medallions''', or additional wishes with Yun'Shul, starting at 15 '''{{c|knowledge|Knowledge}}''', with an additional 5 knowledge per wish you have. ==Objectives== [[File:Kyrsan Obelisk Lantern.png|thumb|right|An activated Obelisk in the Kyrsan Shrine of Arrival]] #Activate the 5 Obelisks before time collapses three times. ##One is located in the Kyrsan Shrine of Arrival, which you automatically run into when entering the second floor. ##One is located inside of the Kyrsan Library on the set path to the city, in order to access the city and the obelisk, the sequence to get in is '''1 2 1 2 2 2 1 2 3 1 4 2 3 1''', with the numbers being each time you have to interact with a pillar. ###If you make a mistake in the sequence, you will be taken to the beginning of the labyrinth and the sequence of buttons will be reset. ##One is located inside the top floor of a building, accessed primarily through white particles on the top of a tower. ##One is located in the Sunken Railways, accessed through one of many broken sewer grates and navigating through it. ##One is located in the outside the city in an island locked behind a gate and guarded by eight Lost Divers. #Head towards the giant red orb that was powered by the Obelisks, the door it was guarding is now open. #Go down the path infront of the gate, careful not to fall into a void. #Defeat [[Scion of Ethiron]] by completing the Nine-Fold ritual and damaging the puppet. #Go back the way you came into a giant glowing light-hook to escape. *Do note this is the '''only''' way to escape aside from using the Light Hook. ==Optional Content==
===Secrets===
#Within a building on the left in the center path to Ethiron, you may '''Interact''' with a panel in order to start a 3 Enemy wave, doing this rewards you with '''5 Medallions'''. This may be done '''twice'''. #If instead of jumping into the Library, you follow the glass, you will be greeted by a tower. Occasionally at the top of this tower there may be a Medallion Chest, however, the top is guarded by four Kyrsgarde Lancers and a Kyrsgarde Brute at the bottom. #On the top of a tall tower on the left side of the city, there are glowing white particles. Going in will lead you to [[Kaide, the Drowned Light]], where you can then get lore.
===Standard Medallion Chests===
[[File:Chest in building.png|thumb|right|A Kyrsan Medallion chest]] Large radiant pink chests spawn around the City and the Wilds, interacting with them will give you a random amount of medallions between 5-9. '''6''' spawn per run. #There is one to the right of the first Obelisk. #There is one in the tower near the Library. #There are '''two''' per large building. #On top of a metal plate near the tower obelisk location. #On the edge of the city near the entrance. #On the edge of the city to the right near the Lost Divers. #At the obelisk of the Lost Divers. #At the edge of the city to the left near the Lost Divers. #Near [[Misérables]] on top of a rock. #On the top of a large tower near library. #Near [[Kaide, the Drowned Light]]. #Near the library incredibly high.
===Escaping Medallion Chests===
During the '''Escape Sequence''', 5-8 additional Medallion chests spawn around the city in differing locations to the first. #To the Left of the city near a stone wall with two Kyrsgardes. #'''Two''' may spawn per large building. #Within the tower buildings 2 may spawn.
==Potential Enemies== {{EnemyGallery |KyrsBrute.png|Kyrsgarde Brute |Kyrsgardecrawler.PNG|Kyrsgarde Crawler |KyrsgardeLancer.png|Kyrsgarde Lancer |Kyrslancer.png|Kyrsgarde Sniper |Lost diver.png|Lost Diver |Scionfinal.png|Scion of Ethiron }} ==Quests== *[[Carrion, Father of Evolution|Dr. Carrion]] - '''Grants Monster Mantras.''' *[[Naerotiv]] and [[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] - '''Obtaining the [[Kyrswynter]].''' *[[Mendacia]] - '''Gives 2 knowledge''' ==NPCs== *[[Naerotiv]] *[[Frosviernr Joraelnaero]] *[[Kaide, the Drowned Light]] *[[Cap'n Orlandeau]] *[[Misérables]] - '''Grants Yun'shul Wishes and a temporary Strength Buff''' *[[Kennith]] *[[Carrion, Father of Evolution|Dr. Carrion]] *[[F'leche]] *[[Okumay]] *[[C'lantaa]] *[[Plath]] *[[Amenre Skiggle Bop]] *[[Mendacia]] ==Loot Table== *[[Enchant Stone]] *[[Weaponry|Weapons]] *[[Mantra Modifiers|Deep Gems]] *[[Equipment]] *[[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]] * ===Medallion Chest=== *15-18 [[Kyrsan Medallions]] ===From Scion of Ethiron only=== *[[Kyrsieger]] *[[Railblade]] *[[Gran Sudaruska]] *[[Light's Final Toll]] *[[Curved Blade of Winds]] *[[Relics|All Lesser Relics]] + [[Relics|Spires]] *[[Whistling Periapt]] ==Tips & Notes== *The entire layout for this dungeon is entirely '''linear''', you are always forced to get the Starting and Library lantern in that order (unless you have a skip), and the rest can be done with a linear path of Start -> Library -> Tower -> Sewer -> Lost Divers (As of 8/12/2026, you are able to use the [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine#Puzzle Route (Skip)|Floor 1 puzzle entrance]] to skip the obelisks.) *Do '''NOT''' enter random buildings, as they may be a trap-room which will lead to a '''swift death'''. *Sliding on ROBLOX Smooth Terrain is risky, as it can take you down into the void unintentionally, and as such, should be done sparingly. *Bring as many people as you wish, as the Scion's health does '''not''' increase proportionally to players. *Avoid fighting multiple Kyrsgarde unless you have [[Talents#Human Architecture|Brick Wall]]. Engaging a group of them without knowing how to fight them can leave you trapped in an endless stun lock, likely leading to a wipe. *The Kyrsgarde Artillery on the outskirts of the city can be avoided by standing under cover. The spears do not go through objects. *[[Talents#Undying Ember|Undying Flame]], [[Gliders]], [[Teleportation]], and [[Mute]] all do not work in the Second Layer. *[[Dimensional Travel]] will fling you the way you're facing if attempted to be used. *You do not have to escape Second Floor via defeating the Scion of Ethiron in order to keep your progress with Carrion's quest. Talking to Carrion will still make him appear in Castle Light even if you Lighthook up or die within Lighthook's time frame. (Confirmed) *Before you do anything else, focus on activating the five Obelisks. *If you want to explore, bring a supply of food and water because there is no way to get food in this location. Players with bloodrend can eat raw fish. *'''Fight or flight?''' That is the question you should ask yourself when facing a Kyrsgarde—or an entire group of them. Do not overestimate your abilities. When you know you cannot win, run. Kyrsgardes have a large aggro range, so creating distance is your best option when you need to heal, escape, or lose their attention. *Memorize the Kyrsgarde spawn points so you can avoid running into them in the first place. Kyrsgardes eventually respawn after being killed, and they will reappear in the same spawn points. ==Gallery== File:New kyrsa streets.png|A street in New Kyrsa. File:New kyrsa fishing spot.png|A fishing spot in the outskirts of New Kyrsa, next to [[Kaide, the Drowned Light]]. File:New Kyrsa Library Entrance.png|New Kyrsa Library Entrance File:New Kyrsa Library Hallway.png|New Kyrsa Library Hallway File:New Kyrsa Library Switch.png|New Kyrsa Library Switch File:New Kyrsa Library Floating Books.png|New Kyrsa Library Floating Books File:New Kyrsa Map.png|New Kyrsa Library Map File:New Kyrsa Environmental Hazard.png|New Kyrsa Environmental Hazard File:New Kyrsa Outskirts Entrance.png|New Kyrsa Outskirts Entrance File:New Kyrsa Outskirts.png|New Kyrsa Outskirts File:New Kyrsa Library Obelisk.png|New Kyrsa Library Obelisk File:New Kyrsa Diver Obelisk.png|New Kyrsa Diver Obelisk File:ClosedMedallionChest.png|Closed Medallion Chest File:OpenMedallionChest.png|Open Medallion Chest ==Lore==
New Kyrsa is a beautiful and huge place with many buildings and "alien-like" technology, such as trains or artillery. The architecture is futuristic, with gold and white designs and streamlined structures. You can meet a lot of Kyrsgarde here and only two, Naerotiv and his hidden brother, are not hostile. Many buildings are extremely tall, and streets are patrolled by large, bulky Kyrsgarde. There is an underground sewage system, along with an underground subway in New Kyrsa. Despite the beautiful outward appearance and the seemingly volatile enemies, New Kyrsa is stuck in a time loop. People stuck in the city are trapped in the time loop forever, unable to escape, or even die. The Second Floor is the deepest point of the Eternal Gale. In here, you can find New Kyrsa, the Sleeping City, an ancient city built by the [[Kyrsgarde]] race to contain the [[Scion of Ethiron]]. The Kyrsgarde race is different from human race. The Kyrsgarde are intelligent creatures, able to talk and consciously think, same as the human race. They built New Kyrsa as a "shrine" and "bed chamber" to the Scion of Ethiron. A long time ago, the Kyrsgarde experimented with the Avatar (Scion of Ethiron), but they didn't know where it would lead. It made [[Ethiron, The Maelstrom's Eye|Ethiron]] draw even closer, and then a wave of "mist" engulfed the city. The "Mist" is actually hypnotic, created by Ethiron to protect his Avatar. When Ethiron drew even closer to New Kyrsa, he created this mist to get control over every living creature within its scope, and now any creature who got affected by the mist obey Ethiron and lose their mind. The Kyrsgarde inside New Kyrsa and some of the [[Diver|Black Divers]] here are affected by it. [[Naerotiv]] and the Kyrsgarde in [[Firfire]] were too far from the mist, so they didn't get affected by the mist's presence. Naerotiv tells you about New Kyrsa, how they tried to complete "the Ninth Blessing", and if we won't stop the Scion of Ethiron from awakening, Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity will wake up and the world will die. The Scion of Ethiron, or Avatar acts as a shrine. If one of the Avatars wake up, Ethiron will wake up too. Naerotiv tells us that we should complete this ritual and seal the Avatar. New Kyrsa has an artifact with unstable [[The Song|Song]] in it, the big purple sphere. When all 5 obelisks are activated, the artifact releases unstable Song and primary collapses stop. The reason why collapses even exist is that Ethiron causes them by his presence being near to New Kyrsa. When we defeat one of his Avatars, he releases compressed unstable gale (pure Song) from his body. The Second Layer becomes too charged with the Song, and it destabilizes. Another Space-time collapse happens. After this collapse, the whole Second Layer resets.
==Trivia== ===In-game=== *The music for this area is [[Kyrie]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]. *The combat music for this area is [[INSOMNIA]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]. **As stated in its [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YMJBMjergiI Youtube video], the music present in game is altered due to ROBLOX's guidelines regarding screaming and distorted audio. *Kennith will appear regardless of whether or not you have completed or even started the Duke of Sin questline. *New Kyrsa appears to contain many references to the 2019 indie game [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Risk_of_Rain_2_Wiki ''Risk Of Rain 2'']. **Foremost, upon entering Floor 2, you are greeted In a dimly-lit stone-like room lined with marble shrines that encompass a grand stairway that leads upwards. This introduction has stark similarities to the entrance to the final stage of the game in Risk Of Rain 2, called [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Commencement Commencement] on [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Petrichor_V Petrichor V]'s moon. **In addition, upon defeating [[Scion of Ethiron]], both games feature a two-minute timer as the entirety of Floor Two begins to collapse, similar to how [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Petrichor_V Petrichor V]'s moon collapses once you defeat the final boss of the game, [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Mithrix Mithrix, King of Nothing]. **Finally, your escape is littered with instakill-capable imploding explosions that function and sound the exact same as the ones seen in [https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Commencement Commencement]'s escape sequence in addition to both containing swaths of enemies attempting to stop you, swiftly requiring you to reach a set point ([https://riskofrain2.fandom.com/wiki/Commencement#Releasing_the_Rescue_Ship Rescue ship] for Risk of Rain 2, and the Light hook at the entrance of the city for Deepwoken) in order to survive the escape sequence. ===Lore=== *New Kyrsa exists in infinite amount of realities at the same time, and every human stuck here is doomed to stay here forever and suffer from Space-time collapse. *Kyrsgarde in New Kyrsa are affected by some sort of hypnosis. Their minds are under hypnosis from Ethiron, the Eye of Calamity, and they're here to protect Scion of Ethiron and let him grow. Naerotiv and Kyrsgarde in Firfire aren't affected by this hypnosis due to them being a safe distance from the mist. We can discover from Naerotiv that we must "seal" (kill) [[Scion of Ethiron]] or the world will be under a large threat. **Ironically, this won't happen, because New Kyrsa is stuck in a time cycle, where Scion of Ethiron can't grow enough to create this threat. **The 45 minute time limit is in place because New Kyrsa suffers under time dilation. It's also called Space-time collapse. **It seems like you can find some people who have lost their minds and gone insane from infinite amount of time resets. *Some of Black Divers in New Kyrsa are affected by this "Ethiron's hypnosis", actually named "Mist Presence". Some of them are located near one of five Obelisks. They all wield Markor's Inheritor. *Contrary to popular belief, New Kyrsa didn't sink into the Depths. It was actually built within the Depths by Kyrsgarde. New Kyrsa does not match human standards at all, not to mention the fact that Kaide and Naerotiv talks about it. Firfire also has the same technology and the fact entering Firfire makes you quote "seem familiar but very alien". New Kyrsa was made as shrine and bedchamber to Scion of Ethiron. *New Kyrsa may be a reference to Amaurot from the game Final Fantasy XIV, with both having similar concept and design and Ethrion can be anagram of Therion, the final boss of Amaurot. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Locations in the Second Floor of the Second Layer]] [[Category:Dungeons]]

title: Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine
content:
{{DISPLAYTITLE:The Ethironal Shrine}}
{{Location|name=Ethironal Shrine Outskirts|caption=You awake to a land covered in frost, the wind piercing your ears like the cries of lost souls.}}[[File:Layer2comb.png|850x850px|thumb|center]]

==Overview==
The '''[[Second Layer]]''' of [[The Depths]] starts with the Ethironal Shrine, a bridge between Scyphozia and the resting chamber of Ethiron. It consists of the [[Ethironal Shrine Outskirts|Shrine]], the [[The Maw of Ethiron|Maw]], and the [[Sanctuary Gatehouse|Sanctuary]]. All leading into the [[Cathedral of Ethiron|Cathedral]]. Just be wary of the '''parasites''' coating the floor like strange snow.

Below the first floor lies the [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|Sleeping City]], more detail can be found on its respective page.

==Access==
Unlike other dungeons, the Second Layer has multiple different methods to access it, while more in-depth on the [[Second Layer]] page, it can be accessed via either jumping into a void while above 50% Health (75% in Player Combat), by taking the Ignition Union’s deepdriller from the [[The Chariot's Spire|Chariot’s Spire]], dying in depths to a player with the contractor Oath while having an Oath or by using a [[Light Hook|Light-hook]], provided by talking to [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights]] while above Power 15.

Going into the dungeon via Klaris will provide a safe-guard in the form of a [[Light Hook|Light-hook]], which will safely eject you back into Layer 1 if you die within the duration of the lighthook. Entering via Klaris or the deepdriller will also allow you to take up to 4 other players with you into the dungeon.

==Points of Interest==
*[[Pilgrim's Respite]]
*[[The Frontier Furnace]]
*[[Firfire]]
*[[Firfire Caverns]]
*[[Cathedral of Ethiron]]

==Objectives==
For a visual guide, consider watching ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z0jUO6LiA_8 this video]''.

While navigating the First Floor, there is a clear-set quest-line, which will prove to make subsequent runs easier after the first time done.

===<u>Main Questline</u>===
#Open the starting door via a glowing orb on the cliffs of the outskirts (alternatively use the resonance door).
#Turn on the Generator at the top of the tower near Pilgrim's Respite, this requires you to kill a weakened [[Bone Keeper]]. If you're not able to or scared to fight the [[Bone Keeper]], there is a way to skip him by dropping down at the end of the bridge, traversing trough the snow until you reach [[The Frontier Furnace]] to remove Parasites and regenerate. The barrier will despawn after some minutes, though the Bone Keeper won't. You will still be able to activate the generator.
##'''(OPTIONAL)''' Gain the Union Hook Talent by traversing the snow in Layer Two until you reach the [[The Frontier Furnace|Frontier Furnace]] and talk to [[Alpha]]. You may also talk to [[Llevyn]] to activate the Deepdrill.
#Retrieve the Blue Spear within the depths of [[Firfire Caverns]] (OPTIONAL AFTER THE FIRST RUN), and go to [[Firfire]]
#Talk to Leader Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus, where he will then open the door to the [[Nest Corridor]]. If you have a form of wall-clipping, you may skip talking to him.
##'''(OPTIONAL)''' If you have talked to Llevyn, you may take the Deepdrill in order to abandon a run early within the Nest Corridor.
#Traverse through [[The Maw of Ethiron]] and reach [[Cathedral of Ethiron|The Cathedral]] in order to defeat [[Chaser, Scholar of the Burning Blood|a traitorous Black Diver]].
#From there you may either Leave or [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|Delve Deeper]].
##Note that delving deeper will '''lower your hook time''' to 10 minutes if you have more than 10 minutes left on your hook.

=== <u>'''Puzzle Route (Skip)'''</u> ===
To do this repeat the same steps as the Main method up to 4
#Instead of obtaining the blue spear in the firfire caverns keep going and then make a U turn to the left, keep walking forward and eventually after seeing a fence on the wall there will be a floor collapse, you will then go the opposite way you were going until you see openings to the left which you will go to the deepest one, by then you should see pits of parasites hidden by fog, make a right turn and then keep going until you see rocks which allow you to climb over a layer of fog, you will then find the entrance to the puzzle room
#to complete the puzzle you must enter the right symbols in the 4 slots before the spikes reach you '''(The spikes wipe you instantly)''' the code is fairly simple, from the entrance it goes 2 1 3 4, if you are confused on which side you came from if you follow from the gray door the order will be 4 3 1 2.
#Run from the 2 bounders until you reach a portal
#enter the portal '''(Requires defeating chaser once on your character before)'''
#Additionally, entering Floor 2 this way will activate all obelisk required to fight Ethiron, and skips the Misérables requirement to activate the purge shrine in Layer 2 Floor 2, and will remove your light hook.

File:Layer2 test2.png|''Map of the Ethironal Shrine.''

==Hazards==
===<u>Fog</u>===
Upon exiting the outskirts and entering the shrine, the first thing noticed will be the thick fog around the player. While this can be negated [[Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus|later]], it proves '''no threat''' aside from inhibiting the players vision within the shrine. There is no fog after exiting the Firfire cavern and approaching the Cathedral. 
*The fog can be '''heavily reduced''' by obtaining the '''Ethiron's Gaze''' Talent from the main questline.

===<u>Parasites</u>===
[[File:Pilgrims Lantern.png|thumb|300px|''An Ignition Lantern.'']]
The Parasites function as a '''passive time limit''' for the player, accumulating over-time in snow covered areas until they all burst and leave the player dead. It takes ~'''5 minutes''' for a lethal amount of parasites to accumulate on the player, instantly killing them. Parasites do not accumulate within areas with no snow. 

Though, these are reducible via the following means.
*[[Flame Wisp]]: +1 minute (needs further testing.)
*[[Winter Corps Parka]]: +1.5 minutes.
*[[Survivalist]] Boon: +1.5 minutes.
*[[Wormwarder Lantern]]: Negates parasites, movement speed penalty.
*[[Grand Fisher Helm]]: Negates parasites.
*[[Arc Suit]]: Negates parasites.
Otherwise, in order to remove your parasites, you must interact with an [[Ignition Lanterns|Ignition Lantern]], which removes all parasites instantly.

However, it is important to be warned of '''parasite pools''', which '''heavily accelerate''' parasite gain by '''5x'''.

[[Insanity]] also influences parasite gain, so if you go into a parasite pool after having used {{t|Heretic's Sutra}}, you better get out quickly.

===<u>Wind</u>===
Upon exiting the shrine, the player is greeted by a strong gust of wind attempting to push them off, and in order to not get knocked off, the player must move towards the wind. If the player does not fight against the wind, they will instead be thrown off with an un-cancellable ragdoll and a great knockback, either knocking them into the snow filled floor of the shrine, or directly into a void.  '''It's important to note: you do not have to be facing the wind to combat it, but you can if you wanna play it safe.'''
*It may be negated via wearing the [[Delver Boots]] or having the {{t|Brick Wall}} talent.

==Leaving the Second Layer==
There are three different methods to escape the second layer, however all of which require pre-requisites.

===Lighthook===
*This may only be used if you have accessed Layer 2 via [[Klaris Llfiend, Mother of Lights|Klaris]] and her light hook.
*You may '''Die''' or '''use the Lighthook''' in order to escape.
*However, you will lose '''all loot you collected in that run''' if you use this method to escape.

===The Deepdrill===
#Do Floor 1 as normal.
#After killing the Bonekeeper and activating the Generator, instead head to the [[The Frontier Furnace|Frontier Furnace]].
#Talk to [[Llevyn]] in order to activate the Deepdrill.
#Escape Firfire Cavern and head into the [[Nest Corridor]], but instead of going to the exit, go straight into the Deepdrill.
#You will have escaped into [[The Chariot's Spire]] and '''lost all loot''' if you do this method.

===Finishing the Floor===
*Do the entire floor and defeat [[Chaser]].
*Instead of going down into [[New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City]], take the giant lighthook out.
*You '''keep''' all the loot gained.

==Recommended Talents & Equipment==
Do note that this list is assuming that it is your '''first few''' delves within the Eternal Gale, as you get more experienced you may find yourself needing these Talents less.
*'''Carnivore''' (5STR/5WLP): This Talent is '''recommended''' for longer expeditions within the Gale, as it replenishes Thirst and Hunger on kill.
*'''Surestep''' ([[Delver Boots]]) / '''Brickwall''' (100FTD/100WLP): Grants resistance to the wind, making you immune to the ragdoll of the winds.
*'''Wormwarder''' ([[Wormwarder Lantern]]) / '''Coldseep Reactor''' ([[Grand Fisher Helm]]): Grants complete immunity to the parasites of the Eternal Gale.
It is important to note that '''very few''' good items drop from standard enemy lootpools, and as such it is better to farm the Boss rather than the monsters.

These optional quests are not essential to the main objective of clearing the second layer.

#Kill Three Ministry Bloodrenders, then come back with three Heartstars.
#After obtaining Bloodrend, you may Lighthook out to keep it.

===[[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]] Questline===
*You are required to have '''20 [[Flamecharm]]''', '''20 [[Thundercall]]''', and '''20 [[Fortitude]]''' in order to get Arcwarder.
#Do Floor 1 and Activate the Generator.

==Description==
Sekh is [[Vesperian]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is a [[Hive Scout]].

His dialogue gives insight to the region of [[The Aratel Sea]] and its conflicts, mainly involving [[The Hive]], [[The Central Authority]], [[Etrea]] and [[The Children of Navae]], as well as the inhabitants of Meteor Isle, especially [[Eres]], whom he speaks fondly of. 

==Location==
Sekh is located at [[Meteor Isle]], standing in front of a [[Inn]].
<gallery position="center" widiths="300">
NPC Map Sekh.png
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|Base Dialogue=
{{#tag:tabber|First Encounter=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Oh, greetings! Fancy seeing an outsider other than myself here. I'm Sekh, a scout of the Greathive Aratel. I'm on a mission in the area.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What is this place?
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A scouting mission?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}You mean the settlement? This is Meteor Isle, friend. Though, I guess it's technically not an isle in the conventional sense... But it's definitely a haven of relative safety in Aratel, from what I've seen so far.
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*The Vesperian gives you a quick nod.*'' Yep. You might've seen other hivekin in uniforms similar to mine all over the place. Greathive Aratel feeds—err, ''relies'' on the surrounding areas for its continued growth and survival, so it makes sense to send scouts to get a lay of the land here. We're also the first line of defence against would-be interlopers, like those nosy Etrean Navy sailors.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what about the 'meteor' part?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you mean by 'relative safety'?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The Etrean Navy? Here?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What about the people here? Are they interlopers?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Don't scouts normally travel in small groups?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*He makes a sweeping gesture.*'' Look around us, friend - we're surrounded by starfall. The shimmer in the air is hard to miss. It's that, and the continuously falling meteros. They call the desert nearby 'the Starswept Valley' for the same reason. Folks say it's like this because there's a crumbling city above, in the skies. I wouldn't know, though - I'm a scout, not a scolar.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Aratel as a whole is a very dangerous place, as you might be aware. The constant conflict, the wildlife, the meteors... But this place is a small oasis of greenery and peace, at least compared to the vast desert out there. Plus, the wanderkind here - the Gremor settlers, that is - are a very hospitable people. A little stange, but ultimately kind.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}I know, right? It's baffling! How does a dinky little splinter-kingdom manage to extend their reach to here? They wouldn't be all that bad if they didn't always get in our way, either. It seems they're not very fond of what the Hive is doing to—err, in Aratel.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*He chuckles, and looks around slowly.*'' No, not really. They don't bother us, and we don't bother them. Our scouts tend to stop by here, to resupply and rest. The locals treat hivekin with cautious hospitality. Of course, the Hive is a tad troubled by the locals rescuing Etrean prisoners from Fort Merit, but... let's just say we don't have a proverbial horse in this race.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}I'm on a special assignment. I'm a... liaison, so to say. I also keep an eye on the comings and goings of the place. ''*You can't tell for sure, but you think he winks.*''
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What do you mean by 'relative safety'?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do the settlers here get on with the others in Aratel?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If Meteor Isle is so safe, then why don't more Children of Navae seek refuge here?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What about the people here? Are they interlopers?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And how do '''you''' feel about the people here?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what have you seen so far?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*He thumbs the point of his mask contemplatively.*'' The folks here mostly keep to themselves. But Meteor Isle is a thorn in the Central Authority's side. The locals initially settled here because they got tired of running from the Authority and decided to make a stand. They've been rescuing their own kind - also Etreans - from the nearby Fort Merit prison for a while now.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Actually, every now and then, nomadic wanderkind bands do visit Meteor Isle to resupply. But from what I've seen, the nomads tend to be rather cold to the settlers - most of the time anyway. Something about 'abandoning the Navaean way'. Hardly any of them stay behind. ''*He lowers his head pensively.*'' How unfortunate, not to get along with your own kin like that...
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Personally? I admire their selflessness and open-minded ness. Oh, and the Etreans themselves quite alright, when you get to know them, like the one praying over there. Can't say the same about their government, though. ''*He sighs, bitterly.*'' If only things were different...
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}It's a lovely place. The locals are kind and peace-loving. Gremor nomads translating their culture into a settled lifestyle is fascinating. But... *He shrugs.* It's a shame that Meteor Isle is in Aratel, of all places.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm guessing the Authority aren't too fond of that?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've spoken to some of the Etreans?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do the settlers here get on with the others in Aratel?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}As if. The Authority respond in kind by sending raiding parties to Meteor Isle. Though, they hardly achieve much. But they can't exactly launch a full-scale takeover either - the place is simply too close to the Greathive, it'd be seen as an act of aggression. As for the other powers in Aratel, they hardly know this place exists. To them, it's not even a blip on the map.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Well, in official records, I call it 'interrogation'. But for the most part, yes - you'd be surprised how far a little bit of small-talk can get you. ''*He flicks his wrists and gestures at you with both hands, making a click sound, his fingers imitating pistols.*'' Besides... the praying one over there makes my idle hours here all the more eventful.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} If Meteor Isle is so safe, then why don't more Children of Navae seek refuge here?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}} How do the settlers here get on with the others in Aratel?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Ah, fellow outsider! Nice seeing you here again. I'm still on my scouting mission business, as you can see. What d'ya need?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What is this place?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A scouting mission?
{{!}}-

Greathive Aratel feeds—err, ''relies'' on the surrounding areas for its continued growth and survival, so it makes sense to send scouts to get a lay of the land here. We're also the first line of defence against would-be interlopers, like those nosy Etrean Navy sailors.

{{!}}-

{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}''*He chuckles, and looks around slowly.*'' No, not really. They don't bother us, and we don't bother them. Our scouts tend to stop by here, to resupply and rest. The locals treat hivekin with cautious hospitality. Of course, the Hive is a tad troubled by the locals rescuing Etrean prisoners from Fort Merit, but... let's just say we don't have a proverbial horse in this race.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="8" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And how do '''you''' feel about the people here?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="8" {{!}}Personally? I admire their selflessness and open-minded ness. Oh, and the Etreans themselves quite alright, when you get to know them, like the one praying over there. Can't say the same about their government, though. ''*He sighs, bitterly.*'' If only things were different...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've spoken to some of the Etreans?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How do the settlers here get on with the others in Aratel?
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You've spoken to Eres?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*You can't tell for sure, but it appears he gives you a big smile.*'' I have! 'Know thy enemy', as they say. Don't ask who's 'they', though - again, I'm a scout, not a scholar. ''*He assumes a more laid-back stance.*'' Besides, he's good company. I enjoy our little talks. Shame someone like him ended up in a mess like this...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I spoke to him, too. He's mentioned you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}''*Sekh immediately straightens his posture attentively, like a soldier before an officer.*'' Really? And what did he say of me?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}He said you make for good conversation, and called you 'witty'.
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Nothing much. He just mentioned you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} 
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*You've never seen a Vesperian blushing, but you're dead certain this one is.*'' Er... Why! He's very kind! ''*There is a cheerful chirring in his voice.*'' I'm glad he enjoys the company! Do me a favour, friend, and... let him know I feel the same way! About talking to him, I mean. ''*He looks away, lingering, then quickly reassumes his relaxed stance.*''
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*The scout seems a little dejected at your response.*'' Oh. Well. Of course. Our homelands are at war, after all...
