__TOC__
==Description==
Self is located in the [[Fragments of Self]] past the stone arches, a reflection of the player's character awaits it's final confrontation. Talking to it will end the existence of said character.

Self takes on appearance of player's character, with the [[outfit]], all the [[equipment]] and [[aspect]] features.

title: Semblance
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |image1= Semblance.png|Soulthorn Nocturne Semblance.png|Nocturne Fractine Semblance.png|Fractine |caption1=For what is a man, what has he got? If not himself, then he has naught. |health=500 |weapon=*[[Fractine]] *[[Soulthorn]] *[[Nocturne]] *[[Shattered Katana]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Time-Slowing Orb *Wind Forge *Twister Kicks *Wind Blade}} == Description == The Semblance is a mysterious humanoid enemy NPC that can be found at [[Voidsea]] outposts sometimes even replacing the [[Mudskipper Broodlord]] in their respective outpost. Their aspect and gender is unknown or rather none. Their faces are always distorted, no matter how much sanity or Willpower you have. They have a chance to drop their respective weapons, those weapons being the [[Soulthorn]], [[Nocturne]], or [[Fractine]]. Wearing a [[Bloodfeather Cowl]], [[Dark Owl Cloak]], and a Gray [[Traveler Cloak]]. They also use the Specter Path of the [[Galebreathe]] Attunement {{clear}} == Moveset == The Semblance uses the [[Galebreathe]] attunement with Specter Path alongside the [[Fractine]], [[Soulthorn]], or [[Nocturne]]. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Semblace uses the critical attack of their equipped weapon. Refer to the [[Fractine]], [[Soulthorn]], and [[Nocturne]] pages for more info. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Feint'''
(☆☆☆) |Attacks, but stops during the windup in an attempt to catch the opponent off-guard. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |- |
'''Time-Slowing Orb'''
(★☆☆) |The Semblance creates a bubble. After it's been made, any player or non-allied npc that steps inside is severely slowed. {{AttackTags |debuff, misc, unharmful }} |- |
'''Wind Blade'''
(★☆☆) |The Semblance shoots out an arc of gale. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Wind Forge'''
(★☆☆) |The Semblance conjures up a line of 4 wind projectiles before sending them towards the target. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Twister Kicks'''
(★☆☆) |The Semblance dashes forwards kicking with a rush of winds dealing damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Passives === * Third Eye - The Semblance cannot be assassinated. == Finisher == The Semblance executes it's opponents after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Fractine]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. [[[Soulthorn]] & [[Nocturne]]] Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with their blade. |} ==Gallery== SemblanceHeadless.png|Semblance without face cover. File:Close up semblance.png|Semblance Closeup File:SemblanceYapping.png|Semblance Yapping ==Trivia== *If you zoom in the camera enough to their face, it reveals they're actually headless. *'''Semblance''' means the outward appearance or apparent form of something, especially when the reality is different. Signifying they could not be real, simply an enemy whose form our mortal eyes cannot comprehend or from a different reality. *Despite wielding incredibly strong weapons, they have a relatively low health pool, with little to no resistances making this the easiest way to obtain a Unique and '''Legendary Weapon'''. *They may be related to [[The Knives of Eylis]] or the [[Voidmother]] due to being able to use the '''Time-Slowing Orb''', or due to their name they may be [[The Knives of Eylis]] from another reality, however this maybe unlikely due to their weaponry. Interestingly, one of their lines is "She...", which may be referring to [[Eylis, the Punished Dreamer]], or the [[Voidmother]]. *The '''Time-Slowing Orb''' attack that the Semblance NPCS use can be used to obtain the [[Voidwalker]] Origin. **Whether this is just an oversight due to it being the same attack as the one the [[Subtle Knife of Eylis]] uses, or if there's some greater lore reason behind this, we may never know. However, it only goes to strengthen the idea of Semblance having some connection to [[Eylis, the Punished Dreamer|Eylis]] and the [[The Knives of Eylis|Knives]] faction, or perhaps the Void. *Hilariously, because Semblance aren't in [[The Knives of Eylis]] faction, they get slowed by their own '''Time-Slowing Orbs'''. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]]

title: Sentinel Augustus
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{InProgress}} {{NPCInfobox |title1=Sentinel Augustus |name=Augustus Baaset |alias=Sentinel Augustus |location=[[Fort Merit]] |aspect=Adret |pronouns=He/him |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]] |family=*[[Augustus Baaset's family]] **Unnamed parents (deceased)
**Two unnamed siblings (deceased)
**[[Augustus Baaset's sister]] (younger sister)
**[[Augustus Baaset's brother]] (younger brother) |image1=Sentinel Augustus.png}} ==Description== Sentinel Augustus is an [[Adret]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He is part of the Shock Trooper division for [[The Central Authority]]. He received his current position after [[Sentinel Faris Kesset]] was killed by [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]]. The at the time Operator Augustus was close to the late Sentinel, and was eventually assigned her position by [[Warden Jericho]]. He swore to avenge her, and eventually did so when he captured General Destellus. He wields the [[Duskguard Axe]]. As signified by his [[Resonance]] he is moderately strong. ==Location== Sentinel Augustus is located on a balcony along-side [[Chud Steel]] at the large castle in [[Fort Merit]]. Sentinel Augustus Map.png {{clear}} ==Dialogue== |-|Authority Ensign= {{#tag:tabber|No Division= {{#tag:tabber|Private / Corporal= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The hulking armoured man looks down at you. His thoughts - if, indeed, he experiences any - are inscrutable, but his demeanor seems polite.*'' Hey. Aren't you a [Rank]? You've still got a bit to go before you get to choose your division. If you're lost, you should go look for Drill Sergeant Kernel. He's a good man, he'll get you sorted. ''*He gives you a way too hefty pat on the shoulder - hope that won't leave a mark.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Lance Corporal= {{#tag:tabber|Meets requirements= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}''*You offer a salute to the hulking armoured man before you - the Sentinel of the Shock Corps, Augustus Baaset.*'' At ease. You must be Lance Corporal [Last Name], right? Good, good. I've recently been looking over the of your mission performance, soldier. I have to say, I'm impressed. You've done well, and meet our division criteria. Would you like to join the Shock Corps, under my wing? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Yes, Sentinel {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'd like some time to think about it, Sentinel. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute the Sentinel. He returns a solemn, sturdy salute.*'' If that is your wish, Lance Corporal [Last Name], then... By the powers vested in me, in the name of our {{g|The Sovereign Drallis Ehr|Sovereign}} of Eras, {{g|The Sovereign Drallis Ehr|Drallis Ehr}}, I name you a member of the {{g|The Central Authority|Central Authority}} Shock Corps. You will now serve under my supervision. May you hold fast as the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority's}} strong arm, may you unyielding serve as its immortal sword and shield, and may you shatter hard with might the walls which bear our way. Report back to me when you've got a moment, soldier. {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The Sentinel retains a stone-like composure.*'' Of course. There is no need to rush such things, Lance Corporal. But remember - it is a great honour to serve in the Shock Corps. If you change your mind, let me know again. I'd be more than happy to take you under my wing, soldier. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player joins Shock Corps Division {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Does not meet requirements= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The hulking armoured man looks down at you. His thoughts - if, indeed, he experiences any - are inscrutable, but his demeanor seems polite.*'' Hey. Aren't you a Lance Corporal? You've still got a bit to go before you get to choose your division. If you're lost, you should go look for Drill Sergeant Kernel. He's a good man, he'll get you sorted. ''*He gives you a way too hefty pat on the shoulder - hope that won't leave a mark.*'' {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} }}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Command Division= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*Noticing your presence, Sentinel Augustus immediately jumps to attention, as you both exchange stiff salutes. There's a look of excitement on his face.*'' At ease! Do you bring news from Warden Jericho, [Rank]? Are we finally mustering to march on the enemy?.. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Uh... No, Sentinel, I'm sorry to say. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}No?.. Is that so?.. Oh... ''*His expression looks as if you just told him Kyrsmas isn't real. He turns to his aide-de-camp, who looks just as dejected as the Sentinel.*'' Myself and Interceptor Steel though... ''*He shakes his head.*'' Ah, nevermind that. Hey, listen, solider, if you ''do'' hear news of action, I ask that you tell the Shock Corps ''first'', alright? We'll '''hit 'em where it hurts'''! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Inquisition Division= {{#tag:tabber|Inquisitor / Inquisition 1st Class= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute the Sentinel. He looks down at you with mild confusion on his face, saluting back.*'' At ease. Huh, I don't think we've got any business with the Inquisition scheduled for today, [Rank]?.. Oh, I get it. You're here to fawn over young Interceptor Steel there like all the others, huh. Well, don't loiter around too long. I don't think the High Inquisitor appreciates that kind of idling, and we at the Shock Corps have business to get to today. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}-{{!}}Handler= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*You salute Sentinel Augustus. He looks down at you, saluting back, the gears in his head visibly turning.*'' At ease, Handler. Did High Inquisitor Merey send you? No? Well... Since you're here, could you pass her an important message? ''*He gives you a wide grin.*'' I want to know when the next interrogation of General Destellus will take place. I'd like to participate in it, if she wouldn't mind. Could you let her know? Thanks in advance, soldier. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], unlocks dialogue with [[High Inquisitor Merey]] {{!}}} }} {{!}}-{{!}}Shock Corps Division= {{#tag:tabber|Frontliner / Interceptor= {{#tag:tabber|First Encounter= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*The Sentinel sizes you up with a blank expression on his face.*'' Three cheers once more, soldier, and welcome to the Shock Corps. I should introduce myself properly -I'm Sentinel Augustus Baaset, your division commander. The heartthrob with the blue armour there is Interceptor Chud Steel, my current aide-de-camp.. Hm. You're a ''little skinny'', but we'll put some muscle on you in no time. Remind me your name, soldier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I'm [Rank] [Full Name], sir. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*You salute the Sentinel, and he returns the favor.*'' Very good. '''Always''' salute the rank. Good to know the Drill Sergeant still knows how to teach you fresh-faced recruits. Do you have any questions for me? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Shock Corps? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...Sorry, did you say *Chud Steel* earlier? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all, thank you Sentinel. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Augustus nods.''* I assume Drill Sergeant Kernel must have given you the general gist of each of the military branches. But basically, we're the elite heavy infantry. The division that goes right into the action, and gets things '''done'''. Only the toughest and strongest make it in the Shock Corps, and we train our members to be juggernauts in the field. We're kinda like a sledgehammer - when Warden Jericho feels a wall is beginning to crumble, he sends us in to bring it all the way down. Any other questions? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Saying it out loud yourself, recognition tugs at the back of your mind. You remember now- the name 'Chud Steel' is plastered all over Authority recruitment posters''*Yeah. The very same. Did you know he's a fellow Shock Corps member? They assigned him here not long ago to serve as my assistant. Just a damned shame his deployment isn't likely to be permanent. You two should have chat once we're finished - it is good to know your comrades. Any other questions? {{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}*''Augustus salutes you with a smirk on his face.''* Alright, [Rank]. Keep up the good work, and maybe you'll be half as strong as me someday. If you've got any questions, feel free to come back anytime. *''He gives you a hard friendly clap on your shoulder, but you bear it with relative ease - at last, you're made of sterner stuff than before.''* {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...Sorry, did you say *Chud Steel* earlier? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all, thank you Sentinel. {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Shock Corps? {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that's all, thank you Sentinel. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Subsequent Encounters= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="4" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}*''You salute the Sentinel, and he salutes you back''* Welcome back, [Rank] [Last Name]. I hope your Shock Corps training has been doing well. Don't worry - we'll get you in tip-top shape in no time. ...Well. You didn't just come to gawk at me and Interceptor Chud Steel, right? Do you have some questions? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me more about the Shock Corps? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}...Sorry, did you say *Chud Steel* earlier? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="4" {{!}}[See previous instance] {{!}}} }} {{!}}-{{!}}Operator= {{#tag:tabber|Base Dialogue= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="216" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="216" {{!}}''*The Sentinel greets you with a big grin and the two of you exchange enthusiastic salutes, before he gives you a hard clap on the shoulder.*'' If it isn't Operator [last name], one of our star juggernauts! I see you've finally put on some muscle, too - you're filling out your armor well. Don't forget to work on your calves too. There's nothing worse than a leg cramp on the battle field - or worse, in a charge! Hah!.. Ah, I almost forgot. Here, soldier, take this with you.
[Player obtains [[Duskguard Axe]]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="216" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something, Sentinel? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="216" {{!}}''*The Sentinel nods.*'' Sure, go ahead Operator. I wouldn't mind a chat. It is good to know your comrades. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me about yourself? {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It seems to me the High Inquisitor and yourself may not be on the best of terms?.. {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If I may speak freely - what do you think of Warden Jericho? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}Sure, anything particular you want to hear about? {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}''*Sentinel Augustus rubs the back of his head, as if stumped.*'' I respect her greatly as the High Inquisitor. She's a key player in our operations. But she can be pretty intense, you know. I can never really tell what she thinks, or what she means... I'm pretty straight forward myself as it goes - I say what I mean, and I mean what I say. But Merey, well... trying to understand her often feels like reading a closed book. {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}''*Augustus straightens up, almost saluting instinctively.*'' Warden Jericho is an inspiration to us all, Operator [Last Name]. When he was younger, he oversaw the establishment of the Aratel spearhead, the building and expansion of Fort Merit, and all our operations in the Eastern and {{g|The Etrean Luminant|Etrean Luminants}}. He's achieved plenty over the years. I mean, there's a reason he's 'The Warden of the East', not just 'of Merit'. Though... {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If it's not too personal - where are you from? {{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you join the Authority military? {{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You seem to be close to the Drill Sergeant, are you kin? {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How so? {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Though..? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*The Sentinel's expression is inscrutable. Is he wistful, or mournful?*'' I was raised in a small fishing village in the {{g|The Central Luminant|Central Luminant}}, on the outskirts of {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} territory. I'm from a long line of fisherfolk, and I was the eldest of five. Wasn't easy living. Never was... But we got by. When I was 15, there was a bad harvest in the outskirt islands for a few seasons, and poor fishing... So a lot of the folk took to piracy and banditry. It got ugly at times. {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*Augustus' face darkens, and his voice drops low.*'' I made a promise. ...My village was attacked by marauders. We wouldn't give them our winter stockpile. They torched the place in response. ...We fought. Many died. My parents, and two siblings... By the time the navy patrol could help us, it was just me and two of my siblings left. ...The three of us swore a vow that night. That we would leave our past behind, and join the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}}, in order to avenge our kin. So we did. {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*The Sentinel chuckles.*'' Not by blood. But since I lost my parents before I enlisted in the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} forces, Drill Sergeant Kernel filled a mentor role for me. In a way, he's like a father to all recruits in Merit. I have great respect for the man. In fact, he inspired me to join the Shock Corps - his official rank is technically Interceptor. But with the structure of our military, he trains the recruits until they're placed in a division, after which the division leaders take over training and command. {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}''*He shrugs.*'' She's always steely, always tense, always frosty. Don't get me wrong, Operator, I also respect rank and order. It's what keeps the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} from falling apart. But sometimes, it feels like she speaks in riddles. It makes my head hurt. We work together occasionally, but we don't talk much. Though... a few times, she did let her mask slip. It's like she's a different person under that visor. I bet she's actually ''fun'' to be around, when she wants to be. {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}''*He grumbles.*'' I think people give him too much unfair criticism. High command demands results. But I mean... Sure, we've been on the defensive for a while now, not making any major moves. Some criticise the Warden's call for reinforcements from the {{g|The Central Luminant|Central Luminant}} - the waves of new recruits coming in. But can you blame him? Major operations need loads of manpower, which we didn't have until recently. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you join the Authority military? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You seem to be close to the Drill Sargent, are you kin? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that is all for now, Sentinel, thank you. {{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}My condolences for your loss, sir. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If it's not too personal, where are you from? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you join the Authority military? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that is all for now, Sentinel, thank you. {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So the main challenge for Merit's expansion is manpower? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*The Sentinel nods.*'' Yeah [Last Name], go ahead. I'm happy to talk. Got some time to spare. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*The two of you once again exchange enthusiastic salutes. Sentinel Augustus gives you a hard pat on the back.*'' Good talk, Operator [Last Name]. Don't forget to work on those calves, alright? I'll see you around. {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*He lowers his head, in thanks and mourning.*'' That's all in the past now, [Last Name]. Even if I still dream about that night... My surviving siblings still serve the {{g|The Central Authority|Authority}} in the heartlands - my brother as a High Inquisitor, and my sister as a Navy Captain. Myself, I got deployed to Merit in my first assignments, then I joined the Shock Corps. It took a while for me to make my way through the ranks, but eventually I became an Operator, just like you. {{!}} colspan="96" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}''*The Sentinel nods curtly.*'' Yeah. Think about it, Operator. There's an enemy on every corner. There's the Eastern conflict with Etrea, skirmishes with the Hive and the Legions, the Navaen insurgency, all that spy talk I've been hearing about... You can't expect us to go on the offensive when we lack the people to cover our home base. But now that we've got fresh blood in the ranks... ''*Augustus cracks his knuckles, grinning.*'' Maybe things will start moving again. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Could you tell me about yourself? {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}It seems to me the High Inquisitor and yourself may not be on the best of terms?.. {{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If I may speak freely - what do you think of Warden Jericho? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}} colspan="24" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you become the Sentinel, sir? {{!}} colspan="96" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="72" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}''*His tone gains an air of reverence and vengeance.*'' The previous Sentinel, Faris Kesset, fell in battle against General Titus Fulminus Destellus. ''*His fist clenches*'' I've sought to avenge her ever since... I was one of the many Operators in Merit at the time, and basically her second-in-command. There were a few other candidates for the role, but Warden Jericho ended up choosing me. Sentinel Faris was a great woman - it wasn't easy filling her shoes. I'd like to think she'd say I did well, though. {{!}} colspan="96" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="72" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If it's not too personal - where are you from? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You seem to be close to the Drill Sargent, are you kin? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I think that is all for now, Sentinel, thank you. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}} {{!}} colspan="24" {{!}}[See first instance] {{!}}} {{!}}-{{!}}Unlockable Dialogue= This dialogue is unlocked by speaking with [[High Inquisitor Merey]] after reaching Operator rank. {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The Sentinel greets you with a big grin and the two of you exchange enthusiastic salutes, before he gives you a hard clap on the shoulder.*'' If it isn't Operator [last name], one of our star juggernauts! I see you've finally put on some muscle, too - you're filling out your armor well. Don't forget to work on your calves too. There's nothing worse than a leg cramp on the battle field - or worse, in a charge! Hah!.. Ah, I almost forgot. Here, soldier, take this with you.
[Player obtains [[Duskguard Axe]]] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}High Inquisitor Merey requested me to pass a you a message, sir... Sort of. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The Sentinel's eyes widen, as he holds his breath in anticipation. Interceptor Chud Steel also perks up at the mention of the message.*'' Yeah? What did she say, Operator? Is it about the prisoner? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Tell them what High Inquisitor Merey said to you.] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*Sentinel Augustus' face sours a little, and he groans in disappointment. Interceptor Steel suddenly loses interest.*'' Ugh I bet she only says that because she knows I'd ground him to dust if he broke loose, and then he'd be no good for interrogating. Besides, he doesn't get all ''that'' strong. A hard enough cereeb... cebebrum... cebral... uh... '''brain''' shock could get him talking. Guess I'll have to ask the High Inquisitor if I can participate in the next interrogation. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who is this 'General Destellus'? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The Sentinel tightens his fist at the thought of the name, almost unwittingly.*'' He's one of our most important prisoners in the Detainment Core prison. '''General Titus Fulminus Destellus''' of the Hundred Legions, commander of the 49th Legion. We've been trying to get him to spill his secrets about the legion, but - no dice. He shrugs off most of our methods. I didn't think he had that kind of resolve after my soldiers defeated him on the field. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Were you the one who captured him, then? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*He puffs out his chest with pride, his facial expression suggesting a solemn hubris.*'' Who else, soldier? I was en route to a different mission in Aratel with the Shock Corps when we ran into him running a small detachment. He only had a few Legion Shock Troopers with him, the opportunity was too good to miss. He gave us a run for our money, I'll admit - but we captured him all the same. You should've seen the look on Warden Jericho's face when I reported our victory, Operator. He was stunned! {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Why is he considered an important prisoner? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The sentinel frowns.*'' He was a real pain to our behinds when he was free. See myself, I'm the kind of officer who does best following our great Warden's orders. But Destellus... I hate to admit it, but his might rivals mine, and his mind rivals Warden Jericho's. He'd catch us in ambushes, set traps for us, and always be three steps ahead of us. When outnumbered, he would often survive just through sheer strength and discipline. I couldn't stand it. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}How did you manage to capture him, Sentinel? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*His brow quivers, a defiant spark of pride flashing in his eyes.*'' Good question, Operator. In the end, during our skirmish, it came down to a showdown between me and him. I guess I was '''stronger'''. ''*He tilts his head to the side, revealing a gnarly scar to you.*'' He left me with a parting gift before he surrendered. I could have ended him, but the rules of engagement say all surrendered hostiles must be brought back to Merit for interrogation and imprisonment. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Has the High Inquisitor been interrogating him? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*The Sentinel glances away disappointedly.*'' Yeah. Though, she says she's not had much luck so far. Not only is the General persistent, but I'm told he's also capable of some kind of technique that lets him channel some types of electricity into himself. During the first interrogation, they called me in to restrain him, because he broke loose. I was able to subdue him easily. ''*The Sentinel cracks his knuckles.*'' But it wasn't a ''true'' rematch. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}If you defeated him fair and square, Sentinel, why are you itching for a rematch? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="9" {{!}}''*Augustus seems blindsided by your question. He holds his breath for a moment, but your verbal jab finally breaks his silence.*'' ...I guess it's somethin' I've been too proud to admit myself. Reassuring myself that I'm stronger than the man who's been our - ''my'' - nemesis on the field for so long. And maybe I am. But... Something was off, when we fought in Aratel. I can't put my finger on it. It felt like he wasn't '''giving it his all'''. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}You caught him off-guard - maybe he didn't have enough time to prepare? {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Maybe he's actually just weak? I heard he's been getting on in years. {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Maybe he was trying to get captured? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*The Sentinel considers the idea for a moment, then solemnly shakes his head.*'' It would make sense, if he hadn't been travelling with a small group of Shock Troopers. He ''was'' prepared. Otherwise he'd have travelled alone - not even I willingly do that in a warzone. No it was something else... There was hesitation in his moves. I could ''see it'' in his eyes. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*The Sentinel firmly shakes his head.*'' Negative, Operator. What is it the High Inquisitor always tells me? Something about.. Don't book a judge... Er, point being - don't let his looks fool you. Recently, someone tried to free him from the Detainment Core. He broke out of his cell and brought the house down. Then, he started fighting his own allies, and in the end, he ''stayed'' behind. I've never been good at maths - but something doesn't add up. But that's neither here nor there, soldier. {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*The Sentinel's brow furrows. You can almost see smoke coming out of his ears as he thinks.*'' But... Hm... But then?... Hrmmmm... I can't say for sure that he ''didn't'' just throw the fight. It does ''feel'' that way... But why? Why would he let himself get captured?.. Hrm... Grah, I can't make any sense of it. I'm sure the High Inquisitor or the Warden have their thoughts about it. But I don't even know if your idea is true, Operator. Either way... It's not my place to make guesses. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Hesitation?.. {{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*He nods.*'' A warrior like him moves on instinct. I do, too. Maybe you move like that, too. To us, it's second nature. But in our fight, he'd swing out of reflex then pull his punches at the last second. He'd move to dodge before he thought about it, but then his feet would double-back. Like his nature was telling him to do one thing, and his mind - another. I just can't make sense of it, and it's been bothering me... But that's neither here nor there, soldier. {{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}[See first instance on Base Dialogue] {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}May I ask you something else, Sentinel? {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance on Base Dialogue] }}}}}} |-|Not Authority Ensign= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The giant of a man pays you little heed.*'' This place is off-limits to outsiders, bub. You should leave. Unless you'd like me to cave your skull in. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue] {{!}}} |-|Bad Authority Reputation= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}You must think yourself ''*real*'' sneaky, huh? Tsch. It's only too bad you ran straight into '''me''', chump. {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue], player is jailed and sent to '''execution''' {{!}}} ==Gallery== Sentinel Augustus Old.png|Old appearance ==Trivia== *Sentinel Augustus's hair id is 15108173343 with the beard being 15216772565 {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]] [[Category:Military personnel of The Central Authority]]

Sentinel Faris Kesset is a [[Tiran]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. She was part of the Shock Trooper division for [[The Central Authority]].

She wielded the [[Duskguard Axe]]. As signified by her [[resonance]], she was moderately strong.

title: Serena
content:
{{CutContent}} {{EnemyInfobox |health=2000 |drops=N/A |weapon=*[[Shotel]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Ice Eruption *Glacial Shower *Ice Smash |image1=Serena.png|caption1=The sole reason for Felinor prejudice}} == Description== Serena is a cut NPC lynx [[Felinor]] who wore the [[Veteran Adventurer]] [[Outfits|Outfit]], and who could randomly spawn around [[Starswept Valley]]. When talked to, she would ask for water. If you had a canteen with water, you could give her a sip. From here, two things could happen: * She would thank the player and reward them with a chest. *She would attack the player - if defeated, she would still grant the chest. If you didn't have a [[canteen]] with water, she would either stay there as an interactable NPC, or attack the player. While knocked and being gripped by the player or NPC, she would also ''kindly'' ask you if she "is convincing". ==Moveset:== Serena's arsenal consisted of a [[Shotel]] along with the [[Frostdraw]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Performs a sideflip while swinging blade. *Has 100% chip damage. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Ice Smash'''
(★★☆) |User performs a wind-up before slamming an ice club into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Ice Eruption'''
(★★★) |A flurry of ice spikes. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, stun }} |- |
'''Glacial Shower'''
(★★☆) |Rains down shards of ice. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} == Finisher == Serena would execute her opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before slicing their throat. |} ==Trivia== *One of [[Authority Captain|two enemies]] that utilized the unobtainable "Glacial Shower" Mantra. *She was essentially an [[Authority Captain]], but had half of their HP. *Her Shotel animation used to be glitched: she would unsheathe her weapon, but not have it in her hand, *Her hair ID was 4997322761. *She was hostile to all NPCS of all factions. *There used to be a bug where if there were two or more Serenas in a server and you gave water to one of them, the other/s would still thank you for the water, even though you hadn't actually given them the water. *She didn't actually need ''water''. If you gave her a canteen with any other liquid (even Celestial ichor), she would still accept it as if it were water. *She was removed because "there was a softlock bug with it that was hard to test and it was an annoying event so it was just removed for both reasons". {{History}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:NPCs located in the Eastern Luminant]] [[Category:Quests]]

==Description==
Seroth is an Etrean amongst the ranks of the [[Etrean Royal Guard (NPC)|Etrean Royal Guard]]. Located near the [[Isle of Vigils]] docks, Seroth resides in a cave that acts as a makeshift workshop for experiments, with markings sprawled across the walls and books lying on the floor.

Leaning against the far wall before Seroth, there lies the lifeless corpse of a [[Capra]] [[The Ministry|Ministry]] agent, with their blood staining the cave floor. This person was likely killed by Seroth to advance his experiments in some fashion, as he appears to be studying the corpse.

Seroth is trying to craft... something with the [[Ancient Dagger Remains]], though what he is trying to create is a mystery in and of itself. Seroth has unique dialogue if you speak to him while you have the [[Sanguine Transfuser]] equipped which heavily implies that this may be the item he was attempting to make, though this cannot be said for sure. In any case, his true motives remain unclear.

==Location==
Seroth is located in a cave near the docks of [[Isle of Vigils]].

==Description==
The Serpent's Edge is an endgame [[Weaponry#Medium Weapons|Medium Weapon]], known for its iconic curved design resembling a snake.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center>
File:SerpentsEdge.gif
</gallery>Has a unique critical attack consisting of three one-handed heavy slashes, each coming out a little less than a second from the last. The critical propels the user forward with every slash, making it difficult to land all three slashes.

This has a 0.75x scaled damage multiplier per hit.

You can aim each slash by turning your camera, and the critical can be feinted after the first slash.

{{text|m1tag}}

The critical has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*The critical can be used in water as a method of escape due to its movement.
*Possibly a reference to the [https://darksouls.wiki.fextralife.com/Flamberge Flamberge] from Dark Souls.
**The Flamberge is also a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flamberge real weapon].
*Also could be a reference to [https://kimetsu-no-yaiba.fandom.com/wiki/Obanai_Iguro Iguro Obanai's] [https://kimetsu-no-yaiba.fandom.com/wiki/Nichirin_Sword nichirin blade] from [https://kimetsu-no-yaiba.fandom.com/wiki/Kimetsu_no_Yaiba_Wiki Demon Slayer].

File:Server List.png
== Description == '''Servers''' are the primary way to join ''[[Deepwoken (game)|Deepwoken]]''. The [[Locations|Etrean Luminant]] can host 24 people, the [[Locations|Eastern Luminant]], 20, and [[The Depths]], 14. If [[Hell Mode]] is active in a server, the server card will appear red with [HELL] labeled next to the player count. Similarly, an ongoing [[War Mode]] server will appear yellow with [WAR] labeled next to the player count. Private Servers will only have both their text and border in a orange color, as well as removing the limit on player counts. These are reserved for events, testing, etc.; and require developer or moderation permission to view and access. == Server Regions == There are approximately 23 possible regions: * NSW, AU (Australia) * Hesse, DE (Germany) * Paris, FR (France) * Tokyo, JP (Japan) * North Holland, NL (Netherlands) * Mazovia, PL (Poland) * Singapore, SG (Singapore) * England, UK (United Kingdom) * Maharashtra, IN (India) * Leinster, IE (Ireland) * São Paulo, BR (Brazil) In addition, the USA has its own subregions: * California * Florida * Georgia * Illinois * New Jersey * New York * Ohio * Oregon * Texas * Virginia * Washington It is also possible to encounter a region known as the Unknown Region, which may be referred to as Instanced in dungeons, although this is an uncommon occurrence. ''Please note that it is possible that some locations may have been missed, as Roblox servers may not be up at all times, or may lack sufficient dedicated servers for certain locations due to a possible shortage of players.'' ==Server Names== Servers follow a naming scheme of two adjectives (descriptive and color) followed by a noun. They're a lower-level variant of the [[Semblance]], appearing in place of them until a certain Power. Their aspect and gender is unknown or rather none. Their faces are always distorted, no matter how much sanity or Willpower you have. They have a chance to drop their weapon, the [[Shattered Katana]]. They wear a [[Bloodfeather Cowl]], [[Dark Owl Cloak]], and a Gray [[Traveler Cloak]]. They also use the Specter Path of the [[Galebreathe]] Attunement == Moveset == A Shade uses the [[Shattered Katana]] with Specter [[Galebreathe]]. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

After it's been made, any player or non-allied npc that steps inside is severely slowed. {{AttackTags |misc, debuff }} |} === Passives === * Third Eye - The Shade cannot be assassinated. == Finisher == The Shade executes it's opponents after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with their blade. |} ==Gallery== SemblanceHeadless.png|Shade without face cover. File:Close up semblance.png|Shade Closeup File:SemblanceYapping.png|Shade Yapping ==Trivia== *If you zoom in the camera enough to their face, it reveals they're actually headless. *Despite wielding incredibly strong weapons, they have a relatively low health pool, with little to no resistances making this the easiest way to obtain a Unique and '''Legendary Weapon'''. *They may be related to [[The Knives of Eylis]] or the [[Voidmother]] due to being able to use the '''Time-Slowing Orb''', or due to their name they may be [[The Knives of Eylis]] from another reality, however this maybe unlikely due to their weaponry. This Outfit additionally requires the player have at least 10 [[Agility]] to be crafted. === ''Armor Stats'' === This Outfit has 1500 durability, grants {{stats|phys|+10% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+5% Elemental resistance}}, and {{stats|sdw|+10% Shadow resistance}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Lowstride}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|phys|10% Physical}}, {{stats|sdw|14.5% Shadowcast}}, and {{stats|elm|5% Elemental|sdw=n}}. The {{t|Lowstride}} Talent increases your [[Stealth]] and movement speed while crouching. Additionally, this removes the sound that sheathing and unsheathing your weapon makes. == Trivia == *Shadow Hunter is the only non-Starter outfit to not have a Power requirement. *Worn by [[Thief|Thieves]] in Erisia, as well as the [[Mindless Servant]]s in Duke Erisia's Manor. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Non-exclusive Talents]]

title: Shadowcast

{{Quotes|quote=Ooh dearie, I can see the darkness within your heart. But it simply won't do until you draw it out.|author=Beatra, Trainer of Shadow}}[[File:Shadowcast.png|thumb|Shadowcast icon]] == Description == '''Shadowcast''' is an [[Attunement]] that, if previously unlocked, can be started with at character creation. It is unique due to the fact that it drains Ether from those that are hit by its Mantras and returns the drained Ether to the caster. This does come at a cost to its damage output, which tends to be a little lower. Shadowcast applies a black particle effect on hit that can be stacked. Many Shadowcast Talents are centered on Ether drain, obscuring vision and AoE. ==Obtainment== The [[Attunement]] can be unlocked by drinking a [[Attunement Potions|Nightblood potion]] obtained from [[Nostor]] in the [[First Layer|The Depths]] inside [[The City of the Drowned]], requiring 2 [[Umbral Obsidian]]. You don't have to venture back into the depths to upgrade Shadowcast Mantras however, as [[Beatra]] is found in [[Derelict Highchurch]]. She will upgrade your Mantras but not allow you to obtain Shadowcast. Shadowcast is unlocked permanently from the character creation screen. ==Training== {{text|att-training |train=using the [[Pure Heart]] to increase the attribute after either landing {{PAGENAME}} Mantras or eating [[Umbral Obsidian]] to gain enough EXP |trainer=[[Nostor]] in [[Lost Celtor]], [[Beatra]] at the [[Derelict Highchurch]], }} ===Mantra Damage Calculation=== {{text|mantracalc}} ==Cantrip(s)== Cantrips are, often minor, passive abilities that are granted upon obtaining any Mantra from the respective Attunement. ===Night Vision=== This Cantrip increases the brightness in dark locations, allowing the player to see better in low-light environments. Puppets turn purple if they've been alive for 15 seconds, signifying that they only have 10 seconds left to live. |} ==Gallery== ShadeWisp.png|Shade Wisp concept art ==Trivia== *The Ether drain of Mantras is affected by [[Songchant]]. *In past updates the selection icon for Shadowcast had the same art as [[Flamecharm]], but was oddly tinted white. *Many factions view the use of Shadowcast as taboo due to the nature of the Attunement. *{{cl|sdw|'''Shadow Vortex'''}} is a reference to Planetary Devastation from ''Naruto Shippuden''. *The Spring Spark modified version of {{cl|sdw|'''Shade Bringer'''}} is a reference to a similar attack used by Knight Artorias from ''Dark Souls'' and the Lions Claw Ash of War from ''Elden Ring'' *The Blast Spark modified version of Shadow Assault is a reference to Akuma's Raging Demon from Street Fighter *{{cl|sdw|'''Shade Wisp'''}} is arguably one of the most controversial Mantras ever added to the game, as its purpose is to hide animations. The reason this was added was, according to its creator yayafino, because he hated "parry bots," though he would later clarify this was him trolling. This came shortly after the appearances of the [[Big Alchemist's Hat]] and [[Big Herbalist's Hat]] were reworked by co-owner Ragoozer himself due to them hiding animations, which some came to view as a direct betrayal of the ethos of the game's very owners. Not helping this was that, according to tester MrTheBest2, almost every tester was staunchly against {{cl|sdw|'''Shade Wisp'''}}'s inclusion; it didn't even get past testing, but it was added to the game. *Shadowcast has many moves that seem to be direct references to abilities in ''Rogue Lineage'' and ''Tales from the Valley'', and the element seems to have much more general utility than the others. [[File:Shadow.png|thumb]] **An interesting example of this would be using a Blast Spark on {{cl|sdw|'''Shadow Gun'''}}, giving it a striking resemblance to Duelist Dash from ''Rogue Lineage'' (and by extension, Cero Metralleta from ''Bleach''). ** Base {{cl|sdw|'''Shadow Gun'''}}'s animation is identical to the Duelist's M2 from ''Rogue Lineage''. *Similarly to every other ritual cast Mantra, {{cl|sdw| '''Shade Wisp'''}} gives the player a finger on the hand that casts the Mantra. *Shadowcast is the only Attunement to have two trainers: [[Nostor, Master of Shadow|Nostor]] and [[Beatra]]. However, Beatra cannot be used to obtain Shadowcast or to progress the [[Silentheart]] Oath, but only to upgrade Shadowcast Mantras without going to Scyphozia. *Shadowcast appears to be the attunement associated with [[the Ministry]], although NPCs not associated can be seen using it. *Shadowcast is likely a reference to Re: Zero's [https://rezero.fandom.com/wiki/Magic# Shadow Magic, or otherwise Yin Magic]. This is seen as Shadow Magic is said to have very similar properties, instilling fear, stopping movement, etc. *Shadowcast and [[Bloodrend]] are the only attunements to not have their own respective paths. *The {{cl|sdw|'''Encircle'''}} mantra is notorious for a tech involving using the [[Stoneheart]]'s critical, which is unparryable and has hyperarmor, during Encircles windup. ==References== {{Nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

==Description==
'''Shard Bow''' is a [[Resonance]] that players can obtain, and is '''common''' to roll.

==Usage==
'''Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the "Shard Bow" Resonance.

'''Shard Bow''' conjures a shimmering white bow that fires 1 or 3 explosive arrows at the cursor from midair, kicking the user off the floor. These arrows deal typeless damage, and do not scale off of any modifiers. This ability has a 20 second cooldown.

{{cl|corres|If Shard Bow is corrupted, your Shard Bow will deal an additional 5 posture damage, no longer deal typeless, instead dealing Flamecharm damage and applying {{status|White Flames}} to your target. Additionally, this Resonance comes with a unique downside, applying White Flames to the caster on use, while sending them higher into the air.}}

===''Resonance Point Usage''===
When obtained, Shard Bow will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Jump Distance:''' Determines how far up the user is propelled off the floor upon firing Shard Bow.
*'''Range:''' Determines how long the arrow can travel on it's own before detonating without hitting a surface.
*'''Radius:''' Determines how large the explosion of the arrow is.

====<u>'''''Variants'''''</u>====

*'''Variant 1''' allows the user to leap backward into the air, before firing a single explosive arrow at their cursor. It deals 70 damage with 15 posture damage (20 posture damage if {{cl|corres|Corrupted}}).

*'''Variant 2''' allows the user to leap backwards and upwards before firing 3 explosive arrows below you. Each arrow will toss you into the air further. It deals 28 damage per shot with 7.5 posture damage per shot (10 posture damage per if {{cl|corres|Corrupted}}).

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Shardbowneon.png|Shard Bow being activated
File:Shard Bow 4K.png
File:Shard bow.png|Corrupted Shard Bow
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*White Burn has a DPS of 9.6 at 0 Flamecharm, and a DPS of 14.4 at 100 Flamecharm.
**With {{t|Azure Flames}}, you can bring this up to 10.8 to 16.25 DPS, depending on your Flamecharm investment.
**[[Deepfire Ring]] does not affect White burn.
*Reference to ''The Stormlight Archive'''s Grandbows.
*The self burn Corrupt Resonance downside is exclusive to Shard Bow.
**Self burn was an obtainable downside for all other Resonances, but it was reworked into the Wither downside that we know today. As Shard Bow's downside was unique to itself anyways, it kept the White Flames.
*Possibly a reference to the Risk of Rain Huntress ability called "Ballista" which makes you jump into the sky and fire three "energy bolts."
*Shard bow's string stretches when pulled back, unlike real world bows, in which the string does not stretch, but rather the legs bend.
*Shard bow appears to be a 'Bare bow' which is an unmodified version of a recurve bow.
*Due a bug, the {{cl|corres|Corrupted}} variant had Flamecharm scaling, increasing its base damage from 70 to up to 105.

==Description==
The '''Sharko Plush''' was a plush released as part of a Deepwoken and Makeship collaboration, classified under the "Plushie" category. It features [[Destroyman III]]. Its original campaign ran from November 24th, 2023, to December 31st, 2023, before selling out. However, due to its popularity, the Sharko Plush was added to the Makeship Hall of Fame and became a permanent item available for purchase. The plush measures 13.3 cm in height, 13.0 cm in width, and 17.8 cm in depth, and is made from polypropylene cotton and plush fabric (ultra soft fleece).

===Official Description===
<poem style="text-align: center">
"Once a screenpet, this fearsome Megalodaunt has made good on his promise and broken out of the confines of your computer screen - this time for good!

Whether you decide to befriend, punt, arrest, or start a band with this creature, he's sure to take it in stride with his vacant smile and lack of moral responsibility.

Thank you to sycne for the original sticker design!"
</poem>

==Description==
The Shattered Katana is an endgame [[Weapons#Medium Weapons|Medium]] Katana.

The {{t|Paired Soul}} Talent from the [[Vigil Initiate]], [[Cloak of Winds]], and [[Royal Etrean Guard]] outfits increases Shattered Katana's damage by 5%.
==Critical Attack ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Katana Critical.gif|One-Handed
File:Shattered Critical.gif|Two-Handed
</gallery>

While one handed it uses the default [[Katana]] critical but gains a unique critical while two handed. This has 1.1x scaled damage multiplier with innate '''bleed'''.

For the two-handed critical, the user does a quick vertical and horizontal slash, which is followed with two additional delayed slashes. The first two cuts have a 0.3x scaled damage multiplier each, while the delayed slashes have a 0.75x scaled damage multiplier each, with innate {{status|Bleed}}. This critical deals 1.5 posture damage on the first hit, ending the critical early if blocked, and 3 posture damage on all subsequent hits. The delayed slashes also ignore hitstun, meaning if you get hit stunned after the first hit landed, the delayed slashes would still trigger anyways.

The critical has a cooldown of '''6 seconds'''.

== Trivia ==
*It is one of five weapons that comes with a scabbard, the others being the [[Katana]]/[[Alloyed Katana]], [[Palace Tachi]], [[Purple Cloud]], and [[Bloodfouler]].
**It's appropriate that the scabbards of both the Shattered and regular Katana are placed cutting-edge facing upwards: many samurai preferred to draw their swords facing downward only if they were wearing armor, as that would prevent the blade from getting caught on it. Conversely, they would wear their katana facing upwards without armor since that wouldn't be an issue; as most [[outfits]] in Deepwoken lack heavy armor, it makes sense for the scabbard to be facing up.
*The incredible length of the blade would classify this weapon as an ōdachi, as opposed to a katana.
**Despite its blade being much longer than the Katana, both weapons have the same range of 8.
*On release, the Shattered Katana had 50% PEN and 0.75x swing speed (Which is 1x swing speed of now). It also received the full 25% damage buff from Paired Soul which was later nerfed to its current 5%.

title: Shields

==Description==
Shields are an offhand weapon type in Deepwoken. These defensive tools increase the wearer's maximum '''posture''' stat, but reduce the amount of posture you recover from parrying by 40% as a downside.

A shield's Max Posture Bonus stat can be increased with '''Weight''' Quality Stars.

Certain Talents, most notably the aptly named {{t|Shieldbreaker}}, allow people to ignore the posture bonus shields grant players. Take caution when using shields, as they may not work in all scenarios.

Shields have their own Talents in the {{t|Shieldmaster}} Talent tree as well as an exclusive Mantra - [[Rally]].

title: Ships & Sailing
content:
File:Witherald has good suggestion ideas you should discuss your suggestions with him.png
==Description== Ships and Sailing are a core gameplay mechanic introduced in ''Deepwoken.'' The player is introduced to sailing on their first playthrough and will automatically spawn in with a Dinghy. There are currently 6 ships the player can use, those ships being: * Dinghy * Sloop * Schooner * Merchant Schooner * Frigate * Ironclad The player can buy and build ships through the [[Shipwright]], normally found at the docks of Towns or other Islands.
Once a ship has been purchased, the player can deploy it through a Shipwright Merchant, a Ship Post, or by pressing the "Summon Ship" keybind (Default: N). The player can only have a maximum of 9 ships. Sails on the ship will default to red and its flag black, but being in a [[Guilds|Guild]] will change the sails and flag to bear the colors and emblem of the Guild. With an Ironclad, the side lining will instead change to the background color of the Guild. ==Usage== ===Sailing=== To begin sailing, the player will have to press {{Input|input|W}} to drop the sails and move forward. To move backwards and raise a boats sails, press {{Input|input|S}}. By pressing {{Input|input|A}} or {{Input|input|D}} a boat will quickly turn towards left or right, indicated by a small dial. Letting go of the input, the boat will quickly readjust and continue to go straight. If the player is turning the boat while reversing, the direction will be inverted. This happens since the direction the player attempts to sail with {{Input|input|A}} or {{Input|input|D}} is proportional to the rudder, not the direction wish to steered in. While sailing, the player can angle their sails by pressing {{Input|keybind|Z}} or {{Input|keybind|C}} towards a certain direction. If their sails are facing in the same direction as the wind, their ship will gain a speed boost. Sailing further from land will gradually increase the speed of a boat, and being closer vice-versa. When a boat is not in control by any player it will quickly decelerate and come to a stop. ===Cannons=== Starting with the Schooner and above, ships will contain Cannons. Cannons can be operated by pressing {{Input|keybind|interact}}. Clicking will cause the Cannon to aim towards a target and shoot with no endlag. Cannon damage will scale with the player's Power and deal double damage in PvE. If someone is controlling the wheel of the ship, they can fire Cannons without being stationed near one by clicking where they want to fire. Doing this will shoot from the cannon that is best able to shoot from the point clicked. In return, this will increase the cooldown by a certain amount. Cannons can have some weird aim tracing, sometimes firing past hitboxes and firing at the sea instead. Cannons have a max distance that they are able to be fired. ===Ship Health=== Ships contain health that can be damaged by a number of environmental factors, such as [[Mantras]] that destroy terrain, Cannonballs, and certain [[Monsters|Monster]] attacks. If a ship reaches 50% health, the player can no longer respawn on that ship and will move slower. This is signified by smoke particles coming off of the ship. * [[Celtor]]'s Aspect passive increases the base health of a boat by 10%. * {{t|Seamaster's Guile}} gives your boat 25% damage reduction while you're piloting it. ===Repairing and Selling=== Ships can be repaired by paying {{c|notes|[[Notes]]}} at Shipwights or Posts. When a ship reaches 0% health, it will sink and then must be salvaged at a Shipwright Merchant or Shipyard Post for half its original price, where it can then be spawned again at full health. A Dinghy that has sunk will have their repair cost be free. Ships can be sold for half of their original price, and the price will be lower the more damaged the ship is. ==List of Ships== '''(The square brackets refer to [[Celtor]]'s Aspect passive)''' {| class="fandom-table" !Image !Ship !Details |- |[[File:Dinghy.png|frameless|227x227px]] |Dinghy | * No Price (0 Notes) * 300 Health [330 Health] * You can only have 1 Dinghy. |- |[[File:Sloop.png|frameless|206x206px]] |Sloop | * Price: 50 Notes [40 Notes] * Sell Price: 25 Notes * 600 Health [660 Health] |- |[[File:Schooner.png|frameless|206x206px]] |Schooner | * Price: 500 Notes [400 Notes] * Sell Price: 250 Notes * 2,000 Health [2,200 Health] * 4 Cannons |- |[[File:Merchantschooner.png|frameless|207x207px]] |Merchant Schooner | * Price: 1,000 Notes [800 Notes] * Sell Price: 500 Notes * 3,000 Health [3,300 Health] * 4 Cannons * Lantern (Resting Place) |- |[[File:Frigate.png|frameless|212x212px]] |Frigate | * Price: 2,000 Notes [1600 Notes] * Sell Price: 1,000 Notes * 5,000 Health [5,500 Health] * 6 Cannons * Lantern (Resting Place) |- |[[File:Ironclad.png|frameless|256x256px]] |Ironclad | * Price: 6,000 Notes [4,800 Notes] * Sell Price: 3,000 Notes * 10,000 Health [11,000 Health] * 20 Cannons * Lantern (Resting Place) |} ==Gallery== File:The Boat Dude.png|[[Shipwright]] Merchant File:Build Ship UI.png|Ship Building UI ==Trivia== * [[Food]] is unable to be cooked using the ship lanterns, nor can [[Campfire]]s be placed on ships. ** The Graceful Flame mantra may still be used on ships with no caveat or risk. * It is recommended to buy a ship like the Merchant Schooner, due to being the earliest with a Lantern and being cheap to repair if broken. * Ironclads are always travelling at max speed, since they don't use flag sails to take advantage of the wind. * Cannons are viable in combat, whether it be for PVP or PVE. * Mantras that can damage the environment/terrain are capable of hurting ships. However, the best way to destroy a ship is sailing one into a [[Whirlpools|Whirlpool]], instantly destroying it. * The flag at the top of the mast of a ship always points in the direction of the wind. * There is a 4th sea called "[[Open Sea]]" which is only able to be found in areas such as [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]]. There are 4 static spawns for them in [[Etris]], as well as a [[Job Boards|job]] for them in the same location. They are the guards who stormed the royal palace with Zi'eer to steal the throne of [[Etrea]]. They became monstrosities through the power granted by Zi'eer. Their attire consists of a [[Blackleaf Helm]] that is combined with a [[Royal Guard's Kabuto]], an [[Etrean Siege Cuirass]] combined with an [[Iron Cestus]], and [[Etrean Siege Sabatons]]. {{Clear}} ==Moveset== {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |

content:
{{Topbuttons|{{iv|Shogun of the Prophet's Guard}}, p}} {{IronVowEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Evil assaults even the most sacred of places. I suppose we should have seen it coming.|author=High Monk Junsui}} {{EnemyInfobox |drops=* 2 [[Knowledge]] * 2,000 [[Notes]] * [[Vibrant Gem]] * [[Pluripotent Alloy]] * [[Ardour Manifestation]] * [[Memento]] Talents |weapon=[[The Endless Wave]] |moves=*High Cleave *Crush & Rend *Graceful Slicer *Severing Flourish *Low Cleave *Shogun's Brutality *Serpent-Slaying Sweep *Eight Heavens |image1=ShogunCaptain.png |health=4000 |pronouns=He/him{{Ref/NPC|Mofisu Clan Informant|quote=Good work... Had that beast not caught me off guard, I too would have made quick work of him...}} |affiliation=[[Etrea]] |challenges= }} ==Description== The Shogun of the Prophet's Guard at the {{iv|Temple of Mur}}, formerly known as the Shogun Captain, is an instanced boss near the [[Deep Thresher Nest]] encountered through its location by a boundary. This boss is optional to challenge {{iv|Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet}}, however each {{iv|Memento}} has certain Talents and Mantras that can only be obtained by defeating this boss. It also goes without say that defeating the Temple Shogun is necessary to obtain a completion mark on the associated Memento tag in the character creation menu. === Starting Fight with Shogun === #Recommended but not mandatory: Reach Power 5. #Make your way to the [[Deep Thresher Nest]], below the trenches close to where the [[Deep Widow]] is and instead of going towards the Widow, go the other direction and enter the [[Boundary]]. #Upon loading into the instanced area, walk up to the standing Shogun and he will start fighting you. His attire consists of a [[Blackleaf Helm]] that is combined with a [[Royal Guard's Kabuto]], an [[Etrean Siege Cuirass]] combined with an [[Iron Cestus]], and [[Etrean Siege Sabatons]]. ==Moveset== {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name !Description !Media |- |
'''High Cleave''' (★☆☆)
|The Shogun performs a simple upward slash toward the right with his blade. This has no highlight, and acts as a regular attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip }} |[[File:Shogun Slice.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Crush & Rend''' (★☆☆)
|The Shogun kicks forward, obscuring themselves partially with dust, before swinging downward at the player. This has no highlight, and acts as a regular attack. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip }} |[[File:Shogun KickCombo.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Graceful Slicer''' (★☆☆)
|The Shogun highlights Green, leaping backwards a fair distance before slashing twice in opposing directions, moving them towards the player. {{AttackTags |indicator = parry |parry.y, block.n, dodge.n, autogrip }} |[[File:Shogun Whirlwind 2.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Severing Flourish''' (★★☆)
|The Shogun highlights Red, spinning around into two devastating slashes that cannot be parried. The first slash is very delayed, and a roll cancel must be employed to avoid the attack completely. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, autogrip }} |[[File:Shogun Flourish 2.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Low Cleave''' (★☆☆)
|The Shogun performs a simple slash with his blade. Visually distinct from '''High Cleave''' by the Yellow highlight, indicating that you must either crouch, uppercut or block the attack. Consider blocking this attack '''ONLY''' if you've reached 26 posture as this keeps the timing simple and reliable. The extra 1 posture can be obtained through equipment. {{AttackTags |indicator = duck |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, crouch, autogrip |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Shogun CrouchSlice 2.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Shogun's Brutality''' (★★☆)
|The Shogun highlights Magenta , indicating the attack must be jumped over, performing a brisk stomp, before then quickly following it up with two strikingly fast slashes that can be parried, before spinning around into a '''White'''-highlighted leg slash that must be jumped over.
Consider dodging one of the slashes after the first jump to better prepare yourself for the timing of the second jump only attack. {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, jump, autogrip |type1_color=DarkOrange |type2_color=DarkOrange |type3_color=DarkOrange }} |[[File:Shogun StompCombo 2.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |
'''Serpent-Slaying Sweep''' (★★★)
|The Shogun crouches low and performs a slash to the left, before following up with a Red-highlighted slash, and then two more extremely brisk spinning slashes that can both be parried. There is an extremely small delay between the third and fourth slash. This attack can be differentiated from '''High Cleave''' by the Shogun's crouching motion and differing slash direction. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip |type1_color=DarkOrange |type2_color=DarkOrange }} |[[File:Shogun Sweeps 2.gif|thumb|centre]] |- |colspan="3" style="text-align:center" | '''Attacks unlocked on Phase 2''' |- |
'''Eight Heavens''' (★★★)
|The Shogun lets out a distinct roar, indicating a devastating combo. He will perform two slashes without a highlight, followed by two devastating slashes with Red highlights, and he finally ends with four slower slashes with Green highlights. Once this attack is used it goes on cooldown for roughly 30 seconds and can be reused again.
To deal with it, you should parry twice, then roll cancel into another roll cancel in quick succession, and then parry 4 times; parry parry, roll cancel roll cancel, parry parry parry parry. Additionally, if you can manage the first 4 slashes, you can simply s hold and walk out of his range, though beware it is deceptively large especially during the parry only attacks so walking the extra mile is recommended.

A safer way of dealing with this attack is to bait it out by barely staying in the shoguns range and waiting for him to use the move so that you can easily avoid it.{{clear}}[[File:shogun ragebait.gif|thumb|left|Baiting out Eight Heavens]]{{clear}} {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, autogrip |type1_color=DarkOrange |type2_color=DarkOrange |type3_color=DarkOrange }} |[[File:Shogun Ult.gif|thumb|centre]] |} ==Tips== *It is recommended to enter the [[Temple of Mur]] [[Boundary]] to unlock it for future runs as it allows you to very quickly retry the boss if you fail. *The Shogun has no set attack pattern, and will chain moves together seemingly at random. It will not however use the same attack twice in a row. *You can tell whenever he is are attacking or not by the sudden snaps in stance; use this to your advantage to deal or avoid incoming damage. *Attempting to kite The Shogun and kill them with ranged attacks will prove tedious; he will will parry any attack attempted from a distance unless they are in the middle of an attack animation. *The Shogun's attacks have deceivingly large hitboxes. If you don't know if you will be hit, it's best to assume you will, and to act accordingly. *The Shogun has minimal downtime between attacks, chaining them together at great speeds. *The Shogun has 2 attacks with blind spots: Crush & Rend and Severing Flourish can be walked behind after his first hit. *If you attempt to parry '''Low Cleave''', you can still crouch under it despite being in lingering block frames, However this is not recommended, as this just puts extra stress on you for almost no benefit. *'''The Shogun can use his ultimate attack more than once. Remember to look out for it at all times once he is below half health.''' ==Trivia== *The variant encountered in the Temple of Mur was originally named "Shogun Captain", a nonsensical, contradictory title. A ''shogun'', short for ''sei-i taishogun'' meaning "Commander-in-Chief of the Expeditionary Force Against the Barbarians", was the chief military ruler of Japan for a portion of its history. There are no other ranks within the position of ''shogun'', and as such, a "Shogun Captain" is akin to a "Secretary of Defense Captain", "General Captain" or "President Captain". This is likely why it was renamed to match the other [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard|Shoguns of the Prophet's Guard]], following complaints of racism, as those enemies represent a more accurate use of the title. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Bosses}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Individuals with He/him pronouns]] [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]]

==Description==
The Shotel is a Medium Weapon. It can be found through chests in [[Minityrsa]], [[Songseeker Wilds]], and [[The Depths]]. This weapon can be alloyed, giving it a damascus steel-type texture with light purple tint and raising the stats to match late game tier weaponry.

The critical has a cooldown of '''3 seconds.'''

title: Shrine of Winter
content:
{{CutContent}}
{{Location|name=Shrine of Winter|caption=Winter's call beckons you to join its frozen embrace.}}
[[File:Shrine of Winter.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Description ==
The '''Shrine of Winter''' was a location in Deepwoken's Pre-Release phase used to enter the Depths without having to die, similarly to [[Whirlpools]]. The Shrine was most likely located in either [[Etris]] or the [[Isle of Vigils]] due to the soundtrack [[Deepwoken OST|Peregrine]] playing in the area.

To activate the shrine, a user in its proximity of activation would use a wisp-type ritual (most likely the [[Frostdraw|Frost Wisp]],) and would be teleported to [[Scyphozia]] instantly.

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
ShrineOfWinter.gif|The Shrine of Winter being activated
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
*The Shrine of Winter is still present in the game, being behind [[Galpin Spellhardt]] in [[The Floating Keep]]. However, it no longer serves it's original purpose nor can it be used to enter The Depths.
*The GIF and picture used in this article are from ReEvolu's video [https://youtu.be/wm-WwWlKxp4?si=DJdQ1LdAtCqF-Wr- Clips from Ancient Deepwoken]

title: Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
''This is a page about a shrine dedicated to Yun’Shul. For the Drowned God, see [[Yun'Shul]].''
{{Quotes|quote=PLUCK OUT THINE EYES; TEAR OUT THINE THROAT; LAY WASTE TO ALL WHICH IS SACRED; THE MOONSEYE CONVERGES WITH THAT BELOW.|author=Yun'Shul to the unworthy}}
{{NPCInfobox|title1=Shrine of Yun'Shul|image1=Shrine of Yun'Shul.png|location=[[Temple of Hearts]]}}

== Description ==
'''The Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts''' is a shrine dedicated to the Drowned God [[Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts]]. It allows the player to use wishes to grant

The shrine also acts as the penultimate step of obtaining the [[Contractor]] [[Oath]]; choosing the "What happened to this place?" dialogue option will enable the dialogue with [[The Lord Regent]] offering to join him.

Speaking with Yun'Shul will show another dialogue for getting the [[Soulbreaker]] [[Oath]] after meeting all requirements, the second to last step.

It's possible to interact with the shrine at range using the [[Idol of Yun'Shul]]. This will allow for one wish to be made and consume the item after usage. The item doesn't require a Resonance and will consume your wish if you have it; though, it can still be used without a wish - to get the most mileage out of it, you should be unable to obtain a wish from Yun'Shul's ''shrine'' itself by the time you use it.

==Location==
The Shrine of Yun'shul can be found in the [[Temple of Hearts]], locked behind a [[Resonance#Rerolling & Resonance Doors|Resonance Door]] within the [[First Layer]] of [[The Depths]].
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
NPC Map Shrine of Yun'shul 1.png|Zoomed Out
NPC Map Shrine of Yun'shul 2.png|Zoomed In
</gallery>

== Wishes ==
The player can interact with Yun'Shul's shrine to obtain a wish. Making a wish requires some criteria:

*You need to have a Resonance, normally needed to get past the Resonance Door. '''If you attempt to speak to Yun'Shul without a Resonance and you are not a [[Deepbound]] (such as glitching in or being carried in by another player) you will be instantly killed and wipe if you do not log fast enough.'''
**Interacting with the shrine without a wish will not kill you assuming you meet these criteria.
*Have a wish available (sometime referred to as Yun'Shul wish CD).
**A wish can be obtained by levelling up 3 times, via the use of the [[Idol of Yun'Shul]], or by seeking clarity at [[Misérables]] for 15 Knowledge.
***Misérables in particular enables you to stack wishes. Its Clarity transaction will cost 5 more [[Knowledge]] for each wish you already have. (20 Knowledge if you already have 1 Wish, 25 If you have 2, etc.)
***Note that Misérables's Clarity transaction resets the levels necessary to obtain a new wish (ex. Getting a wish at Power 13, a Clarity transaction at Power 14 means another wish would be obtained at Power 17 instead of Power 16).
**Wishes are occasionally granted on updates, usually when theres a major changes involving Resonance.
*[[Boons_and_Flaws#Flaws|Tarnished]] prevents you from rerolling your Resonance, as well as debuffing it.
**You can remove it at [[Yamaketzal]] for 1,000 Notes, at [[Carrion, Father of Evolution]] for 1 Knowledge, or by seeking clarity at [[Misérables]] for 15 [[Knowledge]] (which also grants a wish.)


If you meet all the criteria, you are able to make one of seven wishes:

#'''"The trials ahead of me fill me with trepidation, I wish to escape this place."'''
#*Instantly sends the player back to The Overworld.
#**This can be used in combat, but escaping this way will start a 5 second kneeling animation before the escape cutscene queues. Being hit in these 5 seconds will cancel the escape, but not consume your wish.
#*'''You can only make this wish once''' per character.
#**The [[Idol of Yun'Shul]] also has a once per character limit, but it is separate to the regular Yun'Shul wish.
#'''"My Flaws weigh me down too much, I wish for relief."'''
#*Rerolls a chosen [[Flaws|Flaw]] for a random one. Has a small chance of replacing it with the [[Vacant]] flaw.
#**Can be used to get rid of the [[Tarnished]] flaw.
#**'''You can only make this wish once''' per character. You can still, however, use Shrines.
#**Essentially useless, due to the [[Shrine of Blasphemy]] which does the exact same thing with less risks (you can't be given the Vacant flaw), and for only 5 Knowledge.
#'''"The Vows I made give me much regret, I wish to break them."'''
#*Erase all your active [[Vows]], including [[Vow of Mastery]], whether it be for the master or the servant, and Vow of Allegiance.
#'''"The powers I have been granted displease me, I wish for new gifts."'''
#*Erases your current [[Resonance]], and draws 4 new Resonance cards (or 5, if you have a corrupted resonance, the 5<sup>th</sup> card being the corrupted resonance and the 4<sup>th</sup> one being the uncorrupted variant). The 4<sup>th</sup>card will always be the same resonance you had, albeit rerolled; the variant may also be changed, such as when rerolling physical [[Sacred Field]] you will get the mantra version. Gives your Resonance the [[Tarnished]] Flaw unless you have [[Echoes#Upgrades, Unlocks, and Modifiers|Soul Plasticity]].
#'''"For now I am one, but I wish to be three."'''
#*If you meet the requirements, gives you the [[Soulbreaker]] Oath.
#"'''The Vows I made to keep an Oath no longer suit my ideals. I wish for a new path."'''
#*Removes your current [[Oath]]. Gives a disclaimer prior to breaking it, warning you that becoming an Oathbreaker has its own consequences. Upon breaking an Oath, you will receive a dialogue from your Oath-giver along with other potential consequences.
#"'''I wish for my Soul's Murmur to be highly strung no longer."'''
#*Your current [[Murmur]] will be removed without any further notice or opportunity for confirmation. This action can be done multiple times but will cost you your Murmur and a wish. You can still regain the same Murmur afterwards (Murmur: Rhythm is currently bugged and you '''CAN'T''' get it again after removing it).
#*If you wipe after your Murmur is removed, you won't receive the Echoes for having it. You'll need to reobtain a Murmur to complete this Echo Triumph.

== Trivia ==
* Originally, only [[Oathless]] could be removed, and it had differing dialogue: ''"The Vow I made to never take up an Oath no longer matches my ambitions. I wish for a new path."''
* The maximum amount of Wishes a player can carry at any given time is 197. You can purchase Wishes from [[Misérables]], however the price ramps up, costing 15 Knowledge initially with every stacking Wish costing the previous price + 5 Knowledge (e.g. 15 -> 20 -> 25 -> 30, stacking a mere 4 wishes has cost you a total of 90 Knowledge). Wish 197 costs 995 Knowledge, making 198 Wishes not possible, as it'd require you to go past the Knowledge cap.
** This would require a combined total of ~99,485 Knowledge.
* [[Yun'Shul]] is one of three confirmed Drowned Gods so far, along with [[Korilfiend]], the Drowned God of Fire, and [[Ethiron]], the Drowned God of Sky and Pressure.
* There is an [[Curse of Yun'Shul|Enchantment]] named after Yun'Shul, the Curse of Yun'Shul.
* Oathbreaking while having equipped an weapon that you dont have requirements of will result on that weapon being unequiped and automatically being swapped by a [[Sword]] even if you don't have it on your inventory.
