title: Shrine of the Drowned
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
'''Not to be confused with [[Deep Shrines]] and [[Shrines]] (aka Fountain Gates).
{{Quotes|quote=You know why it stands here-it offers an alternative. It beckons you to offer a part of who you are to the cold voice - a voice that’s always been at the back of your mind.|author=Shrine of the Drowned when requirements are met for Drowned Favour}}
{{NPCInfobox
|location=[[Fragments of Self]]
|image1=Shrine of the Drowned.jpg}}

==Description==
The Shrine of the Drowned is an NPC located in the [[Fragments of Self]] when wiping, found just in-between the two archways that lead to [[Self]]. It allows you to buy the Drowned Favour for {{c|robux|1000}} if Power 2 or above. Upon buying the Drowned Favour, your character will be revived and will be returned to the [[Luminants|Etrean Luminant]] with 2 of your 3 lives, regardless of being in the Depths. 

[[File:Using the Shrine, right before payment.png|frameless|320x320px]]

"NOTE: This product will bring the current character back to life, but it cannot be used on the same character twice. Deepwoken is a game where characters ''cannot last forever'' - please spent responsibly" --''Note on the purchase page, next to the popup''

The Shrine can be used once per character instead of once per slot, as depicted in an image above. Occasionally, this will be reset (Around once a half year, usually at huge updates or New Year).

|-

</tabber>
==Trivia==
*Previously, the Drowned Favour product used to cost {{c|robux|500}}. It was changed at a later date to {{c|robux|1000}}.
**However, whenever there is a sale on Deepwoken, the Drowned Favour product goes on sale too, costing {{c|robux|500}}.
*The Drowned Favour product is often reset upon big updates, many of these big updates happen around [[Kyrsmas]].
**This means that even if you have already revived a character with Drowned Favour before, you may revive that same slot again with it.
*It is recommended not purchase a Drowned Favour on a low power character, as it is most likely a waste and should be saved for a more valuable character.
*If you pass down an item and then buy Drowned Favour, you will '''not''' get your item back. Your item will be passed down to the next slot upon wiping as normal.

Sibex is capable of telling you your current [[Bell Progress|Resonance progress]], and what gives you the most Resonance progress. Once speaking to Sibex for the first time, they will prompt you to collect a Thresher Spine for them, and in return they will tell you the details of your Resonance obtainment method. Sibex will not take your Thresher Spine. title: Sightless
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{Memento |image=Sightless Memento.png |description=Clinging to their clouded reality, they rejected the teachings of Blindseers. |starting attributes=*6 Light weapon *1 Fortitude *2 Agility *5 Intelligence *5 Willpower |final attributes=*110 Light Weapon *20 Fortitude *40 Agility *100 Intelligence *100 Willpower |starting armor=[[Stranded]] |allowed weapons=Any |starting weapons=[[Iron Cestus]] |starting items=[[Pathfinder Lantern]] |unlock=Unlocked by default }} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. This Memento starts with [[Murmur: Rhythm]], a recolored [[Arc Beam]], and the {{t|Blinded}} Talent. Defeating [[Dravik, The Rat King]] with this Memento will unlock the [[Flashing Thunder]] Memento.
==Starting Abilities==
*Blinded: [Equipment Talent] - Your vision is obscured by something. Somehow, you feel safer. You remember the warmth of your youth. **Makes everything darker and creates fog at long distances. **Grants immunity to the [[Flame Blind]] and [[Gaze]] Mantras. *Murmur: Rhythm [Unlockable Talent] - An application of your Soul Murmur that enables the user to perceive the subtle murmur emanating from all things. Press {{Input|input|G}} while crouched.'' **Rhythm's activation keybind can be configured in settings. **Pings all nearby Monsters, NPC’s, and Players, through walls while gray-scaling your screen. **Red = Low Health, Yellow = Moderate Health, Grey = Healthy. **'''Disabled on players with Not a Scratch.''' *{{cl|origintl|Way of Navae}} [Quest Talent] - Gain the ability to use fist combat against weapons. Including the ability to block weapons with your hands using Ether. **Allows you to use the [[Way of Navae]] [[Fists|fist style]]. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Arc Beam (☆☆☆) |image=Arc beam.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Fire plasma energy. Deals additional damage in PvE. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} + {{stats|thundercall|Lightning}} |reqs=N/A |effect=''User fires a white beam out of their eyes, ragdolling and applying burn to anyone it hits. If cast midair, the beam will home in on targets.'' *Has a base damage of 20, dealt as Flamecharm and Thundercall damage. Additionally, this with both Flamecharm and Thundercall. *Can apply both Shock and Burning, or its Path alternate variants. *12s CD. *Can be used in the air to shoot under yourself. **The Aerial variant has homing properties. **The aerial variant gains the Oath damage typing alongside its original Flame and Thunder damage typings. The damage this deals is the same as grounded Arc Beam though. **You have to have downwards momentum for this to activate, wait until after the peak of your jump. *Instantly grips low health players if the attack were to knock them. *Can be cancelled early, letting it explode before hitting a target. *While Arc Suit is active, using Arc Beam restores 70% of your current posture. Additionally your Arc Beam will gain a +50% '''base''' damage buff during Arc Suit if you have the Arc Module: Enhance Talent. *Has a 15x PvE multiplier (multiply damage dealt by 15 to get PvE damage). }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Against All Odds [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - For each combat tag you have on your character, increase your damage by 1% (max of 7%). **Works in PvE combat. *Battle Tendency [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen. (+2 Posture, +10 Sanity) **In combat, by not running/blocking regenerate posture passively, Battle Tendency increases this regen by +20%. *Fast Blade [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) **Parrying without this Talent gives you a speed boost, but it's barely noticeable and lasts for the duration of the parry. **Increases the speed boost duration from parrying by 3 seconds. *Hard Read [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Hitting your opponent during a feint will cause them to be dazed. **Applies daze for 1 second. *Magical Resolve [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Being hit increases [[Ether]] regen for a short duration, the strength of the regen scales off your Willpower. (+7 Sanity) *Moving Fortress [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking no longer slows you down as much. (+1 Posture) **Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to a -20%. *Old Habits Die Hard [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking an attack with your lingering block frames after failing a parry will cause the attack to deal 15% less posture damage. (+5 Health) *Speed Emission [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Gain a slight speed boost after landing a vent. *Swift Rebound [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Move faster after successfully dodging an attack. (+1 Passive Agility) *Unwavering Focus [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - When your mantras are parried, receive less posture (scales with intelligence). *{{cl|raretl|All the Dead Gods}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your Basic Attacks now apply anti-heal for 8s. (+7 Sanity) **Whenever you land a Basic Attack, the target has most healing forms reduced/disabled for 8 seconds. **The anti-heal will not stack with any other source of anti-heal, as the higher potency anti-heal will take priority over all other sources. **The anti-heal effect is signified by a purple "fog" particle effect on the victim. **Does not work on allies. **Does not affect healthpacks. **Also procs on criticals with the [[M1 tag]]. *{{cl|raretl|Eureka}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration. Reaching 3 stacks grants +10% Mantra Damage to your next Mantra attack. (+7 Carry Load) **Landing and parrying Mantras grants Inspiration stacks. Mantras cap at giving 1 stack per, and you do not gain stacks from autoparry frames. **At 3 stacks, gain the Inspired buff for 30 seconds or until you cast a Mantra. Inspired increases the damage of your next Mantra cast by 10%. ***If you gain Inspired by parrying Mantras, you gain the Inspired status effect for 30 seconds. ***If you gain Inspired by landing Mantras, the Inspired status will be instantly consumed to increase the damage of the Mantra used to gain the status. **Inspiration Stacks do not decay, even if you whiff Mantras entirely. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Gaze (☆☆☆) |image=Gaze.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Gaze into your opponent's souls. |ethercost={{stats|ether|70 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User casts a penetrating gaze, frightening all opponents they make eye contact with'' *Inflicts shadow insanity on target, causing them to shiver a couple of times. You must be looking at your opponent. **Shadow insanity doesn't actually reduce your sanity, but it can still cause the effect of tier 1 insanity (shivering) *Upgrading this Mantra extends the duration. **At level 5 it lasts 12 seconds. *Deals 3 damage per tick with no posture damage. *'''Cannot proc [[Deep Gems]]''' *Can be countered by holding block, wearing a [[Blindfold]], or having a higher Willpower attribute than the caster. }}
===Power 5===
*Behind You [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a basic attack behind your enemy after feinting a mantra will apply an ether slash, dealing extra damage based on how much ether you have left. **This deals a separate instance of physical damage, scaling on your weapon's damage and your current Ether%. **This has no cooldown. *Disbelief [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You're resistant to the effects of Illusion magic. You are resistant to charms and tricks. (+5 Sanity) **Halves the duration of the Charmed status effect and Illusionary Servant casted against you. ***Tough Love: 2s -> 1s ***Overcharm's Basic Attacks and [[Kyrsieger]] critical attack: 5s -> 2.5s ***Unnecessary Theatrics (at reqs): 7s -> 3.5s ***[[Dread Whisper]] and [[Sing]]: 7.5s -> 3.25s ***Overcharm's self-charm proc: 8s -> 4s ***Charismatic Cast, [[Allure]]: 10s -> 5s ***Chaotic Charm, [[Hair Spray|Fadetrimmer's Charming Spray]]: 15s -> 7.5s ***Lasting Charisma (at reqs): 20s -> 10s *Keen Recovery [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a basic attack after feinting a mantra will restore the feinted mantra's ether cost. (+3 Carry Load) **If you have 55 or more Intelligence, this will recover double the feinted Mantra's Ether cost instead. **Does not proc if your basic attack is blocked, parried, or dodged. *{{cl|raretl|Observation}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately. (+1 Passive Agility) **Cancelling your roll quickly will grant dodge frames equals to the length of a regular roll. Basically giving extra 0.1s dodge frames. *{{cl|raretl|Evasive Expert}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretl|Peripheral Vision}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your glare now ignores if your opponent is facing you. (+5 Sanity) *{{cl|raretl|Safety Dance}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s. (+1 Passive Agility) **You gain more invincibility frames while dodging, granting you longer immunity to damage. **Dodge IFrames increased from 0.3s to 0.35s. *{{cl|raretl|Sin Stacker}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your All The Dead Gods' duration is now based on how many stacks of antiheal you already have on your opponent. **By landing additional basic attacks on a target affected by All the Dead Gods' Anti-Heal, you can increase the duration of subsequently applied Anti-Heal stacks by 1 second per Anti-Heal stacks affected the target. ***Starting at 1 Anti-Heal stack lasting 8 seconds, applying another will make the second stack last 9 seconds, and applying another will make the third stack last 10 seconds, etc. **As Anti-Heal stacks decay, the additional duration they apply to future stacks will be nullified. For example, if you apply Stack 1 for 8 seconds and Stack 2 for 9 seconds, then wait until Stack 1 runs out of duration before landing another hit, Anti-Heal from the third M1 will only last 9 seconds. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Glare (☆☆☆) |image=Glare.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Opponents facing you are briefly rendered immobile. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''User summons an invisible AoE projectile upon activation, briefly stunning anyone hit by it.'' *Deals 1 damage on proc with no posture damage. *Has a wind-up of 0.49s. *May still combat tag opponents who are not facing you. *This move causes humanoid NPCs to block less. *Parry window is at the end of the first flash. *Shares a cooldown with [[Sing]]. *Can be upgraded with the '''Peripheral Vision''' Talent, allowing Glare to hit enemies without them having to face you. }}
===Power 10===
*Emergency Reserves [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - When you get hit below 20% health, gain 20% tempo immediately (3 minute CD). **Being hit can repeatedly proc Emergency Reserves as long as it is off cooldown. *Foolish Outburst [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking or parrying a vent will absorb the Tempo cost of the vent. A Tactician steadies the course of battle. **Steals 40% of the Tempo used. *Unswayed [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - The effects of Taunt and Encore no longer work on you. (+20 Sanity) **The [[Taunt]] Mantra, and the "Cornered Fool" Talent can no longer inflict "Taunt" on the user. **The [[Sing]] Mantra can no longer use the Talent "Encore" on the user, nullifying the stun effect. ***Sing can still apply Charm/Overcharm to the user. *Water off a Duck's Back [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Venting will shift any elemental status effects affecting you onto those hit by your vent. **Transfers [[Suffocation]], [[Winded]], [[Chill]], [[Shock]], [[Burn]], and [[potions|potion]] effects from yourself to your enemy on vent. *{{cl|oathtlnf|All-Seeing Eye}} [Oath Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted. **Invisible players are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position. ***Specifically reveals those under the effects of {{cl|advancedtlnf|Ghost}}, Static Flash Clone, [[Oath: Visionshaper|Cheap Trick]], [[Oath: Visionshaper|Illusory Servant's]] casting animation, [[Beast Burrow]], [[Portals]], and other invisibility effects. **With this Talent, the [[Tacet]] is completely nullified, allowing you to see cloaked players normally. **This works on anyone who is invisible, yourself and monsters included. *{{cl|raretl|Lightspeed Reflexes}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Feinting gives a very brief auto-parry window. (+1 Passive Agility) *{{cl|raretl|Speed Demon}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your attacks now inflict a reduced-strength bleed while you have a speed boost. 1s cooldown. (+1 Passive Agility) **Bleed is not accounted for in the damage modifier cap and bypasses armor. **Speed Demon's bleed deals 5% of your weapon's damage every 0.3s, three times. This totals to +15% damage over a 0.9 second period. **Works with M1s and criticals. *{{cl|advancedtl|Not a Scratch}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - You don't show any signs of damage. (+2 Posture) **Your character no longer visually shows any signs of damage no matter how low their HP is. No cuts, no scratches, no low hp anims, no torn clothing, etc. **Spotter (for your opponent's allies) / [[Rhythm]] no longer shows how much health your character has. **If you have less than 100 Willpower, your character has a chance to yell out in agony upon being taking damage. This is purely visual. ***These include: "HEEAAAAUUUUURRGHHH!!", "HEEAAAARRGH!!", "OHHHHH GODS THE AGONY!!", "YEAARURUGHH!!", "UUUURURGHHH!!", and "SWEET MEEEEEERRRRRCCCCCYYYY!!". Quite dramatic. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Sightless Beam (☆☆☆) |image=Sightless Beam.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Turn insanity against your enemies, incredibly strong against depths creatures. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User fires a high pressure beam from their eyes at the cost of their Sanity.'' *The entire beam deals around 150 damage as basic dmg (0 songchant). With extra damage and posture dealt at the start of the beam. *This mantra can make you go insane if you use it too much. *Sightless Beam can be canceled midway by pressing F. *Steals eyesight proccing the blind effect if enough hits land. *Has a '''high''' windup. **Not parryable, deals a little bit of posture damage every hit. Can be used to bait vents by staying at a distance. *Deals bonus damage to any monsters from the Depths family (Gigameds, Crustaceous Rex, Nautilodaunt, Enforcer). **Nautilodaunts and Enforcers are very likely to just block the entire beam. It is advised to get a friend to distract them. *You can run during the windup, but can only walk while the beam is active. *Getting hit by a Vent while using Sightless Beam cancels it. }}
===Power 15===
*Successive Prediction [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Predicting an attack will briefly allow you to predict another. **Allows you to reflect the entirety of multi-hit moves (such as Enforcer's spin attack) *Twelve Steps Ahead [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing Prediction will halve the cooldown to a minimum of 2s. Whiffing will double the cooldown to a maximum of 30s. This effect stacks for up to 30 seconds. **This effect requires your opponent to be within 90 studs of you. *{{cl|raretl|All Knowing}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your prediction now ignores the range requirement to reflect attacks. *{{cl|advancedtl|All Above, Gods Below}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Any healing your opponent were to receive while All The Dead Gods is active on them is stolen and given to you. (+20 Sanity) **Though not visually displayed, the duration of this effect is separate from your anti-heal. ***Lasts 8 seconds after an All the Dead Gods proc with 100 Willpower 100 Intelligence, which is halved to 4 seconds if you don't meet this Talent's requirements. **This will not proc if you are the one who applied the healing; you cannot heal yourself by healing your opponent. **This only procs on non-passive healing. For example (non exhaustive list): something like [[Flame Wisp]], spits, or [[Bloodless Gem]] will proc this effect, but campfires, Conditioned Runner, or [[Curse of the No Life King]] will not. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Prediction (☆☆☆) |image=Prediction.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Predict an opponent's attack and reflect it. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype=Enemy's Attack |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''User creates a white pattern on the floor while deflecting attacks they take during the duration.'' *'''Deflects''' an attack back to the attacker. *Prediction cannot proc anything that procs "on hit" such as [[Deep Gems]]. *Upgrading this Mantra extends the 'prediction' frames (iframes). *Can be upgraded with the {{t|All Knowing}} Talent, removing the range limit Prediction normally has. *Can be upgraded with the {{t|Successive Prediction}} Talent, which allows you to predict multihits, as it grants a brief window of auto prediction. *Can be upgraded with the {{t|Twelve Steps Ahead}} Talent, halving Prediction's cooldown on successful Prediction (minimum 2s) and doubling Prediction's cooldown if you whiff it (maximum 30s). Going 30s without using Prediction will reset this effect. **The maximum Prediction cooldown from this Talent scales on your Intelligence investment. }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Purge Shot}} [Memento Talent] - Landing an arc beam while your opponent has anti heal stacks purges the stacks, with it dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had. **Landing Arc Beam removes all stacks of anti-heal from your opponent, dealing 5 true damage for every stack they had. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Unmended Eye}} [Memento Talent] - All mantras you land now apply anti heal. ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Focused Perception}} [Memento Talent] - Massively increase the range of your Rhythm if you use it while [[Tranquil Circle]] is active. **The Sightless Memento does not unlock Tranquil Circle at any point, causing this Talent to do nothing. *[[Flashing Thunder]] Memento ===True Heart of Enmity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Scornful Scowl}} [Memento Talent] - Your [[Glare]] stuns enemies for much longer.

title: Silhuett
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{NPCInfobox
|title1=Silhuett
|name=Silhuett
|aspect=Capra|location=[[First Layer]]|affiliation=[[The Divers]]|image1=Silhuett Full.png}}
== Description ==
Silhuett is a [[Capra]] [[NPC]] who spawns randomly in the [[First Layer]], and is the first step towards obtaining the [[Deepspindle]]. In order to teleport to [[The Understrand]], one must either use [[Shadowcast|Shadow Travel]] or use the [[Shadow's Flight]] item (craftable with 2 Void Feathers and 1 [[Umbral Obsidian]]), near him. Upon doing so, you get sent to the Understrand where you can kill the [[Ministry Agent]] and get the Deepspindle.

If the player has high Ally [[Reputation]] with [[The Ministry]], then they can convince the Ministry Agent to hand over the Deepspindle, Darkscorn Casque and Darkened Bastion without a fight, but only if they teleported to him through Silhuett.  

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|{{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
|Ugh. Typical. Never going to get our hands on those relics at this rate.
|-
|{{cl|reply}} |What's up?
|-
|The Ministry have a network of hidden passage and caches, and I managed to tail one of their agents to this point. Only, they disappeared into a swirl of shadows... Now the trail's gone cold. Those freaks have plenty of horrible stuff in store. We need to secure them before it's too late.
|-
|{{cl|reply}} |A swirl of shadows?
|-
|Aye. Some kind of Shadowcast technique. Ministry are fond of it - let's them escape in a pinch. Cowards. Still, this kinda technique leaves ''residuals''. Maybe a Shadowcaster could give them a chase somehow?
|-
| {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}

|-|Subsequent Encounters=
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
|{{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue
|-
|Should be some residuals nearby... We sometimes find a whole heap of '''Umbral Obsidian''' and '''Void Feathers''' on the agents we capture, maybe that has something to do with it?
|-
| {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue]
|}
</tabber>
== Trivia ==
* Silhuett is much easier to find if you use the [[Hell Mode|Hell Bell]], though that also increases monster spawn rates and will make your journey very dangerous.
* His name is pronounced very similarly to silhouette, which is the image of a person or a thing usually represented with a single shade of color. In other words, a silhouette is very similar to a shadow.

The Silver Dagger is a LHT dagger weapon that can be purchased at [[Summer Isle]] for 50 Notes and can be rarely found in [[Erisia]].

It is a decent dagger to use from early to mid game. However, it is highly suggested to use the [[Gilded Knife]] instead as it outranks the Silver Dagger in everything except the swing speed (only .02x faster).

{{text|wtal}}

This Talent is quite strong, even when at Silver Dagger's requirements, as a level 2 Rapid Slashes paired with this Talent will deal more damage than a level 5 one without it. Additionally, because this increases the Mantra's base damage, it provides a higher starting value for damage modifiers.

title: Simforea
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Simforea|caption=At the outermost extremities of a vast and ancient mechanism, whose true purpose has long since been swallowed by the passage of ages.}}

[[File:Simforea.png|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
Simforea is an island in the [[Voidsea]]. It is a [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Glossary#Driftlands Driftland] that has recently come back from the Voidsea into the far edges of the [[Eastern Luminant]]. It's a (largely) abandoned island with abundant growths of grey vegetation and huge bells scattered around. 

In the [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Glossary#The_Old_World Old World],<ref>[[Ringing Scholar's Garb]]</ref> Simforea was the site of experimentation that resulted in the creation of a [[Remnants of Soul|soul-based concoction]]. Simforea eventually fell to ruin, taking its founder and the [[Anansi]] with it in the [[Voidsea]].<ref>[[Remnants of Soul]]</ref> [[Knell, The Lunatic Resonator|Knell]] was the only survivor, left alone with his ever deteriorating sanity.

Simforea eventually got close to the Eastern Luminant, piquing the interest of [[The Central Authority]]'s [[Peipre]],<ref>{{Ref/NPC|Peipre}}</ref> as well as [[The Ministry]].

==Potential Enemies==
<gallery>
File:Knellbossicon.png|[[Knell, The Lunatic Resonator]]
File:ArkasidIcon.png|[[Arkasid]]
File:Voidthresher.png|[[Void Thresher]]
File:MinistryCultist.png|[[Ministry Scout]]
File:BrainsuckerIcon.png|[[Brainsucker]]
</gallery>

== Location ==
Simforea can be reached through heading north from meteor isle, where you should be able to see a large island in the distance.
[[File:Rough location of Simforea.png|none|thumb|Rough location of simforea, marked off the map]]

*Simforea likely derives from the word sinfonia, the Italian word for symphony.
*Many pieces of text on the island are written in [[Gatherhand]], a writing system used to transcribe the [[common]] language in the world of Deepwoken.

More info on the [[Soulbreaker]] page. The known downsides of a Corrupted [[Resonance]] are as followed: * '''WITHER:''' On use player will receive [[Wither]] for 10% of their max HP. * '''MANIA:''' On use, player will lose 40 sanity. * '''POISON:''' On use, player will lose 7% HP. ==Description==
Skeleton Key is a [[Resonance]] that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll.

===Appearance===
When summoned, a gray wall will manifest, with the bottom part of it resembling skeleton hands and the top embodying a symbol.

If corrupted. the walls become a dark blue/violet.

==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Skeleton Key''' Resonance.

Skeleton key will summon a wall, up to five if not corrupted under a set duration. If touched the wall will push anyone indiscriminately, ally or not. However, if they press {{Input|keybind|resonance}} again, the wall will be pushed forward so long your cursor is aimed at the desired wall.

{{cl|corres|If Skeleton Key is corrupted, a third wall type can be rolled. When used, your wall is 500% larger. The massive variant can stack with the spiked variant.}}<ref>https://www.youtube.com/clip/UgkxASRtKcxLyuHy-ki_xxVnXe5lJZ6wIey_?si=mA9Fe1rAoDep_27U</ref>

===Resonance Point Usage===
When obtained, Skeleton Key will spend its points on the following stats:

* '''Wall type:''' Decides the type of wall that will be used. 
** Normal doesn't deal damage on push
** Spiked deals around 50 blunt damage on push, winding back before launching itself further than the normal push.

* '''Wall Amount:''' How many walls you can spawn. 
* '''Duration:''' How fast it takes to spawn a wall.
* '''Range (?):''' How far a wall can push.
* '''Wall Durability:''' How many hits (ex: m1-ing) the wall can take before breaking.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Skeleton key.gif|Previous Gif
File:Skeleton Key1.png|Normal
File:Skeleton Key Back.png|Behind
File:Skeleton Key2.png|Old
File:New skeleton key variant.png|Spiked
File:Massivewall.png|Corrupt - Massive Variant
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*A skeleton key is a key that can unlock any lock. This has nothing to do with the Resonance's actual function of making largely ineffective walls.
*Based on the dev spec ability under the same name used by Zartania, rebalanced and reworked for public use.
*The name, “Skeleton Key” is a reference to the Mario Party Superstars item that allows the user to freely travel across the map, which was the original effect of Skeleton Key. However the effect has been changed and not the name.
**Purportedly, when released, if a person obtained it in a new server/instance and joined an old server, the bell would function like said specs.
*A corrupted Skeleton Key does not guarantee five walls, as the number is still based on the resonance point usage.
*Skeleton Key walls when activated, will push in the direction you were looking when you first placed them, this means that if you were to place a Skeleton Key wall then go on the other side of it and then activate it, it will push towards you.
*Skeleton Key walls will always be placed on the level of your character, which leaves them floating in the air if you're hanging off of a chandelier for example.
*The walls can block ships from sailing, and also are invulnerable to their cannonballs, making them great for shielding your ship as you sail.
*Make sure to remember that the walls will quickly despawn prematurely if the owner is far away.
*You can somewhat consistently get pushed/push yourself through walls with the Skeleton Key's activated push, provided the wall you're trying to pass through is thin enough. A good example of this is the Mineskipper cave next to the small house by the side of the windmill in Songseeker.

==Description==
'''Smith's Alloy''' is one of many [[Relics]] that can be found having the appearance of [[Pluripotent Alloy]] with a hint of red.

== Farming ==
Currently known to drop from a wide variety of sources. Refer to the obtainment section in the infobox.

If you are in dire need of many '''Smith's Alloys''', the best and safest way to farm them is by killing [[The Ferryman]], as he is a fairly weak boss that can be defeated in just a few minutes. Once beaten, you can leave the instanced server and can quickly fight him again.

If you are more confident in your PvE skills, you may farm [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] for multiple alloys per run per relic chest. This will take around 20-25 minutes solo, due to having to clear out guards and position prisoners for emergency-healing; so it is advisable to have allies clear out enemies in one section, while you clear out another, to get to the boss-fight quicker, and increase relic-yield (how the relics are distributed amongst players is at the party's discretion). 

Another method to farm them quickly is by doing [[The Diluvian Mechanism|Diluvian Mechanism]] runs. After completing waves 25 and 50, many relic chests will spawn, which each have a chance to hold one or multiple '''Smith's Alloys'''. With the proper build and careful planning, you can easily solo Diluvian up to wave 25s in only a few minutes. Going to wave 50 will get you even more '''Smith's Alloys''', but more preparation and time is needed.

== Usage ==

=== 1. Quality stars: ===
When used, it'll add a quality star to your currently held weapon, or reroll the quality-type of your currently held weapon if it already has 3 stars. 

=== 2. [[Motifs]] ===
When used on a compatible weapon, the Smith's Alloy can be used to destroy your weapon, creating a Motif. Motifs save the critical of the weapon it came from, allowing you to apply that critical to compatible weapons (e.g. you can take the [[Trident Spear]] Motif and equip it onto an [[Iron Spear]], granting you the Trident Spear critical on a lower requirement weapon). See the [[Motifs]] page for more information.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Smith's Alloy secret.png|Attempting to use on bare [[Fists]]
File:Smith's Alloy usage.gif|Usage
File:Screenshot (424).png|Obtaining a Smith's Alloy from a fishing chest
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*Five of them can be used to craft one [[Armorer's Needle]].
*You can hold up to 25 Smith's Alloys at any given point of time.
*Smith's Alloy can be used in [[Chime of Conflict]], and it'll save the data as it normally would.
*Smith's Alloy can't be used on Side Weapons, like Shields.
*Using Smith's Alloy won't soulbound your weapon. This can be useful for trading or upgrading the weapons of friends.
*Smith's Alloy can be obtained by using the [[Hollow Forge]] to convert 3 [[Pluripotent Alloy]]s into one Smith's Alloy, or 1 [[Armorer's Needle]]s into 3 Smith's Alloys. This can only be done by people who are using the [[Ignition Delver]] Origin.
*When you use the Smith's Alloy to create a Motif, it replaces your old weapon with [[Formless Shard]]. Formless Shard retains your original weapon's enchant and quality stars. This weapon's sole purpose is for the player to still have an equipped weapon after destroying their previous one.
*The concept of the item was suggested by YouTuber Agamatsu, who conceptually named it "Blacksmith Alloy". The concept encompassed both the Sinner's Ash and the Forge Needle.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aYmOWi8fUZY</ref>

|quote=Create a smokescreen for a diversion!
|author=Smokescreen description
}}
{{Resonance
|effect=Creates a smokescreen around the caster.
|appearance=A dark cloud appears around the caster.
|image1 =<gallery> 
SmokescreenResonance.gif|Smokescreen
File:Smokescreen Card.png|Card
File:Smokescreen Corrupt Card1.png|Corrupt
</gallery>
}}
==Description==
'''Smokescreen''' is a [[Resonance]] that players can obtain.
===''Appearance''===
When used, a cloud of smoke appears around the user. This smoke cloud hides the user and acts as sort of a mini [[Murmur: Tacet|Tacet]] murmur. 
==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate '''Smokescreen'''.

'''Smokescreen''' will near instantly generate an extremely dark cloud of smoke that makes the user invisible while inside, and makes hostile mobs lose aggro on the user. 

'''Note that smokescreen does NOT grant the user invincibility frames.'''

The invisibility is cancelled when using an attack.

Smokescreen will give 20% Stealth when active.

{{cl|corres|If Smokescreen is corrupted, it can be activated again by pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}}, which teleports the user backwards and places another smoke on the teleport location. The length of this teleport scales on the user's current health.}}

== Point Usage ==
When obtained, Smokescreen will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Smoke Duration'''
*'''Smoke Size'''
*'''Amount of clouds {{cl|corres|(Corrupted)'''}}
*'''Teleport distance {{cl|corres|(Corrupted)'''}}

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Corrupt Smokescreen.gif|Corrupt Smokescreen
</gallery>
==Trivia==
*This Resonance was added alongside [[Smite]] & [[Preservation]] on the September 15th, 2023 update. All of these bells were inspired by AlwaysAFK.
*The card description for Smokescreen is the only one ending in an exclamation mark instead of a period.
*Using the corrupt variant's teleport will easily teleport the player under the map, which might cause unavoidable deaths.
*Wisp Mantras are not hidden during Smokescreen, giving away your current location.

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that reduces Ether regeneration, Tempo gain, and steals Tempo on [[Vent]].

==Effect==
Upon landing an uppercut, flourish, or critical attack, {{PAGENAME}} applies the {{status|Solar Mark}} status effect to your opponent for 8 seconds, reducing their passive Ether regeneration and Tempo gain.

If you land a [[Vent]] on someone who has a Solar Mark, the Mark will be removed and their Tempo will be drained to pay for your Vent. If your opponent cannot afford your Vent's Tempo cost, you will still have to pay for the difference. If that enemy is a PvE enemy, deal heavily increased Vent damage instead.

===Notes===
*Solar's effects also proc on the [[Imperator's Fury]] Vent. In PvE, using both allows for extremely high damage, and entirely free Vents.

title: Solborn
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{Memento |image=Solborn Memento.png |description=Worthy of bonding with a phoenix, their heart kept an unquenchable flame alight. |final attributes=*120 Flamecharm *40 Strength *30 Fortitude *40 Agility *35 Intelligence |final traits=*7 Songchant *4 Erudition *3 Dexterity *2 Proficiency *2 Vitality |starting health=230 |locked armor=[[Cindergarb]] |starting items=[[Solfeather Earrings]], [[Emberseal Pendant]] |allowed weapons=Any |unlock=Destroy the throne of [[Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet]] and survive phase 1. |aspect=[[Heliodar]] |starting attributes=*6 Flamecharm *2 Strength *2 Fortitude *2 Agility *2 Intelligence|starting traits=*6 Songchant *2 Erudition *2 Dexterity *1 Proficiency *1 Vitality}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. It is unlocked by destroying the throne of [[Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet]] in his fight. This Memento gives the user access to a spawnable Phoenix that normally acts similarly to a campfire but can be commanded to attack. Additionally, a lot of this Memento's abilities use the ''Heartfire Gauge'', a gauge that lies above your posture bar, similar to Specter Path's Spectral Gauge. Adult Phoenix.png|Adult Phoenix Adult Phoenix Flight.png|Adult Phoenix preparing for a Divebomb Phoenix Divebomb.gif|Phoenix performing a Divebomb {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Command Phoenix}} [Memento Talent] - Command your Phoenix to scout, and dive into enemies. **Gives a Talent tool that allows you to summon and command your Phoenix to attack an enemy. **Summoning a Phoenix, then commanding it to take air will allow you to select a spot where it should Divebomb on the next usage of the Talent. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Solborn}} [Memento Talent] - Harness your Heartfire to command the Phoenix bound to your soul. **Allows you to spawn a small orange, stationary, Phoenix near you. The size of the Phoenix will increase based on the user's level. **This Phoenix can be used like a campfire to rest and heal yourself. **Utilized in many other Solborn Talents. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Fire Blade (☆☆☆) |image=fire-blade-2025.gif |desc=Slicing blades of flame. |ethercost={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=N/A |effect=User forcefully slams down their blade coated in flames. *Has a base damage of 18/21/24/27/30 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 18 posture damage at levels 1-4, guard breaks at level 5. **At level 5, this Mantra takes 20 additional Ether on cast to retain its guard breaking property. This additional Ether cost cannot be reduced. *Has a windup of 0.7 seconds and a cooldown of 10 seconds. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *Breaks destructible objects on hit. *Can be modified with [[Vibrant Gem]]s, causing the attack to destroy more environment. *While having [[Starkindred]] wings activated, Fire Blade now launches the user upward before releasing a large plume of flames after a long windup. **A [[Reversal Spark]] can be used to negate this variation, allowing you to use normal fire blade with wings. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Fire Gun (☆☆☆) |image=FireGun.gif |desc=A bullet of flames shot through each hand. |ethercostesc={{stats|ether|10 Ether}} per shot |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=N/A |effect=Caster draws out and propels bullets of flames from their hands towards the cursor's location. Clicking again while firing will fire additional bullets, at the cost of more Ether. *Has a base damage of 6.5/8.5/10.5/12.5/14.5 per level, per hit with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Has a windup of 0.35 seconds and no cooldown. *Deals 1 posture damage per hit. *Has 5.13x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 5.13 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *Breaks tiles, including the [[Hidden Village]] Door & [[Pathfinder's Respite]] Barricade. *Lights campfires. *Doesn't not apply hit stun, allowing to use it on people stunned by Equalizer and them not being freed early. (Need testing) *Propels the user backward if cast while jumping/walking backward or in water. *Can be modified with [[Drift Shard|Drift]]/[[Rush Shard]]s to make the bullets fly faster + farther. *Can be modified with a [[Round Spark]], causing the bullets to split into two, reducing the base damage by 45%. *Can be modified with a [[Blast Spark]], causing bullets to explode opponents after 6 hits, but reducing the base damage by 25%. Explosion auto grips if the opponent is low. *Can be canceled early through right clicking. File:Fire Gun Round Spark.gif|Round Spark File:Fire Gun Blast Spark.gif|Blast Spark File:Fire Gun Blast Spark + Round Spark.gif|Both Sparks }}
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Dancing Steps [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Fire mantras now move you in the direction you're facing. **Casting a Flamecharm Mantra will give you a moderate boost of horizontal movement in the direction your character is facing. This will still proc even if the Mantra is feinted. **Very useful for closing distance and getting into close quarters combat. *Meteor Impact [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Aerial moves will follow up into a devastating slam. **Deals 10 flat Flamecharm damage on top of your weapon's scaled damage. **Meteor Impact's damage can be buffed via damage modifiers, but does not scale on your Flamecharm investment. **Meteor impact is used by light attacking after using some mantras that end with both user and victim suspended in air. Most notably for this Memento, this includes [[Rising Flame]] and [[Flame Leap]], though many other Mantras proc this Talent. See the [[Talents#Meteor Impact|Talents]] page for more info. *Unyielding Inferno [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your flames burn just as strong even in the fiercest of storms. **Negates the innate 10% damage debuff Flamecharm Mantras receive during the [[rain]]. **Prevents your burn from going out in rain. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Flame Assault (★★☆) |image=Flame Assualt.gif.gif |desc=Dash forward in a spiral of flames. |ethercost={{stats|ether|40 Ether}} |mantratype=Mobility Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=User propels and spins in a 360 motion forward coated in flames leaving a trail behind; hitting anyone in their path. *Has a base damage of 8/16/24/32/40 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 1.5/3/4.5/6/7.5 posture damage per level. *Has a windup of 0.5 and 0.2 seconds before it hits, and a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.17x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.17 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn and Ragdolls. *Its distance is reduced by 60% when used in water. *Can be modified with [[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]]es to cause the Mantra to fly farther (at the same pace). *Can be modified with [[Glass Stone|Glass]]/[[Magnifying Stone]]s to increase the hitbox size. **This reduces the damage dealt however. }}
===Power 5===
*Corpse Explosion [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your flames will incinerate unconscious Targets much faster and bodies that you burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage. **Burn grip unconscious targets, even yourself, in 3.5 seconds instead of 7. ***The time it takes for burn to execute is very reliant on server performance, it may take longer than what is listed here. **The explosion does not work; you'll burn them to death without an explosion. *Flaming Flourish [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. **You also apply burn on enemies by swinging uppercut nearby. Aka doesn't have to be a hit to apply burn. *Legendary [Equipment Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Parrying and landing hits with your weapon gives you ether back. *{{Cl|oathtlnf|Death from Above}} [Oath Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - Upon cancelling your Air Dash, reveal your wings and strike your enemy. **Cancelling an Air Dash without your wings grows your wings without having to use any Starkindred Mantras. **Cancelling an Air Dash with your wings out makes you perform three large slashes with your weapon. **Deals moderate Slash damage and posture damage per hit. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Wyvern's Claw}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead. **Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds. **Synergizes very well with uppercuts. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Flame of Denial (☆☆☆) |image=Flame of Denial (gif).gif |desc=Undying flame. |mantratype=Support Mantra |ethercost={{stats|ether|80 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=Caster conjures an aura of flame in their hand before forcefully inserting it in their chest. Ritual Casted. *Prevents the user from being knocked from damaging attacks for 25 seconds, also preventing auto-executes while active. Having Azure Flames or Twisted Puppets will increase the duration of Flame of Denial by 25%, up to 31.25 seconds. *Flame of Denial has a 1 minute 40 second cooldown. *Flame of Denial has a windup of 1.1s with 0.9s of endlag, during which you will be forced into an animation where you cannot move. *If Flame of Denial prevents lethal damage, you will gain 0.1s of i-frames, be set to 1% of your maximum health, and then restore 12%/14%/16%/18%/20% of your maximum health per level. This healing cannot be reduced or negated by anti-heal. **Due to it setting you to 1% health on proc, you'll actually be at 13/15/17/19/21% health after it procs. *Flame of Denial completely disables burn damage if you are below 12.5 health. Temporary Health does not count towards this health threshold and Twisted Puppets' burn will still drain your Ether. *When Flame of Denial procs, any burn on your character will be extinguished. *Can be upgraded with the '''Denial Repulse''' Talent, causing a 20 Flamecharm damage AOE explosion with a 0.6s windup upon proccing Flame of Denial. This explosion cannot be parried nor dodged, but can be blocked, dealing 5 posture damage. *Denial Repulse's explosion has 5 Flamecharm scaling, dealing 30 Flamecharm damage at 100 Flamecharm. *While you can modify [[Vibrant Gem]]s onto Flame of Denial, they won't do anything except for increase the amount of ritual keys required to cast it. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Rising Flame (★★☆) |image=Risingflames.gif |desc=A rising tornado of flames. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=User spins and releases a fury of flames that sends both the user and opponent vertically into the air. *Has a base damage of 20/23/26/29/32 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 10 posture damage. *Has a windup of 0.55 seconds and a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *Does not send the user into the air if missed. *Can be upgraded with the "'''Meteor Impact'''" and "'''Phoenix Impact'''" Talents, allowing you to follow up with a meteor strike. *Can be modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloud]]/[[Stratus Stone]]s to make the hitbox larger. }}
===Power 10===
*Agitating Spark [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If you hit an opponent that you've lit on fire, it spreads to anyone nearby. Including yourself. **"Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you. **"Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. It also applies burn even if you have Eruption Path: Lava Serpent. ***Not all attacks proc this effect, unlike what the Talent description implies. Instead, all instances of Physical damage apply burn, even if the attack doesn't deal pure Physical damage . And all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) vfx on hit will also proc Immolation, applying burn. *Padded Armor [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - While your armor is broken (or if you have no armor), you take 5% less damage. (+3% Blunt Armor) *Phoenix Impact [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If you Meteor Slam an opponent whilst on fire, restore some HP and Ether. **It heals 4% max HP and restores 20 ether. *{{Cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode. **Does not have a cooldown. **Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. **Will not proc on knocked NPCs/players and mobs. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Flaming Scourge (★★★) |image=FlameScourage.gif |desc=Lash out with flames. |ethercost={{stats|ether|70 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=User gathers flames in their hand and spins it like a whip grabbing enemies around them, before slamming them into the ground. *Has a base damage of 10/11/12/13/14 per level, per hit (3, 2 if Reversal Spark) with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 14 posture damage per hit (3, 2 if Reversal Spark). *Has a windup of 0.6 seconds (0.65 seconds if Reversal Spark) with 0.2 seconds of endlag. Has an 18 second cooldown. *Inflicts burn. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Mantra continues if the second hit isn't parried. **''Autoparry frames on the second hit will '''NOT''' cancel the Mantra.'' **''Mantra also continues after the user gets knocked.'' *Can be modified with a [[Reversal Spark]], acting as a pull/grab, but dealing less damage. Flaming Scourge Reversal Spark.gif|Reversal Spark }}
===Power 15===
*Cauterized Wounds [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blood loss from all sources is lowered. (+1 Passive Agility) **Despite what the description states, this Talent only affects blood loss from directly taking damage. Blood drain effects (e.g. casting or being hit by Bloodrend Mantras, blood loss Potions, the blood loss Corrupt Resonance downside) are entirely unaffected by this Talent. **Effectiveness of this Talent is reduced if you are using the Curse of the No Life King enchantment. *Intrepid Flame [Equipment Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Flames wear off twice as fast on you. **Halves the maximum duration of burn on you. *{{Cl|questtlnf|Thresher Scales}} [Echo Talent, Quest Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You regenerate your armor at campfires. (+5 Health) *{{Cl|raretlnf|Mirage Clone}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at you on fire. **Has a 20s cooldown. *{{cl|advancedtl|Phoenix Flames}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Any time you would burn to death, you instead rise again with 50% of your health restored. Has a 60 second cooldown. **Healing scales on your Flamecharm investment; heals 25% health at 0 Flamecharm and scales up to 50% health at 75 Flamecharm, gaining 0.33% healing per point in Flamecharm. **If you used Flame Within while knocked to proc Phoenix Flames, then the healing received will be halved. Though, if you activated Flame Within prior to being knocked, you'll receive the full healing. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Flame Repulsion (☆☆☆) |image=Fire Replusion gif.gif |desc=Charge up an exertion of flames that knocks opponents backwards. If you take damage while charging, you repulse it back. |ethercost={{stats|ether|30 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=User charges up releases an explosion of flames around them. *Has a base damage of 16/18.4/20.8/23.2/25.6/28 with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *The Spring Spark variant's projectile has a base damage of 14.4/16.56/18.72/20.88/23.04 per level, while the explosion always has a base damage of 17 regardless of Mantra level. Both hits have 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *The base variant deals 15 posture damage, while the Spring Spark variant deals 6 + 10 posture damage. *The base variant has a windup of 0.7 seconds. The Spring Spark variant is a projectile, with a point blank windup of 1 second. Both variants have a 15 second cooldown. *If your are hit near the end of the base variant's windup, you will absorb the damage with 75% damage reduction and reflect it back with in the form of increased base damage. You gain very brief [[Status Effects#Hyperarmor|hyper-armor]] to signify this effect. **This effect has a very small activation window, as if you get hit too early in the windup the Mantra will just be canceled. This also works on fall damage. *Knocks enemies back. *Inflicts Burn. *Can be modified with [[Cloudstone|Cloud]]/[[Stratus Stone]]s to increase the size. *Can be modified with a Spring Spark, causing the repulsion to be stored in a projectile, dealing increased damage and posture damage. *Can be modified with a Blast Spark, seems to have no effect? File:Flame Repulsion Spring Spark.gif|Spring Spark }}
===Power 20=== *Emperor Flame [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Absorb fire produced by you, once you reach 5 stacks your next attack will be an automatic Explosive Finish flourish. This flourish will deal additional damage and proc Wither, reducing your opponent's maximum health temporarily. **Landing a basic attack while you have the Emperor Flame status effect will proc the flourish, dealing 15 Flamecharm damage, 25 Wither damage, and applying burn to the victim and anyone else nearby. This cannot proc on knocked enemies and does not proc Dazing Finisher. **The Emperor Flame status effect lasts 10 seconds or until you land a basic attack. Emperor Flame has a 30 second cooldown. **Hitting enemies with attacks that apply burn will grant Emperor Flame stacks. This will proc regardless of if the target is currently burning or not. There is a 2 second cooldown for stack gain. **Emperor Flame extinguishes burn applied to yourself through Agitating Spark. If Emperor Flame is on cooldown, yourself applied burn will not be extinguished. *Explosive Finish [Common Talent, Flamecharm Exclusive] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If an enemy is on fire when you flourish, blast them away with a fire blast. **the equation for this damage is: (weapon damage + 1 blunt damage + 5 flame damage) **Upon proccing Emperor Flame, this Talent will be put on a 3s cd. *{{Cl|oathtlnf|Ichor Imbuement}} [Oath Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - Using a Starkindred mantra while your wings are not out increases the damage they deal by 2 times. **Doubles the damage of your Starkindred Mantras if they are casted without your wings out. **This Talent is extremely situational, as your wings will be equipped upon casting a Starkindred Mantra or using Death From Above, regardless of it hits or not, and there is no way to deactivate your wings once they are out. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Graceful Steps}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your dancing steps now gives a faster speed boost. **If you lack the ether to cast a Mantra, the speed boost will trigger regardless. Also triggers if the Mantra is feinted. **The speed boost has a very short duration; having a fast swingspeed weapon is recommended to capitalize off this Talent's effect. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Sinister Halo (☆☆☆) |image=Sinister_Halo.gif |desc=Emit a spinning ring of celestial energy, trapping and shredding any who steps before its wake. |ethercost={{stats|ether|(?) Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |reqs={{c|notes|1200}} |effect=Similar to the Galebreathe Mantra [[Tornado]], but instead of it manually aiming, it will head forward until it hits an opponent, stopping where it hits. *Deals 32 (3.2*10) Oath damage with 1.65 Strength scaling. *Has a 0.6 second windup (with wings) and a 15 second cooldown. }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Heliodar Wings}} [Memento Talent] - Take flight [{{input|keybind|H}}]. **Gives a Talent tool that allows you to fly. This flight will passively drain your Heartfire Gauge. Using the wings with an empty Heartfire Gauge will set you on fire. **Attempting to use this during the Rat King fight will cause him to use the Sparkle Blitz move. **While flying, hold {{input|input|Space}} to ascend, {{input|keybind|crouch}} to descend, and {{input|keybind|roll}} to speed up. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Flame Grab (☆☆☆) |image=FlameGrab.gif |desc=Jet forwards with flames and slam anyone you catch in your clutches. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |reqs=Defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)]] |effect=User lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. *Has a base damage of 15/20/25/30/35 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 6 posture damage. *Has a 0.6 second windup with a 10 second cooldown. *Has a large hitbox both horizontally and backwards. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *Shares a cooldown with all of [[Grab Mantras|grab Mantras]]. *Travels for 0.6 seconds. *[[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]] increase the duration (distance travelled). }} ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ignition Rite}} [Memento Talent] - Landing fire attacks with the phoenix summoned regenerates Heartfire. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Ascension (☆☆☆) |image=Ascension.gif |desc=Take to the skies for a devastating strike. |ethercost={{stats|ether|(?) Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |reqs=Defeat [[Dravik, The Rat King]] |effect=The user rises into the air before swooping in. *Deals 37 Oath damage with 1.65 Strength scaling. *This attack cannot be parried or blocked, indicated by a sound effect and a red eye icon. *Applies hard knockdown on hit. *Wayward Gem will not proc on this Mantra. *Can knockdown any enemy ingame. }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ash Slam (★★★) |image=Ash-slam-2025.gif |desc=Strike the ground, turning it to ash. |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} + {{stats|blunt|Blunt}} |reqs=Defeat [[Dravik, The Rat King]] |effect=User imbues their fist with flames that explode on impact with the ground. Strikes twice in front of the user and creates a bursting explosion each time. *The first hit has a base damage of 10/14/18/22/26 while the second hit has a base damage of 6/8.4/10.8/13.2/15.6 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Has a windup of 0.65 seconds and a cooldown of 15 seconds. *Has a very large circular hitbox that is comparable to venting. *Deals 4 posture damage on the first hit and 2 on the second for a total of 6 posture damage. *Has 9.14x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.14 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *User maintains mobility during wind-up. *Can be modified with [[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]]es to make the hitbox bigger. }} ===True Heart of Enmity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ascended Phoenix Flames}} [Memento Talent] - Once per fight, when an attack would down you, immediately revive with 30% HP. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Heartfire Renewal}} [Memento Talent] - Regenerate Heartfire whenever you are burning. Upon revival with Phoenix Flames, restore half of your Heartfire gauge. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Celestial Assault (☆☆☆) |image=Celestial_Assault.gif |desc=Use your wings and deliver two critical blows. |ethercost={{stats|ether|(?) Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|oath|Oath}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=Defeat [[True Heart of Enmity]] |effect=Deliver a vertical slash (that launches the user and target up) and a horizontal slash (that pushes the target). *Deals 40 (20*2) Oath damage with 1.65 Strength scaling. *Initial 0.5 second windup (with wings) and a 10 second cooldown. }}

== Description ==
Songseekers are a religious [[Factions & Groups|group]], bound by the goal of wielding [[Glossary#The Song|The Song]] like in the [[Timeline|Old World]].  They believe in reincarnation by "returning to The Song", although, it's actually unknown whether or not that is true.

They seem to have a [[Tzaraan|mistress]], which suggests that there's some kind of a hierarchy, but it's yet unknown what her powers and beliefs are.

== Notable Members ==
[[Tz'araan]]: The Songseeker mistress, which encourages freedom of mind, as long as it aligns with her ideals. "But not outside th'box" as mentioned by [[Yamaketzal]].

title: Songseeker Flamecharmer
content:
{{EnemyInfobox|health=900|moves=*Assault *Critical *Fire Blade *Flame Repulsion *Fire Palm *Fire Eruption *Flame Ballista|image1=Flamercharmermonk.png|drops=*[[Dying Embers]] *[[Aspirant Mask]]|weapon=*Fists|caption1=Everything changed when the fire nation attacked}} '''Songseeker Flamecharmers''' are a [[Enemies|humanoid enemy]] in ''Deepwoken''. ==Description== A Songseeker Flamecharmer is an enemy NPC that can only be found in [[Songseeker Wilds]]. They can appear in Random Encounters or on fixed spawns in [[Songseeker Wilds]]. A Songseeker Flamecharmer wears an Aspirant Mask (Carmine) and an Unknown/Unlisted outfit, Varying with their [[Aspects|aspect]] and gender. == Moveset == A Songseeker Flamecharmer's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] ('''Way of Navae''') and the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Raises left leg before slamming it to the ground below. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |User slams down with their blade coated in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Flame Repulsion'''
(★☆☆) |After a wind-up of ~2 seconds, user releases a burning AoE blast. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Fire Palm'''
(★★☆) |Conjures a wave of fire from the palm of the users hand. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Fire Eruption'''
(★★☆) |An eruption of flame under the user hitting anyone nearby. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Flame Ballista'''
(★★☆) |Conjures a blazing arrow that tracks opponents. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Vent'''
(★☆☆) |An explosion of blue ether around the user that pushes opponents away. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, unharmful }} |} ===Boons=== * Third Eye - A Songseeker Flamecharmer cannot be assassinated. ===Talents=== *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Phoenix Flames}} - Any time a Songseeker Flamecharmer would burn to death, they instead rise again with 50% of their health restored. *{{cl|raretlnf|Everchanging Aegis}} - Songseeker Flamecharmer take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element they were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element. *{{cl|raretlnf|Perfect Flash}} - Having full health causes their mantras to do 25% extra damage *Immolation - Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If a Songseeker Flamecharmer hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. They take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. *{{cl|raretlnf|Mirage Clone}} - Successfully dodging leaves behind a heat mirage clone that sets enemies that swung at it on fire. *{{cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} - Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode. *Agitating Spark - If a Songseeker Flamecharmer hit an opponent that they've lit on fire, it spreads to themselves and others around you. *Controlled Combustion - Agitating Spark no longer spreads to their allies. *Flaming Flourish - Set enemies on fire when the Songseeker Flamecharmer flourish or uppercut them. *Corpse Explosion - Bodies that Songseeker Flamecharmer burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage. The bodies will also be incinerated much faster. ==Finisher== A Songseeker Flamcharmer executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name ! Description |- | Incineration |The flame status effect from the Flamecharm attunement burns away the opponent's corpse. |- |Execute | Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} ==Tips == * Constantly flourishing them/using Mantras will prevent them from spamming Mantras. * If not constantly attacked, they become a real threat as they can sometimes only spam Flame Repulsion, which if you're unlucky enough, will hit ''and'' aggro other Songseekers. ** Be warned that if they knock another Flamecharmer, or one is knocked and set on Fire, they will get up via Phoenix Flames. *Despite being immune to assassination, the player can still sneak behind and use a powerful mantra to pile up some good damage. *If you're fighting against this and other Monks, make sure it is ''never'' a Galebreather or Thundercaller. The constant mantra spam from the Flamecharmer, as well as having to parry trade and fight against the primary Monk will easily begin to overwhelm you, as well as having anti-running mantras to keep you from going too far. ==Trivia== * '''Songseekers''' use the following outfits made by '''SirAndrove2:''' * https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842791234/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Shirt *https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842793449/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Pants {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Songseekers]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

title: Songseeker Frostdrawer
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=1000 |moves=*Assault *Critical *Ice Spikes *Ice Daggers *Ice Blade *Ice Eruption *Ice Smash |image1=Songseeker Frostdrawer.png |title1= |drops=*[[Frigid Prism]] *[[Aspirant Mask]] |weapon=*Fists |caption1=Random ice daggers, GO!}} ==Description== Songseeker Frostdrawers are enemy [[NPCs]] that can be found in [[Songseeker Wilds]] and on [[Minityrsa]]. They can appear in Random Encounters or on fixed spawns in [[Songseeker Wilds]]. As for [[Minityrsa]], they can only spawn in Random Encounters. Songseeker Frostdrawers wear an Aspirant Mask (Saphire) and an Unknown/Unlisted outfit, Varying with their [[Aspects|aspect]] and gender. ==Moveset== A Songseeker Frostdrawer's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] '''(Way of Navae)''' and the [[Frostdraw]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Raises left leg before slamming it to the ground below. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.n, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Spikes'''
(★☆☆) |Conjure a spike of ice from the ground at cursor location. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Daggers'''
(★★☆) |User forms three daggers of ice before throwing them towards the nearest person. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Blade'''
(★☆☆) |Creates two blades of ice and rushes forward rapidly slashing. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Ice Eruption'''
(★★☆) |Erupts ice from the ground trapping anyone caught in it. {{AttackTags |parry.n, block.n, dodge.y, stun }} |- |
'''Ice Smash'''
(★★☆) |Creates a giant mace of ice to smash opponents with. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Vent'''
(★☆☆) |An explosion of blue ether around the user that pushes opponents away. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, unharmful }} |} ===Passives=== * Third Eye - A Songseeker Frostdrawer cannot be assassinated. * Emergency Extinguisher - Songseeker Frostdrawer is unable to be killed via burning to death, and will instead get up as normal and have their flames extinguished. ===Talents=== *{{cl|raretlnf|Everchanging Aegis}} - A Songseeker Frostdrawer take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element they were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different elements. *{{cl|raretlnf|Perfect Flash}} - Having full health causes a Songseeker Frostdrawer's mantras to do 25% extra damage. *Fragile Freeze - Getting blockbroken by the Songseeker's Light Attack or Critical will apply Frozen to you *Cool Head - If set on fire while on ice, the Songseeker Frostdrawer will put it out and enter a state of chill. During this state, they cannot be lit on fire. *{{cl|raretlnf|Preceding Chill}} - Enemies hit during the last moments of a Songseeker Frostdrawer's 'Ice Beam' are frozen. *Orbital Ice - Whenever a Songseeker Frostdrawer lands a parry while standing on ice, they automatically form a gravitational ring of ice that absorbs 15% of the physical damage they take. The ring breaks after sustaining a certain amount of damage. ==Finisher== A Songseeker Frostdrawer executes it's opponents after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" ! Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} ==Tips== *Despite being immune to assassination, the player can still sneak behind and use a powerful mantra to pile up some good damage. *Constantly flourishing them/using mantras will prevent them from spamming mantras. * Watch out for Ice Daggers, as this move can be spammed and be easily proven lethal. *Get them into corners as it will make it impossible for the Songseeker Frostdrawers to deal damage. Even though they will cast mantras, they won't deal damage while being attacked when casting a mantra. Or keep hitting them and spamming mantras on them. *Fighting Songseeker Frostdrawers with Songseeker Flamecharmers can be very annoying, and lethal. If you are planning to fight the two monks at the same time, make sure to know what you are doing otherwise you can get knocked. *Escaping them is very hard at a low level as their Ice Daggers can track you down very easily so you must parry if they do use Ice Daggers. ==Trivia== *Songseekers use the following outfits made by '''SirAndrove2''': [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842791234/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods Shirt] and [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842793449/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods Pants] {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Songseekers]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

They can appear in Random Encounters, on fixed spawns, or in the Songseeker Fanactics [[Job_Boards#Songseeker_Wilds|job]]. A Songseeker Galebreather wears an Aspirant Mask (Emerald) and an Unknown/Unlisted outfit, Varying with their [[Aspects|aspect]] and gender. == Moveset == A Songseeker Galebreather's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] '''(Way of Navae)''' and the [[Galebreathe]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''

If an attack was a mantra, it does 5% damage instead. *Breathing Impact - When a Songseeker Galebreather gets knocked into objects by wind mantras, enemies take additional blunt damage based off of how hard they are hit. ==Finisher== A Songseeker Galebreather executes its opponents after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} ==Tips== *Despite being immune to assassination, the player can still sneak behind and use a powerful mantra to pile up some good damage. *Constantly flourishing them/using mantras will prevent them from spamming mantras. * Watch out for their "Heavenly Wind", as this move can catch the player off guard due to its very fast windup and odd hitbox. *Get them into corners as it will make it impossible for the Songseeker Galebreathers to deal damage. When added, it was stated in the update log that they had 'been on vacation.'[[Version History/Uncollapsed#August 15th, 2022|Version History: August 15th, 2022]] *They are the only songseekers to have only three Mantras. *'''Songseekers''' use the following outfits made by '''SirAndrove2:''' *https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842791234/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Shirt *https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842793449/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Pants ==References== {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Songseekers]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

title: Songseeker Temple
content:
{{Location|name=Songseeker Temple|caption=There are those who seek to wield the Song as those of the Old World once did, as an artform to be cultivated into something transcendent.}}
[[File:Songseeker Temple!.jpg|thumb|900px|center]]

'''Songseeker Temple''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a landmark found in the [[Songseeker Wilds]].

==Overview==
Songseeker Temple resembles a dojo on the interior. It can be found higher in the island with the windmill on it.

Inside the Temple is Amashi, a [[Spelltrainers|spelltrainer]].

==Contents==

===NPCs=== 
*Players can find [[Amashi]], a [[Spelltrainers|spelltrainer]] who can help you acquire [[Flamecharm]], or upgrade your existing [[Flamecharm]] [[Mantras]].
*Just outside the temple, players can find [[Yamaketzal]], who can either give you the [[Chime of Conflict]] or remove your [[Tarnished]] Flaw.

==Potential Enemies==
<gallery>
File:Amashi.png|[[Amashi, Master of Flame]]
File:Songseeker Frostdrawer.png|[[Songseeker Frostdrawer]]
File:Flamercharmermonk.png|[[Songseeker Flamecharmer]]
File:Galebreathermonk.png|[[Songseeker Galebreather]]
File:Songseeker Frostdrawer.png|[[Songseeker Thundercaller]]
</gallery>

==Quests==

===Flamecharm Spelltrainer Quest===  
*If you are unattuned with [[Flamecharm]], the [[Spelltrainers|spelltrainer]] will give you a quest.
*He will ask for five [[Dying Embers]], obtain them and give them to him. This is reduced to 2 Dying Embers if you have previously unlocked Flamecharm on your account.
*Doing this will result in a potion that will attune you with [[Flamecharm]].

A Songseeker Thundercaller's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] '''(Way of Navae)''' and the [[Thundercall]] attunement: == Moveset == A Songseeker Thundercaller's arsenal consists of [[Fists]] '''(Way of Navae)''' and the [[Thundercall]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |

Songseeker Thundercaller's lightning stuns enemies for 1.5x as long. *Static Ace - A Songseeker Thundercaller's Lightning Stream with an active tether links the targets to the closest active link. *Static Allure - Having two active tethers will cause the previous tethered enemy to get magnetized to the Songseeker Thundercaller's newest tethered enemy, also increases the duration of tethers by 15 seconds. *Discharge - Every 5th successful attack of a Songseeker Thundercaller, they will discharge static dealing lightning damage to those nearby. *Stratoshock - The lightning of a Songseeker Thundercaller deal an additional +5% damage on the rain. ==Finisher == A Songseeker Thundercaller executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face. |} ==Tips== *Despite being immune to [[Stealth|assassination]], the player can still sneak behind and use a powerful mantra to pile up some good damage. * Constantly flourishing them/using Mantras will prevent them from spamming Mantras. * Lightning Stream can be extremely dangerous, especially if a Flame Songseeker fires a fully charged flame ballista while you're being dragged towards the caster of the stream. Always attempt to block Lightning Stream to avoid losing control of the fight and being put into close proximity of all of the Songseekers at once. ==Trivia== * '''Songseekers''' use the following outfits made by '''SirAndrove2''': * https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842791234/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Shirt *https://www.roblox.com/catalog/6842793449/Aldritch-Devourer-of-Gods - Pants {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Songseekers]] [[Category:Humanoids with Unobtainable Outfits]]

title: Songseeker Wilds
content:
{{Location|name=Songseeker Wilds}}
[[File:Songseekerwilds.png|center|thumb|900x900px]]


'''Songseeker Wilds''' is a [[Location]] in ''Deepwoken.'' It is a group of islands that can be found in [[The Aratel Sea]].

==Overview==
Songseeker Wilds is a set of islands located in [[the Aratel Sea]]. It is home to [[Ancient Rotlands]], provides a passage to [[Minityrsa]], and is south-east of [[Summer Isle]]. 

It consists of 2 land masses, a smaller and larger one, separated by the ocean.

==Points of Interest==
*[[Ancient Rotlands]]
*[[Derelict Highchurch]]
*[[Songkeeper Temple]]

==Contents==

===Small Island===
*Many unknown structures resembling jellyfish like construction can be found on this island.
*A mineshaft containing several nodes of [[Gold]], [[Rock]], [[Iron]], and [[Coal]]
*Inside the mineshaft, the [[Mime]] plays a trick on the player by disguising [[Mineskipper]]s as [[Barrel]]s.
*There are a lot of trees bearing fruits, ranging from [[Redd]], [[Plumfruit]], [[Ongo]], and [[Pomar]].
*A small campsite on top of a hill with [[Jeandae]].
*Near the hill, one of the small structures with a quest NPC named [[Ezra]], who ask you to clear out Songseekers at [[Derelict Highchurch]].
*A ginormous structure with a single Songseeker inside.

===Large Island===
====Mineshaft====
*There are a lot of trees bearing [[Fruit]], ranging from [[Redd]]s, [[Plumfruit]]s, and [[Pomar]]s.
*A larger mineshaft with [[Mineskipper]]s littering the cave.
**Going up the mineshaft will also lead to the [[Shrine of Order]].
**Along with that, you will find some nodes of [[Astruline]] deeper within.
*Outside of the mineshaft, [[Lucien]] asks the player to clear out the Mineskippers for the {{t|Pocket Bombs}} Talent and a Bravery Talent hand.
*A gateway that leads to the [[Ancient Rotlands]], a [[Voidzone]] that was once home to a Celestial.
*There are two structures:
*#A windmall with a [[Guild Banners|Guild Banner]] in front of it. Inside of the windmill is a [[Mantra Lectern]] and some small chests.
*#A small hut with some chests inside.

File:Mineskipper Mine Location.png|Mineskipper Mineshaft Location
File:Shrine  of Order Location.gif|Shrine of Order path
</gallery>

====Ravine Entrance====
*Taking a right will lead to three Songseekers worshipping one of the unknown structures.
*Following the right side of the path from the staircase leads to the [[Songseeker Temple]]. Inside is [[Amashi, Master of Flame|Amashi]], the [[Flamecharm]] trainer.
*Outside of the temple, a strange Capra named [[Yamaketzal]] who can grant 
*Following the left side of the path leads to a [[Guild Banners|Guild Banner]] across from a broken bridge thats connects to the [[Derelict Highchurch]].
