title: Status Effects
content:
Status effects are effects that can negatively or positively affect the player. Some of these are deadly and should be taken with caution. =={{anch|Health State}}s== Displayed on your health bar, these display the vitality of your character, telling you what would happen should you perish. ==={{anch|Healthy}}=== Your health state is normal. Perishing will send you to your spawn location and change your health state to {{status|b=y|Injured}}. ==={{anch|Injured}}=== You have perished. Perishing again will send you to [[the Depths]]. This effect can be cleared, returning you to {{status|b=y|Healthy}} by escaping [[the Depths]] or [[Power]]ing up. ==={{anch|Drowned}}=== You are in [[the Depths]]. Perishing will send you to the [[Fragments of Self]] in [[Pathfinder]] or [[Fragments of Else]] in {{iv|Vow of Iron}}. [[Cathedral of the Interstice|Escape]] the [[The Depths|Depths]] to clear this effect, restoring you back to {{status|b=y|Healthy}} when you arrive back on the Surface. ==={{anch|Void}}=== You are in a [[Voidzone]] or in the range of a [[Void Spire]] while being Power 15 or higher. While you have the Void health state, all incoming healing is massively reduced and perishing will send you to [[the Depths]] regardless of you were {{status|b=y|Injured}} or not. While in a Voidzone, the edges of your screen will have a white cracked effect. While under the effects of a [[Void Spire]], the screen will go monochrome. Leave the Void one to clear this state. ==={{anch|Cursed}}=== You currently have a [[Curse of the No Life King]] or [[Curse of Void]] enchanted weapon equipped. Similar to {{status|b=y|Injured}}, perishing will send you to [[the Depths]]. This effect can be removed by changing your weapon or enchantment, returning you to your previous state. However, this effect will persist for 60 seconds after you take damage, effectively preventing you from swapping to a different weapon near the end of a fight to prevent your trip to [[the Depths]]. ==General== These status effects come from several different sources, are tied to the state of the player, or are the focal point of other mechanics. ===Resting === This effect causes the player to regain lost health and blood much faster, but lose hunger and thirst much faster (for blood regain). This effect is only caused when the player rests at a [[Campfire Pit]], [[Graceful Flame]], or a Stove. ==={{anch|Parched}}/{{anch|Starved}}=== This effect happens when you are low on thirst/stomach. When this occurs, your vision will start to blur and darken. If either of these bars are below 20%, you will not be able to heal past 90% health. If one, but not both, of these bare are fully empty, the drain on the other bar will be doubled, your health regen will be halved, and you will not be able to heal past 80% health. If both of these bars are empty, your blood will gradually drain and your health will be drained down to 50%. Upon reaching 0 thirst or stomach, a message will appear at the top of your screen, reminding you to eat something. File:Foodlow.gif ==={{anch|Hypovolemic Shock}}=== This effect happens once your blood bar is below 5%, causing your stomach and thirst meters to rapidly drain in order to sustain yourself. Your health will also rapidly deteriorate. If you have enough food and thirst, you can stabilize yourself, but if not you will eventually die from starvation/dehydration. If you are swimming while below 50% health in this state, you will instantly be knocked and will drown. To avoid bleeding out, replenish your blood at [[Campfire Pit]]s, and to prepare for it, always keep food and water on you. ==={{anch|Knocked|Unconscious}}=== Commonly referred to as being "knocked", this effect is applied once any humanoid target or player reaches 0 health, and is signified by their body going limp. Unless specified by an ability, being Unconscious prevents all actions. Unconscious characters can be executed or {{status|Carried}} and take significantly more blood damage from being hit. Unconscious lasts 10 seconds at base, but its duration can be altered through the {{t|Perseverance}}, {{t|Defiance}}, {{t|Charismatic Cast}}, and {{t|Concussive Force}} Talents. Unconscious duration will be reset upon taking damage unless the Unconscious party has the {{t|Impervious Slumber}} Talent. Being set {{status|Burn|on fire}} while Unconscious will cause the Unconscious party to burn to death after 8 seconds. The target will stop burning if a manual execution is initiated or if the target gets {{status|Carried}} for any duration. It will take 4 seconds for them to burn to death instead if the burn applicator has the {{t|Corpse Explosion}} Talent. Being in deep water, like the sea, while Unconscious will cause you to drown to death after a few seconds. This can be prevented by having the {{t|Fishman}} Talent. File:Knocked.png ==={{anch|Carried}}=== By pressing {{input|keybind|V}} near an {{status|Unconscious}} player or NPC, you can '''carry''' them, lifting them over your shoulder. Unless specified by an ability, being Carried prevents all actions, similar to being {{status|Unconscious}}. Carried entities will be dropped if the person carrying them takes damage or if the Carried entity has been carried for too long. File:Carried.png ==={{anch|Speed Boost}}=== Speed boosts are one of Deepwoken's core status effects, being responsible for a lot of Talent effects and being very important for the core combat loop, especially in PvP. Speed boosts are simply a movement speed increase, with the effectiveness and duration of the speed boost depending on the source. The way the movement speed increase from speed boosts are applied is not standardized. Some speed boosts give you a flat increase to your studs per second, some increase your movement speed by a percentage, and some do both of these. There is little consistency to be found. Speed boosts are distinctly different from {{status|Mobility Buff|mobility buffs}}, as the former allows you to proc certain Talents while the latter does not. Speed boosts do not have a visual indicator, and are applied from a multitude of sources such as: [[Combat Mechanics|parrying and dodging attacks]], [[Wind Gem]], certain [[Talents]], some [[Weapon]] criticals, other Status Effects, etc. ==={{anch|Mobility Buff}}=== Mobility buffs are very similar to {{status|Speed Boost|speed boosts}}, being a movement speed increase, with the effectiveness and duration depending on the source, though they are distinctly different from {{status|Speed Boost|speed boosts}}, as they cannot proc {{status|Speed Boost|speed boost}}-reliant Talents. Mobility buffs do not have a visual indicator, and are applied from a multitude of sources such as: {{t|Flame Within}}, {{t|Lightweight}}, [[Stratos' Cloak]], other Status Effects, etc. ==={{anch|Ragdoll}}=== While ragdolled, you gain slight damage reduction at the cost of your character going limp and being able to perform most actions. This status effect can be ended early, in most cases, by pressing Feint ({{input|keybind|feint}}), though some sources of ragdoll cannot be ended early. Ragdoll is applied through various sources and is signified by your character going limp. ==={{anch|Knockdown}}=== While affected by knockdowns, you cannot move or cast any abilities. This effect can be cleared early by [[Vent]]ing. Knockdowns are applied through various sources such as default heavy weapon criticals and certain [[Mantras]]. Upon being knocked down, gain a short duration of knockdown immunity. During knockdown immunity, gain {{status|Daze}} immunity as well. This effect is signified by your character being slammed into the ground briefly. File:Knockdown.png ==={{anch|Respite}}=== If you aren't already at full health, gain the Respite status effect after standing still for 15 seconds. This effect will heal your character, with the healing ramping up the longer you are stationary. Performing any actions or taking damage will end this effect early. Signified by white rings ascending over your character. File:Respite.gif ==={{cl|fir|{{anch|Burning|Burn}}}}=== This effect can be applied on you by most notably, being hit by a [[Flamecharm]] move, but there are many other burn application sources. Has a base damage of 3.33 per tick with 5 Flamecharm scaling (damage = 3.33 × (1 + 0.005 × Flamecharm Investment)), ticking 2.4 times a second. Burn damage has slight fluctuation to account for ping. Burning opponents have their '''base''' passive health regeneration disabled. If an {{status|Unconscious}} body is set on fire, they will automatically be gripped after 8 seconds if not picked up (4 seconds if the user who applied the fire has the Corpse Explosion Talent). Burn benefits from '''general''' PEN sources such as [[Strength]]. Burn will be extinguished when rolling, jumping in water/standing in rain, or sliding. When burn is extinguished, gain immunity to burn for 2 seconds. Additionally, certain objects are flammable and will glow orange when hit by a terrain-interacting [[Flamecharm]] or [[Thundercall]] Mantra, applying burn to anyone who touches it. Signified by fire particles coming from your character. File:Burning.gif|The normal Burn effect It has a few sub-variants: *{{anch|Azure Flames|Azure Burning}}: Deals 12.5% more damage per tick than base burn. This burn type comes from {{t|Azure Flames}}. *{{anch|Black Flames}}: This burn type has two sub types. Both of these burns come from {{t|Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets}} and drain a flat 6.25 Ether from affected targets per tick. **{{anch|Puppet Burn}}: Derived from any non-Shadowcast burn applicator, this burn type deals 87.5% less damage than base burn. Uniquely, this burn type will spawn Puppets with a 4 second cooldown. **{{anch|Shadow Burn}}: Derived from Shadowcast sources, this burn type deals 75% less damage than base burn. *{{anch|Lifelord's Blaze}}: [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]] and [[Curse of Ysley's Ember]] exclusive, completely cosmetic and functions the same as base burn. *'''White Flames''': [[Shard Bow#Corrupt|{{cl|corres|Corrupt}} Shard Bow]] and [[Edenbrand Hellcoil]] exclusive, white flames that tick 25% faster (3 ticks per second) but have a lower base damage of 3.21. White Flames has a higher DPS than base burn, especially as it benefits from all of your Flamecharm Talents. The [[Deepfire Ring]] has no effect with this burn type, as it innately has the effects of the ring. *{{cl|attnfir|{{anch|Flamewreathe Burn}}}}: [[Monsters#Attuned Monsters|Attuned Monster]] exclusive, this burn is harder to remove; requiring 2 roll cancels or 1 full roll to be extinguished. It is applied on every attack (even if it doesn't deal damage) from any Flamewreathed Monster. This burn is a light orange. *{{anch|Flame Within|Self Immolation|Self Immolation}}: {{t|Flame Within}} exclusive, grants a 10% damage buff and a movement speed bonus. Cannot be removed from self via rolling or sliding, instead needing you to use the tool again to deactivate it. This effect is visually indistinguishable from normal burn, being based off your current Flamecharm color. File:Azureburn.gif|Azure Flames Burn effect File:Lifelordblaze.gif|Lifelord's Blaze Burn effect File:Blackflames.gif|Twisted Puppet's Burn effect File:Whiteflames.gif|The White Flames from corrupted Shard Bow ==={{anch|Hyperarmor}}=== Make your attacks uninterruptible and become immune to most forms of stun; [[Vent]]s and Thundercall's {{status|Shock}} will bypass this and will interrupt your attack. Can be applied with the Critical attack of most heavy weapons, [[Brace]], and many other sources. Signified by your character gaining a red highlight. Hyperarmor ends early if you cast a Mantra. File:Brace.gif ===={{anch|True Hyperarmor}} ==== An enhanced form of {{status|Hyperarmor}}. Your attack becomes entirely uninterruptable; [[Vent]]s and {{status|Shock}} have no effect. Can be applied with [[Darksteel Greatsword]]'s Critical attack, [[Stoneheart]]'s Critical's charge animation, [[Chorus of Agonies]]' Critical attack and the [[Iron Hug]] Mantra. This effect is visually indistinguishable from normal Hyperarmor, being the same red highlight. ==={{anch|Daze|Dazed}}=== Have your dodge frames lowered and be unable to sprint for a brief period. This effect can be cleared early by [[Vent]]ing. Applied after being flourished into a wall and through several effects and abilities. You cannot be Dazed if you are under {{status|Knockdown}} Immunity. Signified by yellow stars around your character. Can also be applied after being hit by certain mantras, criticals, or applied by certain Talents. File:Dazed.gif ===={{anch|True Daze}}==== An enhanced form of {{status|Dazed}}. True Daze makes you completely unable to dodge or move for a short duration. This effect can be cleared early by [[Vent]]ing. Applied primarily through wallbangs. This effect is visually indistinguishable from normal daze, being the same yellow stars. ==={{anch|Bleed}}=== This effect can be applied by being hit by a weapon, monster attack, or Mantra that applies bleed. Bleed deals 5% of the initial attack's '''scaled''' damage in three damage ticks, totaling to a 15% total damage increase. Bleed from {{t|Speed Demon}} deals 2.5% of the attack's scaled damage per tick, resulting in a 7.5% total damage increase. Bleed damage can only be buffed via the [[Crimson Terraplate Pauldrons]] and [[Razor Cutlass]]' Talents, and increasing the scaled damage of the attack. Bleed damage deals increased blood bar damage. Signified by blood pouring out from your character. File:Bleed.gif|The brief blood splatter vfx from Bleed proccing. ==={{anch|Wither}}=== Temporarily reduces your maximum health. This effect can be removed by being out of combat, {{status|Resting}}, and when knocking opponents. Signified by a dark blue portion on your healthbar. Applied by getting hit by an opponent with {{t|Emperor Flame}}, [[Darkened Bastion]]'s ''Withering Soul'' Talent, [[Umbrite Witherblade]]'s basic attacks and critical, [[Pleeksty's Inferno]]'s Critical Attack, both of [[Kindred Edict]]'s Critical Attacks when using the [[Starkindred]] Oath, [[Spectral Grasp]]'s Critical Attack, [[Blightsurger|Blightsurger's]] {{status|Blightshock|Blightshock}} status effect, and [[Black Death|Black Death's]] unique weapon Talent ''Corporeal Dissolution''. It can also be applied to yourself through [[Bladeharper]]'s ''Reveal'', using [[Linkstrider|Linkstrider's]] ''Symbiotic Sustain'', [[Vortex Echo]]'s Critical attack, [[Sanguine Transfuser]]'s Critical attack, and the Wither [[Resonance#Corrupted Resonances|Corrupted Resonance]] downside. File:Wither.png ==={{anch|Anti-Heal}}=== Disallows healing by a percentage from '''any''' source while active and completely nullifies passive regeneration. This effect can be applied through being hit by a basic attack by someone that has the Talent {{t|All the Dead Gods}} for 8 seconds, or when hit by the first hit of [[Umbrite Witherblade]]'s Critical attack for 10 seconds. The Anti-Heal effectiveness from All the Dead Gods scales on investment up to its combined requirement. This does not stack with any other source of Anti-Heal, as the higher potency Anti-Heal will take priority. Signified by purple smoke on your character. File:Antiheal.gif ===={{anch|Pestilence}}==== While active, suffer from 50% {{status|Anti-Heal}} for 10 seconds, halving all incoming healing. This effect can be applied through being hit by a basic attack with someone who has a [[Ring of Pestilence]] equipped. This does not stack with any other source of {{status|Anti-Heal}}, as the higher potency {{status|Anti-Heal}} will take priority. Signified by a light yellow smoke on your character. File:Pestilience.gif|Pestilence on a sandbag ===={{anch|Broodlord Rot}}==== While active, suffer from 80% {{status|Anti-Heal}} meaning you will only get healed 20% of any healing source instead of the full heal. This effect can be applied through being hit by a [[Mudskipper Broodlord]]. This effect is amplified in [[The Diluvian Mechanism]] but does not apply to health packs from killing monsters, and reduced in [[Hell Mode]]. This does not stack with any other source of {{status|Anti-Heal}}, as the higher potency {{status|Anti-Heal}} will take priority. Signified by purple smoke on your character. File:Antiheal.gif|Broodlord Rot is visually identical to the full Anti Heal from All the Dead Gods ==={{anch|Primal Fear}}=== Incoming attacks deal 12.5% more damage and 50% more posture damage, while also disabling [[Murmur: Tacet]]. Applied through a [[Megalodaunt]]'s roar, [[Primadon]]'s Phase 2 transformation and by {{t|Ardour Scream}}. Signified by pink/purple particles on your character. File:Fear.gif ===Blinded=== Your range of vision is severely reduced, with everything far away from you being effectively pitch black. This effect is applied through many sources, such as: the [[Blind]] Flaw, wearing a [[Blindfold]], being hit by [[Sightless Beam]], or the {{t|Light's Out}} Talent. File:Blind at night.png ==={{anch|Temporary Health}}=== Signified by a white bar on your health bar, gain a Temporary Health bar which decays at a rate of 1 Temporary health lost per second. You cannot have more than 200 flat temporary health at any given time. Damage taken from almost all sources will damage your Temporary Health before it damages your actual health bar. This is gained through the use of certain [[Bloodrend]] Talents like {{t|Sow and Mend}}, {{t|Armored Plating}}, {{t|Enhanced Flow}}, the Talents from the [[Necrotic Cowl|Necrotic]] set, as well as the [[Vampirism]] Enchant. Alternatively, it can be applied to your opponent with the [[Curse of Ysley's Ember]] enchantment. Having {{status|Anti-Heal}} applied on you will reduce or negate the amount of Temporary Health given. File:Overheal.png ==={{anch|Enhanced Perception}}=== A red highlight applied onto enemies, allowing you to see them through walls. Applied through [[Voidwalker]] bounties, [[Chrysid|Chrysid's]] Mothwing Dust, and the Heart Reverb Talent's [[Rhythm]] upgrade from [[Soulbreaker]]. File:Revealed.png|Enhanced Perception through Mothwing Dust. ==={{anch|Insanity}}=== As you lose sanity, your screen will begin to darken and gain a blue hue. This vision distortion effect will only progress as your Sanity continues to lower, especially around the sides of your screen. While affected by insanity, you will periodically Shiver, Panic, or Scratch yourself depending on your "Tier" of Insanity, temporarily stunning you in place and dealing damage in higher tiers. Damage dealt from Panicking and Scratching is typeless, though it will be halved if you have the {{t|Grasp on Reality}} Talent. Sanity can be lost in many ways such as [[potions]], certain [[Monsters|monster]] attacks, some [[Talents]], and being in the [[First Layer]] to name a few. Each "tier" of insanity has its own distinct effects as listed below: ====Tier 1 Insanity==== This effect happens when your Sanity is 70% or less, aptly named "Tier 1 [[Insanity]]." Your character will start occasionally shivering, which will stop any action you may have been doing for '''2 seconds'''. This can be deadly if you shiver while using a [[Gliders|Glider]] at a great height, as it will immediately make you drop down. If you have the {{t|Unfazed}} Talent, you will not Shiver at Tier 1 Insanity. ====Tier 2 Insanity==== This effect happens when your Sanity is 30% or less, aptly named "Tier 2 [[Insanity]]." Your character will lose their ability to recognize people around them, with their faces and names being obscured. Shivering will be replaced with Panicking and scratching your arms, dealing '''10 damage''' and stunning you for '''1 second''' and then you will Shiver for 2 seconds. If you have the {{t|Unfazed}} Talent, you will Shiver for '''2.5 seconds''' instead of Panicking at Tier 2 Insanity. ====Tier 3 Insanity==== This effect happens when your Sanity is 10% or less, aptly named "Tier 3 [[Insanity]]." Panicking will be replaced with your character Scratching their body and face which deals '''20 damage''' and stunning you for '''1.5 seconds''', and then you will Shiver for 2 seconds. If you don't have enough health left when Scratching or get knocked at any point while having Tier 3 Insanity, your character will instantly die. If you have the {{t|Unfazed}} Talent, you will Panic instead of Scratching. Due to how long it takes to get to max insanity, (unless you have [[Manic]]) you will almost never get this unless you've been in [[the Depths]] for long periods of time, had a considerable amount of Mindbreaking Potions thrown at you, or used a Corrupted Resonance with the Insanity downside. ==={{anch|Food Buff|Reinforced Hunger}}=== Eating certain [[food]] items can provide the user with useful buffs. The food buff you have as well as its duration can be viewed on your hunger bar, with a colored section at the top displaying the duration. The duration of food buffs are tied to the food eaten and your hunger bar as a whole, meaning if you are losing hunger from doing something like swimming, the buff will drain faster. *{{cl|power|Power}}: +5% M1 damage; ''"A hearty meal that'll empower your melee strikes!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Glazed Fish]], [[Megurger]], [[Mushroom Omelette]], or [[Toffee]]. *{{cl|enchant|Enchant}}: +5% Mantra damage; ''"An energising meal that'll empower your mantras!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Candied Fruit]] or [[Fish Omelette]]. *{{cl|speed|Speed}}: +5% sprint speed; ''"A complex meal that'll get you moving!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Cake]]. *{{cl|ether|Ether}}: +20% Ether regeneration; ''"An aromatic meal to cultivate your focus!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Sticky Bun]]. *{{cl|heal|Heal}}: +30% health regeneration; ''"A soothing meal to recover your strength!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Candy Suncorn]], [[Crab Stuffed Browncaps]], [[Fruit Salad]], or [[Pumpkin Pie]]. *{{cl|full|Full}}: Lowers passive hunger loss by 10%; ''"A filling meal to keep you fed for longer!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Candy]] or [[Seafood Boil]]. *{{cl|brain|Brain}}: Increases the effectiveness or efficiency of your [[Deep Gems]]; ''"A strange meat that empowers your Deep Gem knowledge."'' Applied by consuming the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]]. **[[Aegis Gem]]: Duration increased from 10s to 15s. **[[Blessed Gem]]: Cooldown reduction is increased from -50% to -66%. **[[Bloodless Gem]]: Heal cap increased from 15 to 20. **[[Blue Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Insignia Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Might Gem]]: Posture damage buff increased from +10% to +15%. **[[Nocturnal Gem]]: Damage is increased from 10 to 15. **[[Warped Blue Gem]]: No noticeable difference. **[[Wayward Gem]]: Cooldown is reduced from 8s to 3s. **[[Wind Gem]]: {{status|Speed Boost|Speed boost}} duration increased from 10s to 15s. **[[Wrath Gem]]: Critical damage buff per-combat tag increased from 7.5% to 15%. *{{cl|scale|Scale}}: Reduces incoming Penetration by 15%; ''"A heavy meat that hardens your skin!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Heavy Steak]]. *{{cl|throat|Throat}}: Increases your [[Taunt]] (Mantra)'s duration by 8 seconds and {{status|Fight|Vow Command: Fight}} duration by 7.5 seconds; ''"An odd meal that soothes your throat!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Dread Filet]]. *{{cl|strength|Strength}}: +10% M1 posture damage; ''"An invigorating meal that strengthens your muscles!"'' Applied by consuming the [[Primal Cutlet]]. ==={{anch|Potions}}=== Special brews created by Alchemists. Potion effects vary heavily based on the ingredients used in the potion. Please check the [[Alchemy]] page for more information on how each potion is made. *'''Instant Health Gain''' - Instantly restore health. Applied through Rejuvenating Salves. *'''Instant Health Loss''' - Instantly take damage. Applied through Disgusting Banes/Blights. *'''Health Regeneration''' - Restores health over time. Applied through Invigorating Potions/Tinctures/Elixirs/Salves. *'''Damage over Time''' - Deals damage over time. Applied through Grueling Banes/Blights. *'''Instant Ether Gain''' - Instantly restore Ether. Applied through Soothing Tinctures/Potions/Salves. *'''Instant Ether Loss''' - Instantly lose Ether. Applied through Appalling Blights/Potions. *'''Ether Regeneration''' - Grants Ether restoration over time. Applied through Focusing Elixirs/Salves/Tinctures. *'''Ether Depletion''' - Depletes your Ether over time. Applied through Icky Potions/Banes/Blights. *'''Damage Buff''' - Gain a damage buff. Applied through Strengthening Salves/Tinctures/Potions. *'''Damage Debuff''' - Gain a damage debuff. Applied through Dulling Potions/Banes/Blights. *'''Posture Resistance Buff''' - Increases your posture resistance by a percentage, making you take reduced posture damage. Applied through Steadfast Tinctures/Potions/Elixirs/Salves. *'''Posture Resistance Debuff''' - Reduces your posture resistance by a percentage, making you take increased posture damage. Applied through Buckling Banes/Blights. *'''Posture Damage Buff''' - Increases your posture damage by a percentage. Applied through Staggering Salves. *'''Posture Damage Debuff''' - Reduces your posture damage by a percentage. Applied through Weakening Potions. *'''Sanity Restoration''' - Quickly restore Sanity. Applied through Heartening Remedies/Potions/Salves/Tinctures/Elixirs. *'''Sanity Deprecation''' - Reduces your sanity over time. Applied through Mindbreaker Banes/Blights/Potions. *'''Speed Boost''' - Grants a {{status|Speed Boost|speed boost}}. Applied through Hastening Potions/Elixirs/Salves/Tinctures. *'''Slowing''' - Grants a speed debuff. Applied through Slowing Blights. *'''Blood Restoration''' - Restores blood. Applied through Revitalizing Potions. ==Attunement Applied== These status effects are applied by some or all [[Mantras]] of a certain [[Attunement]]. ==={{anch|Winded}}=== Winded reduces your swing speed by 5% (15% if applied by Specter path). This effect can be applied by being hit with [[Galebreathe]] Mantras or {{cl|attnwnd|Galeforce}} monsters. Signified by green (white if the user has Specter Path) spirals on your character. This effect is signified by a crimson chain linking yourself and affected opponents. ==={{anch|Bloodwarden's Sense|Bloodwarden's Mark}}=== Applied through the {{t|Bloodwarden's Sense}} Talent, take 20% more {{status|Blood Poisoning}} and become highlighted with the {{status|Enhanced Perception}} effect for 5 seconds. File:Revealed.png ==Deep Gem Applied== These status effects are applied when landing a Mantra with a certain [[Deep Gems|Deep Gem]] equipped on it. ==={{anch|Wrath}}=== Procced from landing a Mantra with the [[Wrath Gem]] equipped, this effect increases the damage of your critical attack by 7.5% per player combat tag you have. This damage bonus will be increased to 15% per player combat tag if you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Reinforced Hunger|food buff}}. Additionally, this allows you to proc the Talents from the [[Reinforced War Helmet|Reinforced War Set]]. Wrath lasts 9 seconds with the Wrath Gem having a 10 second cooldown. This effect has no visual indicator. ==={{anch|Aegis}}=== Gain 10% damage reduction for 10 seconds, applied by landing a Mantra with the [[Aegis Gem]] equipped, signified by a pink translucent, cylindrical dome on your character. This duration of this effect will be increased to 15 seconds if you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Reinforced Hunger|food buff}}. Note: This effect will not proc if you have not beaten [[The Gaunt Man|The Gaunt Man's]] experiment on your character. ==PvE Exclusive== Not to be confused with [[#NPC Exclusive|NPC exlusive]] status effects, these are effects that are applied by Players and '''only''' work in PvE. ==={{anch|Chain of Perfection|Perfection}}=== Applied through the {{t|Chain of Perfection}} Talent, gain a final +5% damage buff to your attacks in PvE per Perfection stack above 5, capping at +100% damage with 25 stacks (the first five stacks do not contribute to the damage buff). Perfection acts as a final damage multiplier, bypassing the damage modifier cap entirely. Perfection stacks are gained through dealing damage to NPCs, gaining 0.5 stacks per hit, doubled for weapon attacks. You cannot get more than 3 stacks from any attack. All Perfection stacks will be lost if you take damage from any non-self damage source (excluding fall damage). Perfection stacks can also be consumed for the {{t|Finishing Slay}} Talent from the [[Messer]], dealing damage based on the amount of Perfection stacks you had when your critical landed. Signified by a translucent white chain halo rotating on your head, visible only to you. File:Chainsofperfection.gif ===Stagger=== Increase the amount of posture damage your opponent takes by 33%. This effect can be applied through a multitude of Talents. ===Collapsed=== Upon proccing {{t|Collapsed Lung|r=advanced}} on a PvE enemy, also apply the Collapsed status effect to them. While affected, enemies deal 40% less posture damage to you. ==={{anch|Confused|Confusion}}=== When proccing [[Harrowing]] on a PvE enemy, apply Confusion to them for 12 seconds. Confused enemies have a 5% chance to hit themselves instead of their intended target when landing attacks, nullifying their attack, stunning them, and dealing their damage back to themselves. The Confusion effect is signified by yellow question marks around the enemy's head. The attack redirection is signified by a yellow circle on the attack's target. ===Ether Sunder=== Gain +30% elemental damage reduction against PvE targets for the duration of Ether Sunder. This effect can be applied from the {{t|Chronostasis}}, {{t|Dark Waltz}}, and {{t|Sightless Still}} Talents. ===Gem Enhancement=== Upon proccing {{t|Vasculitis}} on a PvE enemy or using the {{t|Elegy of Light}} Talent Tool, gain the Gem Enhancement status effect. This effectively applies the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} to all of your [[Deep Gem]]s that apply on hit; *[[Aegis Gem]]: Duration increased from 10s to 15s. *[[Blessed Gem]]: Cooldown reduction is increased from -50% to -66%. *[[Bloodless Gem]]: Heal cap increased from 15 to 20. *[[Insignia Gem]]: No noticeable difference. *[[Might Gem]]: Posture damage buff increased from +10% to +15%. *[[Nocturnal Gem]]: Damage is increased from 10 to 15. *[[Wayward Gem]]: Cooldown is reduced from 8s to 3s. *[[Wind Gem]]: {{status|Speed Boost|Speed boost}} duration increased from 10s to 15s. *[[Wrath Gem]]: Critical damage buff per-combat tag increased from 7.5% to 15%. ===Gale Reflection=== Upon killing a PvE enemy while having the {{t|Gale Trap}} Talent, gain the Gale Reflection status effect. The next time any PvE enemy attempts to hit you, you will gain damage reduction to the attack and they will be Gale Trapped, dealing damage to them. This can also proc if you parry or block their attack. The damage this deals is based on the maximum health of the target you killed. ===Heal Boost=== Increase the amount of offensive healing (e.g. [[Bloodless Gem]]s) gained from attacking targets who are affected by your {{status|Anti-Heal}}. Each {{status|Anti-Heal}} Talent grants a different amount of Heal Boost. These Talents are: {{t|All Above, Gods Below|r=advanced}} (+15%), {{t|All the Dead Gods|r=rare}} (+5%), {{t|Frostbite}} (+5%),{{t|Saint Jay|r=rare}} (+10%), and {{t|Sin Stacker|r=rare}} (+10%) for a maximum possible Heal Boost of 45%. ===Sluggish=== Upon proccing specific Talents and abilities that apply a slowing effect, also proc Sluggish. This effect reduces the damage enemies deal by 15%, with its duration being based on the slow that procced this effect. ===Madness=== [{{iv|Vow of Iron}} Exclusive] Applied through the {{iv|Strange Merchant}} Memento's [[Talents#Toxic Personality (Vow of Iron)|Toxic Personality]] Talent tree, this effect causes non-player enemies to attack eachother instead of the caster. Additionally, non-player enemies affected by Madness will not be able to deal damage to or hitstun the caster. '''This effect does not work on bosses.''' Signified by pink circles around the eyes of affected targets. ==NPC Exclusive== Not to be confused with [[#PvE Exclusive|PvE exclusive]] status effects, these, almost always harmful, status effects are exclusively used by and applied from Monsters or other non playable characters. ==={{anch|Time Stasis}}=== Applied by standing in the time stasis bubble made by the [[Knives of Eylis Captain|Knives of Eylis Captains]] and [[Semblance]] NPCs. Have your screen gray-scaled, movement speed and attack speed lowered heavily. Can be removed by hitting and breaking the center of the time bubble or by walking out of its range. ==={{anch|Venom}}=== This can be applied by being hit by the [[Deep Widow|Deep Widow's]] venomous bite. While inflicted with venom, your HP will drain at a moderate pace, it will bypass armor and instantly grip you if you were to get downed from its damage. There is no visual indicator for this. ==={{anch|Magma Flow}}=== Monsters in [[Saramaed Hollow]] have a chance to spawn with Magma Flow, this chance increases the deeper you go. When a Magma Flow-affected Monster hits you or another Monster with any attack, they'll apply Magma Flow, weakening your armor resistances and nullifying all Monster Armor temporarily. Monsters can spawn in with Magma Flow, Magma Guard, and being Attuned, in fact it is a common occurrence for Monsters to have at least 2 of these effects at once on the lower floors. Signified by a dripping lava effect on your character and the Monster who has this effect. File:lavadrip.gif|A [[Mechalodaunt]] with Magma Flow ==={{anch|Magma Guard}}=== Monsters in [[Saramaed Hollow]] have a chance to spawn with Magma Guard, this chance increases the deeper you go. Magma Guarded Monsters are immune to any Damage vs Monsters effect. Monsters can spawn in with Magma Guard, Magma Flow, and being Attuned, in fact it is a common occurrence for Monsters to have at least 2 of these effects at once on the lower floors. These monsters have exteriors encrusted with magma and rock. File:lavaarmor.gif|A [[Mechalodaunt]] with Magma Guard ==={{cl|Attuned}}{{invanch|Attuned}}=== The effects of this status effect depends on which [[Attunement]] the Monsters are attuned to. Some Monsters are always Attuned to a specific Attunement (e.g. [[Fury Nautilodaunt|Fury Nautilodaunts]] (Thundercall) or [[Glacial Lionfish]] (Frostdraw)). This effect can also be applied to humanoid enemies within [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]. Additionally, Monsters can spawn as both Attuned and another effect such as being Corrupted or having Magma Flow and/or Magma Guard. *{{cl|attnfir|Flamewreathed}} - [[Flamecharm]]: Flamewreathed Monsters apply {{status|Burn}} with their attacks. This is a unique burn variant that is harder to remove. Additionally, Flamewreathed Monsters have 50% Flamecharm resistance, but take double damage from Galebreathe. Signified by the Monster being engulfed in flames. *{{cl|attnice|Frostmantle}} - [[Frostdraw]]: Frostmantled Monsters apply {{status|Chill}} and create ice patches on the floor with all of their attacks. Additionally, Frostmantled Monsters have 50% Frostdraw resistance, but take double damage from Flamecharm. Signified by the Monster radiating with frost. *{{cl|attnwnd|Galeforce}} - [[Galebreathe]]: Galeforce Monsters apply {{status|Winded}} and/or {{status|Suffocate|Suffocation}} on hit. These Monsters also have increased movement speed and deal extra knockback. Additionally, Galeforce Monsters have 50% Galebreathe resistance, but take double damage from Thundercall. Signified by the Monster emanating the winds. *{{cl|attnltn|Thunderstruck}} - [[Thundercall]]: Thunderstruck Monsters apply {{status|Shock}} on hit, making them very dangerous, especially in group settings. Additionally, Thunderstruck Monsters have 50% Thundercall resistance, but take double damage from Frostdraw. Signified by the Monster cackling with electricity. *{{cl|attnsdw|Shadowmeld}} - [[Shadowcast]]: Shadowmeld Monsters steal ether on hit. Additionally, Shadowmeld Monsters have 50% Physical resistance, but take double damage from all Attunements. Signified by the Monster exuding a black aura. ==={{cl|Corrupt}}=== Monsters within [[The Depths]] have a chance to spawn Corrupt, boasting a much higher health pool and increased damage. This chance is made guaranteed during [[Hell Mode]] and during your [[Cathedral of the Interstice|Depths Trial]] if you have the Deep Champion [[Echo Modifier]]. Additionally, ringing the black bells within the [[First Layer]] will increase the odds of surrounding Monsters spawning corrupt. Signified by a dark purple aura on the Monster. File:Corruptedmob.gif|A Corrupted [[Mudskipper Brute]] ==Other== ==={{anch|Acid}}=== Not to be confused with Acid Rain, this effect refers to the large pools of Acid found in [[Erisia]]. When standing in these pools, you will lose a small amount of your health and armor at a time. If your health reaches 0 or if you're unconscious while in Acid, your character will instantly die. This is relatively uncommon as the acid pools can easily be avoided by parkour or by jumping right after touch the acid, but it can pose a danger if you are being chased into a pool of acid. ===[ Coral Fever ]=== This effect happened on April 1 of 2023 and it was obtained either when you got stabbed by a [[Megalodaunt|Megalodaunt's]] Coral Spear, got scratched by a [[Megalodaunt]] or you got sneezed on by a [[Megalodaunt]] or emoting near the [[The Great Sharko Rumbling|Great Sharko Rumbling]] statue in [[Etris Docks]]. When obtained, you were greeted by [[Destroyman III]] and you couldn’t get rid of him, unless you emoted near the same statue again, which will destroy [[Destroyman III]]. [[Category:Mechanics]]

title: Staves
content:
==Description== Staves are polearm weapons with two blunt ends. Staves specialize in follow-up strikes featuring the opposite end of your Staff. These attacks, triggered by pressing {{input|k|feint}} after triggering the conditional for {{t|Both Ends}} or {{t|Counter Strike}}, deal 45% of your weapon's damage. These attacks are much faster than a standard basic attack, and have the [[M1 tag]], allowing them to proc M1-exclusive [[Talents]] and [[Enchantment]] effects. The follow-up strikes have a 1 second cooldown, shared between all Talents that trigger them. Typically, these weapons can freely swap between the One and Two-Handed stances. ==Default Animations==

title: Stealth
content:
{{Quotes|quote=We head to the Erisian Village to become acquainted with the STEALTH. Unfortunately for the Bandits, it's completely optional|author=A basic description of a fairly useless stat.}} [[File:Stealth.png|thumb|Vesperian crouched, increasing their stealth]] '''Stealth''' is a [[:Category:Mechanics|Mechanic]] that allows the player to stay hidden from people. NPCs and monsters alike have a cone of vision in which they can spot the player, resulting in them attacking. Improving stealth makes that cone smaller, reducing from how far player can be seen. == Modifications == '''Stealth''' can be improved in several ways. *Crouching. This increases your Stealth by 50% multiplicatively and adds a flat +50% Stealth afterwards.
CrouchingStealth = Stealth \times 1.5 + 50 *Improving your [[Agility]] will improve your Stealth. **Every point of [[Agility]] grants +0.2% Stealth. **Passive Agility does '''not''' grant Stealth. *The [[Felinor]] aspect starts with +20% Stealth and has a 1.2x multiplier on Stealth gain. **The Stealth gain multiplier does not apply to Stealth gained from crouching, {{t|Lowstride}}, Felinor's flat stealth, Tacet, or {{t|Taced Minimization}}. *The {{t|Lowstride}} Talent doubles the Stealth bonuses from crouching; increasing your Stealth by 100% multiplicatively and adding +100% flat Stealth, while crouching.
LowstrideStealth = Stealth \times 2 + 100 *Being in [[Tacet]] provides +400% flat Stealth. Tacet's Stealth cannot receive Stealth gain multipliers. **This is doubled to +800% if you are using {{t|Tacet Minimization}} from the [[Authority Ensign]] Origin. *The [[Sly]] Boon grands +15% Stealth. *The [[Obvious]] Flaw grants -20% Stealth. *{{cl|lh|Equipping specific Outfits}}: **[[Darkened Bastion]], [[Familiar Assassin's Armor]], [[Inquisition Light]], [[Navaen Nomad Robes]], [[Navaen War Chief]], and [[Whaler Coat]] all grant +50% Stealth. **[[Grand Pathfinder Cloak]] grants +40% Stealth. **[[Whaler Initiate]] grants +25% Stealth. **{{cl|lh|Some Outfits have the {{t|Lowstride}} Talent}}: ***[[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]], [[Diver Journeyman Robes]], [[Hive Adjudicator]], [[Hive Drone]], [[Pathfinder Sorcerer]], [[Pathfinder Thaumaturge]], [[Shadow Hunter]], and [[Steel Plate]] *Wearing the following Equipment: **{{text|lhhead}}: ***[[Dark Owl Chapeau]] and [[Mercenary's Hood]] grant 10% Stealth. ***[[Bloodfeather Cowl]], [[Bloodcurdle Cowl]], and [[Necrotic Cowl]] grant 6% Stealth. ***[[Assassin's Hood]], [[Rogue Assassin's Hood]], [[Monastery Cowl]], [[Gale Enhanced Cowl]], and [[Hallowed Monastery Cowl]] grant 5% Stealth. ***[[Dark Cowl]] and [[Plain Hood]] grant 4% Stealth. **{{text|lharms}}: ***[[Dark Owl Cloak]], [[Mercenary's Garb]], [[Bounty Hunter's Garb]], [[Ministry Operative Cloak]], and [[Prophet's Operative Cloak]] grant 6% Stealth. ***[[Sandrunner Wraps]] grants 4% Stealth. ***[[Assassin's Cloak]] grants 3% Stealth. **{{text|lhlegs}}: N/A **{{text|lhtorso}}: ***[[Shrouded Cape]] grants 5% Stealth. ***[[Dark Owl Cape]] grants 2% Stealth. **{{text|lhface}}: ***[[Duelist Mask]], [[Corrupted Duelist Mask]] grant 6% Stealth. **{{text|lhears}}: ***[[Master Thief Earrings]], [[Assassin's Earrings]], and [[Ossified Blood Earrings]] grant 3% Stealth. **{{text|lhrings}}: N/A **{{cl|lh|Some Equipment items have the {{t|Lowstride}} Talent}}: ***[[Assassin's Cloak]], [[Hive Scourge Cuirass]], and [[Tracker's Boots]] '''Calculator [https://www.desmos.com/calculator/ar6qiytogo here].''' ===Maximum Stealth=== The current maximum Stealth possible is '''1,130%''' or '''1,216%''', depending on your Aspect; *[[Felinor]] - 140% maximum base Stealth, 260% when crouching, and 380% with {{t|Lowstride}}. **A [[Sly]] [[Felinor]] - 158% maximum base Stealth, 287% when crouching, and 416% with {{t|Lowstride}}. **An [[Obvious]] [[Felinor]] - 112% maximum base Stealth, 218% when crouching, and 324% with {{t|Lowstride}}. *Any other Aspect - 100% maximum base Stealth, 200% when Crouching, and 300% with {{t|Lowstride}}. **With [[Sly]] - 115% maximum base Stealth, 222.5% when crouching, and 330% with {{t|Lowstride}}. **With [[Obvious]] - 80% maximum base Stealth, 170% when crouching, and 260% with {{t|Lowstride}}. *[[Tacet]] provides 400% flat Stealth while active, and an additional 400% if you are using {{t|Tacet Minimization}}. *In the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode, the [[Rogue Assassin]] Memento can reach a maximum Stealth value of '''1,120''' or '''1,204%''', depending on the Ironsworn's Aspect. This Memento has 150 Agility when Power 20 alongside having access to Lowstride, Tacet, and Tacet Minimization. ==Usage== ===General=== Against NPCs, Stealth affects the range where they can detect you. The higher your Stealth, the closer you have to be for them to detect you and vice versa. Against players, Stealth outside of Tacet is suboptimal if your opponent has a functional monitor. However, there are two Talents that allow Stealth to provide benefits in PvP; *{{t|Fatal Stealth}} from the [[Authority Ensign]] Origin grants a 0.2% damage buff for every 1% Stealth gained from '''equipment''' or '''outfit''' sources. This buff only applies to attacks that hit your opponent's back, however. Due to equipment limitations, this damage buff (currently) caps out at +16% damage. *{{t|Merc Blade}} from the [[Mercenary's Hood]] equipment grants +1 flat damage on all attacks for every 10% Stealth you have. It is unknown if Stealth gained from unconventional sources (crouching, Lowstride, Tacet, or Tacet Minimization) affect this Talent. This item, and its Talent, are exclusive to the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. ===Crouching=== Crouching is activated by pressing {{Input|keybind|crouch}}. When crouched: *Parkour is restricted and Stealth is increased. *Players can assassinate other humanoids by pressing {{Input|keybind|M1}} behind them while crouched. You must be out of combat to assassinate unless you have the {{t|Dustlunge}} Talent. **It is important to not ''hold'' the crouch key, as this may perform an uppercut instead. **Against players, assassinations deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage. Initially starting at 15%, you gain 0.1% assassination damage per point in [[Agility]], capping at 25% with 100 Agility. **Against humanoid NPCs, assassinations deal large damage, though you can increase the damage further with the {{t|Deep Wound}} Talent. **Some NPCs such as the [[Songseeker Flamecharmer|Songseekers]] at [[Songseeker Wilds]] or the [[Ministry Necromancer]]s at [[Minityrsa]] are immune to assassinations, along with all non-humanoid Monsters such as [[Megalodaunt]]s. *Players can activate [[Murmur: Tacet]], a Murmur that turns the player invisible in Stealth. **[[Tacet]] has a range, or a bubble, where the player is visible to all other players who are also inside the bubble. The range of this bubble scales inversely with both [[Power]] and Stealth. **The size of the Tacet bubble caps at 100% Stealth; going above 100% Stealth causes the size to increase instead, due to a bug. *Players can activate [[Murmur: Rhythm]], a Murmur that pinpoints the locations of nearby entities and highlights how much current health they have compared to their maximum health by making them "pulse". When an NPC detects you or an different NPC they are enemies with, a dark yellow '''"!"''' will appear above their head. Enemies who are alert are unable to be assassinated. File:AlertBandit.png|An alert bandit == Trivia == *There's a very small chance the Metal Gear Solid alert sound effect will play when enemies notice you. [[Category:Mechanics]]

title: Steampunk Soldier
content:
{{IronVowEx}} {{Quotes|quote=Succeed in showing that superior firepower triumphs over all.|author=Steampunk Soldier obtainment hint}} {{Memento |name=Steampunk Soldier |image=Steampunk Soldier Memento.png |description=Combining frost and flame, they developed a unique steam-powered rifle. |final attributes=*60 Flamecharm *60 Frostdraw *80 Medium Weapon *25 Strength *25 Fortitude *40 Agility *25 Intelligence *25 Willpower |final traits=*5 Songchant *3 Proficiency *3 Vitality *2 Dexterity |starting health=175 |allowed weapons=Rifle |starting armor=[[Stranded]] |starting weapons=[[Vapormaw Carbine]] |unlock=Defeat [[Shogun Captain]], [[Dravik, The Rat King]], or [[True Heart of Enmity]] with a Pistol, Rifle, or Greatcannon weapon
([[Rifle Spear]] counts) |starting attributes=*3 Flamecharm *3 Frostdraw *4 Medium Weapon *2 Strength *2 Fortitude *2 Agility *2 Intelligence *2 Willpower|starting traits=*3 Songchant *2 Proficiency *1 Vitality *1 Dexterity}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. It is unlocked by defeating any of the three main progression bosses with a gun-type weapon; a Pistol, Rifle, or Greatcannon. The [[Rifle Spear]] counts as a Rifle and a spear, meaning many Mementos can equip it and it counts for the obtainment requirement of this Memento. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Steampunk Soldier}} [Memento Talent] - Increase the size of your steam which you activate Flashboil. Flashboil's cooldown is also reduced. *Boiling Point [Common Talent] - Using a fire mantra near your own steam cloud detonates it. **Landing a Flamecharm Mantra on one of your steam clouds causes the cloud to detonate, dealing 10 damage in an AoE. **Because this procs when the steam cloud is hit and not the player, even if your opponent parries your Mantra, it will still detonate your steam. **Has a short delay which can throw players off. **Generally this Talent is not worth taking, as the steam itself will out damage it, and having a stage hazard can be quite useful. **The detonation is unparryable, unblockable, and bypasses armor resistances. *Flashboil [Common Talent] - Landing Ice/fire attacks on burning/chilled enemies extinguishes the flame and generates steam. **Dealing Frostdraw damage to a burning target or Flamecharm damage to a chilled target removes the burn and creates a ''stationary'' steam cloud. ***The burn status effect doesn't count as "Flamecharm damage" for this Talent, meaning if you apply burn via Agitating Spark, Immolation, or some other non-Flamecharm damaging source to a chilled target, nothing will happen. **Steam clouds deal 2 damage per tick in an AoE at a rate similar to burn's. **Steam clouds are unparryable, unblockable, and bypass armor resistances. **Steam clouds last 10 seconds and have an internal proc cooldown '''per target''' of 10 seconds. **This Talent is incredibly good for PvE in high mob density areas because of the AoE nature and long duration per cloud. Additionally, you can create a large amount of steam clouds at the same time by hitting multiple mobs at once. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Flame Grab (☆☆☆) |image=FlameGrab.gif |desc=Jet forwards with flames and slam anyone you catch in your clutches. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=N/A |effect=User lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. *Has a base damage of 15/20/25/30/35 per level with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *Deals 6 posture damage. *Has a 0.6 second windup with a 10 second cooldown. *Has a large hitbox both horizontally and backwards. *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Inflicts Burn. *Travels for 0.6 seconds. *[[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]] increase the duration (distance travelled). }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ice Daggers (★☆☆) |image=ice_daggers.gif |desc=Form and toss daggers of ice at your aimed opponent. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=N/A |effect=''Form 3 daggers of ice before throwing them towards the nearest target.'' *Has a base damage of 5/6/7/8/9 per level, per hit (3) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 1 posture damage per dagger (3). *Has a 13 second cooldown (4 seconds if whiffed entirely or used when not aimed at an opponent). *Has 9.18x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18 for PvE damage). *Projectiles have homing. *Does not inflict Chill. *Consumes Ether even if desired target is out of range. Mantra goes on a 4 second cooldown if no target is within range. *If used in water, the daggers won't spawn. *Can grant an additional effect with the '' ===Starting Deck===
*Battle Tendency [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen. (+2 Posture, +10 Sanity) **In combat, by not running/blocking regenerate posture passively, Battle Tendency increases this regen by +20%. *Cauterized Wounds [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blood loss from all sources is lowered. (+1 Passive Agility) **Effectiveness of this Talent is reduced if you are using the [[Curse of the No Life King]] enchantment. *Cool Head [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If set on fire while on ice, immediately put it out and gain the Cool Head status for 30s. During Cool Head, you cannot be lit on fire. 15s cooldown **While the effect is active, the user breathes cold air. *Disbelief [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You're resistant to the effects of Illusion magic. You are resistant to charms and tricks. (+5 Sanity) **Halves the duration of the Charmed status effect and Illusionary Servant casted against you. ***Tough Love: 2s -> 1s ***Overcharm's Basic Attacks and [[Kyrsieger]] critical attack: 5s -> 2.5s ***Unnecessary Theatrics (at reqs): 7s -> 3.5s ***[[Dread Whisper]] and [[Sing]]: 7.5s -> 3.25s ***Overcharm's self-charm proc: 8s -> 4s ***Charismatic Cast, [[Enchantments#Equipment|Allure]]: 10s -> 5s ***Chaotic Charm, [[Oath: Fadetrimmer#Hair Spray|Fadetrimmer's Charming Spray]]: 15s -> 7.5s ***Lasting Charisma (at reqs): 20s -> 10s *Gourmand [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your hunger and thirst gain from eating increased. (+2 Carry Load, +1 Posture) *Hell's Partisan [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above. (+4 Sanity) **Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. **This is parryable, but is not blockable nor dodgeable due to hitstun. *Iron Gut [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You have resistance against being poisoned by foods. **Does not work when eating [[Fishing|Pufferfish]] (gamebreaking). *Kick Off [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall. (+6 Passive Agility) **Causes '''''all''''' falls to be considered "shorter" by 10 studs, also reducing larger falls. **Increases climb distance by ~15% when off cooldown. **Slide jumping now also slightly increases climb distance. **Has a cooldown of 3 seconds. *Martyr [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Enemies gain less health and posture when knocking you. **Enemies who knock you restore only half of the posture and health they would normally obtain (50% -> 25%). **If the enemy have the Talent Replenishing Knockout, both Talents negate each other, resulting in a normal health pack. *Moving Fortress [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking no longer slows you down as much. (+1 Posture) **Increases your movement speed while blocking by 5%, from -25% movement speed to a -20%. *Old Habits Die Hard [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Blocking an attack with your lingering block frames after failing a parry will cause the attack to deal 15% less posture damage. (+5 Health) *Pack Mule [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - The max quantity for food you can hold is increased by 5. (+1 Carry Load) *Produce Spark [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - A simple production of Flame for the use of making Campfires. **Grants a Talent tool that works like an infinite [[Flint]]. *Target Switch [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Parrying an opponent then hitting someone else makes your next mantra free. **This effect is signalled by a yellow halo. **Has a 4 second activation window with a 10 second duration. **This talent will still proc if you hit a knocked enemy. *{{cl|raretlnf|Armor Piercing}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - {{ttag|Guns}} Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied. **Mathematically speaking, Armor Piercing is effectively a multiplicative 10% increase to your PEN against blunt armor, applied '''after''' all other PEN sources, meaning Armor Piercing has heavy diminishing returns based on how much PEN you have. ***While at 0% PEN, this effectively grants +10% PEN against blunt armor, but this amount gets reduced by 1% for every 10% PEN you have. The formula is as follows: (1 - ((1 - Current PEN/100) *(1 - 0.1))) *100 = effective PEN against blunt armor. ***For example: having 20% PEN + Armor Piercing is equivalent to having 28% PEN against blunt armor (+8). **Specific rifles benefit less from Armor Piercing than others due to their damage typings. ***For [[Rosen's Hellflame]], it will only circumstantially benefit from Armor Piercing, because of its elemental damage. ****In some circumstances, Armor Piercing may give your opponent higher weighting on their elemental resistances by lowering their blunt resistance, causing them to resist your damage based on their elemental resistance instead. Alternatively, if they have higher elemental resistance than blunt resistance, Armor Piercing will do nothing at all. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Fire Forge (★☆☆) |image=Fire_forge(2).gif |desc=Toss a nimble dagger. |ethercost={{stats|ether|55 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|flamecharm|Fire}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=User throws 3 quick burning daggers. *Both variants are currently bugged to where their hitbox will almost always not be present. (1st September 2025) *Has a base damage of 8.33/9.33/10.33/11.33/12.33 per level, per hit (3) with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *The Tornado Spark variant has a base damage of 4.17/4.67/5.17/5.67/6.17 per level, per hit (10) with 2.75 Flamecharm scaling. *The base variant deals 4 posture damage per dagger, while the Tornado spark variant deals 3 posture damage per dagger with an additional 5 posture damage per tornado hit (2). *Has a 10 second cooldown. *Has 8.45x PvE scaling (multiply damage dealt by 8.45 for PvE damage). *Does '''not''' inflict Burn. *Breaks destructible terrain on hit. *Can be upgraded with the "'''Hell's Partisan'''" Talent, summoning a flame spear that ragdolls and inflicts burn after you land 3 flame daggers. *Can be modified with [[Crystal Lens|Crystal]]/[[Perfect Lens]] to make the daggers move faster. *Can be modified with a [[Tornado Spark]] to make it throw 5 unparryable daggers in a straight line. Each dagger hits twice. File:Fire Forge Tornado Spark.gif|Tornado Spark }} {{MantraInfobox|end |name=Ice Lance (★★☆) |image=ice_lance.gif |desc=Form an ice spear and lunges forward. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''Conjure a spear of ice while lunging forward; if hit, impale the spear into the target before detonating it upon impact.'' *Has a base damage of 20/24/28/32/36 per level with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *The Lance shatter has a base damage of 5/6/7/8/9 per level with 5 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 4/5/6/7/8 posture damage per level. *Has a cooldown of 12 seconds. *The first hit has 9.18x PvE scaling, the second hit has 6.5x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.18/6.5x for PvE damage). *Inflicts 2 seconds of Chill on the initial hit. This Chill duration can be increased with [[Mantra Modifiers|Aeon]] and [[Eternal Logstone]]s. *You can press block during the windup to cancel the impale. *Both the impact and the detonation are parriable. *User gains considerable forward momentum on use. }}
===Power 5===
*Agitating Spark [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If you hit an opponent that you've lit on fire, it spreads to anyone nearby. Including yourself. **On proc, a small orange particle will trail between the burning target you hit and other targets nearby, setting them on fire. ***This visual effect will still happen when hitting a non-burning target with a burn-applying attack, granting Emperor Flame stacks without spreading burn. **Agitating Spark bypasses block and parry. **Agitating Spark procs caused by self damage will not apply burn. Flame Within is an exception to this. **Has a 1 second cooldown. **Can spread to allies. *Bottom Freeze [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Hitting chilled enemies with Ice Projectiles while they are on ice freezes them to the ground. **Prevents you from rotating your character and moving around overall. *Flaming Flourish [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. **You also apply burn on enemies by swinging uppercut nearby. Aka doesn't have to be a hit to apply burn. *Immolation [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. (+8 Sanity) **"Self-Inflicted flames" include Flame Within, Agitating Spark you spread and environmental burns created by you. **"Apply fire damage" applies the burn status effect instead of adding Flamecharm damage. It also applies burn even if you have Eruption Path: Lava Serpent. ***Not all attacks proc this effect, unlike what the Talent description implies. Instead, all instances of Physical damage apply burn, even if the attack doesn't deal pure Physical damage (e.g. [[Clutching Shadow]] or [[Metal Eruption]]). And all attacks that have the slash (blood particle) vfx on hit like [[Ice Daggers]] or [[Gale Lunge]] will also proc Immolation, applying burn. *{{cl|raretlnf|Frozen Pin-Cushion}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Ice Daggers now freeze opponents. *{{cl|raretlnf|True Ether Bullets}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Using Ether Bullets applies elemental damage of your highest investment. **Landing 2 shots will make the 3rd shot deal elemental damage. ***The 3rd shot apply your attunement's elemental effect: ****Flamecharm: Your bullets apply burn/eruption (Lava Serpent) ****Frostdraw: Your bullets apply chill/crystal (Crystallization) ****The other Attunements' effects are not listed here due to being irrelevant to this Memento. See the [[Talents#True Ether Bullets|Talents page]] for this Talent's full effect. ***If the user has multiple attunement at the same level, it will use the first attunement in the priority list: Thundercall > Shadowcast > Flamecharm > Galebreathe > Frostdraw **This Talent does not make guns scale off your attunement attribute, it just converts your Physical Damage to Elemental Damage. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Ice Cubes (★★★) |image=Ice_Cubes.gif |desc=Manifest cubes of Ice to fire at your enemies. Cast the Mantra again to fire cubes. |ethercostesc={{stats|ether|45 Ether}} (Summon), {{stats|ether|45 Ether}} (Fire Manually), {{stats|ether|0 Ether}} (Fired Automatically) |dmgtype={{stats|frostdraw|Ice}} |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs={{c|notes|450}} |effect=''Conjure 3 ice cubes above the user that are on standby and throws them to where their cursor is. Costs 45 Ether to summon the ice cubes and 45 Ether to fire them manually for a total of 90 Ether cost. However, if they're fired off automatically, it costs no Ether.'' *Has a base damage of 8/10/12/14/16 per level, per hit (3) with 2.75 Frostdraw scaling. *Deals 5 posture damage per hit (3). *Has 9.178x PvE scaling (multiply scaled damage dealt by 9.178 for PvE damage). *Projectiles have homing. *Does not inflict Chill. *Has a good amount of range. *Can be modified with a [[Multiplying Spark]] to cause the Mantra to send out each projectile individually. Ice Cubes Multiplying Spark.gif|Multiplying Spark }}
===Power 10===
*Explosive Finish [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - If an enemy is on fire when you flourish, blast them away with a fire blast. **the equation for this damage is: (weapon damage + 1 blunt damage + 5 flame damage) **Upon proccing Emperor Flame, this Talent will be put on a 3s cd. *Fragile Freeze [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Your Light Attacks and Critical will now freeze chilled opponents on guardbreak. **Guardbreaking a chilled opponent with a weapon attack will encase them in ice, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time. **Taking damage by any source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early. **You can spam F to get out of Freeze faster. *Stock Bash [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - {{ttag|Rifles}} Your running attacks now apply a brief amount of daze. **Applies daze for one second. *{{cl|raretlnf|Frozen Legs}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Your slow effect prevents your opponents from rolling. **Lasts the first 0.75 seconds after chill/freeze procs. **Only procs off mantras. *{{cl|raretlnf|Leg Shot}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - {{ttag|Rifles}} Landing your critical slows your enemy for a bit, and also disables any speed boosts they get for the next 10 seconds.
===Power 15===
*Emperor Flame [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Absorb fire produced by you, once you reach 5 stacks your next attack will be an automatic Explosive Finish flourish. This flourish will deal additional damage and proc Wither, reducing your opponent's maximum health temporarily. **Landing a basic attack while you have the Emperor Flame status effect will proc the flourish, dealing 15 Flamecharm damage, 25 Wither damage, and applying burn to the victim and anyone else nearby. This cannot proc on knocked enemies and does not proc Dazing Finisher. **The Emperor Flame status effect lasts 10 seconds or until you land a basic attack. Emperor Flame has a 30 second cooldown. **Hitting enemies with attacks that apply burn will grant Emperor Flame stacks. This will proc regardless of if the target is currently burning or not. There is a 2 second cooldown for stack gain. **Emperor Flame extinguishes burn applied to yourself through Agitating Spark. If Emperor Flame is on cooldown, your self applied burn will not be extinguished. *{{cl|raretlnf|Tactical Reload}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - {{ttag|Rifles}} Activate to make your rifle shoot bullets for 15 seconds. (90 second CD) **Upon activating the Talent tool, your rifle will gain the ability to fire [[Bullets]] for 15 seconds, with a downtime of 75 seconds. **You do not need to have physical bullets in your inventory for this to work. **Has a 45 second cooldown instead if you are wielding the [[Rosen's Peacemaker]], giving it a downtime of only 30 seconds. **This talent has no effect on [[Rifle Spear]]. *{{cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode. **Does not have a cooldown. **Deals 5 Flamecharm damage. **Will not proc on knocked NPCs/players and mobs. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Flame Wisp (★★☆) |image=FlameWisp.gif |desc=A servant of flames. |ethercost={{stats|ether|70 Ether}} |mantratype=Wisp Mantra |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|950}} |effect=''The caster summons a wisp of magma. Ritual Casted.'' *Flame Wisp reduces the burn damage you deal by 20% and turns the damage it reduced into healing. This affects ALL burn tick damage you do, whether it be on yourself or others. *Ignites nearby campfire pits if not currently healing you. *Converts about 25-30 burning damage total. [[Aeon Logstone|Logstones]] increase the amount of burn it can convert. **Logstones will increase the amount of keys in the Ritual Cast. }}
==Boss Unlocks==
===Shogun of the Prophet's Guard=== {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end|name=Steam Grenade (☆☆☆) |image=Steam Grenade.gif |desc=Fire a steam grenade at your opponent and create a massive area of steam. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype=(?) |mantratype=Combat Mantra |reqs=defeat [[Shogun of the Prophet's Guard (Temple of Mur)]] |effect=''Fire a grenade of steam out of the underbarrel of your Carbine.'' *Instantly creates a steam cloud on hit. }} ===Dravik, The Rat King=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Mist Mobility}} [Memento Talent] - Anytime you proc Boiling Point, increase the speed at which you reload your Vapormaw Carbine and increase your Critical Attack's fire rate. **Despite what the description states, this actually procs when you activate Flashboil, and not Boiling Point. ===True Heart of Enmity=== *{{cl|mementotlnf|Explosive Ignition}} [Memento Talent] - Ignite nearby steam, causing a large explosion. **Grants a Talent tool, that when used while standing inside of a steam cloud causes a very large explosion after a delay, dealing high damage and consuming the Steam cloud.

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage-dealing equipment [[enchantment]] that creates a lingering damage cloud on proc.

==Effect==
Upon taking damage, {{PAGENAME}} has a 20% chance to proc. On proc, create a stench cloud that deals 1% of your opponent's maximum health per tick. This ticks 3 times, totaling to 3% damage dealt.

This has a 40 second cooldown.

===Notes===
*Stench cannot deal more than 10 damage per tick, heavily limiting its use in PvE.
*This enchant is very buggy against humanoids in PvE, sometimes dealing massive bursts of damage if an enemy lingers in the cloud.
*Stench's gas is 360 blockable, dealing 0 posture damage when blocked.

'''Sticks''' are an [[Ingredients|Ingredient]] used to craft tools and other materials.

== Obtainment ==
Sticks can be can be obtained in a few ways:

*Littered on the ground around most trees.
*Crafted with one (1) [[Wood]].

== Uses ==
Sticks can be used for the following:

* Crafting a [[Gliders|Glider]] or [[Gliders|Sharkscale Glider]].
* Crafting three (3) Sticks together into one (1) [[Wood]].
* Crafting three (3) Sticks together into one (1) [[Campfire|Campfire Pit]].
* Summoning [[Primadon, Titan of the East]] with ninety nine (99) Sticks.
* Brew seemingly useless [[Alchemy|potions]].

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300">
File:Stick by tree.png|Sticks beside a tree.

== Trivia ==
*Sticks cannot be traded to [[Korin]] or [[Drefa]], they need to be crafted into Wood.
*Sticks were remodeled in the September 15th, 2025 update, to be "considerably less laggy."

Blizzard Knights are a far stronger version of the Stone Knight, spawning in a pack of 6 in [[The Valley of Heroes]] during Winter, introduced as a trap by [[Aelita]] telling you to "come back during the winter for more fun". Moss Knights are similar to Desert Knights, spawning in singles in [[Bluster Rift]]. This monster only spawns in [[Vow of Iron]]. [[Moon Knight]]s are stronger and contain a few unique moves. [[Star Knight]] is almost the same, but instead is a [[Random_Encounters#Resonant_Dawn|very rare encounter]] that guaranteed drops an [[Astral]] [[Enchant Stone]] and contains a meteorite that immediately grants a [[Resonance]]. {{clear}} ==Moveset== {| class="sortable fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |

(★☆☆) |Swings its sword at the opponent once or twice. *'''Insta-executes the player if health is low.''' {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Stone Knight slashes.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Kick'''
(★★★) |Deftly kicks the opponent with added momentum from its body. *Deals extra damage and dazes if the player is slammed against a wall. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Stone Knight Kick.gif|border|frameless]] |- |

'''Terra Eruption'''
(★★☆) |Punches the ground, causing a pillar to erupt below the player. *The next attack from the Stone Knight is guaranteed to hit if the player is hit by Terra Eruption first. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.fyw, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Stone Knight Pillar.gif|border|frameless]] |} ===Passives=== *'''Artificial Construct''' - The [[Bloodless Gem]] does not work against Stone Knights as they don't have blood. *'''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal ??? less damage to Stone Knights. ==Finisher== A Stone Knight executes the player: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |
'''Death by Thousand Cuts''' |Slowly walks toward the player and then slashes the player with their sword, dismembering and killing them instantly. |} ==Tips== *Usually after every move, you can get 1-2 basic attacks off, unless they use the single swing, in which only go for one. *In order to dodge the Terra Eruption, do a full dodge instead of a roll cancel. *All of the Stone Knight's moves can be dodged with little consequence, with the exception of the double slash. * The Blizzard Knight spawns only as a pack of 6, thus it is recommended to slowly fight them one at a time rather than risk being infinitely stunned. * You can right-click after getting kick or hit with Terra Eruption to cancel the ragdoll. * Their Kick is very quick so always keep an eye out. * The Talent "Brick Wall" can help you recover much more quickly from the ragdoll from the Kick and Terra Eruption especially being attacked by more than one Stone Knight. ==Gallery== Stone Knight Concept Art.png|Concept Art Stone Knight Model Render.png|Model Render Stone Knight Bestiary.png|Bestiary Art ==Trivia== *Stone Knights are artificial and are thus not affected by the "Mute" [[Regalia]] and will still attack if they spot you. *Stone Knights and Blizzard Knights are very hostile towards most mobs and will target them. *They have a 360 degrees detection range. *During the early stages of the [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]'s release, multiple Blizzard Knights were able to spawn {{cl|corrupted|corrupted}} as early as the third wave in, boasting a ridiculous '''27000 health'''. The patch note following this replaced them with uncorrupted Stone Knights. *Stone Knights can actually swim in water, however it makes their moves way harder to react to, so be careful when fighting them in water. *The animations and model of the Stone Knight were overhauled on the January 11th, 2025 Update. *Note: They are extremely likely to animation bug with attacks just being outright hidden at times. *Sand Knights were most likely Moss Knights, gradually turning into a Sand Knight as the desert winds blew. {{History}} {{Nav|Monsters}} [[Category:Monsters]] [[Category:Knights]]
