==Stances== Pressing {{Input|keybind|Y}} will change your stance, changing the way you wield your weapon. *'''Light Weapons''' are locked to the One Handed stance. **'''[[Fists]]''' are able to switch between the [[Way of Navae]], [[Legion Kata]], [[Imperium Kata]], and [[Fang and Coil]] fighting styles. *All '''Medium Weapons''' except for Bows, Rifles, [[Imperial Staff]], [[Purple Cloud]], and [[Wyrmtooth]] can freely switch between One-Handed and Two-Handed stances. *All '''Heavy Weapons''' are locked to the two-handed stance unless you have 40 or higher Heavy Weapon investment, only then will you be able to stance swap freely. Exceptions to this are the [[Wyrmtooth]] and [[Railblade]], which are locked into the One-Handed stance. ===One-Handed (1H)=== *Can use offhand weapons such as shields, guns, or side daggers. ===Two-Handed (2H)=== *Deal 10% more posture damage with M1s and Criticals. *Cannot use offhand weapons. **Your Shield will be equipped onto your back, allowing you to use {{t|Turtle Shell}}. ===Dual Wield=== *The Dual Wield "stance" shares properties of both the One-Handed and Two-Handed stances. *Most notably, the game refers to this "stance" as One-Handed, and as such, you will not gain the posture damage bonus of the Two-Handed stance. *Similar to the Two-Handed stance, you cannot use offhand weapons, and any equipped Shield will be put on your back. This allows you to use {{t|Turtle Shell}} on Dual Wielded Light Weapons. *Only specific weapons have access to this "stance." These weapons can be found [[:Category:Dual-wielded Weapons|here]]. ==Key Terminology== *'''Requirements:''' [[Attributes|Attribute(s)]] and/or [[Power|levels]] required to wield a weapon. *'''Base Damage:''' Base weapon damage dealt with 0 investment in scaling attributes. *'''Penetration:''' Weapon damage% ignoring [[Outfits|armor]] resistances. For example 50% PEN vs 50% armor resistance = 25% damage resisted. PEN caps at 50%, but the cap can be removed with the {{t|Million Ton Piercer}} or {{t|Ether Overdrive}} Talents. *'''Chip Damage:''' A percentage of your weapon's scaled damage that goes through block. E.g. 20% chip with 30 damage = 6 damage to blocking opponents. Chip damage is not affected by PEN, and cannot receive most damage modifiers. Attacks that guardbreak do not deal their chip damage. *'''Scaling:''' Attribute scaling for weapons. *'''Weight:''' Posture damage dealt. Weapons deal 10% more posture damage when two-handed. *'''Range:''' Horizontal reach of a weapon (not counted by studs). *'''Swing Speed:''' Speed of basic weapon attacks (M1s), in reference to the default [[Sword]] swing speed of 1x. *'''Endlag:''' Additional lingering duration after a basic weapon attack (Self-stun after M1s). All weapons have endlag, these weapons have additional endlag. *'''Scaled Damage:''' Weapon damage dealt with full attribute scaling (100 points in each scaled attribute). This does not account for damage stars or [[Proficiency]]. Weapons that scale on 4 or more attributes will assume 330 point investment with optimal stats to maximize damage. *Specific weapon terminology: These terms only apply to specific weapons **'''FULL''' and '''BRKN/Shattered''': A term used specifically for the [[Fractine]] weapon's two states of being, the full greatsword form and the broken/shattered dagger form that it becomes after the critical attack is used, changing its stats. This is exclusive to the [[Fractine]] weapon. **'''1H''' and '''2H''': A term used specifically for the [[Ignition Deepcrusher]] weapon's two states being the Club (2H) and Sword (1H) that it becomes when stance swapping. These forms differ in stats. This is (currently) exclusive to the [[Ignition Deepcrusher]] weapon. **'''GS''', '''Dagger''', and '''Both''': Terms used for [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]], as the dagger M1s have light scaling instead of heavy. Both have Flamecharm scaling however. This is (currently) exclusive to the [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]] weapon. *{{status|Bleed|'''Bleed:'''}} 5% of the weapon's scaled damage proccing 3 times over a 0.3 second period, causing a total of 15% more damage in 0.9 seconds. Bleed causes extra blood loss as well. *[[:Category:Legendary Weapons|{{cl|mythical|'''Legendary:'''}}]] Special weapons which cannot be enchanted and are automatically soulbounded upon being equipped. This is not to be confused with the '{{cl|ilegendary|Legendary}}' item rarity. **[[:Category:Relic Weapon|{{cl|relic|'''Relic:'''}}]] [[Relic]] rarity weapons that are functionally identical to Legendary Weapons, though they often have more unique obtainment methods. These will be treated as Legendary Weapons as they are functionally identical with only differing drop sources.
*[[:Category:Alloyed Weapons|{{cl|alloyed|'''Alloyed Weapon:'''}}]] Weapons stats from the [[Pluripotent Alloy|Alloyed]] version. Stats which remain white are the same as the non-alloyed version. *[[:Category:Named Weapons|{{cl|war|'''Named Items:'''}}]] Similar to {{cl|alloyed|Alloyed}} weapons, these weapons are enhanced variants of a normal weapon, having unique traits and differing stats from their base variants. Stats which remain white are the same as their non-Named versions. *[[:Category:Hallowtide|{{cl|hallowtide|'''Hallowtide:'''}}]] Weapons only obtainable during the [[Hallowtide (Event)|Hallowtide event]], which occurs yearly to celebrate Halloween, or with [[Hallowtide Medals]] at [[Blacksmith]]s outside of the event. These weapons cannot be dropped but can be passed down normally through the [[Hippocampal Pool]] located in the [[Fragments of Self]]. *{{cl|enemydrop|'''Boss Weapon:'''}} Weapons that can only be obtained by killing certain [[Bosses]]. Boss Weapons with additional tags (e.g. Legendary Weapon) will have the other tags prioritized instead. *[[Origins|{{cl|origin|'''Origin Weapon:'''}}]] Weapons exclusive to a specific [[Origin]]. These weapons often have unique obtainment methods. *{{cl|divine|'''Ability-bound Weapons:'''}} Weapons gained from activating a specific ability. These weapons will replace your currently held weapon while active. These weapons may be granted from an [[Oath]], [[Talent]], or a [[Resonance]]. *[[Vow of Iron|{{cl|voii|'''Vow of Iron Exclusive Weapons:'''}}]] Weapons that are exclusively found in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} gamemode. *[[:Category:Exclusive|{{cl|spec|'''Exclusive Weapons/Skins:'''}}]] Weapons that can only be obtained by some / given to by special people. ==Types of Weapons== |-|Light= Light weapons are one-handed weapons. They are fast and agile, with high attack speed, but they often lack damage and range. {{#tag:tabber|Daggers= Daggers are one-handed weapons. They are fast and agile, with high attack speed and innate endlag, but they often lack damage and range. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Daggers]].
{{AllDaggerWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Fists= Fists make use of various gauntlets to wear, that are made with leather strips and sometimes filled with metal iron plates. When equipping fists when you had another weapon equipped beforehand, you'll throw your weapon to the ground. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Fists]].
{{AllFistWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Pistols= Pistols are a ranged weapon class designed to shoot projectiles. They can be used in three different ways; Singular, which involves only using a singular pistol, giving you a pistol whip when you have no loaded ammo and the ability to load bullets to shoot, Offhand Pistol, which consists of using a pistol in your offhand with a non-pistol main hand, and Dual Guns, which involves cycling your shots between each pistol. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Pistols]].
{{AllPistolWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Rapiers= Rapiers are Light Weapons that bridge the gap between the Medium and Light playstyles. It has the rapid strikes of a Light Weapon combined with the extended range of a Medium Weapon. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Rapiers]].
{{AllRapierWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} All=
{{AllLightWeapons}}
}} |-|Medium= Medium Weapons are both one-handed and two-handed weapons. They are a balance between speed and damage. {{#tag:tabber|Swords= Swords are weapons with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard used for cutting down opponents. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Swords]].
{{AllSwordWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Spears= Spears are weapons with a long pole, with a sharp pointed end, used for attacking enemies at a safe distance. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Spears]].
{{AllSpearWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Staves= Staves are polearm weapons with two blunt ends. These weapons specialize in swift followup strikes.
{{AllStaffWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Clubs= Clubs are weapons that, as opposed to most other weapons in the game, deal blunt damage. In the real world, these weapons were used for breaking through armor with heavy strikes; in Deepwoken, this is no different, being excellent weapons for breaking through even the toughest of guards. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Clubs]].
{{AllClubWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Rifles= Rifles are two-handed guns that use blunt melee attacks and incorporate the firing of the rifle itself. Loading Bullets or Bullet Casings into the Rifles will cause them to have a different effect on their Blast shots, but no projectiles will be fired.
{{AllRifleWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Twinblades= Twinblades are medium weapons with a blade at either side of their main hilt. Uniquely, running attacks with these weapons will followup with another attack. When two-handed, they do not perform flourish attacks. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Twinblades]].
{{AllTwinbladeWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Bows= Bows are one handed medium weapons that see the user fire arrows to attack. They boast high ranges and have fast animations, making them harder to parry than most other options. By holding your basic attack input, you can charge your shots, increasing the damage they deal and turning your M1s into aim-able projectiles if you've charged for long enough. Release your {{input|keybind|M1}} key to fire the bow shot at any point. Charging a shot while midair will slow your descent briefly. If a charged shot gets parried, you will be forced into a [[Status Effects#Knockdown|Knockdown]] state for a brief duration. Once you've charged your bow for long enough, a high pitched sound effect will play, indicating a perfect shot. Firing your bow during the perfect shot window will increase the shot's damage drastically. Charging for any longer will result in the shot losing damage. Uniquely, uppercuts from Bows send the target upwards at a 45 degree angle, while the user stays grounded. This gives the user an opening to charge a shot or fire a projectile Mantra while their opponent is airborne.
{{AllBowWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} All=
{{AllMediumWeapons}}
}} |-|Heavy= Heavy Weapons are two-handed weapons, but they can be wielded with one hand if you have 40 stat points into heavy weapon. They are slow, but have superior range and pack quite a punch. They feature powerful critical attacks, that usually provide hyperarmor, instantly guard breaks if blocked and apply knockdown on the enemy. All Heavy Weapons uniquely possess the "return swing" function, which allows them to gain [[Hyperarmor]] on a basic attack after a successful parry. {{#tag:tabber|Greataxes= Greataxes are large axe weapons, bearing an oversized axe head upon a long handle for increased reach.
{{AllGreataxeWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Greatswords= Greatswords are bigger than normal swords, possessing a large grip for the wielder to increase leverage.
{{AllGreatswordWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Greathammers= Greathammers are weapons with a heavy metal head mounted at right angles at the end of a handle. These weapons are second to none for their high posture damage.
{{AllGreathammerWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Greatcannons= Greatcannons are large cannon weapons, wielded with both hands. These weapons have indescribable firepower at the price of being incredibly heavy and cumbersome. Uniquely to Greatcannons, they do not receive reduced aerial attack damage unlike all other heavy weapon classes.
{{AllGreatcannonWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} All=
{{AllHeavyWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} }} |-|Hybrid= Hybrid Weapons are weapons that require and scale on two or more different weapon or attunement stats, such as requiring Medium and Heavy stats. This weapon class is too diverse to be explained simply, with each weapon being uniquely itself.
{{AllHybridWeapons}}
|-|Elemental= Elemental weapons scale off a certain element, but that does not mean that all of them deal elemental damage. Apart from that, they share similar traits to their respective category of weapon. Almost all elemental weapons are legendary weapons, removing your ability to [[Enchantments|enchant]] them.
{{AllElementalWeapons}}
|-|Offhand= Offhand tools/weapons, are tools/weapons that you wield in your offhand and in order to be used require you to one hand your main weapon. These offhand tools/weapons have their own requirements, and can range from shields, to guns. {{#tag:tabber|Shields= Shields are defensive tools that when wielded in your offhand, apply their posture stat as a flat amount of additional posture to your character. However, your posture restoration from parrying will be reduced by 40%. Shields typically have a Fortitude requirement, and do not have any scaling. Certain Talents and Mantras will also require using a shield.
{{AllShieldWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Miscellaneous= Miscellaneous offhands are tools that do not fit being a shield or a weapon, and serve more as utility rather than offense or defense.
{{AllParryingDaggersWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} Weapons= Offhand weapons are weapons that can be wielded at the same time along with your mainhand as long as you are one-handing it. They add additional offensive tools to your arsenal, and can offer greater combat versatility. Currently the only offhand weapon type are pistols. Offhand pistols slightly change depending on what your main hand weapon is. If your main weapon is another pistol, the offhand pistol will adopt all stats from the main one. If your main weapon is not another pistol, your offhand pistol will have a -20% base damage penalty and will adopt the scaling and swing speed stats from the main weapon. For example, an offhand pistol wielded on [[First Light]] will have -20% base damage with 8 Heavy Weapons scaling and 0.82x swing speed. For more in-depth info about the weapon class, see [[Pistols]].
{{AllPistolOffhandWeapons}}
{{!}}-{{!}} All= {{AllOffhandWeapons}} {{!}}-{{!}} }} |-|Exclusive= Weapons/Weapon Skins that are exclusive for special people.
{{AllExclusiveWeapons}} |-|All= Every player-obtainable weapon, excluding offhands.
{{AllWeapons}}
==Calculating Damage== ===Scaled Damage=== This is the formula used to calculate the damage of a weapon with one scaled attribute (excluding bleed and/or modifiers). ''[https://www.desmos.com/calculator/ukb3vjlbwc Damage calculator (Single, Dual, Tertiary, and Quaternary Attribute Scaling [Scaling rings included])]'' The scaled damage formula is as follows:
BaseDamage \times (1 + ((0.75 \times \frac{S_1 + S_2 + S_3 + S_4}{1000} + R_1 + R_2 + R_3 + R_4) \times (1 + Proficiency \times 0.065))) Key: *BaseDamage accounts for damage stars as well. This can be calculated with the following formula:
BaseDamge = WeaponBaseDamage \times (1 + 0.02 \times DamageStars) *S1-4 = Attribute Level x Attribute Scaling for each stat. *R1-4 = [[Scaling Rings]]. The order the rings are added is based on your respective attribute investment. The highest investment is R1, the next is R2, and so on. **Scaling Rings are calculated as follows: ***R1: \frac{1.2 \times Investment}{1000} ***R2: \frac{1.2 \times Investment}{2 \times 1000} ***R3: \frac{1.2 \times Investment}{4 \times 1000} ***R4: \frac{1.2 \times Investment}{8 \times 1000} ===Damage Modifiers=== The formula to calculate the damage with damage multipliers taken into account is: MultipliedDamage = ScaledDamage \times (1 + \frac{DamageModifiers}{100}) ===Bleed=== The formula to calculate the damage of a weapon including bleed is: BleedDamage = ScaledDamage \times 1.15 ===Miscellaneous=== If you do not meet the requirements of your weapon, you will be inflicted with a damage debuff, the formula is as follows: Damage \times (1 - 0.25 \times \frac{m}{r}) m is your current stat and r is your weapon's requirements [https://www.desmos.com/calculator/3hj2bmdzzj calculator here]. *If your weapon requires multiple stats, this will prioritize the fraction that is farthest from 1, for example if you have 17/20 Strength and 90/100 Weapon, your weapon's damage will be reduced based off your Strength stat and instead of your Weapon stat, as 17/20 < 90/100. *[[Khan]]'s requirement reduction is applied in these calculations. *This debuff is a damage modifier to your scaled damage that is multiplicative to all other multipliers. ==Trivia== *You can pass down soulbound weapons for 40 [[echoes]] each; however the weapon will be automatically soulbound to the next character. *Changing stances, contrary to popular belief, does NOT affect swing speed. The [[Curved Blade of Winds]] and [[Ignition Deepcrusher]] are the only weapons with differing swing speed depending on stance. *The weapon with the highest: **Base damage: [[Metal Greatsword]] (45) **Singular attribute requirement: [[Hero Blades]] (all of them) (100 respective Attunement) **Multiple attribute requirement: [[Imperator's Edge]] (80 STR, 80 FTD, 80 MED) **Amount of individual attribute requirements: [[Red Death]] (4) **Penetration: [[Shattered Katana]], [[Nemit's Sickle]], [[Kyrsedge]], [[Kyrstreza]], [[Flareblood Kamas]], [[Pernach]] (30%) **Chip damage: [[Night Axe]] (80%) **Scaling: {{iv|Par's Glaive}} (30 CHA) **Weight: [[Sovereign's Punishment]] (13) **Range: {{iv|Darksteel Cleaver}} (13) ***Honorable mention: [[Rangescraper]] (11, Talent gives it a scaling range bonus) **Swing speed: [[Rangescraper]] (1.3x) **Amount of unique criticals: [[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]] (5) *Both of the Rifle Basic Attacks have the same range. *Rifles are the only weapon type that have four basic m1s before a flourish. *Twinblades lack a flourish when two handed, making them the only weapon class to lack a flourish... sometimes. *[[Ysley's Pyre Keeper]] is the only weapon to scale on alternating weapon stats. *Not including weapons that have no attribute requirements, [[Flareblood Kamas]], [[Frostthorn]], and {{iv|The Death Knell}} are the only weapons to scale on attributes that they do not require. *The critical attacks of the [[First Light]], [[Formless Shard]], [[Hero Blades]], [[Ignition Deepcrusher]], [[Iron Requiem]], [[Krulian Knife]], [[Kyrsieger]], [[Markor's Inheritor]], [[Saintsblade]], [[Sovereign Bangle]], and [[Stoneheart]] are mechanically different from all others, having a separate base damage value from the weapons they're tied to. **The First Light, Hero Blades, Ignition Deepcrusher, Iron Requiem, Krulian Knife, and Saintsblade criticals additionally have separate investment scaling from their equipped weapon. **The Formless Shard, Kyrseiger, Sovereign Bangle, and Stoneheart criticals deal flat damage with no investment scaling. *The [[Saintsblade]], [[Sovereign Bangle]], [[Handcuffs]], and [[Formless Shard]] are the only weapons to lack a scaling stat. To make up for this, Saintsblade and Sovereign Bangle have very high base damage; Formless Shard on the other hand... **The above weapons are also the only weapons in the game that do not naturally benefit from [[Proficiency]]'s weapon scaling increase buff. [[Scaling Rings]] will still benefit from your Proficiency even on these weapons, however. *[[:Category:Named Weapons|Named Weapons]] are heavily inspired by Artifacts from ''Dark and Darker'', weapons that bear the same appearance and stats as a certain regular weapon but come with a special ability, very similarly to Named weapons. *Medium has both the highest individual weapon count, as well as the highest amount of weapon categories, out of all three weapon stats. {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Mechanics]]

{{Quotes|quote=Hi.|author=Weird Trader}} {{NPCInfobox |image1=Weird_Trader.png |aspect=Ganymede |location=Random Encounter (Sea)}} ==Description== The Weird Trader is an inconspicuous [[Ganymede]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. They can rarely be spotted sailing in a Dinghy just about anywhere in the sea. This includes the waters of the Etrean Luminant, the Eastern Luminant and even the Voidsea. The Weird Trader will request three items from a long list of possible choices. Providing these three items will reward the player with a very rare [[Weapons|weapon]], a [[Relics|relic]], or an [[Enchantments|Astral Enchantment Stone]]. This trade can only be performed once per encounter, a new Weird Trader must be found to attempt another trade. Claiming you have the items without having them in your inventory causes the Weird Trader to perform an uppercut, sending those hit extremely high in the sky and almost certainly resulting in death if the victim doesn't have the aid of a [[Tiran Pendant]], an I-Frame mantra, or some other form of fall damage negation to prevent their likely inevitable demise. The event despawns after 30 minutes have elapsed or if you leave the server after talking to them.

==Description==
The Whaling knife is a midgame dagger type weapon.

This weapon can be [[Pluripotent Alloy|Alloyed]], increasing its stats and requirements, turning the Whaling Knife into an endgame weapon. This also changes its appearance, granting it a green hue.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Whaling Knife Critical.gif
</gallery>

The user rushes forward while performing a horizontal slash forward, the slash having a red trail. This attack has a 1.4x scaled damage multiplier.

The critical has a cooldown of '''3 seconds'''.

{{text|m1tag}}

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Whaling Knife (unequipped).png|Unequipped
File:Alloyed Whaling Knife (unequipped).png|Unequipped (Alloyed)
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*It is the standard weapon of members of [[The Knives of Eylis]].
**The name references the other nickname of The Knives of Eylis, that being The Whalers.
*Available on the Roblox catalog as a [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/14542129946/Whaling-Knife waist accessory].
*The critical formerly benefitted from the Talent ''Knife's Journey'', which had a 30% chance to deal 1.2x, signified by red sparks on hit. Having the Talent stacked the chance to 40%.
*The model of this weapon is an exact copy of [[w:c:lotr:Sting|Sting]], a blade from ''[[wp:The Lord of the Rings|the Lord of the Rings]]''.
*Despite it's name, Whales (or any mammals for that matter) do not exist in the game.

title: Whirlpools
content:
{{ToolInfobox|image1=LuminantWhirlpool.png|usage=Sink into [[The Depths]] without having to die}}

<tabber>

</tabber>
== Description ==
Whirlpools are vortexes of water that allow the player to sink into [[The Depths]] safely. They are scattered across the sea.

== Usage ==
Whirlpools can be used to access [[The Depths]]. If the player is within the vicinity of a whirlpool, they will swiftly be dragged to the eye and sink into the water.

If the player has accessed The Depths through this way, they can enter certain places like [[Castle Light]] and [[The Chariot's Spire]], bypassing its barriers.

Allows the player to access and escape The Depths, Unstaining them without adding a drown to their slot.

== Locations ==

=== Etrean Luminant ===


* Next to [[Duke Erisia's Manor|Duke's Manor]].
* In between [[Minityrsa]] and the [[Beloved Zofia]]. 
* Next to the isle of vigils decently close to [[Vigil Isaac]].
=== Eastern Luminant ===

* Around the [[Moon's Eyrie]].
* At the right-hand side of [[The Monkey's Paw|Monkey's Paw]].
* To the left and right of the sea highway connecting [[Miner's Landing]] and [[Fort Merit]].
* Many whirlpools within the vicinity of [[Boatman's Watch]].
* Multiple on the way to the [[Moon's Eyrie]], and at the bottom of the Eyrie.
* Far and in between [[Greathive Aratel]] and the [[Fort Merit]] beach.

== Trivia ==

* Some [[Monsters]] can get dragged into Whirlpools.
* Driving [[Boats]] into a whirlpool will result in the boat sinking and being destroyed.
* Evil freshies would have glacial arc setups over a whirlpool and call upon a Justicar to get them depth sent.

title: Whisper Draw
content:
Whisper Draws are special hands of [[Talent]] cards that provide the player with [[Mantras]]. You can usually choose from 2-3 Mantras, a random Mantra or a 'Roll 2', giving you 2 random Talents that are available to you.

== <u>Info</u> ==
Whisper Draws only present themselves on [[Power|powering up to certain levels]]. By the time the player has reached Power 20, they will have been offered 12 Whisper Draws. A Whisper Draw can also be gained through combining two [[Talents]] into a Mantra at the [[Shrine of Unification]].

Whisper Draws can also be obtained from specific methods. You can only gain '''1''' Whisper Draw total from these, as only the first one you complete will grant the Whisper Draw. These tasks are:
*[[Kelsius]]' quest
*Completing the [[Tutorial]]
*Escaping [[The Depths]] for the first time
*Defeating any [[Bosses|World Boss]] for the first time (Note: this requires you to deal a considerable amount of damage)
*Completing [[The Gaunt Man|The Gaunt Man's]] experiments in [[The Vat]] for the first time

Every Whisper Draw obtained from leveling also provides you with an [[Aces|Ace]], allowing you to either burn or freeze Mantra and Talent cards.

content:

{{stats|wnd|+8% Wind Armor}} }} == Description == The Whistling Periapt is a [[Relic]] [[Equipment]] item under the "Torso" category. When equipped, the gemstone emits constant rays of green light. File:PeriaptStart.gif|Whistleguard {{t|Whistleguard}} applies a shield of wind after inflicting continuous damage onto an enemy without taking damage, parrying, or dodging. The shield grants protection against one hit, absorbing the hit before dissipating. While a shield is active, performing combat actions other than basic attacks will have it expire early. It will also expire after some time has passed if the user took no damage. The hit absorption does not grant autoparry frames like a usual parry would. Shields cannot stack. Whistleguard has a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. Burn damage in PvE combat can also trigger Whistleguard. == Gallery == File:Whistling Periapt VFX3.gif|VFX File:Whistling Periapt Back.png|Back File:Whistling Periapt Held.png|Held File:Whistling Periapt Toggled.png|Vanity Toggled Off File:Purple.png|Dyed File:Periapt.gif|Whistleguard's effect == Trivia == * It can be dyed, changing the color of the light it produces, however it only gives a tint to the necklace itself, so the green stone stays green. * In March 2024, developer Ragoozer, accidentally or intentionally, dropped it as loot in a [[Chime of Conflict]] match.Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1rFxJSsJOrA ** It was formerly known as the Wind Amulet. * Whistleguard is a weaker variant of the [[Duke Erisia]]'s shield of Galebreathe he uses in the first phase of his fight that parries any and all attacks. * This item is able to be passed down to another life and stored in the item bank. * If smelted, cannot be banked (you can still use it as the attributes and bank it). * Whistling Periapt cannot autoparry Vents. * It can synergize with the talent ''Force Your Way and Diver's Resilience'' provided by [[Ignition Deepdelver]], [[Ignition Gauntlets]] and [[Grand Fisher Plate]] which will allow the shield to parry unparryable attacks. * This is one of the droppable torso relics alongside the [[Tiran Pendant]], [[Lightkeeper's Medallion]], and the [[Warmaster's Medallion]]. * Upon equipping the Whistling Periapt it does NOT get soulbound and may be dropped once more. * When you have the {{t|Tidal Shock}} CD, you cannot use {{t|Whistleguard}}, and when you use {{t|Whistleguard}} and critical hit with [[Cala-Mariner]], {{t|Whistleguard}} will break. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Equipment}} [[Category:Necklaces]] [[Category:Torso]] [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:Relics]] [[Category:Equipment Relics]] [[Category:Equipment with Talents]] [[Category:Equipment with Exclusive Talents]]

title: Widow's Hollow
content:
{{Location|name=Widow's Hollow}}[[File:WidowHollow.png|thumb|1000x1000px|center]]

The '''Widow's Hollow''' is a [[Locations|location]] in ''Deepwoken''. It is a landmark of the [[Starswept Valley]] found in the [[Aratel Island]].

== Overview ==
The Widow's hollow is a large cave with its entrance found near the top of the giant mountain in the [[Starswept Valley]]. It consists of two "floors" eventually opening into a large chamber where the [[Deep Widow]] resides as well as an exit which leads to the [[Lightkeeper Temple]].

== Contents ==

=== Deep Widow ===

* The [[Deep Widow]] can be fought here. For more information on its attacks, see [[Deep Widow|here.]]

=== Shelter ===

* At the upper "floor" of the cave, there is a boarded-up door that can be destroyed or opened, leading to a small library of sorts containing the [[Deep_Shrines|Shrine Of Mastery]] as well as [[Ciea]]. For some reason, this place does not count as its own area.
** A button in the room with Ciea can be interacted with, opening a door that directly leads into the cave with the Deep Widow.

== Potential Enemies ==
<gallery>
File:Deep Widow Icon.png|[[Deep Widow]]
File:Hostile Legion Captain.png|[[Legion Sniper]]
File:AlphsharkoIcon.png|[[Megalodaunt|Alpha Megalodaunt]]
File:KingthresherIcon.png||[[King Thresher]]
</gallery>

== Trivia/Notes ==

* Legion Snipers have a small chance to spawn here.
* While not being present through normal gameplay, clipping outside of the Lightkeeper Temple brings up the location marker for Widow's Hollow, and is established as a [[Voidzones|voidzone]].

title: Widow's Wail Cemetery
content:
{{EventContent|Body=This location is exclusive to [[Hallowtide]].}} {{Location|name=Widow's Wail Cemetery|caption=The restless dead stir beneath the ground. Just what manner of trickery is this?}} [[File:Widow's Wail Cemetery.png|center|thumb|900px]] ==Overview== The Widow's Wail Cemetery is a dungeon that players can teleport to accessed by [[The Floating Keep]]. The main focus of this area is the Trial of the Gourdskipper, activated by the stand in the middle. [[File:Widow's Wail teleport.png|400px|center|thumb]] ==Trial of the Gourdskipper== The Trial of the Gourdskipper a trial where you must survive 8 waves of [[Gourdskipper|Gourdskippers]] using only the Pumpkin Pitch Mantra that replaces your M1's. On certain waves, chests containing Hallowtide weapons & equipment will spawn where players are standing. After clearing each wave, each player is awarded with 3 [[Joy]], and when you complete all 8 waves you are awarded with 16 [[Joy]]. Note that Mantras and Resonance's are disabled during the trial. Murmurs are also disabled, unless you activate them before and then start the trial. If you get hit by a Gourdskipper during the event, you become infected, and your M1's resemble that of a regular Mudskippers. If you are hit by Pumpkin Pitch twice when you are infected, you are teleported outside of the Widow's Wail Cemetery to the portal you came in through. If you are infected and the only person doing the trial, then the trial immediately ends, and you must wait for it to come off of the cooldown. If you are infected and not doing the trial solo, then you can infect other players for 3 [[Joy]] per person.
There is a chance you will be bugged when getting hit with Pumpkin Pitch after being infected. This bug takes you out of the infected state and if you go to the next round, you'll be able to use Mantras, Resonance's, Murmurs, and your weapon while the trial is active. You will also be immortal to Gourdskippers but you can be gripped by them. To resolve this, just restart the trial. When the trial is active, you cannot teleport into the Widow's Wail Cemetery. Note that you do '''NOT''' need a mask to obtain [[Joy]] from the Trial of the Gourdskipper. {| class="fandom-table" |+Note that the number of Gourdskippers that spawn is per player (i.e. with two players the number of gourdskippers will be doubled, three players tripled, etc.) !Wave !Number of gourdskippers !Chest? |- |1 |1 |✗ |- |2 |1 |✗ |- |3 |2 |◯ |- |4 |2 |✗ |- |5 |2 |◯ |- |6 |2-3 |✗ |- |7 |2-3 |◯ |- |8 |3 |◯ |- |} ===Rewards=== *[[Hallowtide_(Event)#Description|Hallowtide Weapons]] *[[Hallowtide_(Event)#Description|Hallowtide Equipment]] *[[Umbral Obsidian]] *[[Gems]] *[[Mantra Modifiers]] *[[Deep Gems]] *[[Goodie Bag]]s ==Points of Interest== *Tunnels *Houses *Graveyards ==Contents== *Trial of the Gourdskipper ==Trivia== *The amount of players in the trial increases the amount of Gourdskippers that spawn. If you're the only player in the trial, only 1-3 spawn making it insanely easy. *In previous years you were able to stand on the trees and stack barrels to cheese the trial but as of '25 Hallowtide, this is no longer possible. *The name, "Widow's Wail", comes from Joffrey Baratheon's Valyrian steel sword from Game of Thrones. *Yes, you can hide from the Gourdskippers in Tacet. *With the talent Death From Above, Starkindred wings can still be summoned in an active wave even if mantras are disabled from use. This provides a massive mobility boost with the increased dashes and the attack from the talent itself. *Beating all eight waves gives a total of 40 Joy. *The trial has a cooldown of one minute after completion. *Sometimes wave seven only spawns two [[Gourdskipper|Gourdskippers]], as displayed in the latter half of [https://youtu.be/rBY5oJz7-wM this video]. This is likely a bug. *Wave six also can spawn two or three Gourdskippers, though this is also likely a bug, akin to the previously listed trivia. {{nav|hallowtide}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Hallowtide]] [[Category:Dungeons]]

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that applies deals your weapon's damage in an AoE.

==Effect==
On weapon hit, {{PAGENAME}} deals 85% of your weapon's damage in an ~18.25 stud AoE around the target you hit. This cannot hit the target who was hit by the initial attack, unless two targets were hit at the same time.

Allies take 50% of your weapon's damage from Wild instead of the full 85%.

===Notes===
*Wild's damage is dealt as typeless damage, bypassing armor resistances.

title: Wind-Up
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Wind up your arm, and unleash the shattering power on your foes.|author=Wind-Up description}}
{{Resonance|effect=Charges your arm and amplifies your next attack|appearance=Small particles that surround the arm|cooldown=0.3s (Recast) / 5s (Initial Cast) |
image1 =<gallery>
File:Tjin & Witherald Windup Combo.gif|Wind-Up
Windup_card.png|Card
File:Corrupt Wind-Up Card.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
==Description==
'''Wind-Up''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain and is common to roll.
===''Appearance''===
When used, small circles appear around your right arm. Per use, more circles will appear indicating an increase in level. The circles can be multiple different colors, such as gold and red when charged in combat.
==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Wind-Up''' Resonance.

'''Wind-Up''' will store a charge that will strengthen your next attack. These charges have a duration of roughly one minute, after which the effect will disappear, and the Resonance will go on a short cooldown of around ten seconds. '''Wind-Up's''' max charges is 5 while in combat, but can only be charged up to 2 when out of combat.

When a physical attack is landed while a charge is stored, the attack will be accompanied by a blast that deals additional damage and ragdolls. If a charged attack gets parried, it will cancel the blast, inflict major damage to the user's posture, and knock back the enemy who parried it. A dodged attack will only cancel the blast. If a charged attack gets parried by an NPC, posture damage received will be treated like a parried uncharged attack.

'''Wind-Up''' can execute NPCs and players if a certain amount of charges are stored.

{{cl|corres|If Wind-Up is corrupted, the ability to execute knocked entities only requires 1 charge. Additionally, it will count as a ''Flourish'' for the purpose of proccing Talent and Mantra effects.}}

=== '''''Resonance Point Usage''''' ===
When obtained, Wind-Up will spend its points on the following stats:

* '''Charge amount:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the fewer charges it takes to reach max charges.
* '''Charge speed:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the shorter the charge animation is.

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
File:Wind-up appearance.png|Old Reference (Image)
File:Windupmoment.gif|Verse One Reference
File:Gold windup.png|Windup Particles
</gallery>
==Trivia==
*Similar to Phink's "Ripper Cyclotron" from ''Hunter X Hunter''.
*Corrupted Wind-Up can have a one-charge shot, though it is questionable to use as the damage is quite bad.
*You cannot charge while you are in [[Tacet]].
*Be very careful when near a cliff, as this has massive knockback, surpassing even Strong Left.
*Especially devastating on heavy weapons.
*When Corrupted, this Resonance is one of the best executors there are in the game. It only takes around one second to execute a downed player and it will out-speed [[Preservation]] or [[Blood Scourge]] Resonances.
*It does not proc on Mantras. [[Kyrsieger]], [[Wyrmtooth]], and [[Imperator's Edge]] criticals also can't proc Wind-Up; It doesn't seem to work on criticals that ragdoll. Some Knockdown criticals work (like [[Railblade]]), while other criticals like [[Darksteel Greatsword]] do not.

The {{t|Wind Dancer}} Talent grants a 10% speed boost for 12 seconds after roll cancelling twice in quick succession, but one of your rolls must dodge a hit in order for it to activate. This has a 10 second cooldown. ==Trivia== *This Outfit is a reference to the dress worn by [[w:c:darksouls:Dark Sun Gwyndolin|Dark Sun Gwyndolin]] from the first ''[[wp:Dark Souls (video game)|Dark Souls]]'' video game created by [[wp:FromSoftware|FromSoftware]]. *Originally this Outfit had a Power requirement of 10, being the only Master Outfit at the time to not require Power Level 15. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Exclusive Talents]]

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a debuffing [[enchantment]] that applies {{status|b=y|Winded|winded}} to your opponent.

==Effect==
After landing enough M1s, {{PAGENAME}} applies {{status|b=y|Winded|winded}} to your opponent. The duration of this winded effect scales on your Weapon attribute investment. This enchantment has a 5 second cooldown regardless of investment, making it very weak on low investment.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 3 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 2 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 1 hit for [[Heavy Weapons]]. These stacks do not decay over time.

Windswept gains +0.08 second duration for every 1 weapon attribute investment, capping at 8 seconds with 100 Weapon. Windswept cannot have below a 0.5 second duration, making the first 0-6 weapon investment indifferent to Windswept's winded duration.

===Notes===
*{{PAGENAME}} stacks can be gained from weapon criticals if they have the [[M1 tag]].
*[[Wyrmtooth]] will prioritize its medium weapon investment over its heavy weapon investment for Windswept's winded duration.

==Description==
The Withered Death Knell is a blood-red spirit lantern. This weapon is obtained by interacting with the [[Lost Forge]] with a [[Light's Final Toll]] equipped or by holding the weapon out.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Crit 1.gif|Way of Navae/Fang and Coil/Jus Karita LFT Critical (#1)
File:Crit 1bA.gif|Legion/Imperium Kata Crit (#1)
File:Crit 2.gif|Jumping Critical (#2 and #3)
File:Crit 3.gif|Final Critical (#4)
</gallery>The Withered Death Knell has 4 different criticals. When a critical is landed, it will advance to the next stage.

For the first critical, the user smacks the target with the lantern ([[Way of Navae]], [[Untrained Fist]], or [[Fang and Coil]] equipped), or grabs the target with the lantern ([[Legion Kata]] or [[Imperium Kata]] equipped), and smacking them down.

For the second and third critical, the user leaps into the air and unleashes three blood-red strikes before stomping on the ground. This must be landed twice to advance to the final phase.

For the final critical, the user raises into the air with a [[Combat Mechanics#Green|green telegraph]], unleashing a heavy smack with the lantern and flinging the opponent back. If missed, the critical will reset to its first phase. This critical acts as a counter, absorbing the damage from attacks you get hit by during its windup.

All criticals have a cooldown of '''5 seconds'''.

All of these critical drain the target's blood while restoring the user's, and applies 3% of [[Blood Poison]] per hit.

==Trivia==
*A death knell is the ringing of a church bell to announce the death of a person.

'''Wood''' is an essential resource used to craft tools and other materials.

== Obtainment ==
Wood can be can be obtained in a few ways:

* Destroying trees.
* Bought for {{c|Notes|2}} or {{c|Notes|5}} depending on the vendor.
* Crafting together three (3) Sticks.

== Uses ==
Wood can be used for the following:

* Crafting a [[Campfire Pit]].
* Crafting a [[Lumber Axe]] or [[Pickaxe]].
* Crafting a [[Repair Kit]].
* Crafting into three (3) [[Stick]]s.
* Crafting into [[Ashes]] at a [[Campfire]].
* Turning it in to [[Korin]] or [[Drefa]] for [[Etris]] [[Reputation]].
* Repairing Boats.

title: Words of Light
content:
[[File:Words of Light.png|right|255x255px]] {{clear}} ==Description== '''''{{PAGENAME}}''''' is a [[Books|Book]] obtained after defeating the [[Kyrsgarde Champion, Kyrsa's Star]]. ==Text== ===
Words of Light
===
A Kyrsan Manifesto [The same text appears to be written twice on the scroll. The first instance is written in a tongue unknown to you. But the second instance is unmistakably penned in familiar Gatherhand. The letters tower imposingly upon the parchment, evenly spaced, and inimitably uniform. The way the ink sits upon the page suggests that the message was written by hand - but you would be forgiven for believing that its form was ordained by some universal constant, not unlike the forming of quartz crystals, or high pillars of basalt. The Gatherhand portion reads as follows.] ---------- HEAR ME NOW, AND DEIGN TO LEND AN EAR. BEHOLD NOW THUS, OUR MANIFESTED DISCONTENT. LONG AGO DID I FIRST SERVE NEW KYRSA, WHEN IT WAS FREE OF THE USURPER'S UNYIELDING THRALL. WHEN ITS SPIRES REACHED EVER HIGHER AND THE CITY DREW ITS BREATH, I BREATHED ALONGSIDE IT, AND GAZED TOWARD THE SKIES. I WAS ITS SENTINEL AND GUARDIAN, BOUND BY A VOW UNENDING. I SERVED IT STILL WHEN THE CHAINS FELL UPON US, AND THE CREEPING MISTS ROLLED IN TO BLANKET ALL. WHEN THE STORM TURNED OUR MIGHT AGAINST US, AND BOUND US TO ITS SERVITUDE. WHEN THE SPIRES OF OUR TRIUMPH BECAME THE WATCHTOWERS OF OUR CAPTIVITY. WHEN THE STORM'S EYE WATCHED, PEERING DEEP INTO OUR MINDS. I SERVED IT STILL WHEN OUR CAPTOR BID US MARCH BEYOND THE FRINGES. ITS REGIMENTS I LED BENEATH A TATTERED STANDARD, LIKE CLOTHEN FINGERS RAKING THROUGH THE STORM. PROUD WARRIORS DEBASED TO WANTON PILLAGE. BENEATH A BLOODWORN FLAG, WE KILLED. WE CONQUERED. INNOCENTS WERE SLAIN. FOR YEARS WE ROVED, FOR CENTURIES WE REAPED. I SERVED IT STILL WHEN IN THE RUINS OF CONSTELLIA, AMONG THE ASH AND FLAMES OF OUR DESTRUCTION, I FOUND A RADIANCE. A BLESSING FAR BEYOND OUR RECKONING AND KEN, AND ALIEN TO US. A HUMMING NOT UNLIKE A SOUL. A PRESENCE LINGERING, INVITING. ---------- THIS ESSENCE SPOKE TO ME BY NAME. IT DREW ME CLOSE, AND PIERCED MY VERY SOUL. IT SPOKE THE TRUTH IN SOFT AND DULCET TONES. ITS LIGHT WAS BRILLIANT AND BLINDING, ALL THE SAME. ITS RADIANCE EASED THE SHACKLES OF MY MIND. IT IS GLORIOUS. IT IS WONDERFUL. IT IS RADIANT. IT IS BEAUTIFUL. THE ESSENCE IS NAMED LIGHT, AND I AM ITS APOSTLE. ---------- THE LIGHT MADE ME AN INSTRUMENT OF LIBERATION. I TOOK UPON A WEAPON OF THE FALLEN, AND SWORE MY HEART TO KYRSA AND THE HEAVENS: I SHALL BECOME A BLADE OF RETRIBUTION; BRING DEATH UPON THE SCION AND HIS STORM. THE TYRANT NOW APPROACHES, COME TO TAKE ME PRISONER. I SENSE IT. HE SEEKS WITHIN A TIMELESS CAGE TO BIND ME. TO QUELL THE LIGHT, AND SHROUD OUR WORLD IN DARKNESS. SO HEAR ME NOW, AND DEIGN TO LEND AN EAR. LEARN NOW THE NAME, 'RAEVA FERASH KENESTOS! HEAR NOW HOW MUCH THE BLOOD-SOAKED HEAVENS WEPT. HEAR NOW THE PRAYERS OF OUR KINFOLK TO THEIR MASTER, THE SAME WHO GRIPS THEIR CHAINS AND HOLDS THEM ALL IN THRALL. IF YOU ARE FREE - BE YOU A KYRSAN OR FRINGEWALKER, - AWAIT MY MARK, AND JOIN IN MY RETURN. ---------- AND TO THE FOUL USURPER AND ITS SCION: HEAR NOW MY ONLY SOLEMN WORDS OF WARNING. KNOW MY NAME. KNOW THAT I APPROACH. BEHOLD THE LIGHT OF HEAVENS - KNOW AND FEAR ITS MIGHT. DO WHAT YOU MAY MY ARRIVAL IS INEVITABLE. THE ELEVENTH HOUR STRIKES. YOUR RECKONING IS COMING. ----------
==Gallery== File:Words of Light Sneak.png|The Words of Light shown in a sneakpeek prior to being added File:Original words of light texture.png|The Words of Light Texture [[Category:Books]]

title: World Events
content:
File:DWZ 004 Aelita Trickery GFX.png
==Description== World events are game-wide events that occur in every server once every real life 30 minutes (exactly at XX:30 and XX:00). Each [[Luminants|Luminant]] will have their own world events and every server of that Luminant will have the same event. World events are focused on uniting the players towards accomplishing a single goal and awarding them individually. However, you should note that ganking is not disabled and may result in players attempting to kill you so you can't get the loot. ==World Events== * '''Carnival of Hearts''' ** Partake in a series of games within the '''[[Carnival of Hearts]]''', hosted by [[Aelita]] and [[Tillian]]. ** "Partake in a deadly series of games hosted by Aelita and Tillian!" * '''Interluminary Interloper''' ** Defeat the [[Interluminary Parasol|'''Interluminary Parasol''']] within the Eastern Luminant before it may spreads the plagues of The Depths. ** "Defeat the Interluminary Parasol before it can complete its harvest!" *'''Battle Royale''' ** A battle royale game mode where you are queued with up to 49 other players. ** "Starting from scratch, warriors from across the Lumen compete to be the last one standing!" == Disaster == Disasters are events that occur globally on the server without a UI pop-up, it's a subcategory to World Events. '''Disasters are NOT bugged, they are disabled in low tier servers.''' * '''[[Cinders of Etris]]''' ** [[Etris]] is being raided by [[The Central Authority]], where you may help them or oppose them. ** "Defend Etris or bring it to its knees" * '''Caeranthil's Wake''' ** Defeat [[The Doom of Caeranthil|'''The Doom of Caeranthil''']] within the Etrean Luminant before it causes further doom upon [[Isle of Vigils]] or Etris. ** "Slay the Doom of Caeranthil before it lays waste to the Luminant" ==Rewards== * Unique rewards for each world event ([[Eye of Malice]], [[Parasol Planter]] etc.) * [[Resonance]] progression and a great amount of attribute EXP * [[Crowns]] * (Caeranthil's Wake only) [[Fang and Coil]] Fist style * (Cinders of Etris only) [[Justicar]] Origin {{History}} [[Category:World Event]] [[Category:Bosses]]

==Description==
Worms are a species endemic to [[First Layer|Scyphozia]], one of the few inhabitants of the First Layer that aren't hostile to humanity.

They are lengthy gray organisms that live together in colonies in the sand, emerging every three hours. They have visible black, beady eyes and large, fleshy mandibles, used to move food into their beak. They feed on microbes and sea scum.<ref>[[File:ToonsWorms1.png]]</ref>

They are currently the subject of researched by [[The Ignition Union]], headed by [[Merryweather]]. Their regular emergence is used by the Union for timekeeping, as attempting to do so with any other method results in times that are inconsistent with those on the surface. The idea is that juvenile worms, placed in a sand-filled apparatus, would emerge at these set intervals, allowing the operator to tell the time. However, the worms have proved uncooperative with the Union.<ref>[[Merryweather]]</ref>

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Worms.png|Worms in the Depths
BunchofWorms.gif|Worms in motion
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*They're stated to emerge every three hours, but they emerge every ten minutes in the game due to time compression, given this is a video game.
*According to Nuttoons, [[the Divers]] also make use of worms for timekeeping,<ref>[[File:ToonsWorms2.png]]</ref> but this is not supported by the game itself nor the word of other developers.<ref>[[File:HautWorms.png]]</ref>
*They're likely based on bobbit worms.

==Description==
The '''Wraithclaw''' is a Legendary [[Weapons#Fists|Cestus]]; branching spirals of wind around the wrists underset by wraps and sinew which anchor six blades of spectral energy over the knuckles. The Wraithclaw is forged from the souls of the dead carried by the gale giving into claws, to rake and dig into opponents much as their dreading and sorrowful hearts do their own. Its damage scales off both Light Weapon and [[Galebreathe]]. 

The Wraithclaw comes with a single passive ability:

*'''Gale After Cut''' - M1 attacks now apply After Cut, dealing 5% of the initial damage of the attack.
** If you have the After Cut Talent, your M1 attacks will apply an After Cut dealing 10% of the initial attack instead of the usual 5%.

Do keep in mind that [[Fists|Fist style]] [[Outfit]] [[Talents]], such as [[Legion Centurion]] or [[Navaen War Chief]], work with this weapon, but critical attacks stay unchanged and do not switch depending on your style. The [[Fang and Coil]] running critical from [[Jade Vigil's Weave]] cannot be used on Wraithclaw.

The Wraithclaw can be obtained from the unique NPC named "[[Grudge]]" which you have to defeat. Various spawn locations for the NPC are:

*[[Minityrsa]]
*[[Upper Erisia]]
*[[First Layer]]
*[[Starswept Valley]]
*[[Songseeker Wilds]]
*[[Bluster Rift]] 
*[[The Viper's Jaw]]
*[[Bluster Rift]] 

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Standing.gif|Standing
WraithclawAerialCritNew.gif|Aerial
File:Specter Standing crit v2.gif|Specter Path: Standing
File:Jumpy crit v2.gif|Specter Path: Aerial
</gallery>

The Wraithclaw has '''two''' criticals.

For the '''standing''' critical, the user winds up a barrage of six slashes, each dealing a small amount of damage & posture damage with low range, with the final hit dealing greater damage and posture. The attack can be cancelled by user themselves by pressing M2, getting damaged or getting parried.

Standing crit DMG: 0.6x of M1 DMG (First hit) + 0.35x*4 of M1 DMG (Middle hits) + 1x of M1 DMG (Last hit) + 10% aftercut DMG bonus

For the '''aerial''' critical, the user quickly whirls in front of them, dealing 2x of M1 DMG + 10% aftercut bonus and a massive amount of posture damage. The critical can be also activated during {{t|Gale Dash}}. This Critical counts as an uppercut & procs all "on uppercut talents".

Both criticals share the cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

{{text|m1leg2}}

==Trivia== 
* The aerial Critical Attack is deadly if used in {{t|Gale Dash}} or uppercut because of incredible posture damage and low windup. 
**Aerial Critical Attack is not AOE and does the slash only in front of the user, despite the character doing a whirlwind windup in the animation, which could mislead your opponent.
* It is similar to "Tekagi-Shuko", a weapon comprised of deadly "claws" that protrudes from the palm, utilized by ninjas. Or the weapon might be inspired by the Marvel comics character, Wolverine, specifically his metal claws of similar design.
*With [[Oath: Chainwarden|Chainwarden]], one of the claws disappear and is replaced by the chained gauntlet.<ref>[[File:Wraithclaw + Chainwarden.png|300px]]</ref>
*While using the criticals it will play the sound of a bear roaring.
*The latter part of the weapon's description is speculated to be a meta comment on the common and popular criticism from the Deepwoken community by veteran players.

content: {{ItemTemplate |image=Wrath gem.png |value=200 |weight=1 |stack=25 |type=Deep Gem |rarity=Legendary |desc=It hurts to hold... ---- On hit, apply '''Wrath'''. |obtainment=*[[Titus Fulminus Destellus]] (guaranteed) {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *Found in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} *{{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} chests}} ==Description== The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a light red diamond-shaped [[Deep Gem]]. ==Effect== Upon landing a Mantra with a Wrath Gem equipped, apply the {{status|Wrath}} status effect for 9 seconds, increasing your critical attack damage by 7.5% per player combat tag you have. This effect has a 10 second cooldown. ===Notes=== *If you are using the [[Reinforced War Helmet|Reinforced War Set]], then the Wrath Gem is best used on [[Attunement-less#Strength Mantras|Strength Mantras]], to proc their equipment Talents. If not, then this Gem will be most effective on any easy-to-hit Mantra with a low cooldown. **Additionally, using a weapon with a high damage critical is highly recommended, as it will benefit more from the percentage damage increase. If you are using the [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Reinforced War Set]], then it is recommended to use a weapon that has a low critical cooldown or a critical that resets its critical cooldown on hit, as two of the equipment Talents proc on critical hit. *If you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} from the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]], {{PAGENAME}}'s damage buff per player combat tag will be increased from 7.5% to 15%. *As previously mentioned, the Wrath status effect can gain additional effects through the equipment Talents in the [[Reinforced War Helmet|Reinforced War Set]]. **The {{t|Fatal Strike}} Talent from the [[Reinforced War Helmet]] increases the damage of your [[Attunement-less#Strength Mantras|Strength Mantra]] guardbreaks by 20% and applies a 50% slow for 5.5 seconds, if they have a Wrath Gem equipped. **The {{t|Crippling Impact}} Talent from the [[Reinforced War Plate]] disables your opponent's [[Vent]] for a few seconds if you land a critical attack while your opponent is afflicted with the {{status|Wrath}} status effect. The duration of this effect scales on your [[Strength]] investment. **The {{t|Repeated Blows}} Talent from the [[Reinforced War Boots]] resets the cooldown of your [[Attunement-less#Strength Mantras|Strength Mantras]] if you land a critical attack while your opponent is afflicted with the {{status|Wrath}} status effect. **The {{t|Lasting Trauma}} Set Talent from the [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Reinforced War Set]] additionally applies the {{status|Fearful}} status effect for 19 seconds whenever you land a Mantra with a Wrath Gem equipped, disabling your opponent's ability to use their critical attack. *For usage with {{t|Critical Engine}}, the damage buff will not be applied to the hit that procced the Deep Gem, but will be applied to subsequent hits after granting the Wrath status effect. It is highly suggested that you use a multi-hitting critical for this Gem. *Wrath Gem's damage buff is affected by the damage modifier cap. *You are guaranteed to get 1 Wrath Gem (and [[Might Gem]]) for every time you defeat Titus Fulminus Destellus. ==Crafting== This Gem can also be used to craft a variety of items. *[[Equipment]]: [[Reinforced War Helmet]], [[Reinforced War Plate]], and [[Reinforced War Boots]]. ==Trivia== *Likely inspired by the wrath gem from the Enigma mod for Terraria. {{History}} [[Category:Treasures]] [[Category:Mantras]] [[Category:Deep Gems]]

==Description==
The '''Wyrmtooth''' is a sword that drops from bosses and endgame events like the [[Dread Serpent]] or [[The Diluvian Mechanism]]. It has a base damage of 20 with 25% PEN, requiring 60 MED, 40 HVY and Power 10 to equip. Wyrmtooth is compatible with Medium and Heavy Talents, acting as '''both''' a Medium Sword and a Heavy Greatsword.

The Wyrmtooth boasts a massive 9 range and an above average weight of 7; it can reliably outrange the majority of light and medium melee weapons and, paired with its decently high swing speed, allows you to maintain pressure on your opponents while remaining relatively safe.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Ebb and Flow}} procs when landing a [[Attunement-less#Medium Weapon Mantras|Medium]] or [[Attunement-less#Heavy Weapon Mantras|Heavy]] weapon Mantra, increasing the Mantra level of your next casted Mantra of the opposing type by +1. This effect '''only''' applies when alternating weapon Mantras. For example, if you land one heavy Mantra and then follow up with two medium Mantras, the second medium Mantra will '''not''' receive the buff; your stacks won't be lost, the effect just won't be applied.

This can bypass the level 5 cap, and is stackable, capping at at +5 levels. If one of your Medium or Heavy Mantras get parried, dodged, or blocked, all stacks will be lost. Multi-hits do not grant multiple stacks.

For example, if you have a level 5 [[Pressure Blast]], landing [[Master's Flourish]] before casting Pressure Blast will increase Pressure Blast's level by +1, to 6, and vice versa. You will then need to follow up with a Mantra of the opposing type to stack the buff further and apply its bonuses.

This does '''not''' apply to [[Punishment]], presumably for balancing reasons.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Wyrmtooth Standing Critical.gif|Standing
Wyrmtooth Sliding Critical.gif|Sliding
Combo Wyrmtooth Critical.gif|Critical chain
</gallery>

For the '''standing''' critical, the user thrusts their weapon forwards, dealing damage and ragdolling enemies. Deals '''1.45x scaled damage'''.

For the '''sliding''' critical, the user sweeps their weapon in a 360° angle, dealing damage to those caught in it. The user can follow-up by clicking M1 while casting (and successfully landing) the sliding critical which will cause the user to perform the standard critical immediately afterwards. Do note that enemies will recover in time to parry the follow-up crit. The initial slash of the sliding critical deals '''1.25x scaled damage''', and the M1 follow-up deals the same amount of damage as the normal critical '''(1.45x scaled damage)'''.

The cooldown for either critical is '''10 seconds'''.

==Trivia==
*Wyrmtooth proccing both Medium and Heavy Talents includes both the Medium and Heavy weapon variants of the [[Silentheart]] moves, proccing the heavy ones if the medium ones are on cooldown.
**However, as the Silentheart abilities scale on their respective attributes (heavy attacks on Heavy Weapons and vice versa for the medium ones), this weapon can be very expensive to use on a Silentheart build without sacrificing damage.
*Before the update that classified Wyrmtooth as both a Sword and Greatsword, it could only proc Talents from the {{t|Thunderblade}} Talent tree and {{t|Destructive Recovery}}.
*Wyrmtooth benefits from the Heavy weapon hit count for [[Enchantments|Enchant]] effects. For example, Detonation will proc after landing 3 hits instead of 4.
*On the {{VersionHistory|2024|April 13th}} update, the Wyrmtooth was purported to have had its PEN increased to 25% but this was never applied ingame until {{VersionHistory|2025|June 9th}}, when the PEN was shadow fixed to 25%.
*This weapon shares basic attack animations with the [[Railblade]].
*Both its criticals formerly lacked the universal windup VFX. Its sliding critical also lacked a sound cue.

title: Yamaketzal
content:
{{PathfinderEx}} {{NPCInfobox |image1=Yamaket.png |name=Yamaketzal |aspect=Capra |pronouns=He/him |location=[[Songseeker Temple]] }} ==Description== Yamaketzal is a [[Capra]] [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He appears to be drunk, as he is swaying around and talking in an odd manner. Talking to Yamaketzal above [[Power]] 5 will unlock the [[Echo Talents|Echo Talent]], [[Chime of Conflict]]. The Chime of Conflict allows the player to fight in instanced PVP arenas against other players. Additionally, he can help player claim Echo Talents that they've unlocked in another slot, but don't own on their current slot. Speaking to Yamaketzal after claiming the Chime of Conflict will tell the player their W:L ratio in the arena. His second set of dialogue can range from ominous messages to mentioning notable people, including [[The Ferryman]], [[Duke Erisia]], [[The Lord Regent]], Wardens, and [[Gunsmith Rosen]]. He also speaks of a Driver, riding horses. Furthermore, if the player character has the [[Tarnished]] Flaw, Yamaketzal can remove it from the player for the price of {{c|notes|1000}}, making it possible to reroll their [[Resonance]] again. Despite his disheveled appearance, the combination of these two behaviors and his broad, if drunkenly muddled, knowledge of the world indicates that Yamaketzal is both powerful and knowledgeable. ==Location== Yamaketzal can be found standing right outside of the [[Songseeker Temple]] in [[Songseeker Wilds]]. title: Yesterwynde Tavern
content:
''This is about The '''Yesterwynde Tavern''', which was created as a part of the event. For more general information on the event and obtainment of the Gilded [[Instruments]], see [[Nightwish x Deepwoken Promotional Event]].'' {{NonCanon}} {{EventContent}} {{Location|name=Yesterwynde Tavern|caption=Music permeates the halls of this inn between space and time.}} [[File:Yesterwynde_Tavern_front.png|center|thumb|981x552px]] == Description == The Yesterwynde Tavern is a large room, resembling part of a large inn, floating in the middle of nothingness. There are a total of seven tavern doors scattered across the Lumen that can lead to this place. The different doors in the Etrean Luminent are located at: # In front of [[Erisia]], sailing from [[Etris]], where the tree bandits would be placed around a campfire, on the right. # Near the food stand in the [[Isle of Vigils]], walk behind stand that [[Lance's Brother]] owns and to the left, continuing further until you're met with a gateway on the side of the rock. # Also in [[Isle of Vigils]], near the [[Barber]] or [[Training Gear#Attunement_Training_Gears|Mantra training gear]] shop. On the right of it would be the gateway. # In [[Minityrsa]], found by going to the shore and hugging the left edge of the island until reaching the area with the downwards zipline to the shore next to another zipline. The door is embedded in a wall next to free snow-capped trees. With the other doors being placed in the Eastern Luminant are: # In the [[Greathive Aratel]], near the [[Fountain Gates]], walk forward until you meet the stairs outside of Greathive. On your left and besides the stairs would be the gateway. # In front of the door to [[The Lordsgrove]] from [[Starswept Valley]]. On the right of the door, near the jump pad is the tavern door. # To the left of the log that leads to [[Cerulean]]'s cave. Inside the tavern there are sets of tables and chairs looking what seems to represent a bar. In the front of bar are four loudspeakers with '''Nightwish''' written in cursive above it. At the counter sits various drinks, plates, and bowls, and of course, with [[The Ferryman]] as the barman. Opposite to the main counter sits an assortment of boxes, barrels, stand-up torches, and an unlit fireplace. There is a wooden mantle above the fireplace, one book sat atop of it. Above that can be seen a mount of moose antlers hung as decoration. There are two doors within, one to the Ferryman's left and the other to his right. Players can leave from both, but will always enter through the one to his right. == Locations == File:Door Fishing.png|thumb|Tavern Entrance door on island between Lower Erisia and Isle of Vigils File:Isle Door.png|thumb|Entrance at Isle of Vigils. Behind the food stand down to the left File:TavernDoor Vigils2.png|Isle of Vigils, to the right of the house of the barber File:TavernDoor Minityrsa.png|At minityrsa, located on the left of the island from up the shore near some trees File:TavernDoor StarsweptValley.png|Starswept Valley, to the right of the large door to the Lordsgrove File:TavernDoor Hive.png|Greathive Aratel's Approach, to the right of the bounty board File:TavernDoor MinersLanding.png|Miner's Landing, near the log leading to the Oathless trainer Cerulean == The Ferryman == [[The Ferryman]] floats behind the counter serving free drinks to anyone who comes by, but only if they don't already have a drink on hand. In his usual outfit and demeanor, he asks the player for help in retrieving his lost records from his vinyl collection. While he was setting up the tavern gateways, he lost '''three''' of his records along the way. In which he says "One lurks over the machinery threaded through the caldera of a volcano, another lies within a nestled spot of nature within a frozen waste, and the final record can be found in a land lost to time, yet familiar all the same." Which can be deducted as the [[Saramaed Summit]]"The machinery threaded through the caldera of a volcano," can be assumed to be the [[Saramaed Summit]] of [[The Ignition Union]], due to the volcanic and mechanical nature of the place., [[Minityrsa]]"A nestled spot of nature within a frozen waste," can be assumed to be the [[Minityrsa]] of [[The Ministry]], due to the hail they receive all year round and the nature befitting to be called a desolate wasteland., and [[Erisia]]"A land lost to time, yet familiar all the same," refers to the fact that [[Erisia]] has been floating in and out of the [[Voidsea]] for years. The "familiar all the same," is more ambiguous; it may refer to player familiarity due to it being a well known location that most players have visited, the fact that it was not always a Driftland or the influence of the Voidsea forcibly implanting memories into the heads of visitors, as with [[Erisor's Church]]., respectively. === Dialogue === |-|First Encounter= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" |- | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |'''''If you haven't beaten The Ferryman'''''

'''''If you have beaten The Ferryman'''''
Ah, welcome, [Name]! Care for a drink on the house? |- | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |2. What made you start up a tavern? | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |1. Sure. |- | colspan="6" |Well, I needed a venue to show off my superior collection of music, didn't I? Only... Ah. I managed to misplace '''three records''' from my vinyl collection while setting up the gateways here... | colspan="3" |'''''No drinks in inventory''''' | colspan="3" |'''''Already holding a drink''''' |- | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Maybe I can look around? | colspan="3" |Of course, I have just the drink for you!

I've got an old set of instruments I've been meaning to get rid of for you if you do. | colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |- | colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} |Where can I find the records? |- | colspan="6" |One lurks over the machinery threaded through the caldera of a volcano, another lies within a nestled spot of nature within a frozen waste, and the final record can be found in a land lost to time, yet familiar all the same. |- | colspan="6" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} |-|Subsequent Encounters= {| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" |- | colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} |Begin Dialogue |- | colspan="12" |'''''If none collected'''''

(Gives Redd Juice) | colspan="6" |Hah! Finish what you have already. |- | colspan="12" {{cl|end}} |[End Dialogue] |} == Gallery == YesterDoor.png|A Tavern Entrance Door YesterExit.png|A door within the Tavern '''View of inside the tavern''' Yesterwynde_tavern1.png|Front view from inside the Tavern Yesterwynde_tavern2.png|Back view from inside the Tavern Yesterwynde_tavern3.png|View from above ==Music Tracks== Below you can find the sound tracks that play in the tavern
==Trivia== * The Ferryman will not give any Redd Juice if you have Redd Juice in your inventory, even if it was obtained prior to the event. * When approaching each record, they will play their respective song. Make sure your music volume is up! * The Yesterwynde Tavern will play Nightwish songs, indicating which song is playing on the left of the screen. * This confirms that [[The Ferryman]] has access to vinyl records, means to play them, and is a fan of metal. * Every tavern door leads to the same instance of the Yesterwynde Tavern, meaning it can get quite overpopulated and dangerous. You can always exit by walking up to the tavern doors again. ==Footnotes== {{nav|events}} [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Events]]

LHT: 5, FIR: 4 (Dagger) |posture damage=5 |range=8 |range type=Sweep |swing speed=0.93x |attack duration=0.8s |endlag=0.1s |penetration=15% |obtainment=Chests From: *{{lp|Aratel}} *[[Primadon, Titan of the East]] *[[Elder Primadon, The Titan Warlord]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Weird Trader]] |selling price=105 |m.equip=No |enchantable=No |rarity=Mythical |oath=Silentheart |special effect=The 2nd M1 and the crouching and sliding criticals scale on Light Weapon invest instead of Heavy Weapon. These attacks have 5 LHT scaling. |description=A pair of blades once used by a High Curator of [[the Hive]]. Said to be crafted by the 2nd Greatlord as a Gift to the 3rd, though due to their pacifism it collected dust until acquired by [[Ysley]]. Burns brightly with the Fire of Life. Attacks with its dagger offhand scale with LHT. |image= Ysley's Pyre Keeper.png|Base Ysley's Pyre Keeper Azure Flames.png|Azure Flames Ysley's Pyre Keeper Lava Serpent.png|Lava Serpent Ysley's Pyre Keeper Twisted Puppets.png|Twisted Puppets |stances=1H}} == Description == '''Ysley's Pyre Keeper,''' or "Callow & Verdant" is a legendary [[Weapons|Greatsword]]; a thorned chassis opening to a serrated green blade that breathes bright green flames, wielded alongside a curved, serrated dagger. It scales off [[Flamecharm]] and Heavy, but attacks that utilize the dagger scale with Light Weapon instead. The Pyre Keeper comes with the following passives: * '''Lifelord's Blaze:''' M1 attacks spawn green-yellowish flames on hit. This has a 4 second cooldown before it can proc green flames again. * '''Dual Scaling M1s:''' M1 or critical attacks that swing with the dagger scale off light weapon rather then heavy. As suggested by its item description, this blade was used by Ysley after it was crafted by a Greatlord of the Hive using the Flames of Life. The lore implications of this distinctive appearance may be written off by some, as its appearance may change color depending on the Azure Flame/Twisted Puppets/Eruption path chosen by its user, though it is important to remember that its appearance could not be altered upon release. ==Criticals== File:PyreBasic.gif|Standard File:PyreRunningCrit(PlusUppercut).gif|Running File:Pyrerunning2.gif|Running + Follow-up File:Pyrecritfart.gif|Aerial File:PyreKeeperCrouchingCrit.gif|Crouching File:PyreSliding.gif|Sliding Ysley's Pyre Keeper has five different criticals: Normal, Aerial, Crouching, Running, and Sliding. For the '''standing''' critical, the user performs a slow slash followed by two faster slashes. This critical gives a speed boost for a small duration. For the '''running''' critical, the user rushes towards the target with both blades behind them. Upon hitting a target. they will be knocked down and diagonally split by the user. The critical cooldown will be cleared upon use, allowing to follow up into a slash that counts as an uppercut. For the '''aerial''' critical, the user raises the greatsword into the air and chops the opponent downwards, guardbreaking them. This is followed up by an explosion that ragdolls and dazes the opponent. For the '''crouching''' critical, the user performs a swift slash before flipping into a lighter slash. This critical gives a slight speed boost for a small duration. For the '''sliding critical''', the user flips forward, while constantly slicing for the direction they traveled. All criticals have a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''. {{text|m1leg2}} == Gallery == File:YPKRedesignConceptArt.png|Redesign concept art File:PyreM1Fixed.gif|M1 cycle === Old version === File:YPKconceptart.png|Concept art File:Ysley's Pyre Keeper Old.png|Old version File:YPKazure.png|Azure Flames File:YPKTwistedPuppets.png|Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets == Trivia == *The weapon is a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Farron Greatsword|Farron Greatsword]] from ''Dark Souls III'', an arsenal consisting of a large greatsword and an accompanying dagger to use as a pivot. Its fire-infused state is a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Abyss Watchers|Abyss Watchers]] who, as Lords of Cinder, imbue their form and weapon with fire in the second phase of their fight. *This weapon is currently the only thing in the game to change colors if the user has Eruption Path: Lava Serpent. *This weapon was originally hidden from testers, explaining how strong it was on release. *It was formerly the only Elemental weapon to not require 75 of the element. With a requirement of 65 HVY, 50 FLM, and 15 LHT, its total required investment was the third highest of any weapon; 5 points behind the [[Ignition Deepcrusher]] at the time, and 30 points behind the [[Hivelord's Hubris]]. **This was changed to require 25 HVY; 10 LHT; 75 FIR on the patch the day after the legendary was added to the game. *The M1s used to have the same animations as the [[Wyrmtooth]] and [[Railblade]], but this was changed on April 19, 2024. *You cannot use running critical attacks at [[The Interstice]], instead you will proc the air critical attacks. Probably a bug or it was just because [[The Interstice]] is a place that was above the Voidsea. *It has the most amount of critical attack variations (Six, one for nearly every possible character state). *The sliding critical slashes don't match the animations. **Three circular slashes somehow appear from the dagger in the singular 360˚ front flip despite the dagger not being moved more than the rest of the body. *Quite powerful with the {{t|Switchblade}} talent, due to overlapping investment points. {{History}} {{Nav|Weapons}} [[Category:Greatswords]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Attunement-based Weapons]] [[Category:Legendary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons with Unique Animations]] [[Category:Weapons with Multi-Hit Criticals]] [[Category:Multi-Weapon Scaling]] [[Category:Heavy Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with multiple Criticals]] [[Category:Weapons of The Hive]]

{{quotes|quote=TELL ME, OH CHILD OF WANT, WHAT IS YOUR DESIRE?|author=Shrine of Yun'Shul}}
::''This is a page about the Drowned God. For their shrine that grants wishes, see [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts]].''

== Overview ==
'''Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts''' is a [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Drowned_Gods Drowned God] within the world of ''Deepwoken.'' It is unknown what property they are the Drowned God of, but it is often speculated that it is of wishes, [[Resonance]]s, or souls.

As with all the other known Drowned Gods, they are one of the strongest non-gag beings, while simultaneously operating on a scale, one both physical and moral, different to humanity.

Notably, [[Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts|the avatar]] that appears behind the Resonance Door in Scyphozia is not actually Yun'Shul, but rather a shrine used by humans to communicate with them safely. Additionally, while the [[Deep Shrines]] that appear in their temple are not confirmed to be theirs, the similar mannerisms and appearance suggest they are indeed connected.
== Trivia ==
*While often attributed to them by the community, Yun'Shul is not the cause of [[Insanity]], rather it's the First Layer's status of an Eldritch Location that does not obey the laws of physics. This is why the Second Layer does not cause insanity, as, despite its variety of Monsters, it's more grounded in reality.
* The [[Enchantments|Enchantment]] Curse of Yun'Shul is named after them.
* If attempting to reach [[Fragments of Self]] without proper means a text box from Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts is to appear saying, "INCONIEVABLE".
